// Put the implementation in a struct so we don't pollute the top-level namespace
fileprivate struct UniffiCallbackInterfaceCredentialSave {

    // Create the VTable using a series of closures.
    // Swift automatically converts these into C callback functions.
    //
    // Store the vtable directly.
    static let vtable: UniffiVTableCallbackInterfaceCredentialSave = UniffiVTableCallbackInterfaceCredentialSave(
        uniffiFree: { (uniffiHandle: UInt64) -> () in
            do {
                try FfiConverterTypeCredentialSave.handleMap.remove(handle: uniffiHandle)
            } catch {
                print("Uniffi callback interface CredentialSave: handle missing in uniffiFree")
            }
        },
        uniffiClone: { (uniffiHandle: UInt64) -> UInt64 in
            do {
                return try FfiConverterTypeCredentialSave.handleMap.clone(handle: uniffiHandle)
            } catch {
                fatalError("Uniffi callback interface CredentialSave: handle missing in uniffiClone")
            }
        },
        save: { (
            uniffiHandle: UInt64,
            uniffiOutReturn: UnsafeMutableRawPointer,
            uniffiCallStatus: UnsafeMutablePointer<RustCallStatus>
        ) in
            let makeCall = {
                () throws -> () in
                guard let uniffiObj = try? FfiConverterTypeCredentialSave.handleMap.get(handle: uniffiHandle) else {
                    throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedStaleHandle
                }
                return uniffiObj.save(
                )
            }

            
            let writeReturn = { () }
            uniffiTraitInterfaceCall(
                callStatus: uniffiCallStatus,
                makeCall: makeCall,
                writeReturn: writeReturn
            )
        }
    )

    // Rust stores this pointer for future callback invocations, so it must live
    // for the process lifetime (not just for the init function call).
    //
    // `nonisolated(unsafe)` is needed under Swift 6 strict concurrency.
    // This is safe because the pointee is initialized once during static init
    // and never mutated by either side of the FFI.  Its fields are C function pointers.
    nonisolated(unsafe) static let vtablePtr: UnsafePointer<UniffiVTableCallbackInterfaceCredentialSave> = {
        let ptr = UnsafeMutablePointer<UniffiVTableCallbackInterfaceCredentialSave>.allocate(capacity: 1)
        ptr.initialize(to: vtable)
        return UnsafePointer(ptr)
    }()
}

private func uniffiCallbackInitCredentialSave() {
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_init_callback_vtable_credentialsave(UniffiCallbackInterfaceCredentialSave.vtablePtr)
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeCredentialSave: FfiConverter {
    fileprivate static let handleMap = UniffiHandleMap<CredentialSave>()

    typealias FfiType = UInt64
    typealias SwiftType = CredentialSave

    public static func lift(_ handle: UInt64) throws -> CredentialSave {
        if ((handle & 1) == 0) {
            // Rust-generated handle, construct a new class that uses the handle to implement the
            // interface
            return CredentialSaveImpl(unsafeFromHandle: handle)
        } else {
            // Swift-generated handle, get the object from the handle map
            return try handleMap.remove(handle: handle)
        }
    }

    public static func lower(_ value: CredentialSave) -> UInt64 {
         if let rustImpl = value as? CredentialSaveImpl {
             // Rust-implemented object.  Clone the handle and return it
            return rustImpl.uniffiCloneHandle()
         } else {
            // Swift object, generate a new vtable handle and return that.
            return handleMap.insert(obj: value)
         }
    }

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> CredentialSave {
        let handle: UInt64 = try readInt(&buf)
        return try lift(handle)
    }

    public static func write(_ value: CredentialSave, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        writeInt(&buf, lower(value))
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeCredentialSave_lift(_ handle: UInt64) throws -> CredentialSave {
    return try FfiConverterTypeCredentialSave.lift(handle)
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeCredentialSave_lower(_ value: CredentialSave) -> UInt64 {
    return FfiConverterTypeCredentialSave.lower(value)
}






/**
 * The process's download queue.
 */
public protocol DownloadsProtocol: AnyObject, Sendable {
    
    /**
     * Waits for a revision newer than `after`.
     */
    func changed(after: UInt64) async  -> DownloadQueueState
    
    /**
     * Moves the waiting Transfer first. The one under way goes on.
     */
    func moveToTop(id: UInt64) 
    
    /**
     * Pauses the Transfer: the running one stops and waits first.
     */
    func pause(id: UInt64) 
    
    /**
     * Takes the Transfer out of the queue, stopping it when it runs.
     */
    func remove(id: UInt64) 
    
    func resume(id: UInt64) 
    
    func state()  -> DownloadQueueState
    
}
/**
 * The process's download queue.
 */
open class Downloads: DownloadsProtocol, @unchecked Sendable {
    fileprivate let handle: UInt64

    /// Used to instantiate a [FFIObject] without an actual handle, for fakes in tests, mostly.
#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    public struct NoHandle {
        public init() {}
    }

    // TODO: We'd like this to be `private` but for Swifty reasons,
    // we can't implement `FfiConverter` without making this `required` and we can't
    // make it `required` without making it `public`.
#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    required public init(unsafeFromHandle handle: UInt64) {
        self.handle = handle
    }

    // This constructor can be used to instantiate a fake object.
    // - Parameter noHandle: Placeholder value so we can have a constructor separate from the default empty one that may be implemented for classes extending [FFIObject].
    //
    // - Warning:
    //     Any object instantiated with this constructor cannot be passed to an actual Rust-backed object. Since there isn't a backing handle the FFI lower functions will crash.
#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    public init(noHandle: NoHandle) {
        self.handle = 0
    }

#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    public func uniffiCloneHandle() -> UInt64 {
        return try! rustCall { uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_clone_downloads(self.handle, $0) }
    }
public convenience init() {
    let handle =
        try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_constructor_downloads_new(uniffiCallStatus
    )
}
    self.init(unsafeFromHandle: handle)
}

    deinit {
        if handle == 0 {
            // Mock objects have handle=0 don't try to free them
            return
        }

        try! rustCall { uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_free_downloads(handle, $0) }
    }

    

    
    /**
     * Waits for a revision newer than `after`.
     */
open func changed(after: UInt64)async  -> DownloadQueueState  {
    return
        try!  await uniffiRustCallAsync(
            rustFutureFunc: {
                uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_downloads_changed(
                        self.uniffiCloneHandle(),FfiConverterUInt64.lower(after)
                )
            },
            pollFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_poll_rust_buffer,
            completeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_complete_rust_buffer,
            freeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_free_rust_buffer,
            liftFunc: FfiConverterTypeDownloadQueueState_lift,
            errorHandler: nil
            
        )
}
    
    /**
     * Moves the waiting Transfer first. The one under way goes on.
     */
open func moveToTop(id: UInt64)  {try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_downloads_move_to_top(
            self.uniffiCloneHandle(),
        FfiConverterUInt64.lower(id),uniffiCallStatus
    )
}
}
    
    /**
     * Pauses the Transfer: the running one stops and waits first.
     */
open func pause(id: UInt64)  {try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_downloads_pause(
            self.uniffiCloneHandle(),
        FfiConverterUInt64.lower(id),uniffiCallStatus
    )
}
}
    
    /**
     * Takes the Transfer out of the queue, stopping it when it runs.
     */
open func remove(id: UInt64)  {try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_downloads_remove(
            self.uniffiCloneHandle(),
        FfiConverterUInt64.lower(id),uniffiCallStatus
    )
}
}
    
open func resume(id: UInt64)  {try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_downloads_resume(
            self.uniffiCloneHandle(),
        FfiConverterUInt64.lower(id),uniffiCallStatus
    )
}
}
    
open func state() -> DownloadQueueState  {
    return try!  FfiConverterTypeDownloadQueueState_lift(try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_downloads_state(
            self.uniffiCloneHandle(),uniffiCallStatus
    )
})
}
    

    
}

#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeDownloads: FfiConverter {
    typealias FfiType = UInt64
    typealias SwiftType = Downloads

    public static func lift(_ handle: UInt64) throws -> Downloads {
        return Downloads(unsafeFromHandle: handle)
    }

    public static func lower(_ value: Downloads) -> UInt64 {
        return value.uniffiCloneHandle()
    }

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> Downloads {
        let handle: UInt64 = try readInt(&buf)
        return try lift(handle)
    }

    public static func write(_ value: Downloads, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        writeInt(&buf, lower(value))
    }
}

    return try FfiConverterTypeDownloads.lift(handle)
}

@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeDownloads_lower(_ value: Downloads) -> UInt64 {
    return FfiConverterTypeDownloads.lower(value)
}






public protocol EpicSessionProtocol: AnyObject, Sendable {
    
    /**
     * The share of each of `namespaces`' achievements the account unlocked,
     * by namespace, as `achievements` reads them: none for a sandbox without
     * achievements or that Epic did not answer for. It fails only when no
     * sandbox could be told.
     */
    func achievementShares(namespaces: [String], locale: String) async throws  -> [String: Double]
    
    /**
     * The game's achievements in `locale`, such as the game page's: the
     * library's while the game was not played since they were read, unless
     * `fresh`, else Epic's, which the library then keeps. Epic tells them by
     * sandbox, which several games may share.
     */
    func achievements(namespace: String, locale: String, fresh: Bool) async throws  -> [LibraryAchievement]
    
    func credentials() async throws  -> EpicCredentials
    
    func disconnect() async throws 
    
    func gameDetails(namespace: String, catalogItemId: String, appName: String) async throws  -> EpicGameDetails
    
    func games() async throws  -> [EpicGame]
    
    func nextCredentialsRevision(afterRevision: UInt64) async  -> UInt64?
    
    func nextFriends(afterRevision: UInt64) async  -> EpicFriendsSnapshot
    
    /**
     * Saves the account's credentials through `credentials` now and after
     * every rotation, one save at a time and in order, until the session's
     * observers stop. Every account call relies on it.
     */
    func persist(credentials: CredentialSave) async 
    
    /**
     * Every game the account played, in one request.
     */
    func playtimes() async throws  -> [EpicPlaytime]
    
    func reconnectFriends() async 
    
    func shutdownObservers() 
    
    func startFriends() async 
    
    func stopFriends() 
    
    /**
     * Opens Epic's site signed in as the account, then `redirect_url`, an
     * Epic page. The address holds a single-use code: never keep or log it.
     */
    func webSignInUrl(redirectUrl: String) async throws  -> String
    
}

/**
 * Obelisk's games folder.
 */
public protocol GamesFolderProtocol: AnyObject, Sendable {
    
    /**
     * Waits for a revision newer than `after`.
     */
    func changed(after: UInt64) async  -> GamesFolderState
    
    /**
     * Makes the games folder `chosen` gives the one new installations go
     * to, and queues the move of every installation into it.
     */
    func choose(chosen: String) throws 
    
    /**
     * Makes Obelisk's own folder the games folder again, and queues the
     * move of every installation into it.
     */
    func chooseDefault() throws 
    
    /**
     * Queues the move of the installations still outside the games folder.
     */
    func gather() 
    
    /**
     * What choosing `chosen` would do. It blocks on file reads.
     */
    func inspect(chosen: String)  -> GamesFolderInspection
    
    /**
     * What making Obelisk's own folder the games folder again would do. It
     * makes that folder, and blocks on file reads.
     */
    func inspectDefault()  -> GamesFolderInspection
    
    func state()  -> GamesFolderState
    
    /**
     * A disk came or left.
     */
    func volumesChanged() 
    
}
/**
 * Obelisk's games folder.
 */
open class GamesFolder: GamesFolderProtocol, @unchecked Sendable {
    fileprivate let handle: UInt64

    /// Used to instantiate a [FFIObject] without an actual handle, for fakes in tests, mostly.
#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    public struct NoHandle {
        public init() {}
    }

    // TODO: We'd like this to be `private` but for Swifty reasons,
    // we can't implement `FfiConverter` without making this `required` and we can't
    // make it `required` without making it `public`.
#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    required public init(unsafeFromHandle handle: UInt64) {
        self.handle = handle
    }

    // This constructor can be used to instantiate a fake object.
    // - Parameter noHandle: Placeholder value so we can have a constructor separate from the default empty one that may be implemented for classes extending [FFIObject].
    //
    // - Warning:
    //     Any object instantiated with this constructor cannot be passed to an actual Rust-backed object. Since there isn't a backing handle the FFI lower functions will crash.
#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    public init(noHandle: NoHandle) {
        self.handle = 0
    }

#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    public func uniffiCloneHandle() -> UInt64 {
        return try! rustCall { uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_clone_gamesfolder(self.handle, $0) }
    }
    /**
     * The games folder of the Obelisk whose library is `library`.
     */
public convenience init(library: String) {
    let handle =
        try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_constructor_gamesfolder_new(
        FfiConverterString.lower(library),uniffiCallStatus
    )
}
    self.init(unsafeFromHandle: handle)
}

    deinit {
        if handle == 0 {
            // Mock objects have handle=0 don't try to free them
            return
        }

        try! rustCall { uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_free_gamesfolder(handle, $0) }
    }

    

    
    /**
     * Waits for a revision newer than `after`.
     */
open func changed(after: UInt64)async  -> GamesFolderState  {
    return
        try!  await uniffiRustCallAsync(
            rustFutureFunc: {
                uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_gamesfolder_changed(
                        self.uniffiCloneHandle(),FfiConverterUInt64.lower(after)
                )
            },
            pollFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_poll_rust_buffer,
            completeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_complete_rust_buffer,
            freeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_free_rust_buffer,
            liftFunc: FfiConverterTypeGamesFolderState_lift,
            errorHandler: nil
            
        )
}
    
    /**
     * Makes the games folder `chosen` gives the one new installations go
     * to, and queues the move of every installation into it.
     */
open func choose(chosen: String)throws   {try rustCallWithError(FfiConverterTypeGameSessionError_lift) {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_gamesfolder_choose(
            self.uniffiCloneHandle(),
        FfiConverterString.lower(chosen),uniffiCallStatus
    )
}
}
    
    /**
     * Makes Obelisk's own folder the games folder again, and queues the
     * move of every installation into it.
     */

public protocol GogSessionProtocol: AnyObject, Sendable {
    
    /**
     * The share of each of `product_ids`' achievements the account unlocked,
     * by product, as `achievements` reads them: none for a game without
     * achievements or that GOG did not answer for. It fails only when no
     * game could be told.
     */
    func achievementShares(productIds: [String], locale: String) async throws  -> [String: Double]
    
    /**
     * The game's achievements in `locale`, such as `fr-FR`, as the game
     * page reads them: the library's while the game was not played since
     * they were read, unless `fresh`, else GOG's, which the library then
     * keeps.
     */
    func achievements(productId: String, locale: String, fresh: Bool) async throws  -> [LibraryAchievement]
    
    /**
     * The account's avatar, as its GOG profile shows it.
     */
    func avatarUrl()  -> String?
    
    func credentials() async throws  -> GogCredentials
    
    func disconnect() async throws 
    
    /**
     * `language` names the depots, such as `fr-FR`.
     */
    func gameDetails(productId: String, language: String) async throws  -> GogGameDetails
    
    func games() async throws  -> [GogGame]
    
    func nextCredentialsRevision(afterRevision: UInt64) async  -> UInt64?
    
    /**
     * Saves the account's credentials through `credentials` now and after
     * every rotation, one save at a time and in order, until the session's
     * observers stop. Every account call relies on it.
     */
    func persist(credentials: CredentialSave) async 
    
    /**
     * How long the account played each of `product_ids`; a game never
     * played has no entry. GOG answers one game at a time.
     */
    func playtimes(productIds: [String]) async throws  -> [GogPlaytime]
    
    func shutdownObservers() 
    
}
open class GogSession: GogSessionProtocol, @unchecked Sendable {
    fileprivate let handle: UInt64

#endif

        public init() {}
    }

    // make it `required` without making it `public`.

/**
 * The last library of every storefront account, in the library directory.
 */
public protocol LibraryCacheProtocol: AnyObject, Sendable {
    
    /**
     * The account's last Epic library, empty when it has none.
     */
    func epicLibrary(accountId: String)  -> [CachedEpicGame]
    
    /**
     * Writes the last change now, as Obelisk quits.
     */
    func flush() 
    
    /**
     * Removes the account's library and its launches, as signing it out
     * does. Its session can no longer write it.
     */
    func forget(account: GameAccount) 
    
    /**
     * The account's last GOG library, empty when it has none.
     */
    func gogLibrary(userId: String)  -> [CachedGogGame]
    
    /**
     * Every launch the cache keeps, for every storefront and account.
     */
    func launches()  -> [GameLaunch]
    
    /**
     * Records a launch in its game's entry. A game whose library was never
     * kept has no entry to keep it.
     */
    func recordLaunch(launch: GameLaunch) 
    
    /**
     * The account's last Steam library, empty when it has none, with each
     * game's artwork in `language` and what the library orders by.
     */
    func steamLibrary(steamId: UInt64, language: String)  -> [CachedSteamGame]
    
}
/**
 * The last library of every storefront account, in the library directory.
 */

    //

     */

    return try!  FfiConverterSequenceTypeCachedEpicGame.lift(try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in

}
    
    /**
     * Writes the last change now, as Obelisk quits.
     */
open func flush()  {try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_librarycache_flush(
            self.uniffiCloneHandle(),uniffiCallStatus
    )
}
}
    
    /**
     * Removes the account's library and its launches, as signing it out
     * does. Its session can no longer write it.
     */
open func forget(account: GameAccount)  {try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_librarycache_forget(
            self.uniffiCloneHandle(),
        FfiConverterTypeGameAccount_lower(account),uniffiCallStatus
    )
}
}
    
    /**
     * The account's last GOG library, empty when it has none.
     */
open func gogLibrary(userId: String) -> [CachedGogGame]  {
    return try!  FfiConverterSequenceTypeCachedGogGame.lift(try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_librarycache_gog_library(
            self.uniffiCloneHandle(),
        FfiConverterString.lower(userId),uniffiCallStatus
    )
})
}
    
    /**
     * Every launch the cache keeps, for every storefront and account.
     */
open func launches() -> [GameLaunch]  {
    return try!  FfiConverterSequenceTypeGameLaunch.lift(try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_librarycache_launches(
            self.uniffiCloneHandle(),uniffiCallStatus
    )
})
}
    
    /**
     * Records a launch in its game's entry. A game whose library was never
     * kept has no entry to keep it.
     */
open func recordLaunch(launch: GameLaunch)  {try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_librarycache_record_launch(
            self.uniffiCloneHandle(),
        FfiConverterTypeGameLaunch_lower(launch),uniffiCallStatus
    )
}
}
    
    /**
     * The account's last Steam library, empty when it has none, with each
     * game's artwork in `language` and what the library orders by.
     */
open func steamLibrary(steamId: UInt64, language: String) -> [CachedSteamGame]  {
    return try!  FfiConverterSequenceTypeCachedSteamGame.lift(try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_librarycache_steam_library(
            self.uniffiCloneHandle(),
        FfiConverterUInt64.lower(steamId),
        FfiConverterString.lower(language),uniffiCallStatus
    )
})
}
    

    
}

    typealias SwiftType = LibraryCache

    public static func lift(_ handle: UInt64) throws -> LibraryCache {
        return LibraryCache(unsafeFromHandle: handle)
    }

    public static func lower(_ value: LibraryCache) -> UInt64 {
        return value.uniffiCloneHandle()
    }

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> LibraryCache {
        let handle: UInt64 = try readInt(&buf)
        return try lift(handle)
    }

    public static func write(_ value: LibraryCache, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        writeInt(&buf, lower(value))
    }
}

/**
 * Debug-only controlled chat and own-game sources. They use the production
 * decoders and observation, letting macOS tests drive both streams.
 */
public protocol SteamChatFixtureProtocol: AnyObject, Sendable {
    
    /**
     * A connect invitation into `app_id`, its header's routing AppID.
     */
    func connectInvite(friendSteamId: UInt64, appId: UInt32, connect: String) 
    
    func disconnect() 
    
    /**
     * A friend's chat message, as Steam writes it for an invitation too.
     */
    func incomingInvitation(friendSteamId: UInt64, message: String, timestamp: UInt32, ordinal: UInt32) 
    
    func incomingMessage(friendSteamId: UInt64, message: String, timestamp: UInt32, ordinal: UInt32, fromMe: Bool) 
    
    /**
     * A lobby invitation, as Steam sends it apart from the chat.
     */
    func lobbyInvite(friendSteamId: UInt64, lobbyId: UInt64, appId: UInt32) 
    
    func nextChat(afterSequence: UInt64) async  -> SteamChatEvents
    
    func nextInvites(afterRevision: UInt64) async  -> SteamReceivedInvites
    
    func nextOwnGame(afterRevision: UInt64) async  -> SteamOwnGame
    
    /**
     * The account playing `app_id` (0 for none), with an optional lobby and
     * rich presence `connect` string.
     */
    func ownGame(appId: UInt32, lobbyId: UInt64, connect: String?) 
    
    func readElsewhere(friendSteamId: UInt64, timestamp: UInt32) 
    
    func typing(friendSteamId: UInt64) 
    
}

/**
 * Debug-only controlled Account session. Its friends go through the
 * production reducer and its states through the production conversion,
 * letting macOS tests exercise raw packets and reconnections across UniFFI.
 */
public protocol SteamFriendsFixtureProtocol: AnyObject, Sendable {
    
    /**
     * The session is shut down.
     */
    func close() 
    
    /**
     * The CM connection drops and the session connects again, or Steam
     * asks the account to sign in again.
     */
    func disconnect(authenticationRequired: Bool) 
    
    /**
     * Steam pushes `friend_steam_id` playing `app_id` (0 for none), in a
     * lobby and with a rich presence `connect` string when given.
     */
    func friendPlaying(friendSteamId: UInt64, appId: UInt32, lobbyId: UInt64, connect: String?) 
    
    func nextFriends(afterRevision: UInt64) async  -> SteamFriendsSnapshot
    
    /**
     * The CM connection of the moment receives a packet.
     */
    func receive(kind: UInt32, body: Data) 
    
    /**
     * A new CM connection replaces the one that dropped, its friends still
     * loading.
     */
    func reconnect() 
    
    /**
     * The player's retry, or the Mac's wake: the session connects again,
     * unless its account must sign in again or it closed.
     */
    func retry() 
    
    /**
     * Every attempt to connect again failed.
     */
    func unreachable() 
    
}

}
    
    /**
     * Every attempt to connect again failed.
     */

        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_steamfriendsfixture_unreachable(
            self.uniffiCloneHandle(),uniffiCallStatus
    )
}
}

public protocol SteamLoginProtocol: AnyObject, Sendable {
    
    func challenge() async  -> SteamChallenge
    
    func poll() async throws  -> SteamCredentials?
    
    func submitGuard(code: String, kind: SteamGuardKind) async throws 
    
}
open class SteamLogin: SteamLoginProtocol, @unchecked Sendable {
    fileprivate let handle: UInt64

    /// Used to instantiate a [FFIObject] without an actual handle, for fakes in tests, mostly.
#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    public struct NoHandle {
        public init() {}
    }

    // TODO: We'd like this to be `private` but for Swifty reasons,
    // we can't implement `FfiConverter` without making this `required` and we can't
    // make it `required` without making it `public`.
#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    required public init(unsafeFromHandle handle: UInt64) {
        self.handle = handle
    }

    // This constructor can be used to instantiate a fake object.
    // - Parameter noHandle: Placeholder value so we can have a constructor separate from the default empty one that may be implemented for classes extending [FFIObject].
    //
    // - Warning:
    //     Any object instantiated with this constructor cannot be passed to an actual Rust-backed object. Since there isn't a backing handle the FFI lower functions will crash.
#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    public init(noHandle: NoHandle) {
        self.handle = 0
    }

#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    public func uniffiCloneHandle() -> UInt64 {
        return try! rustCall { uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_clone_steamlogin(self.handle, $0) }
    }
    // No primary constructor declared for this class.

    deinit {
        if handle == 0 {
            // Mock objects have handle=0 don't try to free them
            return
        }

        try! rustCall { uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_free_steamlogin(handle, $0) }
    }

    
public static func beginCredentials(accountName: String, password: String)async throws  -> SteamLogin  {
    return
        try  await uniffiRustCallAsync(
            rustFutureFunc: {
                uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_constructor_steamlogin_begin_credentials(FfiConverterString.lower(accountName),FfiConverterString.lower(password)
                )
            },

            completeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_complete_u64,
            freeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_free_u64,
            liftFunc: FfiConverterTypeSteamLogin_lift,
            errorHandler: FfiConverterTypeSteamError_lift
        )
}

    return
        try  await uniffiRustCallAsync(
            rustFutureFunc: {
                uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_constructor_steamlogin_begin_qr(
                )
            },
            pollFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_poll_u64,
            completeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_complete_u64,
            freeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_free_u64,
            liftFunc: FfiConverterTypeSteamLogin_lift,
            errorHandler: FfiConverterTypeSteamError_lift
        )
}
    

    
open func challenge()async  -> SteamChallenge  {
    return
        try!  await uniffiRustCallAsync(
            rustFutureFunc: {
                uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_steamlogin_challenge(
                        self.uniffiCloneHandle()
                )
            },
            pollFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_poll_rust_buffer,
            completeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_complete_rust_buffer,
            freeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_free_rust_buffer,

            errorHandler: nil
            
        )
}

    return
        try  await uniffiRustCallAsync(
            rustFutureFunc: {

                        self.uniffiCloneHandle()
                )
            },

            completeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_complete_rust_buffer,

            errorHandler: FfiConverterTypeSteamError_lift
        )
}
    
open func submitGuard(code: String, kind: SteamGuardKind)async throws   {
    return
        try  await uniffiRustCallAsync(
            rustFutureFunc: {
                uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_steamlogin_submit_guard(

                )
            },
            pollFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_poll_void,
            completeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_complete_void,

            errorHandler: FfiConverterTypeSteamError_lift
        )

public protocol SteamSessionProtocol: AnyObject, Sendable {
    
    /**
     * The share of each of `app_ids`' achievements the account unlocked, by
     * app ID, as `achievements` reads them: none for a game without
     * achievements or that Steam did not answer for. It fails only when no
     * game could be told.
     */
    func achievementShares(appIds: [UInt32], language: String) async throws  -> [UInt32: Double]
    
    /**
     * The game's achievements in `language`, such as the game page's: the
     * library's while the game was not played since they were read, unless
     * `fresh`, else Steam's, which the library then keeps.
     */
    func achievements(appId: UInt32, language: String, fresh: Bool) async throws  -> [LibraryAchievement]
    
    /**
     * When the account got each game its licenses grant, in seconds since
     * the Unix epoch, by app ID. It expands every license through PICS.
     */
    func acquisitions() async throws  -> [UInt32: UInt64]
    
    func cloudAutocloudMetadata() async throws  -> String
    
    /**
     * Explicit diagnostic operation using this already-authenticated session.
     * It downloads a verified backup; no Cloud mutation or game launch occurs.
     */
    func cloudBackup(appId: UInt32, directory: String) async throws  -> String
    
    func cloudInterruptionProbe(appId: UInt32, directory: String) async throws  -> String
    
    /**
     * Returns only Cloud preferences and source revision, never roaming data.
     */
    func cloudPreferences(appId: UInt32) async throws  -> String
    
    func cloudSdkCandidates() async throws  -> String
    
    func cloudTransferProbe(appId: UInt32, directory: String) async throws  -> String
    
    func details(appId: UInt32, language: String) async throws  -> SteamGameDetails
    
    func games() async throws  -> [SteamGame]
    
    /**
     * The session's state after `after_revision`: its friends and how it
     * stands with Steam, across its CM connections. No content-query mutex
     * is held.
     */
    func nextFriends(afterRevision: UInt64) async  -> SteamFriendsSnapshot
    
    /**
     * Declared application platforms in batches; an empty platform list means
     * unknown. Each game's library artwork comes with them, in `language`.
     */
    func platforms(appIds: [UInt32], language: String) async throws  -> [SteamGamePlatforms]
    
    func profile() async throws  -> SteamProfile
    
    /**
     * Replaces the CM connection, live or not, and connects again, as on the
     * player's retry or the Mac's wake. Nothing once Steam asked the account
     * to sign in again.
     */
    func reconnect() 
    
    /**
     * Stops reconnecting and ends the CM connection. Also wakes UniFFI
     * futures, whose Swift wrappers do not cancel Rust awaits.
     */
    func shutdown() 
    
    /**
     * Cookies that sign Steam's sites in as this session's account.
     */
    func webCookies() async throws  -> [SteamWebCookie]
    
    /**
     * Marks the conversation read up to `timestamp` in every session.
     */
    func ack(friendSteamId: UInt64, timestamp: UInt32) async throws 
    
    func activeSessions() async throws  -> [SteamChatSession]
    
    /**
     * Invites into `invite`, which the account's running game of `app_id`
     * reported itself. Fails with `backend.steam.invite.unavailable` for an
     * invitation Steam cannot carry or while the account plays another game.
     */
    func inviteIntoGame(friendSteamId: UInt64, appId: UInt32, invite: SteamGameInvite) async throws 
    
    /**
     * Fails with `backend.steam.invite.unavailable` unless the account plays
     * `app_id` and that game can take an invitation now.
     */
    func inviteToGame(friendSteamId: UInt64, appId: UInt32) async throws 
    
    /**
     * Suspends until chat events follow `after_sequence` or the session ends.
     */
    func nextChat(afterSequence: UInt64) async  -> SteamChatEvents
    
    /**
     * Suspends until the invitations friends sent change or the session ends.
     */
    func nextInvites(afterRevision: UInt64) async  -> SteamReceivedInvites
    
    /**
     * Suspends until the own game's revision differs or the session ends.
     */
    func nextOwnGame(afterRevision: UInt64) async  -> SteamOwnGame
    
    /**
     * Up to `count` (at most 50) messages before `before`, or the latest ones.
     */
    func recentMessages(friendSteamId: UInt64, before: SteamChatPosition?, count: UInt32) async throws  -> SteamChatHistory
    
    func sendMessage(friendSteamId: UInt64, text: String) async throws  -> SteamSentMessage
    
    /**
     * Throttled per friend in Rust; calling on every keystroke is fine.
     */
    func sendTyping(friendSteamId: UInt64) async throws 
    
    /**
     * Shows the account Online again, for instance after a game ended.
     */
    func setOnline() async throws 
    
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeSteamSession: FfiConverter {
    typealias FfiType = UInt64
    typealias SwiftType = SteamSession

    public static func lift(_ handle: UInt64) throws -> SteamSession {
        return SteamSession(unsafeFromHandle: handle)
    }

    public static func lower(_ value: SteamSession) -> UInt64 {
        return value.uniffiCloneHandle()
    }

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> SteamSession {
        let handle: UInt64 = try readInt(&buf)
        return try lift(handle)
    }

    public static func write(_ value: SteamSession, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        writeInt(&buf, lower(value))
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeSteamSession_lift(_ handle: UInt64) throws -> SteamSession {
    return try FfiConverterTypeSteamSession.lift(handle)
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeSteamSession_lower(_ value: SteamSession) -> UInt64 {
    return FfiConverterTypeSteamSession.lower(value)
}






/**
 * One storefront's Game sessions, for the whole life of Obelisk.
 */
public protocol StorefrontSessionsProtocol: AnyObject, Sendable {
    
    /**
     * The player accepted `friend_steam_id`'s invitation into session
     * `session_id`'s running Steam game, from `received_invites` or from
     * Steam's chat: the game joins as if Steam's overlay had accepted it.
     */
    func acceptInvite(sessionId: String, friendSteamId: UInt64, invite: SteamGameInvite) async throws 
    
    /**
     * The player's answer to `micro_txn`, the purchase session
     * `session_id`'s Steam game waits on: only that order is answered.
     */
    func authorizeMicroTxn(sessionId: String, orderId: UInt64, approve: Bool) async throws 
    
    /**
     * Waits for a revision newer than `after`, or returns at once.
     */
    func changed(after: UInt64) async  -> GameSessionsState
    
    /**
     * The player declined to install Rosetta: the waiting launch stops.
     */
    func declineRosetta(sessionId: String, account: GameAccount, decisionId: UInt64) 
    
    /**
     * The player's Force Quit of session `session_id`'s game, which ignored
     * Quit: it ends now, with whatever still runs for its installation, and
     * its session still settles its Cloud saves. A launch still preparing is
     * cancelled.
     */
    func forceQuit(sessionId: String) async throws 
    
    /**
     * Obelisk's overlay opened (`active`) or closed over session
     * `session_id`'s running Steam game, as Steam's overlay would tell it;
     * `user_initiated` when the player opened it rather than the game. The
     * game sees a close only after an open.
     */
    func overlayState(sessionId: String, active: Bool, userInitiated: Bool) async throws 
    
    /**
     * The player's Quit of session `session_id`'s game: it is asked to close
     * its windows, and nothing is killed. A launch still preparing is
     * cancelled.
     */
    func quit(sessionId: String) async throws 
    
    func resumeAfterRosetta(sessionId: String, account: GameAccount, decisionId: UInt64) async throws 
    
    /**
     * Account revocation. The game keeps running.
     */
    func revoke(account: GameAccount) 
    
    func state()  -> GameSessionsState
    
    /**
     * Ends the running game, as quitting Obelisk does; its session still
     * settles its Cloud saves. A launch still preparing is cancelled.
     */
    func stop() async throws 
    
}
/**
 * One storefront's Game sessions, for the whole life of Obelisk.
 */
open class StorefrontSessions: StorefrontSessionsProtocol, @unchecked Sendable {
    fileprivate let handle: UInt64

    /// Used to instantiate a [FFIObject] without an actual handle, for fakes in tests, mostly.
#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    public struct NoHandle {
        public init() {}
    }

    // TODO: We'd like this to be `private` but for Swifty reasons,
    // we can't implement `FfiConverter` without making this `required` and we can't
    // make it `required` without making it `public`.
#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    required public init(unsafeFromHandle handle: UInt64) {
        self.handle = handle
    }

    // This constructor can be used to instantiate a fake object.
    // - Parameter noHandle: Placeholder value so we can have a constructor separate from the default empty one that may be implemented for classes extending [FFIObject].
    //
    // - Warning:
    //     Any object instantiated with this constructor cannot be passed to an actual Rust-backed object. Since there isn't a backing handle the FFI lower functions will crash.
#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    public init(noHandle: NoHandle) {
        self.handle = 0
    }

#if swift(>=5.8)
    @_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
    public func uniffiCloneHandle() -> UInt64 {
        return try! rustCall { uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_clone_storefrontsessions(self.handle, $0) }
    }
    /**
     * Starts by recovering the session a previous Obelisk left running. Its
     * launches and Transfers get their runtimes into the places `locations`
     * names, and the installations given it read them back from their own
     * locations: those must name the same places.
     */
public convenience init(storefront: SessionStorefront, locations: ObeliskLocations) {
    let handle =
        try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_constructor_storefrontsessions_new(
        FfiConverterTypeSessionStorefront_lower(storefront),
        FfiConverterTypeObeliskLocations_lower(locations),uniffiCallStatus
    )
}
    self.init(unsafeFromHandle: handle)
}

    deinit {
        if handle == 0 {
            // Mock objects have handle=0 don't try to free them
            return
        }

        try! rustCall { uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_free_storefrontsessions(handle, $0) }
    }

    

    
    /**
     * The player accepted `friend_steam_id`'s invitation into session
     * `session_id`'s running Steam game, from `received_invites` or from
     * Steam's chat: the game joins as if Steam's overlay had accepted it.
     */
open func acceptInvite(sessionId: String, friendSteamId: UInt64, invite: SteamGameInvite)async throws   {
    return
        try  await uniffiRustCallAsync(
            rustFutureFunc: {
                uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_method_storefrontsessions_accept_invite(
                        self.uniffiCloneHandle(),FfiConverterString.lower(sessionId),FfiConverterUInt64.lower(friendSteamId),FfiConverterTypeSteamGameInvite_lower(invite)
                )
            },
            pollFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_poll_void,
            completeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_complete_void,
            freeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_free_void,
            liftFunc: { $0 },
            errorHandler: FfiConverterTypeGameSessionError_lift
        )
}
    
    /**
     * The player's answer to `micro_txn`, the purchase session
     * `session_id`'s Steam game waits on: only that order is answered.
     */
open func authorizeMicroTxn(sessionId: String, orderId: UInt64, approve: Bool)async throws   {
    return
        try  await uniffiRustCallAsync(
            rustFutureFunc: {

                )
            },
            pollFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_poll_void,
            completeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_complete_void,
            freeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_free_void,
            liftFunc: { $0 },
            errorHandler: FfiConverterTypeGameSessionError_lift
        )
}
    
    /**

     */
open func changed(after: UInt64)async  -> GameSessionsState  {

        )
}
    
    /**
     * The player declined to install Rosetta: the waiting launch stops.
     */
open func declineRosetta(sessionId: String, account: GameAccount, decisionId: UInt64)  {try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in

    /**
     * The player's Force Quit of session `session_id`'s game, which ignored

/**

    public var game: String

     */

    /**
     * It compares or transfers saves now.
     */
    public var working: Bool
    /**
     * Its Game session's control connection was lost: nothing reaches it.
     */
    public var reconnecting: Bool
    /**
     * The player may cancel it: a launch check still in progress.

    // declare one manually.

        /**
         * It compares or transfers saves now.
         */working: Bool, 
        /**
         * Its Game session's control connection was lost: nothing reaches it.
         */reconnecting: Bool, 
        /**
         * The player may cancel it: a launch check still in progress.
         */cancellable: Bool, question: CloudQuestion?) {
        self.game = game
        self.kind = kind
        self.decisionId = decisionId
        self.working = working
        self.reconnecting = reconnecting
        self.cancellable = cancellable

/**
 * One Transfer in the queue.
 */
public struct DownloadItem: Equatable, Hashable {
    public var id: UInt64
    public var storefront: SessionStorefront
    public var account: String
    /**
     * The game, as its storefront's installations name it.
     */
    public var game: String
    public var name: String
    public var kind: DownloadKind
    /**
     * Obelisk queued it for a newer build, not the player.
     */
    public var automatic: Bool
    /**
     * A launch waits for it: it goes first and cannot be paused.
     */
    public var launching: Bool
    public var paused: Bool

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(id: UInt64, storefront: SessionStorefront, account: String, 
        /**
         * The game, as its storefront's installations name it.
         */game: String, name: String, kind: DownloadKind, 
        /**
         * Obelisk queued it for a newer build, not the player.
         */automatic: Bool, 
        /**
         * A launch waits for it: it goes first and cannot be paused.
         */launching: Bool, paused: Bool) {
        self.id = id
        self.storefront = storefront
        self.account = account
        self.game = game
        self.name = name
        self.kind = kind
        self.automatic = automatic
        self.launching = launching
        self.paused = paused
    }

    

    
}

/**
 * Everything the queue presents. `revision` grows with every change.
 */

    public var revision: UInt64
    public var running: DownloadItem?
    /**
     * In the order they will run.
     */
    public var waiting: [DownloadItem]
    /**
     * A game runs: automatic updates wait.
     */
    public var held: Bool

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(revision: UInt64, running: DownloadItem?, 
        /**
         * In the order they will run.
         */waiting: [DownloadItem], 
        /**
         * A game runs: automatic updates wait.
         */held: Bool) {
        self.revision = revision
        self.running = running
        self.waiting = waiting
        self.held = held

/**
 * What a session's game did once it ran, for the player's performance
 * reports. Frame rates are absent when Metal reported no frame.
 */
public struct GamePlayed: Equatable, Hashable {
    public var seconds: UInt64
    public var frames: UInt64
    public var medianFps: Double?
    public var low1pctFps: Double?
    public var hitches: UInt64
    public var exitCode: Int32?
    public var exitSignal: Int32?
    public var endedByObelisk: Bool
    /**
     * `rosetta` or `linux` for a Windows game, absent for a Mac one.
     */
    public var engine: String?
    /**
     * `dxmt` or `d3dmetal` for a Windows game, absent for a Mac one.
     */
    public var graphics: String?
    public var voile: String?

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(seconds: UInt64, frames: UInt64, medianFps: Double?, low1pctFps: Double?, hitches: UInt64, exitCode: Int32?, exitSignal: Int32?, endedByObelisk: Bool, 
        /**
         * `rosetta` or `linux` for a Windows game, absent for a Mac one.
         */engine: String?, 
        /**
         * `dxmt` or `d3dmetal` for a Windows game, absent for a Mac one.
         */graphics: String?, voile: String?) {
        self.seconds = seconds
        self.frames = frames
        self.medianFps = medianFps
        self.low1pctFps = low1pctFps
        self.hitches = hitches
        self.exitCode = exitCode
        self.exitSignal = exitSignal
        self.endedByObelisk = endedByObelisk
        self.engine = engine
        self.graphics = graphics
        self.voile = voile
    }

    

    
}

extension GamePlayed: Sendable {}
#endif

@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif

                frames: FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf), 
                medianFps: FfiConverterOptionDouble.read(from: &buf), 
                low1pctFps: FfiConverterOptionDouble.read(from: &buf), 
                hitches: FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf), 
                exitCode: FfiConverterOptionInt32.read(from: &buf), 
                exitSignal: FfiConverterOptionInt32.read(from: &buf), 
                endedByObelisk: FfiConverterBool.read(from: &buf), 
                engine: FfiConverterOptionString.read(from: &buf), 
                graphics: FfiConverterOptionString.read(from: &buf), 
                voile: FfiConverterOptionString.read(from: &buf)
        )
    }

    public static func write(_ value: GamePlayed, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        FfiConverterUInt64.write(value.seconds, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterUInt64.write(value.frames, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionDouble.write(value.medianFps, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionDouble.write(value.low1pctFps, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterUInt64.write(value.hitches, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionInt32.write(value.exitCode, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionInt32.write(value.exitSignal, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterBool.write(value.endedByObelisk, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionString.write(value.engine, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionString.write(value.graphics, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionString.write(value.voile, into: &buf)
    }

public struct GameSessionState: Equatable, Hashable {
    public var id: String
    public var game: GameIdentity
    public var phase: GamePhase
    /**
     * The control connection was lost; the game may still run.
     */
    public var reconnecting: Bool
    public var cloud: CloudStatus
    /**
     * Steam's native host.
     */
    public var host: SteamHostState?
    /**
     * A supervisor snapshot backs this session, not only its admission.
     */
    public var observed: Bool
    /**
     * How much of a runtime has downloaded while the launch waits for it.
     */
    public var runtimeInstall: RuntimeInstallState?
    /**
     * When this Obelisk saw the game start, in seconds since the Unix epoch,
     * even if it already exited. A game recovered running has none.
     */
    public var startedAt: UInt64?
    /**
     * The latest invite dialog the Steam game asked for, while its host is
     * online: the picker it opens invites into its target.
     */
    public var inviteRequest: SteamInviteRequest?
    /**
     * The Steam lobby the game is in now, as the account's engine shows it:
     * the friends list invites into it.
     */
    public var lobbyId: UInt64?
    /**
     * The latest overlay the Steam game asked for, while its host is online,
     * invite dialogs included: `invite_request` is the same request when it
     * asks for one, with the same sequence.
     */
    public var overlayRequest: SteamOverlayRequest?
    /**
     * Invitations friends sent into the Steam game, newest first, while its
     * host is online.
     */
    public var receivedInvites: [SteamReceivedInvite]
    /**
     * The purchase the Steam game waits on the player to confirm.
     */
    public var microTxn: SteamMicroTxn?
    /**
     * What the game did, once it ran and exited.
     */
    public var played: GamePlayed?

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(id: String, game: GameIdentity, phase: GamePhase, 
        /**
         * The control connection was lost; the game may still run.
         */reconnecting: Bool, cloud: CloudStatus, 
        /**
         * Steam's native host.
         */host: SteamHostState?, 
        /**
         * A supervisor snapshot backs this session, not only its admission.
         */observed: Bool, 
        /**
         * How much of a runtime has downloaded while the launch waits for it.
         */runtimeInstall: RuntimeInstallState?, 
        /**
         * When this Obelisk saw the game start, in seconds since the Unix epoch,
         * even if it already exited. A game recovered running has none.
         */startedAt: UInt64? = nil, 
        /**
         * The latest invite dialog the Steam game asked for, while its host is
         * online: the picker it opens invites into its target.
         */inviteRequest: SteamInviteRequest? = nil, 
        /**
         * The Steam lobby the game is in now, as the account's engine shows it:
         * the friends list invites into it.
         */lobbyId: UInt64? = nil, 
        /**
         * The latest overlay the Steam game asked for, while its host is online,
         * invite dialogs included: `invite_request` is the same request when it
         * asks for one, with the same sequence.
         */overlayRequest: SteamOverlayRequest? = nil, 
        /**
         * Invitations friends sent into the Steam game, newest first, while its
         * host is online.
         */receivedInvites: [SteamReceivedInvite] = [], 
        /**
         * The purchase the Steam game waits on the player to confirm.
         */microTxn: SteamMicroTxn? = nil, 
        /**
         * What the game did, once it ran and exited.
         */played: GamePlayed? = nil) {
        self.id = id
        self.game = game
        self.phase = phase
        self.reconnecting = reconnecting
        self.cloud = cloud
        self.host = host
        self.observed = observed
        self.runtimeInstall = runtimeInstall
        self.startedAt = startedAt
        self.inviteRequest = inviteRequest
        self.lobbyId = lobbyId
        self.overlayRequest = overlayRequest
        self.receivedInvites = receivedInvites
        self.microTxn = microTxn
        self.played = played
    }

    

    
}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension GameSessionState: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeGameSessionState: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> GameSessionState {
        return
            try GameSessionState(
                id: FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf), 
                game: FfiConverterTypeGameIdentity.read(from: &buf), 
                phase: FfiConverterTypeGamePhase.read(from: &buf), 
                reconnecting: FfiConverterBool.read(from: &buf), 
                cloud: FfiConverterTypeCloudStatus.read(from: &buf), 
                host: FfiConverterOptionTypeSteamHostState.read(from: &buf), 
                observed: FfiConverterBool.read(from: &buf), 
                runtimeInstall: FfiConverterOptionTypeRuntimeInstallState.read(from: &buf), 
                startedAt: FfiConverterOptionUInt64.read(from: &buf), 
                inviteRequest: FfiConverterOptionTypeSteamInviteRequest.read(from: &buf), 
                lobbyId: FfiConverterOptionUInt64.read(from: &buf), 
                overlayRequest: FfiConverterOptionTypeSteamOverlayRequest.read(from: &buf), 
                receivedInvites: FfiConverterSequenceTypeSteamReceivedInvite.read(from: &buf), 
                microTxn: FfiConverterOptionTypeSteamMicroTxn.read(from: &buf), 
                played: FfiConverterOptionTypeGamePlayed.read(from: &buf)
        )
    }

    public static func write(_ value: GameSessionState, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        FfiConverterString.write(value.id, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterTypeGameIdentity.write(value.game, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterTypeGamePhase.write(value.phase, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterBool.write(value.reconnecting, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterTypeCloudStatus.write(value.cloud, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionTypeSteamHostState.write(value.host, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterBool.write(value.observed, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionTypeRuntimeInstallState.write(value.runtimeInstall, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionUInt64.write(value.startedAt, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionTypeSteamInviteRequest.write(value.inviteRequest, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionUInt64.write(value.lobbyId, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionTypeSteamOverlayRequest.write(value.overlayRequest, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterSequenceTypeSteamReceivedInvite.write(value.receivedInvites, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionTypeSteamMicroTxn.write(value.microTxn, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionTypeGamePlayed.write(value.played, into: &buf)
    }

public struct GameSessionsState: Equatable, Hashable {
    /**
     * Grows with every change.
     */
    public var revision: UInt64
    /**
     * The session holding the Reservation.
     */
    public var active: GameSessionState?
    /**
     * The last session observed, kept after it ends.
     */
    public var last: GameSessionState?
    /**
     * A session a previous Obelisk left may still run.
     */
    public var recovering: Bool
    /**
     * The last recovery attempt failed; it is retried.
     */
    public var recoveryFailed: Bool
    /**
     * Accounts signed out since the last admission.
     */
    public var revoked: [GameAccount]
    public var rosetta: RosettaPromptState?

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(
        /**
         * Grows with every change.
         */revision: UInt64, 
        /**
         * The session holding the Reservation.
         */active: GameSessionState?, 
        /**
         * The last session observed, kept after it ends.
         */last: GameSessionState?, 
        /**
         * A session a previous Obelisk left may still run.
         */recovering: Bool, 
        /**
         * The last recovery attempt failed; it is retried.
         */recoveryFailed: Bool, 
        /**
         * Accounts signed out since the last admission.
         */revoked: [GameAccount], rosetta: RosettaPromptState?) {
        self.revision = revision
        self.active = active
        self.last = last
        self.recovering = recovering
        self.recoveryFailed = recoveryFailed
        self.revoked = revoked
        self.rosetta = rosetta
    }

    

    
}

public struct GogGame: Equatable, Hashable {
    public var productId: String
    public var title: String
    /**
     * The portrait cover.
     */
    public var imageUrl: String?
    /**
     * The wide artwork the hero and the game's page show.
     */
    public var headerImageUrl: String?
    public var windows: Bool
    public var macos: Bool
    /**
     * In English: gamesdb has no other language.
     */
    public var summary: String
    public var developers: [String]
    public var publishers: [String]
    /**
     * Seconds since the Unix epoch.
     */
    public var releaseDate: UInt64?
    public var genres: [String]
    /**
     * The critics' rating, out of 100.
     */
    public var rating: UInt32?
    /**
     * The languages the game speaks, such as `fr-FR`.
     */
    public var languages: [String]
    /**
     * When the game joined the account's library, in seconds since the
     * Unix epoch.
     */
    public var addedAt: UInt64?

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(productId: String, title: String, 
        /**
         * The portrait cover.
         */imageUrl: String?, 
        /**
         * The wide artwork the hero and the game's page show.
         */headerImageUrl: String?, windows: Bool, macos: Bool, 
        /**
         * In English: gamesdb has no other language.
         */summary: String, developers: [String], publishers: [String], 
        /**
         * Seconds since the Unix epoch.
         */releaseDate: UInt64?, genres: [String], 
        /**
         * The critics' rating, out of 100.
         */rating: UInt32?, 
        /**
         * The languages the game speaks, such as `fr-FR`.
         */languages: [String], 
        /**
         * When the game joined the account's library, in seconds since the
         * Unix epoch.
         */addedAt: UInt64? = nil) {
        self.productId = productId
        self.title = title
        self.imageUrl = imageUrl
        self.headerImageUrl = headerImageUrl
        self.windows = windows
        self.macos = macos
        self.summary = summary
        self.developers = developers
        self.publishers = publishers
        self.releaseDate = releaseDate
        self.genres = genres
        self.rating = rating
        self.languages = languages
        self.addedAt = addedAt
    }

    

    
}

        self.game = game
        self.name = name
        self.directory = directory
        self.platform = platform

        self.needsVerification = needsVerification

/**
 * What the Reservation lets start now.
 */
public struct InstallationGate: Equatable, Hashable {
    /**
     * A Transfer, which waits in the download queue.
     */
    public var modify: GameOpening
    /**
     * An uninstall: no Transfer, launch or other uninstall of the storefront
     * runs.
     */
    public var uninstall: GameOpening
    /**
     * A launch: a Transfer holds only its own game, and those whose launch
     * would need one.
     */
    public var launch: GameOpening
    public var maintain: GameOpening

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(
        /**
         * A Transfer, which waits in the download queue.
         */modify: GameOpening, 
        /**
         * An uninstall: no Transfer, launch or other uninstall of the storefront
         * runs.
         */uninstall: GameOpening, 
        /**
         * A launch: a Transfer holds only its own game, and those whose launch
         * would need one.
         */launch: GameOpening, maintain: GameOpening) {
        self.modify = modify
        self.uninstall = uninstall
        self.launch = launch
        self.maintain = maintain
    }

    

    
}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension InstallationGate: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeInstallationGate: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> InstallationGate {
        return
            try InstallationGate(
                modify: FfiConverterTypeGameOpening.read(from: &buf), 
                uninstall: FfiConverterTypeGameOpening.read(from: &buf), 
                launch: FfiConverterTypeGameOpening.read(from: &buf), 
                maintain: FfiConverterTypeGameOpening.read(from: &buf)
        )
    }

    public static func write(_ value: InstallationGate, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        FfiConverterTypeGameOpening.write(value.modify, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterTypeGameOpening.write(value.uninstall, into: &buf)

    }

/**
 * Everything the account's installations present.
 */
public struct InstallationsState: Equatable, Hashable {
    /**
     * Grows with every change.
     */
    public var revision: UInt64
    public var installations: [Installation]
    public var transfer: GameTransfer?
    /**
     * The game the last Transfer progress belongs to.
     */
    public var transferGame: String?
    public var downloading: Bool
    public var launching: Bool
    public var verifyingBeforeLaunch: Bool
    public var launchGame: String?
    public var uninstallGame: String?
    /**
     * The game whose Transfer stopped before its receipt: the player can
     * resume it.
     */
    public var resumable: String?
    public var report: InstallationReport?
    public var warning: InstallationWarning?
    public var gate: InstallationGate
    public var cloudSync: CloudSync?
    /**
     * The games whose Transfer waits in the download queue.
     */
    public var queued: [String]

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(
        /**
         * Grows with every change.
         */revision: UInt64, installations: [Installation], transfer: GameTransfer?, 
        /**
         * The game the last Transfer progress belongs to.
         */transferGame: String?, downloading: Bool, launching: Bool, verifyingBeforeLaunch: Bool, launchGame: String?, uninstallGame: String?, 
        /**
         * The game whose Transfer stopped before its receipt: the player can
         * resume it.
         */resumable: String?, report: InstallationReport?, warning: InstallationWarning?, gate: InstallationGate, cloudSync: CloudSync?, 
        /**
         * The games whose Transfer waits in the download queue.
         */queued: [String]) {
        self.revision = revision
        self.installations = installations
        self.transfer = transfer
        self.transferGame = transferGame
        self.downloading = downloading
        self.launching = launching
        self.verifyingBeforeLaunch = verifyingBeforeLaunch
        self.launchGame = launchGame
        self.uninstallGame = uninstallGame
        self.resumable = resumable
        self.report = report
        self.warning = warning
        self.gate = gate
        self.cloudSync = cloudSync
        self.queued = queued
    }

    

    
}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension InstallationsState: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeInstallationsState: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> InstallationsState {
        return
            try InstallationsState(
                revision: FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf), 
                installations: FfiConverterSequenceTypeInstallation.read(from: &buf), 
                transfer: FfiConverterOptionTypeGameTransfer.read(from: &buf), 
                transferGame: FfiConverterOptionString.read(from: &buf), 
                downloading: FfiConverterBool.read(from: &buf), 
                launching: FfiConverterBool.read(from: &buf), 
                verifyingBeforeLaunch: FfiConverterBool.read(from: &buf), 
                launchGame: FfiConverterOptionString.read(from: &buf), 
                uninstallGame: FfiConverterOptionString.read(from: &buf), 
                resumable: FfiConverterOptionString.read(from: &buf), 
                report: FfiConverterOptionTypeInstallationReport.read(from: &buf), 
                warning: FfiConverterOptionTypeInstallationWarning.read(from: &buf), 
                gate: FfiConverterTypeInstallationGate.read(from: &buf), 
                cloudSync: FfiConverterOptionTypeCloudSync.read(from: &buf), 
                queued: FfiConverterSequenceString.read(from: &buf)
        )
    }

    public static func write(_ value: InstallationsState, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        FfiConverterUInt64.write(value.revision, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterSequenceTypeInstallation.write(value.installations, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionTypeGameTransfer.write(value.transfer, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionString.write(value.transferGame, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterBool.write(value.downloading, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterBool.write(value.launching, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterBool.write(value.verifyingBeforeLaunch, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionString.write(value.launchGame, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionString.write(value.uninstallGame, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionString.write(value.resumable, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionTypeInstallationReport.write(value.report, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionTypeInstallationWarning.write(value.warning, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterTypeInstallationGate.write(value.gate, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionTypeCloudSync.write(value.cloudSync, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterSequenceString.write(value.queued, into: &buf)
    }
}

/**
 * How a Windows game runs from its next launch, and what its player can
 * change.
 */
public struct LaunchSettings: Equatable, Hashable {
    public var engine: LaunchEngine
    public var graphics: LaunchGraphics
    /**
     * Direct3D 12 offers DirectX Raytracing, on D3DMetal.
     */
    public var rayTracing: Bool
    /**
     * Metal's Performance HUD shows over the game, whatever renders it.
     */
    public var performanceHud: Bool
    /**
     * What the player changed from what Obelisk knows of the game.
     */
    public var choices: LaunchChoices
    /**
     * The engine the game runs on without choices.
     */
    public var defaultEngine: LaunchEngine
    /**
     * Every engine, with what it offers and how the game runs there
     * without choices.
     */
    public var engines: [LaunchEngineOffer]

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(engine: LaunchEngine, graphics: LaunchGraphics, 
        /**
         * Direct3D 12 offers DirectX Raytracing, on D3DMetal.
         */rayTracing: Bool, 
        /**
         * Metal's Performance HUD shows over the game, whatever renders it.
         */performanceHud: Bool, 
        /**
         * What the player changed from what Obelisk knows of the game.
         */choices: LaunchChoices, 
        /**
         * The engine the game runs on without choices.
         */defaultEngine: LaunchEngine, 
        /**
         * Every engine, with what it offers and how the game runs there
         * without choices.
         */engines: [LaunchEngineOffer]) {
        self.engine = engine
        self.graphics = graphics
        self.rayTracing = rayTracing
        self.performanceHud = performanceHud
        self.choices = choices
        self.defaultEngine = defaultEngine
        self.engines = engines
    }

    

    
}

                performanceHud: FfiConverterBool.read(from: &buf), 
                choices: FfiConverterTypeLaunchChoices.read(from: &buf), 
                defaultEngine: FfiConverterTypeLaunchEngine.read(from: &buf), 
                engines: FfiConverterSequenceTypeLaunchEngineOffer.read(from: &buf)
        )
    }

    public static func write(_ value: LaunchSettings, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {

/**
 * Where Obelisk keeps everything, derived from its library directory, its
 * application bundle and the user's home.
 */
public struct ObeliskLocations: Equatable, Hashable {
    public var library: String
    public var home: String
    /**
     * The Cloud archive every storefront shares. The folder keeps its first
     * name so existing save versions and running Game sessions stay valid.
     */
    public var cloudArchive: String
    public var steamSessions: String
    public var epicSessions: String
    public var gogSessions: String
    /**
     * The bundled native host every supervisor runs as.
     */
    public var helper: String
    public var helpers: String
    /**
     * Valve's Steam components the Steam host loads, which a Steam game's
     * download, or a launch that misses them, gets from Valve's CDN.
     */
    public var steamRuntimePackage: String
    public var steamRuntimeCache: String
    /**
     * The Voile runtimes that run Windows games: the pinned release and a
     * development runtime.
     */
    public var voile: String
    /**
     * One Wine prefix per Windows installation, named after its folder.
     */
    public var winePrefixes: String

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(library: String, home: String, 
        /**
         * The Cloud archive every storefront shares. The folder keeps its first
         * name so existing save versions and running Game sessions stay valid.
         */cloudArchive: String, steamSessions: String, epicSessions: String, gogSessions: String, 
        /**
         * The bundled native host every supervisor runs as.
         */helper: String, helpers: String, 
        /**
         * Valve's Steam components the Steam host loads, which a Steam game's
         * download, or a launch that misses them, gets from Valve's CDN.
         */steamRuntimePackage: String, steamRuntimeCache: String, 
        /**
         * The Voile runtimes that run Windows games: the pinned release and a
         * development runtime.
         */voile: String, 
        /**
         * One Wine prefix per Windows installation, named after its folder.
         */winePrefixes: String) {
        self.library = library
        self.home = home
        self.cloudArchive = cloudArchive
        self.steamSessions = steamSessions
        self.epicSessions = epicSessions
        self.gogSessions = gogSessions
        self.helper = helper
        self.helpers = helpers
        self.steamRuntimePackage = steamRuntimePackage
        self.steamRuntimeCache = steamRuntimeCache
        self.voile = voile
        self.winePrefixes = winePrefixes
    }

    

    
}

public struct SteamFriendsSnapshot: Equatable, Hashable {
    /**
     * The session's revision, which grows across its CM connections.
     */
    public var revision: UInt64
    public var accountId: UInt64
    public var connection: SteamFriendsConnection
    /**
     * The session's CM connection: 0 for the first, one more for each that
     * replaced a dropped one.
     */
    public var transport: UInt64
    public var friends: [SteamFriend]

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(
        /**
         * The session's revision, which grows across its CM connections.
         */revision: UInt64, accountId: UInt64, connection: SteamFriendsConnection, 
        /**
         * The session's CM connection: 0 for the first, one more for each that
         * replaced a dropped one.
         */transport: UInt64, friends: [SteamFriend]) {
        self.revision = revision
        self.accountId = accountId
        self.connection = connection
        self.transport = transport
        self.friends = friends
    }

    

    
}

#endif

        return

                revision: FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf), 
                accountId: FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf), 
                connection: FfiConverterTypeSteamFriendsConnection.read(from: &buf), 
                transport: FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf), 
                friends: FfiConverterSequenceTypeSteamFriend.read(from: &buf)
        )
    }

    public static func write(_ value: SteamFriendsSnapshot, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        FfiConverterUInt64.write(value.revision, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterUInt64.write(value.accountId, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterTypeSteamFriendsConnection.write(value.connection, into: &buf)

        FfiConverterSequenceTypeSteamFriend.write(value.friends, into: &buf)
    }

/**
 * A game's library artwork, each image's path under the game's store assets.
 */
public struct SteamGameArtwork: Equatable, Hashable {
    /**
     * The portrait capsule, 300 × 450.
     */
    public var cover: String?
    /**
     * The wide hero, 1920 × 620.
     */
    public var hero: String?
    public var logo: String?
    /**
     * The library header, or the store's when the game has no library one.
     */
    public var header: String?
    /**
     * The app whose artwork stands in for the game's missing images, such
     * as Rust's for its staging branch.
     */
    public var parent: UInt32?

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(
        /**
         * The portrait capsule, 300 × 450.
         */cover: String?, 
        /**
         * The wide hero, 1920 × 620.
         */hero: String?, logo: String?, 
        /**
         * The library header, or the store's when the game has no library one.
         */header: String?, 
        /**
         * The app whose artwork stands in for the game's missing images, such
         * as Rust's for its staging branch.
         */parent: UInt32? = nil) {
        self.cover = cover
        self.hero = hero
        self.logo = logo
        self.header = header
        self.parent = parent
    }

    

    
}

/**
 * An invitation a friend sent into a game, as the running game's Steam or
 * the account's session received it. The running game takes one into it
 * with `StorefrontSessions::accept_invite`; another game joins it as it
 * starts, with `AccountInstallations::join`.
 */
public struct SteamReceivedInvite: Equatable, Hashable {
    public var friendSteamId: UInt64
    public var appId: UInt32
    /**
     * Never `None`.
     */
    public var invite: SteamGameInvite
    /**
     * When it was last received, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
     */
    public var receivedAt: UInt64

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(friendSteamId: UInt64, appId: UInt32, 
        /**
         * Never `None`.
         */invite: SteamGameInvite, 
        /**
         * When it was last received, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
         */receivedAt: UInt64) {
        self.friendSteamId = friendSteamId
        self.appId = appId
        self.invite = invite
        self.receivedAt = receivedAt
    }

    

    
}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension SteamReceivedInvite: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeSteamReceivedInvite: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> SteamReceivedInvite {
        return
            try SteamReceivedInvite(
                friendSteamId: FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf), 
                appId: FfiConverterUInt32.read(from: &buf), 
                invite: FfiConverterTypeSteamGameInvite.read(from: &buf), 
                receivedAt: FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf)
        )
    }

    public static func write(_ value: SteamReceivedInvite, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        FfiConverterUInt64.write(value.friendSteamId, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterUInt32.write(value.appId, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterTypeSteamGameInvite.write(value.invite, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterUInt64.write(value.receivedAt, into: &buf)
    }
