```swift
public 
enum CoreError: Swift.Error, Equatable, Hashable, Foundation.LocalizedError {

    
    
    case InvalidGame(reason: String
    )
    case Storage(reason: String
    )
    case CorruptLibrary(reason: String
    )
    case NotFound(id: String
    )

    

    

    
    public var errorDescription: String? {
        String(reflecting: self)
    }
    
}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension CoreError: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeCoreError: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = CoreError

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> CoreError {
        let variant: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        switch variant {

        

        
        case 1: return .InvalidGame(
            reason: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
            )
        case 2: return .Storage(
            reason: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
            )
        case 3: return .CorruptLibrary(
            reason: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
            )
        case 4: return .NotFound(
            id: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
            )

         default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: CoreError, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {

        

        
        
        case let .InvalidGame(reason):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(1))
            FfiConverterString.write(reason, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .Storage(reason):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
            FfiConverterString.write(reason, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .CorruptLibrary(reason):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(3))
            FfiConverterString.write(reason, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .NotFound(id):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(4))
            FfiConverterString.write(id, into: &buf)
            
        }
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeCoreError_lift(_ buf: RustBuffer) throws -> CoreError {
    return try FfiConverterTypeCoreError.lift(buf)
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeCoreError_lower(_ value: CoreError) -> RustBuffer {
    return FfiConverterTypeCoreError.lower(value)
}

/**

    /**
     * With the depots of `language`. Steam picks the build the account can

     * natively on Apple silicon, else the Windows build.
     */
    case steam(appId: UInt32, name: String, language: String
    )
    /**
     * Epic picks the build as Steam does.
     */
    case epic(namespace: String, catalogItemId: String, appName: String, title: String
    )
    /**
     * GOG picks the build as Steam does.
     */
    case gog(productId: String, title: String
    )

        )
        
        case 2: return .epic(namespace: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf), catalogItemId: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf), appName: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf), title: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 3: return .gog(productId: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf), title: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: GameOffer, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {
        
        
        case let .steam(appId,name,language):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(1))
            FfiConverterUInt32.write(appId, into: &buf)
            FfiConverterString.write(name, into: &buf)
            FfiConverterString.write(language, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .epic(namespace,catalogItemId,appName,title):

            FfiConverterString.write(catalogItemId, into: &buf)

/**
 * What choosing a folder would do.

public enum GamesFolderInspection: Equatable, Hashable {
    
    /**
     * The games go in `path`: `games` installations move there, and
     * `copied_bytes` of theirs are copied from another disk.
     */
    case ready(path: String, games: UInt32, copiedBytes: UInt64
    )
    /**
     * The folder is gone.
     */
    case missing
    /**
     * The folder is inside Obelisk's library or a game's installation.
     */
    case inside





}

        switch variant {
        
        case 1: return .ready(path: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf), games: try FfiConverterUInt32.read(from: &buf), copiedBytes: try FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 2: return .missing
        
        case 3: return .inside
        
        default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: GamesFolderInspection, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {
        
        
        case let .ready(path,games,copiedBytes):

            FfiConverterString.write(path, into: &buf)
            FfiConverterUInt32.write(games, into: &buf)
            FfiConverterUInt64.write(copiedBytes, into: &buf)
            
        
        case .missing:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
        
        
        case .inside:

/**
 * A failure the player sees, and what it is about.
 */

public enum InstallationReport: Equatable, Hashable {
    
    /**
     * A storefront's localization key.
     */
    case storefront(key: String
    )
    /**
     * The chosen folder could not be created.
     */
    case downloadDirectory(message: String
    )
    /**
     * An uninstall failed for this reason, a localization key.
     */
    case uninstall(reason: String
    )
    /**
     * A move into the games folder failed for this reason, a localization
     * key or the system's message.
     */
    case move(reason: String
    )
    /**
     * The games folder's disk is not connected: this folder.
     */
    case gamesFolderUnavailable(path: String
    )





}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension InstallationReport: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeInstallationReport: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = InstallationReport

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> InstallationReport {
        let variant: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        switch variant {
        
        case 1: return .storefront(key: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 2: return .downloadDirectory(message: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 3: return .uninstall(reason: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 4: return .move(reason: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 5: return .gamesFolderUnavailable(path: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: InstallationReport, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {
        
        
        case let .storefront(key):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(1))
            FfiConverterString.write(key, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .downloadDirectory(message):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
            FfiConverterString.write(message, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .uninstall(reason):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(3))
            FfiConverterString.write(reason, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .move(reason):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(4))
            FfiConverterString.write(reason, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .gamesFolderUnavailable(path):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(5))
            FfiConverterString.write(path, into: &buf)
            
        }
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeInstallationReport_lift(_ buf: RustBuffer) throws -> InstallationReport {
    return try FfiConverterTypeInstallationReport.lift(buf)
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeInstallationReport_lower(_ value: InstallationReport) -> RustBuffer {
    return FfiConverterTypeInstallationReport.lower(value)
}

public enum SteamChatEvent: Equatable, Hashable {
    
    case message(message: SteamChatMessage
    )
    case typing(friendSteamId: UInt64
    )
    /**
     * The account read the conversation up to `timestamp` in another session.
     */
    case read(friendSteamId: UInt64, timestamp: UInt32
    )





}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension SteamChatEvent: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeSteamChatEvent: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = SteamChatEvent

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> SteamChatEvent {
        let variant: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        switch variant {
        
        case 1: return .message(message: try FfiConverterTypeSteamChatMessage.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 2: return .typing(friendSteamId: try FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 3: return .read(friendSteamId: try FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf), timestamp: try FfiConverterUInt32.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: SteamChatEvent, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {
        
        
        case let .message(message):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(1))
            FfiConverterTypeSteamChatMessage.write(message, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .typing(friendSteamId):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
            FfiConverterUInt64.write(friendSteamId, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .read(friendSteamId,timestamp):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(3))
            FfiConverterUInt64.write(friendSteamId, into: &buf)
            FfiConverterUInt32.write(timestamp, into: &buf)
            
        }
    }
}

        String(reflecting: self)
    }

        switch variant {

        

        
        case 1: return .Failure(
            reason: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
            )
        case 2: return .AuthenticationRequired
        case 3: return .Cancelled

         default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: SteamError, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {

        case .AuthenticationRequired:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
        
        
        case .Cancelled:

/**
 * What the game asked Steam's overlay to show; Obelisk shows its own.
 */

public enum SteamOverlayKind: Equatable, Hashable {
    
    /**
     * `ActivateGameOverlay`: "friends", "community", "players", "settings",
     * "officialgamegroup", "stats", "achievements", "chatroomgroup/<id>", …
     */
    case dialog(dialog: String
    )
    /**
     * `ActivateGameOverlayToUser`: "steamid", "chat", "jointrade", "stats",
     * "achievements", "friendadd", … about `steam_id`.
     */
    case user(dialog: String, steamId: UInt64
    )
    /**
     * `ActivateGameOverlayToWebPage`: an http or https URL.
     */
    case webPage(url: String, modal: Bool
    )
    /**
     * `ActivateGameOverlayToStore`; app 0 is the store's front page.
     */
    case store(appId: UInt32, flag: SteamStoreFlag
    )
    /**
     * `ActivateGameOverlayInviteDialog`: invite friends into the lobby.
     */
    case lobbyInvite(lobbyId: UInt64
    )
    /**
     * `ActivateGameOverlayRemotePlayTogetherInviteDialog`.
     */
    case remotePlayTogetherInvite(lobbyId: UInt64?
    )
    /**
     * `ActivateGameOverlayInviteDialogConnectString`.
     */
    case connectInvite(connect: String
    )
    /**
     * Steam's own Remote Play Together dialog.
     */
    case remotePlayTogether





}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension SteamOverlayKind: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeSteamOverlayKind: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = SteamOverlayKind

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> SteamOverlayKind {
        let variant: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        switch variant {
        
        case 1: return .dialog(dialog: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 2: return .user(dialog: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf), steamId: try FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 3: return .webPage(url: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf), modal: try FfiConverterBool.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 4: return .store(appId: try FfiConverterUInt32.read(from: &buf), flag: try FfiConverterTypeSteamStoreFlag.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 5: return .lobbyInvite(lobbyId: try FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 6: return .remotePlayTogetherInvite(lobbyId: try FfiConverterOptionUInt64.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 7: return .connectInvite(connect: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 8: return .remotePlayTogether
        
        default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: SteamOverlayKind, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {
        
        
        case let .dialog(dialog):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(1))
            FfiConverterString.write(dialog, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .user(dialog,steamId):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
            FfiConverterString.write(dialog, into: &buf)
            FfiConverterUInt64.write(steamId, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .webPage(url,modal):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(3))
            FfiConverterString.write(url, into: &buf)
            FfiConverterBool.write(modal, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .store(appId,flag):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(4))
            FfiConverterUInt32.write(appId, into: &buf)
            FfiConverterTypeSteamStoreFlag.write(flag, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .lobbyInvite(lobbyId):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(5))
            FfiConverterUInt64.write(lobbyId, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .remotePlayTogetherInvite(lobbyId):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(6))
            FfiConverterOptionUInt64.write(lobbyId, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .connectInvite(connect):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(7))
            FfiConverterString.write(connect, into: &buf)
            
        
        case .remotePlayTogether:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(8))
        
        }
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeSteamOverlayKind_lift(_ buf: RustBuffer) throws -> SteamOverlayKind {
    return try FfiConverterTypeSteamOverlayKind.lift(buf)
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeSteamOverlayKind_lower(_ value: SteamOverlayKind) -> RustBuffer {
    return FfiConverterTypeSteamOverlayKind.lower(value)
}

/**
 * Lifecycle of one storefront transfer, shared by every store's progress record.
 */

public enum TransferState: Equatable, Hashable {
    
    case preparing
    case verifying
    case downloading
    /**
     * The installation moves into the games folder.
     */
    case moving
    case complete
    case cancelled
    case failed





}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension TransferState: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeTransferState: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = TransferState

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> TransferState {
        let variant: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        switch variant {
        
        case 1: return .preparing
        
        case 2: return .verifying
        
        case 3: return .downloading
        
        case 4: return .moving
        
        case 5: return .complete
        
        case 6: return .cancelled
        
        case 7: return .failed
        
        default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: TransferState, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {
        
        
        case .preparing:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(1))
        
        
        case .verifying:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
        
        
        case .downloading:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(3))
        
        
        case .moving:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(4))
        
        
        case .complete:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(5))
        
        
        case .cancelled:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(6))
        
        
        case .failed:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(7))
        
        }
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeTransferState_lift(_ buf: RustBuffer) throws -> TransferState {
    return try FfiConverterTypeTransferState.lift(buf)

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
fileprivate struct FfiConverterSequenceUInt32: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = [UInt32]

    public static func write(_ value: [UInt32], into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        let len = Int32(value.count)
        writeInt(&buf, len)
        for item in value {
            FfiConverterUInt32.write(item, into: &buf)
        }
    }

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> [UInt32] {
        let len: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        var seq = [UInt32]()
        seq.reserveCapacity(Int(len))
        for _ in 0 ..< len {
            seq.append(try FfiConverterUInt32.read(from: &buf))
        }
        return seq
    }
}

@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
fileprivate struct FfiConverterDictionaryUInt32UInt64: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    public static func write(_ value: [UInt32: UInt64], into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        let len = Int32(value.count)
        writeInt(&buf, len)
        for (key, value) in value {
            FfiConverterUInt32.write(key, into: &buf)
            FfiConverterUInt64.write(value, into: &buf)
        }
    }

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> [UInt32: UInt64] {
        let len: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        var dict = [UInt32: UInt64]()
        dict.reserveCapacity(Int(len))
        for _ in 0..<len {
            let key = try FfiConverterUInt32.read(from: &buf)
            let value = try FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf)
            dict[key] = value
        }
        return dict
    }
}

private let UNIFFI_RUST_FUTURE_POLL_READY: Int8 = 0
private let UNIFFI_RUST_FUTURE_POLL_WAKE: Int8 = 1

fileprivate let uniffiContinuationHandleMap = UniffiHandleMap<UnsafeContinuation<Int8, Never>>()

fileprivate func uniffiRustCallAsync<F, T>(
    rustFutureFunc: () -> UInt64,
    pollFunc: (UInt64, @escaping UniffiRustFutureContinuationCallback, UInt64) -> (),
    completeFunc: (UInt64, UnsafeMutablePointer<RustCallStatus>) -> F,
    freeFunc: (UInt64) -> (),
    liftFunc: (F) throws -> T,
    errorHandler: ((RustBuffer) throws -> Swift.Error)?
) async throws -> T {
    // Make sure to call the ensure init function since future creation doesn't have a
    // RustCallStatus param, so doesn't use makeRustCall()
    uniffiEnsureObeliskBridgeInitialized()
    let rustFuture = rustFutureFunc()
    defer {
        freeFunc(rustFuture)
    }
    var pollResult: Int8;
    repeat {
        pollResult = await withUnsafeContinuation {
            pollFunc(
                rustFuture,
                { handle, pollResult in
                    uniffiFutureContinuationCallback(handle: handle, pollResult: pollResult)
                },
                uniffiContinuationHandleMap.insert(obj: $0)
            )
        }
    } while pollResult != UNIFFI_RUST_FUTURE_POLL_READY

    return try liftFunc(makeRustCall(
        { completeFunc(rustFuture, $0) },
        errorHandler: errorHandler
    ))
}

// Callback handlers for an async calls.  These are invoked by Rust when the future is ready.  They
// lift the return value or error and resume the suspended function.
fileprivate func uniffiFutureContinuationCallback(handle: UInt64, pollResult: Int8) {
    if let continuation = try? uniffiContinuationHandleMap.remove(handle: handle) {
        continuation.resume(returning: pollResult)
    } else {
        print("uniffiFutureContinuationCallback invalid handle")
    }
}

    )

public func steamNews(appId: UInt32)async throws  -> [SteamNews]  {
    return
        try  await uniffiRustCallAsync(
            rustFutureFunc: {
                uniffi_obelisk_bridge_fn_func_steam_news(FfiConverterUInt32.lower(appId)
                )
            },
            pollFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_poll_rust_buffer,
            completeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_complete_rust_buffer,
            freeFunc: ffi_obelisk_bridge_rust_future_free_rust_buffer,
            liftFunc: FfiConverterSequenceTypeSteamNews.lift,
            errorHandler: FfiConverterTypeSteamError_lift
        )
}

private enum InitializationResult {
    case ok
    case contractVersionMismatch
    case apiChecksumMismatch
}
// Use a global variable to perform the versioning checks. Swift ensures that
// the code inside is only computed once.
private let initializationResult: InitializationResult = {
    // Get the bindings contract version from our ComponentInterface
    let bindings_contract_version = 30
    // Get the scaffolding contract version by calling the into the dylib
    let scaffolding_contract_version = ffi_obelisk_bridge_uniffi_contract_version()
    if bindings_contract_version != scaffolding_contract_version {
        return InitializationResult.contractVersionMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_obelisk_bridge_checksum_func_storefronts() != 5932) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_obelisk_bridge_checksum_func_diagnostic_files() != 60320) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_obelisk_bridge_checksum_func_without_metal_hud_frames() != 20665) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_obelisk_bridge_checksum_func_epic_authorization_code() != 42633) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_obelisk_bridge_checksum_func_epic_login_url() != 45052) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_obelisk_bridge_checksum_func_gog_authorization_code() != 19621) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_obelisk_bridge_checksum_func_gog_is_login_redirect() != 36862) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }

        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch

    switch initializationResult {
    case .ok:
        break
    case .contractVersionMismatch:
        fatalError("UniFFI contract version mismatch: try cleaning and rebuilding your project")
    case .apiChecksumMismatch:
        fatalError("UniFFI API checksum mismatch: try cleaning and rebuilding your project")
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation

/// Only the refresh token is persisted. Access tokens remain in the Rust session.
struct GogKeychain: CredentialStore {
    private let store: KeychainStore<StoredGogCredentials>

    init(service: String = AppIdentity.storageIdentifier + ".gog") {
        store = KeychainStore(service: service, account: "gog-session", label: L10n.string("model.brand.gog"))
    }

    func load() async throws -> GogCredentials? {
        try await store.load().map {
            GogCredentials(userId: $0.userId, username: $0.username, refreshToken: $0.refreshToken)
        }
    }

    func save(_ credentials: GogCredentials) async throws {
        try await store.save(StoredGogCredentials(
            userId: credentials.userId,
            username: credentials.username,
            refreshToken: credentials.refreshToken
        ))
    }

    func remove() async throws {
        try await store.remove()
    }
}

private struct StoredGogCredentials: Codable {
    let userId: String
    let username: String
    let refreshToken: String
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Bridge/KeychainStore.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation
import Security

/// One generic-password Keychain item holding a JSON-encoded value. Items are
/// device-bound (`AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly`) and never synchronised.
actor KeychainStore<Stored: Codable & Sendable> {
    private let service: String
    private let account: String
    private let label: String

    /// `label` names the stored session in error messages ("Steam", "Epic").
    init(service: String, account: String, label: String) {
        self.service = service
        self.account = account
        self.label = label
    }

    func load() throws -> Stored? {
        var query = baseQuery
        query[kSecReturnData as String] = true
        query[kSecMatchLimit as String] = kSecMatchLimitOne
        var item: CFTypeRef?
        let status = SecItemCopyMatching(query as CFDictionary, &item)
        if status == errSecItemNotFound { return nil }
        guard status == errSecSuccess, let data = item as? Data else {
            throw KeychainFailure(label: label, operation: .read, status: status)
        }
        do {
            return try JSONDecoder().decode(Stored.self, from: data)
        } catch {
            throw KeychainFailure(label: label, operation: .read, status: errSecDecode)
        }
    }

    func save(_ value: Stored) throws {
        let data = try JSONEncoder().encode(value)
        let update = [kSecValueData as String: data]
        var status = SecItemUpdate(baseQuery as CFDictionary, update as CFDictionary)
        if status == errSecItemNotFound {
            var query = baseQuery
            query[kSecValueData as String] = data
            query[kSecAttrAccessible as String] = kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly
            status = SecItemAdd(query as CFDictionary, nil)
        }
        guard status == errSecSuccess else {
            throw KeychainFailure(label: label, operation: .save, status: status)
        }
    }

    func remove() throws {
        let status = SecItemDelete(baseQuery as CFDictionary)
        guard status == errSecSuccess || status == errSecItemNotFound else {
            throw KeychainFailure(label: label, operation: .remove, status: status)
        }
    }

    private var baseQuery: [String: Any] {
        [
            kSecClass as String: kSecClassGenericPassword,
            kSecAttrService as String: service,
            kSecAttrAccount as String: account,
            kSecAttrSynchronizable as String: false,
        ]
    }
}

private struct KeychainFailure: LocalizedError {
    enum Operation {
        case read, save, remove
    }

    let label: String
    let operation: Operation
    let status: OSStatus

    var errorDescription: String? {
        switch operation {
        case .read: L10n.string("model.keychain.readFailed", label, Int64(status))
        case .save: L10n.string("model.keychain.saveFailed", label, Int64(status))
        case .remove: L10n.string("model.keychain.removeFailed", label, Int64(status))
        }
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Bridge/SteamSessionConnection.swift`:

```swift
import AppKit
import Foundation

/// UniFFI 0.32 async wrappers do not propagate Swift cancellation to Rust.
/// This explicit token cancels directory lookup, TLS connection and CM logon.
enum SteamSessionConnection {
    /// The account's session, which keeps every library it loads in `library`.
    static func connect(_ credentials: SteamCredentials, library: LibraryCache?) async throws -> any SteamSessionProtocol {
        let attempt = SteamConnectionAttempt()
        return try await withTaskCancellationHandler {
            try Task.checkCancellation()
            let session = try await attempt.connect(credentials: credentials, library: library)
            if Task.isCancelled {
                session.shutdown()
                throw CancellationError()
            }
            return session
        } onCancel: {
            attempt.cancel()
        }
    }
}

extension FriendPresence {
    init(_ presence: SteamFriendPresence) {
        switch presence {
        case .unknown: self = .unknown
        case .offline: self = .offline
        case .online: self = .online
        case .busy: self = .busy
        case .away: self = .away
        case .snooze: self = .snooze
        case .lookingToTrade: self = .lookingToTrade
        case .lookingToPlay: self = .lookingToPlay
        case .invisible: self = .invisible
        }
    }
}

/// NotificationCenter retains observer blocks, so removal follows the model's lifetime.
final class SystemWakeObservation: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let token: NSObjectProtocol
    init(action: @escaping @Sendable () -> Void) {
        token = NSWorkspace.shared.notificationCenter.addObserver(
            forName: NSWorkspace.didWakeNotification, object: nil, queue: .main
        ) { _ in action() }
    }
    deinit { NSWorkspace.shared.notificationCenter.removeObserver(token) }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Bridge/WebAuthentication.swift`:

```swift
import AppKit
import WebKit

/// The storefront whose web sign-in a window shows, and the text it shows.
enum WebSignInStore: Sendable {
    case epic, gog

    fileprivate enum Text {
        case title, host, loading, connecting, invalidResponse, network, unsupportedPage
    }

    fileprivate func string(_ text: Text) -> String {
        switch (self, text) {
        case (.epic, .title): L10n.string("model.epicWeb.title")
        case (.gog, .title): L10n.string("model.gogWeb.title")
        case (.epic, .host): L10n.string("model.epicWeb.host")
        case (.gog, .host): L10n.string("model.gogWeb.host")
        case (.epic, .loading): L10n.string("model.epicWeb.loading")
        case (.gog, .loading): L10n.string("model.gogWeb.loading")
        case (.epic, .connecting): L10n.string("model.epicWeb.connecting")
        case (.gog, .connecting): L10n.string("model.gogWeb.connecting")
        case (.epic, .invalidResponse): L10n.string("model.epicWeb.invalidResponse")
        case (.gog, .invalidResponse): L10n.string("model.gogWeb.invalidResponse")
        case (.epic, .network): L10n.string("model.epicWeb.network")
        case (.gog, .network): L10n.string("model.gogWeb.network")
        case (.epic, .unsupportedPage): L10n.string("model.epicWeb.unsupportedPage")
        case (.gog, .unsupportedPage): L10n.string("model.gogWeb.unsupportedPage")
        }
    }
}

extension WebSignInStore {
    /// Where its sign-in page keeps its cookies. GOG's site cannot be signed
    /// in from the app's token: its sign-in keeps them for its store pages,
    /// until the account signs out. Epic's sign-in keeps nothing.
    @MainActor var dataStore: WKWebsiteDataStore { site ?? .nonPersistent() }

    @MainActor func forgetSite() {
        site?.removeData(ofTypes: WKWebsiteDataStore.allWebsiteDataTypes(), modifiedSince: .distantPast) {}
    }

    @MainActor private var site: WKWebsiteDataStore? {
        switch self {
        case .epic: nil
        case .gog: Self.gogSite
        }
    }

    @MainActor private static let gogSite = WKWebsiteDataStore(
        forIdentifier: UUID(uuidString: "5C6F6B0E-3E0B-4C55-9B57-0D5B9E2A4F61")!)
}

enum WebAuthenticationError: LocalizedError {
    case invalidResponse(WebSignInStore)
    case network(WebSignInStore)
    case unsupportedPage(WebSignInStore)

    var errorDescription: String? {
        switch self {
        case let .invalidResponse(store): store.string(.invalidResponse)
        case let .network(store): store.string(.network)
        case let .unsupportedPage(store): store.string(.unsupportedPage)
        }
    }
}

/// How one storefront's web sign-in returns its authorization code.
struct WebSignIn: Sendable {
    let store: WebSignInStore
    let loginURL: @Sendable () -> URL
    /// Fixed for the protocol, including its popups, when the storefront
    /// recognizes its launcher by it.
    var userAgent: String?
    /// The code a main-frame navigation carries, or nil when it carries
    /// none; it throws when the navigation is the callback but malformed.
    let code: @MainActor @Sendable (URL) throws -> String?
    /// A page whose JSON body carries the code, never shown.
    var isJSONEndpoint: @MainActor @Sendable (URL) -> Bool = { _ in false }
    var codeFromJSON: @MainActor @Sendable (String, URL) throws -> String = { _, _ in
        throw CocoaError(.featureUnsupported)
    }

    static let epic = WebSignIn(
        store: .epic,
        loginURL: { URL(string: epicLoginUrl())! },
        // Epic uses the launcher marker to return an authorization code to
        // localhost.
        userAgent: "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) EpicGamesLauncher",
        code: EpicAuthorizationCallback.code(from:),
        isJSONEndpoint: EpicAuthorizationCallback.isJSONEndpoint,
        codeFromJSON: EpicAuthorizationCallback.code(fromJSON:at:)
    )

    static let gog = WebSignIn(
        store: .gog,
        loginURL: { URL(string: gogLoginUrl())! },
        code: { url in
            guard gogIsLoginRedirect(url: url.absoluteString) else { return nil }
            return try gogAuthorizationCode(input: url.absoluteString)
        }
    )
}

/// Owns one login attempt and its popup windows. No callback is registered with
/// the OS: only navigations made inside this attempt can complete the login.
@MainActor
final class WebAuthentication: NSObject, WKNavigationDelegate, WKUIDelegate, NSWindowDelegate {
    private let flow: WebSignIn
    private var continuation: CheckedContinuation<String, Error>?
    private var windows: [LoginWindow] = []

    init(_ flow: WebSignIn) {
        self.flow = flow
    }

    static func authorize(_ flow: WebSignIn) async throws -> String {
        let attempt = WebAuthentication(flow)
        return try await attempt.authorize { webView in
            webView.load(URLRequest(url: flow.loginURL()))
        }
    }

    /// The loader allows WebKit integration tests to use local fixture pages.
    func authorize(load: @escaping @MainActor (WKWebView) -> Void) async throws -> String {
        return try await withTaskCancellationHandler {
            try Task.checkCancellation()
            return try await withCheckedThrowingContinuation { continuation in
                self.continuation = continuation
                self.start(load: load)
            }
        } onCancel: {
            Task { @MainActor in self.finish(.failure(CancellationError())) }
        }
    }

    private func start(load: @MainActor (WKWebView) -> Void) {
        let configuration = WKWebViewConfiguration()
        configuration.websiteDataStore = flow.store.dataStore
        configuration.preferences.javaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically = true
        let window = makeWindow(configuration: configuration, primary: true)
        load(window.webView)
    }

    private func makeWindow(configuration: WKWebViewConfiguration, primary: Bool) -> LoginWindow {
        let window = LoginWindow(configuration: configuration, store: flow.store, primary: primary)
        window.delegate = self
        window.webView.navigationDelegate = self
        window.webView.uiDelegate = self
        window.webView.customUserAgent = flow.userAgent
        windows.append(window)
        window.center()
        window.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
        NSApp.activate(ignoringOtherApps: true)
        return window
    }

    private func finish(_ result: Result<String, Error>) {
        guard let continuation else { return }
        self.continuation = nil
        let closing = windows
        windows = []
        for window in closing {
            window.delegate = nil
            window.webView.navigationDelegate = nil
            window.webView.uiDelegate = nil
            window.webView.stopLoading()
            window.close()
        }
        continuation.resume(with: result)
    }

    private func window(for webView: WKWebView) -> LoginWindow? {
        windows.first { $0.webView === webView }
    }

    func windowWillClose(_ notification: Notification) {
        guard let closed = notification.object as? LoginWindow,
              windows.contains(where: { $0 === closed }) else { return }
        if closed.isPrimary {
            finish(.failure(CancellationError()))
        } else {
            closed.webView.stopLoading()
            closed.webView.navigationDelegate = nil
            closed.webView.uiDelegate = nil
            windows.removeAll { $0 === closed }
            windows.first?.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
        }
    }

    func webView(
        _ webView: WKWebView,
        decidePolicyFor navigationAction: WKNavigationAction,
        decisionHandler: @escaping @MainActor @Sendable (WKNavigationActionPolicy) -> Void
    ) {
        guard continuation != nil, window(for: webView) != nil,
              let url = navigationAction.request.url else {
            decisionHandler(.cancel)
            return
        }
        if navigationAction.targetFrame?.isMainFrame == true {
            do {
                if let code = try flow.code(url) {
                    decisionHandler(.cancel)
                    finish(.success(code))
                    return
                }
            } catch {
                decisionHandler(.cancel)
                finish(.failure(WebAuthenticationError.invalidResponse(flow.store)))
                return
            }
            // Never show the raw JSON endpoint, even briefly, if the
            // storefront returns that variant instead of its callback.
            if flow.isJSONEndpoint(url) {
                window(for: webView)?.showProgress(flow.store.string(.connecting))
            }
        }
        guard url.scheme == "https" || url.absoluteString == "about:blank" else {
            decisionHandler(.cancel)
            if navigationAction.targetFrame?.isMainFrame == true {
                finish(.failure(WebAuthenticationError.unsupportedPage(flow.store)))
            }
            return
        }
        decisionHandler(.allow)
    }

    func webView(
        _ webView: WKWebView,
        decidePolicyFor navigationResponse: WKNavigationResponse,
        decisionHandler: @escaping @MainActor @Sendable (WKNavigationResponsePolicy) -> Void
    ) {
        guard continuation != nil, window(for: webView) != nil,
              navigationResponse.canShowMIMEType else {
            decisionHandler(.cancel)
            if continuation != nil { finish(.failure(WebAuthenticationError.unsupportedPage(flow.store))) }
            return
        }
        if navigationResponse.isForMainFrame,
           let url = navigationResponse.response.url,
           flow.isJSONEndpoint(url) {
            window(for: webView)?.showProgress(flow.store.string(.connecting))
        }
        decisionHandler(.allow)
    }

    func webView(_ webView: WKWebView, didCommit navigation: WKNavigation!) {
        guard continuation != nil, let window = window(for: webView), let url = webView.url else { return }
        window.setHost(url.host)
        if !flow.isJSONEndpoint(url) { window.showPage() }
    }

    func webView(_ webView: WKWebView, didFinish navigation: WKNavigation!) {
        guard continuation != nil, let window = window(for: webView), let url = webView.url else { return }
        guard flow.isJSONEndpoint(url) else {
            window.showPage()
            return
        }
        // Evaluate only the final, allowlisted authorization response. The
        // script never runs on sign-in forms and never reads passwords/cookies.
        webView.evaluateJavaScript("document.body.innerText") { [weak self, weak webView] body, error in
            guard let self, let webView, self.continuation != nil,
                  self.window(for: webView) != nil, webView.url == url else { return }
            guard error == nil, let json = body as? String else {
                self.finish(.failure(WebAuthenticationError.invalidResponse(self.flow.store)))
                return
            }
            do {
                let code = try self.flow.codeFromJSON(json, url)
                self.finish(.success(code))
            } catch {
                self.finish(.failure(WebAuthenticationError.invalidResponse(self.flow.store)))
            }
        }
    }

    func webView(_ webView: WKWebView, didFailProvisionalNavigation navigation: WKNavigation!, withError error: Error) {
        failNavigation(webView, error: error)
    }

    func webView(_ webView: WKWebView, didFail navigation: WKNavigation!, withError error: Error) {
        failNavigation(webView, error: error)
    }

    private func failNavigation(_ webView: WKWebView, error: Error) {
        guard continuation != nil, window(for: webView) != nil else { return }
        let error = error as NSError
        if error.domain == NSURLErrorDomain && error.code == NSURLErrorCancelled { return }
        finish(.failure(WebAuthenticationError.network(flow.store)))
    }

    func webViewWebContentProcessDidTerminate(_ webView: WKWebView) {
        if window(for: webView) != nil { finish(.failure(WebAuthenticationError.network(flow.store))) }
    }

    func webView(
        _ webView: WKWebView,
        createWebViewWith configuration: WKWebViewConfiguration,
        for navigationAction: WKNavigationAction,
        windowFeatures: WKWindowFeatures
    ) -> WKWebView? {
        guard continuation != nil, window(for: webView) != nil,
              navigationAction.targetFrame == nil, windows.count < 4,
              let url = navigationAction.request.url,
              url.scheme == "https" || url.absoluteString == "about:blank" else { return nil }
        // Use WebKit's supplied configuration so popup sign-in retains its
        // opener and the same ephemeral cookie store.
        return makeWindow(configuration: configuration, primary: false).webView
    }

    func webViewDidClose(_ webView: WKWebView) {
        window(for: webView)?.close()
    }
}

@MainActor
private final class LoginWindow: NSWindow {
    let webView: WKWebView
    let isPrimary: Bool
    private let store: WebSignInStore
    private let hostLabel = NSTextField(labelWithString: "")
    private let loading = NSProgressIndicator()
    private let statusLabel = NSTextField(labelWithString: "")
    private let progress = NSStackView()

    init(configuration: WKWebViewConfiguration, store: WebSignInStore, primary: Bool) {
        webView = WKWebView(frame: .zero, configuration: configuration)
        isPrimary = primary
        self.store = store
        super.init(
            contentRect: NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 540, height: 720),
            styleMask: [.titled, .closable, .miniaturizable, .resizable],
            backing: .buffered,
            defer: false
        )
        title = store.string(.title)
        isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        minSize = NSSize(width: 480, height: 560)
        let content = NSView()
        contentView = content
        hostLabel.stringValue = store.string(.host)
        hostLabel.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 12, weight: .medium)
        hostLabel.textColor = .secondaryLabelColor
        hostLabel.alignment = .center
        hostLabel.lineBreakMode = .byTruncatingMiddle
        loading.style = .spinning
        loading.controlSize = .regular
        statusLabel.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 13)
        statusLabel.textColor = .secondaryLabelColor
        progress.orientation = .vertical
        progress.alignment = .centerX
        progress.spacing = 16
        progress.addArrangedSubview(loading)
        progress.addArrangedSubview(statusLabel)
        for view in [hostLabel, webView, progress] {
            view.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
            content.addSubview(view)
        }
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            hostLabel.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: content.topAnchor, constant: 10),
            hostLabel.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: content.leadingAnchor, constant: 16),
            hostLabel.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: content.trailingAnchor, constant: -16),
            webView.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: hostLabel.bottomAnchor, constant: 10),
            webView.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: content.leadingAnchor),
            webView.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: content.trailingAnchor),
            webView.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: content.bottomAnchor),
            progress.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: webView.centerXAnchor),
            progress.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: webView.centerYAnchor),
        ])
        showProgress(store.string(.loading))
    }

    func setHost(_ host: String?) { hostLabel.stringValue = host ?? store.string(.host) }

    func showProgress(_ message: String) {
        webView.isHidden = true
        statusLabel.stringValue = message
        progress.isHidden = false
        loading.startAnimation(nil)
    }

    func showPage() {
        webView.isHidden = false
        progress.isHidden = true
        loading.stopAnimation(nil)
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/DesignSystem/CachedArtwork.swift`:

```swift
import AppKit
import SwiftUI

/// The first of `urls` that loads, decoded at `maxPixelSize` and shared
/// through `ArtworkCache`.
struct CachedArtwork<Content: View, Placeholder: View, Failure: View>: View {
    /// Tried in order: a storefront does not publish every image of every game.
    let urls: [URL]
    let maxPixelSize: Int
    @ViewBuilder var content: (Image) -> Content
    @ViewBuilder var placeholder: () -> Placeholder
    /// Shown once every URL failed.
    @ViewBuilder var failure: () -> Failure
    @State private var loaded: (requests: [ArtworkCache.Request], image: NSImage?)?

    init(
        urls: [URL],
        maxPixelSize: Int,
        @ViewBuilder content: @escaping (Image) -> Content,
        @ViewBuilder placeholder: @escaping () -> Placeholder,
        @ViewBuilder failure: @escaping () -> Failure
    ) {
        self.urls = urls
        self.maxPixelSize = maxPixelSize
        self.content = content
        self.placeholder = placeholder
        self.failure = failure
    }

    private var requests: [ArtworkCache.Request] {
        urls.map { ArtworkCache.Request(url: $0, maxPixelSize: maxPixelSize) }
    }

    var body: some View {
        let requests = requests
        Group {
            if let loaded, loaded.requests == requests {
                if let image = loaded.image { content(Image(nsImage: image)) }
                else { failure() }
            } else if let image = requests.lazy.compactMap(ArtworkCache.shared.cachedImage(for:)).first {
                // A recycled view can display an already decoded image on its first frame.
                content(Image(nsImage: image))
            } else {
                placeholder()
            }
        }
        .task(id: requests) {
            for request in requests {
                let image = await ArtworkCache.shared.image(for: request)
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                if let image { return loaded = (requests, image) }
            }
            loaded = (requests, nil)
        }
    }
}

extension CachedArtwork where Failure == Placeholder {
    /// The placeholder also stands for artwork that failed to load.
    init(
        url: URL?,
        maxPixelSize: Int,
        @ViewBuilder content: @escaping (Image) -> Content,
        @ViewBuilder placeholder: @escaping () -> Placeholder
    ) {
        self.init(urls: url.map { [$0] } ?? [], maxPixelSize: maxPixelSize, content: content,
                  placeholder: placeholder, failure: placeholder)
    }
}

/// Shares decoded public artwork across storefronts, keyed by URL and pixel size.
@MainActor
final class ArtworkCache {
    struct Request: Hashable, Sendable {
        let url: URL
        let maxPixelSize: Int

        var cacheKey: NSString { "\(maxPixelSize):\(url.absoluteString)" as NSString }
    }

    static let shared = ArtworkCache()
    private let images = NSCache<NSString, NSImage>()
    private var pending: [Request: Task<NSImage?, Never>] = [:]
    private let load: @Sendable (Request) async -> CGImage?

    init(load: @escaping @Sendable (Request) async -> CGImage? = ArtworkCache.download) {
        self.load = load
        images.totalCostLimit = 128 * 1024 * 1024
        images.countLimit = 256
    }

    func cachedImage(for request: Request) -> NSImage? {
        images.object(forKey: request.cacheKey)
    }

    func image(for request: Request) async -> NSImage? {
        if let image = cachedImage(for: request) { return image }
        if let task = pending[request] { return await task.value }
        // A disappearing card must not cancel a download needed by another
        // card, or by the same library when the user returns to it.
        let task = Task { @MainActor [load] in
            defer { pending[request] = nil }
            guard let bitmap = await load(request) else { return nil as NSImage? }
            let image = NSImage(cgImage: bitmap, size: .zero)
            images.setObject(image, forKey: request.cacheKey, cost: bitmap.bytesPerRow * bitmap.height)
            return image
        }
        pending[request] = task
        return await task.value
    }

    nonisolated static func download(_ request: Request) async -> CGImage? {
        do {
            let (data, response) = try await URLSession.shared.data(for: URLRequest(url: request.url, timeoutInterval: 20))
            guard let response = response as? HTTPURLResponse,
                  (200..<300).contains(response.statusCode), data.count <= 32 * 1024 * 1024
            else { return nil }
            // Decode at display resolution rather than retaining full-size
            // store originals for every small card. This runs off MainActor.
            return ImageDecoding.thumbnail(from: data, maxPixelSize: request.maxPixelSize)
        } catch { return nil }
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/DesignSystem/CloudIndicator.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// What a game's Cloud indicator shows. Rust derives the persisted state;
/// this adds the live states: a sync in progress and a running game.
struct CloudIndicatorPresentation: Equatable {
    enum Tone: Equatable { case normal, warning, muted }

    /// `nil` shows progress instead of a symbol.
    let symbol: String?
    let value: String
    let tone: Tone

    /// `nil` hides the indicator. An uninstalled game shows it only while an
    /// upload is pending. A missing record means the game never synced.
    static func make(saved: CloudIndicator?, isSyncing: Bool, isPlaying: Bool, isInstalled: Bool,
                     now: Date = Date()) -> CloudIndicatorPresentation? {
        let saved = saved ?? CloudIndicator(state: .neverSynced, gameSession: false, syncedAt: nil,
                                            pendingUpload: false, installationRemoved: false)
        guard isInstalled || saved.pendingUpload else { return nil }
        if isSyncing {
            return CloudIndicatorPresentation(symbol: nil, value: L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.syncing"), tone: .normal)
        }
        let lastSync = saved.syncedAt.map { CloudSyncDate.text(Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval($0)), now: now) }
        let pending = L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.pending")
        if saved.gameSession {
            if isPlaying {
                return CloudIndicatorPresentation(symbol: "cloud", value: lastSync ?? L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.never"),
                                                  tone: .normal)
            }
            // The next launch or maintenance recovers a guard nobody holds.
            return .warning(pending)
        }
        switch saved.state {
        case .recoveryNeeded, .uploadUncertain, .localChanges:
            return .warning(pending)
        case .conflict:
            return .warning(L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.conflict"))
        case .pending:
            return .warning(lastSync.map { L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.pending_since", $0) } ?? pending)
        case .unavailable:
            return CloudIndicatorPresentation(symbol: "icloud.slash", value: L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.unavailable"),
                                              tone: .normal)
        case .lastFailed:
            return .warning(L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.failed"))
        case .synced:
            let value = lastSync.map { L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.synced_at", $0) } ?? L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.synced")
            return CloudIndicatorPresentation(symbol: "icloud", value: value, tone: .normal)
        case .neverSynced:
            return CloudIndicatorPresentation(symbol: "icloud", value: L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.never"), tone: .muted)
        }
    }

    private static func warning(_ value: String) -> CloudIndicatorPresentation {
        CloudIndicatorPresentation(symbol: "exclamationmark.icloud", value: value, tone: .warning)
    }
}

/// A Last Cloud sync reads relative for a week, then as a day and month. The
/// year appears only when it is not the current one.
enum CloudSyncDate {
    static func text(_ date: Date, now: Date = Date(), locale: Locale = L10n.locale,
                     calendar: Calendar = .current) -> String {
        let elapsed = now.timeIntervalSince(date)
        if elapsed < 60 { return L10n.string("ui.cloud.date.just_now") }
        if elapsed < 7 * 86_400 {
            let formatter = RelativeDateTimeFormatter()
            formatter.locale = locale
            formatter.calendar = calendar
            formatter.unitsStyle = .short
            return formatter.localizedString(for: date, relativeTo: now)
        }
        let style = Date.FormatStyle(locale: locale, calendar: calendar, timeZone: calendar.timeZone).day().month(.abbreviated)
        let sameYear = calendar.component(.year, from: date) == calendar.component(.year, from: now)
        return date.formatted(sameYear ? style : style.year())
    }
}

/// A game page's Cloud metric. Its menu starts Cloud maintenance of the
/// game, which is also how the player retries a failed one.
struct CloudIndicatorButton: View {
    let presentation: CloudIndicatorPresentation
    let canSync: Bool
    let sync: () -> Void
    @State private var isHovered = false

    var body: some View {
        Menu {
            Button(L10n.string("ui.cloud.sync_now"), systemImage: "arrow.triangle.2.circlepath", action: sync)
                .disabled(!canSync)
        } label: {
            GameMetricLabel(caption: L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.caption"), isHighlighted: isHovered && canSync) {
                icon
            } value: {
                if presentation.tone == .muted {
                    Text(presentation.value).foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
                } else {
                    Text(presentation.value)
                }
            }
        }
        .menuStyle(.button)
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
        .menuIndicator(.hidden)
        // Horizontally flexible so a narrow metrics row truncates the value.
        .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
        .disabled(!canSync)
        .onHover { isHovered = $0 }
        .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.caption"))
        .accessibilityValue(presentation.value)
        .accessibilityIdentifier("game-cloud-indicator")
        .help(L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.help"))
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var icon: some View {
        if let symbol = presentation.symbol {
            GameMetricSymbol(name: symbol, isWarning: presentation.tone == .warning)
        } else {
            ProgressView().controlSize(.small).frame(width: 26, height: 26)
        }
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/DesignSystem/CoverShelf.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// Where each of a page's shelves was scrolled, and how far it can go, kept
/// while a game's page replaces it. Nothing observes it, so scrolling redraws
/// nothing.
@MainActor
final class ShelfScrollMemory {
    fileprivate struct Shelf {
        var offset: CGFloat = 0
        var maxOffset: CGFloat = 0
        /// The width the cards show in, between the margins.
        var width: CGFloat = 0
    }

    fileprivate var shelves: [String: Shelf] = [:]
}

/// A titled row of covers that scrolls sideways: a swipe moves it, and the
/// arrows beside its title page through it a screenful at a time.
struct CoverShelf<Item: Identifiable, Card: View>: View {
    let title: String
    let items: [Item]
    /// Names the shelf in its memory and its accessibility identifiers.
    let id: String
    let memory: ShelfScrollMemory
    @ViewBuilder let card: (Item) -> Card
    @State private var position: ScrollPosition
    @State private var edges = Edges()
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    static var cardWidth: CGFloat { 176 }
    private static var spacing: CGFloat { 16 }

    /// Which way the shelf can still scroll.
    private struct Edges: Equatable {
        var back = false
        var forward = false
    }

    init(title: String, items: [Item], id: String, memory: ShelfScrollMemory,
         @ViewBuilder card: @escaping (Item) -> Card) {
        self.title = title
        self.items = items
        self.id = id
        self.memory = memory
        self.card = card
        let offset = memory.shelves[id]?.offset ?? 0
        _position = State(initialValue: offset > 0 ? ScrollPosition(x: offset) : ScrollPosition())
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                Text(title)
                    .font(.system(size: 22, weight: .bold))
                    .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
                Spacer(minLength: 16)
                if edges.back || edges.forward {
                    StorefrontGlassButton(systemName: "chevron.left", size: 12, label: L10n.string("ui.home.shelf_previous"),
                                          identifier: "home-shelf-\(id)-previous") { page(by: -1) }
                        .disabled(!edges.back)
                    StorefrontGlassButton(systemName: "chevron.right", size: 12, label: L10n.string("ui.home.shelf_next"),
                                          identifier: "home-shelf-\(id)-next") { page(by: 1) }
                        .disabled(!edges.forward)
                }
            }
            .frame(height: 36)
            .padding(.horizontal, ObeliskStyle.contentPadding)

            ScrollView(.horizontal) {
                // Eager: a lazy stack measures its cards late and moves a
                // restored position as it does. A shelf holds a few dozen.
                HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: Self.spacing) {
                    ForEach(items) { item in
                        card(item).frame(width: Self.cardWidth)
                    }
                }
                .scrollTargetLayout()
                // Room for a card's lift and shadow under the pointer.
                .padding(.top, 10)
                .padding(.bottom, 26)
            }
            .contentMargins(.horizontal, ObeliskStyle.contentPadding, for: .scrollContent)
            .scrollIndicators(.never)
            .scrollTargetBehavior(.viewAligned)
            .scrollPosition($position)
            // Offsets count from the first card at the margin. The shelf
            // reaches under the sidebar, so its leading inset holds the
            // sidebar's width besides the margin; the container leaves both out.
            .onScrollGeometryChange(for: ShelfScrollMemory.Shelf.self, of: { geometry in
                ShelfScrollMemory.Shelf(
                    offset: geometry.contentOffset.x + geometry.contentInsets.leading,
                    maxOffset: max(0, geometry.contentSize.width - geometry.containerSize.width),
                    width: geometry.containerSize.width
                )
            }) { _, shelf in
                memory.shelves[id] = shelf
                let edges = Edges(back: shelf.offset > 1, forward: shelf.offset < shelf.maxOffset - 1)
                if edges != self.edges { self.edges = edges }
            }
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
        .accessibilityIdentifier("home-shelf-\(id)")
    }

    /// Scrolls by as many whole cards as the shelf shows, onto a card's edge.
    private func page(by direction: CGFloat) {
        guard let shelf = memory.shelves[id] else { return }
        let stride = Self.cardWidth + Self.spacing
        let visible = max(1, ((shelf.width + Self.spacing) / stride).rounded(.down))
        let target = (((shelf.offset / stride).rounded() + direction * visible) * stride)
        withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.45)) {
            position.scrollTo(x: min(max(target, 0), shelf.maxOffset))
        }
    }
}

extension ShelfScrollMemory.Shelf: Equatable {}
```
