`apps/macos/Obelisk/DesignSystem/GameActionButton.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// A game's Game action as its page and its library's hero show it. It reads
/// the game's progress in its own body, so a progress tick redraws the button
/// alone.
struct GameActionButton: View {
    let action: GameAction
    /// Names the game a Force Quit asks about.
    let gameName: String
    /// The Force Quit its player is asked to confirm.
    @State private var asking: GameAction?

    /// A step outranks a byte-counted transfer: it has no per-file title to show.
    /// A closing game shows as a step, and so does a wait in the library, as
    /// its cards show one busy.
    private enum Mode { case idle, transferring, step }
    private var mode: Mode {
        switch action.kind {
        case .step, .running(.closing): .step
        case .waiting where action.place == .library: .step
        case .transferring: .transferring
        default: .idle
        }
    }

    /// Set while the game runs: the button then ends it.
    private var quitStage: GameQuitStage? {
        if case let .running(stage) = action.kind { stage } else { nil }
    }

    private var colors: [Color] {
        switch quitStage {
        case .quit, .closing: ObeliskStyle.quitGradient
        case .forceQuit: ObeliskStyle.forceQuitGradient
        case nil: action.launches ? ObeliskStyle.launchGradient : ObeliskStyle.installGradient
        }
    }

    private var symbol: String {
        if quitStage != nil { return "stop.fill" }
        return action.launches ? "play.fill" : "arrow.down.to.line"
    }

    private func showsProgress(_ transfer: GameTransfer?) -> Bool {
        switch mode {
        case .step: true
        case .transferring: transfer?.isInProgress ?? true
        case .idle: false
        }
    }
    private func helpText(_ transfer: GameTransfer?) -> String {
        switch quitStage {
        case .closing: L10n.string("ui.game.closing_help")
        case .forceQuit: L10n.string("ui.game.force_quit_help")
        case .quit, nil: mode == .step ? action.title : transfer?.progressSummary ?? action.title
        }
    }
    private func accessibilityText(_ transfer: GameTransfer?) -> String {
        switch mode {
        case .step: action.title
        case .transferring: transfer?.progressSummary ?? L10n.string("ui.transfer.preparing_accessibility")
        case .idle: ""
        }
    }

    var body: some View {
        let transfer = action.transfer()
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            Button { action.run(asking: $asking) } label: {
                Group {
                    switch mode {
                    case .step:
                        Text(action.title)
                    case .transferring:
                        Text(transfer?.buttonTitle ?? L10n.string("ui.transfer.preparing_short"))
                    case .idle:
                        Label(action.title, systemImage: symbol)
                    }
                }
                .lineLimit(1)
                .minimumScaleFactor(0.8)
                .frame(width: 150)
            }
            .buttonStyle(GameActionButtonStyle(colors: colors, isBusy: mode != .idle))
            .overlay(alignment: .bottom) {
                if showsProgress(transfer) {
                    GameButtonProgress(fraction: mode == .step ? action.stepFraction() : transfer?.progressFraction)
                        .frame(height: 3)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 24)
                        .padding(.bottom, 6)
                        .allowsHitTesting(false)
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)
                }
            }
            .disabled(!action.isAvailable || mode != .idle)
            .help(helpText(transfer))
            .accessibilityValue(accessibilityText(transfer))

            if action.isCancellable {
                Button(action: action.cancel) {
                    StorefrontGlassIcon(systemName: "xmark", size: 12)
                }
                .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.transfer.cancel"))
                .help(L10n.string("ui.transfer.cancel"))
                .transition(.scale(scale: 0.5).combined(with: .opacity))
            }
        }
        .fixedSize()
        .forceQuitConfirmation(gameName, for: action, asking: $asking)
    }
}

/// The game's launch button: an uppercase title on a gradient capsule seen
/// through glass, green to launch, blue to install, grey to quit and red to
/// force quit, as the library's cards.
private struct GameActionButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {
    let colors: [Color]
    /// A button showing progress keeps its color while it cannot be pressed.
    let isBusy: Bool

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        Appearance(configuration: configuration, colors: colors, isBusy: isBusy)
    }

    private struct Appearance: View {
        let configuration: Configuration
        let colors: [Color]
        let isBusy: Bool
        @Environment(\.isEnabled) private var isEnabled
        @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency) private var reduceTransparency
        @State private var isHovered = false

        private var isDimmed: Bool { !isEnabled && !isBusy }

        var body: some View {
            let label = configuration.label
                .font(.system(size: 14, weight: .bold))
                .textCase(.uppercase)
                .tracking(0.5)
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(isDimmed ? 0.6 : 1))
                .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.2), radius: 1.5, y: 0.5)
                .padding(.horizontal, 18)
                .frame(height: 44)
                .background {
                    Capsule()
                        .fill(LinearGradient(colors: colors, startPoint: .leading, endPoint: .trailing))
                        .saturation(isDimmed ? 0.35 : 1)
                        .opacity(isDimmed ? 0.5 : reduceTransparency ? 1 : 0.85)
                        .brightness(configuration.isPressed ? -0.08 : isHovered && isEnabled ? 0.06 : 0)
                }
            Group {
                if reduceTransparency {
                    label
                } else {
                    label.glassEffect(.regular.interactive(isEnabled), in: .capsule)
                }
            }
            .contentShape(.capsule)
            .onHover { isHovered = $0 }
            .pointerCursor()
        }
    }
}

private struct GameButtonProgress: View {
    let fraction: Double?
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { geometry in
            ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
                Capsule().fill(.white.opacity(0.25))
                if let fraction {
                    Capsule().fill(.white)
                        .frame(width: geometry.size.width * fraction)
                } else {
                    // Keyframes move the offset alone. A repeating animation
                    // started on appear also repeated the page's layout changes
                    // of that moment, and the bar swung outside the button.
                    Capsule().fill(.white)
                        .frame(width: geometry.size.width * 0.3)
                        .keyframeAnimator(initialValue: 0.0, repeating: !reduceMotion) { bar, travel in
                            bar.offset(x: geometry.size.width * 0.7 * travel)
                        } keyframes: { _ in
                            LinearKeyframe(1, duration: 0.9, timingCurve: .easeInOut)
                            LinearKeyframe(0, duration: 0.9, timingCurve: .easeInOut)
                        }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

extension GameAction {
    /// Runs the action, or hands it to `asking` when its player confirms it first.
    func run(asking: Binding<GameAction?>) {
        if needsConfirmation { asking.wrappedValue = self } else { perform() }
    }
}

extension View {
    /// Asks before forcing `gameName` to quit, as macOS's own Force Quit does:
    /// what the game did not save is lost. The confirmation runs the action
    /// `asking` holds. The question goes away once `action` no longer needs
    /// it, as when the game exits by itself first.
    func forceQuitConfirmation(_ gameName: String, for action: GameAction,
                               asking: Binding<GameAction?>) -> some View {
        // Read now: the alert may clear `asking` before its button runs.
        let asked = asking.wrappedValue
        return onChange(of: action.needsConfirmation) { _, needs in
            if !needs { asking.wrappedValue = nil }
        }
        .alert(L10n.string("ui.game.force_quit_title", gameName), isPresented: Binding(
            get: { asking.wrappedValue != nil },
            set: { if !$0 { asking.wrappedValue = nil } }
        )) {
            Button(L10n.string("ui.common.cancel"), role: .cancel) {}
            Button(L10n.string("model.game.forceQuit"), role: .destructive) { asked?.perform() }
        } message: {
            Text(L10n.string("ui.game.force_quit_message"))
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
import AppKit
import SwiftUI

struct GameManagementButton: View {
    let gameName: String
    let canVerify: Bool
    let canUninstall: Bool
    /// Verifies the installed game's files, repairing or updating them.
    let verify: () -> Void
    let uninstall: () -> Void
    /// The installed game's directory, revealed in Finder from the menu.
    let directory: String
    /// Opens a Windows build's launch settings; nil for a Mac build.
    var launchSettings: (() -> Void)?
    @State private var confirmsUninstall = false

    /// The menu opens while either of its actions may start, and whenever a
    /// Windows build's launch settings may change.
    private var isAvailable: Bool { canVerify || canUninstall || launchSettings != nil }

    var body: some View {
        Menu {
            if let launchSettings {
                Button(L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.title"), systemImage: "slider.horizontal.3",
                       action: launchSettings)
                Divider()
            }
            Button(L10n.string("ui.game.show_files"), systemImage: "folder") {
                NSWorkspace.shared.selectFile(nil, inFileViewerRootedAtPath: directory)
            }
            Button(L10n.string("ui.game.verify_files"), systemImage: "checkmark.shield", action: verify)
                .disabled(!canVerify)
            Divider()
            Button(L10n.string("ui.game.uninstall"), systemImage: "trash", role: .destructive) {
                confirmsUninstall = true
            }
            .disabled(!canUninstall)
        } label: {
            StorefrontGlassIcon(systemName: "gearshape.fill", size: 15)
                .foregroundStyle(.primary)
        }
        .menuStyle(.button)
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
        .menuIndicator(.hidden)
        .fixedSize()
        .disabled(!isAvailable)
        .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.game.manage_named", gameName))
        .accessibilityIdentifier("game-management-menu")
        .help(L10n.string("ui.game.manage"))
        .uninstallConfirmation(gameName, isPresented: $confirmsUninstall, canUninstall: canUninstall,
                               uninstall: uninstall)
    }
}

extension View {
    /// Asks before uninstalling `gameName`: its files are deleted.
    func uninstallConfirmation(_ gameName: String, isPresented: Binding<Bool>, canUninstall: Bool,
                               uninstall: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        alert(L10n.string("ui.game.uninstall_title", gameName), isPresented: isPresented) {
            Button(L10n.string("ui.common.cancel"), role: .cancel) {}
            Button(L10n.string("ui.game.uninstall"), role: .destructive, action: uninstall)
                .disabled(!canUninstall)
        } message: {
            Text(L10n.string("ui.game.uninstall_message"))
        }
    }

/// A game page's launch row: its launch and management buttons, then its metrics.
struct GameLaunchRow<Buttons: View>: View {
    let metrics: GameMetrics
    @ViewBuilder let buttons: Buttons

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14) {
            HStack(spacing: 10) { buttons }
            GameMetricsRow(metrics: metrics)
        }
    }
}

/// What a game page's metrics report. The row orders them as Steam does and,
/// when it runs out of width, drops the least useful ones first.
struct GameMetrics {
    var isInstalled: Bool
    var size: String?
    var lastPlayed: String?
    var playtime: String?
    var cloud: CloudIndicatorButton?
    var achievements: GameAchievementsModel
    /// How the game runs on this Mac's chip, as other players measured it.
    var estimate: PerformanceEstimates.Estimate?
}

/// A game page's metrics, under its launch button.
struct GameMetricsRow: View {
    let metrics: GameMetrics

    var body: some View {
        // The last level keeps only the controls. When even they do not fit,
        // the Cloud value truncates.
        ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) {
            ForEach(0...4, id: \.self) { metricRow(dropping: $0) }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
    }

    /// Each level drops one more metric: an installed game's size, then the
    /// last played date, the playtime and the space a game needs, which matters
    /// most before it is installed. The Cloud and achievement metrics are
    /// controls and never leave.
    private func metricRow(dropping level: Int) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 2) {
            if let cloud = metrics.cloud { cloud }
            if !metrics.isInstalled, level < 4, let size = metrics.size {
                GameMetricLabel(caption: L10n.string("ui.game.metric.space_required")) {
                    GameMetricSymbol(name: "internaldrive")
                } value: {
                    Text(size)
                }
            }
            if level < 2, let lastPlayed = metrics.lastPlayed {
                GameMetricLabel(caption: L10n.string("ui.game.metric.last_played")) {
                    GameMetricSymbol(name: "calendar")
                } value: {
                    Text(lastPlayed)
                }
            }
            if level < 3, let playtime = metrics.playtime {
                GameMetricLabel(caption: L10n.string("ui.game.metric.playtime")) {
                    GameMetricSymbol(name: "clock")
                } value: {
                    Text(playtime)
                }
            }
            if level < 3, let estimate = metrics.estimate, let fps = estimate.fpsMedian {
                GameExpectedFPSButton(estimate: estimate, fps: fps)
            }
            GameAchievementsButton(model: metrics.achievements)
            // An installed game's size moves last, where it leaves first.
            if metrics.isInstalled, level < 1, let size = metrics.size {
                GameMetricLabel(caption: L10n.string("ui.game.metric.size")) {
                    GameMetricSymbol(name: "internaldrive")
                } value: {
                    Text(size)
                }
            }
        }
        // Aligns the first metric's symbol with the launch button's edge.
        .padding(.leading, -10)
    }
}

/// The frame rate other players measured on this Mac's chip, or on the
/// nearest weaker one. It opens the game's page on getobelisk.app, with
/// every chip's numbers.
struct GameExpectedFPSButton: View {
    let estimate: PerformanceEstimates.Estimate
    let fps: Double
    @State private var isHovered = false
    @Environment(\.openURL) private var openURL

    private var value: String {
        let rate = String(Int(fps.rounded()))
        guard estimate.measuredOn != MacHardware.current.chip else {
            return L10n.string("ui.game.metric.expected_fps_value", rate)
        }
        let name = estimate.measuredOn
        let chip = name.hasPrefix("Apple ") ? String(name.dropFirst("Apple ".count)) : name
        return L10n.string("ui.game.metric.expected_fps_value_other_chip", rate, chip)
    }

    var body: some View {
        Button { estimate.page.map { openURL($0) } } label: {
            GameMetricLabel(caption: L10n.string("ui.game.metric.expected_fps"), isHighlighted: isHovered) {
                GameMetricSymbol(name: "gauge.with.needle")
            } value: {
                Text(value).monospacedDigit()
            }
        }
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
        .onHover { isHovered = $0 }
        .fixedSize()
        .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.game.metric.expected_fps"))
        .accessibilityValue(value)
        .accessibilityIdentifier("game-expected-fps")
        .help(L10n.string("ui.game.metric.expected_fps_help", String(estimate.sessions), estimate.measuredOn))
    }
}

/// A game page metric: an uppercase caption over its value, after an optional
/// large symbol. A metric that is a control highlights under the pointer.
struct GameMetricLabel<Icon: View, Value: View>: View {
    let caption: String
    private let isHighlighted: Bool
    private let icon: Icon
    private let value: Value

    init(caption: String, isHighlighted: Bool = false, @ViewBuilder icon: () -> Icon,
         @ViewBuilder value: () -> Value) {
        self.caption = caption
        self.isHighlighted = isHighlighted
        self.icon = icon()
        self.value = value()
    }

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 9) {
            icon
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                Text(caption)
                    .font(.system(size: 10, weight: .semibold))
                    .tracking(0.4)
                    .textCase(.uppercase)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                value
                    .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .medium))
                    .foregroundStyle(.primary)
            }
            .lineLimit(1)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 10)
        .padding(.vertical, 6)
        .background(.primary.opacity(isHighlighted ? 0.08 : 0), in: .capsule)
        .contentShape(.capsule)
    }
}

extension GameMetricLabel where Icon == EmptyView {
    init(caption: String, @ViewBuilder value: () -> Value) {
        self.init(caption: caption, icon: { EmptyView() }, value: value)
    }
}

/// The symbol before a game page metric.
struct GameMetricSymbol: View {
    let name: String
    var isWarning = false

    var body: some View {
        Image(systemName: name)
            .font(.system(size: 18, weight: .regular))
            .foregroundStyle(isWarning ? AnyShapeStyle(.orange) : AnyShapeStyle(.secondary))
            .frame(width: 26, height: 26)
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/DesignSystem/LibraryCoverCard.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// A game of a storefront library: its portrait cover, which lifts under the
/// pointer and then shows a glass bar holding its title and its launch or
/// download button.
struct LibraryCoverCard<Artwork: View>: View {
    let title: String
    let accessibilityLabel: String
    var help: String?
    /// The storefront the game belongs to, where a page mixes several.
    var store: LibrarySection?
    /// What the game's button shows and does. Its button reads the Transfer's
    /// progress alone, so a progress tick redraws only the button.
    let action: GameAction
    /// The game, matching this cover with the one on its page as it opens.
    let matchID: AnyHashable
    let open: () -> Void
    @ViewBuilder let artwork: Artwork
    @State private var hovered = false
    /// The Force Quit its player is asked to confirm. The card asks, not its
    /// bar, which goes as the alert takes the pointer.
    @State private var asking: GameAction?
    @Environment(\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private static var cornerRadius: CGFloat { ObeliskStyle.coverCornerRadius }
    private static var barInset: CGFloat { 8 }

    var body: some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Self.cornerRadius, style: .continuous)
        return Button(action: open) {
            Color.clear
                .aspectRatio(ObeliskStyle.coverAspectRatio, contentMode: .fit)
                .overlay { artwork }
                .contentShape(shape)
        }
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
        .help(help ?? title)
        .accessibilityLabel(accessibilityLabel)
        // The bar only shows under the pointer; its action stays reachable.
        .accessibilityActions {
            if action.isAvailable, let name = label(action.kind, title: title) {
                Button(name) { action.run(asking: $asking) }
            }
        }
        .overlay(alignment: .topLeading) {
            if hovered, let logo = store?.logoAssetName {
                LibraryCardBadge(logo: logo)
                    .padding(Self.barInset + 2)
                    .transition(.opacity.combined(with: .scale(scale: 0.85)))
            }
        }
        .overlay(alignment: .bottom) {
            if hovered {
                LibraryCardBar(
                    title: title,
                    action: action,
                    // Concentric with the card: its radius less the margin.
                    cornerRadius: Self.cornerRadius - Self.barInset,
                    open: open,
                    run: { action.run(asking: $asking) }
                )
                // A point closer to the sides than to the bottom.
                .padding(.horizontal, Self.barInset - 1)
                .padding(.bottom, Self.barInset)
                .transition(.opacity.combined(with: .offset(y: 12)))
            }
        }
        .clipShape(shape)
        .overlay {
            shape.strokeBorder(.white.opacity(hovered ? 0.3 : colorScheme == .dark ? 0.08 : 0.2), lineWidth: 1)
                .allowsHitTesting(false)
        }
        .modifier(GameCoverMatch(game: matchID, isPage: false))
        .shadow(
            color: .black.opacity(colorScheme == .dark ? (hovered ? 0.5 : 0.3) : (hovered ? 0.25 : 0.12)),
            radius: hovered ? 18 : 7,
            y: hovered ? 12 : 4
        )
        .scaleEffect(hovered && !reduceMotion ? 1.03 : 1)
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.72), value: hovered)
        .onHover { hovered = $0 }
        .forceQuitConfirmation(title, for: action, asking: $asking)
    }
}

/// What a card's button does for `title`, when it launches, downloads or ends
/// the game.
private func label(_ kind: GameAction.Kind, title: String) -> String? {
    switch kind {
    case .launch: L10n.string("ui.game.launch_named", title)
    case .download: L10n.string("ui.game.download_named", title)
    case let .running(stage): stage?.label(title: title)
    case .queued, .transferring, .waiting, .step: nil
    }
}

/// The card's glass bar: the title opens the game, the button acts on it.
private struct LibraryCardBar: View {
    let title: String
    let action: GameAction
    let cornerRadius: CGFloat
    let open: () -> Void
    let run: () -> Void

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            Button(action: open) {
                Text(title)
                    .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.45), radius: 3, y: 1)
                    .lineLimit(1)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                    .contentShape(.rect)
            }
            .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
            // The cover already opens the game for assistive technologies.
            .accessibilityHidden(true)

            LibraryCardButton(title: title, action: action, run: run)
        }
        .padding(.leading, 12)
        .padding(.trailing, 6)
        .padding(.vertical, 6)
        // Clear glass, as the Dock's, lets the cover show through; the light
        // text and its shadow keep the title legible over any artwork.
        .glassEffect(.clear, in: .rect(cornerRadius: cornerRadius, style: .continuous))
        .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
    }
}

private struct LibraryCardButton: View {
    let title: String
    let action: GameAction
    let run: () -> Void

    private static var diameter: CGFloat { 32 }

    var body: some View {
        switch action.kind {
        case .launch:
            button(symbol: "play.fill", colors: ObeliskStyle.launchGradient)
        case .download:
            button(symbol: "square.and.arrow.down", colors: ObeliskStyle.installGradient)
        case .waiting, .step:
            ProgressView()
                .controlSize(.small)
                .frame(width: Self.diameter, height: Self.diameter)
                .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.transfer.preparing_accessibility"))
        case .transferring:
            LibraryCardProgress(progress: { action.transfer()?.progressFraction }, diameter: Self.diameter)
        case .queued:
            Image(systemName: "clock")
                .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.85))
                .frame(width: Self.diameter, height: Self.diameter)
                .background(.white.opacity(0.14), in: Circle())
                .help(L10n.string("model.game.queued"))
                .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("model.game.queued"))
        case .running(.quit):
            button(symbol: "stop.fill", colors: ObeliskStyle.quitGradient)
        case .running(.closing):
            ProgressView()
                .controlSize(.small)
                .frame(width: Self.diameter, height: Self.diameter)
                .help(L10n.string("ui.game.closing_help"))
                .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("model.game.closing"))
        case .running(.forceQuit):
            button(symbol: "stop.fill", colors: ObeliskStyle.forceQuitGradient,
                   help: L10n.string("ui.game.force_quit_help"))
        case .running(nil):
            Image(systemName: "play.fill")
                .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .bold))
                .foregroundStyle(.green)
                .frame(width: Self.diameter, height: Self.diameter)
                .help(L10n.string("model.game.running"))
                .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("model.game.running"))
        }
    }

    /// Green launches, blue downloads, grey quits and red forces a quit, as on
    /// the game's page, through glass.
    private func button(symbol: String, colors: [Color], help: String? = nil) -> some View {
        let name = label(action.kind, title: title) ?? title
        return Button(action: run) {
            Image(systemName: symbol)
                .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .bold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.25), radius: 1.5, y: 0.5)
                .frame(width: Self.diameter, height: Self.diameter)
                .background {
                    Circle()
                        .fill(LinearGradient(colors: colors, startPoint: .leading, endPoint: .trailing))
                        .opacity(0.75)
                }
                .glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: .circle)
                .contentShape(.circle)
        }
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
        .disabled(!action.isAvailable)
        .help(help ?? name)
        .accessibilityLabel(name)
    }
}

/// A Transfer's progress around the card's button.
private struct LibraryCardProgress: View {
    let progress: @MainActor () -> Double?
    let diameter: CGFloat

    var body: some View {
        let fraction = progress()
        ZStack {
            Circle().stroke(.primary.opacity(0.15), lineWidth: 3)
            if let fraction {
                Circle()
                    .trim(from: 0, to: fraction)
                    .stroke(LinearGradient(colors: ObeliskStyle.installGradient, startPoint: .leading, endPoint: .trailing),
                            style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 3, lineCap: .round))
                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(-90))
            } else {
                ProgressView().controlSize(.mini)
            }
            Image(systemName: "square.and.arrow.down")
                .font(.system(size: 10, weight: .bold))
                .opacity(fraction == nil ? 0 : 1)
        }
        .padding(4)
        .frame(width: diameter, height: diameter)
        .help(L10n.string("ui.transfer.downloading"))
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.transfer.downloading"))
        .accessibilityValue(fraction.map(DownloadFormatting.percent) ?? "")
    }
}

/// A game's storefront, in glass over its cover.
struct LibraryCardBadge: View {
    let logo: String

    var body: some View {
        Image(logo)
            .renderingMode(.template)
            .resizable()
            .scaledToFit()
            .frame(width: 12, height: 12)
            .frame(width: 26, height: 26)
            .glassEffect(.regular, in: .circle)
            .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
            .allowsHitTesting(false)
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/DesignSystem/LibraryGlassControls.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// The floating bar over a library: its own controls on the leading edge,
/// such as a storefront's account, and the library's search on the trailing
/// one. On a game's page, a back button comes first and the search leaves;
/// the game's title takes the middle once its page scrolled under the bar.
/// Its backdrop only shows while content scrolls beneath it, never over a
/// hero's artwork.
struct LibraryGlassBar<Leading: View>: View {
    @Binding var searchText: String
    /// Names what the search looks through, for VoiceOver.
    let searchLabel: String
    var showsBackdrop = true
    /// The game whose page shows, if any.
    var game: GameBar?
    @ViewBuilder let leading: Leading
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    /// What the bar shows of a game's page.
    struct GameBar {
        let title: String
        /// Names the library the back button returns to.
        let libraryTitle: String
        /// Whether the page's own title scrolled under the bar.
        var showsTitle: Bool
        let back: () -> Void
    }

    var body: some View {
        GlassEffectContainer(spacing: 6) {
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                if let game {
                    // Back to the library, also with Command-[.
                    StorefrontGlassButton(systemName: "chevron.left", label: game.libraryTitle,
                                          identifier: "storefront-back", action: game.back)
                        .keyboardShortcut("[", modifiers: .command)
                        .transition(.scale(scale: 0.4).combined(with: .opacity))
                }

                leading

                Spacer(minLength: 12)
                    .overlay { StorefrontWindowDragRegion() }

                if game == nil {
                    LibrarySearchField(label: searchLabel, text: $searchText)
                        .transition(.scale(scale: 0.85, anchor: .trailing).combined(with: .opacity))
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 20)
        .frame(height: ObeliskStyle.titleBarHeight)
        .overlay {
            ZStack {
                if let game, game.showsTitle {
                    Text(game.title)
                        .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                        .lineLimit(1)
                        // Clear of the controls on both edges.
                        .padding(.horizontal, 250)
                        .transition(.opacity.combined(with: .offset(y: 6)))
                }
            }
            .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .easeOut(duration: 0.2), value: game?.showsTitle == true)
            .allowsHitTesting(false)
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
        }
        .background {
            Rectangle()
                .fill(.bar)
                .opacity(showsBackdrop ? 1 : 0)
                .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .easeInOut(duration: 0.2), value: showsBackdrop)
                .allowsHitTesting(false)
        }
    }
}

/// The store and its signed-in account, opening the account menu.
struct LibraryAccountPill<MenuContent: View>: View {
    let storeTitle: String
    let accountName: String?
    let avatarURL: URL?
    var unreadCount = 0
    @ViewBuilder let menu: MenuContent

    private var name: String? {
        let name = accountName?.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines) ?? ""
        return name.isEmpty ? nil : name
    }

    private var accountLabel: String { name ?? L10n.string("ui.account.store", storeTitle) }

    var body: some View {
        Menu { menu } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 9) {
                AccountAvatar(name: name, url: avatarURL)
                    .frame(width: 28, height: 28)
                    .overlay(alignment: .topTrailing) {
                        if unreadCount > 0 {
                            UnreadBadge(count: unreadCount, compact: true)
                                .offset(x: 6, y: -5)
                                .accessibilityHidden(true)
                        }
                    }
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                    Text(storeTitle)
                        .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                    if let name {
                        Text(name)
                            .font(.system(size: 10, weight: .medium))
                            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                }
                .lineLimit(1)
                Image(systemName: "chevron.down")
                    .font(.system(size: 9, weight: .bold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.primary)
            .padding(.leading, 4)
            .padding(.trailing, 13)
            .frame(height: 36)
            .modifier(StorefrontControlGlass())
            .contentShape(.capsule)
        }
        .menuStyle(.button)
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
        .menuIndicator(.hidden)
        .fixedSize()
        .accessibilityLabel(accountLabel)
        .accessibilityValue(unreadCount > 0 ? L10n.string("ui.chat.unreadCount", Int64(unreadCount)) : "")
        .accessibilityIdentifier("storefront-account-menu")
        .help(accountLabel)
    }
}

/// A round account picture, or the account's initials while it has none.
struct AccountAvatar: View {
    let name: String?
    let url: URL?

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Circle().fill(.primary.opacity(0.12))
            CachedArtwork(url: url, maxPixelSize: 64) { image in
                image.resizable().scaledToFill()
            } placeholder: {
                placeholder
            }
        }
        .clipShape(.circle)
        .overlay { Circle().strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.18), lineWidth: 0.75) }
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var placeholder: some View {
        let initials = (name ?? "").initials
        if initials.isEmpty {
            Image(systemName: "person.fill")
                .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .medium))
        } else {
            Text(initials)
                .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .semibold))
        }
    }
}

struct LibrarySearchField: View {
    /// Names what the search looks through, for VoiceOver.
    let label: String
    @Binding var text: String
    @FocusState private var isFocused: Bool

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 7) {
            Image(systemName: "magnifyingglass")
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
            TextField(L10n.string("ui.search.placeholder"), text: $text)
                .textFieldStyle(.plain)
                .focused($isFocused)
                .accessibilityLabel(label)
                .accessibilityIdentifier("storefront-search")
                .onExitCommand {
                    if text.isEmpty { isFocused = false }
                    else { text = "" }
                }
            if !text.isEmpty {
                Button { text = "" } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "xmark.circle.fill").foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
                .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
                .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.search.clear"))
            }
        }
        .font(.system(size: 13))
        .padding(.horizontal, 13)
        .frame(height: 36)
        .frame(minWidth: 160, idealWidth: 250, maxWidth: 280)
        .modifier(StorefrontControlGlass(interactive: false))
    }
}

/// The library's filters as one glass capsule; the selection slides between them.
struct LibraryFilterPicker: View {
    let storeTitle: String
    let filters: [StorefrontLibraryFilter]
    @Binding var selection: StorefrontLibraryFilter
    @Namespace private var namespace
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 2) {
            ForEach(filters) { filter in
                let isSelected = filter == selection
                Button {
                    withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : ObeliskStyle.selectionAnimation) {
                        selection = filter
                    }
                } label: {
                    Text(filter.title)
                        .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold))
                        .foregroundStyle(isSelected ? .primary : .secondary)
                        .lineLimit(1)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 12)
                        .frame(height: 28)
                        .background {
                            if isSelected {
                                Capsule()
                                    .fill(.primary.opacity(0.13))
                                    .matchedGeometryEffect(id: "selection", in: namespace)
                            }
                        }
                        .contentShape(.capsule)
                }
                .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
                .accessibilityIdentifier("storefront-filter-option-\(filter.id)")
            }
        }
        .padding(4)
        .modifier(StorefrontControlGlass(interactive: false))
        .fixedSize()
        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
        .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.filter.library_named", storeTitle))
        .accessibilityIdentifier("storefront-filter-menu")
    }
}

/// The library's sort order, chosen from a popover.
struct LibrarySortButton: View {
    let storeTitle: String
    let sortTitle: String
    let options: [StorefrontSortOption]
    @State private var isPresented = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        Button { isPresented.toggle() } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 7) {
                Image(systemName: "arrow.up.arrow.down")
                    .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold))
                Text(sortTitle)
                    .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold))
                    .lineLimit(1)
                    .contentTransition(.interpolate)
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.primary)
            .padding(.horizontal, 14)
            .frame(height: 36)
            // The outgoing title stays inside while the capsule resizes.
            .clipShape(.capsule)
            .modifier(StorefrontControlGlass())
            .contentShape(.capsule)
        }
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
        .fixedSize()
        .popover(isPresented: $isPresented, arrowEdge: .bottom) {
            StorefrontSortPopover(options: options.map(animated)) { isPresented = false }
        }
        .disabled(options.isEmpty)
        .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.sort.library_named", storeTitle))
        .accessibilityValue(sortTitle)
        .accessibilityIdentifier("storefront-sort-menu")
        .help(L10n.string("ui.sort.library"))
    }

    /// Applies the option with the filters' motion: the capsule resizes and
    /// the games slide to their new places.
    private func animated(_ option: StorefrontSortOption) -> StorefrontSortOption {
        let animation = reduceMotion ? nil : ObeliskStyle.selectionAnimation
        return StorefrontSortOption(id: option.id, title: option.title, isSelected: option.isSelected) {
            withAnimation(animation) { option.action() }
        }
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/DesignSystem/LibraryHero.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// A game shown wide at the top of a library, its artwork reaching under the
/// library's floating bar: Home's and each storefront's. Its text stays light,
/// with its own shadow, in both appearances.
struct LibraryHero<Artwork: View, Logo: View>: View {
    /// The game's name, read aloud as the hero's heading.
    let title: String
    let details: [Detail]
    /// What the game's button shows and does, as on its cover and its page.
    let action: GameAction
    /// Opens the game's page.
    let open: () -> Void
    @ViewBuilder let artwork: Artwork
    /// What shows the game's name over its artwork, if the artwork does not.
    @ViewBuilder let logo: Logo

    typealias Detail = LibraryHeroDetail

    var body: some View {
        // How far the artwork reaches up under the library's bar.
        let reach = ObeliskStyle.titleBarHeight
        return HeroBackdrop { artwork }
            .overlay(alignment: .bottomLeading) {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14) {
                    logo
                        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.35), radius: 14, y: 4)
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)
                    HStack(spacing: 16) {
                        ForEach(details) { detail in
                            Label {
                                Text(detail.text)
                            } icon: {
                                if let symbol = detail.symbol {
                                    Image(systemName: symbol)
                                } else if let logo = detail.logo {
                                    Image(logo)
                                        .renderingMode(.template)
                                        .resizable()
                                        .scaledToFit()
                                        .frame(width: 13, height: 13)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.6), radius: 6)
                    HStack(spacing: 12) {
                        GameActionButton(action: action, gameName: title)
                        LibraryHeroOpenButton(open: open)
                    }
                    .padding(.top, 4)
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, ObeliskStyle.contentPadding)
                .padding(.bottom, 28)
                .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
                .accessibilityLabel(title)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
                // The text fades out as it slides under the bar's controls.
                .visualEffect { [reach] content, geometry in
                    // Fully visible until its top nears the bar, gone a little
                    // past the bar's bottom edge.
                    let top = geometry.frame(in: .scrollView).minY
                    return content.opacity(min(max((top - reach + 40) / 80, 0), 1))
                }
            }
            .heroFrame()
    }
}

/// One fact of a hero's game under its logo, such as when it was last played.
struct LibraryHeroDetail: Identifiable {
    let text: String
    /// An SF Symbol, or an asset such as a storefront's logo.
    let symbol: String?
    let logo: String?
    var id: String { symbol ?? logo ?? text }

    init(symbol: String, text: String) {
        self.symbol = symbol
        logo = nil
        self.text = text
    }

    init(logo: String, text: String) {
        symbol = nil
        self.logo = logo
        self.text = text
    }
}

extension View {
    /// Frames a page's hero: a library hero's height below the floating bar,
    /// reaching up under it, light on its dark artwork in both appearances.
    func heroFrame() -> some View {
        frame(height: ObeliskStyle.libraryHeroHeight + ObeliskStyle.titleBarHeight)
            .padding(.top, -ObeliskStyle.titleBarHeight)
            .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
    }
}

/// A page's wide artwork at the top of its scroll view: it lags behind the page
/// as it scrolls, stretches over an overscroll and reaches beyond the sidebar.
struct HeroBackdrop<Artwork: View>: View {
    @ViewBuilder let artwork: Artwork
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        // How much of the scrolling the artwork follows less than the page.
        let parallax = reduceMotion ? 0 : 0.7
        return Color.clear
            .overlay {
                artwork
                    .visualEffect { content, geometry in
                        let top = geometry.frame(in: .scrollView).minY
                        let height = max(geometry.size.height, 1)
                        // Scrolled down, the artwork lags behind the page; pulled
                        // past the top, it stretches over the gap above it.
                        return content
                            .offset(y: top < 0 ? -top * parallax : 0)
                            .scaleEffect(top > 0 ? 1 + top / height : 1, anchor: .bottom)
                    }
            }
            .clipShape(OpenTopRectangle())
            .backgroundExtensionEffect()
    }
}

/// The hero's frame, open above so the stretched artwork can fill an overscroll.
private struct OpenTopRectangle: Shape {
    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        Path(CGRect(x: rect.minX, y: rect.minY - 10_000, width: rect.width, height: rect.height + 10_000))
    }
}

/// Opens the hero's game page: plain glass as tall as the game's button
/// beside it.
private struct LibraryHeroOpenButton: View {
    let open: () -> Void

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: open) {
            Label(L10n.string("ui.library.hero.open"), systemImage: "arrow.right")
                .labelStyle(TrailingIconLabelStyle())
                .font(.system(size: 14, weight: .semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .padding(.horizontal, 20)
                .frame(height: 44)
                .modifier(StorefrontControlGlass())
                .contentShape(.capsule)
        }
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
    }
}

/// The title, then its icon, as in "View game →".
private struct TrailingIconLabelStyle: LabelStyle {
    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 7) {
            configuration.title
            configuration.icon
        }
    }
}

/// The featured game's logo, or its title when its store publishes none.
struct LibraryHeroLogo: View {
    let url: URL?
    let title: String

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if let url {
                // Cached, so a game's page shows the logo its library hero loaded.
                CachedArtwork(urls: [url], maxPixelSize: 960) { image in
                    image.resizable().scaledToFit()
                } placeholder: {
                    Color.clear
                } failure: {
                    titleText
                }
            } else {
                titleText
            }
        }
        .frame(width: 360, height: 120, alignment: .bottomLeading)
    }

    private var titleText: some View {
        Text(title)
            .font(.system(size: 38, weight: .bold))
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .lineLimit(2)
            .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/DesignSystem/LibraryTile.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// One of the player's libraries on Home: its storefront, its account and how
/// many games it holds, beside a fan of its last played covers that spreads
/// under the pointer. It opens the library.
struct LibraryTile: View {
    let section: LibrarySection
    let title: String
    let status: Status
    /// The library's last played covers, the last played on top.
    let covers: [AnyView]
    let open: () -> Void
    @State private var hovered = false
    @Environment(\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    enum Status {
        /// The account's library shows.
        case signedIn(account: String?, avatarURL: URL?, games: Int, installed: Int)
        case restoring
        case signedOut
    }

    private static var coverWidth: CGFloat { 58 }

    var body: some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 22, style: .continuous)
        let palette = ObeliskPalette(colorScheme: colorScheme)
        return Button(action: open) {
            HStack(alignment: .center, spacing: 12) {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                    HStack(spacing: 9) {
                        mark(size: 20)
                        Text(title)
                            .font(.system(size: 17, weight: .bold))
                            .lineLimit(1)
                            .minimumScaleFactor(0.85)
                    }
                    Spacer(minLength: 14)
                    details
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                fan
            }
            .padding(.leading, 20)
            .padding(.trailing, 14)
            .padding(.vertical, 18)
            .frame(height: 158)
            .background {
                shape.fill(palette.surface)
                    .overlay {
                        LinearGradient(colors: [section.tint.opacity(colorScheme == .dark ? 0.2 : 0.16), .clear],
                                       startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
                            .clipShape(shape)
                    }
            }
            .overlay {
                shape.strokeBorder(hovered ? section.tint.opacity(0.45) : palette.border, lineWidth: 1)
                    .allowsHitTesting(false)
            }
            .contentShape(shape)
        }
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.library.store_accessibility", title))
        .accessibilityValue(summary)
        .accessibilityIdentifier("home-library-\(section.rawValue)")
        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(hovered ? (colorScheme == .dark ? 0.35 : 0.14) : 0), radius: 16, y: 8)
        .scaleEffect(hovered && !reduceMotion ? 1.015 : 1)
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(response: 0.32, dampingFraction: 0.75), value: hovered)
        .onHover { hovered = $0 }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func mark(size: CGFloat) -> some View {
        if let logo = section.logoAssetName {
            Image(logo)
                .renderingMode(.template)
                .resizable()
                .scaledToFit()
                .frame(width: size, height: size)
        }
    }

    /// What the tile tells of the library, read aloud as its value.
    private var summary: String {
        switch status {
        case let .signedIn(account, _, games, installed):
            return [account, counts(games: games, installed: installed)].compactMap { $0 }.joined(separator: ", ")
        case .restoring: return L10n.string("ui.account.signing_in")
        case .signedOut: return L10n.string("ui.home.signed_out")
        }
    }

    private func counts(games: Int, installed: Int) -> String {
        [L10n.string("ui.library.game_count", Int64(games)),
         installed > 0 ? L10n.string("ui.home.installed_count", Int64(installed)) : nil]
            .compactMap { $0 }
            .joined(separator: " · ")
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var details: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 7) {
            switch status {
            case let .signedIn(account, avatarURL, games, installed):
                if let account, !account.isEmpty {
                    HStack(spacing: 7) {
                        AccountAvatar(name: account, url: avatarURL)
                            .frame(width: 22, height: 22)
                        Text(account)
                            .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .medium))
                    }
                }
                Text(counts(games: games, installed: installed))
                    .font(.system(size: 12))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .monospacedDigit()
            case .restoring:
                HStack(spacing: 8) {
                    ProgressView().controlSize(.small)
                    Text(L10n.string("ui.account.signing_in"))
                        .font(.system(size: 13))
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
            case .signedOut:
                Text(L10n.string("ui.home.signed_out"))
                    .font(.system(size: 12))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                callToAction(L10n.string("ui.account.sign_in"))
            }
        }
        // Each fact on one line, a little smaller rather than cut.
        .lineLimit(1)
        .minimumScaleFactor(0.85)
    }

    private func callToAction(_ title: String) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 5) {
            Text(title)
            Image(systemName: "arrow.right")
                .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .bold))
                .offset(x: hovered && !reduceMotion ? 3 : 0)
        }
        .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
        .foregroundStyle(ObeliskStyle.accent)
    }

    /// The covers fanned out, the last played in front; the storefront's logo
    /// while it shows none.
    @ViewBuilder private var fan: some View {
        let width = Self.coverWidth
        let height = width / ObeliskStyle.coverAspectRatio
        ZStack {
            if covers.isEmpty {
                mark(size: 48)
                    .foregroundStyle(section.tint.opacity(0.35))
            } else {
                ForEach(Array(covers.prefix(3).enumerated()), id: \.offset) { index, cover in
                    // The front cover, then one on each side behind it.
                    let side: CGFloat = index == 0 ? 0 : index == 1 ? -1 : 1
                    let spread: CGFloat = hovered && !reduceMotion ? 1.35 : 1
                    let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 9, style: .continuous)
                    Color.clear
                        .frame(width: width, height: height)
                        .overlay { cover }
                        .clipShape(shape)
                        .overlay { shape.strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.14), lineWidth: 0.75) }
                        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.35), radius: 6, y: 3)
                        .rotationEffect(.degrees(Double(side * 9 * spread)), anchor: .bottom)
                        .offset(x: side * 21 * spread, y: side == 0 ? 0 : 5)
                        .zIndex(Double(3 - index))
                }
            }
        }
        .frame(width: covers.isEmpty ? 60 : width + 2 * 30, height: height + 8)
        .allowsHitTesting(false)
    }
}
```

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// A card of rows, as a game page's card, its rows divided: Settings' cards
/// and the sheets' own.

/// A row of a card: its symbol, its title over what it does, then its control.
struct ObeliskRow<Icon: View, Detail: View, Accessory: View>: View {
    let title: String
    @ViewBuilder let icon: Icon
    @ViewBuilder let detail: Detail
    @ViewBuilder let accessory: Accessory

/// A symbol, white on a tile of its colors, as System Settings shows its
/// panes: a row's at 32 points, a sheet's header at 44.
struct SymbolTile: View {
    let name: String
    let colors: [Color]
    var size: CGFloat = 32

            .foregroundStyle(.white)

            .background(LinearGradient(colors: colors, startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom), in: shape)
            .overlay { shape.strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.16), lineWidth: 0.5) }
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

/// How large a capsule button is: a row's, or a sheet's own answers.
enum CapsuleButtonSize {
    case regular, large

    var height: CGFloat { self == .large ? 36 : 32 }
    var fontSize: CGFloat { self == .large ? 13 : 12 }
    var padding: CGFloat { self == .large ? 18 : 14 }
}

/// An action on a glass capsule, as the libraries' controls.
struct GlassCapsuleButton: View {
    let title: String
    var systemImage: String?
    var size = CapsuleButtonSize.regular
    var accessibilityLabel: String?
    let identifier: String
    let action: () -> Void

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            HStack(spacing: 6) {
                if let systemImage {
                    Image(systemName: systemImage)
                        .font(.system(size: size.fontSize - 1, weight: .semibold))
                }
                Text(title)
            }
        }
        .buttonStyle(GlassCapsuleStyle(size: size))
        .pointerCursor()
        .fixedSize()
        .accessibilityLabel(accessibilityLabel ?? title)
        .accessibilityIdentifier(identifier)
    }
}

/// A button's glass capsule, for a button that keeps its own label.
struct GlassCapsuleStyle: ButtonStyle {
    var size = CapsuleButtonSize.regular
    @Environment(\.isEnabled) private var isEnabled

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .font(.system(size: size.fontSize, weight: .semibold))
            .foregroundStyle(isEnabled ? .primary : .tertiary)
            .lineLimit(1)
            .padding(.horizontal, size.padding)
            .frame(height: size.height)
            .modifier(StorefrontControlGlass())
            .contentShape(.capsule)
    }
}

/// The main action, on a capsule of the accent color. While `isBusy`, a
/// spinner leads its title.
struct AccentCapsuleButton: View {
    let title: String
    var systemImage: String?
    var size = CapsuleButtonSize.regular
    var isBusy = false
    var accessibilityLabel: String?
    let identifier: String
    let action: () -> Void

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            HStack(spacing: 7) {
                if isBusy {
                    ProgressView().controlSize(.mini).tint(.white)
                } else if let systemImage {
                    Image(systemName: systemImage)
                        .font(.system(size: size.fontSize - 1, weight: .semibold))
                }
                Text(title)
            }
            .font(.system(size: size.fontSize, weight: .semibold))
            .lineLimit(1)
            .padding(.horizontal, size.padding)
            .frame(height: size.height)
        }
        .buttonStyle(AccentCapsuleStyle())
        .pointerCursor()
        .fixedSize()
        .accessibilityLabel(accessibilityLabel ?? title)
        .accessibilityIdentifier(identifier)
    }
}

private struct AccentCapsuleStyle: ButtonStyle {
    @Environment(\.isEnabled) private var isEnabled

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(isEnabled ? 1 : 0.6))
            .background(ObeliskStyle.accent.opacity(isEnabled ? (configuration.isPressed ? 0.75 : 1) : 0.4),
                        in: .capsule)
            .contentShape(.capsule)
    }
}

/// A few actions behind a glass capsule, which opens their menu.
struct GlassCapsuleMenu<Items: View>: View {
    let title: String
    /// What the capsule shows instead of its title, such as a picker's value.
    var value: String?
    var chevron = "chevron.down"
    let identifier: String
    @ViewBuilder let items: Items
    @Environment(\.isEnabled) private var isEnabled

    private var size: CapsuleButtonSize { .regular }

    var body: some View {
        Menu {
            items
        } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 6) {
                Text(value ?? title)
                Image(systemName: chevron)
                    .font(.system(size: 9, weight: .bold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            .font(.system(size: size.fontSize, weight: .semibold))
            .foregroundStyle(isEnabled ? .primary : .tertiary)
            .lineLimit(1)
            .padding(.horizontal, size.padding)
            .frame(height: size.height)
            .modifier(StorefrontControlGlass())
            .contentShape(.capsule)
        }
        .menuStyle(.button)
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
        .menuIndicator(.hidden)
        .fixedSize()
        .accessibilityLabel(title)
        .accessibilityValue(value ?? "")
        .accessibilityIdentifier(identifier)
    }
}

/// A choice among a few values, as a glass capsule naming the chosen one; its
/// menu checks it.
struct GlassMenuPicker<Value: Hashable, Options: View>: View {
    let title: String
    let value: String
    @Binding var selection: Value
    let identifier: String
    @ViewBuilder let options: Options

    var body: some View {
        GlassCapsuleMenu(title: title, value: value, chevron: "chevron.up.chevron.down", identifier: identifier) {
            Picker(title, selection: $selection) { options }
                .pickerStyle(.inline)
                .labelsHidden()
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// Every sheet's header: its symbol on a tile, as Settings' rows show theirs,
/// its title over what it is about, and the glass button that closes a sheet
/// nothing else answers.
struct SheetHeader<Tile: View>: View {
    let title: String
    var subtitle: String?
    /// Closes the sheet; nil when its own buttons answer it.
    var close: (() -> Void)?
    var closeIdentifier = "sheet-close"
    @ViewBuilder let tile: Tile

    var body: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 14) {
            tile
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                Text(title)
                    .font(.system(size: 20, weight: .bold))
                    .tracking(-0.2)
                    .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                    .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
                if let subtitle {
                    Text(subtitle)
                        .font(.system(size: 13))
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                }
            }
            // Centered on the tile while it is a line or two.
            .frame(minHeight: 44)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            if let close {
                StorefrontGlassButton(systemName: "xmark", size: 13, label: L10n.string("ui.common.close"),
                                      identifier: closeIdentifier, action: close)
                    .keyboardShortcut(.cancelAction)
            }
        }
    }
}

extension SheetHeader where Tile == SymbolTile {
    init(title: String, subtitle: String? = nil, symbol: String, colors: [Color], close: (() -> Void)? = nil,
         closeIdentifier: String = "sheet-close") {
        self.init(title: title, subtitle: subtitle, close: close, closeIdentifier: closeIdentifier) {
            SymbolTile(name: symbol, colors: colors, size: 44)
        }
    }
}

/// A line a sheet tells in passing: a wait under way, or what went wrong.
struct SheetNotice: View {
    enum Kind {
        case progress, warning, failure
    }

    let kind: Kind
    let text: String

    private var tint: Color {
        switch kind {
        case .progress: ObeliskStyle.accent
        case .warning: .orange
        case .failure: .red
        }
    }

    var body: some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12, style: .continuous)
        HStack(alignment: .firstTextBaseline, spacing: 10) {
            switch kind {
            case .progress:
                ProgressView().controlSize(.small)
                    // Its middle on the text's first line.
                    .alignmentGuide(.firstTextBaseline) { $0[VerticalAlignment.center] + 4 }
            case .warning, .failure:
                Image(systemName: "exclamationmark.triangle.fill")
                    .foregroundStyle(tint)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
            Text(text)
                .font(.system(size: 12))
                .foregroundStyle(kind == .progress ? .secondary : .primary)
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 14)
        .padding(.vertical, 11)
        .background(tint.opacity(0.1), in: shape)
        .overlay { shape.strokeBorder(tint.opacity(0.22), lineWidth: 0.75) }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
    }
}

/// What a sheet could not load, in the middle of the space it left, and how
/// to try again.
struct SheetFailure<Actions: View>: View {
    let message: String
    @ViewBuilder var actions: Actions

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 12) {
            Image(systemName: "exclamationmark.triangle")
                .font(.system(size: 26))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
            Text(message)
                .font(.system(size: 13))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
            actions
                .padding(.top, 2)
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
    }
}

extension SheetFailure where Actions == EmptyView {
    init(message: String) {
        self.init(message: message) { EmptyView() }
    }
}

/// A titled group of a sheet's cards, as a game page's sections, smaller.
struct SheetSection<Content: View>: View {
    let title: String
    @ViewBuilder let content: Content

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
            Text(title)
                .font(.system(size: 15, weight: .bold))
                .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
            content
        }
    }
}

/// A field's caption over it, in a sheet's form.
struct SheetFieldLabel: View {
    let text: String

    var body: some View {
        Text(text)
            .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold))
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/DesignSystem/ObeliskStyle.swift`:

```swift
import AppKit
import SwiftUI

/// Shared colors and spacing for the native macOS interface.
enum ObeliskStyle {
    /// The violet of Obelisk's icon.
    static let accent = Color(red: 0.77, green: 0.235, blue: 1.0)
    static let sidebarWidth: CGFloat = 216
    static let contentPadding: CGFloat = 32
    /// The floating glass bar's height; a storefront's pages reserve the same space.
    static let titleBarHeight: CGFloat = 58
    /// A library hero's height below the bar it reaches under.
    static let libraryHeroHeight: CGFloat = 330
    /// Steam's colors to launch and to install a game, leading to trailing.
    static let launchGradient = [Color(red: 0.46, green: 0.77, blue: 0.27), Color(red: 0.32, green: 0.63, blue: 0.20)]
    static let installGradient = [Color(red: 0.28, green: 0.55, blue: 0.98), Color(red: 0.40, green: 0.38, blue: 0.88)]
    /// A running game's colors: neutral to quit it, red to force it to quit.
    static let quitGradient = [Color(red: 0.50, green: 0.52, blue: 0.56), Color(red: 0.38, green: 0.40, blue: 0.44)]
    static let forceQuitGradient = [Color(red: 0.93, green: 0.30, blue: 0.27), Color(red: 0.78, green: 0.16, blue: 0.20)]
    /// A game's portrait cover, on its library card and on its page.
    static let coverCornerRadius: CGFloat = 20
    static let coverAspectRatio: CGFloat = 2.0 / 3.0
    /// How a library moves to a new filter or sort order.
    static var selectionAnimation: Animation { .spring(response: 0.32, dampingFraction: 0.82) }

    /// How a game's page replaces its library and back, and reveals itself.
    static func pageAnimation(reduceMotion: Bool) -> Animation {
        reduceMotion ? .easeInOut(duration: 0.2) : .spring(response: 0.38, dampingFraction: 0.86)
    }
}

extension LibrarySection {
    /// The storefront's color, or Obelisk's violet for its own sections.
    var tint: Color {
        switch self {
        case .steam: Color(red: 0.40, green: 0.75, blue: 0.96)
        case .epic: Color(white: 0.85)
        case .gog: Color(red: 0.69, green: 0.43, blue: 0.91)
        default: ObeliskStyle.accent
        }
    }
}

struct ObeliskPalette {
    let colorScheme: ColorScheme

    var background: Color {
        colorScheme == .dark
            ? Color(red: 0.135, green: 0.13, blue: 0.135)
            : Color(red: 0.975, green: 0.97, blue: 0.97)
    }

    var surface: Color {
        colorScheme == .dark
            ? Color.white.opacity(0.035)
            : Color.white.opacity(0.85)
    }

    var border: Color {
        Color.primary.opacity(colorScheme == .dark ? 0.075 : 0.08)
    }
}

extension View {
    /// Shows the pointing hand while the pointer is over a clickable control,
    /// the way `cursor: pointer` behaves on the web. A disabled control, or one
    /// passed `isClickable: false`, keeps the arrow so the cursor never
    /// promises an action that cannot happen.
    func pointerCursor(_ isClickable: Bool = true) -> some View {
        modifier(PointerCursor(isClickable: isClickable))
    }

    /// `buttonStyle`, paired with the pointing hand every clickable control in
    /// Obelisk is meant to show. Prefer it over `.buttonStyle` so the two cannot
    /// drift apart: a button that opts out of the pointer should say so with an
    /// explicit `.pointerCursor(false)`, not by omission.
    ///
    /// Apply `.disabled(_:)` after this, never before — `pointerCursor` reads
    /// the enabled state from the environment.
    func obeliskButtonStyle<S: PrimitiveButtonStyle>(_ style: S) -> some View {
        buttonStyle(style).pointerCursor()
    }
}

private struct PointerCursor: ViewModifier {
    let isClickable: Bool
    @Environment(\.isEnabled) private var isEnabled

    private var pointsAtAction: Bool { isClickable && isEnabled }

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        // `.default` rather than `nil`: an unclickable control nested in a
        // clickable one must not inherit its pointing hand.
        content.pointerStyle(pointsAtAction ? .link : .default)
    }
}

struct ObeliskPrimaryButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {
    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .padding(.horizontal, 15)
            .padding(.vertical, 10)
            .background(
                ObeliskStyle.accent.opacity(configuration.isPressed ? 0.75 : 1),
                in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8)
            )
            .pointerCursor()
    }
}

struct StoreMark: View {
    let section: LibrarySection
    var size: CGFloat = 40

    private var tint: Color {
        switch section {
        case .steam: Color(red: 0.36, green: 0.64, blue: 0.88)
        case .epic: Color.secondary
        case .gog: Color(red: 0.69, green: 0.43, blue: 0.91)
        default: ObeliskStyle.accent
        }
    }

    var body: some View {
        Image(systemName: section.symbol)
            .font(.system(size: size * 0.45, weight: .medium))
            .foregroundStyle(tint)
            .frame(width: size, height: size)
            .background(tint.opacity(0.12), in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: size * 0.25))
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}
```

```swift
/// A glass panel, solid while transparency is reduced.
struct StorefrontPanelGlass: ViewModifier {
    let cornerRadius: CGFloat
    var tint: Color?
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency) private var reduceTransparency

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: cornerRadius)
        if reduceTransparency {
            content.background {
                shape
                    .fill(Color(nsColor: .controlBackgroundColor))
                    .overlay { shape.strokeBorder(.primary.opacity(0.1), lineWidth: 0.75) }
            }
        } else {
            content.glassEffect(.regular.tint(tint), in: shape)
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// The three storefronts' cards in one row, or, short of room, the first two
/// side by side over the last, which takes their whole width.
struct StorefrontRows<Card: View>: View {
    var inOneRow = false
    var spacing: CGFloat = 16
    /// A storefront's card, told whether it spans a row of its own.
    @ViewBuilder let card: (LibrarySection, _ spansRow: Bool) -> Card

    var body: some View {
        let stores = LibrarySection.storefronts
        if inOneRow {
            HStack(spacing: spacing) {
                ForEach(stores) { card($0, false) }
            }
            .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
        } else {
            VStack(spacing: spacing) {
                HStack(spacing: spacing) {
                    ForEach(stores.dropLast()) { card($0, false) }
                }
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                ForEach(stores.suffix(1)) { card($0, true).fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true) }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// A storefront on a sign-in page: its logo, its name and what its library
/// holds, leading to its own sign-in. Spanning a row, it lays out in one line.
struct StorefrontSignInCard: View {
    let section: LibrarySection
    /// Whether the storefront is restoring or signing in an account.
    let isConnecting: Bool
    var spansRow = false
    let open: () -> Void
    @State private var hovered = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var name: String { section.storeName ?? section.title }

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: open) {
            Group {
                if spansRow {
                    HStack(spacing: 18) {
                        logo
                        texts
                        Spacer(minLength: 12)
                        status
                    }
                } else {
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 18) {
                        logo
                        texts
                        Spacer(minLength: 0)
                        status
                    }
                    .frame(minHeight: 190, alignment: .top)
                }
            }
            .padding(24)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
            .modifier(StorefrontPanelGlass(cornerRadius: 26, tint: section.tint.opacity(hovered ? 0.18 : 0.08)))
            .contentShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 26))
        }
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
        .disabled(isConnecting)
        .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.home.sign_in_store", name))
        .accessibilityValue(isConnecting ? L10n.string("ui.account.signing_in") : "")
        .accessibilityIdentifier("home-sign-in-\(section.rawValue)")
        .scaleEffect(hovered && !reduceMotion ? 1.015 : 1)
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(response: 0.32, dampingFraction: 0.75), value: hovered)
        .onHover { hovered = $0 }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var logo: some View {
        if let logo = section.logoAssetName {
            Image(logo)
                .renderingMode(.template)
                .resizable()
                .scaledToFit()
                .frame(width: 34, height: 34)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
        }
    }

    private var texts: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 5) {
            Text(name)
                .font(.system(size: 19, weight: .bold))
            if let subtitle = section.storeSubtitle {
                Text(subtitle)
                    .font(.system(size: 13))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
            }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var status: some View {
        if isConnecting {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                ProgressView().controlSize(.small)
                Text(L10n.string("ui.account.signing_in"))
                    .font(.system(size: 13))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            .frame(height: 34)
        } else {
            HStack(spacing: 6) {
                Text(L10n.string("ui.account.sign_in"))
                Image(systemName: "arrow.right")
                    .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .bold))
                    .offset(x: hovered && !reduceMotion ? 3 : 0)
            }
            .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .frame(height: 34)
            .background(ObeliskStyle.accent, in: .capsule)
        }
    }
}
```
