```swift
import AppKit
import SwiftUI

struct StorefrontSortOption: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let title: String
    let isSelected: Bool
    let action: @MainActor () -> Void
}

struct StorefrontSortPopover: View {
    let options: [StorefrontSortOption]
    let dismiss: @MainActor () -> Void
    @FocusState private var focusedOption: String?

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
            ForEach(options) { option in
                Button { select(option) } label: {
                    HStack(spacing: 8) {
                        Image(systemName: "checkmark")
                            .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .semibold))
                            .opacity(option.isSelected ? 1 : 0)
                            .frame(width: 14)
                            .accessibilityHidden(true)
                        Text(option.title).lineLimit(1)
                        Spacer(minLength: 0)
                    }
                    .font(.system(size: 13))
                    .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                    .padding(.horizontal, 10)
                    .padding(.vertical, 8)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                    .background(focusedOption == option.id ? Color.primary.opacity(0.09) : .clear, in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 6))
                    .contentShape(Rectangle())
                }
                .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
                .focusable()
                .focused($focusedOption, equals: option.id)
                .focusEffectDisabled()
                .onHover { if $0 { focusedOption = option.id } }
                .accessibilityLabel(option.title)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(option.isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
                .accessibilityIdentifier("storefront-sort-option-\(option.id)")
            }
        }
        .padding(6)
        .frame(minWidth: 230)
        .fixedSize(horizontal: true, vertical: true)
        .onAppear { focusedOption = options.first(where: \.isSelected)?.id ?? options.first?.id }
        .onMoveCommand { direction in
            if direction == .up { moveFocus(by: -1) }
            else if direction == .down { moveFocus(by: 1) }
        }
        .onKeyPress(.return) {
            guard let option = options.first(where: { $0.id == focusedOption }) else { return .ignored }
            select(option)
            return .handled
        }
        .onExitCommand(perform: dismiss)
    }

    private func select(_ option: StorefrontSortOption) {
        option.action()
        dismiss()
    }

    private func moveFocus(by offset: Int) {
        guard !options.isEmpty else { return }
        let current = options.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == focusedOption }) ?? 0
        focusedOption = options[(current + offset + options.count) % options.count].id
    }
}

        .accessibilityIdentifier(identifier)
        .help(label)
    }

/// A storefront control's glass capsule, solid while transparency is reduced.
struct StorefrontControlGlass: ViewModifier {
    /// Whether the glass reacts to the pointer, as a button's does.
    var interactive = true
    @Environment(\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency) private var reduceTransparency

    @ViewBuilder
    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        if reduceTransparency {
            content.background {
                Capsule()
                    .fill(Color(nsColor: .controlBackgroundColor))
                    .overlay { outline }
            }
        } else {
            content.glassEffect(interactive ? .regular.interactive() : .regular, in: Capsule())
        }
    }

    private var outline: some View {
        Capsule().strokeBorder(
            LinearGradient(
                colors: [.white.opacity(colorScheme == .dark ? 0.24 : 0.65), .primary.opacity(0.1)],
                startPoint: .top,
                endPoint: .bottom
            ),
            lineWidth: 0.75
        )
    }
}

struct StorefrontWindowDragRegion: NSViewRepresentable {
    func makeNSView(context: Context) -> DragRegion {
        let view = DragRegion()
        view.identifier = NSUserInterfaceItemIdentifier("storefront-titlebar-drag-region")
        return view
    }
    func updateNSView(_ nsView: DragRegion, context: Context) {}

    final class DragRegion: NSView {
        override func mouseDown(with event: NSEvent) {
            window?.performDrag(with: event)
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
import ImageIO
import SwiftUI

/// Decodes downloaded artwork at display size instead of retaining full originals.
enum ImageDecoding {
    nonisolated static func thumbnail(from data: Data, maxPixelSize: Int) -> CGImage? {
        guard let source = CGImageSourceCreateWithData(data as CFData, [kCGImageSourceShouldCache: false] as CFDictionary) else {
            return nil
        }
        return CGImageSourceCreateThumbnailAtIndex(source, 0, [
            kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailFromImageAlways: true,
            kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailWithTransform: true,
            kCGImageSourceShouldCacheImmediately: true,
            kCGImageSourceThumbnailMaxPixelSize: maxPixelSize,
        ] as CFDictionary)
    }
}

enum StorefrontLibraryFilter: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable, Sendable {
    case all, installed, played

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var title: String {
        switch self {
        case .all: L10n.string("ui.filter.all")
        case .installed: L10n.string("ui.filter.installed")
        case .played: L10n.string("ui.filter.played")
        }
    }
}

        case .size: L10n.string("model.library.sort.size")

        case .playtime: L10n.string("model.library.sortMenu.playtime")
        case .lastPlayed: L10n.string("model.library.sortMenu.lastPlayed")

        case .size: L10n.string("model.library.sortMenu.size")
        }

/// How every storefront presents a game's history and size.
enum GameFormatting {
    static func playtime(_ playtime: Duration) -> String {
        let seconds = max(0, playtime.components.seconds)
        if seconds == 0 { return L10n.string("ui.game.never_played") }
        if seconds < 3600 { return L10n.string("ui.game.playtime_minutes", seconds / 60) }
        let hours = Double(seconds) / 3600
        return L10n.string("ui.game.playtime_hours", hours.formatted(.number.precision(.fractionLength(0...1)).locale(L10n.locale)))
    }

    static func lastPlayed(_ date: Date?) -> String {
        guard let date else { return L10n.string("ui.game.never_launched") }
        return date.formatted(.dateTime.day().month(.abbreviated).year().locale(L10n.locale))
    }

    static func bytes(_ value: UInt64) -> String {
        Int64(clamping: value).formatted(.byteCount(style: .file).locale(L10n.locale))
    }
}

/// Shown when the library is empty or no game matches its search and filter.
struct StorefrontEmptyLibrary: View {
    @Binding var searchText: String
    @Binding var filter: StorefrontLibraryFilter
    let refresh: () -> Void

    init(searchText: Binding<String>, filter: Binding<StorefrontLibraryFilter> = .constant(.all), refresh: @escaping () -> Void) {
        self._searchText = searchText
        self._filter = filter
        self.refresh = refresh
    }

    private var hasCriteria: Bool {
        filter != .all || !searchText.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 14) {
            Image(systemName: hasCriteria ? "magnifyingglass" : "gamecontroller")
                .font(.system(size: 36, weight: .light)).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            Text(L10n.string(hasCriteria ? "ui.library.no_games_found" : "ui.library.empty"))
                .font(.system(size: 20, weight: .semibold))
            Button(L10n.string(filter != .all ? "ui.filter.show_all" : hasCriteria ? "ui.search.clear" : "ui.common.refresh")) {
                if hasCriteria {
                    searchText = ""
                    filter = .all
                } else {
                    refresh()
                }
            }
            .obeliskButtonStyle(.bordered)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 260)
    }
}

extension View {
    /// Presents `message` in an alert and clears it when dismissed.
    func errorAlert(_ title: String, message: Binding<String?>) -> some View {
        alert(
            title,
            isPresented: Binding(get: { message.wrappedValue != nil }, set: { if !$0 { message.wrappedValue = nil } })
        ) {
            Button(L10n.string("ui.common.ok"), role: .cancel) { message.wrappedValue = nil }
        } message: { Text(L10n.message(message.wrappedValue ?? "")) }
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/DesignSystem/StorefrontScrollView.swift`:

```swift
import AppKit
import SwiftUI

/// A storefront page's scroll view. Its scrollbar floats over the content as
/// an overlay scroller, whatever the system setting, so artwork reaches the
/// window's edge and the content width never changes with the scrollbar. Its
/// content starts below the storefront's floating bar.
struct StorefrontScrollView<Content: View>: View {
    @ViewBuilder let content: Content

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            content
                .padding(.top, ObeliskStyle.titleBarHeight)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                .background {
                    StorefrontOverlayScroller()
                        .frame(width: 0, height: 0)
                }
        }
    }
}

private struct StorefrontOverlayScroller: NSViewRepresentable {
    func makeNSView(context: Context) -> ScrollerConfigurationView {
        ScrollerConfigurationView()
    }

    func updateNSView(_ nsView: ScrollerConfigurationView, context: Context) {
        nsView.configureScroller()
    }

    final class ScrollerConfigurationView: NSView {
        override func viewDidMoveToSuperview() {
            super.viewDidMoveToSuperview()
            configureScroller()
        }

        override func viewDidMoveToWindow() {
            super.viewDidMoveToWindow()
            configureScroller()
        }

        override func layout() {
            super.layout()
            configureScroller()
        }

        func configureScroller() {
            guard let scrollView = enclosingScrollView else { return }
            if scrollView.scrollerStyle != .overlay { scrollView.scrollerStyle = .overlay }
            if !scrollView.hasVerticalScroller { scrollView.hasVerticalScroller = true }
            // The scrollbar starts below the floating bar.
            if scrollView.scrollerInsets.top != ObeliskStyle.titleBarHeight {
                scrollView.scrollerInsets.top = ObeliskStyle.titleBarHeight
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
    var isPanel = true
    /// The storefront whose page it is, its tile before the title.
    var store: LibrarySection?
    @State private var browser: WebPageBrowser?

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                if !showsCloseButton || browser?.canGoBack == true {
                    StorefrontGlassButton(systemName: "chevron.left", label: L10n.string("ui.overlay.back"),
                                          identifier: "\(identifier)-back") {
                        if browser?.canGoBack == true { browser?.webView.goBack() } else { close() }
                    }
                }
                if let store { StoreTile(section: store, size: 36) }
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                    Text(browser?.title ?? placeholderTitle ?? "")
                        .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                    Text(browser?.url?.host() ?? "")
                        .font(.system(size: 11))
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
                .lineLimit(1)
                Spacer(minLength: 12)
                if browser?.isLoading != false { ProgressView().controlSize(.small) }
                StorefrontGlassButton(systemName: "arrow.clockwise", size: 13,
                                      label: L10n.string("ui.overlay.web.reload"), identifier: "\(identifier)-reload") {
                    browser?.webView.reload()
                }
                StorefrontGlassButton(systemName: "safari", label: L10n.string("ui.overlay.web.openInBrowser"),
                                      identifier: "\(identifier)-open-in-browser") {
                    // The page's own address: the one that signed it in spent its code.
                    if let url = browser?.url { NSWorkspace.shared.open(url) }
                }
                .disabled(browser?.url == nil)
                if showsCloseButton {
                    StorefrontGlassButton(systemName: "xmark", size: 13, label: L10n.string("ui.common.close"),
                                          identifier: "\(identifier)-close", action: close)
                        .keyboardShortcut(.cancelAction)
                }
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 14)
            .frame(height: 60)
            Group {
                if let browser { WebPageView(webView: browser.webView) } else { Color.clear }
            }
            .clipShape(UnevenRoundedRectangle(bottomLeadingRadius: isPanel ? 24 : 0,
                                              bottomTrailingRadius: isPanel ? 24 : 0))
        }
        .modifier(PanelGlass(isPanel: isPanel))
        .task {
            let page = await start()
            // Closed while it signed in: a code it spent would load nowhere.
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            browser = WebPageBrowser(page)
        }
        .accessibilityIdentifier(identifier)
    }
}

private struct PanelGlass: ViewModifier {
    let isPanel: Bool

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        if isPanel { content.modifier(StorefrontPanelGlass(cornerRadius: 24)) } else { content }
    }
}

/// The page's web view and what its toolbar shows of it.
@MainActor @Observable
final class WebPageBrowser: NSObject, WKNavigationDelegate, WKUIDelegate, NSWindowDelegate {
    @ObservationIgnored let webView: WKWebView
    /// Windows a script of the page opened, such as a sign-in through another
    /// site's account: they keep their opener, which reads their answer.
    @ObservationIgnored private var popups: [NSWindow] = []
    private(set) var title: String?
    private(set) var url: URL?
    private(set) var canGoBack = false
    private(set) var isLoading = true

    init(_ start: WebPageStart) {
        let configuration = WKWebViewConfiguration()
        configuration.websiteDataStore = start.dataStore
        webView = WKWebView(frame: .zero, configuration: configuration)
        super.init()
        webView.navigationDelegate = self
        webView.uiDelegate = self
        let store = configuration.websiteDataStore.httpCookieStore
        Task { [webView] in
            for cookie in start.cookies { await store.setCookie(cookie) }
            webView.load(URLRequest(url: start.url))
        }
    }

    func webView(_ webView: WKWebView, didStartProvisionalNavigation navigation: WKNavigation!) {
        isLoading = true
    }

    func webView(_ webView: WKWebView, didCommit navigation: WKNavigation!) { update() }

    func webView(_ webView: WKWebView, didFinish navigation: WKNavigation!) {
        update()
        isLoading = false
    }

    func webView(_ webView: WKWebView, didFail navigation: WKNavigation!, withError error: Error) {
        isLoading = false
    }

    func webView(_ webView: WKWebView, didFailProvisionalNavigation navigation: WKNavigation!, withError error: Error) {
        isLoading = false
    }

    /// A link that opens a new window opens in the page instead; a script's
    /// window opens beside it, above the page's own window.
    func webView(_ webView: WKWebView, createWebViewWith configuration: WKWebViewConfiguration,
                 for navigationAction: WKNavigationAction, windowFeatures: WKWindowFeatures) -> WKWebView? {
        guard navigationAction.targetFrame == nil else { return nil }
        guard navigationAction.navigationType != .linkActivated, popups.count < 4 else {
            webView.load(navigationAction.request)
            return nil
        }
        let size = NSSize(width: windowFeatures.width?.doubleValue ?? 540,
                          height: windowFeatures.height?.doubleValue ?? 720)
        let popup = NSWindow(contentRect: NSRect(origin: .zero, size: size),
                             styleMask: [.titled, .closable, .resizable], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        let content = WKWebView(frame: NSRect(origin: .zero, size: size), configuration: configuration)
        content.uiDelegate = self
        popup.contentView = content
        popup.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        popup.delegate = self
        if let opener = webView.window {
            popup.level = opener.level
            popup.collectionBehavior = opener.collectionBehavior
        }
        popup.center()
        popups.append(popup)
        popup.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
        return content
    }

    func webViewDidClose(_ webView: WKWebView) {
        popups.first { $0.contentView === webView }?.close()
    }

    func windowWillClose(_ notification: Notification) {
        guard let closed = notification.object as? NSWindow else { return }
        (closed.contentView as? WKWebView)?.stopLoading()
        popups.removeAll { $0 === closed }
        webView.window?.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
    }

    isolated deinit {
        for popup in popups {
            popup.delegate = nil
            popup.close()
        }
    }

    private func update() {
        title = webView.title.flatMap { $0.isEmpty ? nil : $0 }
        url = webView.url
        canGoBack = webView.canGoBack
    }
}

private struct WebPageView: NSViewRepresentable {
    let webView: WKWebView

    func makeNSView(context: Context) -> WKWebView { webView }
    func updateNSView(_ nsView: WKWebView, context: Context) {}
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Features/Downloads/DownloadsView.swift`:

```swift
import Charts
import SwiftUI

/// What the download queue shows of a game: its title, and its cover and
/// wide artwork once its storefront's library knows it, built when shown.
struct DownloadGame {
    let title: String
    let cover: (() -> AnyView)?
    let artwork: (() -> AnyView)?
}

extension LibraryStorefront {
    /// The queued Transfer's game, as the account's library knows it.
    func downloadGame<Cover: View, Artwork: View>(
        _ item: DownloadItem, cover: @escaping (Game) -> Cover, artwork: @escaping (Game) -> Artwork
    ) -> DownloadGame {
        guard let game = Store.game(item.game).flatMap({ library.game($0) }) else {
            return DownloadGame(title: item.name, cover: nil, artwork: nil)
        }
        return DownloadGame(
            title: game.title,
            cover: { AnyView(cover(game)) },
            artwork: { AnyView(artwork(game)) }
        )
    }
}

/// A count, as figures alone.
private func verbatimCount(_ prefix: String, _ count: Int) -> String {
    prefix + count.formatted(.number.locale(L10n.locale))
}

extension SessionStorefront {
    var section: LibrarySection {
        switch self {
        case .steam: .steam
        case .epic: .epic
        case .gog: .gog
        }
    }
}

enum DownloadFormatting {
    /// A speed in the file sizes Finder shows; nothing reads as "0 kB/s".
    static func speed(_ bytesPerSecond: Double) -> String {
        L10n.string("ui.downloads.speed", size(UInt64(max(0, bytesPerSecond))))
    }

    /// A size in the units Finder shows; nothing reads as "Zero kB".
    static func size(_ bytes: UInt64) -> String {
        guard bytes == 0 else { return GameFormatting.bytes(bytes) }
        return Int64(0).formatted(.byteCount(style: .file, allowedUnits: .kb, spellsOutZero: false).locale(L10n.locale))
    }

    static func percent(_ fraction: Double) -> String {
        fraction.formatted(.percent.precision(.fractionLength(0)).locale(L10n.locale))
    }

    static func kind(_ kind: DownloadKind) -> String {
        switch kind {
        case .install: L10n.string("ui.downloads.kind_install")
        case .update: L10n.string("ui.downloads.kind_update")
        case .repair: L10n.string("ui.downloads.kind_repair")
        case .move: L10n.string("ui.downloads.kind_move")
        }
    }

    static func storefront(_ storefront: SessionStorefront) -> String {
        storefront.section.title
    }
}

// MARK: - Sidebar

/// The queue at the bottom of the sidebar, over its game's artwork: the
/// running Transfer's game and progress, or what waits. It opens the queue in
/// a popover.
struct DownloadsSidebarButton: View {
    let downloads: DownloadsModel
    let game: (DownloadItem) -> DownloadGame
    let open: (DownloadItem) -> Void
    @Environment(\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme
    @State private var isHovered = false

    /// The ink: white over darkened artwork in dark mode, black over a white
    /// veil in light mode.
    private var ink: Color { colorScheme == .dark ? .white : .black }
    private var shape: RoundedRectangle { RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous) }

    var body: some View {
        // The running game, else the next one: resolved once per update.
        let shown = (downloads.running ?? downloads.waiting.first).map(game)
        let title = (downloads.running == nil ? nil : shown?.title) ?? L10n.string("ui.downloads.title")
        Button { downloads.isPresented = true } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                DownloadRing(fraction: fraction, active: downloads.running != nil, ink: ink)
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                    Text(title)
                        .font(.system(size: 12.5, weight: .semibold))
                        .lineLimit(1)
                    Text(subtitle)
                        .font(.system(size: 11))
                        .monospacedDigit()
                        .foregroundStyle(ink.opacity(0.72))
                        .lineLimit(1)
                }
                Spacer(minLength: 4)
                if downloads.waiting.count > 0 && downloads.running != nil {
                    Text(verbatimCount("+", downloads.waiting.count))
                        .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .bold))
                        .monospacedDigit()
                        .padding(.horizontal, 7)
                        .padding(.vertical, 3)
                        .background(ink.opacity(0.14), in: Capsule())
                }
            }
            .foregroundStyle(ink)
            .padding(.leading, 9)
            .padding(.trailing, 11)
            .frame(height: 50)
            .background { background(shown?.artwork) }
            .overlay { shape.strokeBorder(.primary.opacity(0.1), lineWidth: 1) }
            .shadow(color: .black.opacity(colorScheme == .dark ? 0.35 : 0.18), radius: 10, y: 4)
            .contentShape(shape)
        }
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
        .onHover { isHovered = $0 }
        .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.15), value: isHovered)
        .popover(isPresented: Bindable(downloads).isPresented, arrowEdge: .trailing) {
            DownloadsPanel(downloads: downloads, game: game, open: open)
        }
        .help(L10n.string("ui.downloads.open"))
        .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.downloads.title"))
        .accessibilityValue([title, subtitle].joined(separator: ", "))
        .accessibilityIdentifier("downloads-button")
    }

    private var transfer: GameTransfer? { downloads.currentTransfer }
    private var fraction: Double? { transfer?.progressFraction }

    /// The running game's artwork, else the next one's, under a veil the
    /// text reads over: darkest behind it, lighter on hover.
    private func background(_ artwork: (() -> AnyView)?) -> some View {
        let dark = colorScheme == .dark
        let veil: Color = dark ? .black : .white
        let opacity = (dark ? 0.82 : 0.84) - (isHovered ? 0.08 : 0)
        return Rectangle()
            .fill(dark ? Color(white: 0.14) : Color(white: 0.95))
            .overlay {
                if let artwork { artwork() }
            }
            .overlay {
                LinearGradient(colors: [veil.opacity(opacity), veil.opacity(opacity - 0.24)],
                               startPoint: .leading, endPoint: .trailing)
            }
            .clipShape(shape)
    }

    private var subtitle: String {
        if let running = downloads.running {
            guard let transfer else { return L10n.string("ui.transfer.preparing_short") }
            let phase = running.launching ? L10n.string("ui.downloads.before_launch") : transfer.activityTitle
            // A move's pace reads as a download's.
            let paced = transfer.state == .downloading || transfer.state == .moving
            let lead = (paced ? downloads.currentSpeed.map(DownloadFormatting.speed) : nil) ?? phase
            return [lead, fraction.map(DownloadFormatting.percent)].compactMap { $0 }.joined(separator: " · ")
        }
        if downloads.waitsForGame { return L10n.string("ui.downloads.waiting_for_game") }
        if downloads.waiting.allSatisfy(\.paused) { return L10n.string("ui.downloads.paused") }
        return L10n.string("ui.downloads.waiting_count", Int64(downloads.waiting.count))
    }
}

/// The running Transfer's progress around a download arrow.
private struct DownloadRing: View {
    let fraction: Double?
    let active: Bool
    let ink: Color

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Circle().stroke(ink.opacity(0.2), lineWidth: 2.5)
            if let fraction {
                Circle()
                    .trim(from: 0, to: max(0.02, fraction))
                    .stroke(ink, style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 2.5, lineCap: .round))
                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(-90))
                    .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.4), value: fraction)
            }
            Image(systemName: active ? "arrow.down" : "pause.fill")
                .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .bold))
        }
        .frame(width: 30, height: 30)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

// MARK: - Modal

/// The download queue, in its popover: the running Transfer's speed over
/// time, the Transfer itself, then what waits.
struct DownloadsPanel: View {
    let downloads: DownloadsModel
    let game: (DownloadItem) -> DownloadGame
    let open: (DownloadItem) -> Void

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            header
            ScrollView {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 18) {
                    if downloads.isVisible {
                        if let running = downloads.running {
                            DownloadSpeedCard(downloads: downloads)
                            DownloadCurrentCard(item: running, game: game(running), downloads: downloads,
                                                open: { open(running) })
                        }
                        if !downloads.waiting.isEmpty { queue }
                    } else {
                        empty
                    }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 18)
                .padding(.bottom, 18)
            }
            .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
            // As tall as the queue, up to a scrolling limit.
            .frame(maxHeight: 520)
            .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
        }
        .frame(width: 440)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
        .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.downloads.title"))
        .accessibilityIdentifier("downloads-panel")
    }

    private var header: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .firstTextBaseline) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 3) {
                Text(L10n.string("ui.downloads.title"))
                    .font(.system(size: 22, weight: .bold))
                    .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
                Text(downloads.count == 0 ? L10n.string("ui.downloads.empty_short")
                     : L10n.string("ui.downloads.count", Int64(downloads.count)))
                    .font(.system(size: 12))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            Spacer()
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 18)
        .padding(.top, 16)
        .padding(.bottom, 14)
    }

    private var queue: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
            HStack {
                Text(L10n.string("ui.downloads.up_next"))
                    .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                Text(verbatimCount("", downloads.waiting.count))
                    .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .bold))
                    .monospacedDigit()
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .padding(.horizontal, 6)
                    .padding(.vertical, 2)
                    .background(.primary.opacity(0.07), in: Capsule())

            if downloads.held && downloads.waiting.contains(where: \.automatic) {

                    .font(.system(size: 11.5))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            VStack(spacing: 2) {
                ForEach(downloads.waiting, id: \.id) { item in
                    DownloadQueueRow(item: item, game: game(item), downloads: downloads, open: { open(item) })
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private var empty: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 10) {
            Image(systemName: "arrow.down.circle")
                .font(.system(size: 34, weight: .light))
                .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
            Text(L10n.string("ui.downloads.empty"))
                .font(.system(size: 14, weight: .semibold))
            Text(L10n.string("ui.downloads.empty_message"))
                .font(.system(size: 12))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        .padding(.vertical, 56)

// MARK: - Speed

/// The running Transfer's download speed over the last two minutes, under its
/// current value. Hovering reads any moment.
private struct DownloadSpeedCard: View {
    let downloads: DownloadsModel
    @State private var selected: Date?

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14) {
            HStack(alignment: .lastTextBaseline, spacing: 24) {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                    Text(L10n.string("ui.downloads.speed_title"))
                        .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .medium))
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    Text(headline)
                        .font(.system(size: 34, weight: .bold, design: .rounded))
                        .monospacedDigit()
                }
                Spacer()
                DownloadStat(title: L10n.string("ui.downloads.peak"),
                             value: downloads.samples.count > 1 ? DownloadFormatting.speed(downloads.peakSpeed) : "—")
                DownloadedStat(downloads: downloads)
            }
            chart
                .frame(height: 104)
        }
        .modifier(GamePageCard())
    }

    private var headline: String { DownloadFormatting.speed(downloads.currentSpeed ?? 0) }

    @ViewBuilder private var chart: some View {
        let samples = downloads.samples
        if samples.count < 2 {
            VStack {
                Spacer()
                Text(L10n.string("ui.downloads.speed_waiting"))
                    .font(.system(size: 11.5))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                Spacer()
                Rectangle().fill(.primary.opacity(0.08)).frame(height: 1)
            }
        } else {
            Chart {
                ForEach(samples) { sample in
                    AreaMark(x: .value("time", sample.time), y: .value("speed", sample.bytesPerSecond))
                        .interpolationMethod(.monotone)
                        .foregroundStyle(LinearGradient(colors: [ObeliskStyle.accent.opacity(0.22),
                                                                 ObeliskStyle.accent.opacity(0.02)],
                                                        startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
                    LineMark(x: .value("time", sample.time), y: .value("speed", sample.bytesPerSecond))
                        .interpolationMethod(.monotone)
                        .foregroundStyle(ObeliskStyle.accent)
                        .lineStyle(StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 2, lineCap: .round, lineJoin: .round))
                }
                if let hovered {
                    RuleMark(x: .value("time", hovered.time))
                        .foregroundStyle(.primary.opacity(0.25))
                        .lineStyle(StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 1))
                        .annotation(position: .top, spacing: 4,
                                    overflowResolution: .init(x: .fit(to: .chart), y: .disabled)) {
                            Text(DownloadFormatting.speed(hovered.bytesPerSecond))
                                .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .semibold))
                                .monospacedDigit()
                                .padding(.horizontal, 8)
                                .padding(.vertical, 4)
                                .background(.regularMaterial, in: Capsule())
                        }
                    PointMark(x: .value("time", hovered.time), y: .value("speed", hovered.bytesPerSecond))
                        .symbolSize(48)
                        .foregroundStyle(ObeliskStyle.accent)
                }
            }
            .chartXAxis(.hidden)
            .chartYAxis {
                AxisMarks(position: .trailing, values: .automatic(desiredCount: 3)) { value in
                    AxisGridLine(stroke: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 1)).foregroundStyle(.primary.opacity(0.07))
                    AxisValueLabel {
                        if let speed = value.as(Double.self) {
                            Text(DownloadFormatting.speed(speed))
                                .font(.system(size: 10))
                                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            // A still Transfer's axis reads up to 1 MB/s rather than in bytes.
            .chartYScale(domain: 0...max(1_000_000, downloads.peakSpeed * 1.15))
            .chartXSelection(value: $selected)
            .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.downloads.speed_title"))
            .accessibilityValue(headline)
        }
    }

    /// The sample nearest the pointer.
    private var hovered: DownloadSpeedSample? {
        guard let selected else { return nil }
        return downloads.samples.min {
            abs($0.time.timeIntervalSince(selected)) < abs($1.time.timeIntervalSince(selected))
        }
    }
}

/// One figure beside the speed.
private struct DownloadStat: View {
    let title: String
    let value: String

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .trailing, spacing: 2) {
            Text(title)
                .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            Text(value)
                .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                .monospacedDigit()
        }
    }
}

/// The running Transfer's downloaded size, in its own body: it changes with
/// every progress snapshot, the chart only with each speed sample.
private struct DownloadedStat: View {
    let downloads: DownloadsModel

    var body: some View {
        DownloadStat(title: L10n.string("ui.downloads.downloaded"),
                     value: downloads.currentTransfer.map { DownloadFormatting.size($0.contentBytes) } ?? "—")
    }
}

// MARK: - Transfers

/// A queued game's cover, or a quiet stand-in until its library knows it.
private struct DownloadCover: View {
    let game: DownloadGame
    let width: CGFloat

    var body: some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: width * 0.14, style: .continuous)
        Group {
            if let cover = game.cover { cover() } else {
                Image(systemName: "gamecontroller")
                    .font(.system(size: width * 0.32))
                    .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                    .background(.primary.opacity(0.06))
            }
        }
        .frame(width: width, height: width / ObeliskStyle.coverAspectRatio)
        .clipShape(shape)
        .overlay { shape.strokeBorder(.primary.opacity(0.1), lineWidth: 1) }
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

/// The Transfer under way: its game, its progress and what it does.
private struct DownloadCurrentCard: View {
    let item: DownloadItem
    let game: DownloadGame
    let downloads: DownloadsModel
    let open: () -> Void

    /// Read here, so progress updates this card rather than the whole panel.
    private var transfer: GameTransfer? { downloads.currentTransfer }

    var body: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .center, spacing: 16) {
            Button(action: open) { DownloadCover(game: game, width: 60) }
                .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
                .help(L10n.string("ui.downloads.show_game"))
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                HStack(spacing: 8) {
                    Text(game.title)
                        .font(.system(size: 15, weight: .semibold))
                        .lineLimit(1)
                    DownloadBadge(text: item.launching ? L10n.string("ui.downloads.before_launch")
                                  : DownloadFormatting.kind(item.kind), prominent: true)
                }
                HStack {
                    Text(phase)
                    Spacer()
                    if let fraction = transfer?.progressFraction {
                        Text(DownloadFormatting.percent(fraction)).fontWeight(.semibold)
                    }
                }
                .font(.system(size: 11.5))
                .monospacedDigit()
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                DownloadProgressBar(fraction: transfer?.progressFraction)
                Text(detail)
                    .font(.system(size: 11))
                    .monospacedDigit()
                    .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
                    .lineLimit(1)
            }
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                if !item.launching {
                    StorefrontGlassButton(systemName: "pause.fill", size: 12, label: L10n.string("ui.downloads.pause"),
                                          identifier: "downloads-pause") { downloads.pause(item) }
                }
                StorefrontGlassButton(systemName: "xmark", size: 12, label: L10n.string("ui.downloads.remove"),
                                      identifier: "downloads-cancel") { downloads.remove(item) }
            }
        }
        .modifier(GamePageCard())
        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
        .accessibilityLabel(game.title)
    }

    private var phase: String {
        guard let transfer else { return L10n.string("ui.transfer.preparing_short") }
        return transfer.activityTitle
    }

    private var detail: String {
        guard let transfer else { return DownloadFormatting.storefront(item.storefront) }
        return [
            DownloadFormatting.storefront(item.storefront),
            transfer.countedFilesText,
            transfer.downloadedGameDataText,
        ]
        .compactMap { $0 }
        .joined(separator: " · ")
    }
}

/// One waiting Transfer, its controls showing on hover.
private struct DownloadQueueRow: View {
    let item: DownloadItem
    let game: DownloadGame
    let downloads: DownloadsModel
    let open: () -> Void
    @State private var isHovered = false

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            DownloadCover(game: game, width: 30)
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 3) {
                Text(game.title)
                    .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .medium))
                    .lineLimit(1)
                Text(subtitle)
                    .font(.system(size: 11))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .lineLimit(1)
            }
            Spacer(minLength: 8)
            if item.paused { DownloadBadge(text: L10n.string("ui.downloads.paused"), prominent: false) }
            HStack(spacing: 4) {
                if downloads.waiting.first?.id != item.id && !item.launching {
                    rowButton("arrow.up.to.line", L10n.string("ui.downloads.move_to_top")) { downloads.moveToTop(item) }
                }
                if !item.launching {
                    if item.paused {
                        rowButton("play.fill", L10n.string("ui.downloads.resume")) { downloads.resume(item) }
                    } else {
                        rowButton("pause.fill", L10n.string("ui.downloads.pause")) { downloads.pause(item) }
                    }
                }
                rowButton("xmark", L10n.string("ui.downloads.remove")) { downloads.remove(item) }
            }
            .opacity(isHovered ? 1 : 0.35)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 10)
        .padding(.vertical, 8)
        .background(.primary.opacity(isHovered ? 0.05 : 0), in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12, style: .continuous))
        .contentShape(.rect)
        .onHover { isHovered = $0 }
        .onTapGesture(count: 2, perform: open)
        .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.12), value: isHovered)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
        .accessibilityLabel([game.title, subtitle].joined(separator: ", "))
    }

    private var subtitle: String {
        [
            DownloadFormatting.kind(item.kind),
            DownloadFormatting.storefront(item.storefront),
            item.automatic ? L10n.string("ui.downloads.automatic") : nil,
            downloads.held && item.automatic ? L10n.string("ui.downloads.waiting_for_game") : nil,
        ]
        .compactMap { $0 }
        .joined(separator: " · ")
    }

    private func rowButton(_ symbol: String, _ label: String, action: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Image(systemName: symbol)
                .font(.system(size: 10.5, weight: .bold))
                .frame(width: 26, height: 26)
                .background(.primary.opacity(0.07), in: Circle())
                .contentShape(.circle)
        }
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        .help(label)
        .accessibilityLabel(label)
    }
}

private struct DownloadBadge: View {
    let text: String
    let prominent: Bool

    var body: some View {
        Text(text)
            .font(.system(size: 10, weight: .semibold))
            .foregroundStyle(prominent ? ObeliskStyle.accent : .secondary)
            .padding(.horizontal, 7)
            .padding(.vertical, 2.5)
            .background((prominent ? ObeliskStyle.accent : Color.primary).opacity(prominent ? 0.13 : 0.07), in: Capsule())
            .lineLimit(1)
            .fixedSize()
    }
}

/// A thin track the progress fills; indeterminate while unknown.
private struct DownloadProgressBar: View {
    let fraction: Double?

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { proxy in
            ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
                Capsule().fill(.primary.opacity(0.08))
                if let fraction {
                    Capsule()
                        .fill(LinearGradient(colors: [ObeliskStyle.accent.opacity(0.85), ObeliskStyle.accent],
                                             startPoint: .leading, endPoint: .trailing))
                        .frame(width: max(6, proxy.size.width * fraction))
                        .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.4), value: fraction)
                }
            }
        }
        .frame(height: 6)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}
```

```swift
            heroLogo: Self.heroLogo,
            artwork: Self.cover
        ) {

        }
    }

    }

    static func heroLogo(_ game: EpicGame) -> EmptyView { EmptyView() }

    }

        Divider()
        Button(L10n.string("ui.account.sign_out"), systemImage: "rectangle.portrait.and.arrow.right", action: model.signOut)
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Features/GOG/GogGameDetailView.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

struct GogGameDetailView: View {
    @Bindable var model: GogModel
    let game: GogGame
    let context: GamePageContext<StorefrontArtwork, StorefrontArtwork>

    private var installations: GogInstallations { model.installations }

    var body: some View {
        GameDetailPage(
            model: model,
            game: game,
            context: context,
            size: (installations.selectedReceipt?.totalBytes ?? model.selectedGameDetails?.installationBytes)
                .map(GameFormatting.bytes)
        ) {
            GameOperationStatus(installations: installations, game: game.productId)
            GameAboutSection(summary: game.summary, facts: facts)
        }
    }

    /// What gamesdb tells of the game, in the player's language where it can.
    private var facts: [GameAboutSection.Fact] {
        var facts: [GameAboutSection.Fact] = []
        func add(_ key: String, _ values: [String]) {
            let values = values.filter { !$0.isEmpty }
            guard !values.isEmpty else { return }
            facts.append(.init(label: L10n.string(key), value: values.formatted(.list(type: .and).locale(L10n.locale))))
        }
        add("ui.game.developer", game.developers)
        add("ui.game.publisher", game.publishers)
        if let released = game.releaseDate {
            var style = Date.FormatStyle(date: .long, time: .omitted, locale: L10n.locale)
            // gamesdb dates a release at midnight UTC.
            style.timeZone = .gmt
            add("ui.game.release_date", [Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval(released)).formatted(style)])
        }
        add("ui.game.genres", game.genres)
        if let rating = game.rating {
            add("ui.game.rating", [L10n.string("ui.game.rating_value", Int64(rating))])
        }
        add("ui.game.languages", languages)
        return facts
    }

    /// The game's languages, named in the player's language, once each.
    private var languages: [String] {
        var seen = Set<String>()
        return game.languages.compactMap { code in
            let language = Locale(identifier: code).language.languageCode?.identifier ?? code
            guard seen.insert(language).inserted else { return nil }
            return L10n.locale.localizedString(forLanguageCode: language)
        }
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Features/GameDetailPage.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// A storefront's game page: the game's wide artwork reaching under the
/// browser's glass bar, its cover overlapping the artwork's lower edge, its
/// launch row and metrics beside the cover, then what only the storefront shows.
/// Opened from the library, the page reveals itself around the cover flying
/// in: the artwork settles, then the header and the content rise.
struct GameDetailPage<Model: LibraryStorefront, HeroArtwork: View, Cover: View, Content: View>: View {
    @Bindable var model: Model
    let game: Model.Game
    let size: String?
    /// Whether a game never played says so, rather than showing no last
    /// played date and no playtime.
    let showsUnplayed: Bool
    private let context: GamePageContext<HeroArtwork, Cover>
    private let content: Content
    @State private var appeared = false
    /// The launch settings sheet of the installed Windows build, while open.
    @State private var launchSettings: LaunchSettingsModel?
    @State private var isCompact = false
    @Environment(\.gameTransition) private var transition
    @Environment(\.storefrontBar) private var bar
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme
    @Environment(PerformanceEstimates.self) private var estimates: PerformanceEstimates?

    /// The artwork's height below the bar it reaches under, as a library hero's.
    private static var heroHeight: CGFloat { ObeliskStyle.libraryHeroHeight }
    /// How much of the cover rises over the artwork.
    private static var coverOverlap: CGFloat { 150 }

    init(
        model: Model,
        game: Model.Game,
        context: GamePageContext<HeroArtwork, Cover>,
        size: String?,
        showsUnplayed: Bool = false,
        @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content
    ) {
        self.model = model
        self.game = game
        self.context = context
        self.size = size
        self.showsUnplayed = showsUnplayed
        self.content = content()
    }

    private var installations: GameInstallations<Model.Store> { model.installations }
    private var name: String { game.title }

    /// Whether the page shows whole: at once, unless it opened with motion.
    private var isRevealed: Bool { appeared || transition?.source == nil }

    /// One step of the page's reveal, `delay` seconds after the cover leaves.
    private func reveal(_ delay: Double) -> Animation? {
        guard transition?.source != nil else { return nil }
        return reduceMotion ? .easeOut(duration: 0.2) : ObeliskStyle.pageAnimation(reduceMotion: false).delay(delay)
    }

    var body: some View {
        @Bindable var achievements = model.achievements
        return StorefrontScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                hero
                header
                details
                    .opacity(isRevealed ? 1 : 0)
                    .offset(y: isRevealed || reduceMotion ? 0 : 36)
                    .animation(reveal(0.1), value: isRevealed)
            }
        }
        // The bar's backdrop shows once the artwork scrolled under it, and the
        // game's title once its own scrolled past the bar.
        .onScrollGeometryChange(for: Bool.self, of: { $0.contentOffset.y + $0.contentInsets.top > Self.heroHeight }) { _, under in
            bar?.showsBackdrop = under
        }
        .onScrollGeometryChange(
            for: Bool.self,
            of: { $0.contentOffset.y + $0.contentInsets.top > Self.heroHeight - 40 }
        ) { _, scrolled in
            bar?.showsGameTitle = scrolled
        }
        .onGeometryChange(for: Bool.self, of: { $0.size.width < 760 }) { isCompact = $0 }
        // Hides the library beneath while the page is revealed, and leaving.
        .background {
            ObeliskPalette(colorScheme: colorScheme).background
                .opacity(isRevealed ? 1 : 0)
                .animation(reveal(0), value: isRevealed)
                .ignoresSafeArea()
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea(.container, edges: .top)
        .onAppear {
            appeared = true
            estimates?.refresh()
        }
        .sheet(isPresented: $achievements.isPresented) {
            GameAchievementsView(model: achievements, gameName: name, retry: model.reloadAchievements)
        }
        .sheet(item: $launchSettings) { LaunchSettingsSheet(model: $0, gameName: name) }
    }

    private var hero: some View {
        HeroBackdrop {
            context.heroArtwork
                // The artwork settles from a little closer as it sharpens.
                .scaleEffect(isRevealed || reduceMotion ? 1 : 1.08)
                .blur(radius: isRevealed || reduceMotion ? 0 : 16)
                .opacity(isRevealed ? 1 : 0)
                .animation(reveal(0), value: isRevealed)
        }
        .heroFrame()
    }

    /// The cover overlapping the artwork, then its launch row and metrics
    /// beside it, below the artwork.
    private var header: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: isCompact ? 20 : 28) {
            coverView
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                // The part of the cover over the artwork.
                Color.clear.frame(height: Self.coverOverlap)
                GameLaunchRow(metrics: metrics) {
                    GamePageAction(installations: installations, gameName: name)
                    if let id = Model.Store.storeGameID(game.id) {
                        GameReportButton(subject: .game(store: Model.Store.storefront, id: id, name: name),
                                         gameName: name)
                    }
                    if let receipt = installations.selectedReceipt {
                        GameManagementButton(
                            gameName: name,
                            canVerify: installations.canVerifySelectedGame,
                            canUninstall: installations.canUninstallSelectedGame,
                            verify: { installations.verify(receipt) },
                            uninstall: { installations.uninstall(receipt) },
                            directory: receipt.directory,
                            launchSettings: receipt.platform == .mac ? nil : {
                                launchSettings = LaunchSettingsModel(
                                    load: { [installations] in try await installations.launchSettings(receipt) },
                                    save: { [installations] in
                                        try await installations.setLaunchSettings(receipt, choices: $0)
                                    }
                                )
                            }
                        )
                        .id(receipt.id + receipt.directory)
                    }
                }
                .padding(.top, 18)
                .opacity(isRevealed ? 1 : 0)
                .offset(y: isRevealed || reduceMotion ? 0 : 24)
                .animation(reveal(0.07), value: isRevealed)
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, ObeliskStyle.contentPadding)
        .padding(.top, -Self.coverOverlap)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
    }

    private var coverView: some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: ObeliskStyle.coverCornerRadius, style: .continuous)
        // A cover flown from the library shows whole all along; one opened
        // from the hero rises into place with the header.
        let flies = transition?.source == .cover && !reduceMotion
        let shown = isRevealed || flies
        return Color.clear
            .aspectRatio(ObeliskStyle.coverAspectRatio, contentMode: .fit)
            .overlay { context.cover }
            .clipShape(shape)
            .overlay {
                shape.strokeBorder(.white.opacity(colorScheme == .dark ? 0.12 : 0.3), lineWidth: 1)
                    .allowsHitTesting(false)
            }
            .modifier(GameCoverMatch(game: AnyHashable(game.id), isPage: true))
            .frame(width: isCompact ? 150 : 190)
            .shadow(color: .black.opacity(colorScheme == .dark ? 0.5 : 0.3), radius: 24, y: 14)
            .opacity(shown ? 1 : 0)
            .scaleEffect(shown || reduceMotion ? 1 : 0.9, anchor: .bottom)
            .offset(y: shown || reduceMotion ? 0 : 30)
            .animation(flies ? nil : reveal(0.03), value: shown)
            // The page's heading: the artwork shows no name.
            .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
            .accessibilityLabel(name)
            .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
    }

    private var lastPlayed: String? {
        let date = model.library.lastPlayed(of: game)
        return showsUnplayed ? GameFormatting.lastPlayed(date) : date.map(GameFormatting.lastPlayed)
    }

    private var playtime: String? {
        let playtime = model.library.playtime(of: game)
        return showsUnplayed ? GameFormatting.playtime(playtime ?? .zero) : playtime.map(GameFormatting.playtime)
    }
    private var metrics: GameMetrics {
        GameMetrics(
            isInstalled: installations.selectedReceipt != nil,
            size: size,
            lastPlayed: lastPlayed,
            playtime: playtime,
            cloud: installations.cloudIndicator.map {
                CloudIndicatorButton(presentation: $0, canSync: installations.canSyncCloud, sync: model.syncCloud)
            },
            achievements: model.achievements,
            estimate: Model.Store.storeGameID(game.id).flatMap { estimates?.estimate(store: Model.Store.storefront, id: $0) }
        )
    }

    /// Notices, then what only the storefront shows of the game.
    private var details: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 26) {
            StorefrontWarningBanner(message: $model.storageWarning)
            if model.cloud.failurePresented {
                SteamCloudFailureView(model: model, storefront: context.storeID)
            }
            if let message = model.gameSessionMessage {
                Text(message).font(.system(size: 12)).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            content
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, ObeliskStyle.contentPadding)
        .padding(.top, 34)
        .padding(.bottom, 40)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
    }
}

/// The game's Game action. It reads the action in its own body, and its button
/// the progress, so neither redraws the page.
private struct GamePageAction<Store: InstallationStorefront>: View {
    let installations: GameInstallations<Store>
    let gameName: String

    var body: some View {
        if let action = installations.selectedAction {
            GameActionButton(action: action, gameName: gameName)
        }
    }
}

/// Reports a game's failed or cancelled Transfer, or another game's operation
/// holding the storefront.
struct GameOperationStatus<Store: InstallationStorefront>: View {
    let installations: GameInstallations<Store>
    let game: Store.GameID

    var body: some View {
        if let message {
            Text(message).font(.system(size: 12)).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
    }

    private var message: String? {
        if let transfer = installations.transfer(for: game), transfer.state == .failed || transfer.state == .cancelled {
            return transfer.message.isEmpty ? transfer.activityTitle : L10n.message(transfer.message)
        }
        // Another game's operation matters only when it keeps this one waiting.
        if let activeGame = installations.activeTransferGame ?? installations.launchGame, activeGame != game,
           installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable != true {
            return L10n.string(Store.otherGameOperation)
        }
        return nil
    }
}

/// A titled section of a game's page.
struct GamePageSection<Content: View>: View {
    let title: String
    @ViewBuilder let content: Content

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
            Text(title)
                .font(.system(size: 22, weight: .bold))
                .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
            content
        }
    }
}

/// A game page's card: a rounded surface, concentric with the covers.
struct GamePageCard: ViewModifier {
    let padding: CGFloat
    @Environment(\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme

    init(padding: CGFloat = 18) {
        self.padding = padding
    }

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        let palette = ObeliskPalette(colorScheme: colorScheme)
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 18, style: .continuous)
        content
            .padding(padding)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .background(palette.surface, in: shape)
            .overlay { shape.strokeBorder(palette.border, lineWidth: 1).allowsHitTesting(false) }
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Features/Home/HomeGame.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// A game of any of the player's storefronts, as Home shows it beside the
/// other storefronts' games: what orders and names it, what its cover and hero
/// show, and what its buttons do.
@MainActor
struct HomeGame: Identifiable {
    /// The game within its storefront's library.
    struct ID: Hashable, Sendable {
        let section: LibrarySection
        let game: String
    }

    /// A storefront game's wide artwork and what names the game over it.
    struct Hero {
        let artwork: () -> AnyView
        let logo: () -> AnyView
    }

    let id: ID
    let title: String
    let lastPlayed: Date?
    let playtime: Duration?
    /// What the game's card and hero buttons show and do.
    let action: GameAction
    let cover: () -> AnyView
    let hero: Hero
    /// Opens the game's page in its storefront.
    let open: () -> Void
}

/// One account's library as Home shows it, built only for the games Home lists.
@MainActor
struct HomeLibrary {
    let featured: HomeGame?
    /// Its played games, the last played first: one more than a shelf holds,
    /// as the hero may be one of them.
    let recent: [HomeGame]
    /// Its installed games, the last played first.
    let installed: [HomeGame]
    /// The first games of its last played order, as its tile shows them.
    let covers: [HomeGame]
    let count: Int
}

extension HomeGame {
    /// `game` of `library`, named, dated and timed as the library knows it.
    init<Store, Game>(_ game: Game, of library: AccountLibrary<Store, Game>, in section: LibrarySection,
                      action: GameAction, cover: @escaping () -> AnyView, hero: Hero, open: @escaping () -> Void) {
        self.init(id: ID(section: section, game: "\(game.id)"), title: game.title,
                  lastPlayed: library.lastPlayed(of: game), playtime: library.playtime(of: game),
                  action: action, cover: cover, hero: hero, open: open)
    }
}

extension HomeLibrary {
    /// `library` as Home shows it; `home` makes each game Home lists.
    init<Store, Game>(_ library: AccountLibrary<Store, Game>, home: (Game) -> HomeGame) {
        let order = library.games(by: .lastPlayed)
        self.init(
            featured: library.featured.map(home),
            recent: order.prefix { library.lastPlayed(of: $0) != nil }.prefix(HomeShelves.shelfLimit + 1).map(home),
            installed: library.games(by: .lastPlayed, filter: .installed).map(home),
            covers: order.prefix(3).map(home),
            count: library.games.count
        )
    }
}

extension LibraryStorefront {
    /// The account's library as Home shows it, in the storefront's own artwork.
    func homeLibrary<Cover: View, Artwork: View, Logo: View>(
        in section: LibrarySection,
        cover: @escaping (Game) -> Cover,
        heroArtwork: @escaping (Game) -> Artwork,
        heroLogo: @escaping (Game) -> Logo
    ) -> HomeLibrary {
        let actions = GameActions(installations, in: .library)
        return HomeLibrary(library) { game in
            homeGame(game, in: section, actions: actions, cover: cover, heroArtwork: heroArtwork, heroLogo: heroLogo)
        }
    }

    /// The account's games whose title matches `query`, by name.
    func homeResults<Cover: View, Artwork: View, Logo: View>(
        matching query: String,
        in section: LibrarySection,
        cover: @escaping (Game) -> Cover,
        heroArtwork: @escaping (Game) -> Artwork,
        heroLogo: @escaping (Game) -> Logo
    ) -> [HomeGame] {
        let actions = GameActions(installations, in: .library)
        return library.games(by: .name, matching: query).map { game in
            homeGame(game, in: section, actions: actions, cover: cover, heroArtwork: heroArtwork, heroLogo: heroLogo)
        }
    }

    private func homeGame<Cover: View, Artwork: View, Logo: View>(
        _ game: Game,
        in section: LibrarySection,
        actions: GameActions<Store>,
        cover: @escaping (Game) -> Cover,
        heroArtwork: @escaping (Game) -> Artwork,
        heroLogo: @escaping (Game) -> Logo
    ) -> HomeGame {
        HomeGame(
            game, of: library, in: section,
            action: actions(librarySelection(game)),
            cover: { AnyView(cover(game)) },
            hero: HomeGame.Hero(artwork: { AnyView(heroArtwork(game)) }, logo: { AnyView(heroLogo(game)) }),
            open: { self.open(game) }
        )
    }
}

/// What Home shows of every library at once.
@MainActor
struct HomeShelves {
    /// The game Home shows first: the last one played anywhere, else the most
    /// played, as a library's hero.
    let hero: HomeGame?
    /// The games played before the hero's, the last played first.
    let recent: [HomeGame]
    /// Every game on the Mac, the last played first.
    let installed: [HomeGame]

    static let shelfLimit = 20

    /// `libraries` in Home's order, which equal games across libraries keep.
    init(_ libraries: [HomeLibrary]) {
        let featured = Array(libraries.compactMap(\.featured).enumerated())
        let hero = LibraryOrder.featured(featured, title: { $0.element.title }, id: { $0.offset },
                                         lastPlayed: { $0.element.lastPlayed }, playtime: { $0.element.playtime })?.element
        self.hero = hero
        let recent = Self.lastPlayedFirst(libraries.map(\.recent))
        self.recent = Array(recent.filter { $0.id != hero?.id }.prefix(Self.shelfLimit))
        installed = Self.lastPlayedFirst(libraries.map(\.installed))
    }

    /// Merges each library's games, each in its last played order.
    private static func lastPlayedFirst(_ games: [[HomeGame]]) -> [HomeGame] {
        LibraryOrder.merge(games, title: \.title, rank: { $0.lastPlayed?.timeIntervalSince1970 })
    }
}
```
