`apps/macos/Obelisk/Features/Home/HomeView.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// Home: every library at once. The last game played anywhere is its hero,
/// then come the games played before it and the games on the Mac, each a
/// shelf of covers, then a tile for each library. Its search looks through
/// every library. A game opens its page over Home, its cover flying in as
/// from the game's own library. Signed in nowhere, Home is a sign-in page
/// leading to each storefront's.
struct HomeView: View {
    @Bindable var model: AppModel
    @Namespace private var namespace
    @State private var bar = StorefrontBarState()
    /// Where the open game came from, once a game opened with motion.
    @State private var source: GameOpeningSource?
    /// The card the open game's cover flew from, and flies back to.
    @State private var card: AnyHashable?
    @State private var scrollMemory = LibraryScrollMemory()
    @State private var shelfMemory = ShelfScrollMemory()
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    /// A storefront's game whose page Home opened.
    private enum OpenGame {
        case steam(SteamGame), epic(EpicGame), gog(GogGame)

        var title: String {
            switch self {
            case let .steam(game): game.name
            case let .epic(game): game.title
            case let .gog(game): game.title
            }
        }

        var section: LibrarySection {
            switch self {
            case .steam: .steam
            case .epic: .epic
            case .gog: .gog
            }
        }
    }

    /// The game Home opened, while its storefront still shows its page.
    private var openGame: OpenGame? {
        guard let id = model.homeGame else { return nil }
        func opened<Game: Identifiable>(_ game: Game?) -> Game? {
            game.flatMap { "\($0.id)" == id.game ? $0 : nil }
        }
        switch id.section {
        case .steam: return opened(model.steam.selectedGame).map(OpenGame.steam)
        case .epic: return opened(model.epic.selectedGame).map(OpenGame.epic)
        case .gog: return opened(model.gog.selectedGame).map(OpenGame.gog)
        default: return nil
        }
    }

    private var showsLibrary: Bool {
        model.steam.showsLibrary || model.epic.showsLibrary || model.gog.showsLibrary
    }

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if showsLibrary {
                libraries
            } else if model.restoringStorefronts.isEmpty {
                HomeSignIn(model: model)
            } else {
                // Saved sessions are restoring: their libraries are on their way.
                Color.clear
            }
        }
        .errorAlert(L10n.string("ui.store.steam"), message: Bindable(model.steam).errorMessage)
        .errorAlert(L10n.string("ui.store.epic"), message: Bindable(model.epic).errorMessage)
        .errorAlert(L10n.string("ui.store.gog"), message: Bindable(model.gog).errorMessage)
    }

    private var libraries: some View {
        let openGame = openGame
        return ZStack {
            if let openGame {
                gamePage(openGame)
                    // Above Home, which falls back beneath it.
                    .zIndex(1)
                    .transition(.asymmetric(insertion: .identity, removal: .opacity))
            } else {
                HomePage(model: model, scrollMemory: scrollMemory, shelfMemory: shelfMemory, open: open)
                    .transition(.asymmetric(insertion: .identity,
                                            removal: .opacity.combined(with: .scale(scale: reduceMotion ? 1 : 0.94))))
            }
        }
        // An overlay rather than a safe area bar, as a library's.
        .overlay(alignment: .top) {
            HomeBar(model: model, bar: bar, game: openGame.map { ($0.title, $0.section) }, back: back,
                    openLibrary: openLibrary)
        }
        .environment(\.storefrontBar, bar)
        .environment(\.gameTransition, GameTransition(namespace: namespace, source: source, card: card))
        .ignoresSafeArea(.container, edges: .top)
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func gamePage(_ game: OpenGame) -> some View {
        switch game {
        case let .steam(game):
            SteamGameDetailView(model: model.steam, game: game, context: GamePageContext(
                storeID: "steam", heroArtwork: SteamView.heroArtwork(game), cover: SteamView.cover(game)
            ))
            .id(game.id)
        case let .epic(game):
            EpicGameDetailView(model: model.epic, game: game, context: GamePageContext(
                storeID: "epic", heroArtwork: EpicView.heroArtwork(game), cover: EpicView.cover(game)
            ))
            .id(game.id)
        case let .gog(game):
            GogGameDetailView(model: model.gog, game: game, context: GamePageContext(
                storeID: "gog", heroArtwork: GogView.heroArtwork(game), cover: GogView.cover(game)
            ))
            .id(game.id)
        }
    }

    private func open(_ game: HomeGame, from source: GameOpeningSource, card: AnyHashable?) {
        self.source = source
        self.card = card
        withAnimation(ObeliskStyle.pageAnimation(reduceMotion: reduceMotion)) {
            model.homeGame = game.id
            game.open()
        }
    }

    private func back() {
        withAnimation(ObeliskStyle.pageAnimation(reduceMotion: reduceMotion)) { closeGame() }
    }

    /// Leaves the game's page for its storefront's library.
    private func openLibrary(_ section: LibrarySection) {
        closeGame()
        model.selection = section
    }

    private func closeGame() {
        switch model.homeGame?.section {
        case .steam: model.steam.closeGame()
        case .epic: model.epic.closeGame()
        case .gog: model.gog.closeGame()
        default: break
        }
        model.homeGame = nil
    }
}

/// Home's bar: the search through every library, or, on a game's page, the
/// way back and the game's storefront. It reads the scroll state in its own
/// body, so scrolling redraws the bar alone.
private struct HomeBar: View {
    @Bindable var model: AppModel
    let bar: StorefrontBarState
    /// The title and storefront of the game whose page shows.
    let game: (title: String, section: LibrarySection)?
    let back: () -> Void
    let openLibrary: (LibrarySection) -> Void

    var body: some View {
        LibraryGlassBar(
            searchText: $model.searchText,
            searchLabel: L10n.string("ui.home.search_label"),
            showsBackdrop: bar.showsBackdrop,
            game: game.map { game in
                LibraryGlassBar.GameBar(title: game.title, libraryTitle: LibrarySection.home.title,
                                        showsTitle: bar.showsGameTitle, back: back)
            }
        ) {
            if let game {
                storeButton(game.section)
            }
        }
    }

    /// The game's storefront, opening its library.
    private func storeButton(_ section: LibrarySection) -> some View {
        let name = section.storeName ?? section.title
        let label = L10n.string("ui.library.store_accessibility", name)
        return Button { openLibrary(section) } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                if let logo = section.logoAssetName {
                    Image(logo)
                        .renderingMode(.template)
                        .resizable()
                        .scaledToFit()
                        .frame(width: 16, height: 16)
                }
                Text(name)
                    .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.primary)
            .padding(.horizontal, 14)
            .frame(height: 36)
            .modifier(StorefrontControlGlass())
            .contentShape(.capsule)
        }
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
        .fixedSize()
        .accessibilityLabel(label)
        .accessibilityIdentifier("home-store")
        .help(label)
    }
}

/// Home's scrolling content: its hero, shelves and libraries, or what every
/// library finds for the search.
private struct HomePage: View {
    @Bindable var model: AppModel
    let scrollMemory: LibraryScrollMemory
    let shelfMemory: ShelfScrollMemory
    /// Opens a game's page, from one of its cards or from the hero.
    let open: (HomeGame, GameOpeningSource, AnyHashable?) -> Void
    @State private var position: ScrollPosition
    @State private var tilesInOneRow = true
    @Environment(\.storefrontBar) private var bar

    /// A game's card on one shelf: a game may show on more than one.
    private struct Card: Hashable {
        let shelf: String
        let game: HomeGame.ID
    }

    private static var columns: [GridItem] {
        [GridItem(.adaptive(minimum: 160, maximum: 220), spacing: 16, alignment: .top)]
    }

    /// Whether the library tiles fit in one row.
    private static func tilesInOneRow(width: CGFloat) -> Bool {
        width >= 3 * 280 + 2 * 16
    }

    init(model: AppModel, scrollMemory: LibraryScrollMemory, shelfMemory: ShelfScrollMemory,
         open: @escaping (HomeGame, GameOpeningSource, AnyHashable?) -> Void) {
        self.model = model
        self.scrollMemory = scrollMemory
        self.shelfMemory = shelfMemory
        self.open = open
        let offset = scrollMemory.offset
        _position = State(initialValue: offset > 0 ? ScrollPosition(y: offset) : ScrollPosition())
    }

    /// Every library as Home shows it, in Home's order.
    private struct Libraries {
        let steam: HomeLibrary
        let epic: HomeLibrary
        let gog: HomeLibrary

        var all: [HomeLibrary] { [steam, epic, gog] }
    }

    private var homeLibraries: Libraries {
        Libraries(
            steam: model.steam.homeLibrary(in: .steam, cover: SteamView.cover, heroArtwork: SteamView.heroArtwork,
                                           heroLogo: SteamView.heroLogo),
            epic: model.epic.homeLibrary(in: .epic, cover: EpicView.cover, heroArtwork: EpicView.heroArtwork,
                                         heroLogo: EpicView.heroLogo),
            gog: model.gog.homeLibrary(in: .gog, cover: GogView.cover, heroArtwork: GogView.heroArtwork,
                                       heroLogo: GogView.heroLogo)
        )
    }

    /// What every library finds for `query`, by name.
    private func homeResults(matching query: String) -> [HomeGame] {
        LibraryOrder.merge([
            model.steam.homeResults(matching: query, in: .steam, cover: SteamView.cover,
                                    heroArtwork: SteamView.heroArtwork, heroLogo: SteamView.heroLogo),
            model.epic.homeResults(matching: query, in: .epic, cover: EpicView.cover,
                                   heroArtwork: EpicView.heroArtwork, heroLogo: EpicView.heroLogo),
            model.gog.homeResults(matching: query, in: .gog, cover: GogView.cover,
                                  heroArtwork: GogView.heroArtwork, heroLogo: GogView.heroLogo),
        ], title: \.title, rank: { _ in nil })
    }

    var body: some View {
        let query = model.searchText.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        let libraries = query.isEmpty ? homeLibraries : nil
        let shelves = libraries.map { HomeShelves($0.all) }
        let heroGame = shelves?.hero
        let backdropOffset = heroGame == nil ? 0 : ObeliskStyle.libraryHeroHeight
        return StorefrontScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                if let heroGame {
                    hero(heroGame)
                }
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 30) {
                    notices
                    if let shelves, let libraries {
                        if !shelves.recent.isEmpty {
                            CoverShelf(title: L10n.string("ui.home.recent"), items: shelves.recent, id: "recent",
                                       memory: shelfMemory) { card($0, on: "recent") }
                        }
                        if !shelves.installed.isEmpty {
                            CoverShelf(title: L10n.string("ui.home.installed"), items: shelves.installed, id: "installed",
                                       memory: shelfMemory) { card($0, on: "installed") }
                        }
                        self.libraries(libraries)
                    } else {
                        results(homeResults(matching: query))
                    }
                }
                .padding(.top, heroGame == nil ? 12 : 24)
                .padding(.bottom, 36)
            }
        }
        .scrollPosition($position)
        // The results, and Home back from them, show from their top.
        .onChange(of: query.isEmpty) { position.scrollTo(edge: .top) }
        .onScrollGeometryChange(for: CGFloat.self, of: { $0.contentOffset.y + $0.contentInsets.top }) { _, offset in
            scrollMemory.offset = offset
        }
        // Whether shelves are under the bar, rather than the hero's artwork
        // or nothing at all.
        .onScrollGeometryChange(for: Bool.self, of: { $0.contentOffset.y + $0.contentInsets.top > backdropOffset }) { _, under in
            bar?.showsBackdrop = under
            bar?.showsGameTitle = false
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea(.container, edges: .top)
    }

    private var hasNotices: Bool {
        hasNotice(model.steam) || hasNotice(model.epic) || hasNotice(model.gog)
    }

    private func hasNotice<Model: LibraryStorefront>(_ storefront: Model) -> Bool {
        storefront.storageWarning != nil || storefront.cloud.failurePresented
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var notices: some View {
        if hasNotices {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 22) {
                notice(model.steam, storeID: "steam")
                notice(model.epic, storeID: "epic")
                notice(model.gog, storeID: "gog")
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, ObeliskStyle.contentPadding)
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private func notice<Model: LibraryStorefront>(_ storefront: Model, storeID: String) -> some View {
        StorefrontWarningBanner(message: Bindable(storefront).storageWarning)
        if storefront.cloud.failurePresented {
            SteamCloudFailureView(model: storefront, storefront: storeID)
        }
    }

    private func hero(_ game: HomeGame) -> some View {
        let section = game.id.section
        return LibraryHero(
            title: game.title,
            details: [
                section.logoAssetName.map { LibraryHeroDetail(logo: $0, text: section.storeName ?? section.title) },
                game.lastPlayed.map { LibraryHeroDetail(symbol: "calendar", text: GameFormatting.lastPlayed($0)) },
                game.playtime.map { LibraryHeroDetail(symbol: "clock", text: GameFormatting.playtime($0)) },
            ].compactMap { $0 },
            action: game.action,
            open: { open(game, .hero, nil) }
        ) {
            game.hero.artwork()
        } logo: {
            game.hero.logo()
        }
    }

    private func card(_ game: HomeGame, on shelf: String) -> some View {
        let card = AnyHashable(Card(shelf: shelf, game: game.id))
        return LibraryCoverCard(
            title: game.title,
            accessibilityLabel: L10n.string("ui.library.game_accessibility", game.title,
                                            GameFormatting.lastPlayed(game.lastPlayed)),
            help: [game.title, game.id.section.storeName, game.playtime.map(GameFormatting.playtime)]
                .compactMap { $0 }
                .joined(separator: " · "),
            store: game.id.section,
            action: game.action,
            matchID: card,
            open: { open(game, .cover, card) }
        ) {
            game.cover()
        }
    }

    private func libraries(_ libraries: Libraries) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14) {
            Text(L10n.string("ui.library.your_libraries"))
                .font(.system(size: 22, weight: .bold))
                .frame(height: 36)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
            StorefrontRows(inOneRow: tilesInOneRow) { section, _ in
                switch section {
                case .steam:
                    tile(.steam, library: libraries.steam, showsLibrary: model.steam.showsLibrary,
                         isRestoring: model.steam.isRestoring, account: model.steam.displayName,
                         avatarURL: model.steam.avatarURL)
                case .epic:
                    tile(.epic, library: libraries.epic, showsLibrary: model.epic.showsLibrary,
                         isRestoring: model.epic.isRestoring, account: model.epic.accountName,
                         avatarURL: model.epic.avatarURL)
                default:
                    tile(.gog, library: libraries.gog, showsLibrary: model.gog.showsLibrary,
                         isRestoring: model.gog.isRestoring, account: model.gog.accountName,
                         avatarURL: model.gog.avatarURL)
                }
            }
            .onGeometryChange(for: Bool.self, of: { Self.tilesInOneRow(width: $0.size.width) }) { tilesInOneRow = $0 }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, ObeliskStyle.contentPadding)
    }

    private func tile(_ section: LibrarySection, library: HomeLibrary, showsLibrary: Bool, isRestoring: Bool,
                      account: String?, avatarURL: URL?) -> some View {
        let status: LibraryTile.Status = if showsLibrary {
            .signedIn(account: account, avatarURL: avatarURL, games: library.count, installed: library.installed.count)
        } else if isRestoring || model.restoringStorefronts.contains(section) {
            .restoring
        } else {
            .signedOut
        }
        return LibraryTile(
            section: section,
            title: section.storeName ?? section.title,
            status: status,
            covers: library.covers.map { $0.cover() },
            open: { model.selection = section }
        )
    }

    private func results(_ games: [HomeGame]) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 22) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 3) {
                Text(L10n.string("ui.home.results"))
                    .font(.system(size: 22, weight: .bold))
                    .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
                Text(L10n.string("ui.library.game_count", Int64(games.count)))
                    .font(.system(size: 12))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .monospacedDigit()
            }
            if games.isEmpty {
                StorefrontEmptyLibrary(searchText: $model.searchText, refresh: model.refresh)
            } else {
                LazyVGrid(columns: Self.columns, alignment: .leading, spacing: 18) {
                    ForEach(games) { card($0, on: "search") }
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, ObeliskStyle.contentPadding)
    }
}

/// Home while no storefront is signed in: a sign-in page whose cards lead to
/// each storefront's own sign-in, Steam and Epic side by side over GOG.
private struct HomeSignIn: View {
    @Bindable var model: AppModel

    var body: some View {
        SignInPage(section: .home, title: L10n.string("ui.home.welcome_title", AppIdentity.name),
                   subtitle: L10n.string("ui.home.welcome_subtitle")) {
            StorefrontRows { section, spansRow in
                StorefrontSignInCard(section: section, isConnecting: isConnecting(section), spansRow: spansRow) {
                    model.selection = section
                }
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: 640)
        }
    }

    private func isConnecting(_ section: LibrarySection) -> Bool {
        switch section {
        case .steam: model.steam.isRestoring || model.steam.isConnecting
        case .epic: model.epic.isRestoring || model.epic.isConnecting
        case .gog: model.gog.isRestoring || model.gog.isConnecting
        default: false
        }
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Features/LaunchSettingsSheet.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// The launch settings of one installed Windows game, as its sheet shows
/// them: read from Rust, and kept there at each change.
@MainActor @Observable
final class LaunchSettingsModel: Identifiable {
    private(set) var settings: LaunchSettings?
    private(set) var isLoading = true
    private(set) var error: String?
    @ObservationIgnored private let load: () async throws -> LaunchSettings?
    @ObservationIgnored private let save: (LaunchChoices) async throws -> LaunchSettings?

    init(load: @escaping () async throws -> LaunchSettings?,
         save: @escaping (LaunchChoices) async throws -> LaunchSettings?) {
        self.load = load
        self.save = save
    }

    func appear() async {
        isLoading = true
        do {
            settings = try await load()
            error = nil
        } catch {
            self.error = error.localizedDescription
        }
        isLoading = false
    }

    /// Changes one of the player's choices and keeps them: Rust drops those
    /// the game already has by default.
    func choose(_ change: (inout LaunchChoices) -> Void) {
        guard var choices = settings?.choices else { return }
        change(&choices)
        Task { await keep(choices) }
    }

    /// Keeps what the player typed as the game's launch arguments, when it
    /// changed. Spaces alone are no arguments.
    func setArguments(_ text: String) {
        let arguments = text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        guard let settings, (settings.choices.arguments ?? "") != arguments else { return }
        choose { $0.arguments = arguments.isEmpty ? nil : arguments }
    }

    /// Forgets every choice: the game runs as Obelisk knows it best.
    func reset() {
        Task { await keep(LaunchChoices()) }
    }

    private func keep(_ choices: LaunchChoices) async {
        do {
            if let saved = try await save(choices) { settings = saved }
            error = nil
        } catch {
            self.error = error.localizedDescription
        }
    }

    var isCustomized: Bool { settings.map { $0.choices != LaunchChoices() } ?? false }

    /// What the chosen engine offers.
    var engineOffer: LaunchEngineOffer? {
        settings.flatMap { settings in settings.engines.first { $0.engine == settings.engine } }
    }

    /// What the chosen backend offers on the chosen engine.
    var graphicsOffer: LaunchGraphicsOffer? {
        guard let settings else { return nil }
        return engineOffer?.graphics.first { $0.graphics == settings.graphics }
    }
}

/// The sheet behind a Windows game's Launch Settings: the arguments added to
/// its command line, its engine, then the CPU translator that engine has,
/// then the graphics backend and its options, each as the chosen engine
/// allows, and Metal's Performance HUD, every one said in a sentence.
struct LaunchSettingsSheet: View {
    let model: LaunchSettingsModel
    let gameName: String
    /// The arguments as the player types them, kept once the field is done.
    @State private var arguments = ""
    @FocusState private var editsArguments: Bool
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            SheetHeader(title: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.title"), subtitle: gameName,
                        symbol: "slider.horizontal.3", colors: TileColors.violet, close: { dismiss() },
                        closeIdentifier: "launch-settings-close")
                .padding(.horizontal, 24)
                .padding(.top, 24)
                .padding(.bottom, 18)
            content
        }
        .frame(width: 560, height: 680)
        .tint(ObeliskStyle.accent)
        .task {
            await model.appear()
            arguments = model.settings?.choices.arguments ?? ""
        }
        .onChange(of: model.settings?.choices.arguments) { _, kept in
            if !editsArguments { arguments = kept ?? "" }
        }
        .onChange(of: editsArguments) { _, editing in
            if !editing { model.setArguments(arguments) }
        }
        .onDisappear { model.setArguments(arguments) }
        .accessibilityIdentifier("launch-settings-sheet")
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var content: some View {
        if model.isLoading {
            ProgressView(L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.loading"))
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        } else if let settings = model.settings {
            form(settings)
        } else if let error = model.error {
            SheetFailure(message: error)
        }
    }

    private func form(_ settings: LaunchSettings) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            ScrollView {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 22) {
                    ObeliskCard { argumentsRow }
                    ObeliskCard { engineRow(settings) }
                    SheetSection(title: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.cpu")) {
                        ObeliskCard { translatorRow }
                    }
                    SheetSection(title: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.graphics")) {
                        ObeliskCard {
                            graphicsRow(settings)
                            if model.graphicsOffer?.options.contains(.rayTracing) == true {
                                ObeliskCardDivider()
                                rayTracingRow(settings)
                            }
                            ObeliskCardDivider()
                            performanceHudRow(settings)
                        }
                    }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 24)
                .padding(.bottom, 22)
            }
            .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
            Divider()
            footer
        }
    }

    /// A whole command line: a field across the card, under its row.
    private var argumentsRow: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            ObeliskRow(title: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.arguments")) {
                SymbolTile(name: "terminal.fill", colors: TileColors.graphite)
            } detail: {
                Text(L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.arguments_detail"))
            } accessory: {
                EmptyView()
            }
            TextField(L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.arguments"), text: $arguments,
                      prompt: Text(L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.arguments_placeholder")))
                .textFieldStyle(.plain)
                .font(.system(size: 13, design: .monospaced))
                .labelsHidden()
                .focused($editsArguments)
                .onSubmit { model.setArguments(arguments) }
                .padding(.horizontal, 12)
                .frame(height: 36)
                .modifier(SignInWell(isFocused: editsArguments))
                .accessibilityIdentifier("launch-settings-arguments")
                .padding(.leading, 64)
                .padding(.trailing, 18)
                .padding(.bottom, 16)
        }
    }

    private func engineRow(_ settings: LaunchSettings) -> some View {
        ObeliskRow(title: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.engine")) {
            SymbolTile(name: "gearshape.2.fill", colors: TileColors.violet)
        } detail: {
            Text(Self.detail(of: settings.engine))
        } accessory: {
            GlassMenuPicker(title: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.engine"),
                            value: marked(Self.name(of: settings.engine),
                                          isDefault: settings.engine == settings.defaultEngine),
                            selection: Binding(get: { settings.engine },
                                               set: { engine in model.choose { $0.engine = engine } }),
                            identifier: "launch-settings-engine") {
                ForEach(settings.engines, id: \.engine) { offer in
                    Text(marked(Self.name(of: offer.engine), isDefault: offer.engine == settings.defaultEngine))
                        .tag(offer.engine)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var translatorRow: some View {
        if let offer = model.engineOffer {
            ObeliskRow(title: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.translator")) {
                SymbolTile(name: "cpu", colors: TileColors.blue)
            } accessory: {
                Text(Self.name(of: offer.translator))
                    .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .medium))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func graphicsRow(_ settings: LaunchSettings) -> some View {
        if let engine = model.engineOffer {
            ObeliskRow(title: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.backend")) {
                SymbolTile(name: "square.3.layers.3d", colors: TileColors.green)
            } detail: {
                Text(Self.detail(of: settings.graphics))
            } accessory: {
                GlassMenuPicker(title: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.backend"),
                                value: marked(Self.name(of: settings.graphics),
                                              isDefault: settings.graphics == engine.defaultGraphics),
                                selection: Binding(get: { settings.graphics },
                                                   set: { graphics in model.choose { $0.graphics = graphics } }),
                                identifier: "launch-settings-graphics") {
                    ForEach(engine.graphics, id: \.graphics) { offer in
                        Text(marked(Self.name(of: offer.graphics), isDefault: offer.graphics == engine.defaultGraphics))
                            .tag(offer.graphics)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func rayTracingRow(_ settings: LaunchSettings) -> some View {
        ObeliskRow(title: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.ray_tracing")) {
            SymbolTile(name: "sparkles", colors: TileColors.gold)
        } detail: {
            Text(L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.ray_tracing_detail"))
        } accessory: {
            Toggle(L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.ray_tracing"),
                   isOn: Binding(get: { settings.rayTracing },
                                 set: { rayTracing in model.choose { $0.rayTracing = rayTracing } }))
                .toggleStyle(.switch)
                .labelsHidden()
                .pointerCursor()
                .accessibilityIdentifier("launch-settings-ray-tracing")
        }
    }

    private func performanceHudRow(_ settings: LaunchSettings) -> some View {
        ObeliskRow(title: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.performance_hud")) {
            SymbolTile(name: "gauge.with.needle.fill", colors: TileColors.violet)
        } detail: {
            Text(L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.performance_hud_detail"))
        } accessory: {
            Toggle(L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.performance_hud"),
                   isOn: Binding(get: { settings.performanceHud },
                                 set: { shown in model.choose { $0.performanceHud = shown } }))
                .toggleStyle(.switch)
                .labelsHidden()
                .pointerCursor()
                .accessibilityIdentifier("launch-settings-performance-hud")
        }
    }

    /// When the choices apply, how to forget them, and why the last could not
    /// be kept.
    private var footer: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
            if let error = model.error {
                SheetNotice(kind: .warning, text: error)
            }
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                Text(L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.next_launch"))
                    .font(.system(size: 12))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                GlassCapsuleButton(title: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.reset"), systemImage: "arrow.counterclockwise",
                                   identifier: "launch-settings-reset", action: model.reset)
                    .disabled(!model.isCustomized)
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 24)
        .padding(.vertical, 16)
    }

    private func marked(_ name: String, isDefault: Bool) -> String {
        isDefault ? L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.default", name) : name
    }

    static func name(of engine: LaunchEngine) -> String {
        switch engine {
        case .rosetta: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.engine.rosetta")
        case .linux: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.engine.linux")
        }
    }

    static func detail(of engine: LaunchEngine) -> String {
        switch engine {
        case .rosetta: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.engine.rosetta_detail")
        case .linux: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.engine.linux_detail")
        }
    }

    static func name(of translator: LaunchTranslator) -> String {
        switch translator {
        case .rosetta: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.translator.rosetta")
        case .fex: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.translator.fex")
        }
    }

    static func name(of graphics: LaunchGraphics) -> String {
        switch graphics {
        case .d3dMetal: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.graphics.d3dmetal")
        case .dxmt: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.graphics.dxmt")
        }
    }

    static func detail(of graphics: LaunchGraphics) -> String {
        switch graphics {
        case .d3dMetal: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.graphics.d3dmetal_detail")
        case .dxmt: L10n.string("ui.launch_settings.graphics.dxmt_detail")
        }
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Features/Overlay/GameOverlayView.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// The overlay over the dimmed game: its bar on top, the friends of the
/// game's storefront on the leading side, and the page it shows.
struct GameOverlayView: View {
    let overlay: GameOverlayController
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency) private var reduceTransparency

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            backdrop
            if overlay.session != nil {
                VStack(spacing: 18) {
                    OverlayTopBar(overlay: overlay)
                    HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 18) {
                        if let friends = overlay.friends {
                            FriendsPanel(state: friends, avatars: overlay.avatars, chat: overlay.chat,
                                         picker: overlay.invitePicker, closable: false,
                                         accessory: showsHome ? nil : AnyView(OverlayInvitations(overlay: overlay, compact: true)),
                                         focus: overlay.focus,
                                         dismiss: overlay.hide, retry: overlay.retryFriends,
                                         signIn: overlay.openLibrary)
                                .frame(width: 400)
                                .id(friends.account)
                        }
                        page.frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                    }
                }
                .padding(32)
                .frame(maxWidth: 1480, maxHeight: 960)
            }
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
        .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.overlay.title"))
        .accessibilityIdentifier("game-overlay")
    }

    private var backdrop: some View {
        Rectangle()
            .fill(reduceTransparency ? AnyShapeStyle(Color.black.opacity(0.82)) : AnyShapeStyle(.ultraThinMaterial))
            .overlay { Color.black.opacity(reduceTransparency ? 0 : 0.45) }
            .ignoresSafeArea()
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    /// The home page shows the invitations into the game; other pages leave
    /// them to the friends column.
    private var showsHome: Bool {
        switch overlay.request {
        case .achievements, .webPage: false
        case .microTxn(let orderId): overlay.pendingPurchase?.orderId != orderId
        case .home, .friends, .invite, .user: true
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var page: some View {
        switch overlay.request {
        case .microTxn(let orderId) where overlay.pendingPurchase?.orderId == orderId:
            OverlayPurchasePage(overlay: overlay, purchase: overlay.steam.purchase)
        case .achievements:
            if let achievements = overlay.achievements {
                OverlayAchievementsPage(model: achievements, gameTitle: overlay.gameTitle,
                                        back: { overlay.back() }, retry: overlay.retryAchievements)
            }
        case .webPage(let url):
            WebPagePanel(start: { WebPageStart(url: url, cookies: await overlay.webCookies(for: url)) },
                         close: { overlay.back() }, placeholderTitle: url.host() ?? url.absoluteString,
                         identifier: "game-overlay-web-page")
                .id(url)
        case .home, .friends, .invite, .user, .microTxn:
            OverlayHome(overlay: overlay)
        }
    }
}

/// The running game, its storefront, how long it has run, the time, and how
/// to close the overlay.
private struct OverlayTopBar: View {
    let overlay: GameOverlayController

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 14) {
            OverlayGameArtwork(overlay: overlay, maxPixelSize: 400)
                .frame(width: 96, height: 45)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 3) {
                Text(overlay.gameTitle)
                    .font(.system(size: 16, weight: .semibold))
                    .lineLimit(1)
                HStack(spacing: 6) {
                    if let store = overlay.session.flatMap({ LibrarySection(rawValue: $0.storeID) }) {
                        if let logo = store.logoAssetName {
                            Image(logo).resizable().scaledToFit().frame(width: 13, height: 13).accessibilityHidden(true)
                        }
                        Text(store.title)
                    }
                    if let startedAt = overlay.session?.startedAt {
                        Text(verbatim: "·").accessibilityHidden(true)
                        TimelineView(.everyMinute) { context in
                            Text(L10n.string("ui.overlay.playingFor",
                                             OverlayFormatting.duration(from: startedAt, to: context.date)))
                        }
                    }
                }
                .font(.system(size: 12))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .lineLimit(1)
            }
            Spacer(minLength: 16)
            TimelineView(.everyMinute) { context in
                Text(context.date, format: .dateTime.hour().minute().locale(L10n.locale))
            }
            .font(.system(size: 22, weight: .semibold))
            .monospacedDigit()
            Text(L10n.string("ui.overlay.closeHint"))
                .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .padding(.horizontal, 10)
                .frame(height: 26)
                .background(.primary.opacity(0.08), in: Capsule())
            StorefrontGlassButton(systemName: "xmark", size: 13, label: L10n.string("ui.overlay.close"),
                                  identifier: "game-overlay-close", action: overlay.hide)
        }
        .padding(.leading, 12)
        .padding(.trailing, 14)
        .frame(height: 70)
        .modifier(StorefrontPanelGlass(cornerRadius: 24))
    }
}

/// The running game's wide artwork, as its storefront publishes it.
private struct OverlayGameArtwork: View {

    let maxPixelSize: Int

    var body: some View {
        if case .steam(let appId)? = overlay.session?.game {
            SteamArtwork(appId: appId, portrait: false)
        } else {
            StorefrontArtwork(imageURL: overlay.gameArtwork, maxPixelSize: maxPixelSize)
        }
    }
}

/// The game's artwork, and what the overlay opens for it.
private struct OverlayHome: View {
    let overlay: GameOverlayController

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            OverlayGameArtwork(overlay: overlay, maxPixelSize: 2048)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .frame(height: 300)
                .clipped()
                .overlay(alignment: .bottomLeading) {
                    Text(overlay.gameTitle)
                        .font(.system(size: 30, weight: .bold))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white)
                        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.5), radius: 8, y: 2)
                        .lineLimit(2)
                        .padding(24)
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.clear, .black.opacity(0.65)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
                }
            // Friends' invitations come first; many of them scroll.
            ScrollView {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
                    OverlayInvitations(overlay: overlay)
                    LazyVGrid(columns: [GridItem(.adaptive(minimum: 190), spacing: 12)], alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
                        OverlayTile(title: L10n.string("ui.game.achievements.title"), systemImage: "trophy",
                                    identifier: "game-overlay-achievements") { overlay.show(.achievements) }
                        if case .steam(let appId)? = overlay.session?.game {
                            OverlayTile(title: L10n.string("ui.overlay.storePage"), systemImage: "bag",
                                        identifier: "game-overlay-store") {
                                overlay.show(.webPage(GameOverlayController.storeURL(appId: appId)))
                            }
                        }
                        OverlayTile(title: L10n.string("ui.overlay.library"), systemImage: "square.grid.2x2",
                                    identifier: "game-overlay-library") { overlay.openLibrary() }
                    }
                }
                .padding(20)
            }
            .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
        }
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 24))
        .modifier(StorefrontPanelGlass(cornerRadius: 24))
    }
}

private struct OverlayTile: View {
    let title: String
    let systemImage: String
    let identifier: String
    let action: () -> Void

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                Image(systemName: systemImage)
                    .font(.system(size: 15, weight: .semibold))
                    .frame(width: 22)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
                Text(title)
                    .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                    .lineLimit(1)
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.primary)
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            .frame(height: 48)
            .modifier(StorefrontPanelGlass(cornerRadius: 14))

enum OverlayFormatting {
    /// How long the game has run: minutes, then hours and minutes.
    static func duration(from start: Date, to now: Date) -> String {
        let seconds = Int64(max(0, now.timeIntervalSince(start)))
        return Duration.seconds(seconds - seconds % 60)
            .formatted(.units(allowed: [.hours, .minutes], width: .abbreviated).locale(L10n.locale))
    }
}
```

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// Friends' invitations while a Steam game runs: the player joins one into
/// that game, back in it at once, or dismisses one.
struct OverlayInvitations: View {
    let overlay: GameOverlayController
    /// The friends column's narrow rows put their buttons under the text.
    var compact = false

    var body: some View {
        let invites = overlay.receivedInvites
        if !invites.isEmpty {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                Text(L10n.string("ui.overlay.invites.title"))
                    .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
                ForEach(invites, id: \.self) { invite in
                    OverlayInvitationRow(overlay: overlay, invite: invite, compact: compact)
                }
            }
            .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
            .accessibilityIdentifier("game-overlay-invites")
        }
    }
}

private struct OverlayInvitationRow: View {
    let overlay: GameOverlayController
    let invite: SteamReceivedInvite
    let compact: Bool

    var body: some View {
        let friend = overlay.sender(of: invite)
        let key = SteamReceivedInvitations.Key(invite)
        let invitations = overlay.steam.invitations
        let accepting = invitations.accepting == key
        let failure = invitations.failures[key]
        let availability = invitations.availability(appId: invite.appId)
        let name = friend?.displayName ?? L10n.string("ui.overlay.invites.someone")
        let summary = HStack(spacing: 12) {
            if let friend {
                FriendAvatar(friend: friend, avatars: overlay.avatars, size: 36)
            } else {
                Image(systemName: "person.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 16))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .frame(width: 36, height: 36)
                    .background(.primary.opacity(0.08), in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 9))
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                Text(name)
                    .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                    .lineLimit(1)
                TimelineView(.everyMinute) { context in
                    Text(L10n.string("ui.overlay.invites.subtitle", overlay.steam.gameName(appId: invite.appId) ?? L10n.string("ui.invites.unknownGame"),
                                     Self.received(invite, now: context.date)))
                }
                .font(.system(size: 11))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .lineLimit(2)
                if let failure {
                    Label(failure, systemImage: "exclamationmark.triangle.fill")
                        .font(.system(size: 11))
                        .foregroundStyle(.red)
                        .lineLimit(2)
                        .accessibilityIdentifier("game-overlay-invite-error-\(invite.friendSteamId)")
                }
            }
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        let buttons = HStack(spacing: 8) {
            Button { overlay.dismiss(invite) } label: {
                Text(L10n.string("ui.overlay.invites.dismiss"))
                    .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold))
                    .padding(.horizontal, 12).frame(height: 28)
                    .background(.primary.opacity(0.08), in: Capsule())
                    .contentShape(Capsule())
            }
            .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
            .disabled(accepting)
            .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.overlay.invites.dismissNamed", name))
            .accessibilityIdentifier("game-overlay-invite-dismiss-\(invite.friendSteamId)")
            Button { overlay.accept(invite) } label: {
                HStack(spacing: 6) {
                    if accepting { ProgressView().controlSize(.mini).tint(.white) }
                    else { Image(systemName: "gamecontroller.fill") }
                    Text(L10n.string(failure != nil ? "ui.friends.retry" : "ui.overlay.invites.join"))
                }
                .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .padding(.horizontal, 12).frame(height: 28)
                .background(LinearGradient(colors: ObeliskStyle.launchGradient, startPoint: .leading, endPoint: .trailing),
                            in: Capsule())
                .contentShape(Capsule())
            }
            .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
            .disabled(invitations.accepting != nil || !availability.canJoin)
            .help(availability.reason ?? "")
            .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.overlay.invites.joinNamed", name))
            .accessibilityIdentifier("game-overlay-invite-join-\(invite.friendSteamId)")
        }
        Group {
            if compact {
                VStack(alignment: .trailing, spacing: 8) {
                    summary
                    buttons
                }
            } else {
                HStack(spacing: 8) {
                    summary
                    buttons
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(10)
        .background(.primary.opacity(0.05), in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
    }

    /// How long ago the game's Steam received it.
    static func received(_ invite: SteamReceivedInvite, now: Date) -> String {
        let date = min(Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval(invite.receivedAt)), now)
        return date.formatted(.relative(presentation: .named).locale(L10n.locale))
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Features/RootView.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

struct RootView: View {
    @Bindable var model: AppModel
    @Environment(\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme
    @State private var friendsAvatars = FriendsAvatarCache()
    @State private var shownFriends: FriendsPresentationState?
    @State private var windowSize = CGSize(width: 1120, height: 760)

    var body: some View {
        NavigationSplitView {
            SidebarView(model: model)
                .navigationSplitViewColumnWidth(ObeliskStyle.sidebarWidth)
        } detail: {
            Group {
                switch model.selection {
                case .home: HomeView(model: model)
                case .steam: SteamView(model: model.steam)
                case .epic: EpicView(model: model.epic)
                case .gog: GogView(model: model.gog)
                case .settings: SettingsView(model: model)
                }
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
            .background(ObeliskPalette(colorScheme: colorScheme).background)
        }
        .frame(minWidth: 860, minHeight: 600)
        .tint(ObeliskStyle.accent)
        .onGeometryChange(for: CGSize.self) { $0.size } action: { windowSize = $0 }
        .sheet(isPresented: Binding(get: { model.presentedFriends != nil }, set: { if !$0 { model.closeFriends() } })) {
            // The last friends shown, while the sheet goes away.
            if let friends = model.presentedFriends ?? shownFriends {
                FriendsModal(state: friends, avatars: friendsAvatars,
                             chat: friends.store.id == "steam" ? model.steam.chat : nil,
                             dismiss: { model.closeFriends() },
                             retry: model.retryPresentedFriends, signIn: model.signInPresentedFriends)
                    .frame(width: 520, height: 550)
                    .id(friends.account)
            }
        }
        .sheet(item: $model.presentedStore) { store in
            // As large as the window leaves room for: a sheet does not keep
            // within it.
            StorefrontStoreModal(store: store) { model.presentedStore = nil }
                .frame(width: min(1100, max(640, windowSize.width - 120)),
                       height: max(460, windowSize.height - 50))
        }
        .environment(\.presentStore) { model.presentedStore = $0 }
        .sheet(item: $model.bugReport) { report in
            BugReportSheet(model: report) { model.bugReport = nil }
        }
        .environment(\.reportBug) { model.reportBug($0) }
        .environment(model.estimates)
        .environment(model.steam.libraryArtwork)
        // A store belongs to the library it opened from.
        .onChange(of: model.selection) { model.presentedStore = nil }
        .onChange(of: model.steam.isFriendsPresented, initial: true) { _, presented in
            if presented { model.presentFriends(storeID: "steam") }
            else { model.closeFriends(storeID: "steam") }
        }
        .onChange(of: model.epic.isFriendsPresented, initial: true) { _, presented in
            if presented { model.presentFriends(storeID: "epic") }
            else { model.closeFriends(storeID: "epic") }
        }
        .onChange(of: model.steam.friends?.account) { _, _ in model.validateFriendsAccount() }
        .onChange(of: model.epic.friends?.account) { _, _ in model.validateFriendsAccount() }
        .onChange(of: model.presentedFriends?.account, initial: true) { _, account in
            friendsAvatars.activate(account: account)
            if let friends = model.presentedFriends { shownFriends = friends }
        }
        .sheet(isPresented: Binding(get: { model.presentedPrompt != nil }, set: { _ in })) {
            prompt.interactiveDismissDisabled()
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var prompt: some View {
        switch model.presentedPrompt {
        case .steamRosetta:
            RosettaPromptView(model: model.steam.rosetta)
        case .steamCloud:
            let cloud = model.steam.cloud
            SteamCloudPromptView(
                title: model.steam.cloudTitle(for: cloud.promptGame),
                message: cloud.promptMessage,
                busy: cloud.promptWorking,
                onCancel: { cloud.respond(.cancel) },
                onChooseLocal: { cloud.respond(.local) },
                onChooseCloud: { cloud.respond(.cloud) }
            )
        case .epicRosetta:
            RosettaPromptView(model: model.epic.rosetta, storefront: "epic")
        case .epicCloud:
            let cloud = model.epic.cloud
            SteamCloudPromptView(
                title: model.epic.cloudTitle(for: cloud.promptGame),
                message: cloud.promptMessage,
                busy: cloud.promptWorking,
                onCancel: { cloud.respond(.cancel) },
                onChooseLocal: { cloud.respond(.local) },
                onChooseCloud: { cloud.respond(.cloud) },
                storefront: "epic"
            )
        case .gogRosetta:
            RosettaPromptView(model: model.gog.rosetta, storefront: "gog")
        case nil:
            EmptyView()
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
/// The modal the gallery shows, with the made-up models behind it.
@MainActor @Observable
final class DeveloperModals {
    var sheet: Sheet?
    var confirmsUninstall = false
    var forceQuit: GameAction?

    /// A sheet and the models it shows, kept while it is open.
    struct Sheet: Identifiable {
        let id = UUID()
        let content: @MainActor (_ close: @escaping () -> Void) -> AnyView
    }

    nonisolated static let gameName = "ELDEN RING"
    nonisolated static let gameID = "1245620"

    private func present<Content: View>(_ content: @escaping @MainActor (_ close: @escaping () -> Void) -> Content) {
        sheet = Sheet { AnyView(content($0)) }
    }

    func cloudConflict(storefront: String, title: String, message: String, busy: Bool = false) {
        present { close in
            SteamCloudPromptView(title: "\(title) · \(Self.gameName)", message: message, busy: busy,
                                 onCancel: close, onChooseLocal: close, onChooseCloud: close, storefront: storefront)
                .interactiveDismissDisabled()
        }
    }

    func rosetta() {
        let sessions = DeveloperRosettaSessions { [weak self] in self?.sheet = nil }
        // Rust never confirms Rosetta here: the installation fails once the
        // first readiness check comes.
        let model = RosettaModel(sessions: sessions, install: { try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(3600)) },
                                 readinessDelay: { try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(3)) })
        model.connect(accountId: 0)
        present { _ in RosettaPromptView(model: model).interactiveDismissDisabled() }
    }

    /// `answer` is the HTTP status getobelisk.app answers with: 201 gives the
    /// report a code, 429 turns away more reports, anything else fails.
    func bugReport(_ subject: BugReportSubject, answer: Int) {
        let model = BugReportModel(subject: subject, sources: Self.bugReportSources()) { request in
            try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.5))
            let response = HTTPURLResponse(url: request.url ?? BugReportPayload.endpoint, statusCode: answer,
                                           httpVersion: nil, headerFields: nil)
            return (Data(#"{"code":"K7F3-9QX2"}"#.utf8), response ?? URLResponse())
        }
        present { close in BugReportSheet(model: model, close: close) }
    }

    /// A few made-up diagnostics, which the report lists: a game's logs and
    /// launch report, and for Obelisk the report alone. Nothing reads
    /// Obelisk's own log or crash reports.
    private static func bugReportSources() -> BugReportSources {
        let folder = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: "obelisk-developer-modals",
                                                                       directoryHint: .isDirectory)
        try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: folder, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        let logs = ["game.log", "game.previous.log", "input.log"].map { folder.appending(path: $0) }
        let report = folder.appending(path: "launch-report.json")
        for url in logs + [report] {
            try? Data("Made up for the modal gallery.\n".utf8).write(to: url)
        }
        let diagnostics: @Sendable (BugReportSubject, Date) -> [URL] = { subject, _ in
            if case .app = subject { [report] } else { logs + [report] }
        }
        return BugReportSources(diagnostics: diagnostics, crashReports: folder,
                                process: "obelisk-developer-modals", home: NSHomeDirectory(), unifiedLog: { "" },
                                voile: { nil })
    }

    /// A folder the player picked: by default 23 games, 271 GB of them to
    /// copy to an APFS disk with room for them.
    func gamesFolder(chosen: URL? = URL(filePath: "/Volumes/Games SSD/Jeux"), games: Int = 23,
                     available: UInt64 = 912_000_000_000, format: String? = nil, readOnly: Bool = false) {
        let path = chosen.map { $0.appending(path: "Obelisk Games").path }
            ?? AppIdentity.libraryDirectory.appending(path: "Games").path
        let proposal = GamesFolderProposal(
            chosen: chosen, path: path, games: games, copiedBytes: games > 0 ? 271_000_000_000 : 0,
            volume: chosen == nil ? "Macintosh HD" : "Games SSD", availableBytes: available, format: format,
            isReadOnly: readOnly)
        present { close in GamesFolderSheet(proposal: proposal, cancel: close, confirm: close) }
    }

    func launchSettings(_ load: @escaping () async throws -> LaunchSettings?) {
        let model = LaunchSettingsModel(load: load) { Self.launchSettings($0) }
        present { _ in LaunchSettingsSheet(model: model, gameName: Self.gameName) }
    }

    /// What Rust offers a Windows game, `choices` applied.
    nonisolated static func launchSettings(_ choices: LaunchChoices = LaunchChoices()) -> LaunchSettings {
        let engines = [
            LaunchEngineOffer(engine: .rosetta, translator: .rosetta, defaultGraphics: .d3dMetal, graphics: [
                LaunchGraphicsOffer(graphics: .d3dMetal, options: [.rayTracing]),
                LaunchGraphicsOffer(graphics: .dxmt, options: []),
            ]),
            LaunchEngineOffer(engine: .linux, translator: .fex, defaultGraphics: .dxmt,
                              graphics: [LaunchGraphicsOffer(graphics: .dxmt, options: [])]),
        ]
        let engine = choices.engine ?? .rosetta
        let offer = engines.first { $0.engine == engine } ?? engines[0]
        let graphics = choices.graphics.flatMap { chosen in offer.graphics.contains { $0.graphics == chosen } ? chosen : nil }
            ?? offer.defaultGraphics
        return LaunchSettings(engine: engine, graphics: graphics, rayTracing: choices.rayTracing ?? false,
                              performanceHud: choices.performanceHud, choices: choices, defaultEngine: .rosetta,
                              engines: engines)
    }

    func achievements(_ fetch: @escaping @MainActor @Sendable () async throws -> [GameAchievement]) {
        let model = GameAchievementsModel(storeID: "steam") { _ in
            L10n.message("backend.steam.achievements.invalidResponse")
        }
        model.load(fetch)
        present { _ in GameAchievementsView(model: model, gameName: Self.gameName) { model.load(fetch) } }
    }

    static var achievements: [GameAchievement] {
        let day: TimeInterval = 24 * 3600
        let unlocked = Date(timeIntervalSinceNow: -40 * day)
        let items: [(name: String, description: String, unlocked: Date?)] = [
            ("The Roundtable Hold", "Arrived at the Roundtable Hold", unlocked),
            ("Shardbearer Godrick", "Defeated Shardbearer Godrick", unlocked + 2 * day),
            ("Great Rune", "Restored the power of a Great Rune", unlocked + 2 * day),
            ("Legendary Armaments", "Acquired all legendary armaments", nil),
            ("Elden Lord", "Achieved the \"Elden Lord\" ending", nil),
        ]
        return items.enumerated().map { index, item in
            GameAchievement(id: String(index), name: item.name, description: item.description, iconUrl: "",
                            hidden: false, unlocked: item.unlocked != nil, unlockDate: item.unlocked)
        } + [GameAchievement(id: "hidden", name: "", description: "", iconUrl: "", hidden: true, unlocked: false,
                             unlockDate: nil)]
    }

    func friends(_ connection: FriendsConnectionState, friends: [FriendPresentation]? = nil) {
        let account = FriendsAccountIdentity(storeID: "steam", accountID: "0")
        let state = FriendsPresentationState(
            store: FriendsStoreIdentity(id: "steam", name: L10n.string("ui.store.steam"), logoAssetName: "SteamLogo"),
            account: account, friends: friends ?? Self.friends(of: account), connection: connection,
            lastKnownOnlineCount: connection == .interrupted ? 4 : nil)
        let avatars = FriendsAvatarCache()
        present { close in
            FriendsModal(state: state, avatars: avatars, dismiss: { close() }, retry: {}, signIn: { close() })
                .frame(width: 520, height: 550)
        }
    }

    private static func friends(of account: FriendsAccountIdentity) -> [FriendPresentation] {
        let friends: [(String, FriendPresence, String?)] = [
            ("Mira Okafor", .online, "ELDEN RING"),
            ("Jonas Lindqvist", .online, "Rocket League"),
            ("Ana Sousa", .online, nil),
            ("Theo Marchand", .away, nil),
            ("Kenji Watanabe", .busy, nil),
            ("Lea Brandt", .snooze, nil),
            ("Sam Carter", .offline, nil),
            ("Priya Raman", .offline, nil),
            ("Noah Fischer", .unknown, nil),
        ]
        return friends.enumerated().map { index, friend in
            FriendPresentation(id: FriendIdentity(account: account, friendID: String(index)), name: friend.0,
                               avatarURL: nil, presence: friend.1,
                               activity: friend.2.map { FriendGameActivity(id: $0, name: $0) })
        }
    }

    func store(_ id: String, title: String, url: String) {
        guard let url = URL(string: url) else { return }
        let store = StorePresentation(storeID: id, storeTitle: title) { WebPageStart(url: url) }
        present { close in
            StorefrontStoreModal(store: store, close: close)
                .frame(width: 1000, height: 680)
        }
    }

    static var forceQuitAction: GameAction {
        GameAction(kind: .running(.forceQuit), title: L10n.string("model.game.forceQuit"), isAvailable: true,
                   launches: false)
    }

    static func stopGame(_ message: String, _ stop: String) {
        _ = AppLifecycle.confirmsStoppingGames(running: message, stop: stop)
    }
}

extension View {
    /// Presents the gallery's modals over this view.
    func developerModals(_ modals: DeveloperModals) -> some View {
        modifier(DeveloperModalsPresentation(modals: modals))
    }

private struct DeveloperModalsPresentation: ViewModifier {
    @Bindable var modals: DeveloperModals

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        content
            .sheet(item: $modals.sheet) { sheet in sheet.content { modals.sheet = nil } }
            .uninstallConfirmation(DeveloperModals.gameName, isPresented: $modals.confirmsUninstall,
                                   canUninstall: true) {}
            .forceQuitConfirmation(DeveloperModals.gameName, for: DeveloperModals.forceQuitAction,
                                   asking: $modals.forceQuit)
    }
}

/// A Rosetta requirement always waiting; its cancellation closes the sheet.
@MainActor
private final class DeveloperRosettaSessions: RosettaSessions {
    struct Prompt: Equatable {}
    private let close: () -> Void

    init(close: @escaping () -> Void) {
        self.close = close
    }

    func rosettaPrompt(accountId: Int) -> Prompt? { Prompt() }
    func resumeAfterRosetta(_ prompt: Prompt) async throws { throw DeveloperModalFailure("Rosetta is not ready") }
    func cancelRosetta(_ prompt: Prompt) { close() }
    static func rosettaUnavailable(_ error: Error) -> Bool { false }
}

private struct DeveloperModalFailure: LocalizedError {
    let errorDescription: String?

    init(_ description: String) {
        errorDescription = description
    }
}
```

```swift
/// Obelisk's settings: a hero drawn from Obelisk's icon, its prism and the
/// stores' beams, reaching under the title bar band; then the appearance, the
/// language, the games, the storage, the storefronts and help, each a card of rows
/// as a game page's. The
/// bar's backdrop and the page's title show once the hero scrolled under it.
struct SettingsView: View {
    @Bindable var model: AppModel
    @State private var showsBackdrop = false
    @State private var showsTitle = false
    /// The player picks another folder for the games.
    @State private var picksGamesFolder = false

    /// The hero's height below the bar it reaches under.
    private static var heroHeight: CGFloat { 210 }
    /// How wide the cards grow: rows any wider read poorly.
    private static var contentWidth: CGFloat { 900 }

    var body: some View {
        StorefrontScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                SettingsHero(height: Self.heroHeight)
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 34) {
                    GamePageSection(title: L10n.string("ui.settings.appearance")) {
                        ObeliskCard {
                            AppearancePicker(selection: $model.appearance)
                                .padding(18)
                        }
                    }
                    GamePageSection(title: L10n.string("ui.settings.language")) {
                        ObeliskCard {
                            LanguagePicker(selection: $model.language)
                                .padding(18)
                            if model.languageNeedsRestart {
                                ObeliskCardDivider()
                                languageRestart
                                    .transition(.opacity)
                            }
                        }
                        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.2), value: model.languageNeedsRestart)
                    }
                    GamePageSection(title: L10n.string("ui.settings.games")) {
                        ObeliskCard {
                            automaticUpdates
                            ObeliskCardDivider()
                            overlay
                            ObeliskCardDivider()
                            sharePerformance
                        }
                    }
                    GamePageSection(title: L10n.string("ui.settings.storage")) {
                        storage
                    }
                    GamePageSection(title: L10n.string("ui.settings.stores")) {
                        ObeliskCard {
                            ForEach(LibrarySection.storefronts) { section in
                                if section != LibrarySection.storefronts.first { ObeliskCardDivider() }
                                SettingsStoreRow(section: section, status: status(of: section)) {
                                    model.selection = section
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    GamePageSection(title: L10n.string("ui.settings.updates")) {
                        ObeliskCard {
                            installUpdates
                            ObeliskCardDivider()
                            version
                        }
                    }
                    GamePageSection(title: L10n.string("ui.settings.help")) {
                        ObeliskCard {
                            reportBug
                            ObeliskCardDivider()
                            requestFeature
                        }

                    #if DEBUG

                }
                .frame(maxWidth: Self.contentWidth, alignment: .leading)
                .padding(.horizontal, ObeliskStyle.contentPadding)
                .padding(.top, 30)
                .padding(.bottom, 40)
            }
        }
        // The bar's backdrop shows once the hero scrolled under it, and the
        // page's title once the hero's own scrolled past the bar.
        .onScrollGeometryChange(for: Bool.self, of: { $0.contentOffset.y + $0.contentInsets.top > Self.heroHeight }) { _, under in
            showsBackdrop = under
        }
        .onScrollGeometryChange(for: Bool.self, of: { $0.contentOffset.y + $0.contentInsets.top > Self.heroHeight - 40 }) { _, under in
            showsTitle = under
        }
        .overlay(alignment: .top) {
            SettingsBar(showsBackdrop: showsBackdrop, showsTitle: showsTitle)
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea(.container, edges: .top)
        .fileImporter(isPresented: $picksGamesFolder, allowedContentTypes: [.folder]) { result in
            if case let .success(folder) = result { model.gamesFolder.propose(folder) }
        }
        .fileDialogMessage(L10n.string("ui.settings.games_folder_pick", AppIdentity.name))
        .fileDialogConfirmationLabel(L10n.string("ui.settings.games_folder_pick_confirm"))
        .fileDialogDefaultDirectory(URL(filePath: "/Volumes", directoryHint: .isDirectory))
        .sheet(item: Bindable(model.gamesFolder).proposal) { proposal in
            GamesFolderSheet(proposal: proposal, cancel: { model.gamesFolder.proposal = nil },
                             confirm: model.gamesFolder.confirm)
        }
        .errorAlert(L10n.string("ui.settings.games_folder_failed"), message: Bindable(model.gamesFolder).failure)
    }

    /// Asks for the restart a newly chosen language waits for.

    private var storage: some View {

        let outside = moving > 0 ? 0 : model.gamesOutsideFolder

    private func gamesFolder(isMoving: Bool) -> some View {
        let folder = model.gamesFolder
        return ObeliskRow(title: L10n.string("ui.settings.games_folder")) {

                                     identifier: "settings-change-games-folder") {

                        Button(L10n.string("ui.settings.games_folder_back")) { folder.proposeDefault() }
                    }
                }
            }
            .disabled(isMoving)
        }
    }

    private func gamesMoving(_ count: Int) -> some View {
        ObeliskRow(title: L10n.string("ui.settings.games_moving", Int64(count))) {

        } accessory: {

            Text(L10n.string("ui.settings.games_outside_description"))
        } accessory: {

    private var libraryFolder: some View {

                                identifier: "settings-show-library-folder") {

            }
        }
```
