```swift
    /// What a storefront's row tells of its account, as Home's tile does.
    private func status(of section: LibrarySection) -> LibraryTile.Status {
        switch section {
        case .steam:
            status(of: model.steam, in: section, showsLibrary: model.steam.showsLibrary,
                   isRestoring: model.steam.isRestoring, account: model.steam.displayName,
                   avatarURL: model.steam.avatarURL)
        case .epic:
            status(of: model.epic, in: section, showsLibrary: model.epic.showsLibrary,
                   isRestoring: model.epic.isRestoring, account: model.epic.accountName,
                   avatarURL: model.epic.avatarURL)
        default:
            status(of: model.gog, in: section, showsLibrary: model.gog.showsLibrary,
                   isRestoring: model.gog.isRestoring, account: model.gog.accountName,
                   avatarURL: model.gog.avatarURL)
        }
    }

    private func status<Store: LibraryStorefront>(
        of store: Store, in section: LibrarySection, showsLibrary: Bool, isRestoring: Bool, account: String?,
        avatarURL: URL?
    ) -> LibraryTile.Status {
        if showsLibrary {
            .signedIn(account: account, avatarURL: avatarURL, games: store.library.games.count,
                      installed: Set(store.installations.receipts.map(\.gameID)).count)
        } else if isRestoring || model.restoringStorefronts.contains(section) {
            .restoring
        } else {
            .signedOut
        }
    }
}

/// The settings' bar: the window's drag region, whose backdrop and title show
/// once the hero scrolled under it, as a game page's.
private struct SettingsBar: View {
    let showsBackdrop: Bool
    let showsTitle: Bool
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        StorefrontWindowDragRegion()
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .frame(height: ObeliskStyle.titleBarHeight)
            .overlay {
                ZStack {
                    if showsTitle {
                        Text(L10n.string("ui.settings.title"))
                            .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                            .transition(.opacity.combined(with: .offset(y: 6)))
                    }
                }
                .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .easeOut(duration: 0.2), value: showsTitle)
                .allowsHitTesting(false)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
            .background {
                Rectangle()
                    .fill(.bar)
                    .opacity(showsBackdrop ? 1 : 0)
                    .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .easeInOut(duration: 0.2), value: showsBackdrop)
                    .allowsHitTesting(false)
            }
    }
}

/// The settings' hero: Obelisk's icon as a wide scene, then the page's title
/// and Obelisk's version, light in both appearances as a library hero's.
private struct SettingsHero: View {
    /// The hero's height below the bar it reaches under.
    let height: CGFloat

    var body: some View {
        let reach = ObeliskStyle.titleBarHeight
        return HeroBackdrop { SettingsHeroArtwork() }
            .overlay(alignment: .bottomLeading) {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
                    Text(L10n.string("ui.settings.title"))
                        .font(.system(size: 40, weight: .bold))
                        .tracking(-1)
                    HStack(spacing: 16) {
                        Label {
                            Text(AppIdentity.name)
                        } icon: {
                            Image("MenuBarIcon")
                                .renderingMode(.template)
                                .resizable()
                                .scaledToFit()
                                .frame(width: 13, height: 13)
                        }
                        Label(L10n.string("ui.settings.version", AppIdentity.version), systemImage: "tag")
                            .textSelection(.enabled)
                    }
                    .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.85))
                }
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.35), radius: 10, y: 2)
                .padding(.horizontal, ObeliskStyle.contentPadding)
                .padding(.bottom, 28)
                .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
                // The text fades out as it slides under the bar, as a library
                // hero's.
                .visualEffect { [reach] content, geometry in
                    let top = geometry.frame(in: .scrollView).minY
                    return content.opacity(min(max((top - reach + 40) / 80, 0), 1))
                }
            }
            .frame(height: height + reach)
            .padding(.top, -reach)
            .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
    }
}

/// Obelisk's icon, wide: the stores' colored beams meet in a glass prism on
/// the trailing side and leave it as one white beam, on the icon's night sky.
private struct SettingsHeroArtwork: View {
    var body: some View {
        Canvas { context, size in
            SettingsHeroPrism(size: size).draw(in: &context)
        }
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

/// The icon's prism scene, in the icon's 1024-point units, placed on the
/// hero: the prism on the trailing side, its beams reaching toward the leading
/// side but fading out before the title.
private struct SettingsHeroPrism {
    let size: CGSize

    private static let apex = CGPoint(x: 512, y: 300)
    private static let baseLeading = CGPoint(x: 292, y: 681)
    private static let baseTrailing = CGPoint(x: 732, y: 681)
    private static let center = CGPoint(x: 512, y: 490)
    /// The stores' beams, magenta to cyan: where the icon starts each one and
    /// how far down the prism's leading side it enters.
    private static let beams: [(color: Color, start: CGPoint, entry: CGFloat)] = [
        (Color(red: 1, green: 0.31, blue: 0.847), CGPoint(x: 20, y: 600), 0.46),
        (Color(red: 0.753, green: 0.294, blue: 1), CGPoint(x: 20, y: 750), 0.505),
        (Color(red: 0.482, green: 0.361, blue: 1), CGPoint(x: 70, y: 890), 0.55),
        (Color(red: 0.298, green: 0.553, blue: 1), CGPoint(x: 170, y: 1000), 0.595),
        (Color(red: 0.247, green: 0.878, blue: 1), CGPoint(x: 310, y: 1080), 0.64),
    ]
    /// Where the white beam leaves the prism's trailing side.
    private static let exit = (on(apex, baseTrailing, 0.40), on(apex, baseTrailing, 0.47))

    /// Points per icon unit: the prism stands 58% of the hero's height.
    private var scale: CGFloat { size.height * 0.58 / 381 }

    /// How far the beams run past where the icon starts them: further on a wide
    /// hero, their faded start kept clear of the title on a narrow one.
    private var reach: CGFloat {
        let first = Self.beams[0]
        let entry = place(Self.on(Self.apex, Self.baseLeading, first.entry))
        let run = (Self.on(Self.apex, Self.baseLeading, first.entry).x - first.start.x) * scale
        return min(max((entry.x - 300) / run, 0.7), 1.8)
    }

    func draw(in context: inout GraphicsContext) {
        context.fill(Path(CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size)), with: .radialGradient(
            Gradient(stops: [
                .init(color: Color(red: 0.165, green: 0.102, blue: 0.416), location: 0),
                .init(color: Color(red: 0.067, green: 0.043, blue: 0.2), location: 0.55),
                .init(color: Color(red: 0.02, green: 0.012, blue: 0.071), location: 1),
            ]),
            center: place(CGPoint(x: 560, y: 420)), startRadius: 0, endRadius: max(size.width * 0.8, 680 * scale)))

        let beams = Self.beams.map { beam in
            let entry = Self.on(Self.apex, Self.baseLeading, beam.entry)
            let start = Self.on(entry, beam.start, reach)
            let length = hypot(start.x - entry.x, start.y - entry.y)
            let normal = CGPoint(x: -(entry.y - start.y) / length, y: (entry.x - start.x) / length)
            let startWidth = 6 + 20 * reach
            let path = polygon([
                CGPoint(x: start.x + normal.x * startWidth, y: start.y + normal.y * startWidth),
                CGPoint(x: entry.x + normal.x * 6, y: entry.y + normal.y * 6),
                CGPoint(x: entry.x - normal.x * 6, y: entry.y - normal.y * 6),
                CGPoint(x: start.x - normal.x * startWidth, y: start.y - normal.y * startWidth),
            ])
            let shading = GraphicsContext.Shading.linearGradient(
                Gradient(stops: [
                    .init(color: beam.color.opacity(0), location: 0),
                    .init(color: beam.color.opacity(0.85), location: 0.5),
                    .init(color: beam.color, location: 1),
                ]),
                startPoint: place(start), endPoint: place(entry))
            return (path, shading)
        }
        context.drawLayer { glow in
            glow.addFilter(.blur(radius: 24 * scale))
            for (path, shading) in beams { glow.fill(path, with: shading) }
        }
        for (path, shading) in beams { context.fill(path, with: shading) }

        // The light crossing the prism, from the beams to the white beam.
        let (exitTop, exitBottom) = Self.exit
        let entries = Self.beams.map { Self.on(Self.apex, Self.baseLeading, $0.entry) }
        context.drawLayer { inner in
            inner.addFilter(.blur(radius: 8 * scale))
            inner.fill(polygon([entries[0], entries[4], exitBottom, exitTop]), with: .linearGradient(
                Gradient(colors: [.white.opacity(0.45), .white.opacity(0.95)]),
                startPoint: place(entries[2]), endPoint: place(exitTop)))
        }

        let beamOut = polygon([
            exitTop, Self.on(exitTop, CGPoint(x: 1060, y: 170), 3),
            Self.on(exitBottom, CGPoint(x: 1060, y: 250), 3), exitBottom,
        ])
        context.drawLayer { glow in
            glow.addFilter(.blur(radius: 24 * scale))
            glow.fill(beamOut, with: .color(Color(red: 1, green: 0.839, blue: 0.965).opacity(0.9)))
        }
        context.fill(beamOut, with: .linearGradient(
            Gradient(colors: [.white, .white.opacity(0.75)]),
            startPoint: place(exitTop), endPoint: place(CGPoint(x: 1024, y: 200))))

        let prism = polygon([Self.apex, Self.baseTrailing, Self.baseLeading])
        let top = place(Self.apex)
        let bottom = CGPoint(x: top.x, y: place(Self.baseLeading).y)
        context.fill(prism, with: .linearGradient(
            Gradient(colors: [.white.opacity(0.3), .white.opacity(0.06)]), startPoint: top, endPoint: bottom))
        context.stroke(prism, with: .linearGradient(
            Gradient(colors: [.white.opacity(0.95), .white.opacity(0.35)]), startPoint: top, endPoint: bottom),
            style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 10 * scale, lineJoin: .round))
    }

    /// An icon point on the hero: the prism's center 240 points from the
    /// trailing edge, a little below the middle.
    private func place(_ point: CGPoint) -> CGPoint {
        CGPoint(x: size.width - 240 + (point.x - Self.center.x) * scale,
                y: size.height * 0.56 + (point.y - Self.center.y) * scale)
    }

    private func polygon(_ points: [CGPoint]) -> Path {
        Path { path in
            path.addLines(points.map(place))
            path.closeSubpath()
        }
    }

    private static func on(_ from: CGPoint, _ to: CGPoint, _ fraction: CGFloat) -> CGPoint {
        CGPoint(x: from.x + (to.x - from.x) * fraction, y: from.y + (to.y - from.y) * fraction)
    }
}

/// The three appearances as small windows of Obelisk, the chosen one ringed in
/// the accent color; the ring slides to a new choice.
private struct AppearancePicker: View {
    @Binding var selection: AppAppearance
    @State private var hovered: AppAppearance?
    @Namespace private var namespace
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 20) {
            ForEach(AppAppearance.allCases) { option($0) }
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
        .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.settings.theme"))
    }

    private func option(_ appearance: AppAppearance) -> some View {
        let isSelected = appearance == selection
        let window = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10, style: .continuous)
        return Button {
            withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : ObeliskStyle.selectionAnimation) { selection = appearance }
        } label: {
            VStack(spacing: 9) {
                AppearancePreview(appearance: appearance)
                    .frame(width: 150, height: 96)
                    .clipShape(window)
                    .overlay { window.strokeBorder(.primary.opacity(0.14), lineWidth: 1) }
                    .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.18), radius: 6, y: 3)
                    .padding(4)
                    .overlay {
                        if isSelected {
                            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous)
                                .strokeBorder(ObeliskStyle.accent, lineWidth: 2.5)
                                .matchedGeometryEffect(id: "selection", in: namespace)
                        }
                    }
                    .scaleEffect(hovered == appearance && !isSelected && !reduceMotion ? 1.03 : 1)
                Text(appearance.title)
                    .font(.system(size: 12, weight: isSelected ? .semibold : .medium))
                    .foregroundStyle(isSelected ? .primary : .secondary)
            }
            // The choices share the card's width.
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
        .onHover { hovered = $0 ? appearance : (hovered == appearance ? nil : hovered) }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.75), value: hovered)
        .accessibilityLabel(appearance.title)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
        .accessibilityIdentifier("settings-appearance-\(appearance.id)")
    }
}

/// A language's flag, two split across the diagonal as the system's
/// appearance is for a language several countries speak, and for the Mac's
/// language a globe; on a flag's rounded shape, edged so a white stripe stays
/// visible.
private struct LanguageFlag: View {
    let language: AppLanguage

    var body: some View {
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 7, style: .continuous)
        let flags = language.flags.filter { NSImage(named: $0) != nil }
        ZStack {
            if let first = flags.first {
                Image(first)
                    .resizable()
                if let second = flags.dropFirst().first {
                    // The second flag's middle, where its emblem sits, moves
                    // to the middle of its half.
                    GeometryReader { geometry in
                        Image(second)
                            .resizable()
                            .offset(x: geometry.size.width * (1 - (TrailingDiagonalHalf.top + TrailingDiagonalHalf.bottom) / 2) / 2)
                    }
                    .mask { TrailingDiagonalHalf() }
                    // A white edge parts two flags of the same colors.
                    DiagonalEdge()
                        .stroke(.white, lineWidth: 2.5)
                        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.35), radius: 1.5)
                }
            } else {
                LinearGradient(colors: [Color(red: 0.38, green: 0.68, blue: 0.98), Color(red: 0.2, green: 0.45, blue: 0.9)],
                               startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                Image(systemName: language.code == nil ? "globe" : "character.bubble")
                    .font(.system(size: 22, weight: .medium))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
            }
        }
        .clipShape(shape)
        .overlay { shape.strokeBorder(.primary.opacity(0.14), lineWidth: 1) }
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

/// A small window of Obelisk in one appearance; the system's is light, then
/// dark past a diagonal.
private struct AppearancePreview: View {
    let appearance: AppAppearance

        case .dark: MiniatureWindow(colorScheme: .dark)
        case .system:

        }
    }
}

/// Obelisk's window in miniature: its sidebar, a hero and a shelf of covers.
private struct MiniatureWindow: View {
    let colorScheme: ColorScheme

    private static let covers = [
        Color(red: 0.95, green: 0.58, blue: 0.25), Color(red: 0.3, green: 0.56, blue: 0.95),
        Color(red: 0.4, green: 0.76, blue: 0.45), Color(red: 0.92, green: 0.4, blue: 0.6),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        let isDark = colorScheme == .dark
        let line = isDark ? Color.white.opacity(0.22) : Color.black.opacity(0.13)
        HStack(spacing: 0) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 5) {
                HStack(spacing: 2.5) {
                    ForEach([Color.red, .yellow, .green], id: \.self) { color in
                        Circle().fill(color.opacity(0.85)).frame(width: 4.5, height: 4.5)
                    }
                }
                .padding(.bottom, 3)
                Capsule().fill(ObeliskStyle.accent.opacity(0.85)).frame(width: 24, height: 5)
                ForEach([18, 21, 15] as [CGFloat], id: \.self) { width in
                    Capsule().fill(line).frame(width: width, height: 4)
                }
            }
            .padding(6)
            .frame(width: 42, alignment: .topLeading)
            .frame(maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
            .background(isDark ? Color(white: 0.19) : Color(white: 0.91))
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
                LinearGradient(colors: [Color(red: 0.62, green: 0.2, blue: 0.92), Color(red: 0.25, green: 0.12, blue: 0.6)],
                               startPoint: .topTrailing, endPoint: .bottomLeading)
                    .frame(height: 38)
                    .overlay(alignment: .bottomLeading) {
                        Capsule().fill(.white.opacity(0.8)).frame(width: 30, height: 4).padding(6)
                    }
                HStack(spacing: 4) {
                    ForEach(Self.covers, id: \.self) { color in
                        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 2.5, style: .continuous)
                            .fill(color.opacity(isDark ? 0.8 : 0.9))
                            .frame(width: 22, height: 33)
                    }
                }
                .padding(.leading, 6)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                .clipped()
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
            .background(ObeliskPalette(colorScheme: colorScheme).background)
        }
    }
}

/// The part of a rectangle past a diagonal from its top to its bottom edge.
private struct TrailingDiagonalHalf: Shape {
    /// Where the diagonal meets the top and the bottom edge, from the leading
    /// one.
    static let top = 0.62
    static let bottom = 0.38

    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        Path { path in
            path.move(to: CGPoint(x: rect.minX + rect.width * Self.top, y: rect.minY))
            path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: rect.maxX, y: rect.minY))
            path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: rect.maxX, y: rect.maxY))
            path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: rect.minX + rect.width * Self.bottom, y: rect.maxY))
            path.closeSubpath()
        }
    }
}

/// The diagonal that bounds `TrailingDiagonalHalf`, past both edges so a
/// stroke reaches the corners.
private struct DiagonalEdge: Shape {
    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        let slope = rect.width * (TrailingDiagonalHalf.bottom - TrailingDiagonalHalf.top) / rect.height
        return Path { path in
            path.move(to: CGPoint(x: rect.minX + rect.width * TrailingDiagonalHalf.top - slope * 4, y: rect.minY - 4))
            path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: rect.minX + rect.width * TrailingDiagonalHalf.bottom + slope * 4,
                                     y: rect.maxY + 4))
        }
    }
}

/// A storefront and its account, as Home's tile tells it, opening its library
/// or its sign-in.
private struct SettingsStoreRow: View {
    let section: LibrarySection
    let status: LibraryTile.Status
    let open: () -> Void

    private var name: String { section.storeName ?? section.title }

    var body: some View {
        ObeliskRow(title: name) {
            StoreTile(section: section)
        } detail: {
            detail
        } accessory: {
            accessory
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
        .accessibilityIdentifier("settings-store-\(section.rawValue)")
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var detail: some View {
        switch status {
        case let .signedIn(account, avatarURL, games, installed):
            HStack(spacing: 6) {
                if let account, !account.isEmpty {
                    AccountAvatar(name: account, url: avatarURL)
                        .frame(width: 16, height: 16)
                    Text(account)
                        .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                    Text(verbatim: "·")
                }
                Text([L10n.string("ui.library.game_count", Int64(games)),
                      installed > 0 ? L10n.string("ui.home.installed_count", Int64(installed)) : nil]
                    .compactMap { $0 }
                    .joined(separator: " · "))
                    .monospacedDigit()
            }
            .lineLimit(1)
        case .restoring:
            HStack(spacing: 6) {
                ProgressView().controlSize(.mini)
                Text(L10n.string("ui.account.signing_in"))
            }
        case .signedOut:
            Text(L10n.string("ui.home.signed_out"))
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var accessory: some View {
        switch status {
        case .signedIn:
            GlassCapsuleButton(title: L10n.string("ui.settings.open"),
                                accessibilityLabel: L10n.string("ui.settings.open_store", name),
                                identifier: "settings-open-\(section.rawValue)", action: open)
        case .restoring:
            EmptyView()
        case .signedOut:
            AccentCapsuleButton(title: L10n.string("ui.account.sign_in"),
                                 accessibilityLabel: L10n.string("ui.home.sign_in_store", name),
                                 identifier: "settings-sign-in-\(section.rawValue)", action: open)
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
import SwiftUI

struct SidebarView: View {
    @Bindable var model: AppModel

    var body: some View {
        List(selection: selection(where: { $0 != .settings })) {
            row(.home)

            Section {
                ForEach(LibrarySection.storefronts) { row($0) }
            } header: {
                Text(L10n.string("ui.library.title"))
                    .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
            }
        }
        .listStyle(.sidebar)
        .environment(\.sidebarRowSize, .large)
        .toolbar(removing: .sidebarToggle)
        // The download queue, then Settings, stay at the bottom of the
        // sidebar, whatever its height.
        .safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom, spacing: 0) {
            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                if model.downloads.isVisible {
                    DownloadsSidebarButton(downloads: model.downloads, game: model.downloadGame,
                                           open: model.openDownload)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 10)
                        .padding(.top, 6)
                        .transition(.move(edge: .bottom).combined(with: .opacity))
                }
                List(selection: selection(where: { $0 == .settings })) {
                    row(.settings)
                }
                .listStyle(.sidebar)
                .environment(\.sidebarRowSize, .large)
                .scrollDisabled(true)
                .frame(height: 52)
            }
            .animation(.spring(response: 0.35, dampingFraction: 0.85), value: model.downloads.isVisible)
        }
    }

    /// One list's share of the app's single selection.
    private func selection(where owns: @escaping (LibrarySection) -> Bool) -> Binding<LibrarySection?> {
        Binding(
            get: { owns(model.selection) ? model.selection : nil },
            set: { if let section = $0 { model.selection = section } }
        )
    }

    private func row(_ section: LibrarySection) -> some View {
        Label {
            Text(section.title)
        } icon: {
            sidebarIcon(section)
        }
        .listItemTint(section == .settings ? .monochrome : .fixed(ObeliskStyle.accent))
        .pointerCursor()
        .tag(section)
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func sidebarIcon(_ section: LibrarySection) -> some View {
        if let logoAssetName = section.logoAssetName {
            Image(logoAssetName)
                .renderingMode(.template)
                .resizable()
                .scaledToFit()
                .frame(width: 20, height: 20)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
        } else {
            Image(systemName: section.symbol)
        }
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Features/Steam/SteamArtwork.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// A game's library artwork, in the order Steam's library tries it: the image
/// its PICS app info names, which newer games publish only under a hashed
/// folder, then the one at Steam's plain name, as while PICS has not told of
/// the game. A game without a cover has the portrait Steam generates for it,
/// and one that publishes no image at all, such as a staging branch, its
/// parent game's.
struct SteamArtwork: View {
    let appId: UInt32
    var portrait = true
    var iconHash = ""
    @Environment(SteamLibraryArtwork.self) private var library: SteamLibraryArtwork?

    /// The image at `path` under the game's store assets.
    static func url(appId: UInt32, path: String) -> URL? {
        URL(string: "https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/\(appId)/\(path)")
    }

    /// The header last, which games without library artwork still have.
    private var urls: [URL] {
        let parent = library?.games[appId]?.parent
        // A game such as ELDEN RING names its images at the plain names.
        var seen: Set<URL> = []
        return [appId, parent].compactMap { $0 }.flatMap(urls(of:)).filter { seen.insert($0).inserted }
    }

    private func urls(of app: UInt32) -> [URL] {
        let artwork = library?.games[app]
        let paths: [String?] = portrait
            ? [artwork?.cover, "library_600x900.jpg", "portrait.png?v=2", artwork?.header, "header.jpg"]
            : [artwork?.hero, "library_hero.jpg", artwork?.header, "header.jpg"]
        return paths.compactMap { $0 }.compactMap { Self.url(appId: app, path: $0) }
    }

    var body: some View {
        // A cover decodes at its published size, a hero at most 2048 pixels wide as Epic's.
        CachedArtwork(urls: urls, maxPixelSize: portrait ? 900 : 2048) { image in
            image.resizable().scaledToFill()
        } placeholder: {
            ArtworkPlaceholder()
        } failure: {
            icon
        }
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var icon: some View {
        if iconHash.count == 40 && iconHash.allSatisfy(\.isHexDigit),
           let url = URL(string: "https://media.steampowered.com/steamcommunity/public/images/apps/\(appId)/\(iconHash).jpg") {
            CachedArtwork(url: url, maxPixelSize: 64) { image in
                ArtworkPlaceholder().overlay { image.resizable().scaledToFit().padding(30) }
            } placeholder: {
                ArtworkPlaceholder()
            }
        } else {
            ArtworkPlaceholder()
        }
    }
}

/// The game's library logo over its hero, or its name where the game
/// publishes none.
struct SteamHeroLogo: View {
    let appId: UInt32
    let title: String
    @Environment(SteamLibraryArtwork.self) private var library: SteamLibraryArtwork?

    var body: some View {
        let artwork = library?.games[appId]
        // A staging branch shows its parent game's logo, as its hero.
        let app = artwork?.logo == nil ? artwork?.parent ?? appId : appId
        let path = library?.games[app]?.logo ?? "logo.png"
        LibraryHeroLogo(url: SteamArtwork.url(appId: app, path: path), title: title)
    }
}
```

```swift
import SwiftUI

struct SteamGameDetailView: View {
    @Bindable var model: SteamModel
    let game: SteamGame
    let context: GamePageContext<SteamArtwork, SteamArtwork>

    private var installations: SteamInstallations { model.installations }

    private var estimatedBytes: UInt64 {
        model.platform == .mac ? model.details?.macosBytes ?? 0 : model.details?.windowsBytes ?? 0
    }

    private static var newsColumns: [GridItem] {
        [GridItem(.adaptive(minimum: 340), spacing: 16, alignment: .top)]
    }

    var body: some View {
        GameDetailPage(
            model: model,
            game: game,
            context: context,
            size: sizeText,
            showsUnplayed: true
        ) {
            if model.isLoadingDetails {
                ProgressView(L10n.string("ui.steam.finding_files")).controlSize(.small)
            } else if let error = model.detailsError {
                HStack {
                    Text(L10n.message(error)).font(.system(size: 12)).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    Button(L10n.string("ui.common.retry"), action: model.reloadDetails)
                        .obeliskButtonStyle(.glass)
                        .controlSize(.small)
                }
            }

            GameOperationStatus(installations: installations, game: game.appId)

            newsSection
        }
    }

    // This view is only shown for `model.selectedGame`, so the receipts agree.
    private var sizeText: String {
        let bytes = installations.selectedReceipt?.totalBytes ?? estimatedBytes
        return bytes > 0 ? GameFormatting.bytes(bytes) : "—"
    }

    private var newsSection: some View {
        GamePageSection(title: L10n.string("ui.game.news")) {
            if model.isLoadingNews {
                ProgressView(L10n.string("ui.game.loading_news")).controlSize(.small)
            } else if let error = model.newsError {
                Text(L10n.message(error)).font(.system(size: 12)).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            } else if model.news.isEmpty {
                Text(L10n.string("ui.game.no_recent_news")).font(.system(size: 12)).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            } else {
                LazyVGrid(columns: Self.newsColumns, alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
                    ForEach(model.news, id: \.id) { article in
                        newsCard(article)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func newsCard(_ article: SteamNews) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 9) {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                Text(article.source)
                Text("·")
                Text(Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval(article.date)), format: .dateTime.day().month(.abbreviated).year().locale(L10n.locale))
            }
            .font(.system(size: 10, weight: .medium)).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            Text(article.title).font(.system(size: 15, weight: .semibold))
            if !article.excerpt.isEmpty {
                Text(article.excerpt).font(.system(size: 12)).foregroundStyle(.secondary).lineLimit(5)
            }
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
            if let url = URL(string: article.url), url.scheme == "https", url.host != nil {
                Link(destination: url) { Label(L10n.string("ui.game.read_article"), systemImage: "arrow.up.right") }
                    .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .semibold))
                    .pointerCursor()
            }
        }
        .modifier(GamePageCard())
    }
}
```

```swift
import CoreImage.CIFilterBuiltins
import SwiftUI

struct SteamLoginView: View {
    @Bindable var model: SteamModel
    @State private var account = ""
    @State private var password = ""
    @State private var guardCode = ""
    @FocusState private var isGuardCodeFocused: Bool

    var body: some View {
        StorefrontSignInPage(
            section: .steam,
            title: L10n.string("ui.steam.sign_in_title"),
            subtitle: L10n.string("ui.steam.sign_in_subtitle"),
            cardWidth: isWaiting || isGuardStep ? 480 : 720,
            warning: $model.storageWarning
        ) {
            if isWaiting {
                SignInProgress(title: model.isRestoring ? L10n.string("ui.account.restoring_session") : L10n.string("ui.steam.connecting"))
            } else if isGuardStep {
                guardStep
            } else {
                HStack(alignment: .center, spacing: 30) {
                    credentials
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                    Rectangle()
                        .fill(.primary.opacity(0.1))
                        .frame(width: 1)
                        .padding(.vertical, 8)
                    // As wide as the code, so both columns keep the card's margins.
                    qrCode
                        .frame(width: 176)
                }
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
            }
        }
    }

    private var isWaiting: Bool { model.isRestoring || model.isConnecting }
    private var isGuardStep: Bool { model.isCredentialChallenge && !model.isSubmittingCredentials }

    private var credentials: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14) {
            Text(L10n.string("ui.steam.account_sign_in"))
                .font(.system(size: 16, weight: .semibold))
                .padding(.bottom, 2)
            SignInField(
                symbol: "person",
                placeholder: L10n.string("ui.steam.account_name_placeholder"),
                text: $account,
                contentType: .username,
                accessibilityLabel: L10n.string("ui.steam.account_name_accessibility")
            )
            SignInField(
                symbol: "lock",
                placeholder: L10n.string("ui.account.password"),
                text: $password,
                isSecure: true,
                contentType: .password,
                onSubmit: signIn
            )
            SignInRememberToggle(isOn: $model.rememberSession)
                .padding(.horizontal, 2)
            Button(action: signIn) {
                HStack(spacing: 8) {
                    if model.isSubmittingCredentials { ProgressView().controlSize(.small) }
                    Text(model.isSubmittingCredentials ? L10n.string("ui.account.signing_in") : L10n.string("ui.account.sign_in"))
                }
                .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            }
            .obeliskButtonStyle(.glassProminent)
            .controlSize(.extraLarge)
            .disabled(account.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).isEmpty || password.isEmpty || model.isSubmittingCredentials)
            Link(L10n.string("ui.steam.sign_in_help"), destination: URL(string: "https://help.steampowered.com/\(L10n.languageCode)/wizard/HelpWithLogin")!)
                .font(.system(size: 12))
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .pointerCursor()
        }
        .disabled(model.isSubmittingCredentials)
    }

    private var qrCode: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 14) {
            Text(L10n.string("ui.steam.qr_title"))
                .font(.system(size: 16, weight: .semibold))
            ZStack {
                if let url = model.qrURL {
                    SteamQRCode(value: url)
                } else {
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16).fill(.primary.opacity(0.05))
                    if model.qrError == nil { ProgressView() }
                    else { Image(systemName: "qrcode").font(.system(size: 45)).foregroundStyle(.secondary) }
                }
            }
            .frame(width: 176, height: 176)
            if let error = model.qrError {
                Text(L10n.message(error))
                    .font(.system(size: 12)).foregroundStyle(.secondary).multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                Button(L10n.string("ui.steam.qr_refresh"), systemImage: "arrow.clockwise", action: model.beginQR)
                    .obeliskButtonStyle(.glass)
            } else {
                Text(model.challenge?.remoteInteraction == true ? L10n.string("ui.steam.qr_confirm") : L10n.string("ui.steam.qr_instructions"))
                    .font(.system(size: 12)).foregroundStyle(.secondary).multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                    .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
            }
        }
    }

    private var guardStep: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 18) {
            Image(systemName: "lock.shield")
                .font(.system(size: 28, weight: .medium))
                .foregroundStyle(ObeliskStyle.accent)
                .frame(width: 64, height: 64)
                .background(ObeliskStyle.accent.opacity(0.14), in: Circle())
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
            Text(L10n.string("ui.steam.guard_title"))
                .font(.system(size: 22, weight: .semibold))
            if let challenge = model.challenge {
                let methods = challenge.confirmations.filter { [.deviceConfirmation, .emailCode, .deviceCode, .emailConfirmation].contains($0.kind) }
                if methods.count > 1 {
                    Picker(L10n.string("ui.steam.guard_method"), selection: $model.guardKind) {
                        ForEach(Array(methods.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { _, method in
                            Text(guardLabel(method.kind)).tag(method.kind)
                        }
                    }
                    .labelsHidden()
                    .pointerCursor()
                    .frame(maxWidth: 280)
                }
                if model.guardKind == .emailCode || model.guardKind == .deviceCode {
                    Text(model.guardKind == .emailCode ? L10n.string("ui.steam.guard_email_code_instructions") : L10n.string("ui.steam.guard_device_code_instructions"))
                        .font(.system(size: 13)).foregroundStyle(.secondary).multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                    if let message = challenge.confirmations.first(where: { $0.kind == model.guardKind })?.message, !message.isEmpty {
                        Text(L10n.message(message)).font(.system(size: 12)).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                    // The field's own placeholder would take the code's large type.
                    TextField("", text: $guardCode)
                        .textFieldStyle(.plain)
                        .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.steam.guard_code"))
                        .font(.system(size: 24, weight: .semibold, design: .monospaced))
                        .tracking(6)
                        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                        .focused($isGuardCodeFocused)
                        .onSubmit(submitGuard)
                        .frame(width: 220, height: 54)
                        .overlay {
                            if guardCode.isEmpty {
                                Text(L10n.string("ui.steam.guard_code"))
                                    .font(.system(size: 14))
                                    .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
                                    .allowsHitTesting(false)
                                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
                            }
                        }
                        .modifier(SignInWell(isFocused: isGuardCodeFocused))
                        .onTapGesture { isGuardCodeFocused = true }
                    Button(action: submitGuard) {
                        Text(model.isSubmittingGuard ? L10n.string("ui.transfer.verifying_short") : L10n.string("ui.steam.guard_verify_code"))
                            .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                            .frame(width: 196)
                    }
                    .obeliskButtonStyle(.glassProminent)
                    .controlSize(.extraLarge)
                    .disabled(guardCode.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).count != 5 || model.isSubmittingGuard)
                } else {
                    ProgressView()
                    Text(model.guardKind == .emailConfirmation ? L10n.string("ui.steam.guard_email_instructions") : L10n.string("ui.steam.guard_device_instructions"))
                        .font(.system(size: 13)).foregroundStyle(.secondary).multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                }
            } else { ProgressView(L10n.string("ui.steam.guard_preparing")) }
            Button(L10n.string("ui.steam.back_to_sign_in"), systemImage: "chevron.left", action: model.beginQR)
                .obeliskButtonStyle(.borderless)
                .font(.system(size: 12))
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
    }

    private func signIn() {
        guard !password.isEmpty && !account.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).isEmpty else { return }
        let suppliedPassword = password
        password = ""
        model.signIn(account: account, password: suppliedPassword)
    }

    private func submitGuard() {
        model.submitGuard(guardCode)
        guardCode = ""
    }

    private func guardLabel(_ kind: SteamGuardKind) -> String {
        switch kind {
        case .deviceConfirmation: L10n.string("ui.steam.guard_method_notification")
        case .deviceCode: L10n.string("ui.steam.guard_method_device_code")
        case .emailCode: L10n.string("ui.steam.guard_method_email_code")
        case .emailConfirmation: L10n.string("ui.steam.guard_method_email_confirmation")
        default: L10n.string("ui.steam.guard_method_default")
        }
    }
}

private struct SteamQRCode: View {
    let value: String
    // Context creation is expensive; one shared instance serves every render.
    private static let context = CIContext()

    private var image: CGImage? {
        let filter = CIFilter.qrCodeGenerator()
        filter.message = Data(value.utf8)
        filter.correctionLevel = "H"
        guard let output = filter.outputImage else { return nil }
        return Self.context.createCGImage(output, from: output.extent)
    }

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if let image {
                Image(decorative: image, scale: 1)
                    .interpolation(.none).resizable().scaledToFit()
                    .padding(12).background(.white, in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16))
            } else { Image(systemName: "qrcode").font(.largeTitle) }
        }
        .accessibilityLabel(L10n.string("ui.steam.qr_accessibility"))
    }
}
```

```swift
import SwiftUI

struct SteamView: View {
    @Bindable var model: SteamModel
    @State private var libraryScroll = LibraryScrollMemory()

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if model.showsLibrary {
                browser
            } else {
                SteamLoginView(model: model)
            }
        }
        .task { await model.start() }
        .errorAlert(L10n.string("ui.store.steam"), message: $model.errorMessage)
    }

    private var browser: some View {
        StorefrontBrowser(
            model: model,
            storeID: "steam",
            storeTitle: L10n.string("ui.store.steam"),
            libraryTitle: L10n.string("ui.steam.library"),
            accountName: model.displayName,
            avatarURL: model.avatarURL,
            storePage: model.storePage,
            scrollMemory: libraryScroll,
            heroArtwork: Self.heroArtwork,
            heroLogo: Self.heroLogo,
            artwork: Self.cover
        ) {
            accountMenu
        } gamePage: { game, context in
            SteamGameDetailView(model: model, game: game, context: context)
        }
    }

    /// A game's wide artwork, as its library's hero and its page show it.
    static func heroArtwork(_ game: SteamGame) -> SteamArtwork {
        SteamArtwork(appId: game.appId, portrait: false, iconHash: game.iconHash)
    }

    static func heroLogo(_ game: SteamGame) -> SteamHeroLogo {
        SteamHeroLogo(appId: game.appId, title: game.name)
    }

    static func cover(_ game: SteamGame) -> SteamArtwork {
        SteamArtwork(appId: game.appId, iconHash: game.iconHash)
    }

    @ViewBuilder private var accountMenu: some View {
        Text(model.displayName ?? L10n.string("ui.steam.account"))
        Text(L10n.string("ui.library.account_game_count", Int64(model.library.games.count)))
        Divider()
        SteamFriendsMenuButton(model: model)
        Divider()
        Button(L10n.string("ui.library.refresh"), systemImage: "arrow.clockwise", action: model.refresh)
        Divider()
        Button(L10n.string("ui.account.sign_out"), systemImage: "rectangle.portrait.and.arrow.right", action: model.signOut)
    }
}

/// Reads the friends and the unread messages in its own body: their every
/// change redraws the button alone, not the library.
private struct SteamFriendsMenuButton: View {
    let model: SteamModel

    var body: some View {
        Button(title, systemImage: "person.2", action: model.openFriends)
            .accessibilityIdentifier("steam-friends-menu")
    }

    private var title: String {
        let title = model.friends?.menuTitle ?? L10n.string("ui.friends.menuLoading")
        let unread = model.chat.totalUnread
        return unread > 0 ? [title, L10n.string("ui.chat.unreadCount", Int64(unread))].joined(separator: " · ") : title
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Features/StorefrontBrowser.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// A signed-in storefront: its library, or the page of the game it opened,
/// under one floating glass bar. Opening a game from its cover flies the cover
/// from the library to the game's page while the library falls back and the
/// page's artwork settles in; going back flies it home.
struct StorefrontBrowser<Model: LibraryStorefront, HeroArtwork: View, HeroLogo: View, Artwork: View,
                         AccountMenu: View, GamePage: View>: View {
    @Bindable var model: Model
    let storeID: String
    let storeTitle: String
    let libraryTitle: String
    let accountName: String?
    let avatarURL: URL?
    /// How the storefront's store opens, signed in as the account.
    let storePage: (@MainActor () async -> WebPageStart)?
    let scrollMemory: LibraryScrollMemory
    @ViewBuilder let heroArtwork: (Model.Game) -> HeroArtwork
    @ViewBuilder let heroLogo: (Model.Game) -> HeroLogo
    @ViewBuilder let artwork: (Model.Game) -> Artwork
    @ViewBuilder let accountMenu: AccountMenu
    @ViewBuilder let gamePage: (Model.Game, GamePageContext<HeroArtwork, Artwork>) -> GamePage
    @Namespace private var namespace
    @State private var bar = StorefrontBarState()
    /// Where the open game came from, once a game opened with motion.
    @State private var source: GameOpeningSource?
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.presentStore) private var presentStore

    init(
        model: Model,
        storeID: String,
        storeTitle: String,
        libraryTitle: String,
        accountName: String?,
        avatarURL: URL? = nil,
        storePage: (@MainActor () async -> WebPageStart)? = nil,
        scrollMemory: LibraryScrollMemory,
        @ViewBuilder heroArtwork: @escaping (Model.Game) -> HeroArtwork,
        @ViewBuilder heroLogo: @escaping (Model.Game) -> HeroLogo,
        @ViewBuilder artwork: @escaping (Model.Game) -> Artwork,
        @ViewBuilder accountMenu: () -> AccountMenu,
        @ViewBuilder gamePage: @escaping (Model.Game, GamePageContext<HeroArtwork, Artwork>) -> GamePage
    ) {
        self.model = model
        self.storeID = storeID
        self.storeTitle = storeTitle
        self.libraryTitle = libraryTitle
        self.accountName = accountName
        self.avatarURL = avatarURL
        self.storePage = storePage
        self.scrollMemory = scrollMemory
        self.heroArtwork = heroArtwork
        self.heroLogo = heroLogo
        self.artwork = artwork
        self.accountMenu = accountMenu()
        self.gamePage = gamePage
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            if let game = model.selectedGame {
                gamePage(game, GamePageContext(storeID: storeID, heroArtwork: heroArtwork(game), cover: artwork(game)))
                    .id(game.id)
                    // Above the library it replaces, which falls back beneath it.
                    .zIndex(1)
                    // The page reveals itself; leaving, it fades over the
                    // library as its cover flies home.
                    .transition(.asymmetric(insertion: .identity, removal: .opacity))
            } else {
                StorefrontLibraryPage(
                    model: model,
                    storeID: storeID,
                    storeTitle: storeTitle,
                    libraryTitle: libraryTitle,
                    scrollMemory: scrollMemory,
                    open: open,
                    heroArtwork: heroArtwork,
                    heroLogo: heroLogo,
                    artwork: artwork
                )
                .transition(.asymmetric(insertion: .identity,
                                        removal: .opacity.combined(with: .scale(scale: reduceMotion ? 1 : 0.94))))
            }
        }
        // An overlay rather than a safe area bar: on macOS the bar's scroll
        // edge effect cannot be turned off, and it veils the hero's artwork.
        .overlay(alignment: .top) {
            StorefrontBrowserBar(
                model: model,
                bar: bar,
                storeTitle: storeTitle,
                libraryTitle: libraryTitle,
                accountName: accountName,
                avatarURL: avatarURL,
                openStore: openStore,
                back: back
            ) {
                accountMenu
            }
        }
        .environment(\.storefrontBar, bar)
        .environment(\.gameTransition, GameTransition(namespace: namespace, source: source))
        .ignoresSafeArea(.container, edges: .top)
    }

    /// Opens the store over the whole window, when the storefront has one.
    private var openStore: (() -> Void)? {
        guard let storePage, let presentStore else { return nil }
        let store = StorePresentation(storeID: storeID, storeTitle: storeTitle, start: storePage)
        return { presentStore(store) }
    }

    private func open(_ game: Model.Game, from source: GameOpeningSource) {
        self.source = source
        withAnimation(ObeliskStyle.pageAnimation(reduceMotion: reduceMotion)) { model.open(game) }
    }

    private func back() {
        withAnimation(ObeliskStyle.pageAnimation(reduceMotion: reduceMotion)) { model.closeGame() }
    }
}

/// The browser's bar. It reads the scroll state and the unread messages in its
/// own body, so they redraw the bar alone.
private struct StorefrontBrowserBar<Model: LibraryStorefront, AccountMenu: View>: View {
    @Bindable var model: Model
    let bar: StorefrontBarState
    let storeTitle: String
    let libraryTitle: String
    let accountName: String?
    let avatarURL: URL?
    let openStore: (() -> Void)?
    let back: () -> Void
    @ViewBuilder let accountMenu: AccountMenu

    var body: some View {
        LibraryGlassBar(
            searchText: Bindable(model.library).searchText,
            searchLabel: L10n.string("ui.search.store_library", storeTitle),
            showsBackdrop: bar.showsBackdrop,
            game: model.selectedGame.map { game in
                LibraryGlassBar.GameBar(title: game.title, libraryTitle: libraryTitle,
                                        showsTitle: bar.showsGameTitle, back: back)
            }
        ) {
            LibraryAccountPill(storeTitle: storeTitle, accountName: accountName, avatarURL: avatarURL,
                               unreadCount: model.unreadCount) {
                accountMenu
            }
            if let openStore {
                StorefrontGlassButton(systemName: "storefront", label: L10n.string("ui.store.openStore", storeTitle),
                                      identifier: "storefront-store", action: openStore)
            }
        }
    }
}

/// A storefront's store, as the window presents it in a sheet.
struct StorePresentation: Identifiable {
    let storeID: String
    let storeTitle: String
    let start: @MainActor () async -> WebPageStart

    var id: String { storeID }
}

/// The storefront's store in a sheet, in a web page signed in as the
/// account. Its close button or Escape closes it.
struct StorefrontStoreModal: View {
    let store: StorePresentation
    let close: () -> Void

    var body: some View {
        let title = L10n.string("ui.store.openStore", store.storeTitle)
        WebPagePanel(start: store.start, close: close, showsCloseButton: true, placeholderTitle: title,
                     identifier: "\(store.storeID)-store", isPanel: false,
                     store: LibrarySection(rawValue: store.storeID))
            .presentationSizing(.fitted)
            .accessibilityLabel(title)
    }
}

/// What the page under a storefront's bar tells it as it scrolls.
@MainActor @Observable
final class StorefrontBarState {
    /// Whether content, rather than a hero's artwork or nothing, is under the bar.
    var showsBackdrop = false
    /// Whether a game's page scrolled its title under the bar.
    var showsGameTitle = false
}

/// Where a game's page was opened from.
enum GameOpeningSource {
    /// The game's cover in the library grid, which flies to the page.
    case cover
    /// The library's hero, whose artwork the page's own replaces in place.
    case hero
}

/// What a storefront's browser hands the page of the game it opened. The
/// artwork is the library's own, so the cover flies between the same image.
struct GamePageContext<HeroArtwork: View, Cover: View> {
    /// Names the storefront in accessibility identifiers.
    let storeID: String
    let heroArtwork: HeroArtwork
    let cover: Cover
}

/// How a library and a game's page hand the game's cover to each other.
struct GameTransition {
    let namespace: Namespace.ID
    /// Where the open game came from; nil when it opened without motion, as
    /// when a test or a refresh opens it.
    let source: GameOpeningSource?
    /// The card the page's cover flies from and back to, when its game alone
    /// does not name it: on Home, a game may show on more than one shelf.
    var card: AnyHashable? = nil
}

extension EnvironmentValues {
    @Entry var gameTransition: GameTransition?
    @Entry var storefrontBar: StorefrontBarState?
    /// Opens a storefront's store above the whole window.
    @Entry var presentStore: (@MainActor (StorePresentation) -> Void)?
}

/// Matches a game's cover in the library with its cover on the game's page.
/// The page's cover only matches when the game opened from its cover, so a
/// game opened from the hero does not pull a card from the grid.
struct GameCoverMatch: ViewModifier {
    let game: AnyHashable
    let isPage: Bool
    @Environment(\.gameTransition) private var transition
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private struct ID: Hashable {
        let game: AnyHashable
        let matched: Bool
    }

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        if let transition {
            content.matchedGeometryEffect(
                // While motion is reduced, the page only fades in and out.
                id: ID(game: isPage ? transition.card ?? game : game,
                       matched: !isPage || (transition.source == .cover && !reduceMotion)),
                in: transition.namespace
            )
        } else {
            content
        }
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Features/StorefrontLibraryPage.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// What a storefront model gives its library and its game page.
@MainActor protocol LibraryStorefront: AnyObject, Observable {
    associatedtype Store: InstallationStorefront
    associatedtype Game: LibraryGame where Game.ID == Store.GameID
    var installations: GameInstallations<Store> { get }
    /// The account's games, which every library view reads.
    var library: AccountLibrary<Store, Game> { get }
    var achievements: GameAchievementsModel { get }
    var gameSessionMessage: String? { get }
    func syncCloud()
    func reloadAchievements()
    var isLoadingGames: Bool { get }
    var storageWarning: String? { get set }
    var cloud: CloudModel<Store> { get }
    func refresh()
    /// The game whose page shows instead of the library.
    var selectedGame: Game? { get }
    func open(_ game: Game)
    /// Returns from the game's page to the library.
    func closeGame()
    /// What the library installs of `game` without opening its page, when
    /// the storefront has a build of it.
    func libraryOffer(of game: Game) -> GameOffer?
    /// The messages the account has not read, which its menu tells.
    var unreadCount: Int { get }
}

extension LibraryStorefront {
    func syncCloud() { installations.syncCloud() }
    var unreadCount: Int { 0 }

    /// Names the game a Cloud question or banner is about.
    func cloudTitle(for game: Store.GameID?) -> String {
        guard let game else { return Store.cloudTitle }
        let name = library.game(game)?.title
            ?? installations.receipts.first { $0.gameID == game }?.name
            ?? Store.name(game)
        return "\(Store.cloudTitle) · \(name)"
    }

    /// A game of the library, as its Game action reads it: its native build
    /// first, and what the library installs without opening its page.
    func librarySelection(_ game: Game) -> InstallationSelection<Store> {
        InstallationSelection(game: game.id, platform: .mac, offer: libraryOffer(of: game))
    }
}

/// Where a library was scrolled, kept while a game's page replaces it. Nothing
/// observes it, so scrolling redraws nothing.
@MainActor
final class LibraryScrollMemory {
    var offset: CGFloat = 0
}

/// A storefront's signed-in library: the featured game as its hero, then every
/// game of the account under the browser's floating glass bar, and the
/// storefront's Transfer floating at the bottom.
struct StorefrontLibraryPage<Model: LibraryStorefront, HeroArtwork: View, HeroLogo: View, Artwork: View>: View {
    @Bindable var model: Model
    /// Names the storefront in accessibility identifiers.
    let storeID: String
    let storeTitle: String
    let libraryTitle: String
    let scrollMemory: LibraryScrollMemory
    /// Opens a game's page, from its cover or from the hero.
    let open: (Model.Game, GameOpeningSource) -> Void
    /// The featured game's wide artwork, reaching under the bar.
    @ViewBuilder let heroArtwork: (Model.Game) -> HeroArtwork
    @ViewBuilder let heroLogo: (Model.Game) -> HeroLogo
    /// A game's cover.
    @ViewBuilder let artwork: (Model.Game) -> Artwork
    @State private var position: ScrollPosition
    @Environment(\.storefrontBar) private var bar

    private static var columns: [GridItem] {
        [GridItem(.adaptive(minimum: 160, maximum: 220), spacing: 16, alignment: .top)]
    }

    init(
        model: Model,
        storeID: String,
        storeTitle: String,
        libraryTitle: String,
        scrollMemory: LibraryScrollMemory,
        open: @escaping (Model.Game, GameOpeningSource) -> Void,
        @ViewBuilder heroArtwork: @escaping (Model.Game) -> HeroArtwork,
        @ViewBuilder heroLogo: @escaping (Model.Game) -> HeroLogo,
        @ViewBuilder artwork: @escaping (Model.Game) -> Artwork
    ) {
        self.model = model
        self.storeID = storeID
        self.storeTitle = storeTitle
        self.libraryTitle = libraryTitle
        self.scrollMemory = scrollMemory
        self.open = open
        self.heroArtwork = heroArtwork
        self.heroLogo = heroLogo
        self.artwork = artwork
        // A library opened at its top stays free to grow above, as its hero
        // does once the games arrive.
        let offset = scrollMemory.offset
        _position = State(initialValue: offset > 0 ? ScrollPosition(y: offset) : ScrollPosition())
    }

    var body: some View {
        // The hero belongs to the whole library, never to a search or a filter.
        let heroGame = model.library.hero
        let actions = GameActions(model.installations, in: .library)
        let backdropOffset = heroGame == nil ? 0 : ObeliskStyle.libraryHeroHeight
        return StorefrontScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                if let heroGame {
                    hero(heroGame, action: actions(model.librarySelection(heroGame)))
                }
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 22) {
                    StorefrontWarningBanner(message: $model.storageWarning)
                    if model.cloud.failurePresented {
                        SteamCloudFailureView(model: model, storefront: storeID)
                    }
                    library(actions)
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, ObeliskStyle.contentPadding)
                .padding(.top, heroGame == nil ? 12 : 30)
                .padding(.bottom, 36)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            }
        }
        .scrollPosition($position)
        .onScrollGeometryChange(for: CGFloat.self, of: { $0.contentOffset.y + $0.contentInsets.top }) { _, offset in
            scrollMemory.offset = offset
        }
        // Whether games or the library's header are under the bar, rather
        // than the hero's artwork or nothing at all.
        .onScrollGeometryChange(for: Bool.self, of: { $0.contentOffset.y + $0.contentInsets.top > backdropOffset }) { _, under in
            bar?.showsBackdrop = under
            bar?.showsGameTitle = false
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea(.container, edges: .top)
    }

    private func hero(_ game: Model.Game, action: GameAction) -> some View {
        LibraryHero(
            title: game.title,
            details: [
                model.library.lastPlayed(of: game).map { .init(symbol: "calendar", text: GameFormatting.lastPlayed($0)) },
                model.library.playtime(of: game).map { .init(symbol: "clock", text: GameFormatting.playtime($0)) },
            ].compactMap { $0 },
            action: action,
            open: { open(game, .hero) }
        ) {
            heroArtwork(game)
        } logo: {
            heroLogo(game)
        }
    }

    private func library(_ actions: GameActions<Model.Store>) -> some View {
        let library = model.library
        let filtered = library.shown
        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 22) {
            header(count: filtered.count)

            if let missing = library.missingMetadata {
                HStack(spacing: 12) {
                    Text(missing)
                        .font(.system(size: 12))
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    Spacer(minLength: 0)
                    Button(L10n.string("ui.common.retry"), action: model.refresh)
                        .obeliskButtonStyle(.glass)
                        .controlSize(.small)
                        .disabled(model.isLoadingGames || library.pendingMetadata != nil)
                }
            }

            if model.isLoadingGames && library.games.isEmpty {
                ProgressView(L10n.string("ui.library.fetching")).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 260)
            } else if filtered.isEmpty, let pending = library.pendingMetadata {
                ProgressView(pending).frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 260)
            } else if filtered.isEmpty {
                StorefrontEmptyLibrary(searchText: Bindable(library).searchText, filter: Bindable(library).filter,
                                       refresh: model.refresh)
            } else {
                grid(filtered, actions: actions)
                if model.isLoadingGames || library.pendingMetadata != nil {
                    ProgressView().controlSize(.small).frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func header(count: Int) -> some View {
        let title = VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 3) {
            Text(libraryTitle)
                .font(.system(size: 22, weight: .bold))
                .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
            if !model.library.games.isEmpty {
                Text(L10n.string("ui.library.game_count", Int64(count)))
                    .font(.system(size: 12))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .monospacedDigit()
            }
        }
        .fixedSize()
        let filters = LibraryFilterPicker(storeTitle: storeTitle, filters: StorefrontLibraryFilter.allCases,
                                          selection: Bindable(model.library).filter)
        return ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) {
            HStack(spacing: 14) {
                title
                Spacer(minLength: 16)
                filters
                sortButton
            }
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
                HStack(spacing: 14) {
                    title
                    Spacer(minLength: 16)
                    sortButton
                }
                filters
            }
        }
    }

    private var sortButton: some View {
        let library = model.library
        return LibrarySortButton(
            storeTitle: storeTitle,
            sortTitle: library.sort.title,
            options: StorefrontLibrarySort.allCases.map { sort in
                StorefrontSortOption(id: sort.id, title: sort.menuTitle, isSelected: library.sort == sort) {
                    library.sort = sort
                }
            }
        )
    }

    private func grid(_ games: [Model.Game], actions: GameActions<Model.Store>) -> some View {
        LazyVGrid(columns: Self.columns, alignment: .leading, spacing: 18) {
            ForEach(games) { game in
                let title = game.title
                LibraryCoverCard(
                    title: title,
                    accessibilityLabel: L10n.string("ui.library.game_accessibility", title,
                                                    GameFormatting.lastPlayed(model.library.lastPlayed(of: game))),
                    help: [title, model.library.playtime(of: game).map(GameFormatting.playtime)].compactMap { $0 }
                        .joined(separator: " · "),
                    action: actions(model.librarySelection(game)),
                    matchID: game.id,
                    open: { open(game, .cover) }
                ) {
                    artwork(game)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
/// A wall of covers under the store's colors, or Obelisk's own.
struct CoverWallBackdrop: View {
    let section: LibrarySection

    var body: some View {
        let base = Color(white: 0.07)
        let tint = section.tint
        SignInCoverWall(glow: base.mix(with: tint, by: 0.45), soft: base.mix(with: tint, by: 0.16), base: base, tintOpacity: 0.3)
    }
}

/// Covers on a tilted wall, drifting from the top right to the bottom left,
/// under the store's colors. The bundled tile repeats seamlessly on every edge
/// and the wall moves by a whole number of tiles per cycle, so the loop never
/// shows. Core Animation runs the drift, so the app does no work between
/// frames; the colors are layers too, as SwiftUI content would sit beneath.
private struct SignInCoverWall: NSViewRepresentable {
    /// The top right corner's color.
    let glow: Color
    /// The top edge's and the bottom left corner's color.
    let soft: Color
    /// The color at the center.
    let base: Color
    /// How much of the wall the colors cover.
    let tintOpacity: Float
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    func makeNSView(context: Context) -> CoverWallView { CoverWallView() }

    func updateNSView(_ view: CoverWallView, context: Context) {
        let environment = context.environment
        view.tint(glow: glow.resolve(in: environment).cgColor, soft: soft.resolve(in: environment).cgColor,
                  base: base.resolve(in: environment).cgColor, opacity: tintOpacity)
        view.isDrifting = !reduceMotion
    }
}

private final class CoverWallView: NSView {
    /// The tile's size in points.
    private static let tile = CGSize(width: 1280, height: 940)
    /// Clockwise on screen.
    private static let tilt: CGFloat = 15 * .pi / 180
    /// How far the wall leans back, its top receding as a film's opening crawl.
    private static let pitch: CGFloat = 55 * .pi / 180
    /// The viewer's distance from the wall, in window heights.
    private static let distance: CGFloat = 1.2
    /// How much nearer the viewer the wall comes, as a share of that distance:
    /// a quarter larger at the window's center.
    private static let approach: CGFloat = 0.2
    /// What the wall moves by in one cycle, in tiles: with the tilt, down and
    /// to the left at about 45 degrees.
    private static let drift = CGSize(width: -1, height: 2)
    private static let period: CFTimeInterval = 120

    var isDrifting = true {
        didSet { if isDrifting != oldValue { rebuild(force: true) } }
    }
    /// Holds the perspective the leaning wall is seen through.
    private let stage = CALayer()
    /// Leans back from the window.
    private let plane = CALayer()
    /// Tilted, and as large as the window seen on the plane plus a cycle's drift.
    private let wall = CALayer()
    /// The tiles, drifting inside the wall.
    private let grid = CALayer()
    /// The store's colors, from the top right corner to the bottom left one.
    private let colors = CAGradientLayer()
    /// Calmer behind the title and the card, livelier toward the edges.
    private let vignette = CAGradientLayer()
    /// Fades the wall's far end into the dark, as it nears the horizon.
    private let horizon = CAGradientLayer()
    /// When the drift started, so a rebuilt wall carries on where it was.
    private let start = CACurrentMediaTime()
    private var built: (size: CGSize, scale: CGFloat)?

    override init(frame: NSRect) {
        super.init(frame: frame)
        wantsLayer = true
        layer?.masksToBounds = true
        wall.addSublayer(grid)
        plane.addSublayer(wall)
        stage.addSublayer(plane)
        layer?.addSublayer(stage)
        colors.startPoint = CGPoint(x: 1, y: 1)
        colors.endPoint = CGPoint(x: 0, y: 0)
        colors.locations = [0, 0.35, 0.7, 1]
        layer?.addSublayer(colors)
        vignette.type = .radial
        vignette.startPoint = CGPoint(x: 0.5, y: 0.5)
        layer?.addSublayer(vignette)
        horizon.startPoint = CGPoint(x: 0.5, y: 1)
        horizon.endPoint = CGPoint(x: 0.5, y: 0.6)
        layer?.addSublayer(horizon)
    }

    func tint(glow: CGColor, soft: CGColor, base: CGColor, opacity: Float) {
        CATransaction.begin()
        CATransaction.setDisableActions(true)
        colors.colors = [glow, soft, base, soft]
        colors.opacity = opacity
        vignette.colors = [base.copy(alpha: 0.55) ?? base, base.copy(alpha: 0) ?? base]
        horizon.colors = [base.copy(alpha: 0.7) ?? base, base.copy(alpha: 0) ?? base]
        CATransaction.commit()
    }

    @available(*, unavailable)
    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("init(coder:) is not supported") }

    // Decoration only: clicks and scrolling belong to the page above.
    override func hitTest(_ point: NSPoint) -> NSView? { nil }

    override func layout() {
        super.layout()
        rebuild()
    }

    override func viewDidChangeBackingProperties() {
        super.viewDidChangeBackingProperties()
        rebuild()
    }

    private func rebuild(force: Bool = false) {
        let size = bounds.size
        let scale = window?.backingScaleFactor ?? 2
        guard force || built?.size != size || built?.scale != scale, size.width > 0, size.height > 0 else { return }
        built = (size, scale)
        CATransaction.begin()
        CATransaction.setDisableActions(true)
        defer { CATransaction.commit() }

        let tile = Self.tile
        let tilt = Self.tilt
        let pitch = Self.pitch
        let distance = Self.distance * size.height
        let approach = Self.approach * distance
        // The window's corners on the leaning plane, then on the tilted wall,
        // from the plane's center with the y axis up. The far corners lie
        // well beyond the window: the plane recedes toward a horizon above it.
        let corners = [(-1.0, -1.0), (1, -1), (-1, 1), (1, 1)].map { sx, sy in
            let screen = CGPoint(x: sx * size.width / 2, y: sy * size.height / 2)
            let y = screen.y * (1 - approach / distance) / (cos(pitch) - screen.y * sin(pitch) / distance)
            let x = screen.x * (1 + (y * sin(pitch) - approach) / distance)
            return CGPoint(x: x * cos(tilt) - y * sin(tilt), y: x * sin(tilt) + y * cos(tilt))
        }
        let reach = CGSize(width: corners.map { abs($0.x) }.max() ?? 0, height: corners.map { abs($0.y) }.max() ?? 0)
        let width = 2 * reach.width + 2 * abs(Self.drift.width) * tile.width
        let height = 2 * reach.height + 2 * abs(Self.drift.height) * tile.height
        let columns = Int((width / tile.width).rounded(.up))
        let rows = Int((height / tile.height).rounded(.up))
        colors.frame = bounds
        horizon.frame = bounds
        // A circle 620 points wide, clear from 120 points.
        let radius: CGFloat = 620
        vignette.frame = bounds
        vignette.endPoint = CGPoint(x: 0.5 + radius / size.width, y: 0.5 + radius / size.height)
        vignette.locations = [NSNumber(value: Double(120 / radius)), 1]

        stage.frame = bounds
        var perspective = CATransform3DIdentity
        perspective.m34 = -1 / distance
        stage.sublayerTransform = perspective
        plane.bounds = CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size)
        plane.position = CGPoint(x: bounds.midX, y: bounds.midY)
        // A negative angle about the x axis takes the top away from the viewer;
        // the plane then comes nearer.
        plane.transform = CATransform3DConcat(CATransform3DMakeRotation(-pitch, 1, 0, 0),
                                              CATransform3DMakeTranslation(0, 0, approach))

        wall.bounds = CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: CGFloat(columns) * tile.width, height: CGFloat(rows) * tile.height)
        wall.position = CGPoint(x: plane.bounds.midX, y: plane.bounds.midY)
        // The layer's y axis points up: a negative angle turns it clockwise.
        wall.transform = CATransform3DMakeRotation(-tilt, 0, 0, 1)
        grid.frame = wall.bounds

        let contents = NSImage(named: "SignInCoverWall")?.layerContents(forContentsScale: scale)
        let tiles = grid.sublayers ?? []
        tiles.dropFirst(columns * rows).forEach { $0.removeFromSuperlayer() }
        for index in 0..<columns * rows {
            let layer = index < tiles.count ? tiles[index] : CALayer()
            if layer.superlayer == nil { grid.addSublayer(layer) }
            layer.contents = contents
            layer.contentsScale = scale
            // Mipmaps keep the far, tiny covers from shimmering as they move.
            layer.minificationFilter = .trilinear
            layer.frame = CGRect(x: CGFloat(index % columns) * tile.width, y: CGFloat(index / columns) * tile.height,
                                 width: tile.width, height: tile.height)
        }

        grid.removeAnimation(forKey: "drift")
        guard isDrifting else { return }
        let drift = CABasicAnimation(keyPath: "position")
        drift.fromValue = grid.position
        drift.toValue = CGPoint(x: grid.position.x + Self.drift.width * tile.width,
                                y: grid.position.y - Self.drift.height * tile.height)
        drift.duration = Self.period
        drift.repeatCount = .infinity
        drift.timingFunction = CAMediaTimingFunction(name: .linear)
        drift.timeOffset = (CACurrentMediaTime() - start).truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: Self.period)
        grid.add(drift, forKey: "drift")
    }
}
```

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// The sign-in page of a storefront that signs in through its own web page,
/// in that storefront's words.
struct WebSignInView<Store: WebStorefront>: View {
    @Bindable var model: WebAccountModel<Store>
    let section: LibrarySection
    let title: String
    let subtitle: String
    /// Shown while the signed-in account connects.
    let connecting: String
    let accountSignIn: String
    let instructions: String
    let signInLabel: String

    var body: some View {
        StorefrontSignInPage(
            section: section,
            title: title,
            subtitle: subtitle,
            warning: $model.storageWarning
        ) {
            if model.isRestoring || model.isConnecting || model.isSigningOut {
                progress
            } else {
                signIn
            }
        }
    }

    private var progress: some View {
        let title = model.isSigningOut ? L10n.string("ui.account.signing_out")
            : model.isRestoring ? L10n.string("ui.account.restoring_session")
            : connecting
        return SignInProgress(title: title, cancel: model.isSigningOut ? nil : { model.cancelSignIn() })
    }

    private var signIn: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 18) {
            Text(accountSignIn)
                .font(.system(size: 16, weight: .semibold))
            Text(instructions)
                .font(.system(size: 13))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
            SignInRememberToggle(isOn: $model.rememberSession)
            VStack(spacing: 10) {
                Button { model.signIn() } label: {
                    Label(signInLabel, systemImage: "arrow.up.forward.app")
                        .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                }
                .obeliskButtonStyle(.glassProminent)
                .controlSize(.extraLarge)
                if model.canRetryRestore {
                    Button(action: model.retryRestore) {
                        Text(L10n.string("ui.account.retry_saved_session"))
                            .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .medium))
                            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    }
                    .obeliskButtonStyle(.glass)
                    .controlSize(.extraLarge)
                }
            }
            .padding(.top, 4)
        }
    }
}
```
