`apps/macos/Obelisk/Models/GameAction.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation

/// Where a game's button shows. The library plays an installed game, and its
/// launch installs a newer build first; the game's page offers that update alone.
enum GameActionPlace {
    case page
    case library
}

/// What the player can do with one game of the account now, as its button
/// shows it, and what pressing or cancelling it does.
@MainActor
struct GameAction {
    enum Kind: Equatable {
        case launch
        case download(Download)
        /// The game's Transfer waits in the download queue.
        case queued
        case transferring(Transfer)
        case waiting(Wait)
        /// A step outside any Transfer holds the game.
        case step(Step)
        /// This account's game runs; nil while its session cannot be asked anything.
        case running(GameQuitStage?)
    }

    /// What a download starts.
    enum Download: Equatable {
        /// Installs the Offer.
        case install
        /// Resumes the game's interrupted Transfer.
        case resume
        /// Updates the installation, from the game's page.
        case update
    }

    /// Whose Transfer runs for the game.
    enum Transfer: Equatable {
        /// The game's own: an install, an update or a repair.
        case files
        /// The one its launch runs first, to verify or update its files.
        case launch
    }

    /// What the game waits for.
    enum Wait: Equatable {
        case uninstall
        /// Its launch, or this account's Game session before its game runs.
        case launch
        /// This account's Game session after its game exited, until it ends.
        case closing
        /// Its launch's Transfer, until that Transfer's turn comes.
        case verification
    }

    enum Step: Equatable {
        case cloudSync
        /// A runtime the launch waits for.
        case runtime(RuntimeComponent)
    }

    let kind: Kind
    let title: String
    let isAvailable: Bool
    /// Green to launch, blue to install or update.
    let launches: Bool
    /// Whether the button shows its cross.
    let isCancellable: Bool
    /// Where the button shows, which changes how it shows a wait.
    let place: GameActionPlace
    /// The game's Transfer, read only in the body of the view showing its
    /// progress, so a progress tick redraws that view alone.
    let transfer: @MainActor () -> GameTransfer?
    /// How far the runtime the launch waits for downloaded, read likewise.
    let stepFraction: @MainActor () -> Double?
    /// Runs at once, a Force Quit too: whoever shows the action asks first.
    let perform: @MainActor () -> Void
    let cancel: @MainActor () -> Void

    /// A Force Quit loses what the game did not save: its player confirms it.
    var needsConfirmation: Bool { kind == .running(.forceQuit) }

    init(kind: Kind, title: String, isAvailable: Bool, launches: Bool, isCancellable: Bool = false,
         place: GameActionPlace = .page,
         transfer: @escaping @MainActor () -> GameTransfer? = { nil },
         stepFraction: @escaping @MainActor () -> Double? = { nil },
         perform: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void = {}, cancel: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void = {}) {
        self.kind = kind
        self.title = title
        self.isAvailable = isAvailable
        self.launches = launches
        self.isCancellable = isCancellable
        self.place = place
        self.transfer = transfer
        self.stepFraction = stepFraction
        self.perform = perform
        self.cancel = cancel
    }
}

/// What every button of one place shows, read once for a whole set of games:
/// it changes with an operation, not with its progress.
@MainActor
struct GameActions<Store: InstallationStorefront> {
    private typealias Receipt = InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>

    private let installations: GameInstallations<Store>
    private let place: GameActionPlace
    private let receipts: [Store.GameID: [Receipt]]
    private let transferring: Store.GameID?
    /// The game whose launch prepares, and whether it verifies its files first.
    private let launching: Store.GameID?
    private let verifying: Bool
    private let uninstalling: Store.GameID?
    private let queued: Set<Store.GameID>
    private let resumable: Store.GameID?
    private let isConnected: Bool
    private let isRecovering: Bool
    private let session: GameSessions<Store>.ActiveGame?
    /// What ending this account's running game asks of its player now.
    private let quitStage: GameQuitStage?
    /// The game whose Cloud sync works, and the one whose sync the player may cancel.
    private let synchronizing: Store.GameID?
    private let cancellableSync: Store.GameID?

    init(_ installations: GameInstallations<Store>, in place: GameActionPlace) {
        self.installations = installations
        self.place = place
        receipts = Dictionary(grouping: installations.receipts, by: \.gameID)
        transferring = installations.activeTransferGame
        launching = installations.isLaunching ? installations.launchGame : nil
        verifying = installations.isVerifyingBeforeLaunch
        uninstalling = installations.uninstallGame
        queued = Set(installations.queuedGames)
        resumable = installations.resumableGame
        isConnected = installations.isConnected
        isRecovering = installations.sessions.isRecovering
        session = installations.accountSession
        // The quit stage reads the active session, which changes with its
        // progress: only this account's running game needs it.
        quitStage = session?.running == true ? installations.sessions.quitStage : nil
        let cloud = installations.cloud
        let syncGame = cloud.sync?.game
        synchronizing = syncGame.flatMap { cloud.isSynchronizing(for: $0) ? $0 : nil }
        cancellableSync = syncGame.flatMap { cloud.canCancelSynchronization(for: $0) ? $0 : nil }
    }

    func callAsFunction(_ selection: InstallationSelection<Store>) -> GameAction {
        let game = selection.game
        let receipt = Receipt.preferred(among: receipts[game] ?? [], platform: selection.platform)
        let update = place == .page && receipt?.updateAvailable == true
        let ownSession = session?.game == game ? session : nil
        let kind = self.kind(of: game, session: ownSession, receipt: receipt, update: update)
        let installations = installations
        return GameAction(
            kind: kind,
            title: title(of: kind),
            isAvailable: isAvailable(kind, of: selection),
            launches: ownSession != nil || (receipt != nil && !update),
            isCancellable: cancellableSync == game || transferring == game || launching == game
                || queued.contains(game),
            place: place,
            transfer: { installations.transfer(for: game) },
            stepFraction: {
                guard installations.accountSession?.game == game else { return nil }
                return installations.sessions.active?.runtimeInstall?.fraction
            },
            perform: perform(kind, of: selection, receipt: receipt),
            cancel: {
                if installations.cloud.canCancelSynchronization(for: game) {
                    installations.cloud.cancelSynchronization(for: game)
                } else {
                    installations.cancel(game)
                }
            }
        )
    }

    /// The one order every place reads a game's state in. `session` is this
    /// account's Game session of `game`, if any; `update` tells that the
    /// page offers the installation's newer build.
    private func kind(of game: Store.GameID, session: GameSessions<Store>.ActiveGame?, receipt: Receipt?,
                      update: Bool) -> GameAction.Kind {
        let isLaunching = launching == game
        if synchronizing == game { return .step(.cloudSync) }
        if isLaunching, let runtime = session?.runtime { return .step(.runtime(runtime)) }
        if session?.running == true { return .running(quitStage) }
        if transferring == game { return .transferring(isLaunching ? .launch : .files) }
        if uninstalling == game { return .waiting(.uninstall) }
        if isLaunching { return .waiting(verifying ? .verification : .launch) }
        if queued.contains(game) { return .queued }
        if let session { return .waiting(session.ended ? .closing : .launch) }
        if receipt != nil { return update ? .download(.update) : .launch }
        return .download(resumable == game && installations.canModify(game) ? .resume : .install)
    }

    private func title(of kind: GameAction.Kind) -> String {
        // Only a Cloud sync outranks the sessions' recovery.
        if isRecovering && kind != .step(.cloudSync) { return L10n.string(Store.recoveringSession) }
        return switch kind {
        case .launch: L10n.string(place == .page ? "model.game.launch" : "ui.game.play")
        case .download(.install): L10n.string("model.game.download")
        case .download(.resume): L10n.string("model.game.resume")
        case .download(.update): L10n.string("model.game.update")
        case .queued: L10n.string("model.game.queued")
        // The Transfer names itself once its progress shows.
        case .transferring(.files): L10n.string("ui.transfer.preparing_short")
        case .transferring(.launch), .waiting(.verification): L10n.string("model.game.verifying")
        case .waiting(.uninstall): L10n.string("model.game.uninstalling")
        case .waiting(.launch): L10n.string("model.game.launching")
        case .waiting(.closing): L10n.string("model.game.closing")
        case .step(.cloudSync): L10n.string("ui.cloud.sync_short")
        case .step(.runtime(.voile)): L10n.string("model.game.installingVoile")
        case .step(.runtime(.steamComponents)): L10n.string("model.game.installingSteamComponents")
        case let .running(stage): stage?.title ?? L10n.string("model.game.running")
        }
    }

    /// The Reservation gate is read here, for each game: it changes with an
    /// operation too.
    private func isAvailable(_ kind: GameAction.Kind, of selection: InstallationSelection<Store>) -> Bool {
        let game = selection.game
        return switch kind {
        case let .running(stage): stage == .quit || stage == .forceQuit
        case .launch: isConnected && installations.canLaunch(game)
        // An installation updates from its receipt; only a new download waits
        // for the storefront to know what it can install.
        case .download(.update): isConnected && installations.canModify(game)
        case .download: isConnected && selection.offer != nil && installations.canModify(game)
        case .queued, .transferring, .waiting, .step: false
        }
    }

    /// Each target checks again that it may still run.
    private func perform(_ kind: GameAction.Kind, of selection: InstallationSelection<Store>,
                         receipt: Receipt?) -> @MainActor () -> Void {
        let installations = installations
        switch kind {
        case .running(.quit):
            return { installations.quitRunningGame() }
        case .running(.forceQuit):
            return { installations.forceQuitRunningGame() }
        case .launch:
            guard let receipt else { return {} }
            return { installations.launch(receipt) }
        case .download(.update):
            guard let receipt else { return {} }
            return { installations.verify(receipt) }
        case .download:
            guard let offer = selection.offer else { return {} }
            let game = selection.game
            return { installations.install(offer, of: game) }
        case .running, .queued, .transferring, .waiting, .step:
            return {}
        }
    }
}

extension GameInstallations {
    /// The Game action of the game on screen.
    var selectedAction: GameAction? { selection().map { GameActions(self, in: .page)($0) } }
}

/// Both stores use the same progress text, accessibility and transfer controls.
extension GameTransfer {
    /// The runtimes a Transfer gets before its game's files, by the message
    /// that names them while they download.
    private static let runtimeMessages: Set<String> = ["model.game.installingVoile", "model.game.installingSteamComponents"]

    /// The runtime the Transfer downloads now, before its game's files.
    var runtimeTitle: String? {
        guard isInProgress, Self.runtimeMessages.contains(message) else { return nil }
        return L10n.string(message)
    }

    var activityTitle: String {
        if let runtimeTitle { return runtimeTitle }
        return switch state {
        case .preparing: L10n.string("ui.transfer.checking_updates")
        case .verifying: L10n.string("ui.transfer.verifying_files")
        case .downloading: L10n.string("ui.transfer.downloading")
        case .moving: L10n.string("ui.transfer.moving")
        case .complete: L10n.string("ui.transfer.up_to_date")
        case .cancelled: L10n.string("ui.transfer.interrupted")
        case .failed: L10n.string("ui.transfer.failed")
        }
    }

    var verifiedProgressText: String {
        let key = state == .moving ? "ui.transfer.moved_files" : "ui.transfer.verified_files"
        return L10n.string(key, GameFormatting.bytes(completedBytes), GameFormatting.bytes(totalBytes))
    }

    var downloadedGameDataText: String? {
        if contentBytes > 0 {
            L10n.string("ui.transfer.downloaded_data", GameFormatting.bytes(contentBytes))
        } else if state == .verifying {
            L10n.string("ui.transfer.no_downloaded_data")
        } else {
            nil
        }
    }

    var buttonTitle: String {
        if let runtimeTitle { return runtimeTitle }
        return switch state {
        case .preparing: L10n.string("ui.transfer.preparing_short")
        case .verifying: L10n.string("ui.transfer.verifying_short")
        case .downloading: L10n.string("ui.transfer.downloading_short")
        case .moving: L10n.string("ui.transfer.moving_short")
        case .complete: L10n.string("ui.transfer.finishing_short")
        case .cancelled: L10n.string("ui.transfer.cancelling_short")
        case .failed: L10n.string("ui.transfer.failed_short")
        }
    }

    var isInProgress: Bool {
        state == .preparing || state == .verifying || state == .downloading || state == .moving
    }

    var progressFraction: Double? {
        guard totalBytes > 0 else { return nil }
        return Double(min(completedBytes, totalBytes)) / Double(totalBytes)
    }

    /// The files verified so far; a runtime's download counts no game files.
    var countedFilesText: String? {
        totalBytes > 0 && runtimeTitle == nil ? verifiedProgressText : nil
    }

    var progressSummary: String {
        [
            activityTitle,
            countedFilesText,
            downloadedGameDataText,
            currentFile.isEmpty ? nil : L10n.message(currentFile),
            message.isEmpty || runtimeTitle != nil ? nil : L10n.message(message),
        ]
        .compactMap { $0 }
        .joined(separator: "\n")
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Models/GameInstallations.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation
import Observation

/// What a storefront adds to its installation actions.
protocol InstallationStorefront: GameStorefront {
    /// A failed answer, as the storefront's models describe errors.
    @MainActor static func describe(_ error: Error) -> String
    /// The game Rust names `id`.
    static func game(_ id: String) -> GameID?
    /// How Rust names `game`.
    static func name(_ game: GameID) -> String
    /// Shown on a game's page while another game's operation holds the storefront.
    static var otherGameOperation: String { get }
    /// Whether Obelisk syncs the storefront's Cloud saves.
    static var syncsCloud: Bool { get }
    /// Names a Cloud question or banner; the game's name follows it.
    static var cloudTitle: String { get }
}

extension InstallationStorefront {
    static var syncsCloud: Bool { true }
}

/// One installation of the account, as its Installation receipt in Rust
/// records it. Its id names it in every action.
struct InstallationReceipt<GameID: Hashable & Sendable>: Identifiable, Equatable, Sendable {
    let id: String
    let gameID: GameID
    let name: String
    let directory: String
    let platform: GamePlatform
    let totalBytes: UInt64
    /// A Transfer started over it and has not succeeded since.
    var needsVerification = false
    /// The storefront offers a newer build than the installed one.
    var updateAvailable = false

    /// The installation for `platform` among one game's `receipts`, else its
    /// other one: an installed build shows whatever the storefront would
    /// install now.
    static func preferred(among receipts: [Self], platform: GamePlatform) -> Self? {
        receipts.first { $0.platform == platform } ?? receipts.first
    }
}

/// A game as the storefront model sees it: the one on screen, or one of its library.
struct InstallationSelection<Store: InstallationStorefront> {
    let game: Store.GameID
    let platform: GamePlatform
    /// The build Obelisk can install, once the storefront knows one.
    let offer: GameOffer?
}

/// What may start now, of one kind of action, as Rust's Reservation shows it.
enum InstallationOpening<GameID: Hashable>: Equatable {
    case closed
    /// It may start, for any game but these.
    case open(except: [GameID])

    func allows(_ game: GameID) -> Bool {
        switch self {
        case .closed: false
        case let .open(except): !except.contains(game)
        }
    }
}

/// What Rust's Reservation lets start now.
struct InstallationsGate<GameID: Hashable>: Equatable {
    /// A Transfer, which waits in the download queue.
    var modify: InstallationOpening<GameID>
    /// An uninstall: no Transfer, launch or other uninstall of the storefront runs.
    var uninstall: InstallationOpening<GameID>
    /// A launch: a Transfer holds only its own game.
    var launch: InstallationOpening<GameID>
    var maintain: InstallationOpening<GameID>

    static var closed: Self { Self(modify: .closed, uninstall: .closed, launch: .closed, maintain: .closed) }

    init(modify: InstallationOpening<GameID>, uninstall: InstallationOpening<GameID>,
         launch: InstallationOpening<GameID>, maintain: InstallationOpening<GameID>) {
        self.modify = modify
        self.uninstall = uninstall
        self.launch = launch
        self.maintain = maintain
    }

    /// Rust's gate, whose games `game` names.
    init(_ gate: InstallationGate, game: (String) -> GameID?) {
        func opening(_ opening: GameOpening) -> InstallationOpening<GameID> {
            switch opening {
            case .closed: .closed
            case let .open(except): .open(except: except.compactMap(game))
            }
        }
        self.init(modify: opening(gate.modify), uninstall: opening(gate.uninstall), launch: opening(gate.launch),
                  maintain: opening(gate.maintain))
    }
}

/// A signed-in account's storefront operations. Every closure belongs to one
/// connection; signing out drops them.
struct InstallationPort<Store: InstallationStorefront> {
    /// Presents a failure; nil clears the last one.
    var report: @MainActor (Error?) -> Void
    var warn: @MainActor (String) -> Void
    /// The game's last installation left the receipts.
    var uninstalled: @MainActor (Store.GameID) -> Void = { _ in }
}

/// Everything one account's installations present, as Rust keeps them.
struct InstallationsSnapshot<Store: InstallationStorefront>: Equatable {
    var revision: UInt64
    var receipts: [InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>]
    var transfer: GameTransfer?
    var transferGame: Store.GameID?
    var downloading: Bool
    var launching: Bool
    var verifyingBeforeLaunch: Bool
    var launchGame: Store.GameID?
    var uninstallGame: Store.GameID?
    /// The game whose Transfer stopped before its receipt.
    var resumable: Store.GameID?
    var report: InstallationReport?
    var warning: InstallationWarning?
    var gate: InstallationsGate<Store.GameID>
    var cloudSync: GameCloudSync<Store.GameID>?
    /// The games whose Transfer waits in the download queue.
    var queued: [Store.GameID] = []
}

/// One account's installations of one storefront, in Rust. Each action
/// returns at once; the snapshot tells how it goes.
@MainActor
protocol InstallationsBackend<Store>: AnyObject {
    associatedtype Store: InstallationStorefront
    func snapshot() -> InstallationsSnapshot<Store>
    /// Waits for a revision newer than `after`.
    func changed(after: UInt64) async -> InstallationsSnapshot<Store>
    func setDiagnostic(_ running: Bool)
    /// Installs `offer`'s build, or resumes the game's interrupted Transfer.
    func install(_ offer: GameOffer)
    /// Verifies `receipt`'s files and repairs or updates them in place, or
    /// resumes the game's interrupted Transfer.
    func update(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>)
    /// Stops `game`'s Transfer, or its launch still preparing.
    func cancel(_ game: Store.GameID)
    /// Asks the storefronts which installations have a newer build, unless
    /// they were asked a short while ago.
    func checkUpdates()
    /// Whether each newer build installs as soon as it is known, rather than
    /// at the game's next launch.
    func setAutomaticUpdates(_ enabled: Bool)
    /// Launches `receipt`'s installation, updating or repairing it first
    /// when it needs it.
    func launch(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>)
    /// Launches `receipt`'s Steam installation as `launch` does, its game
    /// joining `invite`.
    func join(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>, invite: SteamGameInvite)
    func uninstall(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>)
    func signedOut()
    /// Syncs the game's Cloud saves: those of `installed`, or an uninstalled
    /// game's when nil.
    func maintainCloud(_ game: Store.GameID, installed: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>?)
    /// Answers the Cloud question the game shows: its maintenance's or its
    /// Game session's.
    func answerCloud(_ game: Store.GameID, decisionId: UInt64, choice: CloudChoice) async throws
    /// The games' Cloud indicators, and those of every other game of the
    /// account with pending work.
    func cloudIndicators(_ games: [Store.GameID]) async throws -> [(Store.GameID, CloudIndicator)]
    /// The launch settings of `receipt`'s Windows installation; nil for a Mac
    /// build.
    func launchSettings(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>) async throws -> LaunchSettings?
    /// Keeps `choices` as the player's launch settings of `receipt`'s Windows
    /// installation, and returns them as its next launch applies them.
    func setLaunchSettings(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>, choices: LaunchChoices) async throws
        -> LaunchSettings?
}

/// One storefront's installed games and the actions on them, as Rust keeps
/// them: Transfers, launches and uninstalls. This presents them, with each
/// game's Game action, and forwards the player's actions.
@MainActor @Observable
final class GameInstallations<Store: InstallationStorefront> {
    typealias Receipt = InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>

    private(set) var receipts: [Receipt] = [] {
        // Every path that removes a game's last installation reports it here,
        // so no caller has to remember to. Each change is one assignment, so
        // replacing a receipt never reads as a removal.
        didSet {
            for game in Set(oldValue.map(\.gameID)).subtracting(receipts.map(\.gameID)) { port?.uninstalled(game) }
        }
    }
    private(set) var transfer: GameTransfer?
    /// The game the last Transfer progress belongs to.
    private(set) var transferGame: Store.GameID?
    private(set) var isDownloading = false
    private(set) var isLaunching = false
    private(set) var isVerifyingBeforeLaunch = false
    private(set) var launchGame: Store.GameID?
    private(set) var uninstallGame: Store.GameID?
    var isUninstalling: Bool { uninstallGame != nil }
    /// The game whose Transfer stopped before its receipt: the player can
    /// resume it.
    private(set) var resumableGame: Store.GameID?
    /// The games whose Transfer waits in the download queue.
    private(set) var queuedGames: [Store.GameID] = []
    /// What Rust's Reservation lets start now.
    private(set) var gate = InstallationsGate<Store.GameID>.closed
    /// A DEBUG diagnostic fences the storefront like a Game session would.
    var diagnosticReservation = false {
        didSet { backend?.setDiagnostic(diagnosticReservation) }
    }
    /// The player keeps games up to date: each newer build installs as soon
    /// as it is known.
    var updatesAutomatically = false {
        didSet { if updatesAutomatically != oldValue { backend?.setAutomaticUpdates(updatesAutomatically) } }
    }
    @ObservationIgnored var selection: @MainActor () -> InstallationSelection<Store>? = { nil }

    let sessions: GameSessions<Store>
    let cloud: CloudModel<Store>
    private var account: Store.AccountID?
    @ObservationIgnored private var backend: (any InstallationsBackend<Store>)?
    @ObservationIgnored private var port: InstallationPort<Store>?
    @ObservationIgnored private var revision: UInt64 = 0
    @ObservationIgnored private var report: InstallationReport?
    @ObservationIgnored private var warning: InstallationWarning?
    @ObservationIgnored private var observation: Task<Void, Never>?
    /// Asks for newer builds each time Obelisk comes to the front.
    @ObservationIgnored private var activity: ApplicationActivityObservation?
    /// Whether a Game session was active, and its game running, when last seen.
    @ObservationIgnored private var observedSession: (busy: Bool, running: Bool)?

    init(sessions: GameSessions<Store>, cloud: CloudModel<Store>) {
        self.sessions = sessions
        self.cloud = cloud
        if Store.syncsCloud { observeSessions() }
    }

    /// The game on screen's Cloud indicator is read again once a Game
    /// session ends, and once its game runs: the game's guard and launch
    /// sync are on disk then.
    private func observeSessions() {
        let observed = withObservationTracking {
            (busy: sessions.isBusy, running: sessions.activeGame?.running == true)
        } onChange: { [weak self] in
            Task { @MainActor [weak self] in self?.observeSessions() }
        }
        defer { observedSession = observed }
        guard let previous = observedSession else { return }
        if (previous.busy && !observed.busy) || (!previous.running && observed.running) { refreshCloudIndicator() }
    }

    func connect(account: Store.AccountID, backend: any InstallationsBackend<Store>, port: InstallationPort<Store>) {
        reset()
        self.account = account
        self.backend = backend
        self.port = port
        cloud.connect(account: account, backend: backend)
        backend.setDiagnostic(diagnosticReservation)
        backend.setAutomaticUpdates(updatesAutomatically)
        apply(backend.snapshot())
        backend.checkUpdates()
        activity = ApplicationActivityObservation { [weak self] active in
            guard active else { return }
            Task { @MainActor in self?.backend?.checkUpdates() }
        }
        observation = Task { [weak self, backend] in
            var after = self?.revision ?? 0
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                let snapshot = await backend.changed(after: after)
                guard let self, self.backend === backend else { return }
                after = snapshot.revision
                apply(snapshot)
            }
        }
    }

    /// Stops the account's Transfer. A running game keeps its Game session.
    func signedOut() {
        backend?.signedOut()
        reset()
    }

    private func reset() {
        observation?.cancel()
        observation = nil
        activity = nil
        port = nil
        backend = nil
        account = nil
        revision = 0
        report = nil
        warning = nil
        receipts = []
        transfer = nil
        transferGame = nil
        resumableGame = nil
        queuedGames = []
        gate = .closed
        isDownloading = false
        isLaunching = false
        isVerifyingBeforeLaunch = false
        launchGame = nil
        uninstallGame = nil
    }

    private func apply(_ snapshot: InstallationsSnapshot<Store>) {
        guard snapshot.revision > revision else { return }
        revision = snapshot.revision
        // Repeated snapshots do not invalidate unchanged presentation.
        if receipts != snapshot.receipts { receipts = snapshot.receipts }
        if transfer != snapshot.transfer { transfer = snapshot.transfer }
        if transferGame != snapshot.transferGame { transferGame = snapshot.transferGame }
        if isDownloading != snapshot.downloading { isDownloading = snapshot.downloading }
        if isLaunching != snapshot.launching { isLaunching = snapshot.launching }
        if isVerifyingBeforeLaunch != snapshot.verifyingBeforeLaunch {
            isVerifyingBeforeLaunch = snapshot.verifyingBeforeLaunch
        }
        if launchGame != snapshot.launchGame { launchGame = snapshot.launchGame }
        if uninstallGame != snapshot.uninstallGame { uninstallGame = snapshot.uninstallGame }
        if resumableGame != snapshot.resumable { resumableGame = snapshot.resumable }
        if queuedGames != snapshot.queued { queuedGames = snapshot.queued }
        if gate != snapshot.gate { gate = snapshot.gate }
        if cloud.sync != snapshot.cloudSync { cloud.sync = snapshot.cloudSync }
        if report != snapshot.report {
            report = snapshot.report
            if let report { port?.report(Self.failure(report)) }
        }
        if warning != snapshot.warning {
            warning = snapshot.warning
            if let warning { port?.warn(L10n.string(warning.key)) }
        }
    }

    private static func failure(_ report: InstallationReport) -> Error {
        switch report {
        case let .storefront(key): Store.failure(key)
        case let .downloadDirectory(message): GameInstallationFailure.downloadDirectory(message)
        case let .uninstall(reason): GameInstallationFailure.uninstall(reason)
        case let .move(reason): GameInstallationFailure.move(reason)
        case let .gamesFolderUnavailable(path): GameInstallationFailure.gamesFolderUnavailable(path)
        }
    }

    /// Runs an action on the account's installations, then shows its state.
    private func act(_ action: (any InstallationsBackend<Store>) -> Void) {
        guard let backend else { return }
        port?.report(nil)
        action(backend)
        apply(backend.snapshot())
        sessions.refresh()
    }

    /// Whether an account is signed in, whose installations these are.
    var isConnected: Bool { account != nil }

    // MARK: Reservation gate

    /// Whether a Transfer of `game` may join the download queue, as Rust's
    /// Reservation shows it.
    func canModify(_ game: Store.GameID?) -> Bool {
        game.map(gate.modify.allows) ?? false
    }

    /// Whether `game`'s Transfer waits in the download queue.
    func isQueued(_ game: Store.GameID) -> Bool { queuedGames.contains(game) }

    /// The running Transfer's progress, when it belongs to the game Rust names `game`.
    func transfer(named game: String) -> GameTransfer? {
        Store.game(game).flatMap(transfer(for:))
    }

    /// Whether `game` may launch: no Game session runs, and no Transfer holds it.
    func canLaunch(_ game: Store.GameID) -> Bool {
        gate.launch.allows(game)
    }

    /// Whether the player may sync `game`'s Cloud saves.
    func canMaintainCloud(_ game: Store.GameID) -> Bool {
        Store.syncsCloud && account != nil && gate.maintain.allows(game)
    }

    /// Identifies the operation before its first progress snapshot arrives.
    var activeTransferGame: Store.GameID? {
        if isDownloading { return transferGame }
        if isLaunching && isVerifyingBeforeLaunch { return launchGame }
        return nil
    }

    /// The active Game session's game when it is this account's: a session of
    /// another account is not this account's game.
    var accountSession: GameSessions<Store>.ActiveGame? {
        sessions.activeGame.flatMap { $0.account == account ? $0 : nil }
    }

    /// The last Transfer progress, when it belongs to `game`.
    func transfer(for game: Store.GameID) -> GameTransfer? {
        transferGame == game ? transfer : nil
    }

    /// The game's installation for `platform`, else its other one.
    func receipt(for game: Store.GameID, preferring platform: GamePlatform) -> Receipt? {
        Receipt.preferred(among: receipts.filter { $0.gameID == game }, platform: platform)
    }

    // MARK: The game on screen

    /// The installation of the selected platform, else the game's other one: an
    /// installed build stays on screen whatever the storefront would install now.
    var selectedReceipt: Receipt? {
        selection().flatMap { receipt(for: $0.game, preferring: $0.platform) }
    }

    /// Whether the game on screen's installation may be verified.
    var canVerifySelectedGame: Bool {
        account != nil && selectedReceipt != nil && canModify(selection()?.game)
    }

    /// Whether the game on screen's installation may be uninstalled.
    var canUninstallSelectedGame: Bool {
        guard account != nil, selectedReceipt != nil, let game = selection()?.game else { return false }
        return gate.uninstall.allows(game)
    }

    var isSynchronizingSaves: Bool {
        selection().map { cloud.isSynchronizing(for: $0.game) } ?? false
    }

    var canSyncCloud: Bool { selection().map { canMaintainCloud($0.game) } ?? false }

    /// Syncs the Cloud saves of the game on screen: of its installation, or
    /// of an uninstalled game.
    func syncCloud() {
        guard canSyncCloud, let selection = selection() else { return }
        let installed = selectedReceipt
        act { $0.maintainCloud(selection.game, installed: installed) }
    }

    /// Asks Rust again for the Cloud indicator of the game on screen.
    func refreshCloudIndicator() {
        guard Store.syncsCloud, let game = selection()?.game else { return }
        cloud.refreshIndicators(for: [game])
    }

    /// The game on screen's Cloud indicator, or nil when it is hidden.
    var cloudIndicator: CloudIndicatorPresentation? {
        guard Store.syncsCloud, let game = selection()?.game, account != nil else { return nil }
        let playing = accountSession?.game == game
        return CloudIndicatorPresentation.make(saved: cloud.indicator(for: game), isSyncing: isSynchronizingSaves,
                                               isPlaying: playing, isInstalled: selectedReceipt != nil)
    }

    // MARK: Game actions

    /// Asks the running game to quit, from wherever its Game action shows: a
    /// Mac build is asked as its own Quit menu would.
    func quitRunningGame() {
        guard let active = sessions.active else { return }
        // Only a Mac build runs from its own installation.
        let macApps = active.account != account ? [] : receipts
            .filter { $0.gameID == active.game && $0.platform == .mac }
            .map(\.directory)
        Task { await sessions.quit(macApps: macApps) }
    }

    /// The Force Quit its player confirmed, while the running game may still
    /// be forced.
    func forceQuitRunningGame() {
        Task { await sessions.forceQuit() }
    }

    /// Launches an installation, from its game's page or from the library.
    func launch(_ receipt: Receipt) {
        guard account != nil, canLaunch(receipt.gameID), receipts.contains(receipt) else { return }
        act { $0.launch(receipt) }
    }

    /// Whether `game` may be installed: no build of it is installed and no
    /// operation holds it.
    private func canInstall(_ game: Store.GameID) -> Bool {
        account != nil && canModify(game) && !receipts.contains { $0.gameID == game }
    }

    /// Installs `offer`, a build of a game none of whose builds is installed,
    /// from its page or from the library. Rust resumes the game's interrupted
    /// Transfer instead, and picks every folder.
    func install(_ offer: GameOffer, of game: Store.GameID) {
        guard canInstall(game) else { return }
        act { $0.install(offer) }
    }

    // MARK: Transfers

    /// Stops `game`'s Transfer, or its launch still preparing. Another game's
    /// operation goes on, and a running game keeps its Game session.
    func cancel(_ game: Store.GameID) {
        let transfers = isDownloading && transferGame == game
        guard transfers || (isLaunching && launchGame == game) || isQueued(game), let backend else { return }
        backend.cancel(game)
        apply(backend.snapshot())
        sessions.refresh()
    }

    // MARK: Verification and uninstall

    /// Verifies an installation's files, from its game's page: the Transfer
    /// repairs or updates them in place.
    func verify(_ receipt: Receipt) {
        guard account != nil, canModify(receipt.gameID), receipts.contains(receipt) else { return }
        act { $0.update(receipt) }
    }

    func uninstall(_ receipt: Receipt) {
        guard account != nil, gate.uninstall.allows(receipt.gameID), receipts.contains(receipt) else { return }
        act { $0.uninstall(receipt) }
    }

    // MARK: Launch settings

    /// The launch settings of an installed Windows build; nil for a Mac build
    /// or once the account is gone.
    func launchSettings(_ receipt: Receipt) async throws -> LaunchSettings? {
        guard let backend, receipts.contains(receipt) else { return nil }
        return try await backend.launchSettings(receipt)
    }

    /// Keeps the player's launch settings of an installed Windows build, from
    /// its next launch.
    func setLaunchSettings(_ receipt: Receipt, choices: LaunchChoices) async throws -> LaunchSettings? {
        guard let backend, receipts.contains(receipt) else { return nil }
        return try await backend.setLaunchSettings(receipt, choices: choices)
    }
}

extension GameInstallations where Store == SteamGames {
    /// Launches a Steam installation as `launch` does, its game joining
    /// `invite`, a friend's lobby or `connect` string.
    func join(_ receipt: Receipt, invite: SteamGameInvite) {
        guard account != nil, canLaunch(receipt.gameID), receipts.contains(receipt) else { return }
        act { $0.join(receipt, invite: invite) }
    }
}

extension SteamGames: InstallationStorefront {
    static func game(_ id: String) -> UInt32? { UInt32(id) }
    static func name(_ game: UInt32) -> String { String(game) }
    static let otherGameOperation = "ui.steam.other_game_operation"
    @MainActor static func describe(_ error: Error) -> String { SteamModel.message(error) }
    static var cloudTitle: String { L10n.string("ui.steam.cloud.title") }
}

extension EpicGames: InstallationStorefront {
    /// Rust names an Epic game as its library ID does.
    static func game(_ id: String) -> String? { epicGameID(id) == nil ? nil : id }
    static func name(_ game: String) -> String { game }
    static let otherGameOperation = "ui.epic.other_game_operation"
}

extension GogGames: InstallationStorefront {
    /// GOG product ids are decimal numbers.
    static func game(_ id: String) -> String? {
        !id.isEmpty && id.utf8.count <= 20 && id.utf8.allSatisfy { (48...57).contains($0) } ? id : nil
    }
    static func name(_ game: String) -> String { game }
    static let otherGameOperation = "ui.gog.other_game_operation"
    /// GOG Cloud saves need each game's own Galaxy credentials: not yet.
    static let syncsCloud = false
}

typealias SteamInstallations = GameInstallations<SteamGames>
typealias EpicInstallations = GameInstallations<EpicGames>
typealias GogInstallations = GameInstallations<GogGames>

/// The installations of a session that is not Rust's: it has none, and every
/// action does nothing.
final class NoInstallations<Store: InstallationStorefront>: InstallationsBackend {
    private let empty = InstallationsSnapshot<Store>(
        revision: 1, receipts: [], transfer: nil, transferGame: nil, downloading: false, launching: false,
        verifyingBeforeLaunch: false, launchGame: nil, uninstallGame: nil, resumable: nil,
        report: nil, warning: nil, gate: .closed, cloudSync: nil
    )

    func snapshot() -> InstallationsSnapshot<Store> { empty }
    func changed(after: UInt64) async -> InstallationsSnapshot<Store> {
        // Nothing ever changes: wait until the observer goes.
        while !Task.isCancelled { try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(3600)) }
        return empty
    }
    func setDiagnostic(_ running: Bool) {}
    func install(_ offer: GameOffer) {}
    func update(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>) {}
    func cancel(_ game: Store.GameID) {}
    func checkUpdates() {}
    func setAutomaticUpdates(_ enabled: Bool) {}
    func launch(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>) {}
    func join(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>, invite: SteamGameInvite) {}
    func uninstall(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>) {}
    func signedOut() {}
    func maintainCloud(_ game: Store.GameID, installed: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>?) {}
    func answerCloud(_ game: Store.GameID, decisionId: UInt64, choice: CloudChoice) async throws {
        throw Store.failure(Store.invalidSession)
    }
    func cloudIndicators(_ games: [Store.GameID]) async throws -> [(Store.GameID, CloudIndicator)] { [] }
    func launchSettings(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>) async throws -> LaunchSettings? { nil }
    func setLaunchSettings(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>, choices: LaunchChoices) async throws
        -> LaunchSettings? { nil }
}

/// The file that keeps `account`'s Installation receipts in `directory`.
func receiptsFile(in directory: URL, storefront: String, account: String) -> URL {
    // Account identifiers are opaque. Encode them before using them in a file name.
    let component = account.utf8.map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
    return directory.appending(path: "\(storefront)-installations-\(component).json")
}

/// One account's installations in Rust, of either storefront: games cross
/// under the names Rust gives them, installations under their receipt's id.
final class RustInstallations<Store: InstallationStorefront>: InstallationsBackend {
    private let core: any AccountInstallationsProtocol

    init(_ core: any AccountInstallationsProtocol) { self.core = core }

    func snapshot() -> InstallationsSnapshot<Store> { Self.snapshot(core.state()) }
    func changed(after: UInt64) async -> InstallationsSnapshot<Store> {
        Self.snapshot(await core.changed(after: after))
    }
    func setDiagnostic(_ running: Bool) { core.setDiagnostic(running: running) }
    func install(_ offer: GameOffer) { core.install(offer: offer) }
    func update(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>) { core.update(installation: receipt.id) }
    func cancel(_ game: Store.GameID) { core.cancel(game: Store.name(game)) }
    func checkUpdates() { core.checkUpdates() }
    func setAutomaticUpdates(_ enabled: Bool) { core.setAutomaticUpdates(enabled: enabled) }
    func launch(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>) { core.launch(installation: receipt.id) }
    func join(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>, invite: SteamGameInvite) {
        core.join(installation: receipt.id, invite: invite)
    }
    func uninstall(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>) { core.uninstall(installation: receipt.id) }
    func signedOut() { core.signedOut() }
    func maintainCloud(_ game: Store.GameID, installed: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>?) {
        core.maintainCloud(game: Store.name(game), installation: installed?.id)
    }
    func answerCloud(_ game: Store.GameID, decisionId: UInt64, choice: CloudChoice) async throws {
        do { try await core.answerCloud(game: Store.name(game), decisionId: decisionId, choice: choice) }
        catch { throw GameSessions<Store>.translated(error) }
    }
    func cloudIndicators(_ games: [Store.GameID]) async throws -> [(Store.GameID, CloudIndicator)] {
        try await core.cloudIndicators(games: games.map(Store.name)).compactMap { shown in
            Store.game(shown.game).map { ($0, shown.indicator) }
        }
    }
    func launchSettings(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>) async throws -> LaunchSettings? {
        do { return try await core.launchSettings(installation: receipt.id) }
        catch { throw GameSessions<Store>.translated(error) }
    }
    func setLaunchSettings(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>, choices: LaunchChoices) async throws
        -> LaunchSettings? {
        do { return try await core.setLaunchSettings(installation: receipt.id, choices: choices) }
        catch { throw GameSessions<Store>.translated(error) }
    }

    private static func snapshot(_ state: InstallationsState) -> InstallationsSnapshot<Store> {
        InstallationsSnapshot(
            revision: state.revision,
            receipts: state.installations.compactMap { installation in
                Store.game(installation.game).map {
                    InstallationReceipt(id: installation.id, gameID: $0, name: installation.name,
                                        directory: installation.directory, platform: installation.platform,
                                        totalBytes: installation.totalBytes,
                                        needsVerification: installation.needsVerification,
                                        updateAvailable: installation.updateAvailable)
                }
            },
            transfer: state.transfer, transferGame: state.transferGame.flatMap(Store.game),
            downloading: state.downloading, launching: state.launching,
            verifyingBeforeLaunch: state.verifyingBeforeLaunch, launchGame: state.launchGame.flatMap(Store.game),
            uninstallGame: state.uninstallGame.flatMap(Store.game),
            resumable: state.resumable.flatMap(Store.game), report: state.report, warning: state.warning,
            gate: InstallationsGate(state.gate, game: Store.game),
            cloudSync: state.cloudSync.flatMap { sync in
                Store.game(sync.game).map {
                    GameCloudSync(game: $0, kind: sync.kind, decisionId: sync.decisionId, working: sync.working,
                                  reconnecting: sync.reconnecting, cancellable: sync.cancellable,
                                  question: sync.question)
                }
            },
            queued: state.queued.compactMap(Store.game)
        )
    }
}
```

```swift
import AppKit
import Observation

/// What one storefront adds to its Game sessions: how its games and accounts
/// are named, and its errors.
protocol GameStorefront {
    associatedtype GameID: Hashable & Sendable
    associatedtype AccountID: Hashable & Sendable
    static var storefront: SessionStorefront { get }
    /// The game and account a session names, when it is this storefront's.
    static func identity(of game: GameIdentity) -> (game: GameID, account: AccountID)?
    /// How a session names `game` of `account`.
    static func identity(_ game: GameID, account: AccountID) -> GameIdentity?
    static func account(_ account: AccountID) -> GameAccount
    static func account(of account: GameAccount) -> AccountID?
    /// How getobelisk.app names `game`: its ID in the store.
    static func storeGameID(_ game: GameID) -> String?
    /// A refused or failed session call, as this storefront reports errors.
    static func failure(_ key: String) -> Error
    static var invalidSession: String { get }
    /// Localization key shown while a session is being recovered.
    static var recoveringSession: String { get }
}

enum SteamGames: GameStorefront {
    static let storefront = SessionStorefront.steam
    static func identity(of game: GameIdentity) -> (game: UInt32, account: UInt64)? {
        guard case let .steam(appId, accountId) = game else { return nil }
        return (appId, accountId)
    }
    static func identity(_ game: UInt32, account: UInt64) -> GameIdentity? { .steam(appId: game, accountId: account) }
    static func account(_ account: UInt64) -> GameAccount { .steam(steamId: account) }
    static func account(of account: GameAccount) -> UInt64? {
        guard case let .steam(steamId) = account else { return nil }
        return steamId
    }
    static func storeGameID(_ game: UInt32) -> String? { String(game) }
    /// Steam's own errors keep their meaning, such as a sign-in to renew.
    static func failure(_ key: String) -> Error {
        switch key {
        case "backend.steam.friends.authenticationRequired": SteamError.AuthenticationRequired
        case "backend.steam.content.cancelled": SteamError.Cancelled
        default: SteamError.Failure(reason: key)
        }
    }
    static let invalidSession = "backend.steam.runtime.invalidSession"
    static let recoveringSession = "model.steam.recoveringSession"

    @MainActor static let sessions = GameSessions<SteamGames>(
        StorefrontSessions(storefront: storefront, locations: .live), history: .live
    )
}

enum EpicGames: GameStorefront {
    static let storefront = SessionStorefront.epic
    static func identity(of game: GameIdentity) -> (game: String, account: String)? {
        guard case let .epic(accountId, namespace, appName) = game else { return nil }
        return (epicLibraryID(namespace: namespace, appName: appName), accountId)
    }
    static func identity(_ game: String, account: String) -> GameIdentity? {
        epicGameID(game).map { .epic(accountId: account, namespace: $0.namespace, appName: $0.appName) }
    }
    static func account(_ account: String) -> GameAccount { .epic(accountId: account) }
    static func account(of account: GameAccount) -> String? {
        guard case let .epic(accountId) = account else { return nil }
        return accountId
    }
    static func storeGameID(_ game: String) -> String? { epicGameID(game)?.appName }
    /// A signed-out account still signs Obelisk out, as any Epic call does.
    static func failure(_ key: String) -> Error {
        switch key {
        case "backend.epic.unauthorized": EpicError.Unauthorized
        case "backend.epic.network": EpicError.Network
        default: EpicError.Service(message: key)
        }
    }
    static let invalidSession = "backend.epic.cloud.invalidSession"
    static let recoveringSession = "model.epic.recoveringSession"

    @MainActor static let sessions = GameSessions<EpicGames>(
        StorefrontSessions(storefront: storefront, locations: .live), history: .live
    )
}

enum GogGames: GameStorefront {

    static func account(of account: GameAccount) -> String? {

    static func failure(_ key: String) -> Error {
        switch key {
        case "backend.gog.unauthorized": GogError.Unauthorized
        case "backend.gog.network": GogError.Network
        default: GogError.Service(message: key)
        }
    }
    static let invalidSession = "backend.gog.invalidSession"
    static let recoveringSession = "model.gog.recoveringSession"

        StorefrontSessions(storefront: storefront, locations: .live), history: .live

/// How the player ends the running game: Quit asks it to close, then while
/// it closes nothing more can be asked until a frozen game may be forced.
enum GameQuitStage: Equatable {
    case quit
    case closing
    case forceQuit

    var title: String {
        switch self {
        case .quit: L10n.string("model.game.quit")
        case .closing: L10n.string("model.game.closing")
        case .forceQuit: L10n.string("model.game.forceQuit")
        }
    }

    /// What the stage's button does for the game named `title`.
    func label(title: String) -> String {
        switch self {
        case .quit: L10n.string("ui.game.quit_named", title)
        case .closing: L10n.string("model.game.closing")
        case .forceQuit: L10n.string("ui.game.force_quit_named", title)
        }
    }
}

/// How the player's Quit reaches a running game, and how long it gets before
/// Force Quit.
struct GameQuitting: Sendable {
    /// How long a game asked to quit gets before the player may force it.
    var delay: Duration = .seconds(10)
    /// How long Force Quit stays offered. A game may answer Quit with a
    /// question of its own, such as saving first, and play on: its player can
    /// then ask it to quit again rather than only kill it.
    var window: Duration = .seconds(60)
    var sleep: @Sendable (Duration) async throws -> Void = { try await Task.sleep(for: $0) }
    /// Asks the Mac apps running from these folders to quit, as their own
    /// Quit menu does, and tells whether one was asked.
    var quitMacApps: @MainActor @Sendable ([String]) -> Bool = GameQuitting.quitApps(in:)

    /// A Mac game handles its app's Quit: SIGTERM, which the supervisor
    /// otherwise sends, ends most of them at once.
    @MainActor static func quitApps(in folders: [String]) -> Bool {
        let roots = folders.map { URL(fileURLWithPath: $0).resolvingSymlinksInPath().path + "/" }
        let apps = NSWorkspace.shared.runningApplications.filter { app in
            guard let executable = app.executableURL?.resolvingSymlinksInPath().path else { return false }
            return roots.contains { executable.hasPrefix($0) }
        }
        return apps.map { $0.terminate() }.contains(true)
    }
}

typealias SteamGameSessions = GameSessions<SteamGames>
typealias EpicGameSessions = GameSessions<EpicGames>
typealias GogGameSessions = GameSessions<GogGames>

extension GameSessions where Store == SteamGames {
    static var shared: SteamGameSessions { SteamGames.sessions }
}

/// A storefront's Game sessions as Rust keeps them: the Reservation, recovery,
/// Account revocation and the checks on every answer. This presents their
/// state and forwards the player's answers.
@MainActor @Observable
final class GameSessions<Store: GameStorefront> {
    struct Session: Identifiable, Equatable {
        let id: String
        let game: Store.GameID
        var account: Store.AccountID
        var phase: GamePhase
        /// The control connection was lost; the game may still run.
        var reconnecting: Bool
        var cloud: CloudStatus
        /// Steam's native host.
        var host: SteamHostState?
        /// The latest invite dialog a Steam game asked for.
        var inviteRequest: SteamInviteRequest?
        /// The Steam lobby a Steam game is in now.
        var lobbyId: UInt64?
        /// The latest overlay a Steam game asked for, invite dialogs included.
        var overlayRequest: SteamOverlayRequest?
        /// Invitations friends sent into a Steam game, newest first.
        var receivedInvites: [SteamReceivedInvite]
        /// The purchase a Steam game waits on the player to authorize.
        var microTxn: SteamMicroTxn?
        /// A supervisor snapshot backs this session, not only its admission.
        var observed: Bool
        /// Which runtime downloads while the launch waits for it, and how much.
        var runtimeInstall: RuntimeInstallState?
        /// When this Obelisk saw the game start, even if it already exited. A
        /// game recovered running started before, and has none.
        var startedAt: Date?
        /// What the game did, once it ran and exited.
        var played: GamePlayed?
        var running: Bool { phase == .running }

        init?(_ state: GameSessionState) {
            guard let identity = Store.identity(of: state.game) else { return nil }
            id = state.id
            game = identity.game
            account = identity.account
            phase = state.phase
            reconnecting = state.reconnecting
            cloud = state.cloud
            host = state.host
            inviteRequest = state.inviteRequest
            lobbyId = state.lobbyId
            overlayRequest = state.overlayRequest
            receivedInvites = state.receivedInvites
            microTxn = state.microTxn
            observed = state.observed
            runtimeInstall = state.runtimeInstall
            startedAt = state.startedAt.map { Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval($0)) }
            played = state.played
        }
    }

    /// The active session's game, as the library and the Cloud indicator read it.
    struct ActiveGame: Equatable {
        let game: Store.GameID
        let account: Store.AccountID
        let running: Bool
        /// Its game exited and the session settles before it ends.
        let ended: Bool
        /// The runtime the launch waits for, while it downloads.
        let runtime: RuntimeComponent?
    }

    private(set) var active: Session?
    /// Changes with `active`'s game, phase and awaited runtime only, not with
    /// how far that runtime downloaded.
    private(set) var activeGame: ActiveGame?
    private(set) var isRecovering = true
    private(set) var recoveryError: String?
    var isBusy: Bool { activeGame != nil || isRecovering }
    /// The player's Quit of the active session's game, until that session
    /// stops running.
    private(set) var quitRequest: QuitRequest?
    @ObservationIgnored let quitting: GameQuitting
    private var revokedAccounts: [Store.AccountID] = []
    private var rosetta: RosettaPrompt?
    /// Rust's Game sessions, which the account's installations admit launches into.
    @ObservationIgnored let core: any StorefrontSessionsProtocol
    /// Where every game this Obelisk saw start is recorded.
    @ObservationIgnored let history: LaunchHistory
    /// The last session whose launch `history` recorded.
    @ObservationIgnored private var recordedLaunch: String?
    /// Told once of each session whose game ran and exited, with what it played.
    @ObservationIgnored var reportPlayed: ((Store.GameID, GamePlayed) -> Void)?
    /// The last session `reportPlayed` was told of.
    @ObservationIgnored private var reportedSession: String?
    @ObservationIgnored private var revision: UInt64 = 0
    @ObservationIgnored private var escalation: Task<Void, Never>?

    struct QuitRequest: Equatable {
        let session: String
        let requestedAt: Date
        /// `quitting.delay` passed and the game still runs.
        var forceable = false
    }

    init(_ core: any StorefrontSessionsProtocol, history: LaunchHistory, quitting: GameQuitting = GameQuitting()) {
        self.core = core
        self.history = history
        self.quitting = quitting
        apply(core.state())
        let revision = revision
        Task { [weak self] in
            var after = revision
            while true {
                let state = await core.changed(after: after)
                guard let self else { return }
                after = state.revision
                apply(state)
            }
        }
    }

    /// Shows Rust's state at once, such as an admission the account's
    /// installations just made.
    func refresh() {
        apply(core.state())
    }

    private func apply(_ state: GameSessionsState) {
        guard state.revision > revision else { return }
        revision = state.revision
        let active = state.active.flatMap(Session.init)
        let last = state.last.flatMap(Session.init)
        // The last session is the one observed most recently: a short game may
        // show only there, already finished, as Rust publishes only its latest
        // state.
        if let last, let startedAt = last.startedAt, last.id != recordedLaunch {
            recordedLaunch = last.id
            history.record(last.game, account: last.account, in: Store.self, at: startedAt)
        }
        if let last, let played = last.played, last.id != reportedSession {
            reportedSession = last.id
            reportPlayed?(last.game, played)
        }
        // Repeated states do not invalidate unchanged presentation.
        if self.active != active { self.active = active }
        let activeGame = active.map {
            ActiveGame(game: $0.game, account: $0.account, running: $0.running,
                       ended: $0.phase == .finalizing || $0.phase == .finished,
                       runtime: $0.runtimeInstall?.component)
        }
        if self.activeGame != activeGame { self.activeGame = activeGame }
        if isRecovering != state.recovering { isRecovering = state.recovering }
        let recoveryError = state.recoveryFailed ? L10n.string(Store.recoveringSession) : nil
        if self.recoveryError != recoveryError { self.recoveryError = recoveryError }
        let revoked = state.revoked.compactMap(Store.account(of:))
        if revokedAccounts != revoked { revokedAccounts = revoked }
        let rosetta = state.rosetta.flatMap { prompt in
            Store.account(of: prompt.account).map {
                RosettaPrompt(id: prompt.sessionId, accountId: $0, decisionId: prompt.decisionId)
            }
        }
        if self.rosetta != rosetta { self.rosetta = rosetta }
        if let quitRequest, active?.id != quitRequest.session || active?.running != true {
            self.quitRequest = nil
            escalation?.cancel()
            escalation = nil
        }
    }

    func revoked(_ account: Store.AccountID) -> Bool { revokedAccounts.contains(account) }

    /// What the page of `game` tells of the Game sessions while `account` is
    /// signed in: one recovering, its recovery's failure, or that
    /// `otherGameRunning`.
    func message(for game: Store.GameID?, of account: Store.AccountID?, otherGameRunning: String) -> String? {
        if isRecovering || active?.reconnecting == true { return L10n.string(Store.recoveringSession) }
        if let recoveryError { return recoveryError }
        if let active, active.account != account || active.game != game { return otherGameRunning }
        return nil
    }

    typealias RosettaPrompt = RosettaLaunchPrompt<String, Store.AccountID>

    func rosettaPrompt(accountId: Store.AccountID) -> RosettaPrompt? {
        rosetta?.accountId == accountId ? rosetta : nil
    }

    func resumeAfterRosetta(_ prompt: RosettaPrompt) async throws {
        try Task.checkCancellation()
        do {
            try await core.resumeAfterRosetta(sessionId: prompt.id, account: Store.account(prompt.accountId),
                                              decisionId: prompt.decisionId)
        }
        catch let GameSessionError.Failure(reason) where reason == Self.rosettaUnavailableKey {
            throw RosettaStillUnavailable()
        }
        catch { throw Self.translated(error) }
    }

    func cancelRosetta(_ prompt: RosettaPrompt) {
        guard rosettaPrompt(accountId: prompt.accountId) == prompt else { return }
        core.declineRosetta(sessionId: prompt.id, account: Store.account(prompt.accountId),
                            decisionId: prompt.decisionId)
        apply(core.state())
    }

    /// Ends the running game, as quitting Obelisk does: it gets a few seconds
    /// to quit, and its session still settles its Cloud saves.
    func stop() async {
        try? await core.stop()
        apply(core.state())
    }

    /// What ending the active session's running game asks of the player now.
    var quitStage: GameQuitStage? {
        // A session reconnecting to its supervisor cannot be asked anything.
        guard let active, active.running, !active.reconnecting else { return nil }
        guard let quitRequest, quitRequest.session == active.id else { return .quit }
        return quitRequest.forceable ? .forceQuit : .closing
    }

    /// The player's Quit: the running game is asked to close its windows, and
    /// nothing is killed. A Mac game running from one of `macApps` is asked
    /// as its own Quit menu would. Once `quitting.delay` passed with the game
    /// still running, the player may force it to quit for `quitting.window`.
    func quit(macApps: [String] = []) async {
        guard quitStage == .quit, let active else { return }
        let session = active.id
        quitRequest = QuitRequest(session: session, requestedAt: .now)
        escalation = Task { [weak self, quitting] in
            try? await quitting.sleep(quitting.delay)
            guard !Task.isCancelled, self?.quitRequest?.session == session else { return }
            self?.quitRequest?.forceable = true
            try? await quitting.sleep(quitting.window)
            guard !Task.isCancelled, self?.quitRequest?.session == session else { return }
            self?.quitRequest = nil
        }
        if quitting.quitMacApps(macApps) { return }
        // A refused Quit still lets the player force the game once it is due.
        try? await core.quit(sessionId: session)
        apply(core.state())
    }

    /// The player's Force Quit of a game that ignored Quit: it ends now, and
    /// its session still settles its Cloud saves. The player confirms it
    /// first: what the game did not save is lost.
    func forceQuit() async {
        guard quitStage == .forceQuit, let active else { return }
        try? await core.forceQuit(sessionId: active.id)
        apply(core.state())
    }

    /// Account revocation. Admission checks it at once; the supervisor learns
    /// it as soon as it can be reached.
    func signedOut(account: Store.AccountID) {
        core.revoke(account: Store.account(account))
        apply(core.state())
    }

    /// A session call's failure, reported as the storefront's error.
    static func translated(_ error: Error) -> Error {
        switch error {
        case GameSessionError.Cancelled: CancellationError()
        case let GameSessionError.Failure(reason): Store.failure(reason)
        default: error
        }
    }
}

extension GameSessions where Store == SteamGames {
    /// Obelisk's overlay opened or closed over session `id`'s running game,
    /// which learns it as from Steam's overlay; `userInitiated` when the
    /// player opened it rather than the game.
    func overlayState(sessionId id: String, active: Bool, userInitiated: Bool) async throws {
        do { try await core.overlayState(sessionId: id, active: active, userInitiated: userInitiated) }
        catch { throw Self.translated(error) }
    }

    /// The player joins `friend`'s invitation into session `id`'s running
    /// game, as Steam's overlay would accept it.
    func acceptInvite(sessionId id: String, friendSteamId friend: UInt64, invite: SteamGameInvite) async throws {
        do { try await core.acceptInvite(sessionId: id, friendSteamId: friend, invite: invite) }
        catch { throw Self.translated(error) }
        refresh()
    }

    /// The player's answer to the purchase `orderId` session `id`'s game waits on.
    func authorizeMicroTxn(sessionId id: String, orderId: UInt64, approve: Bool) async throws {
        do { try await core.authorizeMicroTxn(sessionId: id, orderId: orderId, approve: approve) }
        catch { throw Self.translated(error) }
        refresh()
    }
}

/// The supervisor's "Rosetta still unavailable" reply to a resumed launch.
struct RosettaStillUnavailable: Error {}

extension GameSessions: RosettaSessions {
    static func rosettaUnavailable(_ error: Error) -> Bool { error is RosettaStillUnavailable }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Models/GamesFolderModel.swift`:

```swift
import AppKit
import Foundation
import Observation

/// Obelisk's games folder, as Rust keeps it. Each change returns at once;
/// the moves it queues show in the download queue.
@MainActor
protocol GamesFolderBackend: AnyObject {
    func state() -> GamesFolderState
    /// Waits for a revision newer than `after`.
    func changed(after: UInt64) async -> GamesFolderState
    /// What choosing `folder` would do. It reads the disk.
    func inspect(_ folder: String) -> GamesFolderInspection
    /// What choosing Obelisk's own folder again would do. It makes that folder.
    func inspectDefault() -> GamesFolderInspection
    func choose(_ folder: String) throws
    func chooseDefault() throws
    /// Queues the move of the games still outside the games folder.
    func gather()
    /// A disk came or left.
    func volumesChanged()
}

/// The games folder every account's installations of the library share in Rust.
final class RustGamesFolder: GamesFolderBackend {
    private let core: GamesFolder

    init(library: URL) {
        core = GamesFolder(library: library.path)
    }

    func state() -> GamesFolderState { core.state() }
    func changed(after: UInt64) async -> GamesFolderState { await core.changed(after: after) }
    func inspect(_ folder: String) -> GamesFolderInspection { core.inspect(chosen: folder) }
    func inspectDefault() -> GamesFolderInspection { core.inspectDefault() }
    func choose(_ folder: String) throws { try core.choose(chosen: folder) }
    func chooseDefault() throws { try core.chooseDefault() }
    func gather() { core.gather() }
    func volumesChanged() { core.volumesChanged() }
}

/// A folder the player picked for the games, and what choosing it does,
/// before they agree.
struct GamesFolderProposal: Identifiable, Equatable {
    let id = UUID()
    /// The folder the player picked; nil for Obelisk's own on this Mac.
    let chosen: URL?
    /// Where the games go: Obelisk's folder inside the picked one.
    let path: String
    /// The installed games that move there.
    let games: Int
    /// What those of another disk copy there.
    let copiedBytes: UInt64
    /// The disk's name, as Finder shows it.
    let volume: String
    let availableBytes: UInt64?
    /// The disk's format when games may not all run from it, such as ExFAT.
    let format: String?
    let isReadOnly: Bool

    /// Whether the copies outgrow the disk's free space.
    var lacksSpace: Bool { availableBytes.map { $0 < copiedBytes } ?? false }
    var canChoose: Bool { !isReadOnly && !lacksSpace }

    /// The disk facts of `folder`, which it reads.
    static func volume(of folder: URL) -> (name: String, available: UInt64?, format: String?, readOnly: Bool) {
        let keys: Set<URLResourceKey> = [
            .volumeLocalizedNameKey, .volumeAvailableCapacityForImportantUsageKey, .volumeAvailableCapacityKey,
            .volumeIsReadOnlyKey, .volumeTypeNameKey, .volumeLocalizedFormatDescriptionKey,
        ]
        let values = try? folder.resourceValues(forKeys: keys)
        // An external disk answers zero for important usage: only the Mac's
        // own counts what it can purge.
        let important = values?.volumeAvailableCapacityForImportantUsage.map { UInt64(max(0, $0)) }
        let plain = values?.volumeAvailableCapacity.map { UInt64(max(0, $0)) }
        let available = [important, plain].compactMap { $0 }.max()
        // Only Mac formats keep everything a game holds, such as its links.
        let type = values?.volumeTypeName?.lowercased()
        let recommended = type.map { ["apfs", "hfs"].contains($0) } ?? true
        return (
            values?.volumeLocalizedName ?? folder.lastPathComponent,
            available,
            recommended ? nil : (values?.volumeLocalizedFormatDescription ?? values?.volumeTypeName),
            values?.volumeIsReadOnly ?? false
        )
    }
}

/// Where Obelisk installs games, and the player's change of it: the folder
/// they pick, what moving the games there does, then the moves, which run in
/// the download queue.
@MainActor @Observable
final class GamesFolderModel {
    private(set) var path: String
    /// Obelisk's own folder, inside its library on this Mac.
    private(set) var isDefault: Bool
    /// Whether the folder's disk is there: Obelisk's own folder always is.
    private(set) var isConnected: Bool
    /// The folder the player picked, waiting for them to agree.
    var proposal: GamesFolderProposal?
    /// Why the last folder the player picked was not taken.
    var failure: String?

    @ObservationIgnored private let backend: any GamesFolderBackend
    @ObservationIgnored private var revision: UInt64 = 0
    @ObservationIgnored private var observation: Task<Void, Never>?
    @ObservationIgnored private var volumes: [NSObjectProtocol] = []
    @ObservationIgnored private let center: NotificationCenter

    init(library: URL, backend: (any GamesFolderBackend)? = nil, workspace: NotificationCenter? = nil) {
        let backend = backend ?? RustGamesFolder(library: library)
        self.backend = backend
        let center = workspace ?? NSWorkspace.shared.notificationCenter
        self.center = center
        let state = backend.state()
        path = state.path
        isDefault = state.isDefault
        isConnected = state.isConnected
        revision = state.revision
        observation = Task { [weak self, backend] in
            var after = self?.revision ?? 0
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                let state = await backend.changed(after: after)
                guard let self else { return }
                after = state.revision
                apply(state)
            }
        }
        // A game on a disk that left shows as not installed until it comes back.
        volumes = [NSWorkspace.didMountNotification, NSWorkspace.didUnmountNotification,
                   NSWorkspace.didRenameVolumeNotification].map { name in
            center.addObserver(forName: name, object: nil, queue: .main) { [weak self] _ in
                MainActor.assumeIsolated { self?.volumesChanged() }
            }
        }
    }

    isolated deinit {
        observation?.cancel()
        for volume in volumes { center.removeObserver(volume) }
    }

    private func apply(_ state: GamesFolderState) {
        guard state.revision > revision else { return }
        revision = state.revision
        if path != state.path { path = state.path }
        if isDefault != state.isDefault { isDefault = state.isDefault }
        if isConnected != state.isConnected { isConnected = state.isConnected }
    }

    /// The games folder's new state follows through `changed(after:)`.
    private func volumesChanged() { backend.volumesChanged() }

    /// Whether `directory`, an installation's folder, is inside the games folder.
    func holds(_ directory: String) -> Bool {
        directory.hasPrefix(path.hasSuffix("/") ? path : path + "/")
    }

    /// Asks the player to move the games to the folder they picked.
    func propose(_ folder: URL) {
        propose(chosen: folder, backend.inspect(folder.path))
    }

    /// Asks the player to move the games back to Obelisk's own folder.
    func proposeDefault() {
        propose(chosen: nil, backend.inspectDefault())
    }

    private func propose(chosen: URL?, _ inspection: GamesFolderInspection) {
        failure = nil
        switch inspection {
        case let .ready(path, games, copiedBytes):
            // Obelisk's own folder exists once inspected; the one inside a
            // picked folder only once chosen.
            let volume = GamesFolderProposal.volume(of: chosen ?? URL(filePath: path, directoryHint: .isDirectory))
            proposal = GamesFolderProposal(
                chosen: chosen, path: path, games: Int(games), copiedBytes: copiedBytes, volume: volume.name,
                availableBytes: volume.available, format: volume.format, isReadOnly: volume.readOnly)
        case .missing:
            failure = L10n.string("model.gamesFolder.missing")
        case .inside:
            failure = L10n.string("model.gamesFolder.inside", AppIdentity.name)
        }
    }

    /// Takes the folder the player agreed to: the games move there.
    func confirm() {
        guard let proposal, proposal.canChoose else { return }
        self.proposal = nil
        do {
            if let chosen = proposal.chosen {
                try backend.choose(chosen.path)
            } else {
                try backend.chooseDefault()
            }
            apply(backend.state())
        } catch {
            failure = L10n.string("model.gamesFolder.failed", L10n.message(Self.reason(error)))
        }
    }

    /// Moves the games still outside the games folder.
    func gather() { backend.gather() }

    private static func reason(_ error: Error) -> String {
        if case let GameSessionError.Failure(reason) = error { return reason }
        return error.localizedDescription
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Models/GitHubIssues.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation

/// Obelisk's GitHub issue forms, in the repository's .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE,
/// opened with what Obelisk knows filled in: GitHub fills a form's fields
/// from query items named after their ids.
enum GitHubIssues {
    static let newIssue = URL(string: "https://github.com/Zagrios/obelisk/issues/new")!
    /// How long the description's start may be in a title, after its prefix.
    static let titleLimit = 80
    /// GitHub refuses very long URLs; the report keeps the whole description.
    static let textLimit = 2000

    /// The bug form for `report`, which the site gave `code`, titled "BUG : "
    /// then the game and the description's start. The contact the player gave
    /// stays out: an issue is public.
    static func bug(_ report: BugReport, code: String) -> URL {
        let summary = shortened(report.description.prefix { !$0.isNewline }, to: titleLimit)
        var fields = [
            ("template", "bug_report.yml"),
            ("title", "BUG : " + (report.game.map { "\($0.name): \(summary)" } ?? summary)),
            ("report-code", code),
        ]
        if let game = report.game {
            fields.append(("game", "\(game.name) (\(storeName(game.store)) \(game.id))"))
        }
        fields += [
            ("what-happened", shortened(report.description, to: textLimit)),
            ("obelisk-version", report.voileVersion.map { "\(report.obeliskVersion) (Voile \($0))" }
                ?? report.obeliskVersion),
            ("mac", "\(report.chip), \(report.macModel), macOS \(report.macOSVersion)"),
        ]
        return url(fields)
    }

    /// The feature form, its title started for the player.
    static func feature(obeliskVersion: String) -> URL {
        url([("template", "feature_request.yml"), ("title", "FEATURE : "), ("obelisk-version", obeliskVersion)])
    }

    private static func storeName(_ store: String) -> String {
        switch store {
        case "steam": "Steam"
        case "epic": "Epic Games"
        case "gog": "GOG"
        default: store
        }
    }

    /// `text` in at most `limit` UTF-16 units, cut after a word with "…".
    private static func shortened(_ text: some StringProtocol, to limit: Int) -> String {
        var text = String(text)
        guard text.utf16.count > limit else { return text }
        while text.utf16.count > limit - 1 { text.removeLast() }
        if let space = text.lastIndex(of: " "), text.distance(from: text.startIndex, to: space) > limit / 2 {
            text = String(text[..<space])
        }
        return text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) + "…"
    }

    /// A query keeps `+`, `&`, `=` and `#` encoded: a `+` would read as a space.
    private static let allowed = CharacterSet.urlQueryAllowed.subtracting(CharacterSet(charactersIn: "+&=#"))

    private static func url(_ fields: [(String, String)]) -> URL {
        var components = URLComponents(url: newIssue, resolvingAgainstBaseURL: false)!
        components.percentEncodedQueryItems = fields.map {
            URLQueryItem(name: $0.0, value: $0.1.addingPercentEncoding(withAllowedCharacters: allowed))
        }
        return components.url!
    }
}
```
