```swift
typealias GogModel = WebAccountModel<GogGames>

extension GogGames: WebStorefront {
    typealias Session = any GogSessionProtocol
    typealias Credentials = GogCredentials
    typealias Game = GogGame
    typealias Details = GogGameDetails

    static let storeID = "gog"
    /// The store through its site's own sign-in, as its Sign in button
    /// opens it: GOG's site takes no token of the app, but its sign-in page
    /// remembers the account Obelisk's sign-in signed in there, and then
    /// returns to the store signed in without asking.
    static let storeURL: URL = {
        let back = "https://www.gog.com/on_login_success?returnTo=/"
            .addingPercentEncoding(withAllowedCharacters: .alphanumerics)!
        return URL(string: "https://login.gog.com/auth?client_id=46755278331571209&response_type=code&redirect_uri=\(back)")!
    }()
    static let webSignIn = WebSignIn.gog
    static func keychain() -> any CredentialStore<GogCredentials> { GogKeychain() }

    static func signIn(code: String, library: LibraryCache?) async throws -> Session {
        try await GogSession.signIn(authorizationCode: code, library: library)
    }
    static func restore(_ credentials: GogCredentials, library: LibraryCache?) async throws -> Session {
        try await GogSession.restore(credentials: credentials, library: library)
    }
    static func accountID(_ credentials: GogCredentials) -> String { credentials.userId }
    static func accountName(_ credentials: GogCredentials) -> String { credentials.username }
    static func avatar(of session: Session) -> URL? { session.avatarUrl().flatMap(URL.init(string:)) }
    static func rotating(_ session: Session) -> RotatingSession<GogCredentials> {
        RotatingSession(
            identity: ObjectIdentifier(session),
            credentials: { try await session.credentials() },
            persist: { (saver: any CredentialSave) in await session.persist(credentials: saver) },
            shutdownObservers: { session.shutdownObservers() }
        )
    }
    /// GOG offers no revocation of a Galaxy token: this only forgets the session.
    static func disconnect(_ session: Session) async throws { try await session.disconnect() }

    static func games(of session: Session) async throws -> [GogGame] { try await session.games() }
    /// GOG answers each game's playtime on its own, in minutes.
    static func playtimes(of session: Session, games: [GogGame]) async throws -> [String: Duration] {
        let loaded = try await session.playtimes(productIds: games.map(\.productId))
        return Dictionary(loaded.map { ($0.productId, played(minutes: $0.minutes)) }, uniquingKeysWith: max)
    }
    /// GOG answers one game at a time.
    static func achievementShares(of games: [GogGame], session: Session, language: String) async throws -> [String: Double] {
        try await session.achievementShares(productIds: games.map(\.productId), locale: achievementLocale(language))
    }
    static func cachedLibrary(in cache: LibraryCache, account: String)
        -> [(game: GogGame, playtime: Duration?, achievements: Double?)] {
        cache.gogLibrary(userId: account).map {
            ($0.game, $0.playtimeMinutes.map(played(minutes:)), $0.achievementShare)
        }
    }
    /// `language` names the depots, such as "fr-FR".
    static func details(of game: GogGame, session: Session, language: String) async throws -> GogGameDetails {
        try await session.gameDetails(productId: game.productId, language: language)
    }
    static func achievements(of game: GogGame, session: Session, language: String,
                             fresh: Bool) async throws -> [GameAchievement] {
        try await session.achievements(productId: game.productId, locale: achievementLocale(language), fresh: fresh)
            .map(GameAchievement.init)
    }
    /// GOG names achievements in a full language tag, such as "fr-FR".
    private static func achievementLocale(_ language: String) -> String {
        Locale(identifier: language).identifier(.bcp47)
    }
    @MainActor static func installations(of session: Session, account: String, language: String,
                                          sessions: any StorefrontSessionsProtocol, receipts: URL,
                                          locations: ObeliskLocations) -> any InstallationsBackend<GogGames> {
        guard let session = session as? GogSession, let sessions = sessions as? StorefrontSessions else {
            return NoInstallations<GogGames>()
        }
        return RustInstallations<GogGames>(try! AccountInstallations.gog(
            session: session, userId: account, language: language, sessions: sessions,
            receipts: receipts.path, locations: locations
        ))
    }
    static func isUnauthorized(_ error: Error) -> Bool {
        if case GogError.Unauthorized = error { true } else { false }
    }
    @MainActor static func describe(_ error: Error) -> String {
        switch error {
        case GogError.Network: L10n.string("model.gog.network")
        case GogError.Unauthorized: L10n.string("model.gog.unauthorized")
        case GogError.InvalidCode: L10n.string("model.gog.invalidCode")
        case GogError.InvalidResponse: L10n.string("model.gog.invalidResponse")
        case let GogError.Service(message): L10n.message(message)
        case let browserError as WebAuthenticationError: browserError.localizedDescription
        case let failure as GameInstallationFailure: failure.localizedDescription
        default: L10n.string("model.gog.failure")
        }
    }

    static var sessionNotSaved: String { L10n.string("model.gog.sessionNotSaved") }
    static var revocationUnconfirmed: String { L10n.string("model.gog.revocationUnconfirmed") }
    static var otherGameRunning: String { L10n.string("model.gog.otherGameRunning") }
    /// GOG asks no Cloud question: Obelisk does not sync its saves.
    static var cloudTitle: String { L10n.string("ui.store.gog") }

    /// GOG counts playtime in minutes. A count too large to hold saturates.
    static func played(minutes: UInt64) -> Duration {
        let (seconds, overflow) = minutes.multipliedReportingOverflow(by: 60)
        return .seconds(Int64(clamping: overflow ? .max : seconds))
    }
}

extension GogGameDetails: WebGameDetails {}

extension GogGame: WebGame {
    public var id: String { productId }

    /// What GOG can install of the game. GOG picks the build as the Transfer
    /// starts.
    var offer: GameOffer? {
        guard macos || windows else { return nil }
        return .gog(productId: productId, title: title)
    }

    func libraryValue(for sort: StorefrontLibrarySort) -> Double? {
        sort == .dateAdded ? addedAt.map { Double($0) } : nil
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Models/LaunchHistory.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation
import Observation

/// When each account last launched each of its games from Obelisk, for every
/// storefront. The library cache keeps each launch in its game's entry; a
/// storefront that records no last played date, as Epic, learns it here.
@MainActor @Observable
final class LaunchHistory {
    private var launches: [GameIdentity: Date] {
        didSet { revision &+= 1 }
    }
    /// Changes with every launch recorded or forgotten.
    private(set) var revision = 0
    @ObservationIgnored private let cache: LibraryCache

    /// The history of the library Obelisk shows.
    static let live = LaunchHistory(cache: LibraryCache(directory: AppIdentity.libraryDirectory.path))

    init(cache: LibraryCache) {
        self.cache = cache
        launches = Dictionary(cache.launches().map { ($0.game, Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval($0.at))) },
                              uniquingKeysWith: max)
    }

    func record<Store: GameStorefront>(_ game: Store.GameID, account: Store.AccountID, in store: Store.Type,
                                        at date: Date = .now) {
        guard let identity = Store.identity(game, account: account) else { return }
        launches[identity] = date
        cache.recordLaunch(launch: GameLaunch(game: identity, at: UInt64(max(0, date.timeIntervalSince1970))))
    }

    /// When `account` last launched `game` from Obelisk.
    func lastLaunch<Store: GameStorefront>(of game: Store.GameID, account: Store.AccountID,
                                            in store: Store.Type) -> Date? {
        Store.identity(game, account: account).flatMap { launches[$0] }
    }

    /// Drops the account's launches, as signing it out drops its library.
    func forget<Store: GameStorefront>(account: Store.AccountID, in store: Store.Type) {
        launches = launches.filter { Store.identity(of: $0.key)?.account != account }
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Models/PerformanceEstimates.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation
import Observation

/// How each game runs on this Mac's chip, as other Obelisk players measured
/// it: getobelisk.app's numbers for the chip, else for the nearest weaker one.
/// The whole table comes in one answer, kept for an hour, so the site never
/// learns which game the player looks at.
@MainActor @Observable
final class PerformanceEstimates {
    struct Estimate: Decodable, Equatable {
        let store: String
        let id: String
        let name: String
        /// Names the game's page on the site.
        let slug: String
        /// The chip these numbers come from: this Mac's, or a weaker one.
        let measuredOn: String
        let sessions: Int
        let fpsMedian: Double?
        let fpsLow1Percent: Double?
        let crashRate: Double

        enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
            case store, id, name, slug, sessions
            case measuredOn = "measured_on"
            case fpsMedian = "fps_median"
            case fpsLow1Percent = "fps_low_1pct"
            case crashRate = "crash_rate"
        }

        /// The game's page on the site, with every chip's numbers.
        var page: URL? { URL(string: "https://getobelisk.app/games/\(slug)") }
    }

    private struct Answer: Decodable {
        let games: [Estimate]
    }

    nonisolated static let endpoint = URL(string: "https://getobelisk.app/api/performance")!
    /// How long an answer stays fresh.
    static let lifetime: TimeInterval = 3600

    private var estimates: [String: Estimate] = [:]
    @ObservationIgnored private var fetchedAt: Date?
    @ObservationIgnored private var loading: Task<Void, Never>?
    @ObservationIgnored private let chip: String
    @ObservationIgnored private let load: @Sendable (String) async -> [Estimate]?

    init(chip: String = MacHardware.current.chip,
         load: @escaping @Sendable (String) async -> [Estimate]? = { await PerformanceEstimates.fetch(chip: $0) }) {
        self.chip = chip
        self.load = load
    }

    /// The estimate of the game `store` names `id`, once an answer came.
    func estimate(store: SessionStorefront, id: String) -> Estimate? {
        estimates["\(store.siteName):\(id)"]
    }

    /// Asks the site again when the last answer is older than `lifetime`. A
    /// failed answer keeps the previous one until the next try.
    func refresh(now: Date = .now) {
        guard loading == nil, fetchedAt.map({ now.timeIntervalSince($0) >= Self.lifetime }) ?? true else { return }
        fetchedAt = now
        loading = Task {
            if let games = await load(chip) {
                estimates = Dictionary(games.map { ("\($0.store):\($0.id)", $0) }, uniquingKeysWith: { first, _ in first })
            }
            loading = nil
        }
    }

    private nonisolated static let session = URLSession(configuration: .ephemeral)

    nonisolated static func fetch(chip: String) async -> [Estimate]? {
        var components = URLComponents(url: endpoint, resolvingAgainstBaseURL: false)
        components?.queryItems = [URLQueryItem(name: "chip", value: chip)]
        guard let url = components?.url,
              let (data, response) = try? await session.data(for: URLRequest(url: url, timeoutInterval: 20)),
              (response as? HTTPURLResponse)?.statusCode == 200 else { return nil }
        return try? JSONDecoder().decode(Answer.self, from: data).games
    }
}

extension SessionStorefront {
    /// How getobelisk.app names the storefront.
    var siteName: String {
        switch self {
        case .steam: "steam"
        case .epic: "epic"
        case .gog: "gog"
        }
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Models/PerformanceReports.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation
import IOKit

/// What Obelisk sends getobelisk.app when a game it ran exits: the game, how
/// smoothly it ran, how it ended and the Mac it ran on. Nothing in it names
/// the player or ties two reports together. The site's docs/contracts.md
/// describes every field.
struct SessionReport: Encodable, Equatable {
    let store: String
    let storeGameID: String
    let gameName: String
    let gamePlatform: String
    let engine: String
    let graphics: String?
    let chip: String
    let gpuCores: Int?
    let macModel: String
    let memoryGB: Int
    let macOSVersion: String
    let obeliskVersion: String
    let voileVersion: String?
    let durationSeconds: UInt64
    let frames: UInt64
    let fpsMedian: Double?
    let fpsLow1Percent: Double?
    let hitches: UInt64
    let exitCode: Int32?
    let exitSignal: Int32?
    let stoppedFromObelisk: Bool

    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case store, engine, graphics, chip, frames, hitches
        case storeGameID = "store_game_id"
        case gameName = "game_name"
        case gamePlatform = "game_platform"
        case gpuCores = "gpu_cores"
        case macModel = "mac_model"
        case memoryGB = "memory_gb"
        case macOSVersion = "macos_version"
        case obeliskVersion = "obelisk_version"
        case voileVersion = "voile_version"
        case durationSeconds = "duration_s"
        case fpsMedian = "fps_median"
        case fpsLow1Percent = "fps_low_1pct"
        case exitCode = "exit_code"
        case exitSignal = "exit_signal"
        case stoppedFromObelisk = "stopped_from_obelisk"
    }

    /// The report of `game`, as `store` names it, which played `played` on `mac`.
    init(store: SessionStorefront, game: String, title: String, played: GamePlayed, mac: MacHardware,
         obeliskVersion: String) {
        self.store = store.siteName
        storeGameID = game
        gameName = title
        // Rust names the engine of a Windows game only.
        gamePlatform = played.engine == nil ? "macos" : "windows"
        engine = played.engine ?? "native"
        graphics = played.graphics
        chip = mac.chip
        gpuCores = mac.gpuCores
        macModel = mac.model
        memoryGB = mac.memoryGB
        macOSVersion = mac.macOSVersion
        self.obeliskVersion = obeliskVersion
        voileVersion = played.voile
        durationSeconds = played.seconds
        frames = played.frames
        fpsMedian = played.medianFps
        fpsLow1Percent = played.low1pctFps
        hitches = played.hitches
        exitCode = played.exitCode
        exitSignal = played.exitSignal
        stoppedFromObelisk = played.endedByObelisk
    }
}

/// The Mac a report says games ran on.
struct MacHardware: Equatable {
    /// As `Apple M2 Pro`.
    let chip: String
    /// As `Mac14,12`.
    let model: String
    let memoryGB: Int
    let gpuCores: Int?
    /// As `27.0`, or `27.0.1` once patched.
    let macOSVersion: String

    static let current: MacHardware = {
        let version = ProcessInfo.processInfo.operatingSystemVersion
        return MacHardware(
            chip: sysctlString("machdep.cpu.brand_string") ?? "Apple",
            model: sysctlString("hw.model") ?? "Mac",
            memoryGB: Int((Double(sysctlInteger("hw.memsize") ?? 0) / 1_073_741_824).rounded()),
            gpuCores: gpuCoreCount(),
            macOSVersion: version.patchVersion == 0
                ? "\(version.majorVersion).\(version.minorVersion)"
                : "\(version.majorVersion).\(version.minorVersion).\(version.patchVersion)"
        )
    }()

    private static func sysctlString(_ name: String) -> String? {
        var size = 0
        guard sysctlbyname(name, nil, &size, nil, 0) == 0, size > 0 else { return nil }
        var bytes = [UInt8](repeating: 0, count: size)
        guard sysctlbyname(name, &bytes, &size, nil, 0) == 0 else { return nil }
        return String(decoding: bytes.prefix { $0 != 0 }, as: UTF8.self)
    }

    private static func sysctlInteger(_ name: String) -> UInt64? {
        var value: UInt64 = 0
        var size = MemoryLayout<UInt64>.size
        return sysctlbyname(name, &value, &size, nil, 0) == 0 ? value : nil
    }

    /// The Apple GPU's core count, which its accelerator publishes.
    private static func gpuCoreCount() -> Int? {
        let service = IOServiceGetMatchingService(kIOMainPortDefault, IOServiceMatching("AGXAccelerator"))
        guard service != 0 else { return nil }
        defer { IOObjectRelease(service) }
        let count = IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty(service, "gpu-core-count" as CFString, kCFAllocatorDefault, 0)
        return (count?.takeRetainedValue() as? NSNumber)?.intValue
    }
}

/// Sends a report for each game that ran, while the player shares game
/// performance. A report that fails to send is dropped.
@MainActor
final class PerformanceReports {
    nonisolated static let endpoint = URL(string: "https://getobelisk.app/api/sessions")!
    /// Whether the player shares game performance; nothing is sent otherwise.
    var isEnabled: Bool
    private let mac: MacHardware
    private let deliver: @Sendable (SessionReport) async -> Void

    init(isEnabled: Bool, mac: MacHardware = .current,
         deliver: @escaping @Sendable (SessionReport) async -> Void = { await PerformanceReports.post($0) }) {
        self.isEnabled = isEnabled
        self.mac = mac
        self.deliver = deliver
    }

    /// Reports what `game` played, when its storefront knows its `title`.
    func report(_ played: GamePlayed, of game: String, titled title: String?, in store: SessionStorefront) {
        guard isEnabled, let title, !title.isEmpty else { return }
        let report = SessionReport(store: store, game: game, title: title, played: played, mac: mac,
                                   obeliskVersion: AppIdentity.version)
        Task { await deliver(report) }
    }

    private nonisolated static let session = URLSession(configuration: .ephemeral)

    nonisolated static func post(_ report: SessionReport) async {
        var request = URLRequest(url: endpoint, timeoutInterval: 20)
        request.httpMethod = "POST"
        request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
        guard let body = try? JSONEncoder().encode(report) else { return }
        request.httpBody = body
        _ = try? await session.data(for: request)
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Models/RememberedSession.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation
import Observation

/// One storefront account's Keychain item.
protocol CredentialStore<Credentials>: Sendable {
    associatedtype Credentials: Sendable
    func load() async throws -> Credentials?
    func save(_ credentials: Credentials) async throws
    func remove() async throws
}

/// A signed-in Rust session whose refresh credentials rotate with its calls,
/// as Epic's and GOG's do. It saves each rotation through `persist`.
struct RotatingSession<Credentials: Sendable>: Sendable {
    /// Tells this session from a later one of the same account.
    let identity: ObjectIdentifier
    let credentials: @Sendable () async throws -> Credentials
    let persist: @Sendable (any CredentialSave) async -> Void
    let shutdownObservers: @Sendable () -> Void
}

/// Keeps one active account's refresh credentials in the Keychain. OAuth
/// renewal stays in Rust, which asks for each rotation to be saved, in order.
@MainActor
@Observable
final class RememberedSession<Credentials: Sendable> {
    var rememberSession = true {
        didSet {
            guard rememberSession != oldValue else { return }
            // Enqueue synchronously so a later account change also orders this preference change.
            _ = enqueueWrite()
        }
    }
    var storageWarning: String?

    private struct Account: Sendable {
        let session: RotatingSession<Credentials>
        let id: String
        let revision: UUID
    }

    @ObservationIgnored private let store: any CredentialStore<Credentials>
    /// The account the credentials name.
    @ObservationIgnored private let accountID: (Credentials) -> String
    /// Shown when the session could not be saved.
    @ObservationIgnored private let notSaved: String
    @ObservationIgnored private var account: Account?
    @ObservationIgnored private var revision = UUID()
    @ObservationIgnored private var storageTask: Task<Void, Never>?

    init(keychain store: any CredentialStore<Credentials>, accountID: @escaping (Credentials) -> String,
         notSaved: String) {
        self.store = store
        self.accountID = accountID
        self.notSaved = notSaved
    }

    deinit {
        account?.session.shutdownObservers()
    }

    func load() async throws -> Credentials? {
        await storageTask?.value
        return try await store.load()
    }

    /// Makes `session` the active account. Rust saves its credentials now and
    /// after every rotation, through this.
    func activate(rotating session: RotatingSession<Credentials>, accountID: String) async {
        revision = UUID()
        let active = Account(session: session, id: accountID, revision: revision)
        account = active
        await session.persist(RememberedCredentials(self, session: session.identity))
        // The account is saved before it is used.
        await persist(active)
    }

    /// Saves the credentials of the session `identity` names now, when it is
    /// still the active one.
    func save(on identity: ObjectIdentifier) async {
        guard let active = account, active.session.identity == identity else { return }
        await persist(active)
    }

    /// Invalidates observations and operations immediately. Removal waits for any in-flight save.
    /// Stopping observation neither revokes OAuth nor cancels a download; the caller owns sign-out.
    @discardableResult
    func forget() -> Task<Void, Never> {
        account?.session.shutdownObservers()
        account = nil
        revision = UUID()
        storageWarning = nil
        return enqueueWrite(removing: true)
    }

    private func persist(_ active: Account) async {
        guard revision == active.revision else { return }
        await enqueueWrite().value
    }

    private func enqueueWrite(removing: Bool = false) -> Task<Void, Never> {
        let previous = storageTask
        let expected = revision
        let task = Task {
            await previous?.value
            guard expected == revision else { return }
            do {
                if rememberSession, let active = account {
                    let latest: Credentials
                    do {
                        // Resolve only after previous writes, never from a queued prepare result.
                        latest = try await active.session.credentials()
                    } catch {
                        if expected == revision { storageWarning = notSaved }
                        return
                    }
                    guard expected == revision else { return }
                    if rememberSession {
                        guard accountID(latest) == active.id else {
                            storageWarning = notSaved
                            return
                        }
                        try await store.save(latest)
                    } else {
                        try await store.remove()
                    }
                } else if removing || !rememberSession {
                    try await store.remove()
                }
                guard expected == revision else { return }
                storageWarning = nil
            } catch {
                guard expected == revision else { return }
                storageWarning = error.localizedDescription
            }
        }
        storageTask = task
        return task
    }
}

/// Saves the credentials account calls rotate, such as a launch's exchange
/// before its game starts. Rust waits on its own thread while the save runs
/// on the main actor. Rust holds it, so it leaves the remembered session free
/// to go.
final class RememberedCredentials<Credentials: Sendable>: CredentialSave, @unchecked Sendable {
    private weak var remembered: RememberedSession<Credentials>?
    private let session: ObjectIdentifier

    init(_ remembered: RememberedSession<Credentials>, session: ObjectIdentifier) {
        self.remembered = remembered
        self.session = session
    }

    func save() {
        let semaphore = DispatchSemaphore(value: 0)
        let (remembered, session) = (remembered, session)
        Task { @MainActor in
            await remembered?.save(on: session)
            semaphore.signal()
        }
        semaphore.wait()
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Models/RosettaModel.swift`:

```swift
import AppKit
import Observation
import OSLog

/// The account and decision identities stay owned by each session observer.
@MainActor
protocol RosettaSessions: AnyObject {
    associatedtype AccountID: Equatable
    associatedtype RosettaPrompt: Equatable
    func rosettaPrompt(accountId: AccountID) -> RosettaPrompt?
    func resumeAfterRosetta(_ prompt: RosettaPrompt) async throws
    func cancelRosetta(_ prompt: RosettaPrompt)
    /// True only for the supervisor's "Rosetta still unavailable" reply, which
    /// means installation needs more time rather than that the launch failed.
    static func rosettaUnavailable(_ error: Error) -> Bool
}

extension RosettaSessions {
    /// The Rust runtime reports this key for both storefronts.
    nonisolated static var rosettaUnavailableKey: String { "backend.runtime.rosettaUnavailable" }
}

/// One supervisor-owned Rosetta requirement, identified by its session,
/// account and decision so a stale prompt can never resume a newer one.
struct RosettaLaunchPrompt<SessionID: Hashable, AccountID: Equatable>: Equatable, Identifiable {
    let id: SessionID
    let accountId: AccountID
    let decisionId: UInt64
}

typealias SteamRosettaModel = RosettaModel<SteamGameSessions>
typealias EpicRosettaModel = RosettaModel<EpicGameSessions>

/// Presents a supervisor-owned launch requirement. Only macOS installs Rosetta;
/// only the supervisor decides whether the waiting game can proceed.
@MainActor @Observable
final class RosettaModel<Sessions: RosettaSessions> {
    private let sessions: Sessions
    private var accountId: Sessions.AccountID?
    private var generation = 0
    private var dismissed: Sessions.RosettaPrompt?
    private var working: Sessions.RosettaPrompt?
    private var failed: Sessions.RosettaPrompt?
    @ObservationIgnored private var work: Task<Void, Never>?
    @ObservationIgnored private let installRosetta: @MainActor () async throws -> Void
    @ObservationIgnored private let readinessAttempts: Int
    @ObservationIgnored private let readinessDelay: @MainActor () async throws -> Void
    @ObservationIgnored private let readinessTimeout: Duration
    @ObservationIgnored private let now: @MainActor () -> ContinuousClock.Instant

    init(sessions: Sessions,
         install: @escaping @MainActor () async throws -> Void = { try await RosettaInstaller.install() },
         readinessAttempts: Int = 600,
         readinessDelay: @escaping @MainActor () async throws -> Void = { try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1)) },
         readinessTimeout: Duration = .seconds(600),
         now: @escaping @MainActor () -> ContinuousClock.Instant = { .now }) {
        self.sessions = sessions
        installRosetta = install
        self.readinessAttempts = max(1, readinessAttempts)
        self.readinessDelay = readinessDelay
        self.readinessTimeout = readinessTimeout
        self.now = now
    }

    var prompt: Sessions.RosettaPrompt? {
        guard let accountId, let request = sessions.rosettaPrompt(accountId: accountId), request != dismissed else { return nil }
        return request
    }
    var isInstalling: Bool { prompt != nil && prompt == working }
    var installationFailed: Bool { prompt != nil && prompt == failed }

    func connect(accountId: Sessions.AccountID?) {
        guard self.accountId != accountId else { return }
        cancel()
        self.accountId = accountId
        dismissed = nil
    }

    func cancel() {
        // The session hides its own cancelled prompt until that session ends.
        if let prompt { sessions.cancelRosetta(prompt) }
        generation += 1
        work?.cancel()
        work = nil
        working = nil
        failed = nil
    }

    func install() {
        guard let request = prompt, !isInstalling else { return }
        generation += 1
        work?.cancel()
        let current = generation
        working = request
        failed = nil
        work = Task {
            let deadline = now().advanced(by: readinessTimeout)
            // LaunchServices can return before Rosetta is usable, or fail to
            // reopen its helper after installation. Its callback only proves
            // cancellation; readiness always comes from the Rust supervisor.
            let opening = Task {
                do {
                    try Task.checkCancellation()
                    try await installRosetta()
                } catch {
                    guard current == generation, prompt == request, !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                    if RosettaInstaller.wasCancelled(error) { cancel() }
                }
            }
            defer {
                opening.cancel()
                if current == generation, working == request {
                    working = nil
                    work = nil
                }
            }
            do {
                for _ in 0..<readinessAttempts {
                    guard now() < deadline else { break }
                    try await readinessDelay()
                    guard current == generation, prompt == request, !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                    guard now() < deadline else { break }
                    do {
                        try await sessions.resumeAfterRosetta(request)
                        guard current == generation, prompt == request, !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                        dismissed = request
                        RosettaInstaller.logger.notice("Rust confirmed Rosetta readiness")
                        return
                    } catch {
                        guard current == generation, prompt == request, !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                        // A lost session or another launch failure is not
                        // evidence that Rosetta merely needs more time.
                        guard Sessions.rosettaUnavailable(error) else { throw error }
                    }
                }
                failed = request
            } catch {
                guard current == generation, prompt == request, !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                failed = request
            }
        }
    }
}

@MainActor
private enum RosettaInstaller {
    static let logger = Logger(subsystem: AppIdentity.storageIdentifier, category: "Rosetta")

    static func install() async throws {
        let helper = Bundle.main.bundleURL.appending(path: "Contents/Helpers/Obelisk Rosetta.app")
        let configuration = NSWorkspace.OpenConfiguration()
        configuration.promptsUserIfNeeded = true
        configuration.createsNewApplicationInstance = true
        configuration.activates = false
        do {
            _ = try await NSWorkspace.shared.openApplication(at: helper, configuration: configuration)
            logger.notice("LaunchServices Rosetta helper completed")
        } catch {
            let cocoaError = error as NSError
            logger.error("LaunchServices Rosetta helper failed: domain=\(cocoaError.domain, privacy: .public) code=\(cocoaError.code)")
            throw error
        }
    }

    static func wasCancelled(_ error: Error) -> Bool {
        if error is CancellationError { return true }
        let error = error as NSError
        return (error.domain == NSCocoaErrorDomain && error.code == NSUserCancelledError)
            || (error.domain == NSOSStatusErrorDomain && error.code == -128)
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Models/SteamChatModel.swift`:

```swift
import AppKit
import Foundation
import Observation

/// One line of a conversation: a message Steam stored, or a note Obelisk
/// adds locally, such as an invitation it sent.
struct SteamChatLine: Identifiable, Equatable, Sendable {
    enum ID: Hashable, Sendable {
        /// Steam identifies and orders messages by both.
        case message(timestamp: UInt32, ordinal: UInt32)
        case note(Int)
    }

    enum Content: Equatable, Sendable {
        case message(fromMe: Bool, bbcode: String)
        case invitationSent(appId: UInt32)
    }

    let id: ID
    /// Steam's clock, in seconds since 1970.
    let timestamp: UInt32
    let content: Content
    /// A message's BBCode as it shows, rendered once its conversation keeps it.
    fileprivate(set) var contents: [SteamChatContent] = []
    /// The game and lobby or `connect` string of the invitation it carries,
    /// read as Steam reads it.
    fileprivate(set) var joinTarget: SteamJoinTarget?

    init(id: ID, timestamp: UInt32, content: Content) {
        self.id = id
        self.timestamp = timestamp
        self.content = content
    }

    var date: Date { Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval(timestamp)) }

    /// The games the line names.
    var appIds: [UInt32] {
        switch content {
        case .message: contents.compactMap { if case .invitation(let invitation) = $0 { invitation.appId } else { nil } }
        case .invitationSent(let appId): [appId]
        }
    }

    var fromMe: Bool {
        if case .message(let fromMe, _) = content { fromMe } else { true }
    }

    var position: SteamChatPosition? {
        if case .message(let timestamp, let ordinal) = id { SteamChatPosition(timestamp: timestamp, ordinal: ordinal) } else { nil }
    }

    /// A note follows every message of its second.
    fileprivate var order: (UInt32, UInt32, Int) {
        switch id {
        case .message(let timestamp, let ordinal): (timestamp, ordinal, 0)
        case .note(let number): (timestamp, .max, number)
        }
    }

    static func message(timestamp: UInt32, ordinal: UInt32, fromMe: Bool, bbcode: String) -> Self {
        SteamChatLine(id: .message(timestamp: timestamp, ordinal: ordinal), timestamp: timestamp,
                      content: .message(fromMe: fromMe, bbcode: bbcode))
    }
}

struct SteamConversation: Equatable, Sendable {
    /// Oldest first, each message once.
    private(set) var lines: [SteamChatLine] = []
    /// The latest page of history arrived; events alone may precede it.
    var isLoaded = false
    var isLoading = false
    var hasOlder = false
    var isLoadingOlder = false
    var isSending = false
    var isInviting = false
    var isFriendTyping = false
    var error: String?

    /// Whether any line was new. The same message can arrive as an event, in
    /// a history page and as the answer to sending it.
    @discardableResult
    mutating func merge(_ added: [SteamChatLine]) -> Bool {
        let known = Set(lines.map(\.id))
        let new = added.filter { !known.contains($0.id) }.map { line in
            var line = line
            if case .message(_, let bbcode) = line.content {
                line.contents = SteamBBCode.render(bbcode)
                if line.contents.contains(where: { if case .invitation = $0 { true } else { false } }) {
                    line.joinTarget = steamChatInvite(bbcode: bbcode)
                }
            }
            return line
        }
        guard !new.isEmpty else { return false }
        lines = (lines + new).sorted { $0.order < $1.order }
        return true
    }

    /// Keeps `page`, the local notes from its first message on and the
    /// messages that arrived after it.
    mutating func replace(with page: [SteamChatLine]) {
        let start = page.first?.timestamp ?? 0
        let end = page.last?.order ?? (0, 0, 0)
        lines = lines.filter {
            if case .note = $0.id { $0.timestamp >= start } else { $0.order > end }
        }
        merge(page)
    }

    var oldestPosition: SteamChatPosition? { lines.lazy.compactMap(\.position).first }
    var latestTimestamp: UInt32? { lines.last { $0.position != nil }?.timestamp }
}

/// What the account can invite a friend into right now.
struct SteamInviteOffer: Equatable, Sendable {
    let appId: UInt32
    let gameName: String?
    /// The lobby or connect string the running game named itself, as its own
    /// Invite button does. Without it, the account's Steam persona decides.
    var invite: SteamGameInvite? = nil
    /// The game's invite request that opened this picker; 0 outside one.
    /// Every press of the game's button is another picker.
    var request: UInt64 = 0
}

/// The Steam account's 1:1 chat and game invitations, through the UI session.
/// It follows the account's session across reconnections; signing out
/// forgets every conversation.
@MainActor @Observable
final class SteamChatModel {
    private(set) var conversations: [UInt64: SteamConversation] = [:]
    /// What the account is writing to each friend, apart from the
    /// conversations so that typing redraws none of their messages.
    private(set) var drafts: [UInt64: String] = [:]
    /// Unread messages per friend, as Steam counts them.
    private(set) var unread: [UInt64: Int] = [:]
    private(set) var ownGame: SteamOwnGame?
    private(set) var isConnected = false
    /// The conversation on screen; read as messages arrive while Obelisk is active.
    private(set) var visibleFriend: UInt64?
    private(set) var isApplicationActive: Bool
    var totalUnread: Int { unread.values.reduce(0, +) }
    /// The lobby the account's running Steam game is in now, as the engine
    /// hosting it shows it: Steam may never show this session the game's
    /// lobby, a private one above all. The engine also tells the lobby the
    /// game's invite dialog named, while its matchmaking shows the account in
    /// it. It goes as soon as the game leaves it.
    private(set) var gameLobby: (appId: UInt32, lobbyId: UInt64)?
    /// The game asked to invite friends: the friends list picks them, into
    /// the target the game named then. Nothing else offers that target.
    private(set) var invitePicker: SteamInviteOffer?
    /// Friends invited since the picker opened.
    private(set) var pickerInvited: Set<UInt64> = []
    /// Why inviting a friend from the picker failed, since it opened.
    private(set) var pickerFailures: [UInt64: String] = [:]

    /// Names the account's game, from its library or a friend playing it.
    @ObservationIgnored var gameName: @MainActor (UInt32) -> String? = { _ in nil }
    /// The invitations friends sent, which a conversation and a friend's row join.
    @ObservationIgnored var invitations: SteamReceivedInvitations?
    @ObservationIgnored private var session: (any SteamSessionProtocol)?
    @ObservationIgnored private var account: UInt64?
    @ObservationIgnored private var generation = 0
    @ObservationIgnored private var observations: [Task<Void, Never>] = []
    @ObservationIgnored private var typingExpiries: [UInt64: Task<Void, Never>] = [:]
    /// The latest message each conversation is known read up to.
    @ObservationIgnored private var acknowledged: [UInt64: UInt32] = [:]
    @ObservationIgnored private var notes = 0
    @ObservationIgnored private let typingTimeout: Duration
    @ObservationIgnored private var activity: ApplicationActivityObservation?
    /// The running game's session and the last invite request it showed.
    @ObservationIgnored private var followedRequest = SessionSequence()

    /// Tests tell activity themselves instead of following the application.
    init(typingTimeout: Duration = .seconds(11), isApplicationActive: Bool? = nil) {
        self.typingTimeout = typingTimeout
        self.isApplicationActive = isApplicationActive ?? NSApplication.shared.isActive
        guard isApplicationActive == nil else { return }
        activity = ApplicationActivityObservation { [weak self] active in
            Task { @MainActor [weak self] in self?.applicationActivityChanged(active) }
        }
    }

    /// Follows `session`. A new session of the same account keeps the
    /// conversations and reloads what they may have missed meanwhile.
    func connect(_ session: any SteamSessionProtocol, account: UInt64) {
        if self.account != account { reset() }
        stopObserving()
        self.account = account
        self.session = session
        isConnected = true
        let current = generation
        observations = [observeChat(session, generation: current), observeOwnGame(session, generation: current)]
        reload(session, generation: current)
    }

    /// The session ended; its replacement keeps the conversations.
    func suspend() {
        stopObserving()
        session = nil
        isConnected = false
        ownGame = nil
    }

    /// Forgets the account's conversations, at sign-out or account change.
    func reset() {
        suspend()
        followGame(session: nil, appId: 0, request: nil, lobby: nil)
        account = nil
        conversations = [:]
        drafts = [:]
        unread = [:]
        visibleFriend = nil
        acknowledged = [:]
    }

    /// Requests in flight end with their generation, and their flags with it.
    private func stopObserving() {
        generation += 1
        observations.forEach { $0.cancel() }
        observations = []
        typingExpiries.values.forEach { $0.cancel() }
        typingExpiries = [:]
        for (friend, conversation) in conversations {
            var stopped = conversation
            stopped.isFriendTyping = false
            stopped.isLoading = false
            stopped.isLoadingOlder = false
            stopped.isSending = false
            stopped.isInviting = false
            if stopped != conversation { conversations[friend] = stopped }
        }
    }

    /// Shows the account Online again, as a game's own Steam session can leave
    /// its presence behind when it ends.
    func setOnline() {
        guard let session else { return }
        Task { try? await session.setOnline() }
    }

    // MARK: Observation

    private func observeChat(_ session: any SteamSessionProtocol, generation current: Int) -> Task<Void, Never> {
        Task { [weak self] in
            var cursor: UInt64 = 0
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                let batch = await session.nextChat(afterSequence: cursor)
                guard let self, current == self.generation, !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                cursor = batch.lastSequence
                // Events past a gap are partial: Steam's own counts replace them.
                for entry in batch.events { self.apply(entry.event, counting: !batch.gap) }
                if batch.gap { self.reload(session, generation: current) }
                guard batch.connected else { return }
            }
        }
    }

    private func observeOwnGame(_ session: any SteamSessionProtocol, generation current: Int) -> Task<Void, Never> {
        Task { [weak self] in
            var revision: UInt64 = 0
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                let game = await session.nextOwnGame(afterRevision: revision)
                guard let self, current == self.generation, !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                revision = game.revision
                self.ownGame = game.connected ? game : nil
                guard game.connected else { return }
            }
        }
    }

    private func apply(_ event: SteamChatEvent, counting: Bool) {
        switch event {
        case .message(let message):
            let friend = message.friendSteamId
            var conversation = conversations[friend] ?? SteamConversation()
            let added = conversation.merge([.message(timestamp: message.timestamp, ordinal: message.ordinal,
                                                     fromMe: message.fromMe, bbcode: message.message)])
            if !message.fromMe {
                conversation.isFriendTyping = false
                typingExpiries.removeValue(forKey: friend)?.cancel()
            }
            conversations[friend] = conversation
            guard added, !message.fromMe else { return }
            if isReading(friend) { acknowledgeIfReading(friend) }
            else if counting { unread[friend, default: 0] += 1 }
        case .typing(let friend):
            conversations[friend, default: SteamConversation()].isFriendTyping = true
            typingExpiries[friend]?.cancel()
            let timeout = typingTimeout
            let current = generation
            typingExpiries[friend] = Task { [weak self] in
                try? await Task.sleep(for: timeout)
                guard let self, !Task.isCancelled, current == self.generation else { return }
                self.conversations[friend]?.isFriendTyping = false
                self.typingExpiries[friend] = nil
            }
        case .read(let friend, let timestamp):
            acknowledged[friend] = max(acknowledged[friend] ?? 0, timestamp)
            let later = conversations[friend]?.lines.filter { !$0.fromMe && $0.position != nil && $0.timestamp > timestamp }.count ?? 0
            unread[friend] = later > 0 ? later : nil
        }
    }

    /// Steam's unread counts, and the latest page of every open conversation.
    private func reload(_ session: any SteamSessionProtocol, generation current: Int) {
        Task { [weak self] in
            guard let sessions = try? await session.activeSessions() else { return }
            guard let self, current == self.generation else { return }
            var counts: [UInt64: Int] = [:]
            for entry in sessions {
                acknowledged[entry.friendSteamId] = max(acknowledged[entry.friendSteamId] ?? 0, entry.lastView)
                if entry.unreadMessageCount > 0 { counts[entry.friendSteamId] = Int(entry.unreadMessageCount) }
            }
            unread = counts
            if let visibleFriend { acknowledgeIfReading(visibleFriend) }
        }
        for (friend, conversation) in conversations where conversation.isLoaded {
            loadLatest(friend, replacing: true)
        }
        // Opened while disconnected, or its first page failed.
        if let visibleFriend, conversations[visibleFriend]?.isLoaded != true {
            conversations[visibleFriend]?.error = nil
            loadLatest(visibleFriend, replacing: false)
        }
    }

    // MARK: Conversations

    func show(_ friend: UInt64) {
        visibleFriend = friend
        if conversations[friend]?.isLoaded != true { loadLatest(friend, replacing: false) }
        acknowledgeIfReading(friend)
    }

    func hide(_ friend: UInt64) {
        if visibleFriend == friend { visibleFriend = nil }
    }

    func applicationActivityChanged(_ active: Bool) {
        isApplicationActive = active
        if active, let visibleFriend { acknowledgeIfReading(visibleFriend) }
    }

    private func isReading(_ friend: UInt64) -> Bool { visibleFriend == friend && isApplicationActive }

    private func acknowledgeIfReading(_ friend: UInt64) {
        guard isReading(friend), let session else { return }
        unread[friend] = nil
        guard let latest = conversations[friend]?.latestTimestamp, latest > acknowledged[friend] ?? 0 else { return }
        acknowledged[friend] = latest
        Task { try? await session.ack(friendSteamId: friend, timestamp: latest) }
    }

    /// The latest page. Replacing it drops older pages, which may no longer
    /// join the new one after missed events.
    private func loadLatest(_ friend: UInt64, replacing: Bool) {
        guard let session, conversations[friend]?.isLoading != true else { return }
        conversations[friend, default: SteamConversation()].isLoading = true
        let current = generation
        Task { [weak self] in
            do {
                let history = try await session.recentMessages(friendSteamId: friend, before: nil, count: 50)
                guard let self, current == self.generation else { return }
                var conversation = self.conversations[friend] ?? SteamConversation()
                let page = history.messages.map(Self.line)
                if replacing { conversation.replace(with: page) } else { conversation.merge(page) }
                if replacing || !conversation.isLoaded { conversation.hasOlder = history.moreAvailable }
                conversation.isLoaded = true
                conversation.isLoading = false
                self.conversations[friend] = conversation
                self.acknowledgeIfReading(friend)
            } catch {
                guard let self, current == self.generation else { return }
                self.conversations[friend]?.isLoading = false
                self.conversations[friend]?.error = SteamModel.message(error)
            }
        }
    }

    func loadOlder(_ friend: UInt64) {
        guard let session, let conversation = conversations[friend], conversation.isLoaded, conversation.hasOlder,
              !conversation.isLoadingOlder, let oldest = conversation.oldestPosition else { return }
        conversations[friend]?.isLoadingOlder = true
        let current = generation
        Task { [weak self] in
            do {
                let history = try await session.recentMessages(friendSteamId: friend, before: oldest, count: 50)
                guard let self, current == self.generation else { return }
                self.conversations[friend]?.merge(history.messages.map(Self.line))
                self.conversations[friend]?.hasOlder = history.moreAvailable
                self.conversations[friend]?.isLoadingOlder = false
            } catch {
                guard let self, current == self.generation else { return }
                self.conversations[friend]?.isLoadingOlder = false
                self.conversations[friend]?.error = SteamModel.message(error)
            }
        }
    }

    private static func line(_ message: SteamChatHistoryMessage) -> SteamChatLine {
        .message(timestamp: message.timestamp, ordinal: message.ordinal, fromMe: message.fromMe, bbcode: message.message)
    }

    // MARK: Composing

    func draft(for friend: UInt64) -> String { drafts[friend] ?? "" }

    /// Tells the friend the account is typing; Rust sends it at most every
    /// 10 seconds, as Valve's clients do.
    func setDraft(_ text: String, for friend: UInt64) {
        let previous = draft(for: friend)
        drafts[friend] = text
        guard let session, text.count > previous.count,
              !text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty else { return }
        Task { try? await session.sendTyping(friendSteamId: friend) }
    }

    func send(to friend: UInt64) {
        guard let session, conversations[friend]?.isSending != true else { return }
        let text = draft(for: friend).trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        guard !text.isEmpty else { return }
        conversations[friend, default: SteamConversation()].isSending = true
        conversations[friend]?.error = nil
        drafts[friend] = ""
        let current = generation
        let account = account
        Task { [weak self] in
            do {
                let sent = try await session.sendMessage(friendSteamId: friend, text: text)
                guard let self, current == self.generation else { return }
                self.conversations[friend]?.merge([.message(timestamp: sent.timestamp, ordinal: sent.ordinal,
                                                            fromMe: true, bbcode: sent.message)])
                self.conversations[friend]?.isSending = false
                self.acknowledgeIfReading(friend)
            } catch {
                guard let self, account == self.account else { return }
                // A session that ended meanwhile cleared the flag; the text still goes back.
                if self.conversations[friend] != nil && self.draft(for: friend).isEmpty { self.drafts[friend] = text }
                guard current == self.generation else { return }
                self.conversations[friend]?.isSending = false
                self.conversations[friend]?.error = SteamModel.message(error)
            }
        }
    }

    func dismissError(for friend: UInt64) { conversations[friend]?.error = nil }

    // MARK: Invitations

    /// Offered only while the account plays a game that takes an invitation
    /// now, and to a friend who is online. Steam's own friend menu follows the
    /// account's persona; the lobby the engine shows the running game in
    /// comes next, unless the persona shows another game.
    func inviteOffer(for friend: FriendPresentation) -> SteamInviteOffer? {
        guard friend.presence.isOnline, isConnected else { return nil }
        if let game = ownGame, game.connected, game.appId != 0, game.invite != .none {
            return SteamInviteOffer(appId: game.appId, gameName: gameName(game.appId))
        }
        guard let lobby = gameLobby, (ownGame?.appId ?? 0) == 0 || ownGame?.appId == lobby.appId else { return nil }
        return SteamInviteOffer(appId: lobby.appId, gameName: gameName(lobby.appId),
                                invite: .lobby(lobbyId: lobby.lobbyId))
    }

    /// The picker's invitation, for a friend who is online.
    func pickerOffer(for friend: FriendPresentation) -> SteamInviteOffer? {
        guard friend.presence.isOnline, isConnected else { return nil }
        return invitePicker
    }

    /// Follows the account's running Steam Game session `id`, of `appId`: the
    /// lobby its game is in, and whether it just asked to invite friends.
    /// True when it did, and the picker opened. A request the session already
    /// showed when it was first seen, such as one recovered, opens nothing,
    /// and a request that went, with the game's Steam connection, closes it.
    @discardableResult
    func followGame(session id: String?, appId: UInt32, request: SteamInviteRequest?, lobby: UInt64?) -> Bool {
        guard let id, appId != 0 else {
            followedRequest = SessionSequence()
            if gameLobby != nil { gameLobby = nil }
            closeInvitePicker()
            return false
        }
        let isNew = followedRequest.advance(session: id, sequence: request?.sequence)
        let current = lobby.map { (appId: appId, lobbyId: $0) }
        if gameLobby?.appId != current?.appId || gameLobby?.lobbyId != current?.lobbyId { gameLobby = current }
        guard let request else {
            closeInvitePicker()
            return false
        }
        guard isNew else { return false }
        invitePicker = SteamInviteOffer(appId: appId, gameName: gameName(appId), invite: request.invite,
                                        request: request.sequence)
        pickerInvited = []
        pickerFailures = [:]
        return true
    }

    func closeInvitePicker() {
        if invitePicker != nil { invitePicker = nil }
        if !pickerInvited.isEmpty { pickerInvited = [] }
        if !pickerFailures.isEmpty { pickerFailures = [:] }
    }

    /// A failure in the picker stays on its row; elsewhere the conversation,
    /// which opens to show the outcome, tells it.
    func invite(_ friend: UInt64, to offer: SteamInviteOffer) {
        guard let session, conversations[friend]?.isInviting != true else { return }
        conversations[friend, default: SteamConversation()].isInviting = true
        let picking = offer.request != 0
        if picking { pickerFailures[friend] = nil } else { conversations[friend]?.error = nil }
        let current = generation
        Task { [weak self] in
            do {
                if let invite = offer.invite {
                    try await session.inviteIntoGame(friendSteamId: friend, appId: offer.appId, invite: invite)
                } else {
                    try await session.inviteToGame(friendSteamId: friend, appId: offer.appId)
                }
                guard let self, current == self.generation else { return }
                if self.invitePicker == offer { self.pickerInvited.insert(friend) }
                self.notes += 1
                let now = UInt32(clamping: Int(Date().timeIntervalSince1970))
                let timestamp = max(now, self.conversations[friend]?.lines.last?.timestamp ?? 0)
                self.conversations[friend]?.merge([SteamChatLine(id: .note(self.notes), timestamp: timestamp,
                                                                 content: .invitationSent(appId: offer.appId))])
                self.conversations[friend]?.isInviting = false
            } catch {
                guard let self, current == self.generation else { return }
                self.conversations[friend]?.isInviting = false
                if !picking { self.conversations[friend]?.error = SteamModel.message(error) }
                else if self.invitePicker == offer { self.pickerFailures[friend] = SteamModel.message(error) }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// NotificationCenter retains observer blocks, so removal follows the model's lifetime.
final class ApplicationActivityObservation: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let tokens: [NSObjectProtocol]
    init(action: @escaping @Sendable (Bool) -> Void) {
        let center = NotificationCenter.default
        tokens = [
            center.addObserver(forName: NSApplication.didBecomeActiveNotification, object: nil, queue: .main) { _ in action(true) },
            center.addObserver(forName: NSApplication.didResignActiveNotification, object: nil, queue: .main) { _ in action(false) },
        ]
    }
    deinit {
        for token in tokens { NotificationCenter.default.removeObserver(token) }
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Models/SteamChatText.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation

/// A game invitation written into a conversation. Steam writes one for every
/// invitation, whichever client sent it.
struct SteamChatInvitation: Equatable, Sendable {
    enum Kind: Equatable, Sendable { case lobby, game }
    let kind: Kind
    /// Nil when the tag names no valid app.
    let appId: UInt32?
}

/// What Obelisk shows of a message's BBCode.
enum SteamChatContent: Equatable, Sendable {
    case text(AttributedString)
    case invitation(SteamChatInvitation)
}

/// Renders the little of Steam's chat BBCode a 1:1 conversation needs. Every
/// other tag keeps only its text, as Valve's web chat does with tags it
/// cannot draw.
enum SteamBBCode {
    static func render(_ bbcode: String) -> [SteamChatContent] {
        let tokens = tokenize(bbcode)
        var contents: [SteamChatContent] = []
        var text = AttributedString()
        var link: URL?
        /// The open `[url]` without an argument, whose text is its target.
        var bareLink: String?
        var skipping: String?
        var emoticon: String?

        func append(_ value: String) {
            if bareLink != nil { bareLink? += value; return }
            var run = AttributedString(value)
            if let link { run.link = link }
            text += run
        }
        func flush() {
            guard !text.characters.isEmpty else { return }
            contents.append(.text(linkingBareURLs(text)))
            text = AttributedString()
        }

        for (index, token) in tokens.enumerated() {
            if let skipped = skipping {
                if case .close(skipped) = token { skipping = nil }
                continue
            }
            switch token {
            case .text(let value):
                if emoticon != nil { emoticon? += value } else { append(value) }
            case .open(let name, let arguments):
                switch name {
                case "url":
                    if let target = arguments[""] { link = webURL(target) } else { bareLink = "" }
                case "lobbyinvite", "gameinvite":
                    flush()
                    contents.append(.invitation(SteamChatInvitation(
                        kind: name == "lobbyinvite" ? .lobby : .game,
                        appId: arguments["appid"].flatMap { UInt32($0) }.flatMap { $0 == 0 ? nil : $0 }
                    )))
                    // The tag's text is Steam's fallback for clients without cards.
                    if tokens[(index + 1)...].contains(.close(name)) { skipping = name }
                case "emoticon":
                    if let named = arguments[""] { append(":\(named):") } else { emoticon = "" }
                case "sticker":
                    if let type = arguments["type"] ?? arguments[""] { append(type) }
                default:
                    break
                }
            case .close(let name):
                switch name {
                case "url":
                    if let target = bareLink {
                        bareLink = nil
                        link = webURL(target)
                        append(target)
                    }
                    link = nil
                case "emoticon":
                    if let named = emoticon {
                        emoticon = nil
                        if !named.isEmpty { append(":\(named):") }
                    }
                default:
                    break
                }
            }
        }
        if let target = bareLink { bareLink = nil; append(target) }
        if let named = emoticon, !named.isEmpty { append(":\(named):") }
        flush()
        return contents
    }

    private enum Token: Equatable {
        case text(String)
        /// The unnamed argument (`[url=…]`, `[emoticon …]`) is keyed "".
        case open(String, [String: String])
        case close(String)
    }

    private static func tokenize(_ source: String) -> [Token] {
        var tokens: [Token] = []
        var text = ""
        var index = source.startIndex
        while index < source.endIndex {
            let character = source[index]
            if character == "\\", let next = source.index(index, offsetBy: 1, limitedBy: source.endIndex),
               next < source.endIndex, source[next] == "[" || source[next] == "]" {
                text.append(source[next])
                index = source.index(after: next)
                continue
            }
            if character == "[", let end = source[index...].firstIndex(of: "]"),
               let tag = tag(String(source[source.index(after: index)..<end])) {
                if !text.isEmpty { tokens.append(.text(text)); text = "" }
                tokens.append(tag)
                index = source.index(after: end)
                continue
            }
            text.append(character)
            index = source.index(after: index)
        }
        if !text.isEmpty { tokens.append(.text(text)) }
        return tokens
    }

    private static func tag(_ inner: String) -> Token? {
        if inner.hasPrefix("/") {
            let name = inner.dropFirst().lowercased()
            return name.first?.isLetter == true && name.allSatisfy(\.isTagCharacter) ? .close(name) : nil
        }
        let name = String(inner.prefix(while: \.isTagCharacter)).lowercased()
        guard name.first?.isLetter == true else { return nil }
        var rest = inner.dropFirst(name.count)
        guard rest.isEmpty || rest.first == "=" || rest.first == " " else { return nil }
        var arguments: [String: String] = [:]
        if rest.first == "=" {
            arguments[""] = unquoted(rest.dropFirst())
            return .open(name, arguments)
        }
        // key="value" pairs, or a bare value for `[emoticon name]`.
        while let start = rest.firstIndex(where: { $0 != " " }) {
            rest = rest[start...]
            let key = rest.prefix { $0 != "=" && $0 != " " }
            rest = rest.dropFirst(key.count)
            guard rest.first == "=" else { arguments[""] = String(key); continue }
            rest = rest.dropFirst()
            let value: Substring
            if rest.first == "\"" {
                let body = rest.dropFirst()
                value = body.prefix { $0 != "\"" }
                rest = body.dropFirst(value.count + 1)
            } else {
                value = rest.prefix { $0 != " " }
                rest = rest.dropFirst(value.count)
            }
            arguments[key.lowercased()] = String(value)
        }
        return .open(name, arguments)
    }

    private static func unquoted(_ value: Substring) -> String {
        let trimmed = value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
        guard trimmed.count >= 2, trimmed.hasPrefix("\""), trimmed.hasSuffix("\"") else { return trimmed }
        return String(trimmed.dropFirst().dropLast())
    }

    /// Only web links open from a conversation; a friend's `file:` or custom
    /// scheme stays plain text.
    private static func webURL(_ value: String) -> URL? {
        guard let url = URL(string: value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)),
              let scheme = url.scheme?.lowercased(), scheme == "https" || scheme == "http" else { return nil }
        return url
    }

    private static let detector = try? NSDataDetector(types: NSTextCheckingResult.CheckingType.link.rawValue)

    private static func linkingBareURLs(_ text: AttributedString) -> AttributedString {
        let plain = String(text.characters)
        guard let detector, plain.contains(".") else { return text }
        var linked = text
        for match in detector.matches(in: plain, range: NSRange(plain.startIndex..., in: plain)) {
            guard let url = match.url.flatMap({ webURL($0.absoluteString) }),
                  let range = Range(match.range, in: linked),
                  linked[range].runs.allSatisfy({ $0.link == nil }) else { continue }
            linked[range].link = url
        }
        return linked
    }
}

private extension Character {
    var isTagCharacter: Bool { isASCII && (isLetter || isNumber || self == "_") }
}
```
