`apps/macos/Obelisk/Models/WebAccountModel.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation
import Observation

/// A game of a storefront whose account signs in on the storefront's web
/// page. Its id names it in receipts, Game sessions and the Library cache.
protocol WebGame: LibraryGame, Sendable where ID == String {
    var macos: Bool { get }
    var windows: Bool { get }
    /// What the storefront can install of the game; nil when it ships no build.
    var offer: GameOffer? { get }
}

extension WebGame {
    /// The build the game shows before its page's details load: the Mac
    /// build when there is one.
    var preferredPlatform: GamePlatform { macos ? .mac : .windows }
    /// Neither web storefront tells a playtime in its library entry, nor a
    /// last played date: the playtimes load after the games.
    var playtime: Duration? { nil }
    var lastPlayedOnStorefront: Date? { nil }
}

/// What a game's page reads besides its library entry, starting with the
/// build it shows before any download.
protocol WebGameDetails: Equatable, Sendable {
    /// The build the page shows; nil when the storefront could not tell.
    var platform: GamePlatform? { get }
}

/// What lives as long as an account's connection besides its library, such
/// as Epic's friends. Account revocation stops it before the session goes.
@MainActor
protocol AccountPresence: AnyObject {
    associatedtype Session
    init()
    /// The session became the connected account's.
    func connect(_ session: Session, account: String)
    /// Stops its network work at once: nothing the revoked session sends later shows.
    func revoke()
}

/// The presence of a storefront that has none.
@MainActor
final class NoPresence<Session>: AccountPresence {
    init() {}
    func connect(_ session: Session, account: String) {}
    func revoke() {}
}

/// A storefront whose account signs in on its own web page and whose Rust
/// session rotates its refresh credentials: Epic and GOG. Its enum is the
/// adapter: it makes the session's calls, reads its Library cache and names
/// things. Each text is an `L10n.string` of a literal key, so the
/// localization check sees every storefront's.
///
/// `SendableMetatype`: the model's `@Sendable` closures call `Store`'s statics.
protocol WebStorefront: InstallationStorefront, SendableMetatype where GameID == String, AccountID == String {
    /// The Rust session, as its UniFFI protocol.
    associatedtype Session: Sendable
    associatedtype Credentials: Sendable
    associatedtype Game: WebGame
    /// What the game page reads besides the library entry.
    associatedtype Details: WebGameDetails
    associatedtype Presence: AccountPresence = NoPresence<Session> where Presence.Session == Session

    /// Names the storefront in receipts files and achievements.
    static var storeID: String { get }
    static var webSignIn: WebSignIn { get }
    /// The storefront's store, opened in Obelisk.
    static var storeURL: URL { get }
    @MainActor static var sessions: GameSessions<Self> { get }
    static func keychain() -> any CredentialStore<Credentials>

    static func signIn(code: String, library: LibraryCache?) async throws -> Session
    static func restore(_ credentials: Credentials, library: LibraryCache?) async throws -> Session
    static func accountID(_ credentials: Credentials) -> String
    /// The name the storefront shows. The account shows its id when it is empty.
    static func accountName(_ credentials: Credentials) -> String
    static func avatar(of session: Session) -> URL?
    /// How the remembered session saves each rotation of the session's credentials.
    static func rotating(_ session: Session) -> RotatingSession<Credentials>
    /// Revokes the session. Throws when the storefront did not confirm it.
    static func disconnect(_ session: Session) async throws

    static func games(of session: Session) async throws -> [Game]
    /// The playtime of each played game of `games`, by its id.
    static func playtimes(of session: Session, games: [Game]) async throws -> [String: Duration]
    /// The share of each of `games`' achievements the account unlocked, in
    /// the player's `language`, by game id: the Library cache's for a game
    /// not played since they were read, else the storefront's, which the
    /// session then keeps. A game without achievements, or that the
    /// storefront did not answer for, has none; it throws when no game could
    /// be told. Asked once the playtimes loaded.
    static func achievementShares(of games: [Game], session: Session, language: String) async throws -> [String: Double]
    /// The account's Library cache, with each game's playtime and achievement
    /// share when they were known.
    static func cachedLibrary(in cache: LibraryCache, account: String)
        -> [(game: Game, playtime: Duration?, achievements: Double?)]
    /// `language` is the player's, such as "fr-FR".
    static func details(of game: Game, session: Session, language: String) async throws -> Details
    /// The game's achievements in the player's `language`: the Library
    /// cache's while the game was not played since they were read, unless
    /// `fresh`, else the storefront's.
    static func achievements(of game: Game, session: Session, language: String,
                             fresh: Bool) async throws -> [GameAchievement]
    /// The account's installations in Rust; none for a session that is not Rust's.
    @MainActor static func installations(of session: Session, account: String, language: String,
                                          sessions: any StorefrontSessionsProtocol, receipts: URL,
                                          locations: ObeliskLocations) -> any InstallationsBackend<Self>
    /// An address that opens the storefront's site signed in as the
    /// session's account and goes on to `storeURL`; nil when its site has none.
    static func webSignInURL(session: Session) async throws -> URL?

    /// The storefront refused the account: a restore forgets the saved
    /// session, and any later call signs the account out.
    static func isUnauthorized(_ error: Error) -> Bool

    static var sessionNotSaved: String { get }
    /// Added to the storage warning when the sign-out's revocation fails.
    static var revocationUnconfirmed: String { get }
    static var otherGameRunning: String { get }
}

extension WebStorefront {
    static func avatar(of session: Session) -> URL? { nil }
    static func webSignInURL(session: Session) async throws -> URL? { nil }
}

/// One account of a storefront that signs in on its web page: its sign-in
/// and remembered session, its library (from the Library cache while the
/// session restores), the game on screen, and its installations, Cloud,
/// Rosetta prompts and presence.
///
/// Every sign-in, cancellation and sign-out starts a new generation. An
/// answer from an older one changes nothing, and a session it produced is
/// revoked in its own task. One authentication runs at a time, and none
/// starts before a sign-out's Keychain removal ends.
@MainActor
@Observable
final class WebAccountModel<Store: WebStorefront> {
    typealias Game = Store.Game
    /// The Rust installations of an account a session signed in: its id, the
    /// player's language, and the file its receipts keep.
    typealias MakeInstallations = @MainActor (Store.Session, String, String,
                                              any StorefrontSessionsProtocol, URL) -> any InstallationsBackend<Store>

    private(set) var accountName: String?
    private(set) var avatarURL: URL?
    /// The connected account.
    private var accountID: String?

    let gameSessions: GameSessions<Store>
    let cloud: CloudModel<Store>
    let rosetta: RosettaModel<GameSessions<Store>>
    let installations: GameInstallations<Store>
    /// The account's games, from the Library cache while the session
    /// restores. The share of each game's achievements the account unlocked
    /// loads after the playtimes.
    let library: AccountLibrary<Store, Game>
    let achievements = GameAchievementsModel(storeID: Store.storeID, describe: Store.describe)
    /// What lives with the connection, such as Epic's friends.
    let presence: Store.Presence

    private(set) var selectedGame: Game?
    private(set) var selectedGameDetails: Store.Details?
    private(set) var isLoadingGameDetails = false
    private(set) var isRestoring = false
    private(set) var isConnecting = false
    private(set) var isLoadingGames = false
    private(set) var isSigningOut = false
    private(set) var canRetryRestore = false
    var errorMessage: String?
    var storageWarning: String? {
        get { rememberedSession.storageWarning }
        set { rememberedSession.storageWarning = newValue }
    }
    var rememberSession: Bool {
        get { rememberedSession.rememberSession }
        set { rememberedSession.rememberSession = newValue }
    }

    @ObservationIgnored private let rememberedSession: RememberedSession<Store.Credentials>
    @ObservationIgnored private let directory: URL
    @ObservationIgnored private let language: String
    @ObservationIgnored private let authorize: @MainActor () async throws -> String
    @ObservationIgnored private let createSession: @Sendable (String) async throws -> Store.Session
    @ObservationIgnored private let restoreSession: @Sendable (Store.Credentials) async throws -> Store.Session
    @ObservationIgnored private let makeInstallations: MakeInstallations
    @ObservationIgnored private var session: Store.Session?
    @ObservationIgnored private var started = false
    @ObservationIgnored private var generation = 0
    @ObservationIgnored private var authenticationTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    @ObservationIgnored private var libraryTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    @ObservationIgnored private var detailsTask: Task<Void, Never>?

    init(
        directory: URL = AppIdentity.libraryDirectory,
        keychain: any CredentialStore<Store.Credentials> = Store.keychain(),
        authorize: @escaping @MainActor () async throws -> String = { try await WebAuthentication.authorize(Store.webSignIn) },
        signIn: (@Sendable (String) async throws -> Store.Session)? = nil,
        restore: (@Sendable (Store.Credentials) async throws -> Store.Session)? = nil,
        language: String = Locale.preferredLanguages.first ?? "en-US",
        gameSessions: GameSessions<Store> = Store.sessions,
        libraryCache: LibraryCache? = nil,
        installations makeInstallations: MakeInstallations? = nil
    ) {
        self.directory = directory
        rememberedSession = RememberedSession(keychain: keychain, accountID: Store.accountID,
                                              notSaved: Store.sessionNotSaved)
        self.authorize = authorize
        createSession = signIn ?? { [libraryCache] in try await Store.signIn(code: $0, library: libraryCache) }
        restoreSession = restore ?? { [libraryCache] in try await Store.restore($0, library: libraryCache) }
        self.language = language
        self.gameSessions = gameSessions
        let locations = ObeliskLocations.of(library: directory)
        self.makeInstallations = makeInstallations ?? { session, account, language, sessions, receipts in
            Store.installations(of: session, account: account, language: language, sessions: sessions,
                                receipts: receipts, locations: locations)
        }
        rosetta = RosettaModel(sessions: gameSessions)
        cloud = CloudModel(sessions: gameSessions)
        installations = GameInstallations(sessions: gameSessions, cloud: cloud)
        library = AccountLibrary(history: gameSessions.history, cache: libraryCache,
                                 installations: installations)
        presence = Store.Presence()
        installations.selection = { [weak self] in self?.installationSelection }
    }

    // Always read the observable account, even before the unobserved session exists.
    var isConnected: Bool { accountName != nil && session != nil }

    /// Whether the library shows: once connected, or from the cache while the
    /// saved session restores.
    var showsLibrary: Bool { library.shows(connected: isConnected, restoring: isRestoring) }

    /// No authentication or sign-out runs, and no account is connected.
    private var isIdle: Bool { !isConnected && !isRestoring && !isConnecting && !isSigningOut }

    var gameSessionMessage: String? {
        gameSessions.message(for: selectedGame?.id, of: accountID, otherGameRunning: Store.otherGameRunning)
    }

    // MARK: Account

    /// Restores the saved session once. Returns when the restoration and its
    /// first library load end.
    func start() async {
        guard !started && isIdle else { return }
        beginRestore()
        await authenticationTask?.value
    }

    func retryRestore() {
        guard isIdle else { return }
        errorMessage = nil
        beginRestore()
    }

    /// Opens the storefront's page and exchanges its code. Closing the page is not an error.
    func signIn() {
        guard isIdle else { return }
        generation += 1
        let current = generation
        isConnecting = true
        canRetryRestore = false
        errorMessage = nil
        authenticationTask = Task {
            defer { if current == generation { isConnecting = false } }
            do {
                let code = try await authorize()
                guard isCurrent(current) else { return }
                let connected = try await createSession(code)
                await accept(connected, generation: current)
            } catch is CancellationError {
                // Closing the storefront's window is a normal cancellation.
            } catch {
                guard isCurrent(current) else { return }
                errorMessage = Store.describe(error)
            }
        }
    }

    func cancelSignIn() {
        guard isConnecting || isRestoring else { return }
        generation += 1
        authenticationTask?.cancel()
        authenticationTask = nil
        isConnecting = false
        isRestoring = false
        canRetryRestore = false
        errorMessage = nil
    }

    /// Ignored while a load runs.
    func refresh() {
        guard let session, !isLoadingGames else { return }
        // Set synchronously so two clicks in the same run loop cannot overlap.
        isLoadingGames = true
        errorMessage = nil
        let current = generation
        libraryTask = Task { await reloadGames(session, generation: current) }
    }

    /// The storefront's store: signed in as the account when its storefront
    /// can sign it in, else as its site remembers.
    func storePage() async -> WebPageStart {
        var url = Store.storeURL
        if let session, let signedIn = try? await Store.webSignInURL(session: session) { url = signedIn }
        return WebPageStart(url: url, dataStore: Store.webSignIn.store.dataStore)
    }

    /// Account revocation: forgets the Library cache, the launches and the
    /// saved session, revokes the presence, installations and Cloud, then
    /// revokes the session once the Keychain removal ends.
    func signOut() {
        guard !isSigningOut else { return }
        Store.webSignIn.store.forgetSite()
        library.forget()
        generation += 1
        let current = generation
        let disconnected = session
        rosetta.connect(accountId: nil)
        installations.signedOut()
        cloud.signedOut()
        let removal = rememberedSession.forget()
        presence.revoke()
        authenticationTask?.cancel()
        authenticationTask = nil
        libraryTask?.cancel()
        libraryTask = nil
        session = nil
        accountID = nil
        accountName = nil
        avatarURL = nil
        closeGame()
        errorMessage = nil
        storageWarning = nil
        isConnecting = false
        isLoadingGames = false
        isRestoring = false
        isSigningOut = true
        canRetryRestore = false
        Task {
            await removal.value
            if current == generation { isSigningOut = false }
            guard let disconnected else { return }
            do { try await Store.disconnect(disconnected) }
            catch {
                guard current == generation else { return }
                let warning = Store.revocationUnconfirmed
                storageWarning = storageWarning.map { $0 + " " + warning } ?? warning
            }
        }
    }

    /// Whether the running task still answers for the latest sign-in, cancellation or sign-out.
    private func isCurrent(_ current: Int) -> Bool { current == generation && !Task.isCancelled }

    private func beginRestore() {
        started = true
        isRestoring = true
        canRetryRestore = false
        let current = generation
        authenticationTask = Task { await restoreSavedSession(generation: current) }
    }

    private func restoreSavedSession(generation current: Int) async {
        defer { if current == generation { isRestoring = false } }
        let credentials: Store.Credentials?
        do {
            credentials = try await rememberedSession.load()
        } catch {
            guard current == generation else { return }
            storageWarning = error.localizedDescription
            canRetryRestore = true
            return
        }
        guard isCurrent(current), let credentials else { return }
        let account = Store.accountID(credentials)
        library.showCache(of: account) { cache in
            Store.cachedLibrary(in: cache, account: account).map { entry in
                CachedLibraryGame(game: entry.game, playtime: entry.playtime,
                                  values: entry.achievements.map { [.achievements: $0] } ?? [:])
            }
        }
        do {
            let connected = try await restoreSession(credentials)
            await accept(connected, generation: current)
        } catch {
            guard isCurrent(current) else { return }
            library.dropCache()
            errorMessage = Store.describe(error)
            if Store.isUnauthorized(error) {
                await rememberedSession.forget().value
            } else {
                canRetryRestore = true
            }
        }
    }

    private func accept(_ connected: Store.Session, generation current: Int) async {
        guard isCurrent(current) else {
            await disconnectAbandonedSession(connected)
            return
        }
        let rotating = Store.rotating(connected)
        do {
            let credentials = try await rotating.credentials()
            guard isCurrent(current) else {
                await disconnectAbandonedSession(connected)
                return
            }
            let account = Store.accountID(credentials)
            let name = Store.accountName(credentials)
            library.connect(account)
            accountID = account
            session = connected
            accountName = name.isEmpty ? account : name
            avatarURL = Store.avatar(of: connected)
            presence.connect(connected, account: account)
            isConnecting = false
            isRestoring = false
            errorMessage = nil
            isLoadingGames = true
            await rememberedSession.activate(rotating: rotating, accountID: account)
            guard current == generation else { return }
            rosetta.connect(accountId: account)
            let backend = makeInstallations(connected, account, language, gameSessions.core,
                                            receiptsFile(in: directory, storefront: Store.storeID, account: account))
            installations.connect(account: account, backend: backend, port: installationPort())

            await reloadGames(connected, generation: current)
        } catch {
            await disconnectAbandonedSession(connected)
            guard isCurrent(current) else { return }
            errorMessage = Store.describe(error)
        }
    }

    private func disconnectAbandonedSession(_ connected: Store.Session) async {
        // The authentication task may already be cancelled: Account revocation gets its own task.
        await Task { try? await Store.disconnect(connected) }.value
    }

    // MARK: Library

    private func reloadGames(_ connected: Store.Session, generation current: Int) async {
        defer { if current == generation { isLoadingGames = false } }
        // The playtimes reload with the games: a refresh shows them loading at
        // once. GOG asks each listed game's playtime, so they wait for the games.
        let listing = Task { try await Store.games(of: connected) }
        let language = language
        library.loadPlaytimes({
            let games = try await listing.value
            // Nothing asks the storefront once the account signed out.
            try Task.checkCancellation()
            return try await Store.playtimes(of: connected, games: games)
        }, then: { [weak self] in
            // The session reads again the achievements of the games played since.
            self?.library.load(.achievements) {
                try await Store.achievementShares(of: listing.value, session: connected, language: language)
            }
        })
        do {
            let loaded = try await withTaskCancellationHandler {
                try await listing.value
            } onCancel: {
                listing.cancel()
            }
            guard isCurrent(current) else { return }
            library.show(loaded)
            if let selectedGame {
                if let updated = loaded.first(where: { $0.id == selectedGame.id }) { open(updated) }
                else { closeGame() }
            }
        } catch {
            guard isCurrent(current) else { return }
            // Without the games, the playtimes failed too: the library offers the retry.
            report(error)
        }
    }

    // MARK: Game page

    func open(_ game: Game) {
        closeGame()
        selectedGame = game
        load(achievementsOf: game, into: achievements, fresh: false)
        installations.refreshCloudIndicator()
        guard let session else { return }
        isLoadingGameDetails = true
        detailsTask = Task { await loadDetails(game, session: session) }
    }

    func closeGame() {
        achievements.reset()
        detailsTask?.cancel()
        detailsTask = nil
        selectedGame = nil
        selectedGameDetails = nil
        isLoadingGameDetails = false
    }

    /// The library already tells which builds a game ships, so it downloads
    /// one without opening the game's page.
    func libraryOffer(of game: Game) -> GameOffer? { game.offer }

    /// Reads the game's achievements from the storefront again, as the
    /// page's retry asks.
    func reloadAchievements() {
        guard let game = selectedGame else { return }
        load(achievementsOf: game, into: achievements, fresh: true)
    }

    /// Reads the achievements of the library's game `id` from the storefront
    /// into `model`, as the overlay asks for the running game.
    func loadAchievements(of id: Game.ID, into model: GameAchievementsModel) {
        guard let game = library.game(id) else { return }
        load(achievementsOf: game, into: model, fresh: true)
    }

    /// The Library cache's achievements while the game was not played since,
    /// unless `fresh`.
    private func load(achievementsOf game: Game, into model: GameAchievementsModel, fresh: Bool) {
        guard let session else { return }
        let language = language
        model.load { try await Store.achievements(of: game, session: session, language: language, fresh: fresh) }
    }

    /// Every change of the game on screen, and the sign-out, cancels it in `closeGame`.
    private func loadDetails(_ game: Game, session: Store.Session) async {
        defer { if !Task.isCancelled { isLoadingGameDetails = false } }
        guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
        do {
            let details = try await Store.details(of: game, session: session, language: language)
            if !Task.isCancelled { selectedGameDetails = details }
        } catch {
            // Secondary metadata must not prevent browsing the library.
        }
    }

    /// Shows a failed call. One the storefront refused signs the account out.
    private func report(_ error: Error) {
        if Store.isUnauthorized(error) { signOut() }
        errorMessage = Store.describe(error)
    }

    /// The game on screen, for its installation actions.
    private var installationSelection: InstallationSelection<Store>? {
        guard let game = selectedGame else { return nil }
        let platform = selectedGameDetails?.platform ?? game.preferredPlatform
        return InstallationSelection(game: game.id, platform: platform, offer: game.offer)
    }

    /// The account's part of the installation actions.
    private func installationPort() -> InstallationPort<Store> {
        InstallationPort(
            report: { [weak self] error in
                guard let self else { return }
                guard let error else { return errorMessage = nil }
                report(error)
            },
            warn: { [weak self] in self?.storageWarning = $0 }
        )
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Views/GamesFolderSheet.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// Asks the player to move their games to the folder they picked: how many
/// move and where, then what the disk can hold and run.
struct GamesFolderSheet: View {
    let proposal: GamesFolderProposal
    let cancel: () -> Void
    let confirm: () -> Void

    private var title: String {
        if proposal.chosen == nil { return L10n.string("ui.games_folder.title_mac") }
        return proposal.games > 0
            ? L10n.string("ui.games_folder.title_move", proposal.volume)
            : L10n.string("ui.games_folder.title_install", proposal.volume)
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
            SheetHeader(title: title, subtitle: proposal.path,
                        symbol: proposal.chosen == nil ? "laptopcomputer" : "externaldrive.fill",
                        colors: TileColors.blue)
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                if proposal.games > 0 {
                    Text(L10n.string("ui.games_folder.moves", Int64(proposal.games)))
                    if proposal.copiedBytes > 0, let available = proposal.availableBytes {
                        Text(L10n.string("ui.games_folder.space", GameFormatting.bytes(proposal.copiedBytes),
                                         GameFormatting.bytes(available)))
                            .monospacedDigit()
                    }
                } else {
                    Text(L10n.string("ui.games_folder.installs", AppIdentity.name))
                }
                Text(L10n.string("ui.games_folder.stays", AppIdentity.name))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            .font(.system(size: 13))
            .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
            if proposal.isReadOnly {
                SheetNotice(kind: .failure, text: L10n.string("ui.games_folder.read_only", proposal.volume))
            } else if proposal.lacksSpace, let available = proposal.availableBytes {
                SheetNotice(kind: .failure, text: L10n.string("ui.games_folder.no_space", proposal.volume,
                                                              GameFormatting.bytes(proposal.copiedBytes),
                                                              GameFormatting.bytes(available)))
            }
            if let format = proposal.format, !proposal.isReadOnly {
                SheetNotice(kind: .warning, text: L10n.string("ui.games_folder.format", proposal.volume, format))
            }
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
                GlassCapsuleButton(title: L10n.string("ui.common.cancel"), size: .large,
                                   identifier: "games-folder-cancel", action: cancel)
                    .keyboardShortcut(.cancelAction)
                AccentCapsuleButton(title: L10n.string(proposal.games > 0 ? "ui.games_folder.move"
                                                                           : "ui.games_folder.use"),
                                    size: .large, identifier: "games-folder-confirm", action: confirm)
                    .keyboardShortcut(.defaultAction)
                    .disabled(!proposal.canChoose)
            }
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(width: 480)
        .tint(ObeliskStyle.accent)
        .accessibilityIdentifier("games-folder-sheet")
    }
}

```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Views/RosettaSheet.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

struct RosettaPromptView<Sessions: RosettaSessions>: View {
    @Bindable var model: RosettaModel<Sessions>
    var storefront = "steam"

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
            SheetHeader(title: L10n.string("ui.rosetta.title"), subtitle: L10n.string("ui.rosetta.message"),
                        symbol: "cpu", colors: TileColors.violet)
            if model.isInstalling {
                SheetNotice(kind: .progress, text: L10n.string("ui.rosetta.installing"))
            } else if model.installationFailed {
                SheetNotice(kind: .warning, text: L10n.string("ui.rosetta.failed"))
            }
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
                GlassCapsuleButton(title: L10n.string("ui.common.cancel"), size: .large,
                                   identifier: "\(storefront)-rosetta-cancel", action: model.cancel)
                    .keyboardShortcut(.cancelAction)
                AccentCapsuleButton(title: L10n.string("ui.rosetta.install"), size: .large,
                                    isBusy: model.isInstalling, identifier: "\(storefront)-rosetta-install",
                                    action: model.install)
                    .keyboardShortcut(.defaultAction)
                    .disabled(model.isInstalling)
            }
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(width: 460)
        .tint(ObeliskStyle.accent)
        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.2), value: model.isInstalling)
        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.2), value: model.installationFailed)
        .interactiveDismissDisabled()
        .accessibilityIdentifier("\(storefront)-rosetta-prompt")
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/Obelisk/Views/SteamCloudSheets.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI

struct SteamCloudPromptView: View {
    let title: String
    let message: String
    let busy: Bool
    let onCancel: () -> Void
    let onChooseLocal: () -> Void
    let onChooseCloud: () -> Void
    var storefront = "steam"

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
            SheetHeader(title: L10n.message(title), subtitle: L10n.message(message), symbol: "arrow.triangle.branch",
                        colors: TileColors.blue)
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                CloudCopyChoice(title: L10n.string("ui.cloud.choose_local"), symbol: "internaldrive.fill",
                            colors: TileColors.graphite, identifier: "\(storefront)-cloud-choose-local",
                            action: onChooseLocal)
                CloudCopyChoice(title: L10n.string("ui.cloud.choose_cloud"), symbol: "icloud.fill",
                            colors: TileColors.blue, identifier: "\(storefront)-cloud-choose-cloud",
                            action: onChooseCloud)
            }
            .disabled(busy)
            if busy {
                SheetNotice(kind: .progress, text: L10n.string("ui.cloud.working"))
            }
            HStack {
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
                GlassCapsuleButton(title: L10n.string("ui.common.cancel"), size: .large,
                                   identifier: "\(storefront)-cloud-cancel", action: onCancel)
                    .keyboardShortcut(.cancelAction)
            }
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(width: 500)
        .tint(ObeliskStyle.accent)
        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.2), value: busy)
        .interactiveDismissDisabled()
        .accessibilityIdentifier("\(storefront)-cloud-prompt")
    }
}

/// A copy of the saves to keep: a card that outlines itself in the accent
/// color under the pointer.
private struct CloudCopyChoice: View {
    let title: String
    let symbol: String
    let colors: [Color]
    let identifier: String
    let action: () -> Void
    @State private var isHovered = false
    @Environment(\.isEnabled) private var isEnabled
    @Environment(\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme

    var body: some View {
        let palette = ObeliskPalette(colorScheme: colorScheme)
        let shape = RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 18, style: .continuous)
        let highlighted = isHovered && isEnabled
        Button(action: action) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14) {
                SymbolTile(name: symbol, colors: colors, size: 36)
                Text(title)
                    .font(.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(isEnabled ? .primary : .secondary)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)
                    .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
            }
            .padding(16)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 112, alignment: .topLeading)
            .background(highlighted ? AnyShapeStyle(ObeliskStyle.accent.opacity(0.1)) : AnyShapeStyle(palette.surface),
                        in: shape)
            .overlay {
                shape.strokeBorder(highlighted ? AnyShapeStyle(ObeliskStyle.accent.opacity(0.7))
                                                : AnyShapeStyle(palette.border),
                                   lineWidth: highlighted ? 1.5 : 1)
            }
            .contentShape(shape)
            .opacity(isEnabled ? 1 : 0.55)
        }
        .obeliskButtonStyle(.plain)
        .onHover { isHovered = $0 }
        .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.15), value: highlighted)
        .accessibilityLabel(title)
        .accessibilityIdentifier(identifier)
    }
}

struct SteamCloudFailureView: View {
    let title: String
    let message: String
    let busy: Bool
    let canLaunchAnyway: Bool
    let onRetry: () -> Void
    let onCancel: () -> Void
    let onLaunchAnyway: () -> Void
    var storefront = "steam"

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Label(title, systemImage: "icloud.slash")
                .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold))
            Text(L10n.message(message))
                .font(.system(size: 12))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                Button(L10n.string("ui.common.retry"), action: onRetry)
                if canLaunchAnyway {
                    Button(L10n.string("ui.cloud.launch_anyway"), action: onLaunchAnyway)
                }
                Button(L10n.string("ui.common.cancel"), action: onCancel)
            }
            .obeliskButtonStyle(.borderless)
            .controlSize(.small)
            .disabled(busy)
        }
        .accessibilityIdentifier("\(storefront)-cloud-failure")
    }
}

extension SteamCloudFailureView {
    /// The Cloud failure a storefront's model presents, answered through it.
    init<Model: LibraryStorefront>(model: Model, storefront: String) {
        self.init(
            title: model.cloudTitle(for: model.cloud.promptGame),
            message: model.cloud.promptMessage,
            busy: model.cloud.promptWorking,
            canLaunchAnyway: model.cloud.canLaunchAnyway,
            onRetry: { model.cloud.respond(.retry) },
            onCancel: { model.cloud.respond(.cancel) },
            onLaunchAnyway: { model.cloud.respond(.launchAnyway) },
            storefront: storefront
        )
    }
}
```

```swift
    func testEverySortRanksTheGreatestFirstAndBreaksTiesByNameThenID() throws {
        let root = try temporaryDirectory()
        let games = [
            steamGame(1, "Étoiles", lastPlayed: 100, minutes: 800),
            steamGame(2, "Portal", lastPlayed: 200, minutes: 100),
            steamGame(4, "zéro"),
            steamGame(3, "Alpha"),

        ]
        let fake = FakeInstallations<SteamGames>(receipts: [
            .steam(appId: 4, name: "zéro", directory: root.appending(path: "4-windows").path, platform: .windows, totalBytes: 100),
            .steam(appId: 4, name: "zéro", directory: root.appending(path: "4-macos").path, platform: .mac, totalBytes: 50),
            .steam(appId: 2, name: "Portal", directory: root.appending(path: "2-macos").path, platform: .mac, totalBytes: 120),
        ])
        let library = steamLibrary(root: root, installations: fake)
        let values: [UInt32: [StorefrontLibrarySort: Double]] = [
            1: [.dateAdded: 10], 3: [.dateAdded: 30], 4: [.dateAdded: 30], 5: [.achievements: 1], 2: [.achievements: 0.25],

        })

        let expected: [(StorefrontLibrarySort, [UInt32])] = [
            (.lastPlayed, [2, 5, 1, 3, 4]),
            (.name, [3, 1, 2, 5, 4]),
            (.playtime, [1, 2, 5, 3, 4]),
            (.dateAdded, [3, 4, 1, 2, 5]),
            (.achievements, [5, 2, 3, 1, 4]),
            (.size, [4, 2, 3, 1, 5]),
        ]
        for (sort, order) in expected {
            library.sort = sort
            XCTAssertEqual(library.shown.map(\.appId), order, "\(sort)")
            XCTAssertEqual(library.games(by: sort).map(\.appId), order, "\(sort), read again")
        }

        var older = EpicGames.game("older", title: "Older"), newer = EpicGames.game("newer", title: "Newer")
        older.addedAt = 1_590_000_000
        newer.addedAt = 1_700_000_000
        let epic = epicLibrary(root: root)
        epic.show([older, EpicGames.game("undated", title: "Undated"), newer])
        XCTAssertEqual(epic.games(by: .dateAdded).map(\.appName), ["newer", "older", "undated"],
                       "Epic's entry tells the date it joined the library")
        XCTAssertEqual(epic.value(of: older, for: .dateAdded), 1_590_000_000)
    }

    func testSearchAndFiltersNarrowEveryOrder() throws {
        let root = try temporaryDirectory()
        let steam = steamLibrary(root: root, installations: FakeInstallations(receipts: [
            .steam(appId: 1, name: "Portal Z", directory: root.appending(path: "1").path, platform: .windows),

    func testLastPlayedIsTheLaterOfTheStorefrontAndThisAccountsLaunch() throws {
        let root = try temporaryDirectory()
        let history = LaunchHistory(cache: LibraryCache(directory: root.path))
        let portal = steamGame(620, "Portal 2", lastPlayed: 1_789_430_000)
        let dota = steamGame(570, "Dota 2"), fortress = steamGame(440, "Team Fortress 2")
        let library = steamLibrary(root: root, history: history)
        library.connect(42)
        library.show([portal, dota, fortress])
        XCTAssertEqual(library.shown.map(\.appId), [620, 570, 440])

        let launched = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_789_500_000)
        history.record(570, account: 42, in: SteamGames.self, at: launched)
        XCTAssertEqual(library.lastPlayed(of: dota), launched, "A launch from Obelisk")
        XCTAssertEqual(library.shown.map(\.appId), [570, 620, 440], "The library orders again")
        history.record(620, account: 42, in: SteamGames.self, at: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_789_000_000))
        XCTAssertEqual(library.lastPlayed(of: portal), Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_789_430_000),
                       "Steam's later date wins over an older launch")
        history.record(440, account: 43, in: SteamGames.self, at: launched + 60)
        XCTAssertNil(library.lastPlayed(of: fortress), "Only this account's launches count")
        library.filter = .played
        XCTAssertEqual(library.shown.map(\.appId), [570, 620],
                       "Launched from Obelisk, never played on Steam; never launched by this account, never played")
        library.filter = .all

        let cached = steamLibrary(root: root, history: history)
        cached.showCache(of: 42) { _ in [CachedLibraryGame(game: dota)] }
        XCTAssertEqual(cached.lastPlayed(of: dota), launched, "The cached account's launches already count")
    }

    func testTheHeroIsTheLastPlayedElseTheMostPlayedElseTheFirstByName() throws {
        let root = try temporaryDirectory()
        let history = LaunchHistory(cache: LibraryCache(directory: root.path))

            library.showCache(of: EpicGames.fixtureAccount) { _ in
                entries.map { key, title, minutes in

                }
            }
            return library
        }

        XCTAssertNil(epicLibrary(root: root).featured, "An empty library has none")

        XCTAssertEqual(library([("1", "Zeta", 30), ("2", "beta", 30), ("3", "Alpha", nil)]).featured?.title, "beta",
                       "Equal playtimes: the first by name, whatever its case")

        let played = library([("a", "Alpha", 0), ("b", "Beta", 10), ("c", "Gamma", 600), ("d", "Delta", nil)])
        XCTAssertEqual(played.featured?.title, "Gamma", "The most played game leads before any launch")
        history.record(epicLibraryID(namespace: "fixture", appName: "a"), account: EpicGames.fixtureAccount, in: EpicGames.self)
        XCTAssertEqual(played.featured?.title, "Alpha", "The last game launched leads")
        history.record(epicLibraryID(namespace: "fixture", appName: "b"), account: "another-account", in: EpicGames.self,
                       at: .now + 60)
        XCTAssertEqual(played.featured?.title, "Alpha", "Only this account's launches count")

        XCTAssertEqual(played.hero?.title, "Alpha")
        played.searchText = "  b "
        XCTAssertNil(played.hero, "The hero belongs to the whole library, never to a search")
        XCTAssertEqual(played.featured?.title, "Alpha")
        played.searchText = " "
        played.filter = .played
        XCTAssertNil(played.hero, "Nor to a filter")
        played.filter = .all
        XCTAssertEqual(played.hero?.title, "Alpha")
    }

    // MARK: Lifecycle

    func testTheCacheShowsUntilItsAccountConnectsAndAnotherAccountStartsEmpty() throws {
        let root = try temporaryDirectory()
        let older = steamGame(1, "Older"), newer = steamGame(2, "Newer")
        let cached = [CachedLibraryGame(game: older, values: [.dateAdded: 10]),
                      CachedLibraryGame(game: newer, values: [.dateAdded: 20])]

        let live = steamLibrary(root: root)
        live.show([older])
        var read = false
        XCTAssertFalse(live.showCache(of: 42) { _ in read = true; return cached })
        XCTAssertFalse(read, "The cache is not read while games show")
        XCTAssertFalse(steamLibrary(root: root).showCache(of: 42) { _ in [] }, "An empty cache shows nothing")
        XCTAssertFalse(steamLibrary(root: root, cache: .some(nil)).showCache(of: 42) { _ in cached })

        let same = steamLibrary(root: root)
        XCTAssertTrue(same.showCache(of: 42) { _ in cached })
        XCTAssertTrue(same.isCached)
        XCTAssertEqual(same.games(by: .dateAdded).map(\.appId), [2, 1], "What the cache knew orders the library")
        XCTAssertTrue(same.connect(42))
        XCTAssertFalse(same.isCached)
        XCTAssertEqual(same.games, [older, newer], "The same account keeps its cached games")
        XCTAssertEqual(same.value(of: newer, for: .dateAdded), 20, "And what the cache knew of them")
        XCTAssertFalse(same.dropCache(), "A connected library is no cache")
        XCTAssertEqual(same.games.count, 2)

        let other = steamLibrary(root: root)
        other.showCache(of: 42) { _ in cached }
        XCTAssertFalse(other.connect(43))
        XCTAssertTrue(other.games.isEmpty, "Another account's cached games never show as this one's")
        XCTAssertNil(other.value(of: newer, for: .dateAdded))

        let dropped = steamLibrary(root: root)
        dropped.showCache(of: 42) { _ in cached }
        XCTAssertTrue(dropped.dropCache())
        XCTAssertFalse(dropped.isCached)
        XCTAssertTrue(dropped.games.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertFalse(dropped.dropCache())
    }

    func testShownGamesWithTheSameIDsReorderEveryKeptOrder() throws {

    func testShownObservesSortSearchGamesLaunchesPlaytimesAndReceipts() async throws {
        let root = try temporaryDirectory()
        let history = LaunchHistory(cache: LibraryCache(directory: root.path))
        let fake = FakeInstallations<EpicGames>()
        let library = epicLibrary(root: root, history: history, installations: fake)
        library.connect(EpicGames.fixtureAccount)
        let alpha = EpicGames.game("a", title: "Alpha"), beta = EpicGames.game("b", title: "Beta")
        library.show([alpha, beta])
        _ = library.shown

        var changed = changes(of: { _ = library.shown }, "The sort")
        library.sort = .playtime
        await fulfillment(of: [changed], timeout: 1)

        changed = changes(of: { _ = library.shown }, "The search")
        library.searchText = "a"
        await fulfillment(of: [changed], timeout: 1)
        library.searchText = ""

        changed = changes(of: { _ = library.shown }, "The games")
        library.show([beta, alpha])
        await fulfillment(of: [changed], timeout: 1)

        changed = changes(of: { _ = library.featured }, "A launch")
        history.record(beta.id, account: EpicGames.fixtureAccount, in: EpicGames.self)
        await fulfillment(of: [changed], timeout: 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(library.featured, beta)

        changed = changes(of: { _ = library.shown }, "The playtimes")
        library.loadPlaytimes({ [alpha.id: .seconds(600)] }, then: {})
        await fulfillment(of: [changed], timeout: 1)
        try await eventually { library.shown == [alpha, beta] }

        library.filter = .installed
        XCTAssertTrue(library.shown.isEmpty)
        changed = changes(of: { _ = library.shown }, "The receipts")
        fake.publish { $0.receipts = [self.epicReceipt(alpha, platform: .windows, root: root)] }
        await fulfillment(of: [changed], timeout: 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(library.shown, [alpha])
    }

    // MARK: Loads

    func testPlaytimeLoadsAnnounceThemselvesOnlyWhileAnOrderOrTheFilterReadsThem() async throws {
        let library = epicLibrary(root: try temporaryDirectory())
        let alpha = EpicGames.game("a", title: "Alpha"), beta = EpicGames.game("b", title: "Beta")
        library.connect(EpicGames.fixtureAccount)
        library.show([alpha, beta])
        let ended = Ended()

        let failing = GameSessionGate<[String: Duration]>()
        library.loadPlaytimes({ try await failing.wait() }, then: { ended.loads.append("failing") })
        XCTAssertNil(library.pendingMetadata, "The name order needs no playtime")
        library.sort = .playtime
        XCTAssertNotNil(library.pendingMetadata, "The playtimes show as loading at once")
        library.sort = .name
        library.filter = .played
        XCTAssertNotNil(library.pendingMetadata)
        await failing.fail(EpicError.Network)
        try await eventually { library.missingMetadata != nil }
        XCTAssertNil(library.pendingMetadata)
        XCTAssertEqual(ended.loads, ["failing"], "A failed load still ends")

        let replaced = GameSessionGate<[String: Duration]>(), current = GameSessionGate<[String: Duration]>()
        library.loadPlaytimes({ try await replaced.wait() }, then: { ended.loads.append("replaced") })
        XCTAssertNil(library.missingMetadata, "A new load clears the failure at once")
        XCTAssertNotNil(library.pendingMetadata)
        library.loadPlaytimes({ try await current.wait() }, then: { ended.loads.append("current") })
        await replaced.resolve([alpha.id: .seconds(60)])
        await current.resolve([beta.id: .seconds(120)])
        try await eventually { library.pendingMetadata == nil }
        await drainMainQueue(times: 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(ended.loads, ["failing", "current"], "A replaced load never ends")
        XCTAssertNil(library.missingMetadata)
        XCTAssertNil(library.playtime(of: alpha))
        XCTAssertEqual(library.playtime(of: beta), .seconds(120))
        XCTAssertEqual(library.shown, [beta])
    }

    func testRecordLoadsAreNotRepeatedWhileLoadingAndAFailureKeepsWhatShowed() async throws {
        let library = steamLibrary(root: try temporaryDirectory())
        let portal = steamGame(620, "Portal 2")
        library.connect(42)
        library.show([portal])
        let reads = Reads()

        let dates = GameSessionGate<[UInt32: Double]>()
        library.load(.dateAdded) { await reads.add(); return try await dates.wait() }
        library.load(.dateAdded) { await reads.add(); return [620: 1] }
        await dates.resolve([620: 1_300_000_000])
        try await eventually { library.value(of: portal, for: .dateAdded) == 1_300_000_000 }
        let count = await reads.count
        XCTAssertEqual(count, 1, "A load already running is not asked again")

        library.load(.dateAdded) { await reads.add(); throw EpicError.Network }
        try await eventually { await reads.count == 2 }
        await drainMainQueue(times: 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(library.value(of: portal, for: .dateAdded), 1_300_000_000, "A failure keeps what showed")

        let late = GameSessionGate<[UInt32: Double]>()
        library.load(.achievements) { try await late.wait() }
        try await eventually { await late.requests == 1 }
        library.forget()
        await late.resolve([620: 1])
        await drainMainQueue(times: 3)
        library.show([portal])
        XCTAssertNil(library.value(of: portal, for: .achievements), "A forgotten account's late answer never shows")
    }

    // MARK: Fixtures

    private func temporaryDirectory() throws -> URL {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: "ObeliskAccountLibrary-\(UUID().uuidString)")
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: root, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        addTeardownBlock { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        return root
    }

    private func steamLibrary(root: URL, history: LaunchHistory? = nil, cache: LibraryCache?? = .none,
                              installations fake: FakeInstallations<SteamGames> = FakeInstallations())
        -> AccountLibrary<SteamGames, SteamGame> {
        let history = history ?? LaunchHistory(cache: LibraryCache(directory: root.path))
        return AccountLibrary(history: history, cache: cache ?? LibraryCache(directory: root.path),
                              installations: installations(of: 42, fake, history: history))
    }

    private func epicLibrary(root: URL, history: LaunchHistory? = nil,
                             installations fake: FakeInstallations<EpicGames> = FakeInstallations())
        -> AccountLibrary<EpicGames, EpicGame> {
        let history = history ?? LaunchHistory(cache: LibraryCache(directory: root.path))
        return AccountLibrary(history: history, cache: LibraryCache(directory: root.path),
                              installations: installations(of: EpicGames.fixtureAccount, fake, history: history))
    }

    /// The account's installations as `fake` publishes them; connecting
    /// shows its first snapshot at once.
    private func installations<Store: InstallationStorefront>(
        of account: Store.AccountID, _ fake: FakeInstallations<Store>, history: LaunchHistory
    ) -> GameInstallations<Store> {
        let sessions = GameSessions<Store>(FakeSessions(), history: history)
        let installations = GameInstallations(sessions: sessions, cloud: CloudModel(sessions: sessions))
        installations.connect(account: account, backend: fake, port: InstallationPort(report: { _ in }, warn: { _ in }))
        return installations
    }

    private func changes(of read: () -> Void, _ description: String) -> XCTestExpectation {
        let changed = expectation(description: "The library observes \(description.lowercased())")
        withObservationTracking { read() } onChange: { changed.fulfill() }
        return changed
    }

    private func steamGame(_ appID: UInt32, _ name: String, lastPlayed: UInt64 = 0, minutes: UInt32 = 0) -> SteamGame {
        SteamGame(appId: appID, name: name, iconHash: "", lastPlayed: lastPlayed, playtimeMinutes: minutes)
    }

    private func epicGame(_ appName: String, namespace: String = "first", title: String, macOS: Bool = false) -> EpicGame {
        EpicGame(appName: appName, namespace: namespace, catalogItemId: "catalog-\(appName)", title: title,
                 description: "", imageUrl: nil, headerImageUrl: nil, developer: "", windows: true, macos: macOS)
    }

    private func epicReceipt(_ game: EpicGame, platform: GamePlatform, root: URL, bytes: UInt64 = 1)
        -> InstallationReceipt<String> {
        .epic(namespace: game.namespace, appName: game.appName, name: game.title,
              directory: root.appending(path: "epic-\(game.namespace)-\(game.appName)-\(platform == .mac ? "Mac" : "Windows")").path,
              platform: platform, totalBytes: bytes)
    }
}

/// The playtime loads that ended, in order.
@MainActor
private final class Ended {
    var loads: [String] = []
}

private actor Reads {
    private(set) var count = 0
    func add() { count += 1 }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

@MainActor
final class AppModelTests: XCTestCase {
    func testAnotherSectionClearsTheSearchAndTheAppearanceIsRemembered() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString)
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let suite = "ObeliskTests.\(UUID().uuidString)"
        let defaults = try XCTUnwrap(UserDefaults(suiteName: suite))
        defer { defaults.removePersistentDomain(forName: suite) }
        let model = AppModel(directory: root, defaults: defaults)

        model.searchText = "portal"
        model.selection = .steam
        XCTAssertTrue(model.searchText.isEmpty)

        model.appearance = .dark
        XCTAssertEqual(AppModel(directory: root, defaults: defaults).appearance, .dark)
    }

    func testTheChosenLanguageIsObelisksOwnAppleLanguagesUntilThePlayerFollowsTheMacAgain() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString)
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let suite = "ObeliskTests.\(UUID().uuidString)"
        let defaults = try XCTUnwrap(UserDefaults(suiteName: suite))
        defer { defaults.removePersistentDomain(forName: suite) }
        let model = AppModel(directory: root, defaults: defaults, defaultsDomain: suite)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.language, .system)

        let other = L10n.languageCode == "fr" ? "en" : "fr"
        model.language = .language(other)
        XCTAssertEqual(defaults.persistentDomain(forName: suite)?["AppleLanguages"] as? [String], [other])
        XCTAssertTrue(model.languageNeedsRestart)
        XCTAssertEqual(AppModel(directory: root, defaults: defaults, defaultsDomain: suite).language, .language(other))

        model.language = .language(L10n.languageCode)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.languageNeedsRestart)

        model.language = .system
        XCTAssertNil(defaults.persistentDomain(forName: suite)?["AppleLanguages"])
        XCTAssertEqual(AppModel(directory: root, defaults: defaults, defaultsDomain: suite).language, .system)
    }

    func testALanguageMacOSChoseForObeliskReadsAsTheTranslationItShows() throws {
        let suite = "ObeliskTests.\(UUID().uuidString)"
        let defaults = try XCTUnwrap(UserDefaults(suiteName: suite))
        defer { defaults.removePersistentDomain(forName: suite) }
        defaults.set(["fr-CA"], forKey: "AppleLanguages")
        XCTAssertEqual(AppLanguage(defaults: defaults, domain: suite), .language("fr"))
        defaults.set(["de-DE"], forKey: "AppleLanguages")
        XCTAssertEqual(AppLanguage(defaults: defaults, domain: suite), .language("en"))
    }

    func testGamesUpdateAutomaticallyUnlessThePlayerTurnsItOffInEveryStorefront() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString)
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let suite = "ObeliskTests.\(UUID().uuidString)"
        let defaults = try XCTUnwrap(UserDefaults(suiteName: suite))
        defer { defaults.removePersistentDomain(forName: suite) }
        let model = AppModel(directory: root, defaults: defaults)

        model.updatesGamesAutomatically = false
        XCTAssertFalse(model.steam.installations.updatesAutomatically)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.epic.installations.updatesAutomatically)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.gog.installations.updatesAutomatically)
        let restarted = AppModel(directory: root, defaults: defaults)

        XCTAssertFalse(restarted.gog.installations.updatesAutomatically)
```

```swift
@MainActor

    private var directory: URL!

    override func setUp() async throws {
        directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
            .appending(path: "ObeliskBugReports-\(UUID().uuidString)", directoryHint: .isDirectory)
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: directory.appending(path: "DiagnosticReports"),
                                                withIntermediateDirectories: true)
    }

    override func tearDown() async throws {
        try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory)
    }

    private static let mac = MacHardware(chip: "Apple M2 Pro", model: "Mac14,12", memoryGB: 32, gpuCores: 19,
                                         macOSVersion: "27.0")
    private static let eldenRing = BugReportSubject.game(store: .steam, id: "1245620", name: "ELDEN RING")

    /// Sources whose diagnostics, for any subject, are `diagnostics`: Rust
    /// names and finds them, and its own tests check which.
    private func sources(diagnostics: [URL] = []) -> BugReportSources {
        BugReportSources(
            diagnostics: { _, _ in diagnostics },
            crashReports: directory.appending(path: "DiagnosticReports"), process: "Obelisk",
            home: "/Users/player", unifiedLog: { "unified\n" }, voile: { "v26.3.0-13" }
        )
    }

    @discardableResult
    private func write(_ path: String, _ text: String = "log\n", age: TimeInterval = 0) throws -> URL {
        let url = directory.appending(path: path)
        try Data(text.utf8).write(to: url)
        try FileManager.default.setAttributes([.modificationDate: Date.now - age], ofItemAtPath: url.path)
        return url
    }

    private func crash(_ name: String, process: String, responsible: String, age: TimeInterval = 0) throws {
        try write("DiagnosticReports/\(name).ips", """
        {"app_name":"\(process)","name":"\(process)"}
        {
          "procName" : "\(process)",
          "responsibleProc" : "\(responsible)",
          "crashReporterKey" : "2221FD7C-43D1-9A5C-91C1-E721D03767EF"
        }
        """, age: age)
    }

        XCTAssertEqual(json["kind"] as? String, "game")
        XCTAssertEqual(json["description"] as? String, "It crashes.")
        XCTAssertEqual(json["contact"] as? String, "zag")
        XCTAssertEqual(json["game"] as? [String: String], ["store": "steam", "id": "1245620", "name": "ELDEN RING"])
        XCTAssertEqual(json["obelisk_version"] as? String, "0.1.0")
        XCTAssertEqual(json["voile_version"] as? String, "v26.3.0-13")
        XCTAssertEqual(json["chip"] as? String, "Apple M2 Pro")
        XCTAssertEqual(json["mac_model"] as? String, "Mac14,12")
        XCTAssertEqual(json["macos_version"] as? String, "27.0")
    }

    func testAnAppReportWithoutContactSendsNulls() throws {

                               obeliskVersion: "0.1.0", voileVersion: nil)

    func testGzipRoundTrips() throws {

        let packed = BugReportPayload.gzip(text)
        XCTAssertEqual(Array(packed.prefix(2)), [0x1f, 0x8b])

    func testLogsThatDoNotFitAreCutFromTheirStartKeepingTheirEnd() throws {
        // Random hex compresses poorly, so the budget forces a cut.
        let noise = (0..<20_000).map { _ in String(format: "%08x", UInt32.random(in: .min ... .max)) }
        let large = Data((noise.joined(separator: "\n") + "\nthe crash\n").utf8)
        let small = Data("small log\n".utf8)
        let fitted = BugReportPayload.fitted([BugReportLog(name: "large.log", data: large),
                                              BugReportLog(name: "small.log", data: small)], within: 60_000)
        XCTAssertLessThanOrEqual(fitted.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.data.count }, 60_000)
        XCTAssertEqual(try gunzip(fitted[1].data), small, "the small log is whole")
        let cut = String(decoding: try gunzip(fitted[0].data), as: UTF8.self)
        XCTAssertTrue(cut.hasPrefix(BugReportPayload.cutNote), "the log says it was cut")
        XCTAssertTrue(cut.hasSuffix("\nthe crash\n"), "the end, where errors are, stays")
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(cut.count, 20_000, "most of what fits is kept")
    }

    func testTheContentsAreRedacted() async throws {

    // MARK: Sending

    func testASentReportShowsItsCode() async throws {
        let log = try write("game.log", "boom\n")
        let requests = Requests()
        let sources = self.sources(diagnostics: [log])
        let model = BugReportModel(subject: Self.eldenRing, sources: sources, mac: Self.mac) { request in
            await requests.add(request)
            let response = HTTPURLResponse(url: request.url!, statusCode: 201, httpVersion: nil, headerFields: nil)!
            return (Data(#"{"code":"K7F3-9QX2"}"#.utf8), response)
        }
        await model.load()
        XCTAssertFalse(model.canSend, "a report says what happened")
        model.description = "It crashes."
        await model.send()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.phase, .sent(code: "K7F3-9QX2"))
        let issue = try fields(XCTUnwrap(model.issue))
        XCTAssertEqual(issue["report-code"], "K7F3-9QX2")
        XCTAssertEqual(issue["what-happened"], "It crashes.")
        let sent = await requests.all
        let request = try XCTUnwrap(sent.first)
        XCTAssertEqual(request.url, BugReportPayload.endpoint)
        XCTAssertEqual(request.httpMethod, "POST")
        let body = String(decoding: try XCTUnwrap(request.httpBody), as: UTF8.self)
        XCTAssertTrue(body.contains(#"filename="game.log.gz""#))
        XCTAssertTrue(body.contains(#""voile_version":"v26.3.0-13""#))
    }

    func testAReportWithoutLogsSendsOnlyTheReportAndAFailureCanBeRetried() async throws {
        let log = try write("game.log")
        let requests = Requests()
        let sources = self.sources(diagnostics: [log])
        let model = BugReportModel(subject: Self.eldenRing, sources: sources, mac: Self.mac) { request in
            await requests.add(request)
            let response = HTTPURLResponse(url: request.url!, statusCode: 502, httpVersion: nil, headerFields: nil)!
            return (Data(), response)
        }
        await model.load()
        model.description = "It crashes."
        model.attachesLogs = false
        await model.send()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.phase, .failed(tooMany: false))
        XCTAssertTrue(model.canSend, "a failed report can be sent again")
        let sent = await requests.all
        let body = String(decoding: try XCTUnwrap(sent.first?.httpBody), as: UTF8.self)
        XCTAssertFalse(body.contains(#"name="log""#))
    }

    func testAReportRefusedForTooManyFromThisNetworkSaysSo() async throws {
        let model = BugReportModel(subject: .app, sources: sources(), mac: Self.mac) { request in
            (Data("Too Many Requests".utf8),
             HTTPURLResponse(url: request.url!, statusCode: 429, httpVersion: nil, headerFields: nil)!)
        }
        model.description = "The library is empty."
        await model.send()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.phase, .failed(tooMany: true))
        XCTAssertTrue(model.canSend)
    }

    private func gunzip(_ data: Data) throws -> Data {
        var stream = z_stream()
        XCTAssertEqual(inflateInit2_(&stream, 31, ZLIB_VERSION, Int32(MemoryLayout<z_stream>.size)), Z_OK)
        defer { inflateEnd(&stream) }
        var output = Data()
        var buffer = [UInt8](repeating: 0, count: 65536)
        var input = [UInt8](data)
        var status = Z_OK
        input.withUnsafeMutableBufferPointer { input in
            stream.next_in = input.baseAddress
            stream.avail_in = uInt(input.count)
            repeat {
                buffer.withUnsafeMutableBufferPointer { buffer in
                    stream.next_out = buffer.baseAddress
                    stream.avail_out = uInt(buffer.count)
                    status = inflate(&stream, Z_NO_FLUSH)
                    output.append(buffer.baseAddress!, count: buffer.count - Int(stream.avail_out))
                }
            } while status == Z_OK
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(status, Z_STREAM_END)
        return output
    }
}

private actor Requests {
    private(set) var all: [URLRequest] = []
    func add(_ request: URLRequest) { all.append(request) }
}
```

`apps/macos/ObeliskTests/CloudIndicatorTests.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

final class CloudIndicatorTests: XCTestCase {
    private let now = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_790_000_000)

    private func saved(_ state: CloudSavedState, syncedAt: UInt64? = nil, gameSession: Bool = false,
                       pendingUpload: Bool = false) -> CloudIndicator {
        CloudIndicator(state: state, gameSession: gameSession, syncedAt: syncedAt,
                       pendingUpload: pendingUpload, installationRemoved: false)
    }

    private func shown(_ indicator: CloudIndicator?, syncing: Bool = false, playing: Bool = false,
                       installed: Bool = true) -> CloudIndicatorPresentation? {
        CloudIndicatorPresentation.make(saved: indicator, isSyncing: syncing, isPlaying: playing,
                                        isInstalled: installed, now: now)
    }

    func testEachSavedStateHasItsSymbolTextAndTone() {
        let twoHoursAgo = UInt64(now.timeIntervalSince1970) - 7_200
        let lastSync = CloudSyncDate.text(Date(timeIntervalSince1970: TimeInterval(twoHoursAgo)), now: now)
        let pending = L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.pending")
        let cases: [(CloudIndicator, String?, String, CloudIndicatorPresentation.Tone)] = [
            (saved(.recoveryNeeded), "exclamationmark.icloud", pending, .warning),
            (saved(.uploadUncertain), "exclamationmark.icloud", pending, .warning),
            (saved(.conflict), "exclamationmark.icloud", L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.conflict"), .warning),
            (saved(.pending, syncedAt: twoHoursAgo), "exclamationmark.icloud",
             L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.pending_since", lastSync), .warning),
            (saved(.pending), "exclamationmark.icloud", pending, .warning),
            (saved(.unavailable), "icloud.slash", L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.unavailable"), .normal),
            (saved(.localChanges), "exclamationmark.icloud", pending, .warning),
            (saved(.lastFailed), "exclamationmark.icloud", L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.failed"), .warning),
            (saved(.synced, syncedAt: twoHoursAgo), "icloud",
             L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.synced_at", lastSync), .normal),
            (saved(.synced), "icloud", L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.synced"), .normal),
            (saved(.neverSynced), "icloud", L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.never"), .muted),
        ]
        for (index, (indicator, symbol, value, tone)) in cases.enumerated() {
            let presentation = shown(indicator)
            XCTAssertEqual(presentation?.symbol, symbol, "case \(index)")
            XCTAssertEqual(presentation?.value, value, "case \(index)")
            XCTAssertEqual(presentation?.tone, tone, "case \(index)")
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(shown(nil)?.value, L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.never"), "No journal yet means never synced")
    }

    func testLiveStatesComeFirst() {
        let synced = saved(.synced, syncedAt: UInt64(now.timeIntervalSince1970) - 30, gameSession: true)
        let syncing = shown(synced, syncing: true, playing: true)
        XCTAssertNil(syncing?.symbol, "A sync in progress shows progress")
        XCTAssertEqual(syncing?.value, L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.syncing"))

        let playing = shown(synced, playing: true)
        XCTAssertEqual(playing?.symbol, "cloud")
        XCTAssertEqual(playing?.value, L10n.string("ui.cloud.date.just_now"))
        XCTAssertEqual(playing?.tone, .normal)

        let stale = shown(synced)
        XCTAssertEqual(stale?.value, L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.pending"), "A guard with no live game is stale")
        XCTAssertEqual(stale?.tone, .warning)

        let withoutGuard = shown(saved(.unavailable), playing: true)
        XCTAssertEqual(withoutGuard?.value, L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.unavailable"))
    }

    func testUninstalledGamesShowTheIndicatorOnlyWhileAnUploadIsPending() {
        XCTAssertNil(shown(saved(.synced), installed: false))
        XCTAssertNil(shown(nil, installed: false))
        XCTAssertEqual(shown(saved(.pending, pendingUpload: true), installed: false)?.tone, .warning)
        XCTAssertNotNil(shown(saved(.neverSynced), installed: true))
    }

    func testLastSyncDatesAreRelativeForAWeekThenAbsolute() {
        let french = Locale(identifier: "fr_FR")
        var calendar = Calendar(identifier: .gregorian)
        calendar.timeZone = TimeZone(identifier: "UTC")!
        func text(_ offset: TimeInterval) -> String {
            CloudSyncDate.text(now.addingTimeInterval(offset), now: now, locale: french, calendar: calendar)
        }
        // `now` is 21 September 2026, 14:13 UTC.
        XCTAssertEqual(text(-20), L10n.string("ui.cloud.date.just_now"))
        XCTAssertEqual(text(5), L10n.string("ui.cloud.date.just_now"), "A slightly ahead clock is not a future sync")
        XCTAssertEqual(text(-7_200), "il y a 2\u{00A0}h", "French puts a no-break space before the unit")
        XCTAssertEqual(text(-6 * 86_400), "il y a 6\u{00A0}j")
        XCTAssertEqual(text(-10 * 86_400), "11 sept.")
        XCTAssertEqual(text(-400 * 86_400), "17 août 2025")
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/ObeliskTests/DownloadsModelTests.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

/// The download queue as Swift presents it, over a queue the test publishes.
@MainActor
final class DownloadsModelTests: XCTestCase {
    func testTheQueueShowsWhatRunsAndWaitsAndForwardsEachAction() async throws {
        let queue = FakeDownloads()
        let model = DownloadsModel(backend: queue, period: .seconds(3600))
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isVisible)

        let running = DownloadItem.fixture(1)
        let waiting = DownloadItem.fixture(2, game: "730", kind: .update, automatic: true)
        queue.publish {
            $0.running = running
            $0.waiting = [waiting]
        }
        try await eventually { model.isVisible }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.count, 2)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.waiting, [waiting])

        model.pause(running)
        model.moveToTop(waiting)
        model.remove(waiting)
        XCTAssertEqual(queue.calls, [.pause(1), .moveToTop(2), .remove(2)])
    }

    func testOnlyAutomaticUpdatesWaitingForAGameSaySo() async throws {
        let queue = FakeDownloads()
        let model = DownloadsModel(backend: queue, period: .seconds(3600))
        queue.publish {
            $0.waiting = [.fixture(2, automatic: true)]
            $0.held = true
        }
        try await eventually { model.held }
        XCTAssertTrue(model.waitsForGame)

        queue.publish { $0.waiting.append(.fixture(3, game: "730")) }
        try await eventually { model.waiting.count == 2 }
        XCTAssertFalse(model.waitsForGame, "the player's own download goes on")
    }

    func testTheSpeedComesFromTheRunningTransfersBytesAndStartsAgainWithTheNext() async throws {
        let queue = FakeDownloads()
        let model = DownloadsModel(backend: queue, period: .seconds(3600))
        var bytes: UInt64 = 0
        model.progress = { item in
            GameTransfer(game: item.game, state: .downloading, completedBytes: 0, totalBytes: 100,
                         networkBytes: bytes, contentBytes: bytes, currentFile: "", message: "")
        }
        queue.publish { $0.running = .fixture(1) }
        try await eventually { model.running != nil }

        let start = Date()
        model.sample(at: start)
        XCTAssertTrue(model.samples.isEmpty, "a speed needs two moments")
        bytes = 4_000_000
        model.sample(at: start.addingTimeInterval(2))
        bytes = 10_000_000
        model.sample(at: start.addingTimeInterval(3))
        XCTAssertEqual(model.samples.map(\.bytesPerSecond), [2_000_000, 6_000_000])
        XCTAssertEqual(model.currentSpeed, 6_000_000)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.peakSpeed, 6_000_000)

        queue.publish { $0.running = .fixture(2, game: "730") }
        try await eventually { model.running?.id == 2 }
        XCTAssertTrue(model.samples.isEmpty)
    }
}
```
