`apps/macos/ObeliskTests/EpicAuthorizationCallbackTests.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

final class EpicAuthorizationCallbackTests: XCTestCase {
    private let code = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
    private let clientID = "34a02cf8f4414e29b15921876da36f9a"

    func testLauncherCallbackAcceptsDefaultHTTPSPortAndDecodesCode() throws {
        for (address, expected) in [
            ("https://localhost/launcher/authorized?code=\(code)", code),
            ("https://localhost:443/launcher/authorized?code=\(code)&state=epic", code),
            ("https://localhost/launcher/authorized?code=abc%5F123-XYZ", "abc_123-XYZ"),
        ] {
            XCTAssertEqual(try EpicAuthorizationCallback.code(from: url(address)), expected)
        }
    }

    func testOrdinaryNavigationDoesNotExtractAuthorizationCodes() throws {
        for address in [
            "https://www.epicgames.com/id/login?code=\(code)",
            "https://localhost/launcher/authorized/extra?code=\(code)",
            "https://localhost/launcher/authorized/?code=\(code)",
            "https://localhost/launcher/%61uthorized?code=\(code)",
            "http://localhost/launcher/authorized?code=\(code)",
            "https://localhost:444/launcher/authorized?code=\(code)",
        ] {
            XCTAssertNil(try EpicAuthorizationCallback.code(from: url(address)))
        }
    }

    func testForeignOriginsAndHostLookalikesNeverSupplyCallbackCodes() throws {
        for host in ["localhost.example.com", "notlocalhost", "127.0.0.1", "example.com", "localhost."] {
            XCTAssertNil(try EpicAuthorizationCallback.code(from: url("https://\(host)/launcher/authorized?code=\(code)")))
        }
        XCTAssertNil(try EpicAuthorizationCallback.code(from: url("https://localhost@example.com/launcher/authorized?code=\(code)")))
    }

    func testRecognizedCallbackRejectsFragmentsAndUserInfo() {
        for address in [
            "https://localhost/launcher/authorized?code=\(code)#fragment",
            "https://localhost/launcher/authorized?code=\(code)#",
            "https://user@localhost/launcher/authorized?code=\(code)",
            "https://user:password@localhost/launcher/authorized?code=\(code)",
            "https://@localhost/launcher/authorized?code=\(code)",
        ] {
            assertInvalidResponse { _ = try EpicAuthorizationCallback.code(from: url(address)) }
        }
    }

    func testRecognizedCallbackRequiresOneValidNonemptyCode() {
        for query in [
            "", "code", "code=", "error=access_denied", "code=%20",
            "code=first&code=second", "code=first&co%64e=second",
            "code=first%0Asecond", "code=invalid%20code",
            "code=%20abc%20", "code=%7B%22authorizationCode%22%3A%22abc%22%7D",
        ] {
            assertInvalidResponse { _ = try EpicAuthorizationCallback.code(from: url("https://localhost/launcher/authorized?\(query)")) }
        }
    }

    func testJSONEndpointRequiresExpectedOriginPathAndUniqueClientQuery() {
        for address in [
            "https://www.epicgames.com/id/api/redirect?clientId=\(clientID)&responseType=code",
            "https://epicgames.com:443/id/api/redirect?responseType=code&clientId=\(clientID)",
        ] {
            XCTAssertTrue(EpicAuthorizationCallback.isJSONEndpoint(url(address)))
        }
        for address in [
            "http://www.epicgames.com/id/api/redirect?clientId=\(clientID)&responseType=code",
            "https://www.epicgames.com:444/id/api/redirect?clientId=\(clientID)&responseType=code",
            "https://www.epicgames.com.example.com/id/api/redirect?clientId=\(clientID)&responseType=code",
            "https://www.epicgames.com/id/api/redirect/extra?clientId=\(clientID)&responseType=code",
            "https://www.epicgames.com/id/api/%72edirect?clientId=\(clientID)&responseType=code",
            "https://user@www.epicgames.com/id/api/redirect?clientId=\(clientID)&responseType=code",
            "https://www.epicgames.com/id/api/redirect?clientId=\(clientID)&responseType=code#",
            "https://www.epicgames.com/id/api/redirect?clientId=other&responseType=code",
            "https://www.epicgames.com/id/api/redirect?clientId=\(clientID)",
            "https://www.epicgames.com/id/api/redirect?clientId=\(clientID)&responseType=token",
            "https://www.epicgames.com/id/api/redirect?clientId=\(clientID)&clientId=\(clientID)&responseType=code",
            "https://www.epicgames.com/id/api/redirect?clientId=\(clientID)&responseType=code&responseType=code",
            "https://www.epicgames.com/id/api/redirect?clientId=\(clientID)&responseType=code&extra=value",
        ] {
            XCTAssertFalse(EpicAuthorizationCallback.isJSONEndpoint(url(address)))
        }
    }

    func testJSONResponseExtractsCodeOnlyFromTheTrustedEndpoint() throws {
        let json = "{\"authorizationCode\":\"\(code)\",\"sid\":null}"
        XCTAssertEqual(try EpicAuthorizationCallback.code(fromJSON: json, at: jsonEndpoint), code)
        for address in [
            "https://example.com/id/api/redirect?clientId=\(clientID)&responseType=code",
            "https://www.epicgames.com/id/login",
            "https://localhost/launcher/authorized?code=\(code)",
        ] {
            assertInvalidResponse { _ = try EpicAuthorizationCallback.code(fromJSON: json, at: url(address)) }
        }
    }

    func testJSONResponseRejectsRawPageTextAndInvalidCodeTypes() {
        for json in [
            code, "\"\(code)\"", "<html>\(code)</html>", "{broken}", "[]", "{}",
            "{\"authorizationCode\":null}", "{\"authorizationCode\":123}",
            "{\"authorizationCode\":\"\"}", "{\"authorizationCode\":\"invalid code\"}",
            "{\"authorizationCode\":\"https://www.epicgames.com/id/api/redirect?code=abc\"}",
        ] {
            assertInvalidResponse { _ = try EpicAuthorizationCallback.code(fromJSON: json, at: jsonEndpoint) }
        }
    }

    func testJSONResponseLimitCountsUTF8BytesAndAcceptsBoundary() throws {
        let json = "{\"authorizationCode\":\"\(code)\"}"
        let boundary = json + String(repeating: " ", count: 32_768 - json.utf8.count)
        XCTAssertEqual(try EpicAuthorizationCallback.code(fromJSON: boundary, at: jsonEndpoint), code)
        assertInvalidResponse { _ = try EpicAuthorizationCallback.code(fromJSON: boundary + " ", at: jsonEndpoint) }

        let multibyte = "{\"authorizationCode\":\"\(code)\",\"padding\":\"\(String(repeating: "é", count: 17_000))\"}"
        XCTAssertLessThan(multibyte.count, 32_768)
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(multibyte.utf8.count, 32_768)
        assertInvalidResponse { _ = try EpicAuthorizationCallback.code(fromJSON: multibyte, at: jsonEndpoint) }
    }

    private var jsonEndpoint: URL {
        url("https://www.epicgames.com/id/api/redirect?clientId=\(clientID)&responseType=code")
    }

    private func url(_ value: String) -> URL { URL(string: value)! }

    private func assertInvalidResponse(
        file: StaticString = #filePath,
        line: UInt = #line,
        _ operation: () throws -> Void
    ) {
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try operation(), file: file, line: line) { error in
            guard case WebAuthenticationError.invalidResponse = error else {
                return XCTFail("Expected a sanitized invalid response error", file: file, line: line)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
import AppKit

@testable import Obelisk

@MainActor
final class EpicCloudTests: XCTestCase {
    func testCloudPresentationPreviewWhenRequested() async throws {
        guard let path = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["OBELISK_EPIC_CLOUD_PREVIEW_DIR"] else {
            throw XCTSkip("Set OBELISK_EPIC_CLOUD_PREVIEW_DIR to render disposable Epic Cloud fixtures")
        }
        let output = URL(fileURLWithPath: path, isDirectory: true)
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: output, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        let directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: "ObeliskEpicCloudPreview-\(UUID().uuidString)")
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory) }
        let credentials = EpicCredentials(accountId: "account", displayName: "Fixture", refreshToken: "fixture")
        let owned = EpicGame(appName: "game", namespace: "sandbox", catalogItemId: "catalog", title: "Cloud fixture",
                             description: "", imageUrl: nil, headerImageUrl: nil, developer: "", windows: false, macos: true)
        let account = EpicTestSession(credentials: credentials, games: [owned])
        let sessions = EpicGameSessions()
        let backend = FakeInstallations<EpicGames>()
        let model = EpicModel(directory: directory, keychain: EpicMemoryStore(credentials), restore: { _ in account },
                              gameSessions: sessions, installations: EpicModel.installations(backend))
        await model.start()
        model.open(owned)
        let session = GameSessionState.epic(account: "account", namespace: "sandbox", appName: "game",
                                            phase: .preparing, cloud: .showing(.checking))
        sessions.fake.show(session)
        backend.publish { $0.cloudSync = .launch("sandbox:game", working: true, cancellable: true) }
        try await eventually { model.installations.isSynchronizingSaves }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.selectedAction?.title, L10n.string("ui.cloud.sync_short"))
        let view = EpicView(model: model)
            .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
            .tint(ObeliskStyle.accent)
            .background(ObeliskPalette(colorScheme: .dark).background)
        let fixture = EpicPresentationWindow(view, size: NSSize(width: 1060, height: 720))
        defer { fixture.close() }
        fixture.layout()
        try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(250))
        fixture.layout()
        try savePreview(fixture.host, to: output.appending(path: "epic-cloud-synchronization.png"))
        backend.publish {
            $0.cloudSync = .launch("sandbox:game", question: .conflict(2, error: "backend.epic.cloud_conflict"))
        }
        try await eventually { fixture.layout(); return model.cloud.promptPresented && fixture.sheetContent != nil }
        try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(250))
        fixture.layout()
        let sheet = try XCTUnwrap(fixture.sheetContent)
        try savePreview(sheet, to: output.appending(path: "epic-cloud-conflict.png"))
        backend.publish { $0.cloudSync = nil }
        try await eventually { fixture.layout(); return fixture.sheetContent == nil }
    }

    private func savePreview(_ view: NSView, to file: URL) throws {
        view.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
        let bitmap = try XCTUnwrap(view.bitmapImageRepForCachingDisplay(in: view.bounds))
        view.cacheDisplay(in: view.bounds, to: bitmap)
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(bitmap.pixelsWide, 300)
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(bitmap.pixelsHigh, 150)
        // A sheet's AppKit backdrop is outside its content view. Preserve the
        // captured alpha when compositing onto the fixture's dark background.
        let opaque = try XCTUnwrap(NSBitmapImageRep(bitmapDataPlanes: nil, pixelsWide: bitmap.pixelsWide,
            pixelsHigh: bitmap.pixelsHigh, bitsPerSample: 8, samplesPerPixel: 4, hasAlpha: true,
            isPlanar: false, colorSpaceName: .deviceRGB, bytesPerRow: 0, bitsPerPixel: 0))
        let context = try XCTUnwrap(NSGraphicsContext(bitmapImageRep: opaque))
        NSGraphicsContext.saveGraphicsState()
        NSGraphicsContext.current = context
        let bounds = NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: bitmap.pixelsWide, height: bitmap.pixelsHigh)
        NSColor(ObeliskPalette(colorScheme: .dark).background).setFill()
        bounds.fill()
        context.cgContext.setBlendMode(.normal)
        context.cgContext.draw(try XCTUnwrap(bitmap.cgImage), in: bounds)
        context.flushGraphics()
        NSGraphicsContext.restoreGraphicsState()
        XCTAssertEqual(opaque.colorAt(x: 0, y: 0)?.alphaComponent, 1)
        try XCTUnwrap(opaque.representation(using: .png, properties: [:])).write(to: file)
    }

    func testAStaleEpicRosettaPromptCannotCancelTheCurrentRequirement() async throws {
        let sessions = EpicGameSessions()
        waitForRosetta(sessions)
        try await eventually { sessions.rosettaPrompt(accountId: "account") != nil }
        let request = try XCTUnwrap(sessions.rosettaPrompt(accountId: "account"))
        for obsolete in [EpicGameSessions.RosettaPrompt(id: "old-session", accountId: "account", decisionId: 17),
                         .init(id: request.id, accountId: "other-account", decisionId: 17),
                         .init(id: request.id, accountId: "account", decisionId: 16)] {
            sessions.cancelRosetta(obsolete)
        }
        XCTAssertTrue(sessions.fake.declines.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.rosettaPrompt(accountId: "account"), request)
    }

    func testEpicRosettaCancellationHidesPromptUntilTheSessionEnds() async throws {
        let sessions = EpicGameSessions()
        let model = EpicRosettaModel(sessions: sessions, install: { XCTFail("Cancellation must not install") })
        model.connect(accountId: "account")
        waitForRosetta(sessions)
        try await eventually { model.prompt != nil }
        model.cancel()
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.fake.declines.map(\.decisionID), [17])
        XCTAssertNil(model.prompt)
        XCTAssertTrue(sessions.isBusy)
        sessions.fake.show(nil)
        try await eventually { !sessions.isBusy }
    }

    func testEpicRosettaAccountChangeCancelsInstallationAndPreventsResume() async throws {
        let sessions = EpicGameSessions()
        let gate = EpicCloudPreparationGate()
        let model = EpicRosettaModel(sessions: sessions, install: {}, readinessDelay: { await gate.wait() })
        model.connect(accountId: "account")
        waitForRosetta(sessions)
        try await eventually { model.prompt != nil }
        model.install()
        try await eventually { await gate.waiting }
        model.connect(accountId: "other-account")
        await gate.release()
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.fake.declines.count, 1)
        try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(20))
        XCTAssertTrue(sessions.fake.rosettaChecks.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertNil(model.prompt)
    }

    func testEpicModelConnectsAndDisconnectsSharedRosettaPresentation() async throws {
        let directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: "ObeliskEpicRosetta-\(UUID().uuidString)")
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory) }
        let credentials = EpicCredentials(accountId: "account", displayName: "Fixture", refreshToken: "fixture")
        let account = EpicTestSession(credentials: credentials, games: [])
        let sessions = EpicGameSessions()
        let model = EpicModel(directory: directory, keychain: EpicMemoryStore(credentials), restore: { _ in account },
                              gameSessions: sessions, installations: EpicModel.installations(FakeInstallations()))
        await model.start()
        waitForRosetta(sessions)
        try await eventually { model.rosetta.prompt != nil }
        model.signOut()
        XCTAssertNil(model.rosetta.prompt)
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.fake.declines.count, 1)
        XCTAssertTrue(sessions.isBusy)
    }

    /// An Epic launch of `sandbox:game` waiting for Rosetta, decision 17.
    private func waitForRosetta(_ sessions: EpicGameSessions) {
        sessions.fake.show(.epic(account: "account", namespace: "sandbox", appName: "game", phase: .preparing,
                                 cloud: .showing(.ready)))
        sessions.fake.requireRosetta(decisionID: 17)
    }
}

private actor EpicCloudPreparationGate {
    private var continuation: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>?
    private(set) var waiting = false
    func wait() async {
        waiting = true
        await withCheckedContinuation { continuation = $0 }
    }
    func release() { continuation?.resume(); continuation = nil }
}
```

`apps/macos/ObeliskTests/EpicFriendsIntegrationTests.swift`:

```swift
import AppKit
import Foundation
import SwiftUI
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

final class EpicFriendsIntegrationTests: XCTestCase {
    func testLiveEpicFriendsWhenRequested() async throws {
        guard ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["OBELISK_EPIC_FRIENDS_SMOKE"] == "1" else {
            throw XCTSkip("Set OBELISK_EPIC_FRIENDS_SMOKE=1 to validate the saved Epic account explicitly")
        }
        let store = EpicKeychain()
        let saved = try await store.load()
        let credentials = try XCTUnwrap(saved, "A saved Epic session is required")
        let session = try await EpicSession.restore(credentials: credentials, library: nil)
        try await store.save(session.credentials())
        let persistence = Task {
            var revision: UInt64 = 0
            while let changed = await session.nextCredentialsRevision(afterRevision: revision) {
                revision = changed
                do { try await store.save(session.credentials()) }
                catch { XCTFail("Rotated Epic credentials could not be saved") }
            }
        }
        let requestedSeconds = Int(ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["OBELISK_EPIC_FRIENDS_SMOKE_SECONDS"] ?? "") ?? 40
        let observationSeconds = min(300, max(40, requestedSeconds))
        let deadline = Task {
            do { try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(observationSeconds)); session.stopFriends() } catch {}
        }
        let started = Date()
        await session.startFriends()
        var revision: UInt64 = 0
        var result: EpicFriendsSnapshot?
        var previous: [EpicFriend] = []
        var presenceChanges = 0
        while true {
            let snapshot = await session.nextFriends(afterRevision: revision)
            revision = snapshot.revision
            if snapshot.connection == .stopped { break }
            if snapshot.connection == .loading || snapshot.connection == .interrupted { continue }
            // Safe, opt-in live diagnostics: enums and counts only.
            print("Epic friends observation: elapsedMs=\(Int(Date().timeIntervalSince(started) * 1000)), connection=\(snapshot.connection), accepted=\(snapshot.friends.count), known=\(snapshot.friends.filter { $0.presence != .unknown }.count), online=\(snapshot.friends.filter { $0.presence == .online }.count), away=\(snapshot.friends.filter { $0.presence == .away || $0.presence == .extendedAway }.count), offline=\(snapshot.friends.filter { $0.presence == .offline }.count)")
            if result == nil { result = snapshot }
            else if snapshot.friends.contains(where: { current in
                previous.contains { $0.accountId == current.accountId &&
                    ($0.presence != current.presence || $0.activity != current.activity) }
            }) { presenceChanges += 1 }
            previous = snapshot.friends
            if snapshot.connection == .failed || snapshot.connection == .authenticationRequired { break }
        }
        deadline.cancel()
        session.shutdownObservers()
        await persistence.value
        let observed = try XCTUnwrap(result)
        // Counts and connection enums only. Do not log account/friend IDs, names or tokens.
        print("Epic friends live check: connection=\(observed.connection), accepted=\(observed.friends.count), named=\(observed.friends.filter { $0.displayName != nil }.count), knownPresence=\(observed.friends.filter { $0.presence != .unknown }.count), playing=\(observed.friends.filter { $0.activity != nil }.count), subsequentPresenceSnapshots=\(presenceChanges)")
        XCTAssertEqual(observed.connection, .ready, "Live Epic did not deliver an initial social snapshot")
        if ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["OBELISK_EPIC_FRIENDS_EXPECT_PRESENT"] == "1" {
            XCTAssertTrue(observed.friends.contains { $0.presence == .online || $0.presence == .away || $0.presence == .extendedAway || $0.presence == .busy }, "The controlled friend was not present in the first ready state")
        }
    }

    @MainActor
    func testEventsStayActiveAcrossModalCloseAndSocialRetryPreservesSession() async throws {
        let session = EpicFriendsTestSession()
        let model = epicFriendsModel(session)
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        await session.settled()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.friends.first?.displayName, "Alice")
        model.openFriends()
        model.closeFriends()
        session.publish(presence: .away, game: "Game A")
        await session.settled()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.friends.first?.activity?.name, "Game A")
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isFriendsPresented)
        model.openFriends()
        XCTAssertEqual(session.starts, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(session.maximumWaiters, 1)
        model.retryFriends()
        await session.waitForReconnect()
        await session.settled()
        XCTAssertEqual(session.reconnections, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(session.disconnects, 0)
        XCTAssertTrue(model.isConnected)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testSocialFailureKeepsLibraryAndUnknownCountIsExplicit() async {
        let session = EpicFriendsTestSession()
        let model = epicFriendsModel(session)
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        await session.settled()
        session.publish(presence: .unknown)
        await session.settled()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.onlineSummary, L10n.string("ui.friends.totalCount", Int64(1)))
        session.fail(.forbidden)
        await session.settled()
        XCTAssertTrue(model.isConnected)
        XCTAssertNil(model.errorMessage)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.friends.count, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.menuTitle, L10n.string("ui.friends.menuUnavailable"))
    }

    @MainActor
    func testCredentialRotationIsSavedWithoutAnyFriendEventAndHonorsRememberSetting() async {
        let session = EpicFriendsTestSession()
        let store = EpicFriendsTestStore()
        let model = epicFriendsModel(session, store: store)
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        await session.credentialsSettled()
        session.rotate("test-rotated")
        await session.credentialsSettled()
        let saved = await store.value
        XCTAssertEqual(saved?.refreshToken, "test-rotated")
        model.rememberSession = false
        session.rotate("test-not-remembered")
        await session.credentialsSettled()
        let removed = await store.value
        XCTAssertNil(removed)
        XCTAssertEqual(session.starts, 1)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testAccountChangeWaitsForRotatedCredentialWriteAndRejectsLateSocialData() async {
        let old = EpicFriendsTestSession()
        let replacement = EpicFriendsTestSession(accountID: "replacement-account")
        let store = EpicFriendsTestStore()
        let model = EpicModel(keychain: store, authorize: { "test-code" }, signIn: { _ in replacement },
                              restore: { _ in old })
        await model.start()
        await old.credentialsSettled()
        await store.holdNextSave()
        old.rotate("test-old-rotation")
        await store.waitForHeldSave()
        model.signOut()
        old.publish(presence: .online, game: "Obsolete game")
        model.signIn()
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isConnecting, "A new account must wait for the previous Keychain removal")
        XCTAssertNil(model.friends)
        await store.releaseSaveAndWaitForRemoval()
        // Removal wakes the storage task; allow its MainActor completion to clear sign-out.
        await drainMainQueue()
        model.signIn()
        await replacement.credentialsSettled()
        await replacement.settled()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.account.accountID, "replacement-account")
        let saved = await store.value
        XCTAssertEqual(saved?.accountId, "replacement-account")
        XCTAssertEqual(saved?.refreshToken, "test-initial")
        model.signOut()
    }

    @MainActor
    func testBothStoresUseOneAccountScopedModalIndependentOfSelection() async throws {
        let epicSession = EpicFriendsTestSession()
        let epic = epicFriendsModel(epicSession)
        let steamSession = FriendsBridgeTestSession(hydrated: true)
        let steam = friendsTestModel(session: steamSession)
        await epic.start()
        await steam.start()
        defer { epic.signOut(); steam.signOut() }
        await epicSession.settled()
        await steamSession.settle()
        let directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString)
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory) }
        let model = AppModel(directory: directory, steam: steam, epic: epic)
        let host = NSHostingView(rootView: RootView(model: model))
        let window = NSWindow(contentRect: NSRect(x: -20_000, y: -20_000, width: 860, height: 600), styleMask: .borderless, backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        window.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        window.contentView = host
        window.orderFront(nil)
        defer { window.close() }
        func settle() async {
            for _ in 0..<8 {
                await withCheckedContinuation { c in DispatchQueue.main.async { c.resume() } }
                host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
            }
        }
        func modals(_ view: NSView) -> [FriendsModalContainer] {
            (view as? FriendsModalContainer).map { [$0] } ?? view.subviews.flatMap(modals)
        }
        // The window presents the friends in a sheet.
        func modals() -> [FriendsModalContainer] { window.sheets.compactMap(\.contentView).flatMap(modals) }
        epic.openFriends()
        await settle()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.activeFriendsAccount?.storeID, "epic")
        try await eventually { modals().count == 1 }
        XCTAssertEqual(modals().first?.host.frame.width ?? 0, 520, accuracy: 1)
        model.selection = .settings
        epicSession.publish(presence: .online, game: "New game")
        await epicSession.settled()
        await settle()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.presentedFriends?.friends.first?.activity?.name, "New game")
        steam.openFriends()
        await settle()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.activeFriendsAccount?.storeID, "steam")
        XCTAssertFalse(epic.isFriendsPresented)
        try await eventually { modals().count == 1 }
        epic.signOut()
        await settle()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.presentedFriends?.account.storeID, "steam")
        XCTAssertTrue(steam.isConnected)
        XCTAssertEqual(epicSession.maximumWaiters, 1)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testSignOutClosesEpicModalAndRejectsOldAccountEvents() async throws {
        let session = EpicFriendsTestSession()
        let model = epicFriendsModel(session)
        await model.start()
        await session.settled()
        model.openFriends()
        model.signOut()
        session.publish(presence: .online, game: "Late game")
        await Task.yield()
        XCTAssertNil(model.friends)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isFriendsPresented)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isConnected)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testWakeAfterAnExpiredSessionDoesNotReconnectFriends() async throws {
        let session = EpicFriendsTestSession()
        let model = epicFriendsModel(session)
        await model.start()
        await session.settled()
        // As the wake observer does: a connected account reconnects.
        model.presence.retry()
        await session.waitForReconnect()
        await session.settled()
        let waiters = session.maximumWaiters
        session.expireNextGames()
        model.refresh()
        try await eventually { !model.isConnected }

        model.presence.retry()
        try await letAWakeReconnectRun()
        XCTAssertEqual(session.reconnections, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(session.maximumWaiters, waiters)
        XCTAssertNil(model.friends)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testWakeBeforeSignInStartsNothing() async throws {
        let session = EpicFriendsTestSession()
        let model = epicFriendsModel(session)
        model.presence.retry()
        try await letAWakeReconnectRun()
        XCTAssertEqual(session.starts, 0)
        XCTAssertEqual(session.reconnections, 0)
    }

    /// A wake's friends task starts on the main actor, then reaches the session
    /// off it: a test that expects nothing gives it the time to do something.
    @MainActor
    private func letAWakeReconnectRun() async throws {
        await drainMainQueue(times: 3)
        try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(50))
    }
}

@MainActor
func epicFriendsModel(_ session: EpicFriendsTestSession, store: EpicFriendsTestStore = EpicFriendsTestStore()) -> EpicModel {
    EpicModel(keychain: store, restore: { _ in session })
}

actor EpicFriendsTestStore: CredentialStore {
    private(set) var value: EpicCredentials? = EpicCredentials(accountId: "epic-account", displayName: "Epic fixture", refreshToken: "test-initial")
    func load() async throws -> EpicCredentials? { value }
    private var holdSave = false
    private var heldSave: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>?
    private var holdWaiter: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>?
    private var removalWaiter: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>?
    func save(_ value: EpicCredentials) async throws {
        if holdSave {
            holdSave = false
            await withCheckedContinuation { c in
                heldSave = c
                holdWaiter?.resume(); holdWaiter = nil
            }
        }
        self.value = value
    }
    func remove() async throws {
        value = nil
        removalWaiter?.resume(); removalWaiter = nil
    }
    func holdNextSave() { holdSave = true }
    func waitForHeldSave() async {
        if heldSave != nil { return }
        await withCheckedContinuation { holdWaiter = $0 }
    }
    func releaseSaveAndWaitForRemoval() async {
        await withCheckedContinuation { c in
            removalWaiter = c
            heldSave?.resume(); heldSave = nil
        }
    }
}

/// Atomic revision registration is deliberately controllable, without timers or a live account.
final class EpicFriendsTestSession: EpicSessionProtocol, @unchecked Sendable {
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var snapshot = EpicFriendsSnapshot(accountId: "epic-account", revision: 1, connection: .ready,
        friends: [EpicFriend(accountId: "alice", displayName: "Alice", avatarUrl: nil, presence: .online, activity: nil)], message: nil)
    private var saved = EpicCredentials(accountId: "epic-account", displayName: "Epic fixture", refreshToken: "test-initial")
    private var credentialRevision: UInt64 = 1
    private var credentialStopped = false
    private var friendWaiters: [CheckedContinuation<EpicFriendsSnapshot, Never>] = []
    private var credentialWaiters: [CheckedContinuation<UInt64?, Never>] = []
    private var friendBarriers: [CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>] = []
    private var credentialBarriers: [CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>] = []
    private var reconnectBarriers: [CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>] = []
    private var friendAfter: UInt64 = 0
    private var credentialAfter: UInt64 = 0
    private var startCount = 0, reconnectCount = 0, disconnectCount = 0, maximum = 0
    private var expireNext = false
    init(accountID: String = "epic-account") {
        snapshot.accountId = accountID
        saved.accountId = accountID
    }
    var starts: Int { lock.withLock { startCount } }
    var reconnections: Int { lock.withLock { reconnectCount } }
    var disconnects: Int { lock.withLock { disconnectCount } }
    var maximumWaiters: Int { lock.withLock { maximum } }
    func credentials() async throws -> EpicCredentials { lock.withLock { saved } }
    func games() async throws -> [EpicGame] {
        let expired = lock.withLock {
            let expired = expireNext
            expireNext = false
            return expired
        }
        if expired { throw EpicError.Unauthorized }
        return []
    }
    /// The next library request finds the account signed out.
    func expireNextGames() { lock.withLock { expireNext = true } }
    func playtimes() async throws -> [EpicPlaytime] { [] }
    func startFriends() async { lock.withLock { startCount += 1 } }
    func reconnectFriends() async {
        lock.withLock {
            reconnectCount += 1
            snapshot.revision += 1
            snapshot.connection = .ready
            reconnectBarriers.forEach { $0.resume() }; reconnectBarriers.removeAll()
        }
    }
    func waitForReconnect() async {
        await withCheckedContinuation { c in lock.withLock {
            if reconnectCount > 0 { c.resume() } else { reconnectBarriers.append(c) }
        } }
    }
    func friends() -> EpicFriendsSnapshot { lock.withLock { snapshot } }
    func nextFriends(afterRevision: UInt64) async -> EpicFriendsSnapshot {
        await withCheckedContinuation { c in lock.withLock {
            friendAfter = afterRevision
            if snapshot.revision != afterRevision || snapshot.connection == .stopped { c.resume(returning: snapshot) }
            else {
                friendWaiters.append(c); maximum = max(maximum, friendWaiters.count)
                friendBarriers.forEach { $0.resume() }; friendBarriers.removeAll()
            }
        } }
    }
    func settled() async {
        await withCheckedContinuation { c in lock.withLock {
            if friendAfter == snapshot.revision && !friendWaiters.isEmpty { c.resume() }
            else { friendBarriers.append(c) }
        } }
    }
    func credentialsSettled() async {
        await withCheckedContinuation { c in lock.withLock {
            if credentialAfter == credentialRevision && !credentialWaiters.isEmpty { c.resume() }
            else { credentialBarriers.append(c) }
        } }
    }
    func nextCredentialsRevision(afterRevision: UInt64) async -> UInt64? {
        await withCheckedContinuation { c in lock.withLock {
            credentialAfter = afterRevision
            if credentialStopped { c.resume(returning: nil) }
            else if afterRevision != credentialRevision { c.resume(returning: credentialRevision) }
            else {
                credentialWaiters.append(c)
                credentialBarriers.forEach { $0.resume() }; credentialBarriers.removeAll()
            }
        } }
    }
    func rotate(_ token: String) { lock.withLock {
        saved = EpicCredentials(accountId: saved.accountId, displayName: saved.displayName, refreshToken: token)
        credentialRevision += 1
        credentialWaiters.forEach { $0.resume(returning: credentialRevision) }; credentialWaiters.removeAll()
    } }
    func publish(presence: EpicFriendPresence, game: String? = nil) { lock.withLock {
        snapshot.friends = [EpicFriend(accountId: "alice", displayName: "Alice", avatarUrl: nil, presence: presence,
            activity: game.map { EpicFriendActivity(id: $0, name: $0) })]
        snapshot.revision += 1
        friendWaiters.forEach { $0.resume(returning: snapshot) }; friendWaiters.removeAll()
    } }
    func fail(_ connection: EpicFriendsConnection) { lock.withLock {
        snapshot.connection = connection
        snapshot.message = "backend.epic.friends.forbidden"
        snapshot.revision += 1
        friendWaiters.forEach { $0.resume(returning: snapshot) }; friendWaiters.removeAll()
    } }
    func stopFriends() { lock.withLock {
        snapshot.connection = .stopped; snapshot.revision += 1
        friendWaiters.forEach { $0.resume(returning: snapshot) }; friendWaiters.removeAll()
    } }
    func shutdownObservers() {
        stopFriends()
        lock.withLock {
            credentialStopped = true
            credentialWaiters.forEach { $0.resume(returning: nil) }; credentialWaiters.removeAll()
        }
    }
    func disconnect() async throws { shutdownObservers(); lock.withLock { disconnectCount += 1 } }
    func gameDetails(namespace: String, catalogItemId: String, appName: String) async throws -> EpicGameDetails { throw EpicError.InvalidResponse }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import AppKit
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

final class EpicIntegrationTests: XCTestCase {
    @MainActor
    func testArtworkSharesPendingDownloadAndKeepsItAfterOneConsumerCancels() async throws {
        let bitmap = try artworkBitmap()
        let gate = EpicArtworkTestLoader(results: [bitmap], holdFirst: true)
        let cache = ArtworkCache { _ in await gate.load() }
        let request = ArtworkCache.Request(url: URL(string: "https://artwork.invalid/cover.png")!, maxPixelSize: 768)
        let first = Task { await cache.image(for: request) }
        let second = Task { await cache.image(for: request) }
        for _ in 0..<100 {
            if await gate.isWaiting { break }
            try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(5))
        }
        let isWaiting = await gate.isWaiting
        XCTAssertTrue(isWaiting)
        first.cancel()
        await gate.release()
        let firstImage = await first.value
        let secondImage = await second.value
        let cached = cache.cachedImage(for: request)
        XCTAssertNotNil(firstImage)
        XCTAssertTrue(firstImage === secondImage)
        XCTAssertTrue(cached === secondImage, "The image must be available synchronously when the library returns")
        let again = await cache.image(for: request)
        XCTAssertTrue(again === cached)
        let calls = await gate.calls
        XCTAssertEqual(calls, 1)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testArtworkFailureCanRetryAndDifferentURLOrResolutionLoadsItsOwnImage() async throws {
        let bitmap = try artworkBitmap()
        let loader = EpicArtworkTestLoader(results: [nil, bitmap, bitmap, bitmap])
        let cache = ArtworkCache { _ in await loader.load() }
        let url = URL(string: "https://artwork.invalid/cover.png")!
        let request = ArtworkCache.Request(url: url, maxPixelSize: 768)
        let failed = await cache.image(for: request)
        XCTAssertNil(failed)
        XCTAssertNil(cache.cachedImage(for: request))
        let retried = await cache.image(for: request)
        XCTAssertNotNil(retried)
        let banner = await cache.image(for: ArtworkCache.Request(url: url, maxPixelSize: 2048))
        XCTAssertNotNil(banner)
        let changed = await cache.image(for: ArtworkCache.Request(url: url.appendingPathComponent("updated"), maxPixelSize: 768))
        XCTAssertNotNil(changed)
        let calls = await loader.calls
        XCTAssertEqual(calls, 4)
    }

    @MainActor
    private func artworkBitmap() throws -> CGImage {
        let context = try XCTUnwrap(CGContext(
            data: nil, width: 2, height: 2, bitsPerComponent: 8, bytesPerRow: 8,
            space: CGColorSpaceCreateDeviceRGB(), bitmapInfo: CGImageAlphaInfo.premultipliedLast.rawValue
        ))
        return try XCTUnwrap(context.makeImage())
    }

    func testPlaytimeFormattingDistinguishesZeroAndPositiveDurations() {
        XCTAssertEqual(GameFormatting.playtime(.zero), L10n.string("ui.game.never_played"))
        XCTAssertEqual(GameFormatting.playtime(.seconds(59)), "0 min")
        XCTAssertEqual(GameFormatting.playtime(.seconds(125)), "2 min")
        XCTAssertEqual(GameFormatting.playtime(.seconds(3600)), "1 h")
        let fractionalHours = 1.5.formatted(.number.precision(.fractionLength(0...1)).locale(L10n.locale))
        XCTAssertEqual(GameFormatting.playtime(.seconds(5400)), L10n.string("ui.game.playtime_hours", fractionalHours))
        XCTAssertFalse(GameFormatting.playtime(.seconds(Int64.max)).isEmpty)
    }

    func testEpicKeychainRoundTripUsesSeparateItemFromSteam() async throws {
        let service = "com.zagrios.obelisk.tests.\(UUID().uuidString)"
        let epic = EpicKeychain(service: service)
        let steam = SteamKeychain(service: service)

        XCTAssertNil(initial)

    }

    func testAuthorizationCodeParsingAcrossRustBridge() throws {

        XCTAssertEqual(try epicAuthorizationCode(input: "  \(code)\n"), code)
        XCTAssertEqual(try epicAuthorizationCode(input: "{\"authorizationCode\":\"\(code)\"}"), code)
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try epicAuthorizationCode(input: "{\"authorizationCode\":null}"))

    func testMalformedSavedSessionFailsWithoutExposingToken() async {

    func testEpicAvailabilityAcrossBridge() {

private actor EpicArtworkTestLoader {
    private var results: [CGImage?]
    private let holdFirst: Bool
    private var continuation: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>?
    private(set) var isWaiting = false
    private(set) var calls = 0

    init(results: [CGImage?], holdFirst: Bool = false) {
        self.results = results
        self.holdFirst = holdFirst
    }

    func load() async -> CGImage? {
        calls += 1
        if holdFirst && calls == 1 {
            await withCheckedContinuation { continuation = $0; isWaiting = true }
        }
        return results.isEmpty ? nil : results.removeFirst()
    }

    func release() { continuation?.resume(); continuation = nil; isWaiting = false }
}
```

```swift
import AppKit
import Network
import SwiftUI
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

final class EpicPresentationTests: XCTestCase {
    @MainActor
    func testLoadedArtworkSurvivesLibraryDetailAndReturnWithoutAnotherRequest() async throws {
        let bitmap = try XCTUnwrap(NSBitmapImageRep(
            bitmapDataPlanes: nil, pixelsWide: 24, pixelsHigh: 24, bitsPerSample: 8,
            samplesPerPixel: 4, hasAlpha: true, isPlanar: false,
            colorSpaceName: .deviceRGB, bytesPerRow: 0, bitsPerPixel: 0
        ))
        let artworkColor = NSColor(deviceRed: 0.1, green: 0.95, blue: 0.3, alpha: 1)
        for y in 0..<24 {
            for x in 0..<24 { bitmap.setColor(artworkColor, atX: x, y: y) }
        }
        let image = try XCTUnwrap(bitmap.representation(using: .png, properties: [:]))
        let server = try EpicArtworkHTTPServer(image: image)
        let url = try await server.start()
        defer { server.stop() }
        let game = EpicGame(
            appName: "cached-artwork", namespace: "presentation", catalogItemId: "cached-artwork",
            title: "Cached artwork", description: "", imageUrl: url.absoluteString,
            headerImageUrl: url.absoluteString, developer: "", windows: false, macos: false
        )
        let session = EpicPresentationSession(games: [game])
        let model = EpicModel(keychain: EpicPresentationCredentials(), restore: { _ in session })
        await model.start()
        let fixture = EpicPresentationWindow(EpicView(model: model), size: NSSize(width: 900, height: 700))
        defer { fixture.close() }
        var navigationPhase = "initial library"
        defer {
            XCTContext.runActivity(named: "Epic artwork navigation") { activity in
                activity.add(XCTAttachment(string: "phase=\(navigationPhase), imageRequests=\(server.requestCount), selectedGame=\(String(describing: model.selectedGame?.title))"))
                if let rendered = fixture.host.bitmapImageRepForCachingDisplay(in: fixture.host.bounds) {
                    fixture.host.cacheDisplay(in: fixture.host.bounds, to: rendered)
                    let image = NSImage(size: fixture.host.bounds.size)
                    image.addRepresentation(rendered)
                    activity.add(XCTAttachment(image: image))
                }
            }
        }

        func artworkIsRendered() -> Bool {
            fixture.layout()
            guard let rendered = fixture.host.bitmapImageRepForCachingDisplay(in: fixture.host.bounds) else { return false }
            fixture.host.cacheDisplay(in: fixture.host.bounds, to: rendered)
            var artworkPixels = 0
            for y in stride(from: 0, to: rendered.pixelsHigh, by: 8) {
                for x in stride(from: 0, to: rendered.pixelsWide, by: 8) {
                    guard let color = rendered.colorAt(x: x, y: y)?.usingColorSpace(.deviceRGB) else { continue }
                    if color.greenComponent > 0.75
                        && color.greenComponent - color.redComponent > 0.2
                        && color.greenComponent - color.blueComponent > 0.3 {
                        artworkPixels += 1
                    }
                }
            }
            return artworkPixels > 50
        }

        // Wait for the actual decoded image, so pending or cancelled downloads
        // cannot masquerade as a loaded library cover. The only game is the
        // library's hero too, which decodes the same artwork at its own size.
        try await eventually {
            fixture.layout()
            return self.searchFrame(in: fixture.host) != nil && artworkIsRendered() && server.requestCount == 2
        }
        let libraryRequests = server.requestCount
        XCTAssertEqual(libraryRequests, 2, "One request for the cover, one for the hero")

        model.open(game)
        navigationPhase = "detail"
        try await eventually {
            fixture.layout()
            return self.searchFrame(in: fixture.host) == nil && artworkIsRendered()
        }
        let detailRequests = server.requestCount

        model.closeGame()
        navigationPhase = "returned library"
        try await eventually {
            fixture.layout()
            return self.searchFrame(in: fixture.host) != nil && artworkIsRendered()
        }
        let returnRequests = server.requestCount

        XCTAssertEqual(returnRequests, detailRequests, "Returning to Epic's library must reuse its already loaded cover")
        let gameCalls = await session.gameCalls
        XCTAssertEqual(gameCalls, 1, "Artwork navigation must not reload the Epic library")
    }

    @MainActor
    func testMountedDetailRendersItsPlaytimeAndArrivingSize() async throws {
        let details = EpicGameDetails(platform: .windows, installationBytes: 2_000_000_000)
        let session = EpicPresentationSession(
            games: epicPresentationLibrary, details: details, holdDetails: true,
            playtimes: [EpicPlaytime(appName: epicPresentationLibrary[0].appName, seconds: 5400)]
        )
        let model = EpicModel(keychain: EpicPresentationCredentials(), restore: { _ in session })
        await model.start()
        model.open(epicPresentationLibrary[0])
        let fixture = EpicPresentationWindow(EpicView(model: model), size: NSSize(width: 900, height: 700))
        defer { fixture.close() }
        try await eventually { await session.waitingForDetails }
        fixture.layout()
        try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(50))
        fixture.layout()

        func renderedImage() throws -> Data {
            let bitmap = try XCTUnwrap(fixture.host.bitmapImageRepForCachingDisplay(in: fixture.host.bounds))
            fixture.host.cacheDisplay(in: fixture.host.bounds, to: bitmap)
            return try XCTUnwrap(bitmap.representation(using: .png, properties: [:]))
        }
        let pending = try renderedImage()
        await session.releaseDetails()
        try await eventually { !model.isLoadingGameDetails }
        try await eventually {
            fixture.layout()
            guard let rendered = try? renderedImage() else { return false }
            return rendered != pending
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.selectedGameDetails, details)

        // SwiftUI text can be absent from an offscreen host's accessibility tree.
        // The rendered bitmap above still checks that the mounted view updates.
        if accessibilityElement(in: fixture.host, label: L10n.string("ui.game.metric.playtime")) != nil {
            XCTAssertNotNil(accessibilityElement(in: fixture.host, label: GameFormatting.playtime(.seconds(5400))))
            XCTAssertNotNil(accessibilityElement(in: fixture.host, label: GameFormatting.bytes(2_000_000_000)))
            XCTAssertNil(accessibilityElement(in: fixture.host, label: L10n.string("ui.game.metric.last_played")))
            XCTAssertNil(accessibilityElement(in: fixture.host, label: L10n.string("ui.game.news")))
        }
    }

    @MainActor
    func testMountedViewShowsRestoredLibraryWithoutSwitchingTabs() async throws {
        try await verifyLibraryArrival(restoring: true)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testMountedViewShowsNewlySignedInLibraryWithoutSwitchingTabs() async throws {
        try await verifyLibraryArrival(restoring: false)
    }

    @MainActor
    private func verifyLibraryArrival(restoring: Bool) async throws {
        let store = EpicPresentationCredentials(restoring ? epicPresentationCredentials : nil)
        let session = EpicPresentationSession(games: epicPresentationLibrary, holdGames: true)
        let model = EpicModel(
            keychain: store,
            authorize: { "fixture-browser-code" },
            signIn: { _ in session },
            restore: { _ in session }
        )
        let size = NSSize(width: 900, height: 700)
        // Mount before .task restores credentials, exactly as opening the Epic
        // tab does. Building the host after model.start() hides this regression.
        let fixture = EpicPresentationWindow(EpicView(model: model), size: size)
        defer { fixture.close() }
        fixture.layout()
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isConnected)

        if !restoring {
            try await eventually {
                let loads = await store.loads
                return loads == 1 && !model.isRestoring
            }
            fixture.layout()
            model.signIn()
        }
        try await eventually { await session.waitingForGames }
        fixture.layout()
        XCTAssertTrue(model.isConnected)
        XCTAssertTrue(model.isLoadingGames)
        XCTAssertTrue(model.library.games.isEmpty)
        await session.releaseGames()
        try await eventually { !model.isLoadingGames && model.library.games.count == epicPresentationLibrary.count }

        // This second host is a control for the reported workaround: mounting a
        // new tab after data arrived shows the grid even if the old host is stale.
        let remounted = EpicPresentationWindow(EpicView(model: model), size: size)
        defer { remounted.close() }
        try await eventually {
            remounted.layout()
            guard let scroll = firstScrollView(in: remounted.host), let document = scroll.documentView else { return false }
            return self.searchFrame(in: remounted.host) != nil
                && document.frame.height > scroll.contentView.bounds.height
        }
        let expectedHeight = try XCTUnwrap(firstScrollView(in: remounted.host)?.documentView).frame.height

        // Check AppKit output, not only the populated model. The pending login
        // and empty-library screens are both short and have no game-card grid.
        let deadline = ContinuousClock.now + .seconds(3)
        var libraryVisible = false
        repeat {
            fixture.layout()
            if let scroll = firstScrollView(in: fixture.host), let document = scroll.documentView {
                libraryVisible = searchFrame(in: fixture.host) != nil
                    && document.frame.height > scroll.contentView.bounds.height
                    && abs(document.frame.height - expectedHeight) < 1
            }
            if libraryVisible { break }
            try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(5))
        } while ContinuousClock.now < deadline

        if !libraryVisible {
            XCTContext.runActivity(named: restoring ? "Stale view after Epic restoration" : "Stale view after Epic sign-in") { activity in
                let actualHeight = firstScrollView(in: fixture.host)?.documentView?.frame.height
                activity.add(XCTAttachment(string: "games=\(model.library.games.count), connected=\(model.isConnected), loading=\(model.isLoadingGames), mountedDocumentHeight=\(String(describing: actualHeight)), remountedDocumentHeight=\(expectedHeight), mountedSearch=\(String(describing: searchFrame(in: fixture.host)))"))
                if let bitmap = fixture.host.bitmapImageRepForCachingDisplay(in: fixture.host.bounds) {
                    fixture.host.cacheDisplay(in: fixture.host.bounds, to: bitmap)
                    let image = NSImage(size: fixture.host.bounds.size)
                    image.addRepresentation(bitmap)
                    let attachment = XCTAttachment(image: image)
                    attachment.name = restoring ? "epic-restoration-stale-host" : "epic-sign-in-stale-host"
                    attachment.lifetime = .keepAlways
                    activity.add(attachment)
                }
            }
        }
        XCTAssertTrue(libraryVisible, "The mounted Epic tab must render the arriving games without changing tabs or the search query")
        XCTAssertEqual(model.library.searchText, "")
        XCTAssertNil(model.selectedGame)
        XCTAssertNil(model.errorMessage)
        let gameCalls = await session.gameCalls
        XCTAssertEqual(gameCalls, 1)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testScrollbarAndContentWidthSurviveLibraryDetailAndReturn() async throws {
        for size in [NSSize(width: 900, height: 700), NSSize(width: 903, height: 728)] {
            let session = EpicPresentationSession(games: epicPresentationLibrary)
            let model = EpicModel(keychain: EpicPresentationCredentials(), restore: { _ in session })
            await model.start()
            let fixture = EpicPresentationWindow(EpicView(model: model), size: size)
            defer { fixture.close() }

            try await eventually {
                fixture.layout()
                guard let scroll = firstScrollView(in: fixture.host), let document = scroll.documentView else { return false }
                return document.frame.height > scroll.contentView.bounds.height
            }
            // The library and a game's page each keep their own scroll view,
            // whose scrollbar floats over the artwork. Neither changes its width.
            let library = try StableScroller(in: fixture.host)
            XCTAssertEqual(library.width, size.width, accuracy: 0.5, "The library's covers reach under its scrollbar")
            let searchFrameBefore = try XCTUnwrap(searchFrame(in: fixture.host))

            try library.assertKept(in: fixture.host, during: "the full library")

            model.library.searchText = epicPresentationLibrary[0].title
            try await eventually {
                fixture.layout()
                guard let document = library.scroll.documentView else { return false }
                return document.frame.height <= library.scroll.contentView.bounds.height
            }
            try library.assertKept(in: fixture.host, during: "the filtered library")
            let filteredSearch = try XCTUnwrap(searchFrame(in: fixture.host))
            // The clear button takes space at the field's right edge once text exists.
            XCTAssertEqual(filteredSearch.minX, searchFrameBefore.minX, accuracy: 0.5, "Filtering must not move the search field horizontally")

            model.open(epicPresentationLibrary[0])
            try await eventually {
                fixture.layout()
                guard let current = firstScrollView(in: fixture.host) else { return false }
                return current !== library.scroll
            }
            let detail = try StableScroller(in: fixture.host, width: size.width)
            try detail.assertKept(in: fixture.host, during: "the game detail")
            XCTAssertNil(searchFrame(in: fixture.host), "A game's page has no search")

            model.closeGame()
            model.library.searchText = ""
            try await eventually {
                fixture.layout()
                guard let current = firstScrollView(in: fixture.host), let document = current.documentView else { return false }
                return model.selectedGame == nil && current !== detail.scroll
                    && document.frame.height > current.contentView.bounds.height
            }
            let returned = try StableScroller(in: fixture.host, width: library.width)
            try returned.assertKept(in: fixture.host, during: "returning to the full library")
            let returnedSearch = try XCTUnwrap(searchFrame(in: fixture.host))
            XCTAssertEqual(returnedSearch.maxX, searchFrameBefore.maxX, accuracy: 0.5)
            XCTAssertTrue(returned.scroller.target === returned.scroll)
            XCTAssertNotNil(returned.scroller.action)
            let gameCalls = await session.gameCalls
            XCTAssertEqual(gameCalls, 1, "Opening a cached game and returning must not reload the library")
        }
    }

    @MainActor
    func testHeaderAndSearchStayFixedWhileLibraryCardsScroll() async throws {
        let session = EpicPresentationSession(games: epicPresentationLibrary)
        let model = EpicModel(keychain: EpicPresentationCredentials(), restore: { _ in session })
        await model.start()
        let fixture = EpicPresentationWindow(EpicView(model: model), size: NSSize(width: 900, height: 700))
        defer { fixture.close() }
        try await eventually {
            fixture.layout()
            guard let scroll = firstScrollView(in: fixture.host), let document = scroll.documentView else { return false }
            return document.frame.height > scroll.contentView.bounds.height
                && self.searchFrame(in: fixture.host) != nil
                && self.nativeViewFrame(in: fixture.host, identifier: "storefront-titlebar-drag-region") != nil
        }
        let scroll = try XCTUnwrap(firstScrollView(in: fixture.host))
        let scroller = try XCTUnwrap(scroll.verticalScroller)
        let document = try XCTUnwrap(scroll.documentView)
        let headerBefore = try XCTUnwrap(nativeViewFrame(in: fixture.host, identifier: "storefront-titlebar-drag-region"))
        let searchBefore = try XCTUnwrap(searchFrame(in: fixture.host))
        let contentBefore = document.convert(NSPoint.zero, to: fixture.host)
        let offsetBefore = scroll.contentView.bounds.origin.y
        let offset = min(CGFloat(180), document.frame.height - scroll.contentView.bounds.height)
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(offset, 100, "The fixture must contain enough cards to scroll behind the header")

        scroll.contentView.scroll(to: NSPoint(x: 0, y: offsetBefore + offset))
        scroll.reflectScrolledClipView(scroll.contentView)
        try await eventually {
            fixture.layout()
            return abs(scroll.contentView.bounds.origin.y - offsetBefore - offset) < 0.5
        }
        let headerAfter = try XCTUnwrap(nativeViewFrame(in: fixture.host, identifier: "storefront-titlebar-drag-region"))
        let searchAfter = try XCTUnwrap(searchFrame(in: fixture.host))
        let contentAfter = document.convert(NSPoint.zero, to: fixture.host)

        for (name, before, after) in [("Header drag region", headerBefore, headerAfter), ("Search field", searchBefore, searchAfter)] {
            XCTAssertEqual(after.minX, before.minX, accuracy: 0.5, "\(name) moved horizontally while scrolling")
            XCTAssertEqual(after.minY, before.minY, accuracy: 0.5, "\(name) scrolled with the game cards")
            XCTAssertEqual(after.width, before.width, accuracy: 0.5)
            XCTAssertEqual(after.height, before.height, accuracy: 0.5)
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(abs(contentAfter.y - contentBefore.y), offset, accuracy: 0.5, "The game-card document must move underneath the fixed controls")
        XCTAssertTrue(firstScrollView(in: fixture.host) === scroll)
        XCTAssertTrue(scroll.verticalScroller === scroller, "Scrolling must keep the same scrollbar")
        XCTAssertEqual(scroll.scrollerStyle, .overlay, "The library's scrollbar floats over its covers")
        XCTAssertEqual(model.library.searchText, "")
        let gameCalls = await session.gameCalls
        XCTAssertEqual(gameCalls, 1)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testRenderFixtureLibraryAndDetailWhenRequested() async throws {

    @MainActor
    private func render(_ model: EpicModel, to file: URL, colorScheme: ColorScheme = .dark, scrollOffset: CGFloat = 0, width: CGFloat = 900) async throws {
        let view = EpicView(model: model)
            .environment(\.colorScheme, colorScheme)
            .tint(ObeliskStyle.accent)
            .background(ObeliskPalette(colorScheme: colorScheme).background)
        let fixture = EpicPresentationWindow(view, size: NSSize(width: width, height: 1000))
        defer { fixture.close() }
        fixture.layout()
        try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(200))
        fixture.layout()
        if scrollOffset > 0 {
            let scroll = try XCTUnwrap(firstScrollView(in: fixture.host))
            scroll.contentView.scroll(to: NSPoint(x: 0, y: scrollOffset))
            scroll.reflectScrolledClipView(scroll.contentView)
            fixture.layout()
            try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(100))
            fixture.layout()
        }
        let bitmap = try XCTUnwrap(fixture.host.bitmapImageRepForCachingDisplay(in: fixture.host.bounds))
        fixture.host.cacheDisplay(in: fixture.host.bounds, to: bitmap)
        var luminances: [Double] = []
        for y in stride(from: 0, to: bitmap.pixelsHigh, by: 8) {
            for x in stride(from: 0, to: bitmap.pixelsWide, by: 8) {
                if let color = bitmap.colorAt(x: x, y: y)?.usingColorSpace(.deviceRGB) {
                    luminances.append(Double(0.2126 * color.redComponent + 0.7152 * color.greenComponent + 0.0722 * color.blueComponent))
                }
            }
        }
        let count = Double(max(luminances.count, 1))
        let mean = luminances.reduce(0, +) / count
        let variance = luminances.reduce(0) { $0 + ($1 - mean) * ($1 - mean) } / count
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(variance, 0.002, "The rendered preview must contain visible content")
        guard variance > 0.002 else { throw EpicPresentationFailure.emptyPreview }
        try XCTUnwrap(bitmap.representation(using: .png, properties: [:])).write(to: file)
    }

    @MainActor
    private func searchFrame(in root: NSView) -> NSRect? {
        if let frame = accessibilityFrame(in: root, label: L10n.string("ui.search.store_library", L10n.string("ui.store.epic"))), frame.width > 0 {
            return frame
        }
        // A plain SwiftUI Menu can exist only in the external accessibility
        // tree. Its neighboring TextField still has a native editable control,
        // so measure that real field when virtual labels are absent in-process.
        func field(in view: NSView) -> NSTextField? {
            if let textField = view as? NSTextField, textField.isEditable, textField.placeholderString == L10n.string("ui.search.placeholder") {
                return textField
            }
            return view.subviews.lazy.compactMap { field(in: $0) }.first
        }
        guard let search = field(in: root), let window = search.window else { return nil }
        return window.convertToScreen(search.convert(search.bounds, to: nil))
    }

    @MainActor
    private func nativeViewFrame(in root: NSView, identifier: String) -> NSRect? {
        if root.identifier?.rawValue == identifier, let window = root.window {
            return window.convertToScreen(root.convert(root.bounds, to: nil))
        }
        return root.subviews.lazy.compactMap { self.nativeViewFrame(in: $0, identifier: identifier) }.first
    }

    @MainActor
    private func accessibilityFrame(in root: Any, label: String) -> NSRect? {
        guard let element = accessibilityElement(in: root, label: label),
              element.responds(to: NSSelectorFromString("accessibilityFrame")),
              let frame = element.value(forKey: "accessibilityFrame") as? NSValue else { return nil }
        return frame.rectValue
    }

    @MainActor
    private func accessibilityElement(in root: Any, label: String, depth: Int = 0) -> NSObject? {
        guard depth < 30, let element = root as? NSObject else { return nil }
        func attribute(_ key: String) -> Any? {
            element.responds(to: NSSelectorFromString(key)) ? element.value(forKey: key) : nil
        }
        let names = ["accessibilityLabel", "accessibilityTitle", "accessibilityValue"].compactMap { attribute($0) as? String }
        if names.contains(label) { return element }
        let children = (attribute("accessibilityChildren") as? [Any] ?? [])
            + (attribute("accessibilityChildrenInNavigationOrder") as? [Any] ?? [])
            + ((root as? NSView)?.subviews ?? [])
        for child in children {
            if let match = accessibilityElement(in: child, label: label, depth: depth + 1) { return match }
        }
        return nil
    }

    @MainActor
    private func eventually(_ predicate: @MainActor () async -> Bool) async throws {
        let deadline = ContinuousClock.now + .seconds(3)
        while !(await predicate()) {
            if ContinuousClock.now >= deadline { throw EpicPresentationFailure.timeout }
            try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(5))
        }
    }
}

@MainActor
struct EpicPresentationWindow {
    let host: NSView
    private let window: NSWindow

    init<Content: View>(_ content: Content, size: NSSize) {
        host = NSHostingView(rootView: content.frame(width: size.width, height: size.height))
        let rect = NSRect(x: -20_000, y: -20_000, width: size.width, height: size.height)
        window = NSWindow(contentRect: rect, styleMask: .borderless, backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        window.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        window.sharingType = .none
        window.contentView = host
        window.setFrameOrigin(rect.origin)
        window.orderBack(nil)
    }

    func layout() {
        host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
        window.displayIfNeeded()
    }

    func close() { window.close() }

    var sheetContent: NSView? { window.sheets.first?.contentView }
}

private actor EpicPresentationCredentials: CredentialStore {
    private var value: EpicCredentials?
    private(set) var loads = 0
    init(_ value: EpicCredentials? = epicPresentationCredentials) { self.value = value }
    func load() -> EpicCredentials? { loads += 1; return value }
    func save(_ credentials: EpicCredentials) { value = credentials }
    func remove() { value = nil }
}

private actor EpicPresentationSession: EpicSessionProtocol {
    func startFriends() async {}
    func reconnectFriends() async {}
    nonisolated func stopFriends() {}
    nonisolated func shutdownObservers() { credentialRevisions.stop() }
    nonisolated func friends() -> EpicFriendsSnapshot {
        EpicFriendsSnapshot(accountId: "unused", revision: 1, connection: .stopped, friends: [], message: nil)
    }
    func nextFriends(afterRevision: UInt64) async -> EpicFriendsSnapshot { friends() }
    nonisolated let credentialRevisions = EpicCredentialRevisionFeed()
    func nextCredentialsRevision(afterRevision: UInt64) async -> UInt64? {
        await credentialRevisions.next(after: afterRevision)
    }

    private let library: [EpicGame]
    private let details: EpicGameDetails
    private let achievementItems: [LibraryAchievement]
    private let playtimeItems: [EpicPlaytime]
    private var shouldHoldDetails: Bool
    private var detailsContinuation: CheckedContinuation<EpicGameDetails, Never>?
    private(set) var waitingForDetails = false
    private var shouldHoldGames: Bool
    private var gamesContinuation: CheckedContinuation<[EpicGame], Never>?
    private(set) var waitingForGames = false
    private(set) var gameCalls = 0

    init(
        games: [EpicGame],
        holdGames: Bool = false,
        details: EpicGameDetails = EpicGameDetails(platform: nil, installationBytes: nil),
        holdDetails: Bool = false,
        playtimes: [EpicPlaytime] = [],
        achievements: [LibraryAchievement] = []
    ) {
        library = games
        playtimeItems = playtimes
        shouldHoldGames = holdGames
        self.details = details
        shouldHoldDetails = holdDetails
        achievementItems = achievements
    }
    func achievements(namespace: String, locale: String, fresh: Bool) async throws -> [LibraryAchievement] {
        achievementItems
    }
    func credentials() -> EpicCredentials { epicPresentationCredentials }
    func prepare() -> EpicCredentials { epicPresentationCredentials }
    func gameDetails(namespace: String, catalogItemId: String, appName: String) async -> EpicGameDetails {
        if shouldHoldDetails {
            shouldHoldDetails = false
            waitingForDetails = true
            let result = await withCheckedContinuation { detailsContinuation = $0 }
            waitingForDetails = false
            return result
        }
        return details
    }
    func releaseDetails() {
        detailsContinuation?.resume(returning: details)
        detailsContinuation = nil
    }
    func playtimes() async throws -> [EpicPlaytime] { playtimeItems }
    func games() async -> [EpicGame] {
        gameCalls += 1
        if shouldHoldGames {
            shouldHoldGames = false
            waitingForGames = true
            return await withCheckedContinuation { gamesContinuation = $0 }
        }
        return library
    }
    func releaseGames() {
        shouldHoldGames = false
        waitingForGames = false
        gamesContinuation?.resume(returning: library)
        gamesContinuation = nil
    }
    func disconnect() {}
}

private let epicPresentationCredentials = EpicCredentials(accountId: "epic-presentation", displayName: "Test account", refreshToken: "fixture-only-never-sent")
private let epicPresentationLibrary: [EpicGame] = (0..<24).map { index in
    EpicGame(appName: "fixture-\(index)", namespace: "presentation", catalogItemId: "catalog-\(index)", title: index == 0 ? "Forgotten light" : "Test game \(index)", description: "", imageUrl: nil, headerImageUrl: nil, developer: "", windows: false, macos: false)
}
private enum EpicPresentationFailure: Error { case timeout, emptyPreview }

// A real loopback response exercises SwiftUI's image loader without changing
// URLSession globals or touching an Epic account. Disabling HTTP caching makes
// this check cover decoded-image reuse, independent of server cache headers.
private final class EpicArtworkHTTPServer: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let listener: NWListener
    private let queue = DispatchQueue(label: "ObeliskTests.EpicArtworkHTTPServer")
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var requests = 0
    private let response: Data

    init(image: Data) throws {
        listener = try NWListener(using: .tcp, on: .any)
        let headers = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: image/png\r\nContent-Length: \(image.count)\r\nCache-Control: no-store\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
        response = Data(headers.utf8) + image
    }

    var requestCount: Int { lock.withLock { requests } }

    func start() async throws -> URL {
        try await withCheckedThrowingContinuation { continuation in
            listener.stateUpdateHandler = { [self] state in
                switch state {
                case .ready:
                    listener.stateUpdateHandler = nil
                    guard let port = listener.port,
                          let url = URL(string: "http://127.0.0.1:\(port.rawValue)/\(UUID().uuidString).png") else {
                        continuation.resume(throwing: EpicPresentationFailure.timeout)
                        return
                    }
                    continuation.resume(returning: url)
                case .failed(let error):
                    listener.stateUpdateHandler = nil
                    continuation.resume(throwing: error)
                default: break
                }
            }
            listener.newConnectionHandler = { [self] connection in
                connection.start(queue: queue)
                receiveRequest(connection)
            }
            listener.start(queue: queue)
        }
    }

    func stop() {
        listener.newConnectionHandler = nil
        listener.cancel()
    }

    private func receiveRequest(_ connection: NWConnection, accumulated: Data = Data()) {
        connection.receive(minimumIncompleteLength: 1, maximumLength: 16_384) { [self] data, _, complete, error in
            let request = accumulated + (data ?? Data())
            if request.range(of: Data("\r\n\r\n".utf8)) != nil {
                lock.withLock { requests += 1 }
                connection.send(content: response, completion: .contentProcessed { _ in connection.cancel() })
            } else if complete || error != nil {
                connection.cancel()
            } else {
                receiveRequest(connection, accumulated: request)
            }
        }
    }
}
```
