```swift
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

@MainActor
final class EpicRememberedSessionTests: XCTestCase {
    func testEveryRotationIsSavedWithoutAnyCallAskingForIt() async throws {
        let store = EpicMemoryStore(nil)
        let session = EpicTestSession(credentials: EpicGames.credentials("initial"), games: [])
        let remembered = await activated(store, session)
        let initial = await store.value
        XCTAssertEqual(initial?.refreshToken, "initial", "the account is saved before it is used")
        await session.rotate(EpicGames.credentials("background-rotation"))
        try await eventually { await store.value?.refreshToken == "background-rotation" }
        XCTAssertFalse(session.credentialRevisions.isStopped)
        await remembered.forget().value
    }

    func testARotationDuringAHeldWriteResolvesTheLatestToken() async throws {
        let store = EpicMemoryStore(nil)
        let session = EpicTestSession(credentials: EpicGames.credentials("initial"), games: [])
        let remembered = await activated(store, session)
        try await eventually { session.credentialRevisions.isWaiting }

        await store.holdNextSave()
        await session.rotate(EpicGames.credentials("held"))
        try await eventually { await store.waitingForSave }
        await session.rotate(EpicGames.credentials("latest"))
        await store.completeSave()
        try await eventually { await store.value?.refreshToken == "latest" }
        try await eventually { session.credentialRevisions.isWaiting }
        let writes = await store.writes.compactMap { $0?.refreshToken }
        let held = try XCTUnwrap(writes.firstIndex(of: "held"))
        XCTAssertEqual(writes.last, "latest")
        XCTAssertTrue(writes.suffix(from: held + 1).allSatisfy { $0 == "latest" })
        await remembered.forget().value
    }

    func testAForgottenSessionsLateRotationCannotOverwriteTheReplacementAccount() async throws {
        // Reuse the same account ID to prove isolation follows the session lifetime.
        let store = EpicMemoryStore(nil)
        let old = EpicTestSession(credentials: EpicGames.credentials("old"), games: [])
        let replacement = EpicTestSession(credentials: EpicGames.credentials("replacement"), games: [])
        let remembered = await activated(store, old)
        try await eventually { old.credentialRevisions.isWaiting }
        await store.holdNextSave()
        await old.rotate(EpicGames.credentials("old-held"))
        try await eventually { await store.waitingForSave }
        let removal = remembered.forget()
        XCTAssertTrue(old.credentialRevisions.isStopped)
        await store.completeSave()
        await removal.value
        let removed = await store.value
        XCTAssertNil(removed)
        await remembered.activate(rotating: EpicGames.rotating(replacement), accountID: EpicGames.fixtureAccount)
        await old.rotate(EpicGames.credentials("old-late"))
        try await eventually { replacement.credentialRevisions.isWaiting }
        let saved = await store.value
        let writes = await store.writes
        let removalIndex = try XCTUnwrap(writes.firstIndex(where: { $0 == nil }))
        XCTAssertEqual(saved?.refreshToken, "replacement")
        XCTAssertTrue(writes.suffix(from: removalIndex + 1).allSatisfy { $0?.refreshToken == "replacement" })
        let disconnections = await old.disconnections
        XCTAssertEqual(disconnections, 0, "Storage invalidation must not revoke OAuth")
        await remembered.forget().value
    }

    func testRememberChangesWhileWriteIsHeldApplyToLatestRevision() async throws {
        let store = EpicMemoryStore(nil)
        let session = EpicTestSession(credentials: EpicGames.credentials("initial"), games: [])
        let remembered = await activated(store, session)
        try await eventually { session.credentialRevisions.isWaiting }
        await store.holdNextSave()
        await session.rotate(EpicGames.credentials("held"))
        try await eventually { await store.waitingForSave }
        remembered.rememberSession = false
        await session.rotate(EpicGames.credentials("unremembered"))
        await store.completeSave()
        try await eventually { await store.value == nil }
        try await eventually { session.credentialRevisions.isWaiting }
        let removed = await store.value
        XCTAssertNil(removed)
        XCTAssertFalse(session.credentialRevisions.isStopped)
        remembered.rememberSession = true
        try await eventually { await store.value?.refreshToken == "unremembered" }
        await remembered.forget().value
    }

    func testAStorageFailureWarnsUntilTheNextRotationIsSaved() async throws {
        let store = EpicMemoryStore(nil)
        await store.rejectSaves()
        let session = EpicTestSession(credentials: EpicGames.credentials("initial"), games: [])
        let remembered = await activated(store, session)
        XCTAssertNotNil(remembered.storageWarning)
        try await eventually { session.credentialRevisions.isWaiting }
        await store.rejectSaves(false)
        await session.rotate(EpicGames.credentials("recovered"))
        try await eventually { session.credentialRevisions.isWaiting && remembered.storageWarning == nil }
        let saved = await store.value
        XCTAssertEqual(saved?.refreshToken, "recovered")
        await remembered.forget().value
    }

    func testMismatchedAccountCredentialsAreNeverWritten() async throws {
        let store = EpicMemoryStore(nil)
        let session = EpicTestSession(credentials: EpicGames.credentials("initial"), games: [])
        let remembered = await activated(store, session)
        try await eventually { session.credentialRevisions.isWaiting }
        await session.rotate(EpicGames.credentials("wrong-account", account: "other"))
        try await eventually { remembered.storageWarning != nil }
        let saved = await store.value
        XCTAssertEqual(saved?.refreshToken, "initial")
        await remembered.forget().value
    }

    func testReleasingModuleStopsObservationWithoutRevokingSessionOrRemovingCredentials() async throws {
        let store = EpicMemoryStore(nil)
        let session = EpicTestSession(credentials: EpicGames.credentials("initial"), games: [])
        var remembered: RememberedSession<EpicCredentials>? = await activated(store, session)
        try await eventually { session.credentialRevisions.isWaiting }
        weak var released = remembered
        remembered = nil
        try await eventually { released == nil && session.credentialRevisions.isStopped }
        let saved = await store.value
        let disconnections = await session.disconnections
        XCTAssertEqual(saved?.refreshToken, "initial")
        XCTAssertEqual(disconnections, 0)
    }

    /// The store's remembered session, once it saves `session`'s fixture account.
    private func activated(_ store: EpicMemoryStore, _ session: EpicTestSession) async -> RememberedSession<EpicCredentials> {
        let remembered = RememberedSession(keychain: store, accountID: EpicGames.accountID,
                                           notSaved: EpicGames.sessionNotSaved)
        await remembered.activate(rotating: EpicGames.rotating(session), accountID: EpicGames.fixtureAccount)
        return remembered
    }
}

/// Scripted watch shared by model, download and presentation sessions.
final class EpicCredentialRevisionFeed: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var revision: UInt64 = 1
    private var stopped = false
    private var waiters: [CheckedContinuation<UInt64?, Never>] = []

    var isWaiting: Bool { lock.withLock { !waiters.isEmpty } }
    var isStopped: Bool { lock.withLock { stopped } }

    func next(after: UInt64) async -> UInt64? {
        await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
            lock.withLock {
                if stopped { continuation.resume(returning: nil) }
                else if after != revision { continuation.resume(returning: revision) }
                else { waiters.append(continuation) }
            }
        }
    }

    func publish() {
        lock.withLock {
            revision += 1
            waiters.forEach { $0.resume(returning: revision) }
            waiters.removeAll()
        }
    }

    func stop() {
        lock.withLock {
            stopped = true
            waiters.forEach { $0.resume(returning: nil) }
            waiters.removeAll()
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
@MainActor
final class EpicWebAuthenticationTests: XCTestCase {
    func testWebKitNavigationReturnsCodeAndClosesWindowBeforeLocalhostLoads() async throws {
        let attempt = WebAuthentication(.epic)
        var loginWindow: NSWindow?
        let completed = expectation(description: "Epic callback intercepted")
        let task = Task {
            defer { completed.fulfill() }
            return try await attempt.authorize { webView in
                loginWindow = webView.window
                webView.loadHTMLString("""
                    <html><body><script>
                    window.location.href = 'https://localhost/launcher/authorized?code=fixture-code';
                    </script></body></html>
                    """, baseURL: nil)
            }
        }
        await fulfillment(of: [completed], timeout: 10)
        // Also prevents a regression from leaving the test suspended forever.
        task.cancel()
        let code = try await task.value
        XCTAssertEqual(code, "fixture-code")
        XCTAssertNotNil(loginWindow)
        XCTAssertEqual(loginWindow?.isVisible, false)
    }

                webView.loadHTMLString("<html><body><pre>{\"authorizationCode\":\"fixture-json\"}</pre></body></html>", baseURL: url)
            }
        }
        await fulfillment(of: [completed], timeout: 10)
        task.cancel()

                    <html><body><script>
                    const popup = window.open('about:blank');
                    popup.location.href = 'https://localhost/launcher/authorized?code=fixture-popup';
                    </script></body></html>
                    """, baseURL: nil)
            }
        }
        await fulfillment(of: [completed], timeout: 10)
        task.cancel()
        let code = try await task.value
```

```swift
import Foundation
@testable import Obelisk

/// The download queue as Rust would publish it, driven by the test. Rust's
/// own suite covers its order; this records what Swift asks.
@MainActor
final class FakeDownloads: DownloadsBackend {
    enum Call: Equatable {
        case remove(UInt64), pause(UInt64), resume(UInt64), moveToTop(UInt64)
    }

    private(set) var current = DownloadQueueState(revision: 0, running: nil, waiting: [], held: false)
    private(set) var calls: [Call] = []
    private var waiters: [CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>] = []

    /// Publishes a change, as Rust does after every one.
    func publish(_ change: (inout DownloadQueueState) -> Void) {
        change(&current)
        current.revision += 1
        let woken = waiters
        waiters.removeAll()
        for waiter in woken { waiter.resume() }
    }

    func state() -> DownloadQueueState { current }
    func changed(after: UInt64) async -> DownloadQueueState {
        while current.revision <= after {
            await withCheckedContinuation { waiters.append($0) }
        }
        return current
    }
    func remove(_ id: UInt64) { calls.append(.remove(id)) }
    func pause(_ id: UInt64) { calls.append(.pause(id)) }
    func resume(_ id: UInt64) { calls.append(.resume(id)) }
    func moveToTop(_ id: UInt64) { calls.append(.moveToTop(id)) }
}

extension DownloadItem {
    static func fixture(_ id: UInt64, game: String = "620", kind: DownloadKind = .install,
                        automatic: Bool = false, paused: Bool = false) -> Self {
        DownloadItem(id: id, storefront: .steam, account: "42", game: game, name: "Game \(game)", kind: kind,
                     automatic: automatic, launching: false, paused: paused)
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
@testable import Obelisk

/// One account's installations as Rust would publish them, driven by the test.
/// Rust's own rules are tested in Rust; this only shows snapshots and records
/// the actions Swift forwards.
@MainActor
final class FakeInstallations<Store: InstallationStorefront>: InstallationsBackend {
    enum Call: Equatable {
        case diagnostic(Bool)
        case install(GameOffer)
        case update(InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>)
        case cancel(Store.GameID)
        case checkUpdates
        case automaticUpdates(Bool)
        case launch(InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>)
        case join(InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>, SteamGameInvite)
        case uninstall(InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>)
        case signedOut
        case maintain(Store.GameID, installed: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>?)
        case answer(Store.GameID, decision: UInt64, CloudChoice)
    }

    private(set) var state: InstallationsSnapshot<Store>
    private(set) var calls: [Call] = []
    private var waiters: [CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>] = []
    /// How an answer to a Cloud question ends.
    var answering: (Store.GameID, UInt64, CloudChoice) async throws -> Void = { _, _, _ in }
    /// The indicators the account's journals hold.
    var indicators: [(Store.GameID, CloudIndicator)] = []
    /// How many times Swift asked for indicators.
    private(set) var indicatorRequests = 0
    /// Runs as each action reaches Rust, before the call returns.
    var onCall: (Call) -> Void = { _ in }

    init(receipts: [InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>] = []) {
        state = InstallationsSnapshot(
            revision: 1, receipts: receipts, transfer: nil, transferGame: nil, downloading: false, launching: false,
            verifyingBeforeLaunch: false, launchGame: nil, uninstallGame: nil,
            resumable: nil, report: nil, warning: nil, gate: .open, cloudSync: nil
        )
    }

    /// Publishes a change, as Rust does after every one.
    func publish(_ change: (inout InstallationsSnapshot<Store>) -> Void) {
        change(&state)
        state.revision += 1
        let woken = waiters
        waiters.removeAll()
        for waiter in woken { waiter.resume() }
    }

    private func record(_ call: Call) {
        calls.append(call)
        onCall(call)
    }

    func snapshot() -> InstallationsSnapshot<Store> { state }

    func changed(after: UInt64) async -> InstallationsSnapshot<Store> {
        while state.revision <= after {
            await withCheckedContinuation { waiters.append($0) }
        }
        return state
    }

    func setDiagnostic(_ running: Bool) { record(.diagnostic(running)) }
    func install(_ offer: GameOffer) { record(.install(offer)) }
    func update(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>) { record(.update(receipt)) }
    func cancel(_ game: Store.GameID) { record(.cancel(game)) }
    func checkUpdates() { record(.checkUpdates) }
    func setAutomaticUpdates(_ enabled: Bool) { record(.automaticUpdates(enabled)) }
    func launch(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>) { record(.launch(receipt)) }
    func join(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>, invite: SteamGameInvite) {
        record(.join(receipt, invite))
    }
    func uninstall(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>) { record(.uninstall(receipt)) }
    func signedOut() { record(.signedOut) }
    func maintainCloud(_ game: Store.GameID, installed: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>?) {
        record(.maintain(game, installed: installed))
    }
    func answerCloud(_ game: Store.GameID, decisionId: UInt64, choice: CloudChoice) async throws {
        record(.answer(game, decision: decisionId, choice))
        try await answering(game, decisionId, choice)
    }
    func cloudIndicators(_ games: [Store.GameID]) async throws -> [(Store.GameID, CloudIndicator)] {
        indicatorRequests += 1
        return indicators
    }
    func launchSettings(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>) async throws -> LaunchSettings? { nil }
    func setLaunchSettings(_ receipt: InstallationReceipt<Store.GameID>, choices: LaunchChoices) async throws
        -> LaunchSettings? { nil }

    /// The actions Swift forwarded, without diagnostics or update settings
    /// and checks.
    var actions: [Call] {
        calls.filter {
            switch $0 {
            case .diagnostic, .checkUpdates, .automaticUpdates: false
            default: true
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Installations as Rust names them.
extension InstallationReceipt where GameID == UInt32 {
    static func steam(appId: UInt32, name: String, directory: String, platform: GamePlatform,
                      totalBytes: UInt64 = 100) -> Self {
        Self(id: "\(appId)-\(platform == .mac ? "macos" : "windows")", gameID: appId, name: name,
             directory: directory, platform: platform, totalBytes: totalBytes)
    }
}

extension InstallationReceipt where GameID == String {
    static func epic(namespace: String, appName: String, name: String, directory: String, platform: GamePlatform,
                     totalBytes: UInt64 = 100) -> Self {
        Self(id: "\(namespace):\(appName):\(platform == .mac ? "Mac" : "Windows")",
             gameID: epicLibraryID(namespace: namespace, appName: appName),
             name: name, directory: directory, platform: platform, totalBytes: totalBytes)
    }
}

extension GameOffer {
    var steamApp: UInt32? {
        guard case let .steam(appId, _, _) = self else { return nil }
        return appId
    }
}

/// Cloud syncs Rust publishes, as a test shows them.
extension GameCloudSync {
    static func launch(_ game: Game, decision: UInt64 = 1, working: Bool = false, cancellable: Bool = false,
                       question: CloudQuestion? = nil) -> Self {
        Self(game: game, kind: .launch, decisionId: question?.decisionId ?? decision, working: working,
             reconnecting: false, cancellable: cancellable, question: question)
    }

    static func exit(_ game: Game, working: Bool = false, question: CloudQuestion? = nil) -> Self {
        Self(game: game, kind: .exit, decisionId: question?.decisionId ?? 1, working: working, reconnecting: false,
             cancellable: false, question: question)
    }

    /// Maintenance works until it asks.
    static func maintenance(_ game: Game, question: CloudQuestion? = nil) -> Self {
        Self(game: game, kind: .maintenance, decisionId: question?.decisionId ?? 1, working: question == nil,
             reconnecting: false, cancellable: false, question: question)
    }
}

extension CloudQuestion {
    static func conflict(_ decision: UInt64, error: String? = nil) -> Self {
        Self(decisionId: decision, kind: .conflict, error: error, choices: [.local, .cloud, .cancel])
    }

    static func failed(_ decision: UInt64, error: String? = nil, launchAnyway: Bool = false) -> Self {
        Self(decisionId: decision, kind: .failed, error: error,
             choices: launchAnyway ? [.retry, .cancel, .launchAnyway] : [.retry, .cancel])
    }
}

/// Gates Rust publishes, as a test shows them.
extension InstallationsGate {
    /// Nothing holds the storefront.
    static var open: Self {
        Self(modify: .open(except: []), uninstall: .open(except: []), launch: .open(except: []),
             maintain: .open(except: []))
    }

    /// A Game session runs `game`: its files, every launch and every Cloud
    /// operation wait.
    static func session(_ game: GameID) -> Self {
        Self(modify: .open(except: [game]), uninstall: .open(except: [game]), launch: .closed, maintain: .closed)
    }

    /// A launch or uninstall of `game` runs: every installation and every
    /// launch wait, and so does the game's own Cloud maintenance.
    static func action(_ game: GameID) -> Self {
        Self(modify: .closed, uninstall: .closed, launch: .closed, maintain: .open(except: [game]))
    }

    /// A Transfer of `game` runs: other games may queue theirs and launch,
    /// none may be uninstalled.
    static func transfer(_ game: GameID) -> Self {
        Self(modify: .open(except: [game]), uninstall: .closed, launch: .open(except: [game]),
             maintain: .open(except: [game]))
    }
}

    /// Installations the test drives, whatever session signs in.
    static func installations(_ fake: FakeInstallations<SteamGames>) -> MakeInstallations {
        { _, _, _, _ in fake }
    }

extension WebAccountModel {
    /// Installations the test drives, whatever session signs in.
    static func installations(_ fake: FakeInstallations<Store>) -> MakeInstallations {
        { _, _, _, _, _ in fake }
    }
}

extension CloudIndicator {
    static let neverSynced = CloudIndicator(state: .neverSynced, gameSession: false, syncedAt: nil,
                                            pendingUpload: false, installationRemoved: false)
}

            warn: { _ in }
        ))
        return installations
    }
```

```swift
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

/// A storefront's Game sessions as Rust would publish them, driven by the test.
/// Rust's own rules are tested in Rust; this only shows states and records the
/// calls Swift makes.
final class FakeSessions: StorefrontSessionsProtocol, @unchecked Sendable {
    struct RosettaCall: Equatable, Sendable {
        let session: String
        let account: GameAccount
        let decisionID: UInt64
    }

    struct OverlayStateCall: Equatable, Sendable {
        let session: String
        let active: Bool
        let userInitiated: Bool
    }

    struct AcceptedInvite: Equatable, Sendable {
        let session: String
        let friend: UInt64
        let invite: SteamGameInvite
    }

    struct MicroTxnAnswer: Equatable, Sendable {
        let session: String
        let orderID: UInt64
        let approve: Bool
    }

    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var current: GameSessionsState
    private var waiters: [(after: UInt64, continuation: CheckedContinuation<GameSessionsState, Never>)] = []
    private var _rosettaChecks: [RosettaCall] = []
    private var _rosettaResumes: [RosettaCall] = []
    private var _declines: [RosettaCall] = []
    private var _revocations: [GameAccount] = []
    private var _stops = 0
    private var _quits: [String] = []
    private var _forceQuits: [String] = []
    private var _overlayStates: [OverlayStateCall] = []
    private var _acceptedInvites: [AcceptedInvite] = []
    private var _microTxnAnswers: [MicroTxnAnswer] = []
    /// Steam's in-game calls fail with this key until the test clears it.
    private var steamFailure: String?
    /// Steam's in-game answers wait on it, when the test holds them.
    private var steamGate: GameSessionGate<Void>?
    /// Resuming after Rosetta fails with this key until the test clears it.
    private var rosettaFailure: String?
    private var rosettaFailuresRemaining = 0

    var rosettaChecks: [RosettaCall] { lock.withLock { _rosettaChecks } }
    var rosettaResumes: [RosettaCall] { lock.withLock { _rosettaResumes } }
    var declines: [RosettaCall] { lock.withLock { _declines } }
    var revocations: [GameAccount] { lock.withLock { _revocations } }
    var stops: Int { lock.withLock { _stops } }
    /// The sessions the player asked to quit, then to force quit, in order.
    var quits: [String] { lock.withLock { _quits } }
    var forceQuits: [String] { lock.withLock { _forceQuits } }
    /// What the running Steam game was told of the overlay, in order.
    var overlayStates: [OverlayStateCall] { lock.withLock { _overlayStates } }
    var acceptedInvites: [AcceptedInvite] { lock.withLock { _acceptedInvites } }
    var microTxnAnswers: [MicroTxnAnswer] { lock.withLock { _microTxnAnswers } }

    /// Steam's in-game calls fail with `key` until it is nil again.
    func failSteamCalls(_ key: String?) { lock.withLock { steamFailure = key } }

    /// Accepting an invite and answering a purchase wait on `gate` until it resolves.
    func holdSteamAnswers(_ gate: GameSessionGate<Void>?) { lock.withLock { steamGate = gate } }

    init(recovering: Bool = false) {
        current = GameSessionsState(revision: 1, active: nil, last: nil, recovering: recovering,
                                    recoveryFailed: false, revoked: [], rosetta: nil)
    }

    /// Publishes a change, as Rust does after every one.
    func publish(_ change: (inout GameSessionsState) -> Void) {
        let (state, woken) = lock.withLock {
            change(&current)
            current.revision += 1
            let woken = waiters.filter { $0.after < current.revision }
            waiters.removeAll { $0.after < current.revision }
            return (current, woken)
        }
        for waiter in woken { waiter.continuation.resume(returning: state) }
    }

    /// The session holding the Reservation, as its supervisor last showed it.
    func show(_ session: GameSessionState?) {
        publish { state in
            state.active = session
            if let session { state.last = session }
            state.recovering = false
        }
    }

    /// The active session's supervisor asks for Rosetta with `decisionID`, or
    /// no longer does.
    func requireRosetta(decisionID: UInt64?) {
        publish { state in
            state.rosetta = decisionID.flatMap { decision in
                state.active.map { RosettaPromptState(sessionId: $0.id, account: $0.game.account, decisionId: decision) }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Every resumption fails with `key` until it is nil again.
    func failRosetta(_ key: String?) { lock.withLock { rosettaFailure = key } }

    /// The next `count` resumptions find Rosetta still unavailable.
    func failNextRosettaResumes(_ count: Int) { lock.withLock { rosettaFailuresRemaining = count } }

    func state() -> GameSessionsState { lock.withLock { current } }

    func changed(after: UInt64) async -> GameSessionsState {
        await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
            let ready: GameSessionsState? = lock.withLock {
                if current.revision > after { return current }
                waiters.append((after, continuation))
                return nil
            }
            if let ready { continuation.resume(returning: ready) }
        }
    }

    func declineRosetta(sessionId: String, account: GameAccount, decisionId: UInt64) {
        lock.withLock { _declines.append(.init(session: sessionId, account: account, decisionID: decisionId)) }
        publish { $0.rosetta = nil }
    }

    func resumeAfterRosetta(sessionId: String, account: GameAccount, decisionId: UInt64) async throws {
        let call = RosettaCall(session: sessionId, account: account, decisionID: decisionId)
        let failure: String? = lock.withLock {
            _rosettaChecks.append(call)
            if let rosettaFailure { return rosettaFailure }
            if rosettaFailuresRemaining > 0 {
                rosettaFailuresRemaining -= 1
                return SteamGameSessions.rosettaUnavailableKey
            }
            _rosettaResumes.append(call)
            return nil
        }
        if let failure { throw GameSessionError.Failure(reason: failure) }
    }

    func revoke(account: GameAccount) {
        lock.withLock { _revocations.append(account) }
        publish { if !$0.revoked.contains(account) { $0.revoked.append(account) } }
    }

    func stop() async throws { lock.withLock { _stops += 1 } }

    func quit(sessionId: String) async throws { lock.withLock { _quits.append(sessionId) } }

    func forceQuit(sessionId: String) async throws { lock.withLock { _forceQuits.append(sessionId) } }

    func overlayState(sessionId: String, active: Bool, userInitiated: Bool) async throws {
        let failure = lock.withLock {
            _overlayStates.append(.init(session: sessionId, active: active, userInitiated: userInitiated))
            return steamFailure
        }
        if let failure { throw GameSessionError.Failure(reason: failure) }
    }

    /// As Rust does, the accepted invitation leaves the game's list.
    func acceptInvite(sessionId: String, friendSteamId: UInt64, invite: SteamGameInvite) async throws {
        try await answerSteam()
        lock.withLock { _acceptedInvites.append(.init(session: sessionId, friend: friendSteamId, invite: invite)) }
        publish { state in
            guard state.active?.id == sessionId else { return }
            state.active?.receivedInvites.removeAll { $0.friendSteamId == friendSteamId && $0.invite == invite }
            state.last = state.active
        }
    }

    /// As Rust does, the answered purchase no longer waits.
    func authorizeMicroTxn(sessionId: String, orderId: UInt64, approve: Bool) async throws {
        try await answerSteam()
        lock.withLock { _microTxnAnswers.append(.init(session: sessionId, orderID: orderId, approve: approve)) }
        publish { state in
            guard state.active?.id == sessionId, state.active?.microTxn?.orderId == orderId else { return }
            state.active?.microTxn = nil
            state.last = state.active
        }
    }

    private func answerSteam() async throws {
        let (gate, failure) = lock.withLock { (steamGate, steamFailure) }
        if let gate { try await gate.wait() }
        if let failure { throw GameSessionError.Failure(reason: failure) }
    }
}

extension GameIdentity {
    var account: GameAccount {
        switch self {
        case let .steam(_, accountId): .steam(steamId: accountId)
        case let .epic(accountId, _, _): .epic(accountId: accountId)
        case let .gog(accountId, _): .gog(userId: accountId)
        }
    }
}

extension GameSessionState {
    /// A Steam game's session.
    static func steam(appID: UInt32 = 42, accountID: UInt64 = 42, id: String = UUID().uuidString,
                      phase: GamePhase = .running, cloud: CloudStatus = .idle, observed: Bool = true) -> Self {
        GameSessionState(id: id, game: .steam(appId: appID, accountId: accountID), phase: phase, reconnecting: false,
                         cloud: cloud, host: .online, observed: observed, runtimeInstall: nil)
    }

    /// An Epic game's session.
    static func epic(account: String, namespace: String = "namespace", appName: String = "game",
                     id: String = UUID().uuidString, phase: GamePhase = .running, cloud: CloudStatus = .idle,
                     observed: Bool = true) -> Self {
        GameSessionState(id: id, game: .epic(accountId: account, namespace: namespace, appName: appName),
                         phase: phase, reconnecting: false, cloud: cloud, host: nil, observed: observed,
                         runtimeInstall: nil)
    }
}

extension CloudStatus {
    static let idle = CloudStatus(phase: .idle, decisionId: 0, error: nil, allowedChoices: [])

    /// A question the sync waits on: a conflict, or a failed launch check.
    static func asking(_ phase: CloudPhase, decision: UInt64, error: String? = nil) -> CloudStatus {
        let choices: [CloudChoice] = switch phase {
        case .conflict: [.local, .cloud, .cancel]
        case .failed: [.retry, .cancel]
        default: []
        }
        return CloudStatus(phase: phase, decisionId: decision, error: error, allowedChoices: choices)
    }

    static func showing(_ phase: CloudPhase, error: String? = nil) -> CloudStatus {
        CloudStatus(phase: phase, decisionId: 0, error: error, allowedChoices: [])
    }
}

extension GameSessions {
    /// Game sessions whose state the test publishes through `fake`. No Mac
    /// app of the test's machine is ever asked to quit.
    convenience init(quitting: GameQuitting = GameQuitting(quitMacApps: { _ in false })) {
        self.init(FakeSessions(), history: .temporary(), quitting: quitting)
    }

    var fake: FakeSessions { core as! FakeSessions }
}

/// A Quit's waits, which end only when the test wakes them, in order, and
/// the Mac apps it asked to quit.
@MainActor
final class FakeQuitting {
    private var sleeping: [CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>] = []
    /// What each wait was for, in order.
    private(set) var delays: [Duration] = []
    /// The folders of each Quit asked of the Mac apps running from them.
    private(set) var macApps: [[String]] = []
    /// Whether a Mac app ran from them and was asked.
    var macAppRuns = false

    var quitting: GameQuitting {
        GameQuitting(
            sleep: { [self] delay in await self.sleep(delay) },
            quitMacApps: { [self] folders in
                self.macApps.append(folders)
                return self.macAppRuns
            }
        )
    }

    var waiting: Int { sleeping.count }

    func wake() { sleeping.removeFirst().resume() }

    private func sleep(_ delay: Duration) async {
        delays.append(delay)
        await withCheckedContinuation { sleeping.append($0) }
    }
}

actor GameSessionGate<Value: Sendable> {
    private var result: Result<Value, Error>?
    private var waiters: [CheckedContinuation<Value, Error>] = []
    private(set) var requests = 0

    func wait() async throws -> Value {
        requests += 1
        if let result { return try result.get() }
        return try await withCheckedThrowingContinuation { waiters.append($0) }
    }

    func resolve(_ value: Value) { complete(.success(value)) }
    func fail(_ error: Error) { complete(.failure(error)) }

    private func complete(_ value: Result<Value, Error>) {
        result = value
        let pending = waiters
        waiters.removeAll()
        for waiter in pending { waiter.resume(with: value) }
    }
}

/// Waits until `predicate` holds, or fails the test after three seconds.
@MainActor
func eventually(_ predicate: @MainActor () async -> Bool, file: StaticString = #filePath,
                line: UInt = #line) async throws {
    let deadline = ContinuousClock.now + .seconds(3)
    while !(await predicate()) && ContinuousClock.now < deadline { try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(10)) }
    let satisfied = await predicate()
    if !satisfied {
        XCTFail("Fixture timed out", file: file, line: line)
        throw SteamError.Failure(reason: "Fixture timed out")
    }
}

/// Lets the main queue run `times` turns, such as a continuation the code
/// under test scheduled there.
@MainActor
func drainMainQueue(times: Int = 1) async {
    for _ in 0..<times { await withCheckedContinuation { c in DispatchQueue.main.async { c.resume() } } }
}

extension LaunchHistory {
    /// A history no other test reads, never the live library's.
    static func temporary() -> LaunchHistory {
        LaunchHistory(cache: LibraryCache(
            directory: FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: "ObeliskLibraryCache-\(UUID().uuidString)").path
        ))
    }
}

/// Achievements as the Library cache keeps them, read in French: a hundred,
/// `share` of them unlocked.
private func keptAchievements(share: Double) -> [String: Any] {
    let unlocked = Int((share * 100).rounded())
    let list = (0..<100).map { index -> [String: Any] in
        ["id": "\(index)", "name": "", "description": "", "iconUrl": "", "hidden": false,
         "unlocked": index < unlocked, "unlockedAt": NSNull()]
    }
    return ["list": list, "locale": "french", "at": 0, "playtime": NSNull()]
}

extension LibraryCache {
    /// The cache of `directory` once it holds these libraries, in the file as
    /// Obelisk writes it: Steam's by account ID, Epic's by account.
    static func holding(steam: [UInt64: [CachedSteamGame]] = [:], epic: [String: [CachedEpicGame]] = [:],
                        gog: [String: [CachedGogGame]] = [:], in directory: URL) throws -> LibraryCache {
        let steam = steam.map { account, games in
            (String(account), games.map { cached -> [String: Any] in
                var entry: [String: Any] = [
                    "id": String(cached.game.appId), "appId": cached.game.appId, "name": cached.game.name,
                    "iconHash": cached.game.iconHash, "lastPlayed": cached.game.lastPlayed,
                    "playtimeMinutes": cached.game.playtimeMinutes,
                ]
                entry["platforms"] = cached.platforms
                entry["addedAt"] = cached.addedAt
                entry["achievements"] = cached.achievementShare.map(keptAchievements(share:))
                return entry
            })
        }
        let epic = epic.mapValues { games in
            games.map { cached -> [String: Any] in
                let game = cached.game
                var entry: [String: Any] = [
                    "id": game.libraryID, "appName": game.appName, "namespace": game.namespace,
                    "catalogItemId": game.catalogItemId, "title": game.title, "description": game.description,
                    "developer": game.developer, "windows": game.windows, "macos": game.macos,
                ]
                entry["imageUrl"] = game.imageUrl
                entry["headerImageUrl"] = game.headerImageUrl
                entry["playtimeSeconds"] = cached.playtimeSeconds
                entry["achievements"] = cached.achievementShare.map(keptAchievements(share:))
                return entry
            }
        }
        let gog = gog.mapValues { games in
            games.map { cached -> [String: Any] in
                let game = cached.game
                var entry: [String: Any] = [
                    "id": game.productId, "productId": game.productId, "title": game.title,
                    "windows": game.windows, "macos": game.macos,
                ]
                entry["imageUrl"] = game.imageUrl
                entry["headerImageUrl"] = game.headerImageUrl
                entry["playtimeMinutes"] = cached.playtimeMinutes
                entry["achievements"] = cached.achievementShare.map(keptAchievements(share:))
                return entry
            }
        }
        let document: [String: Any] = ["version": 1, "steam": Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: steam), "epic": epic,
                                       "gog": gog]
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: directory, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: document).write(to: directory.appending(path: "library-cache.json"))
        return LibraryCache(directory: directory.path)
    }
}
```

```swift
private actor AvatarRequests {
    private(set) var count = 0
    private var result: Data?
    private var pending: CheckedContinuation<Data, Never>?
    private var observer: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>?
    func load(_ url: URL) async -> Data {
        count += 1
        observer?.resume(); observer = nil
        if let result { return result }
        return await withCheckedContinuation { pending = $0 }
    }
    func waitUntilRequested() async {
        if count > 0 { return }
        await withCheckedContinuation { observer = $0 }
    }
    func release(_ data: Data) {
        result = data
        pending?.resume(returning: data); pending = nil
    }
}

@MainActor @Observable
private final class FriendsFixtureState {
    var isPresented: Bool
    let friends: FriendsPresentationState
    init(friends: FriendsPresentationState, presented: Bool) { self.friends = friends; isPresented = presented }
}

@MainActor
private final class FriendsModalFixture {
    let window: FriendsFixtureWindow
    let host: NSHostingView<AnyView>
    let state: FriendsFixtureState
    private let directory: URL
    private let defaults: UserDefaults
    private let suite: String

    init(state friends: FriendsPresentationState, size: NSSize = NSSize(width: 860, height: 600), scheme: ColorScheme = .dark, presented: Bool = true) {
        directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString)
        suite = "FriendsFixture.\(UUID().uuidString)"
        defaults = UserDefaults(suiteName: suite)!
        let model = AppModel(directory: directory, defaults: defaults)
        let state = FriendsFixtureState(friends: friends, presented: presented)
        self.state = state
        host = NSHostingView(rootView: AnyView(FriendsFixtureView(model: model, state: state)
            .environment(\.colorScheme, scheme)))
        window = FriendsFixtureWindow(contentRect: NSRect(origin: NSPoint(x: -20_000, y: -20_000), size: size), styleMask: .borderless, backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        window.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        window.sharingType = .none
        window.contentView = host
        window.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
    }

    var modal: FriendsModalContainer? { descendants(host).compactMap { $0 as? FriendsModalContainer }.first }
    var searchField: NSTextField? {
        descendants(host).compactMap { $0 as? NSTextField }.first { $0.placeholderString == L10n.string("ui.friends.search") }
    }
    var scrollView: NSScrollView? {
        guard let modal else { return nil }
        return descendants(modal.host).compactMap { $0 as? NSScrollView }.first
    }

    func enterSearch(_ value: String) throws {
        let field = try XCTUnwrap(searchField)
        window.makeFirstResponder(field)
        let editor = try XCTUnwrap(field.currentEditor() as? NSTextView)
        editor.insertText(value, replacementRange: NSRange(location: 0, length: editor.string.utf16.count))
    }

    func settle() async {
        for _ in 0..<8 {
            await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in DispatchQueue.main.async { continuation.resume() } }
            host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
            window.displayIfNeeded()
        }
    }

    func press(keyCode: UInt16, characters: String) {
        let event = NSEvent.keyEvent(with: .keyDown, location: .zero, modifierFlags: [], timestamp: ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime,
                                    windowNumber: window.windowNumber, context: nil, characters: characters, charactersIgnoringModifiers: characters,
                                    isARepeat: false, keyCode: keyCode)!
        NSApp.sendEvent(event)
    }

    func close() {
        modal?.finish()
        window.close()
        defaults.removePersistentDomain(forName: suite)
        try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory)
    }

    private func descendants(_ view: NSView) -> [NSView] { [view] + view.subviews.flatMap(descendants) }
}

private struct FriendsFixtureView: View {
    let model: AppModel
    let state: FriendsFixtureState
    @State private var avatars = FriendsAvatarCache()
    var body: some View {
        RootView(model: model)
            .disabled(state.isPresented)
            .allowsHitTesting(!state.isPresented)
            .accessibilityHidden(state.isPresented)
            .overlay {
                if state.isPresented {
                    // At the size of the window's sheet.
                    FriendsModal(state: state.friends, avatars: avatars, dismiss: { state.isPresented = false }, retry: {}, signIn: {})
                        .frame(width: 520, height: 550)
                }
            }
    }
}

private final class FriendsFixtureWindow: NSWindow {
    override var canBecomeKey: Bool { true }
}
```

```swift
/// The Game action of any game of an account, on its page and in the library,
/// over installations the test drives. Steam stands in for every storefront;

    func testThePageLaunchesTheInstallationAndCancelReachesItsPreparation() async throws {
        let fixture = InstallationsFixture()
        let installations = fixture.connect()

        installations.selectedAction?.perform()

        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.backend.actions, [.launch(fixture.receipt)])
        fixture.backend.publish {
            $0.launching = true
            $0.launchGame = 620
            $0.gate = .action(620)
        }
        try await eventually { installations.isLaunching }

        XCTAssertEqual(installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable, false)
        XCTAssertEqual(installations.selectedAction?.isCancellable, true)
        installations.selectedAction?.cancel()
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.backend.actions.last, .cancel(620))
    }

    func testEveryPlaceNamesTheRuntimeALaunchWaitsForAndItsProgress() async throws {
        let fixture = InstallationsFixture()
        let installations = fixture.connect()
        installations.selectedAction?.perform()

            $0.launching = true
            $0.launchGame = 620
            $0.gate = .action(620)

        session.runtimeInstall = RuntimeInstallState(component: .voile, fraction: 0.5)
        fixture.sessions.fake.show(session)

            XCTAssertEqual(action.title, L10n.string("model.game.installingVoile"))
            XCTAssertEqual(action.stepFraction(), 0.5)

    func testThePageOffersOnlyWhatRustsGateLetsStart() async throws {
        let fixture = InstallationsFixture()

        XCTAssertEqual(installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable, true)

    // MARK: Quitting the running game

    func testARunningGameIsAskedToQuitThenMayBeForcedOnceItHadTimeToClose() async throws {
        let quitting = FakeQuitting()
        let fixture = InstallationsFixture(quitting: quitting)
        let installations = fixture.connect()
        let running = GameSessionState.steam(appID: 620)
        fixture.sessions.fake.show(running)
        fixture.backend.publish { $0.gate = .session(620) }
        try await eventually { installations.selectedAction?.kind == .running(.quit) }
        XCTAssertEqual(installations.selectedAction?.title, L10n.string("model.game.quit"))
        XCTAssertEqual(installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable, true)

        installations.selectedAction?.perform()
        try await eventually { fixture.sessions.fake.quits == [running.id] && quitting.waiting == 1 }
        XCTAssertEqual(quitting.delays, [.seconds(10)], "The game gets ten seconds to close")
        XCTAssertEqual(quitting.macApps, [[fixture.receipt.directory]], "Its Mac build is asked first")
        XCTAssertEqual(installations.selectedAction?.kind, .running(.closing))
        XCTAssertEqual(installations.selectedAction?.title, L10n.string("model.game.closing"))
        XCTAssertEqual(installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable, false)

        try await eventually { installations.selectedAction?.kind == .running(.forceQuit) }
        let forcing = try XCTUnwrap(installations.selectedAction)
        XCTAssertEqual(forcing.title, L10n.string("model.game.forceQuit"))

        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.sessions.fake.quits, [running.id], "Quit is asked once")
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.backend.actions, [], "Ending the game is no installation action")

        // The game exits: its session settles its Cloud saves, then ends.
        fixture.sessions.fake.show(.steam(appID: 620, id: running.id, phase: .finalizing))
        try await eventually { fixture.sessions.quitRequest == nil }
        XCTAssertEqual(installations.selectedAction?.kind, .waiting(.closing))
        XCTAssertEqual(installations.selectedAction?.title, L10n.string("model.game.closing"))
    }

    func testAMacGameIsAskedToQuitAsItsOwnQuitMenuWould() async throws {

        let fixture = InstallationsFixture(quitting: quitting)
        let installations = fixture.connect()
        fixture.sessions.fake.show(.steam(appID: 620))
        fixture.backend.publish { $0.gate = .session(620) }
        try await eventually { installations.selectedAction?.kind == .running(.quit) }

        installations.selectedAction?.perform()
        try await eventually { quitting.macApps == [[fixture.receipt.directory]] && quitting.waiting == 1 }
        XCTAssertEqual(installations.selectedAction?.kind, .running(.closing))
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.sessions.fake.quits, [], "No signal ends it before it could save")
    }

    func testForceQuitWaitsForItsPlayersConfirmationWhereverItShows() async throws {
        let quitting = FakeQuitting()
        let fixture = InstallationsFixture(quitting: quitting)
        let installations = fixture.connect()
        let running = GameSessionState.steam(appID: 620)
        fixture.sessions.fake.show(running)
        fixture.backend.publish { $0.gate = .session(620) }
        try await eventually { installations.selectedAction?.kind == .running(.quit) }
        XCTAssertFalse(try everyPlace(fixture).contains { $0.needsConfirmation })

        installations.selectedAction?.perform()
        try await eventually { quitting.waiting == 1 }
        for action in try everyPlace(fixture) {
            XCTAssertEqual(action.kind, .running(.closing))
            XCTAssertFalse(action.needsConfirmation)
        }

        quitting.wake()
        try await eventually { installations.selectedAction?.kind == .running(.forceQuit) }
        let actions = try everyPlace(fixture)
        for action in actions {
            XCTAssertEqual(action.kind, .running(.forceQuit))
            XCTAssertTrue(action.needsConfirmation)
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.sessions.fake.forceQuits, [])
        // Its player confirmed in the library.
        actions[1].perform()
        try await eventually { fixture.sessions.fake.forceQuits == [running.id] }
    }

    // MARK: Observation

    func testTheLibrarysActionsChangeWithAnOperationNotWithItsProgress() async throws {
        let fixture = InstallationsFixture()
        let installations = fixture.connect()
        // Another game downloads while Portal 2's launch waits for Voile.
        fixture.backend.publish {
            $0.downloading = true
            $0.transferGame = 730
            $0.transfer = GameTransfer(game: "730", state: .downloading, completedBytes: 10, totalBytes: 100,
                                       networkBytes: 10, contentBytes: 10, currentFile: "", message: "")
            $0.launching = true
            $0.launchGame = 620
            $0.gate = .transfer(730)
        }
        var session = GameSessionState.steam(appID: 620, phase: .preparing, observed: false)
        session.runtimeInstall = RuntimeInstallState(component: .voile, fraction: 0.25)
        fixture.sessions.fake.show(session)
        try await eventually {
            installations.transfer?.completedBytes == 10
                && installations.sessions.active?.runtimeInstall?.fraction == 0.25
        }

        let progress = expectation(description: "No progress tick redraws the library")
        progress.isInverted = true
        readLibrary(fixture) { progress.fulfill() }
        fixture.backend.publish { $0.transfer?.completedBytes = 50 }
        try await eventually { installations.transfer?.completedBytes == 50 }
        session.runtimeInstall = RuntimeInstallState(component: .voile, fraction: 0.5)
        fixture.sessions.fake.show(session)
        try await eventually { installations.sessions.active?.runtimeInstall?.fraction == 0.5 }
        await fulfillment(of: [progress], timeout: 0.2)

        let operation = expectation(description: "A game joining the queue redraws the library")
        readLibrary(fixture) { operation.fulfill() }
        fixture.backend.publish { $0.queued = [440] }
        await fulfillment(of: [operation], timeout: 2)
    }

    /// Reads two games' actions as the library does, and runs `changed` once
    /// what it read changes.
    private func readLibrary(_ fixture: InstallationsFixture, changed: @escaping @Sendable () -> Void) {
        withObservationTracking {
            let actions = GameActions(fixture.installations, in: .library)
            _ = actions(fixture.selection(620))
            _ = actions(fixture.selection(730))
        } onChange: {
            changed()
        }
    }

    /// Portal 2's action on its page, then in the library.
    private func everyPlace(_ fixture: InstallationsFixture) throws -> [GameAction] {
        [try XCTUnwrap(fixture.installations.selectedAction),
         GameActions(fixture.installations, in: .library)(fixture.selection(620))]
    }

    // MARK: Transfer text

    func testLocalVerificationDoesNotPresentManifestBytesAsDownloadedGameData() {
        // A second pass may receive a small manifest, then validate hundreds of MB
        // already on disk without requesting a single game-content chunk.
        let transfer = GameTransfer(game: "620", state: .verifying, completedBytes: 400_000_000, totalBytes: 522_734_781, networkBytes: 253, contentBytes: 0, currentFile: "Game_Data/resources.assets", message: "")
        XCTAssertEqual(transfer.activityTitle, L10n.string("ui.transfer.verifying_files"))
        XCTAssertEqual(transfer.verifiedProgressText, L10n.string("ui.transfer.verified_files", GameFormatting.bytes(400_000_000), GameFormatting.bytes(522_734_781)))
        XCTAssertEqual(transfer.downloadedGameDataText, L10n.string("ui.transfer.no_downloaded_data"))
    }

    func testActualChunkDownloadReportsReceivedGameDataSeparatelyFromVerifiedFiles() {
        let downloading = GameTransfer(game: "620", state: .downloading, completedBytes: 400_000_000, totalBytes: 522_734_781, networkBytes: 12_345 + 253, contentBytes: 12_345, currentFile: "Game_Data/resources.assets", message: "")
        XCTAssertEqual(downloading.activityTitle, L10n.string("ui.transfer.downloading"))
        XCTAssertEqual(downloading.downloadedGameDataText, L10n.string("ui.transfer.downloaded_data", GameFormatting.bytes(12_345)))
        XCTAssertEqual(downloading.verifiedProgressText, L10n.string("ui.transfer.verified_files", GameFormatting.bytes(400_000_000), GameFormatting.bytes(522_734_781)))

        // Returning to disk verification must update the activity while preserving
        // the number of game bytes actually received earlier in this operation.
        var verifying = downloading
        verifying.state = .verifying
        XCTAssertEqual(verifying.activityTitle, L10n.string("ui.transfer.verifying_files"))
        XCTAssertEqual(verifying.downloadedGameDataText, downloading.downloadedGameDataText)
    }

    func testARuntimeDownloadBeforeTheGameNamesTheRuntimeAndCountsNoGameFiles() {
        var transfer = GameTransfer(game: "620", state: .downloading, completedBytes: 5_000_000, totalBytes: 20_000_000, networkBytes: 5_000_000, contentBytes: 0, currentFile: "", message: "model.game.installingVoile")
        XCTAssertEqual(transfer.activityTitle, L10n.string("model.game.installingVoile"))
        XCTAssertEqual(transfer.buttonTitle, L10n.string("model.game.installingVoile"))
        XCTAssertEqual(transfer.progressFraction, 0.25)
        XCTAssertNil(transfer.countedFilesText)
        XCTAssertNil(transfer.downloadedGameDataText)
        XCTAssertEqual(transfer.progressSummary, L10n.string("model.game.installingVoile"))

        // A failed runtime download shows its own failure, as any Transfer's.
        transfer.state = .failed
        transfer.message = "backend.voile.downloadFailed"
        XCTAssertNil(transfer.runtimeTitle)
        XCTAssertEqual(transfer.activityTitle, L10n.string("ui.transfer.failed"))
    }

    func testManifestPreparationAndLocalCompletionDoNotClaimAFileDownload() {
        var transfer = GameTransfer(game: "620", state: .preparing, completedBytes: 0, totalBytes: 0, networkBytes: 253, contentBytes: 0, currentFile: "", message: "")
        XCTAssertEqual(transfer.activityTitle, L10n.string("ui.transfer.checking_updates"))
        XCTAssertNil(transfer.downloadedGameDataText)

        transfer.state = .complete
        transfer.completedBytes = 522_734_781
        transfer.totalBytes = transfer.completedBytes
        XCTAssertEqual(transfer.activityTitle, L10n.string("ui.transfer.up_to_date"))
        XCTAssertNil(transfer.downloadedGameDataText)
    }

    func testTransferProgressIsClamped() {
        let transfer = GameTransfer(game: "one", state: .verifying, completedBytes: 120, totalBytes: 100,
                                    networkBytes: 0, contentBytes: 0, currentFile: "Content/game.pak", message: "")
        XCTAssertEqual(transfer.progressFraction, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(transfer.downloadedGameDataText, L10n.string("ui.transfer.no_downloaded_data"))
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/ObeliskTests/GameInstallationsTests.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

/// Installations as Swift forwards their settings and actions, and the running
/// game's Quit, over installations and Game sessions the test drives. Steam
/// stands in for every storefront; Rust's own suite covers the rules behind them.
@MainActor
final class GameInstallationsTests: XCTestCase {
    func testTheAutomaticUpdatesSettingReachesEachConnectionBeforeItsFirstCheck() throws {
        let fixture = InstallationsFixture()
        let installations = fixture.connect()
        installations.updatesAutomatically = true
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.backend.calls.last, .automaticUpdates(true))

        _ = fixture.connect()
        let calls = fixture.backend.calls
        let setting = try XCTUnwrap(calls.firstIndex(of: .automaticUpdates(true)))
        XCTAssertLessThan(setting, try XCTUnwrap(calls.firstIndex(of: .checkUpdates)))
    }

    func testVerifyingAnInstallationRunsItsTransferInPlace() async throws {
        let fixture = InstallationsFixture()
        let installations = fixture.connect()

        installations.verify(fixture.receipt)

        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.backend.actions, [.update(fixture.receipt)], "Rust repairs or updates the installed build")
    }

    // MARK: Quitting the running game

    func testForceQuitIsOfferedForAWhileThenTheGameMayBeAskedToQuitAgain() async throws {
        let quitting = FakeQuitting()
        let sessions = SteamGameSessions(quitting: quitting.quitting)
        let running = GameSessionState.steam(appID: 620)
        sessions.fake.show(running)
        try await eventually { sessions.quitStage == .quit }
        await sessions.quit()
        try await eventually { quitting.waiting == 1 }
        quitting.wake()
        try await eventually { sessions.quitStage == .forceQuit && quitting.waiting == 1 }
        XCTAssertEqual(quitting.delays, [.seconds(10), .seconds(60)])

        // The game asked its player to save first, and plays on.
        quitting.wake()
        try await eventually { sessions.quitStage == .quit }
        XCTAssertNil(sessions.quitRequest)
        await sessions.quit()
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.quitStage, .closing)
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.fake.quits, [running.id, running.id])
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.fake.forceQuits, [])
    }

    func testTheQuitRequestLivesInTheModelForItsSessionOnly() async throws {
        let sessions = SteamGameSessions(quitting: GameQuitting(delay: .seconds(60), quitMacApps: { _ in false }))
        let first = GameSessionState.steam(appID: 620)
        sessions.fake.show(first)
        try await eventually { sessions.quitStage == .quit }
        await sessions.forceQuit()
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.fake.forceQuits, [], "A game is asked to quit first")

        await sessions.quit()
        // Any page shown later reads the same stage, whatever it showed before.
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.quitStage, .closing)
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.quitRequest?.session, first.id)
        await sessions.quit()
        await sessions.forceQuit()
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.fake.quits, [first.id])
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.fake.forceQuits, [], "Not before the game had its time")

        let second = GameSessionState.steam(appID: 620)
        sessions.fake.show(second)
        try await eventually { sessions.active?.id == second.id }
        XCTAssertNil(sessions.quitRequest)
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.quitStage, .quit)
        var reconnecting = second
        reconnecting.reconnecting = true
        sessions.fake.show(reconnecting)
        try await eventually { sessions.active?.reconnecting == true }
        XCTAssertNil(sessions.quitStage, "A session reconnecting to its supervisor is asked nothing")
    }

    func testAGameGetsTenSecondsToCloseThenAMinuteToBeForced() {
        XCTAssertEqual(GameQuitting().delay, .seconds(10))
        XCTAssertEqual(GameQuitting().window, .seconds(60))
    }

    func testOnlyAMacAppRunningFromTheGameIsAskedToQuit() {
        XCTAssertFalse(GameQuitting.quitApps(in: []))
        XCTAssertFalse(GameQuitting.quitApps(in: ["/nonexistent/obelisk-test-installation"]))
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/ObeliskTests/GameManagementButtonTests.swift`:

```swift
import AppKit
import SwiftUI
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

final class GameManagementButtonTests: XCTestCase {
    @MainActor
    func testManagementControlKeepsASquareFootprint() async {
        let fixture = ManagementButtonWindow(
            GameManagementButton(gameName: "Portal 2", canVerify: true, canUninstall: true, verify: {}, uninstall: {}, directory: "/Applications")
        )
        defer { fixture.close() }
        await fixture.prepare()

        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.host.fittingSize.width, 36, accuracy: 0.5)
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.host.fittingSize.height, 36, accuracy: 0.5)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testManagementAccessibilityNamesTheGameAndReflectsAvailability() async throws {
        for isAvailable in [true, false] {
            let fixture = ManagementButtonWindow(
                GameManagementButton(gameName: "Portal 2", canVerify: isAvailable, canUninstall: isAvailable, verify: {}, uninstall: {}, directory: "/Applications")
            )
            defer { fixture.close() }
            await fixture.prepare()

            guard let element = accessibilityElement(in: fixture.host, identifier: "game-management-menu") else {
                throw XCTSkip("This macOS host does not expose the SwiftUI menu through in-process accessibility")
            }
            let names = ["accessibilityLabel", "accessibilityTitle"].compactMap { attribute($0, of: element) as? String }
            XCTAssertTrue(names.contains(L10n.string("ui.game.manage_named", "Portal 2")))
            if let control = element as? NSControl {
                XCTAssertEqual(control.isEnabled, isAvailable)
            } else if let enabled = attribute("accessibilityEnabled", of: element) as? NSNumber {
                XCTAssertEqual(enabled.boolValue, isAvailable)
            } else {
                throw XCTSkip("The SwiftUI menu does not expose its enabled state through in-process accessibility")
            }
        }
    }

    @MainActor
    func testRenderManagementControlBesideLaunch() async throws {
        let fixture = ManagementButtonWindow(
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                GameActionButton(
                    action: GameAction(kind: .launch, title: L10n.string("model.game.launch"), isAvailable: true,
                                       launches: true),
                    gameName: "Portal 2"
                )
                GameManagementButton(gameName: "Portal 2", canVerify: true, canUninstall: true, verify: {}, uninstall: {}, directory: "/Applications")
            }
            .padding(18)
            .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
            .background(ObeliskPalette(colorScheme: .dark).background)
        )
        defer { fixture.close() }
        await fixture.prepare()

        let bitmap = try XCTUnwrap(fixture.host.bitmapImageRepForCachingDisplay(in: fixture.host.bounds))
        fixture.host.cacheDisplay(in: fixture.host.bounds, to: bitmap)
        let png = try XCTUnwrap(bitmap.representation(using: .png, properties: [:]))
        try png.write(to: URL(fileURLWithPath: "/tmp/obelisk-game-management-preview.png"))
    }

    @MainActor
    private func attribute(_ name: String, of element: NSObject) -> Any? {
        element.responds(to: NSSelectorFromString(name)) ? element.value(forKey: name) : nil
    }

    @MainActor
    private func accessibilityElement(in root: Any, identifier: String, depth: Int = 0) -> NSObject? {
        guard depth < 30, let element = root as? NSObject else { return nil }
        if attribute("accessibilityIdentifier", of: element) as? String == identifier { return element }
        let children = (attribute("accessibilityChildren", of: element) as? [Any] ?? [])
            + (attribute("accessibilityChildrenInNavigationOrder", of: element) as? [Any] ?? [])
            + ((root as? NSView)?.subviews ?? [])
        for child in children {
            if let match = accessibilityElement(in: child, identifier: identifier, depth: depth + 1) { return match }
        }
        return nil
    }
}

@MainActor
private final class ManagementButtonWindow {
    let host: NSView
    private let window: NSWindow

    init<Content: View>(_ content: Content) {
        host = NSHostingView(rootView: content)
        let rect = NSRect(x: -20_000, y: -20_000, width: 300, height: 80)
        window = NSWindow(contentRect: rect, styleMask: .borderless, backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        window.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        window.sharingType = .none
        window.contentView = host
        window.setFrameOrigin(rect.origin)
        window.orderBack(nil)
    }

    func prepare() async {
        for _ in 0..<3 {
            await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
                DispatchQueue.main.async { continuation.resume() }
            }
            host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
            let size = host.fittingSize
            if size.width > 0 && size.height > 0 { window.setContentSize(size) }
            window.displayIfNeeded()
        }
    }

    func close() { window.close() }
}
```
