`apps/macos/ObeliskTests/GameOverlaySteamTests.swift`:

```swift
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

/// What a running Steam game asks of Obelisk's overlay through its Steam
/// engine: its overlay's pages, friends' invitations into it and purchases.
final class GameOverlaySteamTests: XCTestCase {
    private static let peak = SteamGame(appId: 3_527_290, name: "PEAK", iconHash: "", lastPlayed: 0, playtimeMinutes: 0)
    private static let peakLobby: UInt64 = 109_775_244_421_126_053
    private static let alice = ChatBridgeTestSession.friendID
    private static let stranger: UInt64 = 76_561_198_000_000_009
    private static let other: UInt64 = 76_561_198_000_000_010
    private static let account = FriendsWireFixture.accountID
    private static let game = OverlayApplication(pid: 4_242, bundleIdentifier: "com.zagrios.obelisk.game.peak")

    func testEverySteamOverlayKindShowsItsPage() {
        func page(_ kind: SteamOverlayKind) -> OverlayRequest? {
            OverlayRequest.steam(kind, appId: 620, account: Self.account)
        }
        let profile = URL(string: "https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/\(Self.stranger)")!

        for dialog in ["friends", "Players", "community", "chatroomgroup/123456"] {
            XCTAssertEqual(page(.dialog(dialog: dialog)), .friends, dialog)
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(page(.dialog(dialog: "achievements")), .achievements)
        XCTAssertEqual(page(.dialog(dialog: "stats")), .achievements)
        XCTAssertEqual(page(.dialog(dialog: "officialgamegroup")),
                       .webPage(URL(string: "https://steamcommunity.com/app/620")!), "The game's community hub")
        XCTAssertEqual(page(.dialog(dialog: "settings")), .home)
        XCTAssertEqual(page(.dialog(dialog: "something-new")), .home)

        XCTAssertEqual(page(.user(dialog: "steamid", steamId: Self.stranger)), .user(steamId: Self.stranger))
        XCTAssertEqual(page(.user(dialog: "chat", steamId: Self.stranger)), .user(steamId: Self.stranger))
        XCTAssertEqual(page(.user(dialog: "achievements", steamId: Self.account)), .achievements, "The account's own")
        XCTAssertEqual(page(.user(dialog: "stats", steamId: Self.stranger)),
                       .webPage(URL(string: "https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/\(Self.stranger)/stats/620/achievements/")!))
        for dialog in ["friendadd", "friendremove", "friendrequestaccept", "friendrequestignore", "jointrade"] {
            XCTAssertEqual(page(.user(dialog: dialog, steamId: Self.stranger)), .webPage(profile), dialog)
        }

        XCTAssertEqual(page(.webPage(url: "https://example.com/news?id=1", modal: true)),
                       .webPage(URL(string: "https://example.com/news?id=1")!))
        XCTAssertEqual(page(.webPage(url: "http://example.com", modal: false)), .webPage(URL(string: "http://example.com")!))
        XCTAssertNil(page(.webPage(url: "file:///etc/passwd", modal: false)), "Only the web")
        XCTAssertNil(page(.webPage(url: "javascript:alert(1)", modal: false)))
        XCTAssertNil(page(.webPage(url: "not a url", modal: false)))

        let store = URL(string: "https://store.steampowered.com/app/620")!
        XCTAssertEqual(page(.store(appId: 620, flag: .showPage)), .webPage(store))
        XCTAssertEqual(page(.store(appId: 620, flag: .addToCart)), .webPage(store))
        XCTAssertEqual(page(.store(appId: 0, flag: .addToCartAndShow)),
                       .webPage(URL(string: "https://store.steampowered.com/")!), "App 0 is the store's front page")

        XCTAssertNil(page(.lobbyInvite(lobbyId: 1)), "The friends list picks for invite dialogs")
        XCTAssertNil(page(.connectInvite(connect: "+connect 1")))
        XCTAssertEqual(page(.remotePlayTogetherInvite(lobbyId: nil)), .friends)
        XCTAssertEqual(page(.remotePlayTogetherInvite(lobbyId: 3)), .friends)
        XCTAssertEqual(page(.remotePlayTogether), .friends)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testTheGamesOverlayRequestsOpenTheirPageOncePerNewRequest() async throws {
        let (fixture, model, sessions) = try await signedIn()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        let overlay = fixture.overlay
        // A session first seen with a request, such as one recovered, opens nothing.
        sessions.fake.show(peak(.init(sequence: 3, kind: .dialog(dialog: "achievements"))))
        try await eventually { overlay.session != nil && sessions.active?.overlayRequest?.sequence == 3 }
        await drainMainQueue(times: 3)
        XCTAssertFalse(overlay.isPresented)

        sessions.fake.show(peak(.init(sequence: 4, kind: .dialog(dialog: "achievements"))))
        try await eventually { overlay.isPresented }
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.request, .achievements)
        try await eventually { sessions.fake.overlayStates.count == 1 }
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.fake.overlayStates, [.init(session: "peak", active: true, userInitiated: false)],
                       "The game opened it")

        // The same request seen again opens nothing more.
        overlay.hide()
        sessions.fake.show(peak(.init(sequence: 4, kind: .dialog(dialog: "achievements")), lobby: 1))
        try await eventually { sessions.active?.lobbyId == 1 }
        await drainMainQueue(times: 3)
        XCTAssertFalse(overlay.isPresented)
        try await eventually { sessions.fake.overlayStates.count == 2 }
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.fake.overlayStates.last, .init(session: "peak", active: false, userInitiated: false))

        // A page Obelisk cannot show opens nothing, and the next request still opens.
        sessions.fake.show(peak(.init(sequence: 5, kind: .webPage(url: "file:///etc/hosts", modal: false))))
        try await eventually { sessions.active?.overlayRequest?.sequence == 5 }
        await drainMainQueue(times: 3)
        XCTAssertFalse(overlay.isPresented)
        sessions.fake.show(peak(.init(sequence: 6, kind: .store(appId: 0, flag: .addToCart))))
        try await eventually { overlay.isPresented }
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.request, .webPage(URL(string: "https://store.steampowered.com/")!))

        // The open overlay turns to the next request: a friend's conversation.
        sessions.fake.show(peak(.init(sequence: 7, kind: .user(dialog: "chat", steamId: Self.alice))))
        try await eventually { overlay.request == .friends }
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.focus.conversation?.friendID, String(Self.alice))
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.presenter.shown.count, 2)

        // An invite dialog goes to the friends list's picker.
        var invite = peak(.init(sequence: 8, kind: .lobbyInvite(lobbyId: Self.peakLobby)))
        invite.inviteRequest = SteamInviteRequest(sequence: 8, invite: .lobby(lobbyId: Self.peakLobby))
        sessions.fake.show(invite)
        try await eventually { overlay.invitePicker != nil }
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.invitePicker?.invite, .lobby(lobbyId: Self.peakLobby))

        // Another session of the game starts from its own first request.
        overlay.hide()
        sessions.fake.show(peak(.init(sequence: 2, kind: .dialog(dialog: "friends")), id: "peak-again"))
        try await eventually { overlay.session?.id == "peak-again" }
        await drainMainQueue(times: 3)
        XCTAssertFalse(overlay.isPresented)
        sessions.fake.show(peak(.init(sequence: 3, kind: .remotePlayTogether), id: "peak-again"))
        try await eventually { overlay.isPresented }
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.request, .friends)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testTheSteamGameLearnsWhoOpenedTheOverlayAndNothingOnceItEnded() async throws {
        let fixture = OverlayFixture()
        let overlay = fixture.overlay
        let fake = fixture.steamSessions.fake
        fixture.frontmost = Self.game
        fake.show(peak(nil))
        try await eventually { overlay.session != nil && fixture.hotKey.isRegistered }

        // Shift-Tab: the player opened it, and closed it.
        fixture.hotKey.press()
        fixture.hotKey.press()
        try await eventually { fake.overlayStates.count == 2 }
        XCTAssertEqual(fake.overlayStates, [.init(session: "peak", active: true, userInitiated: true),
                                            .init(session: "peak", active: false, userInitiated: true)])

        // The game's request, closed by the player.
        overlay.present(.achievements)
        overlay.hide()
        try await eventually { fake.overlayStates.count == 4 }
        XCTAssertEqual(fake.overlayStates.suffix(2), [.init(session: "peak", active: true, userInitiated: false),
                                                       .init(session: "peak", active: false, userInitiated: false)])

        // A session that refuses changes nothing.
        fake.failSteamCalls("backend.steam.runtime.invalidSession")
        fixture.hotKey.press()
        try await eventually { fake.overlayStates.count == 5 }
        XCTAssertTrue(overlay.isPresented)
        fake.failSteamCalls(nil)

        // The game ends with the overlay open: nothing more is told.
        fake.show(nil)
        try await eventually { overlay.session == nil }
        XCTAssertFalse(overlay.isPresented)
        await drainMainQueue(times: 5)
        XCTAssertEqual(fake.overlayStates.count, 5)

        // Another storefront's game is told nothing.
        fixture.epicSessions.fake.show(.epic(account: "epic-account", id: "epic"))
        try await eventually { overlay.session?.id == "epic" }
        fixture.hotKey.press()
        overlay.hide()
        await drainMainQueue(times: 5)
        XCTAssertEqual(fake.overlayStates.count, 5)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testFriendsInvitationsShowJoinAndDismissAndANewOneToastsOnce() async throws {
        let (fixture, model, sessions) = try await signedIn()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        let overlay = fixture.overlay
        let toaster = fixture.toaster
        let now = UInt64(Date().timeIntervalSince1970)
        let peakApp = Self.peak.appId
        let old = SteamReceivedInvite(friendSteamId: Self.stranger, appId: peakApp, invite: .connect(connect: "+connect 10.0.0.1"),
                                      receivedAt: now - 600)
        let alice = SteamReceivedInvite(friendSteamId: Self.alice, appId: peakApp, invite: .lobby(lobbyId: Self.peakLobby),
                                        receivedAt: now - 500)
        let later = SteamReceivedInvite(friendSteamId: Self.other, appId: peakApp, invite: .lobby(lobbyId: 7),
                                        receivedAt: now - 400)

        // Invitations the session showed when first seen are listed, not toasted.
        sessions.fake.show(peak(nil, invites: [old]))
        try await eventually { overlay.receivedInvites == [old] }
        XCTAssertTrue(toaster.shown.isEmpty)

        // A new one toasts once, over the game, with who sent it.
        sessions.fake.show(peak(nil, invites: [alice, old]))
        try await eventually { toaster.shown.count == 1 }
        XCTAssertEqual(toaster.toasts.first?.message, L10n.string("ui.overlay.invites.toast", "Alice", "PEAK"))
        XCTAssertEqual(toaster.toasts.first?.hint, L10n.string("ui.overlay.invites.toastHint"))
        XCTAssertEqual(toaster.toasts.first?.friend?.steamID, Self.alice)
        XCTAssertEqual(toaster.shown.first?.game, Self.game)
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.receivedInvites, [alice, old], "Newest first")
        sessions.fake.show(peak(nil, invites: [alice, old], lobby: 1))
        try await eventually { sessions.active?.lobbyId == 1 }
        await drainMainQueue(times: 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(toaster.shown.count, 1, "The same invitation again toasts nothing")

        // A click on it opens the overlay, at the player's demand.
        toaster.click()
        XCTAssertTrue(overlay.isPresented)
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.request, .home)
        try await eventually { sessions.fake.overlayStates.first?.userInitiated == true }

        // While the overlay shows, a new invitation only joins the list.
        sessions.fake.show(peak(nil, invites: [later, alice, old], lobby: 1))
        try await eventually { overlay.receivedInvites.count == 3 }
        XCTAssertEqual(toaster.shown.count, 1)

        // Dismissed until its friend sends it again.
        overlay.dismiss(old)
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.receivedInvites, [later, alice])
        let resent = SteamReceivedInvite(friendSteamId: old.friendSteamId, appId: peakApp, invite: old.invite,
                                         receivedAt: now - 300)
        sessions.fake.show(peak(nil, invites: [resent, later, alice], lobby: 1))
        try await eventually { overlay.receivedInvites == [resent, later, alice] }

        // Joining tells the game, which drops it, and the player is back in the game.
        let gate = GameSessionGate<Void>()
        sessions.fake.holdSteamAnswers(gate)
        overlay.accept(alice)
        try await eventually { model.invitations.accepting == SteamReceivedInvitations.Key(alice) }
        XCTAssertTrue(overlay.isPresented, "Until the game is told")
        await gate.resolve(())
        sessions.fake.holdSteamAnswers(nil)
        try await eventually { !overlay.isPresented }
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.fake.acceptedInvites, [.init(session: "peak", friend: Self.alice,
                                                             invite: .lobby(lobbyId: Self.peakLobby))])
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.receivedInvites, [resent, later])
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.presenter.hidden.last, Self.game)

        // A refused join stays on its row, the overlay open.
        overlay.present(.home, userInitiated: true)
        sessions.fake.failSteamCalls("backend.steam.runtime.invalidSession")
        overlay.accept(later)
        try await eventually { model.invitations.failures[SteamReceivedInvitations.Key(later)] != nil }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.invitations.failures[SteamReceivedInvitations.Key(later)],
                       L10n.string("backend.steam.runtime.invalidSession"))
        XCTAssertNil(model.invitations.accepting)
        XCTAssertTrue(overlay.isPresented)
        sessions.fake.failSteamCalls(nil)

        // The game ends: its invitations and its toast go with it.
        sessions.fake.show(nil)
        try await eventually { overlay.receivedInvites.isEmpty && overlay.session == nil }
        XCTAssertFalse(toaster.isShowing)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testAPurchaseAsksThePlayerUntilAnsweredEvenAcrossClosings() async throws {
        let (fixture, model, sessions) = try await signedIn()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        let overlay = fixture.overlay
        let purchase = model.purchase
        sessions.fake.show(peak(nil))
        try await eventually { overlay.session != nil }

        sessions.fake.show(peak(nil, microTxn: SteamMicroTxn(orderId: 77, appId: Self.peak.appId)))
        try await eventually { overlay.isPresented }
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.request, .microTxn(orderId: 77))
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.pendingPurchase?.orderId, 77)
        XCTAssertFalse(overlay.back(), "No page behind it")

        // Closed unanswered, it still waits, and shows at the next opening.
        overlay.hide()
        XCTAssertEqual(purchase.pending?.orderId, 77)
        fixture.hotKey.press()
        XCTAssertTrue(overlay.isPresented)
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.request, .microTxn(orderId: 77))
        overlay.show(.home)
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.request, .microTxn(orderId: 77), "Home waits for the answer")

        // A refused answer shows its error and keeps the page.
        sessions.fake.failSteamCalls("backend.steam.runtime.invalidSession")
        overlay.answerPurchase(approve: false)
        try await eventually { purchase.error != nil }
        XCTAssertEqual(purchase.error, L10n.string("backend.steam.runtime.invalidSession"))
        XCTAssertFalse(purchase.isAnswering)
        XCTAssertTrue(overlay.isPresented)
        sessions.fake.failSteamCalls(nil)

        // Denied: the game is told, and the player is back in it.
        let gate = GameSessionGate<Void>()
        sessions.fake.holdSteamAnswers(gate)
        overlay.answerPurchase(approve: false)
        try await eventually { purchase.isAnswering }
        XCTAssertNil(purchase.error)
        await gate.resolve(())
        sessions.fake.holdSteamAnswers(nil)
        try await eventually { !overlay.isPresented }
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.fake.microTxnAnswers, [.init(session: "peak", orderID: 77, approve: false)])
        try await eventually { purchase.pending == nil }
        XCTAssertFalse(purchase.isAnswering)
        fixture.hotKey.press()
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.request, .home, "Nothing waits any more")
        overlay.hide()

        // The next purchase, authorized.
        sessions.fake.show(peak(nil, microTxn: SteamMicroTxn(orderId: 78, appId: Self.peak.appId)))
        try await eventually { overlay.request == .microTxn(orderId: 78) }
        overlay.answerPurchase(approve: true)
        try await eventually { !overlay.isPresented }
        XCTAssertEqual(sessions.fake.microTxnAnswers.last, .init(session: "peak", orderID: 78, approve: true))

        // A purchase the game stops waiting on leaves its page for home.
        sessions.fake.show(peak(nil, microTxn: SteamMicroTxn(orderId: 79, appId: Self.peak.appId)))
        try await eventually { overlay.request == .microTxn(orderId: 79) }
        sessions.fake.show(peak(nil, lobby: 1))
        try await eventually { purchase.pending == nil }
        XCTAssertTrue(overlay.back())
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.request, .home)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testSteamPagesAreSignedInAsTheAccount() async throws {
        let session = ChatBridgeTestSession(games: [Self.peak])
        let requests = WebSignInRequests()
        let model = friendsTestModel(connect: { _ in session }, webCookies: { asked in
            requests.record(asked === session ? Self.account : 0)
            return [SteamWebCookie(domain: "store.steampowered.com", name: "steamLoginSecure",
                                   value: "\(Self.account)%7C%7Caccess", httpOnly: true)]
        })
        let fixture = OverlayFixture(steam: model)
        let store = URL(string: "https://store.steampowered.com/app/620")!
        let noCookies = await fixture.overlay.webCookies(for: store)
        XCTAssertTrue(noCookies.isEmpty, "Signed out")

        await model.start()
        try await eventually { model.friends?.connection == .connected }
        let cookies = await fixture.overlay.webCookies(for: store)
        XCTAssertEqual(cookies.map(\.name), ["steamLoginSecure"])
        XCTAssertEqual(cookies.first?.domain, "store.steampowered.com")
        XCTAssertEqual(cookies.first?.value, "\(Self.account)%7C%7Caccess")
        XCTAssertEqual(cookies.first?.isSecure, true)
        XCTAssertEqual(cookies.first?.isHTTPOnly, true)
        let other = await fixture.overlay.webCookies(for: URL(string: "https://store.epicgames.com/")!)
        XCTAssertTrue(other.isEmpty, "Another site's page")
        let community = await fixture.overlay.webCookies(for: URL(string: "https://steamcommunity.com/app/620")!)
        XCTAssertEqual(community.count, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(requests.accounts, [Self.account], "Kept a while")
    }

    // MARK: Fixture

    /// A signed-in account's overlay, with PEAK in front once it runs.
    @MainActor
    private func signedIn() async throws -> (OverlayFixture, SteamModel, SteamGameSessions) {
        let session = ChatBridgeTestSession(games: [Self.peak])
        let sessions = SteamGameSessions()
        let model = friendsTestModel(connect: { _ in session }, gameSessions: sessions)
        let fixture = OverlayFixture(steam: model)
        fixture.frontmost = Self.game
        await model.start()
        try await eventually { model.friends?.connection == .connected && !model.library.games.isEmpty }
        return (fixture, model, sessions)
    }

    private func peak(_ request: SteamOverlayRequest?, id: String = "peak", invites: [SteamReceivedInvite] = [],
                      microTxn: SteamMicroTxn? = nil, lobby: UInt64? = nil) -> GameSessionState {
        var state = GameSessionState.steam(appID: Self.peak.appId, accountID: Self.account, id: id)
        state.overlayRequest = request
        state.receivedInvites = invites
        state.microTxn = microTxn
        state.lobbyId = lobby
        return state
    }
}

private final class WebSignInRequests: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var recorded: [UInt64] = []
    var accounts: [UInt64] { lock.withLock { recorded } }
    func record(_ account: UInt64) { lock.withLock { recorded.append(account) } }
}
```

```swift
/// The overlay over test Game sessions of every storefront, with a hot key and
/// a presenter that record what the overlay asks of them. Its panel, when it
/// shows one, opens off screen.
@MainActor
final class OverlayFixture {
    let app: AppModel
    let hotKey = RecordingOverlayHotKey()
    let presenter = RecordingOverlayPresenter()
    let toaster = RecordingOverlayToastPresenter()
    let steamSessions: SteamGameSessions
    let epicSessions = EpicGameSessions()
    let gogSessions = GogGameSessions()
    let voile: URL
    /// The application in front, as the overlay asks.
    var frontmost: OverlayApplication? {
        get { front.application }
        set { front.application = newValue }
    }
    var overlay: GameOverlayController { app.overlay }
    private let front: Front

    @MainActor final class Front {
        var application: OverlayApplication?
    }

    init(steam: SteamModel? = nil, showsPanel: Bool = false) {
        let directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: "ObeliskOverlay-\(UUID().uuidString)")
        let voile = directory.appending(path: "Voile")
        try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: voile.appending(path: "current/bin"), withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        self.voile = voile
        let steam = steam ?? SteamModel(directory: directory, gameSessions: SteamGameSessions())
        steamSessions = steam.gameSessions
        let front = Front()
        self.front = front
        presenter.showsPanel = showsPanel
        app = AppModel(
            directory: directory, steam: steam,
            epic: EpicModel(directory: directory, keychain: MemoryStore<EpicCredentials>(nil), gameSessions: epicSessions),
            gog: GogModel(directory: directory, keychain: MemoryStore<GogCredentials>(nil), gameSessions: gogSessions),
            overlay: GameOverlayEnvironment(hotKey: hotKey, presenter: presenter, toaster: toaster,
                                            frontmost: { front.application }, voile: voile.path,
                                            observesActivations: false)
        )
    }
}

@MainActor
final class RecordingOverlayHotKey: OverlayHotKey {
    private(set) var isRegistered = false
    private var action: (@MainActor () -> Void)?

    func register(_ action: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void) {
        guard !isRegistered else { return }
        isRegistered = true
        self.action = action
    }

    func unregister() {
        isRegistered = false
        action = nil
    }

    /// The player presses Shift-Tab; nothing happens unless it is registered.
    func press() { action?() }
}

@MainActor
final class RecordingOverlayPresenter: OverlayPresenter {
    var showsPanel = false
    private(set) var panel: GameOverlayPanel?
    /// The game each opening covered.
    private(set) var shown: [OverlayApplication?] = []
    /// What each closing brought back in front.
    private(set) var hidden: [OverlayApplication?] = []

    func show(_ overlay: GameOverlayController, over game: OverlayApplication?) {
        shown.append(game)
        guard showsPanel else { return }
        let panel = self.panel ?? GameOverlayPanel(overlay: overlay)
        self.panel = panel
        panel.sharingType = .none
        panel.setFrame(NSRect(x: -20_000, y: -20_000, width: 1280, height: 800), display: true)
        panel.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
    }

    func hide(returningTo application: OverlayApplication?) {
        hidden.append(application)
        panel?.orderOut(nil)
    }
}

@MainActor
final class RecordingOverlayToastPresenter: OverlayToastPresenter {
    /// Each toast shown, and the game whose screen it showed on.
    private(set) var shown: [(toast: OverlayToast, game: OverlayApplication?)] = []
    private(set) var hides = 0
    /// Whether a toast shows now.
    private(set) var isShowing = false
    private var open: (@MainActor () -> Void)?

    var toasts: [OverlayToast] { shown.map(\.toast) }

    func show(_ toast: OverlayToast, avatars: FriendsAvatarCache, over game: OverlayApplication?,
              open: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void) {
        shown.append((toast, game))
        isShowing = true
        self.open = open
    }

    func hide() {
        hides += 1
        isShowing = false
        open = nil
    }

    /// The player clicks the toast showing.
    func click() {
        let open = open
        hide()
        open?()
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/ObeliskTests/GamesFolderModelTests.swift`:

```swift
import AppKit
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

/// A games folder the test publishes, which records the player's changes.
@MainActor
final class FakeGamesFolder: GamesFolderBackend {
    enum Call: Equatable {
        case choose(String), chooseDefault, gather, volumesChanged
    }

    private(set) var calls: [Call] = []
    var inspection: GamesFolderInspection = .missing
    var failure: Error?
    private var current: GamesFolderState
    private var waiters: [CheckedContinuation<GamesFolderState, Never>] = []

    init(path: String = "/library/Games") {
        current = GamesFolderState(revision: 1, path: path, isDefault: true, isConnected: true)
    }

    func publish(path: String, isDefault: Bool, isConnected: Bool = true) {
        current = GamesFolderState(revision: current.revision + 1, path: path, isDefault: isDefault,
                                   isConnected: isConnected)
        let waiting = waiters
        waiters = []
        for waiter in waiting { waiter.resume(returning: current) }
    }

    func state() -> GamesFolderState { current }

    func changed(after: UInt64) async -> GamesFolderState {
        if current.revision > after { return current }
        return await withCheckedContinuation { waiters.append($0) }
    }

    func inspect(_ folder: String) -> GamesFolderInspection { inspection }
    func inspectDefault() -> GamesFolderInspection { inspection }

    func choose(_ folder: String) throws {
        calls.append(.choose(folder))
        if let failure { throw failure }
    }

    func chooseDefault() throws { calls.append(.chooseDefault) }
    func gather() { calls.append(.gather) }
    func volumesChanged() { calls.append(.volumesChanged) }
}

@MainActor
final class GamesFolderModelTests: XCTestCase {
    private func model(_ backend: FakeGamesFolder, center: NotificationCenter = NotificationCenter()) -> GamesFolderModel {
        GamesFolderModel(library: FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory, backend: backend, workspace: center)
    }

    func testAPickedFolderShowsWhatMovesThereThenTheGamesMoveOnceThePlayerAgrees() async throws {
        let backend = FakeGamesFolder()
        let model = model(backend)
        XCTAssertTrue(model.isDefault)
        let picked = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
        backend.inspection = .ready(path: picked.appending(path: "Obelisk Games").path, games: 3,
                                    copiedBytes: 1_000)

        model.propose(picked)
        let proposal = try XCTUnwrap(model.proposal)
        XCTAssertEqual(proposal.games, 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(proposal.copiedBytes, 1_000)
        XCTAssertFalse(proposal.volume.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(proposal.canChoose, "the Mac's own disk holds a kilobyte")
        XCTAssertTrue(backend.calls.isEmpty, "nothing moves before the player agrees")

        model.confirm()
        XCTAssertNil(model.proposal)
        XCTAssertEqual(backend.calls, [.choose(picked.path)])
        backend.publish(path: proposal.path, isDefault: false)
        try await eventually { model.path == proposal.path }
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isDefault)
        XCTAssertTrue(model.holds(proposal.path + "/Steam/steam-620-macos"))
        XCTAssertFalse(model.holds(proposal.path + " 2/Steam/steam-620-macos"))
    }

    func testAFolderThatCannotHoldTheGamesSaysWhyAndAsksNothing() {
        let backend = FakeGamesFolder()
        let model = model(backend)
        backend.inspection = .inside
        model.propose(FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory)
        XCTAssertNil(model.proposal)
        XCTAssertNotNil(model.failure)
    }

    func testAFailedChoiceIsShown() {
        let backend = FakeGamesFolder()
        let model = model(backend)
        backend.inspection = .ready(path: "/Volumes/Disk/Obelisk Games", games: 0, copiedBytes: 0)
        backend.failure = GameSessionError.Failure(reason: "model.gamesFolder.refused")
        model.propose(FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory)
        model.confirm()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.failure, L10n.string("model.gamesFolder.failed", L10n.string("model.gamesFolder.refused")))
    }

    func testADiskWithoutRoomOrWritingKeepsTheGamesWhereTheyAre() {
        let backend = FakeGamesFolder()
        let model = model(backend)
        let full = GamesFolderProposal(chosen: URL(filePath: "/Volumes/Disk"), path: "/Volumes/Disk/Obelisk Games",
                                       games: 2, copiedBytes: 10, volume: "Disk", availableBytes: 9, format: nil,
                                       isReadOnly: false)
        XCTAssertTrue(full.lacksSpace)
        model.proposal = full
        model.confirm()
        XCTAssertNotNil(model.proposal)
        let readOnly = GamesFolderProposal(chosen: URL(filePath: "/Volumes/Disk"), path: "/Volumes/Disk/Obelisk Games",
                                           games: 2, copiedBytes: 1, volume: "Disk", availableBytes: 9,
                                           format: "NTFS", isReadOnly: true)
        XCTAssertFalse(readOnly.canChoose)
        XCTAssertTrue(backend.calls.isEmpty)
    }

    func testMovingBackToThisMacChoosesObelisksOwnFolder() {
        let backend = FakeGamesFolder()
        let model = model(backend)
        backend.inspection = .ready(path: "/library/Games", games: 1, copiedBytes: 5)
        model.proposeDefault()
        XCTAssertNil(model.proposal?.chosen)
        model.confirm()
        XCTAssertEqual(backend.calls, [.chooseDefault])
    }

    func testADiskThatComesOrLeavesShowsItsGamesAgainOrHidesThem() async throws {
        let backend = FakeGamesFolder()
        let center = NotificationCenter()
        let model = model(backend, center: center)
        center.post(name: NSWorkspace.didMountNotification, object: nil)
        center.post(name: NSWorkspace.didUnmountNotification, object: nil)
        try await eventually { backend.calls.count == 2 }
        XCTAssertEqual(backend.calls, [.volumesChanged, .volumesChanged])
        backend.publish(path: "/Volumes/Gone/Obelisk Games", isDefault: false, isConnected: false)
        try await eventually { !model.isConnected }
        model.gather()
        XCTAssertEqual(backend.calls.last, .gather)
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/ObeliskTests/HomeShelvesTests.swift`:

```swift
import AppKit
import SwiftUI
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

/// What Home takes of each account library and how it merges them; each
/// library's own orders and featured game are AccountLibraryTests'.
@MainActor
final class HomeShelvesTests: XCTestCase {
    func testEachLibraryGivesHomeItsLastPlayedOrder() throws {
        let library = try library([
            game("Celeste", installed: true), game("Portal 2", played: 100, minutes: 5),
            game("Hades", played: 300, installed: true), game("Braid", minutes: 60_000),
        ])
        XCTAssertEqual(library.featured?.title, "Hades")
        XCTAssertEqual(library.recent.map(\.title), ["Hades", "Portal 2"], "Played games only")
        XCTAssertEqual(library.installed.map(\.title), ["Hades", "Celeste"])
        XCTAssertEqual(library.covers.map(\.title), ["Hades", "Portal 2", "Braid"])
        XCTAssertEqual(library.count, 4)
        XCTAssertNil(library.featured?.playtime)
        XCTAssertEqual(library.recent.last?.playtime, .seconds(300))
        XCTAssertEqual(library.recent.last?.lastPlayed, Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 100))
    }

    func testTheLastGamePlayedAnywhereLeadsAndTheShelvesFollowIt() throws {
        let shelves = HomeShelves([
            try library([game("Portal 2", played: 100, installed: true), game("Never played", minutes: 150, installed: true)]),
            try library([game("Rocket League", played: 300, installed: true)], in: .epic),
            try library([game("Hades", played: 200)], in: .gog),
        ])
        XCTAssertEqual(shelves.hero?.title, "Rocket League")
        XCTAssertEqual(shelves.recent.map(\.title), ["Hades", "Portal 2"])
        XCTAssertEqual(shelves.installed.map(\.title), ["Rocket League", "Portal 2", "Never played"])
    }

    func testAPlayedGameLeadsBeforeAnotherLibrarysMostPlayed() throws {
        let shelves = HomeShelves([
            try library([game("Celeste", played: 10, minutes: 1)]),
            try library([game("Braid", minutes: 10_000)], in: .epic),
        ])
        XCTAssertEqual(shelves.hero?.title, "Celeste")
        XCTAssertTrue(shelves.recent.isEmpty)
    }

    func testWithNothingPlayedTheMostPlayedLeadsThenTheFirstByName() throws {
        let played = HomeShelves([
            try library([game("Celeste", minutes: 1), game("Antichamber")]),
            try library([game("Braid", minutes: 10)], in: .epic),
        ])
        XCTAssertEqual(played.hero?.title, "Braid")
        XCTAssertTrue(played.recent.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertEqual(HomeShelves([try library([game("Celeste")]), try library([game("Braid")], in: .gog)]).hero?.title,
                       "Braid")
        XCTAssertNil(HomeShelves([try library([]), try library([])]).hero)
    }

    func testTheRecentShelfKeepsTheLastPlayedGamesOnly() throws {
        let shelves = HomeShelves([
            try library((0..<15).map { game("Steam \($0)", played: UInt64(2 * $0 + 2)) }),
            try library((0..<15).map { game("Epic \($0)", played: UInt64(2 * $0 + 3)) }, in: .epic),
        ])
        XCTAssertEqual(shelves.hero?.title, "Epic 14")
        XCTAssertEqual(shelves.recent.count, HomeShelves.shelfLimit)
        XCTAssertEqual(shelves.recent.prefix(3).map(\.title), ["Steam 14", "Epic 13", "Steam 13"])
        XCTAssertFalse(shelves.recent.contains { $0.id == shelves.hero?.id }, "The hero shows once")

        let alone = HomeShelves([try library((0..<25).map { game("Steam \($0)", played: UInt64($0 + 1)) })])
        XCTAssertEqual(alone.hero?.title, "Steam 24")
        XCTAssertEqual(alone.recent.count, HomeShelves.shelfLimit, "The library's hero leaves its shelf full")
    }

    func testEqualGamesGoSteamThenEpicThenGog() throws {
        let shelves = HomeShelves([
            try library([game("Hades", played: 100, installed: true)]),
            try library([game("Hades", played: 100, installed: true)], in: .epic),
            try library([game("Hades", played: 100, installed: true), game("Celeste", installed: true)], in: .gog),
        ])
        XCTAssertEqual(shelves.hero?.id.section, .steam)
        XCTAssertEqual(shelves.recent.map(\.id.section), [.epic, .gog])
        XCTAssertEqual(shelves.installed.map(\.id.section), [.steam, .epic, .gog, .gog])
        XCTAssertEqual(shelves.installed.last?.title, "Celeste")
    }

    func testHomeShowsStorefrontCloudLaunchFailures() async throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: "ObeliskHomeNotices-\(UUID().uuidString)")
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: root, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let suite = "ObeliskTests.\(UUID().uuidString)"
        let defaults = try XCTUnwrap(UserDefaults(suiteName: suite))
        defer { defaults.removePersistentDomain(forName: suite) }
        let epic = await connectedModel(WebTestSession<EpicGames>(
            credentials: EpicGames.credentials("current"),
            games: [EpicGames.game("rocket-league", title: "Rocket League")]
        ))
        let model = AppModel(directory: root, defaults: defaults, epic: epic)
        model.steam.cloud.connect(account: 42, backend: FakeInstallations())
        let host = NSHostingView(rootView: HomeView(model: model).frame(width: 900, height: 700))
        let rect = NSRect(x: -20_000, y: -20_000, width: 900, height: 700)
        let window = NSWindow(contentRect: rect, styleMask: .borderless, backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        window.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        window.sharingType = .none
        window.contentView = host
        window.setFrameOrigin(rect.origin)
        window.orderBack(nil)
        defer { window.close() }

        func documentHeight() async throws -> CGFloat {
            for _ in 0..<5 {
                await Task.yield()
                host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
                window.displayIfNeeded()
            }
            let scroll = try XCTUnwrap(firstScrollView(in: host))
            return try XCTUnwrap(scroll.documentView).frame.height
        }

        let baseHeight = try await documentHeight()
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(baseHeight, 0)

        model.steam.storageWarning = "Fixture storage warning"
        let warningHeight = try await documentHeight()
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(warningHeight, baseHeight)

        model.steam.storageWarning = nil
        let clearedWarningHeight = try await documentHeight()
        XCTAssertEqual(clearedWarningHeight, baseHeight, accuracy: 0.5)

        model.steam.cloud.sync = GameCloudSync.launch(
            2405060, question: .failed(1, error: "backend.steam.cloud.unsupported", launchAnyway: true)
        )
        let steamFailureHeight = try await documentHeight()
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(steamFailureHeight, baseHeight)

        model.steam.cloud.sync = nil
        model.epic.cloud.sync = GameCloudSync.launch(
            "fixture:rocket-league", question: .failed(2, error: "backend.epic.cloud_network", launchAnyway: true)
        )
        let epicFailureHeight = try await documentHeight()
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(epicFailureHeight, baseHeight)

        model.epic.cloud.sync = nil
        let finalHeight = try await documentHeight()
        XCTAssertEqual(finalHeight, baseHeight, accuracy: 0.5)
    }

    // MARK: Fixtures

    private struct Entry {
        let title: String
        let played: UInt64
        let minutes: UInt32
        let installed: Bool
    }

    private func game(_ title: String, played: UInt64 = 0, minutes: UInt32 = 0, installed: Bool = false) -> Entry {
        Entry(title: title, played: played, minutes: minutes, installed: installed)
    }

    /// The account library of `entries`, as Home shows it under `section`.
    private func library(_ entries: [Entry], in section: LibrarySection = .steam) throws -> HomeLibrary {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: "ObeliskHomeShelves-\(UUID().uuidString)")
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: root, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        addTeardownBlock { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let games = entries.enumerated().map { index, entry in
            SteamGame(appId: UInt32(index + 1), name: entry.title, iconHash: "", lastPlayed: entry.played,
                      playtimeMinutes: entry.minutes)
        }
        let receipts = zip(games, entries).filter { $1.installed }.map { game, _ in
            InstallationReceipt.steam(appId: game.appId, name: game.name, directory: root.appending(path: "\(game.appId)").path,
                                      platform: .mac)
        }
        let history = LaunchHistory(cache: LibraryCache(directory: root.path))
        let sessions = GameSessions<SteamGames>(FakeSessions(), history: history)
        let installations = GameInstallations(sessions: sessions, cloud: CloudModel(sessions: sessions))
        installations.connect(account: 42, backend: FakeInstallations(receipts: receipts),
                              port: InstallationPort(report: { _ in }, warn: { _ in }))
        let library = AccountLibrary<SteamGames, SteamGame>(history: history, cache: nil,
                                                            installations: installations)
        library.connect(42)
        library.show(games)
        return HomeLibrary(library) { game in
            HomeGame(game, of: library, in: section,
                     action: GameAction(kind: .download(.install), title: L10n.string("model.game.download"),
                                        isAvailable: true, launches: false),
                     cover: { AnyView(EmptyView()) },
                     hero: HomeGame.Hero(artwork: { AnyView(EmptyView()) }, logo: { AnyView(EmptyView()) }),
                     open: {})
        }
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/ObeliskTests/LaunchHistoryTests.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

@MainActor
final class LaunchHistoryTests: XCTestCase {
    private var directory: URL!

    override func setUp() async throws {
        directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
            .appending(path: "ObeliskLaunchHistory-\(UUID().uuidString)", directoryHint: .isDirectory)
    }

    override func tearDown() async throws {
        try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory)
    }

    private var file: URL { directory.appending(path: "library-cache.json") }

    private func steam(_ appId: UInt32, _ name: String) -> CachedSteamGame {
        CachedSteamGame(game: SteamGame(appId: appId, name: name, iconHash: "", lastPlayed: 0, playtimeMinutes: 0),
                        platforms: nil)
    }

    private let rocket = EpicGame(appName: "rocket", namespace: "space", catalogItemId: "item", title: "Rocket League",
                                  description: "", imageUrl: nil, headerImageUrl: nil, developer: "", windows: true, macos: false)

    func testALaunchIsKeptInItsGamesLibraryEntryUntilItsAccountIsForgotten() throws {
        let cache = try LibraryCache.holding(steam: [7: [steam(620, "Portal 2"), steam(570, "Dota 2")]],
                                             epic: ["epic-a": [CachedEpicGame(game: rocket, playtimeSeconds: nil)]],
                                             in: directory)
        let history = LaunchHistory(cache: cache)
        let earlier = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_790_000_000)
        let later = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_790_000_600)
        history.record(rocket.libraryID, account: "epic-a", in: EpicGames.self, at: earlier)
        history.record(620, account: 7, in: SteamGames.self, at: earlier)
        history.record(rocket.libraryID, account: "epic-a", in: EpicGames.self, at: later)

        let reopened = LaunchHistory(cache: LibraryCache(directory: directory.path))
        XCTAssertEqual(reopened.lastLaunch(of: rocket.libraryID, account: "epic-a", in: EpicGames.self), later)
        XCTAssertEqual(reopened.lastLaunch(of: 620, account: 7, in: SteamGames.self), earlier)
        XCTAssertNil(reopened.lastLaunch(of: 570, account: 7, in: SteamGames.self))
        XCTAssertNil(reopened.lastLaunch(of: rocket.libraryID, account: "epic-b", in: EpicGames.self),
                     "Another account never sees these launches")

        cache.flush()
        let saved = try XCTUnwrap(JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: Data(contentsOf: file)) as? [String: Any])
        let epic = try XCTUnwrap(((saved["epic"] as? [String: Any])?["epic-a"] as? [[String: Any]])?.first)
        XCTAssertEqual(epic["lastLaunchedAt"] as? String, "2026-09-21T14:23:20Z", "In the game's own library entry")
        let steam = try XCTUnwrap((saved["steam"] as? [String: Any])?["7"] as? [[String: Any]])
        XCTAssertEqual(steam.first { $0["id"] as? String == "620" }?["lastLaunchedAt"] as? String, "2026-09-21T14:13:20Z")
        XCTAssertNil(steam.first { $0["id"] as? String == "570" }?["lastLaunchedAt"])

        history.forget(account: 7, in: SteamGames.self)
        cache.forget(account: .steam(steamId: 7))
        XCTAssertNil(history.lastLaunch(of: 620, account: 7, in: SteamGames.self))
        XCTAssertNil(LaunchHistory(cache: cache).lastLaunch(of: 620, account: 7, in: SteamGames.self))
        XCTAssertEqual(history.lastLaunch(of: rocket.libraryID, account: "epic-a", in: EpicGames.self), later)
    }

    func testSessionsRecordALaunchWhenRustSaysItsGameStartedButNotARecoveredGame() async throws {
        let core = FakeSessions(recovering: true)
        let history = LaunchHistory(cache: LibraryCache(directory: directory.path))
        // Rust gives a game recovered running no start: it started before.
        core.show(.epic(account: "epic-a", appName: "recovered"))
        let sessions = EpicGameSessions(core, history: history)
        try await eventually { sessions.active?.running == true }
        XCTAssertNil(history.lastLaunch(of: "namespace:recovered", account: "epic-a", in: EpicGames.self))
        core.show(nil)

        let launch = GameSessionState.epic(account: "epic-a", appName: "launched", phase: .preparing)
        core.show(launch)
        try await eventually { sessions.active?.id == launch.id }
        XCTAssertNil(history.lastLaunch(of: "namespace:launched", account: "epic-a", in: EpicGames.self),
                     "A launch that has not started yet is not a launch")
        var running = launch
        running.phase = .running
        running.startedAt = 1_790_000_000
        core.show(running)
        try await eventually { sessions.active?.running == true }
        XCTAssertEqual(history.lastLaunch(of: "namespace:launched", account: "epic-a", in: EpicGames.self),
                       Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_790_000_000))
    }

    func testSessionsRecordAShortGameWhoseRunningStateTheyNeverSaw() async throws {
        let core = FakeSessions()
        let history = LaunchHistory(cache: LibraryCache(directory: directory.path))
        let sessions = EpicGameSessions(core, history: history)
        let launch = GameSessionState.epic(account: "epic-a", appName: "short", phase: .preparing)
        core.show(launch)
        try await eventually { sessions.active?.id == launch.id }

        // Rust publishes only its latest state: a game that ran and exited
        // between two of them shows only as the last session, finished.
        var finished = launch
        finished.phase = .finished
        finished.startedAt = 1_790_000_000
        core.publish { state in
            state.active = nil
            state.last = finished
        }
        try await eventually { sessions.active == nil }
        XCTAssertEqual(history.lastLaunch(of: "namespace:short", account: "epic-a", in: EpicGames.self),
                       Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_790_000_000))
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/ObeliskTests/LaunchSettingsModelTests.swift`:

```swift
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

final class LaunchSettingsModelTests: XCTestCase {
    private static func settings(choices: LaunchChoices = LaunchChoices(),
                                 engine: LaunchEngine = .rosetta) -> LaunchSettings {
        LaunchSettings(
            engine: engine, graphics: engine == .rosetta ? .d3dMetal : .dxmt, rayTracing: true,
            performanceHud: choices.performanceHud, choices: choices, defaultEngine: .rosetta,
            engines: [
                LaunchEngineOffer(
                    engine: .rosetta, translator: .rosetta, defaultGraphics: .d3dMetal,
                    graphics: [
                        LaunchGraphicsOffer(graphics: .d3dMetal, options: [.rayTracing]),
                        LaunchGraphicsOffer(graphics: .dxmt, options: []),
                    ]
                ),
                LaunchEngineOffer(
                    engine: .linux, translator: .fex, defaultGraphics: .dxmt,
                    graphics: [LaunchGraphicsOffer(graphics: .dxmt, options: [])]
                ),
            ]
        )
    }

    @MainActor
    func testAChoiceKeepsTheOthersAndTheOffersFollowTheEngineRustReturns() async throws {
        var saved: [LaunchChoices] = []
        let saving = expectation(description: "saved")
        let model = LaunchSettingsModel(
            load: { Self.settings() },
            save: { choices in
                saved.append(choices)
                saving.fulfill()
                return Self.settings(choices: choices, engine: choices.engine ?? .rosetta)
            }
        )
        await model.appear()
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isCustomized)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.graphicsOffer?.options, [.rayTracing])

        model.choose { $0.engine = .linux }
        await fulfillment(of: [saving], timeout: 2)

        XCTAssertEqual(saved, [LaunchChoices(engine: .linux)])
        try await waitUntil { model.settings?.engine == .linux }
        XCTAssertTrue(model.isCustomized)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.engineOffer?.translator, .fex)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.graphicsOffer?.graphics, .dxmt)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.graphicsOffer?.options, [])
    }

    @MainActor
    func testRestoringDefaultsForgetsEveryChoice() async throws {
        var saved: [LaunchChoices] = []
        let model = LaunchSettingsModel(
            load: { Self.settings(choices: LaunchChoices(arguments: "-windowed", engine: .linux, rayTracing: false,
                                                                 performanceHud: true),
                                  engine: .linux) },
            save: { choices in
                saved.append(choices)
                return Self.settings(choices: choices)
            }
        )
        await model.appear()
        XCTAssertTrue(model.isCustomized)

        model.reset()

        try await waitUntil { !model.isCustomized }
        XCTAssertEqual(saved, [LaunchChoices()])
    }

    @MainActor
    func testAChangeRustCouldNotKeepIsReportedAndTheSettingsStay() async throws {
        struct NotSaved: LocalizedError { var errorDescription: String? { "not saved" } }
        let model = LaunchSettingsModel(load: { Self.settings() }, save: { _ in throw NotSaved() })
        await model.appear()

        model.choose { $0.rayTracing = false }

        try await waitUntil { model.error != nil }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.error, "not saved")
        XCTAssertEqual(model.settings, Self.settings())
    }

    @MainActor
    func testTypedArgumentsAreKeptTrimmedOnlyWhenTheyChange() async throws {
        var saved: [LaunchChoices] = []
        let model = LaunchSettingsModel(
            load: { Self.settings() },
            save: { choices in
                saved.append(choices)
                return Self.settings(choices: choices)
            }
        )
        await model.appear()

        model.setArguments("   ")
        model.setArguments("  -dx11 \"+exec auto exec.cfg\" ")
        try await waitUntil { model.settings?.choices.arguments != nil }
        model.setArguments("-dx11 \"+exec auto exec.cfg\"")
        model.setArguments("")
        try await waitUntil { saved.count == 2 }

        XCTAssertEqual(saved.map(\.arguments), ["-dx11 \"+exec auto exec.cfg\"", nil])
    }

    @MainActor
    private func waitUntil(_ condition: () -> Bool) async throws {
        for _ in 0..<200 where !condition() {
            try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(10))
        }
        XCTAssertTrue(condition())
    }
}
```

```swift
import AppKit
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

final class LocalizationTests: XCTestCase {
    func testSystemLanguageAndRegionalVariants() {
        for identifier in ["fr", "fr-FR", "fr_CA", "fr-BE"] {
            XCTAssertEqual(L10n.resolvedLanguage(preferredLanguages: [identifier]), "fr", identifier)
        }
        for identifier in ["en", "en-US", "en_GB", "de-DE", "ja-JP", "zh-Hant", ""] {
            XCTAssertEqual(L10n.resolvedLanguage(preferredLanguages: [identifier]), "en", identifier)
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(L10n.resolvedLanguage(preferredLanguages: []), "en")
        XCTAssertEqual(L10n.resolvedLanguage(preferredLanguages: ["de-DE", "fr-FR"]), "en")
        XCTAssertEqual(L10n.resolvedLanguage(preferredLanguages: ["de-DE"], available: ["en", "fr", "de"]), "de")
    }

    func testTheLanguageChoicesAreTheMacsThenEveryTranslationByItsOwnName() {
        XCTAssertEqual(AppLanguage.choices, [.system, .language("en"), .language("fr")])
        XCTAssertEqual(AppLanguage.name(of: "en"), "English")
        XCTAssertEqual(AppLanguage.name(of: "fr"), "Français")
        XCTAssertEqual(AppLanguage.language("fr").resolved(system: ["en-US"]), "fr")
        XCTAssertEqual(AppLanguage.system.resolved(system: ["fr-BE", "en"]), "fr")
        XCTAssertEqual(AppLanguage.system.resolved(system: ["ja-JP"]), "en")
        XCTAssertEqual(AppLanguage.language("en").flags, ["Flag-us", "Flag-gb"])
        XCTAssertEqual(AppLanguage.language("fr").flags, ["Flag-fr"])
        XCTAssertEqual(AppLanguage.system.flags, [])
        for code in L10n.available {
            let flags = AppLanguage.language(code).flags
            XCTAssertFalse(flags.isEmpty, code)
            for flag in flags {
                XCTAssertNotNil(NSImage(named: flag), "\(code) misses \(flag)")
            }
        }
    }

    func testBothTranslationsArePackagedAndUnsupportedLanguagesUseEnglish() {
        XCTAssertTrue(Bundle.main.localizations.contains("en"))
        XCTAssertTrue(Bundle.main.localizations.contains("fr"))
        XCTAssertEqual(Bundle.main.developmentLocalization, "en")
        XCTAssertEqual(LocalizedStrings(language: "en").string("app.library"), "Library")
        XCTAssertEqual(LocalizedStrings(language: "fr-CA").string("app.library"), "Bibliothèque")
        XCTAssertEqual(LocalizedStrings(language: "de-DE").string("app.library"), "Library")
    }

    func testGameCountsUseEachLanguagesPluralRules() {
        let english = LocalizedStrings(language: "en")
        let french = LocalizedStrings(language: "fr")
        for (count, en, fr) in [(0, "0 games", "0 jeu"), (1, "1 game", "1 jeu"), (2, "2 games", "2 jeux")] {
            XCTAssertEqual(english.string("ui.library.game_count", arguments: [Int64(count)]), en)
            XCTAssertEqual(french.string("ui.library.game_count", arguments: [Int64(count)]), fr)
        }
    }

    func testInterpolatedTextAndNumbersKeepTheirPlaceholders() {
        let english = LocalizedStrings(language: "en")
        let french = LocalizedStrings(language: "fr")
        XCTAssertEqual(english.string("ui.transfer.verified_files", arguments: ["12 MB", "30 MB"]), "Files verified: 12 MB of 30 MB")
        XCTAssertEqual(french.string("ui.transfer.verified_files", arguments: ["12 Mo", "30 Mo"]), "Fichiers vérifiés : 12 Mo sur 30 Mo")
        XCTAssertEqual(english.string("model.keychain.readFailed", arguments: ["Steam", Int64(-50)]), "Unable to read the Steam session in the macOS Keychain (-50).")
    }

    func testRustKeysAndStructuredArgumentsAreLocalized() throws {
        let english = LocalizedStrings(language: "en")
        let french = LocalizedStrings(language: "fr")
        XCTAssertEqual(english.message("backend.epic.unauthorized"), "Your Epic Games session has expired. Sign in again.")
        XCTAssertEqual(french.message("backend.epic.unauthorized"), "La session Epic Games a expiré. Reconnectez votre compte.")
        let payload = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: ["key": "backend.epic.http", "args": ["503"]])
        let encoded = try XCTUnwrap(String(data: payload, encoding: .utf8))
        XCTAssertEqual(english.message(encoded), "Epic Games is unavailable for this request (HTTP 503).")
        XCTAssertEqual(french.message(encoded), "Epic Games est indisponible pour cette demande (HTTP 503).")
        XCTAssertEqual(french.message("model.epic.recoveringSession"), "Reconnexion au jeu Epic en cours…")
        XCTAssertEqual(english.message("model.steam.recoveringSession"), "Recovering the Steam game session…")
        for raw in ["Game_Data/level1.bin", "An external diagnostic", "{malformed}", "model.bin"] {
            XCTAssertEqual(french.message(raw), raw)
        }
    }

    func testFormattingKeepsTheRegionAndUsesTheSelectedLanguage() {
        let locale = L10n.formattingLocale(language: "fr", region: "CA")
        XCTAssertEqual(locale.language.languageCode?.identifier, "fr")
        XCTAssertEqual(locale.region?.identifier, "CA")
        let date = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_735_689_600)
        XCTAssertEqual(date.formatted(.dateTime.month(.wide).locale(Locale(identifier: "en"))), "January")
        XCTAssertEqual(date.formatted(.dateTime.month(.wide).locale(Locale(identifier: "fr"))), "janvier")
    }

    func testNestedRustErrorsAndLiteralPathArguments() throws {
        let nested = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: [
            "key": "backend.steam.cm.rejected",
            "args": ["backend.steam.cm.action.depot", "5"]
        ])
        let encoded = try XCTUnwrap(String(data: nested, encoding: .utf8))
        XCTAssertEqual(LocalizedStrings(language: "en").message(encoded), "Steam rejected depot access (result 5).")
        XCTAssertEqual(LocalizedStrings(language: "fr").message(encoded), "Steam a refusé l’accès au dépôt (résultat 5).")

        let filename = "Game Data/\"quoted\"/100%.bin"
        let path = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: ["key": "backend.steam.content.unsafePath", "args": [filename]])
        XCTAssertEqual(LocalizedStrings(language: "en").message(try XCTUnwrap(String(data: path, encoding: .utf8))), "Unsafe download path: \(filename)")
    }
}
```

`apps/macos/ObeliskTests/PerformanceReportsTests.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

@MainActor
final class PerformanceReportsTests: XCTestCase {
    private var directory: URL!

    override func setUp() async throws {
        directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
            .appending(path: "ObeliskPerformanceReports-\(UUID().uuidString)", directoryHint: .isDirectory)
    }

    override func tearDown() async throws {
        try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory)
    }

    private static let windows = GamePlayed(
        seconds: 2410, frames: 140_321, medianFps: 58.2, low1pctFps: 41, hitches: 3, exitCode: 0, exitSignal: nil,
        endedByObelisk: false, engine: "linux", graphics: "d3dmetal", voile: "v26.3.0-13"
    )
    private static let mac = MacHardware(chip: "Apple M2 Pro", model: "Mac14,12", memoryGB: 32, gpuCores: 19,
                                         macOSVersion: "27.0")

    func testAGameThatRanAndExitedIsReportedOnceWithWhatItPlayed() async throws {
        let core = FakeSessions()
        let sessions = EpicGameSessions(core, history: LaunchHistory(cache: LibraryCache(directory: directory.path)))
        var reported: [(String, GamePlayed)] = []
        sessions.reportPlayed = { reported.append(($0, $1)) }
        let launch = GameSessionState.epic(account: "epic-a", appName: "Sugar", phase: .running)
        core.show(launch)
        try await eventually { sessions.active?.running == true }
        XCTAssertTrue(reported.isEmpty, "a running game has played nothing yet")

        var finalizing = launch
        finalizing.phase = .finalizing
        finalizing.played = Self.windows
        core.show(finalizing)
        try await eventually { sessions.active?.phase == .finalizing }
        var finished = finalizing
        finished.phase = .finished
        core.publish { state in
            state.active = nil
            state.last = finished
        }
        try await eventually { sessions.active == nil }
        XCTAssertEqual(reported.map(\.0), ["namespace:Sugar"], "the session's later states report nothing more")
        XCTAssertEqual(reported.first?.1, Self.windows)
    }

    func testAReportNamesItsFieldsAsTheSiteReadsThemAndLeavesOutWhatIsUnknown() throws {
        let native = GamePlayed(seconds: 3, frames: 0, medianFps: nil, low1pctFps: nil, hitches: 0, exitCode: nil,
                                exitSignal: 11, endedByObelisk: false, engine: nil, graphics: nil, voile: nil)
        let report = SessionReport(store: .gog, game: "1207658924", title: "Unrailed!", played: native, mac: Self.mac,
                                   obeliskVersion: "0.1.0")
        let json = try XCTUnwrap(JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: JSONEncoder().encode(report)) as? [String: Any])
        XCTAssertEqual(json["store"] as? String, "gog")
        XCTAssertEqual(json["store_game_id"] as? String, "1207658924")
        XCTAssertEqual(json["game_platform"] as? String, "macos", "Rust names no engine for a Mac game")
        XCTAssertEqual(json["engine"] as? String, "native")
        XCTAssertEqual(json["exit_signal"] as? Int, 11)
        XCTAssertEqual(json["gpu_cores"] as? Int, 19)
        XCTAssertEqual(json["stopped_from_obelisk"] as? Bool, false)
        for absent in ["graphics", "voile_version", "fps_median", "fps_low_1pct", "exit_code"] {
            XCTAssertNil(json[absent], "\(absent) is left out")
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(Set(json.keys), [
            "store", "store_game_id", "game_name", "game_platform", "engine", "chip", "gpu_cores", "mac_model",
            "memory_gb", "macos_version", "obelisk_version", "duration_s", "frames", "hitches", "exit_signal",
            "stopped_from_obelisk",
        ])
    }

    func testNothingIsSentWhileSharingIsOffOrWithoutATitle() async throws {
        let sent = Sent()
        let reports = PerformanceReports(isEnabled: false, mac: Self.mac) { await sent.add($0) }
        reports.report(Self.windows, of: "1245620", titled: "ELDEN RING", in: .steam)
        reports.isEnabled = true
        reports.report(Self.windows, of: "1245620", titled: nil, in: .steam)
        reports.report(Self.windows, of: "1245620", titled: "ELDEN RING", in: .steam)
        try await eventually { await sent.count == 1 }
        let report = await sent.reports.first
        XCTAssertEqual(report?.gameName, "ELDEN RING")
        XCTAssertEqual(report?.gamePlatform, "windows")
        XCTAssertEqual(report?.engine, "linux")
        XCTAssertEqual(report?.voileVersion, "v26.3.0-13")
    }

    func testTheMacsHardwareReadsAsAnAppleChip() {
        let mac = MacHardware.current
        XCTAssertTrue(mac.chip.hasPrefix("Apple M"), mac.chip)
        XCTAssertTrue(mac.model.hasPrefix("Mac"), mac.model)
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(mac.memoryGB, 0)
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(mac.gpuCores ?? 0, 0)
    }
}

private actor Sent {
    private(set) var reports: [SessionReport] = []
    var count: Int { reports.count }
    func add(_ report: SessionReport) { reports.append(report) }
}

@MainActor
final class PerformanceEstimatesTests: XCTestCase {
    /// An answer as getobelisk.app gives it, for an M4.
    private static let answer = Data("""
    {"chip":"Apple M4","games":[
      {"store":"steam","id":"1245620","name":"ELDEN RING","slug":"elden-ring","measured_on":"Apple M3",
       "sessions":4,"fps_median":32,"fps_low_1pct":18,"crash_rate":0},
      {"store":"epic","id":"Sugar","name":"Rocket League","slug":"rocket-league","measured_on":"Apple M4",
       "sessions":3,"fps_median":null,"fps_low_1pct":null,"crash_rate":1}
    ]}
    """.utf8)

    private struct Answer: Decodable { let games: [PerformanceEstimates.Estimate] }

    func testEachGameIsFoundByItsStoreAndID() async throws {
        let games = try JSONDecoder().decode(Answer.self, from: Self.answer).games
        let estimates = PerformanceEstimates(chip: "Apple M4") { _ in games }
        estimates.refresh()
        try await eventually { estimates.estimate(store: .steam, id: "1245620") != nil }
        let eldenRing = try XCTUnwrap(estimates.estimate(store: .steam, id: "1245620"))
        XCTAssertEqual(eldenRing.measuredOn, "Apple M3")
        XCTAssertEqual(eldenRing.fpsMedian, 32)
        XCTAssertEqual(eldenRing.page, URL(string: "https://getobelisk.app/games/elden-ring"))
        XCTAssertNil(estimates.estimate(store: .epic, id: "Sugar")?.fpsMedian, "every session ended too soon")
        XCTAssertNil(estimates.estimate(store: .gog, id: "1245620"), "the store is part of the ID")
    }

    func testTheTableIsAskedForOnceAnHourAndAFailureKeepsTheLastOne() async throws {
        let games = try JSONDecoder().decode(Answer.self, from: Self.answer).games
        let calls = Calls()
        let estimates = PerformanceEstimates(chip: "Apple M4") { chip in
            await calls.add(chip)
            return await calls.count == 1 ? games : nil
        }
        let start = Date.now
        estimates.refresh(now: start)
        try await eventually { await calls.count == 1 && estimates.estimate(store: .steam, id: "1245620") != nil }
        estimates.refresh(now: start.addingTimeInterval(60))
        estimates.refresh(now: start.addingTimeInterval(PerformanceEstimates.lifetime))
        try await eventually { await calls.count == 2 }
        let chips = await calls.chips
        XCTAssertEqual(chips, ["Apple M4", "Apple M4"])
        XCTAssertNotNil(estimates.estimate(store: .steam, id: "1245620"), "a failed answer keeps the last table")
    }
}

private actor Calls {
    private(set) var chips: [String] = []
    var count: Int { chips.count }
    func add(_ chip: String) { chips.append(chip) }
}
```

`apps/macos/ObeliskTests/StableScroller.swift`:

```swift
import AppKit
import XCTest

/// What a page's scrolling must keep while its content changes: the same
/// scroll view and scrollbar, the overlay scroller style, and the content width.
@MainActor
struct StableScroller {
    let scroll: NSScrollView
    let scroller: NSScroller
    let width: CGFloat

    /// The first scroll view in `host` as it is now, whose content keeps
    /// `width`, else its current width.
    init(in host: NSView, width: CGFloat? = nil) throws {
        scroll = try XCTUnwrap(firstScrollView(in: host))
        scroller = try XCTUnwrap(scroll.verticalScroller)
        self.width = width ?? scroll.contentView.bounds.width
    }

    func assertKept(in host: NSView, during phase: String, file: StaticString = #filePath, line: UInt = #line) throws {
        let current = try XCTUnwrap(firstScrollView(in: host), file: file, line: line)
        XCTAssertTrue(current === scroll, "The scroll view changed during \(phase)", file: file, line: line)
        XCTAssertTrue(current.verticalScroller === scroller, "The scrollbar changed during \(phase)", file: file, line: line)
        XCTAssertTrue(current.hasVerticalScroller, file: file, line: line)
        XCTAssertEqual(current.scrollerStyle, .overlay, "Unexpected scroller style during \(phase)", file: file, line: line)
        XCTAssertEqual(current.contentView.bounds.width, width, accuracy: 0.5,
                       "The content width changed during \(phase)", file: file, line: line)
    }
}

@MainActor
func firstScrollView(in view: NSView) -> NSScrollView? {
    if let scroll = view as? NSScrollView { return scroll }
    return view.subviews.lazy.compactMap { firstScrollView(in: $0) }.first
}
```

```swift
import AppKit

@testable import Obelisk

final class SteamAchievementsTests: XCTestCase {
    @MainActor
    func testResetAndReplacementDiscardLateAccountOrGameResponses() async throws {
        let old = AchievementResponse()
        let model = GameAchievementsModel(storeID: "steam", describe: SteamModel.message)
        model.load { await old.get() }
        await old.waitUntilRequested()
        model.reset()
        model.load { [Self.achievement("new", unlocked: true)] }
        try await eventually { model.items != nil }
        await old.resolve([Self.achievement("old", unlocked: false)])
        await Task.yield()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.items?.map(\.id), ["new"])
        XCTAssertEqual(model.countText, "1/1")
        XCTAssertEqual(model.fraction, 1)
        model.isPresented = true
        model.reset()
        XCTAssertNil(model.items)
        XCTAssertNil(model.fraction)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isPresented)
    }

    private static func achievement(_ id: String, unlocked: Bool) -> GameAchievement {
        GameAchievement(id: id, name: unlocked ? "Une première victoire" : "Un nouveau défi", description: "Terminer une partie et défendre le royaume.", iconUrl: "", hidden: false, unlocked: unlocked, unlockDate: unlocked ? Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_790_000_000) : nil)
    }
    @MainActor
    private func eventually(_ condition: () -> Bool) async throws {
        for _ in 0..<200 {
            if condition() { return }
            try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(5))
        }
        XCTFail("Achievement request did not complete")
    }
    @MainActor
    private func render(_ view: some View, to url: URL) async throws {
        let host = NSHostingView(rootView: view)
        let size = host.fittingSize
        let rect = NSRect(x: -20_000, y: -20_000, width: size.width, height: size.height)
        let window = NSWindow(contentRect: rect, styleMask: .borderless, backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        window.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        window.sharingType = .none
        window.contentView = host
        window.setFrameOrigin(rect.origin)
        window.orderBack(nil)
        defer { window.close() }
        host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
        try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(200))
        host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
        window.displayIfNeeded()
        let bitmap = try XCTUnwrap(host.bitmapImageRepForCachingDisplay(in: host.bounds))
        host.cacheDisplay(in: host.bounds, to: bitmap)
        try XCTUnwrap(bitmap.representation(using: .png, properties: [:])).write(to: url)
    }

}

private actor AchievementResponse {
    private var continuation: CheckedContinuation<[GameAchievement], Never>?
    func get() async -> [GameAchievement] { await withCheckedContinuation { continuation = $0 } }
    func waitUntilRequested() async {
        while continuation == nil { await Task.yield() }
    }
    func resolve(_ value: [GameAchievement]) { continuation?.resume(returning: value); continuation = nil }
}
```

```swift
import AppKit
import Foundation
import SwiftUI
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

final class SteamChatIntegrationTests: XCTestCase {
    private let friend = ChatBridgeTestSession.friendID

    @MainActor
    func testIncomingMessagesCountAsUnreadUntilReadInActiveApp() async throws {
        let session = ChatBridgeTestSession()
        let model = friendsTestModel(connect: { _ in session })
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        let chat = model.chat
        chat.applicationActivityChanged(false)

        // Fixture events cross the production decoders and the bridge records.
        session.chat.incomingMessage(friendSteamId: friend, message: "Salut \\[toi]", timestamp: 100, ordinal: 0, fromMe: false)
        try await eventually { chat.unread[self.friend] == 1 }
        session.chat.incomingMessage(friendSteamId: friend, message: "Salut \\[toi]", timestamp: 100, ordinal: 0, fromMe: false)
        session.chat.incomingMessage(friendSteamId: friend, message: "encore", timestamp: 101, ordinal: 0, fromMe: false)
        session.chat.incomingMessage(friendSteamId: friend, message: "depuis le téléphone", timestamp: 102, ordinal: 0, fromMe: true)
        try await eventually { chat.conversations[self.friend]?.lines.count == 3 }
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.unread[friend], 2, "A repeated (timestamp, ordinal) and the account's own echo are not unread")
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.totalUnread, 2)
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.conversations[friend]?.lines.first?.content, .message(fromMe: false, bbcode: "Salut \\[toi]"))
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.conversations[friend]?.lines.last?.fromMe, true)

        // On screen while Obelisk is in the background: still unread.
        chat.show(friend)
        try await eventually { chat.conversations[self.friend]?.isLoaded == true }
        XCTAssertEqual(session.acks, [])
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.unread[friend], 2)
        chat.applicationActivityChanged(true)
        try await eventually { session.acks == [ChatBridgeTestSession.Ack(friend: self.friend, timestamp: 102)] }
        XCTAssertNil(chat.unread[friend])

        // A message arriving while read is acknowledged at once.
        session.chat.typing(friendSteamId: friend)
        try await eventually { chat.conversations[self.friend]?.isFriendTyping == true }
        session.chat.incomingMessage(friendSteamId: friend, message: "là ?", timestamp: 110, ordinal: 0, fromMe: false)
        try await eventually { session.acks.last?.timestamp == 110 }
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.conversations[friend]?.isFriendTyping, false, "A message ends the friend's typing")
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.totalUnread, 0)

        // Read in another session of the account.
        chat.hide(friend)
        session.chat.incomingMessage(friendSteamId: friend, message: "?", timestamp: 120, ordinal: 0, fromMe: false)
        try await eventually { chat.unread[self.friend] == 1 }
        session.chat.readElsewhere(friendSteamId: friend, timestamp: 120)
        try await eventually { chat.unread[self.friend] == nil }
    }

    @MainActor
    func testSteamUnreadCountsShowAtConnectionAndClearOnceRead() async throws {
        let session = ChatBridgeTestSession()
        session.sessions = [SteamChatSession(friendSteamId: friend, lastMessage: 50, lastView: 40, unreadMessageCount: 3)]
        session.history = { _, _ in
            SteamChatHistory(messages: [SteamChatHistoryMessage(fromMe: false, timestamp: 50, ordinal: 1, message: "hello")],
                             moreAvailable: false)
        }
        let model = friendsTestModel(connect: { _ in session })
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        let chat = model.chat
        try await eventually { chat.totalUnread == 3 }
        chat.applicationActivityChanged(true)
        chat.show(friend)
        try await eventually { session.acks == [ChatBridgeTestSession.Ack(friend: self.friend, timestamp: 50)] }
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.totalUnread, 0)
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.conversations[friend]?.lines.map(\.id), [.message(timestamp: 50, ordinal: 1)])
        // Showing it again sends nothing new.
        chat.hide(friend)
        chat.show(friend)
        try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(50))
        XCTAssertEqual(session.acks.count, 1)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testFallingBehindTheEventRingReloadsCountsAndOpenConversation() async throws {
        let session = ChatBridgeTestSession()
        let model = friendsTestModel(connect: { _ in session })
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        let chat = model.chat
        chat.applicationActivityChanged(false)
        chat.show(friend)
        try await eventually {
            session.historyRequests == 1 && session.sessionRequests == 1 && chat.conversations[self.friend]?.isLoaded == true
        }

        await session.gate.close()
        session.chat.incomingMessage(friendSteamId: friend, message: "1", timestamp: 1, ordinal: 0, fromMe: false)
        try await eventually { chat.conversations[self.friend]?.lines.count == 1 }
        // The ring keeps 512 events: these overrun the model's cursor.
        for index in 0..<600 {
            session.chat.incomingMessage(friendSteamId: friend, message: "\(index)", timestamp: 10 + UInt32(index),
                                         ordinal: 0, fromMe: false)
        }
        session.sessions = [SteamChatSession(friendSteamId: friend, lastMessage: 609, lastView: 0, unreadMessageCount: 7)]
        session.history = { _, _ in
            SteamChatHistory(messages: [SteamChatHistoryMessage(fromMe: false, timestamp: 609, ordinal: 0, message: "599")],
                             moreAvailable: true)
        }
        await session.gate.open()
        try await eventually { session.historyRequests == 2 && session.sessionRequests == 2 }
        try await eventually { chat.unread[self.friend] == 7 }
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.conversations[friend]?.hasOlder, true)
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.conversations[friend]?.lines.last?.id, .message(timestamp: 609, ordinal: 0))
    }

    @MainActor
    func testInvitationOfferedOnlyWhileOwnGameTakesOneAndFriendIsOnline() async throws {
        let session = ChatBridgeTestSession(games: [SteamGame(appId: 620, name: "Portal 2", iconHash: "", lastPlayed: 0, playtimeMinutes: 0)])
        let model = friendsTestModel(connect: { _ in session })

        try await eventually { chat.ownGame?.appId == 0 }
        XCTAssertNil(chat.inviteOffer(for: alice))

    private static let peak = SteamGame(appId: 3_527_290, name: "PEAK", iconHash: "", lastPlayed: 0, playtimeMinutes: 0)

    /// The lobby PEAK created after its first run, in the same session.
```
