    /// PEAK's session as its supervisor shows it once the game asked for its
    /// invite dialog `sequence` times, with the engine showing it in `lobby`.
    private func peakSession(requests sequence: UInt64, invite: SteamGameInvite = .lobby(lobbyId: peakLobby),
                             lobby: UInt64? = nil, phase: GamePhase = .running) -> GameSessionState {
        var state = GameSessionState.steam(appID: Self.peak.appId, accountID: FriendsWireFixture.accountID,
                                           id: "peak", phase: phase)
        state.inviteRequest = sequence == 0 ? nil : SteamInviteRequest(sequence: sequence, invite: invite)
        state.lobbyId = lobby
        return state
    }

    private func pickerOffer(_ request: UInt64, invite: SteamGameInvite = .lobby(lobbyId: peakLobby)) -> SteamInviteOffer {
        SteamInviteOffer(appId: Self.peak.appId, gameName: "PEAK", invite: invite, request: request)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testLobbyTheEngineShowsIsOfferedWhenThePersonaShowsNone() async throws {
        let session = ChatBridgeTestSession(games: [Self.peak])
        let sessions = SteamGameSessions()
        let model = friendsTestModel(connect: { _ in session }, gameSessions: sessions)
        let overlay = OverlayFixture(steam: model).overlay
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        let chat = model.chat
        try await eventually { model.friends?.connection == .connected && !model.library.games.isEmpty && chat.ownGame != nil }
        let alice = try XCTUnwrap(model.friends?.friends.first)
        let offline = FriendPresentation(id: alice.id, name: alice.name, avatarURL: nil, presence: .offline, activity: nil)

        // PEAK's lobby is private: the persona shows the game, never its lobby.
        session.chat.ownGame(appId: Self.peak.appId, lobbyId: 0, connect: nil)
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 0))
        try await eventually { chat.ownGame?.appId == Self.peak.appId && sessions.active != nil }
        XCTAssertNil(chat.inviteOffer(for: alice), "Nothing tells the lobby yet")

        // The lobby the game's Invite button named is the picker's alone.
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 1))
        try await eventually { chat.invitePicker != nil }
        XCTAssertNil(chat.inviteOffer(for: alice), "The rows never offer a dialog's lobby the engine has not confirmed")
        overlay.hide()
        XCTAssertNil(chat.inviteOffer(for: alice), "Nor once its picker closed")

        // The engine shows the game in its lobby.
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 1, lobby: Self.peakLobby))
        try await eventually { chat.inviteOffer(for: alice) != nil }
        let expected = SteamInviteOffer(appId: Self.peak.appId, gameName: "PEAK", invite: .lobby(lobbyId: Self.peakLobby))
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.inviteOffer(for: alice), expected)
        XCTAssertNil(chat.inviteOffer(for: offline))
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.inviteOffer(for: alice)?.buttonTitle, L10n.string("ui.chat.inviteTo", "PEAK"))

        chat.invite(friend, to: expected)
        try await eventually { chat.conversations[self.friend]?.lines.last?.content == .invitationSent(appId: Self.peak.appId) }
        XCTAssertEqual(session.reportedInvites, [ChatBridgeTestSession.ReportedInvite(
            friend: friend, appId: Self.peak.appId, invite: .lobby(lobbyId: Self.peakLobby))])
        XCTAssertEqual(session.invites, [], "The persona path is not asked")

        // A new run is a new lobby; back at the title screen there is none.
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 1, lobby: Self.nextPeakLobby))
        try await eventually { chat.inviteOffer(for: alice)?.invite == .lobby(lobbyId: Self.nextPeakLobby) }
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 1))
        try await eventually { chat.inviteOffer(for: alice) == nil }

        // A lobby the persona shows comes first, as in Steam's own menu.
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 1, lobby: Self.peakLobby))
        session.chat.ownGame(appId: Self.peak.appId, lobbyId: 109_775_244_421_126_054, connect: nil)
        try await eventually { chat.ownGame?.invite == .lobby(lobbyId: 109_775_244_421_126_054) && chat.gameLobby != nil }
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.inviteOffer(for: alice), SteamInviteOffer(appId: Self.peak.appId, gameName: "PEAK"))
        // A persona showing another game refuses the engine's lobby.
        session.chat.ownGame(appId: 730, lobbyId: 0, connect: nil)
        try await eventually { chat.ownGame?.appId == 730 }
        XCTAssertNil(chat.inviteOffer(for: alice))

        // The game ends: its lobby goes with it.
        session.chat.ownGame(appId: 0, lobbyId: 0, connect: nil)
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 1, lobby: Self.peakLobby, phase: .finalizing))
        try await eventually { chat.ownGame?.appId == 0 && sessions.active?.running == false }
        XCTAssertNil(chat.inviteOffer(for: alice))
        XCTAssertNil(chat.gameLobby)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testADialogsLobbyIsOfferedInRowsAndHeaderOnlyWhileTheEngineConfirmsIt() async throws {
        let session = ChatBridgeTestSession(games: [Self.peak])

        overlay.hide()
        XCTAssertNil(chat.inviteOffer(for: alice))

        // The engine's matchmaking shows the account in the named lobby: the
        // friends list rows and the conversation header both offer it.
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 1, lobby: Self.peakLobby))
        try await eventually { chat.inviteOffer(for: alice) != nil }
        let expected = SteamInviteOffer(appId: Self.peak.appId, gameName: "PEAK", invite: .lobby(lobbyId: Self.peakLobby))
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.inviteOffer(for: alice), expected)
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.inviteOffer(for: alice)?.buttonTitle, L10n.string("ui.chat.inviteTo", "PEAK"))
        XCTAssertNil(chat.inviteOffer(for: offline))
        XCTAssertNil(chat.invitePicker, "A confirmation opens no picker")

        // The game left that lobby, still running: the engine no longer
        // confirms it, though the last dialog named it.
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 1))
        try await eventually { chat.inviteOffer(for: alice) == nil }
        XCTAssertNil(chat.gameLobby)

        // Its next lobby, once the kiosk named it and the engine confirmed it.
        let next = SteamGameInvite.lobby(lobbyId: Self.nextPeakLobby)
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 2, invite: next))
        try await eventually { chat.invitePicker == self.pickerOffer(2, invite: next) }
        overlay.hide()
        XCTAssertNil(chat.inviteOffer(for: alice))
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 2, invite: next, lobby: Self.nextPeakLobby))
        try await eventually { chat.inviteOffer(for: alice)?.invite == next }
    }

    @MainActor
    func testTheGamesInviteButtonOpensThePickerInTheOverlayWhichInvitesWithoutLeavingIt() async throws {
        let session = ChatBridgeTestSession(games: [Self.peak])
        let sessions = SteamGameSessions()
        let model = friendsTestModel(connect: { _ in session }, gameSessions: sessions)
        let fixture = OverlayFixture(steam: model, showsPanel: true)
        let overlay = fixture.overlay
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        let chat = model.chat
        try await eventually { model.friends?.connection == .connected && !model.library.games.isEmpty }
        let state = try XCTUnwrap(model.friends)
        let alice = try XCTUnwrap(state.friends.first)
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 0))
        try await eventually { sessions.active != nil && overlay.session != nil }
        XCTAssertFalse(overlay.isPresented)

        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 1))
        try await eventually { chat.invitePicker != nil }
        XCTAssertTrue(overlay.isPresented)
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.request, .invite(pickerOffer(1)))
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.invitePicker, pickerOffer(1))
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.presenter.shown.count, 1, "The overlay opens once")
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isFriendsPresented, "The library window's friends list stays closed")
        XCTAssertNil(fixture.app.presentedFriends)
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.invitePicker, pickerOffer(1))
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.pickerOffer(for: alice), pickerOffer(1))
        XCTAssertEqual(pickerOffer(1).pickerTitle, L10n.string("ui.chat.invitePicker.title", "PEAK"))

        // Return on a friend's row invites; the picker stays for the next one.
        let panel = try XCTUnwrap(fixture.presenter.panel)
        let host = try XCTUnwrap(panel.contentView)
        func settle() async {
            for _ in 0..<8 {
                await drainMainQueue()
                host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
                panel.displayIfNeeded()
            }
        }
        func pressReturn(on friend: FriendPresentation) async {
            overlay.focus.target = .friend(friend.id)
            await settle()
            NSApp.sendEvent(NSEvent.keyEvent(with: .keyDown, location: .zero, modifierFlags: [],
                                             timestamp: ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime, windowNumber: panel.windowNumber,
                                             context: nil, characters: "\r", charactersIgnoringModifiers: "\r",
                                             isARepeat: false, keyCode: 36)!)
            await settle()
        }
        await settle()
        XCTAssertTrue(overlay.focus.controls.contains(.friend(alice.id)), "The overlay's friends list takes Tab")
        XCTAssertFalse(overlay.focus.controls.contains(.close), "The overlay closes itself")
        await pressReturn(on: alice)
        try await eventually { chat.pickerInvited.contains(self.friend) }
        XCTAssertEqual(session.reportedInvites, [ChatBridgeTestSession.ReportedInvite(
            friend: friend, appId: Self.peak.appId, invite: .lobby(lobbyId: Self.peakLobby))])
        XCTAssertNil(overlay.focus.conversation, "The picker stays on the list")
        XCTAssertTrue(overlay.isPresented)

        // A conversation opened from the picker gives way to the next press,
        // even for the same lobby.
        overlay.focus.conversation = alice.id
        await settle()
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 2))
        try await eventually { chat.invitePicker?.request == 2 }
        await settle()
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.invitePicker, pickerOffer(2))
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.request, .invite(pickerOffer(2)))
        XCTAssertNil(overlay.focus.conversation, "Back on the picker's list")
        XCTAssertTrue(chat.pickerInvited.isEmpty, "Nobody invited yet")
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.presenter.shown.count, 1, "Still the same overlay")

        // A failed invitation shows on its row only; the conversation keeps
        // its own errors, and the next picker starts clean.
        session.inviteFailure = SteamError.Failure(reason: "backend.steam.invite.unavailable")
        chat.invite(friend, to: pickerOffer(2))
        try await eventually { chat.pickerFailures[self.friend] != nil }
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.pickerFailures[friend], L10n.string("backend.steam.invite.unavailable"))
        XCTAssertNil(chat.conversations[friend]?.error)
        session.inviteFailure = nil

        // Closing the overlay ends the picker; the same request seen again
        // opens nothing.
        overlay.hide()
        XCTAssertNil(chat.invitePicker)
        XCTAssertTrue(chat.pickerInvited.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertTrue(chat.pickerFailures.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertFalse(chat.followGame(session: "peak", appId: Self.peak.appId,
                                       request: SteamInviteRequest(sequence: 2, invite: .lobby(lobbyId: Self.peakLobby)),
                                       lobby: nil))
        // Through the model too: the session changes, its request does not.
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 2, lobby: Self.peakLobby))
        try await eventually { chat.gameLobby?.lobbyId == Self.peakLobby }
        XCTAssertNil(chat.invitePicker)
        XCTAssertFalse(overlay.isPresented)

        // The next press opens it again, with its own target.
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 3, invite: .connect(connect: "+connect_lobby 1"), lobby: Self.peakLobby))
        try await eventually { chat.invitePicker != nil }
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.invitePicker, pickerOffer(3, invite: .connect(connect: "+connect_lobby 1")))
        XCTAssertTrue(overlay.isPresented)
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.presenter.shown.count, 2)
        await settle()

        // Leaving the picker for another page of the overlay ends it.
        overlay.show(.achievements)
        XCTAssertNil(chat.invitePicker)
        overlay.show(.home)
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 4, lobby: Self.peakLobby))
        try await eventually { chat.invitePicker?.request == 4 }
        XCTAssertEqual(overlay.request, .invite(pickerOffer(4)))
        await settle()

        // While Steam's chat reconnects, an online friend's row waits instead
        // of opening a conversation.
        chat.suspend()
        XCTAssertNil(chat.pickerOffer(for: alice))
        XCTAssertNotNil(chat.invitePicker)
        await pressReturn(on: alice)
        XCTAssertNil(overlay.focus.conversation)

        // The game's Steam connection drops: its request, and the picker, go.
        sessions.fake.show(peakSession(requests: 0, lobby: Self.peakLobby))
        try await eventually { chat.invitePicker == nil }
        XCTAssertNil(overlay.invitePicker)

        // The game ends: everything goes with it, the overlay too.
        sessions.fake.show(nil)
        try await eventually { chat.gameLobby == nil && !overlay.isPresented }
        XCTAssertNil(chat.inviteOffer(for: alice))
    }

    @MainActor
    func testSendingKeepsTheServerMessageAndShowsLocalizedErrors() async throws {
        let session = ChatBridgeTestSession()
        let model = friendsTestModel(connect: { _ in session })
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        let chat = model.chat
        chat.setDraft("  [b]salut[/b] ", for: friend)
        chat.send(to: friend)
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.draft(for: friend), "")
        try await eventually { chat.conversations[self.friend]?.lines.count == 1 }
        XCTAssertEqual(session.sent, ["[b]salut[/b]"])
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.conversations[friend]?.lines.first?.content, .message(fromMe: true, bbcode: "\\[b]salut\\[/b]"))
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.conversations[friend]?.isSending, false)

        session.sendFailure = SteamError.Failure(reason: "backend.steam.chat.rateLimited")
        chat.setDraft("encore", for: friend)
        chat.send(to: friend)
        try await eventually { chat.conversations[self.friend]?.error != nil }
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.conversations[friend]?.error, L10n.string("backend.steam.chat.rateLimited"))
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.draft(for: friend), "encore", "A failed message goes back to the composer")
        chat.dismissError(for: friend)
        XCTAssertNil(chat.conversations[friend]?.error)

        model.signOut()
        XCTAssertTrue(chat.conversations.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertNil(chat.ownGame)
    }

    }

    @MainActor
    func testRequestsInFlightEndWithTheirSession() async throws {
        let session = ChatBridgeTestSession()
        let chat = SteamChatModel(isApplicationActive: true)
        let account = FriendsWireFixture.accountID
        chat.connect(session, account: account)
        defer { chat.reset() }
        chat.show(friend)
        try await eventually { chat.conversations[self.friend]?.isLoaded == true }

        await session.sending.close()
        session.sendFailure = SteamError.Failure(reason: "backend.steam.chat.rateLimited")
        chat.setDraft("hey", for: friend)
        chat.send(to: friend)
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.conversations[friend]?.isSending, true)
        chat.suspend()
        chat.connect(session, account: account)
        XCTAssertEqual(chat.conversations[friend]?.isSending, false, "A reconnection does not wait on the old session")
        await session.sending.open()
        try await eventually { chat.draft(for: self.friend) == "hey" }
        XCTAssertNil(chat.conversations[friend]?.error, "The old session's failure is not this one's")

        session.sendFailure = nil
        chat.send(to: friend)
        try await eventually { session.sent == ["hey"] }
    }

    }

    @MainActor
    func testEscapeLeavesTheConversationBeforeClosingThePanel() async throws {
        let session = ChatBridgeTestSession()
        let model = friendsTestModel(connect: { _ in session })
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        try await eventually { model.friends?.connection == .connected }
        let state = try XCTUnwrap(model.friends)
        let alice = try XCTUnwrap(state.friends.first)
        session.chat.incomingMessage(friendSteamId: friend, message: "[lobbyinvite appid=\"620\" lobbyid=\"1\"][/lobbyinvite]",
                                     timestamp: 100, ordinal: 0, fromMe: false)
        try await eventually { model.chat.unread[self.friend] == 1 }

        let presented = ChatModalPresentation()
        let host = NSHostingView(rootView: ChatModalHost(state: state, chat: model.chat, presentation: presented))
        let window = ChatTestWindow(contentRect: NSRect(x: -20_000, y: -20_000, width: 860, height: 600),
                                    styleMask: .borderless, backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        window.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        window.sharingType = .none
        window.contentView = host
        window.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
        defer { window.close() }
        func settle() async {
            for _ in 0..<8 {
                await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in DispatchQueue.main.async { continuation.resume() } }
                host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
                window.displayIfNeeded()
            }
        }
        func container(_ view: NSView) -> FriendsModalContainer? {
            (view as? FriendsModalContainer) ?? view.subviews.compactMap(container).first
        }
        func press(_ keyCode: UInt16, _ characters: String) {
            NSApp.sendEvent(NSEvent.keyEvent(with: .keyDown, location: .zero, modifierFlags: [],
                                             timestamp: ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime, windowNumber: window.windowNumber,
                                             context: nil, characters: characters, charactersIgnoringModifiers: characters,
                                             isARepeat: false, keyCode: keyCode)!)
        }
        await settle()
        let modal = try XCTUnwrap(container(host))
        XCTAssertTrue(modal.focus.controls.contains(.friend(alice.id)), "Rows that open a conversation take part in Tab")

        // Return on the friend's row opens the conversation.
        modal.focus.target = .friend(alice.id)
        await settle()
        press(36, "\r")
        await settle()
        XCTAssertEqual(modal.focus.conversation, alice.id)
        XCTAssertEqual(modal.focus.target, .composer)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.chat.visibleFriend, friend)

        press(53, "\u{1b}")
        await settle()
        XCTAssertNil(modal.focus.conversation)
        XCTAssertEqual(modal.focus.target, .friend(alice.id))
        XCTAssertTrue(presented.isPresented)
        try await eventually { model.chat.visibleFriend == nil }

        press(53, "\u{1b}")
        await settle()
        XCTAssertFalse(presented.isPresented)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testRenderConversationWhenRequested() async throws {
        guard let path = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["OBELISK_RENDER_PREVIEWS"], !path.isEmpty else {
            throw XCTSkip("Set OBELISK_RENDER_PREVIEWS to render the conversation in isolated native windows")
        }
        let output = URL(fileURLWithPath: path)
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: output, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        let session = ChatBridgeTestSession(games: [SteamGame(appId: 620, name: "Portal 2", iconHash: "", lastPlayed: 0, playtimeMinutes: 0)])
        let now = UInt32(Date().timeIntervalSince1970)
        session.history = { _, _ in
            SteamChatHistory(messages: [
                SteamChatHistoryMessage(fromMe: false, timestamp: now - 90_000, ordinal: 0, message: "On se fait une partie ce soir ?"),
                SteamChatHistoryMessage(fromMe: true, timestamp: now - 89_900, ordinal: 0,
                                        message: "Carrément, regarde [url=https://example.com]ce mod[/url] d’abord"),
                SteamChatHistoryMessage(fromMe: false, timestamp: now - 3_000, ordinal: 0,
                                        message: "[lobbyinvite appid=\"620\" lobbyid=\"1\"][/lobbyinvite]"),
                SteamChatHistoryMessage(fromMe: true, timestamp: now - 2_900, ordinal: 0,
                                        message: "J’arrive, je finis un truc [emoticon]steamhappy[/emoticon]"),
            ], moreAvailable: false)
        }
        let sessions = SteamGameSessions()
        let model = friendsTestModel(connect: { _ in session }, gameSessions: sessions)
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        try await eventually { model.friends?.connection == .connected && !model.library.games.isEmpty }
        let game = GameSessionState.steam(appID: 620, accountID: FriendsWireFixture.accountID, id: "portal")
        sessions.fake.show(game)
        session.chat.ownGame(appId: 620, lobbyId: 1, connect: nil)
        try await eventually { model.chat.ownGame?.invite == .lobby(lobbyId: 1) }
        session.chat.incomingMessage(friendSteamId: friend, message: "Tu viens ?", timestamp: now - 60, ordinal: 0, fromMe: false)
        try await eventually { model.chat.unread[self.friend] == 1 }
        let state = try XCTUnwrap(model.friends)
        let alice = try XCTUnwrap(state.friends.first)
        for scheme in [ColorScheme.dark, .light] {
            let presented = ChatModalPresentation()
            let host = NSHostingView(rootView: AnyView(ChatModalHost(state: state, chat: model.chat, presentation: presented)
                .environment(\.colorScheme, scheme)))
            let window = ChatTestWindow(contentRect: NSRect(x: -20_000, y: -20_000, width: 860, height: 600),
                                        styleMask: .borderless, backing: .buffered, defer: false)
            window.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
            window.sharingType = .none
            window.contentView = host
            window.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
            func settle() async {
                for _ in 0..<12 {
                    await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in DispatchQueue.main.async { continuation.resume() } }
                    host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
                    window.displayIfNeeded()
                }
            }
            func container(_ view: NSView) -> FriendsModalContainer? {
                (view as? FriendsModalContainer) ?? view.subviews.compactMap(container).first
            }
            func render(_ name: String) throws {
                let bitmap = try XCTUnwrap(host.bitmapImageRepForCachingDisplay(in: host.bounds))
                host.cacheDisplay(in: host.bounds, to: bitmap)
                try XCTUnwrap(bitmap.representation(using: .png, properties: [:]))
                    .write(to: output.appending(path: "chat-\(name)-\(scheme).png"))
            }
            await settle()
            try render("list")
            try XCTUnwrap(container(host)).focus.conversation = alice.id
            try await eventually { model.chat.conversations[self.friend]?.isLoaded == true }
            session.chat.typing(friendSteamId: friend)
            try await eventually { model.chat.conversations[self.friend]?.isFriendTyping == true }
            try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(400))
            await settle()
            try render("conversation")
            container(host)?.finish()
            window.close()
        }
    }
}

final class SteamChatPresentationTests: XCTestCase {
    func testBBCodeKeepsTextLinksAndInvitationsAndStripsOtherTags() {
        let rendered = SteamBBCode.render(
            "Regarde [url=https://example.com/a]ça[/url] \\[pas une balise] [b]gras[/b] [spoiler]x[/spoiler]"
        )
        guard case .text(let text)? = rendered.first, rendered.count == 1 else { return XCTFail("\(rendered)") }
        XCTAssertEqual(String(text.characters), "Regarde ça [pas une balise] gras x")
        let link = text.runs.first { $0.link != nil }
        XCTAssertEqual(link?.link, URL(string: "https://example.com/a"))
        XCTAssertEqual(link.map { String(text[$0.range].characters) }, "ça")

        XCTAssertEqual(SteamBBCode.render("[lobbyinvite appid=\"620\" lobbyid=\"109775241058543776\"]fallback[/lobbyinvite]"),
                       [.invitation(SteamChatInvitation(kind: .lobby, appId: 620))])
        XCTAssertEqual(SteamBBCode.render("salut [gameinvite appid=730 connect=\"+connect 1\"][/gameinvite] !"),
                       [.text(AttributedString("salut ")), .invitation(SteamChatInvitation(kind: .game, appId: 730)),
                        .text(AttributedString(" !"))])
        XCTAssertEqual(plainText(of: "[emoticon]steamhappy[/emoticon] [sticker type=\"Corgi\" limit=\"0\"][/sticker]"),
                       ":steamhappy: Corgi")
        XCTAssertEqual(plainText(of: "[url]https://store.steampowered.com[/url] [1] [unclosed"),
                       "https://store.steampowered.com [1] [unclosed")
        guard case .text(let unsafe)? = SteamBBCode.render("[url=file:///etc/passwd]x[/url]").first else { return XCTFail() }
        XCTAssertTrue(unsafe.runs.allSatisfy { $0.link == nil }, "Only web links open from a conversation")
        guard case .text(let bare)? = SteamBBCode.render("vu sur https://example.org/b ?").first else { return XCTFail() }
        XCTAssertEqual(bare.runs.compactMap(\.link), [URL(string: "https://example.org/b")!])
    }

    /// The text a message shows, without its invitations.
    private func plainText(of bbcode: String) -> String {
        SteamBBCode.render(bbcode).compactMap {
            if case .text(let text) = $0 { String(text.characters) } else { nil }
        }.joined(separator: " ")
    }

    func testConversationKeepsEachMessageOnceInSteamOrder() {
        var conversation = SteamConversation()
        XCTAssertTrue(conversation.merge([.message(timestamp: 10, ordinal: 1, fromMe: false, bbcode: "b"),
                                          .message(timestamp: 10, ordinal: 0, fromMe: true, bbcode: "a")]))
        XCTAssertFalse(conversation.merge([.message(timestamp: 10, ordinal: 1, fromMe: false, bbcode: "b")]))
        conversation.merge([SteamChatLine(id: .note(1), timestamp: 10, content: .invitationSent(appId: 620)),
                            .message(timestamp: 5, ordinal: 0, fromMe: false, bbcode: "old")])
        XCTAssertEqual(conversation.lines.map(\.id), [.message(timestamp: 5, ordinal: 0), .message(timestamp: 10, ordinal: 0),
                                                      .message(timestamp: 10, ordinal: 1), .note(1)])
        XCTAssertEqual(conversation.lines.first?.contents, [.text(AttributedString("old"))], "Rendered as it is kept")
        XCTAssertEqual(conversation.oldestPosition, SteamChatPosition(timestamp: 5, ordinal: 0))
        XCTAssertEqual(conversation.latestTimestamp, 10)

        conversation.merge([.message(timestamp: 30, ordinal: 0, fromMe: false, bbcode: "after")])
        conversation.replace(with: [.message(timestamp: 10, ordinal: 1, fromMe: false, bbcode: "b"),
                                    .message(timestamp: 20, ordinal: 0, fromMe: false, bbcode: "missed")])
        XCTAssertEqual(conversation.lines.map(\.id), [.message(timestamp: 10, ordinal: 1), .note(1),
                                                      .message(timestamp: 20, ordinal: 0), .message(timestamp: 30, ordinal: 0)])
    }

    func testSeparatorsMarkNewDaysAndLongPauses() {
        var calendar = Calendar(identifier: .gregorian)
        calendar.timeZone = TimeZone(identifier: "UTC")!
        let day: UInt32 = 1_760_000_000 - 1_760_000_000 % 86_400
        let lines: [SteamChatLine] = [
            .message(timestamp: day + 100, ordinal: 0, fromMe: false, bbcode: "a"),
            .message(timestamp: day + 200, ordinal: 0, fromMe: true, bbcode: "b"),
            .message(timestamp: day + 200 + 15 * 60, ordinal: 0, fromMe: false, bbcode: "c"),
            .message(timestamp: day + 86_400 + 10, ordinal: 0, fromMe: false, bbcode: "d"),
        ]
        let items = ConversationItem.items(lines, calendar: calendar)
        let separators = items.compactMap { item -> Bool? in
            if case .separator(_, _, let showsDay) = item { showsDay } else { nil }
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(separators, [true, false, true])
        XCTAssertEqual(items.count, 7)
    }
}

/// A Steam session whose friends, chat and own game come from the debug
/// fixtures, recording every chat request Swift makes. Nothing reaches Steam.
final class ChatBridgeTestSession: SteamSessionProtocol, @unchecked Sendable {
    struct Ack: Equatable { let friend: UInt64; let timestamp: UInt32 }
    struct Invite: Equatable { let friend: UInt64; let appId: UInt32 }
    struct ReportedInvite: Equatable { let friend: UInt64; let appId: UInt32; let invite: SteamGameInvite }
    static let friendID: UInt64 = 0x0110000100000001

    let friends: SteamFriendsFixture
    let chat: SteamChatFixture
    /// Holds chat observation between events, so a test can overrun the ring.
    let gate = ChatTestGate()
    /// Holds a message on its way to Steam.
    let sending = ChatTestGate()
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private let games: [SteamGame]
    private var _acks: [Ack] = []
    private var _invites: [Invite] = []
    private var _reportedInvites: [ReportedInvite] = []
    private var _sent: [String] = []
    private var _onlineRequests = 0
    private var _historyRequests = 0
    private var _sessionRequests = 0
    private var _sessions: [SteamChatSession] = []
    private var _history: @Sendable (UInt64, SteamChatPosition?) -> SteamChatHistory = { _, _ in
        SteamChatHistory(messages: [], moreAvailable: false)
    }
    private var _sendFailure: Error?
    private var _inviteFailure: Error?

    var acks: [Ack] { lock.withLock { _acks } }
    var invites: [Invite] { lock.withLock { _invites } }
    /// Invitations into what the game reported itself, which skip the persona.
    var reportedInvites: [ReportedInvite] { lock.withLock { _reportedInvites } }
    var sent: [String] { lock.withLock { _sent } }
    var onlineRequests: Int { lock.withLock { _onlineRequests } }
    var historyRequests: Int { lock.withLock { _historyRequests } }
    var sessionRequests: Int { lock.withLock { _sessionRequests } }
    var sessions: [SteamChatSession] {
        get { lock.withLock { _sessions } }
        set { lock.withLock { _sessions = newValue } }
    }
    var history: @Sendable (UInt64, SteamChatPosition?) -> SteamChatHistory {
        get { lock.withLock { _history } }
        set { lock.withLock { _history = newValue } }
    }
    var sendFailure: Error? {
        get { lock.withLock { _sendFailure } }
        set { lock.withLock { _sendFailure = newValue } }
    }
    var inviteFailure: Error? {
        get { lock.withLock { _inviteFailure } }
        set { lock.withLock { _inviteFailure = newValue } }
    }

    init(games: [SteamGame] = []) {
        self.games = games
        friends = SteamFriendsFixture(accountId: FriendsWireFixture.accountID)
        friends.receive(kind: 767, body: FriendsWireFixture.fullList)
        friends.receive(kind: 766, body: FriendsWireFixture.initialPersona)
        chat = SteamChatFixture(accountId: FriendsWireFixture.accountID)
    }

    func nextFriends(afterRevision: UInt64) async -> SteamFriendsSnapshot {
        await friends.nextFriends(afterRevision: afterRevision)
    }
    func shutdown() {
        friends.disconnect(authenticationRequired: false)
        chat.disconnect()
    }
    func games() async throws -> [SteamGame] { games }
    func profile() async throws -> SteamProfile { SteamProfile(displayName: nil, avatarUrl: nil) }
    func details(appId: UInt32, language: String) async throws -> SteamGameDetails { throw FriendsTestFailure.unexpected }

    func setOnline() async throws { lock.withLock { _onlineRequests += 1 } }
    func nextChat(afterSequence: UInt64) async -> SteamChatEvents {
        await gate.pass()
        return await chat.nextChat(afterSequence: afterSequence)
    }
    func nextOwnGame(afterRevision: UInt64) async -> SteamOwnGame { await chat.nextOwnGame(afterRevision: afterRevision) }
    func activeSessions() async throws -> [SteamChatSession] {
        lock.withLock { _sessionRequests += 1; return _sessions }
    }
    func recentMessages(friendSteamId: UInt64, before: SteamChatPosition?, count: UInt32) async throws -> SteamChatHistory {
        let history = lock.withLock { _historyRequests += 1; return _history }
        return history(friendSteamId, before)
    }
    func sendMessage(friendSteamId: UInt64, text: String) async throws -> SteamSentMessage {
        await sending.pass()
        if let failure = sendFailure { throw failure }
        let count = lock.withLock { _sent.append(text); return _sent.count }
        // Steam stores the text as Rust escaped it.
        return SteamSentMessage(timestamp: 1_000 + UInt32(count), ordinal: 0,
                                message: text.replacingOccurrences(of: "[", with: "\\["), plainMessage: text)
    }
    func ack(friendSteamId: UInt64, timestamp: UInt32) async throws {
        lock.withLock { _acks.append(Ack(friend: friendSteamId, timestamp: timestamp)) }
    }
    func inviteToGame(friendSteamId: UInt64, appId: UInt32) async throws {
        if let failure = inviteFailure { throw failure }
        lock.withLock { _invites.append(Invite(friend: friendSteamId, appId: appId)) }
    }
    func inviteIntoGame(friendSteamId: UInt64, appId: UInt32, invite: SteamGameInvite) async throws {
        if let failure = inviteFailure { throw failure }
        lock.withLock { _reportedInvites.append(ReportedInvite(friend: friendSteamId, appId: appId, invite: invite)) }
    }
    func nextInvites(afterRevision: UInt64) async -> SteamReceivedInvites {
        await chat.nextInvites(afterRevision: afterRevision)
    }
}

actor ChatTestGate {
    private var isOpen = true
    private var waiters: [CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>] = []

    func pass() async {
        if isOpen { return }
        await withCheckedContinuation { waiters.append($0) }
    }

    func close() { isOpen = false }

    func open() {
        isOpen = true
        let pending = waiters
        waiters.removeAll()
        for waiter in pending { waiter.resume() }
    }
}

@MainActor @Observable
private final class ChatModalPresentation {
    var isPresented = true
}

private struct ChatModalHost: View {
    let state: FriendsPresentationState
    let chat: SteamChatModel
    let presentation: ChatModalPresentation
    @State private var avatars = FriendsAvatarCache()

    var body: some View {
        Color.clear.overlay {
            if presentation.isPresented {
                // At the size of the window's sheet.
                FriendsModal(state: state, avatars: avatars, chat: chat, dismiss: { presentation.isPresented = false },
                             retry: {}, signIn: {})
                    .frame(width: 520, height: 550)
            }
        }
    }
}

private final class ChatTestWindow: NSWindow {
    override var canBecomeKey: Bool { true }
}

import Foundation

final class SteamCloudModelTests: XCTestCase {
    private let accountID: UInt64 = 0x0110_0001_0000_002a

    @MainActor
    func testAnAnswerReachesRustAndTheQuestionFollowsWhatRustShows() async throws {
        let fixture = Fixture()
        let model = fixture.model
        fixture.connect()
        fixture.backend.publish { $0.cloudSync = .launch(42, question: .conflict(2)) }
        try await eventually { model.promptPresented }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.promptGame, 42)

        model.respond(.cancel)
        try await eventually { !model.promptBusy }
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.backend.actions, [.answer(42, decision: 2, .cancel)])
        XCTAssertTrue(model.promptPresented, "Rust closes an answered question, not Swift")

        fixture.backend.publish { $0.cloudSync = .launch(42) }
        try await eventually { !model.promptPresented }
        fixture.signOut()
    }

    @MainActor
    func testSecondLiveChoiceIsIgnoredWhileFirstResponseIsInFlight() async throws {
        let fixture = Fixture()
        let model = fixture.model
        let answer = GameSessionGate<Void>()
        fixture.connect()
        fixture.backend.answering = { _, _, _ in try await answer.wait() }
        fixture.backend.publish { $0.cloudSync = .launch(42, question: .conflict(2)) }
        try await eventually { model.promptPresented }

        model.respond(.local)
        model.respond(.cancel)
        XCTAssertTrue(model.promptWorking)
        await answer.resolve(())
        try await eventually { !model.promptBusy }

        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.backend.actions, [.answer(42, decision: 2, .local)])
        fixture.signOut()
    }

    @MainActor
    func testALaunchCheckCanBeCancelledWhileItWorks() async throws {
        let fixture = Fixture()
        let model = fixture.model
        fixture.connect()
        fixture.backend.publish { $0.cloudSync = .launch(42, decision: 6, working: true, cancellable: true) }
        try await eventually { model.isSynchronizing(for: 42) }
        XCTAssertTrue(model.canCancelSynchronization(for: 42))
        XCTAssertFalse(model.canCancelSynchronization(for: 570))
        XCTAssertFalse(model.promptPresented)

        model.cancelSynchronization(for: 42)

        try await eventually { !model.promptBusy }
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.backend.actions, [.answer(42, decision: 6, .cancel)])
    }

    @MainActor
    func testIndicatorsBelongOnlyToTheirAccount() async throws {
        let fixture = Fixture()
        fixture.connect()
        fixture.backend.indicators = [(42, .neverSynced)]

        fixture.model.refreshIndicators(for: [42])

        try await eventually { fixture.model.indicator(for: 42)?.state == .neverSynced }
        fixture.connect(accountID + 1)
        XCTAssertNil(fixture.model.indicator(for: 42))
        fixture.signOut()
        fixture.model.refreshIndicators(for: [42])
        try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(50))
        XCTAssertNil(fixture.model.indicator(for: 42), "A signed-out model reads nothing")
    }

    @MainActor
    func testMaintenanceAsksLiveAndRefreshesTheIndicatorWhenItEnds() async throws {
        let fixture = Fixture(installed: true)
        let model = fixture.model
        fixture.connect()
        let backend = fixture.backend
        backend.onCall = { call in
            if case .maintain = call { backend.publish { $0.cloudSync = .maintenance(42) } }
        }

        fixture.installations.syncCloud()

        XCTAssertTrue(model.isMaintaining, "Rust holds the Reservation from the call")
        XCTAssertEqual(backend.actions, [.maintain(42, installed: fixture.receipt)])
        XCTAssertTrue(model.isSynchronizing(for: 42))
        backend.publish { $0.cloudSync = .maintenance(42, question: .conflict(1, error: "backend.steam.cloud.conflict")) }
        try await eventually { model.promptPresented }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.promptGame, 42)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.promptMessage, "backend.steam.cloud.conflict")

        model.respond(.local)

        try await eventually { backend.actions.last == .answer(42, decision: 1, .local) }
        backend.indicators = [(42, .neverSynced)]
        backend.publish { $0.cloudSync = nil }
        try await eventually { !model.isMaintaining }
        XCTAssertFalse(model.promptPresented)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.failurePresented)
        try await eventually { model.indicator(for: 42)?.state == .neverSynced }
    }

    @MainActor
    func testAFailedMaintenanceShowsNoBannerAndSyncNowStartsTheNextAttempt() async throws {
        let fixture = Fixture()
        fixture.connect()
        let (model, backend) = (fixture.model, fixture.backend)
        fixture.installations.syncCloud()
        backend.publish { $0.cloudSync = .maintenance(42) }
        try await eventually { model.isMaintaining }

        backend.publish { $0.cloudSync = nil }

        try await eventually { !model.isMaintaining }
        XCTAssertFalse(model.failurePresented, "Only a launch check shows a banner")
        XCTAssertEqual(model.promptMessage, L10n.string("ui.cloud.working"))
        fixture.installations.syncCloud()
        XCTAssertEqual(backend.actions, [.maintain(42, installed: nil), .maintain(42, installed: nil)],
                       "An uninstalled game syncs from its saved context")
    }

    @MainActor
    func testARejectedAnswerShowsItsFailureUntilTheMaintenanceEnds() async throws {
        let fixture = Fixture()
        fixture.connect()
        let (model, backend) = (fixture.model, fixture.backend)
        fixture.installations.syncCloud()
        backend.publish { $0.cloudSync = .maintenance(42, question: .conflict(1, error: "backend.steam.cloud.conflict")) }
        try await eventually { model.promptPresented }
        backend.answering = { _, _, _ in throw SteamError.Failure(reason: "backend.steam.runtime.invalidSession") }

        model.respond(.local)

        try await eventually { model.promptMessage == L10n.message("backend.steam.runtime.invalidSession") }
        backend.publish { $0.cloudSync = nil }
        try await eventually { !model.isMaintaining }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.promptMessage, L10n.string("ui.cloud.working"), "A later question starts without the old error")
    }

    @MainActor
    func testSigningOutCancelsMaintenanceAndItsQuestion() async throws {
        let fixture = Fixture()
        fixture.connect()
        let (model, backend) = (fixture.model, fixture.backend)
        fixture.installations.syncCloud()
        backend.publish { $0.cloudSync = .maintenance(42, question: .conflict(1)) }
        try await eventually { model.promptPresented }

        fixture.signOut()

        XCTAssertEqual(backend.actions.last, .signedOut, "Rust cancels the sync and its question")
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isMaintaining)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.promptPresented)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testALaunchCheckThatFailedAsksWhetherToLaunchAnyway() async throws {
        let fixture = Fixture()
        let model = fixture.model
        fixture.connect()
        fixture.backend.publish {
            $0.cloudSync = .launch(42, question: .failed(4, error: "backend.steam.cloud.network", launchAnyway: true))
        }
        try await eventually { model.failurePresented }
        XCTAssertFalse(model.promptPresented, "A failed check is a banner, not a sheet")
        XCTAssertTrue(model.canLaunchAnyway)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.promptMessage, "backend.steam.cloud.network")
        fixture.backend.publish { $0.cloudSync = .launch(42, question: .failed(4, launchAnyway: false)) }
        try await eventually { !model.canLaunchAnyway }

        model.respond(.retry)

        try await eventually { !model.promptBusy }
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.backend.actions, [.answer(42, decision: 4, .retry)])
    }
}

/// One Steam account's installations as Rust would show them, with game 42
/// on screen, installed for macOS or not at all.
@MainActor
private final class Fixture {
    let sessions = SteamGameSessions()
    let installations: SteamInstallations
    let receipt: InstallationReceipt<UInt32>?
    private(set) var backend = FakeInstallations<SteamGames>()
    var model: SteamCloudModel { installations.cloud }

    init(installed: Bool = false) {
        installations = SteamInstallations(sessions: sessions, cloud: SteamCloudModel(sessions: sessions))
        receipt = installed ? .steam(appId: 42, name: "Fixture", directory: "/fixture/Games/Steam/steam-42-macos",
                                     platform: .mac, totalBytes: 0) : nil
    }

    /// Connects the account as SteamModel does.
    func connect(_ account: UInt64 = 0x0110_0001_0000_002a) {
        installations.selection = {
            InstallationSelection(game: 42, platform: .mac,
                                  offer: GameOffer.steam(appId: 42, name: "Fixture", language: "english"))
        }
        backend = FakeInstallations(receipts: receipt.map { [$0] } ?? [])
        installations.connect(account: account, backend: backend, port: InstallationPort(
            report: { _ in }, warn: { _ in }
        ))
    }

    /// Signs out as SteamModel does.
    func signOut() {
        installations.signedOut()
        model.signedOut()
    }
}

import AppKit
import Foundation
import Observation
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

final class SteamFriendsIntegrationTests: XCTestCase {
    @MainActor
    func testWireEventsCrossRustBridgeAndUpdateClosedPanelWithoutPolling() async throws {
        let session = FriendsBridgeTestSession()
        let model = friendsTestModel(session: session)
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        await session.settle()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.connection, .loading)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isFriendsPresented)

        // Independent hand-authored protobuf fixtures, never project encoder output.
        session.fixture.receive(kind: 766, body: FriendsWireFixture.initialPersona)
        session.fixture.receive(kind: 767, body: FriendsWireFixture.fullList)
        await session.settle()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.connection, .connected)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.friends.first?.displayName, "Alice")
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.onlineCount, 1)
        XCTAssertNil(model.friends?.friends.first?.avatarURL)

        let app = AppModel(directory: FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString), steam: model)
        app.selection = .epic
        model.openFriends()
        model.closeFriends()
        session.fixture.receive(kind: 766, body: FriendsWireFixture.playing)
        await session.settle()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.friends.first?.activity?.name, "Portal 2")
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.sections(matching: "alice").playing.count, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(app.selection, .epic)
        model.openFriends()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.friends.first?.status.contains("Portal 2"), true)

        session.fixture.receive(kind: 766, body: FriendsWireFixture.closedGame)
        await session.settle()
        XCTAssertNil(model.friends?.friends.first?.activity)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.onlineCount, 1)
        session.fixture.receive(kind: 766, body: FriendsWireFixture.offline)
        await session.settle()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.onlineCount, 0)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.sections(matching: "ALICE").offline.count, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(session.maximumSimultaneousWaits, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(session.shutdownCount, 0)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testADroppedConnectionKeepsStaleRowsAndTheNextOneReplacesThemOnceHydrated() async {
        let session = FriendsBridgeTestSession(hydrated: true)
        let model = friendsTestModel(session: session)
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        await session.settle()

        await session.settle()

        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.friends.count, 1)

        await session.settle()

        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.friends.count, 1)

        await session.settle()

        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.friends.count, 0)
        XCTAssertEqual(session.shutdownCount, 0)
    }

    @MainActor

        let session = FriendsBridgeTestSession(hydrated: true)
        let model = friendsTestModel(session: session)
        await model.start()
        await session.settle()
        model.openFriends()
        model.signOut()

        XCTAssertFalse(model.isFriendsPresented)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isConnected)

        XCTAssertNil(model.friends)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testASignedOutAccountsSessionCannotAffectTheNextAccount() async {
        let gamesOfA = FriendsTestLibraryRequest()
        let first = FriendsBridgeTestSession(hydrated: true, games: { try await gamesOfA.request() })
        let connections = FriendsTestConnections()
        let model = friendsTestModel(connect: { try await connections.connect($0) })
        let start = Task { await model.start() }
        await connections.waitForRequest(1)
        await connections.release(1, session: first)
        await gamesOfA.waitUntilRequested()
        await first.settle()
        model.signOut()
        // Sign-out advances the authentication generation once, then restarts
        // QR sign-in, which advances it again. Wait for that restart so the
        // handoff below uses the generation the model actually reached.
        await waitForSignInRestart(model)

        let accountB = FriendsWireFixture.accountID + 1
        let second = FriendsBridgeTestSession(accountID: accountB, hydrated: true)
        // Hand off a new authenticated account exactly as login polling does.
        let switchAccount = Task {
            await model.connect(
                SteamCredentials(accountName: "Fixture B", steamId: accountB, refreshToken: "fixture-only-never-sent"),
                generation: 2, persist: false
            )
        }
        await connections.waitForRequest(2)
        await connections.release(2, session: second)
        await switchAccount.value
        defer { model.signOut() }
        await second.settle()

        // Account A's session connects again, and its library request fails late.
        first.fixture.reconnect()
        first.fixture.receive(kind: 767, body: Data([0x08, 0x00]))
        await gamesOfA.reject()
        await start.value
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.account.accountID, String(accountB))
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.friends.count, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.connection, .connected)
        XCTAssertNil(model.errorMessage)
        XCTAssertGreaterThanOrEqual(first.shutdownCount, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(second.shutdownCount, 0)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testAuthenticationRequiredAsksToSignInAgainEvenAfterARetry() async {
        let session = FriendsBridgeTestSession(hydrated: true)
        let model = friendsTestModel(session: session)
        await model.start()

        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.friends.count, 1)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testAReconnectionThatGaveUpShowsItsFailureAndKeepsStaleFriends() async {
        let session = FriendsBridgeTestSession(hydrated: true)
        let model = friendsTestModel(session: session)
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        await session.settle()
        session.fixture.disconnect(authenticationRequired: false)
        await session.settle()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.connection, .interrupted)

        session.fixture.unreachable()
        await session.settle()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.connection, .failed(L10n.string("model.friends.reconnectFailed")))
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.friends.first?.displayName, "Alice")
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.friends.first?.presence, .online)
        XCTAssertEqual(session.shutdownCount, 0)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testRetryAndWakeAskTheSessionToReconnect() async throws {
        let session = FriendsBridgeTestSession(hydrated: true)
        let model = friendsTestModel(session: session)
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        await session.settle()

        model.retryFriends()
        XCTAssertEqual(session.reconnectRequests, 1)
        await session.settle()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.connection, .interrupted)
        NSWorkspace.shared.notificationCenter.post(name: NSWorkspace.didWakeNotification, object: nil)
        try await eventually { session.reconnectRequests == 2 }
        XCTAssertEqual(session.shutdownCount, 0)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testANewConnectionReloadsTheLibraryWhileTheFirstRequestIsStillSuspended() async {
        let initialGames = FriendsTestLibraryRequest()
        let session = FriendsBridgeTestSession(hydrated: true, games: { try await initialGames.request() })
        let model = friendsTestModel(session: session)
        let start = Task { await model.start() }
        defer { model.signOut() }
        await initialGames.waitUntilRequested()
        await session.settle()
        XCTAssertTrue(model.isLoadingGames)

        session.fixture.disconnect(authenticationRequired: false)
        await session.settle()
        let recoveredGame = SteamGame(appId: 620, name: "Portal 2", iconHash: "", lastPlayed: 0, playtimeMinutes: 0)
        session.loadGames = { [recoveredGame] }
        let libraryRecovered = expectation(description: "The new connection reloads the library")
        withObservationTracking {
            _ = model.library.games
        } onChange: { libraryRecovered.fulfill() }
        session.fixture.reconnect()
        await fulfillment(of: [libraryRecovered], timeout: 3)
        session.fixture.receive(kind: 767, body: FriendsWireFixture.fullList)
        session.fixture.receive(kind: 766, body: FriendsWireFixture.initialPersona)
        await session.settle()

        XCTAssertEqual(model.library.games.map(\.appId), [620])
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isLoadingGames)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.friends?.connection, .connected)
        await initialGames.reject()
        await start.value
        XCTAssertEqual(model.library.games.map(\.appId), [620])
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isLoadingGames)
        XCTAssertNil(model.errorMessage, "A failure through the dropped connection must not overwrite recovery")
    }

    @MainActor
    func testAReconnectionKeepsTheAccountsInstallationsUntilSignOut() async {
        let session = FriendsBridgeTestSession(hydrated: true)
        let backend = FakeInstallations<SteamGames>()
        var bound: [any SteamSessionProtocol] = []
        let model = friendsTestModel(session: session, installations: { session, _, _, _ in
            bound.append(session)
            return backend
        })
        await model.start()
        await session.settle()

        session.fixture.disconnect(authenticationRequired: false)
        await session.settle()
        session.fixture.reconnect()
        await session.settle()
        XCTAssertEqual(bound.count, 1)
        XCTAssertTrue(bound.first === session)
        XCTAssertFalse(backend.actions.contains(.signedOut), "Transfers keep going through the account's session")

        model.signOut()
        XCTAssertEqual(backend.actions.filter { $0 == .signedOut }.count, 1)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testTheLibraryDownloadsNothingWhileTheSessionReconnects() async {
        let session = FriendsBridgeTestSession(hydrated: true)
        let backend = FakeInstallations<SteamGames>()
        let model = friendsTestModel(session: session, installations: SteamModel.installations(backend))
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        await session.settle()
        let portal = SteamGame(appId: 620, name: "Portal 2", iconHash: "", lastPlayed: 0, playtimeMinutes: 0)
        let download = { GameActions(model.installations, in: .library)(model.librarySelection(portal)) }
        XCTAssertTrue(download().isAvailable)

        session.fixture.disconnect(authenticationRequired: false)
        await session.settle()
        XCTAssertEqual(download().kind, .download(.install))
        XCTAssertFalse(download().isAvailable, "Nothing downloads without a CM connection")
        download().perform()
        XCTAssertEqual(backend.actions, [])

        session.fixture.reconnect()
        await session.settle()
        XCTAssertTrue(download().isAvailable)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testInitialConnectionCompletingAfterSignOutIsClosed() async {
        let connections = FriendsTestConnections()
        let model = friendsTestModel(connect: { try await connections.connect($0) })
        let start = Task { await model.start() }
        await connections.waitForRequest(1)
        model.signOut()
        let late = FriendsBridgeTestSession(hydrated: true)
        await connections.release(1, session: late)
        await start.value
        XCTAssertNil(model.friends)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isConnected)
        XCTAssertEqual(late.shutdownCount, 1)
    }

    func testExplicitBridgeConnectionCancellationPrecedesAnyNetworkRequest() async {
        let attempt = SteamConnectionAttempt()
        attempt.cancel()
        do {
            _ = try await attempt.connect(credentials: SteamCredentials(accountName: "fixture", steamId: 1, refreshToken: "unused"), library: nil)
            XCTFail("Cancelled connection unexpectedly succeeded")
        } catch {
            guard case SteamError.Cancelled = error else { return XCTFail("Unexpected error: \(error)") }
        }
    }

@MainActor
func friendsTestModel(
    session: FriendsBridgeTestSession? = nil,
    accountID: UInt64 = FriendsWireFixture.accountID,
    connect: (@Sendable (SteamCredentials) async throws -> any SteamSessionProtocol)? = nil,
    installations: SteamModel.MakeInstallations? = nil,
    gameSessions: SteamGameSessions = .shared,
    chat: SteamChatModel? = nil,
    webCookies: @escaping @Sendable (any SteamSessionProtocol) async throws -> [SteamWebCookie] = { _ in [] }
) -> SteamModel {
    SteamModel(
        directory: FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString),
        keychain: FriendsTestCredentials(accountID: accountID),
        connect: connect ?? { _ in session! },
        news: { _ in [] },
        webCookies: webCookies,
        beginLogin: offlineLogin,
        gameSessions: gameSessions,
        installations: installations,
        chat: chat ?? SteamChatModel(isApplicationActive: false)
    )
}

private struct FriendsTestCredentials: CredentialStore {
    let accountID: UInt64
    func load() async throws -> SteamCredentials? {
        SteamCredentials(accountName: "Fixture", steamId: accountID, refreshToken: "fixture-only-never-sent")
    }
    func save(_ credentials: SteamCredentials) async throws {}
    func remove() async throws {}
}

/// Sign-out restarts QR sign-in. These tests never authenticate, so refusing
/// the start keeps that restart off the network and leaves no polling task.
private let offlineLogin: @Sendable (SteamLoginStart) async throws -> any SteamLoginProtocol = { _ in
    throw SteamError.Failure(reason: "Fixture: sign-in is offline in tests")
}

/// The restart is asynchronous. `offlineLogin` reports its refusal once it has
/// run, which is also the point where the authentication generation has settled.
@MainActor
private func waitForSignInRestart(
    _ model: SteamModel, file: StaticString = #filePath, line: UInt = #line
) async {
    let deadline = ContinuousClock.now + .seconds(2)
    while model.qrError == nil {
        if ContinuousClock.now >= deadline {
            return XCTFail("Sign-out never restarted QR sign-in", file: file, line: line)
        }
        await Task.yield()
    }
}

/// A Steam session whose states come from the debug Account session
/// fixture, through Rust's own conversion. Nothing reaches Steam.
final class FriendsBridgeTestSession: SteamSessionProtocol, @unchecked Sendable {
    let fixture: SteamFriendsFixture
    private let requests = FriendsTestSignals<UInt64>()
    private let events = FriendsTestSignals<String>()
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var waiting = 0
    private var maximumWaiting = 0
    private var shutdowns = 0
    private var reconnects = 0
    private var _loadGames: @Sendable () async throws -> [SteamGame]
    var maximumSimultaneousWaits: Int { lock.withLock { maximumWaiting } }
    var shutdownCount: Int { lock.withLock { shutdowns } }
    /// How many times the model asked the session to connect again.
    var reconnectRequests: Int { lock.withLock { reconnects } }
    /// What the library request answers, from now on.
    var loadGames: @Sendable () async throws -> [SteamGame] {
        get { lock.withLock { _loadGames } }
        set { lock.withLock { _loadGames = newValue } }
    }

    init(
        accountID: UInt64 = FriendsWireFixture.accountID,
        hydrated: Bool = false,
        games: @escaping @Sendable () async throws -> [SteamGame] = { [] }
    ) {
        _loadGames = games
        fixture = SteamFriendsFixture(accountId: accountID)
        if hydrated {
            fixture.receive(kind: 767, body: FriendsWireFixture.fullList)
            fixture.receive(kind: 766, body: FriendsWireFixture.initialPersona)
        }
    }
    func nextFriends(afterRevision: UInt64) async -> SteamFriendsSnapshot {
        lock.withLock { waiting += 1; maximumWaiting = max(maximumWaiting, waiting) }
        await requests.signal(afterRevision)
        let snapshot = await fixture.nextFriends(afterRevision: afterRevision)
        let remaining = lock.withLock { waiting -= 1; return waiting }
        if remaining == 0 && shutdownCount > 0 { await events.signal("finished-after-shutdown") }
        return snapshot
    }
    func shutdown() {
        lock.withLock { shutdowns += 1 }
        fixture.close()
    }
    func reconnect() {
        lock.withLock { reconnects += 1 }
        fixture.retry()
    }
    func settle() async {
        let snapshot = await fixture.nextFriends(afterRevision: 0)
        await requests.wait(snapshot.revision)
    }
    func waitForNoWaiters() async {
        if lock.withLock({ waiting == 0 }) { return }
        await events.wait("finished-after-shutdown")
    }
    func games() async throws -> [SteamGame] { try await loadGames() }
    func profile() async throws -> SteamProfile { SteamProfile(displayName: nil, avatarUrl: nil) }
    func details(appId: UInt32, language: String) async throws -> SteamGameDetails { throw FriendsTestFailure.unexpected }
}

actor FriendsTestSignals<Key: Hashable & Sendable> {
    private var signalled: Set<Key> = []
    private var waiters: [Key: [CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>]] = [:]
    func signal(_ key: Key) {
        signalled.insert(key)
        for waiter in waiters.removeValue(forKey: key) ?? [] { waiter.resume() }
    }
    func wait(_ key: Key) async {
        if signalled.contains(key) { return }
        await withCheckedContinuation { waiters[key, default: []].append($0) }
    }
}

private actor FriendsTestConnections {
    private var pending: [Int: CheckedContinuation<any SteamSessionProtocol, any Error>] = [:]
    private let requests = FriendsTestSignals<Int>()
    private var count = 0
    func connect(_ credentials: SteamCredentials) async throws -> any SteamSessionProtocol {
        count += 1
        let number = count
        return try await withCheckedThrowingContinuation { continuation in
            pending[number] = continuation
            Task { await requests.signal(number) }
        }
    }
    func waitForRequest(_ number: Int) async { await requests.wait(number) }
    func release(_ number: Int, session: any SteamSessionProtocol) {
        pending.removeValue(forKey: number)?.resume(returning: session)
    }
}

private actor FriendsTestLibraryRequest {
    private var continuation: CheckedContinuation<[SteamGame], any Error>?
    private let requested = FriendsTestSignals<String>()

    func request() async throws -> [SteamGame] {
        try await withCheckedThrowingContinuation { continuation in
            self.continuation = continuation
            Task { await requested.signal("requested") }
        }
    }

    func waitUntilRequested() async { await requested.wait("requested") }

    func reject() {
        continuation?.resume(throwing: FriendsTestFailure.unexpected)
        continuation = nil
    }
}

enum FriendsTestFailure: Error { case unexpected }

/// Wire tags checked against SteamTracking 08f0f630, not encoded by steam-kit.
/// Friend ID 0x0110000100000001 is synthetic; all names are fixture data.
enum FriendsWireFixture {
    static let accountID: UInt64 = 0x0110000100000064
    static let fullList = Data([0x08, 0x00, 0x12, 0x0b, 0x09, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0x10, 1, 0x10, 3])
    static let identity: [UInt8] = [0x09, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0x10, 1]
    // mask Status | PlayerName | Presence, name tag15, avatar tag31 explicit empty.
    static let initialPersona = Data([0x08, 0x13, 0x12, 21] + identity + [0x10, 1, 0x7a, 5] + Array("Alice".utf8) + [0xfa, 1, 0])
    // GameExtraInfo mask256, game_name tag55, game_id tag56 fixed64 = 620.
    static let playing = Data([0x08, 0x80, 2, 0x12, 30] + identity + [0xba, 3, 8] + Array("Portal 2".utf8) + [0xc1, 3, 0x6c, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0])
    static let closedGame = Data([0x08, 0x80, 2, 0x12, 19] + identity + [0xc1, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0])
    static let offline = Data([0x08, 1, 0x12, 11] + identity + [0x10, 0])
}

final class SteamIntegrationTests: XCTestCase {
    @MainActor
    func testDelayedPublicProfileDoesNotBlockRestoredLibraryOrConnection() async throws {
        let profiles = CachedSteamProfiles()
        let session = CachedSteamSession(games: cachedSteamGames, profile: { try await profiles.request() })
        let model = cachedSteamModel(session: session)
        let started = expectation(description: "Restoring finishes while the public profile is pending")

            await model.start()
            started.fulfill()

        XCTAssertNil(model.avatarURL)
        XCTAssertNil(model.displayName, "The private login must not serve as the public display name")

    @MainActor
    func testProfileRefreshFailurePreservesPublicNamePhotoOrInitialsWithoutAnError() async throws {
        let initialProfiles = [
            SteamProfile(displayName: nil, avatarUrl: nil),
            SteamProfile(displayName: "Public name without photo", avatarUrl: nil),
            cachedSteamProfile,
        ]
        for initialProfile in initialProfiles {

    @MainActor

        let profiles = CachedSteamProfiles()

    @MainActor
    func testNewProfileRefreshRejectsOlderNameAndAvatarResponseThatFinishesLast() async throws {
        let profiles = CachedSteamProfiles()
        let session = CachedSteamSession(games: cachedSteamGames, profile: { try await profiles.request() })
        let model = cachedSteamModel(session: session)
        let started = expectation(description: "The initial library finishes before its public profile")

            await model.start()
            started.fulfill()
        }
        try await waitForProfile { await profiles.requestCount == 1 }
        await fulfillment(of: [started], timeout: 2)
        model.refresh()
        try await waitForProfile { await profiles.requestCount == 2 }

        let refreshedURL = "https://avatars.steamstatic.com/2222222222222222222222222222222222222222_full.jpg"
        await profiles.release(2, result: .success(SteamProfile(displayName: "Updated display name", avatarUrl: refreshedURL)))
        try await waitForProfile { model.avatarURL?.absoluteString == refreshedURL && model.displayName == "Updated display name" }

    }

    @MainActor
    private func waitForProfile(_ predicate: @MainActor () async -> Bool) async throws {
        let deadline = ContinuousClock.now + .seconds(2)
        while !(await predicate()) {
            if ContinuousClock.now >= deadline { throw CachedSteamFailure.timeout }
            await Task.yield()
        }
    }

    @MainActor
    private func releaseProfileWithoutPresentationChange(
        _ profiles: CachedSteamProfiles,
        request: Int,
        result: Result<SteamProfile, CachedSteamFailure>,
        model: SteamModel
    ) async throws {
        let changed = expectation(description: "A failed or obsolete public profile must not change account presentation")
        changed.isInverted = true
        withObservationTracking {
            _ = model.avatarURL
            _ = model.displayName
            _ = model.errorMessage
        } onChange: { changed.fulfill() }
        await profiles.release(request, result: result)
        try await waitForProfile { await profiles.hasReturned(request) }
        await fulfillment(of: [changed], timeout: 0.1)
    }

    @MainActor

            keychain: CachedSteamCredentials(),
            connect: { _ in session },
            news: { _ in [] },
            beginLogin: offlineLogin
        )
    }

    func testMalformedSavedSessionIsRejectedAcrossAsyncRustBridge() async {

        }
    }

    func testSteamKeychainRoundTripUsesIsolatedItem() async throws {
        let store = SteamKeychain(service: "com.zagrios.obelisk.tests.\(UUID().uuidString)")
        let initial = try await store.load()
        XCTAssertNil(initial)
        // Deliberately not a real authentication token or a real account.

            let replaced = try await store.load()

        } catch {
            try? await store.remove()
            throw error
        }
        try await store.remove()
        let removed = try await store.load()
        XCTAssertNil(removed)
    }

    throw SteamError.Failure(reason: "Fixture: sign-in is offline in tests")

private actor CachedSteamSession: SteamSessionProtocol {
    private let library: [SteamGame]
    private let loadProfile: @Sendable () async throws -> SteamProfile
    init(games: [SteamGame], profile: @escaping @Sendable () async throws -> SteamProfile = { SteamProfile(displayName: nil, avatarUrl: nil) }) {
        library = games
        loadProfile = profile
    }
    func games() -> [SteamGame] { library }
    func profile() async throws -> SteamProfile { try await loadProfile() }
    func details(appId: UInt32, language: String) async throws -> SteamGameDetails { throw CachedSteamFailure.unexpectedOperation }
}

private let cachedSteamAvatarURL = "https://avatars.steamstatic.com/1111111111111111111111111111111111111111_full.jpg"

private let cachedSteamProfile = SteamProfile(displayName: "Public name", avatarUrl: cachedSteamAvatarURL)

private actor CachedSteamProfiles {
    private(set) var requestCount = 0
    private var results: [Int: Result<SteamProfile, CachedSteamFailure>] = [:]
    private var pending: [Int: CheckedContinuation<SteamProfile, any Error>] = [:]
    private var returned: Set<Int> = []

    func request() async throws -> SteamProfile {
        requestCount += 1
        let identifier = requestCount
        defer { returned.insert(identifier) }
        if let result = results.removeValue(forKey: identifier) { return try result.get() }
        return try await withCheckedThrowingContinuation { pending[identifier] = $0 }
    }

    func release(_ identifier: Int, result: Result<SteamProfile, CachedSteamFailure>) {
        if let continuation = pending.removeValue(forKey: identifier) {
            continuation.resume(with: result.mapError { $0 as any Error })
        } else {
            results[identifier] = result
        }
    }

    func hasReturned(_ identifier: Int) -> Bool { returned.contains(identifier) }
}

private enum CachedSteamFailure: Error { case timeout, unexpectedOperation, profileUnavailable }
