`apps/macos/ObeliskTests/SteamInvitationsTests.swift`:

```swift
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

/// Friends' invitations the account's Steam session receives, and joining
/// them or a friend's game.
@MainActor
final class SteamInvitationsTests: XCTestCase {
    private static let peak = SteamGame(appId: 3_527_290, name: "PEAK", iconHash: "", lastPlayed: 0, playtimeMinutes: 0)
    private static let lobby: UInt64 = 109_775_244_421_126_053
    private static let alice = ChatBridgeTestSession.friendID
    private static let tag = "[lobbyinvite appid=\"3527290\" lobbyid=\"109775244421126053\"][/lobbyinvite]"

    func testAFriendsInvitationIsToldOnceAndJoinsByStartingTheInstalledGame() async throws {
        let receipt = InstallationReceipt.steam(appId: Self.peak.appId, name: "PEAK", directory: "/tmp/peak",
                                                platform: .windows)
        let (model, session, backend, notifier) = try await signedIn(receipts: [receipt])
        defer { model.signOut() }

        // Steam writes it into the chat and sends it apart: one invitation.
        let now = UInt32(Date().timeIntervalSince1970)
        session.chat.incomingInvitation(friendSteamId: Self.alice, message: Self.tag, timestamp: now, ordinal: 1)
        session.chat.lobbyInvite(friendSteamId: Self.alice, lobbyId: Self.lobby, appId: Self.peak.appId)
        try await eventually { notifier.notices.count == 1 }
        await drainMainQueue(times: 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(notifier.notices.count, 1)
        let notice = try XCTUnwrap(notifier.notices.first)
        XCTAssertEqual(notice.friend, "Alice")
        XCTAssertEqual(notice.game, "PEAK")
        XCTAssertEqual(notice.invite.invite, .lobby(lobbyId: Self.lobby))
        XCTAssertEqual(model.invitations.invites.map(\.friendSteamId), [Self.alice])
        XCTAssertEqual(model.invitations.availability(appId: Self.peak.appId), .launch)

        // Join from the notice: the game starts joining the lobby, and the
        // invitation goes.
        notifier.answer?(.join, notice.invite)
        try await eventually { backend.actions.contains(.join(receipt, .lobby(lobbyId: Self.lobby))) }
        try await eventually { model.invitations.invites.isEmpty }
        XCTAssertEqual(notifier.withdrawn.map(\.friendSteamId), [Self.alice])

        // Its notice, clicked again once the launch ended, joins nothing.
        backend.publish {
            $0.launching = false
            $0.launchGame = nil
            $0.gate = .open
        }
        notifier.answer?(.join, notice.invite)
        await drainMainQueue(times: 3)
        XCTAssertEqual(backend.actions.filter { if case .join = $0 { true } else { false } }.count, 1)
    }

    func testAnInvitationIntoAGameNotInstalledOrWhilePlayIsUnavailableWaits() async throws {
        let (model, session, backend, notifier) = try await signedIn(receipts: [])
        defer { model.signOut() }
        session.chat.connectInvite(friendSteamId: Self.alice, appId: Self.peak.appId, connect: "+connect 10.0.0.1")
        try await eventually { model.invitations.invites.count == 1 }
        XCTAssertEqual(notifier.notices.count, 1)
        let invite = model.invitations.invites[0]
        XCTAssertEqual(model.invitations.availability(appId: Self.peak.appId), .notInstalled)
        let joined = await model.invitations.accept(invite)
        XCTAssertFalse(joined)
        XCTAssertFalse(backend.actions.contains { if case .join = $0 { true } else { false } })

        // Installed, but another launch holds Play.
        let receipt = InstallationReceipt.steam(appId: Self.peak.appId, name: "PEAK", directory: "/tmp/peak",
                                                platform: .windows)
        backend.publish {
            $0.receipts = [receipt]
            $0.gate = .action(620)
        }
        try await eventually { model.installations.receipts == [receipt] }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.invitations.availability(appId: Self.peak.appId), .unavailable)
        XCTAssertNotNil(SteamJoinAvailability.unavailable.reason)
        backend.publish { $0.gate = .open }
        try await eventually { model.invitations.availability(appId: Self.peak.appId) == .launch }

        // Dismissed, it stays hidden until the friend sends another, and its
        // notice goes.
        model.invitations.dismiss(invite)
        XCTAssertTrue(model.invitations.invites.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertEqual(notifier.withdrawn, [invite])
    }

    func testAFriendsGameJoinsFromTheLobbySteamPushesOfThem() async throws {
        let receipt = InstallationReceipt.steam(appId: Self.peak.appId, name: "PEAK", directory: "/tmp/peak",
                                                platform: .windows)
        let (model, session, backend, _) = try await signedIn(receipts: [receipt])
        defer { model.signOut() }
        func alice() -> FriendPresentation? { model.friends?.friends.first { $0.steamID == Self.alice } }
        XCTAssertNil(alice()?.steamJoin, "Online without a game")

        // Steam pushes Alice in PEAK's lobby: her row's menu can join it.
        session.friends.friendPlaying(friendSteamId: Self.alice, appId: Self.peak.appId, lobbyId: Self.lobby,
                                      connect: nil)
        try await eventually { alice()?.steamJoin != nil }
        let target = try XCTUnwrap(alice()?.steamJoin)
        XCTAssertEqual(target, SteamJoinTarget(appId: Self.peak.appId, invite: .lobby(lobbyId: Self.lobby)))
        model.invitations.joinFriend(Self.alice, target: target)
        try await eventually { backend.actions.contains(.join(receipt, .lobby(lobbyId: Self.lobby))) }
        XCTAssertNil(model.invitations.friendJoinFailure)

        // A launch Rust refuses says why.
        backend.publish {
            $0.launching = false
            $0.launchGame = nil
            $0.gate = .open
        }
        backend.onCall = { _ in }
        try await eventually { model.invitations.availability(appId: Self.peak.appId) == .launch }
        model.invitations.joinFriend(Self.alice, target: target)
        try await eventually { model.invitations.friendJoinFailure != nil }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.invitations.friendJoinFailure, L10n.string("ui.invites.unavailable"))

        // A game without lobby or connect string offers nothing to join.
        session.friends.friendPlaying(friendSteamId: Self.alice, appId: Self.peak.appId, lobbyId: 0, connect: nil)
        try await eventually { alice()?.steamJoin == nil }
    }

    func testAnInvitationGoesAfterSixHoursOrOnceItsFriendPlaysAnotherGame() async throws {
        let sessions = SteamGameSessions()
        let installations = SteamInstallations(sessions: sessions, cloud: SteamCloudModel(sessions: sessions))
        var clock = Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 2_000_000_000)
        let invitations = SteamReceivedInvitations(sessions: sessions, installations: installations, now: { clock })
        // nil: online without a game.
        var playing: UInt32?
        invitations.friendMayPlay = { _, appId in playing.map { $0 == appId } ?? true }
        let invite = SteamReceivedInvite(friendSteamId: Self.alice, appId: Self.peak.appId,
                                         invite: .lobby(lobbyId: Self.lobby), receivedAt: 2_000_000_000)
        invitations.follow(session: "peak", invites: [invite])
        XCTAssertEqual(invitations.invites, [invite], "A friend the list shows without a game may still invite")

        playing = 620
        invitations.friendsChanged()
        XCTAssertTrue(invitations.invites.isEmpty, "Its friend plays another game")
        XCTAssertFalse(invitations.isCurrent(invite))
        playing = Self.peak.appId
        invitations.friendsChanged()
        XCTAssertEqual(invitations.invites, [invite])

        clock = clock.addingTimeInterval(SteamReceivedInvitations.lifetime + 1)
        invitations.friendsChanged()
        XCTAssertTrue(invitations.invites.isEmpty, "Six hours later")
    }

    func testAChatMessageCarryingAnInvitationNamesItsLobby() {
        var conversation = SteamConversation()
        conversation.merge([.message(timestamp: 10, ordinal: 1, fromMe: false, bbcode: Self.tag),
                            .message(timestamp: 11, ordinal: 1, fromMe: false, bbcode: "hello")])
        XCTAssertEqual(conversation.lines[0].joinTarget,
                       SteamJoinTarget(appId: Self.peak.appId, invite: .lobby(lobbyId: Self.lobby)))
        XCTAssertNil(conversation.lines[1].joinTarget)
    }

    // MARK: Fixture

    private func signedIn(receipts: [InstallationReceipt<UInt32>]) async throws
        -> (SteamModel, ChatBridgeTestSession, FakeInstallations<SteamGames>, FakeInviteNotifier) {
        let session = ChatBridgeTestSession(games: [Self.peak])
        let backend = FakeInstallations<SteamGames>(receipts: receipts)
        // Rust starts a launch at once.
        backend.onCall = { [weak backend] call in
            guard case let .join(receipt, _) = call else { return }
            backend?.publish {
                $0.launching = true
                $0.launchGame = receipt.gameID
                $0.gate = .action(receipt.gameID)
            }
        }
        let notifier = FakeInviteNotifier()
        let model = friendsTestModel(connect: { _ in session }, installations: SteamModel.installations(backend),
                                     gameSessions: SteamGameSessions())
        model.notifier = notifier
        await model.start()
        try await eventually { model.friends?.connection == .connected && !model.library.games.isEmpty }
        return (model, session, backend, notifier)
    }
}

@MainActor
final class FakeInviteNotifier: SteamInviteNotifying {
    struct Notice: Equatable {
        let invite: SteamReceivedInvite
        let friend: String
        let game: String?
    }

    private(set) var notices: [Notice] = []
    var answer: (@MainActor (SteamInviteAnswer, SteamReceivedInvite) -> Void)?

    private(set) var withdrawn: [SteamReceivedInvite] = []

    func notify(_ invite: SteamReceivedInvite, friend: String, game: String?) {
        notices.append(Notice(invite: invite, friend: friend, game: game))
    }

    func withdraw(_ invites: [SteamReceivedInvite]) {
        withdrawn += invites
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

final class SteamLibraryArtworkTests: XCTestCase {
    @MainActor
    func testLoadsLibraryInSequentialBatchesAndPublishesIncrementally() async throws {
        let library = SteamLibraryArtwork()
        let session = AppInfoSession()
        library.load(appIds: Array(1...121), language: "english", session: session)

        try await waitForRequests(1, on: session)
        let firstRequests = await session.requests
        XCTAssertEqual(firstRequests, [Array(1...50)])
        XCTAssertTrue(library.games.isEmpty)
        await session.complete(0)

        try await waitForRequests(2, on: session)
        XCTAssertEqual(library.games.count, 50)
        XCTAssertEqual(library.games[1], artwork(1))
        XCTAssertNil(library.games[51])
        await session.complete(1)

        try await waitForRequests(3, on: session)
        XCTAssertEqual(library.games.count, 100)
        XCTAssertEqual(library.games[51], artwork(51))
        XCTAssertNil(library.games[101])
        await session.complete(2)
        try await eventually { library.games.count == 121 }

        let requests = await session.requests
        XCTAssertEqual(requests, [Array(1...50), Array(51...100), Array(101...121)])
        XCTAssertEqual(library.games[121], artwork(121))
    }

    @MainActor
    func testDeduplicatesIDsAndKeepsOnlyWhatPICSNames() async throws {
        let library = SteamLibraryArtwork()
        let session = AppInfoSession()
        library.load(appIds: [42, 42, 7, 42, 7], language: "english", session: session)
        try await waitForRequests(1, on: session)
        await session.complete(0, with: .success([
            SteamGamePlatforms(appId: 42, platforms: []),
            SteamGamePlatforms(appId: 7, platforms: [], artwork: artwork(7))
        ]))
        try await eventually { !library.games.isEmpty }

        let requests = await session.requests
        XCTAssertEqual(requests, [[42, 7]])
        XCTAssertEqual(library.games, [7: artwork(7)], "A game PICS names no artwork of keeps Steam's plain names")

        library.load(appIds: [], language: "english", session: session)
        XCTAssertTrue(library.games.isEmpty, "A game that left the library takes its artwork along")
        let requestsAfterEmptyLoad = await session.requests
        XCTAssertEqual(requestsAfterEmptyLoad, [[42, 7]])
    }

    @MainActor
    func testLoadsEachGamesArtworkInTheLanguage() async throws {
        let library = SteamLibraryArtwork()
        let session = AppInfoSession()
        let peak = SteamGameArtwork(cover: "480bd8/library_600x900.jpg", hero: "d75184/library_hero_2x.jpg",
                                    logo: nil, header: "31bac6/header.jpg")
        library.load(appIds: [3_527_290, 7], language: "french", session: session)
        try await waitForRequests(1, on: session)
        await session.complete(0, with: .success([
            SteamGamePlatforms(appId: 3_527_290, platforms: ["windows"], artwork: peak),
            SteamGamePlatforms(appId: 7, platforms: [])
        ]))
        try await eventually { !library.games.isEmpty }

        let languages = await session.languages
        XCTAssertEqual(languages, ["french"])
        XCTAssertEqual(library.games, [3_527_290: peak])

        library.show([3_527_290: peak])
        library.reset()
        XCTAssertTrue(library.games.isEmpty, "Another account's library replaces the artwork")
    }

    @MainActor
    func testAFailedBatchKeepsWhatWasKnownAndLoadingGoesOn() async throws {
        let library = SteamLibraryArtwork()
        let session = AppInfoSession()
        let cached = SteamGameArtwork(cover: "cached/library_600x900.jpg", hero: nil, logo: nil, header: nil)
        library.show([60: cached])
        library.load(appIds: Array(1...121), language: "english", session: session)
        try await waitForRequests(1, on: session)
        await session.complete(0)
        try await waitForRequests(2, on: session)
        await session.complete(1, with: .failure(.unavailable))
        try await waitForRequests(3, on: session)

        XCTAssertEqual(library.games.count, 51)
        XCTAssertEqual(library.games[60], cached, "The library cache's artwork stays when Steam does not answer")
        XCTAssertNil(library.games[51])
        await session.complete(2)
        try await eventually { library.games.count == 72 }
        XCTAssertEqual(library.games[121], artwork(121))

        library.reset()
        XCTAssertTrue(library.games.isEmpty)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testNewLoadRejectsOldAccountReplyAndPreservesReplacementLoad() async throws {
        let library = SteamLibraryArtwork()
        let oldSession = AppInfoSession()
        library.load(appIds: Array(1...101), language: "english", session: oldSession)
        try await waitForRequests(1, on: oldSession)

        let newSession = AppInfoSession()
        library.load(appIds: Array(1...51), language: "english", session: newSession)
        try await waitForRequests(1, on: newSession)
        await oldSession.complete(0)
        try await eventually { await oldSession.returnedRequests == [0] }
        await Task.yield()
        XCTAssertTrue(library.games.isEmpty)

        await newSession.complete(0)
        try await waitForRequests(2, on: newSession)
        XCTAssertEqual(library.games.count, 50)
        await newSession.complete(1)
        try await eventually { library.games.count == 51 }
        let oldRequests = await oldSession.requests
        let oldCancelledRequests = await oldSession.cancelledRequests
        XCTAssertEqual(oldRequests, [Array(1...50)])
        XCTAssertEqual(oldCancelledRequests, [0])
    }

    @MainActor
    func testResetCancelsCurrentBatchAndStopsTheQueue() async throws {
        let library = SteamLibraryArtwork()
        let session = AppInfoSession()
        library.load(appIds: Array(1...101), language: "english", session: session)
        try await waitForRequests(1, on: session)
        library.reset()

        await session.complete(0)
        try await eventually { await session.returnedRequests == [0] }
        await Task.yield()
        let requests = await session.requests
        let cancelledRequests = await session.cancelledRequests
        XCTAssertEqual(requests, [Array(1...50)])
        XCTAssertEqual(cancelledRequests, [0])
        XCTAssertTrue(library.games.isEmpty)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testDisposalCancelsCurrentBatchWithoutRetainingTheLibrary() async throws {
        var library: SteamLibraryArtwork? = SteamLibraryArtwork()
        weak var released = library
        let session = AppInfoSession()
        library?.load(appIds: Array(1...101), language: "english", session: session)
        try await waitForRequests(1, on: session)
        library = nil
        XCTAssertNil(released)

        await session.complete(0)
        try await eventually { await session.returnedRequests == [0] }
        await Task.yield()
        let requests = await session.requests
        let cancelledRequests = await session.cancelledRequests
        XCTAssertEqual(requests, [Array(1...50)])
        XCTAssertEqual(cancelledRequests, [0])
    }

    @MainActor
    private func waitForRequests(_ count: Int, on session: AppInfoSession) async throws {
        try await eventually { await session.requests.count >= count }
    }

    @MainActor
    private func eventually(_ predicate: @MainActor () async -> Bool) async throws {
        for _ in 0..<100 {
            if await predicate() { return }
            try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(10))
        }
        XCTFail("Artwork loading did not complete")
        throw AppInfoFailure.timeout
    }
}

/// The artwork PICS names of a game, as the fixtures answer it.
private func artwork(_ appID: UInt32) -> SteamGameArtwork {
    SteamGameArtwork(cover: "\(appID)/library_600x900.jpg", hero: nil, logo: nil, header: nil)
}

private enum AppInfoFailure: Error {
    case unavailable, unexpectedOperation, timeout
}

/// Deliberately ignores cancellation while suspended, like a UniFFI response.
private actor AppInfoSession: SteamSessionProtocol {
    private(set) var requests: [[UInt32]] = []
    private(set) var languages: [String] = []
    private(set) var returnedRequests: [Int] = []
    private(set) var cancelledRequests: [Int] = []
    private var pending: [Int: CheckedContinuation<[SteamGamePlatforms], any Error>] = [:]

    func platforms(appIds: [UInt32], language: String) async throws -> [SteamGamePlatforms] {
        let request = requests.count
        requests.append(appIds)
        languages.append(language)
        defer {
            returnedRequests.append(request)
            if Task.isCancelled { cancelledRequests.append(request) }
        }
        return try await withCheckedThrowingContinuation { continuation in
            pending[request] = continuation
        }
    }

    /// Answers `request` with every game's artwork.
    func complete(_ request: Int) {
        complete(request, with: .success(requests[request].map {
            SteamGamePlatforms(appId: $0, platforms: [], artwork: artwork($0))
        }))
    }

    func complete(_ request: Int, with result: Result<[SteamGamePlatforms], AppInfoFailure>) {
        guard let continuation = pending.removeValue(forKey: request) else {
            XCTFail("No app info request \(request) to complete")
            return
        }
        continuation.resume(with: result.mapError { $0 as any Error })
    }

    func games() async throws -> [SteamGame] { throw AppInfoFailure.unexpectedOperation }
    func profile() async throws -> SteamProfile { throw AppInfoFailure.unexpectedOperation }
    func details(appId: UInt32, language: String) async throws -> SteamGameDetails { throw AppInfoFailure.unexpectedOperation }
}
```

```swift
@testable import Obelisk

final class SteamPresentationTests: XCTestCase {
    @MainActor
    func testInstalledGameLaunchesWithoutRemoteDetails() async throws {

        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let receipts = [
            InstallationReceipt.steam(appId: 620, name: "Portal 2", directory: root.appending(path: "steam-620-macos").path, platform: .mac, totalBytes: 100),
            InstallationReceipt.steam(appId: 570, name: "Dota 2", directory: root.appending(path: "steam-570-windows").path, platform: .windows, totalBytes: 200)
        ]
        let details = FixtureResponses<DetailsRequest, SteamGameDetails>()

        XCTAssertFalse(portalRequested || dotaRequested, "Installed games never request remote details")
    }

    @MainActor
    func testLibraryLoadsAllArtworkInBackgroundBeforeAnyGameIsOpened() async throws {

        let details = FixtureResponses<DetailsRequest, SteamGameDetails>()
        let platforms = FixtureResponses<[UInt32], [SteamGamePlatforms]>()
        let session = FixtureSteamSession(games: fixtureGames, details: details,
                                          platforms: { try await platforms.request($0.sorted()) })
        let model = SteamModel(directory: root, keychain: FixtureCredentialStore(), connect: { _ in session },
                               news: { _ in [] }, localeIdentifier: "fr-FR", gameSessions: SteamGameSessions())

        await model.start()
        let appIDs = fixtureGames.map(\.appId).sorted()
        try await eventually { await platforms.wasRequested(appIDs) }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.library.shown.map(\.appId), fixtureGames.map(\.appId))
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isLoadingGames, "App info must not block the library")
        XCTAssertTrue(model.libraryArtwork.games.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertNil(model.selectedGame)
        XCTAssertNil(model.details)
        for appID in appIDs {
            let requests = await details.numberOfRequests(DetailsRequest(appId: appID, language: "french"))
            XCTAssertEqual(requests, 0, "Library metadata must not open game details")
        }

        let portal = SteamGameArtwork(cover: "620/library_600x900.jpg", hero: nil, logo: nil, header: nil)
        await platforms.release(appIDs, value: [
            SteamGamePlatforms(appId: 620, platforms: ["macos", "windows"], artwork: portal),
            SteamGamePlatforms(appId: 570, platforms: ["windows"]),
            SteamGamePlatforms(appId: 440, platforms: ["linux"])
        ])
        try await eventually { !model.libraryArtwork.games.isEmpty }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.libraryArtwork.games, [620: portal])
        let requests = await platforms.numberOfRequests(appIDs)
        XCTAssertEqual(requests, 1)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testVerticalScrollerStaysVisibleAcrossLibraryLoadingDetailAndLoadedNews() async throws {
        for size in [NSSize(width: 900, height: 700), NSSize(width: 903, height: 728)] {
            try await verifyScrollerStability(size: size)
        }
    }

    @MainActor
    private func verifyScrollerStability(size: NSSize) async throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString)
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let details = FixtureResponses<DetailsRequest, SteamGameDetails>()
        let news = FixtureResponses<UInt32, [SteamNews]>()
        let library = fixtureGames + (0..<21).map { index in
            SteamGame(appId: UInt32(10_000 + index), name: "Test game \(index)", iconHash: "", lastPlayed: 0, playtimeMinutes: 0)
        }
        let session = FixtureSteamSession(games: library, details: details)
        let model = SteamModel(directory: root, keychain: FixtureCredentialStore(), connect: { _ in session }, news: { try await news.request($0) }, localeIdentifier: "fr-FR")
        await model.start()

        let host = NSHostingView(rootView: SteamView(model: model).frame(width: size.width, height: size.height))
        let rect = NSRect(x: -20_000, y: -20_000, width: size.width, height: size.height)
        let window = NSWindow(contentRect: rect, styleMask: .borderless, backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        window.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        window.sharingType = .none
        window.contentView = host
        window.setFrameOrigin(rect.origin)
        window.orderBack(nil)
        defer { window.close() }

        try await eventually {
            host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
            window.displayIfNeeded()
            guard let scroll = firstScrollView(in: host), let document = scroll.documentView else { return false }
            return document.frame.height > scroll.contentView.bounds.height
        }
        // The library and a game's page each keep their own scroll view, whose
        // scrollbar floats over the artwork. Neither changes the content width.
        var scrolling = try StableScroller(in: host)
        let librarySearchFrame = try XCTUnwrap(accessibilityFrame(in: host, label: L10n.string("ui.search.store_library", L10n.string("ui.store.steam"))), "The search field must be accessible for the layout regression")
        try scrolling.assertKept(in: host, during: "the library")

        model.library.searchText = "Portal 2"
        try await eventually {
            host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
            window.displayIfNeeded()
            guard let document = scrolling.scroll.documentView else { return false }
            return document.frame.height <= scrolling.scroll.contentView.bounds.height
        }
        try scrolling.assertKept(in: host, during: "the filtered library")
        let filteredSearchFrame = try XCTUnwrap(accessibilityFrame(in: host, label: L10n.string("ui.search.store_library", L10n.string("ui.store.steam"))))
        // The clear button takes space at the field's right edge once text exists.
        XCTAssertEqual(filteredSearchFrame.minX, librarySearchFrame.minX, accuracy: 0.5, "The search field shifted horizontally when filtering the library")
        model.library.searchText = ""
        try await eventually {
            host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
            window.displayIfNeeded()
            guard let document = scrolling.scroll.documentView else { return false }
            return document.frame.height > scrolling.scroll.contentView.bounds.height
        }

        // Keep both responses pending: the page must keep its scroll view
        // and width while details, then news, arrive.
        model.open(fixtureGames[0])
        try await eventually { await details.wasRequested(DetailsRequest(appId: 620, language: "french")) }
        try await eventually { await news.wasRequested(620) }
        try await eventually {
            host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
            window.displayIfNeeded()
            guard let scroll = firstScrollView(in: host) else { return false }
            return scroll !== scrolling.scroll
        }
        scrolling = try StableScroller(in: host, width: size.width)
        XCTAssertTrue(model.isLoadingNews)
        try scrolling.assertKept(in: host, during: "detail loading")
        // This hosting fixture exposes the native search field, but not the
        // detail's virtual SwiftUI buttons, even in an onscreen window. The
        // mandatory search-frame assertion above covers the horizontal shift;
        // detail button positions still require a check in the running app.

        let articles = (0..<8).map { index in
            SteamNews(id: "scroll-news-\(index)", title: "Test news \(index)", url: "https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/620", excerpt: "A test excerpt that makes the game detail taller than the window after the news finishes loading.", date: 1_789_430_000, source: "Local fixture")
        }
        await details.release(DetailsRequest(appId: 620, language: "french"), value: fixtureDetails(620))
        try await eventually { model.details != nil && !model.isLoadingDetails }
        host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
        window.displayIfNeeded()
        try scrolling.assertKept(in: host, during: "details loaded, news pending")
        await news.release(620, value: articles)
        try await eventually {
            host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
            window.displayIfNeeded()
            guard !model.isLoadingNews, let scroll = firstScrollView(in: host), let document = scroll.documentView else { return false }
            return document.frame.height > scroll.contentView.bounds.height
        }
        try scrolling.assertKept(in: host, during: "loaded news")
        let (scroll, scroller) = (scrolling.scroll, scrolling.scroller)
        XCTAssertTrue(scroller.isEnabled)
        XCTAssertTrue(scroller.target === scroll)
        XCTAssertNotNil(scroller.action)
        let document = try XCTUnwrap(scroll.documentView)
        let halfway = (document.frame.height - scroll.contentView.bounds.height) / 2
        scroll.contentView.scroll(to: NSPoint(x: 0, y: halfway))
        scroll.reflectScrolledClipView(scroll.contentView)
        XCTAssertEqual(scroller.doubleValue, 0.5, accuracy: 0.02, "The same scrollbar must follow the document's position")

        model.closeGame()
        try await eventually {
            host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
            window.displayIfNeeded()
            guard let scroll = firstScrollView(in: host), let document = scroll.documentView else { return false }
            return scroll !== scrolling.scroll && document.frame.height > scroll.contentView.bounds.height
        }
        try StableScroller(in: host).assertKept(in: host, during: "returning to the library")
    }

    @MainActor
    func testAutomaticDownloadUsesSystemLanguageShowsTheNativeBuildAndCapturesSelectedGame() async throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString)
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let details = FixtureResponses<DetailsRequest, SteamGameDetails>()
        let news = FixtureResponses<UInt32, [SteamNews]>()
        let backend = FakeInstallations<SteamGames>()
        backend.onCall = { call in
            guard case let .install(offer) = call, let appId = offer.steamApp else { return }
            backend.publish {
                $0.downloading = true
                $0.gate = .action(appId)
                $0.transferGame = appId
                $0.transfer = GameTransfer(game: "\(appId)", state: .preparing, completedBytes: 0, totalBytes: 0,
                                           networkBytes: 0, contentBytes: 0, currentFile: "", message: "")
            }
        }
        let fixture = FixtureSteamSession(games: fixtureGames, details: details)
        let model = SteamModel(directory: root, keychain: FixtureCredentialStore(), connect: { _ in fixture }, news: { try await news.request($0) }, localeIdentifier: "zh-TW", installations: SteamModel.installations(backend))
        await model.start()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.language, "tchinese")
        model.open(fixtureGames[0])
        await details.release(DetailsRequest(appId: 620, language: "tchinese"), value: fixtureDetails(620))
        await news.release(620, value: fixtureNews(620))
        try await eventually { model.details?.appId == 620 }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.platform, .mac)

        model.installations.selectedAction?.perform()

        XCTAssertEqual(backend.actions, [.install(GameOffer.steam(appId: 620, name: "Portal 2", language: "tchinese"))])
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.transfer?.state, .preparing, "Progress shows before its first snapshot")
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.activeTransferGame, 620)
        model.closeGame()
        XCTAssertNil(model.selectedGame)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.activeTransferGame, 620)
        model.open(fixtureGames[1])
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.activeTransferGame, 620)
        var windowsOnly = fixtureDetails(570)
        windowsOnly.platform = .windows
        await details.release(DetailsRequest(appId: 570, language: "tchinese"), value: windowsOnly)
        await news.release(570, value: fixtureNews(570))
        try await eventually { model.details?.appId == 570 }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.platform, .windows)

        backend.publish {
            $0.downloading = false
            $0.gate = .open
            $0.transfer?.state = .complete
            $0.receipts = [.steam(appId: 620, name: "Portal 2", directory: root.appending(path: "Games/Steam/steam-620-macos").path,
                                  platform: .mac, totalBytes: 100)]
        }
        try await eventually { !model.installations.isDownloading }
        XCTAssertNil(model.installations.activeTransferGame)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.receipts.first?.gameID, 620)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.installations.isLaunching)
        XCTAssertNil(model.errorMessage)
        model.open(fixtureGames[0])
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isLoadingDetails)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.selectedAction?.title, L10n.string("model.game.launch"))
    }

    @MainActor
    func testTheCachedLibraryShowsWhileSteamConnectsAndSigningOutForgetsIt() async throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString)
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let cached = SteamGame(appId: 620, name: "Portal 2 (cached)", iconHash: "", lastPlayed: 1_789_000_000, playtimeMinutes: 5)
        let freshArtwork = SteamGameArtwork(cover: "fresh/library_600x900.jpg", hero: nil, logo: nil, header: nil)
        let cache = try LibraryCache.holding(steam: [42: [CachedSteamGame(
            game: cached, platforms: ["macos"], addedAt: 1_300_000_000, achievementShare: 0.5
        )]], in: root)
        let connection = GameSessionGate<FixtureSteamSession>()
        let fixture = FixtureSteamSession(games: fixtureGames, details: FixtureResponses<DetailsRequest, SteamGameDetails>()) { ids in
            ids.map { SteamGamePlatforms(appId: $0, platforms: ["windows"], artwork: freshArtwork) }
        }
        let model = SteamModel(directory: root, keychain: FixtureCredentialStore(), connect: { _ in try await connection.wait() },
                               news: { _ in [] }, localeIdentifier: "fr-FR", libraryCache: cache)
        let start = Task { await model.start() }

        try await eventually { model.showsLibrary }
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isConnected, "The cached library shows before Steam answers")
        XCTAssertEqual(model.library.games, [cached])
        XCTAssertEqual(model.library.value(of: cached, for: .dateAdded), 1_300_000_000)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.library.value(of: cached, for: .achievements), 0.5)
        model.library.sort = .achievements
        XCTAssertNil(model.library.pendingMetadata, "What the cache knew orders the library before Steam answers")
        await connection.resolve(fixture)
        await start.value
        try await eventually { model.library.games == fixtureGames && model.libraryArtwork.games[620] == freshArtwork }
        XCTAssertTrue(model.showsLibrary)

        model.signOut()
        XCTAssertTrue(cache.steamLibrary(steamId: 42, language: "english").isEmpty, "Signing out forgets the account's library")
    }

        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString)

    }

    @MainActor
    func testUninstallRemovesCapturedSteamGameAndRestoresDownloadWhenSelectionChanges() async throws {
        let fixture = try await launchFixture()
        defer { fixture.cleanUp() }
        let receipt = fixture.receipt
        XCTAssertTrue(fixture.model.installations.canUninstallSelectedGame)

        fixture.model.installations.uninstall(receipt)

        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.backend.actions, [.uninstall(receipt)])
        fixture.backend.publish {
            $0.uninstallGame = 620
            $0.gate = .action(620)
        }
        try await eventually { fixture.model.installations.isUninstalling }
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.model.installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable, false)
        XCTAssertFalse(fixture.model.installations.canUninstallSelectedGame)
        fixture.model.installations.uninstall(receipt)
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.backend.actions.count, 1)
        fixture.model.open(fixtureGames[1])
        fixture.backend.publish {
            $0.uninstallGame = nil
            $0.receipts = []
            $0.gate = .open
        }
        try await eventually { !fixture.model.installations.isUninstalling }
        XCTAssertNil(fixture.model.errorMessage)
        XCTAssertTrue(fixture.model.installations.receipts.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.model.selectedGame?.appId, fixtureGames[1].appId)
        fixture.model.open(fixtureGames[0])
        try await eventually { fixture.model.details != nil }
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.model.installations.selectedAction?.title, L10n.string("model.game.download"))
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.model.installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable, true)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testCloudProgressUsesLaunchActionAndOnlyConflictPresentsSheet() async throws {
        let fixture = try await launchFixture()
        defer { fixture.cleanUp() }
        let model = fixture.model
        model.installations.selectedAction?.perform()
        fixture.preparing()
        fixture.sessions.fake.show(.steam(appID: 620, phase: .preparing, cloud: .showing(.checking)))
        fixture.sync(.launch(620, decision: 17, working: true, cancellable: true))
        try await eventually { model.cloud.canCancelSynchronization(for: 620) }

        XCTAssertTrue(model.installations.isSynchronizingSaves)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.selectedAction?.title, L10n.string("ui.cloud.sync_short"))
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable, false)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.cloud.promptPresented)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.cloud.failurePresented)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.cloud.isSynchronizing(for: 570))

        if let destination = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["OBELISK_RENDER_PREVIEWS"], !destination.isEmpty {
            let output = URL(fileURLWithPath: destination, isDirectory: true)
            try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: output, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
            try await render(model, to: output.appending(path: "steam-cloud-sync-button.png"))
        }

        fixture.sync(.launch(620, question: .failed(17, error: "backend.steam.cloud.network", launchAnyway: true)))
        try await eventually { model.cloud.failurePresented }
        XCTAssertFalse(model.cloud.promptPresented)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.installations.isSynchronizingSaves)
        XCTAssertTrue(model.cloud.canLaunchAnyway)
        // Error text never grants permission; only the supervisor's choices do.
        fixture.sync(.launch(620, question: .failed(17, error: "backend.steam.cloud.network")))
        try await eventually { !model.cloud.canLaunchAnyway }
        model.cloud.respond(.retry)
        try await eventually { fixture.backend.actions.last == .answer(620, decision: 17, .retry) && !model.cloud.promptBusy }

        fixture.sync(.launch(620, question: .conflict(18, error: "backend.steam.cloud.conflict")))
        try await eventually { model.cloud.promptPresented }
        XCTAssertFalse(model.cloud.failurePresented)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.cloud.canLaunchAnyway)
        model.cloud.respond(.cloud)
        try await eventually { fixture.backend.actions.last == .answer(620, decision: 18, .cloud) && !model.cloud.promptBusy }
        fixture.sync(.launch(620, working: true, cancellable: true))
        try await eventually { model.installations.isSynchronizingSaves && !model.cloud.promptPresented }

        fixture.sync(nil)
        fixture.run(.steam(appID: 620))
        try await eventually { model.gameSessions.active?.running == true }
        XCTAssertFalse(model.installations.isSynchronizingSaves)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.selectedAction?.title, L10n.string("model.game.quit"))
        fixture.sessions.fake.show(.steam(appID: 620, phase: .finalizing, cloud: .showing(.syncing)))
        fixture.sync(.exit(620, working: true))
        try await eventually { model.installations.isSynchronizingSaves }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.selectedAction?.title, L10n.string("ui.cloud.sync_short"))
        XCTAssertFalse(model.cloud.promptPresented)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.cloud.canCancelSynchronization(for: 620))
        fixture.sync(nil)
        fixture.run(nil)
        try await eventually { !model.gameSessions.isBusy }
        XCTAssertFalse(model.installations.isSynchronizingSaves)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.selectedAction?.title, L10n.string("model.game.launch"))
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable, true)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testRosettaPromptSurvivesNavigationAndCancellationRestoresLaunchWithoutAnError() async throws {
        let fixture = try await launchFixture()
        defer { fixture.cleanUp() }
        let model = fixture.model
        model.installations.selectedAction?.perform()
        fixture.preparing()
        fixture.sessions.fake.show(.steam(appID: 620, phase: .preparing, cloud: .showing(.ready)))
        fixture.sessions.fake.requireRosetta(decisionID: 17)
        try await eventually { model.rosetta.prompt != nil }
        let prompt = model.rosetta.prompt
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable, false)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.installations.canUninstallSelectedGame)
        model.closeGame()
        XCTAssertEqual(model.rosetta.prompt, prompt)
        model.open(fixtureGames[1])
        XCTAssertEqual(model.rosetta.prompt, prompt)
        model.installations.selectedAction?.perform()

        XCTAssertTrue(model.gameSessions.isBusy)
        fixture.run(nil)
        try await eventually { !model.gameSessions.isBusy && !model.installations.isLaunching }
        XCTAssertNil(model.errorMessage)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testCloudMaintenanceHoldsTheReservationAndTheSyncMenuFollowsItsRules() async throws {
        let fixture = try await launchFixture()
        defer { fixture.cleanUp() }
        let (model, backend) = (fixture.model, fixture.backend)
        backend.onCall = { call in
            if case .maintain = call {
                backend.publish {
                    $0.cloudSync = .maintenance(620)
                    $0.gate = .closed
                }
            }
        }
        XCTAssertTrue(model.installations.canSyncCloud)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable, true)

        model.syncCloud()

        XCTAssertTrue(model.cloud.isMaintaining)
        XCTAssertEqual(backend.actions, [.maintain(620, installed: fixture.receipt)])
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable, false, "Maintenance holds the game's Reservation")
        XCTAssertFalse(model.installations.canUninstallSelectedGame)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.installations.canSyncCloud)
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.cloudIndicator?.value, L10n.string("ui.cloud.indicator.syncing"))
        backend.publish {
            $0.cloudSync = nil
            $0.gate = .open
        }
        try await eventually { !model.cloud.isMaintaining }
        XCTAssertEqual(model.installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable, true)
        XCTAssertTrue(model.installations.canSyncCloud)

        model.installations.selectedAction?.perform()
        fixture.run(.steam(appID: 620))
        try await eventually { model.gameSessions.active?.running == true }
        XCTAssertFalse(model.installations.canSyncCloud, "A running Steam game keeps Steam Cloud maintenance closed")
        fixture.run(nil)
        try await eventually { !model.gameSessions.isBusy }
        XCTAssertTrue(model.installations.canSyncCloud)
        model.signOut()
        XCTAssertFalse(model.installations.canSyncCloud)
        XCTAssertNil(model.installations.cloudIndicator)
    }

    @MainActor
    func testRunningSessionBlocksRelaunchVerificationAndUninstallUntilActualExit() async throws {
        let fixture = try await launchFixture()
        defer { fixture.cleanUp() }
        fixture.model.installations.selectedAction?.perform()
        fixture.model.installations.selectedAction?.perform()
        var session = GameSessionState.steam(appID: 620)
        fixture.run(session)
        try await eventually { fixture.model.gameSessions.active?.running == true }
        XCTAssertFalse(fixture.model.installations.isLaunching)
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.model.installations.selectedAction?.title, L10n.string("model.game.quit"))
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.model.installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable, true)
        XCTAssertFalse(fixture.model.installations.canUninstallSelectedGame)
        fixture.model.installations.selectedAction?.perform()
        fixture.model.installations.uninstall(fixture.receipt)
        fixture.model.installations.verify(fixture.receipt)
        try await eventually { fixture.sessions.fake.quits == [session.id] }
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.backend.actions.count, 1, "Only the first launch reached Rust")
        XCTAssertNotNil(fixture.model.installations.selectedReceipt)
        session.host = .disconnected
        fixture.sessions.fake.show(session)
        try await eventually { fixture.model.gameSessions.active?.host == .disconnected }
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.model.gameSessionMessage, L10n.string("model.steam.gameDisconnected"))
        session.host = .online
        fixture.sessions.fake.show(session)
        try await eventually { fixture.model.gameSessions.active?.host == .online }
        XCTAssertNil(fixture.model.gameSessionMessage)
        session.host = .lost
        fixture.sessions.fake.show(session)
        try await eventually { fixture.model.gameSessions.active?.host == .lost }
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.model.gameSessionMessage, L10n.string("model.steam.gameHostLost"))
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.model.installations.selectedAction?.title, L10n.string("model.game.closing"))
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.model.installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable, false)
        XCTAssertTrue(fixture.model.gameSessions.isBusy)
        fixture.run(nil)
        try await eventually { !fixture.model.gameSessions.isBusy }
        XCTAssertEqual(fixture.model.installations.selectedAction?.isAvailable, true)
        XCTAssertTrue(fixture.model.installations.canUninstallSelectedGame)
        XCTAssertNil(fixture.model.gameSessionMessage)
    }

    @MainActor
    private func launchFixture(sessions: SteamGameSessions? = nil) async throws -> LaunchFixture {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString)
        let installedDirectory = root.appending(path: "Installed games/steam-620-macos")
        let receipt = InstallationReceipt.steam(appId: 620, name: "Portal 2", directory: installedDirectory.path, platform: .mac, totalBytes: 100)
        let suite = "ObeliskLaunchFixture.\(UUID().uuidString)"
        let preferences = try XCTUnwrap(UserDefaults(suiteName: suite))
        let details = FixtureResponses<DetailsRequest, SteamGameDetails>()
        await details.release(DetailsRequest(appId: 620, language: "french"), value: fixtureDetails(620))
        await details.release(DetailsRequest(appId: 570, language: "french"), value: fixtureDetails(570))
        let session = FixtureSteamSession(games: fixtureGames, details: details)
        let backend = FakeInstallations<SteamGames>(receipts: [receipt])
        backend.indicators = [(620, .neverSynced)]
        // Rust holds a launch from the call on.
        backend.onCall = { call in
            guard case .launch = call else { return }
            backend.publish {
                $0.launching = true
                $0.launchGame = 620
                $0.gate = .action(620)
            }
        }
        let gameSessions = sessions ?? SteamGameSessions()
        let model = SteamModel(directory: root, keychain: FixtureCredentialStore(), connect: { _ in session }, news: { _ in [] }, beginLogin: { _ in throw SteamError.Failure(reason: "Fixture: sign-in is offline in tests") }, localeIdentifier: "fr-FR", gameSessions: gameSessions, installations: SteamModel.installations(backend))
        await model.start()
        model.open(fixtureGames[0])
        return LaunchFixture(root: root, model: model, preferences: preferences, suite: suite, backend: backend,
                             sessions: gameSessions, receipt: receipt)
    }

    @MainActor
    private func accessibilityFrame(in root: Any, label: String, depth: Int = 0) -> NSRect? {
        guard depth < 30, let element = root as? NSObject else { return nil }
        if label == L10n.string("ui.search.store_library", L10n.string("ui.store.steam")),
           let field = root as? NSTextField, field.isEditable, field.placeholderString == L10n.string("ui.search.placeholder"),
           let window = field.window {
            return window.convertToScreen(field.convert(field.bounds, to: nil))
        }
        // SwiftUI nodes may implement the public accessibility getters without
        // declaring conformance to the complete NSAccessibilityProtocol.
        func attribute(_ key: String) -> Any? {
            guard element.responds(to: NSSelectorFromString(key)) else { return nil }
            return element.value(forKey: key)
        }
        let names = ["accessibilityLabel", "accessibilityTitle", "accessibilityValue"]
            .compactMap { attribute($0) as? String }
        if names.contains(label), let frame = attribute("accessibilityFrame") as? NSValue {
            return frame.rectValue
        }
        let children = (attribute("accessibilityChildren") as? [Any] ?? [])
            + (attribute("accessibilityChildrenInNavigationOrder") as? [Any] ?? [])
        for child in children {
            if let frame = accessibilityFrame(in: child, label: label, depth: depth + 1) { return frame }
        }
        if let view = root as? NSView {
            for child in view.subviews {
                if let frame = accessibilityFrame(in: child, label: label, depth: depth + 1) { return frame }
            }
        }
        return nil
    }

    @MainActor
    private func render(_ model: SteamModel, to file: URL) async throws {
        let view = SteamView(model: model)
            .frame(width: 900, height: 1000)
            .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
            .tint(ObeliskStyle.accent)
            .background(ObeliskPalette(colorScheme: .dark).background)
        // ScrollView contains AppKit views, which ImageRenderer may omit entirely.
        // Host the fixture in its own offscreen window so AppKit lays out and paints it.
        let host = NSHostingView(rootView: view)
        let rect = NSRect(x: -20_000, y: -20_000, width: 900, height: 1000)
        let window = NSWindow(contentRect: rect, styleMask: .borderless, backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        window.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        window.sharingType = .none
        window.contentView = host
        window.setFrameOrigin(rect.origin)
        window.orderBack(nil)
        defer { window.close() }
        host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
        try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(200))
        host.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
        window.displayIfNeeded()
        let bitmap = try XCTUnwrap(host.bitmapImageRepForCachingDisplay(in: host.bounds))
        host.cacheDisplay(in: host.bounds, to: bitmap)

        // A PNG file size alone cannot distinguish real content from an empty surface.
        var luminances: [Double] = []
        for y in stride(from: 0, to: bitmap.pixelsHigh, by: 8) {
            for x in stride(from: 0, to: bitmap.pixelsWide, by: 8) {
                if let color = bitmap.colorAt(x: x, y: y)?.usingColorSpace(.deviceRGB) {
                    luminances.append(Double(0.2126 * color.redComponent + 0.7152 * color.greenComponent + 0.0722 * color.blueComponent))
                }
            }
        }
        let count = Double(luminances.count)
        let mean = luminances.reduce(0, +) / max(count, 1)
        let variance = luminances.reduce(0) { $0 + ($1 - mean) * ($1 - mean) } / max(count, 1)
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(variance, 0.002, "The preview must contain visible interface content, not a uniform background")
        guard variance > 0.002 else { throw FixtureFailure.emptyPreview }
        let png = try XCTUnwrap(bitmap.representation(using: .png, properties: [:]))
        try png.write(to: file)
    }

    @MainActor
    private func eventually(timeout: Duration = .seconds(3), _ predicate: @MainActor () async -> Bool) async throws {
        let deadline = ContinuousClock.now + timeout
        while !(await predicate()) {
            if ContinuousClock.now >= deadline { throw FixtureFailure.timeout }
            try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(5))
        }
    }
}

private actor FixtureCredentialStore: CredentialStore {
    private var value: SteamCredentials?
    init(value: SteamCredentials? = SteamCredentials(accountName: "Test account", steamId: 42, refreshToken: "fixture-only-never-sent")) {
        self.value = value
    }
    private(set) var loadCount = 0
    func load() -> SteamCredentials? { loadCount += 1; return value }
    func save(_ credentials: SteamCredentials) { value = credentials }
    func remove() { value = nil }
}

/// A Steam login that never reaches the network. Sign-out restarts QR sign-in,
/// so every model in these tests is built with one.
private final class FixtureLogin: SteamLoginProtocol, @unchecked Sendable {
    private let snapshot: SteamChallenge
    private let credentials: SteamCredentials?
    private let guardRequired: Bool
    private let failsPolling: Bool
    private let state = NSLock()
    private var guardAccepted = false
    private var submissions: [SteamGuardKind] = []

    init(qrUrl: String? = nil, confirmations: [SteamGuardMethod] = [], credentials: SteamCredentials? = nil,
         guardRequired: Bool = false, failsPolling: Bool = false, pollIntervalMs: UInt32 = 1) {
        snapshot = SteamChallenge(qrUrl: qrUrl, confirmations: confirmations, pollIntervalMs: pollIntervalMs, remoteInteraction: false)
        self.credentials = credentials
        self.guardRequired = guardRequired
        self.failsPolling = failsPolling
    }

    func challenge() async -> SteamChallenge { snapshot }

    func poll() async throws -> SteamCredentials? {
        if failsPolling { throw SteamError.Failure(reason: "Fixture: offline") }
        return state.withLock { guardRequired && !guardAccepted ? nil : credentials }
    }

    func submitGuard(code: String, kind: SteamGuardKind) async throws {
        guard code == "12345" else { throw SteamError.Failure(reason: "Fixture: wrong Steam Guard code") }
        state.withLock {
            submissions.append(kind)
            guardAccepted = true
        }
    }

    var submittedKinds: [SteamGuardKind] { state.withLock { submissions } }
}

private actor FixtureLoginStarts {
    private(set) var all: [SteamLoginStart] = []
    func record(_ start: SteamLoginStart) { all.append(start) }
}

private struct DetailsRequest: Hashable, Sendable {
    let appId: UInt32
    let language: String
}

private actor FixtureResponses<Key: Hashable & Sendable, Value: Sendable> {
    private var values: [Key: Value] = [:]
    private var pending: [Key: [CheckedContinuation<Value, any Error>]] = [:]
    private var requests: [Key: Int] = [:]

    func request(_ key: Key) async throws -> Value {
        requests[key, default: 0] += 1
        if let value = values[key] { return value }
        return try await withCheckedThrowingContinuation { pending[key, default: []].append($0) }
    }

    func release(_ key: Key, value: Value) {
        values[key] = value
        for continuation in pending.removeValue(forKey: key) ?? [] { continuation.resume(returning: value) }
    }

    func wasRequested(_ key: Key) -> Bool { requests[key] != nil }
    func numberOfRequests(_ key: Key) -> Int { requests[key, default: 0] }
}

private final class FixtureSteamSession: SteamSessionProtocol, Sendable {
    private let library: [SteamGame]
    private let responses: FixtureResponses<DetailsRequest, SteamGameDetails>
    private let platformsHandler: @Sendable ([UInt32]) async throws -> [SteamGamePlatforms]

    init(games: [SteamGame], details: FixtureResponses<DetailsRequest, SteamGameDetails>, platforms: @escaping @Sendable ([UInt32]) async throws -> [SteamGamePlatforms] = { _ in [] }) {
        library = games
        responses = details
        platformsHandler = platforms
    }

    func games() async throws -> [SteamGame] { library }
    func platforms(appIds: [UInt32], language: String) async throws -> [SteamGamePlatforms] {
        try await platformsHandler(appIds)
    }
    func profile() async throws -> SteamProfile { SteamProfile(displayName: nil, avatarUrl: nil) }
    func details(appId: UInt32, language: String) async throws -> SteamGameDetails {
        try await responses.request(DetailsRequest(appId: appId, language: language))
    }
}

private enum FixtureFailure: Error { case timeout, emptyPreview }

@MainActor
private struct LaunchFixture {

            $0.launching = true
            $0.verifyingBeforeLaunch = verifying
            $0.launchGame = 620
            $0.gate = .action(620)
        }
    }

    }

            $0.verifyingBeforeLaunch = false
            $0.launchGame = nil
            $0.gate = session == nil ? .open : .session(620)
        }
    }

        preferences.removePersistentDomain(forName: suite)
        try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root)
    }
```

```swift
    @MainActor
    private func render(_ model: SteamRosettaModel, to file: URL) async throws {
        let view = RosettaPromptView(model: model)
            .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
            .background(ObeliskPalette(colorScheme: .dark).background)
        let renderer = ImageRenderer(content: view)
        renderer.scale = 2
        let bitmap = NSBitmapImageRep(cgImage: try XCTUnwrap(renderer.cgImage))
        var luminances: [Double] = []
        for y in stride(from: 0, to: bitmap.pixelsHigh, by: 4) {
            for x in stride(from: 0, to: bitmap.pixelsWide, by: 4) {
                if let color = bitmap.colorAt(x: x, y: y)?.usingColorSpace(.deviceRGB) {
                    luminances.append(Double(0.2126 * color.redComponent + 0.7152 * color.greenComponent + 0.0722 * color.blueComponent))
                }
            }
        }
        let mean = luminances.reduce(0, +) / Double(max(luminances.count, 1))
        let variance = luminances.reduce(0) { $0 + ($1 - mean) * ($1 - mean) } / Double(max(luminances.count, 1))
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(variance, 0.002, "The preview must contain visible text and controls")
        guard variance > 0.002 else { throw CocoaError(.coderInvalidValue) }
        let png = try XCTUnwrap(bitmap.representation(using: .png, properties: [:]))
        try png.write(to: file)
    }

    @MainActor
    private func fixture(install: @escaping @MainActor () async throws -> Void, readinessAttempts: Int = 4,
                         readinessDelay: @escaping @MainActor () async throws -> Void = { try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(10)) },
                         readinessTimeout: Duration = .seconds(600),
                         now: @escaping @MainActor () -> ContinuousClock.Instant = { .now }) async throws -> Fixture {
        let sessions = SteamGameSessions()
        let model = SteamRosettaModel(sessions: sessions, install: install,
                                     readinessAttempts: readinessAttempts, readinessDelay: readinessDelay,
                                     readinessTimeout: readinessTimeout, now: now)
        model.connect(accountId: 42)
        sessions.fake.show(.steam(phase: .preparing, cloud: .showing(.ready)))
        sessions.fake.requireRosetta(decisionID: 17)
        try await eventually { model.prompt != nil }
        return Fixture(sessions: sessions, model: model)
    }

    /// A Steam launch of game 42 waiting for Rosetta, decision 17.
    @MainActor
    private struct Fixture {
        let sessions: SteamGameSessions
        let model: SteamRosettaModel
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
@testable import Obelisk

// Older library/download fixtures have no social events. Suspend until the
// model cancels instead of making a network request or polling a fake cache.
extension SteamSessionProtocol {
    func achievements(appId: UInt32, language: String, fresh: Bool) async throws -> [LibraryAchievement] { [] }
    func achievementShares(appIds: [UInt32], language: String) async throws -> [UInt32: Double] { [:] }

    func acquisitions() async throws -> [UInt32: UInt64] { [:] }
    func webCookies() async throws -> [SteamWebCookie] { [] }
    #if DEBUG
    func cloudAutocloudMetadata() async throws -> String {
        throw CocoaError(.featureUnsupported)
    }
    func cloudSdkCandidates() async throws -> String {
        throw CocoaError(.featureUnsupported)
    }
    func cloudInterruptionProbe(appId: UInt32, directory: String) async throws -> String {
        throw CocoaError(.featureUnsupported)
    }

    func cloudTransferProbe(appId: UInt32, directory: String) async throws -> String {
        throw CocoaError(.featureUnsupported)
    }
    #endif

    func cloudPreferences(appId: UInt32) async throws -> String {
        throw CocoaError(.featureUnsupported)
    }

    func cloudBackup(appId: UInt32, directory: String) async throws -> String {
        throw CocoaError(.featureUnsupported)
    }

    func nextFriends(afterRevision: UInt64) async -> SteamFriendsSnapshot {
        let stream = AsyncStream<Void>(bufferingPolicy: .bufferingNewest(1)) { _ in }
        for await _ in stream {}
        return SteamFriendsSnapshot(revision: afterRevision + 1, accountId: 0, connection: .stopped, transport: 0, friends: [])
    }
    func shutdown() {}
    func reconnect() {}

    func setOnline() async throws {}
    func nextChat(afterSequence: UInt64) async -> SteamChatEvents {
        let stream = AsyncStream<Void>(bufferingPolicy: .bufferingNewest(1)) { _ in }
        for await _ in stream {}
        return SteamChatEvents(events: [], lastSequence: afterSequence, gap: false, connected: false)
    }
    func nextOwnGame(afterRevision: UInt64) async -> SteamOwnGame {
        let stream = AsyncStream<Void>(bufferingPolicy: .bufferingNewest(1)) { _ in }
        for await _ in stream {}
        return SteamOwnGame(revision: afterRevision + 1, connected: false, appId: 0, invite: .none)
    }
    func activeSessions() async throws -> [SteamChatSession] { [] }
    func recentMessages(friendSteamId: UInt64, before: SteamChatPosition?, count: UInt32) async throws -> SteamChatHistory {
        SteamChatHistory(messages: [], moreAvailable: false)
    }
    func sendMessage(friendSteamId: UInt64, text: String) async throws -> SteamSentMessage {
        throw CocoaError(.featureUnsupported)
    }
    func sendTyping(friendSteamId: UInt64) async throws {}
    func ack(friendSteamId: UInt64, timestamp: UInt32) async throws {}
    func inviteToGame(friendSteamId: UInt64, appId: UInt32) async throws {
        throw CocoaError(.featureUnsupported)
    }
    func inviteIntoGame(friendSteamId: UInt64, appId: UInt32, invite: SteamGameInvite) async throws {
        throw CocoaError(.featureUnsupported)
    }
    func nextInvites(afterRevision: UInt64) async -> SteamReceivedInvites {
        let stream = AsyncStream<Void>(bufferingPolicy: .bufferingNewest(1)) { _ in }
        for await _ in stream {}
        return SteamReceivedInvites(revision: afterRevision + 1, connected: false, invites: [])
    }
}

/// Saves as Rust does: now, then after every rotation, in order.
private func saveEveryRotation(_ credentials: any CredentialSave, rotations: @escaping @Sendable (UInt64) async -> UInt64?) {
    Task.detached {
        credentials.save()
        var after: UInt64 = 0
        while let next = await rotations(after) {
            after = next
            credentials.save()
        }
    }
}

extension GogSessionProtocol {
    func persist(credentials: any CredentialSave) async {
        let session = self
        saveEveryRotation(credentials) { await session.nextCredentialsRevision(afterRevision: $0) }
    }
}

// Models take launches as injected closures, so a fake
// session never has to build a Rust-backed object.
extension EpicSessionProtocol {
    func webSignInUrl(redirectUrl: String) async throws -> String { throw CocoaError(.featureUnsupported) }
    func persist(credentials: any CredentialSave) async {
        let session = self
        saveEveryRotation(credentials) { await session.nextCredentialsRevision(afterRevision: $0) }
    }

    func achievements(namespace: String, locale: String, fresh: Bool) async throws -> [LibraryAchievement] { [] }
    func achievementShares(namespaces: [String], locale: String) async throws -> [String: Double] { [:] }
}
```

`apps/macos/ObeliskTests/SteamSortingPerformanceTests.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

final class SteamSortingPerformanceTests: XCTestCase {
    @MainActor
    func testProfileLibrarySortingWhenRequested() async throws {
        guard ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["OBELISK_PROFILE_SORTING"] == "1" else {
            throw XCTSkip("Set OBELISK_PROFILE_SORTING=1 to profile the library's orders and their cache")
        }
        var samples: [SortingSample] = []

        for count in [250, 1_000] {
            let games = sortingLibrary(count: count)
            XCTAssertGreaterThan(games.filter { $0.lastPlayed == 0 }.count, count / 2)
            XCTAssertEqual(Set(games.map(\.appId)).count, count)

            let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: "ObeliskSorting-\(UUID().uuidString)")
            defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
            let history = LaunchHistory(cache: LibraryCache(directory: root.path))
            let sessions = SteamGameSessions(FakeSessions(), history: history)
            let installations = SteamInstallations(sessions: sessions, cloud: SteamCloudModel(sessions: sessions))
            let library = AccountLibrary<SteamGames, SteamGame>(history: history, cache: nil,
                                                                installations: installations)
            library.connect(42)

            // Measure only the synchronous order. Validation and JSON logging
            // remain outside the timed sections.
            for iteration in 0..<5 {
                library.show(iteration.isMultiple(of: 2) ? games : games.reversed())
                for sort in [StorefrontLibrarySort.lastPlayed, .name, .playtime] {
                    let began = ContinuousClock.now
                    library.sort = sort
                    let result = library.shown
                    let elapsed = milliseconds(since: began)
                    assertOrder(result, of: library, count: count, sort: sort)
                    samples.append(SortingSample(phase: "order", games: count, sort: sort.rawValue, iteration: iteration, milliseconds: elapsed))

                    let rereadBegan = ContinuousClock.now
                    let reread = library.shown
                    let rereadElapsed = milliseconds(since: rereadBegan)
                    XCTAssertEqual(reread.map(\.appId), result.map(\.appId))
                    samples.append(SortingSample(phase: "kept-order", games: count, sort: sort.rawValue, iteration: iteration, milliseconds: rereadElapsed))
                }
            }
        }

        let encoder = JSONEncoder()
        encoder.outputFormatting = [.sortedKeys]
        for sample in samples {
            print("OBELISK_SORT_PROFILE \(String(decoding: try encoder.encode(sample), as: UTF8.self))")
        }
        let attachment = XCTAttachment(data: try encoder.encode(samples), uniformTypeIdentifier: "public.json")
        attachment.name = "steam-sorting-profile"
        attachment.lifetime = .keepAlways
        add(attachment)
    }

    private func milliseconds(since began: ContinuousClock.Instant) -> Double {
        let components = began.duration(to: .now).components
        return Double(components.seconds) * 1_000 + Double(components.attoseconds) / 1_000_000_000_000_000
    }

    @MainActor
    private func assertOrder(_ games: [SteamGame], of library: AccountLibrary<SteamGames, SteamGame>, count: Int,
                             sort: StorefrontLibrarySort, file: StaticString = #filePath, line: UInt = #line) {
        XCTAssertEqual(games.count, count, file: file, line: line)
        for (left, right) in zip(games, games.dropFirst()) {
            let (leftRank, rightRank): (Double?, Double?) = switch sort {
            case .lastPlayed: (library.lastPlayed(of: left)?.timeIntervalSince1970, library.lastPlayed(of: right)?.timeIntervalSince1970)
            case .playtime: (library.playtime(of: left).map { Double($0.components.seconds) },
                             library.playtime(of: right).map { Double($0.components.seconds) })
            default: (nil, nil)
            }
            if leftRank != rightRank {
                XCTAssertGreaterThan(leftRank ?? -.infinity, rightRank ?? -.infinity, file: file, line: line)
            } else {
                let comparison = left.name.localizedStandardCompare(right.name)
                XCTAssertNotEqual(comparison, .orderedDescending, file: file, line: line)
                if comparison == .orderedSame { XCTAssertLessThan(left.appId, right.appId, file: file, line: line) }
            }
        }
    }
}

private struct SortingSample: Encodable {
    let phase: String
    let games: Int
    let sort: String
    let iteration: Int
    let milliseconds: Double
}

private func sortingLibrary(count: Int) -> [SteamGame] {
    (0..<count).map { index in
        let nameIndex = (index * 37) % count
        let prefix = ["Étoiles", "Portal", "Civilization", "Test game"][nameIndex % 4]
        return SteamGame(
            appId: UInt32(4_000_000_000 + index),
            name: "\(prefix) \(nameIndex / 2)",
            iconHash: "",
            lastPlayed: index % 5 == 0 ? UInt64(1_789_430_000 + index * 300) : 0,
            playtimeMinutes: index % 5 == 0 ? UInt32((index * 173) % 20_000) : 0
        )
    }
}
```

```swift
import Foundation
import Observation
import XCTest
@testable import Obelisk

@MainActor
final class StorefrontLibraryFilterTests: XCTestCase {
    func testSteamLoadsDatesAndAchievementsWithTheLibrary() async throws {
        let root = try temporaryDirectory()
        let games = [steamGame(1, name: "Alpha"), steamGame(2, name: "Beta"), steamGame(3, name: "Gamma")]
        let records = FilterRecordRequests()
        let model = steamModel(root: root, games: games, records: records)
        await model.start()
        defer { model.signOut() }
        try await eventually {
            model.library.value(of: games[2], for: .dateAdded) != nil
                && model.library.value(of: games[2], for: .achievements) != nil
        }
        var asked = await records.counts
        XCTAssertEqual(asked.acquisitions, 1, "The library dates load with the library, before any order asks")
        XCTAssertEqual(asked.achievements, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(asked.achievementApps, [1, 2, 3], "One request names every game")

        model.library.sort = .dateAdded
        XCTAssertEqual(model.library.shown.map(\.appId), [3, 1, 2])
        model.library.sort = .achievements
        XCTAssertEqual(model.library.shown.map(\.appId), [3, 2, 1])
        XCTAssertNil(model.library.pendingMetadata)
        asked = await records.counts
        XCTAssertEqual(asked.acquisitions + asked.achievements, 2, "Picking an order asks nothing")
    }

    func testSteamSignOutResetsFilterAndCachedLibrary() async throws {
        let model = steamModel(root: try temporaryDirectory(), games: [steamGame(1, name: "Played", playtime: 1)])
        await model.start()
        model.library.filter = .played
        XCTAssertEqual(model.library.shown.map(\.appId), [1])

        model.signOut()

        XCTAssertEqual(model.library.filter, .all)
        XCTAssertTrue(model.library.shown.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isConnected)
        try await eventually { !model.isRestoring && !model.isConnecting }
    }

    func testEpicSignOutResetsFilterAndCachedLibrary() async throws {
        let root = try temporaryDirectory()
        let native = epicGame("native", title: "Native", macOS: true)
        let model = epicModel(root: root, games: [native], receipts: epicReceipts([(native, .mac)], root: root))
        await model.start()
        model.library.filter = .installed
        XCTAssertEqual(model.library.shown.map(\.appName), ["native"])

        model.signOut()

        XCTAssertEqual(model.library.filter, .all)
        XCTAssertTrue(model.library.shown.isEmpty)
        XCTAssertFalse(model.isConnected)
        try await eventually { !model.isSigningOut }
    }

    private func temporaryDirectory() throws -> URL {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: "ObeliskLibraryFilters-\(UUID().uuidString)")
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: root, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        addTeardownBlock { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        return root
    }

    private func steamGame(_ appID: UInt32, name: String, playtime: UInt32 = 0) -> SteamGame {
        SteamGame(appId: appID, name: name, iconHash: "", lastPlayed: 0, playtimeMinutes: playtime)
    }

    private func steamModel(root: URL, games: [SteamGame],
                            records: FilterRecordRequests = FilterRecordRequests()) -> SteamModel {
        let session = FilterSteamSession(games: games, platforms: { _ in [] }, records: records)
        return SteamModel(directory: root, keychain: FilterSteamCredentials(), connect: { _ in session }, news: { _ in [] },
                          beginLogin: { _ in throw FilterFixtureFailure.unexpectedOperation },
                          gameSessions: SteamGameSessions(),
                          installations: SteamModel.installations(FakeInstallations()))
    }

    private func epicGame(_ appName: String, namespace: String = "first", title: String, macOS: Bool = false) -> EpicGame {
        EpicGame(appName: appName, namespace: namespace, catalogItemId: "catalog-\(appName)", title: title,
                 description: "", imageUrl: nil, headerImageUrl: nil, developer: "", windows: true, macos: macOS)
    }

    private func epicModel(root: URL, games: [EpicGame], receipts: [InstallationReceipt<String>]) -> EpicModel {
        let credentials = EpicCredentials(accountId: "filters", displayName: "Filter fixture", refreshToken: "fixture-only-never-sent")
        let session = EpicTestSession(credentials: credentials, games: games)
        return EpicModel(directory: root, keychain: EpicMemoryStore(credentials), restore: { _ in session },
                         installations: EpicModel.installations(FakeInstallations(receipts: receipts)))
    }

    private func epicReceipts(_ entries: [(EpicGame, GamePlatform)], root: URL) -> [InstallationReceipt<String>] {
        entries.map { game, platform in
            InstallationReceipt.epic(namespace: game.namespace, appName: game.appName, name: game.title,
                               directory: root.appending(
                                   path: "epic-\(game.namespace)-\(game.appName)-\(platform == .mac ? "Mac" : "Windows")").path,
                               platform: platform, totalBytes: 1)
        }
    }

    private func eventually(file: StaticString = #filePath, line: UInt = #line,
                            _ condition: @MainActor () async -> Bool) async throws {
        for _ in 0..<200 {
            if await condition() { return }
            try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(5))
        }
        XCTFail("Library filter fixture did not finish", file: file, line: line)
        throw FilterFixtureFailure.timeout
    }
}

private enum FilterFixtureFailure: Error { case unexpectedOperation, timeout }

private actor FilterSteamCredentials: CredentialStore {
    func load() -> SteamCredentials? {
        SteamCredentials(accountName: "Filter fixture", steamId: 42, refreshToken: "fixture-only-never-sent")
    }
    func save(_ credentials: SteamCredentials) {}
    func remove() {}
}

private final class FilterSteamSession: SteamSessionProtocol, Sendable {
    private let library: [SteamGame]
    private let loadPlatforms: @Sendable ([UInt32]) async throws -> [SteamGamePlatforms]
    private let records: FilterRecordRequests

    init(games: [SteamGame], platforms: @escaping @Sendable ([UInt32]) async throws -> [SteamGamePlatforms],
         records: FilterRecordRequests) {
        library = games
        loadPlatforms = platforms
        self.records = records
    }

    func games() async throws -> [SteamGame] { library }
    func platforms(appIds: [UInt32], language: String) async throws -> [SteamGamePlatforms] { try await loadPlatforms(appIds) }
    func acquisitions() async throws -> [UInt32: UInt64] { await records.acquisitions() }
    func achievementShares(appIds: [UInt32], language: String) async throws -> [UInt32: Double] {
        await records.achievementShares(appIds)
    }
    func profile() async throws -> SteamProfile { SteamProfile(displayName: nil, avatarUrl: nil) }
    func details(appId: UInt32, language: String) async throws -> SteamGameDetails { throw FilterFixtureFailure.unexpectedOperation }
}

/// Steam's answers about the account's games: Gamma was got last, Alpha
/// before it and Beta through no license; Gamma's achievements are all
/// unlocked, half of Beta's, and Alpha has none.
private actor FilterRecordRequests {
    private(set) var counts = (acquisitions: 0, achievements: 0, achievementApps: [UInt32]())

    func acquisitions() -> [UInt32: UInt64] {
        counts.acquisitions += 1
        return [1: 1_500_000_000, 3: 1_600_000_000]
    }

    func achievementShares(_ appIDs: [UInt32]) -> [UInt32: Double] {
        counts.achievements += 1
        counts.achievementApps = appIDs
        return [2: 0.5, 3: 1]
    }
}
```
