```rs
    drop(vault);
    let mut vault = open(root.path(), scope(1, 10, 42));
    assert!(
        vault
            .reconcile_pending(&id, auth, true, &remote("2", &desired))
            .is_err()
    );
    let fresh = vault.authorize(scope(1, 10, 42).steam_id).unwrap();
    vault
        .reconcile_pending(&id, fresh, true, &remote("2", &desired))
        .unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn missing_receipt_reopens_for_a_new_comparison_without_changing_the_baseline() {
    for outcome in ["unchanged", "committed", "other-device", "deleted"] {
        let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let account = scope(1, 10, 42);
        let mut vault = open(root.path(), account);
        let base = remote("1", &stage(&vault, b"original"));
        vault.confirm_equal(&base.files, &base).unwrap();
        let desired = if outcome == "deleted" {
            Manifest::default()
        } else {
            stage(&vault, b"new progress")
        };
        vault.record_local(&desired).unwrap();
        let auth = vault.authorize(account.steam_id).unwrap();
        let old = vault
            .queue_upload(&desired, &base, "fixture", auth)
            .unwrap();
        let old_permit = vault.begin_upload(&old, auth, &base).unwrap();
        drop(vault);

        let mut vault = open(root.path(), account);
        let observed = match outcome {
            "committed" => remote("2", &desired),
            "other-device" => remote("2", &stage(&vault, b"deck progress")),
            _ => base.clone(),
        };
        vault.recompare_pending(&old, auth, &observed).unwrap();
        assert!(vault.pending().is_none());
        assert_eq!(vault.baseline(), Some(&base));
        assert_eq!(vault.local(), Some(&desired));
        // A late acknowledgement from the retired local attempt is stale.
        assert!(
            vault
                .complete_upload(&old_permit, true, &remote("3", &desired))
                .is_err()
        );
        match outcome {
            "committed" => {
                assert_eq!(
                    vault.decision(&desired, &observed).unwrap(),
                    Decision::Converged
                );
                vault.confirm_equal(&desired, &observed).unwrap();
            }
            "other-device" => {
                assert_eq!(
                    vault.decision(&desired, &observed).unwrap(),
                    Decision::Conflict
                );
                assert!(
                    vault
                        .queue_upload(&desired, &observed, "fixture", auth)
                        .is_err()
                );
                vault.choose_local(&observed, &observed).unwrap();
            }
            _ => {
                assert_eq!(
                    vault.decision(&desired, &observed).unwrap(),
                    Decision::KeepLocal
                );
                let fresh = vault
                    .queue_upload(&desired, &observed, "fixture", auth)
                    .unwrap();
                assert_ne!(fresh, old);
                let permit = vault.begin_upload(&fresh, auth, &observed).unwrap();
                assert!(
                    vault
                        .complete_upload(&permit, false, &remote("3", &desired))
                        .is_err()
                );
                vault
                    .complete_upload(&permit, true, &remote("3", &desired))
                    .unwrap();
                assert!(vault.pending().is_none());
            }
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn recompare_keeps_account_preferences_game_and_verified_content_guards() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let account = scope(1, 10, 42);
    let mut vault = open(root.path(), account);
    let desired = stage(&vault, b"local");
    let base = remote("1", &Manifest::default());
    let auth = vault.authorize(account.steam_id).unwrap();
    let id = vault
        .queue_upload(&desired, &base, "fixture", auth)
        .unwrap();
    vault.begin_upload(&id, auth, &base).unwrap();
    assert!(
        vault
            .recompare_pending("wrong-operation", auth, &base)
            .is_err()
    );
    let unavailable_bytes = remote("2", &manifest(Some(b"not downloaded")));
    assert!(
        vault
            .recompare_pending(&id, auth, &unavailable_bytes)
            .is_err()
    );
    vault.set_preferences(Preferences::default());
    assert!(matches!(
        vault.recompare_pending(&id, auth, &base),
        Err(Error::Preferences)
    ));
    vault.set_preferences(Preferences {
        account_enabled: Some(true),
        game_enabled: Some(true),
    });
    let game = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001";
    vault.game_started(game).unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(
        vault.recompare_pending(&id, auth, &base),
        Err(Error::Busy)
    ));
    vault.game_exited(game).unwrap();
    vault.revoke().unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(
        vault.recompare_pending(&id, auth, &base),
        Err(Error::Authentication)
    ));
    assert_eq!(vault.pending().unwrap().id, id);
    assert_eq!(
        vault.read_content(&desired.0["save.dat"]).unwrap(),
        b"local"
    );
}

#[test]
fn journal_and_blob_corruption_fail_closed() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let mut vault = open(root.path(), scope(1, 10, 42));
    let files = stage(&vault, b"good");
    vault.record_local(&files).unwrap();
    let directory = root
        .path()
        .join(scope(1, 10, 42).steam_id.to_string())
        .join("42");
    fs::write(
        directory
            .join("blobs")
            .join(files.0["save.dat"].hash.as_str()),
        b"evil",
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(
        vault.read_content(&files.0["save.dat"]),
        Err(Error::Integrity)
    ));
    drop(vault);
    fs::write(directory.join("state.json"), b"{truncated").unwrap();
    assert!(Vault::open(root.path(), scope(1, 10, 42)).is_err());
}

#[test]
fn game_guard_survives_signout_and_reopening_until_the_same_session_exits() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let mut vault = open(root.path(), scope(1, 10, 42));
    let session = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001";

    drop(vault);

}

#[test]
fn retries_make_three_attempts_with_one_then_two_seconds_between_failures() {
    let start = Instant::now();
    let mut budget = RetryBudget::new(start);
    assert_eq!(
        budget.poll(start),
        Retry::Attempt {
            remaining: Duration::from_secs(120)
        }
    );
    budget.failed(start + Duration::from_secs(2), false);
    for seconds in [3, 5] {
        assert_eq!(
            budget.poll(start + Duration::from_secs(seconds - 1)),
            Retry::Wait(Duration::from_secs(1))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            budget.poll(start + Duration::from_secs(seconds)),
            Retry::Attempt {
                remaining: Duration::from_secs(120 - seconds)
            }
        );
        budget.failed(start + Duration::from_secs(seconds), false);
    }
    assert_eq!(budget.poll(start + Duration::from_secs(5)), Retry::Defer);
}

#[test]
fn slow_requests_keep_the_retry_delay_and_never_extend_the_deadline() {
    let start = Instant::now();
    let mut budget = RetryBudget::new(start);
    budget.poll(start);
    budget.failed(start, false);
    assert!(matches!(
        budget.poll(start + Duration::from_secs(40)),
        Retry::Attempt { .. }
    ));
    budget.failed(start + Duration::from_secs(40), false);
    assert_eq!(
        budget.poll(start + Duration::from_secs(40)),
        Retry::Wait(Duration::from_secs(2))
    );
    assert_eq!(budget.poll(start + Duration::from_secs(120)), Retry::Defer);
    let mut auth_failure = RetryBudget::new(start);
    auth_failure.poll(start);
    auth_failure.failed(start, true);
    assert_eq!(auth_failure.poll(start), Retry::Defer);
}

#[test]
fn failed_journal_write_requires_reopening_before_more_decisions() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let mut vault = open(root.path(), scope(1, 10, 42));
    let files = stage(&vault, b"save");
    vault.record_local(&files).unwrap();
    let state_path = root
        .path()
        .join(scope(1, 10, 42).steam_id.to_string())
        .join("42/state.json");
    let original = fs::read(&state_path).unwrap();
    let original_permissions = fs::metadata(&state_path).unwrap().permissions();
    fs::remove_file(&state_path).unwrap();
    std::os::unix::fs::symlink("missing", &state_path).unwrap();
    assert!(vault.record_local(&files).is_err());
    fs::remove_file(&state_path).unwrap();
    fs::write(&state_path, original).unwrap();
    fs::set_permissions(&state_path, original_permissions).unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(vault.record_local(&files), Err(Error::Recovery)));
    drop(vault);
    let mut vault = open(root.path(), scope(1, 10, 42));
    vault.record_local(&files).unwrap();

#[test]
fn garbage_collection_retains_pending_bytes_and_conflict_choice_is_fenced() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let mut vault = open(root.path(), scope(1, 10, 42));
    let desired = stage(&vault, b"pending");
    let initial = remote("1", &Manifest::default());
    let auth = vault.authorize(scope(1, 10, 42).steam_id).unwrap();
    let id = vault
        .queue_upload(&desired, &initial, "fixture-v1", auth)
        .unwrap();
    for n in 0..6 {
        let files = stage(&vault, &[n]);
        vault.record_local(&files).unwrap();
    }
    assert_eq!(vault.collect_garbage(&[]).unwrap(), 5);
    assert_eq!(
        vault.read_content(&desired.0["save.dat"]).unwrap(),
        b"pending"
    );
    let current = remote("2", &manifest(Some(b"other device")));
    assert!(
        vault
            .resolve_pending_conflict(&id, &initial, &current, true)
            .is_err()
    );
    vault
        .resolve_pending_conflict(&id, &current, &current, true)
        .unwrap();
    let permit = vault.begin_upload(&id, auth, &current).unwrap();
    assert!(
        vault
            .resolve_pending_conflict(&id, &current, &current, false)
            .is_err()
    );
    vault
        .complete_upload(&permit, true, &remote("3", &desired))
        .unwrap();
    assert!(vault.pending().is_none());
}
```

`crates/cloud-vault/tests/journal.rs`:

```rs
use std::{
    fs::{self, OpenOptions},
    io::Write,
    os::unix::fs::{PermissionsExt, symlink},
};

use cloud_vault::{Error, journal};

#[test]
fn journal_reads_reject_every_group_or_other_permission() {
    let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = temporary.path().join("journal.json");
    for mode in [0o640, 0o620, 0o610, 0o604, 0o602, 0o601, 0o644, 0o666] {
        journal::write(&path, &42_u64).unwrap();
        fs::set_permissions(&path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(mode)).unwrap();
        assert!(
            matches!(journal::read::<u64>(&path), Err(Error::Invalid)),
            "journal with mode {mode:o} must be refused"
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn journal_writes_remain_private_and_private_reads_preserve_json() {
    let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = temporary.path().join("journal.json");
    let value = serde_json::json!({"generation": 42, "files": ["slot-a", "slot-b"]});
    for mode in [0o600, 0o400, 0o700] {
        journal::write(&path, &value).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(fs::metadata(&path).unwrap().permissions().mode() & 0o077, 0);
        fs::set_permissions(&path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(mode)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            journal::read::<serde_json::Value>(&path).unwrap(),
            Some(value.clone())
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn journal_reads_preserve_missing_paths_and_reject_links_and_directories() {
    let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let missing = temporary.path().join("missing.json");
    assert_eq!(journal::read::<u64>(&missing).unwrap(), None);
    let target = temporary.path().join("target.json");
    journal::write(&target, &42_u64).unwrap();
    let link = temporary.path().join("link.json");
    symlink(&target, &link).unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(journal::read::<u64>(&link), Err(Error::Invalid)));
    fs::remove_file(&target).unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(journal::read::<u64>(&link), Err(Error::Invalid)));
    assert!(matches!(
        journal::read::<u64>(temporary.path()),
        Err(Error::Invalid)
    ));
}

#[test]
fn journal_reads_keep_the_64_mib_boundary_and_parse_the_complete_json_document() {
    let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = temporary.path().join("journal.json");
    journal::write(&path, &42_u64).unwrap();
    let mut file = OpenOptions::new().append(true).open(&path).unwrap();
    let spaces = [b' '; 64 * 1024];
    let mut remaining = 64 * 1024 * 1024 - 2;
    while remaining > 0 {
        let count = remaining.min(spaces.len());
        file.write_all(&spaces[..count]).unwrap();
        remaining -= count;
    }
    assert_eq!(journal::read::<u64>(&path).unwrap(), Some(42));
    file.write_all(b" ").unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(journal::read::<u64>(&path), Err(Error::Invalid)));
    drop(file);
    fs::write(&path, b"42\n43\n").unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(
        journal::read::<u64>(&path),
        Err(Error::Journal(_))
    ));
    fs::write(&path, b"42\n").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(journal::read::<u64>(&path).unwrap(), Some(42));
}
```

`crates/cloud-vault/tests/store_identity.rs`:

```rs
use cloud_vault::*;
use std::{collections::BTreeSet, fs, path::Path};

const ACCOUNT_A: &str = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef";
const ACCOUNT_B: &str = "abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789";

fn steam() -> Scope {
    Scope {
        steam_id: 0x0110_0001_0000_0001,
        app_id: 10,
        cloud_app_id: 42,
    }
}

fn epic(account: &str, namespace: &str, app: &str) -> EpicScope {
    EpicScope {
        account_id: account.into(),
        namespace: namespace.into(),
        app_name: app.into(),
    }
}

fn open(root: &Path, scope: impl Into<StoreScope>) -> Vault {
    let mut vault = Vault::open(root, scope).unwrap();
    vault.set_preferences(Preferences {
        account_enabled: Some(true),
        game_enabled: Some(true),
    });
    vault
}

fn staged(vault: &Vault, bytes: &[u8]) -> Manifest {
    Manifest([(String::from("save.dat"), vault.stage(bytes, 2).unwrap())].into())
}

fn remote(files: &Manifest) -> RemoteView {
    RemoteView {
        revision: "fixture-view".into(),
        files: files.clone(),
    }
}

#[test]
fn existing_steam_journals_roundtrip_without_migration_or_path_changes() {
    use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;

    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let scope = steam();
    let directory = root.path().join(scope.steam_id.to_string()).join("42");
    fs::create_dir_all(&directory).unwrap();
    // This is the original Steam schema-2 shape, independent of StoreScope's serializer.
    let original = format!(
        r#"{{"schema":2,"scope":{{"steam_id":{0},"app_id":10,"cloud_app_id":42}},"baseline":null,"intent":null,"local":{{}},"pending":{{"id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","scope":{{"steam_id":{0},"app_id":11,"cloud_app_id":42}},"adapter":"steam-fixture","desired":{{}},"against":{{"revision":"known","files":{{}}}},"may_have_committed":true}},"applying":null,"game":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"}}"#,
        scope.steam_id,
    );
    fs::write(directory.join("state.json"), &original).unwrap();
    fs::set_permissions(
        directory.join("state.json"),
        fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let mut vault = open(root.path(), scope);
    assert_eq!(
        StoreScope::from(scope).directory(root.path()).unwrap(),
        directory
    );
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read_to_string(directory.join("state.json")).unwrap(),
        original
    );
    assert!(vault.pending().unwrap().may_have_committed);
    assert_eq!(
        vault.pending().unwrap().scope,
        StoreScope::Steam(Scope {
            app_id: 11,
            ..scope
        })
    );
    vault
        .game_exited("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002")
        .unwrap();
    vault.record_local(&Manifest::default()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read_to_string(directory.join("state.json")).unwrap(),
        original.replace(
            r#""game":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002""#,
            r#""game":null"#
        )
    );
    vault.revoke().unwrap();
    let authorization = directory.parent().unwrap().join("authorization.json");
    assert_eq!(fs::read_to_string(authorization).unwrap(), "1");
    assert!(!root.path().join("steam").exists());
    assert!(!root.path().join("epic").exists());
}

#[test]
fn epic_storage_separates_accounts_namespaces_apps_case_and_tuple_boundaries() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let scopes = [
        epic(ACCOUNT_A, "namespace", "game"),
        epic(ACCOUNT_B, "namespace", "game"),
        epic(ACCOUNT_A, "other", "game"),
        epic(ACCOUNT_A, "namespace", "Game"),
        epic(ACCOUNT_A, "a.b", "c"),
        epic(ACCOUNT_A, "a", "b.c"),
    ];
    let mut paths = BTreeSet::new();
    for (index, scope) in scopes.iter().enumerate() {
        let store = StoreScope::from(scope.clone());
        let path = store.directory(root.path()).unwrap();
        assert!(path.starts_with(root.path().join("epic").join(&scope.account_id)));
        assert!(paths.insert(path.clone()));
        let mut vault = open(root.path(), scope.clone());
        let files = staged(&vault, &[index as u8]);
        vault.record_local(&files).unwrap();
        let persisted: serde_json::Value =
            serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(path.join("state.json")).unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(persisted["scope"]["account_id"], scope.account_id);
        assert_eq!(persisted["scope"]["namespace"], scope.namespace);
        assert_eq!(persisted["scope"]["app_name"], scope.app_name);
        assert!(persisted["scope"].get("steam_id").is_none());
    }
    assert!(paths.insert(StoreScope::from(steam()).directory(root.path()).unwrap()));
    for (index, scope) in scopes.into_iter().enumerate() {
        let vault = open(root.path(), scope);
        assert_eq!(
            vault
                .read_content(&vault.local().unwrap().0["save.dat"])
                .unwrap(),
            [index as u8]
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn epic_revocation_fences_the_account_across_games_without_revoking_other_accounts() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let original_scope = epic(ACCOUNT_A, "namespace", "game");
    let mut vault = open(root.path(), original_scope.clone());
    let files = staged(&vault, b"pending Epic save");
    let empty = remote(&Manifest::default());
    assert!(matches!(
        vault.authorize(ACCOUNT_B),
        Err(Error::Authentication)
    ));
    assert!(matches!(
        vault.authorize(steam().steam_id),
        Err(Error::Authentication)
    ));
    let authorization = vault.authorize(ACCOUNT_A).unwrap();
    let id = vault
        .queue_upload(&files, &empty, "epic", authorization)
        .unwrap();
    let permit = vault.begin_upload(&id, authorization, &empty).unwrap();
    drop(vault);
    open(
        root.path(),
        epic(ACCOUNT_A, "other-namespace", "other-game"),
    )
    .revoke()
    .unwrap();
    let mut vault = open(root.path(), original_scope.clone());
    assert!(matches!(
        vault.complete_upload(&permit, true, &remote(&files)),
        Err(Error::Authentication)
    ));
    let fresh = vault.authorize(ACCOUNT_A).unwrap();
    drop(vault);
    open(root.path(), epic(ACCOUNT_B, "namespace", "game"))
        .revoke()
        .unwrap();
    open(root.path(), steam()).revoke().unwrap();
    let mut vault = open(root.path(), original_scope);
    vault
        .reconcile_pending(&id, fresh, true, &remote(&files))
        .unwrap();
    assert!(vault.pending().is_none());
    assert_eq!(vault.baseline().unwrap().files, files);
}

#[test]
fn shared_save_projection_preserves_both_steam_and_epic_account_snapshots() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let saves = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = saves.path().join("save.dat");

        },

    assert_eq!(
        vault.read_content(&epic_files.0["save.dat"]).unwrap(),
        b"Epic save"
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_running_steam_game_leaves_epic_cloud_work_on_other_saves_available() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let saves = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let steam_save = saves.path().join("steam.dat");
    let epic_save = saves.path().join("epic.dat");
    fs::write(&steam_save, b"Steam progress").unwrap();
    fs::write(&epic_save, b"Epic progress").unwrap();
    let mut steam_vault = open(root.path(), steam());
    steam_vault.activate(&binding(&steam_save)).unwrap();
    steam_vault.capture(&binding(&steam_save)).unwrap();
    let game = session();
    steam_vault.game_started(&game).unwrap();

    let mut epic_vault = open(root.path(), epic(ACCOUNT_A, "namespace", "game"));
    assert!(!epic_vault.activate(&binding(&epic_save)).unwrap());
    let local = epic_vault.capture(&binding(&epic_save)).unwrap();
    let authorization = epic_vault.authorize(ACCOUNT_A).unwrap();
    epic_vault
        .queue_upload(&local, &remote(&Manifest::default()), "epic", authorization)
        .unwrap();

    assert_eq!(epic_vault.pending().unwrap().desired, local);
    assert_eq!(steam_vault.game_session(), Some(game.as_str()));
    assert_eq!(fs::read(&steam_save).unwrap(), b"Steam progress");
}

#[test]

#[test]
fn restoring_current_local_snapshot_preserves_remote_baseline_and_local_choice() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let saves = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = saves.path().join("save.dat");
    let bindings = Bindings::from([(
        "save.dat".into(),
        SelectedFile {
            path: path.clone(),
            platforms: 2,
        },
    )]);
    let mut vault = open(root.path(), epic(ACCOUNT_A, "namespace", "game"));
    let baseline = staged(&vault, b"confirmed cloud");
    let confirmed = remote(&baseline);
    vault.confirm_equal(&baseline, &confirmed).unwrap();
    fs::write(&path, b"archived progress").unwrap();
    let local = vault.capture(&bindings).unwrap();
    let remote_change = remote(&staged(&vault, b"other device"));
    vault.choose_local(&remote_change, &remote_change).unwrap();
    fs::remove_file(&path).unwrap();
    vault.restore_local(&bindings).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(fs::read(&path).unwrap(), b"archived progress");
    assert_eq!(vault.local(), Some(&local));
    assert_eq!(vault.baseline(), Some(&confirmed));
    assert_eq!(
        vault.decision(&local, &remote_change).unwrap(),
        Decision::KeepLocal
    );
    assert!(vault.pending().is_none());
}
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/cloud.rs`:

```rs
//! What a Cloud sync publishes and asks, shared by every storefront. A Game
//! session journals its status; Cloud maintenance keeps it in Obelisk's memory.
//! Only the publication differs. `sync` runs one Cloud sync, `view` reads and
//! confirms the Cloud view it compares against, and `record` keeps each
//! game's Cloud record between syncs.
pub(crate) mod record;
pub(crate) mod sync;
pub(crate) mod view;

use crate::supervisor::session::Questions;
use obelisk_core::transfer::CancelToken;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::{
    sync::{
        Arc, Mutex,
        atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering},
    },
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum Phase {
    /// Nothing was published yet.
    #[default]
    Idle,
    Checking,
    Ready,
    Syncing,
    Synced,
    Conflict,
    Pending,
    /// Cloud is turned off in the storefront's preferences.
    Disabled,
    /// The game's Cloud rules are not supported on macOS.
    Unsupported,
    Failed,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum Choice {
    Retry,
    Cancel,
    LaunchAnyway,
    Local,
    Cloud,
}

/// A sync's progress and the Cloud question it waits on, if any.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Status {
    pub phase: Phase,
    /// Binds an answer to the question this status shows. Shared with the
    /// Rosetta requirement of a Game session. Steam journals named it `id`.
    #[serde(alias = "id")]
    pub decision_id: u64,
    /// Localization key of the failure the status reports.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub error: Option<String>,
    /// Empty unless a question waits. Presentation never derives choices
    /// from the phase or the error.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub allowed_choices: Vec<Choice>,
}

/// A Cloud question: what the player chooses between.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Question {
    /// Local and Cloud saves both changed.
    Conflict,
    /// A launch check failed after its retries.
    Failed { launch_anyway: bool },
}
impl Question {
    fn choices(self) -> Vec<Choice> {
        match self {
            Self::Conflict => vec![Choice::Local, Choice::Cloud, Choice::Cancel],
            Self::Failed { launch_anyway } => {
                let mut choices = vec![Choice::Retry, Choice::Cancel];
                if launch_anyway {
                    choices.push(Choice::LaunchAnyway);
                }
                choices
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Why a sync must stop now.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Stop {
    /// Cancelled, answered Cancel, or abandoned by its observers.
    Cancelled,
    /// Account revocation: network work stops, the game keeps running.
    Revoked,
}

/// The answer no longer fits the question shown.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, thiserror::Error)]
#[error("the answer does not fit the question shown")]
pub struct Rejected;

struct State {
    status: Status,
    answer: Option<Choice>,
}

/// One sync's status, question, cancellation and revocation.
pub struct Control {
    questions: Arc<Questions>,
    /// Interrupts network work on cancellation and revocation alike.
    cancellation: CancelToken,
    cancelled: AtomicBool,
    revoked: AtomicBool,
    state: Mutex<State>,
    changed: tokio::sync::Notify,
    publish: Box<dyn Fn(Status) + Send + Sync>,
}
impl Control {
    /// Cloud maintenance in Obelisk, where the UI waits for any answer.
    pub fn new(publish: impl Fn(Status) + Send + Sync + 'static) -> Self {
        Self::with_questions(Arc::new(Questions::in_app()), publish)
    }
    /// A Game session's sync, whose questions share its decision counter and
    /// are abandoned once nobody observes the session.
    pub(crate) fn with_questions(
        questions: Arc<Questions>,
        publish: impl Fn(Status) + Send + Sync + 'static,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            questions,
            cancellation: CancelToken::new(),
            cancelled: AtomicBool::new(false),
            revoked: AtomicBool::new(false),
            state: Mutex::new(State {
                status: Status::default(),
                answer: None,
            }),
            changed: tokio::sync::Notify::new(),
            publish: Box::new(publish),
        }
    }

    /// Accepts one answer to the question `decision_id` still shows.
    pub fn answer(&self, decision_id: u64, choice: Choice) -> Result<(), Rejected> {
        let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
        if state.status.decision_id != decision_id
            || state.answer.is_some()
            || !state.status.allowed_choices.contains(&choice)
        {
            return Err(Rejected);
        }
        state.answer = Some(choice);
        // The question is closed once answered, before the sync resumes.
        state.status.allowed_choices.clear();
        (self.publish)(state.status.clone());
        drop(state);
        self.changed.notify_waiters();
        Ok(())
    }
    pub fn cancel(&self) {
        self.cancelled.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        self.cancellation.cancel();
        self.changed.notify_waiters();
    }
    /// Stops the account's network work. The caller checks the account.
    pub fn revoke(&self) {
        self.revoked.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        self.cancellation.cancel();
        self.changed.notify_waiters();
    }
    pub fn revoked(&self) -> bool {
        self.revoked.load(Ordering::Acquire)
    }
    /// For storefront calls that stop on a token.
    pub fn cancellation(&self) -> &CancelToken {
        &self.cancellation
    }
    pub fn check(&self) -> Result<(), Stop> {
        if self.cancelled.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
            Err(Stop::Cancelled)
        } else if self.revoked.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
            Err(Stop::Revoked)
        } else if self.cancellation.is_cancelled() {
            Err(Stop::Cancelled)
        } else {
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    /// Publishes progress. Any question shown is closed.
    pub fn show(&self, phase: Phase, error: Option<String>) {
        let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
        state.status.phase = phase;
        state.status.error = error;
        state.status.allowed_choices.clear();
        state.answer = None;
        // Published under the lock, so observers see statuses in order.
        (self.publish)(state.status.clone());
    }

    /// Asks the player and waits for the answer. Cancel, cancellation and an
    /// abandoned question stop the sync; so does revocation.
    pub async fn ask(&self, question: Question, error: Option<String>) -> Result<Choice, Stop> {
        {
            let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
            state.status = Status {
                phase: match question {
                    Question::Conflict => Phase::Conflict,
                    Question::Failed { .. } => Phase::Failed,
                },
                decision_id: self.questions.next(),
                error,
                allowed_choices: question.choices(),
            };
            state.answer = None;
            (self.publish)(state.status.clone());
        }
        // Abandoned after its deadline, or once nobody observes the session.
        let published = Instant::now();
        loop {
            let changed = self.changed.notified();
            tokio::pin!(changed);
            changed.as_mut().enable();
            self.check()?;
            if let Some(choice) = self.state.lock().unwrap().answer.take() {
                return if choice == Choice::Cancel {
                    Err(Stop::Cancelled)
                } else {
                    Ok(choice)
                };
            }
            if self.questions.abandoned(published) {
                return Err(Stop::Cancelled);
            }
            let _ = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), changed).await;
        }
    }

    /// Paces a retry; cancellation and revocation cut it short.
    pub async fn wait(&self, duration: Duration) -> Result<(), Stop> {
        self.check()?;
        tokio::select! {
            _ = tokio::time::sleep(duration) => (),
            _ = self.cancellation.cancelled() => (),
        }
        self.check()
    }

    /// Runs `future` until it ends, or until cancellation or revocation.
    pub async fn interruptible<F: std::future::Future>(
        &self,
        future: F,
    ) -> Result<F::Output, Stop> {
        self.check()?;
        tokio::select! {
            biased;
            _ = self.cancellation.cancelled() => {
                self.check()?;
                Err(Stop::Cancelled)
            }
            output = future => Ok(output),
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
impl Control {
    /// The status last published, as its observer holds it.
    pub(crate) fn status(&self) -> Status {
        self.state.lock().unwrap().status.clone()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn recorded() -> (Arc<Mutex<Vec<Status>>>, Control) {
        let published = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
        let sink = published.clone();
        let control = Control::new(move |status| sink.lock().unwrap().push(status));
        (published, control)
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn only_published_choices_are_accepted_once() {
        for question in [
            Question::Conflict,
            Question::Failed {
                launch_anyway: false,
            },
            Question::Failed {
                launch_anyway: true,
            },
        ] {
            let (published, control) = recorded();
            let control = Arc::new(control);
            let asking = tokio::spawn({
                let control = control.clone();
                async move { control.ask(question, Some("fixture.failure".into())).await }
            });
            let status = loop {
                if let Some(status) = published.lock().unwrap().last().cloned() {
                    break status;
                }
                tokio::task::yield_now().await;
            };
            assert_eq!(status.allowed_choices, question.choices());
            assert_eq!(status.error.as_deref(), Some("fixture.failure"));
            for choice in [
                Choice::Retry,
                Choice::Local,
                Choice::Cloud,
                Choice::LaunchAnyway,
                Choice::Cancel,
            ] {
                if !status.allowed_choices.contains(&choice) {
                    assert_eq!(control.answer(status.decision_id, choice), Err(Rejected));
                }
            }
            assert_eq!(
                control.answer(status.decision_id + 1, status.allowed_choices[0]),
                Err(Rejected)
            );
            control
                .answer(status.decision_id, status.allowed_choices[0])
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                control.answer(status.decision_id, status.allowed_choices[0]),
                Err(Rejected),
                "a question takes one answer"
            );
            let closed = published.lock().unwrap().last().cloned().unwrap();
            assert!(closed.allowed_choices.is_empty());
            assert_eq!(closed.decision_id, status.decision_id);
            assert_eq!(asking.await.unwrap(), Ok(status.allowed_choices[0]));
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn progress_keeps_the_decision_and_closes_the_question() {
        let (published, control) = recorded();
        control.show(Phase::Checking, None);
        let first = published.lock().unwrap().last().cloned().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(first.decision_id, 0);
        assert!(control.answer(0, Choice::Retry).is_err());
        let control = Arc::new(control);
        let asking = tokio::spawn({
            let control = control.clone();
            async move { control.ask(Question::Conflict, None).await }
        });
        let question = loop {
            let last = published.lock().unwrap().last().cloned().unwrap();
            if !last.allowed_choices.is_empty() {
                break last;
            }
            tokio::task::yield_now().await;
        };
        control
            .answer(question.decision_id, Choice::Cancel)
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(asking.await.unwrap(), Err(Stop::Cancelled));
        control.show(Phase::Pending, Some("fixture.pending".into()));
        let pending = published.lock().unwrap().last().cloned().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(pending.decision_id, question.decision_id);
        assert!(pending.allowed_choices.is_empty());
        assert!(control.answer(pending.decision_id, Choice::Local).is_err());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn revocation_wakes_a_pending_question_and_stops_network_work() {
        let (_, control) = recorded();
        let control = Arc::new(control);
        let asking = tokio::spawn({
            let control = control.clone();
            async move { control.ask(Question::Conflict, None).await }
        });
        tokio::task::yield_now().await;
        control.revoke();
        assert_eq!(asking.await.unwrap(), Err(Stop::Revoked));
        assert!(control.revoked());
        assert!(control.cancellation().is_cancelled());
        assert_eq!(control.check(), Err(Stop::Revoked));
        assert_eq!(
            control.interruptible(std::future::pending::<()>()).await,
            Err(Stop::Revoked)
        );
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn cancellation_cuts_a_wait_short_and_wins_over_revocation() {
        let (_, control) = recorded();
        let control = Arc::new(control);
        let waiting = tokio::spawn({
            let control = control.clone();
            async move { control.wait(Duration::from_secs(60)).await }
        });
        tokio::task::yield_now().await;
        control.cancel();
        assert_eq!(waiting.await.unwrap(), Err(Stop::Cancelled));
        control.revoke();
        assert_eq!(control.check(), Err(Stop::Cancelled));
    }

    #[test]
    fn earlier_status_journals_still_read() {
        let steam: Status = serde_json::from_value(serde_json::json!({
            "phase": "Conflict", "id": 4, "error": "backend.steam.cloud.conflict",
            "allowed_choices": ["Local", "Cloud", "Cancel"],
        }))
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(steam.decision_id, 4);
        assert_eq!(steam.phase, Phase::Conflict);
        let epic: Status = serde_json::from_value(serde_json::json!({
            "phase": "Unsupported", "decision_id": 2, "allowed_choices": [],
        }))
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(epic.decision_id, 2);
        assert_eq!(epic.phase, Phase::Unsupported);
        assert_eq!(epic.error, None);
    }
}
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/cloud/record.rs`:

```rs
//! Each game's Cloud record, whatever the storefront: the work a Cloud sync
//! leaves and the removal fence, and what Obelisk does with the record outside
//! a sync: the uninstall archive, the removal, and the pending discovery behind
//! the Cloud indicators. A storefront plugs in its saved record as a `Record`,
//! which its Cloud sync adapter holds during a sync.
use super::sync::{self, Failure as _, Pending, Work};
use crate::{cloud_status, files::safe_storage_path};
use cloud_vault::{AccountIdentity, Bindings, Manifest, StoreScope, Vault};
use serde::de::DeserializeOwned;
use std::{collections::BTreeSet, fs, path::Path};

#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) mod tests;

/// Where a game is installed and keeps its saves, as its storefront configures it.
pub(crate) trait Configuration: Clone {
    /// The Cloud archive.
    fn root(&self) -> &Path;
    fn install(&self) -> &Path;
    /// Set for a Windows build: its saves live in this Wine prefix.
    fn prefix(&self) -> Option<&Path>;
}

/// A storefront's saved Cloud record of one game: the configuration that holds
/// its saves, its Cloud rules and the work a Cloud sync left.
pub(crate) trait Record: Sized + DeserializeOwned {
    type Failure: sync::Failure;
    type Configuration: Configuration;
    /// Steam's SteamID, Epic's account id.
    type Account: ?Sized;
    /// The record's file in the game's directory of the Cloud archive.
    const FILE: &'static str;

    /// The account as the vault checks it.
    fn identity(account: &Self::Account) -> AccountIdentity;
    /// The game's scope, once `configuration` names only safe paths for `account`.
    fn scope(
        configuration: &Self::Configuration,
        account: &Self::Account,
    ) -> Result<StoreScope, Self::Failure>;
    /// Under the vault's lock. `None` until the game's Cloud rules were known once.
    fn load(
        configuration: &Self::Configuration,
        account: &Self::Account,
    ) -> Result<Option<Self>, Self::Failure>;
    fn save(&self) -> Result<(), Self::Failure>;
    /// A record read without the lock names one account and holds valid manifests.
    fn check(&self) -> Result<(), Self::Failure>;
    fn account(&self) -> &Self::Account;
    fn configuration(&self) -> &Self::Configuration;
    fn configuration_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Self::Configuration;
    fn work(&self) -> Work;
    fn set_work(&mut self, work: Work);
    /// An upload whose outcome is unknown waits to be settled.
    fn uncertain(&self) -> bool {
        false
    }
    /// Where each save lives: the local set, and `remote`'s names. `create`
    /// makes their directories inside an installation that exists. Nothing
    /// is saved: the caller saves the record once it holds what it needs.
    fn bindings(
        &mut self,
        vault: &Vault,
        remote: Option<&Manifest>,
        create: bool,
    ) -> Result<Bindings, Self::Failure>;
}

/// Whether the installation is gone. Anything but a folder there is a storage
/// failure.
pub(crate) fn absent(install: &Path) -> cloud_vault::Result<bool> {
    safe_storage_path(install)?;
    match fs::symlink_metadata(install) {
        Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(true),
        Ok(metadata) if metadata.is_dir() => Ok(false),
        Ok(_) => Err(cloud_vault::Error::Invalid),
        Err(error) => Err(error.into()),
    }
}

/// Obelisk holds this game's saves, so its Cloud cannot silently vanish.
/// `recorded` says whether the game has a record.
pub(crate) fn holds_saves(vault: &Vault, recorded: bool) -> bool {
    recorded
        || vault.pending().is_some()
        || vault.game_session().is_some()
        || vault.local().is_some()
        || vault.baseline().is_some()
}

/// Captures the saves `bindings` name. A save whose folder is gone is left
/// out: a capture never recreates a folder. Behind the removal fence, each
/// save missing now keeps its archived version.
pub(crate) fn capture(
    vault: &mut Vault,
    mut bindings: Bindings,
    fenced: bool,
) -> cloud_vault::Result<Manifest> {
    bindings.retain(|_, file| file.path.parent().is_some_and(Path::is_dir));
    if fenced {
        vault.capture_preserving_missing(&bindings)
    } else {
        vault.capture(&bindings)
    }
}

/// Adopts the configuration the game runs with now. A Windows game whose
/// engine moved it to another Wine prefix saves there, still without the
/// saves of the old one. As after a reinstall, the removal fence goes up: a
/// save missing there keeps its archived version and is restored, never sent
/// as deleted.
pub(crate) fn rebind<R: Record>(record: &mut R, configuration: R::Configuration) {
    if record.configuration().prefix() != configuration.prefix() {
        fence(record);
    }
    *record.configuration_mut() = configuration;
}

/// From now on, a save missing locally may be one an uninstall removed.
fn fence<R: Record>(record: &mut R) {
    let mut work = record.work();
    work.installation_removed = true;
    record.set_work(work);
}

/// The game's vault, which holds its storefront's lock, and its record.
pub(crate) fn locked<R: Record>(
    configuration: &R::Configuration,
    account: &R::Account,
) -> Result<(Vault, Option<R>), R::Failure> {
    let scope = R::scope(configuration, account)?;
    let vault = Vault::open(configuration.root(), scope)?;
    let record = R::load(configuration, account)?;
    Ok((vault, record))
}

/// Before an uninstall removes the game's files: captures the saves under
/// the installation's `configuration`, then raises the removal fence. It
/// never creates work: an exit save or an upload still waiting stays as it
/// is. After a partial uninstall, or once the saves moved to another Wine
/// prefix, a save missing now keeps its archived version.
pub(crate) fn archive<R: Record>(
    vault: &mut Vault,
    mut record: R,
    configuration: R::Configuration,
) -> Result<(), R::Failure> {
    let gone = absent(configuration.install())?;
    rebind(&mut record, configuration);
    let fenced = gone || record.work().installation_removed;
    let bindings = record.bindings(vault, None, false)?;
    capture(vault, bindings, fenced)?;
    // Persist before removal starts: recursive deletion can fail partway.
    fence(&mut record);
    record.save()
}

/// Records a completed uninstall: a save missing from now on is never read
/// as deleted. Exit saves and uploads still waiting stay valid.
pub(crate) fn removed<R: Record>(
    configuration: &R::Configuration,
    account: &R::Account,
) -> Result<(), R::Failure> {
    let (_vault, record) = locked::<R>(configuration, account)?;
    let Some(mut record) = record else {
        return Ok(());
    };
    if !absent(configuration.install())? {
        return Err(R::Failure::recovery());
    }
    fence(&mut record);
    record.save()
}

/// The Cloud indicators of `games`, plus every other game of `account` with
/// pending work, such as an uninstalled one. Nothing here takes a lock: a game
/// or maintenance may be writing these journals meanwhile.
pub(crate) fn indicators<R: Record>(
    root: &Path,
    account: &AccountIdentity,
    games: &[StoreScope],
) -> Result<Vec<(StoreScope, cloud_status::Indicator)>, R::Failure> {
    let mut wanted: BTreeSet<StoreScope> = games.iter().cloned().collect();
    wanted.extend(pending::<R>(root, account)?);
    let mut indicators = Vec::new();
    for scope in wanted {
        match indicator::<R>(root, &scope) {
            Ok(indicator) => indicators.push((scope, indicator)),
            Err(error) => eprintln!("Cloud indicator of {scope:?} unavailable: {}", error.key()),
        }
    }
    Ok(indicators)
}

fn indicator<R: Record>(
    root: &Path,
    scope: &StoreScope,
) -> Result<cloud_status::Indicator, R::Failure> {
    let vault = cloud_vault::peek(root, scope.clone())?;
    // No record: the game has no Cloud rules or was never checked.
    let record = saved::<R>(root, scope)?;
    let journal = journal(
        record.as_ref().map(R::work).as_ref(),
        record.as_ref().is_some_and(R::uncertain),
    );
    let status = cloud_status::read(root, scope)?;
    Ok(cloud_status::indicator(scope, &vault, &journal, &status))
}

/// What Cloud maintenance of an uninstalled game syncs: the record it left.
pub(crate) fn saved<R: Record>(root: &Path, scope: &StoreScope) -> Result<Option<R>, R::Failure> {
    safe_storage_path(root)?;
    read(root, &scope.directory(root)?)
}

/// The games of `account` whose Cloud work still waits. One unreadable record
/// never hides the others' work.
fn pending<R: Record>(
    root: &Path,
    account: &AccountIdentity,
) -> Result<Vec<StoreScope>, R::Failure> {
    safe_storage_path(root)?;
    let directory = account.directory(root)?;
    safe_storage_path(&directory)?;
    if !directory.exists() {
        return Ok(Vec::new());
    }
    let mut games = Vec::new();
    for entry in fs::read_dir(directory).map_err(cloud_vault::Error::from)? {
        let entry = entry.map_err(cloud_vault::Error::from)?;
        if !entry
            .file_type()
            .map_err(cloud_vault::Error::from)?
            .is_dir()
        {
            continue;
        }
        match waiting::<R>(root, &entry.path()) {
            Ok(Some(scope)) => games.push(scope),
            Ok(None) => {}
            Err(error) => eprintln!(
                "Cloud record of {} unreadable: {}",
                entry.file_name().to_string_lossy(),
                error.key()
            ),
        }
    }
    Ok(games)
}

/// The game whose record lives in `directory`, if its work still waits.
fn waiting<R: Record>(root: &Path, directory: &Path) -> Result<Option<StoreScope>, R::Failure> {
    let Some(record) = read::<R>(root, directory)? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let scope = R::scope(record.configuration(), record.account())?;
    // Vault work outlives the record's: an uncertain upload or an
    // interrupted replacement still needs this game's next sync.
    let vault = cloud_vault::peek(root, scope.clone())?;
    Ok(
        (record.work().pending.is_some() || vault.pending.is_some() || vault.applying)
            .then_some(scope),
    )
}

/// A record read without the vault's lock, from the game directory it must
/// name: one copied from another account, game or archive is refused.
fn read<R: Record>(root: &Path, directory: &Path) -> Result<Option<R>, R::Failure> {
    let path = directory.join(R::FILE);
    safe_storage_path(&path)?;
    let Some(record) = cloud_vault::journal::read::<R>(&path)? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    record.check()?;
    if record.configuration().root() != root
        || R::scope(record.configuration(), record.account())?.directory(root)? != directory
    {
        return Err(cloud_vault::Error::Invalid.into());
    }
    Ok(Some(record))
}

/// What a game's Cloud indicator reads from its record's work.
fn journal(work: Option<&Work>, uncertain: bool) -> cloud_status::Journal {
    let pending = work.and_then(|work| work.pending.as_ref());
    cloud_status::Journal {
        pending: matches!(pending, Some(Pending::Capture | Pending::Upload { .. })),
        uncertain,
        applying: matches!(pending, Some(Pending::Applying { .. })),
        installation_removed: work.is_some_and(|work| work.installation_removed),
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Each game's Cloud record through its interface, once for every storefront,
//! on the Cloud sync's harnesses: the uninstall archive, the removal, pending
//! discovery and the indicators.
use super::*;
use crate::cloud::sync::tests::{
    Harness, Of, RecordOf, indicator, listed, pending, played_offline, synced, uninstall,
    uploading, vault, work,
};
use crate::cloud_status::SavedState;
use crate::supervisor::client::no_other_session;
use cloud_vault::{EpicScope, Scope};

/// Beside `scope`: another game of the same account, the same game of another
/// account, and a game of the other storefront.
fn neighbours(scope: &StoreScope) -> [StoreScope; 3] {
    let steam = |steam_id, app_id| {
        StoreScope::from(Scope {
            steam_id,
            app_id,
            cloud_app_id: app_id,
        })
    };
    match scope {
        StoreScope::Steam(scope) => [
            steam(scope.steam_id, 7),
            steam(scope.steam_id + 1, scope.app_id),
            EpicScope {
                account_id: "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef".into(),
                namespace: "namespace".into(),
                app_name: "game".into(),
            }
            .into(),
        ],
        StoreScope::Epic(scope) => [
            EpicScope {
                app_name: "other-game".into(),
                ..scope.clone()
            }
            .into(),
            EpicScope {
                account_id: "abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789".into(),
                ..scope.clone()
            }
            .into(),
            steam(0x0110_0001_0000_0001, 10),
        ],
    }
}

/// The account `scope` belongs to.
fn account(scope: &StoreScope) -> AccountIdentity {
    match scope {
        StoreScope::Steam(Scope { steam_id, .. }) => (*steam_id).into(),
        StoreScope::Epic(scope) => scope.account_id.as_str().into(),
    }
}

/// The games of `account` whose Cloud indicator shows: those `requested`,
/// and those pending discovery finds.
fn shown<H: Harness>(
    game: &H,
    account: &AccountIdentity,
    requested: &[StoreScope],
) -> Vec<StoreScope> {
    indicators::<RecordOf<H>>(&game.root(), account, requested)
        .unwrap()
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(scope, _)| scope)
        .collect()
}

/// The removal of `game`'s installation, recorded.
fn record_removal<H: Harness>(game: &H) -> Result<(), Of<H>> {
    removed::<RecordOf<H>>(&game.configuration(), game.account_id())
}

pub(crate) async fn pending_discovery_includes_uploads_the_vault_still_holds<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    synced(&game, b"old").await;
    let mut vault = vault(&game);
    vault.set_preferences(cloud_vault::Preferences {
        account_enabled: Some(true),
        game_enabled: Some(true),
    });
    let files = Manifest([(game.slot().into(), vault.stage(b"exit", 2).unwrap())].into());
    let authorization = vault.authorize(game.account()).unwrap();
    let before = vault.baseline().unwrap().clone();
    vault
        .queue_upload(&files, &before, "fixture", authorization)
        .unwrap();
    drop(vault);

    assert_eq!(pending(&game), None);
    assert!(listed(&game));
}

pub(crate) async fn indicators_follow_installed_and_uninstalled_games_without_locking<
    H: Harness,
>() {
    let game = H::game();
    assert_eq!(
        indicator(&game, true).unwrap().state,
        SavedState::NeverSynced
    );
    synced(&game, b"old").await;
    let shown = indicator(&game, true).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(shown.state, SavedState::Synced);
    assert!(shown.synced_at.is_some());

    played_offline(&game, b"played offline").await;
    let held = game.open();
    let shown = indicator(&game, true).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(shown.state, SavedState::Pending);
    assert!(shown.pending_upload);
    drop(held);

    uninstall(&game).await;
    let shown = indicator(&game, false).expect("uninstalled games with pending work are listed");
    assert!(shown.installation_removed);
    assert!(shown.pending_upload);
}

pub(crate) async fn a_windows_game_whose_engine_moved_its_prefix_keeps_its_cloud_saves<
    H: Harness,
>() {
    let mut game = H::game();
    let rosetta = game.root().with_file_name("Prefixes/game");
    game.run_in(&rosetta);
    synced(&game, b"progress").await;
    let (old, uploads) = (game.save(), game.uploads());

    // The Linux engine runs the game in a prefix of its own, still empty.
    let linux = game.root().with_file_name("Prefixes/game-linux/prefix");
    game.run_in(&linux);
    let mut sync = game.open();
    sync.prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();

    assert_eq!(fs::read(game.save()).unwrap(), b"progress");
    sync.started().unwrap();
    sync.finished(true).await;
    assert_eq!(game.cloud().as_deref(), Some(&b"progress"[..]));
    assert_eq!(game.uploads(), uploads);
    assert_eq!(pending(&game), None);
    assert_eq!(fs::read(old).unwrap(), b"progress");
}

pub(crate) async fn an_uninstall_after_the_engine_moved_the_prefix_keeps_the_archived_saves<
    H: Harness,
>() {
    let mut game = H::game();
    let rosetta = game.root().with_file_name("Prefixes/game");
    game.run_in(&rosetta);
    synced(&game, b"progress").await;
    // The Linux engine readied a prefix of its own, still empty, and the
    // player uninstalls the game before it ever runs there.
    let linux = game.root().with_file_name("Prefixes/game-linux/prefix");
    game.run_in(&linux);

    uninstall(&game).await;

    let vault = vault(&game);
    let archived = vault.local().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        vault.read_content(&archived.0[game.slot()]).unwrap(),
        b"progress"
    );
    let work = work(&game).unwrap();
    assert!(work.installation_removed);
    assert_eq!(work.pending, None);
}

pub(crate) async fn an_uninstall_archives_the_saves_of_a_game_never_synced<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    fs::write(game.save(), b"progress").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(work(&game), None);

    uninstall(&game).await;

    let vault = vault(&game);
    let archived = vault.local().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        vault.read_content(&archived.0[game.slot()]).unwrap(),
        b"progress"
    );
    assert!(vault.pending().is_none());
    let work = work(&game).unwrap();
    assert!(work.installation_removed);
    assert_eq!(work.pending, None, "an uninstall creates no work");
    assert!(!listed(&game));
    assert!(!game.install().exists());
}

pub(crate) async fn an_uninstall_keeps_the_exit_save_and_the_upload_still_waiting<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    synced(&game, b"old").await;
    played_offline(&game, b"exit save").await;
    let exit = uploading(pending(&game)).unwrap();
    // The exit save's upload began, and its outcome is unknown.
    let mut held = vault(&game);
    held.set_preferences(cloud_vault::Preferences {
        account_enabled: Some(true),
        game_enabled: Some(true),
    });
    let before = held.baseline().unwrap().clone();
    let authorization = held.authorize(game.account()).unwrap();
    let upload = held
        .queue_upload(&exit, &before, "fixture", authorization)
        .unwrap();
    held.begin_upload(&upload, authorization, &before).unwrap();
    drop(held);
    fs::write(game.save(), b"edited before uninstall").unwrap();

    game.archive().await.unwrap();
    game.archive().await.unwrap();
    fs::remove_dir_all(game.install()).unwrap();
    record_removal(&game).unwrap();
    record_removal(&game).unwrap();

    let work = work(&game).unwrap();
    assert!(work.installation_removed);
    assert_eq!(uploading(work.pending), Some(exit.clone()));
    let vault = vault(&game);
    let waiting = vault.pending().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(waiting.id, upload);
    assert_eq!(waiting.desired, exit);
    assert!(waiting.may_have_committed);
    let archived = vault.local().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        vault.read_content(&archived.0[game.slot()]).unwrap(),
        b"edited before uninstall"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        vault.read_content(&exit.0[game.slot()]).unwrap(),
        b"exit save"
    );
    assert!(listed(&game));
}

pub(crate) async fn an_interrupted_uninstall_keeps_the_saves_it_already_removed<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    let other = game.save().with_file_name("other.sav");
    let other_slot = game.slot().replace("slot.sav", "other.sav");
    fs::write(game.save(), b"original slot").unwrap();
    fs::write(&other, b"original other").unwrap();
    game.archive().await.unwrap();
    // The removal deleted one save, then failed with the installation and
    // another save, edited meanwhile, still there.
    fs::remove_file(game.save()).unwrap();
    fs::write(&other, b"edited survivor").unwrap();

    let refused = record_removal(&game).unwrap_err();
    game.archive().await.unwrap();

    assert_eq!(refused.key(), Of::<H>::recovery().key());
    let work = work(&game).unwrap();
    assert!(work.installation_removed);
    assert_eq!(work.pending, None);
    assert!(!listed(&game));
    let vault = vault(&game);
    assert!(vault.pending().is_none());
    let archived = vault.local().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(archived.0.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(
        vault.read_content(&archived.0[game.slot()]).unwrap(),
        b"original slot"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        vault
            .read_content(&archived.0[other_slot.as_str()])
            .unwrap(),
        b"edited survivor"
    );
    assert!(!game.save().exists());
    assert_eq!(fs::read(&other).unwrap(), b"edited survivor");
}

pub(crate) async fn a_failed_uninstall_archive_leaves_the_record_as_it_was<H: Harness>() {
    let mut game = H::game();
    let rosetta = game.root().with_file_name("Prefixes/game");
    game.run_in(&rosetta);
    synced(&game, b"progress").await;
    let record = game
        .scope()
        .directory(&game.root())
        .unwrap()
        .join(RecordOf::<H>::FILE);
    let before = fs::read(&record).unwrap();
    // A Game session that crashed still holds the saves, and the engine has
    // moved the game to a prefix of its own since.
    vault(&game)
        .game_started(&uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string())
        .unwrap();
    let linux = game.root().with_file_name("Prefixes/game-linux/prefix");
    game.run_in(&linux);

    let refused = game.archive().await.unwrap_err();

    assert_eq!(refused.key(), Of::<H>::from(cloud_vault::Error::Busy).key());
    assert_eq!(fs::read(&record).unwrap(), before);
}

pub(crate) async fn an_uninstall_needs_only_its_storefronts_lock<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    synced(&game, b"progress").await;
    let [same_storefront, _, other_storefront] = neighbours(&game.scope());
    let held = Vault::open(&game.root(), other_storefront).unwrap();

    game.archive().await.unwrap();
    fs::remove_dir_all(game.install()).unwrap();
    record_removal(&game).unwrap();

    assert!(work(&game).unwrap().installation_removed);
    let busy = Of::<H>::from(cloud_vault::Error::Busy).key();
    let other_game = Vault::open(&game.root(), same_storefront).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(game.archive().await.unwrap_err().key(), busy);
    assert_eq!(record_removal(&game).unwrap_err().key(), busy);
    drop((held, other_game));
}

pub(crate) async fn an_unreadable_record_neither_hides_nor_fakes_another_games_pending_work<
    H: Harness,
>() {
    let game = H::game();
    synced(&game, b"old").await;
    played_offline(&game, b"exit save").await;
    let [other_game, _, _] = neighbours(&game.scope());
    let directory = other_game.directory(&game.root()).unwrap();
    fs::create_dir_all(&directory).unwrap();
    let broken = directory.join(RecordOf::<H>::FILE);
    fs::write(&broken, b"not valid JSON").unwrap();
    {
        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
        fs::set_permissions(&broken, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)).unwrap();
    }

    let discovered = shown(&game, &game.account(), &[]);

    assert_eq!(discovered, [game.scope()]);
    assert_eq!(
        shown(&game, &game.account(), &[other_game]),
        [game.scope()],
        "an unreadable record shows no indicator"
    );
}

pub(crate) async fn a_record_copied_into_another_account_or_game_is_never_read_as_its_own<
    H: Harness,
>() {
    let game = H::game();
    synced(&game, b"old").await;
    played_offline(&game, b"exit save").await;
    let own = game
        .scope()
        .directory(&game.root())
        .unwrap()
        .join(RecordOf::<H>::FILE);
    let [other_game, other_account, _] = neighbours(&game.scope());

    for copy in [&other_game, &other_account] {
        let directory = copy.directory(&game.root()).unwrap();
        fs::create_dir_all(&directory).unwrap();
        fs::copy(&own, directory.join(RecordOf::<H>::FILE)).unwrap();
        assert!(saved::<RecordOf<H>>(&game.root(), copy).is_err());
    }

    assert_eq!(shown(&game, &game.account(), &[]), [game.scope()]);
    assert!(shown(&game, &account(&other_account), &[]).is_empty());
}

/// Instantiates every Cloud record scenario for one storefront's harness.
macro_rules! record_suite {
    ($harness:ty) => {
        $crate::cloud::record::tests::record_suite!(
            $harness;
            pending_discovery_includes_uploads_the_vault_still_holds,
            indicators_follow_installed_and_uninstalled_games_without_locking,
            a_windows_game_whose_engine_moved_its_prefix_keeps_its_cloud_saves,
            an_uninstall_after_the_engine_moved_the_prefix_keeps_the_archived_saves,
            an_uninstall_archives_the_saves_of_a_game_never_synced,
            an_uninstall_keeps_the_exit_save_and_the_upload_still_waiting,
            an_interrupted_uninstall_keeps_the_saves_it_already_removed,
            a_failed_uninstall_archive_leaves_the_record_as_it_was,
            an_uninstall_needs_only_its_storefronts_lock,
            an_unreadable_record_neither_hides_nor_fakes_another_games_pending_work,
            a_record_copied_into_another_account_or_game_is_never_read_as_its_own,
        );
    };
    ($harness:ty; $($scenario:ident),* $(,)?) => {
        $(
            #[tokio::test]
            async fn $scenario() {
                $crate::cloud::record::tests::$scenario::<$harness>().await
            }
        )*
    };
}
pub(crate) use record_suite;
```
