`crates/game-runtime/src/cloud/sync.rs`:

```rs
//! One Cloud sync, whatever the storefront: before a launch, after the game
//! exits, or as Cloud maintenance. This module owns the order of the steps,
//! the retries and Cloud questions, the choice between local and Cloud saves
//! and the work left pending in the game's Cloud record. A storefront plugs in
//! as a `Storefront`: the record it holds, its Cloud rules and its Cloud's
//! protocol, `view::Remote`.
use super::record::{self, Configuration as _, Record as _};
use super::{Choice, Control, Phase, Question, Stop, view};
use crate::cloud_status::{self, ProblemKind, UnavailableReason};
use crate::supervisor::client::SessionAlive;
use cloud_vault::{Bindings, Decision, Manifest, RemoteView, Retry, RetryBudget, Vault};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::{sync::Arc, time::Instant};

#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) mod tests;

/// How a failed step affects a Cloud sync.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Kind {
    /// Another attempt may succeed: the network, a changing remote, an upload
    /// whose outcome is unknown.
    Transient,
    /// Local and Cloud saves both changed since the last sync.
    Conflict,
    /// The storefront's Cloud cannot sync this game for now. Playing without
    /// it leaves local saves safe.
    Unavailable,
    /// Nothing may go on without a sync: storage, ownership, recovery.
    Blocking,
    /// The account's session was refused or revoked.
    Denied,
    Cancelled,
}
impl Kind {
    fn retryable(self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Transient | Self::Conflict)
    }
    fn launch_anyway(self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Transient | Self::Unavailable)
    }
}

/// A storefront's failures, as the sync classifies and reports them.
pub(crate) trait Failure:
    From<Stop> + From<cloud_vault::Error> + std::fmt::Debug + Send + 'static
{
    fn kind(&self) -> Kind;
    /// Localization key of the failure.
    fn key(&self) -> String;
    /// An attempt ran out of time.
    fn timed_out() -> Self;
    fn conflict() -> Self;
    /// The installation or durable state a sync needs is missing.
    fn recovery() -> Self;
    /// The storefront has no Cloud rules Obelisk can follow for a game whose
    /// saves Obelisk already holds.
    fn unsupported() -> Self;
    /// The Cloud changed while a view was read, or a commit's listing names a
    /// save it did not send.
    fn changed() -> Self;
}

/// The work a Cloud sync leaves durable for a later sync.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "phase", deny_unknown_fields)]
pub(crate) enum Pending {
    /// A game was admitted; its exit save is not captured yet.
    Capture,
    /// An exit save, or local saves the player kept, wait to be sent.
    Upload { desired: Manifest },
    /// A chosen Cloud version is being applied.
    Applying {
        desired: Manifest,
        remote: RemoteView,
        /// Whether the remote set is written into the installation.
        project: bool,
    },
}
impl Pending {
    pub(crate) fn files(&self) -> Option<&Manifest> {
        match self {
            Self::Capture => None,
            Self::Upload { desired } | Self::Applying { desired, .. } => Some(desired),
        }
    }
}

/// A storefront's durable Cloud facts about one game.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct Work {
    pub pending: Option<Pending>,
    /// An uninstall may have removed part of the saves. This records removal
    /// intent, not proof that the installation is absent.
    pub installation_removed: bool,
}

/// Whether the storefront's Cloud can sync this game now.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Availability {
    Available,
    Unavailable(UnavailableReason),
}

/// What a storefront adds to a Cloud sync. It holds the game's Cloud record,
/// which the sync reads and writes. Steps that talk to the storefront take
/// the attempt's `Link`, which the sync drops after each attempt; its Cloud's
/// protocol is a `view::Remote` over that link.
#[allow(async_fn_in_trait)]
pub(crate) trait Storefront {
    type Failure: Failure;
    type Record: record::Record<Failure = Self::Failure>;
    type Link;
    type Remote<'a>: view::Remote<Failure = Self::Failure>
    where
        Self: 'a;

    /// Where the game is installed and keeps its saves now.
    fn configuration(&self) -> &<Self::Record as record::Record>::Configuration;
    /// The account the sync runs for.
    fn account(&self) -> &<Self::Record as record::Record>::Account;
    /// `None` until the game's Cloud rules were known once.
    fn record(&self) -> Option<&Self::Record>;
    fn record_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Option<Self::Record>;
    /// A launch may go on without a sync: it knows where the saves live.
    fn offline(&self) -> bool;
    /// Before garbage collection: every manifest its durable and in-memory
    /// state references. Staged bytes it does not list may be deleted.
    /// `None` defers the collection, when that state cannot be read.
    fn retained(&mut self) -> Option<Vec<Manifest>>;

    async fn connect(&mut self, control: &Arc<Control>) -> Result<Self::Link, Self::Failure>;
    /// Reads the game's Cloud rules and whether Cloud is on. `adopt` accepts
    /// rules that changed: the local side is captured under the new ones.
    async fn rules(
        &mut self,
        link: &mut Self::Link,
        vault: &mut Vault,
        adopt: bool,
    ) -> Result<Availability, Self::Failure>;
    /// Settles an earlier upload whose outcome was unknown. True once that
    /// outcome is established; false leaves only a fresh comparison.
    async fn settle(&mut self, link: &mut Self::Link, vault: &Vault)
    -> Result<bool, Self::Failure>;
    /// The earlier upload is reconciled: forget what settling it needed.
    fn reconciled(&mut self) -> Result<(), Self::Failure>;
    /// The storefront's Cloud for this attempt, over its link, stopping
    /// with `control`.
    fn remote<'a>(
        &'a mut self,
        link: &'a mut Self::Link,
        control: &'a Control,
    ) -> Result<Self::Remote<'a>, Self::Failure>;
}

/// The game's record, which every step after its Cloud rules needs.
fn held<S: Storefront>(store: &mut S) -> Result<&mut S::Record, S::Failure> {
    store.record_mut().as_mut().ok_or_else(S::Failure::recovery)
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum Purpose {
    Launch,
    Exit,
    /// `installed` compares today's saves; otherwise the archived ones.
    Maintenance {
        installed: bool,
    },
}
impl Purpose {
    /// Today's saves are captured under the rules just read.
    fn fresh(self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Launch | Self::Maintenance { installed: true })
    }
}

/// One game's Cloud sync for one account.
pub(crate) struct CloudSync<S: Storefront> {
    store: S,
    vault: Vault,
    views: view::Views,
    control: Arc<Control>,
    /// The Game session whose game guard this sync takes.
    session_id: String,
    shown: Option<(RemoteView, Manifest)>,
    /// How the current operation ended without a sync, for the status file.
    problem: Option<(ProblemKind, String)>,
}

type Outcome<S> = Result<(), <S as Storefront>::Failure>;

impl<S: Storefront> CloudSync<S> {
    pub(crate) fn open(
        mut store: S,
        control: Arc<Control>,
        session_id: String,
    ) -> Result<Self, S::Failure> {
        let (vault, record) = record::locked(store.configuration(), store.account())?;
        *store.record_mut() = record;
        Ok(Self {
            store,
            vault,
            views: view::Views::default(),
            control,
            session_id,
            shown: None,
            problem: None,
        })
    }

    pub(crate) fn store(&self) -> &S {
        &self.store
    }

    /// The launch check. `alive` answers for a previous session whose game
    /// guard remains; the caller holds the storefront's owner lock.
    pub(crate) async fn prepare(&mut self, alive: &SessionAlive<'_>) -> Outcome<S> {
        self.operation(async |sync| {
            sync.recover_dead_owner(alive)?;
            sync.run(Purpose::Launch).await
        })
        .await
        .inspect_err(|failure| {
            if failure.kind() != Kind::Cancelled {
                self.control.show(Phase::Failed, Some(failure.key()));
            }
        })
    }

    /// Inside the admission lock: the game is about to run.
    pub(crate) fn started(&mut self) -> Outcome<S> {
        self.control.check()?;
        let Some(mut work) = self.work() else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        // A persisted marker schedules the exit capture even if the
        // supervisor disappears while the game runs.
        work.pending = Some(Pending::Capture);
        self.save(work)?;
        self.vault.game_started(&self.session_id)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Settles the exit save. `confirmed` is false when exec was never
    /// confirmed: the save is then only captured and kept pending. Never
    /// fails: its result lives in the Cloud status.
    pub(crate) async fn finished(&mut self, confirmed: bool) {
        let syncs = self.vault.syncs();
        self.problem = None;
        if let Err(failure) = self.finish(confirmed).await {
            // An unanswered conflict still reports why the save waits.
            let reason = match &self.problem {
                Some((ProblemKind::Conflict, key)) => key.clone(),
                _ => failure.key(),
            };
            self.control.show(Phase::Pending, Some(reason));
        }
        self.record_outcome(syncs, true);
        self.collect_garbage();
    }

    /// A launch abandoned before spawn releases its Cloud work.
    pub(crate) fn aborted(&mut self) {
        if self.guard_held() {
            let _ = self.vault.game_exited(&self.session_id);
            if self.capture_exit().is_ok() {
                self.control.show(Phase::Pending, None);
            }
        }
        // Account revocation abandoned this launch: its authorization ends now.
        if self.control.revoked() {
            let _ = self.vault.revoke();
        }
    }

    /// Cloud maintenance: a two-way sync without a launch. The caller holds
    /// the idle guard, so no supervisor or game owns the saves.
    pub(crate) async fn maintain(&mut self, alive: &SessionAlive<'_>) -> Outcome<S> {
        self.operation(async |sync| {
            sync.recover_dead_owner(alive)?;
            let installed = !sync.installation_absent()?;
            sync.run(Purpose::Maintenance { installed }).await
        })
        .await
    }

    /// A launch check or Cloud maintenance, with its outcome recorded.
    async fn operation(&mut self, body: impl AsyncFnOnce(&mut Self) -> Outcome<S>) -> Outcome<S> {
        let syncs = self.vault.syncs();
        self.problem = None;
        self.collect_garbage();
        let result = body(self).await;
        if let Err(failure) = &result
            && self.problem.is_none()
        {
            self.problem = Some((ProblemKind::Failed, failure.key()));
        }
        self.record_outcome(syncs, false);
        self.collect_garbage();
        result
    }

    async fn finish(&mut self, confirmed: bool) -> Outcome<S> {
        if self.guard_held() {
            self.vault.game_exited(&self.session_id)?;
        }
        if self.work().is_none() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        self.capture_exit()?;
        if !confirmed {
            self.control.show(Phase::Pending, None);
            return Ok(());
        }
        if self.control.revoked() {
            self.vault.revoke()?;
            self.control.show(Phase::Pending, None);
            return Ok(());
        }
        self.collect_garbage();
        let result = self.run(Purpose::Exit).await;
        if result.is_err() && self.control.revoked() {
            let _ = self.vault.revoke();
        }
        result
    }

    fn guard_held(&self) -> bool {
        self.vault.game_session() == Some(self.session_id.as_str())
    }

    /// The work the game's record holds, `None` until its Cloud rules were
    /// known once.
    fn work(&self) -> Option<Work> {
        self.store.record().map(|record| record.work())
    }

    fn save(&mut self, work: Work) -> Outcome<S> {
        let record = held(&mut self.store)?;
        record.set_work(work);
        record.save()
    }

    fn installation_absent(&self) -> Result<bool, S::Failure> {
        Ok(record::absent(self.store.configuration().install())?)
    }

    /// Where each save lives: the local set, and `remote`'s names. `create`
    /// makes their directories inside an installation that exists. The
    /// record keeps what it bound.
    fn bindings(
        &mut self,
        remote: Option<&Manifest>,
        create: bool,
    ) -> Result<Bindings, S::Failure> {
        let record = held(&mut self.store)?;
        let bindings = record.bindings(&self.vault, remote, create)?;
        record.save()?;
        Ok(bindings)
    }

    fn mark(&self, change: impl FnOnce(&mut cloud_status::Record)) {
        // Display state only: a failed write must not fail the sync itself.
        let root = self.store.configuration().root();
        if let Err(error) = cloud_status::update(root, self.vault.scope(), change) {
            eprintln!("Cloud status not recorded: {error}");
        }
    }

    fn has_pending_work(&self) -> bool {
        self.work().is_some_and(|work| work.pending.is_some()) || self.vault.pending().is_some()
    }

    /// A sync clears the last problem. Otherwise a failed operation leaves a
    /// problem, unless pending work already shows it or `exit` says the game
    /// just exited; an unanswered conflict is recorded either way.
    fn record_outcome(&mut self, syncs: u64, exit: bool) {
        let problem = self.problem.take();
        if self.vault.syncs() != syncs {
            self.mark(cloud_status::synced);
        } else if let Some((kind, key)) = problem
            && (kind == ProblemKind::Conflict || !exit && !self.has_pending_work())
        {
            self.mark(cloud_status::problem(kind, &key));
        }
    }

    /// Only the matching session's actual exit may clear its game guard.
    fn recover_dead_owner(&mut self, alive: &SessionAlive<'_>) -> Outcome<S> {
        if let Some(old) = self.vault.game_session().map(str::to_owned) {
            if alive(&old).map_err(|_| S::Failure::recovery())? {
                return Err(cloud_vault::Error::Busy.into());
            }
            self.vault.game_exited(&old)?;
            self.vault.recover_local()?;
            if self.work().is_some() {
                self.capture_exit()?;
            }
            return Ok(());
        }
        self.vault.recover_local()?;
        self.recover_applying()?;
        if self
            .work()
            .is_some_and(|work| matches!(work.pending, Some(Pending::Capture)))
        {
            self.capture_exit()?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// An interrupted Cloud choice either completed or leaves its local
    /// version to send again.
    fn recover_applying(&mut self) -> Outcome<S> {
        let Some(mut work) = self.work() else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        if let Some(Pending::Applying {
            desired,
            remote,
            project,
        }) = work.pending.clone()
        {
            let completed = self.vault.baseline() == Some(&remote)
                && (!project || self.vault.local() == Some(&remote.files));
            work.pending = (!completed).then_some(Pending::Upload { desired });
            self.save(work)?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Captures the saves the game left as pending work. After an uninstall,
    /// files already removed keep their archived version and no directory is
    /// recreated.
    fn capture_exit(&mut self) -> Outcome<S> {
        let mut work = self.work().ok_or_else(S::Failure::recovery)?;
        let removed = work.installation_removed;
        let bindings = self.bindings(None, !removed)?;
        let desired = record::capture(&mut self.vault, bindings, removed)?;
        work.pending = Some(Pending::Upload { desired });
        self.save(work)
    }

    /// Launch anyway: ownership still applies offline, and the archive holds
    /// today's saves. Files an uninstall removed keep their archived version.
    fn capture_offline(&mut self) -> Outcome<S> {
        let Some(work) = self.work() else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        let bindings = self.bindings(None, true)?;
        self.vault.activate(&bindings)?;
        if !work.installation_removed {
            self.vault.capture(&bindings)?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Compares until both sides agree, the player decides or the retries run
    /// out. Only a launch asks about failures; a conflict is asked always.
    async fn run(&mut self, purpose: Purpose) -> Outcome<S> {
        let mut budget = RetryBudget::new(Instant::now());
        let mut last = None;
        let mut choice = None;
        loop {
            self.control.check()?;
            let remaining = match budget.poll(Instant::now()) {
                Retry::Wait(wait) => {
                    self.control.wait(wait).await?;
                    continue;
                }
                Retry::Defer => {
                    let last = last.take().unwrap_or_else(S::Failure::timed_out);
                    if purpose != Purpose::Launch {
                        self.problem = Some((ProblemKind::Failed, last.key()));
                        return Err(last);
                    }
                    match self.ask_after_failure(&last).await? {
                        Choice::Retry => {
                            budget = RetryBudget::new(Instant::now());
                            continue;
                        }
                        _ => {
                            // Launch anyway: preserve today's saves for the next sync.
                            // Rules the Cloud cannot follow find no saves to preserve.
                            self.problem = Some((ProblemKind::Failed, last.key()));
                            match self.capture_offline() {
                                Err(failure) if failure.kind() == Kind::Unavailable => {}
                                captured => captured?,
                            }
                            self.control.show(Phase::Pending, Some(last.key()));
                            return Ok(());
                        }
                    }
                }
                Retry::Attempt { remaining } => remaining,
            };
            self.control.show(
                if purpose == Purpose::Launch {
                    Phase::Checking
                } else {
                    Phase::Syncing
                },
                None,
            );
            let control = self.control.clone();
            let attempt = self.attempt(purpose, choice.take());
            let result = match tokio::time::timeout(remaining, control.interruptible(attempt)).await
            {
                Ok(Ok(result)) => result,
                Ok(Err(stop)) => Err(stop.into()),
                Err(_) => Err(S::Failure::timed_out()),
            };
            let failure = match result {
                Ok(()) => return Ok(()),
                Err(failure) => failure,
            };
            match failure.kind() {
                Kind::Conflict if self.shown.is_some() => {
                    let answer = self
                        .control
                        .ask(Question::Conflict, Some(failure.key()))
                        .await;
                    match answer {
                        Ok(answer @ (Choice::Local | Choice::Cloud)) => {
                            self.mark(cloud_status::answered);
                            choice = Some(answer);
                            budget = RetryBudget::new(Instant::now());
                        }
                        answer => {
                            self.problem = Some((ProblemKind::Conflict, failure.key()));
                            return Err(match answer {
                                Err(stop) => stop.into(),
                                Ok(_) => Stop::Cancelled.into(),
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
                Kind::Denied | Kind::Cancelled => {
                    self.problem = Some((ProblemKind::Failed, failure.key()));
                    return Err(failure);
                }
                kind => {
                    budget.failed(Instant::now(), !kind.retryable());
                    last = Some(failure);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Retry or Launch anyway, once a launch check's retries are spent.
    async fn ask_after_failure(&mut self, last: &S::Failure) -> Result<Choice, S::Failure> {
        let question = Question::Failed {
            launch_anyway: last.kind().launch_anyway() && self.store.offline(),
        };
        match self.control.ask(question, Some(last.key())).await {
            Ok(choice @ (Choice::Retry | Choice::LaunchAnyway)) => Ok(choice),
            answer => {
                self.problem = Some((ProblemKind::Failed, last.key()));
                Err(match answer {
                    Err(stop) => stop.into(),
                    Ok(_) => Stop::Cancelled.into(),
                })
            }
        }
    }

    async fn attempt(&mut self, purpose: Purpose, choice: Option<Choice>) -> Outcome<S> {
        self.control.check()?;
        self.vault.recover_local()?;
        self.recover_applying()?;
        let mut link = self.store.connect(&self.control).await?;
        match self
            .store
            .rules(&mut link, &mut self.vault, purpose.fresh())
            .await?
        {
            Availability::Available => self.mark(cloud_status::available),
            Availability::Unavailable(reason) => return self.unavailable(purpose, reason),
        }
        // Read before the vault retires an earlier upload below.
        let retrying = self.has_pending_work();
        let captured = if purpose.fresh() {
            None
        } else {
            Some(self.captured_local(purpose)?)
        };
        // A prior request may have committed. Never replay it: a fresh
        // verified complete view admits a new comparison.
        let previous = match self.vault.pending() {
            Some(_) => Some(self.store.settle(&mut link, &self.vault).await?),
            None => None,
        };
        let remote = self
            .views
            .read(
                &mut self.store.remote(&mut link, &self.control)?,
                &self.vault,
                &self.control,
            )
            .await?;
        if let Some(settled) = previous {
            self.reconcile_previous(&remote, settled)?;
        }
        match captured {
            None => {
                self.compare_fresh(&mut link, purpose, &remote, retrying, choice)
                    .await?
            }
            Some(local) => {
                self.compare_captured(&mut link, &remote, local, choice)
                    .await?
            }
        }
        self.control.show(
            if purpose == Purpose::Launch {
                Phase::Ready
            } else {
                Phase::Synced
            },
            None,
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    fn unavailable(&mut self, purpose: Purpose, reason: UnavailableReason) -> Outcome<S> {
        self.mark(cloud_status::unavailable(reason));
        if reason == UnavailableReason::Disabled {
            if purpose.fresh() {
                self.capture_offline()?;
            } else if let Some(mut work) = self.work() {
                // Cloud is off, so this save is never sent. It stays in the
                // archive as the local snapshot, but not as pending work.
                work.pending = None;
                self.save(work)?;
            }
            self.control.show(Phase::Disabled, None);
            return Ok(());
        }
        // Pending work must not pass for a game without Cloud.
        if record::holds_saves(&self.vault, self.work().is_some()) {
            return Err(S::Failure::unsupported());
        }
        self.control.show(Phase::Unsupported, None);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn reconcile_previous(&mut self, current: &RemoteView, settled: bool) -> Outcome<S> {
        self.control.check()?;
        if self.vault.pending().is_none() {
            return Err(S::Failure::recovery());
        }
        let account = S::Record::identity(self.store.account());
        self.vault.settle_pending(account, current, settled)?;
        self.store.reconciled()
    }

    /// Today's saves against the Cloud. A launch sends them only to finish
    /// earlier work; maintenance syncs both ways.
    async fn compare_fresh(
        &mut self,
        link: &mut S::Link,
        purpose: Purpose,
        remote: &RemoteView,
        retrying: bool,
        choice: Option<Choice>,
    ) -> Outcome<S> {
        let mut work = self.work().ok_or_else(S::Failure::recovery)?;
        if self.installation_absent()? {
            return Err(S::Failure::recovery());
        }
        let removed = work.installation_removed;
        let bindings = self.bindings(Some(&remote.files), true)?;
        self.vault.activate(&bindings)?;
        // After a reinstall, missing files keep their archived version: an
        // uninstall never deletes Cloud saves.
        let local = if removed {
            self.vault.capture_preserving_missing(&bindings)?
        } else {
            self.vault.capture(&bindings)?
        };
        let maintenance = purpose != Purpose::Launch;
        // Saves unchanged since the last sync are compared, not queued: a
        // failed check must not report them as waiting to be sent.
        let queued = retrying
            || maintenance && self.vault.baseline().map(|base| &base.files) != Some(&local);
        if queued {
            work.pending = Some(Pending::Upload {
                desired: local.clone(),
            });
            self.save(work.clone())?;
        }
        let decision = self.decide(&mut work, &local, remote, choice)?;
        self.control.check()?;
        match decision {
            Decision::Converged => {
                if removed {
                    self.vault.restore_local(&bindings)?;
                }
                self.vault.confirm_equal(&local, remote)?;
            }
            Decision::Download => {
                work.pending = Some(Pending::Applying {
                    desired: local.clone(),
                    remote: remote.clone(),
                    project: true,
                });
                self.save(work.clone())?;
                let chosen = choice == Some(Choice::Cloud) || removed;
                self.vault
                    .apply_download(&bindings, remote, remote, chosen)?;
            }
            Decision::KeepLocal => {
                if removed {
                    self.vault.restore_local(&bindings)?;
                }
                if queued {
                    self.send(link, &mut work, &local, remote).await?;
                }
            }
            Decision::Conflict => unreachable!("decide reports conflicts"),
        }
        self.shown = None;
        self.save(Work {
            pending: None,
            installation_removed: false,
        })
    }

    /// The captured saves an exit or an uninstalled game's maintenance sends.
    fn captured_local(&self, purpose: Purpose) -> Result<Manifest, S::Failure> {
        let work = self.work().ok_or_else(S::Failure::recovery)?;
        match work.pending.as_ref().and_then(Pending::files) {
            Some(local) => Ok(local.clone()),
            None if purpose == Purpose::Exit => Err(S::Failure::recovery()),
            // Without an exit save, an upload still in the vault supplies it,
            // or else the archive.
            None => self
                .vault
                .pending()
                .map(|pending| pending.desired.clone())
                .or_else(|| self.vault.local().cloned())
                .ok_or_else(S::Failure::recovery),
        }
    }

    /// Captured saves against the Cloud: an exit save, or an uninstalled
    /// game's archive, whose installation is never recreated.
    async fn compare_captured(
        &mut self,
        link: &mut S::Link,
        remote: &RemoteView,
        local: Manifest,
        choice: Option<Choice>,
    ) -> Outcome<S> {
        let mut work = self.work().ok_or_else(S::Failure::recovery)?;
        let absent = self.installation_absent()?;
        let removed = work.installation_removed;
        if absent && !removed {
            return Err(S::Failure::recovery());
        }
        let bindings = self.bindings(Some(&remote.files), !absent)?;
        let decision = self.decide(&mut work, &local, remote, choice)?;
        self.control.check()?;
        match decision {
            Decision::Converged => self.vault.confirm_equal(&local, remote)?,
            Decision::Download => {
                work.pending = Some(Pending::Applying {
                    desired: local.clone(),
                    remote: remote.clone(),
                    project: !absent,
                });
                self.save(work.clone())?;
                if absent {
                    // A Cloud choice resolves remote work only. The archived
                    // local version stays, and a reinstall asks again.
                    self.vault.confirm_equal(&remote.files, remote)?;
                } else {
                    // Never replace files edited since the captured version.
                    if self.vault.capture(&bindings)? != local {
                        return Err(S::Failure::conflict());
                    }
                    let chosen = choice == Some(Choice::Cloud) || removed;
                    self.vault
                        .apply_download(&bindings, remote, remote, chosen)?;
                }
            }
            Decision::KeepLocal => self.send(link, &mut work, &local, remote).await?,
            Decision::Conflict => unreachable!("decide reports conflicts"),
        }
        self.shown = None;
        self.save(Work {
            pending: None,
            installation_removed: removed && absent,
        })
    }

    /// A choice applies only to the question it answered. Without one, the
    /// removal fence and the vault decide.
    fn decide(
        &mut self,
        work: &mut Work,
        local: &Manifest,
        remote: &RemoteView,
        choice: Option<Choice>,
    ) -> Result<Decision, S::Failure> {
        if let Some(choice) = choice {
            if self
                .shown
                .as_ref()
                .is_none_or(|(shown, files)| shown != remote || files != local)
            {
                return self.conflict(work, local, remote);
            }
            self.shown = None;
            return match choice {
                Choice::Local => {
                    self.vault.choose_local(remote, remote)?;
                    Ok(Decision::KeepLocal)
                }
                Choice::Cloud => Ok(Decision::Download),
                _ => Err(Stop::Cancelled.into()),
            };
        }
        self.shown = None;
        // A reinstall can lack saves nobody deleted: never infer upload intent
        // from them, or replace unrelated saves with an entire archive.
        let decision = if work.installation_removed && local != &remote.files {
            Decision::Conflict
        } else {
            self.vault.decision(local, remote)?
        };
        if decision == Decision::Conflict {
            return self.conflict(work, local, remote);
        }
        Ok(decision)
    }

    /// An unanswered conflict is unsettled work, durable before it is shown.
    fn conflict(
        &mut self,
        work: &mut Work,
        local: &Manifest,
        remote: &RemoteView,
    ) -> Result<Decision, S::Failure> {
        self.shown = Some((remote.clone(), local.clone()));
        work.pending = Some(Pending::Upload {
            desired: local.clone(),
        });
        self.save(work.clone())?;
        Err(S::Failure::conflict())
    }

    async fn send(
        &mut self,
        link: &mut S::Link,
        work: &mut Work,
        local: &Manifest,
        remote: &RemoteView,
    ) -> Outcome<S> {
        if work.pending.as_ref().and_then(Pending::files) != Some(local) {
            work.pending = Some(Pending::Upload {
                desired: local.clone(),
            });
            self.save(work.clone())?;
        }
        self.control.check()?;
        let account = S::Record::identity(self.store.account());
        view::send(
            &mut self.store.remote(link, &self.control)?,
            &mut self.vault,
            account,
            local,
            remote,
            &self.control,
        )
        .await
    }

    /// Only between operations: staged bytes must first be referenced by the
    /// vault or the storefront's durable state.
    fn collect_garbage(&mut self) {
        self.views.forget();
        let Some(mut retained) = self.store.retained() else {
            return;
        };
        if let Some((remote, local)) = &self.shown {
            retained.extend([remote.files.clone(), local.clone()]);
        }
        let retained: Vec<&Manifest> = retained.iter().collect();
        if let Err(error) = self.vault.collect_garbage(&retained) {
            // Housekeeping failure must not turn an acknowledged sync into a
            // failed transfer. The next operation boundary tries again.
            eprintln!("Cloud cache cleanup deferred: {error}");
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
//! The Cloud sync through its interface, once for every storefront. Each
//! harness puts an in-memory storefront Cloud behind its real adapter.
use super::*;
use crate::cloud::Status;
use crate::cloud::record;
use crate::cloud_status::{Indicator, Record, SavedState};
use crate::supervisor::client::no_other_session;
use cloud_vault::{AccountIdentity, StoreScope};
use std::{
    fs,
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    time::Duration,
};

pub(crate) type Of<H> = <<H as Harness>::Store as Storefront>::Failure;
/// The storefront's Cloud record of the game.
pub(crate) type RecordOf<H> = <<H as Harness>::Store as Storefront>::Record;

/// A storefront under test: one game with Cloud rules for its save file.
#[allow(async_fn_in_trait)]
pub(crate) trait Harness: Sized + 'static {
    type Store: Storefront;
    /// What the storefront reports when the game has no Cloud rules.
    const NO_RULES: UnavailableReason;
    fn game() -> Self;
    fn control(&self) -> &Arc<Control>;
    /// A new sync of the game, for a new Game session.
    fn open(&self) -> CloudSync<Self::Store>;
    /// The save file, and its name in the Cloud.
    fn save(&self) -> PathBuf;
    fn slot(&self) -> &'static str;
    fn install(&self) -> PathBuf;
    /// Another device publishes this save.
    fn publish(&self, bytes: &[u8]);
    fn cloud(&self) -> Option<Vec<u8>>;
    fn uploads(&self) -> usize;
    /// The next remote step fails. A transient failure is retried; the
    /// other one ends the check at once and still lets a launch go on.
    fn fail_next(&self, transient: bool);
    fn failure_key(&self) -> String;
    fn set_rules(&self, available: bool);
    /// The game becomes a Windows build that runs in `prefix`, where its
    /// save's folder exists, as once an engine readied that prefix.
    fn run_in(&mut self, prefix: &Path);
    /// Archives the saves before an uninstall, under the storefront's rules.
    async fn archive(&self) -> Result<(), Of<Self>>;
    async fn maintain(&self, alive: &SessionAlive<'_>) -> Result<(), Of<Self>>;
    /// Where the game is installed and keeps its saves now.
    fn configuration(&self) -> <RecordOf<Self> as record::Record>::Configuration;
    fn account_id(&self) -> &<RecordOf<Self> as record::Record>::Account;
    fn root(&self) -> PathBuf;
    fn scope(&self) -> StoreScope;
    fn account(&self) -> AccountIdentity;
}

fn status<H: Harness>(game: &H) -> Status {
    game.control().status()
}
fn record<H: Harness>(game: &H) -> Record {
    cloud_status::read(&game.root(), &game.scope()).unwrap()
}
pub(crate) fn vault<H: Harness>(game: &H) -> Vault {
    Vault::open(&game.root(), game.scope()).unwrap()
}
/// The storefront's durable work, as a new sync reads it.
pub(crate) fn work<H: Harness>(game: &H) -> Option<Work> {
    RecordOf::<H>::load(&game.configuration(), game.account_id())
        .unwrap()
        .map(|record| record.work())
}
pub(crate) fn pending<H: Harness>(game: &H) -> Option<Pending> {
    work(game).and_then(|work| work.pending)
}
pub(crate) fn uploading(pending: Option<Pending>) -> Option<Manifest> {
    match pending {
        Some(Pending::Upload { desired }) => Some(desired),
        _ => None,
    }
}
fn conflict_key<H: Harness>() -> String {
    Of::<H>::conflict().key()
}

/// This game's Cloud indicator, whether or not it was requested.
pub(crate) fn indicator<H: Harness>(game: &H, requested: bool) -> Option<Indicator> {
    let requested = if requested {
        vec![game.scope()]
    } else {
        Vec::new()
    };
    record::indicators::<RecordOf<H>>(&game.root(), &game.account(), &requested)
        .unwrap()
        .into_iter()
        .find(|(scope, _)| *scope == game.scope())
        .map(|(_, indicator)| indicator)
}
/// Pending discovery lists this game.
pub(crate) fn listed<H: Harness>(game: &H) -> bool {
    indicator(game, false).is_some()
}

/// Archives the saves, removes the installation and records the removal.
pub(crate) async fn uninstall<H: Harness>(game: &H) {
    game.archive().await.unwrap();
    fs::remove_dir_all(game.install()).unwrap();
    record::removed::<RecordOf<H>>(&game.configuration(), game.account_id()).unwrap();
}

/// A first launch that finds both sides equal and records the baseline.
pub(crate) async fn synced<H: Harness>(game: &H, bytes: &[u8]) {
    fs::write(game.save(), bytes).unwrap();
    game.publish(bytes);
    game.open().prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();
}

/// The game exits while the Cloud is unreachable: its exit save stays pending.
pub(crate) async fn played_offline<H: Harness>(game: &H, bytes: &[u8]) {
    let mut sync = game.open();
    sync.prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();
    sync.started().unwrap();
    fs::write(game.save(), bytes).unwrap();
    game.fail_next(false);
    sync.finished(true).await;
    assert_eq!(status(game).phase, Phase::Pending);
}

/// The installation comes back without the saves the uninstall removed.
fn reinstall<H: Harness>(game: &H) {
    let _ = fs::remove_file(game.save());
    fs::create_dir_all(game.install()).unwrap();
    fs::create_dir_all(game.save().parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
}

async fn maintain<H: Harness>(game: &H) -> Result<(), Of<H>> {
    maintain_beside(game, &no_other_session).await
}
async fn maintain_beside<H: Harness>(game: &H, alive: &SessionAlive<'_>) -> Result<(), Of<H>> {
    // A maintenance never waits on a question it should not ask.
    tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(20), game.maintain(alive))
        .await
        .expect("maintenance finished")
}

/// Waits for a Cloud question newer than decision `after`.
fn next_question(control: &Control, after: u64) -> Status {
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5);
    loop {
        let status = control.status();
        if status.decision_id > after && !status.allowed_choices.is_empty() {
            return status;
        }
        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "no Cloud question after {after}");
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
    }
}

/// Answers the next Cloud question with `choice`, as the UI would. A
/// question already shown when this starts is an older one.
pub(crate) fn answer(control: &Arc<Control>, choice: Choice) -> std::thread::JoinHandle<()> {
    let control = Arc::clone(control);
    let shown = control.status().decision_id;
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let question = next_question(&control, shown);
        assert!(
            question.allowed_choices.contains(&choice),
            "{choice:?} is not offered"
        );
        control.answer(question.decision_id, choice).unwrap();
    })
}

pub(crate) async fn a_launch_with_equal_saves_is_ready_and_records_a_cloud_sync<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    fs::write(game.save(), b"progress").unwrap();
    game.publish(b"progress");
    let mut sync = game.open();

    sync.prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();

    assert_eq!(status(&game).phase, Phase::Ready);
    assert!(sync.vault.synced_at().is_some());
    assert_eq!(game.uploads(), 0);
}

pub(crate) async fn a_launch_downloads_a_newer_cloud_save<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    synced(&game, b"old").await;
    game.publish(b"from another device");

    game.open().prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();

    assert_eq!(status(&game).phase, Phase::Ready);
    assert_eq!(fs::read(game.save()).unwrap(), b"from another device");
}

pub(crate) async fn an_unconfirmed_game_exit_only_captures_its_save<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    synced(&game, b"old").await;
    let mut sync = game.open();
    sync.prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();
    sync.started().unwrap();
    fs::write(game.save(), b"maybe played").unwrap();

    // The helper exited without confirming that the game ever ran.
    sync.finished(false).await;

    assert_eq!(game.cloud().unwrap(), b"old");
    assert_eq!(game.uploads(), 0);
    assert_eq!(status(&game).phase, Phase::Pending);
    assert!(listed(&game));
}

pub(crate) async fn a_launch_revoked_before_spawn_withdraws_its_cloud_authorization<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    synced(&game, b"old").await;
    let mut sync = game.open();
    sync.prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();
    let before = format!("{:?}", sync.vault.authorize(game.account()).unwrap());
    game.control().revoke();

    sync.aborted();

    let after = format!("{:?}", sync.vault.authorize(game.account()).unwrap());
    assert_ne!(before, after, "the account's authorization moved on");
}

pub(crate) async fn a_game_exit_uploads_local_progress<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    synced(&game, b"old").await;
    let mut sync = game.open();
    sync.prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();

    assert_eq!(game.cloud().unwrap(), b"new progress");

    assert_eq!(pending(&game), None);

pub(crate) async fn a_launch_conflict_asks_and_applies_the_cloud_choice<H: Harness>() {

    synced(&game, b"old").await;
    fs::write(game.save(), b"local progress").unwrap();

    game.open().prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();

pub(crate) async fn a_game_without_cloud_rules_is_unavailable_until_they_return<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    game.set_rules(false);

    game.open().prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();

    assert_eq!(status(&game).phase, Phase::Unsupported);
    assert_eq!(
        record(&game).unavailable.map(|marker| marker.reason),

    );

    assert_eq!(record(&game).unavailable, None);
}

pub(crate) async fn an_unanswered_launch_conflict_is_recorded_until_it_is_answered<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    synced(&game, b"old").await;

pub(crate) async fn a_first_conflict_is_durable_before_it_is_shown<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    fs::write(game.save(), b"first local version").unwrap();
    game.publish(b"first cloud version");
    let control = Arc::clone(game.control());
    let shown = control.status().decision_id;
    let mut sync = game.open();

    // An observer may close or cancel as soon as the question shows.
    let (result, (durable, listed)) = tokio::join!(sync.prepare(&no_other_session), async {
        let question = loop {
            let status = control.status();
            if status.decision_id > shown && !status.allowed_choices.is_empty() {
                break status;
            }
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
        };
        let seen = (uploading(pending(&game)), listed(&game));
        control
            .answer(question.decision_id, Choice::Cancel)
            .unwrap();
        seen
    });

    assert!(result.is_err());
    assert!(listed);
    let desired = durable.expect("the local version waits");
    assert_eq!(
        sync.vault.read_content(&desired.0[game.slot()]).unwrap(),
        b"first local version"
    );
}

pub(crate) async fn a_choice_for_saves_changed_since_the_question_asks_again<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    synced(&game, b"old").await;
    fs::write(game.save(), b"local").unwrap();
    game.publish(b"cloud");
    let (control, save) = (Arc::clone(game.control()), game.save());
    let shown = control.status().decision_id;
    let answering = std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let first = next_question(&control, shown);
        fs::write(save, b"later local bytes").unwrap();
        control.answer(first.decision_id, Choice::Cloud).unwrap();
        // The Cloud choice was for saves that no longer exist.
        let again = next_question(&control, first.decision_id);
        control.answer(again.decision_id, Choice::Cancel).unwrap();
    });

    let result = game.open().prepare(&no_other_session).await;

    answering.join().unwrap();
    assert!(result.is_err());
    assert_eq!(fs::read(game.save()).unwrap(), b"later local bytes");
    assert_eq!(game.cloud().unwrap(), b"cloud");
}

pub(crate) async fn a_game_exit_conflict_is_asked_live_and_answered<H: Harness>() {
    for (choice, kept) in [
        (Choice::Local, b"played here".as_slice()),
        (Choice::Cloud, b"played elsewhere".as_slice()),
    ] {
        let game = H::game();
        synced(&game, b"old").await;
        let mut sync = game.open();
        sync.prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();
        sync.started().unwrap();
        fs::write(game.save(), b"played here").unwrap();
        game.publish(b"played elsewhere");
        let answering = answer(game.control(), choice);

        sync.finished(true).await;

        answering.join().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(status(&game).phase, Phase::Synced);
        assert_eq!(fs::read(game.save()).unwrap(), kept);
        assert_eq!(game.cloud().unwrap(), kept);
        assert_eq!(pending(&game), None);
        assert_eq!(record(&game).problem, None);
    }
}

pub(crate) async fn a_stopped_exit_upload_waits_without_claiming_a_conflict<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    synced(&game, b"old").await;
    let mut sync = game.open();
    sync.prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();
    sync.started().unwrap();
    fs::write(game.save(), b"new progress").unwrap();
    game.fail_next(true);
    let control = Arc::clone(game.control());
    // Stops the exit sync during its wait before the second attempt.
    let stopper = std::thread::spawn(move || {
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200));
        control.cancel();
    });

    sync.finished(true).await;

    stopper.join().unwrap();
    let shown = status(&game);
    assert_eq!(shown.phase, Phase::Pending);
    assert_eq!(shown.error, Some(Of::<H>::from(Stop::Cancelled).key()));
    assert_eq!(record(&game).problem, None);
    assert!(uploading(pending(&game)).is_some());
}

pub(crate) async fn an_uninstalled_game_keeps_its_archive_when_the_cloud_is_chosen<H: Harness>() {

    assert_eq!(work.pending, None);

pub(crate) async fn a_reinstall_clears_its_removal_fence_once_the_saves_agree<H: Harness>() {
    // Equal saves, then an explicit Cloud choice for different ones.
    for (local, choice) in [
        (b"progress".as_slice(), None),
        (b"other", Some(Choice::Cloud)),
    ] {
        let game = H::game();
        synced(&game, b"progress").await;
        uninstall(&game).await;
        reinstall(&game);
        fs::write(game.save(), local).unwrap();
        let answering = choice.map(|choice| answer(game.control(), choice));

        game.open().prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();

        if let Some(answering) = answering {
            answering.join().unwrap();
        }
        assert_eq!(fs::read(game.save()).unwrap(), b"progress");
        assert!(!work(&game).unwrap().installation_removed);
    }
}

pub(crate) async fn launching_anyway_after_a_reinstall_keeps_the_removal_fence<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();

    reinstall(&game);
    game.fail_next(false);

    let mut sync = game.open();

    sync.prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();
    sync.started().unwrap();

    answering.join().unwrap();
    assert!(sync.guard_held());
    assert!(work(&game).unwrap().installation_removed);
    let archived = sync.vault.local().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        sync.vault.read_content(&archived.0[game.slot()]).unwrap(),
        b"archived"
    );
}

pub(crate) async fn a_completed_sync_deletes_orphaned_archive_blobs<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    synced(&game, b"old").await;
    let mut sync = game.open();
    let orphan = sync.vault.stage(b"orphaned bytes", 2).unwrap();
    sync.prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();
    sync.started().unwrap();
    // Cleanup never runs through an active game guard.
    let held = sync.vault.stage(b"staged while playing", 2).unwrap();
    sync.collect_garbage();
    assert!(sync.vault.read_content(&held).is_ok());
    fs::write(game.save(), b"new progress").unwrap();

    sync.finished(true).await;

    assert!(sync.vault.read_content(&orphan).is_err());
    assert!(sync.vault.read_content(&held).is_err());
    let local = sync.vault.local().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        sync.vault.read_content(&local.0[game.slot()]).unwrap(),
        b"new progress"
    );
}

pub(crate) async fn cleanup_keeps_what_pending_work_and_a_shown_conflict_reference<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    synced(&game, b"old").await;
    played_offline(&game, b"exit save").await;
    fs::write(game.save(), b"exit save").unwrap();
    game.publish(b"played elsewhere");
    let answering = answer(game.control(), Choice::Cancel);
    let mut sync = game.open();

    assert!(sync.prepare(&no_other_session).await.is_err());

    answering.join().unwrap();
    sync.collect_garbage();
    let desired = uploading(pending(&game)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        sync.vault.read_content(&desired.0[game.slot()]).unwrap(),
        b"exit save"
    );
    let (remote, _) = sync.shown.clone().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        sync.vault
            .read_content(&remote.files.0[game.slot()])
            .unwrap(),
        b"played elsewhere"
    );
}

pub(crate) async fn an_interrupted_cloud_choice_never_resends_the_discarded_save<H: Harness>() {
    for applied in [false, true] {
        let game = H::game();
        synced(&game, b"old").await;
        played_offline(&game, b"old local exit").await;
        let desired = uploading(pending(&game)).unwrap();
        game.publish(b"selected remote");
        let mut sync = game.open();
        let mut link = sync.store.connect(&sync.control).await.unwrap();
        sync.store
            .rules(&mut link, &mut sync.vault, true)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let remote = sync
            .views
            .read(
                &mut sync.store.remote(&mut link, &sync.control).unwrap(),
                &sync.vault,
                &sync.control,
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        drop(link);
        // The choice is durable before the projection or the baseline change.
        let mut work = sync.work().unwrap();
        work.pending = Some(Pending::Applying {
            desired: desired.clone(),
            remote: remote.clone(),
            project: true,
        });
        sync.save(work).unwrap();
        if applied {
            let bindings = sync.bindings(Some(&remote.files), true).unwrap();
            sync.vault
                .apply_download(&bindings, &remote, &remote, true)
                .unwrap();
        }
        drop(sync);
        game.set_rules(false);

        // Recovery runs first; no rules then stops the sync before transfers.
        assert!(maintain(&game).await.is_err());

        if applied {
            assert_eq!(pending(&game), None);
            assert_eq!(fs::read(game.save()).unwrap(), b"selected remote");
        } else {
            assert_eq!(uploading(pending(&game)), Some(desired));
            assert_eq!(fs::read(game.save()).unwrap(), b"old local exit");
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) async fn maintenance_of_a_game_without_cloud_rules_reports_it_unavailable<H: Harness>() {
    let game = H::game();
    game.set_rules(false);

    maintain(&game).await.unwrap();

    assert_eq!(status(&game).phase, Phase::Unsupported);
}

macro_rules! cloud_suite {
    ($harness:ty) => {

            a_game_exit_uploads_local_progress,
            a_launch_conflict_asks_and_applies_the_cloud_choice,
            a_failed_exit_upload_keeps_the_exit_save_pending,
            a_game_without_cloud_rules_is_unavailable_until_they_return,
            saves_obelisk_holds_never_pass_for_a_game_without_cloud,
            a_cancelled_launch_check_is_a_failed_sync_until_the_next_sync,
            launching_anyway_without_pending_work_is_a_failed_sync,
            an_unanswered_launch_conflict_is_recorded_until_it_is_answered,
            a_first_conflict_is_durable_before_it_is_shown,
            a_choice_for_saves_changed_since_the_question_asks_again,
            a_game_exit_conflict_is_asked_live_and_answered,
            an_unanswered_exit_conflict_stays_pending_with_a_conflict_marker,
            a_stopped_exit_upload_waits_without_claiming_a_conflict,
            maintenance_of_a_synced_game_confirms_it_without_launching,
            maintenance_sends_an_exit_save_left_pending,
            maintenance_downloads_a_newer_cloud_save,
            maintenance_asks_about_a_conflict_and_cancel_keeps_the_work_pending,
            maintenance_leaves_unchanged_saves_unqueued_when_it_fails,
            maintenance_clears_the_guard_of_a_dead_game_session,
            maintenance_keeps_the_guard_of_a_game_session_that_still_runs,
            maintenance_sends_the_exit_save_of_an_uninstalled_game,
            an_uninstalled_game_keeps_its_archive_when_the_cloud_is_chosen,
            an_exit_capture_left_for_after_an_uninstall_keeps_the_archived_save,
            a_missing_installation_without_an_uninstall_keeps_the_saved_work,
            a_reinstall_restores_saves_the_uninstall_removed,
            keeping_local_saves_after_a_reinstall_never_deletes_cloud_saves,
            a_reinstall_clears_its_removal_fence_once_the_saves_agree,

            an_interrupted_cloud_choice_never_resends_the_discarded_save,
            maintenance_of_a_game_without_cloud_rules_reports_it_unavailable,
        );
    };
    ($harness:ty; $($scenario:ident),* $(,)?) => {
        $(
            #[tokio::test]
            async fn $scenario() {
                $crate::cloud::sync::tests::$scenario::<$harness>().await
            }
        )*
    };
}
pub(crate) use cloud_suite;
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/cloud/view.rs`:

```rs
//! The Cloud view a Cloud sync compares against, whatever the storefront:
//! archived bytes stand in for listed saves they match, the rest is fetched,
//! the view holds only while the storefront still lists the same Cloud, and
//! an upload ends with the view its storefront confirmed.
use super::{
    Control,
    sync::{self, Failure as _},
};
use cloud_vault::{AccountIdentity, FileVersion, Manifest, RemoteView, Vault};
use std::{
    collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet},
    marker::PhantomData,
};

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests;

/// One save a storefront's Cloud lists.
pub(crate) struct Listed<'a> {
    pub name: &'a str,
    pub size: u64,
    pub platforms: u32,
}

/// A complete listing of one game's Cloud, as its storefront gives it.
pub(crate) trait Listing {
    fn revision(&self) -> String;
    /// The saves Obelisk manages, in listing order. The rest is never read
    /// into the view or sent as deleted.
    fn saves(&self) -> Vec<Listed<'_>>;
    /// Whether `bytes` are exactly the listed save `name`, by the storefront's
    /// own identity check.
    fn holds(&self, name: &str, bytes: &[u8]) -> bool;
}

/// A storefront's Cloud for one game, account and attempt: protocol work
/// only. It stops with the sync's `Control`, held itself or by the connection
/// it was built over, so no call takes a cancellation.
#[allow(async_fn_in_trait)]
pub(crate) trait Remote {
    type Failure: sync::Failure;
    type Listing: Listing;
    /// Names the storefront's uploads in the Cloud archive's journal. On
    /// disk: never change it.
    const JOURNAL: &'static str;

    async fn list(&mut self) -> Result<Self::Listing, Self::Failure>;
    /// True while the Cloud still lists exactly `listing`.
    async fn unchanged(&mut self, listing: &Self::Listing) -> Result<bool, Self::Failure>;
    /// Reads these saves of `listing`, each checked against it, and hands each
    /// over once read; a storefront may deliver them together. Runs exactly
    /// once per read, after reuse, even with no names: a storefront whose
    /// commit resends files Obelisk does not manage reads them here.
    async fn fetch(
        &mut self,
        listing: &Self::Listing,
        names: &[&str],
        receive: impl FnMut(&str, Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), cloud_vault::Error>,
    ) -> Result<(), Self::Failure>;
    /// Keeps a verified view and the listing that confirmed it.
    fn adopt(
        &mut self,
        listing: Self::Listing,
        view: &RemoteView,
        vault: &Vault,
    ) -> Result<(), Self::Failure>;
    /// The view the storefront's record kept from an earlier sync.
    fn adopted(&self) -> Option<&Manifest> {
        None
    }
    /// Commits `change`. Only `Change::send` makes a `Committed`.
    async fn commit(
        &mut self,
        change: Change<'_, Self::Failure>,
    ) -> Result<Committed<Self::Listing>, Self::Failure>;
}

/// What an upload sends: local saves over the view they replace.
pub(crate) struct Change<'a, F> {
    vault: &'a mut Vault,
    account: AccountIdentity,
    local: &'a Manifest,
    view: &'a RemoteView,
    journal: &'static str,
    control: &'a Control,
    failure: PhantomData<F>,
}

impl<'a, F: sync::Failure> Change<'a, F> {
    pub(crate) fn vault(&self) -> &Vault {
        self.vault
    }
    pub(crate) fn local(&self) -> &'a Manifest {
        self.local
    }
    pub(crate) fn view(&self) -> &'a RemoteView {
        self.view
    }
    /// Saves that are new or differ from the view, in name order.
    pub(crate) fn uploads(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (&'a str, &'a FileVersion)> + use<'a, F> {
        let view = self.view;
        self.local
            .0
            .iter()
            .filter(move |(name, file)| view.files.0.get(*name) != Some(file))
            .map(|(name, file)| (name.as_str(), file))
    }
    /// Names in the view that the local saves lack, in name order.
    pub(crate) fn deletes(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a str> + use<'a, F> {
        let local = self.local;
        self.view
            .files
            .0
            .keys()
            .filter(move |name| !local.0.contains_key(*name))
            .map(String::as_str)
    }

    /// Sends this change as one upload. `journal` keeps what settling a lost
    /// reply needs, after the vault queued the upload and before it may
    /// commit; `send` returns the complete listing that confirmed it.
    pub(crate) async fn send<L: Listing>(
        self,
        journal: impl FnOnce() -> Result<(), F>,
        send: impl AsyncFnOnce() -> Result<L, F>,
    ) -> Result<Committed<L>, F> {
        let Self {
            vault,
            account,
            local,
            view,
            journal: adapter,
            control,
            ..
        } = self;
        vault
            .upload(account, local, view, adapter, journal, async |_| {
                let listing = send().await?;
                // Every listed save carries the identity the commit gave it,
                // so the managed ones are the local versions just sent or
                // kept. Nothing is downloaded again.
                let mut files = Manifest::default();
                for save in listing.saves() {
                    let version = local.0.get(save.name).ok_or_else(F::changed)?;
                    files.0.insert(save.name.to_owned(), version.clone());
                }
                let confirmed = RemoteView {
                    revision: listing.revision(),
                    files,
                };
                control.check()?;
                Ok((
                    confirmed.clone(),
                    Committed {
                        listing,
                        view: confirmed,
                    },
                ))
            })
            .await
    }
}

/// Sends `local` over `view` and completes the vault's upload with the view
/// its storefront confirmed. It reads nothing, so it needs no `Views`.
pub(crate) async fn send<R: Remote>(
    remote: &mut R,
    vault: &mut Vault,
    account: AccountIdentity,
    local: &Manifest,
    view: &RemoteView,
    control: &Control,
) -> Result<(), R::Failure> {
    let change = Change {
        vault,
        account,
        local,
        view,
        journal: R::JOURNAL,
        control,
        failure: PhantomData,
    };
    let committed = remote.commit(change).await?;
    remote.adopt(committed.listing, &committed.view, vault)
}

/// A listing that confirmed an upload, with its view.
pub(crate) struct Committed<L> {
    listing: L,
    view: RemoteView,
}

/// The Cloud views of one Cloud sync, and the bytes its reads staged.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct Views {
    /// Files this operation staged, reused by later reads in it.
    downloaded: Manifest,
}

impl Views {
    /// A verified complete view of the game's Cloud saves.
    pub(crate) async fn read<R: Remote>(
        &mut self,
        remote: &mut R,
        vault: &Vault,
        control: &Control,
    ) -> Result<RemoteView, R::Failure> {
        let listing = remote.list().await?;
        let saves = listing.saves();
        let mut files = Manifest::default();
        let mut missing = BTreeMap::new();
        for save in &saves {
            control.check()?;
            match self.archived(remote.adopted(), vault, &listing, save) {
                Some(version) => {
                    files.0.insert(save.name.to_owned(), version);
                }
                None => {
                    missing.insert(save.name, save.platforms);
                }
            }
        }
        let names: Vec<&str> = saves
            .iter()
            .map(|save| save.name)
            .filter(|name| missing.contains_key(name))
            .collect();
        let downloaded = &mut self.downloaded;
        remote
            .fetch(&listing, &names, |name, bytes| {
                let platforms = missing.remove(name).ok_or(cloud_vault::Error::Integrity)?;
                let version = vault.stage(&bytes, platforms)?;
                downloaded.0.insert(name.to_owned(), version.clone());
                files.0.insert(name.to_owned(), version);
                Ok(())
            })
            .await?;
        // A save the fetch left out would read as deleted in the Cloud.
        if !missing.is_empty() {
            return Err(cloud_vault::Error::Integrity.into());
        }
        // Even an entirely cached view is valid only while the remote listing
        // stays unchanged. No cache may authorize a stale conflict decision.
        if !remote.unchanged(&listing).await? {
            return Err(R::Failure::changed());
        }
        control.check()?;
        self.downloaded = files.clone();
        let view = RemoteView {
            revision: listing.revision(),
            files,
        };
        view.validate()?;
        drop(saves);
        remote.adopt(listing, &view, vault)?;
        Ok(view)
    }

    /// Between operations, before garbage collection: staged bytes stop being
    /// reusable.
    pub(crate) fn forget(&mut self) {
        self.downloaded = Manifest::default();
    }

    fn archived(
        &self,
        adopted: Option<&Manifest>,
        vault: &Vault,
        listing: &impl Listing,
        save: &Listed<'_>,
    ) -> Option<FileVersion> {
        // A storefront's record survives restart. Its listing can have been
        // refreshed before remote bytes, so never trust that pairing: verify
        // the actual blob against the newly listed hash and size on every
        // cache hit.
        let mut checked = BTreeSet::new();
        [
            Some(&self.downloaded),
            adopted,
            vault.baseline().map(|b| &b.files),
            vault.local(),
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .filter_map(|files| files.0.get(save.name))
        .filter(|cached| cached.size == save.size)
        .filter(|cached| checked.insert((&cached.hash, cached.size)))
        .find_map(|cached| {
            let bytes = vault.read_content(cached).ok()?;
            listing.holds(save.name, &bytes).then(|| FileVersion {
                platforms: save.platforms,
                ..cached.clone()
            })
        })
    }
}
```

```rs
//! The Cloud view through its interface, against an in-memory storefront
//! Cloud: archive reuse, one fetch per read, the confirming listing,
//! cancellation, the changed files and the confirmed upload.
use super::*;
use crate::cloud::{Stop, sync::Kind};
use cloud_vault::{Preferences, Scope, StoreScope, UploadState};
use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};
use std::{cell::RefCell, path::PathBuf};

const SCOPE: Scope = Scope {
    steam_id: 0x0110_0001_0000_002a,
    app_id: 42,
    cloud_app_id: 42,
};

#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum Failed {
    Stopped(Stop),
    Vault(String),
    Changed,
    Offline,
    Conflict,
    Recovery,
    Unsupported,
}
impl From<Stop> for Failed {
    fn from(stop: Stop) -> Self {
        Self::Stopped(stop)
    }
}
impl From<cloud_vault::Error> for Failed {
    fn from(error: cloud_vault::Error) -> Self {
        Self::Vault(error.to_string())
    }
}
impl sync::Failure for Failed {
    fn kind(&self) -> Kind {
        match self {
            Self::Stopped(_) => Kind::Cancelled,
            Self::Changed | Self::Offline => Kind::Transient,
            Self::Conflict => Kind::Conflict,
            Self::Unsupported => Kind::Unavailable,
            Self::Vault(_) | Self::Recovery => Kind::Blocking,
        }
    }
    fn key(&self) -> String {
        format!("{self:?}")
    }
    fn timed_out() -> Self {
        Self::Offline
    }
    fn conflict() -> Self {
        Self::Conflict
    }
    fn recovery() -> Self {
        Self::Recovery
    }
    fn unsupported() -> Self {
        Self::Unsupported
    }
    fn changed() -> Self {
        Self::Changed
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
struct FakeListing {
    revision: u64,
    files: BTreeMap<String, (u64, Vec<u8>, u32)>,
}
impl Listing for FakeListing {
    fn revision(&self) -> String {
        format!("r{}", self.revision)
    }
    fn saves(&self) -> Vec<Listed<'_>> {
        self.files
            .iter()
            .map(|(name, (size, _, platforms))| Listed {
                name,
                size: *size,
                platforms: *platforms,
            })
            .collect()
    }
    fn holds(&self, name: &str, bytes: &[u8]) -> bool {
        self.files.get(name).is_some_and(|(size, sha1, _)| {
            *size == bytes.len() as u64 && Sha1::digest(bytes).as_slice() == sha1
        })
    }
}

fn listing(files: &BTreeMap<String, (Vec<u8>, u32)>, revision: u64) -> FakeListing {
    FakeListing {
        revision,
        files: files
            .iter()
            .map(|(name, (bytes, platforms))| {
                let identity = (bytes.len() as u64, Sha1::digest(bytes).to_vec(), *platforms);
                (name.clone(), identity)
            })
            .collect(),
    }
}

/// One game's Cloud in memory, with counters for what a view asked of it.
struct FakeRemote {
    root: PathBuf,
    files: BTreeMap<String, (Vec<u8>, u32)>,
    revision: u64,
    lists: usize,
    fetches: usize,
    fetched: Vec<String>,
    /// Another device publishes this between a listing and its confirmation.
    race: Option<(String, Vec<u8>)>,
    /// What the storefront's record keeps of the last view.
    record: Option<Manifest>,
    adopted: Option<FakeListing>,
    /// A commit's listing also names this save.
    stray: Option<String>,
    /// A fetch leaves this save out yet succeeds.
    skipped: Option<String>,
    /// The vault's upload state when the journal ran, then when sending.
    states: RefCell<Vec<Option<UploadState>>>,
}

impl FakeRemote {
    fn new(root: PathBuf) -> Self {
        Self {
            root,
            files: BTreeMap::new(),
            revision: 0,
            lists: 0,
            fetches: 0,
            fetched: Vec::new(),
            race: None,
            record: None,
            adopted: None,
            stray: None,
            skipped: None,
            states: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
        }
    }
    fn publish(&mut self, name: &str, bytes: &[u8], platforms: u32) {
        self.files.insert(name.into(), (bytes.to_vec(), platforms));
        self.revision += 1;
    }
}

fn state(root: &std::path::Path) -> Option<UploadState> {
    cloud_vault::peek(root, SCOPE).unwrap().pending
}

impl Remote for FakeRemote {
    type Failure = Failed;
    type Listing = FakeListing;
    const JOURNAL: &'static str = "fake-cloud";

    async fn list(&mut self) -> Result<FakeListing, Failed> {
        self.lists += 1;
        Ok(listing(&self.files, self.revision))
    }
    async fn unchanged(&mut self, listed: &FakeListing) -> Result<bool, Failed> {
        if let Some((name, bytes)) = self.race.take() {
            self.publish(&name, &bytes, 2);
        }
        Ok(listing(&self.files, self.revision) == *listed)
    }
    async fn fetch(
        &mut self,
        _: &FakeListing,
        names: &[&str],
        mut receive: impl FnMut(&str, Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), cloud_vault::Error>,
    ) -> Result<(), Failed> {
        self.fetches += 1;
        for name in names {
            if self.skipped.as_deref() == Some(*name) {
                continue;
            }
            self.fetched.push((*name).to_owned());
            receive(name, self.files[*name].0.clone())?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    fn adopt(&mut self, listed: FakeListing, view: &RemoteView, _: &Vault) -> Result<(), Failed> {
        self.record = Some(view.files.clone());
        self.adopted = Some(listed);
        Ok(())
    }
    fn adopted(&self) -> Option<&Manifest> {
        self.record.as_ref()
    }
    async fn commit(
        &mut self,
        change: Change<'_, Failed>,
    ) -> Result<Committed<FakeListing>, Failed> {
        let mut uploads = Vec::new();
        for (name, file) in change.uploads() {
            uploads.push((
                name.to_owned(),
                change.vault().read_content(file)?,
                file.platforms,
            ));
        }
        let deletes: Vec<String> = change.deletes().map(str::to_owned).collect();
        let (root, states) = (&self.root, &self.states);
        let (files, revision, stray) = (&mut self.files, &mut self.revision, &self.stray);
        change
            .send(
                || {
                    states.borrow_mut().push(state(root));
                    Ok(())
                },
                async || {
                    states.borrow_mut().push(state(root));
                    for (name, bytes, platforms) in uploads {
                        files.insert(name, (bytes, platforms));
                    }
                    for name in deletes {
                        files.remove(&name);
                    }
                    if let Some(stray) = stray {
                        files.insert(stray.clone(), (b"stray".to_vec(), 2));
                    }
                    *revision += 1;
                    Ok(listing(files, *revision))
                },
            )
            .await
    }
}

struct Fixture {
    _temporary: tempfile::TempDir,
    root: PathBuf,
    vault: Vault,
    control: Control,
}

fn fixture() -> Fixture {
    let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let root = temporary.path().canonicalize().unwrap().join("cloud");
    let mut vault = Vault::open(&root, SCOPE).unwrap();
    vault.set_preferences(Preferences {
        account_enabled: Some(true),
        game_enabled: Some(true),
    });
    Fixture {
        _temporary: temporary,
        root,
        vault,
        control: Control::new(|_| {}),
    }
}

impl Fixture {
    fn remote(&self) -> FakeRemote {
        FakeRemote::new(self.root.clone())
    }
    fn staged(&self, files: &[(&str, &[u8])]) -> Manifest {
        Manifest(
            files
                .iter()
                .map(|(name, bytes)| ((*name).to_owned(), self.vault.stage(bytes, 2).unwrap()))
                .collect(),
        )
    }
    async fn send(
        &mut self,
        remote: &mut FakeRemote,
        local: &Manifest,
        view: &RemoteView,
    ) -> Result<(), Failed> {
        send(
            remote,
            &mut self.vault,
            SCOPE.steam_id.into(),
            local,
            view,
            &self.control,
        )
        .await
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn unchanged_saves_reuse_archived_bytes_across_reads_and_restarts() {
    let game = fixture();
    let mut remote = game.remote();
    remote.publish("slot.sav", b"cloud v1", 7);
    let mut views = Views::default();

    let first = views
        .read(&mut remote, &game.vault, &game.control)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    views
        .read(&mut remote, &game.vault, &game.control)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(remote.fetched, ["slot.sav"]);
    assert_eq!(remote.lists, 2);
    assert_eq!(first.files.0["slot.sav"].platforms, 7);
    assert_eq!(first.revision, "r1");

    // After a restart only the storefront's record still holds the view.
    let again = Views::default()
        .read(&mut remote, &game.vault, &game.control)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(remote.fetched, ["slot.sav"]);
    assert_eq!(again, first);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn stale_bytes_never_stand_in_for_a_listed_save() {
    let game = fixture();
    let mut remote = game.remote();
    remote.publish("slot.sav", b"cloud v1", 2);
    let mut views = Views::default();
    let first = views
        .read(&mut remote, &game.vault, &game.control)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let blob = StoreScope::from(SCOPE)
        .directory(&game.root)
        .unwrap()
        .join("blobs")
        .join(first.files.0["slot.sav"].hash.as_str());
    std::fs::remove_file(&blob).unwrap();
    views
        .read(&mut remote, &game.vault, &game.control)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(remote.fetched.len(), 2);

    // The same size with other bytes fails the listed hash.
    remote.publish("slot.sav", b"cloud v2", 2);
    let second = views
        .read(&mut remote, &game.vault, &game.control)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(remote.fetched.len(), 3);
    assert_eq!(
        game.vault
            .read_content(&second.files.0["slot.sav"])
            .unwrap(),
        b"cloud v2"
    );
    remote.publish("slot.sav", b"cloud v3, longer", 2);
    let third = views
        .read(&mut remote, &game.vault, &game.control)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(remote.fetched.len(), 4);
    assert_eq!(
        game.vault.read_content(&third.files.0["slot.sav"]).unwrap(),
        b"cloud v3, longer"
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn fetch_runs_once_per_read_with_only_the_missing_saves_and_stages_their_listed_platforms() {
    let game = fixture();
    let mut remote = game.remote();
    remote.publish("a.sav", b"first", 7);
    remote.publish("b.sav", b"second", 1);
    let mut views = Views::default();

    let view = views
        .read(&mut remote, &game.vault, &game.control)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        (remote.fetches, remote.fetched.clone()),
        (1, vec!["a.sav".into(), "b.sav".into()])
    );
    assert_eq!(view.files.0["a.sav"].platforms, 7);
    assert_eq!(view.files.0["b.sav"].platforms, 1);
    assert_eq!(
        game.vault.read_content(&view.files.0["b.sav"]).unwrap(),
        b"second"
    );

    remote.publish("c.sav", b"third", 2);
    views
        .read(&mut remote, &game.vault, &game.control)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(remote.fetches, 2);
    assert_eq!(remote.fetched[2..], ["c.sav"]);

    // Nothing missing still asks once, with no names.
    views
        .read(&mut remote, &game.vault, &game.control)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(remote.fetches, 3);
    assert_eq!(remote.fetched.len(), 3);
}

#[tokio::test]

#[tokio::test]
async fn cancellation_and_revocation_stop_the_read_before_any_fetch() {
    let game = fixture();
    let mut remote = game.remote();
    remote.publish("slot.sav", b"cloud v1", 2);
    for (stop, expected) in [
        (Control::cancel as fn(&Control), Stop::Cancelled),
        (Control::revoke, Stop::Revoked),
    ] {
        let control = Control::new(|_| {});
        stop(&control);
        assert_eq!(
            Views::default()
                .read(&mut remote, &game.vault, &control)
                .await,
            Err(Failed::Stopped(expected))
        );
    }
    assert_eq!(remote.fetches, 0);
    assert!(remote.adopted.is_none());
}

#[test]
fn change_lists_uploads_for_new_or_different_versions_and_deletes_for_missing_names() {
    let mut game = fixture();
    let local = game.staged(&[("a.sav", b"same"), ("b.sav", b"edited"), ("c.sav", b"new")]);
    let view = RemoteView {
        revision: "r1".into(),
        files: game.staged(&[("a.sav", b"same"), ("b.sav", b"older"), ("d.sav", b"gone")]),
    };
    let change = Change::<Failed> {
        vault: &mut game.vault,
        account: SCOPE.steam_id.into(),
        local: &local,
        view: &view,
        journal: FakeRemote::JOURNAL,
        control: &game.control,
        failure: PhantomData,
    };

    let uploads: Vec<_> = change.uploads().map(|(name, _)| name).collect();
    let deletes: Vec<_> = change.deletes().collect();

    assert_eq!(uploads, ["b.sav", "c.sav"]);
    assert_eq!(deletes, ["d.sav"]);
}

#[tokio::test]

        .read(&mut remote, &game.vault, &game.control)

#[tokio::test]
async fn forgetting_drops_the_reuse_cache() {
    let game = fixture();
    let mut remote = game.remote();
    remote.publish("slot.sav", b"cloud v1", 2);
    let mut views = Views::default();
    for _ in 0..2 {
        views
            .read(&mut remote, &game.vault, &game.control)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        // Only this operation's reads may stand in.
        remote.record = None;
    }
    assert_eq!(remote.fetched.len(), 1);

    views.forget();
    views
        .read(&mut remote, &game.vault, &game.control)
        .await
        .unwrap();

    assert_eq!(remote.fetched.len(), 2);
}
```
