```rs
//! Per-scope Cloud markers that the indicator reads without any lock. Both
//! storefront adapters write them beside the vault state they describe, while
//! they hold that storefront's vault. A marker is display state only.
use cloud_vault::StoreScope;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

const FILE: &str = "cloud-status.json";

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Record {
    /// The game this record describes. An Epic directory name is a hash, so
    /// a reader needs this to map the directory back to its game.
    pub scope: Option<StoreScope>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub unavailable: Option<Unavailable>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub problem: Option<Problem>,
}

/// The last check found that Cloud cannot sync this game.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Unavailable {
    pub reason: UnavailableReason,
    pub at: u64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum UnavailableReason {
    /// The game has no Cloud saves on this storefront.
    NoCloud,
    /// The game's Cloud rules are not supported on macOS.
    Unsupported,
    /// Cloud is turned off in the storefront's preferences.
    Disabled,
}

/// The last sync ended without a confirmed sync.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Problem {
    pub kind: ProblemKind,
    /// Localization key of the failure that ended it.
    pub key: String,
    pub at: u64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum ProblemKind {
    /// It failed, was cancelled, or the game launched without it, and no
    /// pending work remains to show that.
    Failed,
    /// A conflict question ended without an answer.
    Conflict,
}

fn path(root: &Path, scope: &StoreScope) -> cloud_vault::Result<PathBuf> {
    Ok(scope.directory(root)?.join(FILE))
}

/// A missing file reads as an empty record.
pub fn read(root: &Path, scope: &StoreScope) -> cloud_vault::Result<Record> {
    Ok(cloud_vault::journal::read(&path(root, scope)?)?.unwrap_or_default())
}

/// The caller holds this scope's vault, which serializes writers.
pub(crate) fn update(
    root: &Path,
    scope: &StoreScope,
    change: impl FnOnce(&mut Record),
) -> cloud_vault::Result<()> {
    let mut record = read(root, scope)?;
    let before = record.clone();
    record.scope = Some(scope.clone());
    change(&mut record);
    if record == before {
        return Ok(());
    }
    cloud_vault::journal::write(&path(root, scope)?, &record)
}

pub(crate) fn unavailable(reason: UnavailableReason) -> impl FnOnce(&mut Record) {
    move |record| {
        if record.unavailable.as_ref().map(|u| u.reason) != Some(reason) {
            record.unavailable = Some(Unavailable {
                reason,
                at: crate::unix_now(),
            });
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn available(record: &mut Record) {
    record.unavailable = None;
}

pub(crate) fn problem(kind: ProblemKind, key: &str) -> impl FnOnce(&mut Record) + '_ {
    move |record| {
        record.problem = Some(Problem {
            kind,
            key: key.into(),
            at: crate::unix_now(),
        });
    }
}

pub(crate) fn synced(record: &mut Record) {
    record.problem = None;
}

/// A conflict that got its answer is no longer unanswered.
pub(crate) fn answered(record: &mut Record) {
    if record
        .problem
        .as_ref()
        .is_some_and(|problem| problem.kind == ProblemKind::Conflict)
    {
        record.problem = None;
    }
}

/// What one game's indicator shows from persisted state. Obelisk adds the live
/// states on top: a sync in progress and a running game.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SavedState {
    RecoveryNeeded,
    UploadUncertain,
    Conflict,
    Pending,
    Unavailable,
    LocalChanges,
    LastFailed,
    /// Without `synced_at`, the sync predates the Last Cloud sync record.
    Synced,
    NeverSynced,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Indicator {
    pub state: SavedState,
    /// A game session's guard is set. Only Obelisk's live sessions tell
    /// whether that game still runs or its supervisor died.
    pub game_session: bool,
    pub synced_at: Option<u64>,
    /// Saves wait to be sent. An uninstalled game shows its indicator only
    /// while this holds.
    pub pending_upload: bool,
    pub installation_removed: bool,
}

/// A storefront context's facts that the vault summary cannot know.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub(crate) struct Journal {
    /// An exit save waits to be sent.
    pub pending: bool,
    /// An upload transaction may have committed.
    pub uncertain: bool,
    /// A chosen Cloud version is being applied.
    pub applying: bool,
    pub installation_removed: bool,
}

/// The first matching row wins. A switch plan that belongs to another game is
/// transient and does not concern this one.
pub(crate) fn indicator(
    scope: &StoreScope,
    vault: &cloud_vault::Summary,
    journal: &Journal,
    record: &Record,
) -> Indicator {
    let problem = record.problem.as_ref().map(|problem| problem.kind);
    let uncertain =
        vault.pending == Some(cloud_vault::UploadState::MayHaveCommitted) || journal.uncertain;
    let pending = journal.pending || vault.pending.is_some();
    let state = if vault.applying || journal.applying || vault.switching.as_ref() == Some(scope) {
        SavedState::RecoveryNeeded
    } else if uncertain {
        SavedState::UploadUncertain
    } else if problem == Some(ProblemKind::Conflict) {
        SavedState::Conflict
    } else if pending {
        SavedState::Pending
    } else if record.unavailable.is_some() {
        SavedState::Unavailable
    } else if vault.local_changes && !journal.installation_removed {
        SavedState::LocalChanges
    } else if problem == Some(ProblemKind::Failed) {
        SavedState::LastFailed
    } else if vault.baseline {
        SavedState::Synced
    } else {
        SavedState::NeverSynced
    };
    Indicator {
        state,
        game_session: vault.game_session,
        synced_at: vault.synced_at,
        pending_upload: pending || uncertain,
        installation_removed: journal.installation_removed,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use cloud_vault::{Summary, UploadState};

    fn scope(app_id: u32) -> StoreScope {
        cloud_vault::Scope {

            pending: true,
            ..Journal::default()
        };
        let removed = Journal {
            installation_removed: true,

        };
        let changed = Summary {
            local_changes: true,

                    ..synced()

                problem(ProblemKind::Conflict),
                SavedState::UploadUncertain,
            ),
            (
                synced(),
                Journal {
                    uncertain: true,
                    ..Journal::default()
                },
                Record::default(),
                SavedState::UploadUncertain,

                unavailable(),
                SavedState::Unavailable,

                problem(ProblemKind::Failed),

            (
                Summary::default(),
                Journal::default(),
                Record::default(),
                SavedState::NeverSynced,
            ),

        for (index, (vault, journal, record, expected)) in cases.into_iter().enumerate() {
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/diagnostics.rs`:

```rs
//! Diagnostics: the files that tell how a game ran, named once. The code
//! that writes them takes their names here, and a bug report finds them
//! here, so the two cannot drift apart.
use crate::queue::Storefront;
use obelisk_core::Platform;
use std::{
    fmt::Display,
    fs::{self, File},
    io,
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    time::{Duration, SystemTime},
};

/// Obelisk's logs, in the user's home.
const LOGS: &str = "Library/Logs/Obelisk";
/// The words starting a launch's reports, in the order a report lists them.
const REPORTS: [&str; 2] = ["launch", "failed"];
/// An Obelisk report attaches the launch reports this recent.
const RECENT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(24 * 3600);

/// A game as its diagnostics name it: Steam's by app ID, Epic's by app name,
/// GOG's by product ID.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Game<'a> {
    Steam(u32),
    Epic(&'a str),
    Gog(&'a str),
}
impl<'a> From<crate::profile::Game<'a>> for Game<'a> {
    fn from(game: crate::profile::Game<'a>) -> Self {
        use crate::profile::Game::{Epic, Gog, Steam};
        // An Epic game's namespace names none of its files.
        match game {
            Steam { app_id } => Self::Steam(app_id),
            Epic { app_name, .. } => Self::Epic(app_name),
            Gog { product_id } => Self::Gog(product_id),
        }
    }
}
impl Game<'_> {
    fn store(self) -> Storefront {
        match self {
            Self::Steam(_) => Storefront::Steam,
            Self::Epic(_) => Storefront::Epic,
            Self::Gog(_) => Storefront::Gog,
        }
    }
    fn id(self) -> String {
        match self {
            Self::Steam(app_id) => app_id.to_string(),
            Self::Epic(id) | Self::Gog(id) => id.to_owned(),
        }
    }
}

/// Every build, in the order that wins a tie between their logs.
const BUILDS: [Platform; 2] = [Platform::Windows, Platform::Mac];

/// How a build's log starts: Wine runs a Windows build, a Mac build runs as
/// itself.
fn word(build: Platform) -> &'static str {
    match build {
        Platform::Windows => "wine",
        Platform::Mac => "game",
    }
}

/// `store`'s diagnostics folder under `home`.
pub fn folder(home: &Path, store: Storefront) -> PathBuf {
    home.join(LOGS).join(match store {
        Storefront::Steam => "Steam",
        Storefront::Epic => "Epic",
        Storefront::Gog => "GOG",
    })
}

/// The file a `build` of `game` writes its standard error to while it runs.
pub fn game_log(home: &Path, game: Game<'_>, build: Platform) -> PathBuf {
    folder(home, game.store()).join(format!("{}-{}.log", word(build), game.id()))
}

/// Opens `log` empty for a new launch. The last launch's log stays beside it
/// as `<name>.previous.log`: a player who relaunches a game that crashed
/// still has the crash's log to send.
pub fn open_log(log: &Path) -> io::Result<File> {
    use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
    let _ = fs::rename(log, previous_log(log));
    fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .write(true)
        .create(true)
        .truncate(true)
        .mode(0o600)
        .open(log)
}

fn previous_log(log: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    log.with_extension("previous.log")
}

/// The log of the input service that serves the game logging to `log`.
pub(crate) fn input_log(log: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    log.with_extension("input.log")
}

/// The report of Steam launch `run` of `app_id`, in `folder`.
pub(crate) fn launch_report(folder: &Path, app_id: u32, run: uuid::Uuid) -> PathBuf {
    report(folder, REPORTS[0], app_id, run)
}

/// The report of failed Steam launch `run` of `app_id`, in `folder`.
pub(crate) fn failure_report(folder: &Path, app_id: u32, run: uuid::Uuid) -> PathBuf {
    report(folder, REPORTS[1], app_id, run)
}

fn report(folder: &Path, word: &str, id: impl Display, run: uuid::Uuid) -> PathBuf {
    folder.join(format!("{}{run}.json", report_prefix(word, id)))
}

/// The start of every `word` report of the game `id`. Its last `-` keeps the
/// reports of app 12456201 from counting as app 1245620's.
fn report_prefix(word: &str, id: impl Display) -> String {
    format!("{}{id}-", report_start(word))
}

/// The start of every `word` report, whichever game it is of.
fn report_start(word: &str) -> String {
    format!("{word}-")
}

/// The diagnostics a bug report attaches, most telling first. For `game`:
/// the logs of the build it launched last, then its newest launch and
/// failure report. For Obelisk: every launch and failure report of the day
/// before `now`, newest first. What cannot be read is left out.
pub fn files(home: &Path, game: Option<Game<'_>>, now: SystemTime) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    match game {
        Some(game) => game_files(home, game),
        None => recent_reports(home, now),
    }
}

fn game_files(home: &Path, game: Game<'_>) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    let mut files = Vec::new();
    // A build's logs are dated by its last launch; the input log is not.
    let mut played: Option<(Platform, SystemTime)> = None;
    for build in BUILDS {
        let log = game_log(home, game, build);
        let Some(modified) = [modified(&log), modified(&previous_log(&log))]
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            .max()
        else {
            continue;
        };
        if played.is_none_or(|(_, best)| modified > best) {
            played = Some((build, modified));
        }
    }
    if let Some((build, _)) = played {
        let log = game_log(home, game, build);
        let logs = [previous_log(&log), input_log(&log)];
        files.extend(
            std::iter::once(log)
                .chain(logs)
                .filter(|path| modified(path).is_some()),
        );
    }
    let listing = listing(&folder(home, game.store()));
    for word in REPORTS {
        let prefix = report_prefix(word, game.id());
        let mut newest: Option<&(String, PathBuf, SystemTime)> = None;
        for entry in &listing {
            let (name, _, modified) = entry;
            if name.starts_with(&prefix)
                && name.ends_with(".json")
                && newest.is_none_or(|(.., best)| modified > best)
            {
                newest = Some(entry);
            }
        }
        files.extend(newest.map(|(_, path, _)| path.clone()));
    }
    files
}

fn recent_reports(home: &Path, now: SystemTime) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    let since = now.checked_sub(RECENT);
    let mut reports: Vec<(PathBuf, SystemTime)> =
        [Storefront::Steam, Storefront::Epic, Storefront::Gog]
            .into_iter()
            .flat_map(|store| listing(&folder(home, store)))
            .filter(|(name, _, modified)| {
                REPORTS
                    .iter()
                    .any(|word| name.starts_with(&report_start(word)))
                    && name.ends_with(".json")
                    && since.is_none_or(|since| *modified >= since)
            })
            .map(|(_, path, modified)| (path, modified))
            .collect();
    reports.sort_by_key(|(_, modified)| std::cmp::Reverse(*modified));
    reports.into_iter().map(|(path, _)| path).collect()
}

fn modified(path: &Path) -> Option<SystemTime> {
    fs::metadata(path)
        .and_then(|metadata| metadata.modified())
        .ok()
}

/// The files in `folder` with their names and when they last changed,
/// hidden ones left out; nothing when it cannot be read.
fn listing(folder: &Path) -> Vec<(String, PathBuf, SystemTime)> {
    let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(folder) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    entries
        .flatten()
        .filter_map(|entry| {
            let name = entry.file_name().into_string().ok()?;
            if name.starts_with('.') {
                return None;
            }
            let path = entry.path();
            let modified = modified(&path)?;
            Some((name, path, modified))
        })
        .collect()
}
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/diagnostics/tests.rs`:

```rs
use super::{Game::*, *};
use obelisk_core::Platform::*;
use std::{io::Write, os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt};
use uuid::Uuid;

/// Writes `path`, with its folder, as last changed `age` before `now`.
fn write(path: &Path, now: SystemTime, age: Duration) -> PathBuf {
    fs::create_dir_all(path.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
    fs::write(path, "log\n").unwrap();
    age_of(path, now, age);
    path.to_owned()
}

fn age_of(path: &Path, now: SystemTime, age: Duration) {
    File::options()
        .write(true)
        .open(path)
        .unwrap()
        .set_times(fs::FileTimes::new().set_modified(now - age))
        .unwrap();
}

fn seconds(seconds: u64) -> Duration {
    Duration::from_secs(seconds)
}

#[test]
fn a_game_report_finds_what_its_launches_wrote() {
    let home = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let home = home.path();
    let now = SystemTime::now();
    let steam = folder(home, Storefront::Steam);
    let log = game_log(home, Steam(1245620), Windows);
    fs::create_dir_all(&steam).unwrap();
    open_log(&log).unwrap().write_all(b"first launch").unwrap();
    open_log(&log).unwrap().write_all(b"second").unwrap();
    let previous = previous_log(&log);
    age_of(&previous, now, seconds(600));
    age_of(&log, now, seconds(60));
    let input = write(&input_log(&log), now, seconds(60));
    write(
        &game_log(home, Steam(1245620), Mac),
        now,
        seconds(3600 * 24 * 3),
    );
    write(
        &launch_report(&steam, 1245620, Uuid::new_v4()),
        now,
        seconds(7200),
    );
    let launch = write(
        &launch_report(&steam, 1245620, Uuid::new_v4()),
        now,
        seconds(60),
    );
    let failure = write(
        &failure_report(&steam, 1245620, Uuid::new_v4()),
        now,
        seconds(300),
    );
    write(
        &launch_report(&steam, 12456201, Uuid::new_v4()),
        now,
        seconds(10),
    );
    write(&game_log(home, Steam(774801), Windows), now, seconds(10));

    let files = files(home, Some(Steam(1245620)), now);

    assert_eq!(files, [log, previous, input, launch, failure]);
    assert_eq!(
        files[0],
        home.join("Library/Logs/Obelisk/Steam/wine-1245620.log")
    );
}

#[test]
fn the_build_launched_last_names_the_logs() {
    let home = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let home = home.path();

#[test]
fn names_on_disk_stay_those_older_versions_wrote() {
    // Older Obelisk versions and running supervisors wrote these names, so
    // they are spelled out here rather than taken from the naming functions.
    let home = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let home = home.path();
    let now = SystemTime::now();
    let logs = home.join("Library/Logs/Obelisk");
    let run = Uuid::new_v4();
    let steam = [
        "Steam/wine-42.log".to_owned(),
        "Steam/wine-42.previous.log".to_owned(),
        "Steam/wine-42.input.log".to_owned(),
        format!("Steam/launch-42-{run}.json"),
        format!("Steam/failed-42-{run}.json"),
    ]
    .map(|name| write(&logs.join(name), now, seconds(60)));
    let epic = write(&logs.join("Epic/game-app.log"), now, seconds(60));
    let gog = write(&logs.join("GOG/game-7.log"), now, seconds(60));

#[test]
fn a_new_launch_keeps_the_last_launchs_log_beside_its_own() {
    let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let log = directory.path().join("wine-1245620.log");
    open_log(&log).unwrap().write_all(b"first launch").unwrap();
    open_log(&log).unwrap().write_all(b"second").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(fs::read_to_string(&log).unwrap(), "second");
    let previous = directory.path().join("wine-1245620.previous.log");
    assert_eq!(fs::read_to_string(&previous).unwrap(), "first launch");
    assert_eq!(
        fs::metadata(&log).unwrap().permissions().mode() & 0o777,
        0o600
    );
    open_log(&log).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(fs::read_to_string(&previous).unwrap(), "second");
}
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/epic/client.rs`:

```rs
//! Starting an Epic Game session. Observation and commands are the shared
//! supervisor client's.
use super::*;
use crate::supervisor::storage;

/// `wine` is how a Windows build runs, from `windows::ready`, and must be
/// absent for a Mac build.
pub fn start(
    config: Configuration,
    account_id: String,
    exchange_code: String,
    wine: Option<crate::wine::Config>,
    cancel: CancelToken,
) -> Result<Client> {
    config.validate(&account_id)?;
    if !config.runs_in(wine.as_ref()) {
        return Err(Error::Unsupported);
    }
    let request = Request {
        config: config.clone(),
        id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
        account_id,
        exchange_code,
        environment: crate::native::environment(&config.home),
        wine,
    };
    let id = request.id.clone();
    let account_id = request.account_id.clone();
    let store = Store {
        namespace: config.namespace.clone(),
        app_name: config.app_name.clone(),
    };
    Ok(Client::start_with(
        &config.session_directory,
        &config.helper,
        id,
        Client::supervisor_command(&config.helper),
        supervisor::client::inspect,
        |pipe| storage::send(pipe, &request),
        |ack| ack.account_id == account_id && ack.store == store,
        || cancel.is_cancelled(),
    )?)
}
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/epic/content.rs`:

```rs
//! Epic's part of an account's installations: where each build and its Cloud
//! saves live, the credentials every account call renews and saves first, and
//! what Epic's network does for them. Only the network is a seam; tests stand
//! in for it.
use super::{Configuration, Epic, Error, IdleGuard, Product, Store, session::Context};
use crate::{
    Locations,
    cloud::{Control, record},
    cloud_status,
    installations::{self, BoxFuture, Credentials, Receipt, Transfer, blocking},
    sessions::{self, Admission, BeforeBegin, Failure, Storefront as _, Supervised, failed},
};
use cloud_vault::{EpicScope, StoreScope};
use epic_kit::{EpicError, client::Client as EpicClient};
use obelisk_core::{Platform, installation::TransferProgress, transfer::CancelToken};
use std::{path::Path, sync::Arc};

/// What an account's installations ask of Epic's network. Every call may wait
/// on it.
pub trait Network: Send + Sync + 'static {
    /// Renews the account's credentials before a long account call.
    fn prepare(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<(), Failure>>;
    /// The account the session is signed in to now.
    fn account_id(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<String, Failure>>;
    /// A short-lived code the game signs in with.
    fn exchange_code(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<String, Failure>>;
    /// The build a Transfer without a platform installs: the Mac build when
    /// its game runs natively on Apple silicon, else the Windows build.
    fn platform<'a>(&'a self, product: &'a Product) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<Platform, Failure>>;
    /// Runs `transfer` into the folder its begin settled the platform of.
    fn download<'a>(
        &'a self,
        transfer: &'a Transfer<Epic>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<epic_kit::client::Installation, Failure>>;
    fn progress(&self) -> Option<TransferProgress>;
    fn cancel(&self);
    /// Whether Epic's live build differs from the one `receipt` installed.
    fn update_available<'a>(
        &'a self,
        receipt: &'a Receipt<Epic>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<bool, Failure>>;
    /// Saves the build's Cloud archive before its files go.
    fn archive(&self, config: Configuration) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<(), Error>>;
    /// Syncs Cloud saves on the player's request, while `idle` keeps every
    /// Epic launch out.
    fn maintain<'a>(
        self: Arc<Self>,
        config: Configuration,
        control: Arc<Control>,
        idle: &'a IdleGuard,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<(), Error>>;
}

impl Network for EpicClient {
    fn prepare(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<(), Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move { EpicClient::prepare(self).await.map(|_| ()).map_err(failed) })
    }
    fn account_id(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<String, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.credentials()
                .await
                .map(|credentials| credentials.account_id)
                .map_err(failed)
        })
    }
    fn exchange_code(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<String, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move { EpicClient::exchange_code(self).await.map_err(failed) })
    }
    fn platform<'a>(&'a self, product: &'a Product) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<Platform, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            EpicClient::platform(
                self,
                &product.namespace,
                &product.catalog_item_id,
                &product.app_name,
            )
            .await
            .map_err(failed)
        })
    }
    fn download<'a>(
        &'a self,
        transfer: &'a Transfer<Epic>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<epic_kit::client::Installation, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            // The Transfer's begin set it; Epic still refuses a download without one.
            let platform = transfer
                .platform
                .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)
                .map_err(failed)?;
            EpicClient::download(
                self,
                &transfer.product.namespace,
                &transfer.product.catalog_item_id,
                &transfer.product.app_name,
                platform,
                &transfer.directory,
            )
            .await
            .map_err(failed)
        })
    }
    fn progress(&self) -> Option<TransferProgress> {
        EpicClient::progress(self)
    }
    fn cancel(&self) {
        self.cancel_download();
    }
    fn update_available<'a>(
        &'a self,
        receipt: &'a Receipt<Epic>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<bool, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            EpicClient::update_available(
                self,
                &receipt.product.namespace,
                &receipt.product.catalog_item_id,
                &receipt.product.app_name,
                receipt.platform,
                Path::new(&receipt.directory),
            )
            .await
            .map_err(failed)
        })
    }
    fn archive(&self, config: Configuration) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<(), Error>> {
        Box::pin(super::archive(config, self))
    }
    fn maintain<'a>(
        self: Arc<Self>,
        config: Configuration,
        control: Arc<Control>,
        idle: &'a IdleGuard,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<(), Error>> {
        Box::pin(super::maintain(config, self, control, idle))
    }
}

/// One signed-in Epic account's installations, as they reach Epic.
pub struct Content<N: Network> {
    network: Arc<N>,
    credentials: Credentials,
    account: String,
    /// The language games launch in.
    language: String,
    locations: Locations,
}

impl<N: Network> Content<N> {
    pub fn new(
        network: Arc<N>,
        saved: Arc<dyn Fn() + Send + Sync>,
        account: String,
        language: String,
        locations: Locations,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            network,
            credentials: Credentials::new(saved, Epic::SESSION_FAILED),
            account,
            language,
            locations,
        }
    }

    /// As every Epic account call: renewed and saved credentials first.
    async fn prepare(&self) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        self.credentials.prepare(self.network.prepare()).await
    }

    /// The build's Cloud configuration: a Windows build keeps its saves in
    /// its Wine prefix.
    fn configuration(&self, receipt: &Receipt<Epic>) -> Configuration {
        Configuration {
            root: self.locations.cloud_archive.clone(),
            home: self.locations.home.clone(),
            install: receipt.directory.clone().into(),
            session_directory: self.locations.epic_sessions.clone(),
            helper: self.locations.helper.clone(),
            namespace: receipt.product.namespace.clone(),
            catalog_item_id: receipt.product.catalog_item_id.clone(),
            app_name: receipt.product.app_name.clone(),
            platform: receipt.platform,
            language: self.language.clone(),
            title: receipt.name.clone(),
            prefix: receipt
                .windows(&self.locations)
                .ok()
                .flatten()
                .map(|windows| windows.prefix().to_owned()),
        }
    }

    /// Where the Cloud archive keeps the saves of `game` for this account.
    fn scope(&self, game: &Store) -> StoreScope {
        EpicScope {
            account_id: self.account.clone(),
            namespace: game.namespace.clone(),
            app_name: game.app_name.clone(),
        }
        .into()
    }

    /// What maintenance of `game` syncs: its installation, or, uninstalled,
    /// the configuration its Cloud record names, with this Obelisk's paths.
    async fn maintenance(
        &self,
        game: &Store,
        installed: Option<&Receipt<Epic>>,
    ) -> Result<Configuration, Failure> {
        if let Some(receipt) = installed {
            return Ok(self.configuration(receipt));
        }
        let (root, scope) = (self.locations.cloud_archive.clone(), self.scope(game));
        let saved = blocking(Epic::SESSION_FAILED, move || {
            record::saved::<Context>(&root, &scope)
        })
        .await?
        .map_err(failed)?;
        let mut configuration = saved
            .map(|record| record.config)
            .ok_or_else(|| failed(Error::Failed))?;
        configuration.root = self.locations.cloud_archive.clone();
        configuration.session_directory = self.locations.epic_sessions.clone();
        configuration.helper = self.locations.helper.clone();
        Ok(configuration)
    }
}

impl<N: Network> installations::Content<Epic> for Content<N> {
    fn begin<'a>(
        &'a self,
        transfer: &'a Transfer<Epic>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<Platform, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.prepare().await?;
            match transfer.platform {
                Some(platform) => Ok(platform),
                None => {
                    let platform = self.network.platform(&transfer.product).await;
                    // The call may have renewed the account's credentials.
                    self.credentials.save_later();
                    platform
                }
            }
        })
    }
    fn download<'a>(
        &'a self,
        transfer: &'a Transfer<Epic>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<Receipt<Epic>, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let installed = self.network.download(transfer).await;
            self.credentials.save_later();
            let installed = installed?;
            Ok(Receipt {
                product: Product {
                    namespace: transfer.product.namespace.clone(),
                    catalog_item_id: transfer.product.catalog_item_id.clone(),
                    app_name: installed.app_name,
                },
                name: transfer.name.clone(),
                directory: installed.directory,
                platform: installed.platform,
                total_bytes: installed.total_bytes,
                needs_verification: false,
            })
        })
    }
    fn progress(&self) -> Option<TransferProgress> {
        self.network.progress()
    }
    fn cancel(&self) {
        self.credentials.cancel();
        self.network.cancel();
    }
    fn update_available<'a>(
        &'a self,
        receipt: &'a Receipt<Epic>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<bool, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let available = self.network.update_available(receipt).await;
            // The call may have renewed the account's credentials.
            self.credentials.save_later();
            available
        })
    }
    fn launch<'a>(
        &'a self,
        receipt: &'a Receipt<Epic>,
        admission: Admission<Epic>,
        _: Option<&'a std::convert::Infallible>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<(), Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let outcome = admission
                .hand_off(Handover {
                    network: self.network.clone(),
                    configuration: self.configuration(receipt),
                    windows: receipt.windows(&self.locations).ok().flatten(),
                    locations: self.locations.clone(),
                    saved: self.credentials.saved.clone(),
                })
                .await;
            self.credentials.save_later();
            outcome
        })
    }
    fn archive<'a>(&'a self, receipt: &'a Receipt<Epic>) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<(), Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.prepare().await?;
            let archived = self.network.archive(self.configuration(receipt)).await;
            self.credentials.save_later();
            archived.map_err(failed)
        })
    }
    fn removed<'a>(&'a self, receipt: &'a Receipt<Epic>) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<(), Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let (config, account) = (self.configuration(receipt), self.account.clone());
            blocking(Epic::SESSION_FAILED, move || {
                record::removed::<Context>(&config, &account)
            })
            .await?
            .map_err(failed)
        })
    }
    fn directory_name(&self, receipt: &Receipt<Epic>) -> String {
        epic_kit::client::installation_directory_name(
            &receipt.product.namespace,
            &receipt.product.catalog_item_id,
            &receipt.product.app_name,
            receipt.platform,
        )
    }
    fn relocated(&self, receipt: &Receipt<Epic>, from: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
        receipt.relocated(&self.locations, from)
    }
    fn remove_prefix(&self, receipt: &Receipt<Epic>) -> Option<Result<(), String>> {
        receipt.remove_prefix(&self.locations)
    }
    fn maintain<'a>(
        &'a self,
        game: &'a Store,
        installed: Option<&'a Receipt<Epic>>,
        control: Arc<Control>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<(), Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let config = self.maintenance(game, installed).await?;
            let (sessions, helper) = (config.session_directory.clone(), config.helper.clone());
            // Its idle guard keeps every launch of Epic out meanwhile.
            let idle = blocking(Epic::SESSION_FAILED, move || {
                super::Client::idle_guard(&sessions, &helper)
            })
            .await?
            .map_err(failed)?;
            match self.network.clone().maintain(config, control, &idle).await {
                Err(Error::Cancelled) => Err(Failure::Cancelled),
                result => result.map_err(failed),
            }
        })
    }
    fn indicators(
        &self,
        games: &[Store],
    ) -> Result<Vec<(Store, cloud_status::Indicator)>, Failure> {
        let scopes: Vec<StoreScope> = games.iter().map(|game| self.scope(game)).collect();
        let shown = record::indicators::<Context>(
            &self.locations.cloud_archive,
            &self.account.as_str().into(),
            &scopes,
        )
        .map_err(failed)?;
        Ok(shown
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|(scope, indicator)| match scope {
                StoreScope::Epic(scope) => Some((
                    Store {
                        namespace: scope.namespace,
                        app_name: scope.app_name,
                    },
                    indicator,
                )),
                StoreScope::Steam(_) => None,
            })
            .collect())
    }
}

/// Starting an installed Epic build: its Wine prefix readied, then an
/// exchange code for its account, then its supervisor.
struct Handover<N: Network> {
    network: Arc<N>,
    configuration: Configuration,
    /// Set for a Windows build, whose prefix it readies.
    windows: Option<crate::wine::Installation>,
    locations: Locations,
    saved: Arc<dyn Fn() + Send + Sync>,
}

impl<N: Network> sessions::Handover<Epic> for Handover<N> {
    /// The account, its exchange code, and how a Windows build runs.
    type Prepared = (String, String, Option<crate::wine::Config>);
    fn platform(&self) -> Platform {
        self.configuration.platform
    }
    fn prepare(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<Self::Prepared, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            // A Windows build runs in Wine, readied before any exchange code
            // exists: a prerequisite may take minutes.
            let wine = match &self.windows {
                None => None,
                Some(windows) => {
                    let (windows, configuration, locations) = (
                        windows.clone(),
                        self.configuration.clone(),
                        self.locations.clone(),
                    );
                    Some(
                        blocking(Error::Session.to_string(), move || {
                            super::windows::ready(&windows, &configuration, &locations)
                        })
                        .await?
                        .map_err(failed)?,
                    )
                }
            };
            let account = self.network.account_id().await?;
            let exchange = self.network.exchange_code().await?;
            // The code must belong to the account the game is launched for.
            if self.network.account_id().await? != account {
                return Err(failed(epic_kit::EpicError::Unauthorized));
            }
            Ok((account, exchange, wine))
        })
    }
    /// The exchange rotated the saved credentials, before the game starts.
    fn before_begin(&self) -> BeforeBegin {
        let saved = self.saved.clone();
        Box::new(move || saved())
    }
    fn start(
        self,
        (account, exchange, wine): Self::Prepared,
        cancel: CancelToken,
    ) -> Result<Arc<dyn Supervised<Epic>>, String> {
        super::start(self.configuration, account, exchange, wine, cancel)
            .map(|client| Arc::new(client) as Arc<dyn Supervised<Epic>>)
            .map_err(|error| error.to_string())
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Epic's part of the installations through their Content interface, with a
//! network the test stands in for and real files in a temporary library.
use super::*;
use crate::{
    installations::{Content as _, tests::eventually},
    runtimes::{
        Runtimes,
        tests::{FakeRuntimes, ready, recorded},
    },
    sessions::Sessions,
};
use std::{collections::VecDeque, sync::Mutex};
use tokio::sync::Notify;

const ACCOUNT: &str = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef";
const STRANGER: &str = "fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210";

/// What the test's Epic network was asked, in order, and what it answers.
#[derive(Default)]
struct Fake {
    calls: Mutex<Vec<String>>,
    /// The account each `account_id` call finds, then `account`.
    accounts: Mutex<VecDeque<String>>,
    /// Renewing credentials waits until the test releases it.
    held: Mutex<bool>,
    released: Notify,
    /// Each maintenance's configuration, and whether an Epic launch could
    /// start meanwhile.
    maintained: Mutex<Vec<(Configuration, bool)>>,
    maintenance: Mutex<Option<Error>>,
}

impl Fake {
    fn call(&self, call: &str) {
        self.calls.lock().unwrap().push(call.into());
    }
    fn calls(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        self.calls.lock().unwrap().clone()
    }
}

impl Network for Fake {
    fn prepare(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<(), Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.call("prepare");
            if *self.held.lock().unwrap() {
                self.released.notified().await;
            }
            Ok(())
        })
    }
    fn account_id(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<String, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.call("account");
            Ok(self
                .accounts
                .lock()
                .unwrap()
                .pop_front()
                .unwrap_or_else(|| ACCOUNT.into()))
        })
    }
    fn exchange_code(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<String, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.call("exchange");
            Ok("fixture-code".into())
        })
    }
    fn platform<'a>(&'a self, _: &'a Product) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<Platform, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.call("platform");
            Ok(Platform::Windows)
        })
    }
    fn download<'a>(
        &'a self,
        transfer: &'a Transfer<Epic>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<epic_kit::client::Installation, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.call("download");
            Ok(epic_kit::client::Installation {
                app_name: transfer.product.app_name.clone(),
                namespace: transfer.product.namespace.clone(),
                catalog_item_id: transfer.product.catalog_item_id.clone(),
                account_id: ACCOUNT.into(),
                directory: transfer
                    .directory
                    .join("epic-hash-Mac")
                    .to_string_lossy()
                    .into_owned(),
                platform: transfer.platform.expect("a settled platform"),
                total_bytes: 100,
                build_version: "1".into(),
                launch_executable: "Game.app".into(),
                launch_command: String::new(),
                deployment_id: None,
                prerequisite: None,
            })
        })
    }
    fn progress(&self) -> Option<TransferProgress> {
        None
    }
    fn cancel(&self) {
        self.call("cancel");
    }
    fn update_available<'a>(
        &'a self,
        _: &'a Receipt<Epic>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<bool, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.call("update");
            Ok(true)
        })
    }
    fn archive(&self, _: Configuration) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<(), Error>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.call("archive");
            Ok(())
        })
    }
    fn maintain<'a>(
        self: Arc<Self>,
        config: Configuration,
        _: Arc<Control>,
        _: &'a IdleGuard,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<(), Error>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let launch_could_start =
                crate::epic::Client::idle_guard(&config.session_directory, &config.helper).is_ok();
            self.maintained
                .lock()
                .unwrap()
                .push((config, launch_could_start));
            match self.maintenance.lock().unwrap().take() {
                Some(error) => Err(error),
                None => Ok(()),
            }
        })
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn every_account_call_renews_and_saves_the_credentials_first() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    let transfer = fixture.transfer(Platform::Mac);

    assert_eq!(
        fixture.content.begin(&transfer).await.unwrap(),
        Platform::Mac
    );
    let receipt = fixture.content.download(&transfer).await.unwrap();

    assert_eq!(receipt.product, product());
    assert_eq!(receipt.name, "Fixture");
    assert!(!receipt.needs_verification);
    // The Transfer's own rotation is saved after it, without holding it.
    eventually(|| fixture.fake.calls().len() == 4).await;
    assert_eq!(
        fixture.fake.calls(),
        ["prepare", "saved", "download", "saved"]
    );

    let receipt = fixture.installed(Platform::Mac);
    fixture.content.archive(&receipt).await.unwrap();
    eventually(|| fixture.fake.calls().len() == 8).await;
    assert_eq!(
        fixture.fake.calls()[4..],
        ["prepare", "saved", "archive", "saved"]
    );

    // A short call renews the token itself, then its rotation is saved.
    assert!(fixture.content.update_available(&receipt).await.unwrap());
    eventually(|| fixture.fake.calls().len() == 10).await;
    assert_eq!(fixture.fake.calls()[8..], ["update", "saved"]);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_transfer_without_a_platform_installs_the_build_epic_picks() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    let transfer = Transfer {
        platform: None,
        ..fixture.transfer(Platform::Mac)
    };

    assert_eq!(
        fixture.content.begin(&transfer).await.unwrap(),
        Platform::Windows

    assert_eq!(
        fixture.fake.calls(),
        ["prepare", "saved", "platform", "saved"]

    // A Transfer that names its build installs that one.

    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .content
            .begin(&fixture.transfer(Platform::Mac))
            .await
            .unwrap(),
        Platform::Mac
    );
    assert!(!fixture.fake.calls().contains(&"platform".to_string()));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_transfer_cancelled_while_its_credentials_renew_never_begins() {

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_windows_build_keeps_its_saves_in_its_wine_prefix_and_a_mac_build_has_none() {

            .content
            .maintain(&game(), Some(&receipt), control())

            .unwrap();

        maintained
            .iter()
            .all(|(_, launch_could_start)| !launch_could_start),
        "maintenance holds Epic's idle guard"
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn an_uninstalled_game_syncs_the_configuration_its_record_names_with_this_obelisks_paths() {
    use crate::cloud::record::{self, Record as _};
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    let receipt = fixture.installed(Platform::Mac);
    std::fs::create_dir_all(fixture.locations.home.join("Saves")).unwrap();
    // An earlier Obelisk, whose sessions and helper lived elsewhere, saved
    // the record of the game it installed.
    let mut configuration = fixture.content.configuration(&receipt);
    configuration.session_directory = fixture.locations.library.join("Older/Sessions");
    configuration.helper = fixture.locations.library.join("Older/helper");
    let (vault, _) = record::locked::<Context>(&configuration, ACCOUNT).unwrap();
    Context {
        config: configuration.clone(),
        rules: epic_kit::cloud::CloudRules {
            cloud_save_folder: None,
            cloud_save_folder_mac: Some("{Home}/Saves".into()),
            include: vec!["*.sav".into()],
            exclude: Vec::new(),
        },
        account_id: ACCOUNT.into(),
        pending: None,
        installation_removed: true,
    }
    .save()
    .unwrap();
    drop(vault);
    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&receipt.directory).unwrap();

    fixture
        .content
        .maintain(&game(), None, control())
        .await
        .unwrap();

    let maintained = fixture.fake.maintained.lock().unwrap()[0].0.clone();
    assert_eq!(maintained.install, configuration.install);
    assert_eq!(maintained.title, "Fixture");
    assert_eq!(maintained.root, fixture.locations.cloud_archive);
    assert_eq!(
        maintained.session_directory,
        fixture.locations.epic_sessions
    );
    assert_eq!(maintained.helper, fixture.locations.helper);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_windows_launch_gets_voile_before_it_is_prepared_and_a_mac_launch_gets_none() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    let (events, record) = recorded();
    let runtimes = FakeRuntimes::new(&[], record);
    runtimes.hold();
    let sessions = Sessions::<Epic>::new(
        Box::new(|| Ok(None)),
        Runtimes::from_source(runtimes.clone()),
    );
    eventually(|| !sessions.state().recovering).await;
    let admission = sessions.admit(game(), ACCOUNT.into()).unwrap();
    let canceller = admission.canceller();
    let windows = fixture.installed(Platform::Windows);

    let (launched, ()) = tokio::join!(fixture.content.launch(&windows, admission, None), async {
        eventually(|| !events.lock().unwrap().is_empty()).await;
        canceller.cancel();
    });

    assert_eq!(launched, Err(Failure::Cancelled), "nothing is prepared");
    assert_eq!(*events.lock().unwrap(), ["voile"]);

    // Downloads no longer wait: one the Mac build got would show.
    runtimes.release();
    // A launch code of another account stops the Mac launch once prepared.
    fixture
        .fake
        .accounts
        .lock()
        .unwrap()
        .extend([ACCOUNT.to_string(), STRANGER.to_string()]);
    let admission = sessions.admit(game(), ACCOUNT.into()).unwrap();
    let launched = fixture
        .content
        .launch(&fixture.installed(Platform::Mac), admission, None)
        .await;
    assert_eq!(
        launched,
        Err(Failure::Failed("backend.epic.unauthorized".into()))
    );
    assert_eq!(*events.lock().unwrap(), ["voile"], "a Mac build needs none");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn an_older_receipt_learns_its_catalog_item_from_the_installation_itself() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    let mut receipt = fixture.installed(Platform::Mac);
    let installed = epic_kit::client::Installation {
        app_name: "game".into(),
        namespace: "sandbox".into(),
        catalog_item_id: "catalog".into(),
        account_id: ACCOUNT.into(),
        directory: receipt.directory.clone(),
        platform: Platform::Mac,
        total_bytes: 100,
        build_version: "1".into(),
        launch_executable: "Game.app".into(),
        launch_command: String::new(),
        deployment_id: None,
        prerequisite: None,
    };
    std::fs::write(
        Path::new(&receipt.directory).join(".obelisk-install.json"),
        serde_json::to_vec(&installed).unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    receipt.product.catalog_item_id.clear();
    let file = fixture.locations.library.join("epic-installations.json");
    // An older receipt file has no catalog item at all.
    let mut older = serde_json::to_value([&receipt]).unwrap();
    older[0].as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("catalogItemId");
    std::fs::write(&file, serde_json::to_vec(&older).unwrap()).unwrap();
    let sessions = Arc::new(Sessions::<Epic>::new(Box::new(|| Ok(None)), ready()));

    let installations = crate::installations::Installations::new(
        Arc::new(Content::new(
            fixture.fake.clone(),
            Arc::new(|| {}),
            ACCOUNT.into(),
            "fr".into(),
            fixture.locations.clone(),
        )),
        sessions,
        ACCOUNT.to_string(),
        file.clone(),
        fixture.locations.home.clone(),
        crate::games_folder::GamesFolder::new(&fixture.locations.library),
        crate::installations::Queueing {
            queue: crate::queue::DownloadQueue::new(),
            account: ACCOUNT.into(),
            name: |game: &Store| game.app_name.clone(),
        },
    );

    assert_eq!(
        installations.state().receipts[0].product.catalog_item_id,
        "catalog"
    );
    let saved: Vec<Receipt<Epic>> = serde_json::from_slice(&std::fs::read(&file).unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        saved[0].product.catalog_item_id, "catalog",
        "the file keeps what it learnt"
    );
}

```

`crates/game-runtime/src/epic/launch.rs`:

```rs
//! An Epic launch: its own Epic session from a one-use exchange code, EGS
//! Cloud, the launch plan and its ownership token, and Epic presence.
use super::session as cloud_session;
use super::*;
use crate::supervisor::{
    Error as Core,
    architecture::Architecture,
    session::{self as lifecycle, LaunchCloud, Opening, Prepared, Session},
    storage,
};
use epic_kit::{client::LaunchPlan, friends::Activity};
use std::{
    io::{Read, Write},
    path::Path,
};

/// The Epic services a launch uses. Tests replace them.
#[allow(async_fn_in_trait)]
pub(crate) trait Services: Sized + Send + Sync + 'static {
    /// Opens the launch's own Epic session; never the UI's remembered token.
    async fn login(exchange_code: &str, account_id: &str) -> Result<Arc<Self>>;
    async fn launch_plan(&self, config: &Configuration) -> Result<LaunchPlan>;
    fn start_presence(&self, activity: Activity);
    fn stop_presence(&self);
    async fn disconnect(&self);
    /// EGS Cloud for this game and Game session.
    async fn cloud(
        self: &Arc<Self>,
        config: Configuration,
        account_id: String,
        session_id: String,
        control: Arc<Control>,
    ) -> Result<Box<dyn LaunchCloud<Error>>>;
    fn rosetta(helper: &Path) -> std::result::Result<bool, Core>;
}

impl Services for epic_kit::client::Client {
    async fn login(exchange_code: &str, account_id: &str) -> Result<Arc<Self>> {
        Ok(Arc::new(
            Self::from_exchange_code(exchange_code, account_id).await?,
        ))
    }
    async fn launch_plan(&self, config: &Configuration) -> Result<LaunchPlan> {
        Ok(epic_kit::client::Client::launch_plan(
            self,
            &config.namespace,
            &config.catalog_item_id,
            &config.app_name,
            config.platform,
            &config.install,
            &config.language,
        )
        .await?)
    }
    fn start_presence(&self, activity: Activity) {
        // Social availability never changes the game's lifetime.
        let _ = self.start_game_presence(activity);
    }
    fn stop_presence(&self) {
        self.stop_friends();
    }
    async fn disconnect(&self) {
        let _ = epic_kit::client::Client::disconnect(self).await;
    }
    async fn cloud(
        self: &Arc<Self>,
        config: Configuration,
        account_id: String,
        session_id: String,
        control: Arc<Control>,
    ) -> Result<Box<dyn LaunchCloud<Error>>> {
        let sync = cloud_session::open(config, account_id, Arc::clone(self), control, session_id)?;
        Ok(Box::new(sync))
    }
    fn rosetta(helper: &Path) -> std::result::Result<bool, Core> {
        crate::supervisor::architecture::rosetta_available(helper)
    }
}

pub(crate) struct Launch<S: Services = epic_kit::client::Client> {
    request: Request,
    api: Option<Arc<S>>,
    activity: Option<Activity>,
    ownership: Option<tempfile::TempDir>,
}

/// Keeps the launch plan's ownership token until the game exits.
pub(crate) struct Host {
    _ownership: Option<tempfile::TempDir>,
}

impl<S: Services> Launch<S> {
    fn api(&self) -> Result<&Arc<S>> {
        self.api.as_ref().ok_or(Error::Session)
    }
}

impl<S: Services> lifecycle::Launch for Launch<S> {
    type P = Epic;
    type Host = Host;
    type Cloud = Box<dyn LaunchCloud<Error>>;
    const BEGIN: bool = true;

    fn wine(&self) -> Option<crate::wine::Config> {
        self.request.wine.clone()
    }

    fn open(input: &mut dyn Read) -> Result<(Opening<Epic>, Self)> {
        let request: Request = storage::packet(input)?;
        request.config.validate(&request.account_id)?;
        if uuid::Uuid::parse_str(&request.id).is_err()
            || !request.config.runs_in(request.wine.as_ref())
        {
            return Err(Error::Session);
        }
        let opening = Opening {
            root: request.config.session_directory.clone(),
            id: request.id.clone(),
            account_id: request.account_id.clone(),
            store: Store {
                namespace: request.config.namespace.clone(),
                app_name: request.config.app_name.clone(),
            },
            helpers: crate::supervisor::rosetta::helpers_of_host(&request.config.helper)
                .ok_or(Error::Session)?
                .into(),
        };
        let launch = Self {
            request,
            api: None,
            activity: None,
            ownership: None,
        };
        Ok((opening, launch))
    }

    async fn authenticate(&mut self, _: &Arc<Session<Epic>>) -> Result<()> {
        let api = S::login(&self.request.exchange_code, &self.request.account_id).await?;
        self.api = Some(api);
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn cloud(
        &mut self,
        session: &Arc<Session<Epic>>,
    ) -> Result<Option<Box<dyn LaunchCloud<Error>>>> {
        let api = self.api()?.clone();
        Ok(Some(
            api.cloud(
                self.request.config.clone(),
                self.request.account_id.clone(),
                self.request.id.clone(),
                session.cloud().clone(),
            )
            .await?,
        ))
    }

    async fn target(
        &mut self,
        session: &Arc<Session<Epic>>,
    ) -> Result<(Target, Option<Architecture>)> {
        let plan = self.api()?.launch_plan(&self.request.config).await?;
        session.cloud().check()?;
        // A fresh plan, after Rosetta was installed, drops the old token.
        let request = &self.request;
        let (target, architecture, ownership) = match &request.wine {
            Some(wine) => windows_target(&plan, &request.config, wine, &request.environment)?,
            None => native_target(&plan, &request.config, &request.environment)?,
        };
        self.activity = plan.activity;
        self.ownership = ownership;
        Ok((target, Some(architecture)))
    }

    async fn prepare_host(
        &mut self,
        _: &Arc<Session<Epic>>,
        target: &Target,
        _: Option<Architecture>,
        _: Option<&Box<dyn LaunchCloud<Error>>>,
    ) -> Result<Prepared<Host>> {
        Ok(Prepared {
            host: Host {
                _ownership: self.ownership.take(),
            },
            helper: self.request.config.helper.clone(),
            subcommand: "game-exec",
            environment: target.environment.clone(),
        })
    }

    fn running(&self, _: &Arc<Host>, _: u32) -> Box<dyn Fn(bool) + Send + Sync> {
        let (Ok(api), activity) = (self.api(), self.activity.clone()) else {
            return Box::new(|_| {});
        };
        let api = api.clone();
        Box::new(move |active| match (&activity, active) {
            (Some(activity), true) => api.start_presence(activity.clone()),
            (_, true) => {}
            (_, false) => api.stop_presence(),
        })
    }

    fn stopped(&self, _: &Host, _: Option<i32>) {}

    async fn close(&mut self) {
        if let Some(api) = &self.api {
            api.disconnect().await;
        }
    }

    fn terminal(record: &mut Snapshot) {
        record.cloud.allowed_choices.clear();
        if record.phase == Phase::Failed
            && !matches!(
                record.cloud.phase,
                CloudPhase::Conflict | CloudPhase::Pending
            )
        {
            record.cloud.phase = CloudPhase::Failed;
        }
    }

    fn rosetta(helper: &Path) -> std::result::Result<bool, Core> {
        S::rosetta(helper)
    }
}

/// A Windows build, which Wine starts in its prefix, with the plan's
/// ownership token where that Wine reads it.
pub(super) fn windows_target(
    plan: &LaunchPlan,
    config: &Configuration,
    wine: &crate::wine::Config,
    environment: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
) -> Result<(Target, Architecture, Option<tempfile::TempDir>)> {
    let mut target = crate::wine::target::<super::windows::Prefix<'_>>(
        wine,
        &config.game(),
        &plan.target,
        environment.clone(),
    )?;
    let ownership = match &plan.ownership_token {
        Some(bytes) => {
            let (directory, path) = crate::wine::private_file(wine, "ownership.bin", bytes)?;
            target.arguments.push(format!("-epicovt={path}"));
            Some(directory)
        }
        None => None,
    };
    Ok((target, wine.architecture(), ownership))
}

/// A Mac build, with the plan's ownership token in a private folder that
/// lives as long as the game.
pub(super) fn native_target(
    plan: &LaunchPlan,
    config: &Configuration,
    environment: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
) -> Result<(Target, Architecture, Option<tempfile::TempDir>)> {
    let mut arguments = plan.target.arguments.clone();
    let ownership = match &plan.ownership_token {
        Some(bytes) => {
            let (directory, path) = crate::files::private_temp_file(
                &std::env::temp_dir(),
                "obelisk-epic-ownership-",
                "ownership.bin",
                bytes,
            )?;
            arguments.push(format!("-epicovt={}", path.display()));
            Some(directory)
        }
        None => None,
    };
    let (target, architecture) = crate::native::target(
        &config.install,
        &plan.target,
        arguments,
        environment.clone(),
        crate::diagnostics::game_log(
            &config.home,
            config.profile_game().into(),
            obelisk_core::Platform::Mac,
        ),
    )?;
    Ok((target, architecture, ownership))
}

/// The `obelisk-steam-host epic-supervise` entry point.
pub fn serve(input: impl Read, output: impl Write, inspect: lifecycle::Inspect) -> Result<()> {
    lifecycle::serve::<Launch>(input, output, inspect)
}
```

```rs
struct FakeCloud {
    directory: PathBuf,
    script: Script,
    control: Arc<Control>,
}
impl LaunchCloud<Error> for FakeCloud {
    fn prepare<'a>(&'a mut self, _: &'a SessionAlive<'a>) -> Operation<'a, Result<()>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            record(&self.directory, "cloud.prepare");
            if self.script.hold_cloud {
                fs::write(self.directory.join("cloud-ready"), b"").unwrap();
                let check = || self.control.check().map_err(Error::from);
                hold(&self.directory, "release-cloud", check).await?;
            }
            if self.script.ask {
                let choice = self
                    .control
                    .ask(crate::cloud::Question::Conflict, None)
                    .await?;
                record(&self.directory, &format!("answered:{choice:?}"));
                self.control.show(CloudPhase::Ready, None);
            }
            Ok(())
        })
    }
    fn started(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
        record(&self.directory, "cloud.started");
        Ok(())
    }
    fn finished(&mut self, confirmed: bool) -> Operation<'_, ()> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            if self.script.hold_finish {
                fs::write(self.directory.join("finish-ready"), b"").unwrap();
                let _ = hold(&self.directory, "release-finish", || Ok::<_, Error>(())).await;
            }
            self.control.show(CloudPhase::Syncing, None);
            record(&self.directory, &format!("cloud.finished:{confirmed}"));
        })
    }
    fn aborted(&mut self) {
        record(&self.directory, "cloud.aborted");
    }
}

#[test]
fn an_epic_target_checks_the_full_macho_before_repairing_its_permission() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let directory = root.path().canonicalize().unwrap();
    let config = config(&directory, &directory.join("sessions"));
    fs::create_dir_all(&config.install).unwrap();
    let executable = config.install.join("game");
    let plan = launch_plan(&config.install, &directory);
    fs::write(&executable, b"\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe").unwrap();
    fs::set_permissions(&executable, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)).unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(
        native_target(&plan, &config, &HashMap::new()),
        Err(Error::NotNative)
    ));
    assert_eq!(
        fs::metadata(&executable).unwrap().permissions().mode() & 0o100,
        0
    );
    // An Intel build never runs natively.
    fs::write(&executable, thin(INTEL, true)).unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(
        native_target(&plan, &config, &HashMap::new()),
        Err(Error::NotNative)
    ));
    assert_eq!(
        fs::metadata(&executable).unwrap().permissions().mode() & 0o100,
        0
    );
    fs::write(&executable, thin(ARM64, true)).unwrap();
    let (target, architecture, ownership) = native_target(&plan, &config, &HashMap::new()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(architecture, Architecture::Arm64);
    assert_eq!(target.executable, executable.canonicalize().unwrap());
    assert!(ownership.is_none());
    assert_ne!(
        fs::metadata(&executable).unwrap().permissions().mode() & 0o100,
        0
    );
    // Nothing outside the installation is ever a target.
    let outside = launch_plan(&directory, &directory);
    fs::write(directory.join("game"), thin(ARM64, true)).unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(
        native_target(&outside, &config, &HashMap::new()),
        Err(Error::Unsupported)
    ));
}

#[test]
fn an_ownership_token_lives_as_long_as_its_prepared_game() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let directory = root.path().canonicalize().unwrap();
    let config = config(&directory, &directory.join("sessions"));
    fs::create_dir_all(&config.install).unwrap();
    fs::write(config.install.join("game"), thin(ARM64, true)).unwrap();
    let mut plan = launch_plan(&config.install, &directory);
    plan.ownership_token = Some(b"ownership".to_vec());
    let (target, _, ownership) = native_target(&plan, &config, &HashMap::new()).unwrap();
    let token = PathBuf::from(target.arguments[0].strip_prefix("-epicovt=").unwrap());
    assert_eq!(fs::read(&token).unwrap(), b"ownership");
    let host = Host {
        _ownership: ownership,
    };
    assert!(token.exists());
    drop(host);
    assert!(!token.exists());
}

#[test]
fn a_windows_build_runs_only_in_its_prefix_and_a_mac_build_never_does() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let directory = root.path().canonicalize().unwrap();
    let mut config = config(&directory, &directory.join("sessions"));
    assert!(config.validate(ACCOUNT).is_ok());
    config.prefix = Some(directory.join("prefix"));
    assert!(matches!(config.validate(ACCOUNT), Err(Error::Unsupported)));
    config.platform = Platform::Windows;
    assert!(config.validate(ACCOUNT).is_ok());
    assert_eq!(
        config.cloud_platform(),
        epic_kit::cloud::CloudPlatform::Windows {
            profile: directory.join("prefix/drive_c/users/crossover"),
        }
    );
    // Wine runs only the prefix the configuration names.
    let wine = crate::wine::tests::config(&directory);
    assert!(config.runs_in(Some(&wine)));
    assert!(!config.runs_in(None));
    for prefix in [None, Some(PathBuf::from("relative/prefix"))] {
        config.prefix = prefix;
        assert!(matches!(config.validate(ACCOUNT), Err(Error::Unsupported)));
        assert!(!config.runs_in(Some(&wine)));
    }
    config.prefix = None;
    assert!(config.runs_in(None));
}

#[test]
fn a_windows_build_gets_its_ownership_token_where_its_engine_s_wine_reads_it() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let directory = root.path().canonicalize().unwrap();
    let mut config = config(&directory, &directory.join("sessions"));
    config.platform = Platform::Windows;
    config.title = "Rocket League".into();
    fs::create_dir_all(&config.install).unwrap();
    fs::write(config.install.join("game"), crate::wine::tests::pe()).unwrap();
    let mut plan = launch_plan(&config.install, &config.install);
    plan.platform = Platform::Windows;
    plan.ownership_token = Some(b"ownership".to_vec());
    let rosetta = crate::wine::tests::config(&directory);
    let linux = crate::wine::Config {
        prefix: directory.join("game-linux/prefix"),
        settings: crate::launch_settings::Settings {
            engine: crate::wine::Engine::Linux,
            ..rosetta.settings.clone()
        },
        ..rosetta.clone()
    };
    fs::create_dir_all(linux.prefix.join("drive_c")).unwrap();

    for (wine, expected) in [
        (&rosetta, Architecture::Intel),
        (&linux, Architecture::Arm64),
    ] {
        let (target, architecture, ownership) =
            windows_target(&plan, &config, wine, &HashMap::new()).unwrap();

        assert_eq!(architecture, expected);
        let token = target
            .arguments
            .last()
            .unwrap()
            .strip_prefix("-epicovt=")
            .unwrap();
        let file = match wine.settings.engine {
            crate::wine::Engine::Rosetta => {
                PathBuf::from(token.strip_prefix("Z:").unwrap().replace('\\', "/"))
            }
            crate::wine::Engine::Linux => {
                // The Dock names the game as the store does.
                assert_eq!(
                    target.environment[crate::wine::linux_engine::APP_NAME],
                    "Rocket League"
                );
                wine.prefix
                    .join("drive_c")
                    .join(token.strip_prefix("C:\\").unwrap().replace('\\', "/"))
            }
        };
        assert_eq!(fs::read(&file).unwrap(), b"ownership");
        drop(ownership);
        assert!(!file.exists());
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Epic game ownership and EGS Cloud orchestration. The UI only observes and
//! answers revision-bound choices; a detached process owns the entire session.
mod client;
pub mod content;

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum Error {
    #[error("backend.epic.cloud.session")]
    Session,
    #[error("backend.epic.cloud.busy")]
    Busy,
    #[error("backend.epic.cloud.cancelled")]
    Cancelled,
    #[error("backend.epic.cloud.recovery")]
    Recovery,
    #[error("backend.epic.cloud.storage")]
    Storage,

    Failed,
    #[error("backend.epic.cloud.unsupported")]
    Unsupported,
    #[error("backend.runtime.macBuildNotNative")]
    NotNative,
    /// The other storefront's copy of this game uses the same save paths.
    #[error("backend.cloud.sharedSavesInUse")]
    SharedSaves,
    #[error("backend.runtime.rosettaUnavailable")]
    RosettaUnavailable,
    #[error("backend.runtime.wineUnavailable")]
    WineUnavailable,
    #[error("{0}")]
    Epic(#[from] epic_kit::EpicError),
    #[error("backend.epic.cloud.storage")]
    Vault(cloud_vault::Error),
    #[error("backend.epic.cloud.storage")]
    Io(#[from] std::io::Error),
}
/// Revocation also cancels: an Epic sync then ends like any cancellation.
impl From<crate::cloud::Stop> for Error {
    fn from(_: crate::cloud::Stop) -> Self {
        Self::Cancelled
    }
}
impl From<cloud_vault::Error> for Error {
    fn from(error: cloud_vault::Error) -> Self {
        match error {
            cloud_vault::Error::Busy => Self::Busy,
            cloud_vault::Error::OtherStoreBusy => Self::SharedSaves,
            error => Self::Vault(error),
        }
    }
}
supervisor::session_error_conversions!(Error);
pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Configuration {
    pub root: PathBuf,
    pub home: PathBuf,
    pub install: PathBuf,
    pub session_directory: PathBuf,
    pub helper: PathBuf,
    pub namespace: String,
    pub catalog_item_id: String,
    pub app_name: String,
    #[serde(serialize_with = "epic_kit::client::write_platform")]
    pub platform: Platform,
    pub language: String,
    /// The game's name in the store, which the Linux engine shows in the
    /// menu bar, the Dock and Cmd-Tab.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub title: String,
    /// Set for a Windows build, which runs in Wine: its saves live in this
    /// prefix.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub prefix: Option<PathBuf>,
}
impl Configuration {
    /// The game as Obelisk's profiles and logs name it.
    pub(crate) fn profile_game(&self) -> crate::profile::Game<'_> {
        crate::profile::Game::Epic {
            namespace: &self.namespace,
            app_name: &self.app_name,
        }
    }
    /// The game as Wine starts a Windows build.
    pub(crate) fn game(&self) -> crate::wine::Game<'_> {
        crate::wine::Game {
            install: &self.install,
            title: &self.title,
        }
    }
    fn scope(&self, account: &str) -> cloud_vault::EpicScope {
        cloud_vault::EpicScope {
            account_id: account.into(),
            namespace: self.namespace.clone(),
            app_name: self.app_name.clone(),
        }
    }
    /// The build whose saves this Cloud manages, and where they are.
    fn cloud_platform(&self) -> epic_kit::cloud::CloudPlatform {
        match &self.prefix {
            Some(prefix) => epic_kit::cloud::CloudPlatform::Windows {
                profile: crate::wine::profile(prefix),
            },
            None => epic_kit::cloud::CloudPlatform::Mac {
                home: self.home.clone(),
            },
        }
    }
    /// Whether `wine` runs this build in its own prefix, and only a Windows
    /// build.
    fn runs_in(&self, wine: Option<&crate::wine::Config>) -> bool {
        self.prefix.as_ref() == wine.map(|wine| &wine.prefix)
    }
    fn validate(&self, account: &str) -> Result<()> {
        cloud_vault::StoreScope::from(self.scope(account)).validate()?;
        // A Mac build runs natively; a Windows build in its prefix.
        let prefix = match (self.platform, &self.prefix) {
            (Platform::Mac, None) => None,
            (Platform::Windows, Some(prefix)) => Some(prefix),
            _ => return Err(Error::Unsupported),
        };
        if [
            &self.root,
            &self.home,
            &self.install,
            &self.session_directory,
            &self.helper,
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .chain(prefix)
        .any(|path| !supervisor::plain_absolute(path))
            || self.catalog_item_id.is_empty()
            || self.catalog_item_id.len() > 256
            || self.language.len() > 128
        {
            return Err(Error::Unsupported);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl record::Configuration for Configuration {
    fn root(&self) -> &Path {
        &self.root
    }
    fn install(&self) -> &Path {
        &self.install
    }
    fn prefix(&self) -> Option<&Path> {
        self.prefix.as_deref()
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Epic;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Store {
    pub namespace: String,
    pub app_name: String,
}

pub type Snapshot = Record<Epic>;
pub type Client = supervisor::Client<Epic>;
pub type IdleGuard = supervisor::IdleGuard<Epic>;

impl supervisor::Provider for Epic {
    type Account = String;
    type Store = Store;
    type Control = supervisor::NoControl;
    type Error = Error;
    const SUPERVISE: &'static str = "epic-supervise";
    const CANCELLED: &'static [&'static str] =
        &["backend.epic.cloud.cancelled", "backend.epic.cancelled"];

    fn valid(record: &Record<Self>) -> bool {
        record.account_id.len() == 32
            && !record.store.app_name.is_empty()
            && record.socket.is_absolute()
    }

    fn cancelled(error: &Error) -> bool {
        matches!(
            error,
            Error::Cancelled | Error::Epic(epic_kit::EpicError::Cancelled)
        )
    }

    fn same_game(a: &Store, b: &Store) -> bool {
        a == b
    }

    /// Epic keeps reconnecting to a game that still runs. A retired session's
    /// Cloud work stays pending for its next sync.
    fn orphaned(record: &mut Record<Self>, owned: bool) {
        if owned {
            record.reconnecting = true;
            return;
        }
        if !matches!(
            record.cloud.phase,
            CloudPhase::Unsupported | CloudPhase::Disabled | CloudPhase::Synced
        ) {
            record.cloud.phase = CloudPhase::Pending;
        }
        record.cloud.allowed_choices.clear();
    }
}

// A one-use exchange code travels solely through the private handoff pipe.
// This request is never persisted, formatted with Debug, or put in argv.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct Request {
    config: Configuration,
    id: String,
    account_id: String,
    exchange_code: String,
    /// Built in Obelisk's process: a supervisor starts without any environment.
    #[serde(default)]
    environment: std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
    /// How a Windows build runs.
    #[serde(default)]
    wine: Option<crate::wine::Config>,
}

pub struct Product {

    /// The catalog item the build belongs to. Older receipt files lack it;
    /// the installation's own receipt records it.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub catalog_item_id: String,
    pub app_name: String,
}

    const RECEIPTS_UNAVAILABLE: &'static str = "model.epic.receiptsUnavailable";

        }
    }
    fn profile_game(product: &Product) -> crate::profile::Game<'_> {
        crate::profile::Game::Epic {
            namespace: &product.namespace,
            app_name: &product.app_name,
        }
    }
    fn receipt_id(game: &Store, platform: Platform) -> String {
        format!(
            "{}:{}:{}",
            game.namespace,
            game.app_name,
            Self::PLATFORM.name(platform)
        )
    }
    fn transfer_name(game: &Store) -> String {
        game.app_name.clone()
    }
    fn complete(receipt: &mut crate::installations::Receipt<Epic>) -> bool {
        if !receipt.product.catalog_item_id.is_empty() {
            return false;
        }
        let directory = std::path::Path::new(&receipt.directory);
        match epic_kit::client::installed_catalog_item(directory) {
            Ok(catalog_item_id) => {
                receipt.product.catalog_item_id = catalog_item_id;
                true
            }
            Err(_) => false,
        }
    }
}
```
