```rs
//! EGS Cloud as a Cloud sync uses it: the game's Cloud rules, where its saves
//! live, its listing, fetches and the republication of a complete set.
use super::*;
use crate::cloud::record::{self, Record as _};
use crate::cloud::sync::{self, Availability, CloudSync, Kind, Storefront};
use crate::cloud_status::UnavailableReason;
use crate::supervisor::client::SessionAlive;
use cloud_vault::{Manifest, Preferences, RemoteView, Vault};
use epic_kit::{
    EpicError,
    client::Client as EpicClient,
    cloud::{CloudGame, CloudRules, ResolvedCloudRules},
};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
mod remote;
mod store;
pub(crate) use remote::CloudRemote;
use remote::{EpicRemote, Kept};
pub(crate) use store::Context;
#[cfg(test)]
mod fake;
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests;

/// One Epic game's Cloud sync.
pub(crate) type Session<R> = CloudSync<Adapter<R>>;

/// Opens the Cloud sync of one Epic game for `account`. It reads nothing
/// remote until a sync runs.
pub(crate) fn open<R: CloudRemote>(
    config: Configuration,
    account: String,
    api: Arc<R>,
    control: Arc<Control>,
    session_id: String,
) -> Result<Session<R>> {
    let adapter = Adapter {
        config,
        account,
        api,
        context: None,
        kept: None,
    };
    CloudSync::open(adapter, control, session_id)
}

/// EGS Cloud for one game and account.
pub(crate) struct Adapter<R: CloudRemote> {
    config: Configuration,
    account: String,
    api: Arc<R>,
    context: Option<Context>,
    /// Set by each read view, taken by the next upload.
    kept: Option<Kept>,
}

impl sync::Failure for Error {
    fn kind(&self) -> Kind {
        match self {
            Self::Cancelled | Self::Epic(EpicError::Cancelled) => Kind::Cancelled,
            Self::Epic(EpicError::Unauthorized) => Kind::Denied,
            Self::Epic(EpicError::CloudConflict) => Kind::Conflict,
            Self::Failed
            | Self::Epic(EpicError::Network | EpicError::Http(408 | 429 | 500..=599))
            | Self::Vault(cloud_vault::Error::Stale) => Kind::Transient,
            Self::Unsupported | Self::Epic(EpicError::UnsupportedContent) => Kind::Unavailable,
            _ => Kind::Blocking,
        }
    }
    fn key(&self) -> String {
        self.to_string()
    }
    fn timed_out() -> Self {
        Self::Failed
    }
    fn conflict() -> Self {
        Self::Epic(EpicError::CloudConflict)
    }
    fn recovery() -> Self {
        Self::Recovery
    }
    fn unsupported() -> Self {
        Self::Unsupported
    }
    fn changed() -> Self {
        Self::Epic(EpicError::CloudConflict)
    }
}

impl<R: CloudRemote> Storefront for Adapter<R> {
    type Failure = Error;
    type Record = Context;
    type Link = ();
    type Remote<'a>
        = EpicRemote<'a, R>
    where
        Self: 'a;

    fn configuration(&self) -> &Configuration {
        &self.config
    }
    fn account(&self) -> &str {
        &self.account
    }
    fn record(&self) -> Option<&Context> {
        self.context.as_ref()
    }
    fn record_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Option<Context> {
        &mut self.context
    }
    /// Without saved rules, nothing tells where the saves live.
    fn offline(&self) -> bool {
        self.context.is_some()
    }
    fn retained(&mut self) -> Option<Vec<Manifest>> {
        self.kept = None;
        // A failed save can leave newer values in memory than on disk.
        let saved = match Context::load(&self.config, &self.account) {
            Ok(saved) => saved,
            Err(error) => {
                eprintln!("Epic Cloud context unreadable: {error}");
                return None;
            }
        };
        Some(
            saved
                .iter()
                .chain(self.context.iter())
                .filter_map(|context| context.pending.as_ref())
                .flat_map(|pending| match pending {
                    sync::Pending::Applying {
                        desired, remote, ..
                    } => vec![desired.clone(), remote.files.clone()],
                    pending => pending.files().cloned().into_iter().collect(),
                })
                .collect(),
        )
    }

    async fn connect(&mut self, _: &Arc<Control>) -> Result<()> {
        // The authenticated session, never a remembered account.
        if self.api.account_id().await? != self.account {
            return Err(Error::Session);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    async fn rules(&mut self, _: &mut (), vault: &mut Vault, _: bool) -> Result<Availability> {
        let rules = self
            .api
            .cloud_configuration(
                &self.config.namespace,
                &self.config.catalog_item_id,
                &self.config.app_name,
                self.config.platform,
            )
            .await?;
        let Some(rules) = rules else {
            return Ok(Availability::Unavailable(UnavailableReason::Unsupported));
        };
        if !supports_rules(
            &self.config,
            &self.account,
            &rules,
            vault,
            self.context.is_some(),
        )? {
            return Ok(Availability::Unavailable(UnavailableReason::Unsupported));
        }
        // Reinterpreting an existing account snapshot under new save rules can
        // turn unselected files into deletions. Require a dedicated conversion.
        if self
            .context
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|context| context.rules != rules)
        {
            return Err(Error::Unsupported);
        }
        let context = self.context.get_or_insert_with(|| Context {
            config: self.config.clone(),
            rules,
            account_id: self.account.clone(),
            pending: None,
            installation_removed: false,
        });
        record::rebind(context, self.config.clone());
        context.save()?;
        // Supported publisher rules activate Obelisk's Cloud policy. These are
        // not preferences read from Epic's official launcher; no such account
        // preference endpoint has been established for this protocol.
        vault.set_preferences(Preferences {
            account_enabled: Some(true),
            game_enabled: Some(true),
        });
        Ok(Availability::Available)
    }
    /// A revision-checked upload either landed or did not: a fresh view
    /// always decides again.
    async fn settle(&mut self, _: &mut (), _: &Vault) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(false)
    }
    fn reconciled(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }
    fn remote<'a>(&'a mut self, _: &'a mut (), control: &'a Control) -> Result<EpicRemote<'a, R>> {
        let context = self.context.as_ref().ok_or(Error::Recovery)?;
        Ok(EpicRemote {
            api: &self.api,
            game: CloudGame {
                namespace: &self.config.namespace,
                catalog_item_id: &self.config.catalog_item_id,
                app_name: &self.config.app_name,
            },
            rules: &context.rules,
            kept: &mut self.kept,
            unmanaged: None,
            control,
        })
    }
}

fn upload_files(
    vault: &Vault,
    rules: &CloudRules,
    remote: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
    local: &Manifest,
) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>> {
    let filters = rules.filters()?;
    let mut files = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut total = 0_u64;
    for (name, bytes) in remote {
        if !filters.accepts(&name)? {
            total = total
                .checked_add(bytes.len() as u64)
                .ok_or(Error::Unsupported)?;
            if bytes.len() > epic_kit::cloud::MAX_FILE_BYTES
                || total > epic_kit::cloud::MAX_TOTAL_BYTES as u64
            {
                return Err(Error::Unsupported);
            }
            files.insert(name, bytes);
        }
    }
    for (name, file) in &local.0 {
        if !filters.accepts(name)? {
            return Err(Error::Unsupported);
        }
        total = total.checked_add(file.size).ok_or(Error::Unsupported)?;
        if file.size > epic_kit::cloud::MAX_FILE_BYTES as u64
            || total > epic_kit::cloud::MAX_TOTAL_BYTES as u64
        {
            return Err(Error::Unsupported);
        }
        files.insert(name.clone(), vault.read_content(file)?);
    }
    if files.len() > epic_kit::cloud::MAX_FILES {
        return Err(Error::Unsupported);
    }
    Ok(files)
}

/// Cloud maintenance of one Epic game, run inside Obelisk with the UI's
/// authenticated client. `idle` proves no Epic launch or supervisor can
/// start while it runs.
pub async fn maintain(
    config: Configuration,
    api: Arc<EpicClient>,
    control: Arc<Control>,
    idle: &IdleGuard,
) -> Result<()> {
    maintain_with(config, api, control, &|id| idle.session_alive(id)).await
}

pub(crate) async fn maintain_with<R: CloudRemote>(
    config: Configuration,
    api: Arc<R>,
    control: Arc<Control>,
    alive: &SessionAlive<'_>,
) -> Result<()> {
    let account = api.account_id().await?;
    let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
    open(config, account, api, control, id)?
        .maintain(alive)
        .await
}

pub async fn archive(config: Configuration, api: &EpicClient) -> Result<()> {
    archive_with(config, api).await
}

async fn archive_with(config: Configuration, api: &impl CloudRemote) -> Result<()> {
    let account = api.account_id().await?;
    let (mut vault, saved) = record::locked::<Context>(&config, &account)?;
    let context = if let Some(saved) = saved {
        saved
    } else {
        let Some(rules) = api
            .cloud_configuration(
                &config.namespace,
                &config.catalog_item_id,
                &config.app_name,
                config.platform,
            )
            .await?
        else {
            if record::holds_saves(&vault, false) {
                return Err(Error::Unsupported);
            }
            return Ok(());
        };
        if !supports_rules(&config, &account, &rules, &vault, false)? {
            return Ok(());
        }
        Context {
            config: config.clone(),
            account_id: account,
            rules,
            pending: None,
            installation_removed: false,
        }
    };
    // Capture rehashes every save file. The caller shares one runtime with
    // downloads and the UI, so that work does not belong on it.
    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || record::archive(&mut vault, context, config))
        .await
        .map_err(|_| Error::Session)?
}

/// Whether Obelisk can follow `rules`. Rules it cannot follow leave a game
/// without Cloud, unless Obelisk holds its saves or `saved` says it has a
/// record.
fn supports_rules(
    config: &Configuration,
    account: &str,
    rules: &CloudRules,
    vault: &Vault,
    saved: bool,
) -> Result<bool> {
    match rules.resolve(
        &config.cloud_platform(),
        &config.install,
        account,
        &config.app_name,
    ) {
        Ok(_) => Ok(true),
        Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent) if !record::holds_saves(vault, saved) => Ok(false),
        Err(error) => Err(error.into()),
    }
}
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/epic/session/fake.rs`:

```rs
//! An in-memory Epic Cloud for session tests. It keeps one complete set,
//! bumps the revision on every upload, counts the files it is asked to read,
//! can fail the next calls and can change between a listing and its check.
use super::*;
use epic_kit::cloud::CloudListing;
use std::{
    collections::{BTreeSet, VecDeque},
    sync::Mutex,
};

pub(crate) struct FakeCloud {
    account: String,
    rules: Mutex<Option<CloudRules>>,
    state: Mutex<FakeState>,
}

struct FakeState {
    files: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
    uploads: usize,
    revision: u64,
    fetched: Vec<String>,
    failures: VecDeque<(Call, EpicError)>,
    /// Another device publishes this set before the next revision check.
    race: Option<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>>,
}

impl FakeState {
    fn listing(&self, account: &str) -> CloudListing {
        CloudListing::of(format!("r{}", self.revision), account.into(), &self.files)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Call {
    Configuration,
    List,
    Fetch,
    Upload,
}

impl FakeCloud {
    pub(crate) fn new(account: &str, rules: Option<CloudRules>) -> Arc<Self> {
        Arc::new(Self {
            account: account.into(),
            rules: Mutex::new(rules),
            state: Mutex::new(FakeState {
                files: BTreeMap::new(),
                uploads: 0,
                revision: 0,
                fetched: Vec::new(),
                failures: VecDeque::new(),
                race: None,
            }),
        })
    }

    /// Another device publishes this complete set.
    pub(crate) fn publish(&self, files: &[(&str, &[u8])]) {
        let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
        state.revision += 1;
        state.files = files
            .iter()
            .map(|(name, bytes)| ((*name).to_owned(), bytes.to_vec()))
            .collect();
    }

    /// Another device publishes this complete set while a read is under way.
    pub(crate) fn publish_during_read(&self, files: &[(&str, &[u8])]) {
        self.state.lock().unwrap().race = Some(
            files
                .iter()
                .map(|(name, bytes)| ((*name).to_owned(), bytes.to_vec()))
                .collect(),
        );
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_rules(&self, rules: Option<CloudRules>) {
        *self.rules.lock().unwrap() = rules;
    }

    pub(crate) fn fail_next(&self, call: Call, error: EpicError) {
        self.state.lock().unwrap().failures.push_back((call, error));
    }

    pub(crate) fn files(&self) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
        self.state.lock().unwrap().files.clone()
    }

    pub(crate) fn uploads(&self) -> usize {
        self.state.lock().unwrap().uploads
    }

    /// Every file read so far, in the order it was asked for.
    pub(crate) fn fetched(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        self.state.lock().unwrap().fetched.clone()
    }

    fn failure(&self, call: Call) -> std::result::Result<(), EpicError> {
        let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
        match state.failures.iter().position(|(next, _)| *next == call) {
            Some(index) => Err(state.failures.remove(index).unwrap().1),
            None => Ok(()),
        }
    }
}

impl CloudRemote for FakeCloud {
    async fn account_id(&self) -> std::result::Result<String, EpicError> {
        Ok(self.account.clone())
    }

    async fn cloud_configuration(
        &self,
        _namespace: &str,
        _catalog_item_id: &str,
        _app_name: &str,
        _platform: Platform,
    ) -> std::result::Result<Option<CloudRules>, EpicError> {
        self.failure(Call::Configuration)?;
        Ok(self.rules.lock().unwrap().clone())
    }

    async fn cloud_list(
        &self,
        _game: CloudGame<'_>,
        _cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> std::result::Result<CloudListing, EpicError> {
        self.failure(Call::List)?;
        Ok(self.state.lock().unwrap().listing(&self.account))
    }

    async fn cloud_revision(
        &self,
        _game: CloudGame<'_>,
        _listing: &CloudListing,
        _cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> std::result::Result<String, EpicError> {
        let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
        if let Some(files) = state.race.take() {
            state.files = files;
            state.revision += 1;
        }
        Ok(format!("r{}", state.revision))
    }

    async fn cloud_fetch(
        &self,
        _game: CloudGame<'_>,
        listing: &CloudListing,
        names: &BTreeSet<String>,
        _cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> std::result::Result<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>, EpicError> {
        self.failure(Call::Fetch)?;
        let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
        state.fetched.extend(names.iter().cloned());
        names
            .iter()
            .map(|name| {
                let bytes = state.files.get(name).ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
                if !listing.holds(name, bytes) {
                    return Err(EpicError::Integrity);
                }
                Ok((name.clone(), bytes.clone()))
            })
            .collect()
    }

    async fn cloud_upload(
        &self,
        _game: CloudGame<'_>,
        _rules: &CloudRules,
        files: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
        expected_revision: &str,
        _cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> std::result::Result<CloudListing, EpicError> {
        self.failure(Call::Upload)?;
        let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
        if format!("r{}", state.revision) != expected_revision {
            return Err(EpicError::CloudConflict);
        }
        state.revision += 1;
        state.uploads += 1;
        state.files = files.clone();
        Ok(state.listing(&self.account))
    }
}
```

```rs
//! The Epic Cloud service as a sync session uses it. Production passes the
//! authenticated `epic_kit` client; tests pass an in-memory store.
use super::*;
use crate::cloud::view::{self, Listed};
use epic_kit::cloud::CloudListing;
use std::{collections::BTreeSet, future::Future};

pub(crate) trait CloudRemote: Send + Sync + 'static {
    /// The account of the authenticated session, never a remembered one.
    fn account_id(&self) -> impl Future<Output = std::result::Result<String, EpicError>> + Send;

    fn cloud_configuration(
        &self,
        namespace: &str,
        catalog_item_id: &str,
        app_name: &str,
        platform: Platform,
    ) -> impl Future<Output = std::result::Result<Option<CloudRules>, EpicError>> + Send;

    /// The game's Cloud now: each file's name, size and hash.
    fn cloud_list(
        &self,
        game: CloudGame<'_>,
        cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> impl Future<Output = std::result::Result<CloudListing, EpicError>> + Send;

    /// The revision the game's Cloud has now, for `listing`'s account.
    fn cloud_revision(
        &self,
        game: CloudGame<'_>,
        listing: &CloudListing,
        cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> impl Future<Output = std::result::Result<String, EpicError>> + Send;

    /// Reads `names` of `listing`, each checked against its hash.
    fn cloud_fetch(
        &self,
        game: CloudGame<'_>,
        listing: &CloudListing,
        names: &BTreeSet<String>,
        cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> impl Future<Output = std::result::Result<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>, EpicError>> + Send;

    /// Publishes a complete set, then returns the listing its verified
    /// readback confirmed.
    fn cloud_upload(
        &self,
        game: CloudGame<'_>,
        rules: &CloudRules,
        files: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
        expected_revision: &str,
        cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> impl Future<Output = std::result::Result<CloudListing, EpicError>> + Send;
}

impl CloudRemote for EpicClient {
    async fn account_id(&self) -> std::result::Result<String, EpicError> {
        Ok(self.credentials().await?.account_id)
    }

    async fn cloud_configuration(
        &self,
        namespace: &str,
        catalog_item_id: &str,
        app_name: &str,
        platform: Platform,
    ) -> std::result::Result<Option<CloudRules>, EpicError> {
        EpicClient::cloud_configuration(self, namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name, platform).await
    }

    async fn cloud_list(
        &self,
        game: CloudGame<'_>,
        cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> std::result::Result<CloudListing, EpicError> {
        EpicClient::cloud_list(self, game, cancel).await
    }

    async fn cloud_revision(
        &self,
        game: CloudGame<'_>,
        listing: &CloudListing,
        cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> std::result::Result<String, EpicError> {
        EpicClient::cloud_revision(self, game, listing, cancel).await
    }

    async fn cloud_fetch(
        &self,
        game: CloudGame<'_>,
        listing: &CloudListing,
        names: &BTreeSet<String>,
        cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> std::result::Result<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>, EpicError> {
        EpicClient::cloud_fetch(self, game, listing, names, cancel).await
    }

    async fn cloud_upload(
        &self,
        game: CloudGame<'_>,
        rules: &CloudRules,
        files: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
        expected_revision: &str,
        cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> std::result::Result<CloudListing, EpicError> {
        EpicClient::cloud_upload(self, game, rules, files, expected_revision, cancel).await
    }
}

/// What the last view verified of the files Obelisk does not manage. An
/// upload republishes them.
pub(crate) struct Kept {
    revision: String,
    files: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
}

/// An EGS Cloud listing, split by the game's Cloud rules.
pub(crate) struct EpicListing {
    listing: CloudListing,
    /// The saves Obelisk manages, with their sizes.
    managed: Vec<(String, u64)>,
    unmanaged: BTreeSet<String>,
}

impl EpicListing {
    pub(super) fn new(listing: CloudListing, rules: &CloudRules) -> Result<Self> {
        let filters = rules.filters()?;
        let mut managed = Vec::new();
        let mut unmanaged = BTreeSet::new();
        for (name, size) in listing.files() {
            if filters.accepts(name)? {
                managed.push((name.to_owned(), size));
            } else {
                unmanaged.insert(name.to_owned());
            }
        }
        Ok(Self {
            listing,
            managed,
            unmanaged,
        })
    }
}

impl view::Listing for EpicListing {
    fn revision(&self) -> String {
        self.listing.revision().to_owned()
    }
    fn saves(&self) -> Vec<Listed<'_>> {
        self.managed
            .iter()
            .map(|(name, size)| Listed {
                name,
                size: *size,
                platforms: 2,
            })
            .collect()
    }
    fn holds(&self, name: &str, bytes: &[u8]) -> bool {
        self.listing.holds(name, bytes)
    }
}

/// EGS Cloud for one game and account, for one attempt.
pub(crate) struct EpicRemote<'a, R> {
    pub(super) api: &'a R,
    pub(super) game: CloudGame<'a>,
    pub(super) rules: &'a CloudRules,
    pub(super) kept: &'a mut Option<Kept>,
    /// Unmanaged files this remote's read fetched.
    pub(super) unmanaged: Option<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>>,
    pub(super) control: &'a Control,
}

impl<R: CloudRemote> view::Remote for EpicRemote<'_, R> {
    type Failure = Error;
    type Listing = EpicListing;
    const JOURNAL: &'static str = "epic-egs-cloud";

    async fn list(&mut self) -> Result<EpicListing> {
        let listing = self
            .api
            .cloud_list(self.game, self.control.cancellation())
            .await?;
        EpicListing::new(listing, self.rules)
    }
    async fn unchanged(&mut self, listing: &EpicListing) -> Result<bool> {
        let revision = self
            .api
            .cloud_revision(self.game, &listing.listing, self.control.cancellation())
            .await?;
        Ok(revision == listing.listing.revision())
    }
    /// Also reads the files Obelisk does not manage, under the same listing,
    /// for the next upload to republish.
    async fn fetch(
        &mut self,
        listing: &EpicListing,
        names: &[&str],
        mut receive: impl FnMut(&str, Vec<u8>) -> std::result::Result<(), cloud_vault::Error>,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let mut wanted: BTreeSet<String> = names.iter().map(|name| (*name).to_owned()).collect();
        wanted.extend(listing.unmanaged.iter().cloned());
        let mut unmanaged = BTreeMap::new();
        if !wanted.is_empty() {
            let files = self
                .api
                .cloud_fetch(
                    self.game,
                    &listing.listing,
                    &wanted,
                    self.control.cancellation(),
                )
                .await?;
            for (name, bytes) in files {
                if listing.unmanaged.contains(&name) {
                    unmanaged.insert(name, bytes);
                } else {
                    receive(&name, bytes)?;
                }
            }
        }
        self.unmanaged = Some(unmanaged);
        Ok(())
    }
    fn adopt(&mut self, listing: EpicListing, _: &RemoteView, _: &Vault) -> Result<()> {
        // A commit reads nothing: the next upload needs a fresh view.
        if let Some(files) = self.unmanaged.take() {
            *self.kept = Some(Kept {
                revision: listing.listing.revision().into(),
                files,
            });
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    async fn commit(
        &mut self,
        change: view::Change<'_, Error>,
    ) -> Result<view::Committed<EpicListing>> {
        let kept = self
            .kept
            .take()
            .filter(|kept| kept.revision == change.view().revision)
            .ok_or(Error::Recovery)?;
        // Retained remote bytes move into the upload set; the kept copy
        // would otherwise stay live alongside the packaged one.
        let files = upload_files(change.vault(), self.rules, kept.files, change.local())?;
        self.control.check()?;
        let (api, game, rules) = (self.api, self.game, self.rules);
        let cancel = self.control.cancellation();
        // Steam's confirming listing comes from its commit reply. EGS gives
        // no such receipt, so `cloud_upload` reads the whole published set
        // back and returns the listing that readback confirmed.
        change
            .send(
                || Ok(()),
                async || {
                    let listing = api
                        .cloud_upload(game, rules, &files, &kept.revision, cancel)
                        .await?;
                    EpicListing::new(listing, rules)
                },
            )
            .await
    }
}
```

```rs
use super::*;
use crate::cloud::record;
pub(super) use crate::cloud::sync::Pending;
use crate::cloud::sync::Work;
use crate::files::safe_storage_path;
use cloud_vault::{AccountIdentity, Bindings, SelectedFile, StoreScope, journal};
use std::{collections::BTreeSet, fs, os::unix::fs::MetadataExt, path::Path};

/// An Epic game's Cloud record, `epic-context.json`.
#[derive(Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub(crate) struct Context {
    pub config: Configuration,
    pub rules: CloudRules,
    pub account_id: String,
    pub pending: Option<Pending>,
    pub installation_removed: bool,
}

impl Context {
    pub fn path(config: &Configuration, account: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
        config.validate(account)?;
        let path = StoreScope::from(config.scope(account))
            .directory(&config.root)?
            .join(Self::FILE);
        safe_storage_path(&path)?;
        Ok(path)
    }
    pub fn validate(&self, config: &Configuration, account: &str) -> Result<()> {
        self.config.validate(account)?;
        // A moved installation keeps its saves: only the game's identity binds.
        if self.account_id != account
            || self.config.root != config.root
            || self.config.home != config.home
            || self.config.namespace != config.namespace
            || self.config.app_name != config.app_name
            || self.config.catalog_item_id != config.catalog_item_id
            || self.config.session_directory != config.session_directory
        {
            return Err(Error::Storage);
        }
        if let Some(pending) = self.pending.as_ref().and_then(Pending::files) {
            pending.validate()?;
        }
        if let Some(Pending::Applying { remote, .. }) = &self.pending {
            remote.validate()?;
        }
        self.resolve()?;
        Ok(())
    }
    pub fn resolve(&self) -> Result<ResolvedCloudRules> {
        Ok(self.rules.resolve(
            &self.config.cloud_platform(),
            &self.config.install,
            &self.account_id,
            &self.config.app_name,
        )?)
    }
}

impl record::Record for Context {
    type Failure = Error;
    type Configuration = Configuration;
    type Account = str;
    const FILE: &'static str = "epic-context.json";

    fn identity(account: &str) -> AccountIdentity {
        account.into()
    }
    fn scope(config: &Configuration, account: &str) -> Result<StoreScope> {
        Self::path(config, account)?;
        Ok(config.scope(account).into())
    }
    fn load(config: &Configuration, account: &str) -> Result<Option<Self>> {
        let context: Option<Self> = journal::read(&Self::path(config, account)?)?;
        if let Some(context) = &context {
            context.validate(config, account)?;
        }
        Ok(context)
    }
    fn save(&self) -> Result<()> {
        self.validate(&self.config, &self.account_id)?;
        journal::write(&Self::path(&self.config, &self.account_id)?, self)?;
        Ok(())
    }
    fn check(&self) -> Result<()> {
        self.validate(&self.config, &self.account_id)
    }
    fn account(&self) -> &str {
        &self.account_id
    }
    fn configuration(&self) -> &Configuration {
        &self.config
    }
    fn configuration_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Configuration {
        &mut self.config
    }
    fn work(&self) -> Work {
        Work {
            pending: self.pending.clone(),
            installation_removed: self.installation_removed,
        }
    }
    fn set_work(&mut self, work: Work) {
        self.pending = work.pending;
        self.installation_removed = work.installation_removed;
    }
    fn bindings(
        &mut self,
        vault: &Vault,
        remote: Option<&Manifest>,
        create: bool,
    ) -> Result<Bindings> {
        bindings(self, vault, remote, create)
    }
}

/// Discover names before ownership activation without reading another account's bytes.
fn local_names(rules: &ResolvedCloudRules) -> Result<BTreeSet<String>> {
    rules.check_directory()?;
    let mut names = BTreeSet::new();
    if !rules.directory.exists() {
        return Ok(names);
    }
    let mut pending = vec![rules.directory.clone()];
    let mut visited = 0;
    while let Some(directory) = pending.pop() {
        for entry in fs::read_dir(directory)? {
            visited += 1;
            if visited > epic_kit::cloud::MAX_FILES * 4 {
                return Err(Error::Unsupported);
            }
            let entry = entry?;
            let path = entry.path();
            let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(&path)?;
            if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
                return Err(Error::Storage);
            }
            if metadata.is_dir() {
                pending.push(path);
                continue;
            }
            if !metadata.is_file() || metadata.nlink() != 1 {
                return Err(Error::Storage);
            }
            let relative = path
                .strip_prefix(&rules.directory)
                .map_err(|_| Error::Storage)?
                .to_str()
                .ok_or(Error::Unsupported)?;
            if rules.accepts(relative)? {
                if metadata.len() > epic_kit::cloud::MAX_FILE_BYTES as u64
                    || names.len() >= epic_kit::cloud::MAX_FILES
                {
                    return Err(Error::Unsupported);
                }
                names.insert(relative.to_owned());
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(names)
}

/// Bind the complete union, including deleted local and newly downloaded names.
/// The caller decides whether absent install paths may be created.
pub(super) fn bindings(
    context: &Context,
    vault: &Vault,
    remote: Option<&Manifest>,
    create: bool,
) -> Result<Bindings> {
    let rules = context.resolve()?;
    let mut names = local_names(&rules)?;
    for files in [
        vault.local(),
        context.pending.as_ref().and_then(Pending::files),
        vault.pending().map(|p| &p.desired),
        remote,
    ]
    .into_iter()
    .flatten()
    {
        for name in files.0.keys() {
            if !rules.accepts(name)? {
                return Err(Error::Unsupported);
            }
            names.insert(name.clone());
        }
    }
    if names.len() > epic_kit::cloud::MAX_FILES {
        return Err(Error::Unsupported);
    }
    let mut output = Bindings::new();
    for name in names {
        if !rules.accepts(&name)? {
            return Err(Error::Unsupported);
        }
        rules.check_directory()?;
        let path = obelisk_core::install::checked_file_path(&rules.directory, Path::new(&name))
            .map_err(epic_kit::EpicError::from)?;
        if create {
            ensure_parent(path.parent().ok_or(Error::Storage)?)?;
        }
        output.insert(name, SelectedFile { path, platforms: 2 });
    }
    rules.check_directory()?;
    Ok(output)
}

fn ensure_parent(path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
    safe_storage_path(path)?;
    let mut missing = Vec::new();
    let mut current = path;
    loop {
        match fs::symlink_metadata(current) {
            Ok(metadata) if metadata.is_dir() && !metadata.file_type().is_symlink() => break,
            Ok(_) => return Err(Error::Storage),
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
                missing.push(current.to_path_buf());
                current = current.parent().ok_or(Error::Storage)?;
            }
            Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
        }
    }
    for directory in missing.into_iter().rev() {
        safe_storage_path(&directory)?;
        match fs::create_dir(&directory) {
            Ok(()) => (),
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => (),
            Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
        }
        let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(&directory)?;
        if !metadata.is_dir() || metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
            return Err(Error::Storage);
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

```rs
//! EGS Cloud behind the Cloud sync: the shared suites over an in-memory Epic
//! Cloud, and what only Epic has: its listing filters, size limits, the files
//! it republishes and changed Cloud rules.
use super::fake::{Call, FakeCloud};

/// The game's saves: in the Mac home, or in a Windows build's profile.
pub(crate) fn rules() -> CloudRules {

pub(crate) struct EpicGame {

impl Harness for EpicGame {
    type Store = Adapter<FakeCloud>;
    const NO_RULES: UnavailableReason = UnavailableReason::Unsupported;

    fn game() -> Self {
        let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let root = temporary.path().to_path_buf();
        let home = root.join("home");
        let config = Configuration {
            root: root.join("archive"),
            install: home.join("Game"),
            session_directory: root.join("sessions"),
            helper: root.join("helper"),
            home,
            namespace: "namespace".into(),
            catalog_item_id: "catalog".into(),
            app_name: "game".into(),
            platform: Platform::Mac,
            language: "en".into(),
            title: String::new(),
            prefix: None,
        };
        for directory in [
            config.home.join("Saves"),
            config.install.clone(),
            config.session_directory.clone(),
        ] {
            fs::create_dir_all(directory).unwrap();
        }
        Self {
            control: Arc::new(Control::new(|_| {})),
            cloud: FakeCloud::new(ACCOUNT, Some(rules())),
            config,
            _temporary: temporary,
        }
    }
    fn control(&self) -> &Arc<Control> {
        &self.control
    }
    fn open(&self) -> Session<FakeCloud> {
        open(
            self.config.clone(),
            ACCOUNT.into(),
            Arc::clone(&self.cloud),
            Arc::clone(&self.control),
            uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
        )
        .unwrap()
    }
    fn save(&self) -> PathBuf {
        match &self.config.prefix {
            Some(prefix) => crate::wine::profile(prefix).join("AppData/Local/Game/slot.sav"),
            None => self.config.home.join("Saves").join("slot.sav"),
        }
    }
    fn slot(&self) -> &'static str {
        "slot.sav"
    }
    fn install(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.config.install.clone()
    }
    fn publish(&self, bytes: &[u8]) {
        self.cloud.publish(&[("slot.sav", bytes)]);
    }
    fn cloud(&self) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
        self.cloud.files().get("slot.sav").cloned()
    }
    fn uploads(&self) -> usize {
        self.cloud.uploads()
    }
    fn fail_next(&self, transient: bool) {
        self.cloud.fail_next(
            Call::List,
            if transient {
                EpicError::Network
            } else {
                EpicError::UnsupportedContent
            },
        );
    }
    fn failure_key(&self) -> String {
        Error::Epic(EpicError::UnsupportedContent).to_string()
    }
    fn set_rules(&self, available: bool) {
        self.cloud.set_rules(available.then(rules));
    }
    fn run_in(&mut self, prefix: &Path) {
        self.config.platform = Platform::Windows;
        self.config.prefix = Some(prefix.to_owned());
        fs::create_dir_all(Harness::save(self).parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
    }
    async fn archive(&self) -> Result<()> {
        archive_with(self.config.clone(), self.cloud.as_ref()).await
    }
    async fn maintain(&self, alive: &SessionAlive<'_>) -> Result<()> {
        let control = Arc::clone(&self.control);
        maintain_with(self.config.clone(), Arc::clone(&self.cloud), control, alive).await
    }
    fn configuration(&self) -> Configuration {
        self.config.clone()
    }
    fn account_id(&self) -> &str {
        ACCOUNT
    }
    fn root(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.config.root.clone()
    }
    fn scope(&self) -> StoreScope {
        self.config.scope(ACCOUNT).into()
    }
    fn account(&self) -> AccountIdentity {
        ACCOUNT.into()
    }
}

fn fixture() -> (tempfile::TempDir, Vault, Context) {
    let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let root = temporary.path();
    let home = root.join("home");
    let install = home.join("Game");
    let session_directory = root.join("sessions");
    for directory in [
        home.join("Saves"),
        install.clone(),
        session_directory.clone(),
    ] {
        fs::create_dir_all(directory).unwrap();
    }
    let config = Configuration {
        root: root.join("archive"),
        home,
        install,
        session_directory,
        helper: root.join("helper"),
        namespace: "namespace".into(),
        catalog_item_id: "catalog".into(),
        app_name: "game".into(),
        platform: Platform::Mac,
        language: "en".into(),
        title: String::new(),
        prefix: None,
    };
    let mut vault = Vault::open(&config.root, config.scope(ACCOUNT)).unwrap();
    vault.set_preferences(Preferences {
        account_enabled: Some(true),
        game_enabled: Some(true),
    });
    let context = Context {
        config,
        account_id: ACCOUNT.into(),
        rules: CloudRules {
            cloud_save_folder: None,
            cloud_save_folder_mac: Some("{Home}/Saves".into()),
            include: vec!["*.sav".into()],
            exclude: vec!["excluded.sav".into()],
        },
        pending: None,
        installation_removed: false,
    };
    context.save().unwrap();
    (temporary, vault, context)
}
fn staged(vault: &Vault, name: &str, bytes: &[u8]) -> Manifest {
    Manifest([(name.to_owned(), vault.stage(bytes, 2).unwrap())].into())
}

#[test]
fn uploads_preserve_excluded_remote_bytes_and_apply_managed_deletions() {
    let (_temporary, vault, context) = fixture();
    let remote: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> = [
        ("deleted.sav".into(), b"old save".to_vec()),
        ("excluded.sav".into(), b"other platform".to_vec()),
        ("settings.ini".into(), b"foreign config".to_vec()),
    ]
    .into();
    let listing = epic_kit::cloud::CloudListing::of("original".into(), ACCOUNT.into(), &remote);
    let managed = EpicListing::new(listing, &context.rules).unwrap();
    let saves: Vec<_> = managed.saves().into_iter().map(|save| save.name).collect();
    assert_eq!(saves, ["deleted.sav"]);
    let local = staged(&vault, "new.sav", b"new bytes");
    let upload = upload_files(&vault, &context.rules, remote.clone(), &local).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(upload["excluded.sav"], b"other platform");
    assert_eq!(upload["settings.ini"], b"foreign config");
    assert_eq!(upload["new.sav"], b"new bytes");
    assert!(!upload.contains_key("deleted.sav"));
    let excluded = staged(&vault, "excluded.sav", b"wrong local selection");
    assert!(matches!(
        upload_files(&vault, &context.rules, remote, &excluded),
        Err(Error::Unsupported)
    ));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_second_sync_with_equal_saves_fetches_nothing() {
    let game = EpicGame::game();
    synced(&game, b"progress").await;
    let first = game.cloud.fetched();
    game.open().prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(game.cloud.fetched(), first);

    // A newer Cloud save is read once, then stands in from the archive.
    game.cloud.publish(&[("slot.sav", b"cloud progress")]);
    game.open().prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();
    game.open().prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();

    assert_eq!(game.cloud.fetched()[first.len()..], ["slot.sav"]);
    assert_eq!(fs::read(Harness::save(&game)).unwrap(), b"cloud progress");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_cloud_that_changes_during_a_read_refuses_the_view_as_a_conflict() {
    let game = EpicGame::game();
    game.cloud.publish(&[("slot.sav", b"progress")]);
    game.cloud
        .publish_during_read(&[("slot.sav", b"other device")]);
    let mut adapter = Adapter {
        config: game.config.clone(),
        account: ACCOUNT.into(),
        api: Arc::clone(&game.cloud),
        context: None,
        kept: None,
    };
    let (mut vault, _) = record::locked::<Context>(&game.config, ACCOUNT).unwrap();
    adapter.connect(&game.control).await.unwrap();
    adapter.rules(&mut (), &mut vault, true).await.unwrap();

    let read = Views::default()
        .read(
            &mut adapter.remote(&mut (), &game.control).unwrap(),
            &vault,
            &game.control,
        )
        .await;

    assert!(matches!(read, Err(Error::Epic(EpicError::CloudConflict))));
    assert!(adapter.kept.is_none());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn unmanaged_cloud_files_are_read_with_the_view_and_republished() {
    let game = EpicGame::game();
    fs::write(Harness::save(&game), b"progress").unwrap();
    game.cloud
        .publish(&[("slot.sav", b"progress"), ("settings.ini", b"other device")]);
    let mut sync = game.open();
    sync.prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();
    let first = game.cloud.fetched();
    assert!(first.iter().any(|name| name == "settings.ini"));
    sync.started().unwrap();
    fs::write(Harness::save(&game), b"new progress").unwrap();
    sync.finished(true).await;

    assert_eq!(game.cloud.uploads(), 1);
    assert_eq!(
        game.cloud.files(),
        BTreeMap::from([
            ("settings.ini".into(), b"other device".to_vec()),
            ("slot.sav".into(), b"new progress".to_vec()),
        ])
    );
    // The exit sync read them again under its own listing.
    assert_eq!(game.cloud.fetched()[first.len()..], ["settings.ini"]);
}

#[test]
fn a_game_without_a_cloud_record_records_its_removal_even_behind_a_symbolic_link() {
    let game = EpicGame::game();
    // The Cloud archive refuses a path through a symbolic link, but this
    // game never gave it saves to keep.
    let linked = game.config.home.with_file_name("linked");
    std::os::unix::fs::symlink(&game.config.home, &linked).unwrap();
    let config = Configuration {
        install: linked.join("Game"),
        ..game.config.clone()
    };
    fs::remove_dir_all(&game.config.install).unwrap();

    record::removed::<Context>(&config, ACCOUNT).unwrap();

    assert!(Context::load(&config, ACCOUNT).unwrap().is_none());
}

#[test]
fn archive_errors_name_the_storefront_that_holds_the_saves() {
    assert!(matches!(Error::from(cloud_vault::Error::Busy), Error::Busy));
    let shared = Error::from(cloud_vault::Error::OtherStoreBusy);
    assert_eq!(shared.to_string(), "backend.cloud.sharedSavesInUse");
    assert_eq!(
        Error::from(cloud_vault::Error::Stale).to_string(),
        "backend.epic.cloud.storage"
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/epic/windows.rs`:

```rs
//! A Windows Epic build: Wine starts it in its installation's prefix, once the
//! prefix ran the prerequisite the installation's manifest names.
use super::{Configuration, Result};
use crate::wine;
use std::path::Path;

/// Readies a Windows build for its Game session in `windows`, its
/// installation's prefix, with the prerequisite the build names. This runs
/// before any short-lived game credential exists, since a prerequisite may
/// take minutes.
pub(super) fn ready(
    windows: &wine::Installation,
    config: &Configuration,
    locations: &crate::Locations,
) -> Result<wine::Config> {
    let installed = epic_kit::client::installed_launch(
        &config.namespace,
        &config.catalog_item_id,
        &config.app_name,
        config.platform,
        &config.install,
    )?;
    let prefix = Prefix {
        install: &config.install,
        prerequisite: installed.prerequisite.as_ref(),
    };
    Ok(windows.ready(locations, &installed.target, &prefix)?)
}

/// What Epic adds to the prefix of the installation in `install`.
pub(super) struct Prefix<'a> {
    install: &'a Path,
    prerequisite: Option<&'a epic_kit::client::Prerequisite>,
}

impl wine::Storefront for Prefix<'_> {
    /// The program the manifest names to run before its game first starts,
    /// unless it leaves the installation.
    fn prerequisites(&self) -> std::result::Result<Vec<wine::Prerequisite>, crate::Error> {
        let Some(prerequisite) = self.prerequisite else {
            return Ok(Vec::new());
        };
        let relative = prerequisite.path.replace('\\', "/");
        let relative = Path::new(&relative);
        let inside = relative
            .components()
            .all(|component| matches!(component, std::path::Component::Normal(_)));
        if !inside {
            return Ok(Vec::new());
        }
        let id = if prerequisite.ids.is_empty() {
            relative.to_string_lossy().into_owned()
        } else {
            prerequisite.ids.join(",")
        };
        Ok(vec![wine::Prerequisite {
            id: format!("epic:{id}"),
            programs: vec![(self.install.join(relative), prerequisite.arguments.clone())],
        }])
    }
}
```

```rs
/// A completed Windows installation whose receipt names `executable` and
/// `prerequisite`.
fn install(
    config: &Configuration,
    executable: &[u8],
    prerequisite: Option<epic_kit::client::Prerequisite>,
) {
    fs::create_dir_all(config.install.join("Binaries")).unwrap();
    fs::write(config.install.join("Binaries/Game.exe"), executable).unwrap();
    let receipt = epic_kit::client::Installation {
        app_name: config.app_name.clone(),
        namespace: config.namespace.clone(),
        catalog_item_id: config.catalog_item_id.clone(),
        account_id: "account".into(),
        directory: config.install.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        platform: config.platform,
        total_bytes: 1,
        build_version: "1.0".into(),
        launch_executable: "Binaries/Game.exe".into(),
        launch_command: String::new(),
        deployment_id: None,
        prerequisite,
    };
    fs::write(
        config.install.join(obelisk_core::install::RECEIPT_FILE),
        serde_json::to_vec(&receipt).unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap();
}

fn prerequisite(ids: &[&str], path: &str) -> epic_kit::client::Prerequisite {
    epic_kit::client::Prerequisite {
        ids: ids.iter().map(|id| (*id).into()).collect(),
        name: "Prerequisites".into(),
        path: path.into(),
        arguments: "/quiet /norestart".into(),
    }
}

#[test]
fn an_epic_prerequisite_runs_unless_it_leaves_the_installation() {
    use wine::Storefront;
    let install = Path::new("/games/epic");
    let listed = |prerequisite: Option<&epic_kit::client::Prerequisite>| {
        Prefix {
            install,
            prerequisite,
        }
        .prerequisites()
        .unwrap()
    };

    assert_eq!(
        listed(Some(&prerequisite(
            &["a", "b"],
            "Redist\\DirectX\\setup.exe"
        ))),
        [wine::Prerequisite {
            id: "epic:a,b".into(),
            programs: vec![(
                install.join("Redist/DirectX/setup.exe"),
                "/quiet /norestart".into()
            )],
        }]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        listed(Some(&prerequisite(&[], "Redist/setup.exe")))[0].id,
        "epic:Redist/setup.exe"
    );
    // Visual C++ and Unreal's prerequisites install as under Proton.
    assert_eq!(
        listed(Some(&prerequisite(
            &["ue"],
            "Engine\\Extras\\Redist\\en-us\\UEPrereqSetup_x64.exe"
        )))[0]
            .programs,
        [(
            install.join("Engine/Extras/Redist/en-us/UEPrereqSetup_x64.exe"),
            "/quiet /norestart".into()
        )]
    );
    for path in ["..\\outside.exe", "/Applications/setup.exe"] {
        assert!(
            listed(Some(&prerequisite(&["a"], path))).is_empty(),
            "{path}"
        );
    }
    assert!(listed(None).is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn a_windows_build_readies_its_prefix_with_its_prerequisite_before_any_credential() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();

    .unwrap();

            "wineboot --init".to_owned(),
            format!(
                "{} /quiet /norestart",
                config.install.join("Redist/setup.exe").display()
            ),
        ]
    );
}
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/files.rs`:

```rs
use crate::{Config, Error};
use std::{
    fs,
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
};

pub(crate) struct Prepared {
    pub directory: PathBuf,
    pub run_directory: PathBuf,
    pub profile: PathBuf,
    pub report: PathBuf,
    pub endpoints: [(String, String); 2],
    pub storage: Option<crate::NativeStorage>,
}
impl Drop for Prepared {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&self.run_directory);
    }
}
impl Prepared {
    pub fn home(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.storage
            .as_ref()
            .map_or_else(|| self.run_directory.join("home"), |s| s.home.clone())
    }
    pub fn enable_storage(&mut self, storage: &crate::NativeStorage) -> Result<(), Error> {
        safe_storage_path(&storage.home).map_err(|error| Error::Cloud(error.into()))?;
        let steam = storage.steam_directory();
        let app = storage.cache_directory();
        for path in [app.join("remote"), steam.join("appcache")] {
            safe_storage_path(&path).map_err(|error| Error::Cloud(error.into()))?;
            private_directory(&path)?;
        }
        // The coordinator must publish a complete local projection before a
        // native host starts. Validate it without loading the game's SDK. SDK
        // quota/readback readiness now belongs to the game's own attachment.
        crate::native_cache_files(app.clone(), storage.app_id, storage.platforms)?;
        use std::io::Write;
        let extra = format!(
            "\n(allow file-read* (subpath {}))\n(allow file-write* (subpath {}) (subpath {}))\n",
            quote(&storage.home)?,
            quote(&app)?,
            quote(&steam.join("appcache"))?
        );
        fs::OpenOptions::new()
            .append(true)
            .open(&self.profile)?
            .write_all(extra.as_bytes())?;
        self.storage = Some(storage.clone());
        Ok(())
    }
    pub fn consumer_environment(&self, service: &str) -> std::collections::HashMap<String, String> {
        let mut environment: std::collections::HashMap<_, _> =
            self.endpoints.iter().cloned().collect();
        environment.insert(
            "DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES".into(),
            self.directory
                .join(crate::package::ADAPTER)
                .to_string_lossy()
                .into_owned(),
        );
        environment.insert("OBELISK_PRIVATE_STEAM_DISCOVERY".into(), service.into());
        environment
    }
}
pub(crate) fn private_directory(path: &Path) -> Result<(), Error> {
    fs::create_dir_all(path)?;
    if !fs::symlink_metadata(path)?.file_type().is_dir() {
        return Err(Error::Storage);
    }
    #[cfg(unix)]
    {
        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
        fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700))?;
    }
    Ok(())
}
/// Refuses a path for Cloud storage that is relative, climbs out with `..`,
/// or passes through a symbolic link other than macOS's /var and /tmp.
pub(crate) fn safe_storage_path(path: &Path) -> cloud_vault::Result<()> {
    if !path.is_absolute()
        || path
            .components()
            .any(|c| matches!(c, std::path::Component::ParentDir))
    {
        return Err(cloud_vault::Error::Invalid);
    }
    for parent in path.ancestors() {
        match fs::symlink_metadata(parent) {
            Ok(m)
                if m.file_type().is_symlink()
                    && ![Path::new("/var"), Path::new("/tmp")].contains(&parent) =>
            {
                return Err(cloud_vault::Error::Invalid);
            }
            Ok(_) => {}
            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
            Err(e) => return Err(e.into()),
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
/// Writes `bytes` to a file named `name` in a new folder inside `parent`
/// that only this user opens, whose name starts with `prefix`. The folder
/// lives as long as the returned TempDir.
pub(crate) fn private_temp_file(
    parent: &Path,
    prefix: &str,
    name: &str,
    bytes: &[u8],
) -> std::io::Result<(tempfile::TempDir, PathBuf)> {
    use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
    let directory = tempfile::Builder::new()
        .prefix(prefix)
        .permissions(fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700))
        .tempdir_in(parent)?;
    let path = directory.path().join(name);
    obelisk_core::write_atomic(&path, bytes)?;
    Ok((directory, path))
}
pub(crate) fn prepare(
    config: &Config,
    cancelled: &std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool,
) -> Result<Prepared, Error> {
    if config.wine.is_none() && !config.steam_api.as_deref().is_some_and(Path::is_file) {
        return Err(Error::Unavailable);
    }
    let directory = crate::package::prepare(config, cancelled)?;
    let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4();
    let run_directory = config.cache.join(format!("{}{id}", crate::package::LAUNCH));
    crate::package::remove_stale(&config.cache, &directory, &run_directory);
    let listeners = [
        std::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0")?,
        std::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0")?,
    ];
    // Refuse an unsupported or malformed SDK library before anything is written.
    // The selected slice itself is owned by Launch, which the supervisor reads.
    if let Some(library) = &config.steam_api {
        crate::supervisor::architecture::Architecture::preferred(library)?;
    }
    let prepared = Prepared {
        storage: None,
        directory,
        profile: run_directory.join("host.sb"),
        report: crate::diagnostics::launch_report(&config.diagnostics, config.app_id, id),
        run_directory,
        endpoints: [
            (
                "Steam3Master".into(),
                listeners[0].local_addr()?.to_string(),
            ),
            (
                "SteamClientService".into(),
                listeners[1].local_addr()?.to_string(),
            ),
        ],
    };
    let run_directory = &prepared.run_directory;
    private_directory(run_directory)?;
    private_directory(&run_directory.join("home"))?;
    private_directory(&run_directory.join("tmp"))?;
    private_directory(&config.diagnostics)?;
    fs::write(&prepared.profile, sandbox(config, &prepared.directory)?)?;
    Ok(prepared)
}
fn quote(path: &Path) -> Result<String, Error> {
    serde_json::to_string(path.to_str().ok_or(Error::Storage)?).map_err(|_| Error::Storage)
}
fn sandbox(config: &Config, directory: &Path) -> Result<String, Error> {
    let mut profile = format!(
        "(version 1)\n(allow default)\n(deny file-write*)\n(allow file-write* (literal \"/dev/null\"))\n(deny file-read* (subpath {}) (subpath {}))\n(deny process-exec)\n(allow process-exec (literal {}))\n(deny mach-lookup (global-name-regex \".*[Ss]team.*\") (global-name \"com.apple.coreservices.launchservicesd\") (global-name \"com.apple.lsd.mapdb\"))\n",
        quote(&config.home.join("Library/Application Support/Steam"))?,
        quote(
            &config
                .home
                .join("Library/Application Support/com.zagrios.obelisk")
        )?,
        quote(&directory.join(crate::package::HOST))?
    );
    // A fresh, read-only native generation cannot inspect the ordinary saves
    // owned by Rust. Permit only the pinned runtime under the real home. The
    // native host never receives root-0 API storage or any save projection.
    profile.push_str(&format!(
        "(deny file-read* (subpath {}))\n(allow file-read* (subpath {}))\n",
        quote(&config.home)?,
        quote(directory)?
    ));
    // realpath on the host executable needs metadata for each ancestor. Grant
    // those exact directories, without granting enumeration or save contents.
    for ancestor in directory.ancestors().skip(1) {
        profile.push_str(&format!(
            "(allow file-read-metadata (literal {}))\n",
            quote(ancestor)?
        ));
    }
    for root in &config.cloud_save_roots {
        profile.push_str(&format!("(deny file-read* (subpath {}))\n", quote(root)?));
    }
    Ok(profile)
}
/// Replaces `path` atomically without fsync: diagnostics need no durability,
/// unlike [`obelisk_core::write_atomic`].
fn atomic_write(
    path: &Path,
    write: impl FnOnce(&mut std::fs::File) -> Result<(), Error>,
) -> Result<(), Error> {
    let mut temporary = tempfile::NamedTempFile::new_in(path.parent().ok_or(Error::Storage)?)?;
    write(temporary.as_file_mut())?;
    temporary.persist(path).map_err(|_| Error::Storage)?;
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn report(path: &Path, proof: &crate::Proof) -> Result<(), Error> {
    atomic_write(path, |file| {
        serde_json::to_writer_pretty(file, proof).map_err(|_| Error::Storage)
    })
}
pub(crate) fn failure_report(
    config: &Config,
    error: &Error,
    events: &[crate::protocol::Event],
) -> Result<(), Error> {
    private_directory(&config.diagnostics)?;
    let path = crate::diagnostics::failure_report(
        &config.diagnostics,
        config.app_id,
        uuid::Uuid::new_v4(),
    );
    let report =
        serde_json::json!({"app_id": config.app_id, "error": error.to_string(), "events": events});
    fs::write(
        path,
        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&report).map_err(|_| Error::Storage)?,
    )?;
    Ok(())
}
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/games_folder.rs`:

```rs
//! Where Obelisk installs games: one folder, Obelisk's own inside its library
//! until the player chooses another, such as one on an external disk. Each
//! storefront keeps its games in its own folder inside it. Choosing another
//! queues the move of every installation outside it, one game at a time in
//! the download queue, and points the new installations still waiting there.
//! An installation whose disk is not connected shows as not installed until
//! the disk comes back.
use crate::supervisor::plain_absolute;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::{
    fs, io,
    os::unix::fs::MetadataExt,
    path::{Component, Path, PathBuf},
    sync::{Arc, Mutex, Weak},
};
use tokio::sync::watch;

/// Obelisk's own games folder, inside its library.
const DEFAULT_DIRECTORY: &str = "Games";
/// The folder Obelisk makes inside the one the player chooses.
pub const CHOSEN_DIRECTORY: &str = "Obelisk Games";
/// The player's games folder, inside Obelisk's library; absent for its own.
const FILE: &str = "games-folder.json";

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct Saved {
    path: PathBuf,
}

/// Where new installations go, as the player sees it. `revision` grows with
/// every change.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct View {
    pub revision: u64,
    pub path: PathBuf,
    /// Obelisk's own folder, inside its library.
    pub default: bool,
    /// Its disk is there: Obelisk's own folder always is.
    pub connected: bool,
}

/// `path` as the player sees it, at `revision`: Obelisk's own folder when it
/// is `default`.
fn view(path: PathBuf, default: &Path, revision: u64) -> View {
    let default = path == default;
    View {
        revision,
        connected: default || path.is_dir(),
        default,
        path,
    }
}

/// What choosing a folder would do.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Candidate {
    /// The games folder it gives: the chosen folder's own, else one made
    /// inside it.
    pub path: PathBuf,
    /// The connected installations outside it, which move into it.
    pub games: u32,
    /// What those of another disk copy there; the others only change their
    /// place.
    pub copied_bytes: u64,
}

/// Why a folder cannot hold the games.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Refusal {
    /// It is not an existing folder.
    Missing,
    /// It is inside Obelisk's library, or inside a game's installation.
    Inside,
}

/// An account's installations, as the games folder moves and finds them.
pub(crate) trait Resident: Send + Sync {
    /// The connected installations' folders, with their bytes.
    fn installations(&self) -> Vec<(PathBuf, u64)>;
    /// Queues the move into `folder` of each installation outside it, and
    /// points the new installations still waiting there.
    fn gather(self: Arc<Self>, folder: &Path);
    /// Hides the installations whose disk left, and shows those whose disk
    /// came back.
    fn refresh(&self);
}

/// Obelisk's games folder, which every account's installations share.
pub struct GamesFolder {
    library: PathBuf,
    published: watch::Sender<View>,
    residents: Mutex<Vec<Weak<dyn Resident>>>,
}

impl GamesFolder {
    /// The games folder of Obelisk's `library`, as the player last chose it.
    pub fn new(library: &Path) -> Arc<Self> {
        // Installations name their canonical folder.
        let library = library
            .canonicalize()
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| library.to_owned());
        let default = library.join(DEFAULT_DIRECTORY);
        let path = fs::read(library.join(FILE))
            .ok()
            .and_then(|bytes| serde_json::from_slice::<Saved>(&bytes).ok())
            .map(|saved| saved.path)
            .filter(|path| plain_absolute(path) && *path != default)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| default.clone());
        // A disk that sleeps wakes slowly: Obelisk's start does not wait.
        let games = path.clone();
        std::thread::spawn(move || clear_staging(&games));
        Arc::new(Self {
            library,
            published: watch::channel(view(path, &default, 1)).0,
            residents: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
        })
    }

    pub fn view(&self) -> View {
        self.published.borrow().clone()
    }

    /// Obelisk's library, which holds its own games folder.
    pub fn library(&self) -> &Path {
        &self.library
    }

    /// Waits for a revision newer than `after`, or returns at once.
    pub async fn changed(&self, after: u64) -> View {
        let mut receiver = self.published.subscribe();
        let _ = receiver.wait_for(|view| view.revision > after).await;
        receiver.borrow().clone()
    }

    /// Where new installations go.
    pub fn path(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.published.borrow().path.clone()
    }

    /// Whether new installations can go there now: Obelisk's own folder is
    /// made when needed, the player's must be there.
    pub fn connected(&self) -> bool {
        let view = self.view();
        view.default || view.path.is_dir()
    }

    fn default_path(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.library.join(DEFAULT_DIRECTORY)
    }

    /// Publishes `path` as the games folder, and whether its disk is
    /// connected.
    fn publish(&self, path: PathBuf) {
        let mut next = view(path, &self.default_path(), 0);
        self.published.send_if_modified(|current| {
            next.revision = current.revision;
            if next == *current {
                return false;
            }
            next.revision += 1;
            *current = next;
            true
        });
    }

    /// Whether `games` is a games folder Obelisk made: its own, or the one
    /// inside a folder the player chose.
    fn ours(&self, games: &Path) -> bool {
        games == self.default_path()
            || games
                .file_name()
                .is_some_and(|name| name == CHOSEN_DIRECTORY)
    }

    /// The games folder `chosen` gives, and what choosing it moves.
    pub fn inspect(&self, chosen: &Path) -> Result<Candidate, Refusal> {
        let (path, installations) = self.destination(chosen)?;
        let device = fs::metadata(chosen).map_err(|_| Refusal::Missing)?.dev();
        let mut candidate = Candidate {
            path: path.clone(),
            games: 0,
            copied_bytes: 0,
        };
        let mut seen = Vec::new();
        for (installation, bytes) in installations {
            // Two accounts may share one installation: it moves once.
            if installation.starts_with(&path) || seen.contains(&installation) {
                continue;
            }
            candidate.games += 1;
            if fs::metadata(&installation).is_ok_and(|metadata| metadata.dev() != device) {
                candidate.copied_bytes += bytes;
            }
            seen.push(installation);
        }
        Ok(candidate)
    }

    /// What making Obelisk's own folder the games folder again would do. It
    /// makes that folder.
    pub fn inspect_default(&self) -> Result<Candidate, Refusal> {
        let path = self.default_path();
        // A folder it cannot make reads as missing.
        let _ = fs::create_dir_all(&path);
        self.inspect(&path)
    }

    /// The games folder `chosen` gives, and the connected installations,
    /// none of which holds it.
    fn destination(&self, chosen: &Path) -> Result<(PathBuf, Vec<(PathBuf, u64)>), Refusal> {
        let path = self.resolve(chosen)?;
        let installations: Vec<(PathBuf, u64)> = self
            .residents()
            .iter()
            .flat_map(|resident| resident.installations())
            .collect();
        if installations
            .iter()
            .any(|(installation, _)| path.starts_with(installation))
        {
            return Err(Refusal::Inside);
        }
        Ok((path, installations))
    }

    /// The games folder `chosen` gives: Obelisk's own folder, or the one
    /// Obelisk makes inside the chosen folder, unless that is one already.
    fn resolve(&self, chosen: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, Refusal> {
        if !plain_absolute(chosen) {
            return Err(Refusal::Missing);
        }
        let chosen = chosen.canonicalize().map_err(|_| Refusal::Missing)?;
        if !chosen.is_dir() {
            return Err(Refusal::Missing);
        }
        if self.ours(&chosen) {
            return Ok(chosen);
        }
        if chosen.starts_with(&self.library) {
            return Err(Refusal::Inside);
        }
        Ok(chosen.join(CHOSEN_DIRECTORY))
    }

    /// Makes the games folder `chosen` gives the one new installations go
    /// to, and queues the move into it of every installation outside it.
    pub fn choose(&self, chosen: &Path) -> Result<(), ChoiceFailure> {
        let (path, _) = self.destination(chosen)?;
        fs::create_dir_all(&path)?;
        self.save(&path)?;
        self.publish(path);
        self.gather();
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Makes Obelisk's own folder the games folder again, and queues the
    /// move into it of every installation outside it.
    pub fn choose_default(&self) -> Result<(), ChoiceFailure> {
        let path = self.default_path();
        fs::create_dir_all(&path)?;
        self.choose(&path)
    }

    /// Queues the move of the installations still outside the games folder.
    pub fn gather(&self) {
        let path = self.path();
        for resident in self.residents() {
            resident.gather(&path);
        }
    }

    /// A disk came or left: the games folder tells whether its disk is
    /// connected, and each account shows the installations whose disk is.
    pub fn volumes_changed(&self) {
        self.publish(self.path());
        for resident in self.residents() {
            resident.refresh();
        }
    }

    fn save(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {
        let file = self.library.join(FILE);
        if path == self.default_path() {
            return match fs::remove_file(&file) {
                Err(error) if error.kind() != io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Err(error),
                _ => Ok(()),
            };
        }
        let saved = Saved {
            path: path.to_owned(),
        };
        obelisk_core::write_atomic(&file, &serde_json::to_vec(&saved)?)
    }

    pub(crate) fn register(&self, resident: Weak<dyn Resident>) {
        let mut residents = self.residents.lock().unwrap();
        residents.retain(|kept| kept.strong_count() > 0);
        residents.push(resident);
    }

    fn residents(&self) -> Vec<Arc<dyn Resident>> {
        self.residents
            .lock()
            .unwrap()
            .iter()
            .filter_map(Weak::upgrade)
            .collect()
    }

    /// The installation `name` of a storefront whose games go in `storefront`,
    /// once moved into the games folder.
    pub(crate) fn installation(&self, storefront: &str, name: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf> {
        let name = name.file_name()?;
        let found = self.path().join(storefront).join(name);
        found.is_dir().then_some(found)
    }

    /// Removes the storefront's folder an installation left, `storefront`,
    /// and the games folder holding it, once empty and no longer the games
    /// folder. Only Obelisk's own folders go.
    pub(crate) fn tidy(&self, storefront: &Path) {
        let Some(games) = storefront.parent() else {
            return;
        };
        if games == self.path() {
            return;
        }
        if self.ours(games) && fs::remove_dir(storefront).is_ok() {
            let _ = fs::remove_dir(games);
        }
    }
}

/// Removes the copies moves to the games folder `games` left when Obelisk
/// quit before they ended.
fn clear_staging(games: &Path) {
    let Ok(storefronts) = fs::read_dir(games) else {
        return;
    };
    for storefront in storefronts.flatten() {
        let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(storefront.path()) else {
            continue;
        };
        for entry in entries.flatten() {
            if obelisk_core::installation::is_staging(&entry.file_name().to_string_lossy())
                && entry.file_type().is_ok_and(|kind| kind.is_dir())
            {
                let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(entry.path());
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Why choosing a folder failed.
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum ChoiceFailure {
    #[error("the folder cannot hold the games: {0:?}")]
    Refused(Refusal),
    #[error(transparent)]
    Io(#[from] io::Error),
}

impl From<Refusal> for ChoiceFailure {
    fn from(refusal: Refusal) -> Self {
        Self::Refused(refusal)
    }
}

/// Whether `path` lies on a disk that is not connected: an external disk's
/// folder under /Volumes whose disk is gone.
pub fn disconnected(path: &Path) -> bool {
    let mut components = path.components();
    let (Some(Component::RootDir), Some(Component::Normal(volumes)), Some(Component::Normal(disk))) =
        (components.next(), components.next(), components.next())
    else {
        return false;
    };
    volumes == "Volumes" && !Path::new("/Volumes").join(disk).exists()
}
```

```rs
use super::*;

/// A library and another place to choose, both canonical.
struct Places {
    _root: tempfile::TempDir,
    library: PathBuf,
    elsewhere: PathBuf,
}

fn places() -> Places {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = root.path().canonicalize().unwrap();
    let (library, elsewhere) = (path.join("library"), path.join("elsewhere"));
    fs::create_dir_all(&library).unwrap();
    fs::create_dir_all(&elsewhere).unwrap();
    Places {
        _root: root,
        library,
        elsewhere,
    }
}

/// An account's installations, as the games folder sees them.
#[derive(Default)]
struct Account {
    installations: Vec<(PathBuf, u64)>,
    gathered: Mutex<Vec<PathBuf>>,
    refreshed: Mutex<u32>,
}

impl Resident for Account {
    fn installations(&self) -> Vec<(PathBuf, u64)> {
        self.installations.clone()
    }
    fn gather(self: Arc<Self>, folder: &Path) {
        self.gathered.lock().unwrap().push(folder.to_owned());
    }
    fn refresh(&self) {
        *self.refreshed.lock().unwrap() += 1;
    }
}

fn registered(folder: &GamesFolder, account: Account) -> Arc<Account> {
    let account = Arc::new(account);
    let resident: Arc<dyn Resident> = account.clone();
    folder.register(Arc::downgrade(&resident));
    account
}

#[test]
fn obelisk_s_own_folder_holds_the_games_until_the_player_chooses_another() {
    let places = places();
    let folder = GamesFolder::new(&places.library);
    let view = folder.view();
    assert_eq!(view.path, places.library.join("Games"));
    assert!(view.default);
    assert!(
        folder.connected(),
        "Obelisk's own folder is made when needed"
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_chosen_folder_gets_obelisk_s_own_folder_inside_it_and_stays_chosen() {
    let places = places();
    let folder = GamesFolder::new(&places.library);
    let account = registered(&folder, Account::default());
    let before = folder.view().revision;
    folder.choose(&places.elsewhere).unwrap();
    let chosen = places.elsewhere.join(CHOSEN_DIRECTORY);
    let view = folder.view();
    assert_eq!(view.path, chosen);
    assert!(!view.default && view.revision > before);
    assert!(chosen.is_dir());
    assert_eq!(
        *account.gathered.lock().unwrap(),
        std::slice::from_ref(&chosen)
    );
    assert_eq!(GamesFolder::new(&places.library).path(), chosen);
    // Choosing Obelisk's folder there again keeps it, not one inside it.
    folder.choose(&chosen).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(folder.path(), chosen);
}

#[test]
fn obelisk_s_own_folder_chosen_again_forgets_the_player_s_choice() {
    let places = places();
    let folder = GamesFolder::new(&places.library);
    folder.choose(&places.elsewhere).unwrap();
    folder.choose_default().unwrap();
    assert!(folder.view().default);
    assert!(!places.library.join(FILE).exists());
    assert!(GamesFolder::new(&places.library).view().default);
}

#[test]
fn a_folder_inside_obelisk_s_library_or_a_game_or_missing_is_refused() {
    let places = places();
    let folder = GamesFolder::new(&places.library);
    let game = places.elsewhere.join("Games/steam-620-macos");
    fs::create_dir_all(&game).unwrap();
    let _account = registered(
        &folder,
        Account {
            installations: vec![(game.clone(), 10)],
            ..Account::default()
        },
    );
    fs::create_dir_all(places.library.join("Voile")).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        folder.inspect(&places.library.join("Voile")),
        Err(Refusal::Inside)
    );
    assert_eq!(folder.inspect(&game), Err(Refusal::Inside));
    assert_eq!(
        folder.inspect(&places.elsewhere.join("missing")),
        Err(Refusal::Missing)
    );
    assert!(matches!(
        folder.choose(&game),
        Err(ChoiceFailure::Refused(Refusal::Inside))
    ));
    assert!(folder.view().default);
}

#[test]
fn inspecting_a_folder_counts_each_installation_outside_it_once() {
    let places = places();
    let folder = GamesFolder::new(&places.library);
    let inside = places
        .elsewhere
        .join(CHOSEN_DIRECTORY)
        .join("Steam/steam-1-macos");
    let outside = places.library.join("Games/Steam/steam-2-macos");
    fs::create_dir_all(&inside).unwrap();
    fs::create_dir_all(&outside).unwrap();
    let _first = registered(
        &folder,
        Account {
            installations: vec![(inside, 5), (outside.clone(), 7)],
            ..Account::default()
        },
    );
    let _second = registered(
        &folder,
        Account {
            installations: vec![(outside, 7)],
            ..Account::default()
        },
    );
    let candidate = folder.inspect(&places.elsewhere).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(candidate.path, places.elsewhere.join(CHOSEN_DIRECTORY));
    assert_eq!(candidate.games, 1);
    // The same disk: the installation only changes its place.
    assert_eq!(candidate.copied_bytes, 0);
}

#[test]
fn a_disk_change_refreshes_every_account_and_a_move_finds_its_installation() {
    let places = places();
    let folder = GamesFolder::new(&places.library);
    let account = registered(&folder, Account::default());
    folder.volumes_changed();
    assert_eq!(*account.refreshed.lock().unwrap(), 1);
    // The chosen folder's disk left: the view tells it.
    folder.choose(&places.elsewhere).unwrap();
    assert!(folder.view().connected);
    fs::remove_dir_all(&places.elsewhere).unwrap();
    let before = folder.view().revision;
    folder.volumes_changed();
    let view = folder.view();
    assert!(!view.connected && view.revision > before);
    folder.choose_default().unwrap();
    let moved = places.library.join("Games/Steam/steam-620-macos");
    fs::create_dir_all(&moved).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        folder.installation(
            "Steam",
            Path::new("/Volumes/Gone/Obelisk Games/Steam/steam-620-macos")
        ),
        Some(moved)
    );
    assert_eq!(
        folder.installation("Steam", Path::new("/elsewhere/steam-570-macos")),
        None
    );
}

#[test]
fn only_obelisk_s_emptied_folders_are_tidied() {
    let places = places();
    let folder = GamesFolder::new(&places.library);
    let old = places.elsewhere.join(CHOSEN_DIRECTORY);
    fs::create_dir_all(old.join("Steam")).unwrap();
    fs::create_dir_all(old.join("Epic/epic-game")).unwrap();
    folder.tidy(&old.join("Steam"));
    assert!(!old.join("Steam").exists());
    assert!(old.exists(), "Epic's games are still there");
    let player = places.elsewhere.join("Jeux");
    fs::create_dir_all(player.join("Steam")).unwrap();
    folder.tidy(&player.join("Steam"));
    assert!(player.join("Steam").exists(), "not Obelisk's folder");
    // The games folder itself stays, even emptied.
    fs::create_dir_all(places.library.join("Games/Steam")).unwrap();
    folder.tidy(&places.library.join("Games/Steam"));
    assert!(places.library.join("Games").exists());
}

#[test]
fn a_copy_an_interrupted_move_left_goes_at_the_next_start() {
    let places = places();
    let left = places
        .library
        .join("Games/Steam/.steam-620-macos.obelisk-moving");
    let game = places.library.join("Games/Steam/steam-570-macos");
    fs::create_dir_all(&left).unwrap();
    fs::create_dir_all(&game).unwrap();
    GamesFolder::new(&places.library);
    let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(5);
    while left.exists() {
        assert!(std::time::Instant::now() < deadline, "the copy stayed");
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(5));
    }
    assert!(game.exists());
}

#[test]
fn only_a_missing_external_disk_is_disconnected() {
    assert!(disconnected(Path::new(
        "/Volumes/Obelisk Test Disk That Is Not There/Obelisk Games/Steam/steam-620-macos"
    )));
    assert!(!disconnected(Path::new(
        "/Users/someone/Games/steam-620-macos"
    )));
    assert!(!disconnected(Path::new("/Volumes")));
}
```
