```rs
#[tokio::test]
async fn finalizing_reserves_the_game_and_the_last_session_keeps_its_pending_cloud_status() {
    let sessions = sessions();
    settled(&sessions).await;
    let game = steam(42, Phase::Running);
    let launch = follow(&sessions, 42, game.clone());
    eventually(|| running(&sessions)).await;
    game.phase(Phase::Finalizing);
    game.cloud(CloudPhase::Syncing, 0);
    eventually(|| {
        sessions
            .state()
            .active
            .is_some_and(|active| active.phase == Phase::Finalizing)
    })
    .await;
    assert!(protects(&sessions, 42));
    assert!(sessions.admit(570, 42).is_none());

    game.change(|state| {
        state.current.cloud.phase = CloudPhase::Pending;
        state.current.cloud.error = Some("backend.steam.cloud.network".into());
    });
    game.finish(false);
    assert_eq!(launch.await.unwrap(), Ok(()));
    let state = sessions.state();
    assert!(!state.busy());
    let last = state.last.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(last.game, 42);
    assert_eq!(last.cloud.phase, CloudPhase::Pending);
    assert_eq!(
        last.cloud.error.as_deref(),
        Some("backend.steam.cloud.network")
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_rosetta_requirement_is_answered_once_for_its_decision_or_declined() {
    let sessions = sessions();
    settled(&sessions).await;
    let game = steam(42, Phase::Preparing);
    game.change(|state| state.current.rosetta = Some(3));
    let launch = follow(&sessions, 42, game.clone());
    eventually(|| sessions.state().rosetta.is_some()).await;
    let prompt = sessions.state().rosetta.unwrap();
    assert_eq!((prompt.account, prompt.decision_id), (42, 3));

    assert!(
        sessions
            .resume_after_rosetta(&prompt.session, &42, 2)
            .is_err()
    );
    assert!(
        sessions
            .resume_after_rosetta(&prompt.session, &43, 3)
            .is_err()
    );
    assert!(
        sessions
            .resume_after_rosetta("another session", &42, 3)
            .is_err()
    );
    sessions.decline_rosetta(&prompt.session, &43, 3);
    assert!(
        sessions.state().rosetta.is_some(),
        "another account never declines"
    );
    game.change(|state| state.rosetta_unavailable = true);
    assert_eq!(
        sessions.resume_after_rosetta(&prompt.session, &42, 3),
        Err(Failure::Failed("backend.runtime.rosettaUnavailable".into()))
    );
    game.change(|state| state.rosetta_unavailable = false);
    sessions
        .resume_after_rosetta(&prompt.session, &42, 3)
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(game.read(|state| state.rosetta_resumes.clone()), [(42, 3)]);

    sessions.decline_rosetta(&prompt.session, &42, 3);
    assert!(sessions.state().rosetta.is_none());
    eventually(|| game.read(|state| state.cancellations == 1)).await;
    game.fail(None, true);
    assert_eq!(launch.await.unwrap(), Err(Failure::Cancelled));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn the_start_gate_opens_only_after_the_step_before_it_and_never_once_cancelled() {
    let sessions = Sessions::<Epic>::new(Box::new(|| Ok(None)), ready());
    eventually(|| !sessions.state().recovering).await;
    let store = crate::epic::Store {
        namespace: "ns".into(),
        app_name: "app".into(),
    };
    let game = Fake::<Epic>::with("account".into(), store.clone(), Phase::Preparing);
    let (saved, save) = std::sync::mpsc::channel::<()>();
    let (entered, entering) = std::sync::mpsc::channel::<()>();
    let admission = sessions.admit(store, "account".into()).unwrap();
    let canceller = admission.canceller();
    let supervisor = game.clone();
    let launch = tokio::spawn(admission.launch_before(
        async move { Ok(supervisor as Arc<dyn Supervised<Epic>>) },
        Box::new(move || {
            entered.send(()).unwrap();
            save.recv().unwrap();
        }),
    ));
    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || entering.recv().unwrap())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(game.read(|state| state.begins), 0);

    canceller.cancel();
    // Cancellation reaches the supervisor while the step still runs.
    eventually(|| game.read(|state| state.cancellations == 1)).await;
    saved.send(()).unwrap();
    eventually(|| {
        sessions
            .state()
            .active
            .is_some_and(|active| active.observed)
    })
    .await;
    assert_eq!(game.read(|state| state.begins), 0);
    game.fail(None, true);
    assert_eq!(launch.await.unwrap(), Err(Failure::Cancelled));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn stopping_asks_the_running_game_to_end_and_cancels_a_launch_still_preparing() {
    let sessions = sessions();
    settled(&sessions).await;
    let game = steam(42, Phase::Running);
    let launch = follow(&sessions, 42, game.clone());
    eventually(|| running(&sessions)).await;
    sessions.stop().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(game.read(|state| state.stops), 1);
    game.finish(false);
    assert_eq!(launch.await.unwrap(), Ok(()));

    let admission = sessions.admit(42, 42).unwrap();
    let canceller = admission.canceller();
    sessions.stop().unwrap();
    assert!(canceller.cancelled());
    drop(admission);
    assert!(!sessions.state().busy());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn quitting_reaches_only_the_session_named_and_cancels_a_launch_still_preparing() {
    let sessions = sessions();
    settled(&sessions).await;
    let game = steam(42, Phase::Running);
    let launch = follow(&sessions, 42, game.clone());
    eventually(|| running(&sessions)).await;
    let id = sessions.state().active.unwrap().id;
    assert_eq!(
        sessions.quit("another-session"),
        Err(Failure::Failed(Steam::INVALID_SESSION.into()))
    );
    assert_eq!(
        sessions.force_quit("another-session"),
        Err(Failure::Failed(Steam::INVALID_SESSION.into()))
    );
    sessions.quit(&id).unwrap();
    sessions.force_quit(&id).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(game.read(|state| state.quits.clone()), ["quit", "force"]);
    game.finish(false);
    assert_eq!(launch.await.unwrap(), Ok(()));
    assert!(sessions.quit(&id).is_err(), "the session ended");

    let admission = sessions.admit(42, 42).unwrap();
    let canceller = admission.canceller();
    let id = sessions.state().active.unwrap().id;
    sessions.force_quit(&id).unwrap();
    assert!(canceller.cancelled());
    drop(admission);
    assert!(!sessions.state().busy());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn the_players_controls_reach_only_the_running_game_of_a_signed_in_account() {
    use crate::{protocol::InviteTarget, steam::Control};
    const FRIEND: u64 = 76_561_197_960_265_729;
    const LOBBY: u64 = 109_775_244_421_126_053;
    let refused = || Err(Failure::Failed(Steam::INVALID_SESSION.into()));
    let sessions = sessions();
    settled(&sessions).await;
    let game = steam(42, Phase::Preparing);
    let launch = follow(&sessions, 42, game.clone());
    eventually(|| {
        sessions
            .state()
            .active
            .is_some_and(|active| active.observed)
    })
    .await;
    let id = sessions.state().active.unwrap().id;
    assert_eq!(
        sessions.overlay_state(&id, true, false),
        refused(),
        "the game does not run yet"
    );
    game.phase(Phase::Running);
    eventually(|| running(&sessions)).await;
    assert_eq!(
        sessions.overlay_state("another-session", true, false),
        refused()
    );
    let lobby = InviteTarget::Lobby { lobby_id: LOBBY };
    assert_eq!(
        sessions.accept_invite(&id, LOBBY, lobby.clone()),
        refused(),
        "a lobby is no friend"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        sessions.accept_invite(
            &id,
            FRIEND,
            InviteTarget::Connect {
                connect: String::new()
            }
        ),
        refused()
    );
    sessions.overlay_state(&id, true, false).unwrap();
    sessions.accept_invite(&id, FRIEND, lobby.clone()).unwrap();
    sessions.authorize_microtxn(&id, 7, true).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        game.read(|state| state.controls.clone()),
        [
            (
                42,
                Control::Overlay {
                    active: true,
                    user_initiated: false
                }
            ),
            (
                42,
                Control::AcceptInvite {
                    friend: FRIEND,
                    target: lobby
                }
            ),
            (
                42,
                Control::AuthorizeMicroTxn {
                    order_id: 7,
                    approve: true
                }
            ),
        ]
    );
    sessions.revoke(42);
    assert_eq!(
        sessions.overlay_state(&id, false, false),
        refused(),
        "the account signed out"
    );
    game.finish(false);
    assert_eq!(launch.await.unwrap(), Ok(()));
    assert_eq!(sessions.overlay_state(&id, false, false), refused());
    assert_eq!(game.read(|state| state.controls.len()), 3);
}

/// What a scripted start returns.
type Started<P> = Result<Arc<dyn Supervised<P>>, String>;

/// A storefront's handover the test scripts, which records its steps.
struct Scripted<P: Provider> {
    /// The platform of the build it starts: a Mac one unless the test says.
    platform: Platform,
    steps: Arc<Mutex<Vec<&'static str>>>,
    /// Preparing waits until the test notifies it.
    held: Option<Arc<tokio::sync::Notify>>,
    prepared: Result<(), Failure>,
    /// Starting waits for its cancellation instead of returning.
    awaits_cancellation: bool,
    started: Mutex<Option<Started<P>>>,
}

impl<P: Provider> Scripted<P> {
    fn starting(supervisor: Started<P>) -> Self {
        Self {
            platform: Platform::Mac,
            steps: Arc::default(),
            held: None,
            prepared: Ok(()),
            awaits_cancellation: false,
            started: Mutex::new(Some(supervisor)),
        }
    }
    fn steps(&self) -> Arc<Mutex<Vec<&'static str>>> {
        self.steps.clone()
    }
}

impl<P: Storefront> Handover<P> for Scripted<P> {
    type Prepared = ();
    fn platform(&self) -> Platform {
        self.platform
    }
    fn prepare(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<(), Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.steps.lock().unwrap().push("prepare");
            if let Some(held) = &self.held {
                held.notified().await;
            }
            self.prepared.clone()
        })
    }
    fn before_begin(&self) -> BeforeBegin {
        let steps = self.steps.clone();
        Box::new(move || steps.lock().unwrap().push("before begin"))
    }
    fn start(self, (): (), cancel: CancelToken) -> Result<Arc<dyn Supervised<P>>, String> {
        self.steps.lock().unwrap().push("start");
        if self.awaits_cancellation {
            let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(3);
            while !cancel.is_cancelled() && Instant::now() < deadline {
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5));
            }
            if cancel.is_cancelled() {
                self.steps.lock().unwrap().push("start cancelled");
            }
            return Err("backend.steam.runtime.cancelled".into());
        }
        self.started.lock().unwrap().take().unwrap()
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_handover_prepares_starts_the_supervisor_and_opens_its_start_gate_after_the_step_before_it()
 {
    let sessions = Sessions::<Epic>::new(Box::new(|| Ok(None)), ready());
    eventually(|| !sessions.state().recovering).await;
    let store = crate::epic::Store {
        namespace: "ns".into(),
        app_name: "app".into(),
    };
    let game = Fake::<Epic>::with("account".into(), store.clone(), Phase::Preparing);
    let handover = Scripted::starting(Ok(game.clone() as Arc<dyn Supervised<Epic>>));
    let steps = handover.steps();
    let admission = sessions.admit(store, "account".into()).unwrap();

    let launch = tokio::spawn(admission.hand_off(handover));
    eventually(|| game.read(|state| state.begins) == 1).await;
    assert_eq!(*steps.lock().unwrap(), ["prepare", "start", "before begin"]);
    game.finish(false);

    assert_eq!(launch.await.unwrap(), Ok(()));
    assert!(sessions.state().active.is_none());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_failed_preparation_refuses_the_launch_and_gives_its_reservation_back_without_recovery() {
    let recoveries = Arc::new(Mutex::new(0));
    let counted = recoveries.clone();
    let sessions = recovering(move || {
        *counted.lock().unwrap() += 1;
        Ok(None)
    });
    settled(&sessions).await;
    let mut handover = Scripted::starting(Err("never started".into()));
    handover.prepared = Err(Failure::Failed("backend.runtime.wineUnavailable".into()));
    let steps = handover.steps();

    let outcome = sessions.admit(42, 42).unwrap().hand_off(handover).await;

    assert_eq!(
        outcome,
        Err(Failure::Failed("backend.runtime.wineUnavailable".into()))
    );
    assert_eq!(*steps.lock().unwrap(), ["prepare"]);
    assert!(!sessions.state().busy());
    assert_eq!(*recoveries.lock().unwrap(), 1, "only startup recovered");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_launch_cancelled_while_it_prepares_never_starts_its_supervisor() {
    let sessions = sessions();
    settled(&sessions).await;
    let held = Arc::new(tokio::sync::Notify::new());
    let mut handover = Scripted::starting(Err("never started".into()));
    handover.held = Some(held.clone());
    let steps = handover.steps();
    let admission = sessions.admit(42, 42).unwrap();
    let canceller = admission.canceller();

    let launch = tokio::spawn(admission.hand_off(handover));
    eventually(|| steps.lock().unwrap().contains(&"prepare")).await;
    canceller.cancel();
    held.notify_one();

    assert_eq!(launch.await.unwrap(), Err(Failure::Cancelled));
    assert_eq!(*steps.lock().unwrap(), ["prepare"]);
    assert!(!sessions.state().busy());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_start_that_failed_may_have_reached_the_supervisor_so_recovery_settles_the_reservation() {
    let recoveries = Arc::new(Mutex::new(0));
    let counted = recoveries.clone();
    let sessions = recovering(move || {
        *counted.lock().unwrap() += 1;
        Ok(None)
    });
    settled(&sessions).await;
    let handover = Scripted::starting(Err("backend.steam.runtime.startFailed".into()));

    let outcome = sessions.admit(42, 42).unwrap().hand_off(handover).await;

    assert_eq!(
        outcome,
        Err(Failure::Failed("backend.steam.runtime.startFailed".into()))
    );
    assert_eq!(
        *recoveries.lock().unwrap(),
        2,
        "recovery confirmed no game runs"
    );
    assert!(!sessions.state().busy());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn cancelling_a_launch_reaches_its_supervisor_while_it_starts() {
    let sessions = sessions();
    settled(&sessions).await;
    let mut handover = Scripted::starting(Err("never returned".into()));
    handover.awaits_cancellation = true;
    let steps = handover.steps();
    let admission = sessions.admit(42, 42).unwrap();
    let canceller = admission.canceller();

    let launch = tokio::spawn(admission.hand_off(handover));
    eventually(|| steps.lock().unwrap().contains(&"start")).await;
    canceller.cancel();

    assert_eq!(launch.await.unwrap(), Err(Failure::Cancelled));
    assert_eq!(
        *steps.lock().unwrap(),
        ["prepare", "start", "start cancelled"]
    );
    assert!(!sessions.state().busy());
}

/// Epic Game sessions with nothing left to recover, which get their
/// runtimes from `runtimes`, and the game their launches start.
async fn epic_launches(runtimes: Arc<Runtimes>) -> (Sessions<Epic>, crate::epic::Store) {
    let sessions = Sessions::<Epic>::new(Box::new(|| Ok(None)), runtimes);
    eventually(|| !sessions.state().recovering).await;
    let store = crate::epic::Store {
        namespace: "ns".into(),
        app_name: "app".into(),
    };
    (sessions, store)
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_launch_gets_the_runtimes_its_build_needs_and_shows_their_download_before_it_prepares() {
    let runtimes = FakeRuntimes::new(&[], |_| {});
    runtimes.hold();
    let (sessions, store) = epic_launches(Runtimes::from_source(runtimes.clone())).await;
    let game = Fake::<Epic>::with("account".into(), store.clone(), Phase::Preparing);
    let mut handover = Scripted::starting(Ok(game.clone() as Arc<dyn Supervised<Epic>>));
    handover.platform = Platform::Windows;
    let held = Arc::new(tokio::sync::Notify::new());
    handover.held = Some(held.clone());
    let steps = handover.steps();
    let admission = sessions.admit(store, "account".into()).unwrap();

    let launch = tokio::spawn(admission.hand_off(handover));
    let install = || {
        sessions
            .state()
            .active
            .and_then(|active| active.runtime_install)
    };
    eventually(|| {
        install()
            == Some(RuntimeInstall {
                runtime: Runtime::Voile,
                fraction: 0.5,
            })
    })
    .await;
    assert!(steps.lock().unwrap().is_empty(), "nothing is prepared yet");

    runtimes.release();
    eventually(|| steps.lock().unwrap().contains(&"prepare")).await;
    assert_eq!(install(), None, "the download no longer shows");
    assert_eq!(runtimes.in_place(), [Runtime::Voile]);
    held.notify_one();
    eventually(|| game.read(|state| state.begins) == 1).await;
    game.finish(false);
    assert_eq!(launch.await.unwrap(), Ok(()));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn cancelling_a_launch_while_a_runtime_downloads_cancels_it_and_gives_the_reservation_back() {
    let runtimes = FakeRuntimes::new(&[], |_| {});
    runtimes.hold();
    let (sessions, store) = epic_launches(Runtimes::from_source(runtimes.clone())).await;
    let mut handover = Scripted::starting(Err("never started".into()));
    handover.platform = Platform::Windows;
    let steps = handover.steps();
    let admission = sessions.admit(store, "account".into()).unwrap();
    let canceller = admission.canceller();

    let launch = tokio::spawn(admission.hand_off(handover));
    eventually(|| {
        sessions
            .state()
            .active
            .is_some_and(|active| active.runtime_install.is_some())
    })
    .await;
    canceller.cancel();

    assert_eq!(launch.await.unwrap(), Err(Failure::Cancelled));
    assert!(steps.lock().unwrap().is_empty(), "nothing is prepared");
    assert!(runtimes.in_place().is_empty());
    assert!(!sessions.state().busy());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_launch_keeps_the_replaced_voile_releases_while_another_storefronts_game_may_run_from_one()
 {
    let (events, record) = recorded();
    let runtimes = Runtimes::from_source(FakeRuntimes::new(
        &[Runtime::SteamComponents, Runtime::Voile],
        record,
    ));
    // An Epic game an earlier Obelisk started still runs.
    let store = crate::epic::Store {
        namespace: "ns".into(),
        app_name: "app".into(),
    };
    let recovered = Fake::<Epic>::with("account".into(), store, Phase::Running);
    let found = recovered.clone();
    let epic_sessions = Sessions::<Epic>::new(
        Box::new(move || Ok(Some(found.clone() as Arc<dyn Supervised<Epic>>))),
        runtimes.clone(),
    );
    let steam_sessions = Sessions::<Steam>::new(Box::new(|| Ok(None)), runtimes);
    settled(&steam_sessions).await;
    eventually(|| {
        epic_sessions
            .state()
            .active
            .is_some_and(|active| active.observed)
    })
    .await;
    let launch = |game: Arc<Fake<Steam>>| {
        let mut handover = Scripted::starting(Ok(game as Arc<dyn Supervised<Steam>>));
        handover.platform = Platform::Windows;
        steam_sessions.admit(42, 42).unwrap().hand_off(handover)
    };

    let game = steam(42, Phase::Running);
    let first = tokio::spawn(launch(game.clone()));
    eventually(|| running(&steam_sessions)).await;
    assert!(
        events.lock().unwrap().is_empty(),
        "the Epic game may run from one"
    );
    game.finish(false);
    assert_eq!(first.await.unwrap(), Ok(()));

    recovered.finish(false);
    eventually(|| !epic_sessions.state().busy()).await;
    let game = steam(42, Phase::Running);
    let second = tokio::spawn(launch(game.clone()));
    eventually(|| running(&steam_sessions)).await;
    assert_eq!(*events.lock().unwrap(), ["remove replaced"]);
    game.finish(false);
    assert_eq!(second.await.unwrap(), Ok(()));
}
```

```rs
//! The Steam adapter of the Game session supervisor.

/// What a Steam game joins as it starts, as Steam's client starts a game

    pub fn arguments(&self, platform: Platform) -> Vec<String> {

impl supervisor::Provider for Steam {
    type Account = u64;
    type Store = Store;
    type Control = Control;
    type Error = Error;
    const SUPERVISE: &'static str = "supervise";
    const CANCELLED: &'static [&'static str] = &["backend.steam.runtime.cancelled"];

    fn valid(record: &Record<Self>) -> bool {
        record.store.app_id != 0 && record.account_id != 0
    }

    fn cancelled(error: &Error) -> bool {
        matches!(
            error,
            Error::Cancelled | Error::Cloud(cloud::Failure::Cancelled)
        )
    }

    fn same_game(a: &Store, b: &Store) -> bool {
        a.app_id == b.app_id
    }

    /// The UI reports host loss and keeps protecting a game that still runs.
    fn orphaned(record: &mut Record<Self>, _owned: bool) {
        record.store.host = HostState::Lost;
    }
}

/// The launch of the Steam game `receipt` installed, started as `target`
/// says, with its Cloud, ready for its supervisor. A Windows game runs in
/// Wine, in the installation's own prefix, which is readied first.
pub fn prepare(
    locations: &crate::Locations,
    receipt: &Receipt<Steam>,
    target: &obelisk_core::launch::LaunchTarget,
) -> Result<Request, Error> {
    let home = &locations.home;
    let install = Path::new(&receipt.directory);
    let app_id = receipt.product.app_id;
    let (wine, target, steam_api) = match receipt.windows(locations)? {
        Some(windows) => {
            let wine = windows.ready(locations, target, &windows::Prefix { install })?;
            let launched = windows::target(&wine, &receipt.wine_game(), target, home)?;
            (Some(wine), launched, None)
        }
        None => {
            let (launched, steam_api) = native_target(install, target, home, app_id)?;
            (None, launched, Some(steam_api))
        }
    };
    let cloud = cloud::Config {
        root: locations.cloud_archive.clone(),
        home: home.clone(),
        install: install.to_owned(),
        app_id,
        prefix: wine.as_ref().map(|wine| wine.prefix.clone()),
    };
    Ok(Request {
        root: locations.steam_sessions.clone(),
        id: String::new(),
        config: Config {
            app_id,
            cloud_save_roots: vec![install.to_owned()],
            helpers: locations.helpers.clone(),
            package: locations.steam_runtime_package.clone(),
            cache: locations.steam_runtime_cache.clone(),
            diagnostics: crate::diagnostics::folder(
                &locations.home,
                crate::queue::Storefront::Steam,
            ),
            steam_api,
            home: home.clone(),
            wine,
        },
        cloud: Some(cloud),
        target,
    })
}

/// The Mac game `target` names inside `install`, and its Steam API library.
fn native_target(
    install: &Path,
    target: &obelisk_core::launch::LaunchTarget,
    home: &Path,
    app_id: u32,
) -> Result<(Target, PathBuf), Error> {
    let steam_api = launch::steam_api(target)?;
    let (target, _) = crate::native::target(
        install,
        target,
        target.arguments.clone(),
        crate::native::environment(home),
        crate::diagnostics::game_log(home, crate::diagnostics::Game::Steam(app_id), Platform::Mac),
    )?;
    Ok((target, steam_api))
}

/// Starts the supervisor of `request`'s game, as a new Game session;
/// `cancelled` stops a start in progress.
pub fn start(
    helper: &Path,
    credentials: &Credentials,
    mut request: Request,
    cancelled: &CancelToken,
) -> Result<Client, Error> {
    request.id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
    start_command(
        helper,
        credentials,
        request,
        cancelled,
        Client::supervisor_command(helper),
        supervisor::client::inspect,
    )
}

pub(crate) fn start_command(
    helper: &Path,
    credentials: &Credentials,
    request: Request,
    cancelled: &CancelToken,
    command: std::process::Command,
    probe: supervisor::client::Probe,
) -> Result<Client, Error> {
    let root = request.root.clone();
    let id = request.id.clone();
    let app_id = request.config.app_id;
    let account_id = credentials.steam_id;
    Ok(Client::start_with(
        &root,
        helper,
        id,
        command,
        probe,
        |pipe| {
            credentials
                .write(&mut *pipe)
                .map_err(|_| supervisor::Error::StartFailed)?;
            supervisor::storage::send(pipe, &request)
        },
        |ack| ack.account_id == account_id && ack.store.app_id == app_id,
        || cancelled.is_cancelled(),
    )?)
}

/// What the player asks of a running Steam game.
impl crate::sessions::Sessions<Steam> {
    /// Obelisk's overlay opened, or closed, over session `id`'s game, which
    /// Steam's overlay would tell it. `user_initiated` when the player opened
    /// it, not the game.
    pub fn overlay_state(
        &self,
        id: &str,
        active: bool,
        user_initiated: bool,
    ) -> Result<(), crate::sessions::Failure> {
        self.control(
            id,
            Control::Overlay {
                active,
                user_initiated,
            },
        )
    }

    /// The player accepted `friend`'s invitation into session `id`'s running
    /// game: the game joins as if Steam's overlay had accepted it.
    pub fn accept_invite(
        &self,
        id: &str,
        friend: u64,
        target: crate::protocol::InviteTarget,
    ) -> Result<(), crate::sessions::Failure> {
        if !crate::protocol::individual(friend) || !target.valid() {
            return Err(crate::sessions::Failure::Failed(
                <Steam as crate::sessions::Storefront>::INVALID_SESSION.to_owned(),
            ));
        }
        self.control(id, Control::AcceptInvite { friend, target })
    }

    /// The player's answer to the purchase `order_id` session `id`'s game
    /// waits on.
    pub fn authorize_microtxn(
        &self,
        id: &str,
        order_id: u64,
        approve: bool,
    ) -> Result<(), crate::sessions::Failure> {
        self.control(id, Control::AuthorizeMicroTxn { order_id, approve })
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod join_tests {
    use super::Join;
    use obelisk_core::Platform;

    #[test]
    fn a_join_adds_what_steams_client_adds_to_the_command_line() {
        let lobby = Join::Lobby {
            lobby_id: 109_775_244_421_126_053,
        };
        assert!(lobby.valid());
        assert_eq!(
            lobby.arguments(Platform::Windows),
            ["+connect_lobby", "109775244421126053"]
        );
        let connect = Join::Connect {
            connect: r#"+connect "10.0.0.1:27015" +password "two words""#.into(),
        };
        for platform in [Platform::Windows, Platform::Mac] {
            assert_eq!(
                connect.arguments(platform),
                ["+connect", "10.0.0.1:27015", "+password", "two words"],
                "{platform:?}"
            );
        }
        // A Mac command line it cannot read splits on spaces.
        let unbalanced = Join::Connect {
            connect: "+connect 'x y".into(),
        };
        assert_eq!(unbalanced.arguments(Platform::Mac), ["+connect", "'x", "y"]);
        for invalid in [
            Join::Lobby {
                lobby_id: 76_561_197_960_265_729,
            },
            Join::Connect {
                connect: String::new(),
            },
            Join::Connect {
                connect: "a".repeat(256),
            },
        ] {
            assert!(!invalid.valid(), "{invalid:?}");
        }
    }
}
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/steam/account_session.rs`:

```rs
//! The Account session of one signed-in Steam account. Steam's client dies
//! with its CM connection, so the session connects again by itself, and
//! everything that holds it reaches Steam through the connection of the
//! moment: the account's installations, chat, its own game, library lookups.
use super::{IdleGuard, Steam, cloud as steam_cloud, content::Network};
use crate::{
    cloud::Control,
    installations::{BoxFuture, Receipt, Transfer},
    protocol::Credentials,
    sessions::Failure,
};
use obelisk_core::{
    Platform, installation::TransferProgress, launch::LaunchTarget, transfer::CancelToken,
    watch::next_matching,
};
use std::{
    path::Path,
    sync::{Arc, Mutex, MutexGuard, PoisonError, Weak},
    time::Duration,
};
use steam_kit::{
    client::{Client, ClientConnectError, Installation},
    cloud::{CloudListing, CloudMetadata},
    friends::{FriendsConnection, FriendsSnapshot},
};
use tokio::{sync::watch, task::AbortHandle};

/// How many times the session connects again once its connection dropped,
/// after waiting 1, 2, then 4 seconds.
const ATTEMPTS: u32 = 3;

/// One CM connection of the session, which ends for good once it drops.
/// Steam's client in production; tests stand in for it.
pub trait Transport: Network {
    /// Its friends after `after_revision`; once it ended, its last ones at once.
    fn next_friends(&self, after_revision: u64) -> BoxFuture<'_, FriendsSnapshot>;
    /// Whether it ended. A request waiting on it, and so the session, learns
    /// of the end only after this tells it.
    fn ended(&self) -> bool;
    /// Ends it now, waking every wait on it and cancelling its download.
    fn shutdown(&self);
}

impl Transport for Client {
    fn next_friends(&self, after_revision: u64) -> BoxFuture<'_, FriendsSnapshot> {
        Box::pin(Client::next_friends(self, after_revision))
    }
    fn ended(&self) -> bool {
        Client::ended(self)
    }
    fn shutdown(&self) {
        Client::shutdown(self);
    }
}

/// Where the session stands with Steam.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Phase {
    /// Its CM connection is up.
    Connected,
    /// Its CM connection dropped, and it connects again.
    Reconnecting,
    /// Every attempt to connect again failed: only `reconnect` tries again.
    Unreachable,
    /// Steam asked the account to sign in again. It is final.
    AuthenticationRequired,
    /// The session was closed. It is final.
    Closed,
}

/// What the session publishes.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct State {
    /// Grows with each change, across CM connections.
    pub revision: u64,
    pub phase: Phase,
    /// The CM connection of the moment: 0 for the first, one more for each
    /// that replaced a dropped one.
    pub transport: u64,
    /// What it, or the one that dropped, last told of the account's friends.
    pub friends: FriendsSnapshot,
}

impl State {
    /// Whether a wait for the state after `after_revision` ends with this
    /// one: a newer one, or at once a closed session's, since UniFFI never
    /// cancels Rust awaits.
    pub fn follows(&self, after_revision: u64) -> bool {
        self.revision != after_revision || self.phase == Phase::Closed
    }

    /// Whether a retry connects again: not once Steam asked the account to
    /// sign in again, nor once the session closed.
    pub fn retries(&self) -> bool {
        !matches!(self.phase, Phase::AuthenticationRequired | Phase::Closed)
    }
}

/// Opens a CM connection of the account.
pub(crate) type Connect<T> =
    Box<dyn Fn() -> BoxFuture<'static, Result<Arc<T>, ClientConnectError>> + Send + Sync>;

/// A CM connection the session follows, and the revision of its friends it
/// already published.
type Following<T> = (Arc<T>, u64);

/// The CM connection of the moment, and the task that follows it.
struct Link<T> {
    transport: Arc<T>,
    /// Grows each time `reconnect` or `close` replaces the cycle under way: a
    /// cycle no longer current changes nothing, and the connection it opens
    /// is shut down.
    cycle: u64,
    /// The current cycle's task, which follows the connection or connects
    /// again.
    task: Option<AbortHandle>,
}

pub struct AccountSession<T: Transport = Client> {
    connect: Connect<T>,
    /// Where cycles run, so that `reconnect` can start one from any thread.
    runtime: tokio::runtime::Handle,
    link: Mutex<Link<T>>,
    /// Sent with the link locked, so a state always names its connection.
    state: watch::Sender<State>,
    /// Lets a cancellation reach a Transfer waiting for the reconnection.
    waiting: Mutex<Option<CancelToken>>,
}

impl AccountSession {
    /// Signs `credentials` in. The first connection's failure is returned as
    /// it is: nothing retries it.
    pub async fn connect(credentials: Credentials) -> Result<Arc<Self>, ClientConnectError> {
        Self::open(Box::new(move || {
            let credentials = credentials.clone();
            Box::pin(async move {
                Client::connect(
                    &credentials.account_name,
                    credentials.steam_id,
                    &credentials.refresh_token,
                )
                .await
                .map(Arc::new)
            })
        }))
        .await
    }
}

impl<T: Transport> AccountSession<T> {
    /// Opens the first connection through `connect`, which every
    /// reconnection uses too.
    pub(crate) async fn open(connect: Connect<T>) -> Result<Arc<Self>, ClientConnectError> {
        let transport = connect().await?;
        let friends = transport.next_friends(0).await;
        let after = friends.revision;
        let (state, _) = watch::channel(State {
            revision: 1,
            phase: Phase::Connected,
            transport: 0,
            friends,
        });
        let session = Arc::new(Self {
            connect,
            runtime: tokio::runtime::Handle::current(),
            link: Mutex::new(Link {
                transport: transport.clone(),
                cycle: 0,
                task: None,
            }),
            state,
            waiting: Mutex::new(None),
        });
        session.spawn(&mut session.link(), Some((transport, after)));
        Ok(session)
    }

    /// The CM connection of the moment. Calls through one that dropped fail
    /// at once, as they always did.
    pub fn current(&self) -> Arc<T> {
        self.link().transport.clone()
    }

    /// The state after `after_revision`. A closed session answers at once,
    /// since UniFFI never cancels Rust awaits.
    pub async fn next(&self, after_revision: u64) -> State {
        let ready = next_matching(self.state.subscribe(), |state| {
            state.follows(after_revision)
        })
        .await;
        match ready {
            Ok(state) | Err(state) => state,
        }
    }

    /// Replaces the CM connection, live or not, and connects again as after a
    /// drop. Nothing once Steam asked the account to sign in again, or once
    /// closed.
    pub fn reconnect(self: &Arc<Self>) {
        let mut link = self.link();
        if !self.state.borrow().retries() {
            return;
        }
        self.end_cycle(&mut link, Phase::Reconnecting);
        self.spawn(&mut link, None);
    }

    /// Stops reconnecting, publishes Closed and shuts the connection down.
    pub fn close(&self) {
        let mut link = self.link();
        if self.state.borrow().phase != Phase::Closed {
            self.end_cycle(&mut link, Phase::Closed);
        }
    }

    fn link(&self) -> MutexGuard<'_, Link<T>> {
        self.link.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner)
    }

    fn waiting(&self) -> MutexGuard<'_, Option<CancelToken>> {
        self.waiting.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner)
    }

    /// Publishes the state `change` makes. The link must be locked.
    fn publish(&self, change: impl FnOnce(&mut State)) {
        self.state.send_modify(|state| {
            change(state);
            state.revision += 1;
        });
    }

    /// Ends the cycle under way, attempt included, publishes `phase`, then
    /// shuts the connection down. Shutting it down stops its download, so
    /// the Transfer whose turn comes next already sees `phase`.
    fn end_cycle(&self, link: &mut Link<T>, phase: Phase) {
        link.cycle += 1;
        if let Some(task) = link.task.take() {
            task.abort();
        }
        self.publish(|state| state.phase = phase);
        link.transport.shutdown();
    }

    /// Starts the link's cycle: it follows `following`, or connects again at
    /// once without it.
    fn spawn(self: &Arc<Self>, link: &mut Link<T>, following: Option<Following<T>>) {
        let task = self
            .runtime
            .spawn(Self::supervise(Arc::downgrade(self), link.cycle, following));
        link.task = Some(task.abort_handle());
    }

    /// Runs `cycle`: follows the connection, connects again once it drops,
    /// and follows the new one. It holds the session only between waits, so
    /// the session can go while it waits.
    async fn supervise(session: Weak<Self>, cycle: u64, mut following: Option<Following<T>>) {
        loop {
            if let Some((transport, after)) = following.take()
                && !Self::follow(&session, cycle, &transport, after).await
            {
                return;
            }
            match Self::connect_again(&session, cycle).await {
                Some(next) => following = Some(next),
                None => return,
            }
        }
    }

    /// Publishes the friends of `transport` after `after` until it ends.
    /// True when it dropped and the session connects again.
    async fn follow(session: &Weak<Self>, cycle: u64, transport: &Arc<T>, mut after: u64) -> bool {
        loop {
            let friends = transport.next_friends(after).await;
            after = friends.revision;
            let Some(session) = session.upgrade() else {
                return false;
            };
            let link = session.link();
            if link.cycle != cycle {
                return false;
            }
            match friends.connection {
                FriendsConnection::Disconnected => {
                    session.publish(|state| {
                        state.phase = Phase::Reconnecting;
                        state.friends = friends;
                    });
                    transport.shutdown();
                    return true;
                }
                FriendsConnection::AuthenticationRequired => {
                    session.publish(|state| {
                        state.phase = Phase::AuthenticationRequired;
                        state.friends = friends;
                    });
                    transport.shutdown();
                    return false;
                }
                _ => session.publish(|state| state.friends = friends),
            }
        }
    }

    /// Connects again, up to three times after growing waits, and makes the
    /// new connection the one of the moment. None when the cycle ends
    /// without one.
    async fn connect_again(session: &Weak<Self>, cycle: u64) -> Option<Following<T>> {
        for attempt in 0..ATTEMPTS {
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1 << attempt)).await;
            let connecting = (session.upgrade()?.connect)();
            match connecting.await {
                Ok(transport) => {
                    let friends = transport.next_friends(0).await;
                    let after = friends.revision;
                    let Some(session) = session.upgrade() else {
                        transport.shutdown();
                        return None;
                    };
                    let mut link = session.link();
                    if link.cycle != cycle {
                        transport.shutdown();
                        return None;
                    }
                    // The connection it replaces already ended.
                    link.transport = transport.clone();
                    session.publish(|state| {
                        state.phase = Phase::Connected;
                        state.transport += 1;
                        state.friends = friends;
                    });
                    return Some((transport, after));
                }
                Err(ClientConnectError::AuthenticationRequired(_)) => {
                    session
                        .upgrade()?
                        .settle(cycle, Phase::AuthenticationRequired);
                    return None;
                }
                Err(ClientConnectError::Other(_)) => {}
            }
        }
        session.upgrade()?.settle(cycle, Phase::Unreachable);
        None
    }

    /// Publishes `phase` the cycle ended in, unless another replaced it.
    fn settle(&self, cycle: u64, phase: Phase) {
        let link = self.link();
        if link.cycle == cycle {
            self.publish(|state| state.phase = phase);
        }
    }

    /// The connection a Transfer goes through: while the session
    /// reconnects, or once the connection of the moment ended before the
    /// session heard of it, the new one, or the one that dropped once it
    /// gave up. The Transfer keeps its turn in the download queue meanwhile,
    /// so those behind it, of every storefront, wait too. `cancel` stops the
    /// wait.
    async fn serving(&self) -> Result<Arc<T>, Failure> {
        let cancel = CancelToken::new();
        *self.waiting() = Some(cancel.clone());
        let settled = cancel
            .race(next_matching(self.state.subscribe(), |state| {
                match state.phase {
                    Phase::Reconnecting => false,
                    // A Transfer that failed as the connection ended may
                    // hand its turn on before the session publishes the end.
                    Phase::Connected => !self.current().ended(),
                    _ => true,
                }
            }))
            .await;
        self.waiting().take();
        settled
            .map(|_| self.current())
            .map_err(|_| Failure::Cancelled)
    }
}

/// A Transfer whose turn comes while the session reconnects waits for the
/// new connection. Every other call goes through the connection of the
/// moment at once.
impl<T: Transport> Network for AccountSession<T> {
    fn platform<'a>(
        &'a self,
        app_id: u32,
        language: &'a str,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<Platform, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move { self.serving().await?.platform(app_id, language).await })
    }
    fn download<'a>(
        &'a self,
        transfer: &'a Transfer<Steam>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<Installation, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move { self.serving().await?.download(transfer).await })
    }
    fn progress(&self) -> Option<TransferProgress> {
        self.current().progress()
    }
    fn cancel(&self) {
        if let Some(waiting) = self.waiting().as_ref() {
            waiting.cancel();
        }
        self.current().cancel();
    }
    fn update_available<'a>(
        &'a self,
        receipt: &'a Receipt<Steam>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<bool, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move { self.current().update_available(receipt).await })
    }
    /// A closed session never connects again.
    fn reconnected(&self, connection: u64) -> BoxFuture<'_, u64> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let ready = next_matching(self.state.subscribe(), |state| {
                state.phase == Phase::Closed
                    || (state.phase == Phase::Connected && state.transport != connection)
            })
            .await;
            match ready {
                Ok(state) if state.phase == Phase::Connected => state.transport,
                _ => std::future::pending().await,
            }
        })
    }
    fn launch_target<'a>(
        &'a self,
        app_id: u32,
        platform: Platform,
        install: &'a Path,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<LaunchTarget, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.current()
                .launch_target(app_id, platform, install)
                .await
        })
    }
    fn archive_rules(
        &self,
        app_id: u32,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<Option<(CloudMetadata, CloudListing)>, steam_cloud::Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move { self.current().archive_rules(app_id).await })
    }
    fn maintain(
        &self,
        target: steam_cloud::MaintenanceTarget,
        credentials: &Credentials,
        control: Arc<Control>,
        idle: &IdleGuard,
    ) -> Result<(), steam_cloud::Failure> {
        self.current().maintain(target, credentials, control, idle)
    }
}

impl<T: Transport> Drop for AccountSession<T> {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let link = self.link.get_mut().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner);
        if let Some(task) = link.task.take() {
            task.abort();
        }
        link.transport.shutdown();
    }
}
```

```rs
//! The Account session through its interface, against CM connections and a
//! connector the test stands in for. Time is paused, except where the
//! account's installations run: a wait passes as soon as nothing else can
//! run, and each attempt to connect records when it came.
use super::*;
use crate::{
    Locations,
    installations::{Installations, Offer, Queueing, Report, tests::eventually},
    queue::DownloadQueue,
    runtimes::tests::ready,
    sessions::Sessions,
    steam::{Product, content::Content},
};
use std::{
    collections::VecDeque,
    path::PathBuf,
    sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering},
};
use steam_kit::{client::ClientError, friends::FriendsEventSource};
use tokio::time::Instant;

/// The account, and its friends list and Alice's persona as Steam sends
/// them: written by hand, as the macOS tests' fixtures are.
const ACCOUNT: u64 = 0x0110_0001_0000_0064;
const FRIENDS_LIST: &[u8] = &[
    0x08, 0x00, 0x12, 0x0b, 0x09, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0x10, 1, 0x10, 3,
];
const ALICE: &[u8] = &[
    0x08, 0x13, 0x12, 21, 0x09, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0x10, 1, 0x10, 1, 0x7a, 5, b'A', b'l', b'i',
    b'c', b'e', 0xfa, 1, 0,
];
/// What a call through a client whose connection ended fails with.
const DISCONNECTED: &str = "backend.steam.cm.disconnected";
/// What a download its client's shutdown stopped fails with.
const STOPPED: &str = "backend.steam.content.cancelled";

/// One CM connection the test stands in for. Its friends go through Steam's
/// own reducer. Every call it serves is recorded, and fails as through a
/// dead client once it ended.
struct Connection {
    friends: FriendsEventSource,
    ended: CancelToken,
    /// Its downloads wait while the test holds them, until it ends.
    held: Mutex<Option<CancelToken>>,
    /// Steam offers a newer build of every installation through it.
    newer: AtomicBool,
    calls: Mutex<Vec<String>>,
}

impl Connection {
    /// A connection whose friends list arrived: Alice, online.
    fn new() -> Arc<Self> {
        let friends = FriendsEventSource::new(ACCOUNT);
        friends.apply_packet(767, FRIENDS_LIST);
        friends.apply_packet(766, ALICE);
        Arc::new(Self {
            friends,
            ended: CancelToken::new(),
            held: Mutex::new(None),
            newer: AtomicBool::new(false),
            calls: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
        })
    }
    /// A connection through which Steam offers newer builds.
    fn offering_updates() -> Arc<Self> {
        let connection = Self::new();
        connection.newer.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        connection
    }
    fn calls(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        self.calls.lock().unwrap().clone()
    }
    fn hold(&self) {
        *self.held.lock().unwrap() = Some(CancelToken::new());
    }
    /// Steam drops the connection, as when its socket closes: it ends
    /// before its friends tell it.
    fn drops(&self) {
        self.ended.cancel();
        self.friends.disconnect(false);
    }
    /// Steam logs the account off: it must sign in again.
    fn logs_off(&self) {
        self.ended.cancel();
        self.friends.disconnect(true);
    }
    /// Records `call`, which fails once the connection ended.
    fn serve(&self, call: impl Into<String>) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        self.calls.lock().unwrap().push(call.into());
        if self.ended() {
            return Err(Failure::Failed(DISCONNECTED.into()));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl Network for Connection {
    fn platform<'a>(&'a self, _: u32, _: &'a str) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<Platform, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move { self.serve("platform").map(|()| Platform::Mac) })
    }
    fn download<'a>(
        &'a self,
        transfer: &'a Transfer<Steam>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<Installation, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let app_id = transfer.product.app_id;
            self.serve(format!("download:{app_id}"))?;
            let held = self.held.lock().unwrap().clone();
            if let Some(held) = held {
                tokio::select! {
                    () = held.cancelled() => {}
                    () = self.ended.cancelled() => {}
                }
            }
            if self.ended() {
                return Err(Failure::Failed(STOPPED.into()));
            }
            Ok(Installation {
                app_id,
                name: transfer.name.clone(),
                directory: transfer
                    .directory
                    .join(format!("steam-{app_id}-macos"))
                    .to_string_lossy()
                    .into_owned(),
                platform: Platform::Mac,
                language: transfer.product.language.clone(),
                total_bytes: 100,
                manifests: Vec::new(),
            })
        })
    }
    fn progress(&self) -> Option<TransferProgress> {
        None
    }
    fn cancel(&self) {
        self.calls.lock().unwrap().push("cancel".into());
    }
    fn update_available<'a>(
        &'a self,
        _: &'a Receipt<Steam>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<bool, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.serve("update")
                .map(|()| self.newer.load(Ordering::Acquire))
        })
    }
    fn launch_target<'a>(
        &'a self,
        _: u32,
        _: Platform,
        install: &'a Path,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<LaunchTarget, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.serve("launch")?;
            Ok(LaunchTarget {
                executable: install.join("Portal 2.app").to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
                arguments: Vec::new(),
                working_directory: install.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
                is_application_bundle: true,
            })
        })
    }
    fn archive_rules(
        &self,
        _: u32,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<Option<(CloudMetadata, CloudListing)>, steam_cloud::Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.serve("archive")
                .map(|()| None)
                .map_err(|_| steam_cloud::Failure::Network)
        })
    }
    fn maintain(
        &self,
        _: steam_cloud::MaintenanceTarget,
        _: &Credentials,
        _: Arc<Control>,
        _: &IdleGuard,
    ) -> Result<(), steam_cloud::Failure> {
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl Transport for Connection {
    fn next_friends(&self, after_revision: u64) -> BoxFuture<'_, FriendsSnapshot> {
        Box::pin(self.friends.next(after_revision))
    }
    fn ended(&self) -> bool {
        self.ended.is_cancelled()
    }
    fn shutdown(&self) {
        self.ended.cancel();
        self.friends.disconnect(false);
    }
}

/// How the test's connector answers one attempt to connect.
enum Answer {
    Connects(Arc<Connection>),
    /// Steam refuses the account's token.
    Refuses,
    Fails,
    /// Connects once the token is cancelled.
    Holds(Arc<Connection>, CancelToken),
}

/// Answers each attempt in turn; an attempt without an answer waits.
struct Connector {
    answers: Mutex<VecDeque<Answer>>,
    /// When each attempt came.
    attempts: Mutex<Vec<Instant>>,
}

impl Connector {
    fn new(answers: impl IntoIterator<Item = Answer>) -> Arc<Self> {
        Arc::new(Self {
            answers: Mutex::new(answers.into_iter().collect()),
            attempts: Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
        })
    }
    fn attempts(&self) -> Vec<Instant> {
        self.attempts.lock().unwrap().clone()
    }
    /// How long after `since` each attempt from then on came.
    fn waits(&self, since: Instant) -> Vec<Duration> {
        self.attempts()
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|attempt| *attempt >= since)
            .map(|attempt| attempt - since)
            .collect()
    }
    fn connect(self: &Arc<Self>) -> Connect<Connection> {
        let connector = self.clone();
        Box::new(move || {
            let connector = connector.clone();
            Box::pin(async move { connector.answer().await })
        })
    }
    async fn answer(&self) -> Result<Arc<Connection>, ClientConnectError> {
        self.attempts.lock().unwrap().push(Instant::now());
        let answer = self.answers.lock().unwrap().pop_front();
        match answer {
            Some(Answer::Connects(connection)) => Ok(connection),
            Some(Answer::Refuses) => Err(ClientConnectError::AuthenticationRequired(
                ClientError::Failure("backend.steam.friends.authenticationRequired".into()),
            )),
            Some(Answer::Fails) => Err(ClientConnectError::Other(ClientError::Failure(
                DISCONNECTED.into(),
            ))),
            Some(Answer::Holds(connection, released)) => {
                released.cancelled().await;
                Ok(connection)
            }
            None => std::future::pending().await,
        }
    }
}

/// A session opened through `connector`'s first answer. The attempts it
/// records start afterwards.
async fn open(connector: &Arc<Connector>) -> Arc<AccountSession<Connection>> {
    let session = AccountSession::open(connector.connect()).await.unwrap();
    connector.attempts.lock().unwrap().clear();
    session
}

/// What the session published last.
fn state(session: &AccountSession<Connection>) -> State {
    session.state.borrow().clone()
}

/// The first state after the one the session published last.
async fn changed(session: &AccountSession<Connection>) -> State {
    session.next(state(session).revision).await
}

/// Lets the session's tasks run until `done`, time passing as they all
/// wait.
async fn until(done: impl Fn() -> bool) {
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(60);
    while !done() {
        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "it never happened");
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
    }
}

fn product(app_id: u32) -> Product {
    Product {
        app_id,
        language: "english".into(),
    }
}

fn transfer(app_id: u32) -> Transfer<Steam> {
    Transfer {
        product: product(app_id),
        name: format!("Game {app_id}"),
        platform: Some(Platform::Mac),
        directory: PathBuf::from("/Games/Steam"),
    }
}

/// The account's installations, which reach Steam through its session and
/// keep their receipts in a library of their own. They run on their own
/// runtime, so tests that use them run in real time.
struct Account {
    _root: tempfile::TempDir,
    receipts: PathBuf,
    installations: Installations<Steam>,
}

impl Account {
    async fn new(session: &Arc<AccountSession<Connection>>) -> Self {
        let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let library = root.path().canonicalize().unwrap();
        let locations = Locations::new(
            &library,
            Path::new("/Applications/Obelisk.app"),
            &library.join("home"),
        );
        let sessions = Arc::new(Sessions::<Steam>::new(Box::new(|| Ok(None)), ready()));
        eventually(|| !sessions.state().recovering).await;
        let receipts = library.join("steam-installations-42.json");
        let credentials = Credentials {
            steam_id: 42,
            account_name: "fixture".into(),
            refresh_token: "fixture-only-never-sent".into(),
        };
        let installations = Installations::new(
            Arc::new(Content::new(session.clone(), credentials, locations)),
            sessions,
            42,
            receipts.clone(),
            library.join("home"),
            crate::games_folder::GamesFolder::new(&library),
            Queueing {
                queue: DownloadQueue::new(),
                account: "42".into(),
                name: |game: &u32| game.to_string(),
            },
        );
        Self {
            _root: root,
            receipts,
            installations,
        }
    }

    /// Installs `app_id`, whose Mac build Steam picks.
    fn install(&self, app_id: u32) {
        self.installations.install(Offer {
            product: product(app_id),
            name: format!("Game {app_id}"),
        });
    }
}

/// Downloads `app_id` through `session`, as the account's installations do.
fn downloading(
    session: &Arc<AccountSession<Connection>>,
    app_id: u32,
) -> tokio::task::JoinHandle<Result<u32, Failure>> {
    let session = session.clone();
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        let installed = session.download(&transfer(app_id)).await?;
        Ok(installed.app_id)
    })
}

#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]
async fn a_dropped_connection_is_replaced_and_the_session_reaches_steam_through_the_new_one() {
    let (a, b) = (Connection::new(), Connection::new());
    let connector = Connector::new([Answer::Connects(a.clone()), Answer::Connects(b.clone())]);
    let session = open(&connector).await;
    let opened = state(&session);
    assert_eq!((opened.phase, opened.transport), (Phase::Connected, 0));
    assert_eq!(opened.friends, a.friends.snapshot());

    let dropped = Instant::now();
    a.drops();
    let reconnecting = changed(&session).await;
    assert_eq!(reconnecting.phase, Phase::Reconnecting);
    assert_eq!(
        reconnecting.friends.friends, opened.friends.friends,
        "the friends stay, stale"
    );
    assert!(a.ended());
    assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&session.current(), &a));

    let connected = changed(&session).await;
    assert_eq!(
        (connected.phase, connected.transport),
        (Phase::Connected, 1)
    );
    assert_eq!(connected.friends, b.friends.snapshot());
    assert_eq!(connector.waits(dropped), [Duration::from_secs(1)]);
    assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&session.current(), &b));
    assert!(opened.revision < reconnecting.revision && reconnecting.revision < connected.revision);
}

#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]
async fn reconnecting_waits_one_two_then_four_seconds_and_gives_up_after_three_attempts() {
    let a = Connection::new();
    let connector = Connector::new([
        Answer::Connects(a.clone()),
        Answer::Fails,
        Answer::Fails,
        Answer::Fails,
        Answer::Connects(Connection::new()),
    ]);
    let session = open(&connector).await;

    let dropped = Instant::now();
    a.drops();
    until(|| state(&session).phase == Phase::Unreachable).await;
    assert_eq!(connector.waits(dropped), [1, 3, 7].map(Duration::from_secs));

    tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(60)).await;
    assert_eq!(
        connector.waits(dropped).len(),
        3,
        "only a retry tries again"
    );
    let unreachable = state(&session);
    assert_eq!(unreachable.phase, Phase::Unreachable);
    assert_eq!(unreachable.transport, 0);
    assert_eq!(unreachable.friends.friends, a.friends.snapshot().friends);
    assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&session.current(), &a));
}

#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]
async fn a_retry_discards_an_attempt_under_way() {
    let (a, b, late) = (Connection::new(), Connection::new(), Connection::new());
    let released = CancelToken::new();
    let connector = Connector::new([
        Answer::Connects(a.clone()),
        Answer::Holds(late.clone(), released.clone()),
        Answer::Connects(b.clone()),
    ]);
    let session = open(&connector).await;
    a.drops();
    until(|| connector.attempts().len() == 1).await;

    let retried = Instant::now();
    session.reconnect();
    released.cancel();
    let connected = changed(&session).await;
    assert_eq!(
        (connected.phase, connected.transport),
        (Phase::Connected, 1)
    );
    assert_eq!(connector.waits(retried), [Duration::from_secs(1)]);

    tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(60)).await;
    assert_eq!(state(&session).transport, 1);
    assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&session.current(), &b));
}

#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]
async fn closing_shuts_the_connection_down_wakes_every_wait_and_stops_reconnecting() {
    let a = Connection::new();
    let connector = Connector::new([Answer::Connects(a.clone())]);
    let session = open(&connector).await;
    a.drops();
    let reconnecting = changed(&session).await;
    let waiting = tokio::spawn({
        let session = session.clone();
        async move { session.next(reconnecting.revision).await }
    });
    let downloaded = downloading(&session, 620);
    until(|| session.waiting().is_some()).await;

    session.close();
    let closed = waiting.await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(closed.phase, Phase::Closed);
    assert_eq!(
        session.next(closed.revision).await,
        closed,
        "a closed session answers at once"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        downloaded.await.unwrap(),
        Err(Failure::Failed(DISCONNECTED.into())),
        "the waiting Transfer goes through the dropped connection"
    );
    tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(60)).await;
    assert!(connector.attempts().is_empty());

    let c = Connection::new();
    let session = open(&Connector::new([Answer::Connects(c.clone())])).await;
    drop(session);
    assert!(c.ended(), "a session that goes shuts its connection down");
}

#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]
async fn calls_go_through_the_connection_of_the_moment_and_fail_at_once_while_reconnecting() {
    let (a, b) = (Connection::new(), Connection::new());
    let connector = Connector::new([Answer::Connects(a.clone()), Answer::Connects(b.clone())]);
    let session = open(&connector).await;
    a.drops();
    changed(&session).await;

    let asked = Instant::now();
    let install = Path::new("/Games/Steam/steam-620-macos");
    assert_eq!(
        session.update_available(&receipt()).await,
        Err(Failure::Failed(DISCONNECTED.into()))
    );
    assert!(
        session
            .launch_target(620, Platform::Mac, install)
            .await
            .is_err()
    );
    assert!(matches!(
        session.archive_rules(620).await,
        Err(steam_cloud::Failure::Network)
    ));
    assert_eq!(Instant::now(), asked, "nothing waits for the reconnection");
    assert_eq!(a.calls(), ["update", "launch", "archive"]);

    changed(&session).await;
    assert_eq!(session.update_available(&receipt()).await, Ok(false));
    assert!(
        session
            .launch_target(620, Platform::Mac, install)
            .await
            .is_ok()
    );
    assert_eq!(b.calls(), ["update", "launch"]);
}

#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]
async fn a_transfer_waits_for_the_reconnection_and_downloads_through_the_new_connection() {

    let session = open(&connector).await;
    let dropped = Instant::now();
    a.drops();
    changed(&session).await;

    assert_eq!(Instant::now() - dropped, Duration::from_secs(1));
    assert_eq!(downloading(&session, 620).await.unwrap(), Ok(620));
    assert!(a.calls().is_empty());
    assert_eq!(b.calls(), ["platform", "download:620"]);
}

#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]
async fn a_transfer_whose_turn_comes_before_the_session_heard_of_the_drop_waits_for_the_new_connection()
 {
    let (a, b) = (Connection::new(), Connection::new());
    let connector = Connector::new([Answer::Connects(a.clone()), Answer::Connects(b.clone())]);
    let session = open(&connector).await;

    // The Transfer before it failed as the connection ended, and handed its
    // turn on at once.
    a.drops();
    assert_eq!(state(&session).phase, Phase::Connected);
    let installed = session.download(&transfer(620)).await;
    assert_eq!(installed.map(|installed| installed.app_id), Ok(620));
    assert!(a.calls().is_empty());
    assert_eq!(b.calls(), ["download:620"]);
}

/// The fix this session exists for: a Transfer whose turn comes while the
/// connection is replaced is neither lost nor run through the dead one. It
/// runs in real time, about a second.
#[tokio::test]
async fn queued_transfers_wait_out_a_reconnection_and_download_through_the_new_connection() {
    let (a, b) = (Connection::new(), Connection::new());
    a.hold();
    let connector = Connector::new([Answer::Connects(a.clone()), Answer::Connects(b.clone())]);
    let session = open(&connector).await;
    let account = Account::new(&session).await;
    let installations = &account.installations;
    account.install(620);
    account.install(730);
    eventually(|| a.calls() == ["platform", "download:620"]).await;
    assert_eq!(installations.state().queued, [730]);

    // 620's download ends with its connection, as it always did. 730's turn
    // comes while the session reconnects, and it waits.
    a.drops();
    eventually(|| {
        let state = installations.state();
        state.transfer_game == Some(730) && state.report.is_some()
    })
    .await;
    assert_eq!(
        installations.state().report,
        Some(Report::Storefront(STOPPED.into()))
    );
    assert_eq!(state(&session).phase, Phase::Reconnecting);
    assert!(b.calls().is_empty());

    eventually(|| !installations.state().downloading).await;
    assert_eq!(a.calls(), ["platform", "download:620"]);
    assert_eq!(b.calls(), ["platform", "download:730"]);
    let saved: Vec<Receipt<Steam>> =
        serde_json::from_slice(&std::fs::read(&account.receipts).unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        saved
            .iter()
            .map(|receipt| receipt.product.app_id)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        [730]
    );
}

/// An update check made through the connection that dropped holds nothing
/// back: the new one is asked at once, as a new sign-in's would be. It runs
/// in real time, about a second.
#[tokio::test]
async fn a_reconnection_asks_the_new_connection_for_newer_builds_at_once() {
    let (a, b) = (Connection::new(), Connection::offering_updates());
    let connector = Connector::new([Answer::Connects(a.clone()), Answer::Connects(b.clone())]);
    let session = open(&connector).await;
    let account = Account::new(&session).await;
    let installations = &account.installations;
    account.install(620);
    eventually(|| installations.state().receipts.len() == 1).await;
    installations.check_updates();
    eventually(|| a.calls() == ["platform", "download:620", "update"]).await;

    a.drops();
    eventually(|| installations.state().updates == ["620-macos"]).await;
    assert_eq!(b.calls(), ["update"]);
    assert_eq!(state(&session).transport, 1);
}
```

```rs
//! Auto-Cloud lifecycle owned by the detached game supervisor. The UI sends
//! decisions, never file transfers. Credentials exist only in process memory.
mod paths;

mod store;
pub use session::maintain;
pub(crate) use session::{Session, open};

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Config {
    pub root: PathBuf,
    pub home: PathBuf,
    pub install: PathBuf,
    pub app_id: u32,
    /// Set for a Windows game: its saves live in this Wine prefix.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub prefix: Option<PathBuf>,
}

impl Config {
    /// The build whose saves this Cloud manages, and where its roots are.
    pub(crate) fn platform(&self) -> steam_kit::cloud::CloudPlatform {
        match &self.prefix {
            Some(prefix) => steam_kit::cloud::CloudPlatform::Windows {
                profile: crate::wine::profile(prefix),
            },
            None => steam_kit::cloud::CloudPlatform::Mac {
                home: self.home.clone(),
            },
        }
    }
}

impl record::Configuration for Config {
    fn root(&self) -> &Path {
        &self.root
    }
    fn install(&self) -> &Path {
        &self.install
    }
    fn prefix(&self) -> Option<&Path> {
        self.prefix.as_deref()
    }
}

/// What Cloud maintenance syncs: an installed game, or an uninstalled game
/// whose saved context still holds pending work.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub enum MaintenanceTarget {
    Installed(Config),
    Uninstalled { root: PathBuf, app_id: u32 },
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, thiserror::Error)]
#[error("{}", self.key())]
pub enum Failure {
    Network,
    Authentication,
    Preferences,
    Unsupported,
    Conflict,
    Storage,
    Ownership,
    Recovery,
    Uncertain,
    Cancelled,
    Changed,
    Busy,
    Quota,
    /// The other storefront's copy of this game uses the same save paths.
    SharedSaves,
    /// An uninstalled game's Cloud rules changed since its exit save.
    RulesChanged,
}
impl Failure {
    pub fn key(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Network => "backend.steam.cloud.network",
            Self::Authentication => "backend.steam.cloud.authentication",
            Self::Preferences => "backend.steam.cloud.preferences",
            Self::Unsupported => "backend.steam.cloud.unsupported",
            Self::Conflict => "backend.steam.cloud.conflict",
            Self::Storage => "backend.steam.cloud.storage",
            Self::Ownership => "backend.steam.cloud.ownership",
            Self::Recovery => "backend.steam.cloud.recovery",
            Self::Uncertain => "backend.steam.cloud.uncertain",
            Self::Cancelled => "backend.steam.runtime.cancelled",
            Self::Changed => "backend.steam.cloud.changed",
            Self::Busy => "backend.steam.runtime.sessionBusy",
            Self::Quota => "backend.steam.cloud.quota",
            Self::SharedSaves => "backend.cloud.sharedSavesInUse",
            Self::RulesChanged => "backend.steam.cloud.rulesChanged",
        }
    }
}
impl From<cloud_vault::Error> for Failure {
    fn from(e: cloud_vault::Error) -> Self {
        use cloud_vault::Error;
        match e {
            Error::Busy => Self::Busy,
            Error::OtherStoreBusy => Self::SharedSaves,
            Error::Authentication => Self::Ownership,
            Error::Preferences => Self::Preferences,
            Error::Recovery => Self::Recovery,
            Error::Stale => Self::Changed,
            Error::Invalid | Error::Integrity | Error::Io(_) | Error::Journal(_) => Self::Storage,
        }
    }
}
impl From<steam_kit::cm::CmError> for Failure {
    fn from(e: steam_kit::cm::CmError) -> Self {
        use steam_kit::cm::CmError;
        match e {
            e if e.authentication_required() => Self::Authentication,
            // EResult::LimitExceeded and EResult::InsufficientPrivilege.
            CmError::Rejected {
                result: 25 | 84, ..
            } => Self::Quota,
            CmError::Protocol(_) | CmError::MissingApp(_) => Self::Unsupported,
            CmError::Rejected { .. }
            | CmError::Disconnected
            | CmError::Timeout
            | CmError::NoContentServer
            | CmError::Directory(_) => Self::Network,
        }
    }
}
impl From<steam_kit::cloud::CloudError> for Failure {
    fn from(e: steam_kit::cloud::CloudError) -> Self {
        use steam_kit::cloud::CloudError;
        match e {
            CloudError::Cm(e) => e.into(),
            CloudError::Network | CloudError::Timeout => Self::Network,
            CloudError::Changed => Self::Changed,
            CloudError::Revoked => Self::Authentication,
            CloudError::Uncertain | CloudError::NotCommitted => Self::Uncertain,
            CloudError::Storage | CloudError::Integrity => Self::Storage,
            CloudError::Invalid(_)
            | CloudError::Delta
            | CloudError::UnsupportedFormat { .. }
            | CloudError::Host(_)
            | CloudError::OtherPlatforms => Self::Unsupported,
        }
    }
}
impl From<Stop> for Failure {
    fn from(stop: Stop) -> Self {
        match stop {
            Stop::Cancelled => Self::Cancelled,
            Stop::Revoked => Self::Authentication,
        }
    }
}
impl From<std::io::Error> for Failure {
    fn from(_: std::io::Error) -> Self {
        Self::Storage
    }
}
impl From<serde_json::Error> for Failure {
    fn from(_: serde_json::Error) -> Self {
        Self::Storage
    }
}
impl From<Failure> for crate::Error {
    fn from(failure: Failure) -> Self {
        match failure {
            Failure::Cancelled => Self::Cancelled,
            Failure::Busy => Self::SessionBusy,
            failure => Self::Cloud(failure),
        }
    }
}

    app_scope(account, config.app_id)
}
```

```rs
use super::{
    Failure,
    store::{Context, directory},
};
use std::path::PathBuf;
use steam_kit::cloud::{AutoCloudPaths, CloudError, CloudFile, LocalCloudFile, SdkCloudPaths};

pub(super) enum Paths {
    Auto(AutoCloudPaths),
    Sdk(SdkCloudPaths),
    Mixed(AutoCloudPaths, SdkCloudPaths),
}
impl Paths {
    pub fn existing_file(&self, file: &CloudFile) -> Result<Option<PathBuf>, CloudError> {
        Ok(match self {
            Self::Auto(p) => p.existing_file(file)?,
            Self::Sdk(p) => p.existing_file(file)?,
            Self::Mixed(auto, sdk) => {
                if file.name.starts_with('%') {
                    auto.existing_file(file)?
                } else {
                    sdk.existing_file(file)?
                }
            }
        })
    }
    pub fn destination(&self, name: &str, platforms: u32) -> Result<Option<PathBuf>, CloudError> {
        Ok(match self {
            Self::Auto(p) => p.destination(name, platforms)?,
            Self::Sdk(p) => p.destination(name, platforms)?,
            Self::Mixed(auto, sdk) => {
                if name.starts_with('%') {
                    auto.destination(name, platforms)?
                } else {
                    sdk.destination(name, platforms)?
                }
            }
        })
    }
    pub fn local_files(&self, files: &[CloudFile]) -> Result<Vec<LocalCloudFile>, CloudError> {
        Ok(match self {
            Self::Auto(p) => p.local_files(files)?,
            Self::Sdk(p) => p.local_files(files)?,
            Self::Mixed(auto, sdk) => {
                let (autofiles, sdkfiles): (Vec<_>, Vec<_>) =
                    files.iter().cloned().partition(|f| f.name.starts_with('%'));
                let mut files = auto.local_files(&autofiles)?;
                files.extend(sdk.local_files(&sdkfiles)?);
                files
            }
        })
    }
}
impl Context {
    pub fn sdk_home(&self) -> Result<PathBuf, Failure> {
        directory(&self.config, self.account_id)?;
        let name = self
            .config
            .root
            .file_name()
            .and_then(|s| s.to_str())
            .ok_or(Failure::Storage)?;
        let home = self
            .config
            .root
            .with_file_name(format!("{name}-sdk"))
            .join(self.account_id.to_string())
            .join(self.config.app_id.to_string());
        crate::files::safe_storage_path(&home)?;
        Ok(home)
    }
    pub fn sdk_paths(&self) -> Result<SdkCloudPaths, Failure> {
        let entries = self.metadata.entries().ok_or(Failure::Unsupported)?;
        let mut keys = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
        for (key, _) in entries {
            if !keys.insert(key.to_ascii_lowercase()) {
                return Err(Failure::Unsupported);
            }
        }
        for key in ["quota", "maxnumfiles"] {
            if !self
                .metadata
                .field(key)
                .and_then(|v| v.text())
                .and_then(|v| v.parse::<u64>().ok())
                .is_some_and(|n| n > 0)
            {
                return Err(Failure::Unsupported);
            }
        }
        Ok(SdkCloudPaths::new(
            self.sdk_home()?.join(format!(
                "Library/Application Support/Steam/userdata/{}/{}",
                self.account_id as u32, self.config.app_id
            )),
            self.config.app_id,
            self.config.platform().mask(),
        )?)
    }
    pub fn prepare_sdk(&self) -> Result<Option<crate::NativeStorage>, Failure> {
        if self.metadata.field("savefiles").is_some() && self.metadata.field("quota").is_none() {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        let paths = self.sdk_paths()?;
        // Reconciliation has finished and no native generation exists yet.
        // Bindings are authoritative here, including newly downloaded files.
        let files = self
            .bindings
            .iter()
            .filter(|(name, _)| !name.starts_with('%'))
            .map(|(name, file)| LocalCloudFile {
                name: name.clone(),
                path: file.path.clone(),
                platforms: file.platforms,
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        paths.prepare_index(&files)?;
        Ok(Some(crate::NativeStorage {
            home: self.sdk_home()?,
            account_id: self.account_id,
            app_id: self.config.app_id,
            platforms: self.config.platform().mask(),
        }))
    }
}
```
