`crates/game-runtime/src/steam/cloud/session.rs`:

```rs
//! Steam Cloud as a Cloud sync uses it: the app's AutoCloud rules and Steam's
//! preferences, verified remote reads over the CM connection, and upload
//! transactions whose receipt can be settled after a lost reply.
use super::{store::Context, *};
use crate::{
    cloud::{
        record::{self, Record as _},
        sync::{self, Availability, CloudSync, Kind, Storefront},
    },
    cloud_status::UnavailableReason,
    protocol::Credentials,
    supervisor::client::SessionAlive,
};
use cloud_vault::{Manifest, Preferences, Vault};
use steam_kit::{
    cloud::{CloudListing, CloudPreferencesCache, UploadTransaction},
    cm::SteamConnection,
};

#[cfg(test)]
mod fake;
mod remote;
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests;
pub(crate) use remote::SteamCm;
use remote::SteamRemote;
pub(crate) use remote::{CloudConnection, CloudRemote};

/// One Steam game's Cloud sync.
pub(crate) type Session<R = SteamCm> = CloudSync<Adapter<R>>;

/// Opens the Cloud sync of one Steam game over Steam's CM.
pub(crate) fn open(
    config: Config,
    credentials: Credentials,
    session_id: String,
    control: Arc<Control>,
) -> Result<Session, Failure> {
    open_with(SteamCm::new()?, config, credentials, session_id, control)
}

pub(crate) fn open_with<R: CloudRemote>(
    remote: R,
    config: Config,
    credentials: Credentials,
    session_id: String,
    control: Arc<Control>,
) -> Result<Session<R>, Failure> {
    let adapter = Adapter {
        config,
        credentials,
        remote,
        preferences: CloudPreferencesCache::default(),
        context: None,
    };
    CloudSync::open(adapter, control, session_id)
}

/// Steam Cloud for one app and account.
pub(crate) struct Adapter<R: CloudRemote = SteamCm> {
    config: Config,
    credentials: Credentials,
    remote: R,
    preferences: CloudPreferencesCache,
    context: Option<Context>,
}

impl<R: CloudRemote> Adapter<R> {
    pub fn native_storage(&self) -> Result<Option<crate::NativeStorage>, crate::Error> {
        self.context
            .as_ref()
            .map(|context| context.prepare_sdk())
            .transpose()
            .map(Option::flatten)
            .map_err(Into::into)
    }
    fn context(&self) -> Result<&Context, Failure> {
        self.context.as_ref().ok_or(Failure::Storage)
    }
    fn context_mut(&mut self) -> Result<&mut Context, Failure> {
        self.context.as_mut().ok_or(Failure::Storage)
    }
    /// Unknown preferences never authorize a transfer, and an explicitly
    /// disabled one is not an error.
    async fn preferences(
        &mut self,
        cm: &mut R::Connection,
        vault: &mut Vault,
    ) -> Result<Availability, Failure> {
        let preferences = cm.preferences(&mut self.preferences).await?;
        vault.set_preferences(Preferences {
            account_enabled: preferences.account_enabled,
            game_enabled: preferences.game_enabled,
        });
        if preferences.account_enabled == Some(false) || preferences.game_enabled == Some(false) {
            return Ok(Availability::Unavailable(UnavailableReason::Disabled));
        }
        if preferences.account_enabled != Some(true) || preferences.game_enabled != Some(true) {
            return Err(Failure::Preferences);
        }
        Ok(Availability::Available)
    }
}

impl sync::Failure for Failure {
    fn kind(&self) -> Kind {
        match self {
            Self::Network | Self::Changed | Self::Uncertain => Kind::Transient,
            Self::Conflict => Kind::Conflict,
            Self::Preferences | Self::Unsupported | Self::Quota => Kind::Unavailable,
            Self::Authentication => Kind::Denied,
            Self::Cancelled => Kind::Cancelled,
            Self::Storage
            | Self::Ownership
            | Self::Recovery
            | Self::Busy
            | Self::SharedSaves
            | Self::RulesChanged => Kind::Blocking,
        }
    }
    fn key(&self) -> String {
        Failure::key(*self).into()
    }
    fn timed_out() -> Self {
        Self::Network
    }
    fn conflict() -> Self {
        Self::Conflict
    }
    fn recovery() -> Self {
        Self::Recovery
    }
    fn unsupported() -> Self {
        Self::Unsupported
    }
    fn changed() -> Self {
        Self::Changed
    }
}

impl<R: CloudRemote> Storefront for Adapter<R> {
    type Failure = Failure;
    type Record = Context;
    type Link = R::Connection;
    type Remote<'a>
        = SteamRemote<'a, R::Connection>
    where
        Self: 'a;

    fn configuration(&self) -> &Config {
        &self.config
    }
    fn account(&self) -> &u64 {
        &self.credentials.steam_id
    }
    fn record(&self) -> Option<&Context> {
        self.context.as_ref()
    }
    fn record_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Option<Context> {
        &mut self.context
    }
    /// A game Steam has no saved rules for has nothing in the archive yet.
    fn offline(&self) -> bool {
        true
    }
    fn retained(&mut self) -> Option<Vec<Manifest>> {
        // A failed context save can leave newer in-memory values alongside an
        // older durable decision. Keep both until a later save commits.
        let saved = match Context::load(&self.config, &self.credentials.steam_id) {
            Ok(saved) => saved,
            Err(error) => {
                eprintln!("Steam Cloud context unreadable: {error}");
                return None;
            }
        };
        Some(
            saved
                .iter()
                .chain(self.context.iter())
                .flat_map(Context::manifests)
                .collect(),
        )
    }

    async fn connect(&mut self, control: &Arc<Control>) -> Result<R::Connection, Failure> {
        control.check()?;
        let cm = self
            .remote
            .connect(&self.credentials, self.config.app_id, control.clone())
            .await?;
        control.check()?;
        Ok(cm)
    }
    async fn rules(
        &mut self,
        cm: &mut R::Connection,
        vault: &mut Vault,
        adopt: bool,
    ) -> Result<Availability, Failure> {
        let Some(metadata) = cm.cloud_metadata().await? else {
            return Ok(Availability::Unavailable(UnavailableReason::NoCloud));
        };
        if metadata
            .field("appidredirect")
            .is_some_and(|v| v.text() != Some("0"))
        {
            return Ok(Availability::Unavailable(UnavailableReason::Unsupported));
        }
        if metadata.field("savefiles").is_some() {
            match steam_kit::cloud::AutoCloudPaths::new(
                &metadata,
                self.credentials.steam_id,
                &self.config.platform(),
                &self.config.install,
            ) {
                // Steam keeps nothing of this build's saves, as KIBORG's Mac
                // build, whose rules are all for Windows and Linux.
                Err(steam_kit::cloud::CloudError::OtherPlatforms) => {
                    return Ok(Availability::Unavailable(UnavailableReason::Unsupported));
                }
                paths => {
                    paths?;
                }
            }
        }
        match &mut self.context {
            // A captured save can only be sent under the rules it was
            // captured with. A reinstall compares it under the new ones.
            Some(context) if !adopt && context.metadata != metadata => {
                return Err(if context.installation_removed {
                    Failure::RulesChanged
                } else {
                    Failure::Unsupported
                });
            }
            Some(context) => {
                record::rebind(context, self.config.clone());
                context.metadata = metadata;
            }
            None => {
                self.context = Some(Context::new(
                    &self.config,
                    self.credentials.steam_id,
                    metadata,
                ));
            }
        }
        // Learn the server's exact remote identities before adopting local
        // files. Optional root separators must not create archive aliases.
        let listing = cm.listing().await?;
        let context = self.context_mut()?;
        context.listing = listing;
        context.save()?;
        self.preferences(cm, vault).await
    }
    async fn settle(&mut self, cm: &mut R::Connection, vault: &Vault) -> Result<bool, Failure> {
        let pending = vault.pending().ok_or(Failure::Storage)?;
        if !pending.may_have_committed {
            return Ok(true);
        }
        let path = self
            .context()?
            .transaction
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or(Failure::Storage)?;
        let mut transaction = UploadTransaction::open(path)?;
        if transaction.steam_id() != self.credentials.steam_id
            || transaction.app_id() != self.config.app_id
        {
            return Err(Failure::Authentication);
        }
        // Keep the proven cleanup for an interrupted HTTP body. A lost
        // receipt must not permanently prevent a new comparison, though.
        let result = cm.settle_upload(&mut transaction).await;
        recovery_is_settled(result, transaction.is_settled())
    }
    fn reconciled(&mut self) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        let context = self.context_mut()?;
        context.transaction = None;
        context.save()
    }
    fn remote<'a>(
        &'a mut self,
        cm: &'a mut R::Connection,
        // The CM connection already stops with the sync's control.
        _: &'a Control,
    ) -> Result<SteamRemote<'a, R::Connection>, Failure> {
        Ok(SteamRemote {
            cm,
            context: self.context.as_mut().ok_or(Failure::Storage)?,
            config: &self.config,
            steam_id: self.credentials.steam_id,
        })
    }
}

// A retry can recompare after a lost receipt or failed best-effort close, while
// retaining hard failures such as revocation, corrupt storage and bad metadata.
fn recovery_is_settled(
    result: Result<(), steam_kit::cloud::CloudError>,
    settled: bool,
) -> Result<bool, Failure> {
    match result.map_err(Failure::from) {
        Ok(()) => Ok(settled),
        Err(Failure::Network | Failure::Changed | Failure::Uncertain) => Ok(false),
        Err(error) => Err(error),
    }
}

/// Cloud maintenance of one Steam game, run inside Obelisk. `idle` proves that
/// no Steam launch or supervisor can start while it runs.
pub fn maintain(
    target: MaintenanceTarget,
    credentials: &Credentials,
    control: Arc<Control>,
    idle: &crate::steam::IdleGuard,
) -> Result<(), Failure> {
    let runtime = crate::executor()?;
    runtime.block_on(maintain_with(
        SteamCm::new()?,
        target,
        credentials,
        control,
        &|id| idle.session_alive(id),
    ))
}

pub(crate) async fn maintain_with<R: CloudRemote>(
    remote: R,
    target: MaintenanceTarget,
    credentials: &Credentials,
    control: Arc<Control>,
    alive: &SessionAlive<'_>,
) -> Result<(), Failure> {
    let config = match target {
        MaintenanceTarget::Installed(config) => config,
        MaintenanceTarget::Uninstalled { root, app_id } => {
            let scope = app_scope(credentials.steam_id, app_id).into();
            record::saved::<Context>(&root, &scope)?
                .ok_or(Failure::Unsupported)?
                .config
        }
    };
    let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
    open_with(remote, config, credentials.clone(), id, control)?
        .maintain(alive)
        .await
}
```

```rs
//! An in-memory Steam Cloud for session tests: one app's files, its Cloud
//! rules and preferences, and failures injected into the next connection.
use super::*;
use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};
use std::{
    collections::{BTreeMap, VecDeque},
    sync::Mutex,
};
use steam_kit::cloud::{CloudError, CloudFile, CloudMetadata, CloudPreferences};

pub(crate) struct FakeSteamCloud {
    state: Arc<Mutex<FakeState>>,
}

struct FakeState {
    steam_id: u64,
    app_id: u32,
    metadata: Option<CloudMetadata>,
    enabled: Option<bool>,
    change_number: u64,
    files: BTreeMap<String, (Vec<u8>, u32)>,
    uploads: usize,
    downloads: usize,
    failures: VecDeque<Failure>,
}

/// AutoCloud rule for `*.sav` files at the top of the installation.
pub(crate) fn save_rule() -> CloudMetadata {
    let rule = CloudMetadata::Object(
        [
            ("root", "GameInstall"),
            ("path", ""),
            ("pattern", "*.sav"),
            ("recursive", "0"),
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(key, value)| (key.into(), CloudMetadata::Value(value.into())))
        .collect(),
    );
    CloudMetadata::Object(vec![(
        "savefiles".into(),
        CloudMetadata::Object(vec![("0".into(), rule)]),
    )])
}

/// The remote name of `slot.sav` under [`save_rule`].
pub(crate) const SLOT: &str = "%GameInstall%slot.sav";

impl FakeSteamCloud {
    pub(crate) fn new(steam_id: u64, app_id: u32) -> Self {
        Self {
            state: Arc::new(Mutex::new(FakeState {
                steam_id,
                app_id,
                metadata: Some(save_rule()),
                enabled: Some(true),
                change_number: 1,
                files: BTreeMap::new(),
                uploads: 0,
                downloads: 0,
                failures: VecDeque::new(),
            })),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn handle(&self) -> Self {
        Self {
            state: Arc::clone(&self.state),
        }
    }

    /// Another device publishes this file.
    pub(crate) fn publish(&self, name: &str, bytes: &[u8]) {
        self.publish_for(name, bytes, 2);
    }

    /// Another device publishes this file for these platforms only.
    pub(crate) fn publish_for(&self, name: &str, bytes: &[u8], platforms: u32) {
        let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
        state.files.insert(name.into(), (bytes.to_vec(), platforms));
        state.change_number += 1;
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_metadata(&self, metadata: Option<CloudMetadata>) {
        self.state.lock().unwrap().metadata = metadata;
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_enabled(&self, enabled: Option<bool>) {
        self.state.lock().unwrap().enabled = enabled;
    }

    pub(crate) fn fail_next_connection(&self, failure: Failure) {
        self.state.lock().unwrap().failures.push_back(failure);
    }

    pub(crate) fn file(&self, name: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
        let state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
        state.files.get(name).map(|(bytes, _)| bytes.clone())
    }

    pub(crate) fn uploads(&self) -> usize {
        self.state.lock().unwrap().uploads
    }

    /// Files read from this Cloud so far.
    pub(crate) fn downloads(&self) -> usize {
        self.state.lock().unwrap().downloads
    }

    /// The Cloud rules and listing Steam gives an uninstall archive, `None`
    /// without Steam Cloud.
    pub(crate) fn archive_rules(&self) -> Option<(CloudMetadata, CloudListing)> {
        let state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
        state
            .metadata
            .clone()
            .map(|metadata| (metadata, state.listing()))
    }
}

impl FakeState {
    fn listing(&self) -> CloudListing {
        CloudListing {
            steam_id: self.steam_id,
            app_id: self.app_id,
            change_number: self.change_number,
            files: self
                .files
                .iter()
                .map(|(name, (bytes, platforms))| CloudFile {
                    name: name.clone(),
                    sha1: Sha1::digest(bytes)
                        .iter()
                        .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
                        .collect(),
                    size: bytes.len() as u32,
                    timestamp: 1,
                    persist_state: 0,
                    platforms: *platforms,
                    reupload_requested: false,
                })
                .collect(),
        }
    }
}

impl CloudRemote for FakeSteamCloud {
    type Connection = FakeConnection;
    async fn connect(
        &self,
        _credentials: &Credentials,
        _app_id: u32,
        _control: Arc<Control>,
    ) -> Result<FakeConnection, Failure> {
        if let Some(failure) = self.state.lock().unwrap().failures.pop_front() {
            return Err(failure);
        }
        Ok(FakeConnection {
            state: Arc::clone(&self.state),
        })
    }
}

pub(crate) struct FakeConnection {
    state: Arc<Mutex<FakeState>>,
}

impl CloudConnection for FakeConnection {
    async fn download_files(
        &mut self,
        files: &[CloudFile],
        mut receive: impl FnMut(&CloudFile, Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), CloudError>,
    ) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        for file in files {
            let bytes = {
                let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
                state.downloads += 1;
                state
                    .files
                    .get(&file.name)
                    .map(|(bytes, _)| bytes.clone())
                    .ok_or(Failure::Changed)?
            };
            file.verify(&bytes)?;
            receive(file, bytes)?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    async fn listing(&mut self) -> Result<CloudListing, Failure> {
        Ok(self.state.lock().unwrap().listing())
    }
    async fn cloud_metadata(&mut self) -> Result<Option<CloudMetadata>, Failure> {
        Ok(self.state.lock().unwrap().metadata.clone())
    }
    async fn preferences(
        &mut self,
        _cache: &mut CloudPreferencesCache,
    ) -> Result<CloudPreferences, CloudError> {
        let enabled = self.state.lock().unwrap().enabled;
        Ok(CloudPreferences {
            account_enabled: enabled,
            game_enabled: enabled,
            revision: 1,
        })
    }
    async fn settle_upload(
        &mut self,
        _transaction: &mut UploadTransaction,
    ) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        Ok(())
    }
    async fn upload(
        &mut self,
        transaction: &mut UploadTransaction,
    ) -> Result<CloudListing, CloudError> {
        let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
        for (index, file) in transaction.uploads().iter().enumerate() {
            let bytes = transaction.upload_body(index)?;
            state
                .files
                .insert(file.name.clone(), (bytes, file.platforms));
        }
        for name in transaction.deletes() {
            state.files.remove(name);
        }
        state.change_number += 1;
        state.uploads += 1;
        Ok(state.listing())
    }
}
```

```rs
use super::super::paths::Paths;
use super::*;
use crate::cloud::view::{self, Listed};
use cloud_vault::RemoteView;
use std::collections::BTreeSet;
use steam_kit::cloud::{CloudError, CloudFile, CloudMetadata, CloudPreferences, CloudUpload};

/// One authenticated Steam Cloud connection, bound to one app.
pub(crate) trait CloudConnection {
    async fn listing(&mut self) -> Result<CloudListing, Failure>;
    /// Reads `files` in one bounded window, each verified against its listed
    /// hash before `receive` gets it.
    async fn download_files(
        &mut self,
        files: &[CloudFile],
        receive: impl FnMut(&CloudFile, Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), CloudError>,
    ) -> Result<(), Failure>;
    /// The app's Cloud rules, or `None` when the game has no Steam Cloud.
    async fn cloud_metadata(&mut self) -> Result<Option<CloudMetadata>, Failure>;
    async fn preferences(
        &mut self,
        cache: &mut CloudPreferencesCache,
    ) -> Result<CloudPreferences, CloudError>;
    async fn settle_upload(
        &mut self,
        transaction: &mut UploadTransaction,
    ) -> Result<(), CloudError>;
    /// Commits the transaction and returns the complete listing that
    /// confirmed it.
    async fn upload(
        &mut self,
        transaction: &mut UploadTransaction,
    ) -> Result<CloudListing, CloudError>;
}

/// Where a session's Cloud connections come from: Steam's CM in production,
/// an in-memory store in tests.
pub(crate) trait CloudRemote {
    type Connection: CloudConnection;
    async fn connect(
        &self,
        credentials: &Credentials,
        app_id: u32,
        control: Arc<Control>,
    ) -> Result<Self::Connection, Failure>;
}

}

            http: steam_kit::client::http_client().map_err(|_| Failure::Network)?,
        })

        })

pub(crate) struct CmConnection {
    cm: SteamConnection,
    http: reqwest::Client,
    app_id: u32,
    control: Arc<Control>,
}

impl CmConnection {
    /// steam-kit's guard, checked before each Cloud request: a cancelled or
    /// revoked sync sends nothing more. Its journaled uploads take this guard
    /// rather than a token, so every call here stops the same way.
    fn authorized(&self) -> impl Fn() -> bool + '_ {
        let control = &self.control;
        move || control.check().is_ok()
    }
}

impl CloudConnection for CmConnection {
    async fn download_files(
        &mut self,
        files: &[CloudFile],
        receive: impl FnMut(&CloudFile, Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), CloudError>,
    ) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        Ok(self
            .cm
            .cloud_download_files(&self.http, self.app_id, files, self.authorized(), receive)
            .await?)
    }
    async fn listing(&mut self) -> Result<CloudListing, Failure> {
        Ok(self.cm.cloud_listing(self.app_id).await?)
    }
    async fn cloud_metadata(&mut self) -> Result<Option<CloudMetadata>, Failure> {
        Ok(self.cm.app_info(self.app_id).await?.cloud)
    }
    async fn preferences(
        &mut self,
        cache: &mut CloudPreferencesCache,
    ) -> Result<CloudPreferences, CloudError> {
        self.cm
            .cloud_preferences_cached(&self.http, self.app_id, cache)
            .await
    }
    async fn settle_upload(
        &mut self,
        transaction: &mut UploadTransaction,
    ) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        self.cm
            .cloud_settle_upload(&self.http, transaction, self.authorized())
            .await
    }
    async fn upload(
        &mut self,
        transaction: &mut UploadTransaction,
    ) -> Result<CloudListing, CloudError> {
        self.cm
            .cloud_upload(&self.http, transaction, self.authorized())
            .await
    }
}

/// A Steam Cloud listing, and which of its files Obelisk manages.
pub(crate) struct SteamListing {
    listing: CloudListing,
    /// Indices of the files Obelisk manages.
    managed: Vec<usize>,
}

impl SteamListing {
    /// `paths.existing_file` decides which files Obelisk manages; it also
    /// leaves out persist-state files.
    pub(super) fn managed(listing: CloudListing, paths: &Paths) -> Result<Self, Failure> {
        let mut managed = Vec::new();
        for (index, file) in listing.files.iter().enumerate() {
            if paths.existing_file(file)?.is_some() {
                managed.push(index);
            }
        }
        Ok(Self { listing, managed })
    }

    fn managed_files(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &CloudFile> {
        self.managed.iter().map(|&index| &self.listing.files[index])
    }
}

impl view::Listing for SteamListing {
    fn revision(&self) -> String {
        self.listing.change_number.to_string()
    }
    fn saves(&self) -> Vec<Listed<'_>> {
        self.managed_files()
            .map(|file| Listed {
                name: &file.name,
                size: u64::from(file.size),
                platforms: file.platforms,
            })
            .collect()
    }
    fn holds(&self, name: &str, bytes: &[u8]) -> bool {
        self.managed_files()
            .find(|file| file.name == name)
            .is_some_and(|file| file.verify(bytes).is_ok())
    }
}

/// Steam Cloud for one app and account, over one CM connection: the game's
/// Cloud record keeps the listing and view it adopts.
pub(crate) struct SteamRemote<'a, C> {
    pub(super) cm: &'a mut C,
    pub(super) context: &'a mut Context,
    pub(super) config: &'a Config,
    pub(super) steam_id: u64,
}

impl<C: CloudConnection> view::Remote for SteamRemote<'_, C> {
    type Failure = Failure;
    type Listing = SteamListing;
    const JOURNAL: &'static str = "steam-cm-autocloud";

    async fn list(&mut self) -> Result<SteamListing, Failure> {
        let listing = self.cm.listing().await?;
        if listing.steam_id != self.steam_id || listing.app_id != self.config.app_id {
            return Err(Failure::Authentication);
        }
        SteamListing::managed(listing, &self.context.paths()?)
    }
    async fn unchanged(&mut self, listing: &SteamListing) -> Result<bool, Failure> {
        Ok(self.cm.listing().await? == listing.listing)
    }
    async fn fetch(
        &mut self,
        listing: &SteamListing,
        names: &[&str],
        mut receive: impl FnMut(&str, Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), cloud_vault::Error>,
    ) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        let names: BTreeSet<&str> = names.iter().copied().collect();
        let files: Vec<_> = listing
            .managed_files()
            .filter(|file| names.contains(file.name.as_str()))
            .cloned()
            .collect();
        self.cm
            .download_files(&files, |file, bytes| {
                receive(&file.name, bytes).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)
            })
            .await
    }
    fn adopt(
        &mut self,
        listing: SteamListing,
        view: &RemoteView,
        vault: &Vault,
    ) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        self.context.listing = listing.listing;
        self.context.remote = view.clone();
        self.context.refresh_bindings(vault.local())?;
        self.context.save()
    }
    fn adopted(&self) -> Option<&Manifest> {
        Some(&self.context.remote.files)
    }
    async fn commit(
        &mut self,
        change: view::Change<'_, Failure>,
    ) -> Result<view::Committed<SteamListing>, Failure> {
        let mut uploads = Vec::new();
        for (name, file) in change.uploads() {
            uploads.push(CloudUpload {
                name: name.to_owned(),
                bytes: change.vault().read_content(file)?,
                timestamp: crate::unix_now(),
                platforms: file.platforms,
            });
        }
        let deletes = change.deletes().map(str::to_owned).collect();
        // Full listing preserves foreign-platform entries. Only the managed
        // Mac subset supplies upload/deletion operations and the Vault baseline.
        let mut transaction = UploadTransaction::create(
            &store::directory(self.config, self.steam_id)?,
            self.context.listing.clone(),
            uploads,
            deletes,
        )?;
        let paths = self.context.paths()?;
        let directory = transaction.directory().to_path_buf();
        let (context, cm) = (&mut *self.context, &mut *self.cm);
        let committed = change
            .send(
                || {
                    // Settling a lost receipt later needs this transaction.
                    context.transaction = Some(directory);
                    context.save()
                },
                async || SteamListing::managed(cm.upload(&mut transaction).await?, &paths),
            )
            .await?;
        self.context.transaction = None;
        Ok(committed)
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Steam's listing as a Cloud view reads it: only this account's app, and of
//! it only the files Obelisk manages, each held to Steam's own hash. The
//! game's Cloud record keeps the view, so a restart reads nothing again.
use super::*;

use crate::cloud::view::{Listing as _, Remote as _, Views};
use crate::steam::cloud::session::fake::{SLOT, save_rule};
use crate::steam::cloud::session::tests::{ACCOUNT, SteamGame};

        name: name.into(),
        sha1: Sha1::digest(bytes)
            .iter()
            .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
            .collect(),
        size: bytes.len() as u32,
        timestamp: 1,

        app_id: 42,

/// A connection that only lists.
struct ListingOnly(CloudListing);
impl CloudConnection for ListingOnly {
    async fn listing(&mut self) -> Result<CloudListing, Failure> {
        Ok(self.0.clone())
    }
    async fn download_files(
        &mut self,
        _: &[CloudFile],
        _: impl FnMut(&CloudFile, Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), CloudError>,
    ) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        unreachable!("a listing reads no file")
    }
    async fn cloud_metadata(&mut self) -> Result<Option<CloudMetadata>, Failure> {
        unreachable!("a listing reads no rules")
    }
    async fn preferences(
        &mut self,
        _: &mut CloudPreferencesCache,
    ) -> Result<CloudPreferences, CloudError> {
        unreachable!("a listing reads no preferences")
    }
    async fn settle_upload(&mut self, _: &mut UploadTransaction) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        unreachable!("a listing settles nothing")
    }
    async fn upload(&mut self, _: &mut UploadTransaction) -> Result<CloudListing, CloudError> {
        unreachable!("a listing uploads nothing")
    }
}

/// The game's listing as its Cloud view reads it.
async fn list(game: &SteamGame, listing: CloudListing) -> Result<SteamListing, Failure> {
    let mut context = Context::new(&game.config, ACCOUNT, save_rule());
    let mut cm = ListingOnly(listing);
    let mut remote = SteamRemote {
        cm: &mut cm,
        context: &mut context,
        config: &game.config,
        steam_id: ACCOUNT,
    };
    remote.list().await
}

#[tokio::test]

    assert!(matches!(

        Err(Failure::Authentication)
    ));
}

#[tokio::test]

        .await
        .unwrap();

    assert!(!listed.holds(NAME, b"sav!"));

#[tokio::test]
async fn unchanged_saves_are_read_once_across_a_restart_through_the_cloud_record() {
    let game = SteamGame::game();
    game.cloud.publish_for(SLOT, b"cloud v1", 7);
    Context::new(&game.config, ACCOUNT, save_rule())
        .save()
        .unwrap();
    let read = async || {
        let (mut adapter, vault) = game.adapter();
        // No baseline: only the record can stand in after a restart.
        assert!(vault.baseline().is_none());
        let mut cm = adapter.connect(&game.control).await.unwrap();
        Views::default()
            .read(
                &mut adapter.remote(&mut cm, &game.control).unwrap(),
                &vault,
                &game.control,
            )
            .await
            .unwrap()
    };

    let first = read().await;
    let again = read().await;

    assert_eq!(game.cloud.downloads(), 1);
    assert_eq!(again, first);
    assert_eq!(again.files.0[SLOT].platforms, 7);
}
```

```rs
//! Steam Cloud behind the Cloud sync: the shared suite over an in-memory Steam
//! Cloud, and what only Steam has: its preferences, AutoCloud rules, SDK
//! storage and upload transactions.
use super::fake::{FakeSteamCloud, SLOT, save_rule};
use super::*;
use crate::cloud::record::tests::record_suite;
use crate::cloud::sync::{
    Work,
    tests::{Harness, answer, cloud_suite, listed, uninstall, work},
};
use crate::cloud::{Choice, Phase};
use crate::cloud_status;
use crate::supervisor::client::no_other_session;
use cloud_vault::{AccountIdentity, RemoteView, StoreScope};
use std::{
    fs,
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
};
use steam_kit::cloud::{CloudMetadata, CloudUpload};

pub(crate) const ACCOUNT: u64 = 0x0110_0001_0000_002a;

/// The remote name of `slot.sav` under [`roaming_rule`].
const ROAMING: &str = "%WinAppDataRoaming%Game/slot.sav";

pub(crate) fn credentials() -> Credentials {
    Credentials {
        steam_id: ACCOUNT,
        account_name: "fixture".into(),
        refresh_token: "unused".into(),
    }
}

pub(crate) struct SteamGame {
    _temporary: tempfile::TempDir,
    pub config: Config,
    pub cloud: FakeSteamCloud,
    pub control: Arc<Control>,
}

impl SteamGame {
    fn uninstalled(&self) -> MaintenanceTarget {
        MaintenanceTarget::Uninstalled {
            root: self.config.root.clone(),
            app_id: self.config.app_id,
        }
    }
    /// The adapter and its vault without a sync around them.
    pub(crate) fn adapter(&self) -> (Adapter<FakeSteamCloud>, Vault) {
        let (vault, context) = record::locked(&self.config, &ACCOUNT).unwrap();
        let adapter = Adapter {
            config: self.config.clone(),
            credentials: credentials(),
            remote: self.cloud.handle(),
            preferences: CloudPreferencesCache::default(),
            context,
        };
        (adapter, vault)
    }
    fn unavailable(&self) -> Option<UnavailableReason> {
        cloud_status::read(&self.config.root, &Harness::scope(self))
            .unwrap()
            .unavailable
            .map(|marker| marker.reason)
    }
}

impl Harness for SteamGame {
    type Store = Adapter<FakeSteamCloud>;
    const NO_RULES: UnavailableReason = UnavailableReason::NoCloud;

    fn game() -> Self {
        let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let base = temporary.path().canonicalize().unwrap();
        let config = Config {
            root: base.join("cloud"),
            home: base.join("home"),
            install: base.join("game"),
            app_id: 42,
            prefix: None,
        };
        for path in [&config.root, &config.home, &config.install] {
            crate::files::private_directory(path).unwrap();
        }
        Self {
            cloud: FakeSteamCloud::new(ACCOUNT, config.app_id),
            control: Arc::new(Control::new(|_| {})),
            config,
            _temporary: temporary,
        }
    }
    fn control(&self) -> &Arc<Control> {
        &self.control
    }
    fn open(&self) -> Session<FakeSteamCloud> {
        open_with(
            self.cloud.handle(),
            self.config.clone(),
            credentials(),
            uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            Arc::clone(&self.control),
        )
        .unwrap()
    }
    fn save(&self) -> PathBuf {
        match &self.config.prefix {
            Some(prefix) => crate::wine::profile(prefix).join("AppData/Roaming/Game/slot.sav"),
            None => self.config.install.join("slot.sav"),
        }
    }
    fn slot(&self) -> &'static str {
        if self.config.prefix.is_some() {
            ROAMING
        } else {
            SLOT
        }
    }
    fn install(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.config.install.clone()
    }
    fn publish(&self, bytes: &[u8]) {
        // A Windows game's save is published for Windows only.
        let platforms = if self.config.prefix.is_some() { 1 } else { 2 };
        self.cloud.publish_for(self.slot(), bytes, platforms);
    }
    fn cloud(&self) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
        self.cloud.file(self.slot())
    }
    fn uploads(&self) -> usize {
        self.cloud.uploads()
    }
    fn fail_next(&self, transient: bool) {
        self.cloud.fail_next_connection(if transient {
            Failure::Network
        } else {
            Failure::Quota
        });
    }
    fn failure_key(&self) -> String {
        Failure::Quota.key().into()
    }
    fn set_rules(&self, available: bool) {
        let rule = if self.config.prefix.is_some() {
            roaming_rule
        } else {
            save_rule
        };
        self.cloud.set_metadata(available.then(rule));
    }
    fn run_in(&mut self, prefix: &Path) {
        self.config.prefix = Some(prefix.to_owned());
        self.cloud.set_metadata(Some(roaming_rule()));
        fs::create_dir_all(Harness::save(self).parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
    }
    async fn archive(&self) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        match self.cloud.archive_rules() {
            Some((metadata, listing)) => store::archive_with_rules(&self.config, metadata, listing),
            None => Ok(()),
        }
    }
    async fn maintain(&self, alive: &SessionAlive<'_>) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        let target = if self.config.install.exists() {
            MaintenanceTarget::Installed(self.config.clone())
        } else {
            self.uninstalled()
        };
        let control = Arc::clone(&self.control);
        maintain_with(self.cloud.handle(), target, &credentials(), control, alive).await
    }
    fn configuration(&self) -> Config {
        self.config.clone()
    }
    fn account_id(&self) -> &u64 {
        &ACCOUNT
    }
    fn root(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.config.root.clone()
    }
    fn scope(&self) -> StoreScope {
        scope(&self.config, ACCOUNT).into()
    }
    fn account(&self) -> AccountIdentity {
        ACCOUNT.into()
    }
}

mod suite {
    super::cloud_suite!(super::SteamGame);
    super::record_suite!(super::SteamGame);
}

    fs::write(Harness::save(game), bytes).unwrap();
    game.cloud.publish(SLOT, bytes);
    game.open().prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn unknown_steam_preferences_never_authorize_a_transfer() {

    let answering = std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let shown = control.status().decision_id;
        loop {
            let status = control.status();
            if status.decision_id > shown && !status.allowed_choices.is_empty() {
                assert!(status.allowed_choices.contains(&Choice::LaunchAnyway));
                control
                    .answer(status.decision_id, Choice::LaunchAnyway)
                    .unwrap();
                return status.error;

            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(10));
        }
    });

    game.open().prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();

    assert_eq!(
        answering.join().unwrap().as_deref(),
        Some(Failure::Preferences.key())
    );
    assert_eq!(game.cloud.file(SLOT).unwrap(), b"old");
    assert_eq!(game.cloud.uploads(), 0);

/// Saves in the Windows profile's roaming AppData, as ELDEN RING's.
fn roaming_rule() -> CloudMetadata {
    let rule = CloudMetadata::Object(
        [
            ("root", "WinAppDataRoaming"),
            ("path", "Game"),
            ("pattern", "*.sav"),
            ("recursive", "0"),
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(key, value)| (key.into(), CloudMetadata::Value(value.into())))
        .collect(),
    );
    CloudMetadata::Object(vec![(
        "savefiles".into(),
        CloudMetadata::Object(vec![("0".into(), rule)]),
    )])
}

#[test]
fn cleanup_keeps_the_last_durable_context_when_memory_has_advanced() {
    let game = SteamGame::game();
    Context::new(&game.config, ACCOUNT, save_rule())
        .save()
        .unwrap();
    let (mut adapter, mut vault) = game.adapter();
    let stage = |bytes: &[u8]| Manifest([(SLOT.into(), vault.stage(bytes, 2).unwrap())].into());
    let desired = stage(b"durable exit");
    let remote = RemoteView {
        revision: "2".into(),
        files: stage(b"durable conflict"),
    };
    let context = adapter.context.as_mut().unwrap();
    context.desired = Some(desired.clone());
    context.needs_work = true;
    context.remote = remote.clone();
    context.save().unwrap();
    // As after an unsuccessful context write, disk still owns these bytes.
    context.desired = None;
    context.remote = RemoteView {
        revision: "3".into(),
        files: Manifest::default(),
    };

    let retained = adapter.retained().unwrap();
    vault
        .collect_garbage(&retained.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>())
        .unwrap();

    assert!(vault.read_content(&desired.0[SLOT]).is_ok());
    assert!(vault.read_content(&remote.files.0[SLOT]).is_ok());
}

/// An upload whose receipt was lost: the vault may have committed it, and
/// its transaction stopped in `phase`.
fn lost_receipt(game: &SteamGame, phase: steam_kit::cloud::UploadPhase) -> (PathBuf, Vec<u8>) {
    let (mut adapter, mut vault) = game.adapter();
    let before = vault.baseline().unwrap().clone();
    vault.set_preferences(Preferences {
        account_enabled: Some(true),
        game_enabled: Some(true),
    });
    let bindings = adapter
        .context
        .as_mut()
        .unwrap()
        .bindings(&vault, None, true)
        .unwrap();
    let local = vault.capture(&bindings).unwrap();
    let authorization = vault.authorize(ACCOUNT).unwrap();
    let id = vault
        .queue_upload(&local, &before, "steam-cm-autocloud", authorization)
        .unwrap();
    let transaction = UploadTransaction::create(
        &store::directory(&game.config, ACCOUNT).unwrap(),
        adapter.context().unwrap().listing.clone(),
        vec![CloudUpload {
            name: SLOT.into(),
            bytes: fs::read(Harness::save(game)).unwrap(),
            timestamp: 1,
            platforms: 2,
        }],
        vec![],
    )
    .unwrap();
    let directory = transaction.directory().to_path_buf();
    drop(transaction);
    let journal = directory.join("state.json");
    let mut state: serde_json::Value =
        serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&journal).unwrap()).unwrap();
    state["phase"] = serde_json::to_value(phase).unwrap();
    state["unanswered_mutation"] = true.into();
    let old_bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&state).unwrap();
    fs::write(&journal, &old_bytes).unwrap();
    let context = adapter.context.as_mut().unwrap();
    context.set_work(Work {
        pending: Some(sync::Pending::Upload { desired: local }),
        installation_removed: false,
    });
    context.transaction = Some(directory);
    context.save().unwrap();
    vault.begin_upload(&id, authorization, &before).unwrap();
    drop((adapter, vault));
    crate::tests::wait_for_lock_release(&game.config.root.join("owner.lock"));
    (journal, old_bytes)
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_lost_receipt_reopens_a_fresh_upload_without_rewriting_the_old_transaction() {
    use steam_kit::cloud::UploadPhase;
    for phase in [
        UploadPhase::Beginning,
        UploadPhase::Open { batch_id: 7 },
        UploadPhase::Interrupted { batch_id: Some(7) },
        UploadPhase::Closed { batch_id: 7 },
    ] {
        let game = SteamGame::game();
        synced(&game, b"old").await;
        fs::write(Harness::save(&game), b"new progress").unwrap();
        let (journal, old_bytes) = lost_receipt(&game, phase);

        game.open().prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();

        assert_eq!(game.cloud.file(SLOT).unwrap(), b"new progress");
        assert_eq!(game.cloud.uploads(), 1, "one fresh upload");
        assert_eq!(fs::read(&journal).unwrap(), old_bytes);
        let saved = Context::load(&game.config, &ACCOUNT).unwrap().unwrap();
        assert!(saved.transaction.is_none());
        assert_eq!(saved.work().pending, None);
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn an_upload_that_landed_before_its_receipt_was_lost_is_not_sent_again() {
    let game = SteamGame::game();
    synced(&game, b"old").await;
    fs::write(Harness::save(&game), b"new progress").unwrap();
    lost_receipt(&game, steam_kit::cloud::UploadPhase::Closed { batch_id: 7 });
    // The server committed it before the reply was lost.
    game.cloud.publish(SLOT, b"new progress");

    game.open().prepare(&no_other_session).await.unwrap();

    assert_eq!(game.cloud.uploads(), 0);
    let vault = Vault::open(&game.config.root, scope(&game.config, ACCOUNT)).unwrap();
    assert!(vault.pending().is_none());
    assert_eq!(
        vault
            .read_content(&vault.baseline().unwrap().files.0[SLOT])
            .unwrap(),
        b"new progress"
    );
}

#[test]
fn receipt_recovery_keeps_hard_errors_and_allows_a_fresh_read_after_timeout() {
    use steam_kit::cloud::CloudError;
    for error in [
        CloudError::Uncertain,
        CloudError::Network,
        CloudError::Timeout,
        CloudError::Changed,
    ] {
        assert!(!recovery_is_settled(Err(error), false).unwrap());
    }
    for error in [
        CloudError::Revoked,
        CloudError::Storage,
        CloudError::Integrity,
        CloudError::Invalid("fixture"),
    ] {
        assert!(recovery_is_settled(Err(error), false).is_err());
    }
    assert!(recovery_is_settled(Ok(()), true).unwrap());
}
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/steam/cloud/store.rs`:

```rs
use super::paths::Paths;
use super::*;
use crate::cloud::record;
use crate::cloud::sync::{Pending, Work};
use crate::files::safe_storage_path;
use cloud_vault::{
    AccountIdentity, Bindings, Manifest, RemoteView, SelectedFile, StoreScope, Vault,
};
use serde::de::DeserializeOwned;
use std::{fs, path::Path};
use steam_kit::cloud::{AutoCloudPaths, CloudListing, CloudMetadata};

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests;

/// A Steam game's Cloud record, `context.json`. Its pending work keeps the
/// shape it had before the Cloud sync was shared: `needs_work`, `desired` and
/// `applying`.
#[derive(Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub(crate) struct Context {
    pub config: Config,
    pub account_id: u64,
    pub metadata: CloudMetadata,
    pub listing: CloudListing,
    pub remote: RemoteView,
    pub bindings: Bindings,
    pub needs_work: bool,
    pub desired: Option<Manifest>,
    pub transaction: Option<PathBuf>,
    /// An uninstall may have removed part of the save projection. This records
    /// removal intent, not proof that the installation directory is absent.
    pub installation_removed: bool,
    /// A chosen Cloud version being applied over `desired`.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub applying: Option<Applying>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub(crate) struct Applying {
    pub remote: RemoteView,
    pub project: bool,
}

pub(super) fn directory(config: &Config, account: u64) -> Result<PathBuf, Failure> {
    for path in [&config.root, &config.home, &config.install] {
        safe_storage_path(path)?;
    }
    let directory = StoreScope::from(scope(config, account)).directory(&config.root)?;
    safe_storage_path(&directory)?;
    Ok(directory)
}

pub(super) fn read<T: DeserializeOwned>(path: &Path) -> Result<Option<T>, Failure> {
    safe_storage_path(path)?;
    Ok(cloud_vault::journal::read(path)?)
}
pub(super) fn write(path: &Path, value: &impl Serialize) -> Result<(), Failure> {
    safe_storage_path(path)?;
    let parent = path.parent().ok_or(Failure::Storage)?;
    crate::files::private_directory(parent).map_err(|_| Failure::Storage)?;
    Ok(cloud_vault::journal::write(path, value)?)
}
impl Context {
    /// A context for a store that has not yet observed its remote view.
    pub fn new(config: &Config, account_id: u64, metadata: CloudMetadata) -> Self {
        Self {
            config: config.clone(),
            account_id,
            metadata,
            listing: CloudListing {
                steam_id: account_id,
                app_id: config.app_id,
                change_number: 0,
                files: Vec::new(),
            },
            remote: RemoteView {
                revision: "unobserved".into(),
                files: Manifest::default(),
            },
            bindings: Bindings::new(),
            needs_work: false,
            desired: None,
            transaction: None,
            installation_removed: false,
            applying: None,
        }
    }
    /// Every manifest this context references, which cleanup must keep.
    pub fn manifests(&self) -> Vec<Manifest> {
        let mut manifests = vec![self.remote.files.clone()];
        manifests.extend(self.desired.clone());
        manifests.extend(self.applying.iter().map(|a| a.remote.files.clone()));
        manifests
    }
    fn validate(&self, config: &Config, account: u64) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        let directory = directory(config, account)?;
        if self.account_id != account
            || self.config.app_id != config.app_id
            || self.config.root != config.root
            || self.config.home != config.home
            || self.listing.steam_id != account
            || self.listing.app_id != config.app_id
        {
            return Err(Failure::Storage);
        }
        self.remote.validate()?;
        if let Some(desired) = &self.desired {
            desired.validate()?;
        }
        if self
            .transaction
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|p| p.parent() != Some(directory.as_path()))
        {
            return Err(Failure::Storage);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    pub(super) fn paths(&self) -> Result<Paths, Failure> {
        // RemoteStorage files live in the macOS Steam engine's storage, whatever
        // the game's platform: a Windows game reaches it through lsteamclient.
        if self.metadata.field("savefiles").is_none() {
            return Ok(Paths::Sdk(self.sdk_paths()?));
        }
        let auto = AutoCloudPaths::new(
            &self.metadata,
            self.account_id,
            &self.config.platform(),
            &self.config.install,
        )?;
        if self.metadata.field("quota").is_some() {
            Ok(Paths::Mixed(auto, self.sdk_paths()?))
        } else {
            Ok(Paths::Auto(auto))
        }
    }
    pub fn refresh_bindings(&mut self, local: Option<&Manifest>) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        let paths = self.paths()?;
        let selected = paths.local_files(&self.listing.files)?;
        let mut foreign_paths = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
        let mask = self.config.platform().mask();
        for file in &self.listing.files {
            if file.platforms & mask == 0
                && let Some(path) = paths.destination(&file.name, mask)?
            {
                foreign_paths.insert(path);
            }
        }
        let mut bindings: Bindings = selected
            .into_iter()
            .map(|f| {
                (
                    f.name,
                    SelectedFile {
                        path: f.path,
                        platforms: f.platforms,
                    },
                )
            })
            .collect();
        // Keep destinations from the account snapshot so switching back can
        // project the complete local set without guessing filesystem paths.
        if let Some(local) = local {
            for (name, file) in &local.0 {
                if bindings.contains_key(name) {
                    continue;
                }
                if let Some(path) = paths.destination(name, file.platforms)? {
                    // A newer listing can exclude a previously managed name.
                    // The archived platform mask cannot override that decision.
                    if foreign_paths.contains(&path) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    bindings.insert(
                        name.clone(),
                        SelectedFile {
                            path,
                            platforms: file.platforms,
                        },
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        for binding in bindings.values() {
            safe_storage_path(&binding.path)?;
        }
        self.bindings = bindings;
        Ok(())
    }
    pub fn ensure_parents(&self) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        if !self.config.install.is_dir() {
            return Err(Failure::Recovery);
        }
        for binding in self.bindings.values() {
            safe_storage_path(&binding.path)?;
            fs::create_dir_all(binding.path.parent().ok_or(Failure::Storage)?)?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl record::Record for Context {
    type Failure = Failure;
    type Configuration = Config;
    type Account = u64;
    const FILE: &'static str = "context.json";

    fn identity(account: &u64) -> AccountIdentity {
        (*account).into()
    }
    fn scope(config: &Config, account: &u64) -> Result<StoreScope, Failure> {
        directory(config, *account)?;
        Ok(scope(config, *account).into())
    }
    fn load(config: &Config, account: &u64) -> Result<Option<Self>, Failure> {
        let context: Option<Self> = read(&directory(config, *account)?.join(Self::FILE))?;
        if let Some(context) = &context {
            context.validate(config, *account)?;
        }
        Ok(context)
    }
    fn save(&self) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        write(
            &directory(&self.config, self.account_id)?.join(Self::FILE),
            self,
        )
    }
    fn check(&self) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        self.validate(&self.config, self.account_id)
    }
    fn account(&self) -> &u64 {
        &self.account_id
    }
    fn configuration(&self) -> &Config {
        &self.config
    }
    fn configuration_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Config {
        &mut self.config
    }
    fn work(&self) -> Work {
        let pending = match (self.needs_work, &self.desired, &self.applying) {
            (true, Some(desired), Some(applying)) => Some(Pending::Applying {
                desired: desired.clone(),
                remote: applying.remote.clone(),
                project: applying.project,
            }),
            (true, Some(desired), None) => Some(Pending::Upload {
                desired: desired.clone(),
            }),
            (true, None, _) => Some(Pending::Capture),
            (false, _, _) => None,
        };
        Work {
            pending,
            installation_removed: self.installation_removed,
        }
    }
    fn set_work(&mut self, work: Work) {
        self.installation_removed = work.installation_removed;
        (self.needs_work, self.desired, self.applying) = match work.pending {
            None => (false, None, None),
            Some(Pending::Capture) => (true, None, None),
            Some(Pending::Upload { desired }) => (true, Some(desired), None),
            Some(Pending::Applying {
                desired,
                remote,
                project,
            }) => (true, Some(desired), Some(Applying { remote, project })),
        };
    }
    /// An upload transaction may have committed.
    fn uncertain(&self) -> bool {
        self.transaction.is_some()
    }
    fn bindings(
        &mut self,
        vault: &Vault,
        _: Option<&Manifest>,
        create: bool,
    ) -> Result<Bindings, Failure> {
        // The listing names every remote file, so it alone binds them.
        self.refresh_bindings(vault.local())?;
        if create {
            self.ensure_parents()?;
        }
        Ok(self.bindings.clone())
    }
}

/// Archives the saves before an uninstall, under the Cloud rules and listing
/// Steam gives now.
pub fn archive_with_rules(
    config: &Config,
    metadata: CloudMetadata,
    listing: CloudListing,
) -> Result<(), Failure> {
    if listing.app_id != config.app_id {
        return Err(Failure::Authentication);
    }
    let account = listing.steam_id;
    let (mut vault, saved) = record::locked::<Context>(config, &account)?;
    let mut context = saved.unwrap_or_else(|| Context::new(config, account, metadata.clone()));
    context.metadata = metadata;
    context.listing = listing;
    record::archive(&mut vault, context, config.clone())
}
```

```rs
use super::*;
use crate::cloud::record::Record as _;
use steam_kit::cloud::CloudFile;

const ACCOUNT: u64 = 0x0110_0001_0000_002a;
const APP: u32 = 42;

struct Fixture {

/// One AutoCloud `savefiles` rule rooted at the install directory.
fn save_rule(path: &str, pattern: &str, recursive: &str) -> CloudMetadata {
    CloudMetadata::Object(vec![(
        "savefiles".into(),
        CloudMetadata::Object(vec![(
            "0".into(),
            CloudMetadata::Object(
                [
                    ("root", "GameInstall"),
                    ("path", path),
                    ("pattern", pattern),
                    ("recursive", recursive),
                ]
                .into_iter()
                .map(|(key, value)| (key.into(), CloudMetadata::Value(value.into())))
                .collect(),
            ),
        )]),
    )])
}

fn metadata() -> CloudMetadata {
    save_rule("saves", "*.sav", "1")
}

fn listing() -> CloudListing {
    CloudListing {
        steam_id: ACCOUNT,
        app_id: APP,
        change_number: 7,
        files: Vec::new(),
    }
}

#[test]
fn a_record_the_previous_version_saved_keeps_loading() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    let config = &fixture.config;
    let path = directory(config, ACCOUNT).unwrap().join("context.json");
    let saved = serde_json::json!({
        "config": {
            "root": config.root,
            "home": config.home,
            "install": config.install,
            "app_id": APP,
        },
        "account_id": ACCOUNT,
        "metadata": serde_json::to_value(metadata()).unwrap(),
        "listing": serde_json::to_value(listing()).unwrap(),
        "remote": {"revision": "8", "files": {}},
        "bindings": {},
        "needs_work": true,
        "desired": {},
        "transaction": null,
        "installation_removed": false,
        "applying": {"remote": {"revision": "8", "files": {}}, "project": true},
    });
    write(&path, &saved).unwrap();

    let mut context = Context::load(config, &ACCOUNT).unwrap().unwrap();

    assert!(matches!(
        context.work().pending,
        Some(Pending::Applying { project: true, .. })
    ));
    context.set_work(Work {
        pending: Some(Pending::Upload {
            desired: Manifest::default(),
        }),
        installation_removed: false,
    });
    context.save().unwrap();
    let mut written: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&path).unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(written["needs_work"], true);
    assert_eq!(written["desired"], serde_json::json!({}));
    assert!(written.get("applying").is_none());
    // The removal fence is never guessed from a record that lacks it.
    written
        .as_object_mut()
        .unwrap()
        .remove("installation_removed");
    assert!(serde_json::from_value::<Context>(written).is_err());
}

#[test]
fn archived_binding_cannot_reclassify_a_now_foreign_only_identity() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    fixture.save("slot.sav", b"local progress");
    let mut context = fixture.context();
    let mut vault = fixture.vault();
    context.refresh_bindings(vault.local()).unwrap();
    vault.capture(&context.bindings).unwrap();
    context.listing.files.push(CloudFile {
        name: SLOT.into(),
        sha1: "00".repeat(20),
        size: 0,
        timestamp: 0,
        platforms: 1,
        persist_state: 0,
        reupload_requested: false,
    });

    context.refresh_bindings(vault.local()).unwrap();

    assert!(
        context.bindings.is_empty(),
        "Archived Mac bindings must not re-adopt a foreign-only identity"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read(fixture.config.install.join("saves/slot.sav")).unwrap(),
        b"local progress"
    );
}

#[test]
fn refreshing_remote_and_local_bindings_never_recreates_removed_install() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    fixture.save("slot.sav", b"archived save");
    let mut context = fixture.context();
    let mut vault = fixture.vault();
    context.refresh_bindings(vault.local()).unwrap();
    vault.capture(&context.bindings).unwrap();
    context.listing.files.push(CloudFile {
        name: "%GameInstall%saves/nested/remote.sav".into(),
        sha1: "00".repeat(20),
        size: 0,
        timestamp: 0,
        platforms: 7,
        persist_state: 0,
        reupload_requested: false,
    });
    fs::remove_dir_all(&fixture.config.install).unwrap();

    context.refresh_bindings(vault.local()).unwrap();

    assert_eq!(context.bindings.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(
        context.bindings[SLOT].path,
        fixture.config.install.join("saves/slot.sav")
    );
    assert_eq!(
        context.bindings["%GameInstall%saves/nested/remote.sav"].path,
        fixture.config.install.join("saves/nested/remote.sav")
    );
    assert!(!fixture.config.install.exists());
    assert!(matches!(context.ensure_parents(), Err(Failure::Recovery)));
    assert!(!fixture.config.install.exists());
}
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/steam/content.rs`:

```rs
//! Steam's part of an account's installations: where each installation and
//! its Cloud saves live, and what Steam's network does for them. Only the
//! network is a seam; tests stand in for it.
use super::{Product, Steam, cloud as steam_cloud};
use crate::{
    Locations,
    cloud::{Control, record},
    cloud_status,
    installations::{self, BoxFuture, Receipt, Transfer, blocking},
    protocol::Credentials,
    sessions::{self, Admission, Failure, Storefront as _, Supervised, failed},
};
use cloud_vault::StoreScope;
use obelisk_core::{
    Platform, installation::TransferProgress, launch::LaunchTarget, transfer::CancelToken,
};
use std::{path::Path, sync::Arc};
use steam_kit::cloud::{CloudListing, CloudMetadata};

/// What an account's installations ask of Steam's network. Every call may
/// wait on it.
pub trait Network: Send + Sync + 'static {
    /// The build a Transfer without a platform installs, of those the
    /// account's licenses grant: the Mac build when its game runs natively
    /// on Apple silicon, else the Windows build.
    fn platform<'a>(
        &'a self,
        app_id: u32,
        language: &'a str,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<Platform, Failure>>;
    /// Runs `transfer` into the folder it names.
    fn download<'a>(
        &'a self,
        transfer: &'a Transfer<Steam>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<steam_kit::client::Installation, Failure>>;
    fn progress(&self) -> Option<TransferProgress>;
    fn cancel(&self);
    /// Whether Steam offers a newer build than the one `receipt` installed.
    fn update_available<'a>(
        &'a self,
        receipt: &'a Receipt<Steam>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<bool, Failure>>;
    /// Waits until it reaches Steam through another CM connection than
    /// `connection`, and returns that one's number. A client alone never
    /// does: only the account session connects again.
    fn reconnected(&self, connection: u64) -> BoxFuture<'_, u64> {
        let _ = connection;
        Box::pin(std::future::pending())
    }
    /// What starts the game installed in `install`.
    fn launch_target<'a>(
        &'a self,
        app_id: u32,
        platform: Platform,
        install: &'a Path,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<LaunchTarget, Failure>>;
    /// The Cloud rules the saves of `app_id` follow, `None` without Steam Cloud.
    fn archive_rules(
        &self,
        app_id: u32,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<Option<(CloudMetadata, CloudListing)>, steam_cloud::Failure>>;
    /// Syncs Cloud saves on the player's request, while `idle` keeps every
    /// Steam launch out. It blocks.
    fn maintain(
        &self,
        target: steam_cloud::MaintenanceTarget,
        credentials: &Credentials,
        control: Arc<Control>,
        idle: &super::IdleGuard,
    ) -> Result<(), steam_cloud::Failure>;
}

impl Network for steam_kit::client::Client {
    fn platform<'a>(
        &'a self,
        app_id: u32,
        language: &'a str,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<Platform, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            steam_kit::client::Client::platform(self, app_id, language)
                .await
                .map_err(failed)
        })
    }
    fn download<'a>(
        &'a self,
        transfer: &'a Transfer<Steam>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<steam_kit::client::Installation, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            // The Transfer's begin set it; Steam still refuses a download without one.
            let platform = transfer
                .platform
                .ok_or_else(|| {
                    steam_kit::client::ClientError::Failure(
                        "backend.steam.client.unsupportedPlatformOrLanguage".into(),
                    )
                })
                .map_err(failed)?;
            steam_kit::client::Client::download(
                self,
                transfer.product.app_id,
                platform,
                &transfer.product.language,
                &transfer.directory,
            )
            .await
            .map_err(failed)
        })
    }
    fn progress(&self) -> Option<TransferProgress> {
        steam_kit::client::Client::progress(self)
    }
    fn cancel(&self) {
        self.cancel_download();
    }
    fn update_available<'a>(
        &'a self,
        receipt: &'a Receipt<Steam>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<bool, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            steam_kit::client::Client::update_available(
                self,
                receipt.product.app_id,
                receipt.platform,
                &receipt.product.language,
                Path::new(&receipt.directory),
            )
            .await
            .map_err(failed)
        })
    }
    fn launch_target<'a>(
        &'a self,
        app_id: u32,
        platform: Platform,
        install: &'a Path,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<LaunchTarget, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.launch_plan(app_id, platform, install)
                .await
                .map(|plan| plan.target)
                .map_err(failed)
        })
    }
    fn archive_rules(
        &self,
        app_id: u32,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<Option<(CloudMetadata, CloudListing)>, steam_cloud::Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.cloud_archive_metadata(app_id)
                .await
                .map_err(Into::into)
        })
    }
    fn maintain(
        &self,
        target: steam_cloud::MaintenanceTarget,
        credentials: &Credentials,
        control: Arc<Control>,
        idle: &super::IdleGuard,
    ) -> Result<(), steam_cloud::Failure> {
        steam_cloud::maintain(target, credentials, control, idle)
    }
}

/// One signed-in Steam account's installations, as they reach Steam.
pub struct Content<N: Network> {
    network: Arc<N>,
    credentials: Credentials,
    locations: Locations,
}

impl<N: Network> Content<N> {
    pub fn new(network: Arc<N>, credentials: Credentials, locations: Locations) -> Self {
        Self {
            network,
            credentials,
            locations,
        }
    }

    fn account(&self) -> u64 {
        self.credentials.steam_id
    }

    /// Where the installation's Cloud saves live: a Windows game's in its
    /// Wine prefix.
    fn cloud(&self, receipt: &Receipt<Steam>) -> steam_cloud::Config {
        steam_cloud::Config {
            root: self.locations.cloud_archive.clone(),
            home: self.locations.home.clone(),
            install: receipt.directory.clone().into(),
            app_id: receipt.product.app_id,
            prefix: receipt
                .windows(&self.locations)
                .ok()
                .flatten()
                .map(|windows| windows.prefix().to_owned()),
        }
    }
}

/// A Cloud failure, as the player sees it.
fn key(failure: steam_cloud::Failure) -> Failure {
    Failure::Failed(failure.key().into())
}

/// How a Cloud sync the player asked for ended.
fn cloud_failure(failure: steam_cloud::Failure) -> Failure {
    match failure {
        steam_cloud::Failure::Cancelled => Failure::Cancelled,
        failure => Failure::Failed(failure.key().into()),
    }
}

impl<N: Network> installations::Content<Steam> for Content<N> {
    /// A Transfer without a platform installs the build Steam picks.
    fn begin<'a>(
        &'a self,
        transfer: &'a Transfer<Steam>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<Platform, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            match transfer.platform {
                Some(platform) => Ok(platform),
                None => {
                    self.network
                        .platform(transfer.product.app_id, &transfer.product.language)
                        .await
                }
            }
        })
    }
    fn download<'a>(
        &'a self,
        transfer: &'a Transfer<Steam>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<Receipt<Steam>, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let installed = self.network.download(transfer).await?;
            Ok(Receipt {
                product: Product {
                    app_id: installed.app_id,
                    language: installed.language,
                },
                name: installed.name,
                directory: installed.directory,
                platform: installed.platform,
                total_bytes: installed.total_bytes,
                needs_verification: false,
            })
        })
    }
    fn progress(&self) -> Option<TransferProgress> {
        self.network.progress()
    }
    fn cancel(&self) {
        self.network.cancel();
    }
    fn update_available<'a>(
        &'a self,
        receipt: &'a Receipt<Steam>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<bool, Failure>> {
        self.network.update_available(receipt)
    }
    fn reconnected(&self, connection: u64) -> BoxFuture<'_, u64> {
        self.network.reconnected(connection)
    }
    fn launch<'a>(
        &'a self,
        receipt: &'a Receipt<Steam>,
        admission: Admission<Steam>,
        join: Option<&'a super::Join>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<(), Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let mut target = self
                .network
                .launch_target(
                    receipt.product.app_id,
                    receipt.platform,
                    Path::new(&receipt.directory),
                )
                .await?;
            if let Some(join) = join {
                target.arguments.extend(join.arguments(receipt.platform));
            }
            admission
                .hand_off(Handover {
                    locations: self.locations.clone(),
                    credentials: self.credentials.clone(),
                    receipt: receipt.clone(),
                    target,
                })
                .await
        })
    }
    fn archive<'a>(&'a self, receipt: &'a Receipt<Steam>) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<(), Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let rules = self
                .network
                .archive_rules(receipt.product.app_id)
                .await
                .map_err(key)?;
            let Some((metadata, listing)) = rules else {
                return Ok(());
            };
            let config = self.cloud(receipt);
            blocking(crate::Error::Storage.to_string(), move || {
                steam_cloud::archive_with_rules(&config, metadata, listing)
            })
            .await?
            .map_err(key)
        })
    }
    fn removed<'a>(&'a self, receipt: &'a Receipt<Steam>) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<(), Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let (config, account) = (self.cloud(receipt), self.account());
            blocking(Steam::SESSION_FAILED, move || {
                record::removed::<steam_cloud::Context>(&config, &account)
            })
            .await?
            .map_err(key)
        })
    }
    fn directory_name(&self, receipt: &Receipt<Steam>) -> String {
        steam_kit::client::installation_directory_name(receipt.product.app_id, receipt.platform)
    }
    fn relocated(&self, receipt: &Receipt<Steam>, from: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
        receipt.relocated(&self.locations, from)
    }
    fn remove_prefix(&self, receipt: &Receipt<Steam>) -> Option<Result<(), String>> {
        receipt.remove_prefix(&self.locations)
    }
    fn maintain<'a>(
        &'a self,
        game: &'a u32,
        installed: Option<&'a Receipt<Steam>>,
        control: Arc<Control>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<(), Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            // An uninstalled game syncs what its saved context names.
            let target = match installed {
                Some(receipt) => steam_cloud::MaintenanceTarget::Installed(self.cloud(receipt)),
                None => steam_cloud::MaintenanceTarget::Uninstalled {
                    root: self.locations.cloud_archive.clone(),
                    app_id: *game,
                },
            };
            let (network, credentials) = (self.network.clone(), self.credentials.clone());
            let locations = self.locations.clone();
            blocking(Steam::SESSION_FAILED, move || {
                // Its idle guard keeps every launch of Steam out meanwhile.
                let idle = super::Client::idle_guard(&locations.steam_sessions, &locations.helper)
                    .map_err(failed)?;
                network
                    .maintain(target, &credentials, control, &idle)
                    .map_err(cloud_failure)
            })
            .await?
        })
    }
    fn indicators(&self, games: &[u32]) -> Result<Vec<(u32, cloud_status::Indicator)>, Failure> {
        let scopes: Vec<StoreScope> = games
            .iter()
            .map(|app_id| steam_cloud::app_scope(self.account(), *app_id).into())
            .collect();
        let shown = record::indicators::<steam_cloud::Context>(
            &self.locations.cloud_archive,
            &self.account().into(),
            &scopes,
        )
        .map_err(key)?;
        Ok(shown
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|(scope, indicator)| match scope {
                StoreScope::Steam(scope) => Some((scope.app_id, indicator)),
                StoreScope::Epic(_) => None,
            })
            .collect())
    }
}

/// Starting an installed Steam game: its launch and Wine prefix readied,
/// then its supervisor, which signs in with the account's credentials.
struct Handover {
    locations: Locations,
    credentials: Credentials,
    receipt: Receipt<Steam>,
    target: LaunchTarget,
}

impl sessions::Handover<Steam> for Handover {
    type Prepared = super::Request;
    fn platform(&self) -> Platform {
        self.receipt.platform
    }
    fn prepare(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<super::Request, Failure>> {
        let (locations, receipt, target) = (
            self.locations.clone(),
            self.receipt.clone(),
            self.target.clone(),
        );
        Box::pin(async move {
            blocking(crate::Error::StartFailed.to_string(), move || {
                super::prepare(&locations, &receipt, &target)
            })
            .await?
            .map_err(|error| match error {
                crate::Error::Cancelled => Failure::Cancelled,
                error => failed(error),
            })
        })
    }
    fn start(
        self,
        request: super::Request,
        cancel: CancelToken,
    ) -> Result<Arc<dyn Supervised<Steam>>, String> {
        let helper = request.config.helpers.join(crate::package::HOST);
        super::start(&helper, &self.credentials, request, &cancel)
            .map(|client| Arc::new(client) as Arc<dyn Supervised<Steam>>)
            .map_err(|error| error.to_string())
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Steam's part of the installations through their Content interface, with a
//! network the test stands in for and real files in a temporary library.
use super::*;
use crate::{
    installations::{Content as _, tests::eventually},
    runtimes::{
        Runtimes,
        tests::{FakeRuntimes, recorded},
    },
    sessions::Sessions,
};
use std::{path::PathBuf, sync::Mutex};

/// The Cloud rules an archive finds.
type Rules = Result<Option<(CloudMetadata, CloudListing)>, steam_cloud::Failure>;

/// What the test's Steam network was asked, and what it answers.
#[derive(Default)]
struct Fake {
    /// The platform pick and the game's files, in the order the Transfer
    /// asked for them.
    calls: Mutex<Vec<String>>,
    /// The build Steam picks; the Mac one without it.
    picked: Mutex<Option<Platform>>,
    downloads: Mutex<Vec<Transfer<Steam>>>,
    /// Each maintenance's target, and whether a Steam launch could start
    /// meanwhile.
    maintained: Mutex<Vec<(steam_cloud::MaintenanceTarget, bool)>>,
    archive: Mutex<Option<Rules>>,
    locations: Mutex<Option<Locations>>,
}

impl Fake {
    fn calls(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        self.calls.lock().unwrap().clone()
    }
}

impl Network for Fake {
    fn platform<'a>(&'a self, _: u32, _: &'a str) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<Platform, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.calls.lock().unwrap().push("platform".into());
            let picked = *self.picked.lock().unwrap();
            Ok(picked.unwrap_or(Platform::Mac))
        })
    }
    fn download<'a>(
        &'a self,
        transfer: &'a Transfer<Steam>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<steam_kit::client::Installation, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            self.calls.lock().unwrap().push("game".into());
            self.downloads.lock().unwrap().push(transfer.clone());
            let platform = transfer.platform.unwrap_or(Platform::Mac);
            Ok(steam_kit::client::Installation {
                app_id: transfer.product.app_id,
                name: transfer.name.clone(),
                directory: transfer
                    .directory
                    .join(steam_kit::client::installation_directory_name(
                        transfer.product.app_id,
                        platform,
                    ))
                    .to_string_lossy()
                    .into_owned(),
                platform,
                language: transfer.product.language.clone(),
                total_bytes: 100,
                manifests: Vec::new(),
            })
        })
    }
    fn progress(&self) -> Option<TransferProgress> {
        None
    }
    fn cancel(&self) {}
    fn update_available<'a>(
        &'a self,
        _: &'a Receipt<Steam>,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<bool, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async { Ok(false) })
    }
    /// The game's own app, which no installation of the test holds.
    fn launch_target<'a>(
        &'a self,
        _: u32,
        _: Platform,
        install: &'a Path,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'a, Result<LaunchTarget, Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            Ok(LaunchTarget {
                executable: install.join("Portal 2.app").to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
                arguments: Vec::new(),
                working_directory: install.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
                is_application_bundle: true,
            })
        })
    }
    fn archive_rules(
        &self,
        _: u32,
    ) -> BoxFuture<'_, Result<Option<(CloudMetadata, CloudListing)>, steam_cloud::Failure>> {
        let rules = self.archive.lock().unwrap().take().unwrap_or(Ok(None));
        Box::pin(async move { rules })
    }
    fn maintain(
        &self,
        target: steam_cloud::MaintenanceTarget,
        _: &Credentials,
        _: Arc<Control>,
        _: &crate::steam::IdleGuard,
    ) -> Result<(), steam_cloud::Failure> {
        let locations = self.locations.lock().unwrap().clone().unwrap();
        let launch_could_start =
            crate::steam::Client::idle_guard(&locations.steam_sessions, &locations.helper).is_ok();
        self.maintained
            .lock()
            .unwrap()
            .push((target, launch_could_start));
        Ok(())
    }
}
```
