```rs
/// The decision a pending Cloud question waits on.
fn question<P: Provider>(record: &Record<P>) -> Option<u64> {
    (!record.cloud.allowed_choices.is_empty()).then_some(record.cloud.decision_id)
}

fn choice(cloud: bool) -> crate::cloud::Choice {
    if cloud {
        crate::cloud::Choice::Cloud
    } else {
        crate::cloud::Choice::Local
    }
}

/// Events the fakes of every storefront record, in the order they occur.
const SHARED: [&str; 8] = [
    "cloud.prepare",
    "answered",
    "target",
    "cloud.started",
    "presence:true",
    "presence:false",
    "cloud.finished",
    "cloud.aborted",
];

pub(crate) fn record(directory: &Path, event: &str) {
    use std::io::Write;
    let mut events = fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .create(true)
        .append(true)
        .open(directory.join("events"))
        .unwrap();
    writeln!(events, "{event}").unwrap();
}

fn events(directory: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
    fs::read_to_string(directory.join("events"))
        .unwrap_or_default()
        .lines()
        .filter(|event| SHARED.iter().any(|shared| event.starts_with(shared)))
        .map(Into::into)
        .collect()
}

/// The test directory of the re-entered supervisor, and its script.
pub(crate) fn fixture_directory() -> (PathBuf, Script) {
    let directory = PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("OBELISK_SESSION_FIXTURE").unwrap());
    let script = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(directory.join("script.json")).unwrap()).unwrap();
    (directory, script)
}

/// Waits in a fake's step until `release` exists, or the launch is stopped.
pub(crate) async fn hold<E>(
    directory: &Path,
    release: &str,
    check: impl Fn() -> Result<(), E>,
) -> Result<(), E> {
    while !directory.join(release).exists() {
        check()?;
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Re-entered as a disposable supervisor process.
#[test]
fn supervisor_fixture() {
    let Some(directory) = std::env::var_os("OBELISK_SESSION_FIXTURE") else {
        return;
    };
    let directory = PathBuf::from(directory);
    let harness = std::env::var("OBELISK_SESSION_HARNESS").unwrap();
    let (input, output) = (std::io::stdin().lock(), std::io::stderr().lock());
    let served = match harness.as_str() {
        recording::Recording::NAME => recording::Recording::serve(input, output),
        recording::Gated::NAME => recording::Gated::serve(input, output),
        crate::steam::launch::tests::SteamHarness::NAME => {
            crate::steam::launch::tests::SteamHarness::serve(input, output)
        }
        crate::epic::launch::tests::EpicHarness::NAME => {
            crate::epic::launch::tests::EpicHarness::serve(input, output)
        }
        other => panic!("unknown harness {other}"),
    };
    if let Err(error) = &served {
        fs::write(directory.join("serve-error"), error).unwrap();
    }
    // Published atomically: a reader never sees an empty code.
    let code = directory.join("exit-code.partial");
    fs::write(&code, if served.is_ok() { "0" } else { "1" }).unwrap();
    fs::rename(code, directory.join("exit-code")).unwrap();
}

// Only the platform identity adapter is replaced.
fn identity(pid: u32) -> Option<Identity> {
    let out = std::process::Command::new("/bin/ps")
        .args(["-p", &pid.to_string(), "-o", "uid=,lstart=,comm="])
        .env("LC_ALL", "C")
        .output()
        .ok()?;
    let text = String::from_utf8(out.stdout).ok()?;
    let fields: Vec<_> = text.split_whitespace().collect();
    if !out.status.success() || fields.len() < 7 {
        return None;
    }
    let birth = fields[1..6]
        .join(" ")
        .bytes()
        .fold(0_u64, |n, b| n.wrapping_mul(31).wrapping_add(b as u64));
    Some(Identity {
        pid,
        uid: fields[0].parse().ok()?,
        birth_seconds: birth,
        birth_microseconds: 0,
        executable: fields[6..].join(" "),
    })
}
pub(crate) fn inspect(pid: u32) -> Result<Option<Identity>, Error> {
    Ok(identity(pid))
}
fn probe(_: &Path, pid: u32) -> Result<Option<Identity>, Error> {
    Ok(identity(pid))
}

/// A shell exec helper: it waits for one complete admission naming an
/// existing executable, enters its working directory, confirms by closing its
/// stdout, then runs the game.
fn helper(directory: &Path, helper: Helper) -> String {
    let directory = directory.to_string_lossy().replace('\'', "'\\''");
    let before = match helper {
        Helper::Exec => String::new(),
        Helper::Hold => format!(
            "printf ready > '{directory}/exec-ready'\nwhile [ ! -f '{directory}/release-exec' ]; do /bin/sleep 0.01; done\n"
        ),
        // A background process keeps the confirmation pipe open past exit.
        Helper::Unconfirmed => "/bin/sleep 2 &\nexit 7\n".into(),
        // Within the reply window that follows reaping, not before it.
        Helper::Late => "/bin/sleep 0.05 &\n".into(),
    };
    let field = |name: &str| {
        format!(
            "\"$(printf '%s' \"$admission\" | /usr/bin/sed -n 's/.*\"{name}\":\"\\([^\"]*\\)\".*/\\1/p')\""
        )
    };
    format!(
        "#!/bin/sh\n\
         IFS= read -r admission || {{ printf 'exec-failed\\n'; exit 126; }}\n\
         executable={}\n\
         [ -x \"$executable\" ] || {{ printf 'exec-failed\\n'; exit 126; }}\n\
         cd {} || {{ printf 'exec-failed\\n'; exit 126; }}\n\
         {before}exec </dev/null >/dev/null\n\
         exec /bin/sh '{directory}/game.sh'\n",
        field("executable"),
        field("working_directory"),
    )
}

/// Installs the script's exec helper at `path`.
pub(crate) fn write_helper(path: &Path, directory: &Path, script: &Script) {
    fs::create_dir_all(path.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
    fs::write(path, helper(directory, script.helper)).unwrap();
    fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700)).unwrap();
}

/// The game a fake storefront names in its target.
pub(crate) fn target(directory: &Path, script: &Script) -> Target {
    Target {
        executable: if script.missing {
            "/obelisk-missing-game-fixture".into()
        } else {
            "/bin/sh".into()
        },
        arguments: vec![directory.join("game.sh").to_string_lossy().into()],
        working_directory: directory.into(),
        environment: [("PATH".to_string(), "/usr/bin:/bin".to_string())].into(),
        log: None,
        installation: Some(directory.into()),
        program: None,
    }
}

pub(crate) struct Run<H: Harness> {
    _root: tempfile::TempDir,
    pub directory: PathBuf,
    pub sessions: PathBuf,
    pub client: Client<H::P>,
}

fn prepare(script: &Script) -> (tempfile::TempDir, PathBuf, PathBuf) {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let directory = root.path().canonicalize().unwrap();
    let sessions = directory.join("sessions");
    fs::write(
        directory.join("script.json"),
        serde_json::to_vec(script).unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    fs::write(directory.join("game.sh"), &script.game).unwrap();
    (root, directory, sessions)
}

fn fixture_command<H: Harness>(directory: &Path) -> Process {
    let mut command = Process::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap());
    command
        .args(["--exact", "supervisor::session::tests::supervisor_fixture"])
        .env("OBELISK_SESSION_FIXTURE", directory)
        .env("OBELISK_SESSION_HARNESS", H::NAME);
    command
}

fn start<H: Harness>(directory: &Path, sessions: &Path) -> Result<Client<H::P>, Error> {
    let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
    let account = H::account();
    Client::<H::P>::start_with(
        sessions,
        Path::new("unused"),
        id.clone(),
        fixture_command::<H>(directory),
        probe,
        |pipe| H::handoff(directory, sessions, &id, pipe),
        |ack| ack.account_id == account,
        || false,
    )
}

pub(crate) fn launch<H: Harness>(script: Script) -> Run<H> {
    let run = launch_without_begin::<H>(script);
    if H::begins() {
        run.client.begin().unwrap();
    }
    run
}

fn launch_without_begin<H: Harness>(script: Script) -> Run<H> {
    let (root, directory, sessions) = prepare(&script);
    let client = start::<H>(&directory, &sessions).unwrap_or_else(|error| {
        let served = fs::read_to_string(directory.join("serve-error")).unwrap_or_default();
        panic!("start failed with {error:?}; the supervisor reported {served:?}")
    });
    Run {
        _root: root,
        directory,
        sessions,
        client,
    }
}

impl<H: Harness> Run<H> {
    pub(crate) fn until(&self, predicate: impl Fn(&Record<H::P>) -> bool) -> Record<H::P> {
        let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(10);
        loop {
            let record = self.client.snapshot(None).unwrap();
            if predicate(&record) {
                return record;
            }
            assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "last state: {record:?}");
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20));
        }
    }
    pub(crate) fn wait_for(&self, name: &str) {
        let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(10);
        while !self.directory.join(name).exists() {
            assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "{name} never appeared");
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
        }
    }
    pub(crate) fn release(&self, name: &str) {
        fs::write(self.directory.join(name), b"").unwrap();
    }
    fn events(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        events(&self.directory)
    }
    fn presence(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        self.events()
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|event| event.starts_with("presence"))
            .collect()
    }
    fn exit_code(&self) -> String {
        self.wait_for("exit-code");
        fs::read_to_string(self.directory.join("exit-code")).unwrap()
    }
    fn ran(&self) -> bool {
        self.directory.join("ran").exists()
    }
}

pub(crate) const QUICK: &str = "printf ran > ran\nexit 5\n";
pub(crate) const HELD: &str =
    "printf ran > ran\nwhile [ ! -f release-game ]; do /bin/sleep 0.01; done\nexit 3\n";

pub(crate) fn script(game: &str) -> Script {
    Script {
        game: game.into(),
        ..Script::default()
    }

pub(crate) fn a_launch_prepares_in_order_then_runs_its_game_and_settles_cloud<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(script(QUICK));
    let finished = run.until(Record::finished);
    assert_eq!(finished.phase, Phase::Finished);
    assert_eq!(finished.exit_code, Some(5));
    assert!(finished.failure_reason().is_none());
    let played = finished
        .played
        .expect("a game that ran reports what it played");
    assert_eq!((played.exit_code, played.exit_signal), (Some(5), None));
    assert!(!played.ended_by_obelisk, "the game exited by itself");
    assert_eq!(played.frames.count, 0, "without a log, no frames are known");
    assert!(run.ran());
    assert_eq!(
        run.events(),
        [
            "cloud.prepare",
            "target",
            "cloud.started",
            "presence:true",
            "presence:false",
            "cloud.finished:true",
        ]
    );
    assert_eq!(run.exit_code(), "0");
}

pub(crate) fn running_is_published_only_after_exec_is_confirmed<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(Script {
        helper: Helper::Hold,
        ..script(HELD)
    });
    run.wait_for("exec-ready");
    let admitted = run.client.snapshot(None).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(admitted.phase, Phase::Preparing);
    assert!(
        admitted.starting.is_some(),
        "the helper is owned before exec"
    );
    assert!(run.presence().is_empty());
    run.release("release-exec");
    let running = run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    assert!(running.game.is_some() && running.starting.is_none());
    run.release("release-game");
    assert_eq!(run.until(Record::finished).exit_code, Some(3));
}

pub(crate) fn a_detached_session_keeps_its_game_reserved_and_recovers<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(script(HELD));
    let running = run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    drop(run.client);
    let recovered = Client::<H::P>::recover_with(&run.sessions, Path::new("unused"), probe)
        .unwrap()
        .expect("the running session is recoverable");
    assert_eq!(recovered.id(), running.id);
    assert!(matches!(
        Client::<H::P>::idle_guard_with(&run.sessions, Path::new("unused"), probe),
        Err(Error::Busy)
    ));
    assert!(matches!(
        start::<H>(&run.directory, &run.sessions),
        Err(Error::Busy)
    ));
    fs::write(run.directory.join("release-game"), b"").unwrap();
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(10);
    let finished = loop {
        let record = recovered.snapshot(None).unwrap();
        if record.finished() {
            break record;
        }
        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline);
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20));
    };
    assert_eq!(finished.exit_code, Some(3));
}

pub(crate) fn a_lost_acknowledgement_never_abandons_an_accepted_launch<H: Harness>() {
    use std::os::{fd::OwnedFd, unix::net::UnixStream};
    let (_root, directory, sessions) = prepare(&script(QUICK));
    let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
    let (mut pipe, child_pipe) = UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
    let mut child = fixture_command::<H>(&directory)
        .stdin(Stdio::from(OwnedFd::from(child_pipe.try_clone().unwrap())))
        .stdout(Stdio::null())
        .stderr(Stdio::from(OwnedFd::from(child_pipe)))
        .spawn()
        .unwrap();
    H::handoff(&directory, &sessions, &id, &mut pipe).unwrap();
    // The UI goes away before reading the acknowledgement.
    drop(pipe);
    if H::begins() {
        // The next UI recovers the accepted launch and begins it.
        let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(10);
        let recovered = loop {
            if let Ok(Some(client)) =
                Client::<H::P>::recover_with(&sessions, Path::new("unused"), probe)
            {
                break client;
            }
            assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "the accepted launch vanished");
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20));
        };
        recovered.begin().unwrap();
    }
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(10);
    while journal::by_id::<Record<H::P>>(&sessions, &id)
        .ok()
        .flatten()
        .is_none_or(|record| !record.finished())
    {
        assert!(
            Instant::now() < deadline,
            "the accepted launch was abandoned"
        );
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20));
    }
    child.wait().unwrap();
    assert!(directory.join("ran").exists());
    let record = journal::by_id::<Record<H::P>>(&sessions, &id)
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(record.phase, Phase::Finished);
}

pub(crate) fn cancelling_before_spawn_runs_nothing_and_ends_silently<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(Script {
        hold_cloud: true,
        ..script(QUICK)
    });
    run.wait_for("cloud-ready");
    run.client.cancel();
    let cancelled = run.until(Record::finished);
    assert_eq!(cancelled.phase, Phase::Failed);
    assert_eq!(cancelled.failure_reason(), Some(FailureReason::Cancelled));
    assert!(!run.ran());
    let events = run.events();
    assert_eq!(events.last().map(String::as_str), Some("cloud.aborted"));
    assert!(!events.contains(&"cloud.started".to_string()));
    assert_eq!(
        run.exit_code(),
        "0",
        "a cancellation is not a supervisor failure"
    );
}

pub(crate) fn cancelling_after_spawn_leaves_the_game_running<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(script(HELD));
    run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    run.client.cancel();
    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200));
    assert_eq!(run.client.snapshot(None).unwrap().phase, Phase::Running);
    run.release("release-game");
    let finished = run.until(Record::finished);
    assert_eq!(finished.phase, Phase::Finished);
    assert_eq!(finished.exit_code, Some(3));
}

/// macOS asks every process Obelisk started to quit when Obelisk ends.
pub(crate) fn a_supervisor_asked_to_quit_stops_its_game_and_still_finishes_the_session<
    H: Harness,
>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(script(HELD));
    let running = run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    assert!(
        Process::new("/bin/kill")
            .args(["-TERM", &running.supervisor.pid.to_string()])
            .status()
            .unwrap()
            .success()
    );
    let finished = run.until(Record::finished);
    assert_eq!(
        finished.phase,
        Phase::Finished,
        "the supervisor settled the session"
    );
    // Only a supervisor that saw its game go records its exit.
    assert!(finished.exit_code.is_some());
    assert!(finished.game.is_none());
}

pub(crate) fn stopping_a_running_game_ends_it_and_still_finishes_the_session<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(script(HELD));
    run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    run.client.stop().unwrap();
    let finished = run.until(Record::finished);
    assert_eq!(
        finished.phase,
        Phase::Finished,
        "a stopped game is no failure"
    );
    assert!(finished.game.is_none());
}

/// A Mac game may handle SIGTERM to quit as its own Quit would.
const CLOSES: &str = "trap 'printf asked > quit-asked; exit 4' TERM\nprintf ran > ran\nwhile [ ! -f release-game ]; do /bin/sleep 0.01; done\nexit 3\n";
/// A frozen game ignores Quit, and leaves a process it started.
const FROZEN: &str = "trap '' TERM\n/bin/sleep 60 &\nprintf %s $! > started\nprintf ran > ran\nwhile :; do /bin/sleep 0.01; done\n";

pub(crate) fn quitting_asks_the_running_game_to_close_and_kills_nothing<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(script(CLOSES));
    run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    run.client.quit().unwrap();
    run.client.quit().unwrap();
    let finished = run.until(Record::finished);
    assert!(run.directory.join("quit-asked").exists());
    assert_eq!(finished.phase, Phase::Finished);
    assert_eq!(finished.exit_code, Some(4), "the game quit by itself");
    assert!(finished.played.unwrap().ended_by_obelisk);
    assert_eq!(
        run.events().last().map(String::as_str),
        Some("cloud.finished:true")
    );
}

pub(crate) fn force_quitting_ends_a_game_that_ignored_quit_and_what_it_started<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(script(FROZEN));
    run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    run.wait_for("started");
    let started = fs::read_to_string(run.directory.join("started")).unwrap();
    run.client.quit().unwrap();
    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(300));
    assert_eq!(run.client.snapshot(None).unwrap().phase, Phase::Running);
    run.client.force_quit().unwrap();
    run.client.force_quit().unwrap();
    let finished = run.until(Record::finished);
    assert_eq!(
        finished.phase,
        Phase::Finished,
        "a game force quit is no failure"
    );
    assert!(finished.game.is_none());
    let played = finished.played.unwrap();
    assert_eq!((played.exit_code, played.exit_signal), (None, Some(9)));
    assert!(played.ended_by_obelisk);
    assert_eq!(
        run.events().last().map(String::as_str),
        Some("cloud.finished:true"),
        "its exit Cloud sync still runs"
    );
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5);
    while identity(started.trim().parse().unwrap()).is_some() {
        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "what the game started survived");
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
    }
    assert_eq!(run.exit_code(), "0");
}

/// A frozen game whose installation runs a process it left apart, which no
/// longer descends from it. Its installation is the test directory, as only
/// the core's harness has it.
const STRAY: &str = "trap '' TERM\ncp /bin/sleep stray && /usr/bin/codesign -s - -f stray 2>/dev/null\n(./stray 60 & printf %s $! > stray.partial && mv stray.partial started)\nprintf ran > ran\nwhile :; do /bin/sleep 0.01; done\n";

pub(crate) fn force_quitting_ends_what_the_game_left_running_apart_from_it<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(script(STRAY));
    run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    run.wait_for("started");
    let stray: u32 = fs::read_to_string(run.directory.join("started"))
        .unwrap()
        .trim()
        .parse()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(identity(stray).is_some());
    run.client.force_quit().unwrap();
    let finished = run.until(Record::finished);
    assert_eq!(finished.phase, Phase::Finished);
    // The session ends only once the Force Quit is over: the stray process
    // was killed, and only its reaping is left.
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(1);
    while identity(stray).is_some() {
        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "the stray process survived");
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
    }
    assert_eq!(run.exit_code(), "0");
}

pub(crate) fn quitting_before_spawn_cancels_the_launch<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(Script {
        hold_cloud: true,
        ..script(QUICK)
    });
    run.wait_for("cloud-ready");
    run.client.quit().unwrap();
    let cancelled = run.until(Record::finished);
    assert_eq!(cancelled.failure_reason(), Some(FailureReason::Cancelled));
    assert!(!run.ran());
    assert_eq!(
        run.events().last().map(String::as_str),
        Some("cloud.aborted")
    );
}

pub(crate) fn quit_and_force_quit_reach_only_their_session<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(script(FROZEN));
    run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    let other = || uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
    assert!(
        run.client
            .command(None, Command::Quit { id: other() }, false)
            .is_err()
    );
    assert!(
        run.client
            .command(None, Command::ForceQuit { id: other() }, false)
            .is_err()
    );
    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200));
    assert_eq!(run.client.snapshot(None).unwrap().phase, Phase::Running);
    run.client.force_quit().unwrap();
    run.until(Record::finished);
}

pub(crate) fn revoking_before_admission_abandons_the_launch_without_presence<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(Script {
        hold_cloud: true,
        ..script(QUICK)
    });
    run.wait_for("cloud-ready");
    assert!(
        run.client.revoke(&H::other_account()).is_err(),
        "another account is refused"
    );
    run.client.revoke(&H::account()).unwrap();
    let revoked = run.until(Record::finished);
    assert_eq!(revoked.failure_reason(), Some(FailureReason::Cancelled));
    assert!(!run.ran());
    assert!(run.presence().is_empty());
}

pub(crate) fn revoking_a_running_game_withdraws_presence_but_keeps_the_game<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(script(HELD));
    run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    run.client.revoke(&H::account()).unwrap();
    // Presence is withdrawn before the reply.
    assert_eq!(run.presence(), ["presence:true", "presence:false"]);
    assert_eq!(run.client.snapshot(None).unwrap().phase, Phase::Running);
    run.release("release-game");
    let finished = run.until(Record::finished);
    assert_eq!(finished.phase, Phase::Finished);
    assert_eq!(finished.exit_code, Some(3));
}

pub(crate) fn revocation_fences_presence_of_a_late_exec<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(Script {
        helper: Helper::Hold,
        ..script(HELD)
    });
    run.wait_for("exec-ready");
    run.client.revoke(&H::account()).unwrap();
    run.release("release-exec");
    run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    run.release("release-game");
    run.until(Record::finished);
    assert!(run.presence().is_empty());
}

pub(crate) fn a_supervisor_crash_keeps_the_game_reserved_until_it_exits<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(script(HELD));
    let running = run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    assert!(
        Process::new("/bin/kill")
            .args(["-KILL", &running.supervisor.pid.to_string()])
            .status()
            .unwrap()
            .success()
    );
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5);
    while identity(running.supervisor.pid).is_some() {
        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "the supervisor survived SIGKILL");
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
    }
    // Each storefront presents the orphan its own way; none releases it.
    let orphan = run.client.snapshot(None).unwrap();
    assert!(!orphan.finished(), "a live game keeps its Reservation");
    assert_eq!(orphan.game, running.game);
    assert!(matches!(
        Client::<H::P>::idle_guard_with(&run.sessions, Path::new("unused"), probe),
        Err(Error::Busy)
    ));
    run.release("release-game");
    let finished = run.until(Record::finished);
    assert!(finished.game.is_none());
}

pub(crate) fn corrupt_metadata_fails_closed<H: Harness>() {
    let (_root, directory, sessions) = prepare(&script(QUICK));
    crate::files::private_directory(&sessions).unwrap();
    fs::write(sessions.join("session.v2.json"), "invalid").unwrap();
    fs::set_permissions(
        sessions.join("session.v2.json"),
        fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600),
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert!(Client::<H::P>::recover_with(&sessions, Path::new("unused"), probe).is_err());
    assert!(start::<H>(&directory, &sessions).is_err());
    assert!(!directory.join("ran").exists());
}

pub(crate) fn a_failed_exec_reaps_its_helper_and_never_claims_a_running_game<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(Script {
        missing: true,
        ..script(QUICK)
    });
    let failed = run.until(Record::finished);
    assert_eq!(failed.phase, Phase::Failed);
    assert_eq!(failed.failure_reason(), Some(FailureReason::Failed));
    assert!(failed.starting.is_none() && failed.game.is_none());
    assert!(run.presence().is_empty());
    assert_eq!(
        run.events().last().map(String::as_str),
        Some("cloud.aborted")
    );
    assert_eq!(run.exit_code(), "1", "a failed launch exits non-zero");
}

pub(crate) fn an_unconfirmed_exec_only_captures_the_exit_save<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(Script {
        helper: Helper::Unconfirmed,
        ..script(QUICK)
    });
    let failed = run.until(Record::finished);
    assert_eq!(failed.phase, Phase::Failed);
    assert_eq!(failed.exit_code, Some(7));
    assert!(run.events().contains(&"cloud.finished:false".to_string()));
    assert!(run.presence().is_empty());
    assert_eq!(
        run.exit_code(),
        "1",
        "an unconfirmed exec is a failed launch"
    );
}

pub(crate) fn a_game_reaped_before_its_confirmation_still_finishes<H: Harness>() {

pub(crate) fn a_journal_failure_before_spawn_never_runs_the_target<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(Script {
        ask: true,
        ..script(QUICK)
    });
    let asked = run.until(|r| question(r).is_some());
    fs::set_permissions(&run.sessions, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o500)).unwrap();
    run.client
        .choose(&H::account(), question(&asked).unwrap(), choice(false))
        .unwrap();
    run.wait_for("exit-code");
    fs::set_permissions(&run.sessions, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700)).unwrap();
    assert!(!run.ran());
    assert!(!run.events().contains(&"cloud.started".to_string()));
}

pub(crate) fn a_journal_failure_after_exit_still_finalizes_cloud<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(script(HELD));
    run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    fs::set_permissions(&run.sessions, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o500)).unwrap();
    run.release("release-game");
    run.wait_for("exit-code");
    fs::set_permissions(&run.sessions, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700)).unwrap();
    assert!(run.events().contains(&"cloud.finished:true".to_string()));
    assert_eq!(run.exit_code(), "0", "a success never turns into a failure");
}

pub(crate) fn cloud_answers_bind_to_the_session_account_and_decision<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(Script {
        ask: true,
        ..script(QUICK)
    });
    let decision = question(&run.until(|r| question(r).is_some())).unwrap();
    let cloud = choice(true);
    assert!(
        run.client
            .choose(&H::other_account(), decision, cloud)
            .is_err()
    );
    assert!(
        run.client
            .choose(&H::account(), decision + 1, cloud)
            .is_err()
    );
    run.client.choose(&H::account(), decision, cloud).unwrap();
    run.until(Record::finished);
    assert!(run.events().contains(&format!("answered:{cloud:?}")));
    assert!(
        run.client.choose(&H::account(), decision, cloud).is_err(),
        "an answer to a terminal session is refused"
    );
}

pub(crate) fn an_observer_waits_for_a_new_revision_while_commands_still_arrive<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(Script {
        hold_cloud: true,
        ..script(QUICK)
    });
    run.wait_for("cloud-ready");
    let current = run.client.snapshot(None).unwrap();
    let observed = std::thread::scope(|scope| {
        let observer = scope.spawn(|| run.client.snapshot(Some(current.revision)).unwrap());
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200));
        assert!(!observer.is_finished(), "Observe waits for a change");
        run.client.cancel();
        observer.join().unwrap()
    });
    assert!(observed.revision > current.revision);
    run.until(Record::finished);
}

#[cfg(target_arch = "aarch64")]
pub(crate) fn rosetta_resumes_only_its_decision_after_installation<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(Script {
        intel: true,
        ..script(QUICK)
    });
    let requested = run.until(|r| r.rosetta.is_some()).rosetta.unwrap();
    let account = H::account();
    assert!(
        run.client
            .resume_after_rosetta(&account, requested.decision_id + 1)
            .is_err()
    );
    assert!(
        run.client
            .resume_after_rosetta(&account, requested.decision_id)
            .is_err(),
        "resuming before installation keeps the requirement"
    );
    let rosetta = crate::supervisor::rosetta::helper(&run.directory);
    fs::create_dir_all(rosetta.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
    fs::write(&rosetta, b"installed").unwrap();
    run.client
        .resume_after_rosetta(&account, requested.decision_id)
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(run.until(Record::finished).phase, Phase::Finished);
    // After an installation, the target is prepared again.
    assert_eq!(run.events().iter().filter(|e| *e == "target").count(), 2);
    assert!(run.ran());
}

/// The player accepted that a game the previous build launched, and that
/// still runs across the upgrade, is not protected: its records never block.
pub(crate) fn records_left_by_the_previous_build_never_block_a_launch_or_its_recovery<
    H: Harness,
>() {
    let (root, directory, sessions) = prepare(&script(QUICK));
    crate::files::private_directory(&sessions).unwrap();
    let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
    let live = identity(std::process::id()).unwrap();
    let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&H::previous_build_record(
        &id,
        &live,
        &sessions.join("old.sock"),
    ))
    .unwrap();
    let old: Vec<_> = ["session.json".to_string(), format!("{id}.json")]
        .into_iter()
        .map(|name| sessions.join(name))
        .collect();
    for path in &old {
        fs::write(path, &bytes).unwrap();
        fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)).unwrap();
    }

    assert!(
        Client::<H::P>::recover_with(&sessions, Path::new("unused"), probe)
            .unwrap()
            .is_none()
    );
    drop(Client::<H::P>::idle_guard_with(&sessions, Path::new("unused"), probe).unwrap());
    crate::tests::wait_for_lock_release(&sessions.join("start.lock"));
    let run = Run::<H> {
        client: start::<H>(&directory, &sessions).unwrap(),
        _root: root,
        directory,
        sessions,
    };
    if H::begins() {
        run.client.begin().unwrap();
    }
    assert_eq!(run.until(Record::finished).phase, Phase::Finished);
    assert!(run.ran());
    for path in old {
        assert_eq!(
            fs::read(&path).unwrap(),
            bytes,
            "{path:?} is left untouched"
        );
    }
}

pub(crate) fn a_control_failure_is_paced_and_keeps_the_game<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(script(HELD));
    let running = run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    let mut unreachable = running.clone();
    unreachable.socket = unreachable.socket.with_file_name("missing");
    journal::write(&run.sessions, &unreachable).unwrap();
    let started = Instant::now();
    let state = run.client.snapshot(Some(running.revision)).unwrap();
    assert!(
        started.elapsed() >= Duration::from_millis(500),
        "retries are paced"
    );
    assert!(state.reconnecting);
    assert_eq!(state.phase, Phase::Running);
    assert_eq!(state.game, running.game);
    journal::write(&run.sessions, &running).unwrap();
    assert!(!run.client.snapshot(None).unwrap().reconnecting);
    run.release("release-game");
    assert_eq!(run.until(Record::finished).exit_code, Some(3));
}

pub(crate) fn unreadable_metadata_does_not_regress_an_observed_live_session<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(script(HELD));
    let running = run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    fs::write(
        run.sessions.join(format!("{}.v2.json", running.id)),
        b"truncated",
    )
    .unwrap();
    let state = run.client.snapshot(None).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(state.phase, Phase::Running);
    assert_eq!(state.game, running.game);
    run.release("release-game");
    run.until(Record::finished);
}

pub(crate) fn a_removed_socket_does_not_prevent_teardown<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(script(HELD));
    let running = run.until(|r| r.phase == Phase::Running);
    fs::remove_file(&running.socket).unwrap();
    run.release("release-game");
    run.wait_for("exit-code");
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5);
    while identity(running.supervisor.pid).is_some() {
        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "the supervisor never exited");
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
    }
    crate::tests::wait_for_lock_release(&run.sessions.join("owner.lock"));
    assert!(storage::lock(&run.sessions, "owner.lock").is_ok());
}

pub(crate) fn finalization_keeps_the_reservation_until_cloud_settles<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch::<H>(Script {
        hold_finish: true,
        ..script(QUICK)
    });
    run.wait_for("finish-ready");
    let Run {
        _root,
        directory,
        sessions,
        client,
    } = run;
    drop(client);
    let recovered = Client::<H::P>::recover_with(&sessions, Path::new("unused"), probe)
        .unwrap()
        .expect("a finalizing session is recoverable");
    assert_eq!(recovered.snapshot(None).unwrap().phase, Phase::Finalizing);
    assert!(matches!(
        start::<H>(&directory, &sessions),
        Err(Error::Busy)
    ));
    assert!(matches!(
        Client::<H::P>::idle_guard_with(&sessions, Path::new("unused"), probe),
        Err(Error::Busy)
    ));
    fs::write(directory.join("release-finish"), b"").unwrap();
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(10);
    while !directory.join("exit-code").exists() {
        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "finalization never ended");
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
    }
    let finished = journal::current::<Record<H::P>>(&sessions)
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(finished.phase, Phase::Finished);
}

#[cfg(target_arch = "aarch64")]
pub(crate) fn cancelling_the_rosetta_wait_never_starts_the_game<H: Harness>() {
    for revoke in [false, true] {
        let run = launch::<H>(Script {
            intel: true,
            ..script(QUICK)
        });
        let requested = run.until(|r| r.rosetta.is_some()).rosetta.unwrap();
        if revoke {
            run.client.revoke(&H::account()).unwrap();
        } else {
            run.client.cancel();
        }
        let ended = run.until(Record::finished);
        assert_eq!(ended.failure_reason(), Some(FailureReason::Cancelled));
        assert!(ended.rosetta.is_none());

            run.client
                .resume_after_rosetta(&H::account(), requested.decision_id)
                .is_err()
        );
        assert!(!run.ran());
    }
}

pub(crate) fn begin_opens_the_start_gate_once_and_only_for_its_account<H: Harness>() {
    let run = launch_without_begin::<H>(script(QUICK));

#[test]
fn a_cloud_question_is_abandoned_after_its_deadline_or_its_observer() {
    let now = Instant::now();
    let long_ago = |seconds| now.checked_sub(Duration::from_secs(seconds)).unwrap();

    let in_app = Questions::in_app();
    assert!(!in_app.abandoned(long_ago(599)));
    assert!(in_app.abandoned(long_ago(601)));

    let supervised = Questions::supervised();
    assert!(!supervised.abandoned(now));
    *supervised.observed.as_ref().unwrap().lock().unwrap() = long_ago(121);
    assert!(
        supervised.abandoned(now),
        "nobody has observed for two minutes"
    );
    supervised.observe();
    assert!(!supervised.abandoned(now));

    // Cloud questions and the Rosetta requirement share one counter.
    assert_eq!((supervised.next(), supervised.next()), (1, 2));
}
```

```rs
    }

/// The recorded Cloud sync, which follows the test's script.
pub(crate) struct Cloud {
    directory: PathBuf,
    script: Script,
    session: Arc<Session<Recording>>,
}

impl LaunchCloud<Failure> for Cloud {
    fn prepare<'a>(&'a mut self, _: &'a SessionAlive<'a>) -> Operation<'a, Result<(), Failure>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            record(&self.directory, "cloud.prepare");
            if self.script.hold_cloud {
                fs::write(self.directory.join("cloud-ready"), b"").unwrap();
                hold(&self.directory, "release-cloud", || self.session.check()).await?;
            }
            if self.script.ask {
                let cloud = self.session.cloud();
                let answer = cloud
                    .ask(crate::cloud::Question::Conflict, None)
                    .await
                    .map_err(|_| Failure::Cancelled)?;
                record(&self.directory, &format!("answered:{answer:?}"));
                cloud.show(crate::cloud::Phase::Ready, None);
            }
            Ok(())
        })
    }
    fn started(&mut self) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        record(&self.directory, "cloud.started");
        Ok(())
    }
    fn finished(&mut self, confirmed: bool) -> Operation<'_, ()> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            if self.script.hold_finish {
                fs::write(self.directory.join("finish-ready"), b"").unwrap();
                let _ = hold(&self.directory, "release-finish", || Ok::<_, Error>(())).await;
            }
            record(&self.directory, &format!("cloud.finished:{confirmed}"));
        })
    }
    fn aborted(&mut self) {
        record(&self.directory, "cloud.aborted");
    }
}
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/supervisor/storage.rs`:

```rs
//! Private session-directory locks and bounded one-line packets.
use super::*;
use std::{
    fs::{self, File, OpenOptions},
    io::{Read, Write},
    os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt,
    path::Path,
};

fn lock_file(root: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<File, Error> {
    crate::files::private_directory(root).map_err(|_| Error::Storage)?;
    let path = root.join(name);
    if fs::symlink_metadata(&path).is_ok_and(|m| !m.file_type().is_file()) {
        return Err(Error::Storage);
    }
    let file = OpenOptions::new()
        .read(true)
        .write(true)
        .create(true)
        .truncate(false)
        .mode(0o600)
        .open(path)?;
    Ok(file)
}

/// Busy only once the lock stays taken past the window in which a child that
/// another thread spawns shares it.
pub(crate) fn lock(root: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<File, Error> {
    let file = lock_file(root, name)?;
    cloud_vault::lock::try_lock(&file).map_err(|_| Error::Busy)?;
    Ok(file)
}

/// Wait for terminal teardown without polling. If the deadline expires, the
/// waiter retains start.lock until it finishes, preventing accumulated waiters
/// or a second launch racing an owner whose first record is not visible yet.
pub(crate) fn owner_released(root: &Path, starting: File) -> Result<File, Error> {
    let owner = lock_file(root, "owner.lock")?;
    let (send, receive) = std::sync::mpsc::sync_channel(1);
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let result = owner.lock().map_err(|_| Error::Storage);
        drop(owner);
        let _ = send.send(result.map(|()| starting));
    });
    receive
        .recv_timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1))
        .map_err(|_| Error::Busy)?
}

pub(crate) fn packet<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(input: impl Read) -> Result<T, Error> {
    use std::io::BufRead;
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    std::io::BufReader::new(input.take(65537)).read_until(b'\n', &mut bytes)?;
    if bytes.len() > 65536 {
        return Err(Error::InvalidSession);
    }
    serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|_| Error::InvalidSession)
}

/// Every control command names the protocol version it was written for.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct Envelope<C> {
    version: u32,
    command: C,
}

pub(crate) fn send_command(output: &mut impl Write, command: &impl Serialize) -> Result<(), Error> {
    send(
        output,
        &Envelope {
            version: journal::VERSION,
            command,
        },
    )
}

pub(crate) fn command<C: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(input: impl Read) -> Result<C, Error> {
    let envelope: Envelope<C> = packet(input)?;
    if envelope.version != journal::VERSION {
        return Err(Error::InvalidSession);
    }
    Ok(envelope.command)
}

pub(crate) fn send(output: &mut impl Write, value: &impl Serialize) -> Result<(), Error> {
    let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(value).map_err(|_| Error::InvalidSession)?;
    if bytes.len() > 65535 {
        return Err(Error::InvalidSession);
    }
    output.write_all(&bytes)?;
    output.write_all(b"\n")?;
    output.flush()?;
    Ok(())
}
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/valve.rs`:

```rs
//! Valve's Steam components, the libraries Obelisk's Steam host loads. Obelisk
//! ships none of them: a Steam game's Transfer downloads the public packages
//! the runtime manifest pins from Valve's CDN before the game's files, and a
//! launch that still misses them downloads them first. Only the files the
//! manifest names are kept, in one payload in the Steam runtime cache, and
//! `package::prepare` extracts it from there. Never searches for Steam,
//! executes an installer or accesses account data.
use crate::{
    package::{self, Manifest, PayloadFile, SourcePackage},
    voile::remove_entries,
};
use obelisk_core::transfer::CancelToken;
use reqwest::StatusCode;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::{
    fs::{self, File},
    future::Future,
    io::Write,
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    sync::{
        Arc,
        atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU64, Ordering},
    },
    time::Duration,
};

/// Unfinished downloads in the cache start with this, and the next install
/// removes them. `package::prepare` stages under another prefix.
const UNFINISHED: &str = ".download-";
/// Every payload's name starts with this; a newer manifest replaces the
/// payloads of the ones before it.
const PAYLOAD: &str = "valve-";

/// Two installs never write the same payload.
static INSTALLING: tokio::sync::Mutex<()> = tokio::sync::Mutex::const_new(());

/// Where the payload of the pinned manifest lives in `cache`.
pub fn payload(cache: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    payload_in(cache, package::manifest())
}

fn payload_in(cache: &Path, manifest: &Manifest) -> PathBuf {
    cache.join(format!("{PAYLOAD}{}.zip", manifest.version))
}

/// Whether `payload` lists every file the pinned manifest names, at its size.
/// It reads the payload's central directory only, never inflates a file:
/// the install hashes every file it keeps, and `package::prepare` every file
/// it extracts.
pub fn installed(payload: &Path) -> bool {
    listed(payload, &package::manifest().files)
}

fn listed(payload: &Path, files: &[PayloadFile]) -> bool {
    package::archive(payload, files).is_ok()
}

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Failure {
    /// The network failed, or Valve's CDN refused the request for a reason
    /// that may pass, such as a server error or a rate limit.
    #[error("backend.steam.components.downloadFailed")]
    Download,
    /// Valve no longer serves a package the manifest pins: only a newer
    /// Obelisk, which pins the current ones, can launch Steam games.
    #[error("backend.steam.components.unavailable")]
    Unavailable,
    #[error("backend.steam.components.damaged")]
    Damaged,
    #[error("backend.steam.components.storageFailed")]
    Storage,
    #[error("backend.steam.components.cancelled")]
    Cancelled,
}
impl From<std::io::Error> for Failure {
    fn from(_: std::io::Error) -> Self {
        Self::Storage
    }
}
impl From<crate::Error> for Failure {
    fn from(error: crate::Error) -> Self {
        match error {
            crate::Error::Cancelled => Self::Cancelled,
            crate::Error::Storage => Self::Storage,
            _ => Self::Damaged,
        }
    }
}

/// One install of the pinned payload, which the player can cancel and watch.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Install {
    received: AtomicU64,
    /// The size of every package being downloaded, once known.
    total: AtomicU64,
    cancel: CancelToken,
    /// Stops the payload's assembly, which runs off the async runtime.
    stopped: Arc<AtomicBool>,
}

impl Install {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    pub fn cancel(&self) {
        self.stopped.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        self.cancel.cancel();
    }

    /// The bytes downloaded so far, and the size of every package.
    pub fn progress(&self) -> (u64, u64) {
        let total = self.total.load(Ordering::Acquire);
        let total = if total == 0 {
            size(package::manifest())
        } else {
            total
        };
        (self.received.load(Ordering::Acquire), total)
    }

    /// Downloads the pinned packages into `payload` unless it already holds
    /// every file intact, then removes the payloads of other manifests.
    pub async fn run(&self, payload: &Path) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        let client = client().map_err(|_| Failure::Download)?;
        self.install(&client, package::manifest(), payload).await
    }

    async fn install(
        &self,
        client: &reqwest::Client,
        manifest: &Manifest,
        payload: &Path,
    ) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        let _installing = self.cancellable(INSTALLING.lock()).await?;
        let (path, files) = (payload.to_owned(), manifest.files.clone());
        let intact = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
            package::verify(&path, &files, &AtomicBool::new(false)).is_ok()
        })
        .await
        .map_err(|_| Failure::Storage)?;
        if intact {
            return Ok(());
        }
        self.total.store(size(manifest), Ordering::Release);
        let cache = payload.parent().ok_or(Failure::Storage)?.to_owned();
        let unfinished = cache.clone();
        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
            crate::files::private_directory(&unfinished).map_err(|_| Failure::Storage)?;
            remove_entries(&unfinished, |name| name.starts_with(UNFINISHED));
            Ok::<_, Failure>(())
        })
        .await
        .map_err(|_| Failure::Storage)??;
        // Goes away with every package once the payload is in place, or on
        // any failure.
        let downloads = tempfile::Builder::new()
            .prefix(UNFINISHED)
            .tempdir_in(&cache)?;
        let mut packages = Vec::new();
        for source in &manifest.packages {
            let path = downloads.path().join(format!("{}.zip", source.sha256));
            self.download(client, source, &path).await?;
            packages.push((source.name.clone(), path));
        }
        let assembled = downloads.path().join("payload.zip");
        let (output, files, stopped) = (
            assembled.clone(),
            manifest.files.clone(),
            self.stopped.clone(),
        );
        // Not raced against cancellation: the assembly stops at its next
        // read once cancelled, before `downloads` goes away under it.
        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || assemble(&packages, &files, &output, &stopped))
            .await
            .map_err(|_| Failure::Storage)??;
        if self.cancel.is_cancelled() {
            return Err(Failure::Cancelled);
        }
        let payload = payload.to_owned();
        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
            fs::rename(&assembled, &payload)?;
            File::open(&cache)?.sync_all()?;
            // No launch reads another manifest's payload: `package::prepare`
            // only reads the one its Locations name.
            let kept = payload.file_name().and_then(|name| name.to_str());
            remove_entries(&cache, |name| {
                name.starts_with(PAYLOAD) && name.ends_with(".zip") && kept != Some(name)
            });
            Ok::<_, Failure>(())
        })
        .await
        .map_err(|_| Failure::Storage)??;
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Downloads `source` into `path`, checking its size and SHA-256.
    async fn download(
        &self,
        client: &reqwest::Client,
        source: &SourcePackage,
        path: &Path,
    ) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        let mut response = self
            .cancellable(client.get(&source.url).send())
            .await?
            .map_err(|_| Failure::Download)?;
        let status = response.status();
        // Only a missing or moved package means the pin is gone: redirects
        // are not followed, since a pinned package lives at its URL. Any
        // other refusal, such as a rate limit, may pass with a retry.
        if status == StatusCode::NOT_FOUND || status == StatusCode::GONE || status.is_redirection()
        {
            return Err(Failure::Unavailable);
        }
        if !status.is_success() {
            return Err(Failure::Download);
        }
        let base = self.received.load(Ordering::Acquire);
        let mut file = File::create(path)?;
        let mut digest = Sha256::new();
        let mut size = 0_u64;
        while let Some(bytes) = self
            .cancellable(response.chunk())
            .await?
            .map_err(|_| Failure::Download)?
        {
            size += bytes.len() as u64;
            if size > source.size {
                return Err(Failure::Damaged);
            }
            digest.update(&bytes);
            file.write_all(&bytes)?;
            self.received.store(base + size, Ordering::Release);
        }
        if size != source.size || format!("{:x}", digest.finalize()) != source.sha256 {
            return Err(Failure::Damaged);
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Stops waiting for `work` as soon as the install is cancelled.
    async fn cancellable<T>(&self, work: impl Future<Output = T>) -> Result<T, Failure> {
        self.cancel.race(work).await.map_err(|_| Failure::Cancelled)
    }
}

/// HTTPS to Valve's CDN only, without redirects, and bounded in time.
fn client() -> reqwest::Result<reqwest::Client> {
    reqwest::Client::builder()
        .https_only(true)
        .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
        .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(20))
        .read_timeout(Duration::from_secs(60))
        .build()
}

/// The size of every package `manifest` pins.
fn size(manifest: &Manifest) -> u64 {
    manifest.packages.iter().map(|source| source.size).sum()
}

/// Writes into `output` a payload of the `files` the downloaded `packages`
/// hold, each bounded and hash-checked by the manifest even for malformed ZIP
/// metadata, then checks the payload as `package::prepare` will read it.
fn assemble(
    packages: &[(String, PathBuf)],
    files: &[PayloadFile],
    output: &Path,
    stopped: &AtomicBool,
) -> Result<(), Failure> {
    let mut payload = File::create(output)?;
    {
        let mut writer = zip::ZipWriter::new(&mut payload);
        let options = zip::write::SimpleFileOptions::default()
            .compression_method(zip::CompressionMethod::Deflated)
            .compression_level(Some(6))
            .unix_permissions(0o644);
        for (name, path) in packages {
            let mut archive =
                zip::ZipArchive::new(File::open(path)?).map_err(|_| Failure::Damaged)?;
            for entry in files.iter().filter(|entry| &entry.package == name) {
                let mut file = archive.by_name(&entry.path).map_err(|_| Failure::Damaged)?;
                if file.size() != entry.size || !file.is_file() {
                    return Err(Failure::Damaged);
                }
                writer
                    .start_file(&entry.path, options)
                    .map_err(|_| Failure::Storage)?;
                package::copy_verified(&mut file, &mut writer, entry, stopped)?;
            }
        }
        writer.finish().map_err(|_| Failure::Storage)?;
    }
    payload.sync_all()?;
    package::verify(output, files, stopped)?;
    Ok(())
}
```

```rs
use super::*;
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    io::{BufRead, BufReader},
    net::{TcpListener, TcpStream},
    sync::Mutex,
    thread,
};

/// What the loopback CDN answers for one path.
#[derive(Clone)]
enum Answer {
    Body(Vec<u8>),
    Status(&'static str),
    /// Sends the first bytes of a body, then never the rest.
    Stall(Vec<u8>),
}

/// Valve's CDN on the loopback interface, which records every request.
struct Cdn {
    base: String,
    requests: Arc<Mutex<Vec<String>>>,
}

impl Cdn {
    fn new(answers: HashMap<String, Answer>) -> Self {
        let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
        let base = format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap());
        let requests = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
        let recorded = requests.clone();
        let answers = Arc::new(answers);
        thread::spawn(move || {
            for socket in listener.incoming().flatten() {
                let (answers, recorded) = (answers.clone(), recorded.clone());
                thread::spawn(move || serve(socket, &answers, &recorded));
            }
        });
        Self { base, requests }
    }

    fn requests(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        std::mem::take(&mut *self.requests.lock().unwrap())
    }
}

fn serve(socket: TcpStream, answers: &HashMap<String, Answer>, requests: &Mutex<Vec<String>>) {
    let mut reader = BufReader::new(socket.try_clone().unwrap());
    let mut line = String::new();
    if reader.read_line(&mut line).is_err() {
        return;
    }
    let path = line
        .split_whitespace()
        .nth(1)
        .unwrap_or_default()
        .to_owned();
    loop {
        let mut header = String::new();
        if reader.read_line(&mut header).unwrap_or(0) <= 2 {
            break;
        }
    }
    requests.lock().unwrap().push(path.clone());
    let mut socket = socket;
    let _ = match answers.get(&path) {
        Some(Answer::Body(body)) => write!(
            socket,
            "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
            body.len()
        )
        .and_then(|()| socket.write_all(body)),
        Some(Answer::Status(status)) => write!(
            socket,
            "HTTP/1.1 {status}\r\nLocation: /elsewhere\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
        ),
        Some(Answer::Stall(body)) => {
            let sent = write!(
                socket,
                "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
                body.len()
            )
            .and_then(|()| socket.write_all(&body[..body.len() / 2]))
            .and_then(|()| socket.flush());
            thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(10));
            sent
        }
        None => write!(
            socket,
            "HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
        ),
    };
}

fn sha(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(bytes))
}

fn zip_of(entries: &[(&str, &[u8])]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut writer = zip::ZipWriter::new(std::io::Cursor::new(Vec::new()));
    for (name, bytes) in entries {
        writer
            .start_file(*name, zip::write::SimpleFileOptions::default())
            .unwrap();
        writer.write_all(bytes).unwrap();
    }
    writer.finish().unwrap().into_inner()
}

/// Two pinned packages, each holding a file the payload keeps and one it
/// leaves out, served by the CDN `edit` may change.
struct Fixture {
    _root: tempfile::TempDir,
    cdn: Cdn,
    manifest: Manifest,
    cache: PathBuf,
    payload: PathBuf,
}

impl Fixture {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self::serving(|_, answer| answer)
    }

    fn serving(edit: impl Fn(&str, Answer) -> Answer) -> Self {
        let files: [(&str, &str, &[u8]); 2] = [
            ("client", "steamclient.dylib", b"fixture engine"),
            (
                "breakpad",
                "Frameworks/Breakpad.framework/Versions/A/Breakpad",
                b"fixture crash reporter",
            ),
        ];
        let packages = files
            .iter()
            .map(|(package, path, bytes)| {
                let other: &[u8] = b"not part of the payload";
                (
                    *package,
                    zip_of(&[(path, bytes), ("unrelated.dylib", other)]),
                )
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        let answers = packages
            .iter()
            .map(|(name, body)| {
                let path = format!("/{name}.zip");
                let answer = edit(name, Answer::Body(body.clone()));
                (path, answer)
            })
            .collect();
        let cdn = Cdn::new(answers);
        let manifest = Manifest {
            version: "42".into(),
            packages: packages
                .iter()
                .map(|(name, body)| SourcePackage {
                    name: (*name).into(),
                    url: format!("{}/{name}.zip", cdn.base),
                    size: body.len() as u64,
                    sha256: sha(body),
                })
                .collect(),
            files: files
                .iter()
                .map(|(package, path, bytes)| PayloadFile {
                    path: (*path).into(),
                    package: (*package).into(),
                    size: bytes.len() as u64,
                    sha256: sha(bytes),
                })
                .collect(),
        };
        let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let cache = root.path().join("SteamRuntime");
        let payload = payload_in(&cache, &manifest);
        Self {
            _root: root,
            cdn,
            manifest,
            cache,
            payload,
        }
    }

    async fn install(&self, install: &Install) -> Result<(), Failure> {
        let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
            .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
            .build()
            .unwrap();
        install
            .install(&client, &self.manifest, &self.payload)
            .await
    }

    fn names(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        let mut names: Vec<_> = fs::read_dir(&self.cache)
            .map(|entries| {
                entries
                    .map(|entry| entry.unwrap().file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned())
                    .collect()
            })
            .unwrap_or_default();
        names.sort();
        names
    }

    fn unfinished(&self) -> bool {
        self.names().iter().any(|name| name.starts_with(UNFINISHED))
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_payload_counts_as_installed_from_its_listing_alone() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    let files = &fixture.manifest.files;
    assert!(!listed(&fixture.payload, files));
    fixture.install(&Install::new()).await.unwrap();
    assert!(listed(&fixture.payload, files));

    // The listing is all it reads: other bytes of the same sizes pass, and
    // `package::prepare` refuses them when it extracts.
    let engine: &[u8] = b"fixture ENGINE";
    let reporter: &[u8] = b"fixture CRASH REPORTER";
    let paths = [files[0].path.as_str(), files[1].path.as_str()];
    let same_sizes = zip_of(&[(paths[0], engine), (paths[1], reporter)]);
    fs::write(&fixture.payload, same_sizes).unwrap();
    assert!(listed(&fixture.payload, files));

    // A missing file, another size or a damaged listing does not pass.
    fs::write(&fixture.payload, zip_of(&[(paths[0], engine)])).unwrap();
    assert!(!listed(&fixture.payload, files));
    let other_size: &[u8] = b"fixture crash reporter, longer";
    let other_sizes = zip_of(&[(paths[0], engine), (paths[1], other_size)]);
    fs::write(&fixture.payload, other_sizes).unwrap();
    assert!(!listed(&fixture.payload, files));
    fs::write(&fixture.payload, b"PK damaged").unwrap();
    assert!(!listed(&fixture.payload, files));
}
```

`crates/game-runtime/src/voile.rs`:

```rs
//! Voile, the Wine runtime Windows games run in. Obelisk runs the newest
//! release installed that keeps its contract: the paths, variables and
//! programs it relies on in a runtime, which docs/CONTRACT.md lists. As a
//! Windows game launches, Obelisk reads Voile's feed: a newer release of its
//! contract downloads once no game runs, unless the game needs it to start.
//! A Windows build's Transfer gets a release before the game's files when
//! none is installed. The release built into Obelisk stands in for the feed
//! until one was read. A development runtime that voile's install-dev.sh put
//! in `current` takes precedence.
//!
//! The release also carries the Linux engine's runtime, in its `linux` folder.
use crate::runtimes::Standing;
use obelisk_core::transfer::CancelToken;
use serde::Deserialize;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::{
    fs,
    future::Future,
    io::Write,
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    sync::{
        OnceLock,
        atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering},
    },
    time::Duration,
};

mod feed;

use feed::Offered;
pub(crate) use feed::refresh;

const RELEASE: &str = include_str!("../voile-release.json");
/// Where install-dev.sh puts a locally built runtime.
const DEVELOPMENT: &str = "current";
/// What every release archive describes itself with.
const MANIFEST: &str = "runtime.json";
/// Unfinished work in the runtimes folder starts with this, and the next
/// install removes it.
const UNFINISHED: &str = ".";
/// The Linux engine's runtime, inside a release (or the development runtime).
const LINUX: &str = "linux";

/// Two installs never extract into the same folder.
static INSTALLING: tokio::sync::Mutex<()> = tokio::sync::Mutex::const_new(());

/// A Voile release: its version and its archive.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Release {
    pub version: String,
    pub url: String,
    pub size: u64,
    pub sha256: String,
}

/// `voile-release.json`: the contract Obelisk keeps with Voile, and the
/// release Obelisk was built with, of that contract.
#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct BuiltIn {
    contract: u32,
    #[serde(flatten)]
    release: Release,
}

fn built_in() -> &'static BuiltIn {
    static VALUE: OnceLock<BuiltIn> = OnceLock::new();
    VALUE.get_or_init(|| serde_json::from_str(RELEASE).expect("checked-in Voile release"))
}

/// The release Obelisk was built with, which Transfers and launches install
/// until they read a feed.
pub fn release() -> &'static Release {
    &built_in().release
}

/// What Obelisk relies on in a runtime, as Voile's `CONTRACT` counts it:
/// Obelisk runs only releases of this contract.
pub fn contract() -> u32 {
    built_in().contract
}

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Failure {
    #[error("backend.voile.downloadFailed")]
    Download,
    #[error("backend.voile.damaged")]
    Damaged,
    #[error("backend.voile.storageFailed")]
    Storage,
    #[error("backend.voile.cancelled")]
    Cancelled,
}
impl From<std::io::Error> for Failure {
    fn from(_: std::io::Error) -> Self {
        Self::Storage
    }
}

/// The runtime in `root` Windows games run in: the development runtime, else
/// the newest release installed there that Obelisk runs.
pub fn runtime(root: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    if let Some(development) = development(root) {
        return Some(development);
    }
    newest(root, &feed::offered(root)).map(|(_, runtime)| runtime)
}

/// The runtime install-dev.sh put in `root`, when there is one.
fn development(root: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let development = root.join(DEVELOPMENT);
    has_wine(&development).then_some(development)
}

fn has_wine(runtime: &Path) -> bool {
    runtime.join("bin/wine").is_file()
}

/// Whether `runtime` holds the Wine of `release`, as its runtime.json names
/// it.
fn holds(runtime: &Path, release: &str) -> bool {
    has_wine(runtime) && version(runtime).as_deref() == Some(release)
}

/// The Linux engine's runtime in `root`: the development runtime's, else the
/// one inside the release Windows games run in.
pub fn linux_runtime(root: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let development = root.join(DEVELOPMENT).join(LINUX);
    if has_engine(&development) {
        return Some(development);
    }
    let linux = newest(root, &feed::offered(root))?.1.join(LINUX);
    has_engine(&linux).then_some(linux)
}

/// The engine and the Wine it runs.
fn has_engine(runtime: &Path) -> bool {
    runtime.join("engine/fexdarwin-run").is_file() && runtime.join("wine/bin/wine").exists()
}

/// The Voile release Windows games run in now, as its runtime.json names it.
pub fn installed_release(root: &Path) -> Option<String> {
    release_of(&runtime(root)?)
}

/// The Voile release `runtime` comes from: a Rosetta runtime, or the Linux
/// engine's runtime inside one.
pub(crate) fn release_of(runtime: &Path) -> Option<String> {
    version(runtime).or_else(|| version(runtime.parent()?))
}

/// What a release says of itself in its runtime.json.
#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct Manifest {
    version: String,
    /// The releases before `CONTRACT` kept the first contract.
    #[serde(default = "first_contract")]
    contract: u32,
}

fn first_contract() -> u32 {
    1
}

fn manifest(runtime: &Path) -> Option<Manifest> {
    serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(runtime.join(MANIFEST)).ok()?).ok()
}

fn version(runtime: &Path) -> Option<String> {
    manifest(runtime).map(|manifest| manifest.version)
}

/// The numbers of a release's version, which order releases: `v26.3.0-16`
/// is [26, 3, 0, 16].
fn numbers(version: &str) -> Option<Vec<u64>> {
    version
        .strip_prefix('v')?
        .split(['.', '-'])
        .map(|number| number.parse().ok())
        .collect()
}

/// Whether `version` names a release as Voile's tags do, such as
/// `v26.3.0-16`.
pub(crate) fn is_version(version: &str) -> bool {
    numbers(version).is_some_and(|numbers| numbers.len() == 4)
}

/// The newest release installed in `root` that Obelisk runs, with its
/// version's numbers: a folder named after the release its runtime.json
/// names, of Obelisk's contract, that the last feed read, which `offered`
/// those, does not withdraw.
fn newest(root: &Path, offered: &[Offered]) -> Option<(Vec<u64>, PathBuf)> {
    let withdrawn: Vec<&str> = offered
        .iter()
        .filter(|offered| offered.withdrawn.is_some())
        .map(|offered| offered.release.version.as_str())
        .collect();
    fs::read_dir(root)
        .ok()?
        .flatten()
        .filter_map(|entry| {
            let name = entry.file_name().into_string().ok()?;
            let order = numbers(&name)?;
            let runtime = entry.path();
            let manifest = manifest(&runtime)?;
            (has_wine(&runtime)
                && manifest.version == name
                && manifest.contract == contract()
                && !withdrawn.contains(&name.as_str()))
            .then_some((order, runtime))
        })
        .max_by(|a, b| a.0.cmp(&b.0))
}

/// The release Obelisk wants of those the last feed read `offered`: the
/// newest for its contract, else the one it was built with.
fn wanted(offered: &[Offered]) -> Release {
    offered
        .iter()
        .filter(|offered| offered.contract == contract() && offered.withdrawn.is_none())
        .filter_map(|offered| Some((numbers(&offered.release.version)?, &offered.release)))
        .max_by(|a, b| a.0.cmp(&b.0))
        .map_or_else(|| release().clone(), |(_, newest)| newest.clone())
}

/// What a launch makes of the runtimes in `root`, for a game whose profile
/// needs `minimum` or a newer release.
pub(crate) fn standing(root: &Path, minimum: Option<&str>) -> Standing {
    if development(root).is_some() {
        return Standing::Current;
    }
    let offered = feed::offered(root);
    let Some((installed, _)) = newest(root, &offered) else {
        return Standing::Missing;
    };
    let Some(wanted) = numbers(&wanted(&offered).version) else {
        return Standing::Current;
    };
    if installed >= wanted {
        return Standing::Current;
    }
    // A game that needs a newer release waits for the one wanted, when that
    // one is enough.
    match minimum.and_then(numbers) {
        Some(minimum) if installed < minimum && wanted >= minimum => Standing::Missing,
        _ => Standing::Outdated,
    }
}

/// One install of a release, which the player can cancel and watch.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Install {
    received: AtomicU64,
    /// The size of the archive being installed, once known.
    total: AtomicU64,
    cancel: CancelToken,
}

impl Install {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    pub fn cancel(&self) {
        self.cancel.cancel();
    }

    /// The bytes downloaded so far, and the archive's size.
    pub fn progress(&self) -> (u64, u64) {
        let total = self.total.load(Ordering::Acquire);
        let total = if total == 0 { release().size } else { total };
        (self.received.load(Ordering::Acquire), total)
    }

    /// Installs in `root` the release Obelisk wants there once it read
    /// Voile's feed again, unless it or a development runtime is already
    /// there. It keeps the releases it replaces: a game may run from one, and
    /// `runtimes` decides when they go. `archive`, a local copy of the
    /// release Obelisk was built with, stands in for the feed and the
    /// download.
    pub async fn run(&self, root: &Path, archive: Option<&Path>) -> Result<PathBuf, Failure> {
        let release = match archive {
            Some(_) => release().clone(),
            None => {
                self.cancellable(feed::refresh(root)).await?;
                wanted(&feed::offered(root))
            }
        };
        self.install(root, &release, archive).await
    }

    async fn install(
        &self,
        root: &Path,
        release: &Release,
        archive: Option<&Path>,
    ) -> Result<PathBuf, Failure> {
        let _installing = self.cancellable(INSTALLING.lock()).await?;
        if let Some(development) = development(root) {
            return Ok(development);
        }
        let destination = root.join(&release.version);
        if holds(&destination, &release.version) {
            return Ok(destination);
        }
        let extracted = self.extract(root, release, archive).await?;
        let runtime = extracted.path().join(format!("voile-{}", release.version));
        if !holds(&runtime, &release.version) {
            return Err(Failure::Damaged);
        }
        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
            if destination.exists() {
                fs::remove_dir_all(&destination)?;
            }
            fs::rename(&runtime, &destination)?;
            Ok(destination)
        })
        .await
        .map_err(|_| Failure::Storage)?
    }

    /// Checks `archive` (or downloads it) and extracts it into a folder of
    /// `root` that goes away unless the caller moves what it holds.
    async fn extract(
        &self,
        root: &Path,
        expected: &Release,
        archive: Option<&Path>,
    ) -> Result<tempfile::TempDir, Failure> {
        self.total.store(expected.size, Ordering::Release);
        let unfinished = root.to_owned();
        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
            fs::create_dir_all(&unfinished)?;
            remove_entries(&unfinished, |name| name.starts_with(UNFINISHED));
            Ok::<_, Failure>(())
        })
        .await
        .map_err(|_| Failure::Storage)??;
        let downloaded;
        let archive = match archive {
            Some(archive) => {
                let (path, expected_sha) = (archive.to_owned(), expected.sha256.clone());
                let matches = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
                    crate::sha(&path).is_ok_and(|sha| sha == expected_sha)
                })
                .await
                .map_err(|_| Failure::Storage)?;
                if !matches {
                    return Err(Failure::Damaged);
                }
                self.received.store(expected.size, Ordering::Release);
                archive
            }
            None => {
                downloaded = self.download(root, expected).await?;
                &*downloaded
            }
        };
        let extracted = tempfile::Builder::new()
            .prefix(UNFINISHED)
            .tempdir_in(root)?;
        let mut tar = tokio::process::Command::new("/usr/bin/tar")
            .arg("-xJf")
            .arg(archive)
            .arg("-C")
            .arg(extracted.path())
            .stdin(std::process::Stdio::null())
            .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
            .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
            .kill_on_drop(true)
            .spawn()?;
        if !self.cancellable(tar.wait()).await??.success() {
            return Err(Failure::Damaged);
        }
        Ok(extracted)
    }

    async fn download(
        &self,
        root: &Path,
        release: &Release,
    ) -> Result<tempfile::TempPath, Failure> {
        let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
            .https_only(true)
            .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(20))
            .read_timeout(Duration::from_secs(60))
            .build()
            .map_err(|_| Failure::Download)?;
        let mut response = self
            .cancellable(client.get(&release.url).send())
            .await?
            .and_then(reqwest::Response::error_for_status)
            .map_err(|_| Failure::Download)?;
        let mut file = tempfile::Builder::new()
            .prefix(UNFINISHED)
            .tempfile_in(root)?;
        let mut digest = Sha256::new();
        let mut size = 0_u64;
        while let Some(bytes) = self
            .cancellable(response.chunk())
            .await?
            .map_err(|_| Failure::Download)?
        {
            size += bytes.len() as u64;
            if size > release.size {
                return Err(Failure::Damaged);
            }
            digest.update(&bytes);
            file.write_all(&bytes)?;
            self.received.store(size, Ordering::Release);
        }
        if size != release.size || format!("{:x}", digest.finalize()) != release.sha256 {
            return Err(Failure::Damaged);
        }
        Ok(file.into_temp_path())
    }

    /// Stops waiting for `work` as soon as the install is cancelled.
    async fn cancellable<T>(&self, work: impl Future<Output = T>) -> Result<T, Failure> {
        self.cancel.race(work).await.map_err(|_| Failure::Cancelled)
    }
}

/// Removes the releases in `root` games no longer run in: all but the newest
/// Obelisk runs, beside the development runtime, the last feed read and
/// unfinished installs. `runtimes` calls it once a launch finds no Game
/// session, of any storefront, that may run a game from one.
pub fn remove_replaced(root: &Path) {
    let Some((_, kept)) = newest(root, &feed::offered(root)) else {
        return;
    };
    let kept = kept
        .file_name()
        .map(|name| name.to_string_lossy().into_owned());
    remove_entries(root, |name| {
        name != DEVELOPMENT
            && Some(name) != kept.as_deref()
            && name != feed::KEPT
            && !name.starts_with(UNFINISHED)
    });
}

/// Removes what `root` holds under the names `remove` picks. Whatever cannot be
/// removed now goes with a later install.
pub(crate) fn remove_entries(root: &Path, remove: impl Fn(&str) -> bool) {
    let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(root) else {
        return;
    };
    for entry in entries.flatten() {
        let name = entry.file_name();
        if !remove(&name.to_string_lossy()) {
            continue;
        }
        let path = entry.path();
        let _ = match entry.file_type() {
            Ok(kind) if kind.is_dir() => fs::remove_dir_all(path),
            _ => fs::remove_file(path),
        };
    }
}
```
