```rs
#[test]
fn the_guest_home_leads_lsteamclient_to_the_runtime_s_linux_steamclient() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let config = linux_config(&root);
    let link = home(&config.prefix).unwrap().join(".steam/sdk64");

    link_steam_client(&config).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read_link(&link).unwrap(),
        Path::new("/opt/steam/linux64")
    );
    link_steam_client(&config).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read_link(&link).unwrap(),
        Path::new("/opt/steam/linux64")
    );

    // A link elsewhere is replaced; anything else is never removed.
    fs::remove_file(&link).unwrap();
    std::os::unix::fs::symlink("/elsewhere", &link).unwrap();
    link_steam_client(&config).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read_link(&link).unwrap(),
        Path::new("/opt/steam/linux64")
    );
    fs::remove_file(&link).unwrap();
    fs::create_dir(&link).unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(link_steam_client(&config), Err(Error::Storage)));
    assert!(link.is_dir());
}

/// A runtime whose window server and render servers only listen, and whose
/// engine records what it was asked to run into `engine.txt`.
fn recording_runtime(root: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
    let runtime = root.join("runtime");
    let script = |relative: &str, body: &str| {
        let path = runtime.join(relative);
        fs::create_dir_all(path.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
        fs::write(&path, format!("#!/bin/sh\n{body}\n")).unwrap();
        fs::set_permissions(&path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).unwrap();
    };
    script("engine/wsd", r#"exec /usr/bin/nc -lU "$2/wsd.sock""#);
    let server = r#"printf '%s\n' "$NPT_BACKEND $NPT_D3D12_LIBRARY_PATH" "$RENDER_SERVER_EXEC_PATH" "residency set ${DMN_RESIDENCY_SET-default}" > "$OBELISK_TEST_ROOT/server.txt"
exec /usr/bin/nc -lU "$4""#;
    script("graphics/bin/virgl_test_server", server);
    script("graphics/x86_64/bin/virgl_test_server", server);
    script(
        "graphics/libexec/virgl_render_server",
        r#"echo "arm64 $*" >> "$OBELISK_TEST_ROOT/servers.txt""#,
    );
    script(
        "graphics/x86_64/libexec/virgl_render_server",
        r#"echo "Intel $*" >> "$OBELISK_TEST_ROOT/servers.txt""#,
    );
    script(
        "engine/fexdarwin-run",
        r#"{ printf '%s\n' "$FEXDARWIN_BIND" "files $(ulimit -S -n)"; printf '%s\n' "$@"; } > "$OBELISK_TEST_ROOT/engine.txt""#,
    );
    runtime
}

/// Runs the launcher with `options` and the program `Game.exe`, from an
/// environment with `variables` and the Finder's 256 open files.
fn run_launcher(root: &Path, options: &[&str], variables: &[(&str, &str)]) -> (String, String) {
    let runtime = recording_runtime(root);
    let mut command = Command::new("/bin/bash");
    command
        .arg("-c")
        .arg(r#"ulimit -S -n 256; exec /bin/bash -c "$0" "$@""#)
        .arg(LAUNCHER)
        .arg("obelisk-linux-engine")
        .arg(&runtime)
        .arg(root.join("home"))
        .arg(root.join("install"))
        .arg("/opt/game")
        .args(options)
        .args(["--", "/opt/game/Game.exe", "-flag"])
        .env_clear()
        .env("PATH", "/usr/bin:/bin")
        .env("TMPDIR", root)
        .env("OBELISK_TEST_ROOT", root)
        .envs(variables.iter().copied());
    let status = command.stdin(Stdio::null()).status().unwrap();
    assert!(status.success(), "{status:?}");
    (
        fs::read_to_string(root.join("engine.txt")).unwrap(),
        fs::read_to_string(root.join("server.txt")).unwrap(),
    )
}

#[test]
fn the_launcher_hands_the_guest_its_binds_its_variables_and_the_session_s_values() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let runtime = root.join("runtime");

    let (engine, server) = run_launcher(
        &root,
        &[
            "--graphics",
            "dxmt",
            "--bind",
            "/opt/steam=/runtime/steam:ro",
            "--env",
            "WINEPREFIX=/home/user/prefix",
            "--pass",
            "Steam3Master",
            "--pass",
            "SteamClientService",
        ],
        &[("Steam3Master", "127.0.0.1:5000")],
    );

    let lines: Vec<&str> = engine.lines().collect();
    assert!(
        lines[0].starts_with(&format!(
            "/opt/wine={}/wine:ro;/home/user={};/opt/game={};/run/obelisk=",
            runtime.display(),
            root.join("home").display(),
            root.join("install").display()
        )),
        "{}",
        lines[0]
    );
    assert!(
        lines[0].ends_with(";/opt/steam=/runtime/steam:ro"),
        "{}",
        lines[0]
    );
    // The Finder's 256 files are not enough for Wine.
    let files: u64 = lines[1].strip_prefix("files ").unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    assert!(files >= 10240, "{files}");
    let variables: Vec<&str> = lines
        .windows(2)
        .filter(|pair| pair[0] == "--env" && !pair[1].starts_with("TZ="))
        .map(|pair| pair[1])
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(
        variables,
        [
            "WINEPREFIX=/home/user/prefix",
            "Steam3Master=127.0.0.1:5000"
        ]
    );
    assert!(lines.ends_with(&["sh", "/opt/game/Game.exe", "-flag"]));
    let dxmt = runtime.join("graphics/dxmt-native.framework/Versions/A/dxmt-native");
    assert_eq!(
        server.lines().next().unwrap(),
        format!("dxmt {}", dxmt.display())
    );
    assert_eq!(server.lines().nth(2).unwrap(), "residency set default");
}

#[test]
fn the_guest_gets_the_mac_s_time_zone_unless_the_caller_passes_one() {
    // The guest root has no zone file: without TZ, every program ran in UTC.
    let mac = fs::read("/etc/localtime").ok().and_then(|zone| {
        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&zone).into_owned();
        let rule: String = text
            .trim_end()
            .rsplit('\n')
            .next()?
            .chars()
            .filter(|c| c.is_ascii_graphic() || *c == ' ')
            .collect();
        (!rule.is_empty()).then(|| format!("TZ={rule}"))
    });
    for (options, expected) in [
        (&[][..], mac.clone()),
        (&["--env", "TZ=UTC0"][..], Some("TZ=UTC0".to_owned())),
    ] {
        let (_directory, root) = installation();

        let (engine, _) = run_launcher(&root, options, &[]);

        let lines: Vec<&str> = engine.lines().collect();
        let zones: Vec<&str> = lines
            .windows(2)
            .filter(|pair| pair[0] == "--env" && pair[1].starts_with("TZ="))
            .map(|pair| pair[1])
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(
            zones,
            expected.iter().map(String::as_str).collect::<Vec<_>>()
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn the_launcher_runs_d3dmetal_in_the_intel_render_server() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();

        format!("d3dmetal {}", library.display())

#[test]
fn each_backend_s_render_server_runs_from_its_own_bundle_inside_the_game_s() {
    use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
    // Metal keeps compiled shaders per bundle identifier: a server outside any
    // bundle shared one cache with every other, which DXMT's emptied.
    for (backend, source, translated) in [
        ("dxmt", "graphics/libexec/virgl_render_server", ""),
        (
            "d3dmetal",
            "graphics/x86_64/libexec/virgl_render_server",
            "Intel --obelisk-translate\nIntel --obelisk-translate\n",
        ),
    ] {
        let (_directory, root) = installation();
        let helper = root.join(format!(
            "obelisk-apps/My-Game/My Game.app/Contents/Helpers/{backend}.app"
        ));
        let executable = helper.join("Contents/MacOS/virgl_render_server");
        let mut copies = Vec::new();

        for _ in 0..2 {
            let (_, server) = run_launcher(
                &root,
                &["--graphics", backend],
                &[("OBELISK_APP_NAME", "My Game")],
            );
            assert_eq!(server.lines().nth(1).unwrap(), executable.to_str().unwrap());
            copies.push(fs::metadata(&executable).unwrap().ino());
        }

        assert_eq!(
            fs::read(&executable).unwrap(),
            fs::read(root.join("runtime").join(source)).unwrap()
        );
        // The copy stays from one launch to the next, with its Rosetta
        // translation, and the Intel one is translated before the game.
        assert_eq!(copies[0], copies[1]);
        let runs = fs::read_to_string(root.join("servers.txt")).unwrap_or_default();
        assert_eq!(runs, translated);
        let plist = fs::read_to_string(helper.join("Contents/Info.plist")).unwrap();
        assert!(
            plist.contains(&format!(
                "<string>com.zagrios.obelisk.game.My-Game.{backend}</string>"
            )),
            "{plist}"
        );
    }
}

#[test]

    }

}

/// A release whose Intel render servers and Obelisk's Intel helper only
/// record that they ran, into `calls`; the helper succeeds unless `failing`.
fn translating_release(root: &Path, failing: bool) -> (wine::Config, PathBuf) {
    use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
    let config = linux_config(root);
    let config = wine::Config {
        runtime: root.join("release/linux"),
        settings: Settings {
            graphics: wine::Graphics::D3DMetal,
            ..config.settings.clone()
        },
        ..config
    };
    let helpers = root.join("Helpers");
    let calls = root.join("calls");
    let script = |path: PathBuf, body: String| {
        fs::create_dir_all(path.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
        fs::write(&path, format!("#!/bin/sh\n{body}\n")).unwrap();
        fs::set_permissions(&path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).unwrap();
    };
    let record = format!(r#"echo "$(basename "$0") $*" >> "{}""#, calls.display());
    let server = config.runtime.join("graphics/x86_64");
    script(server.join("bin/virgl_test_server"), record.clone());
    script(server.join("libexec/virgl_render_server"), record.clone());
    let exit = if failing { "exit 1" } else { "exit 0" };
    script(
        helpers.join(crate::package::SDK_INTEL),
        format!("{record}\n{exit}"),
    );
    (config, calls)
}

#[test]
fn d3dmetal_is_translated_once_per_runtime_and_macos_build_before_its_first_game() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let (config, calls) = translating_release(&root, false);
    let helpers = root.join("Helpers");

    translate_d3dmetal(&config, &helpers);

    let server = config.runtime.join("graphics/x86_64");
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read_to_string(&calls)
            .unwrap()
            .lines()
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        [
            "virgl_test_server --obelisk-translate".to_owned(),
            "virgl_render_server --obelisk-translate".to_owned(),
            format!(
                "{} warm-d3dmetal {} {}",
                crate::package::SDK_INTEL,
                server.join("lib/libd3dmetal-native.dylib").display(),
                root.join("release/lib/external/D3DMetal.framework")
                    .display()
            ),
        ]
    );
    let record = config.runtime.join(TRANSLATED);
    assert_eq!(fs::read_to_string(&record).ok(), macos_build());

    fs::remove_file(&calls).unwrap();
    translate_d3dmetal(&config, &helpers);
    assert!(!calls.exists(), "already translated");

    // A macOS update drops Rosetta's translations.
    fs::write(&record, "an older build").unwrap();
    translate_d3dmetal(&config, &helpers);
    assert_eq!(fs::read_to_string(&calls).unwrap().lines().count(), 3);
}

#[test]
fn a_failed_translation_is_tried_again_and_a_dxmt_game_needs_none() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let (config, calls) = translating_release(&root, true);
    let helpers = root.join("Helpers");

    translate_d3dmetal(&config, &helpers);
    assert!(!config.runtime.join(TRANSLATED).exists());
    translate_d3dmetal(&config, &helpers);
    assert_eq!(fs::read_to_string(&calls).unwrap().lines().count(), 6);

    fs::remove_file(&calls).unwrap();
    let dxmt = wine::Config {
        settings: Settings {
            graphics: wine::Graphics::Dxmt,
            ..config.settings.clone()
        },
        ..config
    };
    translate_d3dmetal(&dxmt, &helpers);
    assert!(!calls.exists());
}

/// End to end on an installed engine runtime, through `prepare` and the
/// launcher as a launch runs them: `OBELISK_LINUX_ENGINE_RUNTIME` names the
/// runtime, `OBELISK_LINUX_ENGINE_PROGRAM` a Windows program that exits by
/// itself, `OBELISK_LINUX_ENGINE_ARGUMENTS` its arguments, and
/// `OBELISK_LINUX_ENGINE_GRAPHICS=d3dmetal` its renderer. It opens a window.
#[test]
#[ignore]
fn smoke() {
    let runtime = PathBuf::from(std::env::var("OBELISK_LINUX_ENGINE_RUNTIME").unwrap());
    let program = PathBuf::from(std::env::var("OBELISK_LINUX_ENGINE_PROGRAM").unwrap());
    let arguments = std::env::var("OBELISK_LINUX_ENGINE_ARGUMENTS").unwrap_or_default();
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let install = root.join("install");
    fs::create_dir_all(&install).unwrap();
    let executable = install.join(program.file_name().unwrap());
    fs::copy(&program, &executable).unwrap();
    let config = wine::Config {
        runtime,
        prefix: root.join("Prefixes/game-linux/prefix"),
        log: root.join("logs/game.log"),
        settings: Settings {
            engine: wine::Engine::Linux,
            graphics: match std::env::var("OBELISK_LINUX_ENGINE_GRAPHICS").as_deref() {
                Ok("d3dmetal") => wine::Graphics::D3DMetal,
                _ => wine::Graphics::Dxmt,
            },
            ..Settings::default()
        },
    };
    let arguments: Vec<&str> = arguments.split_whitespace().collect();
    let launch = launch_target(&executable, &arguments);

    let locations = crate::wine::tests::locations(&root);
    wine::prepare(&config, &locations, &install, &launch, &Plain).unwrap();
    let target = wine::target::<Plain>(&config, &game(&install), &launch, HashMap::new()).unwrap();
    let output = Command::new(&target.executable)
        .args(&target.arguments)
        .current_dir(&target.working_directory)
        .stdin(Stdio::null())
        .output()
        .unwrap();
    println!("{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout));
    let errors = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
    println!(
        "{}",
        errors
            .lines()
            .rev()
            .take(15)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .into_iter()
            .rev()
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\n")
    );
    assert!(output.status.success(), "{:?}", output.status);
}

```

`crates/game-runtime/src/wine/rosetta.rs`:

```rs
//! Voile's Wine for macOS, which Rosetta runs: the engine of every Windows
//! game whose Launch settings name no other.
use super::{Adapter, Additions, Config, Facts, Furnisher, Game, Graphics, Prerequisite};
use crate::{
    Error,
    supervisor::{Target, architecture::Architecture},
};
use obelisk_core::launch::LaunchTarget;
use std::{
    collections::{BTreeSet, HashMap},
    fs,
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    process::{Command, Stdio},
    time::Duration,
};

/// The prerequisites a prefix ran, one id per line.
const PREREQUISITES: &str = "obelisk-prerequisites";
/// The Wine Mono whose .NET registration the prefix holds.
const MONO: &str = "obelisk-mono";
/// The runtime's graphics backends whose DLLs the prefix holds placeholders
/// for, by folder name.
const BACKENDS: &str = "obelisk-graphics";
/// D3DMetal's DLLs in a runtime, beside Wine's own.
const D3DMETAL_DLLS: &str = "lib/d3dmetal";
/// DXMT's DLLs in a runtime, beside Wine's own.
const DXMT_DLLS: &str = "lib/dxmt";
/// D3DMetal's library, which its unix libraries load.
const D3DMETAL_FRAMEWORK: &str = "lib/external/D3DMetal.framework/D3DMetal";
/// Their output, rewritten by each launch that runs one.
const PREREQUISITES_LOG: &str = "obelisk-prerequisites.log";
/// The registry GStreamer keeps of the runtime's plugins.
const GSTREAMER_REGISTRY: &str = "obelisk-gstreamer-registry.bin";
/// An installer still running after this long is stopped.
const PREREQUISITE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10 * 60);
/// Success, "a newer version is already installed" and "restart required".
const INSTALLED: [i32; 3] = [0, 1638, 3010];

/// Wine for macOS, under Rosetta.
pub(super) struct RosettaWine;

static FACTS: Facts = Facts {
    name: "wine-macos",
    // Wine is an Intel program: Rosetta runs it and the Windows game inside it.
    architecture: Architecture::Intel,
    // It ships with the Linux engine's host programs, in every runtime.
    input_service: Some("linux/engine/obelisk-input"),
    graphics: Graphics::D3DMetal,
    launcher_grace: None,
    reserved: super::Reserved {
        variables: &[
            "WINEPREFIX",
            "WINEDLLOVERRIDES",
            "WINEDEBUG",
            "WINEMSYNC",
            "WINE_LARGE_ADDRESS_AWARE",
            "ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX",
            "DOTNET_EnableWriteXorExecute",
            "GST_PLUGIN_SYSTEM_PATH",
            "GST_REGISTRY",
            "CX_APPLEGPTK_LIBD3DSHARED_PATH",
            "D3DMETAL_FRAMEWORK_PATH",
            "WINEDLLPATH_PREPEND",
            "CX_ACTIVE_GRAPHICS_BACKEND",
            "D3DM_SUPPORT_DXR",
            "CX_HIDE_BUILTIN_VERSION_RESOURCES",
            // The Game session adds these to the game's own.
            crate::input::SOCKET,
            crate::metal_hud::ENABLED,
            crate::metal_hud::LOG_ENABLED,
            crate::metal_hud::OPACITY,
            crate::metal_hud::DISABLE_MENU_BAR,
        ],
        dlls: &["mscoree", "mshtml", "winemenubuilder.exe"],
    },
};

impl Adapter for RosettaWine {
    fn facts(&self) -> &'static Facts {
        &FACTS
    }

    fn runtime(&self, voile: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf> {
        crate::voile::runtime(voile)
    }

    fn prefix(&self, rosetta: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, Error> {
        Ok(rosetta.to_owned())
    }

    /// The prefix is created or updated for the runtime, the storefront
    /// furnishes it and its prerequisites run.
    fn ready(
        &self,
        config: &Config,
        locations: &crate::Locations,
        storefront: &dyn Furnisher,
    ) -> Result<(), Error> {
        boot(config, &locations.home)?;
        storefront.furnish_prefix(config)?;
        install_prerequisites(config, &locations.home, &storefront.prerequisites_to_run()?)?;
        match config.log.parent() {
            Some(logs) => crate::files::private_directory(logs),
            None => Err(Error::Storage),
        }
    }

    fn target(
        &self,
        config: &Config,
        game: &Game<'_>,
        launched: &LaunchTarget,
        program: PathBuf,
        additions: Additions,
        environment: HashMap<String, String>,
    ) -> Result<Target, Error> {
        let mut arguments: Vec<String> = additions.helper.map(str::to_owned).into_iter().collect();
        arguments.push(program.to_string_lossy().into_owned());
        arguments.extend(launched.arguments.iter().cloned());
        let mut environment = environment;
        environment.extend(self::environment(config));
        Ok(Target {
            executable: wine(config),
            arguments,
            working_directory: PathBuf::from(&launched.working_directory),
            environment,
            log: Some(config.log.clone()),
            installation: Some(game.install.to_owned()),
            program: Some(program),
        })
    }

    /// Rosetta's Wine reads it on the Mac's disk, through its Z: drive.
    fn private_file(
        &self,
        _config: &Config,
        name: &str,
        bytes: &[u8],
    ) -> Result<(tempfile::TempDir, String), Error> {
        let (directory, path) =
            crate::files::private_temp_file(&std::env::temp_dir(), "obelisk-", name, bytes)?;
        Ok((directory, super::windows_path(&path)))
    }

    /// Taskkill without /F posts WM_CLOSE to the windows of the game's
    /// program and of the processes it started, in the game's prefix and
    /// with its environment, which its Wine server must agree with.
    fn quit_command(
        &self,
        config: &Config,
        environment: &HashMap<String, String>,
        program: Option<&Path>,
        _pid: u32,
    ) -> Option<Command> {
        let mut command = Command::new(wine(config));
        command
            .args(["taskkill", "/T", "/IM"])
            .arg(program?.file_name()?)
            .env_clear()
            .envs(environment);
        Some(command)
    }

    fn end_command(&self, config: &Config) -> Option<Command> {
        let mut command = Command::new(config.runtime.join("bin/wineserver"));
        command
            .arg("-k")
            .env_clear()
            .env("WINEPREFIX", &config.prefix);
        Some(command)
    }

    /// The prefix, and the folder of its Wine server, which Wine names after
    /// the prefix's device and inode.
    fn private_folders(
        &self,
        config: &Config,
        _environment: &HashMap<String, String>,
        _pid: Option<u32>,
    ) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
        use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
        let mut folders = vec![config.prefix.clone()];
        if let Ok(prefix) = fs::metadata(&config.prefix) {
            folders.push(PathBuf::from(format!(
                "/tmp/.wine-{}/server-{:x}-{:x}",
                prefix.uid(),
                prefix.dev(),
                prefix.ino()
            )));
        }
        folders
    }

    fn remove(
        &self,
        locations: &crate::Locations,
        prefix: &Path,
    ) -> Result<(), obelisk_core::installation::RemovalFailure> {
        // A Wine server lingers a few seconds after its game and would write
        // the registry back into the prefix.
        if prefix.is_dir()
            && let Some(runtime) = self.runtime(&locations.voile)
        {
            let _ = wineserver(&runtime, prefix, "-k");
        }
        super::remove_folder(prefix)
    }
}

fn wine(config: &Config) -> PathBuf {
    config.runtime.join("bin/wine")
}

/// Whether the runtime is in place.
fn installed(config: &Config) -> bool {
    wine(config).is_file()
}

/// Released runtimes carry D3DMetal. When one does, CrossOver's Wine
/// preloads libd3dshared for D3DMetal's DLLs.
fn d3dmetal(config: &Config) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let library = config.runtime.join("lib/external/libd3dshared.dylib");
    library.is_file().then_some(library)
}

/// The runtime's graphics backends, D3DMetal's DLLs then DXMT's, each in
/// its own folder beside Wine's. A runtime from before them has D3DMetal's
/// DLLs over Wine's own, and none.
fn backends(config: &Config) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    dll_folders(config, &[D3DMETAL_DLLS, DXMT_DLLS])
}

/// The folders Wine searches before its own for the game's DLLs: its
/// backend's, then, behind D3DMetal, DXMT's for the 32-bit programs D3DMetal
/// does not run.
fn graphics_folders(config: &Config) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    match config.settings.graphics {
        Graphics::D3DMetal => backends(config),
        Graphics::Dxmt => dll_folders(config, &[DXMT_DLLS]),
    }
}

/// Those of the DLL `folders` the runtime carries.
fn dll_folders(config: &Config, folders: &[&str]) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    folders
        .iter()
        .map(|folder| config.runtime.join(folder))
        .filter(|folder| folder.is_dir())
        .collect()
}

/// The backend CrossOver's Wine is told renders, when the runtime carries
/// it: Wine reports the hardware scheduling D3D12 expects from D3DMetal
/// alone.
fn active_graphics(config: &Config) -> Option<&'static str> {
    let carried = match config.settings.graphics {
        Graphics::D3DMetal => d3dmetal(config).is_some(),
        Graphics::Dxmt => config.runtime.join(DXMT_DLLS).is_dir(),
    };
    carried.then_some(config.settings.graphics.name())
}

/// The GStreamer plugins the runtime carries, which decode games' videos and
/// sounds through Media Foundation, DirectShow and WMReader.
fn gstreamer_plugins(config: &Config) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let plugins = config.runtime.join("lib/gstreamer-1.0");
    plugins.is_dir().then_some(plugins)
}

/// The Wine Mono the runtime carries, such as `wine-mono-10.4.1`.
fn mono(config: &Config) -> Option<String> {
    fs::read_dir(config.runtime.join("share/wine/mono"))
        .ok()?
        .filter_map(|entry| entry.ok()?.file_name().into_string().ok())
        .filter(|name| name.starts_with("wine-mono-"))
        .max()
}

/// No Gecko installer prompt and no menu entries. .NET games run on the Wine
/// Mono a runtime carries; without it, mscoree stays off so that no Mono
/// installer prompt appears either. The profile's overrides follow.
fn overrides(config: &Config) -> String {
    let own = if mono(config).is_some() {
        "mshtml=;winemenubuilder.exe=d"
    } else {
        "mscoree,mshtml=;winemenubuilder.exe=d"
    };
    config.with_profile_overrides(own)
}

fn environment(config: &Config) -> HashMap<String, String> {
    let mut environment = HashMap::from([
        (
            "WINEPREFIX".to_owned(),
            config.prefix.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        ),
        ("WINEDLLOVERRIDES".to_owned(), overrides(config)),
        ("WINEDEBUG".to_owned(), config.debug_channels()),
        // Events, mutexes and semaphores become Mach semaphores instead of
        // wineserver requests. The server and every process of the prefix
        // must agree on it, so every Wine command sets it.
        ("WINEMSYNC".to_owned(), "1".to_owned()),
        // 32-bit games get 4 GB of address space, as on 64-bit Windows, even
        // when their executable does not ask for it.
        ("WINE_LARGE_ADDRESS_AWARE".to_owned(), "1".to_owned()),
        // Rosetta translates AVX and AVX2 but hides them from CPUID unless
        // asked, and some games refuse to start without them.
        ("ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX".to_owned(), "1".to_owned()),
        // CrossOver turns off the W^X mode in which .NET 7 and 8 map their
        // JIT code: it breaks those programs under Rosetta.
        ("DOTNET_EnableWriteXorExecute".to_owned(), "0".to_owned()),
    ]);
    // Only the runtime's plugins load, never a GStreamer installed on the Mac
    // or in the home, and the prefix keeps their registry.
    if let Some(plugins) = gstreamer_plugins(config) {
        environment.insert(
            "GST_PLUGIN_SYSTEM_PATH".into(),
            plugins.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        );
        environment.insert(
            "GST_REGISTRY".into(),
            config
                .prefix
                .join(GSTREAMER_REGISTRY)
                .to_string_lossy()
                .into_owned(),
        );
    }
    // CrossOver's Wine preloads libd3dshared whatever renders.
    if let Some(library) = d3dmetal(config) {
        environment.insert(
            "CX_APPLEGPTK_LIBD3DSHARED_PATH".into(),
            library.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        );
    }
    // Outside Apple's own layout, D3DMetal's unix libraries do not find their
    // framework by themselves.
    let framework = config.runtime.join(D3DMETAL_FRAMEWORK);
    if framework.is_file() {
        environment.insert(
            "D3DMETAL_FRAMEWORK_PATH".into(),
            framework.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        );
    }
    if let Some(folders) = search_path(&graphics_folders(config)) {
        environment.insert("WINEDLLPATH_PREPEND".into(), folders);
    }
    if let Some(active) = active_graphics(config) {
        environment.insert("CX_ACTIVE_GRAPHICS_BACKEND".into(), active.into());
    }
    // Direct3D 12 offers DirectX Raytracing unless D3DMetal is told not to.
    if config.settings.graphics == Graphics::D3DMetal && !config.settings.options.ray_tracing {
        environment.insert("D3DM_SUPPORT_DXR".into(), "0".into());
    }
    // The profile's variables come last, so that they may replace Obelisk's
    // own for their game.
    environment.extend(config.settings.variables.clone());
    environment
}

/// `folders` as one search path, or `None` when there are none.
fn search_path(folders: &[PathBuf]) -> Option<String> {
    let folders: Vec<_> = folders
        .iter()
        .map(|folder| folder.to_string_lossy())
        .collect();
    (!folders.is_empty()).then(|| folders.join(":"))
}

/// Creates the prefix on first use, registers the runtime's Wine Mono in it,
/// and keeps its user folders apart from the Mac home.
fn boot(config: &Config, home: &Path) -> Result<(), Error> {
    if !installed(config) {
        return Err(Error::WineUnavailable);
    }
    crate::files::private_directory(&config.prefix)?;
    let created = !config.prefix.join("system.reg").is_file();
    if created {
        wineboot(config, home, "--init")?;
    }
    // wineboot installs Mono's .NET registration and a placeholder for every
    // DLL of the graphics backends when it creates a prefix: Wine loads a
    // DLL only through its placeholder, such as DXMT's winemetal. A prefix
    // created by a runtime without Mono or without one of the backends lacks
    // them: updating the prefix once adds them.
    let backends = backends(config)
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|folder| folder.file_name())
        .map(|name| name.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" ");
    let records = [(MONO, mono(config)), (BACKENDS, Some(backends))];
    let stale: Vec<_> = records
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|(record, value)| Some((config.prefix.join(record), value?)))
        .filter(|(record, value)| fs::read_to_string(record).unwrap_or_default() != *value)
        .collect();
    if !stale.is_empty() {
        if !created {
            wineboot(config, home, "--update")?;
        }
        for (record, value) in stale {
            fs::write(record, value)?;
        }
    }
    unlink_home_folders(&super::profile(&config.prefix))
}

/// Runs wineboot in the prefix and waits until its server stops writing the
/// registry, which the game must not start before. Every backend's folder
/// comes first, so that the prefix gets a placeholder for each of their DLLs.
fn wineboot(config: &Config, home: &Path, argument: &str) -> Result<(), Error> {
    let mut environment = environment(config);
    if let Some(folders) = search_path(&backends(config)) {
        environment.insert("WINEDLLPATH_PREPEND".into(), folders);
    }
    let status = Command::new(wine(config))
        .args(["wineboot", argument])
        .env_clear()
        .envs(crate::native::environment(home))
        .envs(environment)
        .stdin(Stdio::null())
        .stdout(Stdio::null())
        .stderr(Stdio::null())
        .status()?;
    let server = Command::new(config.runtime.join("bin/wineserver"))
        .arg("-w")
        .env_clear()
        .env("WINEPREFIX", &config.prefix)
        .status()?;
    if !status.success() || !server.success() {
        return Err(Error::StartFailed);
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Games save into the profile's Documents and similar folders, which Cloud
/// syncs and never follows through links. A prefix created before the runtime
/// stopped linking them to the Mac home still holds those links: each becomes
/// an empty folder, and the Mac folder it pointed at stays untouched.
fn unlink_home_folders(profile: &Path) -> Result<(), Error> {
    for (folder, recreate) in [(profile.to_owned(), true), (profile.join("Desktop"), false)] {
        let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(&folder) else {
            continue;
        };
        for entry in entries {
            let entry = entry?;
            if entry.file_type()?.is_symlink() {
                fs::remove_file(entry.path())?;
                if recreate {
                    fs::create_dir(entry.path())?;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// The prerequisites `prefix` ran, as its record keeps them.
fn ran_prerequisites(prefix: &Path) -> std::io::Result<BTreeSet<String>> {
    match fs::read_to_string(prefix.join(PREREQUISITES)) {
        Ok(text) => Ok(text.lines().map(str::to_owned).collect()),
        Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(BTreeSet::new()),
        Err(error) => Err(error),
    }
}

/// Records `ran` as the prerequisites `prefix` ran.
fn record_prerequisites(prefix: &Path, ran: &BTreeSet<String>) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let text: Vec<_> = ran.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
    obelisk_core::write_atomic(&prefix.join(PREREQUISITES), text.join("\n").as_bytes())
}

/// Forgets the prerequisites `forget` picks among those `prefix` ran.
pub(super) fn forget_prerequisites(
    prefix: &Path,
    forget: impl Fn(&str) -> bool,
) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let mut ran = ran_prerequisites(prefix)?;
    let before = ran.len();
    ran.retain(|id| !forget(id));
    if ran.len() == before {
        return Ok(());
    }
    record_prerequisites(prefix, &ran)
}

/// Runs, in order, the prerequisites this prefix has not run yet. One that
/// fails or outlasts its timeout runs again on the next launch; the game still
/// starts, and may tell what it misses.
fn install_prerequisites(
    config: &Config,
    home: &Path,
    prerequisites: &[Prerequisite],
) -> Result<(), Error> {
    let mut ran = ran_prerequisites(&config.prefix)?;
    let pending: Vec<_> = prerequisites
        .iter()
        .filter(|prerequisite| !prerequisite.id.contains('\n') && !ran.contains(&prerequisite.id))
        .collect();
    if pending.is_empty() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let log = fs::File::create(config.prefix.join(PREREQUISITES_LOG))?;
    for prerequisite in pending {
        if run_prerequisite(config, home, prerequisite, &log)? {
            ran.insert(prerequisite.id.clone());
            record_prerequisites(&config.prefix, &ran)?;
        }
    }
    // The game must not start while an installer's processes still run.
    wineserver(&config.runtime, &config.prefix, "-w")?;
    Ok(())
}

/// Whether every program of `prerequisite` ran and reported success.
fn run_prerequisite(
    config: &Config,
    home: &Path,
    prerequisite: &Prerequisite,
    log: &fs::File,
) -> Result<bool, Error> {
    for (program, arguments) in &prerequisite.programs {
        let Ok(program) = program.canonicalize() else {
            return Ok(false);
        };
        let mut command = Command::new(wine(config));
        // Wine starts scripts only through cmd, which reads Windows paths.
        let script = program
            .extension()
            .and_then(|extension| extension.to_str())
            .is_some_and(|extension| {
                matches!(extension.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str(), "cmd" | "bat")
            });
        if script {
            command
                .args(["cmd", "/c"])
                .arg(super::windows_path(&program));
        } else {
            command.arg(&program);
        }
        let mut environment = environment(config);
        // Wine's msvcp140, msvcp140_2 and vcruntime140_1 claim the version of
        // the newest Visual C++ runtime, so its installer keeps them over
        // Microsoft's. With their versions hidden, it installs Microsoft's,
        // which a game whose profile loads them native first then gets.
        if visual_cpp_installer(&program) {
            environment.insert("CX_HIDE_BUILTIN_VERSION_RESOURCES".into(), "1".into());
        }
        command
            .args(super::command_line(arguments))
            .current_dir(program.parent().unwrap_or(&config.prefix))
            .env_clear()
            .envs(crate::native::environment(home))
            .envs(environment)
            .stdin(Stdio::null())
            .stdout(log.try_clone()?)
            .stderr(log.try_clone()?);
        let code = super::wait(command.spawn()?, PREREQUISITE_TIMEOUT)?;
        if code.is_none() {
            wineserver(&config.runtime, &config.prefix, "-k")?;
        }
        if !code.is_some_and(|code| INSTALLED.contains(&code)) {
            return Ok(false);
        }
    }
    Ok(true)
}

/// Whether `program` installs a Visual C++ runtime, as Microsoft names its
/// installers: vc_redist or, before 2015, vcredist.
fn visual_cpp_installer(program: &Path) -> bool {
    program
        .file_name()
        .map(|name| name.to_string_lossy().to_ascii_lowercase())
        .is_some_and(|name| name.starts_with("vc_redist") || name.starts_with("vcredist"))
}

/// Waits for, or stops, the Wine server of `prefix`. Neither starts a server,
/// so no Wine setting is needed.
fn wineserver(runtime: &Path, prefix: &Path, argument: &str) -> Result<(), Error> {
    Command::new(runtime.join("bin/wineserver"))
        .arg(argument)
        .env_clear()
        .env("WINEPREFIX", prefix)
        .stdin(Stdio::null())
        .stdout(Stdio::null())
        .stderr(Stdio::null())
        .status()?;
    Ok(())
}
```

```rs
use super::*;
use crate::wine::{
    prepare,

/// Readies the created prefix of `config` for a game whose storefront names
/// `prerequisites`.
fn ready(config: &Config, root: &Path, prerequisites: &[Prerequisite]) {
    fs::write(config.prefix.join("system.reg"), "").unwrap();
    let (install, target) = game(root);
    let storefront = Plain {
        prerequisites: prerequisites.to_vec(),
    };
    prepare(config, &locations(root), &install, &target, &storefront).unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn each_prerequisite_runs_once_and_a_failed_one_again_on_the_next_launch() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let config = recording_runtime(&root);
    let redist = root.join("game/redist");
    fs::create_dir_all(&redist).unwrap();
    for name in ["vc_redist.x64.exe", "Visual C++ x64.cmd", "fail.exe"] {
        fs::write(redist.join(name), "").unwrap();
    }
    let prerequisites = [
        Prerequisite {
            id: "vcredist".into(),
            programs: vec![
                (redist.join("Visual C++ x64.cmd"), String::new()),
                (
                    redist.join("vc_redist.x64.exe"),
                    r#"/q "/log=C:\a b.txt""#.into(),
                ),
            ],
        },
        Prerequisite {
            id: "broken".into(),
            programs: vec![(redist.join("fail.exe"), String::new())],
        },
    ];

    ready(&config, &root, &prerequisites);
    ready(&config, &root, &prerequisites);

    let script = windows_path(&redist.join("Visual C++ x64.cmd"));
    let program = redist.join("vc_redist.x64.exe");
    let failing = redist.join("fail.exe");
    assert_eq!(
        calls(&root),
        [
            format!("cmd /c {script}"),
            format!("{} /q /log=C:\\a b.txt", program.display()),
            failing.display().to_string(),
            failing.display().to_string(),
        ]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read_to_string(config.prefix.join(PREREQUISITES)).unwrap(),
        "vcredist"
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_visual_cpp_installer_runs_with_the_versions_of_wine_s_own_dlls_hidden() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let config = recording_runtime(&root);
    fs::write(
        config.runtime.join("bin/wine"),
        "#!/bin/sh\nprintf '%s %s\\n' \"${1##*/}\" \"${CX_HIDE_BUILTIN_VERSION_RESOURCES:-shown}\" \
         >> \"$WINEPREFIX/../calls\"\n",
    )
    .unwrap();
    let redist = root.join("game/redist");
    fs::create_dir_all(&redist).unwrap();
    let names = ["VC_redist.x64.exe", "vcredist_x86.exe", "DXSETUP.exe"];
    for name in names {
        fs::write(redist.join(name), "").unwrap();
    }
    let prerequisite = Prerequisite {
        id: "redist".into(),
        programs: names
            .iter()
            .map(|name| (redist.join(name), String::new()))
            .collect(),
    };

    ready(&config, &root, &[prerequisite]);

    assert_eq!(
        calls(&root),
        [
            "VC_redist.x64.exe 1",
            "vcredist_x86.exe 1",
            "DXSETUP.exe shown"
        ]
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_missing_program_leaves_its_prerequisite_pending() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let config = recording_runtime(&root);
    let prerequisite = Prerequisite {
        id: "missing".into(),
        programs: vec![(root.join("game/absent.exe"), String::new())],
    };
    ready(&config, &root, &[prerequisite]);
    assert!(calls(&root).is_empty());
    assert!(!config.prefix.join(PREREQUISITES).exists());
}
```

```rs
use super::*;
use crate::launch_settings::Settings;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

/// The smallest file `portable_executable` accepts: a DOS header whose last
/// field points just past it, at a PE signature.
pub(crate) fn pe() -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut bytes = vec![0u8; 64];
    bytes[..2].copy_from_slice(b"MZ");
    bytes[60..64].copy_from_slice(&64u32.to_le_bytes());
    bytes.extend_from_slice(b"PE\0\0");
    bytes
}

pub(crate) fn installation() -> (tempfile::TempDir, PathBuf) {
    let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let root = directory.path().canonicalize().unwrap();
    (directory, root)
}

pub(crate) fn target(executable: &Path, arguments: &[&str]) -> LaunchTarget {
    LaunchTarget {
        executable: executable.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        arguments: arguments
            .iter()
            .map(|argument| (*argument).into())
            .collect(),
        working_directory: executable.parent().unwrap().to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        is_application_bundle: false,
    }
}

/// A game no profile names.
const OTHER: crate::profile::Game<'static> = crate::profile::Game::Steam { app_id: 42 };
/// A game whose profile names the Linux engine and D3DMetal.
const ELDEN_RING: crate::profile::Game<'static> = crate::profile::Game::Steam { app_id: 1245620 };

/// Obelisk's folders under `root`: its library, its bundle and its home.
pub(crate) fn locations(root: &Path) -> crate::Locations {
    crate::Locations::new(
        &root.join("library"),
        &root.join("Obelisk.app"),
        &root.join("home"),
    )
}

/// Installs the Linux engine's runtime as Voile's development runtime: its
/// engine, its Wine and Neptune's Direct3D, each a placeholder.
pub(crate) fn engine_runtime(locations: &crate::Locations) -> PathBuf {
    let runtime = locations.voile.join("current/linux");
    for file in ["engine/fexdarwin-run", "wine/bin/wine"] {
        fs::create_dir_all(runtime.join(file).parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
        fs::write(runtime.join(file), "").unwrap();
    }
    fs::create_dir_all(runtime.join("windows")).unwrap();
    for library in ["d3d11.dll", "dxgi.dll", "d3d12.dll"] {
        fs::write(runtime.join("windows").join(library), library).unwrap();
    }
    runtime
}

pub(crate) fn config(root: &Path) -> Config {
    Config {
        runtime: root.join("runtime"),
        prefix: root.join("prefix"),
        log: root.join("logs/wine-game.log"),
        settings: Settings::default(),
    }
}

/// A storefront that adds nothing, or the prerequisites it is given.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct Plain {
    pub prerequisites: Vec<Prerequisite>,
}
impl Storefront for Plain {
    fn prerequisites(&self) -> Result<Vec<Prerequisite>, Error> {
        Ok(self.prerequisites.clone())
    }
    fn furnish(&self, config: &Config) -> Result<(), Error> {
        fs::write(config.prefix.join("furnished"), "")?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// A storefront whose games start behind its helper and read a variable
/// their session sets.
struct Behind;
impl Storefront for Behind {
    const HELPER: Option<&'static str> = Some(r"C:\helper.exe");
    const PASSED: &'static [&'static str] = &["SESSION_PORT"];
    fn prerequisites(&self) -> Result<Vec<Prerequisite>, Error> {
        Ok(Vec::new())
    }
}

/// A game installed in `install`, without a store title.
fn plain(install: &Path) -> Game<'_> {
    Game { install, title: "" }
}

/// The engine's configuration of a prefix beside `root`.
fn linux_config(root: &Path) -> Config {
    Config {
        prefix: root.join("Prefixes/game-linux/prefix"),
        settings: Settings {
            engine: Engine::Linux,
            ..Settings::default()
        },
        ..config(root)
    }
}

/// A storefront whose games reach Valve's steamclient.
struct Client;
impl Storefront for Client {
    const STEAM_CLIENT: bool = true;
    fn prerequisites(&self) -> Result<Vec<Prerequisite>, Error> {
        Ok(Vec::new())
    }
}

/// `engine`'s configuration of a prefix beside `root`, with the backend it
/// renders with by default.
fn engine_config(root: &Path, engine: Engine) -> Config {
    Config {
        prefix: engine
            .adapter()
            .prefix(&root.join("Prefixes/game"))
            .unwrap(),
        settings: Settings {
            engine,
            graphics: Graphics::default_on(engine),
            ..Settings::default()
        },
        ..config(root)
    }
}

/// What Windows sees of `target`: the command line it starts and the
/// variables Obelisk gives it, in the order it gives them.
fn windows_side(config: &Config, target: &Target) -> (Vec<String>, Vec<(String, String)>) {
    use super::linux_engine::tests::{guest_command, options};
    match config.settings.engine {
        Engine::Rosetta => (
            target.arguments.clone(),
            target.environment.clone().into_iter().collect(),
        ),
        Engine::Linux => (
            guest_command(target).to_vec(),
            options(target, "--env")
                .into_iter()
                .map(|variable| {
                    let (name, value) = variable.split_once('=').unwrap();
                    (name.to_owned(), value.to_owned())
                })
                .collect(),
        ),
    }
}

/// A Windows game inside `root/game`, and its target.
pub(crate) fn game(root: &Path) -> (PathBuf, LaunchTarget) {
    let install = root.join("game");
    fs::create_dir_all(&install).unwrap();
    fs::write(install.join("Game.exe"), pe()).unwrap();
    let target = target(&install.join("Game.exe"), &[]);
    (install, target)
}

/// The environment Wine commands of `config` run with.
fn environment(config: &Config) -> HashMap<String, String> {
    let (install, target) = game(config.prefix.parent().unwrap());
    super::target::<Plain>(config, &plain(&install), &target, HashMap::new())
        .unwrap()
        .environment
}

#[test]
fn a_windows_game_starts_in_wine_itself_when_no_storefront_helper_stands_in() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let install = root.join("game");
    fs::create_dir_all(install.join("Binaries")).unwrap();
    fs::write(install.join("Binaries/Game.exe"), pe()).unwrap();
    let config = config(&root);

    let target = super::target::<Plain>(
        &config,
        &plain(&install),
        &target(&install.join("Binaries/Game.exe"), &["-EpicPortal"]),
        HashMap::from([("HOME".to_owned(), "/home".to_owned())]),
    )
    .unwrap();

    assert_eq!(target.executable, root.join("runtime/bin/wine"));
    assert_eq!(
        target.arguments,
        [
            install.join("Binaries/Game.exe").to_string_lossy().as_ref(),
            "-EpicPortal"
        ]
    );
    assert_eq!(target.working_directory, install.join("Binaries"));
    assert_eq!(target.environment["HOME"], "/home");
    assert_eq!(target.environment["WINEMSYNC"], "1");
    assert_eq!(
        target.environment["WINEPREFIX"],
        root.join("prefix").to_string_lossy()
    );
    assert_eq!(target.log, Some(root.join("logs/wine-game.log")));
}

 {

#[test]
fn a_storefront_s_helper_and_session_variables_reach_its_game_on_either_engine() {
    use super::linux_engine::tests::{guest_command, options};
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let (install, launched) = game(&root);
    let program = install.join("Game.exe").to_string_lossy().into_owned();
    let (rosetta, linux) = (config(&root), linux_config(&root));

    let behind =
        super::target::<Behind>(&rosetta, &plain(&install), &launched, HashMap::new()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(behind.arguments, [r"C:\helper.exe", program.as_str()]);
    let behind =
        super::target::<Behind>(&linux, &plain(&install), &launched, HashMap::new()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        guest_command(&behind),
        [r"C:\helper.exe", "/opt/game/Game.exe"]
    );
    assert_eq!(options(&behind, "--pass"), ["SESSION_PORT"]);

    let alone =
        super::target::<Plain>(&rosetta, &plain(&install), &launched, HashMap::new()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(alone.arguments, [program.as_str()]);
    let alone =
        super::target::<Plain>(&linux, &plain(&install), &launched, HashMap::new()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(guest_command(&alone), ["/opt/game/Game.exe"]);
    assert!(options(&alone, "--pass").is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn a_profile_s_variables_and_dll_overrides_take_effect_on_either_engine() {
    for offer in crate::launch_settings::ENGINES {
        let (_directory, root) = installation();
        let (install, launched) = game(&root);
        let config = engine_config(&root, offer.engine);
        let config = Config {
            settings: Settings {
                // WINEDEBUG is one of Obelisk's own on both engines.
                variables: BTreeMap::from([
                    ("WINENCPU".to_owned(), "10".to_owned()),
                    ("WINEDEBUG".to_owned(), "-all".to_owned()),
                ]),
                dll_overrides: BTreeMap::from([
                    ("xaudio2_7".to_owned(), "n,b".to_owned()),
                    ("SpeechSynthWrapper".to_owned(), String::new()),
                ]),
                ..config.settings.clone()
            },
            ..config
        };

        let started =
            super::target::<Plain>(&config, &plain(&install), &launched, HashMap::new()).unwrap();

        // Of a name given twice, the last counts.
        let (_, variables) = windows_side(&config, &started);
        let last = |name: &str| {
            variables
                .iter()
                .rev()
                .find(|(variable, _)| variable == name)
                .map(|(_, value)| value.clone())
        };
        assert_eq!(
            last("WINENCPU").as_deref(),
            Some("10"),
            "{:?}",
            offer.engine
        );
        assert_eq!(
            last("WINEDEBUG").as_deref(),
            Some("-all"),
            "{:?}",
            offer.engine
        );
        let own = match offer.engine {
            Engine::Rosetta => "mscoree,mshtml=;winemenubuilder.exe=d",
            Engine::Linux => "mscoree,mshtml=;winemenubuilder.exe=d;d3d11,dxgi,d3d12=n",
        };
        assert_eq!(
            last("WINEDLLOVERRIDES"),
            Some(format!("{own};SpeechSynthWrapper=;xaudio2_7=n,b"))
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn every_variable_and_dll_an_engine_sets_is_one_it_reserves() {
    for offer in crate::launch_settings::ENGINES {
        let (_directory, root) = installation();
        let (install, launched) = game(&root);
        let config = engine_config(&root, offer.engine);
        let config = Config {
            settings: Settings {
                graphics: Graphics::D3DMetal,
                options: GraphicsOptions { ray_tracing: false },
                ..config.settings.clone()
            },
            ..config
        };
        // A runtime that carries every optional piece, but no Mono.
        for folder in ["lib/gstreamer-1.0", "guest"] {
            fs::create_dir_all(config.runtime.join(folder)).unwrap();
        }
        backends_runtime(&config);
        fs::write(config.runtime.join("guest/steam-hostpid.so"), b"elf").unwrap();

        let started =
            super::target::<Client>(&config, &plain(&install), &launched, HashMap::new()).unwrap();

        let reserved = offer.engine.reserved();
        let (_, variables) = windows_side(&config, &started);
        for (name, _) in &variables {
            assert!(
                reserved.variables.contains(&name.as_str()),
                "{:?} {name}",
                offer.engine
            );
        }
        let (_, overrides) = variables
            .iter()
            .find(|(name, _)| name == "WINEDLLOVERRIDES")
            .unwrap();
        let dlls = overrides
            .split(';')
            .filter_map(|entry| entry.split_once('='))
            .flat_map(|(dlls, _)| dlls.split(','));
        for dll in dlls {
            assert!(
                reserved.dlls.contains(&dll.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str()),
                "{:?} {dll}",
                offer.engine
            );
        }
    }
}

#[test]

}

#[test]
fn a_private_file_is_read_through_the_z_drive_on_rosetta_and_from_the_c_drive_on_the_engine() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    for config in [config(&root), linux_config(&root)] {
        fs::create_dir_all(config.prefix.join("drive_c")).unwrap();

        let (folder, path) = private_file(&config, "ownership.bin", b"token").unwrap();

        let file = match config.settings.engine {
            Engine::Rosetta => PathBuf::from(path.strip_prefix("Z:").unwrap().replace('\\', "/")),
            Engine::Linux => config
                .prefix
                .join("drive_c")
                .join(path.strip_prefix("C:\\").unwrap().replace('\\', "/")),
        };
        assert!(path.ends_with("\\ownership.bin"), "{path}");
        assert_eq!(fs::read(&file).unwrap(), b"token");
        drop(folder);
        assert!(!file.exists());
    }
}

#[test]
fn each_storefront_s_game_is_readied_in_its_prefix_and_logs_into_its_store_s_diagnostics_folder() {
    use crate::profile::Game::{Epic, Gog, Steam};
    use crate::queue::Storefront;
    let rows: [(crate::profile::Game, &str, Storefront, &str); 3] = [
        (
            Steam { app_id: 42 },
            "Steam/steam-42-windows",
            Storefront::Steam,
            "wine-42.log",
        ),
        (
            Epic {
                namespace: "space",
                app_name: "game",
            },
            "Epic/epic-hash-Windows",
            Storefront::Epic,
            "wine-game.log",
        ),
        (
            Gog {
                product_id: "1207658924",
            },
            "GOG/gog-1207658924-windows",
            Storefront::Gog,
            "wine-1207658924.log",
        ),
    ];
    for (game, folder, store, log) in rows {
        let (_directory, root) = installation();
        let locations = locations(&root);
        record_calls(&locations.voile.join("current"));
        let install = locations.library.join("Games").join(folder);
        fs::create_dir_all(&install).unwrap();
        fs::write(install.join("Game.exe"), pe()).unwrap();
        fs::write(install.join("setup.exe"), "").unwrap();
        let storefront = Plain {
            prerequisites: vec![Prerequisite {
                id: "setup".into(),
                programs: vec![(install.join("setup.exe"), "/quiet".into())],
            }],
        };
        let windows = Installation::of(&locations, game, Platform::Windows, &install)
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap();

        let config = windows
            .ready(
                &locations,
                &target(&install.join("Game.exe"), &[]),
                &storefront,
            )
            .unwrap();

        let prefix = locations.wine_prefixes.join(install.file_name().unwrap());
        assert_eq!(windows.prefix(), prefix);
        assert_eq!(config.prefix, prefix);
        let diagnostics = crate::diagnostics::folder(&locations.home, store);
        assert_eq!(config.log, diagnostics.join(log));
        assert!(diagnostics.is_dir(), "{game:?}");
        assert_eq!(
            calls(&locations.wine_prefixes),
            [
                "wineboot --init".to_owned(),
                format!("{} /quiet", install.join("setup.exe").display()),
            ]
        );
        assert!(prefix.join("furnished").is_file());
    }
}

#[test]
fn the_program_a_profile_names_instead_is_the_one_readied_and_the_one_started() {
    use super::linux_engine::tests::guest_command;
    let rocket_league = crate::profile::Game::Epic {
        namespace: "9773aa1aa54f4f7b80e44bef04986cea",
        app_name: "Sugar",
    };
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let locations = locations(&root);
    engine_runtime(&locations);
    record_calls(&locations.voile.join("current"));
    let install = locations.library.join("Games/Epic/epic-rl-Windows");
    fs::create_dir_all(install.join("Binaries/Win64")).unwrap();
    // The publisher's program is no Windows program Wine could start.
    fs::write(install.join("Launcher.exe"), b"#!/bin/sh\n").unwrap();
    fs::write(install.join("Binaries/Win64/RocketLeague_EAC.exe"), pe()).unwrap();
    let launcher = target(&install.join("Launcher.exe"), &["-AUTH_TYPE=exchangecode"]);
    let windows = Installation::of(&locations, rocket_league, Platform::Windows, &install)
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    // A prefix the engine already created.
    fs::create_dir_all(windows.prefix().join("drive_c/windows/system32")).unwrap();
    fs::write(windows.prefix().join("system.reg"), "registry").unwrap();

    let config = windows
        .ready(&locations, &launcher, &Plain::default())
        .unwrap();
    let started =
        super::target::<Plain>(&config, &plain(&install), &launcher, HashMap::new()).unwrap();

    assert_eq!(
        guest_command(&started),
        [
            "/opt/game/Binaries/Win64/RocketLeague_EAC.exe",
            "-AUTH_TYPE=exchangecode"
        ]
    );
    // The engine's prefix renders through Neptune's Direct3D.
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read(windows.prefix().join("drive_c/windows/system32/d3d11.dll")).unwrap(),
        b"d3d11.dll"
    );
    // Without the profile, the publisher's program is neither readied nor
    // started.
    let other = Installation::of(&locations, OTHER, Platform::Windows, &install)
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(
        other.ready(&locations, &launcher, &Plain::default()),
        Err(Error::NotExecutable)
    ));
    let without = Config {
        settings: Settings {
            executable: None,
            ..config.settings.clone()
        },
        ..config.clone()
    };
    assert!(matches!(
        super::target::<Plain>(&without, &plain(&install), &launcher, HashMap::new()),
        Err(Error::NotExecutable)
    ));
    assert!(calls(&locations.wine_prefixes).is_empty());
    assert!(!other.prefix().exists());
}

#[test]
fn a_d3dmetal_game_is_translated_once_it_is_readied() {
    use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let locations = locations(&root);
    engine_runtime(&locations);
    // Obelisk's Intel helper only records what it was asked.
    let helper = locations.helpers.join(crate::package::SDK_INTEL);
    fs::create_dir_all(&locations.helpers).unwrap();
    let record = root.join("translated");
    fs::write(
        &helper,
        format!("#!/bin/sh\necho \"$1\" >> \"{}\"\n", record.display()),
    )
    .unwrap();
    fs::set_permissions(&helper, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).unwrap();
    let (install, target) = game(&root);
    let windows = Installation::of(&locations, ELDEN_RING, Platform::Windows, &install)
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    fs::create_dir_all(windows.prefix().join("drive_c/windows/system32")).unwrap();
    fs::write(windows.prefix().join("system.reg"), "registry").unwrap();

    windows
        .ready(&locations, &target, &Plain::default())
        .unwrap();

    assert_eq!(fs::read_to_string(&record).unwrap(), "warm-d3dmetal\n");
}

#[test]
fn d3dmetal_is_selected_only_when_the_runtime_carries_it() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let config = config(&root);
    assert!(!environment(&config).contains_key("CX_ACTIVE_GRAPHICS_BACKEND"));

    let library = root.join("runtime/lib/external/libd3dshared.dylib");
    fs::create_dir_all(library.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
    fs::write(&library, b"").unwrap();

    let environment = environment(&config);
    assert_eq!(environment["CX_ACTIVE_GRAPHICS_BACKEND"], "d3dmetal");
    assert_eq!(
        environment["CX_APPLEGPTK_LIBD3DSHARED_PATH"],
        library.to_string_lossy()
    );
}

/// Lays in `config`'s runtime D3DMetal, its DLLs beside Wine's, and DXMT's.
fn backends_runtime(config: &Config) {
    for folder in [
        "lib/d3dmetal/x86_64-windows",
        "lib/dxmt/i386-windows",
        "lib/external/D3DMetal.framework",
    ] {
        fs::create_dir_all(config.runtime.join(folder)).unwrap();
    }
    for file in [
        "lib/external/libd3dshared.dylib",
        "lib/external/D3DMetal.framework/D3DMetal",
    ] {
        fs::write(config.runtime.join(file), b"").unwrap();
    }
}

#[test]
fn a_game_s_backend_comes_before_wine_s_own_dlls_with_dxmt_behind_d3dmetal() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let d3dmetal = config(&root);
    backends_runtime(&d3dmetal);
    let runtime = d3dmetal.runtime.to_string_lossy().into_owned();

    let environment = environment(&d3dmetal);
    assert_eq!(
        environment["WINEDLLPATH_PREPEND"],
        format!("{runtime}/lib/d3dmetal:{runtime}/lib/dxmt")
    );
    assert_eq!(environment["CX_ACTIVE_GRAPHICS_BACKEND"], "d3dmetal");
    assert_eq!(
        environment["D3DMETAL_FRAMEWORK_PATH"],
        format!("{runtime}/lib/external/D3DMetal.framework/D3DMetal")
    );

    let dxmt = Config {
        settings: Settings {
            graphics: Graphics::Dxmt,
            ..d3dmetal.settings.clone()
        },
        ..d3dmetal
    };
    let environment = self::environment(&dxmt);
    assert_eq!(
        environment["WINEDLLPATH_PREPEND"],
        format!("{runtime}/lib/dxmt")
    );
    assert_eq!(environment["CX_ACTIVE_GRAPHICS_BACKEND"], "dxmt");
    assert_eq!(
        environment["CX_APPLEGPTK_LIBD3DSHARED_PATH"],
        format!("{runtime}/lib/external/libd3dshared.dylib")
    );
}

#[test]
fn turning_ray_tracing_off_reaches_d3dmetal_alone() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let config = config(&root);
    let defaults = environment(&config);
    assert!(!defaults.keys().any(|name| name.starts_with("D3DM_")));

    let options = Config {
        settings: Settings {
            options: GraphicsOptions { ray_tracing: false },
            ..config.settings.clone()
        },
        ..config
    };
    let environment = self::environment(&options);
    assert_eq!(environment["D3DM_SUPPORT_DXR"], "0");

    let dxmt = Config {
        settings: Settings {
            graphics: Graphics::Dxmt,
            ..options.settings.clone()
        },
        ..options
    };
    assert!(
        !self::environment(&dxmt)
            .keys()
            .any(|name| name.starts_with("D3DM_"))
    );
}

/// A runtime whose wine records each call with the folders it searches
/// first, in `calls` beside the prefix.
fn backend_recording_runtime(root: &Path) -> Config {
    let config = recording_runtime(root);
    fs::write(
        config.runtime.join("bin/wine"),
        "#!/bin/sh\nprintf '%s %s\\n' \"$*\" \"$WINEDLLPATH_PREPEND\" >> \"$WINEPREFIX/../calls\"\n",
    )
    .unwrap();
    config
}

#[test]
fn a_prefix_gets_every_backend_s_placeholders_when_created_or_when_its_runtime_gains_one() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let config = backend_recording_runtime(&root);
    let config = Config {
        settings: Settings {
            graphics: Graphics::Dxmt,
            ..config.settings.clone()
        },
        ..config
    };
    let runtime = config.runtime.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
    prepare_plain(&config, &root);
    fs::write(config.prefix.join("system.reg"), "").unwrap();
    prepare_plain(&config, &root);
    assert_eq!(calls(&root), ["wineboot --init "]);

    backends_runtime(&config);
    prepare_plain(&config, &root);
    prepare_plain(&config, &root);

    assert_eq!(
        calls(&root),
        [
            "wineboot --init ".to_owned(),
            format!("wineboot --update {runtime}/lib/d3dmetal:{runtime}/lib/dxmt"),
        ]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read_to_string(config.prefix.join("obelisk-graphics")).unwrap(),
        "d3dmetal dxmt"
    );
}

#[test]
fn the_game_s_log_starts_with_how_obelisk_runs_it_and_only_the_player_s_arguments() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let config = Config {
        settings: Settings {
            options: GraphicsOptions { ray_tracing: false },
            profile_arguments: vec!["-secret".into()],
            arguments: vec!["-dx11".into(), "+exec auto exec.cfg".into(), String::new()],
            ..Settings::default()
        },
        ..config(&root)
    };
    assert_eq!(
        config.log_header(),
        "obelisk: engine=wine-macos graphics=d3dmetal ray_tracing=off voile=development \
         arguments=-dx11 \"+exec auto exec.cfg\" \"\"\n"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        command_line(
            config
                .log_header()
                .split_once("arguments=")
                .unwrap()
                .1
                .trim_end()
        ),
        config.settings.arguments
    );
    assert!(!config.log_header().contains("-secret"));

    // The Linux engine's render servers take no options; a release names
    // itself in its manifest, which the engine's runtime sits inside.
    fs::create_dir_all(root.join("v26.3.0-15/linux")).unwrap();
    fs::write(
        root.join("v26.3.0-15/runtime.json"),
        r#"{"version": "v26.3.0-15"}"#,
    )
    .unwrap();
    let linux = Config {
        runtime: root.join("v26.3.0-15/linux"),

#[test]
fn a_prefix_profile_stops_linking_into_the_mac_home() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let home = root.join("home");
    fs::create_dir_all(home.join("Documents")).unwrap();
    fs::write(home.join("Documents/keep.txt"), b"mine").unwrap();
    let profile = profile(&root.join("prefix"));
    fs::create_dir_all(profile.join("Desktop")).unwrap();
    fs::create_dir_all(profile.join("AppData/LocalLow")).unwrap();
    std::os::unix::fs::symlink(home.join("Documents"), profile.join("Documents")).unwrap();
    std::os::unix::fs::symlink(&home, profile.join("Desktop/My Mac Desktop")).unwrap();
    let config = recording_runtime(&root);
    fs::write(config.prefix.join("system.reg"), "").unwrap();
    let (install, target) = game(&root);

    prepare(
        &config,
        &locations(&root),
        &install,
        &target,
        &Plain::default(),
    )
    .unwrap();

    assert!(
        fs::symlink_metadata(profile.join("Documents"))
            .unwrap()
            .is_dir()
    );
    assert_eq!(fs::read_dir(profile.join("Documents")).unwrap().count(), 0);
    assert!(!profile.join("Desktop/My Mac Desktop").exists());
    assert!(profile.join("AppData/LocalLow").is_dir());
    assert_eq!(fs::read(home.join("Documents/keep.txt")).unwrap(), b"mine");
}

#[test]
fn a_prefix_registers_the_runtime_mono_once_even_when_an_older_runtime_created_it() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let config = recording_runtime(&root);
    // A runtime without Mono only creates the prefix.
    prepare_plain(&config, &root);
    assert_eq!(calls(&root), ["wineboot --init"]);
    assert!(!config.prefix.join("obelisk-mono").exists());

    fs::write(config.prefix.join("system.reg"), "").unwrap();
    fs::create_dir_all(config.runtime.join("share/wine/mono/wine-mono-10.4.1")).unwrap();
    prepare_plain(&config, &root);
    prepare_plain(&config, &root);

    assert_eq!(calls(&root), ["wineboot --init", "wineboot --update"]);
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read_to_string(config.prefix.join("obelisk-mono")).unwrap(),
        "wine-mono-10.4.1"
    );
}

fn prepare_plain(config: &Config, root: &Path) {
    let (install, target) = game(root);
    prepare(
        config,
        &locations(root),
        &install,
        &target,
        &Plain::default(),
    )
    .unwrap();
}

/// A runtime whose wine records each call in `calls` beside the prefix, and
/// fails for any program named `fail`.
pub(crate) fn recording_runtime(root: &Path) -> Config {
    let config = config(root);
    fs::create_dir_all(&config.prefix).unwrap();
    record_calls(&config.runtime);
    config
}

/// Installs in `runtime` a wine that records each call in `calls` beside the
/// prefix it runs, and fails for any program named `fail`.
pub(crate) fn record_calls(runtime: &Path) {
    let bin = runtime.join("bin");
    fs::create_dir_all(&bin).unwrap();
    for (name, body) in [
        (
            "wine",
            "printf '%s\\n' \"$*\" >> \"$WINEPREFIX/../calls\"\ncase \"$*\" in *fail*) exit 1;; esac\n",
        ),
        ("wineserver", ""),
    ] {
        let path = bin.join(name);
        fs::write(&path, format!("#!/bin/sh\n{body}")).unwrap();
        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
        fs::set_permissions(&path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).unwrap();
    }
}

pub(crate) fn calls(root: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
    fs::read_to_string(root.join("calls"))
        .unwrap_or_default()
        .lines()
        .map(str::to_owned)
        .collect()
}

#[test]
fn a_windows_installation_runs_in_the_prefix_named_after_its_folder_whatever_the_storefront() {
    let locations = crate::Locations::new(
        Path::new("/library"),
        Path::new("/Obelisk.app"),
        Path::new("/home"),
    );
    for install in [
        "/library/Games/Steam/steam-42-windows",
        "/library/Games/Epic/epic-hash-Windows",
    ] {
        let windows = Installation::of(&locations, OTHER, Platform::Windows, Path::new(install))
            .unwrap()
            .expect("a Windows build");
        let folder = Path::new(install).file_name().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            windows.prefix(),
            Path::new("/library/Prefixes").join(folder)
        );
    }
    let native = Installation::of(
        &locations,
        OTHER,
        Platform::Mac,
        Path::new("/library/Games/native"),
    );
    assert_eq!(native.unwrap(), None, "a Mac build runs outside Wine");
    assert!(
        Installation::of(&locations, OTHER, Platform::Windows, Path::new("/")).is_err(),
        "no folder names no prefix"
    );
}

#[test]
fn an_uninstalled_windows_game_loses_its_prefix_but_never_what_a_link_points_to() {
    use obelisk_core::installation::RemovalFailure;
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let library = root.join("library");
    let locations = crate::Locations::new(&library, Path::new("/Obelisk.app"), Path::new("/home"));
    let windows = |name: &str| {
        Installation::of(
            &locations,
            OTHER,
            Platform::Windows,
            &library.join("Games/Steam").join(name),
        )
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap()
    };
    let prefix = library.join("Prefixes/steam-42-windows");
    fs::create_dir_all(prefix.join("drive_c/users")).unwrap();
    fs::write(prefix.join("system.reg"), "registry").unwrap();
    windows("steam-42-windows").remove(&locations).unwrap();
    assert!(!prefix.exists());
    windows("steam-42-windows").remove(&locations).unwrap();

    let elsewhere = root.join("elsewhere");
    fs::create_dir_all(&elsewhere).unwrap();
    std::os::unix::fs::symlink(&elsewhere, library.join("Prefixes/steam-43-windows")).unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(
        windows("steam-43-windows").remove(&locations),
        Err(RemovalFailure::Unsafe(_))
    ));
    assert!(elsewhere.is_dir());
}

#[test]
fn uninstalling_removes_both_engines_prefixes_and_the_launch_settings() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let locations = locations(&root);
    let install = root.join("library/Games/Steam/steam-1245620-windows");
    let rosetta = Installation::of(&locations, OTHER, Platform::Windows, &install)
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    fs::create_dir_all(rosetta.prefix().join("drive_c")).unwrap();
    let linux = Installation::of(&locations, ELDEN_RING, Platform::Windows, &install)
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    fs::create_dir_all(linux.prefix().join("drive_c")).unwrap();
    let choices = crate::launch_settings::Choices {
        engine: Some(Engine::Rosetta),
        ..Default::default()
    };
    crate::launch_settings::choose(&locations.library, ELDEN_RING, &install, choices).unwrap();
    let settings = locations
        .library
        .join("LaunchSettings/steam-1245620-windows.json");
    assert!(settings.is_file());

    // The player moved the game back to Rosetta: the engine's folder still goes.
    Installation::of(&locations, ELDEN_RING, Platform::Windows, &install)
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap()
        .remove(&locations)
        .unwrap();

    assert!(!rosetta.prefix().exists());
    assert!(!linux.prefix().parent().unwrap().exists());
    assert!(!settings.exists());
}

#[test]
fn quitting_a_windows_game_asks_its_windows_to_close_and_kills_nothing() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let config = recording_runtime(&root);
    let environment = environment(&config);
    let program = root.join("game/Game.exe");
    let command = config
        .adapter()
        .quit_command(&config, &environment, Some(&program), 7)
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(command.get_program(), config.runtime.join("bin/wine"));
    assert_eq!(
        command.get_args().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        ["taskkill", "/T", "/IM", "Game.exe"],
        "without /F, taskkill only posts WM_CLOSE"
    );
    // The game's own environment, which its Wine server agrees with.
    let envs: HashMap<_, _> = command
        .get_envs()
        .map(|(name, value)| (name.to_owned(), value.unwrap().to_owned()))
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(envs.len(), environment.len());
    assert!(
        environment
            .iter()
            .all(|(name, value)| envs[std::ffi::OsStr::new(name)] == **value)
    );

    quit(&config, &environment, Some(&program), 7);
    assert_eq!(calls(&root), ["taskkill /T /IM Game.exe"]);
    assert!(
        config
            .adapter()
            .quit_command(&config, &environment, None, 7)
            .is_none()
    );
}

#[test]
fn quitting_a_linux_engine_game_uses_its_window_server_quit() {
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let config = Config {
        settings: Settings {
            engine: Engine::Linux,
            ..Settings::default()
        },
        ..config(&root)
    };
    let environment = HashMap::from([("TMPDIR".to_owned(), "/var/folders/T/".to_owned())]);
    let command = config
        .adapter()
        .quit_command(&config, &environment, None, 77)
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(command.get_program(), config.runtime.join("engine/wsdctl"));
    assert_eq!(
        command.get_args().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        [
            "/var/folders/T/obelisk-engine-77/wsd.sock",
            "window",
            "quit"
        ]
    );
    let command = config
        .adapter()
        .quit_command(&config, &HashMap::new(), None, 77)
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        command.get_args().next().unwrap(),
        "/tmp/obelisk-engine-77/wsd.sock"
    );
}

#[test]
fn only_a_prefix_and_its_wine_server_belong_to_one_windows_game() {
    use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
    let (_directory, root) = installation();
    let config = recording_runtime(&root);
    let prefix = fs::metadata(&config.prefix).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        private_folders(&config, &HashMap::new(), None),

            root.join("Game-linux"),
            PathBuf::from("/tmp/obelisk-engine-7")
        ]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        private_folders(&linux, &HashMap::new(), None),
        [root.join("Game-linux")]
    );
}
```

```rs
//! Cloud indicators across UniFFI. An account's installations start
//! maintenance and answer its Cloud question.
use game_runtime::cloud_status;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum CloudSavedState {
    RecoveryNeeded,
    UploadUncertain,
    Conflict,
    Pending,
    Unavailable,
    LocalChanges,
    LastFailed,
    Synced,
    NeverSynced,
}

impl From<cloud_status::SavedState> for CloudSavedState {
    fn from(state: cloud_status::SavedState) -> Self {
        use cloud_status::SavedState;
        match state {
            SavedState::RecoveryNeeded => Self::RecoveryNeeded,
            SavedState::UploadUncertain => Self::UploadUncertain,
            SavedState::Conflict => Self::Conflict,
            SavedState::Pending => Self::Pending,
            SavedState::Unavailable => Self::Unavailable,
            SavedState::LocalChanges => Self::LocalChanges,
            SavedState::LastFailed => Self::LastFailed,
            SavedState::Synced => Self::Synced,
            SavedState::NeverSynced => Self::NeverSynced,
        }
    }
}

/// A game's Cloud indicator from persisted state. Swift adds the live states:
/// a sync in progress, a running game, and a game guard with no live session.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct CloudIndicator {
    pub state: CloudSavedState,
    pub game_session: bool,
    /// Last Cloud sync, in Unix seconds.
    pub synced_at: Option<u64>,
    pub pending_upload: bool,
    pub installation_removed: bool,
}

impl From<cloud_status::Indicator> for CloudIndicator {
    fn from(indicator: cloud_status::Indicator) -> Self {
        Self {
            state: indicator.state.into(),
            game_session: indicator.game_session,
            synced_at: indicator.synced_at,
            pending_upload: indicator.pending_upload,
            installation_removed: indicator.installation_removed,
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn indicators_keep_every_saved_state_and_their_facts() {
        use cloud_status::SavedState;
        let states = [
            (SavedState::RecoveryNeeded, CloudSavedState::RecoveryNeeded),
            (
                SavedState::UploadUncertain,
                CloudSavedState::UploadUncertain,
            ),
            (SavedState::Conflict, CloudSavedState::Conflict),
            (SavedState::Pending, CloudSavedState::Pending),
            (SavedState::Unavailable, CloudSavedState::Unavailable),
            (SavedState::LocalChanges, CloudSavedState::LocalChanges),
            (SavedState::LastFailed, CloudSavedState::LastFailed),
            (SavedState::Synced, CloudSavedState::Synced),
            (SavedState::NeverSynced, CloudSavedState::NeverSynced),
        ];
        for (saved, exported) in states {
            let indicator = CloudIndicator::from(cloud_status::Indicator {
                state: saved,
                game_session: true,
                synced_at: Some(1_789_000_000),
                pending_upload: true,
                installation_removed: true,
            });
            assert_eq!(
                indicator,
                CloudIndicator {
                    state: exported,
                    game_session: true,
                    synced_at: Some(1_789_000_000),
                    pending_upload: true,
                    installation_removed: true,
                }
            );
        }
    }
}
```
