`crates/obelisk-bridge/src/credentials.rs`:

```rs
//! An Epic or GOG account's credentials rotate with its calls. Each rotation
//! is saved in order, one save at a time, so no call has to remember to.
use std::{
    sync::{Arc, Condvar, Mutex},
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

/// Saves a storefront account's current credentials, which account calls
/// rotate. It may block.
#[uniffi::export(with_foreign)]
pub trait CredentialSave: Send + Sync {
    fn save(&self);
}

/// How long a launch waits for rotated credentials to be saved.
const SAVE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(60);

/// Where an account's credentials stand: the rotation last saved, once
/// persistence runs.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct Persistence {
    state: Mutex<State>,
    changed: Condvar,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct State {
    running: bool,
    stopped: bool,
    saved: Option<u64>,
}

impl Persistence {
    fn saved(&self, revision: u64) {
        let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
        state.saved = Some(revision);
        self.changed.notify_all();
    }

    fn stopped(&self) {
        self.state.lock().unwrap().stopped = true;
        self.changed.notify_all();
    }

    /// Waits, blocking, until the credentials `account`'s calls rotated are
    /// saved.
    pub(crate) fn waiter<A: Rotating>(
        self: &Arc<Self>,
        account: Arc<A>,
    ) -> Arc<dyn Fn() + Send + Sync> {
        let persistence = Arc::clone(self);
        Arc::new(move || persistence.wait(|| account.revision()))
    }

    /// Waits until the rotation `current` names was saved. Returns at once
    /// without persistence, once it stopped, or after `SAVE_TIMEOUT`.
    pub(crate) fn wait(&self, current: impl Fn() -> u64) {
        let deadline = Instant::now() + SAVE_TIMEOUT;
        let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
        while state.running
            && !state.stopped
            && state.saved.is_none_or(|saved| saved < current())
            && Instant::now() < deadline
        {
            state = self
                .changed
                .wait_timeout(state, Duration::from_millis(100))
                .unwrap()
                .0;
        }
    }
}

/// An account whose credentials rotate.
pub(crate) trait Rotating: Send + Sync + 'static {
    fn revision(&self) -> u64;
    /// The next revision after `after`, or `None` once observers stop.
    fn next(&self, after: u64) -> impl Future<Output = Option<u64>> + Send;
}

impl Rotating for epic_kit::client::Client {
    fn revision(&self) -> u64 {
        self.credentials_revision()
    }
    async fn next(&self, after: u64) -> Option<u64> {
        self.next_credentials_revision(after).await
    }
}

impl Rotating for gog_kit::client::Client {
    fn revision(&self) -> u64 {
        self.credentials_revision()
    }
    async fn next(&self, after: u64) -> Option<u64> {
        self.next_credentials_revision(after).await
    }
}

/// Starts saving `account`'s credentials through `saver`, once per session.
pub(crate) fn persist<A: Rotating>(
    account: Arc<A>,
    persistence: Arc<Persistence>,
    saver: Arc<dyn CredentialSave>,
) {
    {
        let mut state = persistence.state.lock().unwrap();
        if state.running {
            return;
        }
        state.running = true;
    }
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        let mut revision = account.revision();
        loop {
            let save = saver.clone();
            // The saver reads the latest credentials: a rotation during the
            // save is saved again next.
            let _ = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || save.save()).await;
            persistence.saved(revision);
            match account.next(revision).await {
                Some(next) => revision = next,
                None => break,
            }
        }
        persistence.stopped();
    });
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
    use tokio::sync::watch;

    struct Account(watch::Sender<(u64, bool)>);
    impl Rotating for Account {
        fn revision(&self) -> u64 {
            self.0.borrow().0
        }
        async fn next(&self, after: u64) -> Option<u64> {
            let mut changes = self.0.subscribe();
            let state = *changes
                .wait_for(|(revision, stopped)| *stopped || *revision != after)
                .await
                .ok()?;
            (!state.1).then_some(state.0)
        }
    }

    /// Records the revision it saw at each save.
    struct Saver(Arc<Account>, Mutex<Vec<u64>>, AtomicU64);
    impl CredentialSave for Saver {
        fn save(&self) {
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(self.2.load(Ordering::Acquire)));
            self.1.lock().unwrap().push(self.0.revision());
        }
    }

    async fn eventually(predicate: impl Fn() -> bool) {
        let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(3);
        while !predicate() {
            assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "timed out");
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5)).await;
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
    async fn every_rotation_is_saved_in_order_and_a_launch_waits_for_the_last() {
        let account = Arc::new(Account(watch::channel((1, false)).0));
        let saver = Arc::new(Saver(
            account.clone(),
            Mutex::new(Vec::new()),
            AtomicU64::new(0),
        ));
        let persistence = Arc::new(Persistence::default());
        persist(account.clone(), persistence.clone(), saver.clone());
        persist(account.clone(), persistence.clone(), saver.clone());
        eventually(|| saver.1.lock().unwrap().len() == 1).await;

        saver.2.store(200, Ordering::Release);
        account.0.send_modify(|state| state.0 = 2);
        let (waiting, current) = (persistence.clone(), account.clone());
        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || waiting.wait(|| current.revision()))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            *saver.1.lock().unwrap(),
            [1, 2],
            "one loop saves each rotation once"
        );

        account.0.send_modify(|state| state.1 = true);
        eventually(|| persistence.state.lock().unwrap().stopped).await;
        account.0.send_modify(|state| state.0 = 3);
        let started = Instant::now();
        persistence.wait(|| account.revision());
        assert!(
            started.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(1),
            "a stopped persistence never holds a launch"
        );
    }
}
```

```rs
//! The diagnostics a bug report attaches, as the app names its subject.
use crate::{ObeliskLocations, SessionStorefront};
use game_runtime::diagnostics::{self, Game};
use std::{path::Path, time::SystemTime};

/// What a bug report is about, as far as its diagnostics go: Obelisk, or one
/// game as its storefront names it.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum DiagnosticsSubject {
    App,
    Game {
        storefront: SessionStorefront,
        id: String,
    },
}

/// The diagnostics a bug report on `subject` attaches, most telling first.
#[uniffi::export]
pub fn diagnostic_files(
    locations: ObeliskLocations,
    subject: DiagnosticsSubject,
    now: SystemTime,
) -> Vec<String> {
    let game = match &subject {
        DiagnosticsSubject::App => None,
        // A Steam game that names no app has no diagnostics, and never
        // Obelisk's own.
        DiagnosticsSubject::Game {
            storefront: SessionStorefront::Steam,
            id,
        } => match id.parse() {
            Ok(app_id) => Some(Game::Steam(app_id)),
            Err(_) => return Vec::new(),
        },
        DiagnosticsSubject::Game {
            storefront: SessionStorefront::Epic,
            id,
        } => Some(Game::Epic(id)),
        DiagnosticsSubject::Game {
            storefront: SessionStorefront::Gog,
            id,
        } => Some(Game::Gog(id)),
    };
    diagnostics::files(Path::new(&locations.home), game, now)
        .into_iter()
        .map(|path| path.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .collect()
}

/// `text` without the Metal HUD's frame lines, which bug reports leave out.
#[uniffi::export]
pub fn without_metal_hud_frames(text: String) -> String {
    game_runtime::metal_hud::without_frame_lines(&text)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::obelisk_locations;
    use obelisk_core::Platform;
    use std::fs;

    #[test]
    fn a_game_s_diagnostics_are_found_under_its_own_storefront() {
        let home = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let locations = obelisk_locations(
            "/library".into(),
            "/Obelisk.app".into(),
            home.path().to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        );
        // One ID in every storefront, so a subject routed to the wrong one
        // finds that one's log.
        let games = [
            (SessionStorefront::Steam, Game::Steam(7)),
            (SessionStorefront::Epic, Game::Epic("7")),
            (SessionStorefront::Gog, Game::Gog("7")),
        ];
        for (_, game) in games {
            let log = diagnostics::game_log(home.path(), game, Platform::Mac);
            fs::create_dir_all(log.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
            fs::write(&log, "log\n").unwrap();
        }
        for (storefront, game) in games {
            let subject = DiagnosticsSubject::Game {
                storefront,
                id: "7".into(),
            };
            let log = diagnostics::game_log(home.path(), game, Platform::Mac);
            assert_eq!(
                diagnostic_files(locations.clone(), subject, SystemTime::now()),
                [log.to_string_lossy().into_owned()],
                "{game:?}"
            );
        }

        // Obelisk's diagnostics are launch reports, never a game's logs.
        assert!(
            diagnostic_files(
                locations.clone(),
                DiagnosticsSubject::App,
                SystemTime::now()
            )
            .is_empty()
        );
        let unnamed = DiagnosticsSubject::Game {
            storefront: SessionStorefront::Steam,
            id: "abc".into(),
        };
        assert!(diagnostic_files(locations, unnamed, SystemTime::now()).is_empty());
    }
}
```

`crates/obelisk-bridge/src/downloads.rs`:

```rs
//! The process's one download queue, as Swift presents and steers it. Every
//! account's installations queue their Transfers here.
use std::sync::{Arc, OnceLock};

use game_runtime::queue::{self, DownloadQueue};

use crate::SessionStorefront;

/// The queue every account's installations share.
pub(crate) fn queue() -> &'static Arc<DownloadQueue> {
    static QUEUE: OnceLock<Arc<DownloadQueue>> = OnceLock::new();
    QUEUE.get_or_init(DownloadQueue::new)
}

/// What a queued Transfer does to its game.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum DownloadKind {
    Install,
    Update,
    Repair,
    /// The installation moves into the games folder.
    Move,
}

/// One Transfer in the queue.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct DownloadItem {
    pub id: u64,
    pub storefront: SessionStorefront,
    pub account: String,
    /// The game, as its storefront's installations name it.
    pub game: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub kind: DownloadKind,
    /// Obelisk queued it for a newer build, not the player.
    pub automatic: bool,
    /// A launch waits for it: it goes first and cannot be paused.
    pub launching: bool,
    pub paused: bool,
}

/// Everything the queue presents. `revision` grows with every change.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct DownloadQueueState {
    pub revision: u64,
    pub running: Option<DownloadItem>,
    /// In the order they will run.
    pub waiting: Vec<DownloadItem>,
    /// A game runs: automatic updates wait.
    pub held: bool,
}

impl From<queue::Item> for DownloadItem {
    fn from(item: queue::Item) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: item.id,
            storefront: match item.storefront {
                queue::Storefront::Steam => SessionStorefront::Steam,
                queue::Storefront::Epic => SessionStorefront::Epic,
                queue::Storefront::Gog => SessionStorefront::Gog,
            },
            account: item.account,
            game: item.game,
            name: item.name,
            kind: match item.kind {
                queue::Kind::Install => DownloadKind::Install,
                queue::Kind::Update => DownloadKind::Update,
                queue::Kind::Repair => DownloadKind::Repair,
                queue::Kind::Move => DownloadKind::Move,
            },
            automatic: item.automatic,
            launching: item.launching,
            paused: item.paused,
        }
    }
}

impl From<queue::View> for DownloadQueueState {
    fn from(view: queue::View) -> Self {
        Self {
            revision: view.revision,
            running: view.running.map(Into::into),
            waiting: view.waiting.into_iter().map(Into::into).collect(),
            held: view.held,
        }
    }
}

/// The process's download queue.
#[derive(uniffi::Object)]
pub struct Downloads {
    queue: Arc<DownloadQueue>,
}

#[uniffi::export(async_runtime = "tokio")]
impl Downloads {
    #[uniffi::constructor]
    pub fn new() -> Arc<Self> {
        Arc::new(Self {
            queue: queue().clone(),
        })
    }

    pub fn state(&self) -> DownloadQueueState {
        self.queue.view().into()
    }

    /// Waits for a revision newer than `after`.
    pub async fn changed(&self, after: u64) -> DownloadQueueState {
        self.queue.changed(after).await.into()
    }

    /// Takes the Transfer out of the queue, stopping it when it runs.
    pub fn remove(&self, id: u64) {
        self.queue.remove(id)
    }

    /// Pauses the Transfer: the running one stops and waits first.
    pub fn pause(&self, id: u64) {
        self.queue.pause(id)
    }

    pub fn resume(&self, id: u64) {
        self.queue.resume(id)
    }

    /// Moves the waiting Transfer first. The one under way goes on.
    pub fn move_to_top(&self, id: u64) {
        self.queue.move_to_top(id)
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Epic's account seam. Only refresh credentials cross into the macOS Keychain;
//! the account access token stays inside the Rust session.
use std::{collections::HashMap, sync::Arc};

use crate::{
    GamePlatform, LibraryCache,
    library_cache::{self, EpicLibrary, GameAchievements, LibraryAchievement},
};
use epic_kit::{auth, client};

/// Sandboxes whose achievements a library reads at once: each takes two
/// requests.
const ACHIEVEMENT_READS: usize = 4;

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error, uniffi::Error)]
pub enum EpicError {
    #[error("backend.epic.network")]
    Network,
    #[error("backend.epic.unauthorized")]
    Unauthorized,
    #[error("backend.epic.invalid_code")]
    InvalidCode,
    #[error("backend.epic.invalid_response")]
    InvalidResponse,
    #[error("{message}")]
    Service { message: String },
}

impl From<epic_kit::EpicError> for EpicError {
    fn from(error: epic_kit::EpicError) -> Self {
        match error {
            epic_kit::EpicError::Network => Self::Network,
            epic_kit::EpicError::Unauthorized => Self::Unauthorized,
            epic_kit::EpicError::InvalidCode => Self::InvalidCode,
            epic_kit::EpicError::Protocol => Self::InvalidResponse,
            epic_kit::EpicError::Service { message } => Self::Service { message },
            error => Self::Service {
                message: error.to_string(),
            },
        }
    }
}

/// How long the account played one game, as Epic records it.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct EpicPlaytime {
    pub app_name: String,
    pub seconds: u64,
}

#[derive(uniffi::Object)]
pub struct EpicSession {
    /// Shared with the Cloud maintenance this session starts.
    pub(crate) client: Arc<client::Client>,
    pub(crate) persistence: Arc<crate::credentials::Persistence>,
    /// Where the account's library is kept as it loads.
    library: Option<EpicLibrary>,
}
impl EpicSession {
    async fn with(
        client: client::Client,
        library: Option<Arc<LibraryCache>>,
    ) -> Result<Arc<Self>, EpicError> {
        let library = match library {
            Some(library) => Some(library.epic(&client.credentials().await?.account_id)),
            None => None,
        };
        Ok(Arc::new(Self {
            client: Arc::new(client),
            persistence: Default::default(),
            library,
        }))
    }

    /// `namespaces`' achievements in `locale`: the library's for a game not
    /// played since they were read, unless `fresh`, else Epic's, a few
    /// sandboxes at a time, which the library then keeps. A sandbox Epic did
    /// not answer for is left out; when none could be told, the first
    /// failure.
    async fn read_achievements(
        &self,
        namespaces: Vec<String>,
        locale: &str,
        fresh: bool,
    ) -> Result<Vec<GameAchievements>, EpicError> {
        let client = &self.client;
        library_cache::achievements(
            self.library.as_ref().map(|library| library.achievements()),
            namespaces,
            locale,
            fresh,
            ACHIEVEMENT_READS,
            |namespace| async move {
                client
                    .achievements(&namespace, locale)
                    .await
                    .map_err(EpicError::from)
            },
        )
        .await
    }
}

#[uniffi::export(async_runtime = "tokio")]
impl EpicSession {
    /// Keeps every library it loads in `library`.
    #[uniffi::constructor]
    pub async fn sign_in(
        authorization_code: String,
        library: Option<Arc<LibraryCache>>,
    ) -> Result<Arc<Self>, EpicError> {
        Self::with(client::Client::sign_in(&authorization_code).await?, library).await
    }

    /// Keeps every library it loads in `library`.
    #[uniffi::constructor]
    pub async fn restore(
        credentials: EpicCredentials,
        library: Option<Arc<LibraryCache>>,
    ) -> Result<Arc<Self>, EpicError> {
        Self::with(client::Client::restore(credentials.into()).await?, library).await
    }

    pub async fn credentials(&self) -> Result<EpicCredentials, EpicError> {
        Ok(self.client.credentials().await?.into())
    }

    pub async fn start_friends(&self) {
        self.client.start_friends();
    }
    pub async fn reconnect_friends(&self) {
        self.client.reconnect_friends();
    }
    pub fn stop_friends(&self) {
        self.client.stop_friends();
    }
    pub fn shutdown_observers(&self) {
        self.client.shutdown_observers();
    }
    pub async fn next_friends(&self, after_revision: u64) -> crate::EpicFriendsSnapshot {
        self.client.next_friends(after_revision).await.into()
    }
    pub async fn next_credentials_revision(&self, after_revision: u64) -> Option<u64> {
        self.client.next_credentials_revision(after_revision).await
    }

    /// Saves the account's credentials through `credentials` now and after
    /// every rotation, one save at a time and in order, until the session's
    /// observers stop. Every account call relies on it.
    pub async fn persist(&self, credentials: Arc<dyn crate::CredentialSave>) {
        crate::credentials::persist(self.client.clone(), self.persistence.clone(), credentials);
    }

    pub async fn games(&self) -> Result<Vec<EpicGame>, EpicError> {
        let games = self.client.games().await?;
        Ok(match &self.library {
            Some(library) => library.games(games),
            None => games.into_iter().map(Into::into).collect(),
        })
    }

    /// The game's achievements in `locale`, such as the game page's: the
    /// library's while the game was not played since they were read, unless
    /// `fresh`, else Epic's, which the library then keeps. Epic tells them by
    /// sandbox, which several games may share.
    pub async fn achievements(
        &self,
        namespace: String,
        locale: String,
        fresh: bool,
    ) -> Result<Vec<LibraryAchievement>, EpicError> {
        let read = self
            .read_achievements(vec![namespace], &locale, fresh)
            .await?;
        Ok(read
            .into_iter()
            .next()
            .map(|game| game.achievements)
            .unwrap_or_default())
    }

    /// The share of each of `namespaces`' achievements the account unlocked,
    /// by namespace, as `achievements` reads them: none for a sandbox without
    /// achievements or that Epic did not answer for. It fails only when no
    /// sandbox could be told.
    pub async fn achievement_shares(
        &self,
        namespaces: Vec<String>,
        locale: String,
    ) -> Result<HashMap<String, f64>, EpicError> {
        let read = self.read_achievements(namespaces, &locale, false).await?;
        Ok(library_cache::unlocked_shares(read).collect())
    }

    /// Every game the account played, in one request.
    pub async fn playtimes(&self) -> Result<Vec<EpicPlaytime>, EpicError> {
        let playtimes = self.client.playtimes().await?;
        if let Some(library) = &self.library {
            library.playtimes(&playtimes);
        }
        Ok(playtimes
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(app_name, seconds)| EpicPlaytime { app_name, seconds })
            .collect())
    }

    pub async fn disconnect(&self) -> Result<(), EpicError> {
        self.client.disconnect().await.map_err(Into::into)
    }

    /// Opens Epic's site signed in as the account, then `redirect_url`, an
    /// Epic page. The address holds a single-use code: never keep or log it.
    pub async fn web_sign_in_url(&self, redirect_url: String) -> Result<String, EpicError> {
        Ok(self.client.web_sign_in_url(&redirect_url).await?)
    }

    pub async fn game_details(
        &self,
        namespace: String,
        catalog_item_id: String,
        app_name: String,
    ) -> Result<EpicGameDetails, EpicError> {
        Ok(self
            .client
            .game_details(&namespace, &catalog_item_id, &app_name)
            .await?
            .into())
    }

mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn an_unlock_date_reads_with_or_without_fractions_and_only_once_unlocked() {
        let achievement = |date: Option<&str>, unlocked| {
            LibraryAchievement::from(client::Achievement {
                id: "test".into(),
                name: "Title".into(),
                description: String::new(),
                icon_url: String::new(),
                hidden: false,
                unlocked,
                unlock_date: date.map(String::from),
            })
            .unlocked_at
        };
        assert_eq!(
            achievement(Some("2022-09-21T12:00:00Z"), true),
            Some(1_663_761_600)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            achievement(Some("2022-09-21T12:00:00.000Z"), true),
            Some(1_663_761_600)
        );
        assert_eq!(achievement(Some("not-a-date"), true), None);
        assert_eq!(achievement(None, true), None);
        assert_eq!(achievement(Some("2022-09-21T12:00:00Z"), false), None);
    }
```

`crates/obelisk-bridge/src/epic_cloud.rs`:

```rs
//! Presentation of the Rust-owned Epic supervisor and Cloud decisions.
use crate::EpicError;
use game_runtime::epic;

impl From<epic::Error> for EpicError {
    fn from(error: epic::Error) -> Self {
        Self::Service {
            message: error.to_string(),
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::{Value, json};

    fn failed_snapshot(error: &str) -> Value {
        json!({
            "version": 2,
            "id": "fixture-session",
            "account_id": "fixture-account",
            "store": {"namespace": "fixture-namespace", "app_name": "fixture-game"},
            "phase": "Failed",
            "cloud": {"phase": "Failed", "decision_id": 1, "allowed_choices": []},
            "error": error,
            "exit_code": null,
            "revision": 2,
            "supervisor": {
                "pid": 42,
                "uid": 501,
                "birth_seconds": 123,
                "birth_microseconds": 456,
                "executable": "/fixture/helper"
            },
            "game": null,
            "starting": null,
            "socket": "/fixture/control.sock"
        })
    }

    fn bridge_snapshot(value: Value) -> game_runtime::sessions::Observation<epic::Epic> {
        let snapshot: epic::Snapshot = serde_json::from_value(value).unwrap();
        snapshot.into()
    }

    #[test]
    fn epic_publishes_the_shared_rosetta_decision() {
        let mut value = failed_snapshot("fixture");
        value["phase"] = json!("Preparing");
        value["rosetta"] = json!({"decision_id": 17});
        let snapshot = bridge_snapshot(value);
        assert_eq!(snapshot.rosetta.unwrap(), 17);
    }

    #[test]
    fn old_epic_snapshots_have_no_rosetta_requirement() {
        assert!(
            bridge_snapshot(failed_snapshot("fixture"))
                .rosetta
                .is_none()
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn typed_cancellation_reaches_the_bridge_independently_of_its_message() {
        let message = "A renamed cancellation message";
        let mut value = failed_snapshot(message);
        value["failure_reason"] = json!("Cancelled");

        let snapshot = bridge_snapshot(value);
        assert!(matches!(snapshot.phase, epic::Phase::Failed));
        assert!(matches!(
            snapshot.failure,
            Some(epic::FailureReason::Cancelled)
        ));
        assert_eq!(snapshot.error.as_deref(), Some(message));
    }

    #[test]
    fn typed_failure_is_not_reclassified_by_a_legacy_cancellation_message() {
        for message in ["backend.epic.cloud.cancelled", "backend.epic.cancelled"] {
            let mut value = failed_snapshot(message);
            value["failure_reason"] = json!("Failed");

            let snapshot = bridge_snapshot(value);
            assert!(matches!(
                snapshot.failure,
                Some(epic::FailureReason::Failed)
            ));
            assert_eq!(snapshot.error.as_deref(), Some(message));
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn legacy_terminal_snapshots_reach_the_bridge_with_classified_failures() {
        for message in ["backend.epic.cloud.cancelled", "backend.epic.cancelled"] {
            let value = failed_snapshot(message);
            assert!(value.get("failure_reason").is_none());
            let snapshot = bridge_snapshot(value);
            assert!(matches!(
                snapshot.failure,
                Some(epic::FailureReason::Cancelled)
            ));
            assert_eq!(snapshot.error.as_deref(), Some(message));
        }

        let snapshot = bridge_snapshot(failed_snapshot("backend.epic.unauthorized"));
        assert!(matches!(
            snapshot.failure,
            Some(epic::FailureReason::Failed)
        ));
        assert_eq!(snapshot.error.as_deref(), Some("backend.epic.unauthorized"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn cancellation_outside_a_failed_phase_does_not_export_a_failure_reason() {
        for phase in ["Preparing", "Running", "Finalizing", "Finished"] {
            for reason in [None, Some("Cancelled")] {
                let mut value = failed_snapshot("backend.epic.cloud.cancelled");
                value["phase"] = json!(phase);
                if let Some(reason) = reason {
                    value["failure_reason"] = json!(reason);
                }
                assert!(bridge_snapshot(value).failure.is_none());
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Epic protocol values are converted before entering the shared Swift presentation.
use epic_kit::friends;
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum EpicFriendPresence {
    Unknown,
    Offline,
    Online,
    Away,
    Busy,
    ExtendedAway,
    Invisible,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum EpicFriendsConnection {
    Loading,
    Ready,
    Interrupted,
    Failed,
    Forbidden,
    AuthenticationRequired,
    Stopped,
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct EpicFriendActivity {
    pub id: String,
    pub name: Option<String>,
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct EpicFriend {
    pub account_id: String,
    pub display_name: Option<String>,
    pub avatar_url: Option<String>,
    pub presence: EpicFriendPresence,
    pub activity: Option<EpicFriendActivity>,
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct EpicFriendsSnapshot {
    pub account_id: String,
    pub revision: u64,
    pub connection: EpicFriendsConnection,
    pub friends: Vec<EpicFriend>,
    pub message: Option<String>,
}
impl From<friends::Snapshot> for EpicFriendsSnapshot {
    fn from(s: friends::Snapshot) -> Self {
        Self {
            account_id: s.account_id,
            revision: s.revision,
            connection: match s.connection {
                friends::Connection::Loading => EpicFriendsConnection::Loading,
                friends::Connection::Ready => EpicFriendsConnection::Ready,
                friends::Connection::Interrupted => EpicFriendsConnection::Interrupted,
                friends::Connection::Failed => EpicFriendsConnection::Failed,
                friends::Connection::Forbidden => EpicFriendsConnection::Forbidden,
                friends::Connection::AuthenticationRequired => {
                    EpicFriendsConnection::AuthenticationRequired
                }
                friends::Connection::Stopped => EpicFriendsConnection::Stopped,
            },
            message: s.message,
            friends: s
                .friends
                .into_iter()
                .map(|f| EpicFriend {
                    account_id: f.account_id,
                    display_name: f.display_name,
                    avatar_url: f.avatar_url,
                    presence: match f.presence {
                        friends::Presence::Unknown => EpicFriendPresence::Unknown,
                        friends::Presence::Offline => EpicFriendPresence::Offline,
                        friends::Presence::Online => EpicFriendPresence::Online,
                        friends::Presence::Away => EpicFriendPresence::Away,
                        friends::Presence::Busy => EpicFriendPresence::Busy,
                        friends::Presence::ExtendedAway => EpicFriendPresence::ExtendedAway,
                        friends::Presence::Invisible => EpicFriendPresence::Invisible,
                    },
                    activity: f.activity.map(|a| EpicFriendActivity {
                        id: a.id,
                        name: a.name,
                    }),
                })
                .collect(),
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
//! A storefront's Game sessions across UniFFI. Rust keeps the Reservation,
//! recovery, Account revocation and the checks on every answer; Swift presents
//! the state and forwards the player's answers.
use crate::{ObeliskLocations, SteamHostState, steam_chat::SteamGameInvite};
use game_runtime::{
    Locations, cloud, epic, gog, protocol,
    runtimes::{self, Runtimes},
    sessions::{self, Failure, Sessions, Storefront, Supervised},
    steam, supervisor,
};
use std::{
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    sync::{Arc, OnceLock},
};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum GamePhase {
    Preparing,
    Running,
    Finalizing,
    Finished,
    Failed,
}
impl From<supervisor::Phase> for GamePhase {
    fn from(phase: supervisor::Phase) -> Self {
        match phase {
            supervisor::Phase::Preparing => Self::Preparing,
            supervisor::Phase::Running => Self::Running,
            supervisor::Phase::Finalizing => Self::Finalizing,
            supervisor::Phase::Finished => Self::Finished,
            supervisor::Phase::Failed => Self::Failed,
        }
    }
}

/// A runtime a launch downloads before its game is prepared.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum RuntimeComponent {
    /// Voile, the Wine runtime Windows games run in.
    Voile,
    /// Valve's Steam components, which Obelisk's Steam host loads.
    SteamComponents,
}
impl From<runtimes::Runtime> for RuntimeComponent {
    fn from(runtime: runtimes::Runtime) -> Self {
        match runtime {
            runtimes::Runtime::Voile => Self::Voile,
            runtimes::Runtime::SteamComponents => Self::SteamComponents,
        }
    }
}

/// How much of a runtime has downloaded while the launch waits for it.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct RuntimeInstallState {
    pub component: RuntimeComponent,
    pub fraction: f64,
}
impl From<sessions::RuntimeInstall> for RuntimeInstallState {
    fn from(install: sessions::RuntimeInstall) -> Self {
        Self {
            component: install.runtime.into(),
            fraction: install.fraction,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum CloudPhase {
    Idle,
    Checking,
    Ready,
    Syncing,
    Synced,
    Conflict,
    Pending,
    Disabled,
    Unsupported,
    Failed,
}
impl From<cloud::Phase> for CloudPhase {
    fn from(phase: cloud::Phase) -> Self {
        match phase {
            cloud::Phase::Idle => Self::Idle,
            cloud::Phase::Checking => Self::Checking,
            cloud::Phase::Ready => Self::Ready,
            cloud::Phase::Syncing => Self::Syncing,
            cloud::Phase::Synced => Self::Synced,
            cloud::Phase::Conflict => Self::Conflict,
            cloud::Phase::Pending => Self::Pending,
            cloud::Phase::Disabled => Self::Disabled,
            cloud::Phase::Unsupported => Self::Unsupported,
            cloud::Phase::Failed => Self::Failed,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum CloudChoice {
    Retry,
    Cancel,
    LaunchAnyway,
    Local,
    Cloud,
}
impl From<cloud::Choice> for CloudChoice {
    fn from(choice: cloud::Choice) -> Self {
        match choice {
            cloud::Choice::Retry => Self::Retry,
            cloud::Choice::Cancel => Self::Cancel,
            cloud::Choice::LaunchAnyway => Self::LaunchAnyway,
            cloud::Choice::Local => Self::Local,
            cloud::Choice::Cloud => Self::Cloud,
        }
    }
}
impl From<CloudChoice> for cloud::Choice {
    fn from(choice: CloudChoice) -> Self {
        match choice {
            CloudChoice::Retry => Self::Retry,
            CloudChoice::Cancel => Self::Cancel,
            CloudChoice::LaunchAnyway => Self::LaunchAnyway,
            CloudChoice::Local => Self::Local,
            CloudChoice::Cloud => Self::Cloud,
        }
    }
}

/// A Cloud sync's progress and the Cloud question it waits on, if any.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct CloudStatus {
    pub phase: CloudPhase,
    /// Binds an answer to the question this status shows.
    pub decision_id: u64,
    /// Localization key of the failure the status reports.
    pub error: Option<String>,
    /// Empty unless a question waits.
    pub allowed_choices: Vec<CloudChoice>,
}
impl From<cloud::Status> for CloudStatus {
    fn from(status: cloud::Status) -> Self {
        Self {
            phase: status.phase.into(),
            decision_id: status.decision_id,
            error: status.error,
            allowed_choices: status.allowed_choices.into_iter().map(Into::into).collect(),
        }
    }
}

/// The account an answer or a revocation names.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum GameAccount {
    Steam { steam_id: u64 },
    Epic { account_id: String },
    Gog { user_id: String },
}

/// A refused or failed session call, as a localization key.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, thiserror::Error, uniffi::Error)]
pub enum GameSessionError {
    /// The launch was cancelled before its game started.
    #[error("cancelled")]
    Cancelled,
    #[error("{reason}")]
    Failure { reason: String },
}
impl GameSessionError {
    pub(crate) fn new(error: impl std::fmt::Display) -> Self {
        Self::Failure {
            reason: error.to_string(),
        }
    }
}
impl From<Failure> for GameSessionError {
    fn from(failure: Failure) -> Self {
        match failure {
            Failure::Cancelled => Self::Cancelled,
            Failure::Failed(reason) => Self::Failure { reason },
        }
    }
}
impl From<GameSessionError> for String {
    fn from(error: GameSessionError) -> Self {
        error.to_string()
    }
}

/// What the bridge adds to each storefront's Game sessions.
pub(crate) trait Bridged: Storefront {
    fn account(account: GameAccount) -> Option<Self::Account>;
    fn game_account(account: &Self::Account) -> GameAccount;
    fn identity(game: &Self::Game, account: &Self::Account) -> GameIdentity;
    fn host(_: &Self::Store) -> Option<SteamHostState> {
        None
    }
    fn invite_request(_: &Self::Store) -> Option<SteamInviteRequest> {
        None
    }
    fn lobby(_: &Self::Store) -> Option<u64> {
        None
    }
    fn overlay_request(_: &Self::Store) -> Option<SteamOverlayRequest> {
        None
    }
    fn received_invites(_: &Self::Store) -> Vec<SteamReceivedInvite> {
        Vec::new()
    }
    fn micro_txn(_: &Self::Store) -> Option<SteamMicroTxn> {
        None
    }
}

impl Bridged for steam::Steam {
    fn account(account: GameAccount) -> Option<u64> {
        match account {
            GameAccount::Steam { steam_id } => Some(steam_id),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
    fn game_account(account: &u64) -> GameAccount {
        GameAccount::Steam { steam_id: *account }
    }
    fn identity(game: &u32, account: &u64) -> GameIdentity {
        GameIdentity::Steam {
            app_id: *game,
            account_id: *account,
        }
    }
    fn host(store: &steam::Store) -> Option<SteamHostState> {
        Some(store.host.into())
    }
    fn invite_request(store: &steam::Store) -> Option<SteamInviteRequest> {
        store.requests.invite().map(|request| SteamInviteRequest {
            sequence: request.sequence,
            invite: request.target.into(),
        })
    }
    fn lobby(store: &steam::Store) -> Option<u64> {
        store.requests.lobby
    }
    fn overlay_request(store: &steam::Store) -> Option<SteamOverlayRequest> {
        store.requests.overlay.clone().map(Into::into)
    }
    fn received_invites(store: &steam::Store) -> Vec<SteamReceivedInvite> {
        store
            .requests
            .invites
            .iter()
            .cloned()
            .map(|invite| SteamReceivedInvite::into_game(store.app_id, invite))
            .collect()
    }
    fn micro_txn(store: &steam::Store) -> Option<SteamMicroTxn> {
        store
            .requests
            .microtxn
            .as_ref()
            .map(|pending| SteamMicroTxn {
                order_id: pending.order_id,
                app_id: pending.app_id,
            })
    }
}

impl Bridged for epic::Epic {
    fn account(account: GameAccount) -> Option<String> {
        match account {
            GameAccount::Epic { account_id } => Some(account_id),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
    fn game_account(account: &String) -> GameAccount {
        GameAccount::Epic {
            account_id: account.clone(),
        }
    }
    fn identity(game: &epic::Store, account: &String) -> GameIdentity {
        GameIdentity::Epic {
            account_id: account.clone(),
            namespace: game.namespace.clone(),
            app_name: game.app_name.clone(),
        }
    }
}

impl Bridged for gog::Gog {
    fn account(account: GameAccount) -> Option<String> {
        match account {
            GameAccount::Gog { user_id } => Some(user_id),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
    fn game_account(account: &String) -> GameAccount {
        GameAccount::Gog {
            user_id: account.clone(),
        }
    }
    fn identity(game: &String, account: &String) -> GameIdentity {
        GameIdentity::Gog {
            account_id: account.clone(),
            product_id: game.clone(),
        }
    }
}

/// The storefront whose Game sessions an object holds.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum SessionStorefront {
    Steam,
    Epic,
    Gog,
}

/// The game and account a launch is admitted for.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum GameIdentity {
    Steam {
        app_id: u32,
        account_id: u64,
    },
    Epic {
        account_id: String,
        namespace: String,
        app_name: String,
    },
    Gog {
        account_id: String,
        product_id: String,
    },
}

/// The game asked Steam's overlay to invite friends into `invite`. A new
/// `sequence` is a new request, even for the same invitation.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct SteamInviteRequest {
    pub sequence: u64,
    pub invite: SteamGameInvite,
}

/// What `ActivateGameOverlayToStore` asks of the store page.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum SteamStoreFlag {
    /// Only the page (`k_EOverlayToStoreFlag_None`).
    ShowPage,
    AddToCart,
    AddToCartAndShow,
}

/// What the game asked Steam's overlay to show; Obelisk shows its own.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum SteamOverlayKind {
    /// `ActivateGameOverlay`: "friends", "community", "players", "settings",
    /// "officialgamegroup", "stats", "achievements", "chatroomgroup/<id>", …
    Dialog { dialog: String },
    /// `ActivateGameOverlayToUser`: "steamid", "chat", "jointrade", "stats",
    /// "achievements", "friendadd", … about `steam_id`.
    User { dialog: String, steam_id: u64 },
    /// `ActivateGameOverlayToWebPage`: an http or https URL.
    WebPage { url: String, modal: bool },
    /// `ActivateGameOverlayToStore`; app 0 is the store's front page.
    Store { app_id: u32, flag: SteamStoreFlag },
    /// `ActivateGameOverlayInviteDialog`: invite friends into the lobby.
    LobbyInvite { lobby_id: u64 },
    /// `ActivateGameOverlayRemotePlayTogetherInviteDialog`.
    RemotePlayTogetherInvite { lobby_id: Option<u64> },
    /// `ActivateGameOverlayInviteDialogConnectString`.
    ConnectInvite { connect: String },
    /// Steam's own Remote Play Together dialog.
    RemotePlayTogether,
}
impl From<protocol::OverlayDialog> for SteamOverlayKind {
    fn from(dialog: protocol::OverlayDialog) -> Self {
        use protocol::OverlayDialog as Dialog;
        match dialog {
            Dialog::Dialog { dialog } => Self::Dialog { dialog },
            Dialog::User { dialog, steam_id } => Self::User { dialog, steam_id },
            Dialog::WebPage { url, modal } => Self::WebPage { url, modal },
            Dialog::Store { app_id, flag } => Self::Store {
                app_id,
                flag: match flag {
                    1 => SteamStoreFlag::AddToCart,
                    2 => SteamStoreFlag::AddToCartAndShow,
                    _ => SteamStoreFlag::ShowPage,
                },
            },
            Dialog::LobbyInvite { lobby_id } => Self::LobbyInvite { lobby_id },
            Dialog::RemotePlayTogetherInvite { lobby_id } => {
                Self::RemotePlayTogetherInvite { lobby_id }
            }
            Dialog::ConnectInvite { connect } => Self::ConnectInvite { connect },
            Dialog::RemotePlayTogether {} => Self::RemotePlayTogether,
        }
    }
}

/// The latest overlay the game asked for. A new `sequence` is a new
/// request, even for the same overlay.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct SteamOverlayRequest {
    pub sequence: u64,
    pub kind: SteamOverlayKind,
}
impl From<game_runtime::OverlayRequest> for SteamOverlayRequest {
    fn from(request: game_runtime::OverlayRequest) -> Self {
        Self {
            sequence: request.sequence,
            kind: request.dialog.into(),
        }
    }
}

/// An invitation a friend sent into a game, as the running game's Steam or
/// the account's session received it. The running game takes one into it
/// with `StorefrontSessions::accept_invite`; another game joins it as it
/// starts, with `AccountInstallations::join`.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct SteamReceivedInvite {
    pub friend_steam_id: u64,
    pub app_id: u32,
    /// Never `None`.
    pub invite: SteamGameInvite,
    /// When it was last received, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
    pub received_at: u64,
}
impl SteamReceivedInvite {
    /// An invitation the running game of `app_id` received.
    fn into_game(app_id: u32, invite: game_runtime::ReceivedInvite) -> Self {
        Self {
            friend_steam_id: invite.friend,
            app_id,
            invite: invite.target.into(),
            received_at: invite.received_at,
        }
    }
}

/// A purchase the running game asks the player to confirm, answered with
/// `StorefrontSessions::authorize_micro_txn`. Steam tells no price here.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct SteamMicroTxn {
    pub order_id: u64,
    pub app_id: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct GameSessionState {
    pub id: String,
    pub game: GameIdentity,
    pub phase: GamePhase,
    /// The control connection was lost; the game may still run.
    pub reconnecting: bool,
    pub cloud: CloudStatus,
    /// Steam's native host.
    pub host: Option<SteamHostState>,
    /// A supervisor snapshot backs this session, not only its admission.
    pub observed: bool,
    /// How much of a runtime has downloaded while the launch waits for it.
    pub runtime_install: Option<RuntimeInstallState>,
    /// When this Obelisk saw the game start, in seconds since the Unix epoch,
    /// even if it already exited. A game recovered running has none.
    #[uniffi(default = None)]
    pub started_at: Option<u64>,
    /// The latest invite dialog the Steam game asked for, while its host is
    /// online: the picker it opens invites into its target.
    #[uniffi(default = None)]
    pub invite_request: Option<SteamInviteRequest>,
    /// The Steam lobby the game is in now, as the account's engine shows it:
    /// the friends list invites into it.
    #[uniffi(default = None)]
    pub lobby_id: Option<u64>,
    /// The latest overlay the Steam game asked for, while its host is online,
    /// invite dialogs included: `invite_request` is the same request when it
    /// asks for one, with the same sequence.
    #[uniffi(default = None)]
    pub overlay_request: Option<SteamOverlayRequest>,
    /// Invitations friends sent into the Steam game, newest first, while its
    /// host is online.
    #[uniffi(default = [])]
    pub received_invites: Vec<SteamReceivedInvite>,
    /// The purchase the Steam game waits on the player to confirm.
    #[uniffi(default = None)]
    pub micro_txn: Option<SteamMicroTxn>,
    /// What the game did, once it ran and exited.
    #[uniffi(default = None)]
    pub played: Option<GamePlayed>,
}

/// What a session's game did once it ran, for the player's performance
/// reports. Frame rates are absent when Metal reported no frame.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct GamePlayed {
    pub seconds: u64,
    pub frames: u64,
    pub median_fps: Option<f64>,
    pub low_1pct_fps: Option<f64>,
    pub hitches: u64,
    pub exit_code: Option<i32>,
    pub exit_signal: Option<i32>,
    pub ended_by_obelisk: bool,
    /// `rosetta` or `linux` for a Windows game, absent for a Mac one.
    pub engine: Option<String>,
    /// `dxmt` or `d3dmetal` for a Windows game, absent for a Mac one.
    pub graphics: Option<String>,
    pub voile: Option<String>,
}
impl From<game_runtime::supervisor::Played> for GamePlayed {
    fn from(played: game_runtime::supervisor::Played) -> Self {
        use game_runtime::wine::Engine;
        Self {
            seconds: played.seconds,
            frames: played.frames.count,
            median_fps: played.frames.median_fps(),
            low_1pct_fps: played.frames.low_1pct_fps(),
            hitches: played.frames.hitches,
            exit_code: played.exit_code,
            exit_signal: played.exit_signal,
            ended_by_obelisk: played.ended_by_obelisk,
            engine: played.engine.map(|engine| {
                match engine {
                    Engine::Rosetta => "rosetta",
                    Engine::Linux => "linux",
                }
                .to_owned()
            }),
            graphics: played.graphics.map(|graphics| graphics.name().to_owned()),
            voile: played.voile,
        }
    }
}

/// A Rosetta requirement the player can answer.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct RosettaPromptState {
    pub session_id: String,
    pub account: GameAccount,
    pub decision_id: u64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct GameSessionsState {
    /// Grows with every change.
    pub revision: u64,
    /// The session holding the Reservation.
    pub active: Option<GameSessionState>,
    /// The last session observed, kept after it ends.
    pub last: Option<GameSessionState>,
    /// A session a previous Obelisk left may still run.
    pub recovering: bool,
    /// The last recovery attempt failed; it is retried.
    pub recovery_failed: bool,
    /// Accounts signed out since the last admission.
    pub revoked: Vec<GameAccount>,
    pub rosetta: Option<RosettaPromptState>,
}

fn session_state<P: Bridged>(session: sessions::Session<P>) -> GameSessionState {
    GameSessionState {
        game: P::identity(&session.game, &session.account),
        host: session.store.as_ref().and_then(P::host),
        invite_request: session.store.as_ref().and_then(P::invite_request),
        lobby_id: session.store.as_ref().and_then(P::lobby),
        overlay_request: session.store.as_ref().and_then(P::overlay_request),
        received_invites: session
            .store
            .as_ref()
            .map(P::received_invites)
            .unwrap_or_default(),
        micro_txn: session.store.as_ref().and_then(P::micro_txn),
        id: session.id,
        phase: session.phase.into(),
        reconnecting: session.reconnecting,
        cloud: session.cloud.into(),
        observed: session.observed,
        runtime_install: session.runtime_install.map(Into::into),
        started_at: session.started_at,
        played: session.played.map(Into::into),
    }
}

fn state<P: Bridged>(state: sessions::State<P>) -> GameSessionsState {
    GameSessionsState {
        revision: state.revision,
        active: state.active.map(session_state),
        last: state.last.map(session_state),
        recovering: state.recovering,
        recovery_failed: state.recovery_failed,
        revoked: state.revoked.iter().map(P::game_account).collect(),
        rosetta: state.rosetta.map(|prompt| RosettaPromptState {
            session_id: prompt.session,
            account: P::game_account(&prompt.account),
            decision_id: prompt.decision_id,
        }),
    }
}

/// The supervisor a previous Obelisk left for a game of `P`.
fn supervisor_recovery<P: Bridged>(sessions: &Path, helper: &Path) -> sessions::Recovery<P>
where
    P::Error: std::fmt::Display,
{
    let (sessions, helper) = (sessions.to_owned(), helper.to_owned());
    Box::new(move || {
        Ok(supervisor::Client::<P>::recover(&sessions, &helper)
            .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?
            .map(|client| Arc::new(client) as Arc<dyn Supervised<P>>))
    })
}

pub(crate) enum Storefronts {
    Steam(Arc<Sessions<steam::Steam>>),
    Epic(Arc<Sessions<epic::Epic>>),
    Gog(Arc<Sessions<gog::Gog>>),
}

/// Runs `$body` with the Game sessions as `$sessions`, whichever storefront
/// they serve.
macro_rules! each {
    ($storefronts:expr, $sessions:ident => $body:expr) => {
        match $storefronts {
            Storefronts::Steam($sessions) => $body,
            Storefronts::Epic($sessions) => $body,
            Storefronts::Gog($sessions) => $body,
        }
    };
}

impl Storefronts {
    /// A session call that failed without a reason of its own.
    fn failed(&self) -> &'static str {
        fn failed<P: Storefront>(_: &Sessions<P>) -> &'static str {
            P::SESSION_FAILED
        }
        each!(self, sessions => failed(sessions))
    }
}

/// Account revocation, for an account of the sessions' storefront.
fn revoke<P: Bridged>(sessions: &Sessions<P>, account: GameAccount) {
    if let Some(account) = P::account(account) {
        sessions.revoke(account);
    }
}

fn resume_after_rosetta<P: Bridged>(
    sessions: &Sessions<P>,
    session_id: &str,
    account: GameAccount,
    decision_id: u64,
) -> Result<(), Failure> {
    match P::account(account) {
        Some(account) => sessions.resume_after_rosetta(session_id, &account, decision_id),
        None => Err(Failure::Failed(P::INVALID_SESSION.into())),
    }
}

fn decline_rosetta<P: Bridged>(
    sessions: &Sessions<P>,
    session_id: &str,
    account: GameAccount,
    decision_id: u64,
) {
    if let Some(account) = P::account(account) {
        sessions.decline_rosetta(session_id, &account, decision_id);
    }
}

/// One storefront's Game sessions, for the whole life of Obelisk.
#[derive(uniffi::Object)]
pub struct StorefrontSessions {
    pub(crate) sessions: Arc<Storefronts>,
}

impl StorefrontSessions {
    fn with(sessions: Storefronts) -> Arc<Self> {
        Arc::new(Self {
            sessions: Arc::new(sessions),
        })
    }

    /// Runs `call` on the Steam Game sessions; any other storefront's
    /// sessions refuse it.
    async fn steam(
        &self,
        call: impl FnOnce(&Sessions<steam::Steam>) -> Result<(), Failure> + Send + 'static,
    ) -> Result<(), GameSessionError> {
        let Storefronts::Steam(sessions) = &*self.sessions else {
            let refused = each!(&*self.sessions, sessions => invalid_session(sessions));
            return Err(GameSessionError::new(refused));
        };
        let sessions = sessions.clone();
        blocking(self.sessions.failed(), move || call(&sessions)).await
    }
}

/// A refused session call of `sessions`' storefront.
fn invalid_session<P: Storefront>(_: &Sessions<P>) -> &'static str {
    P::INVALID_SESSION
}

/// The runtimes every storefront's Game sessions and Transfers share, and the
/// places the first sessions named for them.
static RUNTIMES: OnceLock<((PathBuf, PathBuf), Arc<Runtimes>)> = OnceLock::new();

/// Where `locations` puts the runtimes: Voile's folder and Valve's Steam
/// components.
fn runtime_places(locations: &Locations) -> (PathBuf, PathBuf) {
    (
        locations.voile.clone(),
        locations.steam_runtime_package.clone(),
    )
}

/// The shared runtimes, in the places the first sessions' `locations` name.
/// The sessions of every other storefront name the same places.
fn runtimes(locations: &Locations) -> Arc<Runtimes> {
    let (places, runtimes) =
        RUNTIMES.get_or_init(|| (runtime_places(locations), Runtimes::new(locations)));
    debug_assert_eq!(
        *places,
        runtime_places(locations),
        "every storefront's sessions name the same runtime places"
    );
    runtimes.clone()
}

/// Whether `locations` names the places of the shared runtimes, as an
/// account's installations must: they get their runtimes through their
/// sessions, and their launches read them from `locations`.
pub(crate) fn shares_runtimes(locations: &Locations) -> bool {
    RUNTIMES
        .get()
        .is_none_or(|(places, _)| *places == runtime_places(locations))
}

#[uniffi::export(async_runtime = "tokio")]
impl StorefrontSessions {
    /// Starts by recovering the session a previous Obelisk left running. Its
    /// launches and Transfers get their runtimes into the places `locations`
    /// names, and the installations given it read them back from their own
    /// locations: those must name the same places.
    #[uniffi::constructor]
    pub fn new(storefront: SessionStorefront, locations: ObeliskLocations) -> Arc<Self> {
        let helper = Path::new(&locations.helper);
        let runtimes = runtimes(&(&locations).into());
        Self::with(match storefront {
            SessionStorefront::Steam => Storefronts::Steam(Arc::new(Sessions::new(
                supervisor_recovery(Path::new(&locations.steam_sessions), helper),
                runtimes,
            ))),
            SessionStorefront::Epic => Storefronts::Epic(Arc::new(Sessions::new(
                supervisor_recovery(Path::new(&locations.epic_sessions), helper),
                runtimes,
            ))),
            SessionStorefront::Gog => Storefronts::Gog(Arc::new(Sessions::new(
                supervisor_recovery(Path::new(&locations.gog_sessions), helper),
                runtimes,
            ))),
        })
    }

    pub fn state(&self) -> GameSessionsState {
        each!(&*self.sessions, sessions => state(sessions.state()))
    }

    /// Waits for a revision newer than `after`, or returns at once.
    pub async fn changed(&self, after: u64) -> GameSessionsState {
        each!(&*self.sessions, sessions => state(sessions.changed(after).await))
    }

    /// Account revocation. The game keeps running.
    pub fn revoke(&self, account: GameAccount) {
        each!(&*self.sessions, sessions => revoke(sessions, account))
    }

    pub async fn resume_after_rosetta(
        &self,
        session_id: String,
        account: GameAccount,
        decision_id: u64,
    ) -> Result<(), GameSessionError> {
        let sessions = self.sessions.clone();
        blocking(self.sessions.failed(), move || {
            each!(&*sessions, sessions => resume_after_rosetta(sessions, &session_id, account, decision_id))
        })
        .await
    }

    /// Ends the running game, as quitting Obelisk does; its session still
    /// settles its Cloud saves. A launch still preparing is cancelled.
    pub async fn stop(&self) -> Result<(), GameSessionError> {
        let sessions = self.sessions.clone();
        blocking(
            self.sessions.failed(),
            move || each!(&*sessions, sessions => sessions.stop()),
        )
        .await
    }

    /// The player's Quit of session `session_id`'s game: it is asked to close
    /// its windows, and nothing is killed. A launch still preparing is
    /// cancelled.
    pub async fn quit(&self, session_id: String) -> Result<(), GameSessionError> {
        let sessions = self.sessions.clone();
        blocking(
            self.sessions.failed(),
            move || each!(&*sessions, sessions => sessions.quit(&session_id)),
        )
        .await
    }

    /// The player's Force Quit of session `session_id`'s game, which ignored
    /// Quit: it ends now, with whatever still runs for its installation, and
    /// its session still settles its Cloud saves. A launch still preparing is
    /// cancelled.
    pub async fn force_quit(&self, session_id: String) -> Result<(), GameSessionError> {
        let sessions = self.sessions.clone();
        blocking(
            self.sessions.failed(),
            move || each!(&*sessions, sessions => sessions.force_quit(&session_id)),
        )
        .await
    }

    /// Obelisk's overlay opened (`active`) or closed over session
    /// `session_id`'s running Steam game, as Steam's overlay would tell it;
    /// `user_initiated` when the player opened it rather than the game. The
    /// game sees a close only after an open.
    pub async fn overlay_state(
        &self,
        session_id: String,
        active: bool,
        user_initiated: bool,
    ) -> Result<(), GameSessionError> {
        self.steam(move |sessions| sessions.overlay_state(&session_id, active, user_initiated))
            .await
    }

    /// The player accepted `friend_steam_id`'s invitation into session
    /// `session_id`'s running Steam game, from `received_invites` or from
    /// Steam's chat: the game joins as if Steam's overlay had accepted it.
    pub async fn accept_invite(
        &self,
        session_id: String,
        friend_steam_id: u64,
        invite: SteamGameInvite,
    ) -> Result<(), GameSessionError> {
        self.steam(move |sessions| {
            let target = protocol::InviteTarget::try_from(invite)
                .map_err(|()| Failure::Failed(steam::Steam::INVALID_SESSION.into()))?;
            sessions.accept_invite(&session_id, friend_steam_id, target)
        })
        .await
    }

    /// The player's answer to `micro_txn`, the purchase session
    /// `session_id`'s Steam game waits on: only that order is answered.
    pub async fn authorize_micro_txn(
        &self,
        session_id: String,
        order_id: u64,
        approve: bool,
    ) -> Result<(), GameSessionError> {
        self.steam(move |sessions| sessions.authorize_microtxn(&session_id, order_id, approve))
            .await
    }

    /// The player declined to install Rosetta: the waiting launch stops.
    pub fn decline_rosetta(&self, session_id: String, account: GameAccount, decision_id: u64) {
        each!(&*self.sessions, sessions => decline_rosetta(sessions, &session_id, account, decision_id))
    }
}

/// Every supervisor call parks on IPC, so it runs off the async runtime, as
/// do an installation's answer to a Cloud question and its journal reads.
pub(crate) async fn blocking<T: Send + 'static>(
    failed: &'static str,
    work: impl FnOnce() -> Result<T, Failure> + Send + 'static,
) -> Result<T, GameSessionError> {
    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(work)
        .await
        .map_err(|_| GameSessionError::new(failed))?
        .map_err(Into::into)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const LOBBY: u64 = 109_775_244_421_126_053;
    const FRIEND: u64 = 76_561_197_960_265_729;

    #[test]
    fn only_a_steam_session_carries_its_games_invite_request_and_lobby() {
        let mut store = steam::Store::new(3527290);
        assert_eq!(steam::Steam::invite_request(&store), None);
        assert_eq!(steam::Steam::lobby(&store), None);
        store.requests.lobby = Some(LOBBY);
        assert_eq!(steam::Steam::lobby(&store), Some(LOBBY));
        store.requests.overlay = Some(game_runtime::OverlayRequest {
            sequence: 2,
            dialog: protocol::OverlayDialog::LobbyInvite { lobby_id: LOBBY },
        });
        assert_eq!(
            steam::Steam::invite_request(&store),
            Some(SteamInviteRequest {
                sequence: 2,
                invite: SteamGameInvite::Lobby { lobby_id: LOBBY },
            })
        );
        store.requests.overlay = Some(game_runtime::OverlayRequest {
            sequence: 3,
            dialog: protocol::OverlayDialog::ConnectInvite {
                connect: "+connect_lobby 1".into(),
            },
        });
        assert_eq!(
            steam::Steam::invite_request(&store).map(|request| request.invite),
            Some(SteamGameInvite::Connect {
                connect: "+connect_lobby 1".into()
            })

            product_id: "1207658924".into(),

        assert!(gog::Gog::received_invites(&gog).is_empty());
        assert_eq!(gog::Gog::micro_txn(&gog), None);

                Dialog::WebPage {
                    url: "https://example.com".into(),
                    modal: true,
                },
                SteamOverlayKind::WebPage {
                    url: "https://example.com".into(),
                    modal: true,
                },
            ),
            (
                Dialog::Store {
                    app_id: 620,
                    flag: 0,

                SteamOverlayKind::Store {
                    app_id: 620,

                    app_id: 620,

        let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let runtimes = Runtimes::new(&Locations::new(root.path(), root.path(), root.path()));
        let sessions = StorefrontSessions::with(Storefronts::Gog(Arc::new(Sessions::new(
            Box::new(|| Ok(None)),
            runtimes,
        ))));
        let refused = |result: Result<(), GameSessionError>| match result {
            Err(GameSessionError::Failure { reason }) => reason,
            other => panic!("{other:?}"),
        };
        let reason = refused(sessions.overlay_state("id".into(), true, false).await);
        assert_eq!(reason, gog::Gog::INVALID_SESSION);
        let reason = refused(
            sessions

                    "id".into(),
                    FRIEND,
                    SteamGameInvite::Lobby { lobby_id: LOBBY },
                )
                .await,
        );
        assert_eq!(reason, gog::Gog::INVALID_SESSION);
        let reason = refused(sessions.authorize_micro_txn("id".into(), 1, true).await);
        assert_eq!(reason, gog::Gog::INVALID_SESSION);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn steam_sessions_refuse_controls_without_a_running_game() {
        let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let runtimes = Runtimes::new(&Locations::new(root.path(), root.path(), root.path()));
        let sessions = StorefrontSessions::with(Storefronts::Steam(Arc::new(Sessions::new(
            Box::new(|| Ok(None)),
            runtimes,
        ))));
        let refused = |result: Result<(), GameSessionError>| match result {
            Err(GameSessionError::Failure { reason }) => reason,
            other => panic!("{other:?}"),

        assert_eq!(
            refused(
                sessions
                    .accept_invite("id".into(), FRIEND, SteamGameInvite::None)

            ),
            steam::Steam::INVALID_SESSION
        );
        assert_eq!(
            refused(sessions.overlay_state("id".into(), true, true).await),
            steam::Steam::INVALID_SESSION
        );
        assert_eq!(
            refused(sessions.authorize_micro_txn("id".into(), 1, false).await),
            steam::Steam::INVALID_SESSION
        );
    }
}
```

`crates/obelisk-bridge/src/games_folder.rs`:

```rs
//! Where Obelisk installs games, as Swift presents and changes it. Every
//! account's installations of one library share its games folder.
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    sync::{Arc, Mutex, OnceLock},
};

use game_runtime::games_folder::{self, Candidate, ChoiceFailure, Refusal};

use crate::GameSessionError;

/// The games folder of Obelisk's `library`, the same for every caller.
pub(crate) fn shared(library: &Path) -> Arc<games_folder::GamesFolder> {
    static FOLDERS: OnceLock<Mutex<HashMap<PathBuf, Arc<games_folder::GamesFolder>>>> =
        OnceLock::new();
    FOLDERS
        .get_or_init(Default::default)
        .lock()
        .unwrap()
        .entry(library.to_owned())
        .or_insert_with(|| games_folder::GamesFolder::new(library))
        .clone()
}

/// Where new installations go. `revision` grows with every change.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct GamesFolderState {
    pub revision: u64,
    pub path: String,
    /// Obelisk's own folder, inside its library.
    pub is_default: bool,
    /// Its disk is there: Obelisk's own folder always is.
    pub is_connected: bool,
}

impl From<games_folder::View> for GamesFolderState {
    fn from(view: games_folder::View) -> Self {
        Self {
            revision: view.revision,
            path: view.path.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
            is_default: view.default,
            is_connected: view.connected,
        }
    }
}

/// What choosing a folder would do.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum GamesFolderInspection {
    /// The games go in `path`: `games` installations move there, and
    /// `copied_bytes` of theirs are copied from another disk.
    Ready {
        path: String,
        games: u32,
        copied_bytes: u64,
    },
    /// The folder is gone.
    Missing,
    /// The folder is inside Obelisk's library or a game's installation.
    Inside,
}

impl From<Result<Candidate, Refusal>> for GamesFolderInspection {
    fn from(inspection: Result<Candidate, Refusal>) -> Self {
        match inspection {
            Ok(candidate) => Self::Ready {
                path: candidate.path.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
                games: candidate.games,
                copied_bytes: candidate.copied_bytes,
            },
            Err(Refusal::Missing) => Self::Missing,
            Err(Refusal::Inside) => Self::Inside,
        }
    }
}

/// Obelisk's games folder.
#[derive(uniffi::Object)]
pub struct GamesFolder {
    folder: Arc<games_folder::GamesFolder>,
}

#[uniffi::export(async_runtime = "tokio")]
impl GamesFolder {
    /// The games folder of the Obelisk whose library is `library`.
    #[uniffi::constructor]
    pub fn new(library: String) -> Arc<Self> {
        Arc::new(Self {
            folder: shared(Path::new(&library)),
        })
    }

    pub fn state(&self) -> GamesFolderState {
        self.folder.view().into()
    }

    /// Waits for a revision newer than `after`.
    pub async fn changed(&self, after: u64) -> GamesFolderState {
        self.folder.changed(after).await.into()
    }

    /// What choosing `chosen` would do. It blocks on file reads.
    pub fn inspect(&self, chosen: String) -> GamesFolderInspection {
        self.folder.inspect(Path::new(&chosen)).into()
    }

    /// What making Obelisk's own folder the games folder again would do. It
    /// makes that folder, and blocks on file reads.
    pub fn inspect_default(&self) -> GamesFolderInspection {
        self.folder.inspect_default().into()
    }

    /// Makes the games folder `chosen` gives the one new installations go
    /// to, and queues the move of every installation into it.
    pub fn choose(&self, chosen: String) -> Result<(), GameSessionError> {
        self.folder
            .choose(Path::new(&chosen))
            .map_err(choice_failure)
    }

    /// Makes Obelisk's own folder the games folder again, and queues the
    /// move of every installation into it.
    pub fn choose_default(&self) -> Result<(), GameSessionError> {
        self.folder.choose_default().map_err(choice_failure)
    }

    /// Queues the move of the installations still outside the games folder.
    pub fn gather(&self) {
        self.folder.gather()
    }

    /// A disk came or left.
    pub fn volumes_changed(&self) {
        self.folder.volumes_changed()
    }
}

fn choice_failure(failure: ChoiceFailure) -> GameSessionError {
    match failure {
        ChoiceFailure::Refused(_) => GameSessionError::new("model.gamesFolder.refused"),
        ChoiceFailure::Io(error) => GameSessionError::new(error),
    }
}
```

```rs
//! GOG's account seam. Only refresh credentials cross into the macOS Keychain;
//! the account access token stays inside the Rust session.
use std::{collections::HashMap, sync::Arc};

use crate::{
    GamePlatform, LibraryCache,
    library_cache::{self, GameAchievements, GogLibrary, LibraryAchievement},
};
use gog_kit::{auth, client};

/// Achievement requests a library sends at once: GOG answers one game at a
/// time.
const ACHIEVEMENT_READS: usize = 6;

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error, uniffi::Error)]
pub enum GogError {
    #[error("backend.gog.network")]
    Network,
    #[error("backend.gog.unauthorized")]
    Unauthorized,
    #[error("backend.gog.invalid_code")]
    InvalidCode,
    #[error("backend.gog.invalid_response")]
    InvalidResponse,
    #[error("{message}")]
    Service { message: String },
}

impl From<gog_kit::GogError> for GogError {
    fn from(error: gog_kit::GogError) -> Self {
        match error {
            gog_kit::GogError::Network => Self::Network,
            gog_kit::GogError::Unauthorized => Self::Unauthorized,
            gog_kit::GogError::InvalidCode => Self::InvalidCode,
            gog_kit::GogError::Protocol => Self::InvalidResponse,
            gog_kit::GogError::Service { message } => Self::Service { message },
            error => Self::Service {
                message: error.to_string(),
            },
        }
    }
}

#[derive(uniffi::Object)]
pub struct GogSession {
    pub(crate) client: Arc<client::Client>,
    pub(crate) persistence: Arc<crate::credentials::Persistence>,
    /// Where the account's library is kept as it loads.
    library: Option<GogLibrary>,
}

impl GogSession {
    async fn with(
        client: client::Client,
        library: Option<Arc<LibraryCache>>,
    ) -> Result<Arc<Self>, GogError> {
        let library = match library {
            Some(library) => Some(library.gog(&client.credentials().await?.user_id)),
            None => None,
        };
        Ok(Arc::new(Self {
            client: Arc::new(client),
            persistence: Default::default(),
            library,
        }))
    }

    /// `product_ids`' achievements in `locale`: the library's for a game not
    /// played since they were read, unless `fresh`, else GOG's, which answers
    /// one game at a time, which the library then keeps. A game GOG did not
    /// answer for is left out; when none could be told, the first failure.
    async fn read_achievements(
        &self,
        product_ids: Vec<String>,
        locale: &str,
        fresh: bool,
    ) -> Result<Vec<GameAchievements>, GogError> {
        let client = &self.client;
        library_cache::achievements(
            self.library.as_ref().map(|library| library.achievements()),
            product_ids,
            locale,
            fresh,
            ACHIEVEMENT_READS,
            |product_id| async move {
                client
                    .achievements(&product_id, locale)
                    .await
                    .map_err(GogError::from)
            },
        )
        .await
    }
}

#[uniffi::export(async_runtime = "tokio")]
impl GogSession {
    /// Keeps every library it loads in `library`.
    #[uniffi::constructor]
    pub async fn sign_in(
        authorization_code: String,
        library: Option<Arc<LibraryCache>>,
    ) -> Result<Arc<Self>, GogError> {
        Self::with(client::Client::sign_in(&authorization_code).await?, library).await
    }

    /// Keeps every library it loads in `library`.
    #[uniffi::constructor]
    pub async fn restore(
        credentials: GogCredentials,
        library: Option<Arc<LibraryCache>>,
    ) -> Result<Arc<Self>, GogError> {
        Self::with(client::Client::restore(credentials.into()).await?, library).await
    }

    pub async fn credentials(&self) -> Result<GogCredentials, GogError> {
        Ok(self.client.credentials().await?.into())
    }

    /// The account's avatar, as its GOG profile shows it.
    pub fn avatar_url(&self) -> Option<String> {
        self.client.avatar_url()
    }

    pub fn shutdown_observers(&self) {
        self.client.shutdown_observers();
    }

    pub async fn next_credentials_revision(&self, after_revision: u64) -> Option<u64> {
        self.client.next_credentials_revision(after_revision).await
    }

    /// Saves the account's credentials through `credentials` now and after
    /// every rotation, one save at a time and in order, until the session's
    /// observers stop. Every account call relies on it.
    pub async fn persist(&self, credentials: Arc<dyn crate::CredentialSave>) {
        crate::credentials::persist(self.client.clone(), self.persistence.clone(), credentials);
    }

    pub async fn games(&self) -> Result<Vec<GogGame>, GogError> {
        let games = self.client.games().await?;
        Ok(match &self.library {
            Some(library) => library.games(games),
            None => games.into_iter().map(Into::into).collect(),
        })
    }

    /// The game's achievements in `locale`, such as `fr-FR`, as the game
    /// page reads them: the library's while the game was not played since
    /// they were read, unless `fresh`, else GOG's, which the library then
    /// keeps.
    pub async fn achievements(
        &self,
        product_id: String,
        locale: String,
        fresh: bool,
    ) -> Result<Vec<LibraryAchievement>, GogError> {
        let read = self
            .read_achievements(vec![product_id], &locale, fresh)
            .await?;
        Ok(read
            .into_iter()
            .next()
            .map(|game| game.achievements)
            .unwrap_or_default())
    }

    /// The share of each of `product_ids`' achievements the account unlocked,
    /// by product, as `achievements` reads them: none for a game without
    /// achievements or that GOG did not answer for. It fails only when no
    /// game could be told.
    pub async fn achievement_shares(
        &self,
        product_ids: Vec<String>,
        locale: String,
    ) -> Result<HashMap<String, f64>, GogError> {
        let read = self.read_achievements(product_ids, &locale, false).await?;
        Ok(library_cache::unlocked_shares(read).collect())
    }

    /// How long the account played each of `product_ids`; a game never
    /// played has no entry. GOG answers one game at a time.
    pub async fn playtimes(&self, product_ids: Vec<String>) -> Result<Vec<GogPlaytime>, GogError> {
        let playtimes = self.client.playtimes(&product_ids).await?;
        if let Some(library) = &self.library {
            library.playtimes(&playtimes);
        }
        Ok(playtimes
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(product_id, minutes)| GogPlaytime {
                product_id,
                minutes,
            })
            .collect())
    }

    pub async fn disconnect(&self) -> Result<(), GogError> {
        self.client.disconnect().await.map_err(Into::into)
    }

    /// `language` names the depots, such as `fr-FR`.
    pub async fn game_details(
        &self,
        product_id: String,
        language: String,
    ) -> Result<GogGameDetails, GogError> {
        Ok(self
            .client
            .game_details(&product_id, &language)
            .await?
            .into())
    }
}
```
