```rs
//! One account's installations across UniFFI, for either storefront. Rust
//! keeps the Installation receipts, runs the Transfers, launches, uninstalls
//! and Cloud maintenance, and holds the account's Cloud question; Swift
//! presents the state and forwards the player's actions. Games cross as Swift
//! names them: a Steam app id, an Epic `namespace:app` pair or a GOG product
//! id; installations as their receipt's id.
use crate::{
    CloudChoice, CloudIndicator, EpicSession, GameSessionError, GameTransfer, GogSession,
    LaunchChoices, LaunchSettings, ObeliskLocations, SteamCredentials, SteamSession,
    StorefrontSessions,
    game_session::{Storefronts, blocking, shares_runtimes},
    steam_chat::SteamGameInvite,
};
use game_runtime::{
    Locations, epic, gog,
    installations::{self, Installations, Report},
    sessions::{Sessions, Storefront as _},
    steam,
};
use obelisk_core::Platform;
use std::sync::Arc;

/// One installation of the account, as its receipt records it.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct Installation {
    /// Names the installation in every action.
    pub id: String,
    pub game: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub directory: String,
    pub platform: GamePlatform,
    pub total_bytes: u64,
    /// A Transfer started over it and has not succeeded since.
    pub needs_verification: bool,
    /// The storefront offers a newer build than the installed one.
    pub update_available: bool,
}

/// Which of a game's builds: the Mac build or the Windows build.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum GamePlatform {
    Mac,
    Windows,
}

impl From<Platform> for GamePlatform {
    fn from(platform: Platform) -> Self {
        match platform {
            Platform::Mac => Self::Mac,
            Platform::Windows => Self::Windows,
        }
    }
}

/// What a storefront offers to install of one game.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum GameOffer {
    /// With the depots of `language`. Steam picks the build the account can
    /// install as the Transfer starts: the Mac build when its game runs
    /// natively on Apple silicon, else the Windows build.
    Steam {
        app_id: u32,
        name: String,
        language: String,
    },
    /// Epic picks the build as Steam does.
    Epic {
        namespace: String,
        catalog_item_id: String,
        app_name: String,
        title: String,
    },
    /// GOG picks the build as Steam does.
    Gog { product_id: String, title: String },
}

/// A failure the player sees, and what it is about.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum InstallationReport {
    /// A storefront's localization key.
    Storefront { key: String },
    /// The chosen folder could not be created.
    DownloadDirectory { message: String },
    /// An uninstall failed for this reason, a localization key.
    Uninstall { reason: String },
    /// A move into the games folder failed for this reason, a localization
    /// key or the system's message.
    Move { reason: String },
    /// The games folder's disk is not connected: this folder.
    GamesFolderUnavailable { path: String },
}

/// What may start now, of one kind of action.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum GameOpening {
    Closed,
    /// It may start, for any game but these.
    Open {
        except: Vec<String>,
    },
}

/// What the Reservation lets start now.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct InstallationGate {
    /// A Transfer, which waits in the download queue.
    pub modify: GameOpening,
    /// An uninstall: no Transfer, launch or other uninstall of the storefront
    /// runs.
    pub uninstall: GameOpening,
    /// A launch: a Transfer holds only its own game, and those whose launch
    /// would need one.
    pub launch: GameOpening,
    pub maintain: GameOpening,
}

/// A storage warning, a localization key; `id` changes each time one is raised.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct InstallationWarning {
    pub id: u64,
    pub key: String,
}

/// Why a Cloud sync runs.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum CloudSyncKind {
    /// Before a launch's game starts.
    Launch,
    /// After its game exited.
    Exit,
    /// On the player's request.
    Maintenance,
}

/// What a Cloud question asks.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum CloudQuestionKind {
    /// Which saves to keep.
    Conflict,
    /// Whether to retry, cancel or launch anyway after a launch check failed.
    Failed,
}

/// The one Cloud question the account asks, until it has its answer.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct CloudQuestion {
    pub decision_id: u64,
    pub kind: CloudQuestionKind,
    /// Localization key of what the sync reports.
    pub error: Option<String>,
    pub choices: Vec<CloudChoice>,
}

/// The account's Cloud sync running now, whichever asks.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct CloudSync {
    pub game: String,
    pub kind: CloudSyncKind,
    /// Binds a cancellation to the sync as it shows now.
    pub decision_id: u64,
    /// It compares or transfers saves now.
    pub working: bool,
    /// Its Game session's control connection was lost: nothing reaches it.
    pub reconnecting: bool,
    /// The player may cancel it: a launch check still in progress.
    pub cancellable: bool,
    pub question: Option<CloudQuestion>,
}

/// A game's Cloud indicator.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct GameCloudIndicator {
    pub game: String,
    pub indicator: CloudIndicator,
}

/// Everything the account's installations present.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct InstallationsState {
    /// Grows with every change.
    pub revision: u64,
    pub installations: Vec<Installation>,
    pub transfer: Option<GameTransfer>,
    /// The game the last Transfer progress belongs to.
    pub transfer_game: Option<String>,
    pub downloading: bool,
    pub launching: bool,
    pub verifying_before_launch: bool,
    pub launch_game: Option<String>,
    pub uninstall_game: Option<String>,
    /// The game whose Transfer stopped before its receipt: the player can
    /// resume it.
    pub resumable: Option<String>,
    pub report: Option<InstallationReport>,
    pub warning: Option<InstallationWarning>,
    pub gate: InstallationGate,
    pub cloud_sync: Option<CloudSync>,
    /// The games whose Transfer waits in the download queue.
    pub queued: Vec<String>,
}

/// How a storefront's games and offers cross UniFFI.
pub(crate) trait Named: installations::Storefront {
    fn name(game: &Self::Game) -> String;
    /// The game Swift names `name`.
    fn named(name: &str) -> Option<Self::Game>;
    fn offer(offer: GameOffer) -> Option<installations::Offer<Self>>;
}

impl Named for steam::Steam {
    fn name(game: &u32) -> String {
        game.to_string()
    }
    fn named(name: &str) -> Option<u32> {
        name.parse().ok()
    }
    fn offer(offer: GameOffer) -> Option<installations::Offer<Self>> {
        match offer {
            GameOffer::Steam {
                app_id,
                name,
                language,
            } => Some(installations::Offer {
                product: steam::Product { app_id, language },
                name,
            }),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
}

impl Named for epic::Epic {
    fn name(game: &epic::Store) -> String {
        format!("{}:{}", game.namespace, game.app_name)
    }
    /// An Epic namespace has no colon.
    fn named(name: &str) -> Option<epic::Store> {
        let (namespace, app_name) = name.split_once(':')?;
        Some(epic::Store {
            namespace: namespace.into(),
            app_name: app_name.into(),
        })
    }
    fn offer(offer: GameOffer) -> Option<installations::Offer<Self>> {
        match offer {
            GameOffer::Epic {
                namespace,
                catalog_item_id,
                app_name,
                title,
            } => Some(installations::Offer {
                product: epic::Product {
                    namespace,
                    catalog_item_id,
                    app_name,
                },
                name: title,
            }),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
}

impl Named for gog::Gog {
    fn name(game: &String) -> String {
        game.clone()
    }
    fn named(name: &str) -> Option<String> {
        gog_kit::client::valid_product_id(name).then(|| name.to_owned())
    }
    fn offer(offer: GameOffer) -> Option<installations::Offer<Self>> {
        match offer {
            GameOffer::Gog { product_id, title } => Some(installations::Offer {
                product: gog::Product { product_id },
                name: title,
            }),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
}

/// An installation as Swift shows it, under the id its actions name.
fn installation<S: Named>(receipt: installations::Receipt<S>, updates: &[String]) -> Installation {
    let (id, game) = (receipt.id(), S::name(&receipt.game()));
    Installation {
        update_available: updates.contains(&id),
        id,
        game,
        name: receipt.name,
        directory: receipt.directory,
        platform: receipt.platform.into(),
        total_bytes: receipt.total_bytes,
        needs_verification: receipt.needs_verification,
    }
}

impl From<Report> for InstallationReport {
    fn from(report: Report) -> Self {
        match report {
            Report::Storefront(key) => Self::Storefront { key },
            Report::DownloadDirectory(message) => Self::DownloadDirectory { message },
            Report::Uninstall(reason) => Self::Uninstall { reason },
            Report::Move(reason) => Self::Move { reason },
            Report::GamesFolderUnavailable(path) => Self::GamesFolderUnavailable {
                path: path.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
            },
        }
    }
}

fn opening<S: Named>(opening: installations::Opening<S::Game>) -> GameOpening {
    match opening {
        installations::Opening::Closed => GameOpening::Closed,
        installations::Opening::Open { except } => GameOpening::Open {
            except: except.iter().map(S::name).collect(),
        },
    }
}

fn state<S: Named>(state: installations::State<S>) -> InstallationsState {
    let name = |game: Option<S::Game>| game.as_ref().map(S::name);
    InstallationsState {
        revision: state.revision,
        installations: state
            .receipts
            .into_iter()
            .map(|receipt| installation(receipt, &state.updates))
            .collect(),
        transfer: state.transfer.map(Into::into),
        transfer_game: name(state.transfer_game),
        downloading: state.downloading,
        launching: state.launching,
        verifying_before_launch: state.verifying_before_launch,
        launch_game: name(state.launch_game),
        uninstall_game: name(state.uninstall_game),
        resumable: name(
            state
                .last_download
                .as_ref()
                .map(installations::Transfer::game),
        ),
        report: state.report.map(Into::into),
        warning: state
            .warning
            .map(|(id, key)| InstallationWarning { id, key }),
        gate: InstallationGate {
            modify: opening::<S>(state.gate.modify),
            uninstall: opening::<S>(state.gate.uninstall),
            launch: opening::<S>(state.gate.launch),
            maintain: opening::<S>(state.gate.maintain),
        },
        cloud_sync: state.cloud_sync.map(|sync| CloudSync {
            game: S::name(&sync.game),
            kind: match sync.kind {
                installations::SyncKind::Launch => CloudSyncKind::Launch,
                installations::SyncKind::Exit => CloudSyncKind::Exit,
                installations::SyncKind::Maintenance => CloudSyncKind::Maintenance,
            },
            decision_id: sync.decision_id,
            working: sync.working,
            reconnecting: sync.reconnecting,
            cancellable: sync.cancellable,
            question: sync.question.map(|question| CloudQuestion {
                decision_id: question.decision_id,
                kind: match question.kind {
                    installations::QuestionKind::Conflict => CloudQuestionKind::Conflict,
                    installations::QuestionKind::Failed => CloudQuestionKind::Failed,
                },
                error: question.error,
                choices: question.choices.into_iter().map(Into::into).collect(),
            }),
        }),
        queued: state.queued.iter().map(S::name).collect(),
    }
}

fn install<S: Named>(installations: &Installations<S>, offer: GameOffer) {
    if let Some(offer) = S::offer(offer) {
        installations.install(offer);
    }
}

fn cancel<S: Named>(installations: &Installations<S>, game: &str) {
    if let Some(game) = S::named(game) {
        installations.cancel(&game);
    }
}

fn maintain_cloud<S: Named>(
    installations: &Installations<S>,
    game: &str,
    installation: Option<&str>,
) {
    if let Some(game) = S::named(game) {
        installations.maintain_cloud(game, installation);
    }
}

/// What a blocking call lost with its thread reports.
const FAILED: &str = "backend.steam.runtime.startFailed";
/// What a launch settings change that could not be kept reports.
const NOT_SAVED: &str = "backend.launchSettings.notSaved";

async fn launch_settings<S: Named>(
    installations: Installations<S>,
    installation: String,
) -> Result<Option<LaunchSettings>, GameSessionError> {
    let view = blocking(FAILED, move || {
        Ok(installations.launch_settings(&installation))
    })
    .await?;
    Ok(view.map(Into::into))
}

async fn set_launch_settings<S: Named>(
    installations: Installations<S>,
    installation: String,
    choices: LaunchChoices,
) -> Result<Option<LaunchSettings>, GameSessionError> {
    let view = blocking(NOT_SAVED, move || {
        installations
            .set_launch_settings(&installation, choices.into())
            .map_err(|_| game_runtime::sessions::Failure::Failed(NOT_SAVED.into()))
    })
    .await?;
    Ok(view.map(Into::into))
}

async fn answer<S: Named>(
    installations: Installations<S>,
    game: String,
    decision_id: u64,
    choice: CloudChoice,
) -> Result<(), GameSessionError> {
    let game = S::named(&game).ok_or_else(|| GameSessionError::new(S::INVALID_SESSION))?;
    blocking(FAILED, move || {
        installations.answer_cloud(&game, decision_id, choice.into())
    })
    .await
}

async fn indicators<S: Named>(
    installations: Installations<S>,
    games: Vec<String>,
) -> Result<Vec<GameCloudIndicator>, GameSessionError> {
    let games: Vec<_> = games.iter().filter_map(|game| S::named(game)).collect();
    let indicators = blocking(FAILED, move || installations.cloud_indicators(&games)).await?;
    Ok(indicators
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(game, indicator)| GameCloudIndicator {
            game: S::name(&game),
            indicator: indicator.into(),
        })
        .collect())
}

fn account<S: Named>(
    content: impl installations::Content<S> + 'static,
    sessions: Arc<Sessions<S>>,
    account: S::Account,
    receipts: String,
    locations: &Locations,
) -> Installations<S>
where
    S::Account: std::fmt::Display,
{
    debug_assert!(
        shares_runtimes(locations),
        "an account's installations name the runtime places of their sessions"
    );
    let queueing = installations::Queueing {
        queue: crate::downloads::queue().clone(),
        account: account.to_string(),
        name: <S as Named>::name,
    };
    Installations::new(
        Arc::new(content),
        sessions,
        account,
        receipts.into(),
        locations.home.clone(),
        crate::games_folder::shared(&locations.library),
        queueing,
    )
}

enum Account {
    Steam(Installations<steam::Steam>),
    Epic(Installations<epic::Epic>),
    Gog(Installations<gog::Gog>),
}

/// Runs `$body` with the account's installations as `$installations`,
/// whichever storefront keeps them.
macro_rules! each {
    ($account:expr, $installations:ident => $body:expr) => {
        match &$account.account {
            Account::Steam($installations) => $body,
            Account::Epic($installations) => $body,
            Account::Gog($installations) => $body,
        }
    };
}

/// One signed-in account's installed games and the actions on them.
#[derive(uniffi::Object)]
pub struct AccountInstallations {
    account: Account,
}

#[uniffi::export(async_runtime = "tokio")]
impl AccountInstallations {
    /// The installations of the Steam account `session` signed in, whose
    /// receipts `receipts` keeps, for the whole sign-in: they reach Steam
    /// through the session's CM connection of the moment.
    #[uniffi::constructor]
    pub fn steam(
        session: Arc<SteamSession>,
        credentials: SteamCredentials,
        sessions: Arc<StorefrontSessions>,
        receipts: String,
        locations: ObeliskLocations,
    ) -> Result<Arc<Self>, GameSessionError> {
        let Storefronts::Steam(sessions) = &*sessions.sessions else {
            return Err(GameSessionError::new(steam::Steam::INVALID_SESSION));
        };
        let locations: Locations = (&locations).into();
        let steam_id = credentials.steam_id;
        let content = steam::content::Content::new(
            session.account.clone(),
            game_runtime::protocol::Credentials {
                steam_id,
                account_name: credentials.account_name,
                refresh_token: credentials.refresh_token,
            },
            locations.clone(),
        );
        let installations = account(content, sessions.clone(), steam_id, receipts, &locations);
        Ok(Arc::new(Self {
            account: Account::Steam(installations),
        }))
    }

    /// The installations of the Epic account `account_id`, which `session`
    /// signed in. `language` names the game's language at launch. The
    /// session's own persistence saves the credentials their calls rotate.
    #[uniffi::constructor]
    pub fn epic(
        session: Arc<EpicSession>,
        account_id: String,
        language: String,
        sessions: Arc<StorefrontSessions>,
        receipts: String,
        locations: ObeliskLocations,
    ) -> Result<Arc<Self>, GameSessionError> {
        let Storefronts::Epic(sessions) = &*sessions.sessions else {
            return Err(GameSessionError::new(epic::Epic::INVALID_SESSION));
        };
        let locations: Locations = (&locations).into();
        // Every account call waits until the credentials it rotated are saved.
        let content = epic::content::Content::new(
            session.client.clone(),
            session.persistence.waiter(session.client.clone()),
            account_id.clone(),
            language,
            locations.clone(),
        );
        let installations = account(content, sessions.clone(), account_id, receipts, &locations);
        Ok(Arc::new(Self {
            account: Account::Epic(installations),
        }))
    }

    /// The installations of the GOG account `user_id`, which `session`
    /// signed in. `language` names the depots Transfers install, such as
    /// `fr-FR`. The session's own persistence saves the credentials their
    /// calls rotate.
    #[uniffi::constructor]
    pub fn gog(
        session: Arc<GogSession>,
        user_id: String,
        language: String,
        sessions: Arc<StorefrontSessions>,
        receipts: String,
        locations: ObeliskLocations,
    ) -> Result<Arc<Self>, GameSessionError> {
        let Storefronts::Gog(sessions) = &*sessions.sessions else {
            return Err(GameSessionError::new(gog::Gog::INVALID_SESSION));
        };
        let locations: Locations = (&locations).into();
        let content = gog::content::Content::new(
            session.client.clone(),
            session.persistence.waiter(session.client.clone()),
            language,
            locations.clone(),
        );
        let installations = account(content, sessions.clone(), user_id, receipts, &locations);
        Ok(Arc::new(Self {
            account: Account::Gog(installations),
        }))
    }

    pub fn state(&self) -> InstallationsState {
        each!(self, installations => state(installations.state()))
    }

    /// Waits for a revision newer than `after`, or returns at once.
    pub async fn changed(&self, after: u64) -> InstallationsState {
        each!(self, installations => state(installations.changed(after).await))
    }

    /// A DEBUG diagnostic holds the storefront while it runs.
    pub fn set_diagnostic(&self, running: bool) {
        each!(self, installations => installations.set_diagnostic(running))
    }

    /// Installs what `offer` names, or updates the game's installation; a
    /// Transfer of the game that stopped resumes instead. An offer of the
    /// other storefront does nothing.
    pub fn install(&self, offer: GameOffer) {
        each!(self, installations => install(installations, offer))
    }

    /// Verifies `installation`'s files and repairs or updates them in place;
    /// a Transfer of the game that stopped resumes instead.
    pub fn update(&self, installation: String) {
        each!(self, installations => installations.update(&installation))
    }

    /// Asks the storefront which installations have a newer build, unless it
    /// was asked a short while ago.
    pub fn check_updates(&self) {
        each!(self, installations => installations.check_updates())
    }

    /// Whether each newer build installs as soon as it is known, rather
    /// than at the game's next launch.
    pub fn set_automatic_updates(&self, enabled: bool) {
        each!(self, installations => installations.set_automatic_updates(enabled))
    }

    /// Stops `game`'s Transfer, or its launch still preparing.
    pub fn cancel(&self, game: String) {
        each!(self, installations => cancel(installations, &game))
    }

    /// Launches `installation`, verifying it first only when it needs it.
    pub fn launch(&self, installation: String) {
        each!(self, installations => installations.launch(&installation))
    }

    /// Launches the Steam `installation` as `launch` does, its game joining
    /// `invite`: a friend's lobby or rich presence `connect` string.
    pub fn join(&self, installation: String, invite: SteamGameInvite) {
        let Account::Steam(installations) = &self.account else {
            return;
        };
        let Ok(join) = steam::Join::try_from(invite) else {
            return;
        };
        if join.valid() {
            installations.join(&installation, join);
        }
    }

    pub fn uninstall(&self, installation: String) {
        each!(self, installations => installations.uninstall(&installation))
    }

    /// The launch settings of the Windows `installation`; `None` for a Mac
    /// build.
    pub async fn launch_settings(
        &self,
        installation: String,
    ) -> Result<Option<LaunchSettings>, GameSessionError> {
        each!(self, installations => launch_settings(installations.clone(), installation).await)
    }

    /// Keeps `choices` as the player's launch settings of the Windows
    /// `installation`, from its game's next launch, and returns them as they
    /// then apply.
    pub async fn set_launch_settings(
        &self,
        installation: String,
        choices: LaunchChoices,
    ) -> Result<Option<LaunchSettings>, GameSessionError> {
        each!(self, installations => {
            set_launch_settings(installations.clone(), installation, choices).await
        })
    }

    /// Stops the account's Transfer, Cloud maintenance and launch still
    /// preparing.
    pub fn signed_out(&self) {
        each!(self, installations => installations.signed_out())
    }

    /// Syncs the game's Cloud saves: those of `installation`, or, when
    /// `None`, those the uninstalled game's saved context names.
    pub fn maintain_cloud(&self, game: String, installation: Option<String>) {
        each!(self, installations => maintain_cloud(installations, &game, installation.as_deref()))
    }

    /// Answers the Cloud question the game shows with `decision_id`, its
    /// maintenance's or its Game session's.
    pub async fn answer_cloud(
        &self,
        game: String,
        decision_id: u64,
        choice: CloudChoice,
    ) -> Result<(), GameSessionError> {
        each!(self, installations => answer(installations.clone(), game, decision_id, choice).await)
    }

    /// The Cloud indicators of `games`, and of every other game of the
    /// account with pending work, which Swift does not know about.
    pub async fn cloud_indicators(
        &self,
        games: Vec<String>,
    ) -> Result<Vec<GameCloudIndicator>, GameSessionError> {
        each!(self, installations => indicators(installations.clone(), games).await)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn games_cross_as_swift_names_them_and_back() {
        let store = epic::Store {
            namespace: "sandbox".into(),
            app_name: "game:with:colons".into(),
        };
        let name = <epic::Epic as Named>::name(&store);
        assert_eq!(name, "sandbox:game:with:colons");
        assert_eq!(<epic::Epic as Named>::named(&name), Some(store));
        assert_eq!(<epic::Epic as Named>::named("no-colon"), None);
        assert_eq!(<steam::Steam as Named>::named("620"), Some(620));
        assert_eq!(<steam::Steam as Named>::named("sandbox:game"), None);
        assert_eq!(
            <gog::Gog as Named>::named("1207658924").as_deref(),
            Some("1207658924")
        );
        assert_eq!(<gog::Gog as Named>::named("../1207658924"), None);
        assert_eq!(<gog::Gog as Named>::named("sandbox:game"), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_installation_crosses_under_the_id_its_actions_name() {
        let receipt = installations::Receipt {
            product: epic::Product {
                namespace: "sandbox".into(),
                catalog_item_id: "catalog".into(),
                app_name: "game".into(),
            },
            name: "Fixture".into(),
            directory: "/library/Games/Epic/epic-hash-Windows".into(),
            platform: Platform::Windows,
            total_bytes: 7,
            needs_verification: true,
        };
        let installation = installation::<epic::Epic>(receipt, &["sandbox:game:Windows".into()]);
        assert_eq!(installation.id, "sandbox:game:Windows");
        assert_eq!(installation.game, "sandbox:game");
        assert_eq!(installation.platform, GamePlatform::Windows);
        assert!(installation.needs_verification);
        assert!(installation.update_available);
        let offer = GameOffer::Steam {
            app_id: 620,
            name: "Portal 2".into(),
            language: "french".into(),
        };
        assert_eq!(
            <epic::Epic as Named>::offer(offer.clone()),
            None,
            "an offer of the other storefront is refused"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            <steam::Steam as Named>::offer(offer).map(|offer| offer.product.app_id),
            Some(620)
        );
    }
}
```

```rs
//! A Windows installation's launch settings across UniFFI: how its game runs
//! and what its player changed, with every engine's offer, so Swift shows the
//! Engine, CPU and GPU choices each engine allows without asking again.
use game_runtime::{
    launch_settings::{
        self, Choices, ENGINES, EngineOffer, GraphicsOffer, GraphicsOption, Translator, View,
    },
    wine::{Engine, Graphics},
};

/// How a Windows game runs from its next launch, and what its player can
/// change.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct LaunchSettings {
    pub engine: LaunchEngine,
    pub graphics: LaunchGraphics,
    /// Direct3D 12 offers DirectX Raytracing, on D3DMetal.
    pub ray_tracing: bool,
    /// Metal's Performance HUD shows over the game, whatever renders it.
    pub performance_hud: bool,
    /// What the player changed from what Obelisk knows of the game.
    pub choices: LaunchChoices,
    /// The engine the game runs on without choices.
    pub default_engine: LaunchEngine,
    /// Every engine, with what it offers and how the game runs there
    /// without choices.
    pub engines: Vec<LaunchEngineOffer>,
}

/// What the player changed; a missing choice follows Obelisk's defaults.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct LaunchChoices {
    /// What the player adds to the game's command line, as typed.
    #[uniffi(default = None)]
    pub arguments: Option<String>,
    #[uniffi(default = None)]
    pub engine: Option<LaunchEngine>,
    #[uniffi(default = None)]
    pub graphics: Option<LaunchGraphics>,
    #[uniffi(default = None)]
    pub ray_tracing: Option<bool>,
    #[uniffi(default = false)]
    pub performance_hud: bool,
}

/// What runs a Windows game's Wine.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum LaunchEngine {
    /// Wine for macOS, under Rosetta.
    Rosetta,
    /// Wine for Linux, in voile-lkd's engine.
    Linux,
}

/// What renders a Windows game's Direct3D.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum LaunchGraphics {
    D3dMetal,
    Dxmt,
}

/// What translates a game's x86 code on one engine.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum LaunchTranslator {
    Rosetta,
    Fex,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum LaunchGraphicsOption {
    RayTracing,
}

/// One engine's offer.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct LaunchEngineOffer {
    pub engine: LaunchEngine,
    pub translator: LaunchTranslator,
    /// The backend the game renders with there without choices.
    pub default_graphics: LaunchGraphics,
    pub graphics: Vec<LaunchGraphicsOffer>,
}

/// One backend's offer on one engine.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct LaunchGraphicsOffer {
    pub graphics: LaunchGraphics,
    pub options: Vec<LaunchGraphicsOption>,
}

impl From<View> for LaunchSettings {
    fn from(view: View) -> Self {
        Self {
            engine: view.settings.engine.into(),
            graphics: view.settings.graphics.into(),
            ray_tracing: view.settings.options.ray_tracing,
            performance_hud: view.settings.performance_hud,
            choices: view.choices.into(),
            default_engine: view.default_engine.into(),
            engines: ENGINES
                .iter()
                .zip(view.default_graphics)
                .map(|(offer, default)| engine_offer(offer, default))
                .collect(),
        }
    }
}

fn engine_offer(offer: &EngineOffer, default: Graphics) -> LaunchEngineOffer {
    LaunchEngineOffer {
        engine: offer.engine.into(),
        translator: match offer.translator {
            Translator::Rosetta => LaunchTranslator::Rosetta,
            Translator::Fex => LaunchTranslator::Fex,
        },
        default_graphics: default.into(),
        graphics: offer.graphics.iter().map(graphics_offer).collect(),
    }
}

fn graphics_offer(offer: &GraphicsOffer) -> LaunchGraphicsOffer {
    LaunchGraphicsOffer {
        graphics: offer.graphics.into(),
        options: offer
            .options
            .iter()
            .map(|option| match option {
                GraphicsOption::RayTracing => LaunchGraphicsOption::RayTracing,
            })
            .collect(),
    }
}

impl From<Choices> for LaunchChoices {
    fn from(choices: Choices) -> Self {
        Self {
            arguments: choices.arguments,
            engine: choices.engine.map(Into::into),
            graphics: choices.graphics.map(Into::into),
            ray_tracing: choices.ray_tracing,
            performance_hud: choices.performance_hud,
        }
    }
}

impl From<LaunchChoices> for launch_settings::Choices {
    fn from(choices: LaunchChoices) -> Self {
        Self {
            arguments: choices.arguments,
            engine: choices.engine.map(Into::into),
            graphics: choices.graphics.map(Into::into),
            ray_tracing: choices.ray_tracing,
            performance_hud: choices.performance_hud,
        }
    }
}

impl From<Engine> for LaunchEngine {
    fn from(engine: Engine) -> Self {
        match engine {
            Engine::Rosetta => Self::Rosetta,
            Engine::Linux => Self::Linux,
        }
    }
}

impl From<LaunchEngine> for Engine {
    fn from(engine: LaunchEngine) -> Self {
        match engine {
            LaunchEngine::Rosetta => Self::Rosetta,
            LaunchEngine::Linux => Self::Linux,
        }
    }
}

impl From<Graphics> for LaunchGraphics {
    fn from(graphics: Graphics) -> Self {
        match graphics {
            Graphics::D3DMetal => Self::D3dMetal,
            Graphics::Dxmt => Self::Dxmt,
        }
    }
}

impl From<LaunchGraphics> for Graphics {
    fn from(graphics: LaunchGraphics) -> Self {
        match graphics {
            LaunchGraphics::D3dMetal => Self::D3DMetal,
            LaunchGraphics::Dxmt => Self::Dxmt,
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use game_runtime::profile;

    #[test]
    fn a_game_s_settings_cross_with_every_engine_s_offer_and_default_backend() {
        let view = launch_settings::of(
            std::path::Path::new("/nowhere"),
            profile::Game::Steam { app_id: 42 },
            std::path::Path::new("/nowhere"),
        );

        let settings = LaunchSettings::from(view);

        assert_eq!(settings.engine, LaunchEngine::Rosetta);
        assert_eq!(settings.graphics, LaunchGraphics::D3dMetal);
        assert!(settings.ray_tracing);
        assert!(!settings.performance_hud);
        assert_eq!(settings.choices, LaunchChoices::default());
        let engines: Vec<_> = settings
            .engines
            .iter()
            .map(|offer| (offer.engine, offer.translator, offer.default_graphics))
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(
            engines,
            [
                (
                    LaunchEngine::Rosetta,
                    LaunchTranslator::Rosetta,
                    LaunchGraphics::D3dMetal
                ),
                (
                    LaunchEngine::Linux,
                    LaunchTranslator::Fex,
                    LaunchGraphics::Dxmt
                ),
            ]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            settings.engines[0].graphics[0].options,
            [LaunchGraphicsOption::RayTracing]
        );
    }
}
```

```rs
#[derive(Clone, Debug, thiserror::Error, uniffi::Error)]
pub enum CoreError {
    #[error("Invalid game: {reason}")]
    InvalidGame { reason: String },
    #[error("Cannot access the library: {reason}")]
    Storage { reason: String },
    #[error("The library cannot be read: {reason}")]
    CorruptLibrary { reason: String },
    #[error("Game not found: {id}")]
    NotFound { id: String },
}

impl From<obelisk_core::CoreError> for CoreError {
    fn from(error: obelisk_core::CoreError) -> Self {
        match error {
            obelisk_core::CoreError::InvalidGame { reason } => Self::InvalidGame { reason },
            obelisk_core::CoreError::Storage { reason } => Self::Storage { reason },
            obelisk_core::CoreError::CorruptLibrary { reason } => Self::CorruptLibrary { reason },
            obelisk_core::CoreError::NotFound { id } => Self::NotFound { id },
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum GameKind {
    NativeMac,
    WindowsExecutable,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct Game {
    pub id: String,
    pub title: String,
    pub path: String,
    pub added_at: u64,
    pub last_played_at: Option<u64>,
    pub kind: GameKind,
}

impl From<obelisk_core::Game> for Game {
    fn from(game: obelisk_core::Game) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: game.id,
            title: game.title,
            path: game.path,
            added_at: game.added_at,
            last_played_at: game.last_played_at,
            kind: match game.kind {
                obelisk_core::GameKind::NativeMac => GameKind::NativeMac,
                obelisk_core::GameKind::WindowsExecutable => GameKind::WindowsExecutable,
            },
        }
    }

/// Lifecycle of one storefront transfer, shared by every store's progress record.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Enum)]
pub enum TransferState {
    Preparing,
    Verifying,
    Downloading,
    /// The installation moves into the games folder.
    Moving,
    Complete,
    Cancelled,
    Failed,
}

impl From<obelisk_core::transfer::TransferState> for TransferState {
    fn from(state: obelisk_core::transfer::TransferState) -> Self {
        use obelisk_core::transfer::TransferState as State;
        match state {
            State::Preparing => Self::Preparing,
            State::Verifying => Self::Verifying,
            State::Downloading => Self::Downloading,
            State::Moving => Self::Moving,
            State::Complete => Self::Complete,
            State::Cancelled => Self::Cancelled,
            State::Failed => Self::Failed,
        }
    }
}

/// One installation Transfer's progress, the same record for every storefront.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct GameTransfer {
    /// The storefront's own identity for the game: Steam's app ID, Epic's app name.
    pub game: String,
    pub state: TransferState,
    pub completed_bytes: u64,
    pub total_bytes: u64,
    pub network_bytes: u64,
    pub content_bytes: u64,
    pub current_file: String,
    pub message: String,
}

impl From<TransferState> for obelisk_core::transfer::TransferState {
    fn from(state: TransferState) -> Self {
        match state {
            TransferState::Preparing => Self::Preparing,
            TransferState::Verifying => Self::Verifying,
            TransferState::Downloading => Self::Downloading,
            TransferState::Moving => Self::Moving,
            TransferState::Complete => Self::Complete,
            TransferState::Cancelled => Self::Cancelled,
            TransferState::Failed => Self::Failed,
        }
    }
}

impl From<GameTransfer> for obelisk_core::installation::TransferProgress {
    fn from(transfer: GameTransfer) -> Self {
        Self {
            game: transfer.game,
            state: transfer.state.into(),
            completed_bytes: transfer.completed_bytes,
            total_bytes: transfer.total_bytes,
            network_bytes: transfer.network_bytes,
            content_bytes: transfer.content_bytes,
            current_file: transfer.current_file,
            message: transfer.message,
        }
    }
}

impl From<obelisk_core::installation::TransferProgress> for GameTransfer {

        Self {
            game: progress.game,
            state: progress.state.into(),

            total_bytes: progress.total_bytes,
            network_bytes: progress.network_bytes,
            content_bytes: progress.content_bytes,
            current_file: progress.current_file,
            message: progress.message,
        }
    }
}

pub enum StorefrontId {
    Steam,
    Epic,
    Gog,
    Other,
}

    pub id: StorefrontId,
    pub display_name: String,
    pub available: bool,
}

impl From<obelisk_core::storefront::StorefrontDescriptor> for StorefrontInfo {
    fn from(storefront: obelisk_core::storefront::StorefrontDescriptor) -> Self {
        use obelisk_core::storefront::StorefrontId as Id;
        Self {
            id: match storefront.id {
                Id::Steam => StorefrontId::Steam,
                Id::Epic => StorefrontId::Epic,
                Id::Gog => StorefrontId::Gog,
                Id::Other => StorefrontId::Other,
            },
            display_name: storefront.display_name.to_owned(),
            available: storefront.capabilities.any_available(),
        }
    }
}
```

`crates/obelisk-bridge/src/library_cache.rs`:

```rs
//! The library cache across UniFFI. Each storefront session keeps the library
//! it loads, with everything its storefront returned; Swift reads the last one
//! of an account while its session connects, records launches and forgets an
//! account that signs out.
use crate::{
    EpicGame, GameAccount, GameIdentity, GogGame, SteamGame, SteamGameArtwork,
    game_session::Bridged, installations::Named,
};
use futures_util::{StreamExt, stream};
use game_runtime::{epic, gog, steam};
use obelisk_core::library_cache::{self, AccountLibrary, Entry};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;
use std::{
    collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap, HashSet},
    future::Future,
    marker::PhantomData,
    sync::{Arc, Mutex},
    time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH},
};

const STEAM: &str = "steam";
const EPIC: &str = "epic";
const GOG: &str = "gog";
/// The entry field that keeps a game's achievement progress.
const ACHIEVEMENTS: &str = "achievements";
/// The entry field that keeps when a Steam game joined the library.
const ADDED_AT: &str = "addedAt";

/// The last library of every storefront account, in the library directory.
#[derive(uniffi::Object)]
pub struct LibraryCache {
    inner: library_cache::LibraryCache,
}

/// One achievement of a game, the same for every storefront.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, uniffi::Record)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct LibraryAchievement {
    pub id: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub icon_url: String,
    pub hidden: bool,
    pub unlocked: bool,
    /// Seconds since the Unix epoch; nil while locked, or when the
    /// storefront did not tell.
    pub unlocked_at: Option<u64>,
}

/// A game's achievements, by the id its storefront reads them with: Steam's
/// app ID, Epic's namespace, GOG's product id.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct GameAchievements {
    pub(crate) id: String,
    pub(crate) achievements: Vec<LibraryAchievement>,
}

/// The share of each of `read`'s games' achievements unlocked, by id; none
/// for a game without any.
pub(crate) fn unlocked_shares(read: Vec<GameAchievements>) -> impl Iterator<Item = (String, f64)> {
    read.into_iter()
        .filter_map(|game| Some((game.id, unlocked_share(&game.achievements)?)))
}

/// A Steam game of the cache, with its platforms, library artwork and what
/// the library orders by once Steam told them.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct CachedSteamGame {
    pub game: SteamGame,
    pub platforms: Option<Vec<String>>,
    #[uniffi(default = None)]
    pub artwork: Option<SteamGameArtwork>,
    /// When the game joined the library, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
    #[uniffi(default = None)]
    pub added_at: Option<u64>,
    /// The share of its achievements unlocked when they were last read;
    /// none for a game without any.
    #[uniffi(default = None)]
    pub achievement_share: Option<f64>,
}

/// An Epic game of the cache, with its playtime and achievements once Epic
/// told them.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct CachedEpicGame {
    pub game: EpicGame,
    pub playtime_seconds: Option<u64>,
    /// The share of its achievements unlocked when they were last read;
    /// none for a game without any.
    #[uniffi(default = None)]
    pub achievement_share: Option<f64>,
}

/// A GOG game of the cache, with its playtime and achievements once GOG
/// told them.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct CachedGogGame {
    pub game: GogGame,
    pub playtime_minutes: Option<u64>,
    /// The share of its achievements unlocked when they were last read;
    /// none for a game without any.
    #[uniffi(default = None)]
    pub achievement_share: Option<f64>,
}

/// When an account launched a game from Obelisk.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct GameLaunch {
    pub game: GameIdentity,
    /// Seconds since the Unix epoch.
    pub at: u64,
}

#[uniffi::export]
impl LibraryCache {
    /// The cache of the library in `directory`. Every cache of one directory
    /// shares one document.
    #[uniffi::constructor]
    pub fn new(directory: String) -> Arc<Self> {
        Arc::new(Self {
            inner: library_cache::LibraryCache::open(directory),
        })
    }

    /// The account's last Steam library, empty when it has none, with each
    /// game's artwork in `language` and what the library orders by.
    pub fn steam_library(&self, steam_id: u64, language: String) -> Vec<CachedSteamGame> {
        // Each field on its own: reading the entry flattened would copy its PICS.
        self.inner.library(STEAM, &steam_id.to_string(), |entry| {
            Some(CachedSteamGame {
                game: SteamGame::deserialize(entry).ok()?,
                platforms: entry
                    .get("platforms")
                    .and_then(|platforms| Vec::deserialize(platforms).ok()),
                artwork: entry.get("pics").map(|pics| {
                    SteamGameArtwork::from(steam_kit::artwork::library_artwork(pics, &language))
                }),
                added_at: entry.get(ADDED_AT).and_then(Value::as_u64),
                achievement_share: kept(entry).and_then(|kept| unlocked_share(&kept.list)),
            })
        })
    }

    /// The account's last Epic library, empty when it has none.
    pub fn epic_library(&self, account_id: String) -> Vec<CachedEpicGame> {
        // Each field on its own: reading the entry flattened would copy its
        // metadata.
        self.inner.library(EPIC, &account_id, |entry| {
            Some(CachedEpicGame {
                game: EpicGame::deserialize(entry).ok()?,
                playtime_seconds: entry.get("playtimeSeconds").and_then(Value::as_u64),
                achievement_share: kept(entry).and_then(|kept| unlocked_share(&kept.list)),
            })
        })
    }

    /// The account's last GOG library, empty when it has none.
    pub fn gog_library(&self, user_id: String) -> Vec<CachedGogGame> {
        // Read field by field: the entry's metadata stays in the cache.
        self.inner.library(GOG, &user_id, |entry| {
            Some(CachedGogGame {
                game: GogGame::deserialize(entry).ok()?,
                playtime_minutes: entry.get("playtimeMinutes").and_then(Value::as_u64),
                achievement_share: kept(entry).and_then(|kept| unlocked_share(&kept.list)),
            })
        })
    }

    /// Every launch the cache keeps, for every storefront and account.
    pub fn launches(&self) -> Vec<GameLaunch> {
        self.inner
            .launches()
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|launch| {
                let game = match launch.storefront.as_str() {
                    STEAM => <steam::Steam as Bridged>::identity(
                        &<steam::Steam as Named>::named(&launch.game)?,
                        &launch.account.parse().ok()?,
                    ),
                    EPIC => <epic::Epic as Bridged>::identity(
                        &<epic::Epic as Named>::named(&launch.game)?,
                        &launch.account,
                    ),
                    GOG => <gog::Gog as Bridged>::identity(
                        &<gog::Gog as Named>::named(&launch.game)?,
                        &launch.account,
                    ),
                    _ => return None,
                };
                Some(GameLaunch {
                    game,
                    at: launch.at,
                })
            })
            .collect()
    }

    /// Records a launch in its game's entry. A game whose library was never
    /// kept has no entry to keep it.
    pub fn record_launch(&self, launch: GameLaunch) {
        let (storefront, account, game) = match launch.game {
            GameIdentity::Steam { app_id, account_id } => (
                STEAM,
                account_id.to_string(),
                <steam::Steam as Named>::name(&app_id),
            ),
            GameIdentity::Epic {
                account_id,
                namespace,
                app_name,
            } => (
                EPIC,
                account_id,
                <epic::Epic as Named>::name(&epic::Store {
                    namespace,
                    app_name,
                }),
            ),
            GameIdentity::Gog {
                account_id,
                product_id,
            } => (GOG, account_id, product_id),
        };
        self.inner
            .record_launch(storefront, &account, &game, launch.at);
    }

    /// Removes the account's library and its launches, as signing it out
    /// does. Its session can no longer write it.
    pub fn forget(&self, account: GameAccount) {
        match account {
            GameAccount::Steam { steam_id } => self.inner.forget(STEAM, &steam_id.to_string()),
            GameAccount::Epic { account_id } => self.inner.forget(EPIC, &account_id),
            GameAccount::Gog { user_id } => self.inner.forget(GOG, &user_id),
        }
    }

    /// Writes the last change now, as Obelisk quits.
    pub fn flush(&self) {
        self.inner.flush();
    }
}

impl LibraryCache {
    pub(crate) fn steam(&self, steam_id: u64) -> SteamLibrary {
        SteamLibrary(self.inner.account(STEAM, &steam_id.to_string()))
    }

    pub(crate) fn epic(&self, account_id: &str) -> EpicLibrary {
        PlaytimeLibrary::new(self.inner.account(EPIC, account_id))
    }

    pub(crate) fn gog(&self, user_id: &str) -> GogLibrary {
        PlaytimeLibrary::new(self.inner.account(GOG, user_id))
    }
}

/// The Steam library a session keeps for its account.
pub(crate) struct SteamLibrary(AccountLibrary);

impl SteamLibrary {
    /// Keeps the account's games with every field Steam returned. Each keeps
    /// the platforms, PICS app info, library date and achievement progress
    /// earlier requests loaded.
    pub(crate) fn games(&self, games: Vec<steam_kit::client::OwnedGame>) -> Vec<SteamGame> {
        let (entries, games) = games
            .into_iter()
            .map(|mut owned| {
                let record = std::mem::take(&mut owned.record);
                let game = SteamGame::from(owned);
                let mut entry = entry_of(&CachedEntry {
                    id: <steam::Steam as Named>::name(&game.app_id),
                    game: &game,
                });
                entry.insert("record".into(), record);
                (entry, game)
            })
            .unzip();
        self.0
            .replace(entries, &["platforms", "pics", ADDED_AT, ACHIEVEMENTS]);
        games
    }

    /// Keeps when each game joined the library, by app ID, from the account's
    /// licenses. A game none of them grants has no date.
    pub(crate) fn acquisitions(&self, acquired: &BTreeMap<u32, u32>) {
        self.0.update(|entry| {
            let added_at = entry
                .get("id")
                .and_then(Value::as_str)
                .and_then(<steam::Steam as Named>::named)
                .and_then(|app_id| acquired.get(&app_id));
            match added_at {
                Some(at) => set(entry, ADDED_AT, (*at).into()),
                None => entry.remove(ADDED_AT).is_some(),
            }
        });
    }

    /// Where the library keeps the games' achievements.
    pub(crate) fn achievements(&self) -> LibraryAchievements<'_> {
        LibraryAchievements {
            account: &self.0,
            id: "id",
            playtime: "playtimeMinutes",
        }
    }

    /// Keeps each game's platforms and whole PICS app info.
    pub(crate) fn platforms(&self, games: Vec<steam_kit::client::GamePlatforms>) {
        let mut games: BTreeMap<String, _> = games
            .into_iter()
            .map(|game| (<steam::Steam as Named>::name(&game.app_id), game))
            .collect();
        self.0.update(|entry| {
            let Some(game) = entry
                .get("id")
                .and_then(Value::as_str)
                .and_then(|id| games.remove(id))
            else {
                return false;
            };
            let platforms = set(entry, "platforms", game.platforms.into());
            game.pics.is_some_and(|pics| set(entry, "pics", pics)) | platforms
        });
    }
}

/// A game a storefront loads apart from its playtime, as Epic and GOG do.
pub(crate) trait PlayedGame {
    /// The game as the library shows it.
    type Shown;
    /// The entry field the loaded playtimes name the game by.
    const PLAYTIME_ID: &'static str;
    /// The entry field that keeps its playtime.
    const PLAYTIME: &'static str;
    /// The entry field its achievements are read by: several games may
    /// share an Epic sandbox.
    const ACHIEVEMENTS_ID: &'static str;
    /// The game's entry, with everything its storefront returned but its
    /// playtime, and the game as the library shows it.
    fn entry(self) -> (Entry, Self::Shown);
}

impl PlayedGame for epic_kit::client::Game {
    type Shown = EpicGame;
    const PLAYTIME_ID: &'static str = "appName";
    const PLAYTIME: &'static str = "playtimeSeconds";
    const ACHIEVEMENTS_ID: &'static str = "namespace";
    fn entry(mut self) -> (Entry, EpicGame) {
        let metadata = std::mem::take(&mut self.metadata);
        let game = EpicGame::from(self);
        let mut entry = entry_of(&CachedEntry {
            id: <epic::Epic as Named>::name(&epic::Store {
                namespace: game.namespace.clone(),
                app_name: game.app_name.clone(),
            }),
            game: &game,
        });
        entry.insert("metadata".into(), metadata);
        (entry, game)
    }
}

impl PlayedGame for gog_kit::client::Game {
    type Shown = GogGame;
    const PLAYTIME_ID: &'static str = "id";
    const PLAYTIME: &'static str = "playtimeMinutes";
    const ACHIEVEMENTS_ID: &'static str = "id";
    fn entry(mut self) -> (Entry, GogGame) {
        let metadata = std::mem::take(&mut self.metadata);
        let game = GogGame::from(self);
        let mut entry = entry_of(&CachedEntry {
            id: game.product_id.clone(),
            game: &game,
        });
        entry.insert("metadata".into(), metadata);
        (entry, game)
    }
}

/// The library a session keeps for its account, whose playtimes load apart
/// from its games: Epic's or GOG's.
pub(crate) struct PlaytimeLibrary<G> {
    account: AccountLibrary,
    /// The playtimes the session last loaded: they may answer before the
    /// games.
    playtimes: Mutex<Option<BTreeMap<String, u64>>>,
    game: PhantomData<fn(G)>,
}

pub(crate) type EpicLibrary = PlaytimeLibrary<epic_kit::client::Game>;
pub(crate) type GogLibrary = PlaytimeLibrary<gog_kit::client::Game>;

impl<G: PlayedGame> PlaytimeLibrary<G> {
    fn new(account: AccountLibrary) -> Self {
        Self {
            account,
            playtimes: Mutex::default(),
            game: PhantomData,
        }
    }

    /// Keeps the account's games with everything their storefront returned.
    /// Until the session loads the playtimes, each game keeps its earlier
    /// one.
    pub(crate) fn games(&self, games: Vec<G>) -> Vec<G::Shown> {
        let playtimes = self.playtimes.lock().unwrap();
        let (entries, games) = games
            .into_iter()
            .map(|loaded| {
                let (mut entry, game) = loaded.entry();
                let playtime = playtimes.as_ref().and_then(|playtimes| {
                    playtimes.get(entry.get(G::PLAYTIME_ID)?.as_str()?).copied()
                });
                if let Some(playtime) = playtime {
                    entry.insert(G::PLAYTIME.into(), playtime.into());
                }
                (entry, game)
            })
            .unzip();
        let kept: &[&str] = if playtimes.is_some() {
            &[ACHIEVEMENTS]
        } else {
            &[G::PLAYTIME, ACHIEVEMENTS]
        };
        self.account.replace(entries, kept);
        games
    }

    /// Where the library keeps the games' achievements.
    pub(crate) fn achievements(&self) -> LibraryAchievements<'_> {
        LibraryAchievements {
            account: &self.account,
            id: G::ACHIEVEMENTS_ID,
            playtime: G::PLAYTIME,
        }
    }

    /// Keeps every game's playtime. A game missing from `playtimes` was
    /// never played.
    pub(crate) fn playtimes(&self, playtimes: &BTreeMap<String, u64>) {
        *self.playtimes.lock().unwrap() = Some(playtimes.clone());
        self.account.update(|entry| {
            let playtime = entry
                .get(G::PLAYTIME_ID)
                .and_then(Value::as_str)
                .and_then(|id| playtimes.get(id).copied());
            match playtime {
                Some(playtime) => set(entry, G::PLAYTIME, playtime.into()),
                None => entry.remove(G::PLAYTIME).is_some(),
            }
        });
    }
}

/// Where an account's library keeps its games' achievements, each with the
/// language, moment and playtime of its last read.
pub(crate) struct LibraryAchievements<'a> {
    account: &'a AccountLibrary,
    /// The entry field the storefront reads a game's achievements by.
    id: &'static str,
    /// The entry field that keeps the game's playtime.
    playtime: &'static str,
}

/// A game's achievements as its entry keeps them: in `locale`, read at
/// `at`, in seconds since the Unix epoch, when the game's playtime was
/// `playtime`.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct KeptAchievements {
    list: Vec<LibraryAchievement>,
    locale: String,
    at: u64,
    playtime: Option<u64>,
}

impl LibraryAchievements<'_> {
    /// The lists the library keeps of `ids`, named as their entries' id
    /// field names them, that are current in `locale`, and the ids to read
    /// again: those it keeps none of, keeps in another language, or keeps
    /// from before one of their games was last played, as its playtime
    /// changed since or Obelisk launched it after.
    fn current<K: ToString>(&self, ids: Vec<K>, locale: &str) -> (Vec<GameAchievements>, Vec<K>) {
        let asked: HashSet<String> = ids.iter().map(ToString::to_string).collect();
        let read = self.account.read(|entry| {
            let id = entry
                .get(self.id)?
                .as_str()
                .filter(|id| asked.contains(*id))?;
            let current = kept(entry).filter(|kept| {
                kept.locale == locale
                    && kept.playtime == entry.get(self.playtime).and_then(Value::as_u64)
                    && library_cache::launched_at(entry).is_none_or(|launched| launched <= kept.at)
            });
            Some((id.to_owned(), current.map(|kept| kept.list)))
        });
        // Games read by one id, such as an Epic sandbox's, are current together.
        let mut lists: HashMap<String, Option<Vec<LibraryAchievement>>> = HashMap::new();
        for (id, list) in read {
            lists
                .entry(id)
                .and_modify(|kept| {
                    if list.is_none() {
                        *kept = None;
                    }
                })
                .or_insert(list);
        }
        let mut current = Vec::new();
        let mut read_again = Vec::new();
        for id in ids {
            let name = id.to_string();
            match lists.remove(&name).flatten() {
                Some(achievements) => current.push(GameAchievements {
                    id: name,
                    achievements,
                }),
                None => read_again.push(id),
            }
        }
        (current, read_again)
    }

    /// Keeps each list read now in `locale`, with its game's playtime of the
    /// moment.
    fn keep(&self, read: &[GameAchievements], locale: &str) {
        let read: HashMap<&str, &[LibraryAchievement]> = read
            .iter()
            .map(|game| (game.id.as_str(), game.achievements.as_slice()))
            .collect();
        let at = SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map_or(0, |since| since.as_secs());
        self.account.update(|entry| {
            let Some(list) = entry
                .get(self.id)
                .and_then(Value::as_str)
                .and_then(|id| read.get(id))
            else {
                return false;
            };
            let kept = KeptAchievements {
                list: list.to_vec(),
                locale: locale.to_owned(),
                at,
                playtime: entry.get(self.playtime).and_then(Value::as_u64),
            };
            set(
                entry,
                ACHIEVEMENTS,
                serde_json::to_value(kept).unwrap_or_default(),
            )
        });
    }
}

/// `ids`' achievements in `locale`: the library's while current, unless
/// `fresh`, else read through `read`, `width` games at a time, which the
/// library then keeps. `ids` name games as their entries' id field does. A
/// game `read` failed for is left out; when no game could be told, the
/// first failure.
pub(crate) async fn achievements<K, A, E, Fut>(
    library: Option<LibraryAchievements<'_>>,
    ids: Vec<K>,
    locale: &str,
    fresh: bool,
    width: usize,
    read: impl Fn(K) -> Fut,
) -> Result<Vec<GameAchievements>, E>
where
    K: ToString,
    A: Into<LibraryAchievement>,
    Fut: Future<Output = Result<Vec<A>, E>>,
{
    let (mut current, stale) = match &library {
        Some(library) if !fresh => library.current(ids, locale),
        _ => (Vec::new(), ids),
    };
    let mut reads = stream::iter(stale)
        .map(|id| {
            let name = id.to_string();
            let reading = read(id);
            async move { (name, reading.await) }
        })
        .buffer_unordered(width);
    let mut failure = None;
    let mut read_now = Vec::new();
    while let Some((id, result)) = reads.next().await {
        match result {
            Ok(list) => read_now.push(GameAchievements {
                id,
                achievements: list.into_iter().map(Into::into).collect(),
            }),
            Err(error) => {
                failure.get_or_insert(error);
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(library) = &library
        && !read_now.is_empty()
    {
        library.keep(&read_now, locale);
    }
    current.extend(read_now);
    match failure {
        Some(error) if current.is_empty() => Err(error),
        _ => Ok(current),
    }
}

/// The achievements an entry keeps, with when and how they were read.
fn kept(entry: &Entry) -> Option<KeptAchievements> {
    KeptAchievements::deserialize(entry.get(ACHIEVEMENTS)?).ok()
}

/// The share of `achievements` unlocked; none when there are none.
fn unlocked_share(achievements: &[LibraryAchievement]) -> Option<f64> {
    let unlocked = achievements
        .iter()
        .filter(|achievement| achievement.unlocked)
        .count();
    (!achievements.is_empty()).then(|| unlocked as f64 / achievements.len() as f64)
}

fn entry_of(entry: &impl Serialize) -> Entry {
    match serde_json::to_value(entry) {
        Ok(Value::Object(entry)) => entry,
        _ => Entry::new(),
    }
}

/// Sets the entry's `key` to `value`; `true` when it changed.
fn set(entry: &mut Entry, key: &str, value: Value) -> bool {
    if entry.get(key) == Some(&value) {
        return false;
    }
    entry.insert(key.into(), value);
    true
}

/// A game as the cache keeps it: as the library shows it. A Steam game's
/// entry also keeps its `Player.GetOwnedGames` `record`, its `platforms`,
/// absent until Steam told them, its whole PICS app info, `pics`, when it
/// joined the library, `addedAt`, and its `achievements` progress. An Epic or
/// GOG game's keeps its playtime, absent until the storefront told it or when
/// the game was never played, its `achievements` progress with when it was
/// read and the playtime then, and everything else the storefront returned,
/// `metadata`: Epic's catalog items, library records and assets, GOG's
/// library record and catalog data.
#[derive(Serialize)]
struct CachedEntry<'a, G> {
    id: String,
    #[serde(flatten)]
    game: &'a G,
}
```

```rs
#[test]
fn an_epic_session_keeps_each_games_playtime_whichever_answers_first() {
    let directory = TempDir::new().unwrap();
    let cache = cache(&directory);
    let first = cache.epic("epic-a");
    first.games(vec![epic("rocket"), epic("fall")]);
    first.playtimes(&BTreeMap::from([("rocket".into(), 3600)]));
    assert_eq!(
        playtimes(&cache),
        [("rocket".into(), Some(3600)), ("fall".into(), None)]
    );

    let next = cache.epic("epic-a");
    next.games(vec![epic("rocket"), epic("fall")]);
    assert_eq!(
        playtimes(&cache)[0],
        ("rocket".into(), Some(3600)),
        "until its playtimes answer, a game keeps the earlier one"
    );
    let next = cache.epic("epic-a");
    next.playtimes(&BTreeMap::from([("fall".into(), 60)]));
    next.games(vec![epic("rocket"), epic("fall")]);
    assert_eq!(
        playtimes(&cache),
        [("rocket".into(), None), ("fall".into(), Some(60))]
    );
    let saved = &file(&cache, &directory)["epic"]["epic-a"][0];
    assert_eq!(saved["id"], "space:rocket");
    assert_eq!(saved["metadata"]["catalogItems"]["item"]["id"], "item");
    assert!(saved.get("headerImageUrl").is_none());
}

#[test]
fn launches_name_their_game_and_forgetting_an_account_stops_its_session_writing() {
    let directory = TempDir::new().unwrap();
    let cache = cache(&directory);
    let steam = cache.steam(7);
    steam.games(vec![owned(620, "Portal 2")]);
    cache.epic("epic-a").games(vec![epic("rocket")]);
    let portal = GameIdentity::Steam {
        app_id: 620,
        account_id: 7,
    };
    let rocket = GameIdentity::Epic {
        account_id: "epic-a".into(),
        namespace: "space".into(),
        app_name: "rocket".into(),
    };
    cache.record_launch(GameLaunch {
        game: portal.clone(),
        at: 1_790_000_000,
    });
    cache.record_launch(GameLaunch {
        game: rocket.clone(),
        at: 1_789_430_000,
    });
    let mut launches = cache.launches();
    launches.sort_by_key(|launch| launch.at);
    assert_eq!(
        launches,
        [
            GameLaunch {
                game: rocket.clone(),
                at: 1_789_430_000
            },
            GameLaunch {
                game: portal,
                at: 1_790_000_000
            },
        ]
    );

    cache.forget(GameAccount::Steam { steam_id: 7 });
    steam.games(vec![owned(620, "Portal 2")]);
    assert!(
        cache.steam_library(7, "english".into()).is_empty(),
        "a signed-out session's late answer"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        cache.launches(),
        [GameLaunch {
            game: rocket,
            at: 1_789_430_000
        }]
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_gog_session_keeps_each_games_page_and_playtime() {
    let directory = TempDir::new().unwrap();
    let cache = cache(&directory);
    let library = cache.gog("48628349957132247");
    let shown = library.games(vec![gog("1"), gog("2")]);
    assert_eq!(shown[0].developers, ["Tango Gameworks"]);
    library.playtimes(&BTreeMap::from([("2".to_owned(), 90)]));
    // A later load keeps the playtimes the session last loaded.
    library.games(vec![gog("1"), gog("2")]);
    let cached = cache.gog_library("48628349957132247".into());
    let read: Vec<_> = cached
        .iter()
        .map(|cached| (cached.game.product_id.as_str(), cached.playtime_minutes))
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(read, [("1", None), ("2", Some(90))]);
    assert_eq!(cached[0].game.release_date, Some(1_413_158_400));
    assert_eq!(cached[0].game.rating, Some(75));
    let file = file(&cache, &directory);
    assert_eq!(
        file["gog"]["48628349957132247"][1]["metadata"]["catalog"]["type"],
        "game"
    );

    let launch = GameLaunch {
        game: GameIdentity::Gog {
            account_id: "48628349957132247".into(),
            product_id: "2".into(),
        },
        at: 1_790_000_000,
    };
    cache.record_launch(launch.clone());
    assert_eq!(cache.launches(), [launch]);
    cache.forget(GameAccount::Gog {
        user_id: "48628349957132247".into(),
    });
    assert!(cache.gog_library("48628349957132247".into()).is_empty());
}

fn achievement(id: &str, unlocked: bool) -> LibraryAchievement {
    LibraryAchievement {
        id: id.into(),
        name: format!("Achievement {id}"),
        description: String::new(),
        icon_url: String::new(),
        hidden: false,
        unlocked,
        unlocked_at: unlocked.then_some(1_790_000_000),
    }
}

fn read(id: &str, unlocked: bool) -> GameAchievements {
    GameAchievements {
        id: id.into(),
        achievements: vec![achievement("a", unlocked)],
    }
}

/// What a storefront tells of a game it was asked.
type Told = Result<Vec<LibraryAchievement>, &'static str>;

/// How `achievements` asks the storefront: each id it reads, told unless it
/// is `failing`.
fn storefront(
    asked: &Mutex<Vec<String>>,
    failing: &'static [&'static str],
) -> impl Fn(String) -> std::future::Ready<Told> {
    move |id: String| {
        let told = match failing.contains(&id.as_str()) {
            true => Err("unavailable"),
            false => Ok(vec![achievement("a", true)]),
        };
        asked.lock().unwrap().push(id);
        std::future::ready(told)
    }
}

#[test]
fn a_steam_library_keeps_its_dates_and_achievements_across_loads() {
    let directory = TempDir::new().unwrap();
    let cache = cache(&directory);
    let library = cache.steam(7);
    library.games(vec![owned(620, "Portal 2"), owned(570, "Dota 2")]);
    library.acquisitions(&BTreeMap::from([(620, 1_300_000_000)]));
    library.achievements().keep(&[read("620", true)], "french");

    library.games(vec![owned(620, "Portal 2"), owned(570, "Dota 2")]);
    let cached = cache.steam_library(7, "english".into());
    let read: Vec<_> = cached
        .iter()
        .map(|cached| {
            (
                cached.game.app_id,
                cached.added_at,
                cached.achievement_share,
            )
        })
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(
        read,
        [(620, Some(1_300_000_000), Some(1.0)), (570, None, None),]
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_games_achievements_are_read_again_once_it_was_played_or_in_another_language() {
    let directory = TempDir::new().unwrap();
    let cache = cache(&directory);
    let library = cache.gog("7");
    library.games(vec![gog("1"), gog("2"), gog("3"), gog("4")]);
    library.playtimes(&BTreeMap::from([
        ("1".to_owned(), 60),
        ("2".to_owned(), 60),
    ]));
    let ids = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5"].map(String::from);
    let (current, stale) = library.achievements().current(ids.to_vec(), "fr-FR");
    assert!(current.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(stale, ids, "nothing was read yet");

    library.achievements().keep(
        &[read("1", true), read("2", false), read("3", true)],
        "fr-FR",
    );
    // 1 was played on another computer, Obelisk launched 3 since.
    library.playtimes(&BTreeMap::from([
        ("1".to_owned(), 90),
        ("2".to_owned(), 60),
    ]));
    cache.record_launch(GameLaunch {
        game: GameIdentity::Gog {
            account_id: "7".into(),
            product_id: "3".into(),
        },
        at: 4_000_000_000,
    });
    library.games(vec![gog("1"), gog("2"), gog("3"), gog("4")]);

    let (current, stale) = library.achievements().current(ids.to_vec(), "fr-FR");
    assert_eq!(current, [read("2", false)]);
    assert_eq!(stale, ["1", "3", "4", "5"].map(String::from));
    let (current, _) = library.achievements().current(ids.to_vec(), "en-US");
    assert!(
        current.is_empty(),
        "another language reads every game again"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        cache.gog_library("7".into())[0].achievement_share,
        Some(1.0),
        "what was read shows until it is read again"
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn achievements_come_from_the_library_unless_fresh_and_fail_only_when_none_could_be_told() {
    let directory = TempDir::new().unwrap();
    let cache = cache(&directory);
    let library = cache.gog("7");
    library.games(vec![gog("1"), gog("2")]);
    let asked = Mutex::new(Vec::new());
    let ids = vec!["1".to_owned(), "2".to_owned()];
    let read = |ids: Vec<String>, fresh, failing| {
        achievements(
            Some(library.achievements()),
            ids,
            "fr-FR",
            fresh,
            2,
            storefront(&asked, failing),
        )
    };

    let first = read(ids.clone(), false, &["2"]).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        first
            .iter()
            .map(|game| game.id.as_str())
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        ["1"],
        "a failed game is left out"
    );
    let again = read(ids.clone(), false, &[]).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(again.len(), 2);
    read(vec!["1".into()], true, &[]).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        *asked.lock().unwrap(),
        ["1", "2", "2", "1"],
        "only the game read last time failed is asked again, and a fresh read asks anyway"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        achievements(
            None,
            vec!["2".to_owned()],
            "fr-FR",
            false,
            1,
            storefront(&asked, &["2"])
        )
        .await,
        Err("unavailable")
    );
}
```

`crates/obelisk-bridge/src/locations.rs`:

```rs
//! Every path Obelisk uses, named once, and the removal of an installation.
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

/// Where Obelisk keeps everything, derived from its library directory, its
/// application bundle and the user's home.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, uniffi::Record)]
pub struct ObeliskLocations {
    pub library: String,
    pub home: String,
    /// The Cloud archive every storefront shares. The folder keeps its first
    /// name so existing save versions and running Game sessions stay valid.
    pub cloud_archive: String,
    pub steam_sessions: String,
    pub epic_sessions: String,
    pub gog_sessions: String,
    /// The bundled native host every supervisor runs as.
    pub helper: String,
    pub helpers: String,
    /// Valve's Steam components the Steam host loads, which a Steam game's
    /// download, or a launch that misses them, gets from Valve's CDN.
    pub steam_runtime_package: String,
    pub steam_runtime_cache: String,
    /// The Voile runtimes that run Windows games: the pinned release and a
    /// development runtime.
    pub voile: String,
    /// One Wine prefix per Windows installation, named after its folder.
    pub wine_prefixes: String,
}

#[uniffi::export]
pub fn obelisk_locations(library: String, bundle: String, home: String) -> ObeliskLocations {
    let locations =
        game_runtime::Locations::new(Path::new(&library), Path::new(&bundle), Path::new(&home));
    let path = |path: PathBuf| path.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
    ObeliskLocations {
        library: path(locations.library),
        home: path(locations.home),
        cloud_archive: path(locations.cloud_archive),
        steam_sessions: path(locations.steam_sessions),
        epic_sessions: path(locations.epic_sessions),
        gog_sessions: path(locations.gog_sessions),
        helper: path(locations.helper),
        helpers: path(locations.helpers),
        steam_runtime_package: path(locations.steam_runtime_package),
        steam_runtime_cache: path(locations.steam_runtime_cache),
        voile: path(locations.voile),
        wine_prefixes: path(locations.wine_prefixes),
    }
}

/// Ends the Windows game processes an Obelisk that died left frozen. Runs
/// once at startup, before any launch.
#[uniffi::export]
pub fn end_orphaned_windows_games(locations: ObeliskLocations) -> u32 {
    game_runtime::wine::end_orphans(Path::new(&locations.voile)) as u32
}

/// The Voile release Windows games run in now, once one is installed. Bug
/// reports name it.
#[uniffi::export]
pub fn installed_voile_release(locations: ObeliskLocations) -> Option<String> {
    game_runtime::voile::installed_release(Path::new(&locations.voile))
}

impl From<&ObeliskLocations> for game_runtime::Locations {
    fn from(locations: &ObeliskLocations) -> Self {
        Self {
            library: (&locations.library).into(),
            home: (&locations.home).into(),
            cloud_archive: (&locations.cloud_archive).into(),
            steam_sessions: (&locations.steam_sessions).into(),
            epic_sessions: (&locations.epic_sessions).into(),
            gog_sessions: (&locations.gog_sessions).into(),
            helper: (&locations.helper).into(),
            helpers: (&locations.helpers).into(),
            steam_runtime_package: (&locations.steam_runtime_package).into(),
            steam_runtime_cache: (&locations.steam_runtime_cache).into(),
            voile: (&locations.voile).into(),
            wine_prefixes: (&locations.wine_prefixes).into(),
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn locations_name_every_folder_once() {
        let locations = obelisk_locations("/library".into(), "/Obelisk.app".into(), "/home".into());
        assert_eq!(locations.cloud_archive, "/library/SteamCloud");
        assert_eq!(locations.steam_sessions, "/library/SteamSessions");
        assert_eq!(locations.epic_sessions, "/library/EpicSessions");
        assert_eq!(locations.gog_sessions, "/library/GOGSessions");
        assert_eq!(
            locations.helpers,
            "/Obelisk.app/Contents/Helpers/SteamNative"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            locations.helper,
            "/Obelisk.app/Contents/Helpers/SteamNative/obelisk-steam-host"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            locations.steam_runtime_package,
            format!(
                "/home/Library/Caches/com.zagrios.obelisk/SteamRuntime/valve-{}.zip",
                game_runtime::package::manifest().version
            )
        );
        assert_eq!(
            locations.steam_runtime_cache,
            "/home/Library/Caches/com.zagrios.obelisk/SteamRuntime"
        );
        assert_eq!(locations.voile, "/library/Voile");
        assert_eq!(locations.wine_prefixes, "/library/Prefixes");
        let runtime = game_runtime::Locations::from(&locations);
        assert_eq!(runtime.home, Path::new("/home"));
        assert_eq!(
            game_runtime::wine::prefix(
                &runtime.wine_prefixes,
                Path::new("/library/Games/Steam/steam-42-windows")
            )
            .unwrap(),
            Path::new("/library/Prefixes/steam-42-windows")
        );
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Asynchronous, account-scoped Steam API for Swift. Secrets cross this seam only
//! for authentication and the macOS Keychain; they are never part of a catalog.
use crate::{
    GamePlatform, LibraryCache,

/// Games whose achievements a library reads at once: each takes up to two

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error, uniffi::Error)]
pub enum SteamError {
    #[error("{reason}")]
    Failure { reason: String },
    #[error("backend.steam.friends.authenticationRequired")]

impl From<client::ClientConnectError> for SteamError {
    fn from(error: client::ClientConnectError) -> Self {
        match error {
            client::ClientConnectError::AuthenticationRequired(_) => Self::AuthenticationRequired,
            client::ClientConnectError::Other(error) => error.into(),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, uniffi::Enum)]

impl From<auth::GuardType> for SteamGuardKind {
```
