`crates/steam-native/adapter/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! Redirect exactly one bootstrap lookup; never replace any Steamworks result.
#[cfg(not(all(
    target_os = "macos",
    any(target_arch = "aarch64", target_arch = "x86_64")
)))]
compile_error!("The discovery adapter requires 64-bit macOS");
use std::ffi::{CStr, c_char};
type Lookup = unsafe extern "C" fn(u32, *const c_char, *mut u32) -> i32;
unsafe extern "C" {
    fn bootstrap_look_up(port: u32, name: *const c_char, result: *mut u32) -> i32;
}
unsafe extern "C" fn lookup(port: u32, name: *const c_char, result: *mut u32) -> i32 {
    // SAFETY: dyld interposing preserves bootstrap_look_up's contract. The
    // environment is inherited before exec and remains unchanged by this image.
    // Calling the original symbol from the interposing image does not recurse.
    unsafe {
        let service = libc::getenv(c"OBELISK_PRIVATE_STEAM_DISCOVERY".as_ptr());
        if !service.is_null()
            && !name.is_null()
            && CStr::from_ptr(service)
                .to_bytes()
                .starts_with(b"com.zagrios.obelisk.discovery.")
            && CStr::from_ptr(name) == c"com.valvesoftware.steam.ipctool"
        {
            return bootstrap_look_up(port, service, result);
        }
        bootstrap_look_up(port, name, result)
    }
}
#[repr(C)]
struct Interpose {
    replacement: Lookup,
    original: Lookup,
}
#[used]
#[unsafe(link_section = "__DATA,__interpose")]
static INTERPOSE: Interpose = Interpose {
    replacement: lookup,
    original: bootstrap_look_up,
};

```

`crates/steam-native/examples/cloud_storage_probe.rs`:

```rs
//! Offline Cloud interface probe. Run only through the disposable-data runner.
//! This example is not included in Obelisk's application build.
use obelisk_steam_native::{Result, abi, host, native, pinned_client, symbol};
use std::{ffi::c_void, io::Write, path::Path};

#[path = "cloud_storage_probe/live_storage.rs"]
mod live_storage;
#[path = "cloud_storage_probe/sync_controls.rs"]
mod sync_controls;

fn main() {
    let result = run();
    // SAFETY: the process owns the loaded Valve image; its private unload ABI is
    // unknown. The probe flushes its report before exiting without destructors.
    unsafe { libc::_exit(i32::from(result.is_err())) }
}

fn run() -> Result<()> {
    native::disable_core_dumps()?;
    let mut output = host::event_pipe()?;
    let result = probe(&mut output);
    if let Err(error) = &result {
        report(
            &mut output,
            serde_json::json!({"event": "probe_error", "detail": error.to_string()}),
        )?;
    }
    result
}

fn probe(output: &mut std::fs::File) -> Result<()> {
    let args: Vec<_> = std::env::args().collect();
    if args.len() != 3
        || ![
            "inventory",
            "storage-inventory",
            "local-write",
            "local-read",
            "project-write",
            "project-read",
            "project-rename",
            "project-read-renamed",
            "live-mutate",
            "live-read",
            "sync-download",
            "sync-upload",
            "sync-cancel",
        ]
        .contains(&args[1].as_str())
    {
        return Err("Expected a probe mode and a verified runtime path".into());
    }
    let path = Path::new(&args[2]);
    let scratch = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var("OBELISK_CLOUD_PROBE_ROOT")?);
    if scratch.parent() != Some(Path::new("/private/tmp"))
        || !scratch
            .file_name()
            .is_some_and(|name| name.to_string_lossy().starts_with("obelisk-cloud-probe-"))
        || path != scratch.join("runtime/steamclient.dylib")
        || std::env::var_os("HOME").as_deref() != Some(scratch.join("home").as_os_str())
    {
        return Err("Use the disposable-data runner".into());
    }
    pinned_client(path)?;
    let library = native::Library::open(path)?;
    let factory = symbol!(
        library,
        c"CreateInterface",
        unsafe extern "C" fn(*const std::ffi::c_char, *mut i32) -> *mut c_void
    );
    // SAFETY: the factory is an exported C function with a static version name
    // and an initialized writable result scalar. No account is created here.
    let (object, base) = unsafe {
        let mut result = -1;
        let object = factory(c"SteamClient020".as_ptr(), &mut result);
        if result != 0 || object.is_null() {
            return Err("Public client interface unavailable".into());
        }
        let mut info: libc::Dl_info = std::mem::zeroed();
        if libc::dladdr(factory as *const c_void, &mut info) == 0 {
            return Err("Cannot identify the pinned image".into());
        }
        (object, info.dli_fbase as usize)
    };
    report(
        output,
        serde_json::json!({
            "event": "client_interface_inventory", "interface": "SteamClient020",
            "authenticated": false, "methods": inventory(object, base, 19)?,
        }),
    )?;
    if args[1] != "inventory" {
        let engine = abi::Engine::open(path)?;
        let (user, pipe) = engine.global();
        if std::env::var_os("OBELISK_CLOUD_PROBE_IDENTITY").is_some() {
            // Disposable account component 1, no credential or external network.
            // This is not authentication or a production identity substitution.
            let requested = engine.user(user, pipe)?.log_on(0x0110_0001_0000_0001)?;
            report(
                output,
                serde_json::json!({"event": "fixture_identity_requested", "result": requested}),
            )?;
        }
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({
                "event": "global_user", "user": user, "pipe": pipe,
                "connected": engine.connected(user, pipe), "logged_on": engine.logged_on(user, pipe),
            }),
        )?;
        if user == 0 || pipe == 0 || engine.logged_on(user, pipe) {
            return Err("Expected an unauthenticated disposable user".into());
        }
        let identity = engine.user(user, pipe)?.steam_id()?;
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({"event": "identity", "is_zero": identity == 0,
            "account_id_is_zero": identity as u32 == 0,
            "instance": (identity >> 32) & 0xfffff, "universe": identity >> 56,
            "account_type": (identity >> 52) & 0xf}),
        )?;
        // SAFETY: the pinned factory accepts this static engine version name.
        let engine_object = unsafe {
            let mut result = -1;
            let object = factory(c"CLIENTENGINE_INTERFACE_VERSION005".as_ptr(), &mut result);
            if result != 0 || object.is_null() {
                return Err("Private engine unavailable".into());
            }
            object
        };
        let address = method(engine_object, base, 24, 0xa03cac)?;
        // SAFETY: pinned engine slot 24 validates user/pipe, then returns record
        // member +0x68. Disassembly establishes this,user32,pipe32 -> pointer.
        // See docs/steam-cloud-runtime-controls.md. No storage method is called.
        let storage = unsafe {
            let get: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, i32, i32) -> *mut c_void =
                std::mem::transmute(address);
            get(engine_object, user, pipe)
        };
        if storage.is_null() {
            return Err("Private RemoteStorage unavailable".into());
        }
        if args[1].starts_with("live-") {
            let address = method(engine_object, base, 14, 0xa04d74)?;
            // SAFETY: pinned engine slot 14 validates a single pipe handle and
            // returns its Utils object. Public factory calls its slot 19.
            let utils = unsafe {
                let get: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, i32) -> *mut c_void =
                    std::mem::transmute(address);
                get(engine_object, pipe)
            };
            if utils.is_null() {
                return Err("Private Utils unavailable".into());
            }
            report(
                output,
                serde_json::json!({"event":"utils_inventory", "methods":inventory(utils, base, 20)?}),
            )?;
            live_storage::prepare_pipe_app(output, utils, base)?;
        }
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({
                "event": "storage_interface_inventory", "interface": "IClientRemoteStorage",
                "methods": inventory(storage, base, 89)?,
            }),
        )?;
        let address = method(object, base, 17, 0x7c9918)?;
        // SAFETY: published ISteamClient::GetISteamRemoteStorage signature;
        // pinned wrapper selects "RemoteStorage", with the version below
        // present in this image. It returns null for unavailable interfaces.
        let public_storage = unsafe {
            let get: unsafe extern "C" fn(
                *mut c_void,
                i32,
                i32,
                *const std::ffi::c_char,
            ) -> *mut c_void = std::mem::transmute(address);
            get(
                object,
                user,
                pipe,
                c"STEAMREMOTESTORAGE_INTERFACE_VERSION016".as_ptr(),
            )
        };
        if public_storage.is_null() {
            return Err("Public RemoteStorage unavailable".into());
        }
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({
                "event": "storage_interface_inventory", "interface": "ISteamRemoteStorage016",
                "methods": inventory(public_storage, base, 23)?,
            }),
        )?;
        let result = if args[1].starts_with("sync-") {
            sync_controls::run(output, storage, base, pipe, &library, &args[1])
        } else if args[1].starts_with("live-") {
            let storage = live_storage::Storage::new(storage, public_storage, base);
            storage.run(output, &args[1], &scratch, &engine, pipe)
        } else if args[1].starts_with("local-") || args[1].starts_with("project-") {
            local_storage(output, storage, base, &args[1], &scratch, &engine, pipe)
        } else {
            Ok(())
        };
        engine.release(user, pipe);
        result?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn local_storage(
    output: &mut std::fs::File,
    storage: *mut c_void,
    base: usize,
    mode: &str,
    scratch: &Path,
    engine: &abi::Engine,
    pipe: i32,
) -> Result<()> {
    const APP: u32 = 480;
    const ROOT: u32 = 0;
    const PAYLOAD: &[u8] = b"Obelisk offline RemoteStorage fixture v1\n";
    let account_component = if std::env::var_os("OBELISK_CLOUD_PROBE_IDENTITY").is_some() {
        "1"
    } else {
        "0"
    };
    let mut name = if mode == "project-read-renamed" {
        c"obelisk-offline-probe-renamed.dat"
    } else {
        c"obelisk-offline-probe.dat"
    };
    let fixture_path = scratch.join(format!(
        "home/Library/Application Support/Steam/userdata/{account_component}/480/remote/{}",
        name.to_str()?
    ));
    let address = method(storage, base, 20, 0x8fd710)?;
    let (mut quota, mut available) = (0_u64, 0_u64);
    // SAFETY: the pinned proxy takes AppID and two writable eight-byte outputs.
    let quota_known = unsafe {
        let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, u32, *mut u64, *mut u64) -> bool =
            std::mem::transmute(address);
        call(storage, APP, &mut quota, &mut available)
    };
    report(
        output,
        serde_json::json!({"event": "quota", "known": quota_known,
            "total": quota_known.then_some(quota), "available": quota_known.then_some(available)}),
    )?;
    let address = method(storage, base, 73, 0x903118)?;
    // SAFETY: pinned read-only sync-state proxy takes AppID and returns i32.
    let state = unsafe {
        let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, u32) -> i32 = std::mem::transmute(address);
        call(storage, APP)
    };
    report(
        output,
        serde_json::json!({"event": "sync_state", "value": state}),
    )?;
    let resolve = method(storage, base, 67, 0x90278c)?;
    let mut path = [0_u8; 4096];
    // SAFETY: the pinned proxy serializes AppID/root/name/buffer size and copies
    // the returned path into the supplied buffer. All buffers outlive the call.
    let resolved = unsafe {
        let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(
            *mut c_void,
            u32,
            u32,
            *const std::ffi::c_char,
            *mut u8,
            u32,
        ) -> bool = std::mem::transmute(resolve);
        call(
            storage,
            APP,
            ROOT,
            name.as_ptr(),
            path.as_mut_ptr(),
            path.len() as u32,
        )
    };
    let length = path
        .iter()
        .position(|byte| *byte == 0)
        .ok_or("Unterminated storage path")?;
    report(
        output,
        serde_json::json!({"event": "resolve_path", "resolved": resolved,
        "app_id": APP, "root": ROOT, "path": String::from_utf8_lossy(&path[..length])}),
    )?;
    if mode == "project-write" {
        if !resolved {
            return Err("Cannot project without a storage path".into());
        }
        let destination = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::str::from_utf8(&path[..length])?);
        let expected = &fixture_path;
        if &destination != expected {
            return Err("Refusing to project outside the disposable fixture path".into());
        }
        let parent = destination.parent().ok_or("Missing fixture parent")?;
        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
        if !parent.canonicalize()?.starts_with(scratch.canonicalize()?) {
            return Err("Unexpected storage symlink".into());
        }
        let mut file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
            .write(true)
            .create_new(true)
            .open(&destination)?;
        file.write_all(PAYLOAD)?;
        file.sync_all()?;
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({"event": "obelisk_projected_fixture", "bytes": PAYLOAD.len()}),
        )?;
        if std::env::var_os("OBELISK_CLOUD_PROBE_CACHE").is_some() {
            // Test fixture only: reproduce the record emitted by this pinned
            // macOS runtime for these exact bytes. No live cache is imported.
            let timestamp = file
                .metadata()?
                .modified()?
                .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)?
                .as_secs();
            let cache_path = parent
                .parent()
                .ok_or("Missing cache parent")?
                .join("remotecache.vdf");
            let cache = format!(
                "\"480\"\n{{\n\"ChangeNumber\" \"0\"\n\"OSType\" \"-1\"\n\"obelisk-offline-probe.dat\"\n{{\n\"root\" \"0\"\n\"size\" \"39\"\n\"localtime\" \"{timestamp}\"\n\"time\" \"{timestamp}\"\n\"remotetime\" \"0\"\n\"sha\" \"b9d228874d30ac5d864bebd5252d232a3858c866\"\n\"syncstate\" \"3\"\n\"persiststate\" \"0\"\n\"platformstosync2\" \"-1\"\n}}\n}}\n"
            );
            let mut index = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
                .write(true)
                .create_new(true)
                .open(cache_path)?;
            index.write_all(cache.as_bytes())?;
            index.sync_all()?;
            report(
                output,
                serde_json::json!({"event": "obelisk_projected_cache", "fixture_records": 1}),
            )?;
        }
    }
    if mode.starts_with("project-") || mode == "local-read" {
        let direct = std::fs::read(&fixture_path)?;
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({"event": "direct_file_read", "bytes": direct.len(), "matches_fixture": direct == PAYLOAD}),
        )?;
        if direct != PAYLOAD {
            return Err("Fixture missing or changed on disk".into());
        }
    }
    load_cache(output, storage, base, engine, pipe)?;
    if mode == "local-write" {
        let address = method(storage, base, 0, 0x8fb410)?;
        // SAFETY: the public FileWrite adapter proves AppID/root/name/data/size
        // order. The private return is EResult (32 bits), NOT C++ bool.
        let result = unsafe {
            let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(
                *mut c_void,
                u32,
                u32,
                *const std::ffi::c_char,
                *const u8,
                u32,
            ) -> u32 = std::mem::transmute(address);
            call(
                storage,
                APP,
                ROOT,
                name.as_ptr(),
                PAYLOAD.as_ptr(),
                PAYLOAD.len() as u32,
            )
        };
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({"event": "file_write", "result": result, "accepted": result == 1}),
        )?;
        if result != 1 {
            return Err("Offline fixture write was rejected".into());
        }
        let cache = fixture_path
            .parent()
            .and_then(Path::parent)
            .ok_or("Missing cache directory")?
            .join("remotecache.vdf");
        let started = std::time::Instant::now();
        let mut checkpoint = false;
        while started.elapsed() < std::time::Duration::from_secs(5) {
            let _ = engine.callback(pipe);
            if std::fs::read_to_string(&cache)
                .is_ok_and(|text| text.contains("obelisk-offline-probe.dat"))
            {
                checkpoint = true;
                break;
            }
            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(10));
        }
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({"event": "local_cache_checkpoint", "fixture_record_present": checkpoint,
            "wait_milliseconds": started.elapsed().as_millis()}),
        )?;
        if !checkpoint {
            return Err("Native cache checkpoint not observed before deadline".into());
        }
    }
    if mode == "project-rename" {
        read_fixture(output, storage, base, name, PAYLOAD)?;
        let parent = fixture_path.parent().ok_or("Missing fixture parent")?;
        if !parent.canonicalize()?.starts_with(scratch.canonicalize()?) {
            return Err("Unexpected storage symlink".into());
        }
        let cache = parent
            .parent()
            .ok_or("Missing cache parent")?
            .join("remotecache.vdf");
        let original = std::fs::read_to_string(&cache)?;
        if !original.contains(name.to_str()?) {
            return Err("Expected initialized native cache record".into());
        }
        let renamed = c"obelisk-offline-probe-renamed.dat";
        let destination = parent.join(renamed.to_str()?);
        if destination.try_exists()? {
            return Err("Renamed fixture already exists".into());
        }
        std::fs::rename(&fixture_path, &destination)?;
        let mut file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
            .write(true)
            .truncate(true)
            .open(cache)?;
        file.write_all(
            original
                .replace(name.to_str()?, renamed.to_str()?)
                .as_bytes(),
        )?;
        file.sync_all()?;
        name = renamed;
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({"event": "obelisk_renamed_fixture_and_cache", "direct_read_matches": std::fs::read(destination)? == PAYLOAD}),
        )?;
        load_cache(output, storage, base, engine, pipe)?;
    }
    let address = method(storage, base, 18, 0x8fd370)?;
    // SAFETY: the pinned public adapter calls private FileCount with AppID and
    // a one-byte true option, reproduced here; no buffers are involved.
    let file_count = unsafe {
        let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, u32, u8) -> i32 = std::mem::transmute(address);
        call(storage, APP, 1)
    };
    report(
        output,
        serde_json::json!({"event": "file_count", "value": file_count}),
    )?;
    read_fixture(output, storage, base, name, PAYLOAD)?;
    if file_count != 1 {
        return Err("Expected exactly one indexed fixture".into());
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn load_cache(
    output: &mut std::fs::File,
    storage: *mut c_void,
    base: usize,
    engine: &abi::Engine,
    pipe: i32,
) -> Result<()> {
    let address = method(storage, base, 70, 0x902cb4)?;
    // SAFETY: pinned proxy sends one AppID scalar and has no return payload.
    unsafe {
        let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, u32) = std::mem::transmute(address);
        call(storage, 480);
    }
    report(output, serde_json::json!({"event": "cache_load_requested"}))?;
    // This bounded callback window is not a completion contract. The caller's
    // actual read assertions determine whether the fixture became visible.
    let start = std::time::Instant::now();
    let mut callbacks = 0;
    while start.elapsed() < std::time::Duration::from_secs(2) {
        if engine.callback(pipe).is_some() {
            callbacks += 1;
        }
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(10));
    }
    report(
        output,
        serde_json::json!({"event": "cache_observation_window", "milliseconds": 2000, "callbacks": callbacks}),
    )
}

fn read_fixture(
    output: &mut std::fs::File,
    storage: *mut c_void,
    base: usize,
    name: &std::ffi::CStr,
    payload: &[u8],
) -> Result<()> {
    let address = method(storage, base, 5, 0x8fbd48)?;
    let mut bytes = [0_u8; 256];
    // SAFETY: same verified argument layout as FileWrite; output is bounded by
    // this buffer's length. The returned count is checked before slicing.
    let count = unsafe {
        let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(
            *mut c_void,
            u32,
            u32,
            *const std::ffi::c_char,
            *mut u8,
            u32,
        ) -> i32 = std::mem::transmute(address);
        call(
            storage,
            480,
            0,
            name.as_ptr(),
            bytes.as_mut_ptr(),
            bytes.len() as u32,
        )
    };
    let matched = count == payload.len() as i32 && bytes.get(..count as usize) == Some(payload);
    report(
        output,
        serde_json::json!({"event": "file_read", "name": name.to_str()?, "bytes": count, "matches_fixture": matched}),
    )?;
    if !matched {
        return Err("Offline fixture read did not match".into());
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn inventory(object: *mut c_void, base: usize, count: usize) -> Result<Vec<serde_json::Value>> {
    let mut methods = Vec::new();
    // SAFETY: only the interfaces obtained above reach this helper. Their
    // verified vtables have at least count entries; no method is invoked here.
    unsafe {
        let table = *object.cast::<*const *const c_void>();
        if table.is_null() {
            return Err("Null client vtable".into());
        }
        for slot in 0..count {
            let address = *table.add(slot);
            let mut info: libc::Dl_info = std::mem::zeroed();
            if libc::dladdr(address, &mut info) == 0 || info.dli_fbase as usize != base {
                return Err("Unexpected client vtable image".into());
            }
            methods.push(serde_json::json!({"slot": slot, "offset": format!("0x{:x}", address as usize - base)}));
        }
    }
    Ok(methods)
}

fn method(object: *mut c_void, base: usize, slot: usize, offset: usize) -> Result<*const c_void> {
    let entry = &inventory(object, base, slot + 1)?[slot];
    if entry["offset"] != format!("0x{offset:x}") {
        return Err("Unrecognized Cloud probe ABI; refusing call".into());
    }
    // SAFETY: inventory checked this entry and its owning image above.
    Ok(unsafe { *(*object.cast::<*const *const c_void>()).add(slot) })
}

fn report(output: &mut std::fs::File, value: serde_json::Value) -> Result<()> {
    serde_json::to_writer(&mut *output, &value)?;
    output.write_all(b"\n")?;
    output.flush()?;
    Ok(())
}
```

`crates/steam-native/examples/cloud_storage_probe/live_storage.rs`:

```rs
//! Disposable, in-process private/public storage coherence experiment.
use super::{load_cache, method, read_fixture, report};
use obelisk_steam_native::{Result, abi};
use std::{
    ffi::{CStr, c_char, c_void},
    fs::File,
    path::Path,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

const APP: u32 = 480;
const ORIGINAL: &CStr = c"obelisk-offline-probe.dat";
const LIVE: &CStr = c"obelisk-offline-live.dat";
const FIRST: &[u8] = b"Obelisk offline RemoteStorage fixture v1\n";
const UPDATED: &[u8] = b"Obelisk offline RemoteStorage fixture v2 - changed length\n";

pub(super) fn prepare_pipe_app(output: &mut File, utils: *mut c_void, base: usize) -> Result<()> {
    let get = method(utils, base, 19, 0x8cc76c)?;
    let set = method(utils, base, 18, 0x8cc5c8)?;
    // SAFETY: pinned Utils proxies serialize no input for GetAppID and u32/u8
    // for SetAppIDForCurrentPipe; both decode four-byte results. The dispatch
    // tables independently identify slots 19/18. Fixture-only option 0 has no
    // assumed production meaning. Re-query before obtaining public interfaces.
    let (before, result, after) = unsafe {
        let get: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void) -> u32 = std::mem::transmute(get);
        let set: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, u32, u8) -> u32 = std::mem::transmute(set);
        let before = get(utils);
        let result = set(utils, APP, 0);
        (before, result, get(utils))
    };
    report(
        output,
        serde_json::json!({"event":"fixture_pipe_app", "before":before, "result":result, "after":after, "option":0}),
    )?;
    if after != APP {
        return Err("Public fixture pipe has the wrong AppID".into());
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) struct Storage {
    private: *mut c_void,
    public: *mut c_void,
    base: usize,
}

impl Storage {
    pub(super) fn new(private: *mut c_void, public: *mut c_void, base: usize) -> Self {
        Self {
            private,
            public,
            base,
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn run(
        &self,
        output: &mut File,
        mode: &str,
        scratch: &Path,
        engine: &abi::Engine,
        pipe: i32,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        if std::env::var_os("OBELISK_CLOUD_PROBE_IDENTITY").is_none() {
            return Err("Live mutation requires the disconnected test identity".into());
        }
        let app = scratch.join("home/Library/Application Support/Steam/userdata/1/480");
        load_cache(output, self.private, self.base, engine, pipe)?;
        let mut callbacks = Vec::new();
        if mode == "live-mutate" {
            self.write(output, ORIGINAL, FIRST, false)?;
            self.read_both(output, ORIGINAL, FIRST)?;
            self.write(output, ORIGINAL, UPDATED, true)?;
            self.read_both(output, ORIGINAL, UPDATED)?;
            self.write(output, LIVE, UPDATED, false)?;
            self.read_both(output, LIVE, UPDATED)?;
            self.delete(output, ORIGINAL)?;
            self.check_final(output, &app)?;
            let started = Instant::now();
            let mut checkpoint = false;
            while started.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(5) {
                if let Some((id, size)) = engine.callback(pipe) {
                    callbacks.push(serde_json::json!({"id":id,"size":size}));
                }
                if std::fs::read_to_string(app.join("remotecache.vdf")).is_ok_and(|cache| {
                    fixture_record_has(
                        &cache,
                        LIVE,
                        "sha",
                        "bd8f4fcb8d3ed72a2528e880e879697129768fa3",
                    ) && fixture_record_has(&cache, LIVE, "size", "56")
                        && fixture_record_has(&cache, ORIGINAL, "persiststate", "2")
                }) {
                    checkpoint = true;
                    break;
                }
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
            }
            report(
                output,
                serde_json::json!({"event":"live_cache_checkpoint", "record_present":checkpoint, "wait_milliseconds":started.elapsed().as_millis()}),
            )?;
            if !checkpoint {
                return Err("Live index checkpoint not observed".into());
            }
        } else {
            self.check_final(output, &app)?;
        }
        let address = method(self.private, self.base, 85, 0x904368)?;
        // SAFETY: pinned private GetLocalFileChangeCount takes AppID and returns u32.
        let changes = unsafe {
            let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, u32) -> u32 = std::mem::transmute(address);
            call(self.private, APP)
        };
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({"event":"local_file_change_count", "value":changes}),
        )?;
        // Observe callback metadata, not payloads, without inventing notification IDs.
        let started = Instant::now();
        while started.elapsed() < Duration::from_millis(500) {
            if let Some((id, size)) = engine.callback(pipe) {
                callbacks.push(serde_json::json!({"id":id,"size":size}));
            }
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
        }
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({"event":"post_mutation_callbacks", "callbacks":callbacks}),
        )?;
        let cache = std::fs::read_to_string(app.join("remotecache.vdf"))?;
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({"event":"fixture_native_index", "vdf":cache}),
        )
    }

    fn write(&self, output: &mut File, name: &CStr, payload: &[u8], public: bool) -> Result<()> {
        let result = if public {
            let address = method(self.public, self.base, 0, 0x7e22d0)?;
            // SAFETY: public FileWrite takes filename, bytes, i32 size and returns bool.
            unsafe {
                let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *const c_char, *const u8, i32) -> bool =
                    std::mem::transmute(address);
                u32::from(call(
                    self.public,
                    name.as_ptr(),
                    payload.as_ptr(),
                    payload.len() as i32,
                ))
            }
        } else {
            let address = method(self.private, self.base, 0, 0x8fb410)?;
            // SAFETY: guarded private FileWrite ABI established by the public adapter.
            unsafe {
                let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(
                    *mut c_void,
                    u32,
                    i32,
                    *const c_char,
                    *const u8,
                    i32,
                ) -> u32 = std::mem::transmute(address);
                call(
                    self.private,
                    APP,
                    0,
                    name.as_ptr(),
                    payload.as_ptr(),
                    payload.len() as i32,
                )
            }
        };
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({"event":"live_write", "interface":if public {"public"} else {"private"}, "name":name.to_str()?, "bytes":payload.len(), "result":result}),
        )?;
        if result != 1 {
            return Err("Live fixture write rejected".into());
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn read_both(&self, output: &mut File, name: &CStr, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {
        read_fixture(output, self.private, self.base, name, payload)?;
        let address = method(self.public, self.base, 1, 0x7e232c)?;
        let mut bytes = [0_u8; 256];
        // SAFETY: published FileRead signature, writable bounded buffer and checked result.
        let count = unsafe {
            let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *const c_char, *mut u8, i32) -> i32 =
                std::mem::transmute(address);
            call(
                self.public,
                name.as_ptr(),
                bytes.as_mut_ptr(),
                bytes.len() as i32,
            )
        };
        let matched = count == payload.len() as i32 && bytes.get(..count as usize) == Some(payload);
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({"event":"public_file_read", "name":name.to_str()?, "bytes":count, "matches_fixture":matched}),
        )?;
        if !matched {
            return Err("Public fixture read did not match".into());
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn delete(&self, output: &mut File, name: &CStr) -> Result<()> {
        let address = method(self.private, self.base, 7, 0x8fc0f0)?;
        // SAFETY: proxy serializes AppID/root/name and decodes one-byte bool.
        // Public adapter 0x7e24ec forwards the same arguments to private slot 7.
        let deleted = unsafe {
            let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, u32, i32, *const c_char) -> bool =
                std::mem::transmute(address);
            call(self.private, APP, 0, name.as_ptr())
        };
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({"event":"private_file_delete", "name":name.to_str()?, "accepted":deleted}),
        )?;
        if !deleted {
            return Err("Fixture deletion rejected".into());
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn check_final(&self, output: &mut File, app: &Path) -> Result<()> {
        self.read_both(output, LIVE, UPDATED)?;
        let address = method(self.public, self.base, 13, 0x7e2658)?;
        // SAFETY: published FileExists signature and pinned public adapter.
        let original_exists = unsafe {
            let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, *const c_char) -> bool =
                std::mem::transmute(address);
            call(self.public, ORIGINAL.as_ptr())
        };
        let address = method(self.public, self.base, 18, 0x7e2784)?;
        // SAFETY: published GetFileCount signature, no additional arguments.
        let count = unsafe {
            let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void) -> i32 = std::mem::transmute(address);
            call(self.public)
        };
        let direct_matches = std::fs::read(app.join("remote").join(LIVE.to_str()?))? == UPDATED;
        let original_on_disk = app.join("remote").join(ORIGINAL.to_str()?).try_exists()?;
        report(
            output,
            serde_json::json!({"event":"live_final_state", "file_count":count, "deleted_file_visible":original_exists, "deleted_file_on_disk":original_on_disk, "direct_read_matches":direct_matches}),
        )?;
        if original_exists || original_on_disk || count != 1 || !direct_matches {
            return Err("Unexpected final live storage state".into());
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

// This is a predicate for two fixed probe filenames in native fixture output,
// not a general VDF parser or a production cache-format implementation.
fn fixture_record_has(cache: &str, name: &CStr, key: &str, value: &str) -> bool {
    let Some((_, record)) = cache.split_once(&format!("\"{}\"", name.to_str().unwrap())) else {
        return false;
    };
    let Some((record, _)) = record.split_once('}') else {
        return false;
    };
    let words: Vec<_> = record.split_whitespace().collect();
    words
        .windows(2)
        .any(|pair| pair[0].trim_matches('"') == key && pair[1].trim_matches('"') == value)
}
```

`crates/steam-native/examples/cloud_storage_probe/sync_controls.rs`:

```rs
//! Observe explicit sync admission, offline failure and cancellation, not transfers.
use super::{method, report};
use obelisk_steam_native::{Result, abi::Callback, native::Library, symbol};
use std::{
    ffi::c_void,
    fs::File,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

pub(super) fn run(
    output: &mut File,
    storage: *mut c_void,
    base: usize,
    pipe: i32,
    library: &Library,
    mode: &str,
) -> Result<()> {
    if std::env::var_os("OBELISK_CLOUD_PROBE_IDENTITY").is_none() {
        return Err("Sync control fixture requires the disconnected test identity".into());
    }
    let next = symbol!(
        library,
        c"Steam_BGetCallback",
        unsafe extern "C" fn(i32, *mut Callback) -> bool
    );
    let free = symbol!(
        library,
        c"Steam_FreeLastCallback",
        unsafe extern "C" fn(i32)
    );
    let direction = if mode == "sync-upload" { 2 } else { 1 };
    let expected_id = if direction == 1 { 1_250_001 } else { 1_250_002 };
    let address = method(storage, base, 78, 0x90393c)?;
    // SAFETY: pinned proxy encodes AppID u32, direction u32, options u64.
    // Server maps 1 to client/download completion and 2 to server/upload.
    // Zero options sets no auxiliary bits. All external network is denied.
    let accepted = unsafe {
        let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, u32, u32, u64) -> bool =
            std::mem::transmute(address);
        call(storage, 480, direction, 0)
    };
    report(
        output,
        serde_json::json!({"event":"sync_request", "direction":direction, "options":0, "accepted":accepted}),
    )?;
    if mode == "sync-cancel" {
        let address = method(storage, base, 84, 0x904220)?;
        // SAFETY: no-argument private cancellation proxy. This disposable
        // runtime owns only this fixture; cancellation is NOT per-app scoped.
        unsafe {
            let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void) = std::mem::transmute(address);
            call(storage);
        }
        report(output, serde_json::json!({"event":"sync_cancel_requested"}))?;
    }
    let started = Instant::now();
    let mut completed = false;
    let mut outcome = None;
    let mut previous = None;
    while started.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(5) {
        let address = method(storage, base, 79, 0x903af8)?;
        // SAFETY: pinned IsAppSyncInProgress proxy accepts AppID and returns bool.
        let active = unsafe {
            let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void, u32) -> bool = std::mem::transmute(address);
            call(storage, 480)
        };
        if previous != Some(active) {
            report(
                output,
                serde_json::json!({"event":"sync_in_progress", "value":active}),
            )?;
            previous = Some(active);
        }
        let mut callback = Callback::default();
        // SAFETY: exported callback API and existing 24-byte CallbackMsg layout.
        // Only exact statically established ID/size pairs may expose bytes.
        // Copy before freeing once; unknown events are represented by metadata.
        let event = unsafe {
            if next(pipe, &mut callback) {
                let recognized = matches!(
                    (callback.id, callback.size),
                    (1_250_001 | 1_250_002, 12) | (1_250_005 | 1_250_006, 8)
                );
                let words = if recognized && !callback.data.is_null() {
                    let bytes = std::slice::from_raw_parts(callback.data, callback.size as usize);
                    Some(
                        bytes
                            .as_chunks::<4>()
                            .0
                            .iter()
                            .map(|word| u32::from_le_bytes(*word))
                            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
                    )
                } else {
                    None
                };
                let event = (callback.id, callback.size, words);
                free(pipe);
                Some(event)
            } else {
                None
            }
        };
        if let Some((id, size, words)) = event {
            report(
                output,
                serde_json::json!({"event":"sync_callback", "id":id, "size":size, "raw_u32":words}),
            )?;
            if id == expected_id
                && let Some(words) = words
                && words[0] == 480
            {
                completed = true;
                outcome = Some(words[1]);
            }
        }
        if completed && !active {
            break;
        }
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
    }
    report(
        output,
        serde_json::json!({"event":"offline_sync_observation", "callback_observed":completed, "result_word":outcome, "idle":previous == Some(false), "milliseconds":started.elapsed().as_millis()}),
    )?;
    if !accepted || !completed || previous != Some(false) {
        return Err("Offline sync control contract not observed".into());
    }
    // This fixture has no remote connection. A success word would need a new
    // explanation; it must never be counted as an uploaded/downloaded fixture.
    if outcome == Some(1) {
        return Err("Unexpected success in the disconnected sync fixture".into());
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

`crates/steam-native/src/abi.rs`:

```rs
//! Pinned private C++ object layout, called using macOS ARM64's C calling ABI.
//! No C++ source, compiler, runtime shim, or historical interface declarations.
use crate::{Result, native::Library, symbol};
use std::ffi::{CStr, c_char, c_void};
use std::ptr::NonNull;

type Object = *mut c_void;
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Callback {
    pub user: i32,
    pub id: i32,
    pub data: *mut u8,
    pub size: i32,
}
const _: () = assert!(std::mem::size_of::<Callback>() == 24);

struct Interface {
    object: NonNull<c_void>,
    image_base: usize,
}
impl Interface {
    fn method(&self, slot: usize, offset: usize) -> Result<*mut c_void> {
        // SAFETY: Interface is constructed only from the hash-pinned Valve
        // factory/user accessor. Its first pointer is the verified C++ vtable;
        // Callers use slots established in the research report and archived at
        // docs/evidence/steam-native-research/user-abi-map.json (repository root).
        unsafe {
            let table = *self.object.as_ptr().cast::<*const *mut c_void>();
            if table.is_null() {
                return Err("Null native vtable".into());
            }
            let address = *table.add(slot);
            let mut info: libc::Dl_info = std::mem::zeroed();
            if libc::dladdr(address, &mut info) == 0
                || info.dli_fbase as usize != self.image_base
                || (address as usize).checked_sub(self.image_base) != Some(offset)
            {
                return Err(
                    format!("Unrecognized internal ABI at slot {slot}; refusing call").into(),
                );
            }
            Ok(address)
        }
    }
}

pub struct Engine {
    interface: Interface,
    create_pipe: unsafe extern "C" fn() -> i32,
    create_global: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut i32) -> i32,
    connect_global: unsafe extern "C" fn(i32) -> i32,
    release_pipe: unsafe extern "C" fn(i32) -> bool,
    release_user: unsafe extern "C" fn(i32, i32),
    connected: unsafe extern "C" fn(i32, i32) -> bool,
    logged_on: unsafe extern "C" fn(i32, i32) -> bool,
    next: unsafe extern "C" fn(i32, *mut Callback) -> bool,
    free: unsafe extern "C" fn(i32),
}

impl Engine {
    pub fn open(path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<Self> {
        crate::pinned_client(path)?;
        let lib = Library::open(path)?;
        println!("dlopen=ok");
        let factory = symbol!(
            lib,
            c"CreateInterface",
            unsafe extern "C" fn(*const c_char, *mut i32) -> Object
        );
        let mut engine = std::ptr::null_mut();
        for name in [
            c"SteamClient023",
            c"SteamClient020",
            c"CLIENTENGINE_INTERFACE_VERSION005",
        ] {
            let mut code = -1;
            // SAFETY: factory export signature; static version strings and valid output scalar.
            let object = unsafe { factory(name.as_ptr(), &mut code) };
            println!("factory name={} code={code}", name.to_string_lossy());
            if name == c"CLIENTENGINE_INTERFACE_VERSION005" {
                engine = object;
            }
        }
        let object = NonNull::new(engine).ok_or("Client engine interface unavailable")?;
        // SAFETY: dladdr accepts the exported factory pointer and initialized output.
        let base = unsafe {
            let mut info: libc::Dl_info = std::mem::zeroed();
            if libc::dladdr(factory as *const c_void, &mut info) == 0 {
                return Err("Cannot identify engine image".into());
            }
            info.dli_fbase as usize
        };
        Ok(Self {
            interface: Interface {
                object,
                image_base: base,
            },
            create_pipe: symbol!(lib, c"Steam_CreateSteamPipe", unsafe extern "C" fn() -> i32),
            create_global: symbol!(
                lib,
                c"Steam_CreateGlobalUser",
                unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut i32) -> i32
            ),
            connect_global: symbol!(
                lib,
                c"Steam_ConnectToGlobalUser",
                unsafe extern "C" fn(i32) -> i32
            ),
            release_pipe: symbol!(
                lib,
                c"Steam_BReleaseSteamPipe",
                unsafe extern "C" fn(i32) -> bool
            ),
            release_user: symbol!(lib, c"Steam_ReleaseUser", unsafe extern "C" fn(i32, i32)),
            connected: symbol!(
                lib,
                c"Steam_BConnected",
                unsafe extern "C" fn(i32, i32) -> bool
            ),
            logged_on: symbol!(
                lib,
                c"Steam_BLoggedOn",
                unsafe extern "C" fn(i32, i32) -> bool
            ),
            next: symbol!(
                lib,
                c"Steam_BGetCallback",
                unsafe extern "C" fn(i32, *mut Callback) -> bool
            ),
            free: symbol!(lib, c"Steam_FreeLastCallback", unsafe extern "C" fn(i32)),
        })
    }
    pub fn pipe(&self) -> i32 {
        // SAFETY: verified export with no arguments.
        unsafe { (self.create_pipe)() }
    }
    pub fn global(&self) -> (i32, i32) {
        let mut pipe = 0;
        // SAFETY: pinned export takes exactly one pointer, as confirmed by its wrapper.
        let user = unsafe { (self.create_global)(&mut pipe) };
        (user, pipe)
    }
    pub fn connect(&self, pipe: i32) -> i32 {
        // SAFETY: scalar handle returned by this engine; export validates handles.
        unsafe { (self.connect_global)(pipe) }
    }
    pub fn connected(&self, user: i32, pipe: i32) -> bool {
        // SAFETY: scalar handles returned by this engine.
        unsafe { (self.connected)(user, pipe) }
    }
    pub fn logged_on(&self, user: i32, pipe: i32) -> bool {
        // SAFETY: scalar handles returned by this engine.
        unsafe { (self.logged_on)(user, pipe) }
    }
    pub fn release(&self, user: i32, pipe: i32) {
        // SAFETY: release order matches exported API; zero handles are ignored.
        unsafe {
            if user != 0 {
                (self.release_user)(pipe, user);
            }
            if pipe != 0 {
                (self.release_pipe)(pipe);
            }
        }
    }
    pub fn callback(&self, pipe: i32) -> Option<(i32, i32)> {
        let mut event = Callback::default();
        // SAFETY: verified CallbackMsg_t layout; the borrowed payload is never
        // accessed, and every retrieved callback is freed exactly once.
        unsafe {
            if !(self.next)(pipe, &mut event) {
                return None;
            }
            let metadata = (event.id, event.size);
            (self.free)(pipe);
            Some(metadata)
        }
    }
    /// The next callback's id, freed at once. Only a payload `wanted` names,
    /// by id and exact size, is copied out first.
    pub fn callback_payload(
        &self,
        pipe: i32,
        wanted: &[(i32, usize)],
    ) -> Option<(i32, Option<Vec<u8>>)> {
        let mut event = Callback::default();
        // SAFETY: verified CallbackMsg_t layout. The engine's payload stays
        // valid until Steam_FreeLastCallback; it is read only when its id and
        // size match a requested layout, within the size the engine gave,
        // and every retrieved callback is freed exactly once.
        unsafe {
            if !(self.next)(pipe, &mut event) {
                return None;
            }
            let payload = match usize::try_from(event.size) {
                Ok(size) if !event.data.is_null() && wanted.contains(&(event.id, size)) => {
                    Some(std::slice::from_raw_parts(event.data, size).to_vec())
                }
                _ => None,
            };
            let id = event.id;
            (self.free)(pipe);
            Some((id, payload))
        }
    }
    pub fn user(&self, user: i32, pipe: i32) -> Result<ClientUser> {
        let address = self.interface.method(8, 0xa02be8)?;
        // SAFETY: pinned GetIClientUser slot, verified to take this,user,pipe.
        let object = unsafe {
            let get: unsafe extern "C" fn(Object, i32, i32) -> Object =
                std::mem::transmute(address);
            get(self.interface.object.as_ptr(), user, pipe)
        };
        Ok(ClientUser(Interface {
            object: NonNull::new(object).ok_or("Client user interface unavailable")?,
            image_base: self.interface.image_base,
        }))
    }
    pub fn friends(&self, user: i32, pipe: i32) -> Result<ClientFriends> {
        let address = self.interface.method(13, 0xa02cb4)?;
        // SAFETY: pinned Engine005 accessor takes this,user,pipe and returns
        // the Friends proxy constructed in the same native session. Evidence:
        // docs/evidence/steam-native-presence-abi.md.
        let object = unsafe {
            let get: unsafe extern "C" fn(Object, i32, i32) -> Object =
                std::mem::transmute(address);
            get(self.interface.object.as_ptr(), user, pipe)
        };
        Ok(ClientFriends(Interface {
            object: NonNull::new(object).ok_or("Client friends interface unavailable")?,
            image_base: self.interface.image_base,
        }))
    }
    /// `GetIClientUtils(pipe)`: the per-pipe Utils proxy that
    /// `Steam_CreateSteamPipe` registered for `pipe`.
    fn utils(&self, pipe: i32) -> Result<ClientUtils> {
        let address = self.interface.method(14, 0xa04d74)?;
        // SAFETY: pinned Engine005 accessor takes this,pipe and returns the
        // Utils proxy its CreateSteamPipe (0xa01e00, insert at 0xa01f94)
        // stored for that pipe. Only a pipe this engine just created reaches it.
        let object = unsafe {
            let get: unsafe extern "C" fn(Object, i32) -> Object = std::mem::transmute(address);
            get(self.interface.object.as_ptr(), pipe)
        };
        Ok(ClientUtils(Interface {
            object: NonNull::new(object).ok_or("Client utils interface unavailable")?,
            image_base: self.interface.image_base,
        }))
    }
    /// `GetIClientMatchmaking(user, pipe)`.
    fn matchmaking(&self, user: i32, pipe: i32) -> Result<ClientMatchmaking> {
        let address = self.interface.method(16, 0xa02d80)?;
        // SAFETY: pinned Engine005 accessor takes this,user,pipe, as Friends'
        // slot 13 does, and returns the Matchmaking proxy (vtable 0x1742d70)
        // of the interface set ConnectToGlobalUser built for them.
        let object = unsafe {
            let get: unsafe extern "C" fn(Object, i32, i32) -> Object =
                std::mem::transmute(address);
            get(self.interface.object.as_ptr(), user, pipe)
        };
        Ok(ClientMatchmaking(Interface {
            object: NonNull::new(object).ok_or("Client matchmaking interface unavailable")?,
            image_base: self.interface.image_base,
        }))
    }
    /// Whether the account is in `lobby` of game `app` now, as the engine's
    /// matchmaking shows it; `None` when it could not be asked this time.
    ///
    /// The engine answers a matchmaking call only for its pipe's AppID (0 on
    /// the host's own pipe), from the per-app object the game's pipe shares.
    /// So the question goes through a pipe of its own, set to `app` without
    /// process tracking, and released at once: kept open, that pipe would
    /// hold the game's lobbies after the game quits, since the engine leaves
    /// them only when the last pipe of the app goes.
    pub fn in_lobby(&self, app: u32, lobby: u64) -> Result<Option<bool>> {
        let pipe = self.pipe();
        if pipe == 0 {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        let user = self.connect(pipe);
        let answer = (|| {
            if user == 0 || self.utils(pipe)?.set_app_for_pipe(app)? != app {
                return Ok(None);
            }
            // The engine gives 0 for a lobby the account is not in, and a
            // lobby's member is an individual account.
            let first = self.matchmaking(user, pipe)?.lobby_member(lobby, 0)?;
            Ok(Some(game_runtime::protocol::individual(first)))
        })();
        // Lobby updates of the game's AppID may reach this pipe meanwhile.
        while self.callback(pipe).is_some() {}
        self.release(user, pipe);
        answer
    }
    pub fn request_app_info(&self, user: i32, pipe: i32, app: u32) -> Result<()> {
        let address = self.interface.method(17, 0xa02e4c)?;
        // SAFETY: pinned Engine005 Apps accessor and RequestAppInfoUpdate ABI
        // independently documented in steam-cloud-gamenative-bootstrap.md.
        let object = unsafe {
            let get: unsafe extern "C" fn(Object, i32, i32) -> Object =
                std::mem::transmute(address);
            get(self.interface.object.as_ptr(), user, pipe)
        };
        let apps = Interface {
            object: NonNull::new(object).ok_or("Apps unavailable")?,
            image_base: self.interface.image_base,
        };
        let address = apps.method(7, 0x8dd498)?;
        // SAFETY: one live u32 AppID and count 1, pinned proxy takes a bool result.
        let accepted = unsafe {
            let request: unsafe extern "C" fn(Object, *const u32, i32) -> bool =
                std::mem::transmute(address);
            request(object, &app, 1)
        };
        if !accepted {
            return Err("App metadata request rejected".into());
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

pub struct ClientUser(Interface);
macro_rules! method {
    ($self:ident, $slot:expr, $offset:expr, ($($ty:ty),*) -> $ret:ty, $($arg:expr),* $(,)?) => {{
        let address = $self.0.method($slot, $offset)?;
        // SAFETY: signature and offset matched to the pinned proxy disassembly;
        // ARM64 macOS passes C++ this as the first pointer argument.
        unsafe {
            let call: unsafe extern "C" fn(Object, $($ty),*) -> $ret = std::mem::transmute(address);
            call($self.0.object.as_ptr(), $($arg),*)
        }
    }};
}
impl ClientUser {
    pub fn login_token(&self, token: &CStr, account: &CStr) -> Result<()> {
        method!(self, 56, 0x896610, (*const c_char, *const c_char) -> (), token.as_ptr(), account.as_ptr());
        Ok(())
    }
    pub fn log_on(&self, id: u64) -> Result<i32> {
        Ok(method!(self, 1, 0x890f10, (u64) -> i32, id))
    }
    pub fn steam_id(&self) -> Result<u64> {
        Ok(method!(self, 10, 0x891bf8, () -> u64,))
    }
    pub fn state(&self) -> Result<i32> {
        Ok(method!(self, 5, 0x8914dc, () -> i32,))
    }
    pub fn subscribed(&self, app: u32) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(method!(self, 181, 0x8a2a10, (u32) -> bool, app))
    }
    pub fn request_ticket(&self, app: u32) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(method!(self, 69, 0x897944, (u32, bool) -> bool, app, false))
    }
    pub fn ticket_length(&self, app: u32) -> Result<u32> {
        Ok(method!(self, 103, 0x89b004, (u32) -> u32, app))
    }
    /// `AuthorizeMicroTxn(order, answer)`: the player's answer to purchase
    /// `order` (`EMicroTxnAuthResponse`: 1 authorize, 2 deny). Returns the
    /// engine's API call handle, 0 when the call failed.
    pub fn authorize_microtxn(&self, order: u64, approve: bool) -> Result<u64> {
        // The pinned proxy 0x89fde4 (vtable 0x173fe80, names IClientUser and
        // AuthorizeMicroTxn at 0x89feb4/0x89febc) serializes the u64 from x1
        // and the u32 from w2, and returns the reply's 8 bytes. The server
        // dispatcher (hash 0x32506707 at 0x8004bc) reads 8 then 4 bytes and
        // calls CUser slot 152 (`ldr x8, [x8, #0x4c0]` at 0x8005ac); its
        // implementation 0xa6b950 queues CAPIJobAuthorizeMicroTxn with the
        // order at +0x1e0 and the answer at +0x1e8. That job (0xa7984c)
        // sends both in EMsg 5505 and, for answer 2 or an accepted answer,
        // drops the order and posts its dismissal (1020044, 0xa79a48).
        Ok(method!(self, 152, 0x89fde4, (u64, u32) -> u64, order, if approve { 1 } else { 2 }))
    }
}

struct ClientUtils(Interface);
impl ClientUtils {
    /// `SetAppIDForCurrentPipe(app, false)`, for this proxy's pipe: the
    /// AppID the engine then gives it, or 0 when the call failed.
    fn set_app_for_pipe(&self, app: u32) -> Result<u32> {
        // The pinned proxy 0x8cc5c8 serializes the u32 and one bool byte and
        // returns the reply's u32. Its server (0xa139f4) maps the calling pipe
        // to the AppID and, without tracking, returns it at once: no process
        // is attached and no game is reported started.
        Ok(method!(self, 18, 0x8cc5c8, (u32, bool) -> u32, app, false))
    }
}

struct ClientMatchmaking(Interface);
impl ClientMatchmaking {
    /// `GetLobbyMemberByIndex(lobby, index)`: 0 unless the account is in
    /// `lobby` and it has that many members.
    fn lobby_member(&self, lobby: u64, index: i32) -> Result<u64> {
        // The pinned proxy 0x8d81ac serializes the CSteamID by value and the
        // i32, and returns the reply's CSteamID, or 0 when the call failed.
        // Its server (0xabbab0) reads only the lobbies the user is in.
        Ok(method!(self, 18, 0x8d81ac, (u64, i32) -> u64, lobby, index))
    }
}

pub struct ClientFriends(Interface);
impl ClientFriends {
    pub fn set_presence(&self, online: bool) -> Result<()> {
        // The pinned proxy serializes one i32 and returns no value. Its server
        // dispatcher independently calls Friends slot 5 with that same scalar.
        method!(self, 5, 0x8b23a0, (i32) -> (), i32::from(online));
        Ok(())
    }
    /// `GetFriendGamePlayed(friend)`: the game `friend` plays as this engine
    /// knows it, or `None` when it knows none.
    pub fn game_played(&self, friend: u64) -> Result<Option<[u8; crate::lobby::SIZE]>> {
        let mut info = [0_u8; crate::lobby::SIZE];
        // The pinned proxy 0x8b4074 serializes the CSteamID by value (x1),
        // reads exactly 24 bytes of the reply into the buffer in x2, or
        // zeroes them, and returns the reply's bool.
        let played = method!(self, 23, 0x8b4074, (u64, *mut u8) -> bool, friend, info.as_mut_ptr());
        Ok(played.then_some(info))
    }
    /// `NotifyGameOverlayStateChanged(pid, app, active, user_initiated)`:
    /// tells game `app` Steam's overlay opened or closed over it.
    ///
    /// The pinned proxy 0x8c42bc (vtable 0x1741520 slot 192; names
    /// IClientFriends and NotifyGameOverlayStateChanged at 0x8c43bc/0x8c43c4)
    /// serializes w1 and w2 as u32, then w3 and w4 as one byte each, and
    /// decodes no value. Its server, CUserFriends slot 192 (0xa9dbdc),
    /// builds `GameOverlayActivated_t` (331, 12 bytes): active at 0,
    /// user_initiated at 1, w2 at 4 (the AppID) and w1 at 8 (the overlay's
    /// pid), and posts it to every pipe of the user, this host's included.
    pub fn overlay_state(
        &self,
        pid: u32,
        app: u32,
        active: bool,
        user_initiated: bool,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        method!(self, 192, 0x8c42bc, (u32, u32, bool, bool) -> (), pid, app, active, user_initiated);
        Ok(())
    }
    /// `NotifyLobbyJoinRequested(app, lobby, friend)`: game `app` gets
    /// `GameLobbyJoinRequested_t` (333), as when the player accepts
    /// `friend`'s lobby invitation in Steam's overlay.
    ///
    /// The pinned proxy 0x8c45e4 (slot 194; names NotifyLobbyJoinRequested
    /// at 0x8c46c4) serializes w1 as u32 and x2, x3 as CSteamIDs by value
    /// (0xcc430 writes the 8 bytes of x1), and decodes a one-byte result.
    /// Its server (0xa9ddcc) stores x2 at 0 and x3 at 8 and posts the 16
    /// bytes through 0x5c56a4, only to pipes whose AppID is w1.
    pub fn lobby_join_requested(&self, app: u32, lobby: u64, friend: u64) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(method!(self, 194, 0x8c45e4, (u32, u64, u64) -> bool, app, lobby, friend))
    }
    /// `NotifyRichPresenceJoinRequested(app, friend, connect)`: game `app`
    /// gets `GameRichPresenceJoinRequested_t` (337).
    ///
    /// The pinned proxy 0x8c4790 (slot 195; names
    /// NotifyRichPresenceJoinRequested at 0x8c4870) serializes w1 as u32, x2
    /// by value and x3 as a C string (0xcc1e4: strlen + 1 bytes after a length
    /// byte, 255 meaning NUL-terminated), and decodes a one-byte result. The
    /// dispatcher (0x819120) reads them back with 0xcc254 and calls slot 195
    /// (0x819228, offset 0x618); the server (0xa9ddfc) copies at most 256
    /// bytes of the string after the friend and posts 264 bytes to pipes
    /// whose AppID is w1.
    pub fn rich_presence_join_requested(
        &self,
        app: u32,
        friend: u64,
        connect: &CStr,
    ) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(
            method!(self, 195, 0x8c4790, (u32, u64, *const c_char) -> bool, app, friend, connect.as_ptr()),
        )
    }
}
```

`crates/steam-native/src/bin/obelisk-steam-host.rs`:

```rs
use game_runtime::protocol::{Event, Failure};
use obelisk_steam_native::{host, native};

fn main() {
    let code = run();
    // SAFETY: process exit owns the native engine's teardown. No unverified
    // private C++ shutdown/destructor ABI is invoked after Rust cleanup.
    unsafe { libc::_exit(code) }
}
fn run() -> i32 {
    if native::disable_core_dumps().is_err() || native::translated() {
        return 2;
    }
    let args: Vec<_> = std::env::args().collect();
    match args.get(1).map(String::as_str) {
        Some("process-identity") => return process_identity(args.get(2)),
        Some("supervise") => return supervise(),
        Some("epic-supervise") => return epic_supervise(),
        Some("gog-supervise") => return gog_supervise(),
        Some("game-exec") => {
            return i32::from(
                game_runtime::supervisor::exec::game_exec(std::io::stdin().lock()).is_err(),
            );
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    let Ok(mut output) = host::event_pipe() else {
        return 2;
    };
    let result = match args.get(1).map(String::as_str) {
        // Offline packaging validation: load pinned libraries and resolve the
        // engine factories only. No global user, credentials or network login.
        Some("verify-runtime") if args.len() == 3 => {
            Some(obelisk_steam_native::abi::Engine::open(args[2].as_ref()).map(|_| ()))
        }
        Some("engine") if args.len() == 6 && args[5] == "-nofriendsui" => args[3]
            .parse::<u32>()
            .ok()
            .map(|app| host::serve(args[2].as_ref(), app, &args[4], &mut output)),
        _ => None,
    };
    match result {
        Some(Ok(())) => 0,
        _ => {
            let _ = host::emit(
                &mut output,
                &Event::Failed {
                    reason: Failure::Engine,
                },
            );
            1
        }
    }
}

fn process_identity(argument: Option<&String>) -> i32 {
    let Some(pid) = argument.and_then(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok()) else {
        return 2;
    };
    let identity = native::process_identity(pid);
    if identity.is_none() && !native::process_is_absent(pid) {
        return 1;
    }
    use std::io::Write;
    let mut output = std::io::stdout().lock();
    let written = serde_json::to_writer(&mut output, &identity).is_ok()
        && output.write_all(b"\n").is_ok()
        && output.flush().is_ok();
    i32::from(!written)
}

/// Process inspection for a supervisor: a missing identity is absence only
/// when the kernel confirms it; otherwise it is uncertainty.
fn inspect(
    pid: u32,
) -> Result<Option<game_runtime::supervisor::Identity>, game_runtime::supervisor::Error> {
    let value = native::process_identity(pid);
    if value.is_none() && !native::process_is_absent(pid) {
        return Err(game_runtime::supervisor::Error::Unavailable);
    }
    Ok(value)
}

fn supervise() -> i32 {
    let served = native::detach_supervisor().is_ok()
        && game_runtime::steam::serve(std::io::stdin().lock(), std::io::stderr().lock(), inspect)
            .is_ok();
    i32::from(!served)
}

fn epic_supervise() -> i32 {
    let served = native::detach_supervisor().is_ok()
        && game_runtime::epic::serve(std::io::stdin().lock(), std::io::stderr().lock(), inspect)
            .is_ok();
    i32::from(!served)
}

fn gog_supervise() -> i32 {
    let served = native::detach_supervisor().is_ok()
        && game_runtime::gog::serve(std::io::stdin().lock(), std::io::stderr().lock(), inspect)
            .is_ok();
    i32::from(!served)
}
```

`crates/steam-native/src/bin/obelisk-steam-sdk.rs`:

```rs
//! Intel game exec handoff. Steamworks initialization belongs to the game.
//! Also translates D3DMetal ahead of the Linux engine's games.
use obelisk_steam_native::native;

fn main() {
    let code = run();
    // SAFETY: terminate this helper after failed exec without running teardown
    // for libraries inherited through the game's discovery environment.
    unsafe { libc::_exit(code) }
}

fn run() -> i32 {
    let arguments: Vec<_> = std::env::args_os().collect();
    if arguments.len() == 2 && arguments[1] == "exec-game" {
        // SETEXEC receives the game its supervisor admits and the environment
        // the supervisor spawned this helper with.
        let _ = native::exec_game();
        return 1;
    }
    if arguments.len() == 4 && arguments[1] == "warm-d3dmetal" {
        return if native::warm_d3dmetal(&arguments[2], &arguments[3]) {
            0
        } else {
            1
        };
    }
    2
}
```

`crates/steam-native/src/events.rs`:

```rs
use crate::Result;
use game_runtime::protocol::Event;
use std::{fs::File, io::Write};

/// Reserve the original stdout for our typed events, then discard all native
/// stdout/stderr before loading Valve. The private FD cannot reach a child exec.
pub fn event_pipe() -> Result<File> {
    use std::os::fd::{AsRawFd, FromRawFd};
    let null = File::options().write(true).open("/dev/null")?;
    // SAFETY: duplicate a valid pipe descriptor into an owned File, set close-on-
    // exec, and redirect only this helper's standard output/error descriptors.
    unsafe {
        let fd = libc::fcntl(1, libc::F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC, 3);
        if fd < 0 {
            return Err(std::io::Error::last_os_error().into());
        }
        let output = File::from_raw_fd(fd);
        if libc::dup2(null.as_raw_fd(), 1) < 0 || libc::dup2(null.as_raw_fd(), 2) < 0 {
            return Err(std::io::Error::last_os_error().into());
        }
        Ok(output)
    }
}
pub fn emit(output: &mut File, event: &Event) -> Result<()> {
    serde_json::to_writer(&mut *output, event)?;
    output.write_all(b"\n")?;
    output.flush()?;
    Ok(())
}
```

`crates/steam-native/src/host.rs`:

```rs
use crate::{
    Result,
    abi::{ClientFriends, ClientUser, Engine},
    lobby, mach, overlay, received,
};
use game_runtime::protocol::{Credentials, Event, Failure, HostCommand, OverlayDialog};
use std::{
    ffi::{CStr, CString},
    fs::File,
    sync::{
        Arc, Mutex,
        atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering},
    },
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};
use zeroize::Zeroizing;

pub use crate::events::{emit, event_pipe};

pub fn serve(
    engine_path: &std::path::Path,
    app: u32,
    service: &str,
    output: &mut File,
) -> Result<()> {
    if app == 0 || !service.starts_with("com.zagrios.obelisk.discovery.") || service.len() > 120 {
        return Err("Invalid native launch".into());
    }
    let credentials = Credentials::read(std::io::stdin().lock())?;
    let expected_id = credentials.steam_id;
    let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
    // No persona change until the supervisor has confirmed the game's exec.
    let presence = Arc::new(Mutex::new(None));
    let parent_closed = stop.clone();
    let requested_presence = presence.clone();
    // The player's other commands wait for the loop, which holds the engine.
    let (commands, player) = std::sync::mpsc::sync_channel(16);
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let mut input = std::io::stdin().lock();
        while let Ok(Some(command)) = HostCommand::read(&mut input) {
            match command {
                HostCommand::SetPresence { online } => {
                    *requested_presence.lock().unwrap() = Some(online);
                }
                command => {
                    if commands.send(command).is_err() {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        parent_closed.store(true, Ordering::Release);
    });
    let engine = Engine::open(engine_path)?;
    let (user, pipe) = engine.global();
    if user == 0 || pipe == 0 {
        return Err("Global user unavailable".into());
    }
    let client = engine.user(user, pipe)?;
    let friends = engine.friends(user, pipe)?;
    let mut token = Zeroizing::new(credentials.refresh_token.as_bytes().to_vec());
    token.push(0);
    let mut account = Zeroizing::new(credentials.account_name.as_bytes().to_vec());
    account.push(0);
    client.login_token(
        CStr::from_bytes_with_nul(&token)?,
        CStr::from_bytes_with_nul(&account)?,
    )?;
    drop(token);
    drop(account);
    drop(credentials);
    client.log_on(expected_id)?;
    let port = mach::ReceivePort::new()?;
    let _registration = port.register(CString::new(service)?)?;
    let executable = std::env::current_exe()?.canonicalize()?;
    use std::os::unix::ffi::OsStrExt;
    let path = executable.as_os_str().as_bytes();
    if path.len() >= 512 {
        return Err("Host path exceeds discovery limit".into());
    }
    let deadline = Instant::now();
    let mut observed_connection = false;
    let mut authenticated = false;
    let mut ready = false;
    let mut disconnected = false;
    let mut applied_presence = None;
    let mut last_check = Instant::now() - Duration::from_secs(1);
    let mut paths = 0_u32;
    let mut requests = overlay::Throttle::new(Duration::from_millis(500));
    let mut budget = overlay::Budget::new(8, Duration::from_secs(1));
    let mut lobbies = lobby::Lobbies::new();
    let mut overlay_active = false;
    let mut wanted = vec![(overlay::REQUESTED, overlay::SIZE)];
    wanted.extend(received::CALLBACKS);
    while !stop.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
        for _ in 0..100 {
            let Some((id, payload)) = engine.callback_payload(pipe, &wanted) else {
                break;
            };
            if id == 101 {
                observed_connection = true;
            }
            if id == 103 {
                observed_connection = false;
                applied_presence = None;
            }
            // The supervisor accepts no event before Ready. The engine echoes
            // the host's own overlay state (331) here too: it is not read.
            let (true, Some(payload)) = (ready, payload) else {
                continue;
            };
            if id == overlay::REQUESTED {
                let Some(request) = overlay::request(&payload, app) else {
                    continue;
                };
                // Even a coalesced request names the game's lobby now.
                if let OverlayDialog::LobbyInvite { lobby_id } = request {
                    lobbies.named(lobby_id);
                }
                if requests.admit(request.clone(), Instant::now()) {
                    emit(
                        output,
                        &Event::OverlayRequested {
                            app_id: app,
                            request,
                        },
                    )?;
                }
            } else if let Some(event) = received::event(id, &payload, app)
                && budget.admit(Instant::now())
            {
                emit(output, &event)?;
            }
        }
        // The player's commands, once the game's Steam is ready. A refused
        // call stops nothing: the game keeps its Steam.
        while let Ok(command) = player.try_recv() {
            if ready {
                let _ = perform(&friends, &client, app, &mut overlay_active, command);
            }
        }
        if last_check.elapsed() >= Duration::from_millis(250) {
            last_check = Instant::now();
            let online = engine.connected(user, pipe)
                && engine.logged_on(user, pipe)
                && observed_connection
                && client.steam_id()? == expected_id;
            if online {
                let requested = *presence.lock().unwrap();
                if let Some(wanted) = requested
                    && applied_presence != Some(wanted)
                {
                    friends.set_presence(wanted)?;
                    applied_presence = Some(wanted);
                }
            } else {
                applied_presence = None;
            }
            if online && !authenticated {
                authenticated = true;
                emit(output, &Event::Authenticated {})?;
                client.request_ticket(app)?;
                if std::env::var_os("OBELISK_STORAGE_METADATA").is_some() {
                    engine.request_app_info(user, pipe, app)?;
                }
            }
            if online && authenticated && !ready {
                let length = client.ticket_length(app)?;
                if client.subscribed(app)? && length > 0 {
                    ready = true;
                    emit(
                        output,
                        &Event::Ready {
                            app_id: app,
                            host_pid: std::process::id(),
                            ticket_bytes: length,
                        },
                    )?;
                }
            }
            if ready && !online && !disconnected {
                emit(output, &Event::Disconnected {})?;
                disconnected = true;
                lobbies.forget();
            }
            if online {
                if disconnected {
                    emit(output, &Event::Reconnected {})?;
                }
                disconnected = false;
            }
            let now = Instant::now();
            // A refused read stops its source, never the game's Steam.
            if ready
                && online
                && lobbies.due(now)
                && let Some(lobby_id) = lobbies.read(
                    now,
                    || {
                        let info = friends.game_played(expected_id)?;
                        Ok(info.and_then(|info| lobby::current(&info, app)))
                    },
                    |lobby| engine.in_lobby(app, lobby),
                )
            {
                emit(
                    output,
                    &Event::GameLobby {
                        app_id: app,
                        lobby_id,
                    },
                )?;
            }
        }
        if !ready && deadline.elapsed() > Duration::from_secs(45) {
            emit(
                output,
                &Event::Failed {
                    reason: if authenticated {
                        Failure::Ownership
                    } else {
                        Failure::Authentication
                    },
                },
            )?;
            break;
        }
        let mut request = mach::Message::default();
        let status = mach::receive(
            &mut request,
            port.0,
            std::mem::size_of::<mach::Message>() as u32,
            50,
        );
        if [mach::RECEIVE_TIMED_OUT, mach::RECEIVE_INTERRUPTED].contains(&status) {
            continue;
        }
        if status != 0 {
            return Err("Native discovery receive failed".into());
        }
        if !mach::valid_request(&request) {
            mach::destroy(&mut request);
            continue;
        }
        let mut reply = mach::Message::default();
        reply.header.bits = if request.header.bits & 0xff == 18 {
            18
        } else {
            17
        };
        reply.header.remote = request.header.remote;
        reply.header.id = 104;
        reply.opcode = request.opcode;
        if request.opcode == 100001 {
            reply.header.size = 32;
            reply.value = 104;
        } else {
            reply.header.size = 544;
            if ready {
                reply.value = std::process::id();
                reply.path[..path.len()].copy_from_slice(path);
            }
            paths = paths.saturating_add(1);
            // Bound event traffic; startup and first game discoveries are enough.
            if paths <= 8 {
                emit(output, &Event::Discovery { paths })?;
            }
        }
        if mach::send(&mut reply) != 0 {
            mach::destroy(&mut reply);
        }
    }
    if let Some(platforms) = std::env::var_os("OBELISK_STORAGE_METADATA") {
        let platforms: u32 = platforms
            .to_str()
            .and_then(|mask| mask.parse().ok())
            .ok_or("Native storage platform invalid")?;
        let home = std::env::var_os("HOME").ok_or("Native storage HOME missing")?;
        let cache = std::path::PathBuf::from(home).join(format!(
            "Library/Application Support/Steam/userdata/{}/{app}",
            expected_id as u32
        ));
        let started = Instant::now();
        while !game_runtime::native_cache_checkpoint(cache.clone(), app, platforms) {
            if started.elapsed() > Duration::from_millis(500) {
                return Err("Native storage index incomplete".into());
            }
            while engine.callback(pipe).is_some() {}
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
        }
    }
    engine.release(user, pipe);
    Ok(())
}

/// Carries out the player's `command` for game `app`. Steam's overlay always
/// opens before it closes: the game's Steam client drops a close it never saw
/// opened, so a close without an open, or the same state twice, is not sent.
fn perform(
    friends: &ClientFriends,
    client: &ClientUser,
    app: u32,
    overlay_active: &mut bool,
    command: HostCommand,
) -> Result<()> {
    if !command.valid() {
        return Err("Invalid host command".into());
    }
    match command {
        HostCommand::SetPresence { .. } => {}
        HostCommand::OverlayState {
            active,
            user_initiated,
        } => {
            if active != *overlay_active {
                // No overlay process exists: pid 0.
                friends.overlay_state(0, app, active, user_initiated)?;
                *overlay_active = active;
            }
        }
        HostCommand::AcceptLobbyInvite { lobby_id, friend } => {
            friends.lobby_join_requested(app, lobby_id, friend)?;
        }
        HostCommand::AcceptRichInvite { friend, connect } => {
            friends.rich_presence_join_requested(app, friend, &CString::new(connect)?)?;
        }
        HostCommand::AuthorizeMicroTxn { order_id, approve } => {
            client.authorize_microtxn(order_id, approve)?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
```
