`crates/steam-native/src/lobby.rs`:

```rs
//! The lobby the account's own engine shows its game in. Steam may never
//! publish a private lobby in the persona other sessions see, but the engine
//! hosting the game is the lobby's member. Two sources tell it:
//!
//! - The pinned engine's IClientFriends slot 23 `GetFriendGamePlayed` (proxy
//!   0x8b4074: this, CSteamID by value, a 24-byte out buffer, bool result;
//!   server 0xa8f3d4) fills `FriendGameInfo_t`: the CGameID at 0, the game
//!   server's address at 8 and the lobby's CSteamID at 16. For the account
//!   itself, that lobby is only the one Steam's persona carries (written by
//!   the persona-state job alone, 0x6068f0), so never a private lobby.
//! - The lobby the game named in its invite dialog (callback 1010001), kept
//!   while the engine's matchmaking shows the account in it
//!   (`Engine::in_lobby`), and forgotten once it does not.
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

/// `FriendGameInfo_t`'s size.
pub const SIZE: usize = 24;
/// How often the host reads it while the game runs.
pub const INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);

/// The lobby of game `app` in `info`, if the engine shows the account in
/// one. Another game, a mod or shortcut game id, or anything but a Chat
/// SteamID is no lobby of this game.
pub fn current(info: &[u8; SIZE], app: u32) -> Option<u64> {
    let game = u64::from_le_bytes(info[..8].try_into().ok()?);
    // CGameID: AppID in the low 24 bits, type 0 (app) above, no mod.
    if app == 0 || game != u64::from(app) {
        return None;
    }
    let lobby = u64::from_le_bytes(info[16..24].try_into().ok()?);
    game_runtime::protocol::lobby(lobby).then_some(lobby)
}

/// The game's lobby from both sources, read on the follower's interval.
pub struct Lobbies {
    follower: Follower,
    named: Option<u64>,
    /// Each source stops for good once the engine refuses its ABI; the other
    /// goes on.
    reads_played: bool,
    checks_named: bool,
}
impl Default for Lobbies {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}
impl Lobbies {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            follower: Follower::new(),
            named: None,
            reads_played: true,
            checks_named: true,
        }
    }
    /// The game named `lobby` in its invite dialog: it replaces any lobby
    /// named before, and the engine is read at once.
    pub fn named(&mut self, lobby: u64) {
        if game_runtime::protocol::lobby(lobby) {
            self.named = Some(lobby);
            self.follower.next = None;
        }
    }
    /// True when the engine is due another read.
    pub fn due(&self, now: Instant) -> bool {
        self.follower.due(now)
    }
    /// Reads the engine at `now`: `played` is slot 23's lobby, `member`
    /// whether the account is in a lobby the game named (`None` when it could
    /// not be asked). The lobby to tell when it changed.
    ///
    /// Slot 23's lobby comes first and spares the matchmaking question. A
    /// named lobby is told only while the engine shows the account in it;
    /// once it does not, it is forgotten, so a lobby the game left is never
    /// told again, even if the game stays in its title screen.
    pub fn read(
        &mut self,
        now: Instant,
        played: impl FnOnce() -> crate::Result<Option<u64>>,
        member: impl FnOnce(u64) -> crate::Result<Option<bool>>,
    ) -> Option<Option<u64>> {
        let played = if self.reads_played {
            played().unwrap_or_else(|_| {
                self.reads_played = false;
                None
            })
        } else {
            None
        };
        let current = played.or_else(|| self.confirmed(member));
        self.follower.read(now, current)
    }
    fn confirmed(
        &mut self,
        member: impl FnOnce(u64) -> crate::Result<Option<bool>>,
    ) -> Option<u64> {
        let lobby = self.named.filter(|_| self.checks_named)?;
        match member(lobby) {
            Ok(Some(true)) => Some(lobby),
            // Unknown this time: not told, still asked next time.
            Ok(None) => None,
            Ok(Some(false)) => {
                self.named = None;
                None
            }
            Err(_) => {
                self.checks_named = false;
                self.named = None;
                None
            }
        }
    }
    /// The engine lost Steam: the next read is told whatever it shows.
    pub fn forget(&mut self) {
        self.follower.forget();
    }
}

/// What the host last told of the lobby, and when it reads it next.
pub struct Follower {
    told: Option<Option<u64>>,
    next: Option<Instant>,
}
impl Default for Follower {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}
impl Follower {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            told: None,
            next: None,
        }
    }
    /// True when the engine is due another read.
    pub fn due(&self, now: Instant) -> bool {
        self.next.is_none_or(|next| now >= next)
    }
    /// Takes a read at `now`; the lobby to tell when it changed.
    pub fn read(&mut self, now: Instant, lobby: Option<u64>) -> Option<Option<u64>> {
        self.next = Some(now + INTERVAL);
        (self.told != Some(lobby)).then(|| {
            self.told = Some(lobby);
            lobby
        })
    }
    /// The engine lost Steam: the next read is told whatever it shows.
    pub fn forget(&mut self) {
        self.told = None;
        self.next = None;
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const PEAK: u32 = 3_527_290;
    const LOBBY: u64 = 109_775_244_421_126_053;

    /// The bytes the engine's server writes for a game in a lobby.
    fn info(game: u64, lobby: u64) -> [u8; SIZE] {
        let mut info = [0; SIZE];
        info[..8].copy_from_slice(&game.to_le_bytes());
        info[8..12].copy_from_slice(&0x0a00_0001_u32.to_le_bytes());
        info[12..14].copy_from_slice(&27015_u16.to_le_bytes());
        info[16..].copy_from_slice(&lobby.to_le_bytes());
        info
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_games_lobby_is_its_chat_steam_id() {
        assert_eq!(current(&info(u64::from(PEAK), LOBBY), PEAK), Some(LOBBY));
        assert_eq!(current(&info(u64::from(PEAK), 0), PEAK), None, "no lobby");
        assert_eq!(
            current(&info(u64::from(PEAK), 76_561_197_960_265_729), PEAK),
            None,
            "an account is no lobby"
        );
        assert_eq!(current(&info(730, LOBBY), PEAK), None, "another game");
        assert_eq!(
            current(&info(u64::from(PEAK) | 2 << 24, LOBBY), PEAK),
            None,
            "a shortcut's game id"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            current(&info(u64::from(PEAK) | 1 << 32, LOBBY), PEAK),
            None,
            "a mod"
        );
        assert_eq!(current(&info(0, LOBBY), 0), None, "no game");
        assert_eq!(current(&[0; SIZE], PEAK), None, "the engine's empty answer");
    }

    const ALICE: u64 = 76_561_197_960_265_729;
    const NEXT: u64 = 109_775_244_423_207_541;

    fn none() -> crate::Result<Option<u64>> {
        Ok(None)
    }

    fn unasked(_: u64) -> crate::Result<Option<bool>> {
        panic!("the named lobby is not asked")
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_named_lobby_is_told_while_the_engine_shows_the_account_in_it() {
        let mut lobbies = Lobbies::new();
        let start = Instant::now();
        assert_eq!(lobbies.read(start, none, unasked), Some(None), "none named");
        lobbies.named(LOBBY);
        assert!(lobbies.due(start), "a named lobby is read at once");
        let asked = std::cell::Cell::new(0);
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(start, none, |lobby| {
                assert_eq!(lobby, LOBBY);
                Ok(Some(true))
            }),
            Some(Some(LOBBY))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(start + INTERVAL, none, |_| {
                asked.set(asked.get() + 1);
                Ok(Some(true))
            }),
            None,
            "still in it"
        );
        assert_eq!(asked.get(), 1);
        // The game left its lobby, still running: told, and never asked again.
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(start + INTERVAL * 2, none, |_| Ok(Some(false))),
            Some(None)
        );
        assert_eq!(lobbies.read(start + INTERVAL * 3, none, unasked), None);
        // Its next lobby, once named.
        lobbies.named(NEXT);
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(start + INTERVAL * 3, none, |lobby| Ok(Some(lobby == NEXT))),
            Some(Some(NEXT))
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_new_name_replaces_the_last_and_anything_but_a_lobby_is_ignored() {
        let mut lobbies = Lobbies::new();
        let start = Instant::now();
        lobbies.named(LOBBY);
        lobbies.named(ALICE);
        lobbies.named(0);
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(start, none, |lobby| Ok(Some(lobby == LOBBY))),
            Some(Some(LOBBY))
        );
        lobbies.named(NEXT);
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(start, none, |lobby| Ok(Some(lobby == LOBBY))),
            Some(None),
            "the dialog moved on to a lobby the account is not in"
        );
        assert_eq!(lobbies.read(start + INTERVAL, none, unasked), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_unanswered_question_tells_nothing_and_asks_again() {
        let mut lobbies = Lobbies::new();
        let start = Instant::now();
        lobbies.named(LOBBY);
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(start, none, |_| Ok(Some(true))),
            Some(Some(LOBBY))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(start + INTERVAL, none, |_| Ok(None)),
            Some(None),
            "an unconfirmed lobby is not told"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(start + INTERVAL * 2, none, |_| Ok(Some(true))),
            Some(Some(LOBBY)),
            "but still asked"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_personas_lobby_comes_first() {
        let mut lobbies = Lobbies::new();
        let start = Instant::now();
        lobbies.named(LOBBY);
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(start, || Ok(Some(NEXT)), unasked),
            Some(Some(NEXT))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(start + INTERVAL, none, |_| Ok(Some(true))),
            Some(Some(LOBBY)),
            "the named lobby once slot 23 shows none"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_refused_source_stops_alone() {
        let mut lobbies = Lobbies::new();
        let start = Instant::now();
        lobbies.named(LOBBY);
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(start, || Err("refused".into()), |_| Ok(Some(true))),
            Some(Some(LOBBY)),
            "slot 23 refused, the named lobby still told"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(
                start + INTERVAL,
                || panic!("slot 23 is not read again"),
                |_| Ok(Some(true))
            ),
            None
        );
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(
                start + INTERVAL * 2,
                || panic!("slot 23 is not read again"),
                |_| Err("refused".into())
            ),
            Some(None),
            "the check refused: nothing unconfirmed is told"
        );
        lobbies.named(NEXT);
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(
                start + INTERVAL * 3,
                || panic!("slot 23 is not read again"),
                unasked
            ),
            None,
            "no named lobby is asked about again"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn after_a_disconnection_the_lobby_is_told_again() {
        let mut lobbies = Lobbies::new();
        let start = Instant::now();
        lobbies.named(LOBBY);
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(start, none, |_| Ok(Some(true))),
            Some(Some(LOBBY))
        );
        lobbies.forget();
        assert!(lobbies.due(start));
        assert_eq!(
            lobbies.read(start, none, |_| Ok(Some(true))),
            Some(Some(LOBBY))
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_follower_reads_on_its_interval_and_tells_changes_once() {
        let mut follower = Follower::new();
        let start = Instant::now();
        assert!(follower.due(start));
        assert_eq!(follower.read(start, None), Some(None), "the first read");
        assert!(!follower.due(start + INTERVAL - Duration::from_millis(1)));
        assert!(follower.due(start + INTERVAL));
        assert_eq!(follower.read(start + INTERVAL, None), None);
        assert_eq!(
            follower.read(start + INTERVAL * 2, Some(LOBBY)),
            Some(Some(LOBBY))
        );
        assert_eq!(follower.read(start + INTERVAL * 3, Some(LOBBY)), None);
        follower.forget();
        assert!(follower.due(start + INTERVAL * 3));
        assert_eq!(
            follower.read(start + INTERVAL * 3, Some(LOBBY)),
            Some(Some(LOBBY)),
            "after a disconnection, told again"
        );
        assert_eq!(follower.read(start + INTERVAL * 4, None), Some(None));
    }
}
```

`crates/steam-native/src/mach.rs`:

```rs
//! Narrow macOS bootstrap/Mach transport, independent of Steam authentication.
use crate::Result;
use std::ffi::{CStr, CString, c_char};
pub type Port = u32;
pub const SEND: u32 = 1;
pub const RECEIVE: u32 = 2;
pub const SEND_TIMEOUT: u32 = 0x10;
pub const RECEIVE_TIMEOUT: u32 = 0x100;
pub const RECEIVE_TIMED_OUT: i32 = 0x10004003;
pub const RECEIVE_INTERRUPTED: i32 = 0x10004005;
pub const COMPLEX: u32 = 0x80000000;

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Default, Clone, Copy)]
pub struct Header {
    pub bits: u32,
    pub size: u32,
    pub remote: Port,
    pub local: Port,
    pub voucher: Port,
    pub id: i32,
}
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct Message {
    pub header: Header,
    pub opcode: u32,
    pub value: u32,
    pub path: [u8; 512],
    pub trailer: [u8; 128],
}
impl Default for Message {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            header: Header::default(),
            opcode: 0,
            value: 0,
            path: [0; 512],
            trailer: [0; 128],
        }
    }
}
const _: () = {
    assert!(std::mem::size_of::<Header>() == 24);
    assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(Message, value) == 28);
    assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(Message, path) == 32);
    assert!(std::mem::offset_of!(Message, trailer) == 544);
};

unsafe extern "C" {
    static mach_task_self_: Port;
    static bootstrap_port: Port;
    fn mach_port_allocate(task: Port, right: i32, name: *mut Port) -> i32;
    fn mach_port_insert_right(task: Port, name: Port, poly: Port, disposition: u32) -> i32;
    fn mach_port_mod_refs(task: Port, name: Port, right: i32, delta: i32) -> i32;
    fn mach_port_deallocate(task: Port, name: Port) -> i32;
    fn mach_msg(
        message: *mut Header,
        options: u32,
        send_size: u32,
        receive_limit: u32,
        receive_port: Port,
        timeout: u32,
        notify: Port,
    ) -> i32;
    fn mach_msg_destroy(message: *mut Header);
    fn bootstrap_register(bootstrap: Port, name: *const c_char, port: Port) -> i32;
    fn bootstrap_look_up(bootstrap: Port, name: *const c_char, port: *mut Port) -> i32;
}

pub struct ReceivePort(pub Port);
impl ReceivePort {
    pub fn new() -> Result<Self> {
        let mut name = 0;
        // SAFETY: current-task port and writable output scalar; receive right = 1.
        let status = unsafe { mach_port_allocate(mach_task_self_, 1, &mut name) };
        if status != 0 {
            return Err(format!("mach_port_allocate status={status}").into());
        }
        Ok(Self(name))
    }
    pub fn register(&self, name: CString) -> Result<Registration> {
        // SAFETY: owned receive right, inserted send right; name is NUL-terminated.
        unsafe {
            let status = mach_port_insert_right(mach_task_self_, self.0, self.0, 20);
            if status != 0 {
                return Err(format!("mach_port_insert_right status={status}").into());
            }
            let status = bootstrap_register(bootstrap_port, name.as_ptr(), self.0);
            // SAFETY: release the local send reference after bootstrap copies it.
            mach_port_deallocate(mach_task_self_, self.0);
            if status != 0 {
                return Err(format!("bootstrap_register status={status}").into());
            }
        }
        Ok(Registration(name))
    }
}
impl Drop for ReceivePort {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // SAFETY: release this object's owned receive right exactly once.
        unsafe {
            mach_port_mod_refs(mach_task_self_, self.0, 1, -1);
        }
    }
}
pub struct Registration(CString);
impl Drop for Registration {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // SAFETY: unregister only the unique name registered by this process.
        unsafe {
            bootstrap_register(bootstrap_port, self.0.as_ptr(), 0);
        }
    }
}
pub struct SendPort(pub Port);
impl SendPort {
    pub fn lookup(name: &CStr) -> Result<Self> {
        let mut port = 0;
        // SAFETY: valid service name and writable output scalar.
        let status = unsafe { bootstrap_look_up(bootstrap_port, name.as_ptr(), &mut port) };
        if status != 0 {
            return Err(format!("bootstrap lookup status={status}").into());
        }
        Ok(Self(port))
    }
}
impl Drop for SendPort {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // SAFETY: release the lookup's owned send reference.
        unsafe {
            mach_port_deallocate(mach_task_self_, self.0);
        }
    }
}
pub fn send(message: &mut Message) -> i32 {
    if message.header.size > 544 {
        return -1;
    }
    // SAFETY: bounded send size within the initialized repr(C) message.
    unsafe {
        mach_msg(
            &mut message.header,
            SEND | SEND_TIMEOUT,
            message.header.size,
            0,
            0,
            1000,
            0,
        )
    }
}
pub fn receive(message: &mut Message, port: Port, limit: u32, timeout: u32) -> i32 {
    if limit > std::mem::size_of::<Message>() as u32 {
        return -1;
    }
    // SAFETY: buffer is writable, aligned and at least limit bytes long.
    unsafe {
        mach_msg(
            &mut message.header,
            RECEIVE | RECEIVE_TIMEOUT,
            0,
            limit,
            port,
            timeout,
            0,
        )
    }
}
pub fn destroy(message: &mut Message) {
    // SAFETY: called only for a received message or a send failure retaining rights.
    unsafe {
        mach_msg_destroy(&mut message.header);
    }
}
pub fn valid_request(message: &Message) -> bool {
    message.header.id == 104
        && message.header.size == 32
        && message.header.bits & COMPLEX == 0
        && message.header.remote != 0
        && message.header.remote != u32::MAX
        && [17, 18].contains(&(message.header.bits & 0xff))
        && [100001, 14].contains(&message.opcode)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn rejects_malformed_discovery_messages() {
        let mut m = Message {
            header: Header {
                bits: 17,
                size: 32,
                remote: 123,
                id: 104,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            opcode: 14,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert!(valid_request(&m));
        m.header.size = 544;
        assert!(!valid_request(&m));
        m.header.size = 32;
        m.header.bits |= COMPLEX;
        assert!(!valid_request(&m));
        m.header.bits = 17;
        m.header.remote = 0;
        assert!(!valid_request(&m));
        m.header.remote = 123;
        m.opcode = 15;
        assert!(!valid_request(&m));
    }
}
```

`crates/steam-native/src/native.rs`:

```rs
//! Process-lifetime dynamic libraries. Steam's internal unload ABI is unknown.
use crate::Result;
use std::ffi::{CStr, CString, c_char, c_void};
use std::os::unix::ffi::OsStrExt;
use std::path::Path;

/// Replace this architecture-specific helper with the selected slice of the
/// game its supervisor admits on stdin. No shell or platform wrapper gets a
/// chance to strip the game's dyld variables.
pub fn exec_game() -> std::io::Result<()> {
    use std::{fs::File, os::fd::AsRawFd};
    // The confirmation descriptor closes atomically on exec, while the game
    // itself gets null stdout.
    game_runtime::protocol::exec_or_report(|| {
        let null = File::options().read(true).write(true).open("/dev/null")?;
        // SAFETY: valid null descriptor, redirecting only this helper's stdout.
        if unsafe { libc::dup2(null.as_raw_fd(), 1) } < 0 {
            return Err(std::io::Error::last_os_error());
        }
        // The supervisor first persists ownership of this PID, then admits it.
        // Losing that parent before its message must never launch a game.
        let admission = game_runtime::supervisor::exec::receive(std::io::stdin().lock())?;
        // SAFETY: valid readable null descriptor; the game must not inherit the
        // private admission pipe or any bytes remaining in it.
        if unsafe { libc::dup2(null.as_raw_fd(), 0) } < 0 {
            return Err(std::io::Error::last_os_error());
        }
        if let Some(log) = &admission.log {
            let log = game_runtime::diagnostics::open_log(log)?;
            // SAFETY: valid writable descriptor, replacing only standard error,
            // which the supervisor left discarded.
            if unsafe { libc::dup2(log.as_raw_fd(), 2) } < 0 {
                return Err(std::io::Error::last_os_error());
            }
        }
        std::env::set_current_dir(&admission.working_directory)?;
        let mut arguments = vec![admission.executable.into_os_string()];
        arguments.extend(admission.arguments.into_iter().map(Into::into));
        exec_game_inner(&arguments)
    })
}

/// d3dmetal-native's `dmn_options`.
#[repr(C)]
struct D3DMetalOptions {
    struct_size: usize,
    framework_path: *const c_char,
    log_callback: Option<extern "C" fn(i32, *const c_char, *mut c_void)>,
    log_context: *mut c_void,
}

/// Loads d3dmetal-native from `library` and the D3DMetal of `framework`
/// through it, as a render server does when its game first asks for
/// Direct3D. Under Rosetta this translates both ahead of the game, which
/// would otherwise wait for it. Whether D3DMetal initialized.
pub fn warm_d3dmetal(library: &std::ffi::OsStr, framework: &std::ffi::OsStr) -> bool {
    let (Ok(library), Ok(framework)) = (
        CString::new(library.as_bytes()),
        CString::new(framework.as_bytes()),
    ) else {
        return false;
    };
    // SAFETY: a NUL-terminated path; the library stays loaded until exit.
    let handle = unsafe { libc::dlopen(library.as_ptr(), libc::RTLD_NOW | libc::RTLD_LOCAL) };
    if handle.is_null() {
        return false;
    }
    // SAFETY: a live handle and a NUL-terminated symbol name.
    let symbol = unsafe { libc::dlsym(handle, c"dmn_init".as_ptr()) };
    if symbol.is_null() {
        return false;
    }
    // SAFETY: d3dmetal-native exports `dmn_result dmn_init(const dmn_options*)`.
    let init: extern "C" fn(*const D3DMetalOptions) -> i32 = unsafe { std::mem::transmute(symbol) };
    let options = D3DMetalOptions {
        struct_size: std::mem::size_of::<D3DMetalOptions>(),
        framework_path: framework.as_ptr(),
        log_callback: None,
        log_context: std::ptr::null_mut(),
    };
    init(&options) == 0
}

fn exec_game_inner(arguments: &[std::ffi::OsString]) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let strings = arguments
        .iter()
        .map(|argument| CString::new(argument.as_os_str().as_bytes()))
        .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
        .map_err(|_| std::io::Error::from_raw_os_error(libc::EINVAL))?;
    let executable = strings
        .first()
        .ok_or_else(|| std::io::Error::from_raw_os_error(libc::EINVAL))?;
    let mut argv: Vec<_> = strings.iter().map(|s| s.as_ptr().cast_mut()).collect();
    argv.push(std::ptr::null_mut());
    let mut attributes = std::ptr::null_mut();
    // SAFETY: writable opaque attribute storage, initialized before any use.
    let status = unsafe { libc::posix_spawnattr_init(&mut attributes) };
    if status != 0 {
        return Err(std::io::Error::from_raw_os_error(status));
    }
    let result = (|| {
        // CPU_ARCH_ABI64 | CPU_TYPE_X86/ARM, from mach/machine.h.
        #[cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")]
        let mut architecture = 0x0100_0007;
        #[cfg(target_arch = "aarch64")]
        let mut architecture = 0x0100_000c;
        let mut accepted = 0;
        // SAFETY: initialized attributes and exactly one valid CPU preference.
        let status = unsafe {
            libc::posix_spawnattr_setbinpref_np(
                &mut attributes,
                1,
                &mut architecture,
                &mut accepted,
            )
        };
        if status != 0 || accepted != 1 {
            return Err(std::io::Error::from_raw_os_error(if status == 0 {
                libc::EINVAL
            } else {
                status
            }));
        }
        // The Rust runtime ignores SIGPIPE; the game starts with the default.
        let mut defaults = std::mem::MaybeUninit::<libc::sigset_t>::uninit();
        // SAFETY: writable signal set storage, initialized by sigemptyset
        // before sigaddset and posix_spawnattr_setsigdefault read it.
        let status = unsafe {
            libc::sigemptyset(defaults.as_mut_ptr());
            libc::sigaddset(defaults.as_mut_ptr(), libc::SIGPIPE);
            libc::posix_spawnattr_setsigdefault(&mut attributes, defaults.as_ptr())
        };
        if status != 0 {
            return Err(std::io::Error::from_raw_os_error(status));
        }
        // SAFETY: SETEXEC replaces this PID, retaining supervisor parentage.
        let status = unsafe {
            libc::posix_spawnattr_setflags(
                &mut attributes,
                (libc::POSIX_SPAWN_SETEXEC | libc::POSIX_SPAWN_SETSIGDEF) as i16,
            )
        };
        if status != 0 {
            return Err(std::io::Error::from_raw_os_error(status));
        }
        unsafe extern "C" {
            fn _NSGetEnviron() -> *mut *mut *mut c_char;
        }
        // SAFETY: argv is NUL terminated and all owned strings remain live. This
        // startup path has not modified the inherited environment. It is passed
        // verbatim, including non-UTF8 values.
        let status = unsafe {
            libc::posix_spawn(
                std::ptr::null_mut(),
                executable.as_ptr(),
                std::ptr::null(),
                &attributes,
                argv.as_ptr(),
                *_NSGetEnviron(),
            )
        };
        // Successful SETEXEC never returns. Refuse an unexpected returned zero.
        Err(std::io::Error::from_raw_os_error(if status == 0 {
            libc::EIO
        } else {
            status
        }))
    })();
    // SAFETY: attribute initialization succeeded; only failed exec returns here.
    unsafe { libc::posix_spawnattr_destroy(&mut attributes) };
    result
}

pub struct Library(*mut c_void);
impl Library {
    pub fn open(path: &Path) -> Result<Self> {
        let path = CString::new(path.as_os_str().as_bytes())?;
        // SAFETY: NUL-terminated path; the handle is deliberately retained until exit.
        let handle = unsafe { libc::dlopen(path.as_ptr(), libc::RTLD_NOW | libc::RTLD_LOCAL) };
        if handle.is_null() {
            // Do not print native error strings, which may contain private data.
            return Err("dlopen failed".into());
        }
        Ok(Self(handle))
    }

    pub fn symbol(&self, name: &CStr) -> Result<*mut c_void> {
        self.optional_symbol(name)
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing export: {}", name.to_string_lossy()).into())
    }

    fn optional_symbol(&self, name: &CStr) -> Option<*mut c_void> {
        // SAFETY: valid open handle and NUL-terminated symbol name.
        let pointer = unsafe { libc::dlsym(self.0, name.as_ptr()) };
        (!pointer.is_null()).then_some(pointer)
    }
}

/// Resolve a known C ABI signature. Each invocation must document the signature.
#[macro_export]
macro_rules! symbol {
    ($image:expr, $name:expr, $signature:ty) => {{
        let address = $image.symbol($name)?;
        // SAFETY: the call site supplies the export's verified C ABI signature;
        // macOS function and data pointers have the same representation.
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute::<*mut std::ffi::c_void, $signature>(address) }
    }};
}

pub fn disable_core_dumps() -> Result<()> {
    let limit = libc::rlimit {
        rlim_cur: 0,
        rlim_max: 0,
    };
    // SAFETY: pointer to an initialized rlimit; affects only this process.
    if unsafe { libc::setrlimit(libc::RLIMIT_CORE, &limit) } != 0 {
        return Err(std::io::Error::last_os_error().into());
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn translated() -> bool {
    let mut value = 0_i32;
    let mut size = std::mem::size_of_val(&value);
    // SAFETY: matching writable scalar/size and a fixed sysctl name.
    unsafe {
        libc::sysctlbyname(
            c"sysctl.proc_translated".as_ptr(),
            (&mut value as *mut i32).cast(),
            &mut size,
            std::ptr::null_mut(),
            0,
        );
    }
    value != 0
}

/// Kernel birth time prevents adopting a different process after PID reuse.
pub fn process_identity(pid: u32) -> Option<game_runtime::supervisor::Identity> {
    let pid = i32::try_from(pid).ok()?;
    // SAFETY: proc_bsdinfo is a C POD; the buffer length matches its allocation.
    let mut info: libc::proc_bsdinfo = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
    let size = std::mem::size_of_val(&info) as i32;
    // SAFETY: initialized writable buffer and documented libproc selector.
    let read = unsafe {
        libc::proc_pidinfo(
            pid,
            libc::PROC_PIDTBSDINFO,
            0,
            (&mut info as *mut libc::proc_bsdinfo).cast(),
            size,
        )
    };
    // SAFETY: geteuid takes no pointers and cannot fail.
    if read != size || info.pbi_uid != unsafe { libc::geteuid() } {
        return None;
    }
    let mut path = [0_u8; 4096];
    // SAFETY: writable byte buffer with its exact capacity, fixed libproc API.
    let count = unsafe { libc::proc_pidpath(pid, path.as_mut_ptr().cast(), path.len() as u32) };
    if count <= 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let end = path.iter().position(|&b| b == 0)?;
    Some(game_runtime::supervisor::Identity {
        pid: pid as u32,
        uid: info.pbi_uid,
        birth_seconds: info.pbi_start_tvsec,
        birth_microseconds: info.pbi_start_tvusec,
        executable: std::str::from_utf8(&path[..end]).ok()?.into(),
    })
}

pub fn detach_supervisor() -> Result<()> {
    // Rust preserves the launching thread's signal mask across exec. Start
    // this standalone supervisor with signals enabled before creating Tokio
    // or any threads, so child-exit notifications cannot remain blocked.
    // SAFETY: initialized mask storage; this changes only the new helper's
    // calling thread, which future supervisor threads will inherit.
    let status = unsafe {
        let mut mask = std::mem::zeroed();
        libc::sigemptyset(&mut mask);
        libc::pthread_sigmask(libc::SIG_SETMASK, &mask, std::ptr::null_mut())
    };
    if status != 0 {
        return Err(std::io::Error::from_raw_os_error(status).into());
    }
    // SAFETY: setsid affects only this freshly spawned helper. It has no terminal
    // or UI log descriptors (stderr carries a private launch acknowledgement).
    // It must survive its parent's termination.
    if unsafe { libc::setsid() } < 0 {
        return Err(std::io::Error::last_os_error().into());
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// A failed identity read is only treated as exit if the kernel says ESRCH.
pub fn process_is_absent(pid: u32) -> bool {
    let Ok(pid) = i32::try_from(pid) else {
        return true;
    };
    if pid <= 0 {
        return true;
    }
    // SAFETY: signal zero only queries existence; it never signals the process.
    (unsafe { libc::kill(pid, 0) }) < 0
        && std::io::Error::last_os_error().raw_os_error() == Some(libc::ESRCH)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod process_tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn kernel_identity_distinguishes_current_process_from_exited_child() {
        let own = process_identity(std::process::id()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(own.pid, std::process::id());
        assert!(own.birth_seconds > 0);
        assert_eq!(process_identity(own.pid), Some(own));
        let mut child = std::process::Command::new("/bin/sleep")
            .arg("0.1")
            .spawn()
            .unwrap();
        let identity = process_identity(child.id()).unwrap();
        assert_ne!(identity.pid, std::process::id());
        assert!(!process_is_absent(child.id()));
        child.wait().unwrap();
        assert!(process_is_absent(child.id()));
        assert!(process_identity(child.id()).is_none());
    }
}

```

`crates/steam-native/src/overlay.rs`:

```rs
//! What a game asks of Steam's overlay. Without an overlay, Steam's engine
//! still turns every `ISteamFriends::ActivateGameOverlay*` call into the
//! internal callback `GameOverlayActivateRequested_t` (1010001), posted to
//! every pipe of the user whose AppID is 0 (0x5c53b8), this host's global
//! pipe included. Obelisk shows its own overlay instead.
//!
//! Layout from the pinned engine's builders, CUserFriends (vtable 0x175e868)
//! slots 184 to 190 and the Remote Play Together dialog (research report
//! docs/research/steam-chat-invites-2026-10-08.md, "Bouton Inviter dans le
//! jeu, sans overlay"). Each zeroes 0x211c bytes, copies its dialog name with
//! `strlcpy(…, 0x2000)` at 0, and stores the requesting pipe's AppID at
//! 0x2118:
//!
//! - slot 184 `ActivateGameOverlay(dialog)` (0xa9d2e8) is slot 185 with
//!   CSteamID 0;
//! - slot 185 `ActivateGameOverlayToUser(dialog, steam_id)` (0xa9d2f8): the
//!   CSteamID at 0x2000;
//! - slot 186 `ActivateGameOverlayToWebPage(url, mode)` (0xa9d4c4): the URL as
//!   the dialog, the byte 1 at 0x200c and the mode at 0x2014;
//! - slot 187 `ActivateGameOverlayToStore(app, flag)` (0xa9d3dc): "store", the
//!   AppID at 0x2008 and the flag at 0x2010;
//! - slot 188 `ActivateGameOverlayInviteDialog(lobby)` (0xa9d8d8):
//!   "lobbyinvite", the lobby at 0x2000;
//! - slot 189 `ActivateGameOverlayRemotePlayTogetherInviteDialog(lobby)`
//!   (0xa9d9b8): "remoteplaytogetherinvite", the lobby at 0x2000;
//! - slot 190 `ActivateGameOverlayInviteDialogConnectString(connect)`
//!   (0xa9da98): "lobbyinviteconnectstring", the caller's AppID at 0x2008 and
//!   the connect string at 0x2018;
//! - 0x9ba544: "remoteplaytogether", nothing else.
//!
//! Only slot 186 writes the byte at 0x200c, which tells a web page from a
//! dialog whose name looks like a URL.
use game_runtime::protocol::OverlayDialog;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

/// `GameOverlayActivateRequested_t`.
pub const REQUESTED: i32 = 1_010_001;
/// The callback's exact size; any other size is another layout.
pub const SIZE: usize = 0x211c;
const DIALOG: std::ops::Range<usize> = 0..0x2000;
const TARGET: usize = 0x2000;
const APP: usize = 0x2008;
const WEB_PAGE: usize = 0x200c;
const STORE_FLAG: usize = 0x2010;
const WEB_MODE: usize = 0x2014;
const CONNECT: std::ops::Range<usize> = 0x2018..0x2118;
const REQUESTER: usize = 0x2118;

/// What a request of game `app` asks the overlay for. Another game's
/// request and anything malformed or beyond `OverlayDialog::valid` is
/// ignored.
pub fn request(payload: &[u8], app: u32) -> Option<OverlayDialog> {
    if payload.len() != SIZE || app == 0 || u32_at(payload, REQUESTER)? != app {
        return None;
    }
    let name = terminated(&payload[DIALOG])?;
    let target = u64_at(payload, TARGET)?;
    let request = if payload[WEB_PAGE] == 1 {
        OverlayDialog::WebPage {
            url: text(name)?,
            modal: match u32_at(payload, WEB_MODE)? {
                0 => false,
                1 => true,
                _ => return None,
            },
        }
    } else {
        match name {
            b"lobbyinvite" => OverlayDialog::LobbyInvite { lobby_id: target },
            b"remoteplaytogetherinvite" => OverlayDialog::RemotePlayTogetherInvite {
                lobby_id: game_runtime::protocol::lobby(target).then_some(target),
            },
            b"lobbyinviteconnectstring" if u32_at(payload, APP)? == app => {
                OverlayDialog::ConnectInvite {
                    connect: text(terminated(&payload[CONNECT])?)?,
                }
            }
            b"lobbyinviteconnectstring" => return None,
            b"remoteplaytogether" => OverlayDialog::RemotePlayTogether {},
            b"store" => OverlayDialog::Store {
                app_id: u32_at(payload, APP)?,
                flag: u32_at(payload, STORE_FLAG)?,
            },
            _ if target == 0 => OverlayDialog::Dialog {
                dialog: text(name)?,
            },
            _ => OverlayDialog::User {
                dialog: text(name)?,
                steam_id: target,
            },
        }
    };
    request.valid().then_some(request)
}

pub(crate) fn u32_at(payload: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Option<u32> {
    Some(u32::from_le_bytes(
        payload.get(offset..offset + 4)?.try_into().ok()?,
    ))
}

pub(crate) fn u64_at(payload: &[u8], offset: usize) -> Option<u64> {
    Some(u64::from_le_bytes(
        payload.get(offset..offset + 8)?.try_into().ok()?,
    ))
}

/// The C string at the start of `field`, which must end inside it.
pub(crate) fn terminated(field: &[u8]) -> Option<&[u8]> {
    field
        .iter()
        .position(|byte| *byte == 0)
        .map(|end| &field[..end])
}

pub(crate) fn text(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<String> {
    std::str::from_utf8(bytes).ok().map(str::to_owned)
}

/// Coalesces a repeated request: a held key or a double press makes one
/// overlay. Another request always goes through.
pub struct Throttle<T> {
    interval: Duration,
    last: Option<(T, Instant)>,
}
impl<T: PartialEq> Throttle<T> {
    pub fn new(interval: Duration) -> Self {
        Self {
            interval,
            last: None,
        }
    }
    pub fn admit(&mut self, request: T, now: Instant) -> bool {
        if self.last.as_ref().is_some_and(|(last, at)| {
            *last == request && now.saturating_duration_since(*at) < self.interval
        }) {
            return false;
        }
        self.last = Some((request, now));
        true
    }
}

/// At most `limit` events per `window`: a flood the engine relays can never
/// fill the supervisor's bounded event queue.
pub struct Budget {
    limit: u32,
    window: Duration,
    started: Option<Instant>,
    spent: u32,
}
impl Budget {
    pub fn new(limit: u32, window: Duration) -> Self {
        Self {
            limit,
            window,
            started: None,
            spent: 0,
        }
    }
    pub fn admit(&mut self, now: Instant) -> bool {
        if self
            .started
            .is_none_or(|started| now.saturating_duration_since(started) >= self.window)
        {
            self.started = Some(now);
            self.spent = 0;
        }
        if self.spent >= self.limit {
            return false;
        }
        self.spent += 1;
        true
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const PEAK: u32 = 3_527_290;
    const LOBBY: u64 = 109_775_244_421_126_053;
    const FRIEND: u64 = 76_561_197_960_265_729;

    /// The bytes a builder writes: memset, dialog name, target, requester.
    fn dialog_request(dialog: &[u8], target: u64, requester: u32) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut payload = vec![0; SIZE];
        payload[..dialog.len()].copy_from_slice(dialog);
        payload[0x2000..0x2008].copy_from_slice(&target.to_le_bytes());
        payload[0x2118..].copy_from_slice(&requester.to_le_bytes());
        payload
    }

    /// The bytes slot 190 builds: its dialog, the caller's AppID and string.
    fn connect_request(connect: &[u8], app: u32, requester: u32) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut payload = dialog_request(b"lobbyinviteconnectstring", 0, requester);
        payload[0x2008..0x200c].copy_from_slice(&app.to_le_bytes());
        payload[0x2018..0x2018 + connect.len()].copy_from_slice(connect);
        payload
    }

    /// The bytes slot 186 builds: the URL, its marker and its mode.
    fn web_request(url: &[u8], mode: u32, requester: u32) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut payload = dialog_request(url, 0, requester);
        payload[0x200c] = 1;
        payload[0x2014..0x2018].copy_from_slice(&mode.to_le_bytes());
        payload
    }

    /// The bytes slot 187 builds: "store", the AppID and the flag.
    fn store_request(app: u32, flag: u32, requester: u32) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut payload = dialog_request(b"store", 0, requester);
        payload[0x2008..0x200c].copy_from_slice(&app.to_le_bytes());
        payload[0x2010..0x2014].copy_from_slice(&flag.to_le_bytes());
        payload
    }

    #[test]
    fn every_dialog_kind_is_read_from_its_builders_bytes() {
        let dialog = |name: &str| OverlayDialog::Dialog {
            dialog: name.into(),
        };
        for name in [
            "friends",
            "community",
            "players",
            "settings",
            "officialgamegroup",
            "stats",
            "achievements",
            "chatroomgroup/3810571",
        ] {
            assert_eq!(
                request(&dialog_request(name.as_bytes(), 0, PEAK), PEAK),
                Some(dialog(name)),
                "slot 184 {name}"
            );
        }
        for name in ["steamid", "chat", "jointrade", "friendadd", "stats"] {
            assert_eq!(
                request(&dialog_request(name.as_bytes(), FRIEND, PEAK), PEAK),
                Some(OverlayDialog::User {
                    dialog: name.into(),
                    steam_id: FRIEND
                }),
                "slot 185 {name}"
            );
        }
        assert_eq!(
            request(&web_request(b"https://example.com/a?b=c", 0, PEAK), PEAK),
            Some(OverlayDialog::WebPage {
                url: "https://example.com/a?b=c".into(),
                modal: false
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            request(&web_request(b"http://example.com", 1, PEAK), PEAK),
            Some(OverlayDialog::WebPage {
                url: "http://example.com".into(),
                modal: true
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            request(&store_request(620, 2, PEAK), PEAK),
            Some(OverlayDialog::Store {
                app_id: 620,
                flag: 2
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            request(&dialog_request(b"lobbyinvite", LOBBY, PEAK), PEAK),
            Some(OverlayDialog::LobbyInvite { lobby_id: LOBBY })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            request(
                &dialog_request(b"remoteplaytogetherinvite", LOBBY, PEAK),
                PEAK
            ),
            Some(OverlayDialog::RemotePlayTogetherInvite {
                lobby_id: Some(LOBBY)
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            request(&dialog_request(b"remoteplaytogetherinvite", 0, PEAK), PEAK),
            Some(OverlayDialog::RemotePlayTogetherInvite { lobby_id: None })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            request(
                &connect_request(b"+connect_lobby 109775244421126053", PEAK, PEAK),
                PEAK
            ),
            Some(OverlayDialog::ConnectInvite {
                connect: "+connect_lobby 109775244421126053".into()
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            request(&dialog_request(b"remoteplaytogether", 0, PEAK), PEAK),
            Some(OverlayDialog::RemotePlayTogether {})
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn other_games_layouts_and_targets_are_ignored() {
        let lobby = dialog_request(b"lobbyinvite", LOBBY, PEAK);
        assert_eq!(request(&lobby[..SIZE - 1], PEAK), None, "short");
        let mut long = lobby.clone();
        long.push(0);
        assert_eq!(request(&long, PEAK), None, "long");
        assert_eq!(request(&lobby, 0), None, "no game");
        assert_eq!(
            request(&dialog_request(b"lobbyinvite", LOBBY, 730), PEAK),
            None,
            "another game's request"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            request(&dialog_request(b"lobbyinvite", FRIEND, PEAK), PEAK),
            None,
            "an account is no lobby"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            request(&dialog_request(b"lobbyinvite", 0, PEAK), PEAK),
            None,
            "no lobby"
        );
        let mut unterminated = lobby.clone();
        unterminated[..0x2000].fill(b'a');
        assert_eq!(request(&unterminated, PEAK), None);
        for name in [&b""[..], b"a b", b"\xff\xfe", b"friends\n"] {
            assert_eq!(request(&dialog_request(name, 0, PEAK), PEAK), None);
        }
        assert_eq!(
            request(&dialog_request(&[b'a'; 129], 0, PEAK), PEAK),
            None,
            "too long a name"
        );
        assert_eq!(request(&store_request(620, 3, PEAK), PEAK), None);
        for (url, mode) in [
            (&b"file:///etc/passwd"[..], 0),
            (b"steam://run/620", 0),
            (b"https://a b", 0),
            (b"https://a\"b", 0),
            (b"https://example.com", 2),
        ] {
            assert_eq!(request(&web_request(url, mode, PEAK), PEAK), None);
        }
        let long_url = [&b"https://"[..], &[b'a'; 2041]].concat();
        assert_eq!(request(&web_request(&long_url, 0, PEAK), PEAK), None);
        let long_url = [&b"https://"[..], &[b'a'; 2040]].concat();
        assert!(request(&web_request(&long_url, 0, PEAK), PEAK).is_some());
    }

    #[test]
    fn connect_strings_must_be_terminated_text_of_the_same_game() {
        assert_eq!(request(&connect_request(b"", PEAK, PEAK), PEAK), None);
        assert_eq!(request(&connect_request(b"+x", 730, PEAK), PEAK), None);
        assert_eq!(
            request(&connect_request(&[0xff, 0xfe], PEAK, PEAK), PEAK),
            None
        );
        assert_eq!(
            request(&connect_request(&[b'a'; 256], PEAK, PEAK), PEAK),
            None,
            "the string fills its buffer without a terminator"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            request(&connect_request(&[b'a'; 255], PEAK, PEAK), PEAK),
            Some(OverlayDialog::ConnectInvite {
                connect: "a".repeat(255)
            })
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_repeated_request_coalesces_another_goes_through() {
        let mut throttle = Throttle::new(Duration::from_millis(500));
        let start = Instant::now();
        assert!(throttle.admit("lobbyinvite", start));
        assert!(!throttle.admit("lobbyinvite", start + Duration::from_millis(499)));
        assert!(throttle.admit("friends", start + Duration::from_millis(499)));
        assert!(throttle.admit("lobbyinvite", start + Duration::from_millis(500)));
        assert!(!throttle.admit("lobbyinvite", start + Duration::from_millis(600)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_budget_admits_its_limit_per_window() {
        let mut budget = Budget::new(2, Duration::from_secs(1));
        let start = Instant::now();
        assert!(budget.admit(start));
        assert!(budget.admit(start + Duration::from_millis(10)));
        assert!(!budget.admit(start + Duration::from_millis(999)));
        assert!(budget.admit(start + Duration::from_secs(1)));
    }
}
```

`crates/steam-native/src/received.rs`:

```rs
//! What Steam tells the account while its game runs, which Steam's overlay
//! would show: invitations from friends and purchases to confirm. Layouts
//! from the pinned engine's posting sites:
//!
//! - `LobbyInvite_t` (503, 24 bytes), posted at 0x6089fc through 0x5c523c to
//!   every pipe of the user: the inviter at 0, the lobby at 8 and the CGameID
//!   at 16, as Steamworks declares it.
//! - `RichInviteReceived_t` (1010035, internal, 0x10c bytes), posted at
//!   0xab0c78 through 0x5c53b8 to the pipes whose AppID is 0: the sender at
//!   0 (from the message body, 0xab0be4), a u32 at 8 from the message header
//!   (0xab0be0; most likely its routing AppID) and the connect string
//!   copied with `strlcpy(…, 256)` at 0xc (0xab0c50).
//! - `MicroTxnAuthRequestCallback_t` (1020043, internal, 16 bytes), posted at
//!   0x60b3a4 through 0x5c53b8: the order at 0 (0x60b364), the AppID at 8
//!   (0x60b370) and an unknown u32 at 0xc.
//! - `MicroTxnAuthDismissCallback_t` (1020044, 16 bytes), posted at 0xa79a58
//!   once the player answered: the order at 0 and its AppID at 8.
use crate::overlay::{terminated, text, u32_at, u64_at};
use game_runtime::protocol::{Event, individual};

pub const LOBBY_INVITE: (i32, usize) = (503, 24);
pub const RICH_INVITE: (i32, usize) = (1_010_035, 0x10c);
pub const MICROTXN_REQUESTED: (i32, usize) = (1_020_043, 16);
pub const MICROTXN_DISMISSED: (i32, usize) = (1_020_044, 16);
/// Every callback this module reads.
pub const CALLBACKS: [(i32, usize); 4] = [
    LOBBY_INVITE,
    RICH_INVITE,
    MICROTXN_REQUESTED,
    MICROTXN_DISMISSED,
];

/// The event callback `id` tells, for the host of game `app`. A lobby
/// invitation names only that game; anything malformed is ignored.
pub fn event(id: i32, payload: &[u8], app: u32) -> Option<Event> {
    if !CALLBACKS.contains(&(id, payload.len())) {
        return None;
    }
    let event = match id {
        503 => {
            // CGameID: AppID in the low 24 bits, type 0 (app), no mod.
            if app == 0 || u64_at(payload, 16)? != u64::from(app) {
                return None;
            }
            let (inviter, lobby_id) = (u64_at(payload, 0)?, u64_at(payload, 8)?);
            if !individual(inviter) || !game_runtime::protocol::lobby(lobby_id) {
                return None;
            }
            Event::LobbyInviteReceived {
                inviter,
                lobby_id,
                app_id: app,
            }
        }
        1_010_035 => {
            let (friend, app_id) = (u64_at(payload, 0)?, u32_at(payload, 8)?);
            let connect = text(terminated(payload.get(0xc..0x10c)?)?)?;
            if !individual(friend) || app_id == 0 || !game_runtime::protocol::connect(&connect) {
                return None;
            }
            Event::RichInviteReceived {
                friend,
                app_id,
                connect,
            }
        }
        1_020_043 => {
            let (order_id, app_id) = (u64_at(payload, 0)?, u32_at(payload, 8)?);
            if order_id == 0 || app_id == 0 {
                return None;
            }
            Event::MicroTxnRequested { order_id, app_id }
        }
        _ => {
            let order_id = u64_at(payload, 0)?;
            if order_id == 0 {
                return None;
            }
            Event::MicroTxnDismissed { order_id }
        }
    };
    Some(event)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const PEAK: u32 = 3_527_290;
    const LOBBY: u64 = 109_775_244_421_126_053;
    const FRIEND: u64 = 76_561_197_960_265_729;

    fn lobby_invite(inviter: u64, lobby: u64, game: u64) -> Vec<u8> {
        [inviter, lobby, game]
            .iter()
            .flat_map(|field| field.to_le_bytes())
            .collect()
    }

    fn rich_invite(friend: u64, app: u32, connect: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut payload = vec![0; 0x10c];
        payload[..8].copy_from_slice(&friend.to_le_bytes());
        payload[8..12].copy_from_slice(&app.to_le_bytes());
        payload[0xc..0xc + connect.len()].copy_from_slice(connect);
        payload
    }

    fn microtxn(order: u64, app: u32, unknown: u32) -> Vec<u8> {
        [
            &order.to_le_bytes()[..],
            &app.to_le_bytes(),
            &unknown.to_le_bytes(),
        ]
        .concat()
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_lobby_invitation_names_a_lobby_of_this_game() {
        let invite = lobby_invite(FRIEND, LOBBY, u64::from(PEAK));
        assert_eq!(
            event(503, &invite, PEAK),
            Some(Event::LobbyInviteReceived {
                inviter: FRIEND,
                lobby_id: LOBBY,
                app_id: PEAK
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(event(503, &invite[..23], PEAK), None, "short");
        assert_eq!(event(503, &invite, 0), None, "no game");
        assert_eq!(
            event(503, &lobby_invite(FRIEND, LOBBY, 730), PEAK),
            None,
            "another game"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            event(
                503,
                &lobby_invite(FRIEND, LOBBY, u64::from(PEAK) | 1 << 32),
                PEAK
            ),
            None,
            "a mod"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            event(503, &lobby_invite(LOBBY, LOBBY, u64::from(PEAK)), PEAK),
            None,
            "a lobby invites no one"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            event(503, &lobby_invite(FRIEND, FRIEND, u64::from(PEAK)), PEAK),
            None,
            "an account is no lobby"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_rich_invitation_carries_its_connect_string() {
        assert_eq!(
            event(
                1_010_035,
                &rich_invite(FRIEND, 620, b"+connect 10.0.0.1"),
                PEAK
            ),
            Some(Event::RichInviteReceived {
                friend: FRIEND,
                app_id: 620,
                connect: "+connect 10.0.0.1".into()
            }),
            "another game's too: the supervisor keeps its own"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            event(1_010_035, &rich_invite(FRIEND, 620, &[b'a'; 255]), PEAK),
            Some(Event::RichInviteReceived {
                friend: FRIEND,
                app_id: 620,
                connect: "a".repeat(255)
            })
        );
        for (payload, why) in [
            (rich_invite(FRIEND, 620, b""), "empty"),
            (rich_invite(FRIEND, 620, &[b'a'; 256]), "unterminated"),
            (rich_invite(FRIEND, 620, &[0xff, 0xfe]), "not text"),
            (rich_invite(FRIEND, 0, b"+x"), "no game"),
            (rich_invite(LOBBY, 620, b"+x"), "from no one"),
        ] {
            assert_eq!(event(1_010_035, &payload, PEAK), None, "{why}");
        }
        let short = rich_invite(FRIEND, 620, b"+x");
        assert_eq!(event(1_010_035, &short[..0x10b], PEAK), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_purchase_is_asked_then_dismissed_by_its_order() {
        assert_eq!(
            event(1_020_043, &microtxn(4242, 620, 7), PEAK),
            Some(Event::MicroTxnRequested {
                order_id: 4242,
                app_id: 620
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(event(1_020_043, &microtxn(0, 620, 0), PEAK), None);
        assert_eq!(event(1_020_043, &microtxn(4242, 0, 0), PEAK), None);
        assert_eq!(
            event(1_020_044, &microtxn(4242, 620, 0), PEAK),
            Some(Event::MicroTxnDismissed { order_id: 4242 })
        );
        assert_eq!(event(1_020_044, &microtxn(0, 620, 0), PEAK), None);
        assert_eq!(event(1_020_044, &microtxn(4242, 620, 0)[..12], PEAK), None);
        assert_eq!(
            event(331, &[0; 12], PEAK),
            None,
            "the host's own GameOverlayActivated_t echo"
        );
    }
}
```

`crates/steam-native/tests/exec_game.rs`:

```rs
//! Both exec helpers through their process boundary: the arm64
//! `obelisk-steam-host game-exec` and the Intel `obelisk-steam-sdk exec-game`.
//! Each becomes the game only after the supervisor's admission message.
use game_runtime::supervisor::exec::Admission;
use std::{
    ffi::OsStr,
    io::{Read, Write},
    os::unix::ffi::OsStrExt,
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    process::{Child, Command, ExitStatus, Stdio},
    time::Duration,
};

/// The two helpers, as the supervisor spawns them.
fn helpers() -> [Command; 2] {
    let mut arm = Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_obelisk-steam-host"));
    arm.arg("game-exec");
    let mut intel = Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_obelisk-steam-sdk"));
    intel.arg("exec-game");
    [arm, intel]
}

fn spawn(mut helper: Command) -> Child {
    helper
        .stdin(Stdio::piped())
        .stdout(Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(Stdio::null())
        .spawn()
        .unwrap()
}

fn admit(child: &mut Child, admission: &Admission) {
    let mut input = child.stdin.take().unwrap();
    game_runtime::supervisor::exec::send(&mut input, admission).unwrap();
}

/// Waits for the helper's exec confirmation, then releases the replacement.
/// Returns the handshake bytes, whether the replacement was still running when
/// they arrived, and its final exit status.
fn confirm_replacement(child: &mut Child, directory: &Path) -> (Vec<u8>, bool, ExitStatus) {
    let mut control = child.stdout.take().unwrap();
    let (sender, receiver) = std::sync::mpsc::channel();
    let reader = std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
        control.read_to_end(&mut bytes).unwrap();
        let _ = sender.send(bytes);
    });
    // A successful exec closes its control descriptor while the replacement is
    // still alive. The fixture cannot exit successfully until this test releases it.
    let handshake = receiver.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(3));
    let running = child.try_wait().unwrap().is_none();
    std::fs::write(directory.join("finish"), b"").unwrap();
    let status = child.wait().unwrap();
    reader.join().unwrap();
    (handshake.unwrap(), running, status)
}

fn scratch(name: &str) -> PathBuf {
    let directory = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("obelisk-{name}-{}", std::process::id()));
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&directory).unwrap();
    directory.canonicalize().unwrap()
}

#[test]
fn a_failed_exec_reports_failure_without_starting_a_replacement() {
    for helper in helpers() {
        let mut child = spawn(helper);
        admit(
            &mut child,
            &Admission {
                executable: "/obelisk-missing-game-fixture".into(),
                arguments: vec![],
                working_directory: "/tmp".into(),
                log: None,
                log_header: None,
            },
        );
        let result = child.wait_with_output().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(result.status.code(), Some(1));
        assert_eq!(result.stdout, game_runtime::protocol::EXEC_FAILED);
    }
}

#[test]
fn a_missing_or_invalid_admission_never_executes_the_target() {
    let marker = scratch("missing-admission").join("started");
    let complete = serde_json::to_vec(&Admission {
        executable: "/usr/bin/touch".into(),
        arguments: vec![marker.to_string_lossy().into_owned()],
        working_directory: "/tmp".into(),
        log: None,
        log_header: None,
    })
    .unwrap();
    let relative = serde_json::to_vec(&Admission {
        executable: "touch".into(),
        arguments: vec![marker.to_string_lossy().into_owned()],
        working_directory: "/tmp".into(),
        log: None,
        log_header: None,
    })
    .unwrap();
    // Losing the supervisor before admission closes the pipe mid-message.
    let inputs: [&[u8]; 4] = [b"", b"1", &complete[..complete.len() - 1], &relative];
    for input in inputs {
        for helper in helpers() {
            let mut child = spawn(helper);
            let mut pipe = child.stdin.take().unwrap();
            pipe.write_all(input).unwrap();
            drop(pipe);
            let result = child.wait_with_output().unwrap();
            let started = marker.exists();
            if started {
                std::fs::remove_file(&marker).unwrap();
            }
            assert!(!started, "target executed without supervisor admission");
            assert_eq!(result.status.code(), Some(1));
            assert_eq!(result.stdout, game_runtime::protocol::EXEC_FAILED);
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn the_game_keeps_the_helper_pid_its_environment_and_default_signals() {
    let directory = scratch("exec-game");
    let executable = directory.join("game-fixture");
    let adapter = directory.join("adapter-fixture.dylib");
    let source = directory.join("adapter.c");
    std::fs::write(&source, "int obelisk_fixture(void) { return 0; }\n").unwrap();
    for (source, output, library) in [
        (
            Path::new(concat!(
                env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"),
                "/tests/fixtures/exec_game.c"
            )),
            &executable,
            false,
        ),
        (source.as_path(), &adapter, true),
    ] {
        let mut compiler = Command::new("/usr/bin/clang");
        if library {
            compiler.arg("-dynamiclib");
        }
        assert!(
            compiler
                .arg(source)
                .arg("-o")
                .arg(output)
                .status()
                .unwrap()
                .success()
        );
    }
    for mut helper in helpers() {
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(directory.join("finish"));
        // The supervisor sets the game's environment when it spawns the
        // helper; only the admission message names the target.
        helper
            .current_dir("/")
            .env_clear()
            .env("EXPECTED_CWD", &directory)
            .env("EXPECTED_ADAPTER", &adapter)
            .env("DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES", &adapter)
            .env(
                "OBELISK_PRIVATE_STEAM_DISCOVERY",
                "com.zagrios.obelisk.discovery.fixture",
            )
            .env("OBELISK_FIXTURE_BYTES", OsStr::from_bytes(b"\xff\xfe"));
        let mut child = spawn(helper);
        let pid = child.id();
        admit(
            &mut child,
            &Admission {
                executable: executable.clone(),
                arguments: vec!["a b".into(), "$not-a-shell".into()],
                working_directory: directory.clone(),
                log: None,
                log_header: None,
            },
        );
        let (handshake, running, status) = confirm_replacement(&mut child, &directory);
        let proof = std::fs::read_to_string(directory.join("game-proof.txt")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(status.code(), Some(23));
        assert!(handshake.is_empty());
        assert!(running);
        assert_eq!(proof.trim(), pid.to_string());
    }
    std::fs::remove_dir_all(directory).unwrap();
}
```

`crates/steam-native/tests/fixtures/exec_game.c`:

```c
// A local process fixture. Verifies the exec boundary without running a game.
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    char cwd[4096];
    if (argc != 3 || strcmp(argv[1], "a b") || strcmp(argv[2], "$not-a-shell")) return 1;
    if (!getcwd(cwd, sizeof(cwd)) || strcmp(cwd, getenv("EXPECTED_CWD"))) return 2;
    if (strcmp(getenv("DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES"), getenv("EXPECTED_ADAPTER"))) return 3;
    if (strcmp(getenv("OBELISK_PRIVATE_STEAM_DISCOVERY"), "com.zagrios.obelisk.discovery.fixture")) return 4;
    // The environment is passed verbatim, including values that are not UTF-8.
    const char *bytes = getenv("OBELISK_FIXTURE_BYTES");
    if (!bytes || strcmp(bytes, "\xff\xfe")) return 8;
    // A game starts with the default SIGPIPE disposition, never an inherited ignore.
    struct sigaction pipe;
    if (sigaction(SIGPIPE, NULL, &pipe) || pipe.sa_handler != SIG_DFL) return 9;
    struct stat input;
    char byte;
    if (fstat(STDIN_FILENO, &input) || !S_ISCHR(input.st_mode) || read(STDIN_FILENO, &byte, 1) != 0) return 7;
    FILE *proof = fopen("game-proof.txt", "w");
    if (!proof) return 5;
    fprintf(proof, "%d\n", getpid());
    fclose(proof);
    for (int i = 0; i < 500; ++i) {
        if (!access("finish", F_OK)) return 23;
        usleep(10000);
    }
    return 6;
}
```

```rs
use obelisk_steam_native::native;
use std::process::{Command, Stdio};

#[test]
fn identity_helper_flushes_its_bounded_response_before_immediate_exit() {

#[test]
fn native_supervisor_acknowledges_and_reports_preparation_failure_without_valve() {
    use game_runtime::{
        Config,
        protocol::Credentials,
        steam::Request,
        supervisor::{Phase, Target},
    };
    use obelisk_core::transfer::CancelToken;
    use std::{
        path::PathBuf,
        time::{Duration, Instant, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH},
    };
    struct Scratch(PathBuf);
    impl Drop for Scratch {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&self.0);
        }
    }
    let root = Scratch(std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
            "obelisk-ack-{}-{}",
            std::process::id(),
            SystemTime::now()
                .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
                .unwrap()
                .as_nanos()
        )));
    std::fs::create_dir(&root.0).unwrap();
    let helper = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_obelisk-steam-host"));
    let credentials = Credentials {
        steam_id: 123,
        account_name: "fixture".into(),
        refresh_token: "fixture-no-steam-account".into(),
    };
    let client = game_runtime::steam::start(
        &helper,
        &credentials,
        Request {
            cloud: None,
            id: String::new(),
            root: root.0.join("sessions"),
            config: Config {
                cloud_save_roots: vec![],
                app_id: 42,
                helpers: helper.parent().unwrap().into(),
                package: root.0.join("missing.zip"),
                cache: root.0.join("cache"),
                diagnostics: root.0.join("logs"),
                steam_api: Some(root.0.join("missing-api.dylib")),
                wine: None,
                home: root.0.clone(),
            },
            target: Target {
                executable: root.0.join("must-not-run"),
                arguments: vec![],
                working_directory: root.0.clone(),
                environment: Default::default(),
                log: None,
                installation: None,
                program: None,
            },
        },
        &CancelToken::new(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(3);
    let mut after = None;
    loop {
        let snapshot = client.snapshot(after).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(snapshot.store.app_id, 42);
        assert_eq!(snapshot.account_id, 123);
        assert!(snapshot.game.is_none());
        if snapshot.finished() {
            assert_eq!(snapshot.phase, Phase::Failed);
            assert_eq!(
                snapshot.error.as_deref(),
                Some("backend.steam.runtime.unavailable")
            );
            break;
        }
        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline);
        after = Some(snapshot.revision);
    }
}
```

`crates/steam-native/tests/supervisor_signals.rs`:

```rs
use obelisk_steam_native::native;
use std::{
    os::unix::process::CommandExt,
    process::{Command, Stdio},
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};

const FIXTURE: &str = "OBELISK_SUPERVISOR_SIGNAL_FIXTURE";

fn current_mask() -> libc::sigset_t {
    // SAFETY: a null input set only queries the calling thread's signal mask;
    // the output points to initialized, correctly sized storage.
    unsafe {
        let mut mask = std::mem::zeroed();
        assert_eq!(
            libc::pthread_sigmask(libc::SIG_SETMASK, std::ptr::null(), &mut mask),
            0
        );
        mask
    }
}

#[test]
fn supervisor_unblocks_signals_inherited_from_its_launcher() {
    if std::env::var_os(FIXTURE).is_some() {
        let before = current_mask();
        // SAFETY: the mask is initialized and both signals are valid on macOS.
        unsafe {
            assert_eq!(libc::sigismember(&before, libc::SIGCHLD), 1);
            assert_eq!(libc::sigismember(&before, libc::SIGTERM), 1);
        }
        native::detach_supervisor().unwrap();
        let after = current_mask();
        // Darwin's signal mask is a bit set; the standalone supervisor must
        // receive signals even when its launching thread deliberately blocked them.
        assert_eq!(after, 0, "supervisor retained its launcher's signal mask");
        return;
    }

    let mut command = Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap());
    command
        .args([
            "--exact",
            "supervisor_unblocks_signals_inherited_from_its_launcher",
            "--nocapture",
        ])
        .env(FIXTURE, "1")
        .stdout(Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(Stdio::piped());
    // SAFETY: this runs only in the new fixture process before exec. The
    // closure uses async-signal-safe libc calls and changes no parent state.
    unsafe {
        command.pre_exec(|| {
            let mut mask = std::mem::zeroed();
            libc::sigemptyset(&mut mask);
            libc::sigaddset(&mut mask, libc::SIGCHLD);
            libc::sigaddset(&mut mask, libc::SIGTERM);
            let status = libc::pthread_sigmask(libc::SIG_SETMASK, &mask, std::ptr::null_mut());
            if status == 0 {
                Ok(())
            } else {
                Err(std::io::Error::from_raw_os_error(status))
            }
        });
    }
    let mut fixture = command.spawn().unwrap();
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5);
    while fixture.try_wait().unwrap().is_none() {
        if Instant::now() >= deadline {
            fixture.kill().unwrap();
            fixture.wait().unwrap();
            panic!("isolated supervisor signal fixture timed out");
        }
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
    }
    let output = fixture.wait_with_output().unwrap();
    assert!(
        output.status.success(),
        "isolated fixture failed:\n{}\n{}",
        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),
        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
    );
}
```
