```rs
impl Mock {
    fn new(objects: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) -> Self {
        let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
        listener.set_nonblocking(true).unwrap();
        let base = format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap());
        let state = Arc::new(Mutex::new(State {
            objects,
            requests: vec![],
            fail_chunk_put: false,
            missing_link: false,
            corrupt_chunk: false,
            redirect_manifest: false,
            inventory_error: false,
            list_count: 0,
            mutate_on_list: None,
            delay_blob_ms: 0,
            nullable_link_metadata: false,
            invalid_link_hash: false,
            null_listing_field: None,
            slow_object: None,
        }));
        let stopped = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
        let thread_stop = stopped.clone();
        let thread_state = state.clone();
        let thread_base = base.clone();
        let handle = thread::spawn(move || {
            let mut served = Vec::new();
            while !thread_stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
                let (socket, _) = match listener.accept() {
                    Ok(value) => value,
                    Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
                        thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2));
                        continue;
                    }
                    Err(error) => panic!("{error}"),
                };
                let state = thread_state.clone();
                let base = thread_base.clone();
                // Transfers overlap, so each connection is answered on its own.
                served.push(thread::spawn(move || serve(socket, &state, &base)));
            }
            // A failed assertion while answering fails the test.
            for handler in served {
                handler.join().unwrap();
            }
        });
        let mut api = Api::new().unwrap();
        api.account = base.clone();
        api.library = base.clone();
        api.cloud = base;
        Self {
            api,
            state,
            stop: stopped,
            handle: Some(handle),
        }
    }
    fn client(&self) -> Client {
        Client::from_session(
            self.api.clone(),
            Session {
                credentials: Credentials {
                    account_id: "account".into(),
                    display_name: "Player".into(),
                    refresh_token: "refresh".into(),
                },
                access_token: "access".into(),
                expires_at: Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(3600),
            },
        )
    }
}

fn links(state: &Mutex<State>) -> usize {
    let state = state.lock().unwrap();
    state
        .requests
        .iter()
        .filter(|(method, _, _)| method == "POST")
        .count()
}

fn serve(mut socket: TcpStream, thread_state: &Mutex<State>, thread_base: &str) {
    socket.set_nonblocking(false).unwrap();
    socket
        .set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(2)))
        .unwrap();
    socket
        .set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(2)))
        .unwrap();
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    let mut buffer = [0u8; 8192];
    let header_end = loop {
        let count = socket.read(&mut buffer).unwrap_or(0);
        if count == 0 {
            break None;
        }
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..count]);
        if let Some(end) = bytes.windows(4).position(|s| s == b"\r\n\r\n") {
            break Some(end);
        }
    };
    let Some(header_end) = header_end else {
        return;
    };
    let headers = String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes[..header_end]).into_owned();
    let length: usize = headers
        .lines()
        .find_map(|line| {
            line.to_ascii_lowercase()
                .strip_prefix("content-length: ")
                .and_then(|v| v.parse().ok())
        })
        .unwrap_or(0);
    while bytes.len() < header_end + 4 + length {
        let count = socket.read(&mut buffer).unwrap_or(0);
        if count == 0 {
            break;
        }
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..count]);
    }
    let mut first = headers.lines().next().unwrap().split_whitespace();
    let method = first.next().unwrap();
    let path = first.next().unwrap().split('?').next().unwrap();
    let auth = headers.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("authorization:");
    let mut state = thread_state.lock().unwrap();
    state
        .requests
        .push((method.to_owned(), path.to_owned(), auth));
    let mut status = 200;
    let mut extra = String::new();
    let body;
    if path == "/library/api/public/items" && method == "GET" {
        assert!(auth);
        body = serde_json::to_vec(&json!({
                "records": [{"namespace":"space", "catalogItemId":"item", "appName":"game", "sandboxType":"PUBLIC"}],
                "responseMetadata": {"nextCursor":null},
            })).unwrap();
    } else if path.ends_with("/manifests/") && method == "GET" {
        assert!(auth);
        state.list_count += 1;
        if state
            .mutate_on_list
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|(count, _, _)| *count == state.list_count)
        {
            let (_, name, bytes) = state.mutate_on_list.take().unwrap();
            state.objects.insert(name, bytes);
        }
        if state.inventory_error {
            status = 503;
            body = b"error".to_vec();
        } else {
            let files: serde_json::Map<_, _> = state.objects.iter().filter(|(name, _)| name.starts_with("manifests/")).map(|(name, bytes)| {
                    let mut entry = json!({"hash":hex(bytes),"lastModified":"2026-09-22T01:00:00Z","readLink":format!("{thread_base}/blob/{name}")});
                    if let Some(field) = state.null_listing_field { entry[field] = Value::Null; }
                    (format!("savesync/account/game/{name}"), entry)
                }).collect();
            body = serde_json::to_vec(&json!({"files":files})).unwrap();
        }
    } else if path.ends_with("/game/") && method == "POST" {
        assert!(auth);
        let request: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes[header_end + 4..]).unwrap();
        let files: serde_json::Map<_, _> = request["files"].as_array().unwrap().iter().skip(usize::from(state.missing_link)).map(|name| {
                let name = name.as_str().unwrap();
                let mut entry = json!({"readLink":format!("{thread_base}/blob/{name}"),"writeLink":format!("{thread_base}/blob/{name}")});
                if state.nullable_link_metadata { entry["hash"] = Value::Null; entry["lastModified"] = Value::Null; }
                if state.invalid_link_hash { entry["hash"] = json!(false); }
                (format!("savesync/account/game/{name}"), entry)
            }).collect();
        body = serde_json::to_vec(&json!({"files":files})).unwrap();
    } else if let Some(name) = path.strip_prefix("/blob/") {
        assert!(!auth, "signed object requests must not carry OAuth");
        if method == "PUT" {
            if state.fail_chunk_put && !name.starts_with("manifests/") {
                status = 503;
            } else {
                state
                    .objects
                    .insert(name.to_owned(), bytes[header_end + 4..].to_vec());
            }
            body = vec![];
        } else if state.redirect_manifest && name.starts_with("manifests/") {
            status = 302;
            extra = format!("Location: {thread_base}/redirect-target\r\n");
            body = vec![];
        } else {
            let delay = state.delay_blob_ms;
            body = match state.objects.get(name) {
                Some(bytes) => {
                    let mut bytes = bytes.clone();
                    if state.corrupt_chunk && !name.starts_with("manifests/") {
                        *bytes.last_mut().unwrap() ^= 1;
                    }
                    bytes
                }
                None => {
                    status = 404;
                    vec![]
                }
            };
            let slow = state.slow_object.as_deref() == Some(name);
            drop(state);
            thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay));
            if slow {
                // Answered once a second link request came, or after a while.
                let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5);
                while Instant::now() < deadline && links(thread_state) < 2 {
                    thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2));
                }
                let mut state = thread_state.lock().unwrap();
                state.requests.push(("DONE".into(), path.to_owned(), false));
            }
            let output = format!(
                "HTTP/1.1 {status} fixture\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
                body.len()
            );
            let _ = socket.write_all(output.as_bytes());
            let _ = socket.write_all(&body);
            return;
        }
    } else {
        panic!("unexpected {method} {path}");
    }
    drop(state);
    let output = format!(
        "HTTP/1.1 {status} fixture\r\n{extra}Content-Length: {}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
        body.len()
    );
    let _ = socket.write_all(output.as_bytes());
    let _ = socket.write_all(&body);
}

        self.stop.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
        self.handle.take().unwrap().join().unwrap();
    }

fn hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    obelisk_core::install::hex(&Sha1::digest(bytes))
}
fn rules() -> CloudRules {
    CloudRules {
        cloud_save_folder: None,
        cloud_save_folder_mac: Some("{Home}/saves".into()),
        include: vec![],
        exclude: vec![],
    }
}
fn fixture(files: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
    let package = codec::package(
        game(),
        "account",
        &rules(),
        files,
        1_790_000_000,
        &CancelToken::new(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let mut objects = package.chunks;
    objects.insert(package.manifest_path, package.manifest);
    objects
}

/// A complete read as a Cloud sync makes it: the listing, every file it names,
/// then the inventory again, which must not have changed.
#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
struct Generation {
    revision: String,
    files: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
}
impl Generation {
    fn revision(&self) -> &str {
        &self.revision
    }
}
async fn download_all(
    client: &Client,
    game: CloudGame<'_>,
    cancel: &CancelToken,
) -> Result<Generation, EpicError> {
    let listing = client.cloud_list(game, cancel).await?;
    let names = listing.files().map(|(name, _)| name.to_owned()).collect();
    let files = client.cloud_fetch(game, &listing, &names, cancel).await?;
    if client.cloud_revision(game, &listing, cancel).await? != listing.revision() {
        return Err(EpicError::CloudConflict);
    }
    Ok(Generation {
        revision: listing.revision().to_owned(),
        files,
    })
}
/// Whether `listing` names exactly `files`, with their sizes and hashes.
fn lists(listing: &CloudListing, files: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) -> bool {
    listing.files().eq(files
        .iter()
        .map(|(name, bytes)| (name.as_str(), bytes.len() as u64)))
        && files.iter().all(|(name, bytes)| listing.holds(name, bytes))
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn upload_download_and_all_deleted_generation_require_full_readback() {
    let mock = Mock::new(BTreeMap::new());
    let client = mock.client();
    let cancel = CancelToken::new();
    let empty = download_all(&client, game(), &cancel).await.unwrap();
    assert!(empty.files.is_empty());
    let files = BTreeMap::from([
        ("slot.sav".into(), b"progress 1".to_vec()),
        ("empty.sav".into(), vec![]),
    ]);
    let sent = mock.state.lock().unwrap().requests.len();
    let uploaded = client
        .cloud_upload(game(), &rules(), &files, empty.revision(), &cancel)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(lists(&uploaded, &files));
    assert_ne!(uploaded.revision(), empty.revision());
    {
        // The upload itself reads every chunk back after writing them.
        let state = mock.state.lock().unwrap();
        let upload = &state.requests[sent..];
        let last_put = upload
            .iter()
            .rposition(|(method, path, _)| method == "PUT" && path.contains("ChunksV4"))
            .unwrap();
        assert!(
            upload[last_put..]
                .iter()
                .any(|(method, path, _)| method == "GET" && path.contains("/blob/ChunksV4"))
        );
    }
    let read = download_all(&client, game(), &cancel).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(read.files, files);
    assert_eq!(read.revision, uploaded.revision());
    let deleted = client
        .cloud_upload(
            game(),
            &rules(),
            &BTreeMap::new(),
            uploaded.revision(),
            &cancel,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(deleted.files().count(), 0);
    assert_ne!(deleted.revision(), uploaded.revision());
    let state = mock.state.lock().unwrap();
    let first_put = state
        .requests
        .iter()
        .position(|(method, _, _)| method == "PUT")
        .unwrap();
    assert!(state.requests[first_put].1.contains("ChunksV4"));
    assert!(
        state
            .requests
            .iter()
            .any(|(method, path, _)| method == "GET" && path.contains("/blob/ChunksV4"))
    );
    assert!(
        state
            .requests
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, path, _)| path.starts_with("/blob/"))
            .all(|(_, _, auth)| !auth)
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn cancellation_interrupts_pending_signed_request_and_session_loss_discards_result() {
    let files = BTreeMap::from([("slot.sav".into(), b"save".to_vec())]);
    let mock = Mock::new(fixture(&files));
    mock.state.lock().unwrap().delay_blob_ms = 200;
    let client = mock.client();
    let cancel = CancelToken::new();
    let task = download_all(&client, game(), &cancel);
    let cancel_later = async {
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(30)).await;
        cancel.cancel();
    };
    let (result, _) = tokio::join!(task, cancel_later);
    assert!(matches!(result, Err(EpicError::Cancelled)));
    let mock = Mock::new(fixture(&files));
    mock.state.lock().unwrap().delay_blob_ms = 100;
    let client = mock.client();
    let cancel = CancelToken::new();
    let discard = async {
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20)).await;
        *client.session.lock().await = None;
    };
    let (result, _) = tokio::join!(download_all(&client, game(), &cancel), discard);
    assert!(matches!(result, Err(EpicError::Unauthorized)));
}

#[test]
fn metadata_rejects_duplicates_and_unsigned_or_foreign_destinations() {

    for url in [
        "https://amazonaws.com.evil.test/key",
        "https://user@bucket.s3.amazonaws.com/key",
        "https://127.0.0.1/key",
        "ftp://bucket.s3.amazonaws.com/key",
        "https://bucket.s3.amazonaws.com/key#fragment",
    ] {
        assert!(signed_url(url).is_err(), "{url}");

#[tokio::test]
async fn native_tuple_is_read_through_the_owned_game_transport() {
    for (name, accepted) in [
        ("space:item:game:account", true),
        ("foreign:item:game:account", false),
    ] {
        let manifest = serde_json::to_vec(&json!({
            "ManifestFileVersion":"017000000000",
            "AppNameString": name,
            "BuildVersionString":"2026.09.22-00.00.00",
            "FileManifestList":[], "ChunkHashList":{}, "ChunkShaList":{},
            "DataGroupList":{}, "ChunkFilesizeList":{},
        }))
        .unwrap();

            manifest,
        )]));
        let result = download_all(&mock.client(), game(), &CancelToken::new()).await;
        if accepted {
            assert!(result.unwrap().files.is_empty());
        } else {
            assert!(matches!(result, Err(EpicError::Protocol)));
        }
        let requests = &mock.state.lock().unwrap().requests;
        assert_eq!(requests[0].1, "/library/api/public/items");
        assert!(requests.iter().all(|(method, _, _)| method == "GET"));
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn nullable_inventory_metadata_and_scalar_link_metadata_still_fail() {
    let files = BTreeMap::from([("slot.sav".into(), b"synthetic progress".to_vec())]);
    for field in ["hash", "lastModified"] {
        let mock = Mock::new(fixture(&files));
        mock.state.lock().unwrap().null_listing_field = Some(field);
        assert!(matches!(
            download_all(&mock.client(), game(), &CancelToken::new()).await,
            Err(EpicError::Protocol)
        ));
        assert!(
            mock.state
                .lock()
                .unwrap()
                .requests
                .iter()
                .all(|(_, path, _)| !path.starts_with("/blob/"))
        );
    }
    let mock = Mock::new(fixture(&files));
    mock.state.lock().unwrap().invalid_link_hash = true;
    assert!(matches!(
        download_all(&mock.client(), game(), &CancelToken::new()).await,
        Err(EpicError::Protocol)
    ));
    for field in ["hash", "lastModified"] {

            entry[field] = invalid;
            assert!(serde_json::from_value::<Entry>(entry).is_err());
        }
    }
}

fn chunk_reads(state: &State) -> usize {
    state
        .requests
        .iter()
        .filter(|(method, path, _)| method == "GET" && path.contains("/blob/ChunksV4"))
        .count()
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn fetching_some_files_downloads_only_their_chunks() {
    // The first save fills a whole chunk, so the second starts its own.
    let files = BTreeMap::from([
        ("a.sav".into(), vec![1; 1024 * 1024]),
        ("b.sav".into(), b"small save".to_vec()),
    ]);
    let mock = Mock::new(fixture(&files));
    let client = mock.client();
    let cancel = CancelToken::new();
    let listing = client.cloud_list(game(), &cancel).await.unwrap();
    let wanted = BTreeSet::from(["b.sav".to_owned()]);
    let fetched = client
        .cloud_fetch(game(), &listing, &wanted, &cancel)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        fetched,
        BTreeMap::from([("b.sav".into(), b"small save".to_vec())])
    );
    assert_eq!(chunk_reads(&mock.state.lock().unwrap()), 1);

    let unlisted = BTreeSet::from(["c.sav".to_owned()]);
    assert!(matches!(
        client
            .cloud_fetch(game(), &listing, &unlisted, &cancel)
            .await,
        Err(EpicError::Protocol)
    ));
    assert_eq!(chunk_reads(&mock.state.lock().unwrap()), 1);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn chunk_transfers_refill_across_link_batches() {
    let files = BTreeMap::from([
        ("a.sav".into(), vec![0; 51 * 1024 * 1024]),
        ("b.sav".into(), vec![0; 51 * 1024 * 1024]),
    ]);
    let objects = fixture(&files);
    let (_, manifest) = objects
        .iter()
        .find(|(name, _)| name.starts_with("manifests/"))
        .unwrap();
    let manifest = codec::parse(manifest, game(), "account").unwrap();
    assert!(manifest.chunks.len() > LINK_BATCH);
    // The first chunk of the first batch is answered last.
    let first = manifest
        .chunks
        .values()
        .next()
        .unwrap()
        .relative_path(manifest.feature_level);
    let mock = Mock::new(objects);
    mock.state.lock().unwrap().slow_object = Some(first.clone());
    let client = mock.client();
    let read = download_all(&client, game(), &CancelToken::new())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(read.files, files);
    let state = mock.state.lock().unwrap();
    let links: Vec<_> = state
        .requests
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter(|(_, (method, _, _))| method == "POST")
        .map(|(index, _)| index)
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(links.len(), manifest.chunks.len().div_ceil(LINK_BATCH));
    let done = state
        .requests
        .iter()
        .position(|(method, path, _)| method == "DONE" && path.ends_with(&first))
        .unwrap();
    // The next batch's links came while the slow chunk of the first was
    // still being read.
    assert!(links[1] < done);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_listing_holds_only_bytes_with_its_size_and_sha1() {
    let files = BTreeMap::from([("slot.sav".into(), b"progress".to_vec())]);

    assert!(!listing.holds("slot.sav", b"progress!"));
    assert!(!listing.holds("other.sav", b"progress"));
    let built = CloudListing::of("revision".into(), "account".into(), &files);
    assert!(lists(&built, &files));
    assert_eq!(built.revision(), "revision");
}
```

`crates/storefronts/epic-kit/src/client/download.rs`:

```rs
//! Epic's side of an installation Transfer: obelisk-core runs the order around
//! it, this module prepares Epic's manifest and runs its content engine.
use std::{path::Path, sync::Arc};

use obelisk_core::{
    install::hex,
    installation::{self, Destination, InstallFailure, InstalledFiles, TransferError},
    platform::Platform,
    transfer::{TransferBusy, TransferContext, Transfers},
};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};

use super::{Client, PLATFORM, validate_identity, write_platform};
pub use crate::content_manifest::Prerequisite;
use crate::{EpicError, content::ContentClient, details};

pub use obelisk_core::{installation::TransferProgress, transfer::TransferState};

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Installation {
    pub app_name: String,
    pub namespace: String,
    pub catalog_item_id: String,
    pub account_id: String,
    pub directory: String,
    #[serde(serialize_with = "write_platform")]
    pub platform: Platform,
    pub total_bytes: u64,
    pub build_version: String,
    pub launch_executable: String,
    pub launch_command: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub deployment_id: Option<String>,
    /// What the build asks to run once before its game first starts.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub prerequisite: Option<Prerequisite>,
}

pub(super) type Downloads = Transfers<TransferProgress>;

impl From<TransferBusy> for EpicError {
    fn from(_: TransferBusy) -> Self {
        Self::AlreadyDownloading
    }
}

impl From<InstallFailure> for EpicError {
    fn from(failure: InstallFailure) -> Self {
        match failure {
            InstallFailure::ParentMissing => Self::Service {
                message: "backend.epic.choose_existing_folder".into(),
            },
            InstallFailure::UnsafeDirectory(name) => Self::UnsafePath(name),
            InstallFailure::DestinationIsLink(path)
            | InstallFailure::DestinationIsFile(path)
            | InstallFailure::UnsafeLock(path)
            | InstallFailure::UnsafeReceipt(path) => {
                Self::UnsafePath(path.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
            }
            InstallFailure::Locked => Self::AlreadyDownloading,
            InstallFailure::Io(error) => Self::Io(error),
        }
    }
}

impl TransferError for EpicError {
    fn is_cancellation(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Cancelled)
    }
}

/// Everything fetched before the installation lock is taken.
struct PreparedDownload {
    fetched: details::FetchedManifest,
    account_id: String,
}

impl Client {
    pub fn progress(&self) -> Option<TransferProgress> {
        self.downloads.snapshot()
    }

    pub fn cancel_download(&self) {
        self.build_choice.cancel();
        self.downloads.cancel();
    }

    /// Whether Epic's live build of the game differs from the one installed
    /// in `directory`, as the launcher service names its version. An
    /// installation whose receipt is gone needs its Transfer too.
    pub async fn update_available(
        &self,
        namespace: &str,
        catalog_item_id: &str,
        app_name: &str,
        platform: Platform,
        directory: &Path,
    ) -> Result<bool, EpicError> {
        validate_identity(namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name)?;
        let Some(installed) =
            installation::read_receipt::<Installation>(directory)?.filter(|receipt| {
                receipt.namespace == namespace
                    && receipt.app_name == app_name
                    && receipt.platform == platform
            })
        else {
            return Ok(true);
        };
        let live = self
            .with_access_token(|token| async move {
                details::live_build_version(
                    &self.api,
                    &token,
                    namespace,
                    catalog_item_id,
                    app_name,
                    platform,
                )
                .await
            })
            .await?;
        Ok(live != installed.build_version)
    }

    pub async fn download(
        &self,
        namespace: &str,
        catalog_item_id: &str,
        app_name: &str,
        platform: Platform,
        parent: &Path,
    ) -> Result<Installation, EpicError> {
        validate_identity(namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name)?;
        let directory = installation_directory_name(namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name, platform);
        installation::install(
            &self.downloads,
            app_name,
            Destination {
                parent,
                directory: &directory,
            },
            |destination, cancel| async move {
                let prepared = cancel
                    .race(self.prepare_download(
                        namespace,
                        catalog_item_id,
                        app_name,
                        platform,
                        &destination,
                    ))
                    .await??;
                // A revoked account withdraws nothing: the receipt stays until
                // the installation lock is taken.
                if self.session.lock().await.is_none() {
                    return Err(EpicError::Unauthorized);
                }
                Ok(prepared)
            },
            |prepared, destination, transfer| async move {
                self.install_files(
                    namespace,
                    catalog_item_id,
                    app_name,
                    platform,
                    prepared,
                    &destination,
                    &transfer,
                )
                .await
            },
        )
        .await
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    async fn install_files(
        &self,
        namespace: &str,
        catalog_item_id: &str,
        app_name: &str,
        platform: Platform,
        prepared: PreparedDownload,
        destination: &Path,
        transfer: &TransferContext<TransferProgress>,
    ) -> Result<InstalledFiles<Installation>, EpicError> {
        let cancel = transfer.cancel_token();
        let PreparedDownload {
            mut fetched,
            account_id,
        } = prepared;
        let network_bytes = fetched.network_bytes;
        let manifest = Arc::new(fetched.manifest.take().ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?);
        if fetched.network_bytes != 0
            && let Some(key) = &fetched.cache_key
        {
            // This bounded atomic write remains under the installation lock;
            // cancelling or dropping the future cannot detach a cache writer.
            cancel.check()?;
            details::manifest_cache::store(destination, key, &fetched.bytes)?;
        }
        drop(fetched.bytes);

        let progress = transfer.clone();
        let summary = ContentClient::new(self.api.http.clone())
            .download(
                Arc::clone(&manifest),
                &fetched.base_urls,
                destination,
                cancel,
                move |snapshot| {
                    debug_assert!(snapshot.completed_files <= snapshot.total_files);
                    progress.update(|progress| {
                        progress.show(snapshot);
                        progress.network_bytes =
                            progress.network_bytes.saturating_add(network_bytes);
                    });
                },
            )
            .await?;
        cancel.check()?;
        if self.session.lock().await.is_none() {
            return Err(EpicError::Unauthorized);
        }
        debug_assert!(summary.reused_bytes <= summary.total_bytes);
        debug_assert_eq!(summary.completed_files as usize, manifest.files.len());
        Ok(InstalledFiles {
            receipt: Installation {
                app_name: app_name.into(),
                namespace: namespace.into(),
                catalog_item_id: catalog_item_id.into(),
                account_id,
                directory: destination.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
                platform,
                total_bytes: summary.total_bytes,
                build_version: manifest.build_version.clone(),
                launch_executable: manifest.launch_executable.clone(),
                launch_command: manifest.launch_command.clone(),
                deployment_id: fetched.deployment_id,
                prerequisite: manifest.prerequisite.clone(),
            },
            total_bytes: summary.total_bytes,
            network_bytes: network_bytes.saturating_add(summary.downloaded_bytes),
            content_bytes: summary.content_bytes,
        })
    }

    async fn prepare_download(
        &self,
        namespace: &str,
        catalog_item_id: &str,
        app_name: &str,
        platform: Platform,
        cache_directory: &Path,
    ) -> Result<PreparedDownload, EpicError> {
        let fetched = self
            .with_access_token(|token| async move {
                self.ensure_owned(&token, namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name)
                    .await?;
                details::fetch_manifest(
                    &self.api,
                    &token,
                    namespace,
                    catalog_item_id,
                    app_name,
                    platform,
                    Some(cache_directory),
                    |key| self.build_choice.take(key),
                )
                .await
            })
            .await?;
        Ok(PreparedDownload {
            fetched,
            account_id: self.credentials().await?.account_id,
        })
    }
}

/// The dedicated directory name for one Epic installation. The host relies on
/// this exact scheme to recognise and remove installations it created.
pub fn installation_directory_name(
    namespace: &str,
    catalog_item_id: &str,
    app_name: &str,
    platform: Platform,
) -> String {
    // Identity is hashed, never interpolated into a filesystem path. App names
    // can include separators and are not globally unique across namespaces.
    let identity =
        serde_json::to_vec(&(namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name)).expect("strings serialize");
    format!(
        "epic-{}-{}",
        hex(&Sha1::digest(identity)),
        PLATFORM.name(platform)
    )
}
```

`crates/storefronts/epic-kit/src/client/launch.rs`:

```rs
//! Resolve a verified Epic installation and obtain fresh, short-lived game
//! credentials. Process execution remains in the native host.
use std::{collections::BTreeMap, path::Path};

use obelisk_core::{
    installation::{self, InstallFailure},
    launch::{self, LaunchTarget},
    platform::Platform,
};
use serde::Deserialize;

use super::{Client, Installation, Prerequisite, endpoint, validate_identity};
use crate::{
    EpicError,
    friends::{Activity, publishable_text},
};

// Intentionally no Debug: arguments contain a one-use exchange code and the
// optional ownership token must only be handed to the game being launched.
pub struct LaunchPlan {
    pub app_name: String,
    /// Absent when the catalog offers no publishable presence identity.
    pub activity: Option<Activity>,
    pub platform: Platform,
    pub target: LaunchTarget,
    pub ownership_token: Option<Vec<u8>>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct ExchangeCode {
    code: String,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct LaunchCatalogItem {
    #[serde(default)]
    title: serde_json::Value,
    #[serde(default)]
    custom_attributes: BTreeMap<String, serde_json::Value>,
}

struct LaunchCredentials {
    exchange: String,
    additional: String,
    ownership_token: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    activity: Option<Activity>,
}

impl LaunchCatalogItem {
    fn attribute(&self, name: &str) -> Result<Option<&str>, EpicError> {
        self.custom_attributes
            .get(name)
            .map(|attribute| {
                attribute
                    .get("value")
                    .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)
                    .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)
            })
            .transpose()
    }
}

/// The game an installation starts and what it asks to run once before its
/// game first starts, as its local receipt names them. Nothing is fetched, so
/// this runs before any short-lived game credential exists.
pub struct InstalledLaunch {
    /// The publisher's executable and command line, without the arguments a
    /// launch plan adds.
    pub target: LaunchTarget,
    pub prerequisite: Option<Prerequisite>,
}

/// What the installation in `directory` starts, from its receipt alone.
pub fn installed_launch(
    namespace: &str,
    catalog_item_id: &str,
    app_name: &str,
    platform: Platform,
    directory: &Path,
) -> Result<InstalledLaunch, EpicError> {
    validate_identity(namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name)?;
    let installed = open_installation(directory)?;
    let receipt = installed
        .receipt
        .as_ref()
        .ok_or_else(|| launch_error("incompleteInstallation"))?;
    if receipt.namespace != namespace
        || receipt.catalog_item_id != catalog_item_id
        || receipt.app_name != app_name
        || receipt.platform != platform
    {
        return Err(launch_error("incompleteInstallation"));
    }
    Ok(InstalledLaunch {
        target: installed_target(platform, &installed.root, receipt)?,
        prerequisite: receipt.prerequisite.clone(),
    })
}

/// The catalog item of the build installed in `directory`, as its own receipt
/// records it.
pub fn installed_catalog_item(directory: &Path) -> Result<String, EpicError> {
    open_installation(directory)?
        .receipt
        .map(|receipt| receipt.catalog_item_id)
        .ok_or_else(|| launch_error("incompleteInstallation"))
}

fn open_installation(
    directory: &Path,
) -> Result<installation::Installation<Installation>, EpicError> {
    installation::open::<Installation>(directory).map_err(|failure| match failure {
        InstallFailure::Io(_) => launch_error("directoryUnreadable"),
        failure => failure.into(),
    })
}

/// The exact publisher executable and argv, with Steam's shared path
/// confinement and quoting rules. Never a shell.
fn installed_target(
    platform: Platform,
    root: &Path,
    receipt: &Installation,
) -> Result<LaunchTarget, EpicError> {
    let executable = receipt.launch_executable.replace('\\', "/");
    let working_directory = Path::new(&executable)
        .parent()
        .and_then(Path::to_str)
        .unwrap_or("");
    launch::resolve(
        platform,
        root,
        &executable,
        &receipt.launch_command,
        working_directory,
    )
    .map_err(|error| launch_error(error.key_suffix()))
}

impl Client {
    pub async fn launch_plan(
        &self,
        namespace: &str,
        catalog_item_id: &str,
        app_name: &str,
        platform: Platform,
        directory: &Path,
        language: &str,
    ) -> Result<LaunchPlan, EpicError> {
        validate_identity(namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name)?;
        let credentials = self.credentials().await?;
        if !directory.is_absolute() || !directory.is_dir() {
            return Err(launch_error("directoryMissing"));
        }
        // No Transfer of this installation can start until the plan returns.
        let installed = open_installation(directory)?;
        let root = &installed.root;
        let receipt = installed
            .receipt
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| launch_error("incompleteInstallation"))?;
        if receipt.namespace != namespace
            || receipt.catalog_item_id != catalog_item_id
            || receipt.app_name != app_name
            || receipt.platform != platform
            || receipt.account_id != credentials.account_id
            || Path::new(&receipt.directory).canonicalize().ok().as_ref() != Some(root)
        {
            return Err(launch_error("incompleteInstallation"));
        }
        let mut target = installed_target(platform, root, receipt)?;
        let account_id = credentials.account_id.as_str();
        let launch = self
            .with_access_token(|token| async move {
                self.launch_credentials(&token, account_id, namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name)
                    .await
            })
            .await?;
        // Disconnect may complete while the account APIs are in flight.
        let current = self.credentials().await?;
        if current.account_id != receipt.account_id {
            return Err(EpicError::Unauthorized);
        }
        target.arguments.extend(
            launch::parse_arguments(&launch.additional, platform)
                .map_err(|error| launch_error(error.key_suffix()))?,
        );
        target.arguments.extend([
            "-AUTH_LOGIN=unused".into(),
            format!("-AUTH_PASSWORD={}", launch.exchange),
            "-AUTH_TYPE=exchangecode".into(),
            format!("-epicapp={app_name}"),
            "-epicenv=Prod".into(),
            "-EpicPortal".into(),
            format!("-epicusername={}", current.display_name),
            format!("-epicuserid={}", current.account_id),
            format!("-epiclocale={}", epic_locale(language)),
            format!("-epicsandboxid={namespace}"),
        ]);
        if let Some(deployment) = &receipt.deployment_id {
            if deployment.is_empty() || deployment.len() > 1024 || deployment.contains('\0') {
                return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
            }
            target
                .arguments
                .push(format!("-epicdeploymentid={deployment}"));
        }
        Ok(LaunchPlan {
            app_name: app_name.into(),
            activity: launch.activity,
            platform,
            target,
            ownership_token: launch.ownership_token,
        })
    }

    async fn launch_credentials(
        &self,
        access_token: &str,
        account_id: &str,
        namespace: &str,
        catalog_item_id: &str,
        app_name: &str,
    ) -> Result<LaunchCredentials, EpicError> {
        self.ensure_owned(access_token, namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name)
            .await?;
        let mut url = endpoint(
            &self.api.catalog,
            &[
                "catalog",
                "api",
                "shared",
                "namespace",
                namespace,
                "bulk",
                "items",
            ],
        )?;
        url.query_pairs_mut()
            .append_pair("id", catalog_item_id)
            .append_pair("locale", "en");
        let mut catalog: BTreeMap<String, LaunchCatalogItem> =
            self.api.get(url, access_token).await?;
        let item = catalog.remove(catalog_item_id).ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
        let additional = item
            .attribute("AdditionalCommandLine")?
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .to_owned();
        let requires_ownership = item
            .attribute("OwnershipToken")?
            .is_some_and(|value| value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("true"));
        let ownership = async {
            if requires_ownership {
                self.api
                    .ownership_token(access_token, account_id, namespace, catalog_item_id)
                    .await
                    .map(Some)
            } else {
                Ok(None)
            }
        };
        let url = endpoint(&self.api.account, &["account", "api", "oauth", "exchange"])?;
        let (exchange, ownership_token): (ExchangeCode, Option<Vec<u8>>) =
            tokio::try_join!(self.api.get(url, access_token), ownership)?;
        if exchange.code.is_empty()
            || exchange.code.len() > 2048
            || !exchange
                .code
                .bytes()
                .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'-' | b'_'))
        {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
        // Presence metadata is optional and must never prevent a valid launch.
        // An unusable title still publishes the activity, without a name.
        let name = item
            .title
            .as_str()
            .filter(|title| publishable_text(title, Activity::NAME_MAX))
            .map(str::to_owned);
        let activity = item.attribute("PresenceId").ok().and_then(|value| {
            let id = value.unwrap_or(namespace);
            (publishable_text(id, Activity::ID_MAX) && !id.starts_with("p-")).then(|| Activity {
                id: id.to_owned(),
                name,
            })
        });
        Ok(LaunchCredentials {
            exchange: exchange.code,
            additional,
            ownership_token,
            activity,
        })
    }
}

fn launch_error(suffix: &str) -> EpicError {
    EpicError::Service {
        message: format!("backend.epic.launch.{suffix}"),
    }
}

fn epic_locale(language: &str) -> String {
    let value = language.replace('_', "-");
    if value.is_empty()
        || value.len() > 64
        || !value
            .bytes()
            .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || byte == b'-')
    {
        "en".into()
    } else {
        value
    }
}
```

```rs
use std::{
    io::{Read, Write},
    net::TcpListener,
    sync::{
        Arc, Mutex as StdMutex,
        atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering},
    },
    thread,
    time::Duration,
};

use serde_json::{Value, json};

use super::*;
use crate::friends::Activity;

struct Reply {
    path: String,
    status: u16,
    body: String,
    bearer: Option<&'static str>,
    delay_ms: u64,
}

fn reply(path: &str, status: u16, body: Value) -> Reply {
    Reply {
        path: path.into(),
        status,
        body: body.to_string(),
        bearer: None,
        delay_ms: 0,
    }
}

#[test]
fn a_game_joins_the_library_with_its_oldest_record() {
    let metadata = json!({ "libraryRecords": [
        { "acquisitionDate": "2022-05-20T10:00:00.000Z" },
        { "acquisitionDate": "2020-05-28T17:33:54.987Z" },
        { "acquisitionDate": "not a date" },
        {}
    ]});
    assert_eq!(added_at(&metadata), Some(1_590_687_234));
    assert_eq!(added_at(&json!({ "libraryRecords": [] })), None);
    assert_eq!(added_at(&json!({})), None);
}

struct Mock {
    api: Api,
    requests: Arc<StdMutex<Vec<String>>>,
    stop: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    handle: Option<thread::JoinHandle<()>>,
}

impl Mock {
    fn new(mut replies: Vec<Reply>) -> Self {
        let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
        listener.set_nonblocking(true).unwrap();
        let base = format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap());
        let requests = Arc::new(StdMutex::new(Vec::new()));
        let captured = requests.clone();
        let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
        let stopped = stop.clone();
        let fixture_base = base.clone();
        let handle = thread::spawn(move || {
            while !stopped.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
                let (mut socket, _) = match listener.accept() {
                    Ok(socket) => socket,
                    Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
                        thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2));
                        continue;
                    }
                    Err(error) => panic!("fixture listener: {error}"),
                };
                // On macOS accepted sockets can inherit O_NONBLOCK.
                socket.set_nonblocking(false).unwrap();
                socket
                    .set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(2)))
                    .unwrap();
                // Oversized responses can be rejected before the client drains
                // the socket. Bound the fixture writer so Drop cannot deadlock.
                socket
                    .set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(2)))
                    .unwrap();
                let mut bytes = Vec::new();
                let mut buffer = [0u8; 4096];
                let mut body_length = None;
                while let Ok(count) = socket.read(&mut buffer) {
                    if count == 0 {
                        break;
                    }
                    bytes.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..count]);
                    if let Some(index) = bytes.windows(4).position(|slice| slice == b"\r\n\r\n") {
                        let headers = String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes[..index]);
                        let length = headers
                            .lines()
                            .find_map(|line| {
                                line.to_ascii_lowercase()
                                    .strip_prefix("content-length: ")
                                    .and_then(|length| length.parse::<usize>().ok())
                            })
                            .unwrap_or(0);
                        body_length = Some(index + 4 + length);
                    }
                    if body_length.is_some_and(|length| bytes.len() >= length) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if bytes.is_empty() {
                    continue;
                }
                let request = String::from_utf8(bytes).unwrap();
                let target = request
                    .lines()
                    .next()
                    .unwrap()
                    .split_whitespace()
                    .nth(1)
                    .unwrap();
                let path = target.split('?').next().unwrap();
                let index = replies
                    .iter()
                    .position(|reply| {
                        reply.path == path
                            && reply
                                .bearer
                                .is_none_or(|token| request.contains(&format!("Bearer {token}")))
                    })
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("unexpected fixture request {path}"));
                let mut response = replies.remove(index);
                response.body = response.body.replace("FIXTURE_BASE", &fixture_base);
                captured.lock().unwrap().push(request);
                thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(response.delay_ms));
                let output = format!(
                    "HTTP/1.1 {} Fixture\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n{}",
                    response.status,
                    response.body.len(),
                    response.body
                );
                let _ = socket.write_all(output.as_bytes());
            }
        });
        let mut api = Api::new().unwrap();
        api.account = base.clone();
        api.store = base.clone();
        api.library = base.clone();
        api.launcher = base.clone();
        api.catalog = base.clone();
        api.ecommerce = base;
        Self {
            api,
            requests,
            stop,
            handle: Some(handle),
        }
    }

    fn client(&self, expired: bool) -> Client {
        Client::from_session(
            self.api.clone(),
            Session {
                credentials: credentials(),
                access_token: "access-old".into(),
                expires_at: if expired {
                    Instant::now()
                } else {
                    Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(3600)
                },
            },
        )
    }

    fn requests(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        self.requests.lock().unwrap().clone()
    }
}

impl Drop for Mock {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.stop.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
        self.handle.take().unwrap().join().unwrap();
    }
}

fn credentials() -> Credentials {
    Credentials {
        account_id: "account-a".into(),
        display_name: "Player".into(),
        refresh_token: "refresh-old".into(),
    }
}

fn token(account: &str) -> Value {
    json!({"access_token":"access-new", "refresh_token":"refresh-new", "account_id":account, "displayName":"Player", "expires_in":3600})
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn web_sign_in_spends_an_exchange_code_on_epics_site_only() {
    let mock = Mock::new(vec![reply(
        "/account/api/oauth/exchange",
        200,
        json!({"code":"single-use-code"}),
    )]);
    let client = mock.client(false);
    for elsewhere in [
        "http://store.epicgames.com/",
        "https://example.com/",
        "https://epicgames.com.example.com/",
        "https://user@store.epicgames.com/",
    ] {
        assert!(matches!(
            client.web_sign_in_url(elsewhere).await,
            Err(EpicError::Protocol)
        ));
    }
    let url = client
        .web_sign_in_url("https://store.epicgames.com/fr/")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        url,
        "https://www.epicgames.com/id/exchange?exchangeCode=single-use-code&redirectUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fstore.epicgames.com%2Ffr%2F"
    );
    assert_eq!(mock.requests().len(), 1, "No code for another site");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn supervisor_exchange_creates_a_distinct_session_without_rotating_parent_credentials() {
    let mock = Mock::new(vec![
        reply(
            "/account/api/oauth/exchange",
            200,
            json!({"code":"single-use-code"}),
        ),
        reply("/account/api/oauth/token", 200, token("account-a")),
    ]);
    let parent = mock.client(false);
    let code = parent.exchange_code().await.unwrap();
    let session = mock.api.exchange(&code, "account-a").await.unwrap();
    let supervisor = Client::from_session(mock.api.clone(), session);
    assert_eq!(
        parent.credentials().await.unwrap().refresh_token,
        "refresh-old"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        supervisor.credentials().await.unwrap().refresh_token,
        "refresh-new"
    );
    let requests = mock.requests();
    assert!(requests[0].contains("Bearer access-old"));
    assert!(requests[1].contains("grant_type=exchange_code"));
    assert!(requests[1].contains("exchange_code=single-use-code"));
    assert!(requests[1].contains("token_type=eg1"));
    assert!(!requests[1].contains("refresh-old"));
    assert!(!requests[1].contains("Bearer access-old"));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn cloud_configuration_requires_ownership_and_reads_the_rules_of_the_platform_build() {
    for (platform, attributes, expected) in [
        (Platform::Mac, json!({}), "none"),
        (
            Platform::Mac,
            json!({"CloudSaveFolder_MAC":{"value":"{Home}/Game"},"CloudExcludeList":{"value":"*.log"}}),
            "some",
        ),
        (
            Platform::Mac,
            json!({"CloudSaveFolder_MAC":{"value":false}}),
            "error",
        ),
        (
            Platform::Mac,
            json!({"CloudSaveFolder":{"value":"{AppData}/Game"}}),
            "none",
        ),
        (
            Platform::Windows,
            json!({"CloudSaveFolder":{"value":"{AppData}/Game"}}),
            "some",
        ),
        (
            Platform::Windows,
            json!({"CloudSaveFolder_MAC":{"value":"{Home}/Game"}}),
            "none",
        ),
        (
            Platform::Windows,
            json!({"CloudSaveFolder":{"value":""}}),
            "error",
        ),
    ] {
        let mock = Mock::new(vec![
            reply(
                "/library/api/public/items",
                200,
                json!({"records":[item("app", "item")], "responseMetadata":{"nextCursor":null}}),
            ),
            reply(
                "/catalog/api/shared/namespace/space/bulk/items",
                200,
                json!({"item":{"customAttributes":attributes}}),
            ),
        ]);
        let result = mock
            .client(false)
            .cloud_configuration("space", "item", "app", platform)
            .await;
        match expected {
            "none" => assert!(result.unwrap().is_none()),
            "some" => assert!(result.unwrap().is_some()),
            _ => assert!(result.is_err()),
        }
    }
    let mock = Mock::new(vec![reply(
        "/library/api/public/items",
        200,
        json!({"records":[],"responseMetadata":{"nextCursor":null}}),
    )]);
    assert!(
        mock.client(false)
            .cloud_configuration("space", "item", "app", Platform::Mac)
            .await
            .is_err()
    );
    assert_eq!(mock.requests().len(), 1);

const PLAYTIME_PATH: &str = "/library/api/public/playtime/account/account-a/all";
const MANIFEST_PATH: &str = "/launcher/api/public/assets/v2/platform/Mac/namespace/space/catalogItem/base/app/game/label/Live";
const WINDOWS_MANIFEST_PATH: &str = "/launcher/api/public/assets/v2/platform/Windows/namespace/space/catalogItem/base/app/game/label/Live";

fn live_asset(manifest: &str) -> Value {
    json!({"elements":[{"manifests":[{"uri":format!("FIXTURE_BASE/{manifest}"),"queryParams":[]}]}]})
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn game_details_name_the_build_a_download_installs_whose_manifest_may_be_unavailable() {
    // Epic has no Mac build, and the Windows build's manifest is gone.
    let mock = Mock::new(vec![
        reply(MANIFEST_PATH, 404, json!({})),
        reply(WINDOWS_MANIFEST_PATH, 200, live_asset("windows.manifest")),
        reply("/windows.manifest", 404, json!({})),
    ]);
    let details = mock
        .client(false)
        .game_details("space", "base", "game")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(details.platform, Some(Platform::Windows));
    assert_eq!(details.installation_bytes, None);
    assert_eq!(
        mock.requests().len(),
        3,
        "the library already read every playtime"
    );
    assert!(
        mock.requests()
            .iter()
            .filter(|request| request.contains("/launcher/"))
            .all(|request| request.contains("Bearer access-old"))
    );
    // Without any build, nothing is installable.
    let mock = Mock::new(vec![
        reply(MANIFEST_PATH, 200, json!({"elements":[]})),
        reply(WINDOWS_MANIFEST_PATH, 404, json!({})),
    ]);
    let details = mock
        .client(false)
        .game_details("space", "base", "game")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(details.platform, None);
    assert_eq!(details.installation_bytes, None);
}

/// A Mac build whose launch executable its manifest does not hold.
fn mac_build_without_program() -> Vec<Reply> {
    use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};
    let empty_hash: String = Sha1::digest([])
        .iter()
        .map(|byte| format!("{byte:03}"))
        .collect();
    vec![
        reply(MANIFEST_PATH, 200, live_asset("mac.manifest")),
        reply(
            "/mac.manifest",
            200,
            json!({
                "AppNameString": "game", "BuildVersionString": "1.0", "LaunchExeString":"Game.app",
                "FileManifestList":[{"Filename":"Game.app/Contents/empty", "FileHash":empty_hash, "FileChunkParts":[]}],
                "ChunkFilesizeList":{}, "ChunkHashList":{}, "ChunkShaList":{}, "DataGroupList":{}
            }),
        ),
    ]
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_game_s_page_shows_its_mac_build_until_a_download_found_it_is_not_native() {
    use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};
    // A Mac build without its program, whose manifest the asset's hash names.
    let manifest = mac_build_without_program().remove(1).body;
    let hash: String = Sha1::digest(manifest.as_bytes())
        .iter()
        .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
        .collect();
    let mut asset = live_asset("mac.manifest");
    asset["elements"][0]["hash"] = json!(hash);
    let mut found = reply("/mac.manifest", 200, Value::Null);
    found.body = manifest;
    let mock = Mock::new(vec![
        // The page: both builds, then the Mac build's size, unknown here.
        reply(MANIFEST_PATH, 200, asset.clone()),
        reply(WINDOWS_MANIFEST_PATH, 200, live_asset("windows.manifest")),
        reply("/mac.manifest", 404, json!({})),
        // The download's pick reads the Mac build's manifest.
        reply(MANIFEST_PATH, 200, asset.clone()),
        reply(WINDOWS_MANIFEST_PATH, 200, live_asset("windows.manifest")),
        found,
        // The page again.
        reply(MANIFEST_PATH, 200, asset),
        reply(WINDOWS_MANIFEST_PATH, 200, live_asset("windows.manifest")),
        reply("/windows.manifest", 404, json!({})),
    ]);
    let client = mock.client(false);
    let shown = client.game_details("space", "base", "game").await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(shown.platform, Some(Platform::Mac));
    assert_eq!(
        client.platform("space", "base", "game").await.unwrap(),
        Platform::Windows
    );
    let shown = client.game_details("space", "base", "game").await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(shown.platform, Some(Platform::Windows));
    assert_eq!(mock.requests().len(), 9);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn game_details_retry_auth_once_and_keep_rotated_credentials() {
    for status in [404, 401] {
        let mut rejected = reply(MANIFEST_PATH, 401, json!({}));
        rejected.bearer = Some("access-old");
        let mut retried = reply(MANIFEST_PATH, status, json!({}));
        retried.bearer = Some("access-new");
        // Epic is asked for both builds at once.
        let mut windows = reply(WINDOWS_MANIFEST_PATH, 404, json!({}));
        windows.bearer = Some("access-old");
        let mut windows_retried = reply(WINDOWS_MANIFEST_PATH, 404, json!({}));
        windows_retried.bearer = Some("access-new");
        let mock = Mock::new(vec![
            reply("/account/api/oauth/token", 200, token("account-a")),
            rejected,
            retried,
            windows,
            windows_retried,
        ]);
        let client = mock.client(false);
        let result = client.game_details("space", "base", "game").await;
        if status == 404 {
            assert_eq!(result.unwrap().installation_bytes, None);
        } else {
            assert!(matches!(result, Err(EpicError::Unauthorized)));
        }
        assert_eq!(
            client.credentials().await.unwrap().refresh_token,
            "refresh-new"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            mock.requests()
                .iter()
                .filter(|request| request.starts_with("POST "))
                .count(),
            1
        );
    }
}

            Value::Null,
        ),

    let client = Arc::new(mock.client(false));
    let reader = client.clone();
    let reading = tokio::spawn(async move { reader.game_details("space", "base", "game").await });
    tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), async {
        while mock.requests().is_empty() {
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1)).await;

        reading.await.unwrap(),

    ));

#[tokio::test]
async fn rotated_credentials_survive_a_failed_library_refresh() {
    let mut replies = empty_assets();
    replies.extend([
        reply("/account/api/oauth/token", 200, token("account-a")),
        reply(
            "/library/api/public/items",

    ]);

    let client = mock.client(true);
    let error = client.games().await.unwrap_err();
    assert!(matches!(error, EpicError::Service { .. }));
    assert!(!error.to_string().contains("secret"));
    assert_eq!(
        client.credentials().await.unwrap().refresh_token,
        "refresh-new"
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn pages_merge_owned_assets_and_metadata_without_duplicate_games() {
    let mut private = item("private", "private");
    private["sandboxType"] = json!("PRIVATE");
    let mock = Mock::new(vec![
        reply(
            "/library/api/public/items",
            200,
            json!({"records":[item("game","base"),item("game","alternate"),item("dlc","dlc"),private,item("asset","asset"),item("mobile","mobile")],"responseMetadata":{"nextCursor":"page2"}}),
        ),
        reply(
            "/library/api/public/items",
            200,
            json!({"records":[item("game","base"),item("missing","missing")],"responseMetadata":{}}),
        ),
        reply(
            "/launcher/api/public/assets/Windows",
            200,
            json!([item("game", "base")]),
        ),
        reply(
            "/launcher/api/public/assets/Mac",
            200,
            json!([item("game", "alternate")]),
        ),
        reply(
            "/catalog/api/shared/namespace/space/bulk/items",
            200,
            json!({
                "base":{"title":"A game","description":"Game description","developer":"Studio","keyImages":[{"type":"DieselGameBoxTall","url":"file:///bad"},{"type":"OfferImageTall","url":"https://cdn.epicgames.com/cover.jpg"},{"type":"DieselStoreFrontWide","url":"https://cdn.epicgames.com/header.jpg"}],"customAttributes":{"CanRunOffline":{"type":"STRING","value":"true"}}},
                "alternate":{"title":"A game"},
                "dlc":{"title":"DLC","mainGameItem":{"id":"base"}},
                "asset":{"title":"Editor asset","categories":[{"path":"asset-format"}]},
                "mobile":{"title":"Mobile","releaseInfo":[{"appId":"mobile","platform":["Android"]}]}
            }),
        ),
    ]);
    let games = mock.client(false).games().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(games.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(games[0].title, "A game");
    assert!(games[0].windows && games[0].macos);
    assert_eq!(
        games[0].image_url.as_deref(),
        Some("https://cdn.epicgames.com/cover.jpg")
    );
    assert_eq!(
        games[0].header_image_url.as_deref(),
        Some("https://cdn.epicgames.com/header.jpg")
    );
    // Everything Epic returned for the game stays available, unknown fields too.
    let metadata = &games[0].metadata;
    assert_eq!(metadata["catalogItems"]["base"]["developer"], "Studio");
    assert_eq!(
        metadata["catalogItems"]["base"]["customAttributes"]["CanRunOffline"]["value"],
        "true"
    );
    assert_eq!(metadata["catalogItems"]["alternate"]["title"], "A game");
    assert_eq!(
        metadata["libraryRecords"],
        json!([item("game", "base"), item("game", "alternate")]),
        "Each record once, though Epic listed one on both pages"
    );
    assert_eq!(metadata["assets"]["Windows"], json!([item("game", "base")]));
    assert_eq!(
        metadata["assets"]["Mac"],
        json!([item("game", "alternate")])
    );
    assert_eq!(games[1].app_name, "missing");
    assert!(games[1].image_url.is_none());
    assert!(games[1].header_image_url.is_none());
    assert!(
        games[1].metadata["catalogItems"]
            .as_object()
            .unwrap()
            .is_empty()
    );
    assert_eq!(mock.requests().len(), 5);
    assert!(
        mock.requests()
            .iter()
            .any(|request| request.contains("cursor=page2"))
    );
    assert!(
        mock.requests()
            .iter()
            .all(|request| request.contains("Bearer access-old"))
    );
}

#[test]
fn cover_and_header_images_use_independent_priorities() {
    let details: CatalogItem = serde_json::from_value(json!({"keyImages":[
        {"type":"Thumbnail","url":"https://cdn.epicgames.com/thumbnail.jpg"},
        {"type":"OfferImageWide","url":"https://cdn.epicgames.com/offer-wide.jpg"},
        {"type":"DieselGameBoxTall","url":"https://cdn.epicgames.com/portrait.jpg"},
        {"type":"DieselStoreFrontWide","url":"https://cdn.epicgames.com/header.jpg"}
    ]}))
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        catalog_image(&details).as_deref(),
        Some("https://cdn.epicgames.com/portrait.jpg")
    );
    assert_eq!(
        catalog_header_image(&details).as_deref(),
        Some("https://cdn.epicgames.com/header.jpg")
    );
}

#[test]
fn header_images_fall_back_through_supported_types_without_using_unsafe_urls() {
    let kinds = [
        "DieselStoreFrontWide",
        "OfferImageWide",
        "DieselGameBox",
        "productFeatured",
        "Thumbnail",
    ];
    for (index, expected) in kinds.iter().enumerate() {
        let mut images = vec![
            json!({"type":"DieselStoreFrontWide","url":"file:///private/header.jpg"}),
            json!({"type":"DieselStoreFrontWide","url":"http://cdn.epicgames.com/header.jpg"}),
            json!({"type":"DieselStoreFrontWide","url":"https://user:secret@cdn.epicgames.com/header.jpg"}),
        ];
        images.extend(kinds[index..].iter().rev().map(|kind| {
            json!({
                "type":kind, "url":format!("https://cdn.epicgames.com/{kind}.jpg")
            })
        }));
        let details: CatalogItem = serde_json::from_value(json!({"keyImages":images})).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            catalog_header_image(&details),
            Some(format!("https://cdn.epicgames.com/{expected}.jpg"))
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn missing_safe_landscape_keeps_portrait_available_for_ui_fallback() {
    let details: CatalogItem = serde_json::from_value(json!({"keyImages":[
        {"type":"DieselGameBoxTall","url":"https://cdn.epicgames.com/portrait.jpg"},
        {"type":"DieselStoreFrontWide","url":"file:///private/header.jpg"},
        {"type":"OfferImageWide","url":"https://user@cdn.epicgames.com/header.jpg"}
    ]}))
    .unwrap();
    assert!(catalog_header_image(&details).is_none());
    assert_eq!(
        catalog_image(&details).as_deref(),
        Some("https://cdn.epicgames.com/portrait.jpg")
    );
    assert!(catalog_header_image(&CatalogItem::default()).is_none());
    assert!(catalog_image(&CatalogItem::default()).is_none());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn library_retries_unauthorized_once_and_preserves_the_new_refresh_token() {
    for retry_status in [200, 401] {
        let mut replies = vec![reply("/account/api/oauth/token", 200, token("account-a"))];
        for path in [
            "/library/api/public/items",
            "/launcher/api/public/assets/Windows",
            "/launcher/api/public/assets/Mac",
        ] {
            let mut rejected = reply(path, 401, json!({}));
            rejected.bearer = Some("access-old");
            replies.push(rejected);
            let body = if path.starts_with("/library") {
                json!({"records":[],"responseMetadata":{}})
            } else {
                json!([])
            };
            let mut retried = reply(path, retry_status, body);
            retried.bearer = Some("access-new");
            replies.push(retried);
        }
        let mock = Mock::new(replies);
        let client = mock.client(false);
        let result = client.games().await;
        if retry_status == 200 {
            assert!(result.unwrap().is_empty());
        } else {
            assert!(matches!(result, Err(EpicError::Unauthorized)));
        }
        assert_eq!(
            client.credentials().await.unwrap().refresh_token,
            "refresh-new"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            mock.requests()
                .iter()
                .filter(|request| request.starts_with("POST /account/api/oauth/token "))
                .count(),
            1
        );
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn disconnect_invalidates_a_library_read_while_http_is_still_in_flight() {
    let mut slow = reply(
        "/library/api/public/items",
        200,
        json!({"records":[],"responseMetadata":{}}),
    );
    slow.delay_ms = 300;
    let mut replies = empty_assets();
    replies.extend([
        slow,
        reply(
            "/account/api/oauth/sessions/kill/access-old",
            204,
            Value::Null,
        ),
    ]);
    let mock = Mock::new(replies);
    let client = Arc::new(mock.client(false));
    let reader = client.clone();
    let reading = tokio::spawn(async move { reader.games().await });
    tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), async {
        while !mock
            .requests()
            .iter()
            .any(|request| request.starts_with("GET /library/"))
        {
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1)).await;
        }
    })
    .await
    .unwrap();
    let disconnecting = client.clone();
    let disconnect = tokio::spawn(async move { disconnecting.disconnect().await });
    tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_millis(100), async {
        while client.credentials().await.is_ok() {
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1)).await;
        }
    })
    .await
    .expect("logout must not wait for the library HTTP response");
    disconnect.await.unwrap().unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(
        reading.await.unwrap(),
        Err(EpicError::Unauthorized)
    ));
}

fn download_replies(app_name: &str) -> Vec<Reply> {
    use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};
    let empty_hash: String = Sha1::digest([])
        .iter()
        .map(|byte| format!("{byte:03}"))
        .collect();
    vec![
        reply(
            "/library/api/public/items",
            200,
            json!({"records":[item("game", "base")],"responseMetadata":{}}),
        ),
        reply(
            MANIFEST_PATH,
            200,
            json!({"elements":[{"manifests":[{"uri":"FIXTURE_BASE/game.manifest","queryParams":[{"name":"Signature","value":"manifest-only"}]}],"sidecar":{"config":json!({"deploymentId":"deployment-fixture"}).to_string()}}]}),
        ),
        reply(
            "/game.manifest",
            200,
            json!({
                "AppNameString": app_name, "BuildVersionString": "1.0", "LaunchExeString":"Game.app",
                "FileManifestList":[{"Filename":"Game.app/Contents/empty", "FileHash":empty_hash, "FileChunkParts":[]}],
                "ChunkFilesizeList":{}, "ChunkHashList":{}, "ChunkShaList":{}, "DataGroupList":{}
            }),
        ),
    ]
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn download_checks_ownership_fetches_manifest_without_bearer_and_writes_receipt_only_on_success()
 {
    let mock = Mock::new(download_replies("game"));
    let client = mock.client(false);
    let parent = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let installed = client
        .download("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, parent.path())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(installed.account_id, "account-a");
    assert_eq!(installed.app_name, "game");
    assert_eq!(installed.platform, Platform::Mac);
    let directory = std::path::Path::new(&installed.directory);
    assert!(directory.starts_with(parent.path().canonicalize().unwrap()));
    assert!(directory.join("Game.app/Contents/empty").is_file());
    let receipt: Installation =
        serde_json::from_slice(&std::fs::read(directory.join(".obelisk-install.json")).unwrap())
            .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(receipt.build_version, "1.0");
    assert_eq!(receipt.deployment_id.as_deref(), Some("deployment-fixture"));
    let progress = client.progress().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(progress.state, TransferState::Complete);
    assert!(progress.network_bytes > 0);
    assert_eq!(progress.content_bytes, 0);
    let requests = mock.requests();
    assert!(requests[0].contains("authorization: Bearer access-old"));
    assert!(requests[1].contains("authorization: Bearer access-old"));
    assert!(!requests[2].to_lowercase().contains("authorization:"));
    assert!(requests[2].contains("Signature=manifest-only"));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn an_update_is_a_live_build_whose_version_differs_from_the_installed_one() {
    let live = |version: &str| {
        reply(
            MANIFEST_PATH,
            200,
            json!({"elements":[{"buildVersion": version, "manifests":[{"uri":"FIXTURE_BASE/game.manifest"}]}]}),
        )
    };
    let mut replies = download_replies("game");
    replies.extend([live("1.0"), live("1.1")]);
    let mock = Mock::new(replies);
    let client = mock.client(false);
    let parent = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let installed = client
        .download("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, parent.path())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let directory = std::path::Path::new(&installed.directory);

    let update = |platform| client.update_available("space", "base", "game", platform, directory);
    assert!(
        !update(Platform::Mac).await.unwrap(),
        "the installed build is live"
    );
    assert!(update(Platform::Mac).await.unwrap(), "Epic published 1.1");
    assert!(
        update(Platform::Windows).await.unwrap(),
        "no build of that platform is installed there"
    );
    assert_eq!(mock.requests().len(), 5, "only the live build is asked for");
}
```
