#[tokio::test]
async fn cancellation_interrupts_preparation_rejects_concurrent_download_and_releases_slot() {
    let mut replies = download_replies("game");
    replies[0].delay_ms = 120;
    let mock = Mock::new(replies);
    let client = Arc::new(mock.client(false));
    let parent = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = parent.path().to_owned();
    let running = tokio::spawn({
        let client = client.clone();
        async move {
            client
                .download("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, &path)
                .await
        }
    });
    for _ in 0..100 {
        if !mock.requests().is_empty() {
            break;
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2)).await;
    }
    assert!(matches!(
        client
            .download("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, parent.path())
            .await,
        Err(EpicError::AlreadyDownloading)
    ));
    client.cancel_download();
    assert!(matches!(
        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_millis(50), running)
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap(),
        Err(EpicError::Cancelled)
    ));
    assert_eq!(client.progress().unwrap().state, TransferState::Cancelled);
    assert!(matches!(
        client
            .download("space", "base", "", Platform::Mac, parent.path())
            .await,
        Err(EpicError::Protocol)
    ));
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read_dir(parent.path()).unwrap().count(), 0);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn dropping_download_future_cancels_the_operation_and_allows_retry() {
    let mut replies = download_replies("game");
    replies[0].delay_ms = 120;
    let mock = Mock::new(replies);
    let client = Arc::new(mock.client(false));
    let parent = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = parent.path().to_owned();
    let running = tokio::spawn({
        let client = client.clone();
        async move {
            client
                .download("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, &path)
                .await
        }
    });
    for _ in 0..100 {
        if !mock.requests().is_empty() {
            break;
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2)).await;
    }
    running.abort();
    assert!(running.await.unwrap_err().is_cancelled());
    assert_eq!(client.progress().unwrap().state, TransferState::Cancelled);
    assert!(matches!(
        client
            .download("space", "base", "", Platform::Mac, parent.path())
            .await,
        Err(EpicError::Protocol)
    ));
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read_dir(parent.path()).unwrap().count(), 0);
}

fn cached_download_replies(version: &str, filename: &str) -> Vec<Reply> {
    use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};
    let mut replies = download_replies("game");
    let mut manifest: Value = serde_json::from_str(&replies[2].body).unwrap();
    manifest["BuildVersionString"] = json!(version);
    manifest["FileManifestList"][0]["Filename"] = json!(filename);
    replies[2].body = manifest.to_string();
    let hash: String = Sha1::digest(replies[2].body.as_bytes())
        .iter()
        .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
        .collect();
    let mut asset: Value = serde_json::from_str(&replies[1].body).unwrap();
    asset["elements"][0]["hash"] = json!(hash);
    replies[1].body = asset.to_string();
    replies
}

fn files_containing(root: &std::path::Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> Vec<std::path::PathBuf> {
    let mut found = Vec::new();
    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(root).unwrap() {
        let entry = entry.unwrap();
        if entry.file_type().unwrap().is_dir() {
            found.extend(files_containing(&entry.path(), bytes));
        } else if std::fs::read(entry.path()).unwrap() == bytes {
            found.push(entry.path());
        }
    }
    found
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn manifest_cache_survives_client_restart_but_rechecks_ownership_metadata_and_files() {
    let mut replies = cached_download_replies("1.0", "Game.app/Contents/empty");
    let manifest_bytes = replies[2].body.as_bytes().to_vec();
    let mut second = cached_download_replies("1.0", "Game.app/Contents/empty");
    let mut asset: Value = serde_json::from_str(&second[1].body).unwrap();
    asset["elements"][0]["manifests"][0]["uri"] = json!("FIXTURE_BASE/current/game.manifest");
    asset["elements"][0]["sidecar"]["config"] =
        json!(json!({"deploymentId":"fresh-deployment"}).to_string());
    second[1].body = asset.to_string();
    // No second CDN response exists: a cache hit must use fresh metadata only.
    replies.extend(second.into_iter().take(2));
    let mock = Mock::new(replies);
    let parent = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let first = mock
        .client(false)
        .download("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, parent.path())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let caches = files_containing(parent.path(), &manifest_bytes);
    assert_eq!(
        caches.len(),
        1,
        "the raw manifest must survive successful installation"
    );
    std::fs::write(
        std::path::Path::new(&first.directory).join("Game.app/Contents/empty"),
        b"corrupt",
    )
    .unwrap();

    let client = mock.client(false);
    let installed = client
        .download("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, parent.path())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(installed.directory, first.directory);
    assert_eq!(installed.deployment_id.as_deref(), Some("fresh-deployment"));
    assert_eq!(
        std::fs::read(std::path::Path::new(&installed.directory).join("Game.app/Contents/empty"))
            .unwrap(),
        b""
    );
    assert_eq!(client.progress().unwrap().network_bytes, 0);
    assert_eq!(client.progress().unwrap().content_bytes, 0);
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read(&caches[0]).unwrap(), manifest_bytes);
    let requests = mock.requests();
    assert_eq!(requests.len(), 5);
    assert_eq!(
        requests
            .iter()
            .filter(|request| request.starts_with("GET /library/"))
            .count(),
        2
    );
    assert_eq!(
        requests
            .iter()
            .filter(|request| request.starts_with("GET /launcher/"))
            .count(),
        2
    );
    assert!(!requests[2].to_lowercase().contains("authorization:"));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn manifest_cache_uses_current_hash_to_fetch_and_install_new_build() {
    let mut replies = cached_download_replies("1.0", "Game.app/Contents/old");
    replies.extend(cached_download_replies("2.0", "Game.app/Contents/new"));
    let mock = Mock::new(replies);
    let client = mock.client(false);
    let parent = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let first = client
        .download("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, parent.path())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let second = client
        .download("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, parent.path())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(first.build_version, "1.0");
    assert_eq!(second.build_version, "2.0");
    assert!(
        std::path::Path::new(&second.directory)
            .join("Game.app/Contents/new")
            .is_file()
    );
    assert!(client.progress().unwrap().network_bytes > 0);
    assert_eq!(
        mock.requests()
            .iter()
            .filter(|request| request.starts_with("GET /game.manifest"))
            .count(),
        2
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn manifest_cache_corruption_refetches_and_replaces_the_archive() {
    let mut replies = cached_download_replies("1.0", "Game.app/Contents/empty");
    let manifest_bytes = replies[2].body.as_bytes().to_vec();
    replies.extend(cached_download_replies("1.0", "Game.app/Contents/empty"));
    let mock = Mock::new(replies);
    let client = mock.client(false);
    let parent = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    client
        .download("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, parent.path())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let cache = files_containing(parent.path(), &manifest_bytes)
        .pop()
        .expect("persisted manifest");
    let mut corrupt = manifest_bytes.clone();
    corrupt[0] ^= 1;
    std::fs::write(&cache, corrupt).unwrap();
    client
        .download("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, parent.path())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read(cache).unwrap(), manifest_bytes);
    assert!(client.progress().unwrap().network_bytes > 0);
    assert_eq!(
        mock.requests()
            .iter()
            .filter(|request| request.starts_with("GET /game.manifest"))
            .count(),
        2
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn manifest_cache_without_server_hash_always_fetches_current_manifest() {
    let mut replies = download_replies("game");
    let manifest_bytes = replies[2].body.as_bytes().to_vec();
    replies.extend(download_replies("game"));
    let mock = Mock::new(replies);
    let client = mock.client(false);
    let parent = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    for _ in 0..2 {
        client
            .download("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, parent.path())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert!(client.progress().unwrap().network_bytes > 0);
    }
    assert!(files_containing(parent.path(), &manifest_bytes).is_empty());
    assert_eq!(mock.requests().len(), 6);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn manifest_cache_never_bypasses_current_ownership_or_authentication() {
    for status in [200, 401] {
        let mut replies = cached_download_replies("1.0", "Game.app/Contents/empty");
        replies.push(reply(
            "/library/api/public/items",
            status,
            json!({"records":[],"responseMetadata":{}}),
        ));
        if status == 401 {
            replies.push(reply("/account/api/oauth/token", 200, token("account-a")));
            replies.push(reply("/library/api/public/items", 401, json!({})));
        }
        let mock = Mock::new(replies);
        let client = mock.client(false);
        let parent = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let installed = client
            .download("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, parent.path())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let receipt = std::path::Path::new(&installed.directory).join(".obelisk-install.json");
        let before = std::fs::read(&receipt).unwrap();
        let result = client
            .download("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, parent.path())
            .await;
        match status {
            200 => assert!(
                matches!(result, Err(EpicError::Service { message }) if message == "backend.epic.game_not_owned")
            ),
            _ => assert!(matches!(result, Err(EpicError::Unauthorized))),
        }
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read(receipt).unwrap(), before);
        assert_eq!(
            mock.requests()
                .iter()
                .filter(|request| request.starts_with("GET /launcher/"))
                .count(),
            1
        );
        assert_eq!(
            mock.requests()
                .iter()
                .filter(|request| request.starts_with("GET /game.manifest"))
                .count(),
            1
        );
    }
}

const LAUNCH_CATALOG_PATH: &str = "/catalog/api/shared/namespace/space/bulk/items";
const EXCHANGE_PATH: &str = "/account/api/oauth/exchange";
const OWNERSHIP_PATH: &str =
    "/ecommerceintegration/api/public/platforms/EPIC/identities/account-a/ownershipToken";

fn launch_installation(directory: &std::path::Path) -> Installation {
    let directory = directory.canonicalize().unwrap();
    let executable = "Game.app/Contents/MacOS/Game";
    std::fs::create_dir_all(directory.join("Game.app/Contents/MacOS")).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(directory.join(executable), b"fixture executable, never run").unwrap();
    let installation = Installation {
        app_name: "game".into(),
        namespace: "space".into(),
        catalog_item_id: "base".into(),
        account_id: "account-a".into(),
        directory: directory.to_str().unwrap().into(),
        platform: Platform::Mac,
        total_bytes: 29,
        build_version: "1.0".into(),
        launch_executable: executable.into(),
        launch_command: "--title \"My game\" --literal '$HOME'".into(),
        deployment_id: Some("deployment-fixture".into()),
        prerequisite: None,
    };
    write_launch_receipt(&installation);
    installation
}

fn write_launch_receipt(installation: &Installation) {
    std::fs::write(
        std::path::Path::new(&installation.directory).join(".obelisk-install.json"),
        serde_json::to_vec(installation).unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap();
}

fn launch_replies(ownership: bool) -> Vec<Reply> {
    let mut replies = vec![
        reply(
            "/library/api/public/items",
            200,
            json!({"records":[item("game", "base")],"responseMetadata":{}}),
        ),
        reply(
            LAUNCH_CATALOG_PATH,
            200,
            json!({"base":{"id":"base", "namespace":"space", "title":"A fixture game", "customAttributes":{
                "AdditionalCommandLine":{"value":"--publisher \"Epic build\" --literal '$(id)'"},
                "OwnershipToken":{"value":if ownership { "TrUe" } else { "false" }}
            }}}),
        ),
        reply(
            EXCHANGE_PATH,
            200,
            json!({"code":"exchange-fixture", "expiresInSeconds":300}),
        ),
    ];
    if ownership {
        let mut raw = reply(OWNERSHIP_PATH, 200, Value::Null);
        raw.body = "ownership\0binary\u{1}".into();
        replies.push(raw);
    }
    replies
}

/// Plan a launch whose catalog reply body has been patched by `patch`.
async fn launch_plan_with_catalog(
    directory: &std::path::Path,
    patch: impl FnOnce(&mut Value),
) -> LaunchPlan {
    launch_installation(directory);
    let mut replies = launch_replies(false);
    let catalog = replies
        .iter_mut()
        .find(|reply| reply.path == LAUNCH_CATALOG_PATH)
        .unwrap();
    let mut body: Value = serde_json::from_str(&catalog.body).unwrap();
    patch(&mut body);
    catalog.body = body.to_string();
    let mock = Mock::new(replies);
    mock.client(false)
        .launch_plan("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, directory, "en")
        .await
        .unwrap()
}

fn request_url(request: &str) -> reqwest::Url {
    let target = request
        .lines()
        .next()
        .unwrap()
        .split_whitespace()
        .nth(1)
        .unwrap();
    reqwest::Url::parse(&format!("http://fixture{target}")).unwrap()
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn launch_tolerates_catalog_items_without_a_display_title() {
    for title in [
        None,
        Some(Value::Null),
        Some(json!("  ")),
        Some(json!(42)),
        Some(json!("bad\u{0000}title")),
    ] {
        let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let plan = launch_plan_with_catalog(temporary.path(), |body| match title {
            Some(title) => body["base"]["title"] = title,
            None => {
                body["base"].as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("title");
            }
        })
        .await;
        // An unusable title still advertises the game, without a display name.
        assert_eq!(
            plan.activity,
            Some(Activity {
                id: "space".into(),
                name: None
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(plan.app_name, "game");
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn launch_uses_catalog_presence_identity_and_ignores_unpublishable_values() {
    for (attribute, expected) in [
        (json!({"value":"published-game"}), Some("published-game")),
        (json!({"value":"p-private-game"}), None),
        (json!({"value":""}), None),
        (json!({"value":"bad\u{0000}id"}), None),
        (json!({"value":"x".repeat(1025)}), None),
        (json!({"value":42}), None),
        (Value::Null, None),
    ] {
        let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let plan = launch_plan_with_catalog(temporary.path(), |body| {
            body["base"]["customAttributes"]["PresenceId"] = attribute;
        })
        .await;
        assert_eq!(
            plan.activity.as_ref().map(|activity| activity.id.as_str()),
            expected
        );
        assert_eq!(plan.app_name, "game");
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn launch_builds_authenticated_literal_arguments_from_verified_installation_metadata() {
    let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let installation = launch_installation(temporary.path());
    let mock = Mock::new(launch_replies(false));
    let plan = mock
        .client(false)
        .launch_plan(
            "space",
            "base",
            "game",
            Platform::Mac,
            temporary.path(),
            "fr-FR",
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(plan.app_name, "game");
    assert_eq!(
        plan.activity,
        Some(Activity {
            id: "space".into(),
            name: Some("A fixture game".into())
        })
    );
    assert_eq!(plan.platform, Platform::Mac);
    assert!(plan.ownership_token.is_none());
    assert!(!plan.target.is_application_bundle);
    assert_eq!(
        std::path::Path::new(&plan.target.executable),
        std::path::Path::new(&installation.directory).join(&installation.launch_executable)
    );
    assert_eq!(
        std::path::Path::new(&plan.target.working_directory),
        std::path::Path::new(&installation.directory).join("Game.app/Contents/MacOS")
    );
    assert_eq!(
        &plan.target.arguments[..8],
        [
            "--title",
            "My game",
            "--literal",
            "$HOME",
            "--publisher",
            "Epic build",
            "--literal",
            "$(id)"
        ]
    );
    let expected = [
        "-AUTH_LOGIN=unused",
        "-AUTH_PASSWORD=exchange-fixture",
        "-AUTH_TYPE=exchangecode",
        "-epicapp=game",
        "-epicenv=Prod",
        "-EpicPortal",
        "-epicusername=Player",
        "-epicuserid=account-a",
        "-epiclocale=fr-FR",
        "-epicsandboxid=space",
        "-epicdeploymentid=deployment-fixture",
    ];
    assert_eq!(&plan.target.arguments[8..], expected);
    assert!(
        !plan
            .target
            .arguments
            .iter()
            .any(|argument| argument.contains("refresh-old") || argument.contains("access-old"))
    );
    let requests = mock.requests();
    assert_eq!(requests.len(), 3);
    assert!(
        requests
            .iter()
            .all(|request| request.contains("authorization: Bearer access-old"))
    );
    let catalog = requests
        .iter()
        .find(|request| request_url(request).path() == LAUNCH_CATALOG_PATH)
        .unwrap();
    assert!(
        request_url(catalog)
            .query_pairs()
            .any(|(key, value)| key == "id" && value == "base")
    );
    assert!(
        requests
            .iter()
            .any(|request| request.starts_with("GET /account/api/oauth/exchange "))
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn launch_fetches_required_ownership_token_as_raw_bytes_and_never_swallows_failure() {
    for status in [200, 403] {
        let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        launch_installation(temporary.path());
        let mut replies = launch_replies(true);
        replies.last_mut().unwrap().status = status;
        let mock = Mock::new(replies);
        let result = mock
            .client(false)
            .launch_plan(
                "space",
                "base",
                "game",
                Platform::Mac,
                temporary.path(),
                "en",
            )
            .await;
        if status == 200 {
            let plan = result.unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                plan.ownership_token.as_deref(),
                Some(b"ownership\0binary\x01".as_slice())
            );
        } else {
            assert!(result.is_err());
        }
        let requests = mock.requests();
        let ownership = requests
            .iter()
            .find(|request| request_url(request).path() == OWNERSHIP_PATH)
            .unwrap();
        assert!(ownership.starts_with("POST "));
        assert!(ownership.contains("authorization: Bearer access-old"));
        assert!(
            ownership
                .to_lowercase()
                .contains("content-type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
        );
        let body = ownership.split_once("\r\n\r\n").unwrap().1;
        let parsed = reqwest::Url::parse(&format!("http://fixture/?{body}")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            parsed.query_pairs().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            [("nsCatalogItemId".into(), "space:base".into())]
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn an_installation_names_its_game_and_prerequisite_from_its_own_receipt_only() {
    let temp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let mut installation = launch_installation(temp.path());
    let directory = std::path::PathBuf::from(&installation.directory);
    let read = |app: &str, platform: Platform| {
        super::installed_launch("space", "base", app, platform, &directory)
    };
    let installed = read("game", Platform::Mac).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(installed.prerequisite, None);
    assert_eq!(
        std::path::Path::new(&installed.target.executable),
        directory.join(&installation.launch_executable)
    );
    installation.prerequisite = Some(Prerequisite {
        ids: vec!["ue".into()],
        name: "Prerequisites".into(),
        path: "Engine\\Extras\\Redist\\en-us\\setup.exe".into(),
        arguments: "/quiet".into(),
    });
    write_launch_receipt(&installation);
    assert_eq!(
        read("game", Platform::Mac).unwrap().prerequisite,
        installation.prerequisite
    );
    assert!(read("other", Platform::Mac).is_err());
    assert!(read("game", Platform::Windows).is_err());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn launch_rejects_missing_mismatched_and_escaping_receipts_before_network() {
    let mock = Mock::new(Vec::new());
    let client = mock.client(false);
    let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    assert!(
        client
            .launch_plan(
                "space",
                "base",
                "game",
                Platform::Mac,
                temporary.path(),
                "en"
            )
            .await
            .is_err()
    );
    let installation = launch_installation(temporary.path());
    let baseline = serde_json::to_value(&installation).unwrap();
    for (field, value) in [
        ("app_name", "another-game"),
        ("namespace", "another-space"),
        ("catalog_item_id", "another-catalog"),
        ("platform", "Windows"),
        ("account_id", "account-b"),
        ("directory", "/another/directory"),
        ("launch_executable", "../outside"),
    ] {
        let mut receipt = baseline.clone();
        receipt[field] = json!(value);
        std::fs::write(
            temporary.path().join(".obelisk-install.json"),
            serde_json::to_vec(&receipt).unwrap(),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(
            client
                .launch_plan(
                    "space",
                    "base",
                    "game",
                    Platform::Mac,
                    temporary.path(),
                    "en"
                )
                .await
                .is_err(),
            "accepted mismatched {field}"
        );
    }
    assert!(mock.requests().is_empty());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn launch_retries_rejected_exchange_once_and_keeps_rotated_credentials() {
    for retry_status in [200, 401] {
        let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        launch_installation(temporary.path());
        let mut replies = launch_replies(false);
        for reply in &mut replies {
            reply.bearer = Some("access-old");
            if reply.path == EXCHANGE_PATH {
                reply.status = 401;
            }
        }
        replies.push(reply("/account/api/oauth/token", 200, token("account-a")));
        let mut retry = launch_replies(false);
        for reply in &mut retry {
            reply.bearer = Some("access-new");
            if reply.path == EXCHANGE_PATH {
                reply.status = retry_status;
            }
        }
        replies.extend(retry);
        let mock = Mock::new(replies);
        let client = mock.client(false);
        let result = client
            .launch_plan(
                "space",
                "base",
                "game",
                Platform::Mac,
                temporary.path(),
                "en",
            )
            .await;
        if retry_status == 200 {
            assert!(result.is_ok());
        } else {
            assert!(matches!(result, Err(EpicError::Unauthorized)));
        }
        assert_eq!(
            client.credentials().await.unwrap().refresh_token,
            "refresh-new"
        );
        let requests = mock.requests();
        assert_eq!(
            requests
                .iter()
                .filter(|request| request.starts_with("POST /account/api/oauth/token "))
                .count(),
            1
        );
        assert_eq!(
            requests
                .iter()
                .filter(|request| request.starts_with("GET /account/api/oauth/exchange "))
                .count(),
            2
        );
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn launch_discards_exchange_code_when_user_disconnects_during_http() {
    let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    launch_installation(temporary.path());
    let mut replies = launch_replies(false);
    replies
        .iter_mut()
        .find(|reply| reply.path == EXCHANGE_PATH)
        .unwrap()
        .delay_ms = 200;
    replies.push(reply(
        "/account/api/oauth/sessions/kill/access-old",
        204,
        Value::Null,
    ));
    let mock = Mock::new(replies);
    let client = Arc::new(mock.client(false));
    let directory = temporary.path().to_owned();
    let launcher = client.clone();
    let running = tokio::spawn(async move {
        launcher
            .launch_plan("space", "base", "game", Platform::Mac, &directory, "en")
            .await
    });
    tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), async {
        while !mock
            .requests()
            .iter()
            .any(|request| request.starts_with("GET /account/api/oauth/exchange "))
        {
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1)).await;
        }
    })
    .await
    .unwrap();
    client.disconnect().await.unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(
        running.await.unwrap(),
        Err(EpicError::Unauthorized)
    ));
}

fn achievement_definitions() -> Value {
    let definitions: Vec<_> = [("earned", false), ("locked", false), ("secret", true)]
        .into_iter().map(|(name, hidden)| json!({"achievement": {
            "name":name,"hidden":hidden,"unlockedDisplayName":"Earned title",
            "lockedDisplayName":"Locked title","unlockedDescription":"Earned description",
            "lockedDescription":"Locked description","unlockedIconLink":"https://example.com/earned.png",
            "lockedIconLink":"https://example.com/locked.png"
        }})).collect();
    json!({"data":{"Achievement":{"productAchievementsRecordBySandbox":{
        "sandboxId":"space","totalAchievements":3,"achievements":definitions
    }}}})
}

fn achievement_player(account: &str) -> Value {
    json!({"data":{"PlayerAchievement":{"playerAchievementGameRecordsBySandbox":{"records":[{
        "playerAchievements":[{"playerAchievement":{
            "sandboxId":"space","epicAccountId":account,"achievementName":"earned",
            "unlocked":true,"unlockDate":"2026-09-21T12:00:00.000Z"
        }}]
    }]}}}})
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn achievements_merge_player_state_and_keep_hidden_locked_details_private() {
    let mock = Mock::new(vec![
        reply("/graphql", 200, achievement_definitions()),
        reply("/graphql", 200, achievement_player("account-a")),
    ]);
    let items = mock
        .client(false)
        .achievements("space", "fr")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(items.len(), 3);
    assert_eq!(items[0].id, "earned");
    assert!(items[0].unlocked);
    assert_eq!(items[0].name, "Earned title");
    assert_eq!(
        items[0].unlock_date.as_deref(),
        Some("2026-09-21T12:00:00.000Z")
    );
    assert_eq!(items[1].name, "Locked title");
    assert!(!items[1].unlocked);
    assert!(items[2].hidden);
    assert!(
        items[2].name.is_empty() && items[2].description.is_empty() && items[2].icon_url.is_empty()
    );
    let requests = mock.requests();
    let bodies: Vec<Value> = requests
        .iter()
        .map(|r| serde_json::from_str(r.split_once("\r\n\r\n").unwrap().1).unwrap())
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(
        bodies[0]["variables"],
        json!({"sandboxId":"space","locale":"fr"})
    );
    assert_eq!(
        bodies[1]["variables"],
        json!({"sandboxId":"space","epicAccountId":"account-a"})
    );
    assert!(
        bodies
            .iter()
            .all(|body| body["query"].as_str().unwrap().starts_with("query "))
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn achievements_distinguish_no_support_from_graphql_and_incomplete_responses() {
    let mock = Mock::new(vec![reply(
        "/graphql",
        200,
        json!({"data":{"Achievement":{"productAchievementsRecordBySandbox":null}}}),
    )]);

//! EGS launcher Cloud Saves rules. EOS Player Data Storage remains game-owned.
//!
//! Protocol references are recorded in docs/research-epic-cloud-saves.md and
//! docs/research-gamenative-epic-cloud.md. No third-party implementation is used.
use std::{
    collections::BTreeMap,
    fs,
    path::{Component, Path, PathBuf},
    sync::Arc,
};

use obelisk_core::Platform;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};
use unicode_normalization::UnicodeNormalization;

use crate::{EpicError, content_manifest::Manifest};

pub(crate) mod codec;

/// Explicit in-memory safety limits, independent of the publisher's quota.
pub const MAX_FILES: usize = 10_000;
pub const MAX_FILE_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
pub const MAX_TOTAL_BYTES: usize = 256 * 1024 * 1024;

/// Catalog identity supplied by the caller and checked against the owned library
/// before a Cloud transaction. The account always comes from the current session.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct CloudGame<'a> {
    pub namespace: &'a str,
    pub catalog_item_id: &'a str,
    pub app_name: &'a str,
}

impl CloudGame<'_> {
    pub(crate) fn validate(self) -> Result<(), EpicError> {
        identity(self.namespace)?;
        identity(self.catalog_item_id)?;
        identity(self.app_name)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CloudRules {
    /// The Windows build's save folder.
    pub cloud_save_folder: Option<String>,
    /// The Mac build's save folder.
    pub cloud_save_folder_mac: Option<String>,
    pub include: Vec<String>,
    pub exclude: Vec<String>,
}

/// The build of a game that runs, and where its save folder's variables point.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum CloudPlatform {
    /// A Mac build: its saves are under the player's home.
    Mac { home: PathBuf },
    /// A Windows build running in Wine: its saves are under the user profile
    /// of its prefix.
    Windows { profile: PathBuf },
}

impl CloudPlatform {
    /// The catalog attribute naming this build's save folder.
    fn attribute(platform: Platform) -> &'static str {
        match platform {
            Platform::Mac => "CloudSaveFolder_MAC",
            Platform::Windows => "CloudSaveFolder",
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct ResolvedCloudRules {
    pub directory: PathBuf,
    include: Vec<String>,
    exclude: Vec<String>,
    anchor: PathBuf,
}

/// One generation of a game's Cloud: the inventory's revision and, from its
/// latest manifest, each file's name, size and SHA-1.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct CloudListing {
    revision: String,
    /// The account it was read for; later reads of it are fenced to it.
    pub(crate) account: String,
    files: BTreeMap<String, (u64, [u8; 20])>,
    /// The parsed latest manifest, `None` for an empty inventory or a listing
    /// built in memory.
    pub(crate) manifest: Option<Arc<Manifest>>,
}

impl CloudListing {
    /// What a Cloud holding exactly `files` lists. An in-memory Cloud builds
    /// its listings with it.
    #[cfg(any(test, feature = "testing"))]
    pub fn of(revision: String, account: String, files: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>) -> Self {
        Self {
            revision,
            account,
            files: files
                .iter()
                .map(|(name, bytes)| {
                    (
                        name.clone(),
                        (bytes.len() as u64, Sha1::digest(bytes).into()),
                    )
                })
                .collect(),
            manifest: None,
        }
    }

    /// The generation `manifest` describes, `None` for an empty inventory.
    pub(crate) fn read(revision: String, account: String, manifest: Option<Manifest>) -> Self {
        let files = manifest
            .iter()
            .flat_map(|manifest| &manifest.files)
            .map(|file| (file.filename.clone(), (file.size(), file.hash)))
            .collect();
        Self {
            revision,
            account,
            files,
            manifest: manifest.map(Arc::new),
        }
    }

    /// Fingerprint of the complete manifest inventory. Not an atomic CAS token.
    pub fn revision(&self) -> &str {
        &self.revision
    }

    /// Each file's name and size.
    pub fn files(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (&str, u64)> {
        self.files
            .iter()
            .map(|(name, (size, _))| (name.as_str(), *size))
    }

    pub(crate) fn lists(&self, name: &str) -> bool {
        self.files.contains_key(name)
    }

    /// Whether `bytes` are exactly the listed file `name`: its size and the
    /// SHA-1 its manifest gives, the check a download passes.
    pub fn holds(&self, name: &str, bytes: &[u8]) -> bool {
        self.files.get(name).is_some_and(|(size, sha1)| {
            *size == bytes.len() as u64 && Sha1::digest(bytes).as_slice() == sha1
        })
    }
}

impl CloudRules {
    /// The rules of the Mac or the Windows build, or `None` when the catalog
    /// names no save folder for it.
    pub(crate) fn from_attributes(
        attributes: &BTreeMap<String, serde_json::Value>,
        platform: Platform,
    ) -> Result<Option<Self>, EpicError> {
        let attr = |key: &str| -> Result<Option<String>, EpicError> {
            attributes
                .get(key)
                .map(|value| {
                    value
                        .get("value")
                        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)
                        .filter(|value| value.len() <= 16_384 && !value.contains('\0'))
                        .map(str::to_owned)
                        .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)
                })
                .transpose()
        };
        let Some(folder) = attr(CloudPlatform::attribute(platform))? else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        if folder.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
        }
        let rules = Self {
            cloud_save_folder: attr("CloudSaveFolder")?,
            cloud_save_folder_mac: attr("CloudSaveFolder_MAC")?,
            include: parse_filters(attr("CloudIncludeList")?)?,
            exclude: parse_filters(attr("CloudExcludeList")?)?,
        };
        rules.validate()?;
        Ok(Some(rules))
    }

    pub(crate) fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), EpicError> {
        let folders = [&self.cloud_save_folder, &self.cloud_save_folder_mac];
        if folders.iter().all(|folder| folder.is_none())
            || folders
                .iter()
                .filter_map(|folder| folder.as_ref())
                .any(|v| v.is_empty() || v.len() > 16_384 || v.contains('\0'))
        {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
        }
        for filters in [&self.include, &self.exclude] {
            if filters.len() > 256 {
                return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
            }
            for filter in filters {
                validate_filter(filter)?;
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Resolves the save folder of `platform`'s build. On a Mac, AppData is
    /// deliberately unsupported: the launcher and Legendary disagree about its
    /// native Mac base directory. On Windows, variables follow the launcher's:
    /// AppData is the profile's AppData/Local, which paths such as
    /// `{AppData}/../LocalLow` leave within the profile.
    /// The caller must handle UnsupportedContent, never treat it as an empty tree.
    pub fn resolve(
        &self,
        platform: &CloudPlatform,
        install: &Path,
        account_id: &str,
        app_name: &str,
    ) -> Result<ResolvedCloudRules, EpicError> {
        self.validate()?;
        identity(account_id)?;
        identity(app_name)?;
        let install = canonical_or_missing(install)?;
        let (base, source, protected) = match platform {
            CloudPlatform::Mac { home } => {
                let home = home.canonicalize()?;
                if !home.is_dir() {
                    return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
                }
                let source = self
                    .cloud_save_folder_mac
                    .as_ref()
                    .ok_or(EpicError::UnsupportedContent)?
                    .replace('\\', "/");
                let source = source
                    .strip_prefix("~/")
                    .map(|rest| format!("{{Home}}/{rest}"))
                    .unwrap_or(source);
                let protected: &[&str] = &["Library", "Documents", "Library/Application Support"];
                (home, source, protected)
            }
            // A prefix that no wineboot created yet still resolves.
            CloudPlatform::Windows { profile } => {
                let source = self
                    .cloud_save_folder
                    .as_ref()
                    .ok_or(EpicError::UnsupportedContent)?
                    .replace('\\', "/");
                let protected: &[&str] = &[
                    "Documents",
                    "AppData",
                    "AppData/Local",
                    "AppData/LocalLow",
                    "AppData/Roaming",
                    "Saved Games",
                ];
                (canonical_or_missing(profile)?, source, protected)
            }
        };
        let lowercase = source.to_ascii_lowercase();
        let personal: &[&str] = match platform {
            CloudPlatform::Mac { .. } => {
                &["{home}/", "{userprofile}/", "{userdir}/", "{userlibrary}/"]
            }
            CloudPlatform::Windows { .. } => &[
                "{userprofile}/",
                "{userdir}/",
                "{appdata}/",
                "{usersavedgames}/",
            ],
        };
        let anchor = if lowercase.starts_with("{installdir}/") {
            &install
        } else if personal.iter().any(|prefix| lowercase.starts_with(prefix)) {
            &base
        } else {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
        };
        let mut expanded = String::new();
        let mut rest = source.as_str();
        while let Some(index) = rest.find('{') {
            expanded.push_str(&rest[..index]);
            let end = rest[index..]
                .find('}')
                .ok_or(EpicError::UnsupportedContent)?
                + index;
            let folder = |relative: &str| base.join(relative).to_string_lossy().into_owned();
            let replacement = match (platform, rest[index + 1..end].to_ascii_lowercase().as_str()) {
                (CloudPlatform::Mac { .. }, "home") | (_, "userprofile") => folder(""),
                (CloudPlatform::Mac { .. }, "userlibrary") => folder("Library"),
                (_, "userdir") => folder("Documents"),
                (CloudPlatform::Windows { .. }, "appdata") => folder("AppData/Local"),
                (CloudPlatform::Windows { .. }, "usersavedgames") => folder("Saved Games"),
                (_, "installdir") => install.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
                (_, "epicid") => account_id.to_owned(),
                (_, "appname") => app_name.to_owned(),
                _ => return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent),
            };
            let replacement = replacement.trim_end_matches('/').to_owned();
            expanded.push_str(&replacement);
            rest = &rest[end + 1..];
        }
        expanded.push_str(rest);
        if expanded.contains(['{', '}']) {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
        }
        let mut directory = PathBuf::new();
        for component in Path::new(&expanded).components() {
            match component {
                Component::RootDir => directory.push("/"),
                Component::Normal(name) => directory.push(name),
                Component::CurDir => (),
                Component::ParentDir if directory.pop() => (),
                _ => return Err(EpicError::UnsafePath(expanded)),
            }
        }
        if !directory.starts_with(anchor) {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsafePath(directory.display().to_string()));
        }
        let directory = spelled_on_disk(anchor, &directory)?;
        let lowercase = |path: &Path| path.to_string_lossy().to_lowercase();
        if directory == *anchor
            || protected
                .iter()
                .any(|folder| lowercase(&directory) == lowercase(&base.join(folder)))
        {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsafePath(directory.display().to_string()));
        }
        let resolved = ResolvedCloudRules {
            directory,
            anchor: anchor.clone(),
            include: self.include.clone(),
            exclude: self.exclude.clone(),
        };
        resolved.check_directory()?;
        Ok(resolved)
    }

    pub fn accepts(&self, relative: &str) -> Result<bool, EpicError> {
        self.filters()?.accepts(relative)
    }

    /// Validate the filter lists once, for callers that then match many names.
    /// `accepts` revalidates on every call, which is O(names x filters).
    pub fn filters(&self) -> Result<CloudFilters<'_>, EpicError> {
        self.validate()?;
        Ok(CloudFilters {
            include: &self.include,
            exclude: &self.exclude,
        })
    }
}

/// Validated include/exclude lists borrowed from a `CloudRules`.
pub struct CloudFilters<'a> {
    include: &'a [String],
    exclude: &'a [String],
}

impl CloudFilters<'_> {
    pub fn accepts(&self, relative: &str) -> Result<bool, EpicError> {
        accepts(relative, self.include, self.exclude)
    }
}

impl ResolvedCloudRules {
    pub fn accepts(&self, relative: &str) -> Result<bool, EpicError> {
        accepts(relative, &self.include, &self.exclude)
    }

    /// Revalidates every existing parent. Does not create directories or files.
    pub fn check_directory(&self) -> Result<(), EpicError> {
        if canonical_or_missing(&self.directory)? != self.directory {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsafePath(self.directory.display().to_string()));
        }
        let relative = self
            .directory
            .strip_prefix(&self.anchor)
            .map_err(|_| EpicError::UnsafePath(self.directory.display().to_string()))?;
        let mut current = self.anchor.clone();
        for component in relative.components() {
            let Component::Normal(name) = component else {
                return Err(EpicError::UnsafePath(self.directory.display().to_string()));
            };
            current.push(name);
            match fs::symlink_metadata(&current) {
                Ok(metadata) if metadata.is_dir() && !metadata.file_type().is_symlink() => (),
                Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => (),
                Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
                _ => return Err(EpicError::UnsafePath(current.display().to_string())),
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// `directory` below `anchor` with each existing folder named as on disk.
/// Save folder names ignore case, as Windows and macOS volumes do: a launcher
/// path such as `{AppData}/../locallow` is the prefix's `LocalLow`, and only
/// that spelling matches the canonical path the folder is checked against.
fn spelled_on_disk(anchor: &Path, directory: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, EpicError> {
    let relative = directory
        .strip_prefix(anchor)
        .map_err(|_| EpicError::UnsafePath(directory.display().to_string()))?;
    let mut spelled = anchor.to_owned();
    let mut exists = true;
    for name in relative.iter() {
        let on_disk = match exists.then(|| fs::read_dir(&spelled)) {
            Some(Ok(entries)) => {
                let mut matches = entries
                    .filter_map(|entry| entry.ok().map(|entry| entry.file_name()))
                    .filter(|entry| {
                        entry
                            .to_str()
                            .zip(name.to_str())
                            .is_some_and(|(entry, name)| entry.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name))
                    })
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>();
                matches.sort_by_key(|entry| entry != name);
                matches.into_iter().next()
            }
            Some(Err(error)) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => None,
            Some(Err(error)) => return Err(error.into()),
            None => None,
        };
        exists = on_disk.is_some();
        spelled.push(on_disk.as_deref().unwrap_or(name));
    }
    Ok(spelled)
}

// An uninstall can remove the installation while its Cloud recovery records
// remain valid. Canonicalize only the existing parent, preserving a checked,
// missing suffix rather than turning this condition into an empty save tree.
fn canonical_or_missing(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, EpicError> {
    if !path.is_absolute()
        || path
            .components()
            .any(|c| matches!(c, Component::ParentDir | Component::CurDir))
    {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsafePath(path.display().to_string()));
    }
    let mut current = path;
    let mut missing = Vec::new();
    loop {
        match fs::symlink_metadata(current) {
            Ok(metadata) if metadata.is_dir() && !metadata.file_type().is_symlink() => {
                let mut resolved = current.canonicalize()?;
                for name in missing.into_iter().rev() {
                    resolved.push(name);
                }
                return Ok(resolved);
            }
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
                missing.push(current.file_name().ok_or(EpicError::UnsupportedContent)?);
                current = current.parent().ok_or(EpicError::UnsupportedContent)?;
            }
            Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
            _ => return Err(EpicError::UnsafePath(path.display().to_string())),
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn identity(value: &str) -> Result<(), EpicError> {
    if value.is_empty()
        || value.len() > 256
        || matches!(value, "." | "..")
        || !value
            .bytes()
            .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(b, b'_' | b'-' | b'.'))
    {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn relative_path(value: &str) -> Result<(), EpicError> {
    if value.is_empty()
        || value.len() > 4096
        || value.contains(['\\', ':', '\0'])
        || value.chars().any(char::is_control)
        || value
            .split('/')
            .any(|part| part.is_empty() || matches!(part, "." | "..") || part.ends_with([' ', '.']))
    {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsafePath(value.into()));
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Comparison only: preserve publisher filenames on the wire. Normalization
/// and case expansion conservatively reject paths that may alias on macOS.
pub(crate) fn path_identity(value: &str) -> String {
    value
        .nfc()
        .flat_map(char::to_uppercase)
        .flat_map(char::to_lowercase)
        .nfc()
        .collect()
}

fn parse_filters(value: Option<String>) -> Result<Vec<String>, EpicError> {
    let Some(value) = value else {
        return Ok(Vec::new());
    };
    if value.is_empty() {
        return Ok(Vec::new());
    }
    let patterns: Vec<_> = value
        .split(',')
        .map(|part| part.trim().replace('\\', "/"))
        .collect();
    for pattern in &patterns {
        validate_filter(pattern)?;
    }
    Ok(patterns)
}

fn validate_filter(pattern: &str) -> Result<(), EpicError> {
    if pattern.is_empty()
        || pattern.len() > 1024
        || pattern.contains(['[', ']', '{', '}', ':', '\\', '\0'])
    {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
    }
    relative_path(pattern.strip_suffix('/').unwrap_or(pattern))
}

fn accepts(relative: &str, include: &[String], exclude: &[String]) -> Result<bool, EpicError> {
    relative_path(relative)?;
    let matches = |pattern: &String| {
        (pattern.ends_with('/') && relative.starts_with(pattern))
            || relative.ends_with(pattern)
            || wildcard(pattern, relative)
    };
    Ok((include.is_empty() || include.iter().any(matches)) && !exclude.iter().any(matches))
}

// Bounded, linear-space glob matching. '*' includes directory separators, as in
// the EGS reference's fnmatch behavior; publisher exclusion wins over inclusion.
fn wildcard(pattern: &str, text: &str) -> bool {
    let text: Vec<_> = text.chars().collect();
    let mut states = vec![false; text.len() + 1];
    let mut next = vec![false; text.len() + 1];
    states[0] = true;
    for ch in pattern.chars() {
        // Every slot is written before it is read again, so the buffer carries
        // nothing over from the previous character.
        for index in 0..states.len() {
            next[index] = if ch == '*' {
                states[index] || index > 0 && next[index - 1]
            } else {
                index > 0 && states[index - 1] && (ch == '?' || ch == text[index - 1])
            };
        }
        std::mem::swap(&mut states, &mut next);
    }
    states[text.len()]
}

mod tests;

//! Bounded BuildPatch save encoder. Decoding reuses the installer's verified
//! manifest/chunk readers; Cloud adds stricter identity and path constraints.
use std::{
    collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet},
    io::Write,
};

use obelisk_core::{date, transfer::CancelToken};
use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};

use super::{
    CloudGame, CloudRules, MAX_FILE_BYTES, MAX_FILES, MAX_TOTAL_BYTES, identity, path_identity,
    relative_path,
};
use crate::{
    EpicError, content,
    content_manifest::{self, Chunk, ChunkGuid, ChunkPart, Manifest, ManifestFile},
};

const CHUNK_SIZE: usize = 1024 * 1024;
pub(crate) const MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;

pub(crate) struct Package {
    pub manifest_path: String,
    pub manifest: Vec<u8>,
    pub chunks: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
}

pub(crate) fn parse(
    bytes: &[u8],
    game: CloudGame<'_>,
    account: &str,
) -> Result<Manifest, EpicError> {
    game.validate()?;
    identity(account)?;
    if bytes.len() > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
    }
    let manifest = content_manifest::parse(bytes)?;
    // Native launcher manifests identify the complete catalog tuple; Legendary
    // writes the compact app/account form. Accept only these exact identities.
    let compact = format!("{}{account}", game.app_name);
    let native = format!(
        "{}:{}:{}:{account}",
        game.namespace, game.catalog_item_id, game.app_name
    );
    if (manifest.app_name != compact && manifest.app_name != native)
        || !manifest.launch_executable.is_empty()
        || !manifest.launch_command.is_empty()
    {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    if manifest.files.len() > MAX_FILES || manifest.chunks.len() > MAX_FILES {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
    }
    let mut paths = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut total = 0usize;
    for file in &manifest.files {
        relative_path(&file.filename)?;
        if file.symlink_target.is_some() || file.flags != 0 {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsafePath(file.filename.clone()));
        }
        if !paths.insert(path_identity(&file.filename)) {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsafePath(file.filename.clone()));
        }
        let size = usize::try_from(file.size()).map_err(|_| EpicError::UnsupportedContent)?;
        if size > MAX_FILE_BYTES {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
        }
        total = total
            .checked_add(size)
            .ok_or(EpicError::UnsupportedContent)?;
        if total > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
        }
    }
    for path in &paths {
        for (index, _) in path.match_indices('/') {
            if paths.contains(&path[..index]) {
                return Err(EpicError::UnsafePath(path.clone()));
            }
        }
    }
    let expanded = manifest.chunks.values().try_fold(0usize, |sum, chunk| {
        sum.checked_add(chunk.window_size as usize)
            .ok_or(EpicError::UnsupportedContent)
    })?;
    if expanded > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES + CHUNK_SIZE {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
    }
    Ok(manifest)
}

/// Rebuilds `names` of `manifest`, or every file when `None`, each checked
/// against its SHA-1.
pub(crate) fn reconstruct(
    manifest: &Manifest,
    chunks: &BTreeMap<ChunkGuid, Vec<u8>>,
    names: Option<&BTreeSet<String>>,
    cancel: &CancelToken,
) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>, EpicError> {
    let mut result = BTreeMap::new();
    for file in &manifest.files {
        cancel.check()?;
        if names.is_some_and(|names| !names.contains(&file.filename)) {
            continue;
        }
        let mut data = Vec::with_capacity(file.size() as usize);
        for part in &file.parts {
            let chunk = chunks.get(&part.guid).ok_or(EpicError::Integrity)?;
            let end = (part.offset as usize)
                .checked_add(part.size as usize)
                .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
            data.extend_from_slice(
                chunk
                    .get(part.offset as usize..end)
                    .ok_or(EpicError::Integrity)?,
            );
        }
        if Sha1::digest(&data).as_slice() != file.hash {
            return Err(EpicError::Integrity);
        }
        result.insert(file.filename.clone(), data);
    }
    Ok(result)
}

pub(crate) fn package(
    game: CloudGame<'_>,
    account: &str,
    rules: &CloudRules,
    files: &BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
    seconds: u64,
    cancel: &CancelToken,
) -> Result<Package, EpicError> {
    game.validate()?;
    identity(account)?;
    rules.validate()?;
    if files.len() > MAX_FILES {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
    }
    let mut total = 0usize;
    for (name, data) in files {
        // The runtime already selected managed local files and retained remote
        // files outside those filters. Re-filtering here would discard the latter.
        relative_path(name)?;
        if data.len() > MAX_FILE_BYTES {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
        }
        total = total
            .checked_add(data.len())
            .ok_or(EpicError::UnsupportedContent)?;
        if total > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
        }
    }
    let build = timestamp(seconds)?;
    let mut manifest = Manifest {
        app_name: format!("{}{account}", game.app_name),
        build_version: build.clone(),
        launch_executable: String::new(),
        launch_command: String::new(),
        files: Vec::new(),
        chunks: BTreeMap::new(),
        feature_level: 18,
        custom_fields: BTreeMap::from([
            (
                "CloudSaveFolder".into(),
                rules.cloud_save_folder.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
            ),
            (
                "CloudSaveFolder_MAC".into(),
                rules.cloud_save_folder_mac.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
            ),
        ]),
        prerequisite: None,
    };
    let mut encoded_chunks = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut buffer = Vec::with_capacity(CHUNK_SIZE);
    let mut guid = new_guid();
    for (filename, data) in files {
        cancel.check()?;
        let mut file = ManifestFile {
            filename: filename.clone(),
            symlink_target: None,
            hash: Sha1::digest(data).into(),
            flags: 0,
            parts: Vec::new(),
        };
        let mut remaining = data.as_slice();
        while !remaining.is_empty() {
            cancel.check()?;
            if buffer.len() == CHUNK_SIZE {
                finish_chunk(&mut buffer, guid, &mut manifest, &mut encoded_chunks)?;
                guid = new_guid();
            }
            let size = remaining.len().min(CHUNK_SIZE - buffer.len());
            file.parts.push(ChunkPart {
                guid,
                offset: buffer.len() as u32,
                size: size as u32,
            });
            buffer.extend_from_slice(&remaining[..size]);
            remaining = &remaining[size..];
        }
        manifest.files.push(file);
    }
    if !buffer.is_empty() {
        finish_chunk(&mut buffer, guid, &mut manifest, &mut encoded_chunks)?;
    }
    let bytes = encode_manifest(&manifest)?;
    // Validate the complete generated structure before any service mutation.
    parse(&bytes, game, account)?;
    Ok(Package {
        manifest_path: format!("manifests/{build}.manifest"),
        manifest: bytes,
        chunks: encoded_chunks,
    })
}

fn new_guid() -> ChunkGuid {
    let bytes = *uuid::Uuid::new_v4().as_bytes();
    std::array::from_fn(|index| {
        u32::from_le_bytes(
            bytes[index * 4..index * 4 + 4]
                .try_into()
                .expect("fixed GUID word"),
        )
    })
}

fn finish_chunk(
    buffer: &mut Vec<u8>,
    guid: ChunkGuid,
    manifest: &mut Manifest,
    encoded: &mut BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
) -> Result<(), EpicError> {
    buffer.resize(CHUNK_SIZE, 0);
    let hash = content::rolling_hash(buffer);
    let sha1 = Sha1::digest(&*buffer).into();
    let identifier: Vec<u8> = guid.iter().flat_map(|word| word.to_le_bytes()).collect();
    let mut compressor =
        flate2::write::ZlibEncoder::new(Vec::new(), flate2::Compression::default());
    compressor.write_all(buffer)?;
    let payload = compressor.finish()?;
    let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(66 + payload.len());
    for word in [0xb1fe_3aa2, 3, 66, payload.len() as u32] {
        bytes.extend(word.to_le_bytes());
    }
    for word in guid {
        bytes.extend(word.to_le_bytes());
    }
    bytes.extend(hash.to_le_bytes());
    bytes.push(1);
    bytes.extend(sha1);
    bytes.push(3);
    bytes.extend((CHUNK_SIZE as u32).to_le_bytes());
    bytes.extend(payload);
    let chunk = Chunk {
        guid,
        hash,
        sha1,
        group: (crc32fast::hash(&identifier) % 100) as u8,
        window_size: CHUNK_SIZE as u32,
        file_size: bytes.len() as u64,
    };
    encoded.insert(chunk.relative_path(18), bytes);
    manifest.chunks.insert(guid, chunk);
    buffer.clear();
    Ok(())
}

fn string(output: &mut Vec<u8>, value: &str) {
    // BuildPatch FString uses UTF-16 for non-ASCII text, including macOS paths.
    if value.is_ascii() {
        output.extend((value.len() as u32 + 1).to_le_bytes());
        output.extend(value.as_bytes());
        output.push(0);
    } else {
        let units: Vec<_> = value.encode_utf16().collect();
        output.extend((-(units.len() as i32 + 1)).to_le_bytes());
        for unit in units {
            output.extend(unit.to_le_bytes());
        }
        output.extend([0, 0]);
    }
}

fn section(output: &mut Vec<u8>, payload: Vec<u8>) {
    output.extend((payload.len() as u32 + 5).to_le_bytes());
    output.push(0);
    output.extend(payload);
}

fn encode_manifest(manifest: &Manifest) -> Result<Vec<u8>, EpicError> {
    let mut body = Vec::new();
    let mut meta = 18u32.to_le_bytes().to_vec();
    meta.push(0);
    meta.extend(0u32.to_le_bytes());
    for value in [&manifest.app_name, &manifest.build_version, "", ""] {
        string(&mut meta, value);
    }
    meta.extend(0u32.to_le_bytes());
    for _ in 0..3 {
        string(&mut meta, "");
    }
    section(&mut body, meta);
    let chunks: Vec<_> = manifest.chunks.values().collect();
    let mut list = (chunks.len() as u32).to_le_bytes().to_vec();
    for chunk in &chunks {
        for word in chunk.guid {
            list.extend(word.to_le_bytes());
        }
    }
    for chunk in &chunks {
        list.extend(chunk.hash.to_le_bytes());
    }
    for chunk in &chunks {
        list.extend(chunk.sha1);
    }
    for chunk in &chunks {
        list.push(chunk.group);
    }
    for chunk in &chunks {
        list.extend(chunk.window_size.to_le_bytes());
    }
    for chunk in &chunks {
        list.extend(chunk.file_size.to_le_bytes());
    }
    section(&mut body, list);
    let mut list = (manifest.files.len() as u32).to_le_bytes().to_vec();
    for file in &manifest.files {
        string(&mut list, &file.filename);
    }
    for _ in &manifest.files {
        string(&mut list, "");
    }
    for file in &manifest.files {
        list.extend(file.hash);
    }
    list.extend(std::iter::repeat_n(0, manifest.files.len()));
    for _ in &manifest.files {
        list.extend(0u32.to_le_bytes());
    }
    for file in &manifest.files {
        list.extend((file.parts.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
        for part in &file.parts {
            list.extend(28u32.to_le_bytes());
            for word in part.guid {
                list.extend(word.to_le_bytes());
            }
            list.extend(part.offset.to_le_bytes());
            list.extend(part.size.to_le_bytes());
        }
    }
    section(&mut body, list);
    let mut custom = (manifest.custom_fields.len() as u32).to_le_bytes().to_vec();
    for key in manifest.custom_fields.keys() {
        string(&mut custom, key);
    }
    for value in manifest.custom_fields.values() {
        string(&mut custom, value);
    }
    section(&mut body, custom);
    if body.len() > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES - 41 {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
    }
    // Raw bodies are a supported BuildPatch container form and avoid nested
    // compression ambiguity. The SHA1 still covers the complete manifest body.
    let mut output = 0x44be_c00cu32.to_le_bytes().to_vec();
    output.extend(41u32.to_le_bytes());
    output.extend((body.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
    output.extend((body.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
    output.extend(Sha1::digest(&body));
    output.push(0);
    output.extend(18u32.to_le_bytes());
    output.extend(body);
    Ok(output)
}

pub(crate) fn timestamp(seconds: u64) -> Result<String, EpicError> {
    let (year, month, day) = date::civil_from_days((seconds / 86_400) as i64);
    if year > 9999 {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    let time = seconds % 86_400;
    Ok(format!(
        "{year:04}.{month:02}.{day:02}-{:02}.{:02}.{:02}",
        time / 3600,
        time % 3600 / 60,
        time % 60
    ))
}

pub(crate) fn manifest_time(name: &str) -> Result<u64, EpicError> {
    let name = name
        .strip_prefix("manifests/")
        .and_then(|s| s.strip_suffix(".manifest"))
        .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
    if name.len() != 19 {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    let values: Vec<u64> = name
        .split(['.', '-'])
        .map(|s| s.parse().map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol))
        .collect::<Result<_, _>>()?;
    if values.len() != 6 {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    let [year, month, day, hour, minute, second] =
        <[u64; 6]>::try_from(values).map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?;
    if !(1970..=9999).contains(&year)
        || !(1..=12).contains(&month)
        || !(1..=31).contains(&day)
        || hour > 23
        || minute > 59
        || second > 59
    {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    let days = date::days_from_civil(year as i64, month as i64, day as i64) as u64;
    let seconds = days * 86_400 + hour * 3600 + minute * 60 + second;
    // A day past its month's end lands in the next month and fails here.
    if timestamp(seconds)? != name {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    Ok(seconds)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod identity_tests {
    use super::*;

    fn fixture(name: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
        let manifest = Manifest {
            app_name: name.into(),
            build_version: "2026.09.22-00.00.00".into(),
            launch_executable: String::new(),
            launch_command: String::new(),
            files: vec![],
            chunks: BTreeMap::new(),
            feature_level: 18,
            custom_fields: BTreeMap::new(),
            prerequisite: None,
        };
        encode_manifest(&manifest).unwrap()
    }

    fn game() -> CloudGame<'static> {
        CloudGame {
            namespace: "space",
            catalog_item_id: "item",
            app_name: "game",
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn accepts_native_cloud_manifest_identity_from_exact_game_tuple() {
        parse(&fixture("space:item:game:account"), game(), "account")
            .expect("native Cloud identity must decode");
        parse(&fixture("gameaccount"), game(), "account")
            .expect("Legendary Cloud identity remains compatible");
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_different_native_tuple_components_and_ambiguous_forms() {
        for name in [
            "foreign:item:game:account",
            "space:foreign:game:account",
            "space:item:foreign:account",
            "space:item:game:foreign",
            "item:game:account",
            "space:item:game:",
            "space:item:game:account:",
            "space::item:game:account",
            "Space:item:game:account",
            "game:account",
            "game_account",
            "gameforeign",
            "foreignaccount",
        ] {
            assert!(parse(&fixture(name), game(), "account").is_err(), "{name}");
        }
        let native = fixture("space:item:game:account");
        for expected in [
            CloudGame {
                namespace: "foreign",
                ..game()
            },
            CloudGame {
                catalog_item_id: "foreign",
                ..game()
            },
            CloudGame {
                app_name: "foreign",
                ..game()
            },
        ] {
            assert!(parse(&native, expected, "account").is_err());
        }
        assert!(parse(&native, game(), "foreign").is_err());
        // Caller identities must not introduce delimiters, including when the
        // manifest uses the legacy representation without namespace/catalog.
        for invalid in [
            CloudGame {
                namespace: "space:extra",
                ..game()
            },
            CloudGame {
                catalog_item_id: "../item",
                ..game()
            },
            CloudGame {
                app_name: "game:extra",
                ..game()
            },
        ] {
            assert!(parse(&fixture("gameaccount"), invalid, "account").is_err());
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn mac_rules_require_explicit_metadata_and_preserve_both_platforms() {
    use serde_json::json;
    assert!(
        CloudRules::from_attributes(&BTreeMap::new(), Platform::Mac)
            .unwrap()
            .is_none()
    );

            "CloudSaveFolder".into(),
            json!({"value":"{AppData}/Example"}),
        ),
        ("CloudIncludeList".into(), json!({"value":"*.sav,profile/"})),

#[test]
fn resolver_confines_roots_and_keeps_missing_installation_recoverable() {
    let temp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let home = temp.path().join("home");
    fs::create_dir(&home).unwrap();
    let install = temp.path().join("deleted/game");
    let resolved = rules("{USERLIBRARY}/Application Support/{AppName}/{EpicId}")
        .resolve(&mac(&home), &install, "account", "game")
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        resolved.directory,
        home.canonicalize()
            .unwrap()
            .join("Library/Application Support/game/account")
    );
    for path in [
        "{AppData}/Game",
        "{Unknown}/Game",
        "{Home}/../foreign",
        "{Home}/Library",
        "{Home}/",
        "/tmp/foreign",
    ] {
        assert!(
            rules(path)
                .resolve(&mac(&home), &install, "account", "game")
                .is_err(),
            "{path}"
        );
    }
    let resolved = rules("{InstallDir}/saves")
        .resolve(&mac(&home), &install, "account", "game")
        .unwrap();
    assert!(resolved.directory.ends_with("deleted/game/saves"));
    assert!(resolved.check_directory().is_ok());
}

#[test]
fn windows_rules_resolve_like_the_launcher_inside_the_prefix_profile() {
    let temp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let profile = temp.path().join("prefix/drive_c/users/crossover");
    fs::create_dir_all(&profile).unwrap();
    let install = temp.path().join("game");
    let windows = CloudPlatform::Windows {
        profile: profile.clone(),
    };
    let profile = profile.canonicalize().unwrap();
    for (path, expected) in [
        ("{AppData}/Game/Saved", "AppData/Local/Game/Saved"),
        (
            "{AppData}\\..\\LocalLow\\Studio\\Game",
            "AppData/LocalLow/Studio/Game",
        ),
        ("{AppData}/../Roaming/Game", "AppData/Roaming/Game"),
        (
            "{UserDir}/My Games/Game/{EpicId}",
            "Documents/My Games/Game/account",
        ),
        ("{UserSavedGames}/Game", "Saved Games/Game"),
        ("{UserProfile}/.game", ".game"),
    ] {
        let resolved = windows_rules(path)
            .resolve(&windows, &install, "account", "game")
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(resolved.directory, profile.join(expected), "{path}");
    }
    for path in [
        "{AppData}",
        "{AppData}/..",
        "{AppData}/../Roaming",
        "{AppData}/../../../foreign",
        "{UserDir}/",
        "{UserLibrary}/Game",
        "{Home}/Game",
        "C:/Games/Save",
    ] {
        assert!(
            windows_rules(path)
                .resolve(&windows, &install, "account", "game")
                .is_err(),
            "{path}"
        );
    }
    let resolved = windows_rules("{InstallDir}/Saved")
        .resolve(&windows, &install, "account", "game")
        .unwrap();
    assert!(resolved.directory.ends_with("game/Saved"));
    // Wine created the prefix's folders; the launcher's path names them in
    // another case, as Kingdom New Lands' `{appdata}/../locallow` does.
    fs::create_dir_all(profile.join("AppData/LocalLow/noio")).unwrap();
    let resolved = windows_rules("{appdata}/../locallow/noio/Kingdom/")
        .resolve(&windows, &install, "account", "game")
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        resolved.directory,
        profile.join("AppData/LocalLow/noio/Kingdom")
    );
    resolved.check_directory().unwrap();
    for path in ["{appdata}/../locallow", "{AppData}/../ROAMING"] {
        assert!(
            windows_rules(path)
                .resolve(&windows, &install, "account", "game")
                .is_err(),
            "{path}"
        );
    }
    // A Mac build's rules name no Windows folder, and the reverse.
    let mut mac_only = rules("{Home}/Game");
    mac_only.cloud_save_folder = None;
    assert!(matches!(
        mac_only.resolve(&windows, &install, "account", "game"),
        Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent)
    ));
    assert!(matches!(
        windows_rules("{AppData}/Game").resolve(&mac(temp.path()), &install, "account", "game"),
        Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent)
    ));
}

#[test]
fn buildpatch_roundtrip_preserves_unicode_empty_files_and_chunk_boundaries() {
    let rules = rules("{Home}/Données");
    let cancel = CancelToken::new();
    let files = BTreeMap::from([
        (
            "Données/slot.sav".into(),
            (0..(1024 * 1024 + 31))
                .map(|index| (index % 251) as u8)
                .collect(),
        ),
        ("empty.sav".into(), Vec::new()),
        ("settings.sav".into(), b"settings".to_vec()),
    ]);
    let package =
        codec::package(game(), "account", &rules, &files, 1_790_000_000, &cancel).unwrap();
    let manifest = codec::parse(&package.manifest, game(), "account").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(manifest.chunks.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(
        manifest.custom_fields["CloudSaveFolder_MAC"],
        rules.cloud_save_folder_mac.unwrap()
    );
    assert_eq!(manifest.custom_fields["CloudSaveFolder"], "{AppData}/Game");
    let chunks: BTreeMap<_, _> = manifest
        .chunks
        .values()
        .map(|chunk| {
            (
                chunk.guid,
                content::decode_chunk(
                    &package.chunks[&chunk.relative_path(manifest.feature_level)],
                    chunk,
                )
                .unwrap(),
            )
        })
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(
        codec::reconstruct(&manifest, &chunks, None, &cancel).unwrap(),
        files
    );
    assert!(codec::parse(&package.manifest, game(), "wrong-account").is_err());
    let mut damaged = package.manifest.clone();
    *damaged.last_mut().unwrap() ^= 1;
    assert!(codec::parse(&damaged, game(), "account").is_err());
    let chunk = manifest.chunks.values().next().unwrap();
    let mut damaged = package.chunks[&chunk.relative_path(18)].clone();
    *damaged.last_mut().unwrap() ^= 1;
    assert!(content::decode_chunk(&damaged, chunk).is_err());
    let mut damaged = chunks;
    damaged.get_mut(&chunk.guid).unwrap()[0] ^= 1;
    assert!(codec::reconstruct(&manifest, &damaged, None, &cancel).is_err());
}

#[test]

    let rules = rules("{Home}/saves");
    let cancel = CancelToken::new();

}

#[test]
