`crates/storefronts/epic-kit/src/content_manifest.rs`:

```rs
//! BuildPatch manifests needed to reconstruct and verify installed files.
//!
//! Format references: Legendary's models/manifest.py and models/json_manifest.py,
//! and EpicManifestParser's UE/FChunkInfo.cs for versioned chunk lists.
use std::{
    collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet},
    io::Read,
};

use base64::{Engine, engine::general_purpose::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD};
use serde::{
    Deserialize, Deserializer, Serialize,
    de::{MapAccess, Visitor},
};
use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};

use crate::{EpicError, manifest::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES};

const MAX_EXPANDED_BYTES: usize = 256 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_ITEMS: usize = 1_000_000;
const MAX_STRING_BYTES: usize = 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_CHUNK_BYTES: u64 = 64 * 1024 * 1024;

pub(crate) type ChunkGuid = [u32; 4];

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub(crate) struct Manifest {
    pub app_name: String,
    pub build_version: String,
    pub launch_executable: String,
    pub launch_command: String,
    pub files: Vec<ManifestFile>,
    pub chunks: BTreeMap<ChunkGuid, Chunk>,
    pub feature_level: u32,
    pub custom_fields: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    pub prerequisite: Option<Prerequisite>,
}

/// The program a build asks to run once before its game first starts, such as
/// a runtime installer.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Prerequisite {
    pub ids: Vec<String>,
    pub name: String,
    /// Relative to the installation, with Windows separators.
    pub path: String,
    /// Its Windows command line.
    pub arguments: String,
}

impl Prerequisite {
    /// A build without a prerequisite program names none.
    fn named(ids: Vec<String>, name: String, path: String, arguments: String) -> Option<Self> {
        (!path.trim().is_empty()).then_some(Self {
            ids,
            name,
            path,
            arguments,
        })
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub(crate) struct ManifestFile {
    pub filename: String,
    pub symlink_target: Option<String>,
    pub hash: [u8; 20],
    pub flags: u8,
    pub parts: Vec<ChunkPart>,
}

impl ManifestFile {
    pub(crate) fn size(&self) -> u64 {
        // Parsing checks this sum before exposing a manifest to the installer.
        self.parts.iter().map(|part| u64::from(part.size)).sum()
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub(crate) struct ChunkPart {
    pub guid: ChunkGuid,
    pub offset: u32,
    pub size: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub(crate) struct Chunk {
    pub guid: ChunkGuid,
    pub hash: u64,
    pub sha1: [u8; 20],
    pub group: u8,
    pub window_size: u32,
    pub file_size: u64,
}

impl Chunk {
    pub(crate) fn relative_path(&self, feature_level: u32) -> String {
        let [a, b, c, d] = self.guid;
        if feature_level < 3 {
            return format!(
                "Chunks/{:02}/{a:08X}{b:08X}{c:08X}{d:08X}.chunk",
                self.group
            );
        }
        if feature_level >= 22 {
            let guid: Vec<u8> = self
                .guid
                .iter()
                .flat_map(|word| word.to_le_bytes())
                .collect();
            return format!(
                "ChunksV5/plain/{:02}/{}_{}.chunk",
                self.group,
                URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.encode(self.hash.to_le_bytes()),
                URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.encode(guid),
            );
        }
        let directory = match feature_level {
            3..6 => "ChunksV2",
            6..15 => "ChunksV3",
            _ => "ChunksV4",
        };
        format!(
            "{directory}/{:02}/{:016X}_{a:08X}{b:08X}{c:08X}{d:08X}.chunk",
            self.group, self.hash
        )
    }
}

pub(crate) fn parse(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Manifest, EpicError> {
    if data.len() > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    let manifest = if data.iter().find(|byte| !byte.is_ascii_whitespace()) == Some(&b'{') {
        json_manifest(data)?
    } else {
        binary_manifest(data)?
    };
    validate(&manifest)?;
    Ok(manifest)
}

fn validate(manifest: &Manifest) -> Result<(), EpicError> {
    // Earlier formats do not carry the chunk SHA1 required by this installer.
    if !(12..=24).contains(&manifest.feature_level) {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
    }
    if manifest.app_name.is_empty()
        || manifest.files.len() > MAX_ITEMS
        || manifest.chunks.len() > MAX_ITEMS
    {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    for value in [
        &manifest.app_name,
        &manifest.build_version,
        &manifest.launch_executable,
        &manifest.launch_command,
    ] {
        validate_string(value)?;
    }
    for chunk in manifest.chunks.values() {
        if chunk.guid == [0; 4]
            || chunk.sha1 == [0; 20]
            || chunk.group >= 100
            || chunk.window_size == 0
            || u64::from(chunk.window_size) > MAX_CHUNK_BYTES
            || chunk.file_size < 41
            || chunk.file_size > MAX_CHUNK_BYTES
        {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
    }
    let mut names = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut total_size = 0_u64;
    let mut total_parts = 0_usize;
    for file in &manifest.files {
        validate_string(&file.filename)?;
        if file.filename.is_empty() || !names.insert(&file.filename) || file.flags & !7 != 0 {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
        if let Some(target) = &file.symlink_target {
            validate_string(target)?;
        } else if file.hash == [0; 20] {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
        total_parts = total_parts
            .checked_add(file.parts.len())
            .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
        if total_parts > MAX_ITEMS {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
        for part in &file.parts {
            let chunk = manifest.chunks.get(&part.guid).ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
            let end = part
                .offset
                .checked_add(part.size)
                .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
            if part.size == 0 || end > chunk.window_size {
                return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
            }
            total_size = total_size
                .checked_add(u64::from(part.size))
                .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_string(value: &str) -> Result<(), EpicError> {
    if value.len() > MAX_STRING_BYTES || value.contains('\0') {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// The fixed BuildPatch container prefix shared by the full parser and the
/// size-only reader. Bounds are checked before any payload is expanded.
pub(crate) struct BinaryHeader {
    pub(crate) flags: u8,
    pub(crate) version: u32,
    header_size: usize,
    expanded_size: usize,
    stored_size: usize,
    hash: [u8; 20],
}

/// Parses the container prefix and returns a reader over the remaining
/// header bytes, which later versions use for encryption metadata.
pub(crate) fn binary_header(data: &[u8]) -> Result<(BinaryHeader, Reader<'_>), EpicError> {
    let mut header = Reader(data);
    if header.u32()? != 0x44be_c00c {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    let header_size = header.u32()? as usize;
    let expanded_size = header.u32()? as usize;
    let stored_size = header.u32()? as usize;
    let hash = header.array::<20>()?;
    let flags = header.byte()?;
    let version = header.u32()?;
    if flags > 3
        || (flags & 2 != 0 && version < 22)
        || header_size < if version >= 22 { 73 } else { 41 }
        || expanded_size > MAX_EXPANDED_BYTES
        || stored_size > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES
    {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    Ok((
        BinaryHeader {
            flags,
            version,
            header_size,
            expanded_size,
            stored_size,
            hash,
        },
        header,
    ))
}

/// The zlib `payload` inflated, unless it is damaged, expands past `limit`
/// bytes, or does not end where `payload` does. The caller checks the length.
pub(crate) fn inflate(payload: &[u8], limit: usize) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut decoder = flate2::read::ZlibDecoder::new(payload);
    let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(limit);
    decoder
        .by_ref()
        .take(limit as u64 + 1)
        .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
        .ok()?;
    (decoder.total_in() == payload.len() as u64).then_some(bytes)
}

/// Expands (when zlib-compressed) and hash-checks the container body.
pub(crate) fn binary_body<'a>(
    data: &'a [u8],
    header: &BinaryHeader,
) -> Result<std::borrow::Cow<'a, [u8]>, EpicError> {
    let payload = data.get(header.header_size..).ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
    if payload.len() != header.stored_size {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    let body: std::borrow::Cow<'a, [u8]> = if header.flags & 1 != 0 {
        inflate(payload, header.expanded_size)
            .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?
            .into()
    } else {
        payload.into()
    };
    if body.len() != header.expanded_size || Sha1::digest(&body).as_slice() != header.hash {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    Ok(body)
}

fn binary_manifest(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Manifest, EpicError> {
    let (header, mut rest) = binary_header(data)?;
    let version = header.version;
    if version > 24 || header.flags & 2 != 0 {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
    }
    if version >= 22 {
        // Names and launch metadata cannot be used before authenticated decryption.
        if rest.guid()? != [0; 4] || rest.array::<16>()? != [0; 16] {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
        }
    }
    let body = binary_body(data, &header)?;
    let mut body = Reader(&body);
    let mut manifest = metadata(body.section(5)?)?;
    manifest.chunks = chunks(body.section(9)?)?;
    manifest.files = files(body.section(9)?)?;
    manifest.custom_fields = custom_fields(body.section(9)?)?;
    if version >= 24 && !body.0.is_empty() {
        // FEncryptedData serializes a versioned byte array. A plain manifest
        // may retain an empty array; nonempty encrypted metadata needs secrets.
        let mut encrypted = body.section(9)?;
        if encrypted.byte()? != 0 {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
        }
        if encrypted.u32()? != 0 {
            return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
        }
        encrypted.finish()?;
    }
    body.finish()?;
    Ok(manifest)
}

fn metadata(mut reader: Reader<'_>) -> Result<Manifest, EpicError> {
    let version = reader.byte()?;
    if version > 2 {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
    }
    let feature_level = reader.u32()?;
    if !(12..=24).contains(&feature_level) {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
    }
    match reader.byte()? {
        0 => (),
        1 => return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent),
        _ => return Err(EpicError::Protocol),
    }
    reader.u32()?; // App ID.
    let app_name = reader.string()?;
    let build_version = reader.string()?;
    let launch_executable = reader.string()?;
    let launch_command = reader.string()?;
    let mut prerequisite_ids = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..reader.count(4)? {
        prerequisite_ids.push(reader.string()?);
    }
    let prerequisite = Prerequisite::named(
        prerequisite_ids,
        reader.string()?,
        reader.string()?,
        reader.string()?,
    );
    if version >= 1 {
        reader.string()?; // Build ID.
    }
    if version >= 2 {
        reader.string()?; // Uninstaller executable.
        reader.string()?; // Uninstaller arguments.
    }
    reader.finish()?;
    Ok(Manifest {
        app_name,
        build_version,
        launch_executable,
        launch_command,
        files: Vec::new(),
        chunks: BTreeMap::new(),
        feature_level,
        custom_fields: BTreeMap::new(),
        prerequisite,
    })
}

fn chunks(mut reader: Reader<'_>) -> Result<BTreeMap<ChunkGuid, Chunk>, EpicError> {
    let version = reader.byte()?;
    if version > 3 {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
    }
    // These fields follow the section's data version, independently of the
    // manifest feature level used to choose the chunk download directory.
    let count = reader.count(match version {
        0 => 57,
        1 => 73,
        2 => 77,
        _ => 93,
    })?;
    let mut chunks = Vec::with_capacity(count);
    for _ in 0..count {
        chunks.push(Chunk {
            guid: reader.guid()?,
            hash: 0,
            sha1: [0; 20],
            group: 0,
            window_size: 0,
            file_size: 0,
        });
    }
    for chunk in &mut chunks {
        chunk.hash = reader.u64()?;
    }
    for chunk in &mut chunks {
        chunk.sha1 = reader.array()?;
    }
    for chunk in &mut chunks {
        chunk.group = reader.byte()?;
    }
    for chunk in &mut chunks {
        chunk.window_size = reader.u32()?;
    }
    for chunk in &mut chunks {
        chunk.file_size = reader.u64()?;
    }
    if version >= 1 {
        for _ in 0..count {
            if reader.guid()? != [0; 4] {
                return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
            }
        }
    }
    if version >= 2 {
        for chunk in &chunks {
            let compressed_size = u64::from(reader.u32()?);
            if compressed_size > chunk.file_size {
                return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
            }
        }
    }
    if version >= 3 {
        for _ in 0..count {
            if reader.array::<16>()? != [0; 16] {
                return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
            }
        }
    }
    reader.finish()?;
    let mut result = BTreeMap::new();
    for chunk in chunks {
        if result.insert(chunk.guid, chunk).is_some() {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
    }
    Ok(result)
}

fn files(mut reader: Reader<'_>) -> Result<Vec<ManifestFile>, EpicError> {
    let version = reader.byte()?;
    if version > 2 {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
    }
    let count = reader.count(37)?;
    let mut files = Vec::with_capacity(count);
    for _ in 0..count {
        files.push(ManifestFile {
            filename: reader.string()?,
            symlink_target: None,
            hash: [0; 20],
            flags: 0,
            parts: Vec::new(),
        });
    }
    for file in &mut files {
        let target = reader.string()?;
        file.symlink_target = (!target.is_empty()).then_some(target);
    }
    for file in &mut files {
        file.hash = reader.array()?;
    }
    for file in &mut files {
        file.flags = reader.byte()?;
    }
    for _ in &files {
        for _ in 0..reader.count(4)? {
            reader.string()?;
        } // Install tags.
    }
    let mut total_parts = 0_usize;
    for file in &mut files {
        let count = reader.count(28)?;
        total_parts = total_parts.checked_add(count).ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
        if total_parts > MAX_ITEMS {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
        for _ in 0..count {
            let mut part = reader.section(28)?;
            file.parts.push(ChunkPart {
                guid: part.guid()?,
                offset: part.u32()?,
                size: part.u32()?,
            });
            part.finish()?;
        }
    }
    if version >= 1 {
        for _ in &files {
            if reader.u32()? != 0 {
                reader.take(16)?;
            }
        }
        for _ in &files {
            reader.string()?;
        } // MIME types.
    }
    if version >= 2 {
        reader.take(count.checked_mul(32).ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?)?;
    }
    reader.finish()?;
    Ok(files)
}

fn custom_fields(mut reader: Reader<'_>) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, String>, EpicError> {
    if reader.byte()? != 0 {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
    }
    let count = reader.count(8)?;
    let keys = (0..count)
        .map(|_| reader.string())
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
    let mut result = BTreeMap::new();
    for key in keys {
        if result.insert(key, reader.string()?).is_some() {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
    }
    reader.finish()?;
    Ok(result)
}

pub(crate) struct Reader<'a>(pub(crate) &'a [u8]);

impl<'a> Reader<'a> {
    pub(crate) fn take(&mut self, count: usize) -> Result<&'a [u8], EpicError> {
        let (value, remaining) = self.0.split_at_checked(count).ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
        self.0 = remaining;
        Ok(value)
    }
    fn array<const N: usize>(&mut self) -> Result<[u8; N], EpicError> {
        self.take(N)?.try_into().map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)
    }
    pub(crate) fn byte(&mut self) -> Result<u8, EpicError> {
        Ok(self.take(1)?[0])
    }
    pub(crate) fn u32(&mut self) -> Result<u32, EpicError> {
        Ok(u32::from_le_bytes(self.array()?))
    }
    fn u64(&mut self) -> Result<u64, EpicError> {
        Ok(u64::from_le_bytes(self.array()?))
    }
    fn guid(&mut self) -> Result<ChunkGuid, EpicError> {
        Ok([self.u32()?, self.u32()?, self.u32()?, self.u32()?])
    }
    pub(crate) fn count(&mut self, minimum_bytes: usize) -> Result<usize, EpicError> {
        let count = self.u32()? as usize;
        if count > MAX_ITEMS || count > self.0.len() / minimum_bytes {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
        Ok(count)
    }
    pub(crate) fn section(&mut self, minimum_bytes: usize) -> Result<Reader<'a>, EpicError> {
        let size = self.u32()? as usize;
        if size < minimum_bytes {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
        Ok(Reader(self.take(size - 4)?))
    }
    pub(crate) fn string(&mut self) -> Result<String, EpicError> {
        let length = self.u32()? as i32;
        if length == 0 {
            return Ok(String::new());
        }
        let unit = if length < 0 { 2 } else { 1 };
        let size = (length.unsigned_abs() as usize)
            .checked_mul(unit)
            .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
        if size > MAX_STRING_BYTES {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
        let bytes = self.take(size)?;
        if bytes[size - unit..].iter().any(|byte| *byte != 0) {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
        let value = if length < 0 {
            let units: Vec<u16> = bytes[..size - 2]
                .as_chunks::<2>()
                .0
                .iter()
                .map(|value| u16::from_le_bytes(*value))
                .collect();
            String::from_utf16(&units).map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?
        } else {
            String::from_utf8(bytes[..size - 1].to_vec()).map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?
        };
        validate_string(&value)?;
        Ok(value)
    }
    pub(crate) fn finish(self) -> Result<(), EpicError> {
        if self.0.is_empty() {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(EpicError::Protocol)
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct JsonManifest {
    #[serde(rename = "CustomFields", default, deserialize_with = "unique_map")]
    custom_fields: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    #[serde(rename = "ManifestFileVersion", default = "json_version")]
    version: String,
    #[serde(rename = "bIsFileData", default)]
    file_data: bool,
    #[serde(rename = "AppNameString")]
    app_name: String,
    #[serde(rename = "BuildVersionString", default)]
    build_version: String,
    #[serde(rename = "LaunchExeString", default)]
    launch_executable: String,
    #[serde(rename = "LaunchCommand", default)]
    launch_command: String,
    #[serde(rename = "PrereqIds", default)]
    prerequisite_ids: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(rename = "PrereqName", default)]
    prerequisite_name: String,
    #[serde(rename = "PrereqPath", default)]
    prerequisite_path: String,
    #[serde(rename = "PrereqArgs", default)]
    prerequisite_arguments: String,
    #[serde(rename = "FileManifestList")]
    files: Vec<JsonFile>,
    #[serde(rename = "ChunkFilesizeList", deserialize_with = "unique_map")]
    sizes: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    #[serde(rename = "ChunkHashList", deserialize_with = "unique_map")]
    hashes: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    #[serde(rename = "ChunkShaList", deserialize_with = "unique_map")]
    sha1s: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    #[serde(rename = "DataGroupList", deserialize_with = "unique_map")]
    groups: BTreeMap<String, String>,
}

fn json_version() -> String {
    "013000000000".to_owned()
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct JsonFile {
    #[serde(rename = "Filename")]
    filename: String,
    #[serde(rename = "SymlinkTarget", default)]
    symlink_target: String,
    #[serde(rename = "FileHash")]
    hash: String,
    #[serde(rename = "bIsReadOnly", default)]
    read_only: bool,
    #[serde(rename = "bIsCompressed", default)]
    compressed: bool,
    #[serde(rename = "bIsUnixExecutable", default)]
    executable: bool,
    #[serde(rename = "FileChunkParts")]
    parts: Vec<JsonPart>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct JsonPart {
    #[serde(rename = "Guid")]
    guid: String,
    #[serde(rename = "Offset")]
    offset: String,
    #[serde(rename = "Size")]
    size: String,
}

fn json_manifest(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Manifest, EpicError> {
    let json: JsonManifest = serde_json::from_slice(data).map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?;
    let feature_level = blob_u32(&json.version)?;
    if json.file_data || !(12..22).contains(&feature_level) {
        return Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent);
    }
    let mut chunks = BTreeMap::new();
    if json.sizes.len() > MAX_ITEMS
        || json.files.len() > MAX_ITEMS
        || json.hashes.len() != json.sizes.len()
        || json.sha1s.len() != json.sizes.len()
        || json.groups.len() != json.sizes.len()
    {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    for (guid, size) in json.sizes {
        let chunk = Chunk {
            guid: hex_guid(&guid)?,
            hash: blob_number(json.hashes.get(&guid).ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?)?,
            sha1: hex_bytes(json.sha1s.get(&guid).ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?)?,
            group: blob_number(json.groups.get(&guid).ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?)?
                .try_into()
                .map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?,
            window_size: 1024 * 1024,
            file_size: blob_number(&size)?,
        };
        if chunks.insert(chunk.guid, chunk).is_some() {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
    }
    let mut files = Vec::with_capacity(json.files.len());
    let mut part_count = 0_usize;
    for file in json.files {
        part_count = part_count
            .checked_add(file.parts.len())
            .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
        if part_count > MAX_ITEMS {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
        let hash = blob_bytes(&file.hash)?;
        let parts = file
            .parts
            .into_iter()
            .map(|part| {
                Ok(ChunkPart {
                    guid: hex_guid(&part.guid)?,
                    offset: blob_u32(&part.offset)?,
                    size: blob_u32(&part.size)?,
                })
            })
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, EpicError>>()?;
        files.push(ManifestFile {
            filename: file.filename,
            symlink_target: (!file.symlink_target.is_empty()).then_some(file.symlink_target),
            hash,
            flags: u8::from(file.read_only)
                | (u8::from(file.compressed) << 1)
                | (u8::from(file.executable) << 2),
            parts,
        });
    }
    Ok(Manifest {
        app_name: json.app_name,
        build_version: json.build_version,
        launch_executable: json.launch_executable,
        launch_command: json.launch_command,
        files,
        chunks,
        feature_level,
        custom_fields: json.custom_fields,
        prerequisite: Prerequisite::named(
            json.prerequisite_ids,
            json.prerequisite_name,
            json.prerequisite_path,
            json.prerequisite_arguments,
        ),
    })
}

fn unique_map<'de, D: Deserializer<'de>>(
    deserializer: D,
) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, String>, D::Error> {
    struct UniqueMap;
    impl<'de> Visitor<'de> for UniqueMap {
        type Value = BTreeMap<String, String>;
        fn expecting(&self, formatter: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
            formatter.write_str("an object with distinct chunk GUIDs")
        }
        fn visit_map<A: MapAccess<'de>>(self, mut map: A) -> Result<Self::Value, A::Error> {
            let mut result = BTreeMap::new();
            while let Some((key, value)) = map.next_entry::<String, String>()? {
                if result.len() >= MAX_ITEMS || result.insert(key, value).is_some() {
                    return Err(serde::de::Error::custom(
                        "duplicate or excessive chunk GUIDs",
                    ));
                }
            }
            Ok(result)
        }
    }
    deserializer.deserialize_map(UniqueMap)
}

fn blob_bytes<const N: usize>(value: &str) -> Result<[u8; N], EpicError> {
    if value.len() != N * 3 {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    let mut bytes = [0; N];
    for (index, digits) in value.as_bytes().as_chunks::<3>().0.iter().enumerate() {
        if !digits.iter().all(u8::is_ascii_digit) {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
        let byte = digits
            .iter()
            .fold(0_u16, |number, digit| number * 10 + u16::from(digit - b'0'));
        bytes[index] = byte.try_into().map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?;
    }
    Ok(bytes)
}

pub(crate) fn blob_number(value: &str) -> Result<u64, EpicError> {
    if value.is_empty() || value.len() > 24 || !value.len().is_multiple_of(3) {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    let mut padded = value.to_owned();
    padded.extend(std::iter::repeat_n('0', 24 - value.len()));
    Ok(u64::from_le_bytes(blob_bytes(&padded)?))
}

fn blob_u32(value: &str) -> Result<u32, EpicError> {
    blob_number(value)?
        .try_into()
        .map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)
}

fn hex_bytes<const N: usize>(value: &str) -> Result<[u8; N], EpicError> {
    obelisk_core::install::unhex(value).ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)
}

fn hex_guid(value: &str) -> Result<ChunkGuid, EpicError> {
    let bytes: [u8; 16] = hex_bytes(value)?;
    let mut guid = [0; 4];
    for (word, bytes) in guid.iter_mut().zip(bytes.as_chunks::<4>().0.iter()) {
        *word = u32::from_be_bytes(*bytes);
    }
    Ok(guid)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::io::Write;

    const GUID: ChunkGuid = [0x1122_aabb, 0x3344_ccdd, 0x5566_eeff, 0x7788_0099];
    const GUID_TEXT: &str = "1122AABB3344CCDD5566EEFF77880099";
    const GAME_PATH: &str = "Game.app/Contents/MacOS/Game";
    const HASH: u64 = 0x0102_0304_0506_0708;

    fn blob(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
        bytes.iter().map(|byte| format!("{byte:03}")).collect()
    }

    fn hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
        bytes.iter().map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}")).collect()
    }

    fn json_fixture() -> serde_json::Value {
        serde_json::json!({
            "ManifestFileVersion": blob(&13_u32.to_le_bytes()),
            "bIsFileData": false,
            "AppNameString": "ExampleGame",
            "BuildVersionString": "1.2.3",
            "LaunchExeString": GAME_PATH,
            "LaunchCommand": "-epicportal",
            "FileManifestList": [{
                "Filename": GAME_PATH,
                "FileHash": blob(&Sha1::digest(b"game")),
                "bIsUnixExecutable": true,
                "InstallTags": ["optional"],
                "FileChunkParts": [{"Guid":GUID_TEXT,"Offset":blob(&1_u32.to_le_bytes()),"Size":blob(&4_u32.to_le_bytes())}]
            }],
            "ChunkFilesizeList": {GUID_TEXT: blob(&72_u64.to_le_bytes())},
            "ChunkHashList": {GUID_TEXT: blob(&HASH.to_le_bytes())},
            "ChunkShaList": {GUID_TEXT: hex(&Sha1::digest(b"!game?"))},
            "DataGroupList": {GUID_TEXT: "042"},
        })
    }

    fn parse_json(value: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<Manifest, EpicError> {
        parse(&serde_json::to_vec(value).unwrap())
    }

    fn section(version: u8, data: Vec<u8>) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut result = ((data.len() + 5) as u32).to_le_bytes().to_vec();
        result.push(version);
        result.extend(data);
        result
    }

    fn string(value: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut result = ((value.len() + 1) as u32).to_le_bytes().to_vec();
        result.extend(value.as_bytes());
        result.push(0);
        result
    }

    fn body(feature_level: u32, metadata_version: u8, file_version: u8) -> Vec<u8> {
        body_with_chunk_version(
            feature_level,
            metadata_version,
            file_version,
            if feature_level >= 22 { 3 } else { 0 },
        )
    }

    fn body_with_chunk_version(
        feature_level: u32,
        metadata_version: u8,
        file_version: u8,
        chunk_version: u8,
    ) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut metadata = feature_level.to_le_bytes().to_vec();
        metadata.push(0); // Chunk-based manifest.
        metadata.extend(7_u32.to_le_bytes()); // App ID.
        for value in ["ExampleGame", "1.2.3", GAME_PATH, "-epicportal"] {
            metadata.extend(string(value));
        }
        metadata.extend(1_u32.to_le_bytes());
        metadata.extend(string("prerequisite-id"));
        for value in ["runtime", "support/setup.exe", "-silent"] {
            metadata.extend(string(value));
        }
        if metadata_version >= 1 {
            metadata.extend(string("build-id"));
        }
        if metadata_version >= 2 {
            metadata.extend(string("uninstall.exe"));
            metadata.extend(string("/quiet"));
        }
        let mut result = section(metadata_version, metadata);
        let mut chunks = 1_u32.to_le_bytes().to_vec();
        chunks.extend(GUID.iter().flat_map(|word| word.to_le_bytes()));
        chunks.extend(HASH.to_le_bytes());
        chunks.extend(Sha1::digest(b"!game?"));
        chunks.push(42);
        chunks.extend(6_u32.to_le_bytes());
        chunks.extend(if feature_level >= 22 { 104_u64 } else { 72_u64 }.to_le_bytes());
        if chunk_version >= 1 {
            chunks.extend([0; 16]); // No chunk encryption key.
        }
        if chunk_version >= 2 {
            chunks.extend(6_u32.to_le_bytes());
        }
        if chunk_version >= 3 {
            chunks.extend([0; 16]); // No chunk encryption tag.
        }
        result.extend(section(chunk_version, chunks));
        let mut files = 2_u32.to_le_bytes().to_vec();
        files.extend(string(GAME_PATH));
        let unicode: Vec<u16> = "Données.txt".encode_utf16().collect();
        files.extend((-(unicode.len() as i32 + 1)).to_le_bytes());
        files.extend(unicode.iter().flat_map(|unit| unit.to_le_bytes()));
        files.extend([0; 2]);
        files.extend(string(""));
        files.extend(string(""));
        files.extend(Sha1::digest(b"game"));
        files.extend(Sha1::digest(b""));
        files.extend([4, 0]);
        files.extend(1_u32.to_le_bytes());
        files.extend(string("optional"));
        files.extend(0_u32.to_le_bytes());
        files.extend(1_u32.to_le_bytes());
        files.extend(28_u32.to_le_bytes());
        files.extend(GUID.iter().flat_map(|word| word.to_le_bytes()));
        files.extend(1_u32.to_le_bytes());
        files.extend(4_u32.to_le_bytes());
        files.extend(0_u32.to_le_bytes());
        if file_version >= 1 {
            files.extend(1_u32.to_le_bytes());
            files.extend([1; 16]);
            files.extend(0_u32.to_le_bytes());
            files.extend(string("application/octet-stream"));
            files.extend(string("text/plain"));
        }
        if file_version >= 2 {
            files.extend([1; 64]);
        }
        result.extend(section(file_version, files));
        let mut custom = 1_u32.to_le_bytes().to_vec();
        custom.extend(string("platform"));
        custom.extend(string("Mac"));
        result.extend(section(0, custom));
        result
    }

    fn binary(body: &[u8], version: u32, compressed: bool) -> Vec<u8> {
        let payload = if compressed {
            let mut encoder =
                flate2::write::ZlibEncoder::new(Vec::new(), flate2::Compression::default());
            encoder.write_all(body).unwrap();
            encoder.finish().unwrap()
        } else {
            body.to_vec()
        };
        let mut result = 0x44be_c00c_u32.to_le_bytes().to_vec();
        result.extend(if version >= 22 { 73_u32 } else { 41_u32 }.to_le_bytes());
        result.extend((body.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
        result.extend((payload.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
        result.extend(Sha1::digest(body));
        result.push(u8::from(compressed));
        result.extend(version.to_le_bytes());
        if version >= 22 {
            result.extend([0; 32]);
        }
        result.extend(payload);
        result
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_manifest_keeps_its_prerequisite_program_and_a_build_without_one_names_none() {
        let expected = Some(Prerequisite {
            ids: vec!["prerequisite-id".into()],
            name: "runtime".into(),
            path: "support/setup.exe".into(),
            arguments: "-silent".into(),
        });
        let manifest = parse(&binary(&body(20, 2, 2), 20, false)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(manifest.prerequisite, expected);

        let mut json = json_fixture();
        assert_eq!(parse_json(&json).unwrap().prerequisite, None);
        let object = json.as_object_mut().unwrap();
        object.insert("PrereqIds".into(), serde_json::json!(["prerequisite-id"]));
        object.insert("PrereqName".into(), "runtime".into());
        object.insert("PrereqPath".into(), "support/setup.exe".into());
        object.insert("PrereqArgs".into(), "-silent".into());
        assert_eq!(parse_json(&json).unwrap().prerequisite, expected);
    }

    #[test]
    fn reads_binary_versions_raw_and_zlib_with_unicode_and_empty_files() {
        for feature in [13, 15, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 24] {
            for metadata_version in 0..=2 {
                for file_version in 0..=2 {
                    for compressed in [false, true] {
                        let bytes = binary(
                            &body(feature, metadata_version, file_version),
                            feature.max(18),
                            compressed,
                        );
                        let manifest = parse(&bytes).unwrap();
                        assert_eq!(manifest.app_name, "ExampleGame");
                        assert_eq!(manifest.build_version, "1.2.3");
                        assert_eq!(manifest.launch_executable, GAME_PATH);
                        assert_eq!(manifest.launch_command, "-epicportal");
                        assert_eq!(manifest.files[0].size(), 4);
                        assert_eq!(manifest.files[0].hash, Sha1::digest(b"game").as_slice());
                        assert_eq!(manifest.files[0].flags, 4);
                        assert_eq!(manifest.files[0].parts[0].guid, GUID);
                        assert_eq!(manifest.files[0].parts[0].offset, 1);
                        assert_eq!(manifest.files[1].filename, "Données.txt");
                        assert_eq!(manifest.files[1].size(), 0);
                        assert_eq!(manifest.chunks[&GUID].window_size, 6);
                        assert_eq!(
                            manifest.chunks[&GUID].sha1,
                            Sha1::digest(b"!game?").as_slice()
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]

    #[test]
    fn modern_plain_manifests_allow_an_empty_encrypted_metadata_array() {
        for compressed in [false, true] {
            let mut empty = body(24, 2, 2);
            empty.extend(section(0, 0_u32.to_le_bytes().to_vec()));
            assert_eq!(
                parse(&binary(&empty, 24, compressed)).unwrap().files[0].size(),
                4
            );
            // The array belongs to manifest encryption support, introduced at24.
            assert!(parse(&binary(&empty, 21, compressed)).is_err());
            let mut bad_length = body(24, 2, 2);
            bad_length.extend(section(0, vec![0; 5]));
            assert!(parse(&binary(&bad_length, 24, compressed)).is_err());
            let mut ciphertext = body(24, 2, 2);
            let mut data = 1_u32.to_le_bytes().to_vec();
            data.push(1);
            ciphertext.extend(section(0, data));
            assert!(matches!(
                parse(&binary(&ciphertext, 24, compressed)),
                Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent)
            ));
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn chunk_paths_follow_manifest_feature_level_and_epic_guid_byte_order() {
        let manifest = parse_json(&json_fixture()).unwrap();

    #[test]
    fn rejects_corrupt_binary_headers_hashes_counts_strings_and_chunk_bounds() {
        for compressed in [false, true] {
            let valid = binary(&body(20, 2, 2), 21, compressed);
            for end in 0..valid.len() {
                assert!(parse(&valid[..end]).is_err(), "prefix {end}");
            }
            for index in [0, 16, 20, 36] {
                let mut corrupt = valid.clone();
                corrupt[index] ^= 0x80;
                assert!(parse(&corrupt).is_err());
            }
            for index in [4, 8, 12] {
                let mut corrupt = valid.clone();
                corrupt[index..index + 4].copy_from_slice(&u32::MAX.to_le_bytes());
                assert!(parse(&corrupt).is_err());
            }
            let mut trailing = body(20, 2, 2);
            trailing.push(0);
            assert!(parse(&binary(&trailing, 21, compressed)).is_err());
            let mut excessive = body(20, 2, 2);
            let chunks_offset = u32::from_le_bytes(excessive[..4].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;
            excessive[chunks_offset + 5..chunks_offset + 9]
                .copy_from_slice(&u32::MAX.to_le_bytes());
            assert!(parse(&binary(&excessive, 21, compressed)).is_err());
            let mut invalid_string = body(20, 2, 2);
            invalid_string[14..18].copy_from_slice(&i32::MIN.to_le_bytes());
            assert!(parse(&binary(&invalid_string, 21, compressed)).is_err());
            let mut bounds = body(20, 2, 2);
            bounds[chunks_offset + 9 + 45..chunks_offset + 9 + 49]
                .copy_from_slice(&3_u32.to_le_bytes());
            assert!(parse(&binary(&bounds, 21, compressed)).is_err());
        }
    }

    #[test]

    #[test]
    fn rejects_json_missing_chunks_duplicates_zero_hashes_overflow_and_bad_blobs() {
        let original = json_fixture();
        for (field, value) in [
            ("Offset", blob(&u32::MAX.to_le_bytes())),
            ("Size", blob(&u64::MAX.to_le_bytes())),
            ("Size", "256000000000".to_owned()),
            ("Size", "-01000000000".to_owned()),
            ("Size", "0000".to_owned()),
            ("Size", "000000000000".to_owned()),
            ("Guid", "00000000000000000000000000000001".to_owned()),
        ] {
            let mut json = original.clone();

            assert!(parse_json(&json).is_err(), "{field}");
        }
        let mut duplicate_file = original.clone();
        duplicate_file["FileManifestList"]
            .as_array_mut()
            .unwrap()
            .push(original["FileManifestList"][0].clone());
        assert!(parse_json(&duplicate_file).is_err());
        for field in ["ChunkShaList", "ChunkHashList", "DataGroupList"] {
            let mut json = original.clone();
            json[field].as_object_mut().unwrap().clear();
            assert!(parse_json(&json).is_err());
        }
        for (field, value) in [
            ("ChunkShaList", "00".repeat(20)),
            ("ChunkShaList", "g0".repeat(20)),
            ("DataGroupList", "100".to_owned()),
            ("ChunkFilesizeList", blob(&u64::MAX.to_le_bytes())),
        ] {
            let mut json = original.clone();
            json[field][GUID_TEXT] = value.into();
            assert!(parse_json(&json).is_err());
        }
        let mut zero_file_hash = original.clone();
        zero_file_hash["FileManifestList"][0]["FileHash"] = "000".repeat(20).into();
        assert!(parse_json(&zero_file_hash).is_err());
        let mut case_duplicate = original.clone();
        for field in [
            "ChunkShaList",
            "ChunkHashList",
            "DataGroupList",
            "ChunkFilesizeList",
        ] {
            case_duplicate[field][GUID_TEXT.to_lowercase()] = original[field][GUID_TEXT].clone();
        }
        assert!(parse_json(&case_duplicate).is_err());
        let json = serde_json::to_string(&original).unwrap();
        let duplicate = json.replace(
            &format!("\"DataGroupList\":{{\"{GUID_TEXT}\":\"042\"}}"),
            &format!("\"DataGroupList\":{{\"{GUID_TEXT}\":\"042\",\"{GUID_TEXT}\":\"042\"}}"),
        );
        assert_ne!(json, duplicate);
        assert!(parse(duplicate.as_bytes()).is_err());
    }
}
```

`crates/storefronts/epic-kit/src/details.rs`:

```rs
//! Current platform manifests for installation estimates and verified
//! downloads, and the build a download installs.
use obelisk_core::{Platform, build_choice::GameBuilds, install::unhex};
use reqwest::Url;
use serde::Deserialize;
use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    path::Path,
    sync::{Mutex, PoisonError},
    time::Duration,
};

use crate::{
    EpicError,
    auth::{self, Api, credential_free},
    client::{PLATFORM, validate_identity},
    content_manifest::Manifest,
    manifest,
};

mod build_choice;
pub(crate) mod diagnostic;
pub(crate) mod manifest_cache;

pub(crate) use build_choice::LiveBuilds;

/// What a build's manifest told, by game identity and live asset hash, which
/// names one immutable build: reopening a game's page skips its manifest.
pub(crate) struct ByBuild<T>(Mutex<HashMap<BuildKey, T>>);

/// Installation sizes.
pub(crate) type InstallationSizes = ByBuild<u64>;

type BuildKey = ([String; 4], String);

impl<T> Default for ByBuild<T> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self(Mutex::new(HashMap::new()))
    }
}

impl<T: Copy> ByBuild<T> {
    fn get(&self, key: &BuildKey) -> Option<T> {
        self.0
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner)
            .get(key)
            .copied()
    }

    fn insert(&self, key: BuildKey, value: T) {
        self.0
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner)
            .insert(key, value);
    }
}

/// The key of `asset`'s build of the game, when Epic names its hash.
fn build_key(identity: [&str; 4], asset: &Asset) -> Option<BuildKey> {
    asset
        .hash
        .clone()
        .map(|hash| (identity.map(str::to_owned), hash))
}

/// Each Mac build's verdict, and the manifest of the last native one, which
/// its download starts from.
pub(crate) type BuildChoice = obelisk_core::build_choice::BuildChoice<BuildKey, FetchedManifest>;

/// The build a game's page shows before any download, and its size: the
/// Mac build, unless a download found that its game does not run natively
/// and Epic has a Windows build of it. None of the build's files is read.
pub(crate) async fn shown_build(
    api: &Api,
    access_token: &str,
    namespace: &str,
    catalog_item_id: &str,
    app_name: &str,
    choice: &BuildChoice,
    sizes: &InstallationSizes,
) -> Result<(Platform, Option<u64>), EpicError> {
    let identity = |platform| [namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name, platform];
    let game = LiveBuilds::new(api, access_token, namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name);
    let offered = game.builds().await?;
    let (platform, asset) = choice
        .shown(&game, offered)
        .await
        .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
    let label = PLATFORM.name(platform);
    let mut trace = trace(namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name, label);
    let size = asset_size(api, &asset, identity(label), sizes, &mut trace).await;
    Ok((platform, reported(&mut trace, size).ok()))
}

/// The size of the build `asset` describes, from its manifest, read once
/// per build.
async fn asset_size(
    api: &Api,
    asset: &Asset,
    identity: [&str; 4],
    sizes: &InstallationSizes,
    trace: &mut diagnostic::Trace,
) -> Result<u64, EpicError> {
    let key = build_key(identity, asset);
    if let Some(size) = key.as_ref().and_then(|key| sizes.get(key)) {
        return Ok(size);
    }
    let [namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name, platform] = identity;
    let fetched = asset_manifest(
        api,
        asset,
        namespace,
        catalog_item_id,
        app_name,
        platform,
        None,
        trace,
    )
    .await?;
    let size = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || manifest::installation_size(&fetched.bytes))
        .await
        .map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)??;
    if let Some(key) = key {
        sizes.insert(key, size);
    }
    Ok(size)
}

pub(crate) struct FetchedManifest {
    pub bytes: Vec<u8>,
    pub base_urls: Vec<Url>,
    pub deployment_id: Option<String>,
    pub network_bytes: u64,
    pub manifest: Option<Manifest>,
    pub cache_key: Option<manifest_cache::ManifestCacheKey>,
}

/// The manifest of the game's live build for `platform`: the one its pick
/// read when it is that build's, else the cached or downloaded one.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub(crate) async fn fetch_manifest(
    api: &Api,
    access_token: &str,
    namespace: &str,
    catalog_item_id: &str,
    app_name: &str,
    platform: Platform,
    cache_directory: Option<&Path>,
    take: impl FnOnce(&BuildKey) -> Option<FetchedManifest>,
) -> Result<FetchedManifest, EpicError> {
    let platform = PLATFORM.name(platform);
    let mut trace = trace(namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name, platform);
    let result = async {
        let asset = live_asset(
            api,
            access_token,
            namespace,
            catalog_item_id,
            app_name,
            platform,
            &mut trace,
        )
        .await?;
        let identity = [namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name, platform];
        if let Some(mut fetched) = build_key(identity, &asset).and_then(|key| take(&key)) {
            fetched.cache_key = cache_directory.and_then(|_| {
                manifest_cache::ManifestCacheKey::new(
                    namespace,
                    catalog_item_id,
                    app_name,
                    platform,
                    asset.hash.as_deref(),
                )
            });
            return Ok(fetched);
        }
        asset_manifest(
            api,
            &asset,
            namespace,
            catalog_item_id,
            app_name,
            platform,
            cache_directory,
            &mut trace,
        )
        .await
    }
    .await;
    reported(&mut trace, result)
}

/// The version of the game's live build, as the launcher service names it.
pub(crate) async fn live_build_version(
    api: &Api,
    access_token: &str,
    namespace: &str,
    catalog_item_id: &str,
    app_name: &str,
    platform: Platform,
) -> Result<String, EpicError> {
    let platform = PLATFORM.name(platform);
    let mut trace = trace(namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name, platform);
    let version = live_asset(
        api,
        access_token,
        namespace,
        catalog_item_id,
        app_name,
        platform,
        &mut trace,
    )
    .await
    .and_then(|asset| {
        asset
            .build_version
            .filter(|version| !version.is_empty())
            .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)
    });
    reported(&mut trace, version)
}

fn trace(
    namespace: &str,
    catalog_item_id: &str,
    app_name: &str,
    platform: &str,
) -> diagnostic::Trace {
    diagnostic::Trace {
        platform: platform.into(),
        namespace: namespace.into(),
        catalog_item_id: catalog_item_id.into(),
        app_name: app_name.into(),
        ..Default::default()
    }
}

/// Writes `trace` when `result` failed other than by the network or a
/// cancellation.
fn reported<T>(
    trace: &mut diagnostic::Trace,
    result: Result<T, EpicError>,
) -> Result<T, EpicError> {
    if let Err(error) = &result
        && !matches!(error, EpicError::Cancelled | EpicError::Network)
    {
        trace.error = format!("{error:?}");
        diagnostic::write(trace);
    }
    result
}

/// The game's live Mac and Windows builds; none for a platform Epic has no
/// build for.
async fn live_builds(
    api: &Api,
    access_token: &str,
    namespace: &str,
    catalog_item_id: &str,
    app_name: &str,
) -> Result<(Option<Asset>, Option<Asset>), EpicError> {
    let (mac_label, windows_label) = (
        PLATFORM.name(Platform::Mac),
        PLATFORM.name(Platform::Windows),
    );
    let mut mac_trace = trace(namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name, mac_label);
    let mut windows_trace = trace(namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name, windows_label);
    let (mac, windows) = tokio::join!(
        live_build(
            api,
            access_token,
            namespace,
            catalog_item_id,
            app_name,
            mac_label,
            &mut mac_trace
        ),
        live_build(
            api,
            access_token,
            namespace,
            catalog_item_id,
            app_name,
            windows_label,
            &mut windows_trace,
        ),
    );
    Ok((
        reported(&mut mac_trace, mac)?,
        reported(&mut windows_trace, windows)?,
    ))
}

/// The game's live build as the launcher service describes it.
async fn live_asset(
    api: &Api,
    access_token: &str,
    namespace: &str,
    catalog_item_id: &str,
    app_name: &str,
    platform: &str,
    trace: &mut diagnostic::Trace,
) -> Result<Asset, EpicError> {
    live_build(
        api,
        access_token,
        namespace,
        catalog_item_id,
        app_name,
        platform,
        trace,
    )
    .await?
    .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)
}

/// The game's live build for `platform`; none when Epic has no such build.
async fn live_build(
    api: &Api,
    access_token: &str,
    namespace: &str,
    catalog_item_id: &str,
    app_name: &str,
    platform: &str,
    trace: &mut diagnostic::Trace,
) -> Result<Option<Asset>, EpicError> {
    trace.step = "identity";
    validate_identity(namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name)?;
    let mut url = Url::parse(&api.launcher).map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?;
    url.path_segments_mut()
        .map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?
        .clear()
        .extend([
            "launcher",
            "api",
            "public",
            "assets",
            "v2",
            "platform",
            platform,
            "namespace",
            namespace,
            "catalogItem",
            catalog_item_id,
            "app",
            app_name,
            "label",
            "Live",
        ]);
    trace.step = "assets request";
    let Some(response) = api
        .get_optional::<serde_json::Value>(url, access_token)
        .await?
    else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    if cfg!(debug_assertions) {
        trace.assets = Some(diagnostic::redact(&response));
    }
    trace.step = "assets response";
    let response: AssetResponse =
        serde_json::from_value(response).map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?;
    trace.step = "asset count";
    let asset = match <[Asset; 1]>::try_from(response.elements) {
        Ok([asset]) => asset,
        Err(elements) if elements.is_empty() => return Ok(None),
        Err(_) => return Err(EpicError::Protocol),
    };
    trace.asset_hash = asset.hash.clone();
    trace.step = "manifest count";
    if asset.manifests.is_empty() || asset.manifests.len() > 8 {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    Ok(Some(asset))
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
async fn asset_manifest(
    api: &Api,
    asset: &Asset,
    namespace: &str,
    catalog_item_id: &str,
    app_name: &str,
    platform: &str,
    cache_directory: Option<&Path>,
    trace: &mut diagnostic::Trace,
) -> Result<FetchedManifest, EpicError> {
    trace.step = "manifest cache";
    let cache_key = cache_directory.and_then(|_| {
        manifest_cache::ManifestCacheKey::new(
            namespace,
            catalog_item_id,
            app_name,
            platform,
            asset.hash.as_deref(),
        )
    });
    let mut cached = if let Some((directory, key)) = cache_directory.zip(cache_key.as_ref()) {
        let directory = directory.to_path_buf();
        let key = key.clone();
        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || manifest_cache::load(&directory, &key))
            .await
            .map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)??
    } else {
        None
    };
    let deployment_id = asset
        .sidecar
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|sidecar| {
            sidecar
                .config
                .as_deref()
                .and_then(|config| serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(config).ok())
        })
        .and_then(|config| {
            config
                .get("deploymentId")
                .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
                .map(str::to_owned)
        });
    let mut last_error = EpicError::Protocol;
    trace.step = "manifests";
    for location in &asset.manifests {
        let attempt = trace.attempts.push_mut(diagnostic::Attempt {
            host: diagnostic::host(&location.uri),
            step: "request",
            ..Default::default()
        });
        let result = async {
            let request = manifest_request(api, location)?;
            // A signed manifest query applies to that manifest only. Chunk URLs
            // use its containing directory and never inherit account tokens.
            let base_url = request.url().join("./").map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?;
            let base_urls = chunk_base_urls(api, &asset.manifests, base_url);
            if let Some(cached) = cached.take() {
                return Ok(FetchedManifest {
                    bytes: cached.bytes,
                    base_urls,
                    deployment_id: deployment_id.clone(),
                    network_bytes: 0,
                    manifest: Some(cached.manifest),
                    cache_key: cache_key.clone(),
                });
            }
            attempt.step = "download";
            let response = api
                .http
                .execute(request)
                .await
                .map_err(|_| EpicError::Network)?;
            attempt.status = Some(response.status().as_u16());
            // CDN errors do not invalidate the account's OAuth session.
            if !response.status().is_success() {
                return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
            }
            attempt.step = "body";
            let bytes = auth::bounded_bytes(response, manifest::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES).await?;
            attempt.bytes = Some(bytes.len());
            attempt.step = "hash and parse";
            if cfg!(debug_assertions) {
                match crate::content_manifest::parse(&bytes) {
                    Ok(manifest) => attempt.manifest_app_name = Some(manifest.app_name),
                    Err(error) => attempt.parse_error = Some(format!("{error:?}")),
                }
                trace.manifest = Some(bytes.clone());
            }
            let hash = asset.hash.clone();
            let deployment_id = deployment_id.clone();
            let cache_key = cache_key.clone();
            let validate_content = cache_directory.is_some();
            tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
                checked_hash(&bytes, hash.as_deref())?;
                let parsed = validate_content
                    .then(|| manifest_cache::validate(&bytes))
                    .transpose()?;
                Ok(FetchedManifest {
                    network_bytes: bytes.len() as u64,
                    bytes,
                    base_urls,
                    deployment_id,
                    manifest: parsed,
                    cache_key,
                })
            })
            .await
            .map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?
        }
        .await;
        match result {
            Ok(fetched) => return Ok(fetched),
            Err(error) => {
                if let Some(attempt) = trace.attempts.last_mut() {
                    attempt.error = format!("{error:?}");
                }
                last_error = error;
            }
        }
    }
    Err(last_error)
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct AssetResponse {
    elements: Vec<Asset>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
pub(crate) struct Asset {
    hash: Option<String>,
    /// The build's version, as its manifest records it too.
    #[serde(default, rename = "buildVersion")]
    build_version: Option<String>,
    sidecar: Option<Sidecar>,
    manifests: Vec<ManifestLocation>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct Sidecar {
    config: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct ManifestLocation {
    uri: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    query_params: Vec<QueryParameter>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct QueryParameter {
    name: String,
    value: String,
}

fn chunk_base_urls(api: &Api, locations: &[ManifestLocation], selected: Url) -> Vec<Url> {
    let mut urls = vec![selected];
    for location in locations {
        if let Ok(request) = manifest_request(api, location)
            && let Ok(base_url) = request.url().join("./")
            && !urls.contains(&base_url)
        {
            urls.push(base_url);
        }
    }
    urls
}

fn manifest_request(api: &Api, location: &ManifestLocation) -> Result<reqwest::Request, EpicError> {
    if location.uri.len() > 16_384 || location.query_params.len() > 64 {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    let mut url = Url::parse(&location.uri).map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?;
    // Some launcher responses still advertise these CDNs with HTTP. Always
    // upgrade known legacy hosts; never send metadata requests in plaintext.
    if url.scheme() == "http"
        && matches!(
            url.host_str(),
            Some(
                "download.epicgames.com"
                    | "download2.epicgames.com"
                    | "download3.epicgames.com"
                    | "download4.epicgames.com"
                    | "epicgames-download1.akamaized.net"
            )
        )
    {
        if url.port().is_some_and(|port| port != 80) {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
        url.set_port(None).map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?;
        url.set_scheme("https").map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?;
    }
    let permitted_scheme = url.scheme() == "https"
        || cfg!(test) && url.scheme() == "http" && url.host_str() == Some("127.0.0.1");
    if !permitted_scheme || !credential_free(&url) {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    if !location.query_params.is_empty() {
        let mut query = url.query_pairs_mut();
        for parameter in &location.query_params {
            if parameter.name.is_empty()
                || parameter.name.len() > 1024
                || parameter.value.len() > 8192
            {
                return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
            }
            query.append_pair(&parameter.name, &parameter.value);
        }
    }
    if url.as_str().len() > 32_768 {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    // Api's client disables redirects and stores no bearer/default credentials.
    api.http
        .get(url)
        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(20))
        .build()
        .map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)
}

#[cfg(test)]
fn checked_size(bytes: &[u8], hash: Option<&str>) -> Result<u64, EpicError> {
    checked_hash(bytes, hash)?;
    manifest::installation_size(bytes)
}

fn checked_hash(bytes: &[u8], hash: Option<&str>) -> Result<(), EpicError> {
    if let Some(hash) = hash
        && !unhex::<20>(hash).is_some_and(|expected| Sha1::digest(bytes)[..] == expected)
    {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::{
        io::{Read, Write},
        net::TcpListener,
        time::{Duration, Instant},
    };

    #[test]
    fn cdn_manifest_requests_use_https_signed_queries_and_no_account_credentials() {
        let api = Api::new().unwrap();
        for uri in [
            "https://download.epicgames.com/game.manifest?existing=1",
            "http://download.epicgames.com/game.manifest?existing=1",
            "http://download4.epicgames.com/game.manifest?existing=1",
            "http://epicgames-download1.akamaized.net/game.manifest?existing=1",
        ] {
            let location = ManifestLocation {
                uri: uri.into(),
                query_params: vec![QueryParameter {
                    name: "Signature".into(),
                    value: "a+b/c=".into(),
                }],
            };
            let request = manifest_request(&api, &location).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(request.url().scheme(), "https");
            assert!(request.headers().get("authorization").is_none());
            assert!(request.headers().get("cookie").is_none());
            let query: std::collections::BTreeMap<_, _> = request.url().query_pairs().collect();
            assert_eq!(
                query.get("Signature").map(|value| value.as_ref()),
                Some("a+b/c=")
            );
            assert_eq!(query.get("existing").map(|value| value.as_ref()), Some("1"));
        }
        for uri in [
            "file:///tmp/game",
            "http://example.com/game",
            "https://user:password@example.com/game",
            "https://example.com/game#fragment",
        ] {
            let location = ManifestLocation {
                uri: uri.into(),
                query_params: vec![],
            };
            assert!(manifest_request(&api, &location).is_err());
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn manifest_sha1_from_asset_response_is_verified_before_using_the_size() {
        let bytes = br#"{"FileManifestList":[{"FileChunkParts":[{"Size":"000016000000"}]}]}"#;
        let hash = "97b66a6f9bb438f612c2feff8de4b80456a6fd5b";
        assert_eq!(checked_size(bytes, Some(hash)).unwrap(), 4096);
        assert_eq!(checked_size(bytes, None).unwrap(), 4096);
        assert!(checked_size(bytes, Some("0000000000000000000000000000000000000000")).is_err());
        assert!(checked_size(bytes, Some("broken")).is_err());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn cached_manifest_uses_current_cdn_directory_and_sidecar_only() {
        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let bytes = manifest_cache::tests::fixture("game", "game.exe");
        let hash: String = Sha1::digest(&bytes)
            .iter()
            .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
            .collect();
        let key =
            manifest_cache::ManifestCacheKey::new("ns", "catalog", "game", "Mac", Some(&hash))
                .unwrap();
        manifest_cache::store(directory.path(), &key, &bytes).unwrap();
        for valid_location in [true, false] {
            let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
            listener.set_nonblocking(true).unwrap();
            let mut api = Api::new().unwrap();
            api.launcher = format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap());
            let current_directory = format!("{}/fresh/release/", api.launcher);
            let uri = if valid_location {
                format!("{current_directory}game.manifest?old-in-query=current")
            } else {
                "file:///invalid/game.manifest".into()
            };
            let mut locations = vec![serde_json::json!({"uri": uri, "queryParams": [
                {"name": "Signature", "value": "fresh-signed-secret"}
            ]})];
            if valid_location {
                locations.extend([
                    serde_json::json!({"uri": "file:///invalid/alternative.manifest"}),
                    serde_json::json!({"uri": "https://second.example.com/fresh/game.manifest?Signature=second-secret"}),
                    serde_json::json!({"uri": format!("{current_directory}duplicate.manifest?Signature=duplicate-secret")}),
                ]);
            }
            let response = serde_json::to_vec(&serde_json::json!({"elements": [{
                "hash": hash,
                "sidecar": {"config": "{\"deploymentId\":\"fresh-deployment\"}"},
                "manifests": locations,
            }]}))
            .unwrap();
            let server = std::thread::spawn(move || {
                let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(3);
                let mut socket = loop {
                    match listener.accept() {
                        Ok((socket, _)) => break socket,
                        Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
                            assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "asset request never arrived");
                            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2));
                        }
                        Err(error) => panic!("{error}"),
                    }
                };
                socket.set_nonblocking(false).unwrap();
                socket
                    .set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(2)))
                    .unwrap();
                let mut request = Vec::new();
                while !request.windows(4).any(|window| window == b"\r\n\r\n") {
                    let mut buffer = [0; 1024];
                    let count = socket.read(&mut buffer).unwrap();
                    assert!(count > 0);
                    request.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..count]);
                }
                write!(socket, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n", response.len()).unwrap();
                socket.write_all(&response).unwrap();
                String::from_utf8(request).unwrap()
            });
            let result = fetch_manifest(
                &api,
                "account-token",
                "ns",
                "catalog",
                "game",
                Platform::Mac,
                Some(directory.path()),
                |_| None,
            )
            .await;
            let request = server.join().unwrap();
            assert!(request.starts_with("GET /launcher/api/public/assets/v2/"));
            if valid_location {
                let fetched = result.unwrap();
                assert_eq!(fetched.network_bytes, 0);
                assert_eq!(fetched.base_urls.len(), 2);
                assert_eq!(fetched.base_urls[0].as_str(), current_directory);
                assert_eq!(
                    fetched.base_urls[1].as_str(),
                    "https://second.example.com/fresh/"
                );
                assert!(fetched.base_urls.iter().all(|url| url.query().is_none()));
                assert_eq!(fetched.deployment_id.as_deref(), Some("fresh-deployment"));
                assert_eq!(fetched.bytes, bytes);
                assert_eq!(fetched.manifest.unwrap().app_name, "game");
            } else {
                assert!(matches!(result, Err(EpicError::Protocol)));
            }
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn a_download_starts_from_the_manifest_its_pick_read_and_caches_it() {
        let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
        listener.set_nonblocking(true).unwrap();
        let mut api = Api::new().unwrap();
        api.launcher = format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap());
        // Only the live asset is served: the manifest is never asked for.
        let response = serde_json::to_vec(&serde_json::json!({"elements": [{
            "hash": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567",
            "manifests": [{"uri": "https://download.epicgames.com/game.manifest"}],
        }]}))
        .unwrap();
        let server = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(3);
            let mut socket = loop {
                match listener.accept() {
                    Ok((socket, _)) => break socket,
                    Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
                        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "asset request never arrived");
                        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2));
                    }
                    Err(error) => panic!("{error}"),
                }
            };
            socket.set_nonblocking(false).unwrap();
            let mut request = Vec::new();
            while !request.windows(4).any(|window| window == b"\r\n\r\n") {
                let mut buffer = [0; 1024];
                let count = socket.read(&mut buffer).unwrap();
                assert!(count > 0);
                request.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..count]);
            }
            write!(socket, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n", response.len()).unwrap();
            socket.write_all(&response).unwrap();
        });
        let expected = (
            ["ns", "catalog", "game", "Mac"].map(str::to_owned),
            "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567".to_owned(),
        );
        let mut picked = Some(FetchedManifest {
            bytes: b"picked manifest".to_vec(),
            base_urls: vec![Url::parse("https://download.epicgames.com/").unwrap()],
            deployment_id: None,
            network_bytes: 15,
            manifest: None,
            cache_key: None,
        });
        let mut asked = None;
        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let fetched = fetch_manifest(
            &api,
            "account-token",
            "ns",
            "catalog",
            "game",
            Platform::Mac,
            Some(directory.path()),
            |key| {
                asked = Some(key.clone());
                picked.take()
            },
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        server.join().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(asked, Some(expected), "it asks for the live build's");
        assert_eq!(fetched.bytes, b"picked manifest");
        assert_eq!(fetched.network_bytes, 15, "its download counts it");
        assert!(fetched.cache_key.is_some(), "the installation caches it");
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn asset_request_uses_platform_and_identity_and_preserves_unauthorized() {
        let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
        listener.set_nonblocking(true).unwrap();
        let mut api = Api::new().unwrap();
        api.launcher = format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap());
        let server = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(3);
            let mut socket = loop {
                match listener.accept() {
                    Ok((socket, _)) => break socket,
                    Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
                        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "asset request never arrived");
                        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2));
                    }
                    Err(error) => panic!("{error}"),
                }
            };
            socket.set_nonblocking(false).unwrap();
            socket
                .set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(2)))
                .unwrap();
            let mut request = Vec::new();
            while !request.windows(4).any(|window| window == b"\r\n\r\n") {
                let mut bytes = [0; 1024];
                let count = socket.read(&mut bytes).unwrap();
                assert!(count > 0);
                request.extend_from_slice(&bytes[..count]);
            }
            socket
                .write_all(
                    b"HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
                )
                .unwrap();
            String::from_utf8(request).unwrap()
        });
        let result = fetch_manifest(
            &api,
            "account-token",
            "ns",
            "catalog",
            "game/name",
            Platform::Mac,
            None,
            |_| None,
        )
        .await;
        assert!(matches!(result, Err(EpicError::Unauthorized)));
        let request = server.join().unwrap();
        assert!(request.starts_with("GET /launcher/api/public/assets/v2/platform/Mac/namespace/ns/catalogItem/catalog/app/game%2Fname/label/Live HTTP/1.1"));
        assert!(
            request
                .to_ascii_lowercase()
                .contains("authorization: bearer account-token\r\n")
        );
    }
}
```

`crates/storefronts/epic-kit/src/details/build_choice.rs`:

```rs
//! Epic's answers to the build choice: the game's live builds, and a Mac
//! build's manifest, read to find its launch executable.
use obelisk_core::{
    Platform,
    build_choice::{GameBuilds, Inspection, Offered},
    mac_build,
    transfer::CancelToken,
};

use super::{
    Asset, BuildKey, FetchedManifest, asset_manifest, build_key, live_builds, manifest_cache,
    reported, trace,
};
use crate::{EpicError, auth::Api, client::PLATFORM, content::ContentClient};

/// A game's live builds, as the launcher service names them for the account.
pub(crate) struct LiveBuilds<'a> {
    api: &'a Api,
    access_token: &'a str,
    namespace: &'a str,
    catalog_item_id: &'a str,
    app_name: &'a str,
}

impl<'a> LiveBuilds<'a> {
    pub(crate) fn new(
        api: &'a Api,
        access_token: &'a str,
        namespace: &'a str,
        catalog_item_id: &'a str,
        app_name: &'a str,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            api,
            access_token,
            namespace,
            catalog_item_id,
            app_name,
        }
    }
}

impl GameBuilds for LiveBuilds<'_> {
    type Build = Asset;
    type Key = BuildKey;
    type Kept = FetchedManifest;
    type Error = EpicError;

    async fn builds(&self) -> Result<Offered<Asset>, EpicError> {
        let (mac, windows) = live_builds(
            self.api,
            self.access_token,
            self.namespace,
            self.catalog_item_id,
            self.app_name,
        )
        .await?;
        Ok(Offered { mac, windows })
    }

    async fn key(&self, mac: &Asset) -> Result<Option<BuildKey>, EpicError> {
        let label = PLATFORM.name(Platform::Mac);
        Ok(build_key(
            [self.namespace, self.catalog_item_id, self.app_name, label],
            mac,
        ))
    }

    /// Whether the build's launch executable holds an arm64 slice: its
    /// manifest, then the first bytes of its program. A build Obelisk cannot
    /// install does not.
    async fn inspect(
        &self,
        mac: &Asset,
        cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> Result<Inspection<FetchedManifest>, EpicError> {
        let label = PLATFORM.name(Platform::Mac);
        let (namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name) =
            (self.namespace, self.catalog_item_id, self.app_name);
        let mut trace = trace(namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name, label);
        let inspection = async {
            let FetchedManifest {
                bytes,
                base_urls,
                deployment_id,
                network_bytes,
                ..
            } = asset_manifest(
                self.api,
                mac,
                namespace,
                catalog_item_id,
                app_name,
                label,
                None,
                &mut trace,
            )
            .await?;
            let validated =
                tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || (manifest_cache::validate(&bytes), bytes))
                    .await
                    .map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?;
            let (manifest, bytes) = match validated {
                (Ok(manifest), bytes) => (manifest, bytes),
                (Err(EpicError::UnsupportedContent), _) => return Ok(Inspection::NotNative),
                (Err(error), _) => return Err(error),
            };
            let mut listing = mac_build::Listing::default();
            for (index, file) in manifest.files.iter().enumerate() {
                listing.file(&file.filename, index, file.size());
            }
            let content = ContentClient::new(self.api.http.clone());
            let read = |index: usize, bytes: u64| {
                content.read(&manifest, &base_urls, &manifest.files[index], bytes, cancel)
            };
            let native =
                mac_build::runs_natively(&listing, &manifest.launch_executable, &[], read).await?;
            Ok(match native {
                true => Inspection::Native(FetchedManifest {
                    bytes,
                    base_urls,
                    deployment_id,
                    network_bytes,
                    manifest: Some(manifest),
                    cache_key: None,
                }),
                false => Inspection::NotNative,
            })
        }
        .await;
        reported(&mut trace, inspection)
    }
}
```
