`crates/storefronts/epic-kit/src/details/diagnostic.rs`:

```rs
//! What a failed manifest fetch received, written by debug builds only to
//! `~/Library/Logs/Obelisk/Epic` for diagnosis. It never holds an access
//! token or a signed URL: the asset response keeps its keys and value types,
//! and manifest URLs keep their host.
use serde::Serialize;
use serde_json::Value;

#[derive(Default, Serialize)]
pub(super) struct Trace {
    pub platform: String,
    pub namespace: String,
    pub catalog_item_id: String,
    pub app_name: String,
    /// The step that failed.
    pub step: &'static str,
    pub error: String,
    pub assets: Option<Value>,
    pub asset_hash: Option<String>,
    pub attempts: Vec<Attempt>,
    /// The last manifest downloaded, public CDN content, written beside.
    #[serde(skip)]
    pub manifest: Option<Vec<u8>>,
}

#[derive(Default, Serialize)]
pub(super) struct Attempt {
    pub host: String,
    pub step: &'static str,
    pub status: Option<u16>,
    pub bytes: Option<usize>,
    /// The app name the manifest itself carries, when it parses.
    pub manifest_app_name: Option<String>,
    pub parse_error: Option<String>,
    pub error: String,
}

/// Values that are identities or sizes, never credentials.
const KEPT: [&str; 7] = [
    "appName",
    "labelName",
    "buildVersion",
    "hash",
    "namespace",
    "catalogItemId",
    "name",
];

/// `value` with every string replaced by its length, except identities, and
/// every URL by its host.
pub(super) fn redact(value: &Value) -> Value {
    fn walk(key: Option<&str>, value: &Value) -> Value {
        match value {
            Value::Object(map) => Value::Object(
                map.iter()
                    .map(|(name, value)| (name.clone(), walk(Some(name), value)))
                    .collect(),
            ),
            Value::Array(items) => Value::Array(items.iter().map(|item| walk(key, item)).collect()),
            Value::String(text) if key == Some("uri") => {
                Value::String(format!("host {}", host(text)))
            }
            Value::String(text) if key.is_some_and(|key| KEPT.contains(&key)) => {
                Value::String(text.clone())
            }
            Value::String(text) => Value::String(format!("<{} characters>", text.len())),
            other => other.clone(),
        }
    }
    walk(None, value)
}

pub(super) fn host(uri: &str) -> String {
    reqwest::Url::parse(uri)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|url| url.host_str().map(str::to_owned))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "<unparsable>".into())
}

/// Where debug builds write diagnostics; none in release builds or tests,
/// which fail fetches on purpose and must not write into the home folder.
fn directory() -> Option<std::path::PathBuf> {
    if !cfg!(debug_assertions) || cfg!(test) {
        return None;
    }
    let directory =
        std::path::Path::new(&std::env::var_os("HOME")?).join("Library/Logs/Obelisk/Epic");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&directory).ok()?;
    Some(directory)
}

/// A chunk the content engine could not decode: its public bytes, its URL
/// without any query, and what the manifest expected of it.
pub(crate) fn write_chunk(
    url: &reqwest::Url,
    chunk: &crate::content_manifest::Chunk,
    bytes: &[u8],
    error: &crate::EpicError,
) {
    let Some(directory) = directory() else {
        return;
    };
    let name = format!(
        "chunk-{:08X}{:08X}{:08X}{:08X}",
        chunk.guid[0], chunk.guid[1], chunk.guid[2], chunk.guid[3]
    );
    let mut url = url.clone();
    url.set_query(None);
    let summary = serde_json::json!({
        "url": url.as_str(),
        "error": format!("{error:?}"),
        "received_bytes": bytes.len(),
        "expected_file_size": chunk.file_size,
        "window_size": chunk.window_size,
        "group": chunk.group,
        "header": bytes.iter().take(98).map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}")).collect::<String>(),
    });
    if let Ok(json) = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&summary) {
        let _ = std::fs::write(directory.join(format!("{name}.json")), json);
    }
    let _ = std::fs::write(directory.join(format!("{name}.chunk")), bytes);
}

/// Writes `trace` and its manifest in debug builds; release builds keep nothing.
pub(super) fn write(trace: &Trace) {
    let Some(directory) = directory() else {
        return;
    };
    let name = format!("manifest-{}-{}", trace.app_name, trace.platform);
    if let Ok(json) = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(trace) {
        let _ = std::fs::write(directory.join(format!("{name}.json")), json);
    }
    if let Some(manifest) = &trace.manifest {
        let _ = std::fs::write(directory.join(format!("{name}.manifest")), manifest);
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn a_redacted_asset_response_keeps_identities_and_hosts_but_no_signature() {
        let response = serde_json::json!({"elements": [{
            "appName": "Game",
            "labelName": "Live-Windows",
            "hash": "0123",
            "manifests": [{
                "uri": "https://download.epicgames.com/Builds/Org/secret/path.manifest",
                "queryParams": [{"name": "f_token", "value": "signed-secret"}]
            }]
        }]});
        let redacted = redact(&response);
        let element = &redacted["elements"][0];
        assert_eq!(element["appName"], "Game");
        assert_eq!(element["labelName"], "Live-Windows");
        let manifest = &element["manifests"][0];
        assert_eq!(manifest["uri"], "host download.epicgames.com");
        assert_eq!(manifest["queryParams"][0]["name"], "f_token");
        assert_eq!(manifest["queryParams"][0]["value"], "<13 characters>");
        let text = redacted.to_string();
        assert!(!text.contains("signed-secret") && !text.contains("secret/path"));
    }
}
```

`crates/storefronts/epic-kit/src/details/manifest_cache.rs`:

```rs
//! Raw manifests keyed by the current asset's immutable hash and full identity.
//! Account rights and CDN metadata are always fetched before consulting this cache.
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use obelisk_core::install::{self, PARTIAL_DIRECTORY, hex, unhex};
use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};

use crate::{
    EpicError,
    client::validate_identity,
    content::validate_manifest,
    content_manifest::{self, Manifest},
    manifest::MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES,
};

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct ManifestCacheKey {
    identity: String,
    hash: String,
}

impl ManifestCacheKey {
    pub(super) fn new(
        namespace: &str,
        catalog_item_id: &str,
        app_name: &str,
        platform: &str,
        hash: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Option<Self> {
        let hash = hash?;
        if validate_identity(namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name).is_err()
            || unhex::<20>(hash).is_none()
        {
            return None;
        }
        let identity = serde_json::to_vec(&(namespace, catalog_item_id, app_name, platform))
            .expect("strings serialize");
        Some(Self {
            identity: hex(&Sha1::digest(identity)),
            hash: hash.to_ascii_lowercase(),
        })
    }

    fn relative_path(&self) -> PathBuf {
        PathBuf::from(PARTIAL_DIRECTORY)
            .join("manifests")
            .join(&self.identity)
            .join(format!("{}.manifest", self.hash))
    }
}

pub(super) struct CachedManifest {
    pub bytes: Vec<u8>,
    pub manifest: Manifest,
}

pub(super) fn load(
    destination: &Path,
    key: &ManifestCacheKey,
) -> Result<Option<CachedManifest>, EpicError> {
    let Some(bytes) =
        install::read_cached_file(destination, &key.relative_path(), MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES)?
    else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let validated = (|| {
        super::checked_hash(&bytes, Some(&key.hash))?;
        validate(&bytes)
    })();
    match validated {
        Ok(manifest) => Ok(Some(CachedManifest { bytes, manifest })),
        // A corrupt cache or an obsolete format is only a miss. Filesystem
        // redirections were rejected above, before reading any cache bytes.
        Err(EpicError::Protocol | EpicError::UnsupportedContent | EpicError::UnsafePath(_)) => {
            Ok(None)
        }
        Err(error) => Err(error),
    }
}

/// The manifest's own app name is not compared with the catalog's: some builds
/// carry an internal one (Rocket League's `Sugar` names itself by a hex id).
/// The SHA-1 from the asset response already binds these bytes to the asset.
pub(super) fn validate(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Manifest, EpicError> {
    let manifest = content_manifest::parse(bytes)?;
    validate_manifest(&manifest)?;
    Ok(manifest)
}

/// The caller holds the installation lock and has validated these exact bytes.
/// Persist only the original body; URLs, authentication and sidecars stay in memory.
pub(crate) fn store(
    destination: &Path,
    key: &ManifestCacheKey,
    bytes: &[u8],
) -> Result<(), EpicError> {
    if bytes.len() > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    Ok(install::write_cached_file(
        destination,
        &key.relative_path(),
        bytes,
    )?)
}

#[cfg(test)]
pub(super) mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::fs::{self, File};

    pub(in crate::details) fn fixture(app: &str, filename: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
        serde_json::to_vec(&serde_json::json!({
            "ManifestFileVersion": "012000000000",
            "bIsFileData": false,
            "AppNameString": app,
            "BuildVersionString": "1.0",
            "LaunchExeString": filename,
            "LaunchCommand": "",
            "FileManifestList": [{
                "Filename": filename,
                "FileHash": Sha1::digest([]).iter().map(|byte| format!("{byte:03}")).collect::<String>(),
                "FileChunkParts": [],
            }],
            "ChunkHashList": {},
            "ChunkShaList": {},
            "DataGroupList": {},
            "ChunkFilesizeList": {},
        }))
        .unwrap()
    }

    fn key(bytes: &[u8]) -> ManifestCacheKey {
        ManifestCacheKey::new(
            "ns",
            "catalog",
            "game",
            "Mac",
            Some(
                &Sha1::digest(bytes)
                    .iter()
                    .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
                    .collect::<String>(),
            ),
        )
        .unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn caches_raw_bytes_and_preserves_validated_snapshot() {
        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let bytes = fixture("game", "game.exe");
        let key = key(&bytes);
        store(directory.path(), &key, &bytes).unwrap();
        let snapshot = load(directory.path(), &key).unwrap().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(snapshot.bytes, bytes);
        assert_eq!(snapshot.manifest.files[0].filename, "game.exe");
        let path = directory.path().join(key.relative_path());
        assert_eq!(fs::read(&path).unwrap(), bytes);
        fs::write(path, b"corrupted after load").unwrap();
        assert!(load(directory.path(), &key).unwrap().is_none());
        assert_eq!(snapshot.manifest.app_name, "game");
    }

    #[test]
    fn cache_keys_require_full_identity_and_valid_current_hash() {
        let bytes = fixture("game", "game.exe");
        let hash = Sha1::digest(&bytes)
            .iter()
            .map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}"))
            .collect::<String>();
        let original = key(&bytes).relative_path();
        for (namespace, catalog, app, platform, hash) in [
            ("other", "catalog", "game", "Mac", hash.as_str()),
            ("ns", "other", "game", "Mac", hash.as_str()),
            ("ns", "catalog", "other", "Mac", hash.as_str()),
            ("ns", "catalog", "game", "Windows", hash.as_str()),
            (
                "ns",
                "catalog",
                "game",
                "Mac",
                "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
            ),
        ] {
            assert_ne!(
                ManifestCacheKey::new(namespace, catalog, app, platform, Some(hash))
                    .unwrap()
                    .relative_path(),
                original
            );
        }
        assert!(ManifestCacheKey::new("ns", "catalog", "game", "Mac", None).is_none());
        assert!(ManifestCacheKey::new("ns", "catalog", "game", "Mac", Some("bad")).is_none());
        assert!(ManifestCacheKey::new("", "catalog", "game", "Mac", Some(&hash)).is_none());
        assert!(ManifestCacheKey::new("ns", "catalog", "\0", "Mac", Some(&hash)).is_none());
        assert_eq!(
            ManifestCacheKey::new("ns", "catalog", "game", "Mac", Some(&hash.to_uppercase()))
                .unwrap()
                .relative_path(),
            original
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_manifest_naming_another_app_is_a_hit() {
        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let bytes = fixture("fd52e5b57c6d4468bfd6b39b5577436d", "game.exe");
        let key = key(&bytes);
        store(directory.path(), &key, &bytes).unwrap();
        assert!(load(directory.path(), &key).unwrap().is_some());
    }

    #[test]
    fn corrupt_oversized_and_unsafe_manifests_are_misses() {
        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        for bytes in [b"invalid".to_vec(), fixture("game", "../escape")] {
            let key = key(&bytes);
            store(directory.path(), &key, &bytes).unwrap();
            assert!(load(directory.path(), &key).unwrap().is_none());
        }
        let bytes = fixture("game", "game.exe");
        let key = key(&bytes);
        store(directory.path(), &key, &bytes).unwrap();
        let path = directory.path().join(key.relative_path());
        fs::write(&path, &bytes[..bytes.len() / 2]).unwrap();
        assert!(load(directory.path(), &key).unwrap().is_none());
        File::options()
            .write(true)
            .open(path)
            .unwrap()
            .set_len(MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES as u64 + 1)
            .unwrap();
        assert!(load(directory.path(), &key).unwrap().is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn cache_miss_does_not_create_installation() {
        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let absent = directory.path().join("absent");
        assert!(
            load(&absent, &key(&fixture("game", "game.exe")))
                .unwrap()
                .is_none()
        );
        assert!(!absent.exists());
    }

    #[cfg(unix)]
    #[test]
    fn cache_parent_symlinks_and_file_links_are_rejected() {
        let bytes = fixture("game", "game.exe");
        let key = key(&bytes);
        for parent in [true, false] {
            for symlink in [true, false] {
                if parent && !symlink {
                    continue;
                }
                let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
                let outside = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
                let external_file = outside.path().join("outside");
                fs::write(&external_file, &bytes).unwrap();
                if parent {
                    std::os::unix::fs::symlink(
                        outside.path(),
                        directory.path().join(".obelisk-content"),
                    )
                    .unwrap();
                } else {
                    let relative = key.relative_path();
                    fs::create_dir_all(directory.path().join(relative.parent().unwrap())).unwrap();
                    let cache_path = directory.path().join(relative);
                    if symlink {
                        std::os::unix::fs::symlink(&external_file, cache_path).unwrap();
                    } else {
                        fs::hard_link(&external_file, cache_path).unwrap();
                    }
                }
                assert!(matches!(
                    load(directory.path(), &key),
                    Err(EpicError::UnsafePath(_))
                ));
                assert!(matches!(
                    store(directory.path(), &key, &bytes),
                    Err(EpicError::UnsafePath(_))
                ));
                assert_eq!(fs::read(&external_file).unwrap(), bytes);
                assert_eq!(fs::read_dir(outside.path()).unwrap().count(), 1);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Launcher relations and presence. Lists replace membership; presence never creates it.
use crate::EpicError;
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::Value;
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

pub(crate) const MAX_FRIENDS: usize = 10_000;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Presence {
    #[default]
    Unknown,
    Offline,
    Online,
    Away,
    Busy,
    ExtendedAway,
    Invisible,
}
impl Presence {
    fn parse(value: &Value) -> Self {
        match value.as_str() {
            Some("online" | "available" | "chat") => Self::Online,
            Some("offline" | "unavailable") => Self::Offline,
            Some("away") => Self::Away,
            Some("xa") => Self::ExtendedAway,
            Some("dnd" | "busy") => Self::Busy,
            Some("invisible" | "hidden") => Self::Invisible,
            _ => Self::Unknown,
        }
    }
    fn visible(self) -> bool {
        matches!(
            self,
            Self::Online | Self::Away | Self::Busy | Self::ExtendedAway
        )
    }
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Activity {
    pub id: String,
    pub name: Option<String>,
}
impl Activity {
    /// Epic's payload bounds for an activity this account may publish.
    pub(crate) const ID_MAX: usize = 1024;
    pub(crate) const NAME_MAX: usize = 4096;
    pub(crate) fn publishable(&self) -> bool {
        publishable_text(&self.id, Self::ID_MAX)
            && self
                .name
                .as_deref()
                .is_none_or(|name| publishable_text(name, Self::NAME_MAX))
    }
}
/// Shared by the launch catalog reader and the presence API guard, so a bound
/// can never be tightened on one side only.
pub(crate) fn publishable_text(value: &str, max: usize) -> bool {
    !value.trim().is_empty() && value.len() <= max && !value.chars().any(char::is_control)
}

        Self {
            account_id,
            ..Self::default()
        }
    }
    pub(crate) fn friends(&self) -> Vec<Friend> {
        self.entries.values().cloned().collect()
    }
    pub(crate) fn apply_profile_names(&mut self, names: &BTreeMap<String, Option<String>>) {
        for (id, friend) in &mut self.entries {
            if friend.display_name.is_none() {
                friend.display_name = names.get(id).cloned().flatten();
            }
        }
    }
    pub(crate) fn retain_tombstones(&mut self, previous: &Self) {
        self.tombstones = previous.tombstones.clone();
        self.entries.retain(|id, _| !self.tombstones.contains(id));
    }

    pub(crate) fn retain_live_presence(&mut self, previous: &Self) {
        // Membership reads contain no presence. Preserve events observed on this
        // same connection for retained friends, never their old metadata.
        for (id, friend) in &mut self.entries {
            if let Some(old) = previous.entries.get(id) {
                friend.presence = old.presence;
                friend.activity = old.activity.clone();
            }
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn replace_summary(&mut self, value: Value) -> Result<(), EpicError> {
        // This endpoint is a complete summary, with no pagination in either reference.
        // Reject a future paginated schema instead of silently presenting a truncated list.
        if value
            .get("nextCursor")
            .is_some_and(|v| !v.is_null() && v != "")
            || value
                .pointer("/responseMetadata/nextCursor")
                .is_some_and(|v| !v.is_null() && v != "")
        {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
        let summary: Summary = serde_json::from_value(value).map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?;
        if summary.friends.len() > MAX_FRIENDS || summary.blocklist.len() > MAX_FRIENDS {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
        let blocked: BTreeSet<_> = summary
            .blocklist
            .into_iter()
            .map(|v| v.account_id)
            .collect();
        let mut entries: BTreeMap<String, Friend> = BTreeMap::new();
        for relation in summary.friends {
            if !valid_id(&relation.account_id) {
                return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
            }
            if relation.account_id == self.account_id || blocked.contains(&relation.account_id) {
                continue;
            }
            let name = relation
                .display_name
                .filter(|v| !v.trim().is_empty() && v.len() <= 4096);
            let avatar = relation
                .connections
                .into_values()
                .filter_map(|v| v.avatar.and_then(crate::auth::safe_https_url))
                .next();
            if let Some(existing) = entries.get_mut(&relation.account_id) {
                if existing.display_name.is_none() {
                    existing.display_name = name;
                }
                if existing.avatar_url.is_none() {
                    existing.avatar_url = avatar;
                }
            } else {
                entries.insert(
                    relation.account_id.clone(),
                    Friend {
                        account_id: relation.account_id,
                        display_name: name,
                        avatar_url: avatar,
                        presence: Presence::Unknown,
                        activity: None,
                    },
                );
            }
        }
        self.entries = entries;
        Ok(())
    }
    pub(crate) fn presence(&mut self, value: Value) -> Result<(), EpicError> {
        let id = value
            .get("accountId")
            .and_then(Value::as_str)
            .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
        let Some(friend) = self.entries.get_mut(id) else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        if let Some(status) = value.get("status") {
            friend.presence = Presence::parse(status);
        }
        if !friend.presence.visible() {
            friend.activity = None;
            return Ok(());
        }
        if let Some(namespaces) = value.get("perNs") {
            friend.activity = activity(namespaces)?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    /// Returns whether relationship metadata needs an event-triggered refresh.
    pub(crate) fn event(&mut self, event: &Value) -> Result<bool, EpicError> {
        let kind = event
            .get("type")
            .and_then(Value::as_str)
            .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
        let payload = event.get("payload").unwrap_or(&Value::Null);
        if kind == "presence.v1.UPDATE" {
            self.presence(payload.clone())?;
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if !kind.starts_with("friends.v1.") {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        // The current official social component renamed the older EGL3 events.
        // Normalize only their relationship meaning; presence never grants friendship.
        let kind = match kind {
            "friends.v1.FRIENDSHIP_REQUEST" => match payload["status"].as_str() {
                Some("ACCEPTED") => "friends.v1.FRIEND_ENTRY_ADDED",
                Some("PENDING") => "friends.v1.FRIEND_INVITE_ENTRY_ADDED",
                _ => return Ok(false),
            },
            "friends.v1.FRIENDSHIP_REMOVE" if payload["reason"] == "DELETED" => {
                "friends.v1.FRIEND_ENTRY_REMOVED"
            }
            "friends.v1.FRIENDSHIP_REMOVE" => "friends.v1.FRIEND_INVITE_ENTRY_REMOVED",
            "friends.v1.FRIENDSHIP_ENTRY_UPDATE" => "friends.v1.FRIEND_ENTRY_UPDATED",
            "friends.v1.USER_BLOCKLIST_UPDATE" if payload["status"] == "BLOCKED" => {
                "friends.v1.BLOCK_LIST_ENTRY_ADDED"
            }
            "friends.v1.USER_BLOCKLIST_UPDATE" => "friends.v1.BLOCK_LIST_ENTRY_REMOVED",
            _ => kind,
        };
        let from = payload.get("from").and_then(Value::as_str);
        let to = payload.get("to").and_then(Value::as_str);
        let id = if from == Some(&self.account_id) {
            to
        } else if to == Some(&self.account_id) {
            from
        } else {
            payload
                .get("friendId")
                .or_else(|| payload.get("accountId"))
                .and_then(Value::as_str)
        };
        match kind {
            "friends.v1.FRIEND_ENTRY_REMOVED" | "friends.v1.BLOCK_LIST_ENTRY_ADDED" => {
                if let Some(id) = id.filter(|id| valid_id(id)) {
                    if self.tombstones.len() >= MAX_FRIENDS {
                        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
                    }
                    self.tombstones.insert(id.to_owned());
                    self.entries.remove(id);
                } else {
                    return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
                }
                Ok(true)
            }
            "friends.v1.FRIEND_ENTRY_ADDED" => {
                let id = id.filter(|id| valid_id(id)).ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
                self.tombstones.remove(id);
                if id != self.account_id && !self.entries.contains_key(id) {
                    if self.entries.len() >= MAX_FRIENDS {
                        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
                    }
                    self.entries.insert(
                        id.into(),
                        Friend {
                            account_id: id.into(),
                            display_name: None,
                            avatar_url: None,
                            presence: Presence::Unknown,
                            activity: None,
                        },
                    );
                }
                Ok(true)
            }
            "friends.v1.FRIEND_ENTRY_UPDATED"
            | "friends.v1.FRIEND_INVITE_ENTRY_ADDED"
            | "friends.v1.FRIEND_INVITE_ENTRY_REMOVED"
            | "friends.v1.BLOCK_LIST_ENTRY_REMOVED" => Ok(true),
            _ => Ok(false),
        }
    }
}

fn activity(value: &Value) -> Result<Option<Activity>, EpicError> {
    if value.is_null() {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let namespaces = value.as_array().ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
    if namespaces.len() > 128 {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    let mut candidates = BTreeMap::new();
    for ns in namespaces {
        let namespace = ns
            .get("ns")
            .and_then(Value::as_str)
            .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
        if !Presence::parse(&ns["status"]).visible() {
            continue;
        }
        let connections = ns
            .get("conns")
            .and_then(Value::as_array)
            .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
        if connections.len() > 128 {
            return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
        }
        if connections.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        for conn in connections {
            let running = conn.get("runningApp");
            let id = running
                .and_then(|v| text(&v["id"]))
                .or_else(|| text(&conn["props"]["running_app_id"]));
            if let Some(id) = id {
                let name = running
                    .and_then(|v| text(&v["displayName"]))
                    .or_else(|| text(&conn["props"]["running_app_name"]));
                candidates.insert(
                    (name.is_none(), namespace.to_owned(), id.clone()),
                    Activity { id, name },
                );
            }
        }
        if !matches!(namespace, "_" | "launcher" | "EGL3") {
            let id = text(&ns["productId"])
                .or_else(|| text(&ns["appId"]))
                .unwrap_or_else(|| namespace.into());
            let name = text(&ns["props"]["EOS_ProductName"])
                .or_else(|| text(&ns["props"]["X_NonEOS_ProductName"]));
            candidates.insert(
                (name.is_none(), namespace.to_owned(), id.clone()),
                Activity { id, name },
            );
        }
    }
    Ok(candidates.into_values().next())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::json;

    #[test]
    fn snapshot_filters_relations_and_presence_cannot_create_a_friend() {
        let mut state = Roster::new("owner".into());
        state.replace_summary(json!({"friends":[{"accountId":"a","displayName":"Alice"},{"accountId":"a"},{"accountId":"owner"},{"accountId":"blocked"}],"blocklist":[{"accountId":"blocked"}],"incoming":[{"accountId":"pending"}]})).unwrap();
        state
            .presence(json!({"accountId":"pending","status":"online","perNs":[]}))
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(state.friends().len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(state.friends()[0].presence, Presence::Unknown);
        state
            .replace_summary(json!({"friends":[],"blocklist":[]}))
            .unwrap();
        assert!(state.friends().is_empty());
    }
    fn roster() -> Roster {
        let mut r = Roster::new("owner".into());
        r.replace_summary(json!({"friends":[{"accountId":"a","displayName":"Alice"}]}))
            .unwrap();
        r
    }
    fn game(name: &str) -> Value {
        json!({"ns":"_","status":"online","conns":[{"id":"one","runningApp":{"id":name,"displayName":name}},{"id":"two","props":{}}]})
    }
    #[test]
    fn games_change_clear_and_do_not_return_from_stale_hidden_state() {
        let mut r = roster();
        for name in ["Game A", "Game B"] {
            r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","status":"away","perNs":[game(name)]}))
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                r.friends()[0].activity.as_ref().unwrap().name.as_deref(),
                Some(name)
            );
            assert_eq!(r.friends()[0].presence, Presence::Away);
        }
        r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","perNs":[{"ns":"_","status":"online","conns":[{"id":"two","props":{}}]}]})).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.friends()[0].presence, Presence::Away);
        assert!(r.friends()[0].activity.is_none());
        r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","perNs":[game("Again")]}))
            .unwrap();
        r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","status":"hidden"}))
            .unwrap();
        assert!(r.friends()[0].activity.is_none());
        r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","status":"online"}))
            .unwrap();
        assert!(r.friends()[0].activity.is_none());
        r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","perNs":[game("Fresh")]}))
            .unwrap();
        r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","status":"offline","perNs":[game("Stale")]}))
            .unwrap();
        assert!(r.friends()[0].activity.is_none());
    }
    #[test]
    fn missing_null_and_unknown_fields_have_distinct_effects() {
        let mut r = roster();
        r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","status":"online","perNs":[game("A")]}))
            .unwrap();
        r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a"})).unwrap();
        assert!(r.friends()[0].activity.is_some());
        r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","perNs":null})).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.friends()[0].presence, Presence::Online);
        assert!(r.friends()[0].activity.is_none());
        r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","status":"new-server-status","perNs":[game("Hidden")]}))
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.friends()[0].presence, Presence::Unknown);
        assert!(r.friends()[0].activity.is_none());
        r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","status":null})).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.friends()[0].presence, Presence::Unknown);
    }
    #[test]
    fn namespaces_are_replaced_and_aggregated_independent_of_array_order() {
        let mut r = roster();
        let known = json!({"ns":"eos-game","productId":"product","status":"xa","conns":[{"id":"1"},{"id":"2"}],"props":{"EOS_ProductName":"Known game"}});
        let unknown = json!({"ns":"unknown-product","status":"online","conns":[{"id":"3"}]});
        r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","status":"xa","perNs":[unknown,known]}))
            .unwrap();
        let expected = r.friends()[0].clone();
        assert_eq!(
            expected.activity.as_ref().unwrap().name.as_deref(),
            Some("Known game")
        );
        r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","status":"xa","perNs":[known,unknown]}))
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.friends()[0], expected);
        r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","perNs":[unknown]}))
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.friends()[0].activity.as_ref().unwrap().name, None);
        r.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","perNs":[]})).unwrap();
        assert!(r.friends()[0].activity.is_none());
    }
    #[test]
    fn removals_and_blocks_survive_later_metadata_snapshots_until_explicit_acceptance() {
        let mut previous = roster();
        previous.event(&json!({"type":"friends.v1.FRIEND_ENTRY_REMOVED","payload":{"from":"a","to":"owner"}})).unwrap();
        let mut late = roster();
        late.retain_tombstones(&previous);
        late.presence(json!({"accountId":"a","status":"online","perNs":[game("Old")]}))
            .unwrap();
        assert!(late.friends().is_empty());
        late.event(
            &json!({"type":"friends.v1.FRIEND_ENTRY_ADDED","payload":{"from":"owner","to":"a"}}),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(late.friends()[0].presence, Presence::Unknown);
        assert_eq!(late.friends()[0].display_name, None);
        late.event(
            &json!({"type":"friends.v1.BLOCK_LIST_ENTRY_ADDED","payload":{"accountId":"a"}}),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(late.friends().is_empty());
        late.event(&json!({"type":"friends.v1.FRIEND_INVITE_ENTRY_ADDED","payload":{"from":"owner","to":"pending"}})).unwrap();
        assert!(late.friends().is_empty());
    }
    #[test]
    fn current_launcher_relationship_events_preserve_acceptance_and_removal_boundaries() {
        let mut r = roster();
        assert!(r.event(&json!({"type":"friends.v1.FRIENDSHIP_REQUEST","payload":{"from":"owner","to":"b","status":"PENDING"}})).unwrap());
        assert_eq!(r.friends().len(), 1);
        assert!(r.event(&json!({"type":"friends.v1.FRIENDSHIP_REQUEST","payload":{"from":"owner","to":"b","status":"ACCEPTED"}})).unwrap());
        assert_eq!(r.friends().len(), 2);
        assert!(
            r.event(
                &json!({"type":"friends.v1.FRIENDSHIP_ENTRY_UPDATE","payload":{"friendId":"b"}})
            )
            .unwrap()
        );
        assert!(r.event(&json!({"type":"friends.v1.FRIENDSHIP_REMOVE","payload":{"from":"owner","to":"b","reason":"DELETED"}})).unwrap());
        r.event(
            &json!({"type":"presence.v1.UPDATE","payload":{"accountId":"b","status":"online"}}),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.friends().len(), 1);
        assert!(r.event(&json!({"type":"friends.v1.USER_BLOCKLIST_UPDATE","payload":{"accountId":"a","status":"BLOCKED"}})).unwrap());
        assert!(r.friends().is_empty());
        assert!(r.event(&json!({"type":"friends.v1.USER_BLOCKLIST_UPDATE","payload":{"accountId":"a","status":"UNBLOCKED"}})).unwrap());
        assert!(r.friends().is_empty());
        let mut stale = roster();
        stale.retain_tombstones(&r);
        assert!(stale.friends().is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn incomplete_summaries_are_rejected_and_unreported_presence_stays_unknown() {
        let mut r = roster();

        assert!(

                .is_err()
        );
        assert!(
            r.replace_summary(json!({"friends":[{"accountId":""}]}))
                .is_err()
        );
    }
    #[test]
    fn metadata_uses_only_returned_safe_avatars_and_explicit_snapshot_names() {
        let mut r = roster();
        r.replace_summary(json!({"friends":[{"accountId":"a","displayName":null,"connections":{"steam":{"avatar":"http://unsafe/image"}}}]})).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.friends()[0].display_name, None);
        assert_eq!(r.friends()[0].avatar_url, None);
        r.replace_summary(json!({"friends":[{"accountId":"a","connections":{"steam":{"avatar":"https://example.invalid/returned.png"}}}]})).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            r.friends()[0].avatar_url.as_deref(),
            Some("https://example.invalid/returned.png")
        );
    }
```

```rs
use obelisk_core::{
    build_choice::{NOT_NATIVE, Unavailable},
    install::InstallError,
    storefront::{StorefrontCapabilities, StorefrontDescriptor, StorefrontId},
    transfer::Cancelled,
};

impl From<Cancelled> for EpicError {
    fn from(_: Cancelled) -> Self {
        Self::Cancelled
    }
}

impl From<Unavailable> for EpicError {
    fn from(unavailable: Unavailable) -> Self {
        match unavailable {
            Unavailable::NoBuild => Self::Protocol,
            Unavailable::NotNative => Self::Service {
                message: NOT_NATIVE.into(),
            },
        }
    }
}

impl From<InstallError> for EpicError {
    fn from(error: InstallError) -> Self {
        match error {
            InstallError::Cancelled => Self::Cancelled,
            InstallError::UnsafePath(path) => Self::UnsafePath(path),
            InstallError::Io(error) => Self::Io(error),
        }
    }
}

        capabilities: StorefrontCapabilities {
            authentication: true,
            owned_library: true,
            downloads: true,
            local_import: false,
        },
    }
}
```

`crates/storefronts/epic-kit/src/manifest.rs`:

```rs
//! Read only the installed file size from Epic BuildPatch manifests, tolerating
//! encrypted metadata sections that the full parser must reject.
// Format reference: Legendary's models/manifest.py and models/json_manifest.py.
use crate::{
    EpicError,
    content_manifest::{self, Reader, blob_number},
};
use serde::Deserialize;

pub(crate) const MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024 * 1024;

pub(crate) fn installation_size(data: &[u8]) -> Result<u64, EpicError> {
    if data.len() > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    if data.iter().find(|byte| !byte.is_ascii_whitespace()) != Some(&b'{') {
        return binary_size(data);
    }
    let manifest: JsonManifest = serde_json::from_slice(data).map_err(|_| EpicError::Protocol)?;
    manifest.files.iter().try_fold(0_u64, |total, file| {
        file.parts.iter().try_fold(total, |total, part| {
            total
                .checked_add(blob_number(&part.size)?)
                .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)
        })
    })
}

fn binary_size(data: &[u8]) -> Result<u64, EpicError> {
    let (header, _) = content_manifest::binary_header(data)?;
    let version = header.version;
    let flags = header.flags;
    let body = content_manifest::binary_body(data, &header)?;
    let mut body = Reader(&body);
    body.section(5)?; // Metadata; its section length handles versioned fields.
    body.section(9)?; // Chunk download sizes are not installed file sizes.
    let mut files = body.section(9)?;
    let file_version = files.byte()?;
    if file_version > 2 {
        return Err(EpicError::Protocol);
    }
    let count = files.count(37)?;
    for _ in 0..count {
        files.string()?;
    }
    for _ in 0..count {
        files.string()?;
    }
    files.take(count.checked_mul(21).ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?)?; // hashes and flags
    for _ in 0..count {
        for _ in 0..files.count(4)? {
            files.string()?;
        }
    }
    let mut size = 0_u64;
    for _ in 0..count {
        for _ in 0..files.count(28)? {
            let mut part = files.section(28)?;
            part.take(20)?; // GUID and offset within the source chunk.
            size = size
                .checked_add(u64::from(part.u32()?))
                .ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?;
        }
    }
    if file_version >= 1 {
        for _ in 0..count {
            if files.u32()? != 0 {
                files.take(16)?;
            }
        }
        for _ in 0..count {
            files.string()?;
        }
    }
    if file_version >= 2 {
        files.take(count.checked_mul(32).ok_or(EpicError::Protocol)?)?;
    }
    files.finish()?;
    body.section(9)?; // Custom fields are irrelevant to installation size.
    if version >= 22 && (!body.0.is_empty() || flags & 2 != 0) {
        // Encryption hides names and launch metadata, not the file-part sizes.
        // Reading those sizes does not require decrypting this opaque section.
        body.section(5)?;
    }
    body.finish()?;
    Ok(size)
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct JsonManifest {
    #[serde(rename = "FileManifestList")]
    files: Vec<JsonFile>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct JsonFile {
    #[serde(rename = "FileChunkParts")]
    parts: Vec<JsonPart>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct JsonPart {
    #[serde(rename = "Size")]
    size: String,
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};
    use std::io::Write;

    #[test]
    fn json_manifest_sums_uncompressed_parts_including_optional_files() {
        let data = br#"{
            "FileManifestList": [
                {"Filename":"game.exe", "FileChunkParts":[{"Size":"000016000000"},{"Size":"001000000000"}]},
                {"Filename":"optional.pak", "InstallTags":["optional"], "FileChunkParts":[{"Size":"002008000000"}]}
            ],
            "ChunkFilesizeList":{"compressed":"001000000000"}
        }"#;
        assert_eq!(installation_size(data).unwrap(), 6147);
    }

    fn section(version: u8, data: Vec<u8>) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut bytes = ((data.len() + 5) as u32).to_le_bytes().to_vec();
        bytes.push(version);
        bytes.extend(data);
        bytes
    }

    fn string(value: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut bytes = ((value.len() + 1) as i32).to_le_bytes().to_vec();
        bytes.extend(value.as_bytes());
        bytes.push(0);
        bytes
    }

    fn binary_body(file_version: u8) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut metadata = 18_u32.to_le_bytes().to_vec();
        metadata.extend([0; 5]); // file-data flag and app ID
        for value in ["app", "1.0", "game.exe", ""] {
            metadata.extend(string(value));
        }
        metadata.extend(0_u32.to_le_bytes()); // no prerequisites
        for _ in 0..3 {
            metadata.extend(string(""));
        }
        let mut body = section(0, metadata);
        body.extend(section(0, 0_u32.to_le_bytes().to_vec())); // no chunk metadata needed
        let mut files = 2_u32.to_le_bytes().to_vec();
        files.extend(string("game.exe"));
        files.extend((-2_i32).to_le_bytes());
        files.extend([0xe9, 0, 0, 0]); // UTF-16 filename
        for _ in 0..2 {
            files.extend(string(""));
        }
        files.extend([0; 40]); // file hashes
        files.extend([0; 2]); // file flags
        files.extend(0_u32.to_le_bytes());
        files.extend(1_u32.to_le_bytes());
        files.extend(string("optional"));
        for sizes in [&[4096_u32, 1][..], &[2050_u32][..]] {
            files.extend((sizes.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
            for size in sizes {
                files.extend(28_u32.to_le_bytes());
                files.extend([0; 20]); // GUID + chunk offset
                files.extend(size.to_le_bytes());
            }
        }
        if file_version >= 1 {
            files.extend(1_u32.to_le_bytes());
            files.extend([0; 16]);
            files.extend(0_u32.to_le_bytes());
            files.extend(string("application/octet-stream"));
            files.extend(string(""));
        }
        if file_version >= 2 {
            files.extend([0; 64]);
        }
        body.extend(section(file_version, files));
        body.extend(section(0, 0_u32.to_le_bytes().to_vec())); // custom fields
        body
    }

    fn binary_manifest(body: &[u8], compressed: bool) -> Vec<u8> {
        let payload = if compressed {
            let mut encoder =
                flate2::write::ZlibEncoder::new(Vec::new(), flate2::Compression::default());
            encoder.write_all(body).unwrap();
            encoder.finish().unwrap()
        } else {
            body.to_vec()
        };
        let mut manifest = 0x44be_c00c_u32.to_le_bytes().to_vec();
        manifest.extend(41_u32.to_le_bytes());
        manifest.extend((body.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
        manifest.extend((payload.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
        manifest.extend(Sha1::digest(body));
        manifest.push(u8::from(compressed));
        manifest.extend(18_u32.to_le_bytes());
        manifest.extend(payload);
        manifest
    }

    #[test]
    fn binary_manifests_sum_file_parts_for_raw_zlib_and_extended_file_records() {
        for version in 0..=2 {
            for compressed in [false, true] {
                let data = binary_manifest(&binary_body(version), compressed);
                assert_eq!(installation_size(&data).unwrap(), 6147);
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn encrypted_metadata_does_not_hide_file_sizes_in_modern_manifests() {
        for compressed in [false, true] {
            let mut body = binary_body(2);
            body.extend(section(0, vec![1, 2, 3])); // opaque encrypted names and launch metadata
            let mut manifest = binary_manifest(&body, compressed);
            manifest[4..8].copy_from_slice(&73_u32.to_le_bytes());
            manifest[36] |= 2;
            manifest[37..41].copy_from_slice(&24_u32.to_le_bytes());
            manifest.splice(41..41, [0; 32]); // secret GUID and encryption tag
            assert_eq!(installation_size(&manifest).unwrap(), 6147);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn malformed_and_truncated_manifests_never_return_a_partial_size() {
        for compressed in [false, true] {
            let valid = binary_manifest(&binary_body(2), compressed);
            for end in 0..valid.len() {
                assert!(installation_size(&valid[..end]).is_err(), "prefix {end}");
            }
            let mut corrupt_hash = valid.clone();
            corrupt_hash[16] ^= 1;
            assert!(installation_size(&corrupt_hash).is_err());
            let mut huge_body = valid.clone();
            huge_body[8..12].copy_from_slice(&u32::MAX.to_le_bytes());
            assert!(installation_size(&huge_body).is_err());
            let mut extra_body = binary_body(2);
            extra_body.push(0);
            assert!(installation_size(&binary_manifest(&extra_body, compressed)).is_err());
            let mut malformed_string = binary_body(0);
            let file_start =
                u32::from_le_bytes(malformed_string[..4].try_into().unwrap()) as usize + 9;
            malformed_string[file_start + 9..file_start + 13]
                .copy_from_slice(&i32::MIN.to_le_bytes());
            assert!(installation_size(&binary_manifest(&malformed_string, compressed)).is_err());
            let mut excessive_count = binary_body(0);
            excessive_count[file_start + 5..file_start + 9]
                .copy_from_slice(&u32::MAX.to_le_bytes());
            assert!(installation_size(&binary_manifest(&excessive_count, compressed)).is_err());
        }
        for size in [
            "",
            "256",
            "-01",
            "abc",
            "0000",
            "255255255255255255255255000",
        ] {
            let json = serde_json::json!({"FileManifestList":[{"FileChunkParts":[{"Size":size}]}]});
            assert!(installation_size(json.to_string().as_bytes()).is_err());
        }
        let overflow = br#"{"FileManifestList":[{"FileChunkParts":[{"Size":"255255255255255255255255"},{"Size":"001"}]}]}"#;
        assert!(installation_size(overflow).is_err());
    }
}
```

```rs
//! One cancellable launcher WebSocket per Epic session. HTTP runs only at bootstrap,
//! after a relationship event, or when recovering a connection/buffer overflow.
use crate::{
    EpicError, auth,
    client::SocialAuth,
    friends::{Activity, Connection, Roster, Snapshot},
    stomp,
};
use futures_util::{SinkExt, StreamExt};
use serde_json::Value;

    collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet},
    sync::{
        Arc, Mutex,
        atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering},
    },
    time::Duration,
};
use tokio::{
    sync::watch,
    task::JoinHandle,
    time::{Instant, sleep_until, timeout},
};
use tokio_tungstenite::{
    connect_async_with_config,
    tungstenite::{self, Message, client::IntoClientRequest, protocol::WebSocketConfig},

const MAX_BUFFERED_EVENTS: usize = 512;
const MAX_BUFFERED_BYTES: usize = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
const REQUEST_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(45);
const HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(20);

pub(crate) struct SocialService {
    state: watch::Sender<Snapshot>,
    epoch: Arc<AtomicU64>,
    task: Mutex<Option<JoinHandle<()>>>,
}
impl SocialService {
    pub(crate) fn new(account: String) -> Self {
        Self {
            state: watch::channel(Snapshot::new(account)).0,
            epoch: Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0)),
            task: Mutex::new(None),
        }
    }
    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(crate) fn snapshot(&self) -> Snapshot {
        self.state.borrow().clone()
    }
    pub(crate) async fn next(&self, revision: u64) -> Snapshot {
        obelisk_core::watch::next_matching(self.state.subscribe(), |snapshot| {
            snapshot.revision != revision || snapshot.connection == Connection::Stopped
        })
        .await
        .unwrap_or_else(|last| last)
    }
    pub(crate) fn start(&self, auth: SocialAuth, force: bool, activity: Option<Activity>) {
        let mut task = self.task.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        if !force && task.as_ref().is_some_and(|t| !t.is_finished()) {
            return;
        }
        if let Some(previous) = task.take() {
            previous.abort();
        }
        let generation = self.epoch.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst) + 1;
        let publish = Publisher {
            state: self.state.clone(),
            epoch: self.epoch.clone(),
            generation,
        };
        publish.set(Connection::Loading, None, None);
        *task = Some(tokio::spawn(run(auth, publish, activity)));
    }
    pub(crate) fn stop(&self) {
        let mut task = self.task.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        self.epoch.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        if let Some(task) = task.take() {
            task.abort();
        }
        self.state.send_modify(|s| {
            s.revision = s.revision.wrapping_add(1);
            s.connection = Connection::Stopped;
            s.friends.clear();
            s.message = None;
        });
    }
}
impl Drop for SocialService {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.stop();
    }
}
struct Publisher {
    state: watch::Sender<Snapshot>,
    epoch: Arc<AtomicU64>,
    generation: u64,
}
impl Publisher {
    fn set(
        &self,
        connection: Connection,
        friends: Option<Vec<crate::friends::Friend>>,
        message: Option<&str>,
    ) {
        self.state.send_if_modified(|s| {
            if self.epoch.load(Ordering::SeqCst) != self.generation {
                return false;
            }
            let rows = friends.as_ref().unwrap_or(&s.friends);
            if s.connection == connection && rows == &s.friends && s.message.as_deref() == message {
                return false;
            }
            if let Some(friends) = friends {
                s.friends = friends;
            }
            s.connection = connection;
            s.message = message.map(str::to_owned);
            s.revision = s.revision.wrapping_add(1);
            true
        });
    }
}
#[derive(Debug)]
enum Failure {
    Network,
    Protocol,
    Forbidden,
    Expired,
    TokenRejected,
    RateLimited(Duration),
    Renew,
}
impl From<EpicError> for Failure {
    fn from(value: EpicError) -> Self {
        match value {
            EpicError::Unauthorized => Self::Expired,
            EpicError::Network => Self::Network,
            _ => Self::Protocol,
        }
    }
}
impl Failure {
    fn message(&self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Network => "backend.epic.friends.network",
            Self::Protocol => "backend.epic.friends.protocol",
            Self::Forbidden | Self::TokenRejected => "backend.epic.friends.forbidden",
            Self::Expired => "backend.epic.unauthorized",
            Self::RateLimited(_) => "backend.epic.rate_limited",
            Self::Renew => "backend.epic.friends.network",
        }
    }
}
fn http_status(
    status: reqwest::StatusCode,
    headers: &reqwest::header::HeaderMap,
) -> Result<(), Failure> {
    match status.as_u16() {
        200..=299 => Ok(()),
        401 => Err(Failure::TokenRejected),
        403 => Err(Failure::Forbidden),
        429 => {
            // Do not retry earlier than Retry-After. Unsupported date syntax stops
            // the automatic cycle instead of guessing an earlier retry time.
            let wait = headers
                .get("retry-after")
                .map(|v| {
                    v.to_str()
                        .ok()
                        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
                        .unwrap_or(86400)
                })
                .unwrap_or(60);
            Err(Failure::RateLimited(Duration::from_secs(wait.max(1))))
        }
        500..=599 => Err(Failure::Network),
        _ => Err(Failure::Protocol),
    }
}
async fn run(auth: SocialAuth, publish: Publisher, activity: Option<Activity>) {
    let account = publish.state.borrow().account_id.clone();
    let mut attempts = 0u32;
    let mut rejected = None;
    // The detached game supervisor has no user action to reconnect after an
    // outage. It keeps network recovery alive until the game stops or access is refused.
    let supervised = activity.is_some();
    loop {
        let mut ready_since = None;
        let (error, token) = match auth.access_token(rejected.as_deref()).await {
            Ok(token) => {
                let result = connection(
                    &auth,
                    &token,
                    &account,
                    &publish,
                    &mut ready_since,
                    activity.as_ref(),
                )
                .await;
                (result.err().unwrap_or(Failure::Network), Some(token))
            }
            Err(error) => {
                let error = Failure::from(error);
                // A supervisor's renewal outage is retried below, like any other
                // network failure; the UI reports it and waits for the user.
                if !supervised || !matches!(error, Failure::Network) {
                    let state = if matches!(error, Failure::Expired) {
                        Connection::AuthenticationRequired
                    } else {
                        Connection::Failed
                    };
                    publish.set(state, None, Some(error.message()));
                    return;
                }
                (error, None)
            }
        };
        if matches!(error, Failure::Renew) {
            publish.set(Connection::Interrupted, None, None);
            rejected = None;
            continue;
        }
        if matches!(error, Failure::TokenRejected) && rejected.is_none() {
            publish.set(Connection::Interrupted, None, Some(error.message()));
            // Only a connection that held a token can have it rejected.
            rejected = token;
            continue;
        }
        if matches!(
            error,
            Failure::Forbidden | Failure::TokenRejected | Failure::Expired
        ) {
            publish.set(
                if matches!(error, Failure::Expired) {
                    Connection::AuthenticationRequired
                } else {
                    Connection::Forbidden
                },
                None,
                Some(error.message()),
            );
            return;
        }
        if ready_since.is_some_and(|since: Instant| since.elapsed() >= Duration::from_secs(60)) {
            attempts = 0;
        }
        attempts = attempts.saturating_add(1);
        let retry_network = supervised && matches!(error, Failure::Network);
        if (attempts >= 5 && !retry_network)
            || matches!(error, Failure::RateLimited(d) if d > Duration::from_secs(3600))
        {
            publish.set(Connection::Failed, None, Some(error.message()));
            return;
        }
        publish.set(Connection::Interrupted, None, Some(error.message()));
        let backoff = Duration::from_secs((1u64 << (attempts - 1).min(5)).min(30));
        let wait = match error {
            Failure::RateLimited(wait) => wait.max(backoff),
            _ => backoff,
        };
        tokio::time::sleep(wait).await;
    }
}

type Socket =
    tokio_tungstenite::WebSocketStream<tokio_tungstenite::MaybeTlsStream<tokio::net::TcpStream>>;
fn ws_error(error: tungstenite::Error) -> Failure {
    if let tungstenite::Error::Http(response) = error {
        return http_status(response.status(), response.headers())
            .err()
            .unwrap_or(Failure::Protocol);
    }
    match error {
        tungstenite::Error::Protocol(_)
        | tungstenite::Error::Utf8(_)
        | tungstenite::Error::Capacity(_) => Failure::Protocol,
        _ => Failure::Network,
    }
}
async fn send(socket: &mut Socket, command: &str, headers: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Result<(), Failure> {
    let bytes = stomp::encode(command, headers, &[]).map_err(|_| Failure::Protocol)?;
    let text = String::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|_| Failure::Protocol)?;
    send_ws(socket, Message::text(text)).await
}
/// One bounded WebSocket write; a stalled socket is a network failure.
async fn send_ws(socket: &mut Socket, message: Message) -> Result<(), Failure> {
    timeout(HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT, socket.send(message))
        .await
        .map_err(|_| Failure::Network)?
        .map_err(ws_error)
}
/// Publishes the current roster as ready, or as forbidden when Epic denied presence.
fn publish_ready(publish: &Publisher, roster: &Roster, presence_forbidden: bool) {
    publish.set(
        if presence_forbidden {
            Connection::Forbidden
        } else {
            Connection::Ready
        },
        Some(roster.friends()),
        presence_forbidden.then_some("backend.epic.friends.presenceForbidden"),
    );
}
async fn get(
    auth: &SocialAuth,
    token: &str,
    base: &str,
    path: &[&str],
    query: &[(&str, &str)],
) -> Result<Value, Failure> {
    let mut url = reqwest::Url::parse(base).map_err(|_| Failure::Protocol)?;
    url.path_segments_mut()
        .map_err(|_| Failure::Protocol)?
        .clear()
        .extend(path.iter().copied());
    url.query_pairs_mut().extend_pairs(query.iter().copied());
    let response = auth
        .api
        .http
        .get(url)
        .bearer_auth(token)
        .send()
        .await
        .map_err(|_| Failure::Network)?;
    http_status(response.status(), response.headers())?;
    auth::bounded_json(response, 8 * 1024 * 1024)
        .await
        .map_err(Into::into)
}
type ProfileNames = BTreeMap<String, Option<String>>;
struct BootstrapState {
    roster: Roster,
    presence_forbidden: Option<bool>,
    profiles: ProfileNames,
}

async fn register_presence(
    auth: &SocialAuth,
    token: &str,
    account: &str,
    registration: &Registration,
) -> Result<(), Failure> {
    let mut url = reqwest::Url::parse(&auth.api.presence).map_err(|_| Failure::Protocol)?;
    url.path_segments_mut()
        .map_err(|_| Failure::Protocol)?
        .clear()
        .extend([
            "epic",
            "presence",
            "internal",
            "v1",
            "_",
            account,
            "presence",
            &registration.connection,
        ]);
    // Epic requires an automatic connection status. Omitting statusSettings follows
    // the launcher's automatic registration and leaves manual preferences to Epic.
    // The supervisor advertises only the game it owns, on its own connection.
    let mut conn = serde_json::json!({"props": {}});
    if let Some(activity) = &registration.activity {
        let mut running = serde_json::json!({"id": activity.id});
        if let Some(name) = &activity.name {
            running["displayName"] = name.clone().into();
        }
        conn["runningApp"] = running;
    }
    let response = auth
        .api
        .http
        .post(url)
        .bearer_auth(token)
        .header("X-Epic-Agent", "epic-social")
        .header("X-HTTP-Method-Override", "PATCH")
        .json(&serde_json::json!({"status":"online", "conn":conn}))
        .send()
        .await
        .map_err(|_| Failure::Network)?;
    http_status(response.status(), response.headers())?;
    let value: Value = auth::bounded_json(response, 8 * 1024 * 1024).await?;
    if value["own"]["accountId"].as_str() != Some(account) || !value["own"]["status"].is_string() {
        return Err(Failure::Protocol);
    }
    // The reply describes self only. Friends arrive as presence.v1.UPDATE events;
    // successful registration is not evidence that unreported friends are offline.
    Ok(())
}

async fn hydrate_names(
    auth: &SocialAuth,
    token: &str,
    roster: &mut Roster,
    profiles: &mut ProfileNames,
) {
    let friends = roster.friends();
    let accepted: BTreeSet<_> = friends
        .iter()
        .map(|friend| friend.account_id.as_str())
        .collect();
    profiles.retain(|id, _| accepted.contains(id.as_str()));
    let missing: Vec<_> = friends
        .iter()
        .filter(|friend| {
            friend.display_name.is_none() && !profiles.contains_key(&friend.account_id)
        })
        .map(|friend| friend.account_id.as_str())
        .collect();
    // This is optional presentation data, with one bounded request at a time.
    // The socket remains readable while the bootstrap future is suspended here.
    let _ = timeout(Duration::from_secs(10), async {
        for ids in missing.chunks(100) {
            for id in ids {
                profiles.insert((*id).to_owned(), None);
            }
            let query: Vec<_> = ids.iter().map(|id| ("accountId", *id)).collect();
            let Ok(value) = get(
                auth,
                token,
                &auth.api.account,
                &["account", "api", "public", "account"],
                &query,
            )
            .await
            else {
                break;
            };
            let Some(accounts) = value.as_array().filter(|accounts| accounts.len() <= 100) else {
                break;
            };
            for account in accounts {
                let Some(id) = account["id"].as_str().filter(|id| ids.contains(id)) else {
                    continue;
                };
                let name = crate::friends::text(&account["displayName"]).or_else(|| {
                    account["externalAuths"]
                        .as_object()?
                        .values()
                        .find_map(|external| crate::friends::text(&external["externalDisplayName"]))
                });
                profiles.insert(id.to_owned(), name);
            }
        }
    })
    .await;
    roster.apply_profile_names(profiles);
}
async fn bootstrap(
    auth: &SocialAuth,
    token: &str,
    account: &str,
    mut profiles: ProfileNames,
    registration: Option<Registration>,
) -> Result<BootstrapState, Failure> {
    if let Some(registration) = registration.as_ref().filter(|r| r.activity.is_some()) {
        // The detached game supervisor needs only its own presence. Do not gate
        // it on friends permissions or load another copy of the user's roster.
        register_presence(auth, token, account, registration).await?;
        return Ok(BootstrapState {
            roster: Roster::new(account.into()),
            presence_forbidden: Some(false),
            profiles,
        });
    }
    let summary_path = ["friends", "api", "v1", account, "summary"];
    let (summary, presence) = tokio::join!(
        get(
            auth,
            token,
            &auth.api.friends,
            &summary_path,
            &[("displayNames", "true")]
        ),
        async {
            match registration {
                Some(registration) => register_presence(auth, token, account, &registration)
                    .await
                    .map(|()| Some(false)),
                None => Ok(None),
            }
        }
    );
    let mut roster = Roster::new(account.into());
    roster.replace_summary(summary?)?;
    let presence_forbidden = match presence {
        Ok(presence) => presence,
        Err(Failure::Forbidden) => Some(true),
        Err(error) => return Err(error),
    };
    hydrate_names(auth, token, &mut roster, &mut profiles).await;
    Ok(BootstrapState {
        roster,
        presence_forbidden,
        profiles,
    })
}

async fn bounded_bootstrap(
    auth: &SocialAuth,
    token: &str,
    account: &str,
    profiles: ProfileNames,
    registration: Option<Registration>,
) -> Result<BootstrapState, Failure> {
    timeout(
        REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
        bootstrap(auth, token, account, profiles, registration),
    )
    .await
    .map_err(|_| Failure::Network)?
}

type Bootstrap<'a> = std::pin::Pin<
    Box<dyn std::future::Future<Output = Result<BootstrapState, Failure>> + Send + 'a>,
>;

struct Registration {
    connection: String,
    activity: Option<Activity>,
}

async fn connection(
    auth: &SocialAuth,
    token: &str,
    account: &str,
    publish: &Publisher,
    ready_since: &mut Option<Instant>,
    activity: Option<&Activity>,
) -> Result<(), Failure> {
    let mut request = auth
        .api
        .connect
        .as_str()
        .into_client_request()
        .map_err(|_| Failure::Protocol)?;
    // EGL3 passes the raw access token, without the REST Bearer prefix.
    request.headers_mut().insert(
        "Authorization",
        token.parse().map_err(|_| Failure::Protocol)?,
    );
    // Epic's current gateway omits Sec-WebSocket-Protocol in its HTTP 101 response.
    // Negotiate the protocol in STOMP CONNECT/CONNECTED instead of advertising a
    // WebSocket subprotocol that the gateway does not select.

    let host = request.uri().host().ok_or(Failure::Protocol)?.to_owned();
    let config = WebSocketConfig::default()
        .max_message_size(Some(1024 * 1024))
        .max_frame_size(Some(1024 * 1024));
    let (mut socket, response) = timeout(
        HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT,
        connect_async_with_config(request, Some(config), false),
    )
    .await
    .map_err(|_| Failure::Network)?
    .map_err(ws_error)?;
    if response
        .headers()
        .get("Sec-WebSocket-Protocol")
        .is_some_and(|v| v != "v12.stomp")
    {
        return Err(Failure::Protocol);
    }
    send(
        &mut socket,
        "CONNECT",
        &[
            ("accept-version", "1.2"),
            ("host", &host),
            ("heart-beat", "30000,0"),
            // Retain the nonstandard spelling used by the Epic launcher reference.
            ("heartbeat", "30000,0"),
        ],
    )
    .await?;
    let mut decoder = stomp::Decoder::new();
    let mut connected = false;
    let mut subscribed = false;
    let mut roster = Roster::new(account.into());
    let mut ready = false;
    let mut presence_forbidden = false;
    let mut profiles = ProfileNames::new();
    let mut invalidate_profiles = false;
    let mut buffer = Vec::new();
    let mut buffer_bytes = 0usize;
    let mut followup_refresh = false;
    let mut refresh: Option<Bootstrap<'_>> = None;
    let mut outgoing = None;
    let far = || Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(86400);
    let mut send_deadline = far();
    let setup_deadline = Instant::now() + HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT;
    let mut ping_deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(30);
    let mut pong_deadline = None;
    let renewal = Instant::from_std(auth.expires_at().await?);
    loop {
        tokio::select! {
            biased;
            _ = sleep_until(renewal) => return Err(Failure::Renew),
            _ = sleep_until(pong_deadline.unwrap_or_else(far)), if pong_deadline.is_some() => return Err(Failure::Network),
            _ = sleep_until(ping_deadline) => {
                send_ws(&mut socket, Message::Ping(vec![].into())).await?;
                ping_deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(30);
                pong_deadline = Some(Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(20));
            }
            _ = sleep_until(setup_deadline), if !subscribed => return Err(Failure::Protocol),
            _ = sleep_until(send_deadline), if outgoing.is_some() => {
                send_ws(&mut socket, Message::text("\n")).await?;
                send_deadline = Instant::now() + outgoing.unwrap();
            }
            message = socket.next() => {
                let message = message.ok_or(Failure::Network)?.map_err(ws_error)?;
                let bytes = match message {
                    Message::Text(text) => text.as_bytes().to_vec(), Message::Binary(bytes) => bytes.to_vec(),
                    Message::Pong(_) => { pong_deadline = None; continue; }
                    Message::Ping(_) => {
                        timeout(HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT, socket.flush()).await.map_err(|_| Failure::Network)?.map_err(ws_error)?;
                        continue;
                    }
                    Message::Close(_) => return Err(Failure::Network), _ => continue,
                };
                for frame in decoder.push(&bytes).map_err(|_| Failure::Protocol)? {
                    match frame.command.as_str() {
                        "CONNECTED" if !connected => {
                            if frame.headers.get("version").map(String::as_str) != Some("1.2") { return Err(Failure::Protocol); }
                            connected = true;
                            if let Some(heartbeat) = frame.headers.get("heart-beat") {
                                let (server_out,server_in) = heartbeat.split_once(',').ok_or(Failure::Protocol)?;
                                let server_out: u64 = server_out.parse().map_err(|_| Failure::Protocol)?;
                                let server_in: u64 = server_in.parse().map_err(|_| Failure::Protocol)?;
                                if server_out > 86400000 || server_in > 86400000 { return Err(Failure::Protocol); }
                                outgoing = (server_in > 0).then(|| Duration::from_millis(server_in.max(30000)));
                                // Client advertises zero incoming STOMP heartbeats. The RFC6455
                                // ping/pong watchdog below detects a silent transport instead.
                                if let Some(interval) = outgoing { send_deadline = Instant::now() + interval; }
                                            }
                            let destination = format!("{}/account/{account}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4().simple());
                            send(&mut socket,"SUBSCRIBE", &[("id","sub-0"),("destination",&destination),("ack","auto"),("receipt","friends-ready")]).await?;
                        }
                        "RECEIPT" if connected && frame.headers.get("receipt-id").map(String::as_str) == Some("friends-ready") => {
                            // Wait for the welcome's connection ID before registering presence.
                        }
                        "MESSAGE" if connected => {
                            if frame.headers.get("subscription").map(String::as_str) != Some("sub-0") { continue; }
                            let content = frame.headers.get("content-type").or_else(|| frame.headers.get("Content-Type"));
                            if !content.is_some_and(|v| v.split(';').next() == Some("application/json")) { continue; }
                            // A game connection consumes nothing past the welcome; skip the parse
                            // rather than build and drop a tree for every friend's event.
                            if subscribed && activity.is_some() { continue; }
                            let event: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&frame.body).map_err(|_| Failure::Protocol)?;
                            if event["type"] == "core.connect.v1.connected" {
                                if !event["connectionId"].as_str().is_some_and(|s| !s.is_empty() && s.len() < 4096) { return Err(Failure::Protocol); }
                                // Welcome also proves subscription on servers without receipts.
                                if !subscribed {
                                    subscribed = true;
                                    let registration = Registration {
                                        connection: event["connectionId"].as_str().unwrap().to_owned(),
                                        activity: activity.cloned(),
                                    };
                                    refresh = Some(Box::pin(bounded_bootstrap(auth, token, account, profiles.clone(), Some(registration))));
                                }
                                continue;
                            }
                            if !subscribed { return Err(Failure::Protocol); }
                            let kind = event["type"].as_str().ok_or(Failure::Protocol)?;
                            if !kind.starts_with("friends.v1.") && kind != "presence.v1.UPDATE" { continue; }
                            if matches!(kind, "friends.v1.FRIEND_ENTRY_UPDATED" | "friends.v1.FRIENDSHIP_ENTRY_UPDATE") {
                                profiles.clear();
                                invalidate_profiles = refresh.is_some();
                            }
                            let relations_changed = roster.event(&event)?;
                            if relations_changed {
                                if refresh.is_some() { followup_refresh = true; }
                                else { refresh = Some(Box::pin(bounded_bootstrap(auth, token, account, profiles.clone(), None))); }
                            }
                            if refresh.is_some() {
                                buffer_bytes = buffer_bytes.saturating_add(frame.body.len());
                                if buffer.len() >= MAX_BUFFERED_EVENTS || buffer_bytes > MAX_BUFFERED_BYTES {
                                    // Discard the incomplete attempt and reconnect/resynchronize with backoff.
                                    return Err(Failure::Protocol);
                                }
                                buffer.push(event);
                            }
                            if ready { publish_ready(publish, &roster, presence_forbidden); }
                        }
                        "ERROR" => return Err(Failure::Protocol),
                        _ => return Err(Failure::Protocol),
                    }
                }
            }
            result = async { refresh.as_mut().unwrap().await }, if refresh.is_some() => {
                let loaded = result?;
                let mut new = loaded.roster;
                profiles = loaded.profiles;
                if std::mem::take(&mut invalidate_profiles) { profiles.clear(); }
                if let Some(forbidden) = loaded.presence_forbidden { presence_forbidden = forbidden; }
                // Replay the ordered socket events received since these HTTP reads started.
                // Removed/blocked IDs remain absent, even if the HTTP snapshot was older.
                new.retain_tombstones(&roster);
                new.retain_live_presence(&roster);
                for event in buffer.drain(..) { new.event(&event)?; }
                buffer_bytes = 0;
                refresh = if std::mem::take(&mut followup_refresh) { Some(Box::pin(bounded_bootstrap(auth, token, account, profiles.clone(), None))) } else { None };
                roster = new; ready = true;
                ready_since.get_or_insert_with(Instant::now);
                publish_ready(publish, &roster, presence_forbidden);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
#[tokio::test]
async fn running_game_is_advertised_on_its_own_connection_and_reconnect() {
    let mut fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    let client = fixture.client();
    client
        .start_game_presence(crate::friends::Activity {
            id: "kingdom-namespace".into(),
            name: Some("Kingdom: New Lands".into()),
        })
        .unwrap();
    let mut peer = fixture.peer().await;
    for reconnect in [false, true] {
        if reconnect {
            peer.socket.close(None).await.unwrap();
            peer = fixture.peer().await;
        }
        peer.subscribe().await;
        let registration = fixture.registration().await;
        let body: Value = serde_json::from_str(&registration.request.body).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            body,
            json!({
                "status": "online",
                "conn": {"props": {}, "runningApp": {
                    "id": "kingdom-namespace",
                    "displayName": "Kingdom: New Lands"
                }}
            })
        );
        registration.respond(200, registration_response());
        state(&client, |s| s.connection == Connection::Ready).await;
        peer.event(REMOVED).await;
        peer.barrier().await;
        assert!(
            fixture.http.try_recv().is_err(),
            "game presence must not read friends"
        );
    }
    client.stop_friends();
    peer.closed().await;
    assert_eq!(client.friends().connection, Connection::Stopped);
    // A later social connection must not inherit the exited game's activity.
    client.start_friends();
    let mut peer = fixture.peer().await;
    peer.subscribe().await;
    let (summary_request, registration) = fixture.bootstrap().await;
    assert_eq!(
        serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&registration.request.body).unwrap(),
        json!({"status":"online","conn":{"props":{}}})
    );
    summary_request.respond(200, summary());
    registration.respond(200, registration_response());
    state(&client, |s| s.connection == Connection::Ready).await;
    client.stop_friends();
    peer.closed().await;
}
```
