```rs
async fn bounded<T>(future: impl Future<Output = T>) -> T {
    timeout(SAFETY_BOUND, future)
        .await
        .expect("loopback fixture did not reach the expected barrier")
}

async fn assert_pending<F: Future>(mut future: Pin<&mut F>) {
    poll_fn(|context| {
        assert!(future.as_mut().poll(context).is_pending());
        Poll::Ready(())
    })
    .await;
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct HttpRequest {
    method: String,
    target: String,
    headers: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    body: String,
}

struct PendingHttp {
    request: HttpRequest,
    response: oneshot::Sender<(u16, Value)>,
}

impl PendingHttp {
    fn respond(self, status: u16, body: Value) {
        assert!(self.response.send((status, body)).is_ok());
    }
}

struct Peer {
    socket: WebSocketStream<TcpStream>,
    authorization: String,
    protocol: Option<String>,
}

impl Peer {
    async fn text(&mut self) -> String {
        let message = bounded(self.socket.next())
            .await
            .expect("client socket closed")
            .expect("invalid client WebSocket message");
        match message {
            Message::Text(value) => value.to_string(),
            other => panic!("expected STOMP text, received {other:?}"),
        }
    }

    async fn subscribe(&mut self) {
        self.subscribe_with_token("fixture-access-token").await;
    }

    async fn subscribe_with_token(&mut self, token: &str) {
        self.subscribe_with_heartbeat(token, "0,0").await;
    }

    async fn subscribe_with_heartbeat(&mut self, token: &str, server_heartbeat: &str) {
        assert_eq!(self.authorization, token);
        assert_eq!(self.protocol, None);
        // Keep standard STOMP negotiation and the Epic gateway's heartbeat alias.
        assert_eq!(
            self.text().await,
            "CONNECT\naccept-version:1.2\nhost:127.0.0.1\nheart-beat:30000,0\nheartbeat:30000,0\n\n\0"
        );
        self.socket
            .send(Message::text(format!(
                "CONNECTED\nversion:1.2\nheart-beat:{server_heartbeat}\n\n\0"
            )))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let subscribe = self.text().await;
        assert!(subscribe.starts_with("SUBSCRIBE\nid:sub-0\ndestination:"));
        assert!(subscribe.ends_with("\nack:auto\nreceipt:friends-ready\n\n\0"));
        let destination = subscribe
            .lines()
            .find_map(|line| line.strip_prefix("destination:"))
            .unwrap();
        let prefix = destination.strip_suffix("/account/account-a").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(prefix.len(), 32);
        assert!(prefix.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()));
        self.socket
            .send(Message::text("RECEIPT\nreceipt-id:friends-ready\n\n\0"))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        self.event(r#"{"type":"core.connect.v1.connected","connectionId":"fixture-connection"}"#)
            .await;
    }

    async fn event(&mut self, json: &str) {
        // Handwritten wire envelope; no production STOMP encoder participates.
        let wire = format!(
            "MESSAGE\nsubscription:sub-0\nmessage-id:fixture\ndestination:fixture/account/account-a\ncontent-type:application/json\n\n{json}\0"
        );
        self.socket.send(Message::text(wire)).await.unwrap();
    }

    async fn barrier(&mut self) {
        self.socket
            .send(Message::Ping(b"barrier".to_vec().into()))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        bounded(async {
            loop {
                let message = self.socket.next().await.unwrap().unwrap();
                match message {
                    Message::Ping(_) => self.socket.flush().await.unwrap(),
                    Message::Text(text) if text == "\n" => {}
                    Message::Pong(value) if value.as_ref() == b"barrier" => break,
                    other => panic!("unexpected message before fixture barrier: {other:?}"),
                }
            }
        })
        .await;
    }

    async fn closed(&mut self) {
        match bounded(self.socket.next()).await {
            None | Some(Ok(Message::Close(_))) | Some(Err(_)) => {}
            other => panic!("observer should release its socket: {other:?}"),
        }
    }
}

struct Fixture {
    api: Api,
    http: mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<PendingHttp>,
    peers: mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<Peer>,
    log: Arc<Mutex<Vec<HttpRequest>>>,
    servers: Vec<JoinHandle<()>>,
}

impl Fixture {
    async fn new() -> Self {
        let http_listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
        let ws_listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
        let http_base = format!("http://{}", http_listener.local_addr().unwrap());
        let ws_base = format!("ws://{}/", ws_listener.local_addr().unwrap());
        let (requests, http) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
        let (connections, peers) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
        let log = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
        let captured = log.clone();
        let http_server = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut children = JoinSet::new();
            loop {
                tokio::select! {
                    connection = http_listener.accept() => {
                        let (socket, _) = connection.unwrap();
                        children.spawn(serve_http(socket, requests.clone(), captured.clone()));
                    }
                    done = children.join_next(), if !children.is_empty() => { done.unwrap().unwrap(); }
                }
            }
        });
        let ws_server = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut children = JoinSet::new();
            loop {
                tokio::select! {
                    connection = ws_listener.accept() => {
                        let (socket, _) = connection.unwrap();
                        let connections = connections.clone();
                        children.spawn(async move {
                            let upgrade = Arc::new(Mutex::new(None));
                            let headers = upgrade.clone();
                            // Tungstenite fixes the callback error type to an HTTP response.
                            #[allow(clippy::result_large_err)]
                            let socket = accept_hdr_async(socket, move |request: &Request, response: Response| {
                                *headers.lock().unwrap() = Some((
                                    request.headers()["authorization"].to_str().unwrap().to_owned(),
                                    request.headers().get("sec-websocket-protocol").map(|value| value.to_str().unwrap().to_owned()),
                                ));
                                Ok(response)
                            }).await.unwrap();
                            let (authorization, protocol) = upgrade.lock().unwrap().take().unwrap();
                            let _ = connections.send(Peer { socket, authorization, protocol });
                        });
                    }
                    done = children.join_next(), if !children.is_empty() => { done.unwrap().unwrap(); }
                }
            }
        });
        let mut api = Api::new().unwrap();
        api.account = http_base.clone();
        api.library = http_base.clone();
        api.launcher = http_base.clone();
        api.catalog = http_base.clone();
        api.ecommerce = http_base.clone();
        api.friends = http_base.clone();
        api.presence = http_base;
        api.connect = ws_base;
        Self {
            api,
            http,
            peers,
            log,
            servers: vec![http_server, ws_server],
        }
    }

    fn client(&self) -> Arc<Client> {
        self.client_with_expiry(Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(3600))
    }

    fn client_with_expiry(&self, expires_at: Instant) -> Arc<Client> {
        Arc::new(Client::from_session(
            self.api.clone(),
            Session {
                credentials: Credentials {
                    account_id: "account-a".into(),
                    display_name: "Fixture Owner".into(),
                    refresh_token: "fixture-refresh-token".into(),
                },
                access_token: "fixture-access-token".into(),
                expires_at,
            },
        ))
    }

    async fn peer(&mut self) -> Peer {
        bounded(self.peers.recv()).await.unwrap()
    }

    async fn bootstrap(&mut self) -> (PendingHttp, PendingHttp) {
        self.bootstrap_with_token("fixture-access-token").await
    }

    async fn bootstrap_with_token(&mut self, token: &str) -> (PendingHttp, PendingHttp) {
        let first = bounded(self.http.recv()).await.unwrap();
        let second = bounded(self.http.recv()).await.unwrap();
        let (summary, presence) = if first.request.target == SUMMARY_PATH {
            (first, second)
        } else {
            (second, first)
        };
        assert_eq!(summary.request.target, SUMMARY_PATH);
        assert_eq!(presence.request.target, REGISTRATION_PATH);
        for request in [&summary.request, &presence.request] {
            assert_eq!(
                request.method,
                if request.target == SUMMARY_PATH {
                    "GET"
                } else {
                    "POST"
                }
            );
            assert_eq!(request.headers["authorization"], format!("Bearer {token}"));
        }
        (summary, presence)
    }

    async fn metadata(&mut self) -> PendingHttp {
        let request = bounded(self.http.recv()).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(request.request.target, SUMMARY_PATH);
        assert_eq!(request.request.method, "GET");
        request
    }

    async fn registration(&mut self) -> PendingHttp {
        let request = bounded(self.http.recv()).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(request.request.target, REGISTRATION_PATH);
        assert_eq!(request.request.method, "POST");
        assert_eq!(request.request.headers["x-http-method-override"], "PATCH");
        request
    }

    async fn renewal(&mut self) -> PendingHttp {
        let request = bounded(self.http.recv()).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(request.request.method, "POST");
        assert_eq!(request.request.target, "/account/api/oauth/token");
        assert!(request.request.headers["authorization"].starts_with("Basic "));
        assert!(request.request.body.contains("grant_type=refresh_token"));
        assert!(
            request
                .request
                .body
                .contains("refresh_token=fixture-refresh-token")
        );
        request
    }

    async fn profiles(&mut self, account_ids: &[&str]) -> PendingHttp {
        let request = bounded(self.http.recv()).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(request.request.method, "GET");
        assert_eq!(
            request.request.headers["authorization"],
            "Bearer fixture-access-token"
        );
        let url =
            reqwest::Url::parse(&format!("http://fixture{}", request.request.target)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(url.path(), PROFILES_PATH);
        let mut queried: Vec<_> = url
            .query_pairs()
            .map(|(key, value)| {
                assert_eq!(key, "accountId");
                value.into_owned()
            })
            .collect();
        queried.sort();
        let mut expected = account_ids.to_vec();
        expected.sort();
        assert_eq!(queried, expected);
        request
    }

    fn assert_request_counts(&mut self, bootstrap_pairs: usize, profile_reads: usize) {
        assert!(
            self.http.try_recv().is_err(),
            "unexpected queued HTTP request"
        );
        let log = self.log.lock().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(log.len(), bootstrap_pairs + 1 + profile_reads);
        assert_eq!(
            log.iter()
                .filter(|request| request.target == SUMMARY_PATH)
                .count(),
            bootstrap_pairs
        );
        assert_eq!(
            log.iter()
                .filter(|request| request.target == REGISTRATION_PATH)
                .count(),
            1
        );
        assert_eq!(
            log.iter()
                .filter(|request| request.target.starts_with(PROFILES_PATH))
                .count(),
            profile_reads
        );
    }

    async fn ready(&mut self) -> (Arc<Client>, Peer, Snapshot) {
        let client = self.client();
        client.start_friends();
        let mut peer = self.peer().await;
        peer.subscribe().await;
        let (summary_request, presence_request) = self.bootstrap().await;
        summary_request.respond(200, summary());
        presence_request.respond(200, registration_response());
        let ready = state(&client, |s| s.connection == Connection::Ready).await;
        (client, peer, ready)
    }

    fn assert_only_bootstrap_requests(&mut self, count: usize) {
        assert!(
            self.http.try_recv().is_err(),
            "unexpected queued HTTP request"
        );
        let log = self.log.lock().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(log.len(), count);
        assert!(log.iter().all(|request| (request.method == "GET"
            && request.target == SUMMARY_PATH)
            || (request.method == "POST" && request.target == REGISTRATION_PATH)));
    }
}

impl Drop for Fixture {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        for server in &self.servers {
            server.abort();
        }
    }
}

async fn serve_http(
    mut socket: TcpStream,
    requests: mpsc::UnboundedSender<PendingHttp>,
    log: Arc<Mutex<Vec<HttpRequest>>>,
) {
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    let mut chunk = [0; 4096];
    let request = loop {
        let length = socket.read(&mut chunk).await.unwrap();
        if length == 0 {
            return;
        }
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..length]);
        assert!(bytes.len() <= 64 * 1024);
        let Some(end) = bytes.windows(4).position(|part| part == b"\r\n\r\n") else {
            continue;
        };
        let headers = std::str::from_utf8(&bytes[..end]).unwrap();
        let mut lines = headers.lines();
        let mut start = lines.next().unwrap().split_whitespace();
        let method = start.next().unwrap().to_owned();
        let target = start.next().unwrap().to_owned();
        let headers: BTreeMap<_, _> = lines
            .map(|line| {
                let (key, value) = line.split_once(':').unwrap();
                (key.to_ascii_lowercase(), value.trim().to_owned())
            })
            .collect();
        let body_length = headers
            .get("content-length")
            .map_or(0, |value| value.parse::<usize>().unwrap());
        if bytes.len() >= end + 4 + body_length {
            break HttpRequest {
                method,
                target,
                headers,
                body: std::str::from_utf8(&bytes[end + 4..end + 4 + body_length])
                    .unwrap()
                    .to_owned(),
            };
        }
    };
    log.lock().unwrap().push(request.clone());
    let (response, receive) = oneshot::channel();
    if requests.send(PendingHttp { request, response }).is_err() {
        return;
    }
    let Ok((status, body)) = receive.await else {
        return;
    };
    let body = body.to_string();
    let response = format!(
        "HTTP/1.1 {status} Fixture\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n{body}",
        body.len()
    );
    let _ = socket.write_all(response.as_bytes()).await;
}

fn summary() -> Value {
    json!({"friends":[{"accountId":"alice","displayName":"Alice"}],"blocklist":[]})
}
fn registration_response() -> Value {
    json!({"own":{"accountId":"account-a","status":"online","perNs":[]}})
}

fn renewed_token() -> Value {
    json!({"access_token":"fixture-access-new", "refresh_token":"fixture-refresh-new",
        "account_id":"account-a", "displayName":"Fixture Owner", "expires_in":3600})
}

async fn advance_time(duration: Duration) {
    tokio::time::pause();
    tokio::time::advance(duration).await;
    tokio::time::resume();
}

async fn state(client: &Client, predicate: impl Fn(&Snapshot) -> bool) -> Snapshot {
    bounded(async {
        let mut snapshot = client.friends();
        while !predicate(&snapshot) {
            snapshot = client.next_friends(snapshot.revision).await;
        }
        snapshot
    })
    .await
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn registers_connection_and_receives_initial_presence_without_a_snapshot_read() {
    let mut fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    let client = fixture.client();
    client.start_friends();
    let mut peer = fixture.peer().await;
    peer.subscribe().await;
    peer.event(r#"{"type":"core.connect.v1.connected","connectionId":"fixture-connection"}"#)
        .await;
    let first = bounded(fixture.http.recv()).await.unwrap();
    let second = bounded(fixture.http.recv()).await.unwrap();
    let (summary_request, registration) = if first.request.target == SUMMARY_PATH {
        (first, second)
    } else {
        (second, first)
    };
    assert_eq!(registration.request.method, "POST");
    assert_eq!(
        registration.request.target,
        "/epic/presence/internal/v1/_/account-a/presence/fixture-connection"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        registration.request.headers["x-http-method-override"],
        "PATCH"
    );
    assert_eq!(registration.request.headers["x-epic-agent"], "epic-social");
    assert_eq!(
        serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&registration.request.body).unwrap(),
        json!({"status":"online","conn":{"props":{}}})
    );
    registration.respond(
        200,
        json!({"own":{"accountId":"account-a","status":"away","perNs":[]}}),
    );
    peer.event(AWAY).await;
    peer.barrier().await;
    summary_request.respond(200, json!({"friends":[{"accountId":"alice","displayName":"Alice"},{"accountId":"bob","displayName":"Bob"}]}));
    let ready = state(&client, |s| s.connection == Connection::Ready).await;
    assert_eq!(ready.friends[0].presence, Presence::Away);
    assert_eq!(ready.friends[1].presence, Presence::Unknown);
    assert_eq!(ready.message, None);
    peer.event(ONLINE).await;
    let changed = state(&client, |s| s.friends[0].presence == Presence::Online).await;
    assert_eq!(changed.connection, Connection::Ready);
    peer.barrier().await;
    assert!(fixture.http.try_recv().is_err());
    assert_eq!(fixture.log.lock().unwrap().len(), 2);
    client.stop_friends();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn bootstraps_real_client_and_replays_presence_received_during_http() {
    let mut fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    let client = fixture.client();
    client.start_friends();
    client.start_friends(); // An existing observer is not duplicated.
    let mut peer = fixture.peer().await;
    peer.subscribe().await;
    let (summary_request, presence_request) = fixture.bootstrap().await;
    peer.event(ONLINE).await;
    peer.event(PLAYING).await;
    peer.barrier().await;
    assert_eq!(client.friends().connection, Connection::Loading);
    summary_request.respond(200, summary());
    presence_request.respond(200, registration_response());
    let ready = state(&client, |s| s.connection == Connection::Ready).await;
    assert_eq!(ready.account_id, "account-a");
    assert_eq!(ready.friends.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(ready.friends[0].display_name.as_deref(), Some("Alice"));
    assert_eq!(ready.friends[0].presence, Presence::Online);
    assert_eq!(
        ready.friends[0].activity.as_ref().unwrap().name.as_deref(),
        Some("Fixture Game")
    );
    fixture.assert_only_bootstrap_requests(2);
    assert!(fixture.peers.try_recv().is_err());
    client.stop_friends();
    peer.closed().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn spontaneous_socket_events_wake_watchers_and_slow_watchers_receive_latest_state() {
    let mut fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    let (client, mut peer, ready) = fixture.ready().await;
    let waiting = client.next_friends(ready.revision);
    tokio::pin!(waiting);
    assert_pending(waiting.as_mut()).await;
    peer.event(AWAY).await;
    let away = bounded(waiting).await;
    assert!(away.revision > ready.revision);
    assert_eq!(away.friends[0].presence, Presence::Away);

    peer.event(ONLINE).await;
    peer.barrier().await;
    peer.event(PLAYING).await;
    peer.barrier().await;
    let latest = bounded(client.next_friends(away.revision)).await;
    assert_eq!(latest.revision, client.friends().revision);
    assert!(latest.revision >= away.revision + 2);
    assert_eq!(latest.friends[0].presence, Presence::Online);
    assert_eq!(latest.friends[0].activity.as_ref().unwrap().id, "game-a");
    fixture.assert_only_bootstrap_requests(2);
    client.stop_friends();
    peer.closed().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn removal_and_late_presence_cannot_resurrect_a_friend_from_delayed_http() {
    let mut fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    let (client, mut peer, _) = fixture.ready().await;
    peer.event(REMOVED).await;
    let summary_request = fixture.metadata().await;
    peer.event(ONLINE).await;
    peer.barrier().await;
    assert!(client.friends().friends.is_empty());
    // Bob makes completion of the replacement snapshot observable. Alice's entry
    // is an intentionally stale HTTP result that must lose to the socket removal.
    summary_request.respond(
        200,
        json!({"friends":[
        {"accountId":"alice","displayName":"Alice"},
        {"accountId":"bob","displayName":"Bob"}
    ],"blocklist":[]}),
    );
    let refreshed = state(&client, |s| s.friends.iter().any(|f| f.account_id == "bob")).await;
    assert_eq!(refreshed.connection, Connection::Ready);
    assert_eq!(refreshed.friends.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(refreshed.friends[0].account_id, "bob");
    peer.event(PLAYING).await;
    peer.barrier().await;
    assert_eq!(client.friends(), refreshed);
    fixture.assert_only_bootstrap_requests(3);
    client.stop_friends();
    peer.closed().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn stopping_wakes_waiters_and_restarting_observers_preserves_the_oauth_session() {
    let mut fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    let (client, mut first_peer, ready) = fixture.ready().await;
    let waiting = client.next_friends(ready.revision);
    let credentials_waiting = client.next_credentials_revision(1);
    tokio::pin!(waiting, credentials_waiting);
    assert_pending(waiting.as_mut()).await;
    assert_pending(credentials_waiting.as_mut()).await;
    client.stop_friends();
    let stopped = bounded(waiting).await;
    assert_eq!(stopped.connection, Connection::Stopped);
    assert!(stopped.friends.is_empty());
    assert!(stopped.revision > ready.revision);
    first_peer.closed().await;
    assert_pending(credentials_waiting.as_mut()).await;
    assert_eq!(
        client.prepare().await.unwrap().refresh_token,
        "fixture-refresh-token"
    );
    assert!(client.progress().is_none());

    client.reconnect_friends();
    let mut second_peer = fixture.peer().await;
    second_peer.subscribe().await;
    let (summary_request, presence_request) = fixture.bootstrap().await;
    summary_request.respond(200, summary());
    presence_request.respond(200, registration_response());
    let restarted = state(&client, |s| s.connection == Connection::Ready).await;
    assert!(restarted.revision > stopped.revision);
    assert_eq!(restarted.friends.len(), 1);
    let waiting = client.next_friends(restarted.revision);
    tokio::pin!(waiting);
    assert_pending(waiting.as_mut()).await;
    client.shutdown_observers();
    assert_eq!(bounded(waiting).await.connection, Connection::Stopped);
    assert_eq!(bounded(credentials_waiting).await, None);
    second_peer.closed().await;
    assert_eq!(client.credentials().await.unwrap().account_id, "account-a");
    assert_eq!(
        client.prepare().await.unwrap().refresh_token,
        "fixture-refresh-token"
    );
    fixture.assert_only_bootstrap_requests(4);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn social_refresh_notifies_credentials_before_http_and_serializes_concurrent_prepare() {
    let mut fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    let client = fixture.client_with_expiry(Instant::now() - Duration::from_secs(1));
    let initial = client.friends();
    let credentials_waiting = client.next_credentials_revision(1);
    let friends_waiting = client.next_friends(initial.revision);
    tokio::pin!(credentials_waiting, friends_waiting);
    assert_pending(credentials_waiting.as_mut()).await;
    assert_pending(friends_waiting.as_mut()).await;
    client.start_friends();
    let renewal = fixture.renewal().await;
    // The social request holds the shared token refresh lock. A library prepare
    // started before its response must join that renewal, not create another POST.
    let prepare = client.prepare();
    tokio::pin!(prepare);
    assert_pending(prepare.as_mut()).await;
    assert_eq!(fixture.log.lock().unwrap().len(), 1);
    renewal.respond(200, renewed_token());
    assert_eq!(bounded(credentials_waiting).await, Some(2));
    assert_eq!(
        bounded(prepare).await.unwrap().refresh_token,
        "fixture-refresh-new"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        client.credentials().await.unwrap().refresh_token,
        "fixture-refresh-new"
    );
    assert_eq!(client.friends(), initial);
    assert_pending(friends_waiting.as_mut()).await;

    let mut peer = fixture.peer().await;
    peer.subscribe_with_token("fixture-access-new").await;
    let (summary_request, presence_request) =
        fixture.bootstrap_with_token("fixture-access-new").await;
    assert_pending(friends_waiting.as_mut()).await;
    presence_request.respond(200, registration_response());
    summary_request.respond(
        403,
        json!({"errorMessage":"fixture social permission denied"}),
    );
    let failure = bounded(friends_waiting).await;
    assert_eq!(failure.connection, Connection::Forbidden);
    assert!(failure.friends.is_empty());
    peer.closed().await;
    assert_eq!(
        client.prepare().await.unwrap().refresh_token,
        "fixture-refresh-new"
    );
    let log = fixture.log.lock().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(log.len(), 3);
    assert_eq!(
        log.iter()
            .filter(|r| r.target == "/account/api/oauth/token")
            .count(),
        1
    );
    drop(log);
    client.stop_friends();
}

    let mut fixture = Fixture::new().await;

    );

    client.stop_friends();

#[tokio::test]
async fn malformed_stomp_retries_are_bounded_and_explicit_reconnect_resynchronizes() {
    let mut fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    let (client, mut peer, ready) = fixture.ready().await;
    peer.socket
        .send(Message::text("MESSAGE\ninvalid-header\n\n\0"))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    for delay in [1, 2, 4, 8] {
        let interrupted = state(&client, |s| s.connection == Connection::Interrupted).await;
        assert_eq!(interrupted.friends, ready.friends);
        peer.closed().await;
        advance_time(Duration::from_secs(delay)).await;
        peer = fixture.peer().await;
        assert!(peer.text().await.starts_with("CONNECT\n"));
        // Wrong-version CONNECTED is also a fatal STOMP setup failure.
        peer.socket
            .send(Message::text("CONNECTED\nversion:1.1\n\n\0"))
            .await
            .unwrap();
    }
    let failed = state(&client, |s| s.connection == Connection::Failed).await;
    assert_eq!(failed.friends, ready.friends);
    assert_eq!(
        failed.message.as_deref(),
        Some("backend.epic.friends.protocol")
    );
    peer.closed().await;
    advance_time(Duration::from_secs(300)).await;
    assert!(fixture.peers.try_recv().is_err());
    assert_eq!(client.friends(), failed);
    fixture.assert_only_bootstrap_requests(2);

    client.reconnect_friends();
    let mut recovered_peer = fixture.peer().await;
    recovered_peer.subscribe().await;
    let (summary_request, presence_request) = fixture.bootstrap().await;
    summary_request.respond(200, json!({"friends":[], "blocklist":[]}));
    presence_request.respond(200, registration_response());
    let recovered = state(&client, |s| s.connection == Connection::Ready).await;
    assert!(recovered.friends.is_empty());
    assert!(recovered.revision > failed.revision);
    fixture.assert_only_bootstrap_requests(4);
    client.stop_friends();
    recovered_peer.closed().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn bootstrap_event_buffer_overflow_reconnects_and_reads_a_fresh_snapshot() {
    let mut fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    let client = fixture.client();
    client.start_friends();
    let mut peer = fixture.peer().await;
    peer.subscribe().await;
    let initial_requests = fixture.bootstrap().await;
    let frame = format!("MESSAGE\nsubscription:sub-0\ncontent-type:application/json\n\n{ONLINE}\0");
    peer.socket
        .send(Message::text(frame.repeat(513)))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let interrupted = state(&client, |s| s.connection == Connection::Interrupted).await;
    assert!(interrupted.friends.is_empty());
    peer.closed().await;
    drop(initial_requests);
    advance_time(Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
    let mut replacement = fixture.peer().await;
    replacement.subscribe().await;
    let (summary_request, presence_request) = fixture.bootstrap().await;
    summary_request.respond(200, summary());
    presence_request.respond(200, registration_response());
    let ready = state(&client, |s| s.connection == Connection::Ready).await;
    assert_eq!(ready.friends.len(), 1);
    // Events buffered on the old connection cannot supply the new initial state.
    assert_eq!(ready.friends[0].presence, Presence::Unknown);
    fixture.assert_only_bootstrap_requests(4);
    client.stop_friends();
    replacement.closed().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn restarting_social_during_oauth_response_preserves_rotation_and_uses_one_refresh() {
    let mut fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    let client = fixture.client_with_expiry(Instant::now() - Duration::from_secs(1));
    let credentials_waiting = client.next_credentials_revision(1);
    tokio::pin!(credentials_waiting);
    assert_pending(credentials_waiting.as_mut()).await;
    client.start_friends();
    let renewal = fixture.renewal().await;
    // The OAuth server has accepted the old token, but its rotated credentials
    // have not reached the client when a system wake restarts the social task.
    client.reconnect_friends();
    renewal.respond(200, renewed_token());
    let revision = bounded(async {
        tokio::select! {
            revision = credentials_waiting.as_mut() => revision,
            request = fixture.http.recv() => {
                panic!("observer restart duplicated the OAuth request: {}", request.unwrap().request.target);
            }
        }
    }).await;
    assert_eq!(revision, Some(2));
    assert_eq!(
        client.credentials().await.unwrap().refresh_token,
        "fixture-refresh-new"
    );
    let mut replacement = fixture.peer().await;
    replacement.subscribe_with_token("fixture-access-new").await;
    let (summary_request, presence_request) =
        fixture.bootstrap_with_token("fixture-access-new").await;
    summary_request.respond(200, summary());
    presence_request.respond(200, registration_response());
    let ready = state(&client, |s| s.connection == Connection::Ready).await;
    assert_eq!(ready.friends.len(), 1);
    replacement.barrier().await;
    {
        let log = fixture.log.lock().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(log.len(), 3);
        assert_eq!(
            log.iter()
                .filter(|r| r.target == "/account/api/oauth/token")
                .count(),
            1
        );
    }
    assert!(fixture.peers.try_recv().is_err());
    client.stop_friends();
    replacement.closed().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn relations_received_during_http_schedule_one_followup_for_names_and_new_friends() {
    let mut fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    let (client, mut peer, _) = fixture.ready().await;
    const UPDATED: &str =
        r#"{"type":"friends.v1.FRIEND_ENTRY_UPDATED","payload":{"from":"account-a","to":"alice"}}"#;
    const ADDED: &str =
        r#"{"type":"friends.v1.FRIEND_ENTRY_ADDED","payload":{"from":"account-a","to":"bob"}}"#;
    peer.event(UPDATED).await;
    let summary_request = fixture.metadata().await;
    peer.event(ADDED).await;
    peer.event(UPDATED).await;
    peer.barrier().await;
    summary_request.respond(200, summary());
    // This snapshot began before Bob's addition and Alice's latest update. A
    // replay alone cannot recover their names from ID-only relationship events.
    let followup_summary = fixture.metadata().await;
    followup_summary.respond(
        200,
        json!({"friends":[
        {"accountId":"alice","displayName":"Alice Updated"},
        {"accountId":"bob","displayName":"Bob"}
    ],"blocklist":[]}),
    );
    peer.event(r#"{"type":"presence.v1.UPDATE","payload":{"accountId":"bob","status":"online","perNs":[]}}"#).await;
    peer.barrier().await;
    let ready = state(&client, |s| {
        s.friends
            .iter()
            .any(|f| f.account_id == "alice" && f.display_name.as_deref() == Some("Alice Updated"))
            && s.friends
                .iter()
                .any(|f| f.account_id == "bob" && f.display_name.as_deref() == Some("Bob"))
    })
    .await;
    assert_eq!(ready.connection, Connection::Ready);
    assert_eq!(ready.friends.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(ready.friends[1].presence, Presence::Online);
    peer.barrier().await;
    fixture.assert_only_bootstrap_requests(4);
    client.stop_friends();
    peer.closed().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn forbidden_initial_presence_keeps_membership_and_live_events_without_polling() {

    peer.subscribe().await;
    let (summary_request, presence_request) = fixture.bootstrap().await;
    // The gateway accepts this launcher token while initialpresence can refuse
    // its scope. A failed presence request must not cancel accepted membership.
    presence_request.respond(403, json!({"errorCode":"fixture.presence.forbidden"}));
    summary_request.respond(200, summary());

        snapshot.connection == Connection::Forbidden
    })
    .await;

    assert_eq!(partial.friends[0].account_id, "alice");

    assert_eq!(partial.friends[0].activity, None);
    assert_eq!(
        partial.message.as_deref(),
        Some("backend.epic.friends.presenceForbidden")
    );

    let waiting = client.next_friends(partial.revision);
    tokio::pin!(waiting);
    assert_pending(waiting.as_mut()).await;
    peer.event(PLAYING).await;
    let playing = bounded(waiting).await;

    assert_eq!(playing.connection, Connection::Forbidden);
    assert_eq!(playing.message, partial.message);

    let activity = playing.friends[0].activity.as_ref().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(activity.id, "game-a");
    assert_eq!(activity.name.as_deref(), Some("Fixture Game"));

    advance_time(Duration::from_secs(300)).await;
    peer.barrier().await;
    assert_eq!(client.friends(), playing);
    assert!(fixture.peers.try_recv().is_err());
    fixture.assert_only_bootstrap_requests(2);
    assert_eq!(
        client.credentials().await.unwrap().refresh_token,
        "fixture-refresh-token"
    );
    client.stop_friends();
    peer.closed().await;

#[tokio::test]
async fn missing_websocket_pong_disconnects_and_exhausts_bounded_retries() {
    let mut fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    let (client, mut peer, initial) = fixture.ready().await;
    for attempt in 0..5 {
        advance_time(Duration::from_secs(30)).await;
        assert!(matches!(
            bounded(peer.socket.next()).await,
            Some(Ok(Message::Ping(_)))
        ));
        // Reading Ping queues tungstenite's automatic Pong. Keep it unflushed
        // until the client's watchdog expires, emulating an unresponsive peer.
        advance_time(Duration::from_secs(20)).await;
        let expected = if attempt == 4 {
            Connection::Failed
        } else {
            Connection::Interrupted
        };
        let disconnected = state(&client, |snapshot| snapshot.connection == expected).await;
        assert_eq!(disconnected.friends, initial.friends);
        assert_eq!(
            disconnected.message.as_deref(),
            Some("backend.epic.friends.network")
        );
        peer.closed().await;
        if attempt < 4 {
            advance_time(Duration::from_secs(1 << attempt)).await;
            peer = fixture.peer().await;
            peer.subscribe().await;
            let (summary_request, presence_request) = fixture.bootstrap().await;
            summary_request.respond(200, summary());
            presence_request.respond(200, registration_response());
            state(&client, |snapshot| snapshot.connection == Connection::Ready).await;
        }
    }
    let failed = client.friends();
    advance_time(Duration::from_secs(300)).await;
    assert_eq!(client.friends(), failed);
    assert!(fixture.peers.try_recv().is_err());
    fixture.assert_only_bootstrap_requests(10);
    client.stop_friends();
}
```

`crates/storefronts/epic-kit/src/stomp.rs`:

```rs
//! Bounded STOMP 1.2 framing. Session negotiation belongs to the caller.
//! Wire rules: <https://stomp.github.io/stomp-specification-1.2.html>.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;

pub(crate) const MAX_FRAME_BYTES: usize = 1024 * 1024;
// Command, header lines and their terminating blank line share this budget.
const MAX_HEADER_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024;
const MAX_HEADERS: usize = 64;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct Frame {
    pub command: String,
    pub headers: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    pub body: Vec<u8>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum ProtocolError {
    MalformedFrame,
    InvalidUtf8,
    InvalidEscape,
    LimitExceeded,
    Terminal,
}

#[derive(Default)]
enum Section {
    #[default]
    Command,
    Headers,
    Body,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct Decoder {
    section: Section,
    line: Vec<u8>,
    command: String,
    headers: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    body: Vec<u8>,
    content_length: Option<usize>,
    terminal: bool,
    frame_bytes: usize,
    header_bytes: usize,
    header_count: usize,
}

impl Decoder {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    pub fn push(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<Frame>, ProtocolError> {
        if self.terminal {
            return Err(ProtocolError::Terminal);
        }
        let result = self.push_inner(bytes);
        if result.is_err() {
            *self = Self {
                terminal: true,
                ..Self::default()
            };
        }
        result
    }

    fn push_inner(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<Frame>, ProtocolError> {
        let mut frames = Vec::new();
        for &byte in bytes {
            self.frame_bytes += 1;
            if self.frame_bytes > MAX_FRAME_BYTES {
                return Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded);
            }
            match self.section {
                Section::Command | Section::Headers => {
                    self.header_bytes += 1;
                    if self.header_bytes > MAX_HEADER_BYTES {
                        return Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded);
                    }
                    if byte != b'\n' {
                        if byte == 0 {
                            return Err(ProtocolError::MalformedFrame);
                        }
                        self.line.push(byte);
                        continue;
                    }
                    let line = std::mem::take(&mut self.line);
                    let line =
                        std::str::from_utf8(&line).map_err(|_| ProtocolError::InvalidUtf8)?;
                    let line = line.strip_suffix('\r').unwrap_or(line);
                    match self.section {
                        Section::Command if line.is_empty() => {
                            self.frame_bytes = 0;
                            self.header_bytes = 0;
                        }
                        Section::Command => {
                            validate_command(line)?;
                            self.command = line.to_owned();
                            self.section = Section::Headers;
                        }
                        Section::Headers if line.is_empty() => {
                            self.content_length = self
                                .headers
                                .get("content-length")
                                .map(|length| parse_content_length(length))
                                .transpose()?;
                            if let Some(length) = self.content_length
                                && length > MAX_FRAME_BYTES - self.frame_bytes - 1
                            {
                                return Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded);
                            }
                            self.section = Section::Body;
                        }
                        Section::Headers => {
                            self.header_count += 1;
                            if self.header_count > MAX_HEADERS {
                                return Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded);
                            }
                            let (key, value) =
                                line.split_once(':').ok_or(ProtocolError::MalformedFrame)?;
                            if key.is_empty() {
                                return Err(ProtocolError::MalformedFrame);
                            }
                            let escaped = !matches!(self.command.as_str(), "CONNECT" | "CONNECTED");
                            let key = decode_header(key, escaped)?;
                            let value = decode_header(value, escaped)?;
                            self.headers.entry(key).or_insert(value);
                        }
                        Section::Body => unreachable!(),
                    }
                }
                Section::Body
                    if self
                        .content_length
                        .map_or(byte == 0, |length| self.body.len() == length) =>
                {
                    if byte != 0 {
                        return Err(ProtocolError::MalformedFrame);
                    }
                    frames.push(Frame {
                        command: std::mem::take(&mut self.command),
                        headers: std::mem::take(&mut self.headers),
                        body: std::mem::take(&mut self.body),
                    });
                    self.section = Section::Command;
                    self.content_length = None;
                    self.frame_bytes = 0;
                    self.header_bytes = 0;
                    self.header_count = 0;
                }
                Section::Body => {
                    if !allows_body(&self.command) {
                        return Err(ProtocolError::MalformedFrame);
                    }
                    self.body.push(byte);
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(frames)
    }
}

fn validate_command(command: &str) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if matches!(
        command,
        "CONNECT"
            | "STOMP"
            | "CONNECTED"
            | "SEND"
            | "SUBSCRIBE"
            | "UNSUBSCRIBE"
            | "ACK"
            | "NACK"
            | "BEGIN"
            | "COMMIT"
            | "ABORT"
            | "DISCONNECT"
            | "MESSAGE"
            | "RECEIPT"
            | "ERROR"
    ) {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(ProtocolError::MalformedFrame)
    }
}

fn allows_body(command: &str) -> bool {
    matches!(command, "SEND" | "MESSAGE" | "ERROR")
}

fn parse_content_length(value: &str) -> Result<usize, ProtocolError> {
    if value.is_empty() || !value.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit()) {
        return Err(ProtocolError::MalformedFrame);
    }
    value.parse().map_err(|_| ProtocolError::LimitExceeded)
}

fn decode_header(value: &str, escaped: bool) -> Result<String, ProtocolError> {
    if value.contains(['\r', '\n', '\0']) || (escaped && value.contains(':')) {
        return Err(ProtocolError::MalformedFrame);
    }
    if !escaped {
        return Ok(value.to_owned());
    }
    let mut decoded = String::with_capacity(value.len());
    let mut chars = value.chars();
    while let Some(character) = chars.next() {
        decoded.push(if character == '\\' {
            match chars.next() {
                Some('r') => '\r',
                Some('n') => '\n',
                Some('c') => ':',
                Some('\\') => '\\',
                _ => return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidEscape),
            }
        } else {
            character
        });
    }
    Ok(decoded)
}

/// Adds an octet-counted content-length when the caller supplies a body without one.
pub(crate) fn encode(
    command: &str,
    headers: &[(&str, &str)],
    body: &[u8],
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, ProtocolError> {
    validate_command(command)?;
    if !body.is_empty() && !allows_body(command) {
        return Err(ProtocolError::MalformedFrame);
    }
    if body.len() >= MAX_FRAME_BYTES || headers.len() > MAX_HEADERS {
        return Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded);
    }
    let content_length = headers.iter().find(|(key, _)| *key == "content-length");
    if let Some((_, length)) = content_length
        && parse_content_length(length)? != body.len()
    {
        return Err(ProtocolError::MalformedFrame);
    }
    let add_length = !body.is_empty() && content_length.is_none();
    if headers.len() + usize::from(add_length) > MAX_HEADERS {
        return Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded);
    }
    let escaped = !matches!(command, "CONNECT" | "CONNECTED");
    let mut output = Vec::new();
    append_header_bytes(&mut output, command.as_bytes())?;
    append_header_bytes(&mut output, b"\n")?;
    for (key, value) in headers {
        if key.is_empty() || (!escaped && key.contains(':')) {
            return Err(ProtocolError::MalformedFrame);
        }
        encode_header(&mut output, key, escaped)?;
        append_header_bytes(&mut output, b":")?;
        encode_header(&mut output, value, escaped)?;
        append_header_bytes(&mut output, b"\n")?;
    }
    if add_length {
        append_header_bytes(&mut output, b"content-length:")?;
        append_header_bytes(&mut output, body.len().to_string().as_bytes())?;
        append_header_bytes(&mut output, b"\n")?;
    }
    append_header_bytes(&mut output, b"\n")?;
    if body.len() > MAX_FRAME_BYTES - output.len() - 1 {
        return Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded);
    }
    output.extend_from_slice(body);
    output.push(0);
    Ok(output)
}

fn encode_header(output: &mut Vec<u8>, value: &str, escaped: bool) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if value.contains('\0') || (!escaped && value.contains(['\r', '\n'])) {
        return Err(ProtocolError::MalformedFrame);
    }
    if !escaped {
        return append_header_bytes(output, value.as_bytes());
    }
    for byte in value.bytes() {
        match byte {
            b'\r' => append_header_bytes(output, b"\\r")?,
            b'\n' => append_header_bytes(output, b"\\n")?,
            b':' => append_header_bytes(output, b"\\c")?,
            b'\\' => append_header_bytes(output, b"\\\\")?,
            _ => append_header_bytes(output, &[byte])?,
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn append_header_bytes(output: &mut Vec<u8>, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> {
    if bytes.len() > MAX_HEADER_BYTES - output.len() {
        return Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded);
    }
    output.extend_from_slice(bytes);
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn decodes_the_spec_message_example() {
        let frames = Decoder::new()
            .push(b"MESSAGE\nsubscription:0\nmessage-id:007\ndestination:/queue/a\ncontent-type:text/plain\n\nhello queue a\0")
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(frames.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(frames[0].command, "MESSAGE");
        assert_eq!(frames[0].headers["destination"], "/queue/a");
        assert_eq!(frames[0].body, b"hello queue a");
    }

    #[test]
    fn handles_every_split_with_heartbeats_crlf_and_byte_counted_binary_body() {
        let wire = b"\n\r\nMESSAGE\r\ncontent-length:6\r\n\r\nh\xc3\xa9\0ok\0\nRECEIPT\nreceipt-id:42\n\n\0\r\n";
        for split in 0..=wire.len() {
            let mut decoder = Decoder::new();
            let mut frames = decoder.push(&wire[..split]).unwrap();
            frames.extend(decoder.push(&wire[split..]).unwrap());
            assert_eq!(frames.len(), 2, "split {split}");
            assert_eq!(frames[0].command, "MESSAGE");
            assert_eq!(frames[0].body, b"h\xc3\xa9\0ok");
            assert_eq!(frames[1].headers["receipt-id"], "42");
            assert!(frames[1].body.is_empty());
        }
        let mut decoder = Decoder::new();
        let mut frames = Vec::new();
        for byte in wire {
            frames.extend(decoder.push(&[*byte]).unwrap());
        }
        assert_eq!(frames.len(), 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn decodes_escapes_without_trimming_and_preserves_first_duplicate() {
        let frames = Decoder::new().push(b"MESSAGE\nx\\ck: a\\rb\\nc\\cd\\\\e \nx\\ck:ignored\ncontent-length:1\ncontent-length:999\n\nx\0").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(frames[0].headers["x:k"], " a\rb\nc:d\\e ");
        assert_eq!(frames[0].body, b"x");
        for command in ["CONNECT", "CONNECTED"] {
            let wire = format!("{command}\npath:a\\tb:c\n\n\0");
            let frames = Decoder::new().push(wire.as_bytes()).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(frames[0].headers["path"], "a\\tb:c");
        }
        let frames = Decoder::new().push(b"STOMP\nx:a\\cb\n\n\0").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(frames[0].headers["x"], "a:b");
    }

    #[test]
    fn malformed_headers_and_commands_make_the_decoder_terminal() {
        for (wire, expected) in [
            (
                &b"MESSAGE\nx:bad\\t\n\n\0"[..],
                ProtocolError::InvalidEscape,
            ),
            (&b"MESSAGE\nx:bad\\\n\n\0"[..], ProtocolError::InvalidEscape),
            (&b"MESSAGE\nx:\xff\n\n\0"[..], ProtocolError::InvalidUtf8),
            (&b"MESSAGE\n\xff:x\n\n\0"[..], ProtocolError::InvalidUtf8),
            (&b"MESSAGE\nx\n\n\0"[..], ProtocolError::MalformedFrame),
            (&b"MESSAGE\n:x\n\n\0"[..], ProtocolError::MalformedFrame),
            (&b"MESSAGE\nx:a:b\n\n\0"[..], ProtocolError::MalformedFrame),
            (&b"MESSAGE\nx:a\rb\n\n\0"[..], ProtocolError::MalformedFrame),
            (&b"MESSAGE\nx:a\0b\n\n\0"[..], ProtocolError::MalformedFrame),
            (&b"message\n\n\0"[..], ProtocolError::MalformedFrame),
            (&b" MESSAGE\n\n\0"[..], ProtocolError::MalformedFrame),
            (&b"UNKNOWN\n\n\0"[..], ProtocolError::MalformedFrame),
            (
                &b"MESSAGE\ncontent-length:+1\n\na\0"[..],
                ProtocolError::MalformedFrame,
            ),
            (
                &b"MESSAGE\ncontent-length:-1\n\na\0"[..],
                ProtocolError::MalformedFrame,
            ),
            (
                &b"MESSAGE\ncontent-length: 1\n\na\0"[..],
                ProtocolError::MalformedFrame,
            ),
            (
                &b"MESSAGE\ncontent-length:\n\n\0"[..],
                ProtocolError::MalformedFrame,
            ),
            (
                &b"MESSAGE\ncontent-length:1\n\nab\0"[..],
                ProtocolError::MalformedFrame,
            ),
            (&b"CONNECTED\n\nbody\0"[..], ProtocolError::MalformedFrame),
        ] {
            let mut decoder = Decoder::new();
            assert_eq!(decoder.push(wire), Err(expected), "{wire:?}");
            assert_eq!(
                decoder.push(b"CONNECTED\nversion:1.2\n\n\0"),
                Err(ProtocolError::Terminal)
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_oversized_incomplete_input_and_enforces_whole_frame_budget() {
        let mut decoder = Decoder::new();
        assert!(decoder.push(b"MESSAGE\nx:").unwrap().is_empty());
        assert_eq!(
            decoder.push(&vec![b'a'; 16 * 1024]),
            Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded)
        );
        let many_headers = format!("MESSAGE\n{}\n\0", "x:y\n".repeat(65));
        assert_eq!(
            Decoder::new().push(many_headers.as_bytes()),
            Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded)
        );
        let limit_headers = format!("MESSAGE\n{}\n\0", "x:y\n".repeat(64));
        assert_eq!(
            Decoder::new().push(limit_headers.as_bytes()).unwrap().len(),
            1
        );
        assert_eq!(
            Decoder::new().push(b"MESSAGE\ncontent-length:1048576\n\n"),
            Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            Decoder::new().push(b"MESSAGE\ncontent-length:999999999999999999999999999999\n\n"),
            Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded)
        );

        let mut frame = b"MESSAGE\n\n".to_vec();
        frame.resize(1024 * 1024 - 1, b'a');
        frame.push(0);
        assert_eq!(
            Decoder::new().push(&frame).unwrap()[0].body.len(),
            1024 * 1024 - 10
        );
        frame.insert(frame.len() - 1, b'a');
        assert_eq!(
            Decoder::new().push(&frame),
            Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded)
        );
        assert!(
            Decoder::new()
                .push(&vec![b'\n'; 2 * 1024 * 1024])
                .unwrap()
                .is_empty()
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn encodes_octet_lengths_and_escapes_using_literal_wire_expectations() {
        assert_eq!(encode("SEND", &[("destination", "/queue/a"), ("a:b", "c\rd\ne\\f")], b"h\xc3\xa9\0ok").unwrap(),
            b"SEND\ndestination:/queue/a\na\\cb:c\\rd\\ne\\\\f\ncontent-length:6\n\nh\xc3\xa9\0ok\0");
        assert_eq!(
            encode(
                "CONNECT",
                &[
                    ("accept-version", "1.2"),
                    ("host", "localhost:443"),
                    ("passcode", "x\\t")
                ],
                b""
            )
            .unwrap(),
            b"CONNECT\naccept-version:1.2\nhost:localhost:443\npasscode:x\\t\n\n\0"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            encode("STOMP", &[("host", "localhost:443")], b"").unwrap(),
            b"STOMP\nhost:localhost\\c443\n\n\0"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            encode("SEND", &[("content-length", "2")], b"ok").unwrap(),
            b"SEND\ncontent-length:2\n\nok\0"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn encoder_rejects_injection_invalid_lengths_and_excessive_output() {
        for (command, headers, body) in [
            ("SEND\n", vec![], &b""[..]),
            ("SEND", vec![("", "x")], &b""[..]),
            ("CONNECT", vec![("host", "x\nhost:evil")], &b""[..]),
            ("CONNECTED", vec![("ho:st", "x")], &b""[..]),
            ("SEND", vec![("x", "\0")], &b""[..]),
            ("SEND", vec![("content-length", "1")], &b"ok"[..]),
            ("SEND", vec![("content-length", "-1")], &b""[..]),
            ("RECEIPT", vec![], &b"x"[..]),
        ] {
            assert_eq!(
                encode(command, &headers, body),
                Err(ProtocolError::MalformedFrame)
            );
        }
        assert_eq!(
            encode("SEND", &vec![("x", "y"); 65], b""),
            Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            encode("SEND", &vec![("x", "y"); 64], b"x"),
            Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            encode("SEND", &[("x", &"y".repeat(16384))], b""),
            Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            encode("SEND", &[], &vec![0; 1024 * 1024]),
            Err(ProtocolError::LimitExceeded)
        );
    }
}
```

```rs
//! GOG Galaxy's OAuth protocol, as heroic-gogdl's `auth.py` and Heroic's
//! `user.ts` use it: a web sign-in returns a code to `embed.gog.com`, which
//! the Galaxy client's public credentials exchange for tokens.
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use reqwest::{StatusCode, Url};
use serde::Deserialize;

use crate::{
    GogError,
    http::{bounded_json, check_status, send},
};

/// The Galaxy client's public credentials, not an account secret.
pub(crate) const CLIENT_ID: &str = "46899977096215655";
const CLIENT_SECRET: &str = "9d85c43b1482497dbbce61f6e4aa173a433796eeae2ca8c5f6129f2dc4de46d9";
const REDIRECT_URI: &str = "https://embed.gog.com/on_login_success?origin=client";
const AUTH: &str = "https://auth.gog.com";

// Deliberately no Debug: callers store this record in the system Keychain.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct Credentials {
    /// The Galaxy user id every account call names.
    pub user_id: String,
    pub username: String,
    pub refresh_token: String,
}

/// The page that signs the player in. GOG then redirects to `REDIRECT_URI`
/// with the code; the native login window intercepts it there.
pub fn login_url() -> String {
    let mut url = Url::parse(&format!("{AUTH}/auth")).expect("a valid URL");
    url.query_pairs_mut()
        .append_pair("client_id", CLIENT_ID)
        .append_pair("redirect_uri", REDIRECT_URI)
        .append_pair("response_type", "code")
        .append_pair("layout", "galaxy");
    url.into()
}

/// Whether `url` is where GOG returns the code: its page itself never loads.
pub fn is_redirect(url: &str) -> bool {
    Url::parse(url).is_ok_and(|url| {
        url.scheme() == "https"
            && url.host_str() == Some("embed.gog.com")
            && url.port().is_none()
            && url.path() == "/on_login_success"
    })
}

/// Accepts the code itself or the redirect URL that carries it. This only
/// extracts a code; it never opens a URL provided by the caller.
pub fn authorization_code(input: &str) -> Result<String, GogError> {
    let input = input.trim();
    if input.len() > 32_768 {
        return Err(GogError::InvalidCode);
    }
    let candidate = if input.contains("://") {
        let url = Url::parse(input).map_err(|_| GogError::InvalidCode)?;
        if !is_redirect(input)
            || !url.username().is_empty()
            || url.password().is_some()
            || url.fragment().is_some()
        {
            return Err(GogError::InvalidCode);
        }
        let codes: Vec<_> = url
            .query_pairs()
            .filter(|(name, _)| name == "code")
            .collect();
        if codes.len() != 1 {
            return Err(GogError::InvalidCode);
        }
        codes[0].1.to_string()
    } else {
        input.to_owned()
    };
    if !valid_code(&candidate) {
        return Err(GogError::InvalidCode);
    }
    Ok(candidate)
}

fn valid_code(code: &str) -> bool {
    !code.is_empty()
        && code.len() <= 4096
        && code
            .bytes()
            .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'-' | b'_' | b'.'))
}

pub(crate) struct Session {
    pub credentials: Credentials,
    pub access_token: String,
    pub expires_at: Instant,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct TokenResponse {
    access_token: String,
    refresh_token: String,
    user_id: String,
    expires_in: u64,
}

/// The account's public profile, as Heroic's `user.ts` reads it.
#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct UserProfile {
    #[serde(default)]
    id: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    username: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    avatar: Avatar,
}

#[derive(Default, Deserialize)]
struct Avatar {
    #[serde(default)]
    medium_2x: Option<String>,
}

/// The signed-in account's name and avatar.
pub(crate) struct Profile {
    pub username: String,
    pub avatar_url: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct Api {
    pub http: reqwest::Client,
    pub auth: String,
    pub users: String,
    pub embed: String,
    pub library: String,
    pub gameplay: String,
    pub api: String,
    pub gamesdb: String,
    pub content: String,
    pub cdn: String,
}

impl Api {
    pub fn new() -> Result<Self, GogError> {
        Ok(Self {
            http: crate::http::client()?,
            auth: AUTH.into(),
            users: "https://users.gog.com".into(),
            embed: "https://embed.gog.com".into(),
            library: "https://galaxy-library.gog.com".into(),
            gameplay: "https://gameplay.gog.com".into(),
            api: "https://api.gog.com".into(),
            gamesdb: "https://gamesdb.gog.com".into(),
            content: "https://content-system.gog.com".into(),
            cdn: "https://gog-cdn-fastly.gog.com".into(),
        })
    }

    /// Signs in with the code the web sign-in returned.
    pub async fn authorize(&self, code: &str) -> Result<Session, GogError> {
        if !valid_code(code) {
            return Err(GogError::InvalidCode);
        }
        self.token(
            &[
                ("grant_type", "authorization_code"),
                ("code", code),
                ("redirect_uri", REDIRECT_URI),
            ],
            GogError::InvalidCode,
        )
        .await
    }

    pub async fn refresh(&self, credentials: &Credentials) -> Result<Session, GogError> {
        if !valid_secret(&credentials.refresh_token) || credentials.user_id.is_empty() {
            return Err(GogError::Unauthorized);
        }
        let mut session = self
            .token(
                &[
                    ("grant_type", "refresh_token"),
                    ("refresh_token", &credentials.refresh_token),
                ],
                GogError::Unauthorized,
            )
            .await?;
        if session.credentials.user_id != credentials.user_id {
            return Err(GogError::Unauthorized);
        }
        session
            .credentials
            .username
            .clone_from(&credentials.username);
        Ok(session)
    }

    /// The session `grant` opens, or `refused` when GOG refuses the grant.
    async fn token(&self, grant: &[(&str, &str)], refused: GogError) -> Result<Session, GogError> {
        let response = self
            .http
            .get(format!("{}/token", self.auth))
            .query(&[("client_id", CLIENT_ID), ("client_secret", CLIENT_SECRET)])
            .query(grant)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|_| GogError::Network)?;
        let status = response.status();
        if matches!(status, StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST | StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED) {
            return Err(refused);
        }
        check_status(status)?;
        let response: TokenResponse = bounded_json(response, 1024 * 1024).await?;
        if !valid_secret(&response.access_token)
            || !valid_secret(&response.refresh_token)
            || !valid_user_id(&response.user_id)
            || response.expires_in == 0
        {
            return Err(GogError::Protocol);
        }
        let lifetime = Duration::from_secs(response.expires_in.saturating_sub(60).max(1));
        let expires_at = Instant::now()
            .checked_add(lifetime)
            .ok_or(GogError::Protocol)?;
        Ok(Session {
            access_token: response.access_token,
            credentials: Credentials {
                user_id: response.user_id,
                username: String::new(),
                refresh_token: response.refresh_token,
            },
            expires_at,
        })
    }

    /// The account's name and avatar, which the token response lacks.
    pub async fn profile(&self, session: &Session) -> Result<Profile, GogError> {
        let url = crate::library::endpoint(&self.users, &["users", &session.credentials.user_id])?;
        let profile: UserProfile = self.get(url, &session.access_token).await?;
        if !profile.id.is_empty() && profile.id != session.credentials.user_id {
            return Err(GogError::Unauthorized);
        }
        Ok(Profile {
            username: profile.username,
            avatar_url: profile
                .avatar
                .medium_2x
                .as_deref()
                .and_then(crate::http::safe_https_url),
        })
    }

    pub async fn get<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(
        &self,
        url: Url,
        access_token: &str,
    ) -> Result<T, GogError> {
        let response = send(self.http.get(url).bearer_auth(access_token)).await?;
        bounded_json(response, 16 * 1024 * 1024).await
    }

    /// A request that carries no account credential: public catalog data.
    pub async fn get_public<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(
        &self,
        url: Url,
    ) -> Result<T, GogError> {
        bounded_json(send(self.http.get(url)).await?, 16 * 1024 * 1024).await
    }
}

fn valid_secret(value: &str) -> bool {
    !value.is_empty() && value.len() <= 16_384 && !value.chars().any(char::is_whitespace)
}

/// Galaxy user ids are decimal numbers.
pub fn valid_user_id(value: &str) -> bool {
    !value.is_empty() && value.len() <= 32 && value.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn code_input_accepts_gog_formats_without_accepting_other_urls() {
        for input in [
            "  abc_123-XYZ \n",
            "https://embed.gog.com/on_login_success?origin=client&code=abc_123-XYZ",
        ] {
            assert_eq!(authorization_code(input).unwrap(), "abc_123-XYZ");
        }
        for input in [
            "",
            "https://example.com/on_login_success?code=secret",
            "http://embed.gog.com/on_login_success?code=secret",
            "https://embed.gog.com/other?code=secret",
            "https://embed.gog.com/on_login_success?code=one&code=two",
            "https://embed.gog.com/on_login_success?origin=client",
            "some words",
            "code\r\ninjection",
        ] {
            assert!(
                matches!(authorization_code(input), Err(GogError::InvalidCode)),
                "{input}"
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_login_page_returns_to_the_galaxy_redirect() {
        let login = Url::parse(&login_url()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(login.host_str(), Some("auth.gog.com"));
        assert_eq!(login.path(), "/auth");
        let query: Vec<_> = login.query_pairs().collect();
        assert!(query.contains(&("client_id".into(), CLIENT_ID.into())));
        assert!(query.contains(&("redirect_uri".into(), REDIRECT_URI.into())));
        assert!(query.contains(&("response_type".into(), "code".into())));
        assert!(is_redirect(REDIRECT_URI));
        assert!(!is_redirect("https://embed.gog.com/account"));
    }
}
```

`crates/storefronts/gog-kit/src/client.rs`:

```rs
//! Account-scoped GOG requests. Token refresh is serialized, while reads
//! release the session lock so disconnect can invalidate them promptly.
use std::{future::Future, sync::Arc, time::Instant};

use obelisk_core::{
    platform::{Platform, Spelling},
    watch::Revisions,
};
use serde::Serializer;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;

use crate::{
    GogError,
    auth::{self, Api, Credentials, Session},
};

mod download;
mod gameplay;
mod launch;
pub use crate::library::{Game, GameDetails, GameInfo};
pub use download::{Installation, TransferProgress, TransferState, installation_directory_name};
pub use gameplay::Achievement;
pub use launch::{InstalledLaunch, Prerequisite, installed_launch};

/// How Obelisk names GOG's two desktop builds in its receipts, folders and
/// ids; the content system's "osx" stays inside `content_platform`.
pub const PLATFORM: Spelling = Spelling::new("macos", "windows");

/// Writes a platform as Obelisk spells GOG's builds.
pub fn write_platform<S: Serializer>(
    platform: &Platform,
    serializer: S,
) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {
    PLATFORM.serialize(*platform, serializer)
}

/// GOG product ids are decimal numbers; they name URLs and folders.
pub fn valid_product_id(value: &str) -> bool {
    !value.is_empty() && value.len() <= 20 && value.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit())
}

/// The content system's name for a build.
pub(crate) fn content_platform(platform: Platform) -> &'static str {
    match platform {
        Platform::Mac => "osx",
        Platform::Windows => "windows",
    }
}

pub struct Client {
    downloads: download::Downloads,
    tokens: TokenSource,
    avatar_url: Option<String>,
    /// Each Mac build's verdict, by product, build and language, and the
    /// depot items the last native one read, for its download.
    build_choice: download::BuildChoice,
}

impl Client {
    /// Signs in with the code the web sign-in returned.
    pub async fn sign_in(input: &str) -> Result<Self, GogError> {
        let code = auth::authorization_code(input)?;
        let api = Api::new()?;
        let session = api.authorize(&code).await?;
        Self::from_session(api, session).await
    }

    pub async fn restore(credentials: Credentials) -> Result<Self, GogError> {
        let api = Api::new()?;
        let session = api.refresh(&credentials).await?;
        Self::from_session(api, session).await
    }

    /// The session's account, named from its profile.
    async fn from_session(api: Api, mut session: Session) -> Result<Self, GogError> {
        let profile = api.profile(&session).await?;
        if !profile.username.is_empty() {
            session.credentials.username = profile.username;
        }
        Ok(Self {
            downloads: download::Downloads::default(),
            tokens: TokenSource {
                api: Arc::new(api),
                session: Arc::new(Mutex::new(Some(session))),
                credential_events: Revisions::new(),
            },
            avatar_url: profile.avatar_url,
            build_choice: Default::default(),
        })
    }

    /// The account's avatar, as its profile shows it.
    pub fn avatar_url(&self) -> Option<String> {
        self.avatar_url.clone()
    }

    pub async fn credentials(&self) -> Result<Credentials, GogError> {
        self.tokens
            .session
            .lock()
            .await
            .as_ref()
            .map(|session| session.credentials.clone())
            .ok_or(GogError::Unauthorized)
    }

    /// Refresh before a long read so the caller can persist a rotated token
    /// before the read starts.
    pub async fn prepare(&self) -> Result<(), GogError> {
        self.tokens.access_token(None).await.map(drop)
    }

    /// Every game the account owns, with its artwork and platforms.
    pub async fn games(&self) -> Result<Vec<Game>, GogError> {
        let user_id = self.credentials().await?.user_id;
        let user_id = user_id.as_str();
        self.with_access_token(|token| async move {
            crate::library::games(&self.tokens.api, &token, user_id).await
        })
        .await
    }

    /// What a game's page adds to its library entry, with the depots of
    /// `language`, such as `fr-FR`: the build it shows before any download,
    /// the Mac build unless a download found that its game does not run
    /// natively, and its size. Only `platform` reads the build's files.
    pub async fn game_details(
        &self,
        product_id: &str,
        language: &str,
    ) -> Result<GameDetails, GogError> {
        if !valid_product_id(product_id) {
            return Err(GogError::Protocol);
        }
        let shown = self
            .with_access_token(|token| async move {
                // Re-raise so the funnel refreshes the token once.
                match self.shown_build(&token, product_id, language).await {
                    Err(GogError::Unauthorized) => Err(GogError::Unauthorized),
                    shown => Ok(shown.ok()),
                }
            })
            .await?;
        Ok(match shown {
            Some((platform, size)) => GameDetails {
                platform: Some(platform),
                installation_bytes: size,
            },
            None => GameDetails::default(),
        })
    }

    /// The revision of the credentials now, which grows with each rotation.
    pub fn credentials_revision(&self) -> u64 {
        self.tokens.credential_events.current()
    }

    pub async fn next_credentials_revision(&self, after_revision: u64) -> Option<u64> {
        self.tokens.credential_events.next(after_revision).await
    }

    /// Synchronous cancellation crosses UniFFI even when a Swift task is
    /// suspended. This affects no running content transfer.
    pub fn shutdown_observers(&self) {
        self.tokens.credential_events.stop();
    }

    /// Forgets the session. GOG offers no revocation of a Galaxy token: it
    /// expires within the hour, and the refresh token is never used again.
    pub async fn disconnect(&self) -> Result<(), GogError> {
        self.shutdown_observers();
        self.cancel_download();
        self.tokens.session.lock().await.take();
        Ok(())
    }

    /// As [`TokenSource::with_access_token`], but a result computed for a
    /// session the account discarded meanwhile is never returned.
    pub(crate) async fn with_access_token<T, Fut>(
        &self,
        operation: impl Fn(String) -> Fut,
    ) -> Result<T, GogError>
    where
        Fut: Future<Output = Result<T, GogError>>,
    {
        let result = self.tokens.with_access_token(operation).await;
        if self.tokens.session.lock().await.is_none() {
            return Err(GogError::Unauthorized);
        }
        result
    }
}

/// The account's access token, renewed as it lapses, for work that outlives
/// one call, such as a Transfer's secure links.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct TokenSource {
    api: Arc<Api>,
    session: Arc<Mutex<Option<Session>>>,
    credential_events: Revisions,
}

impl TokenSource {
    /// Runs `operation` with a current access token. When GOG rejects that
    /// token, it is refreshed once and the operation runs again.
    pub(crate) async fn with_access_token<T, Fut>(
        &self,
        operation: impl Fn(String) -> Fut,
    ) -> Result<T, GogError>
    where
        Fut: Future<Output = Result<T, GogError>>,
    {
        let token = self.access_token(None).await?;
        match operation(token.clone()).await {
            Err(GogError::Unauthorized) => operation(self.access_token(Some(&token)).await?).await,
            result => result,
        }
    }

    /// A current access token, renewed when it lapsed or GOG `rejected` it.
    pub(crate) async fn access_token(&self, rejected: Option<&str>) -> Result<String, GogError> {
        // The renewing task owns the refresh, not the caller awaiting it: a
        // dropped caller never loses a token GOG already rotated.
        let tokens = self.clone();
        let rejected = rejected.map(str::to_owned);
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut guard = tokens.session.lock().await;
            let session = guard.as_mut().ok_or(GogError::Unauthorized)?;
            if session.expires_at <= Instant::now()
                || rejected.as_deref() == Some(&session.access_token)
            {
                *session = tokens.api.refresh(&session.credentials).await?;
                tokens.credential_events.advance();
            }
            Ok(session.access_token.clone())
        })
        .await
        .map_err(|_| GogError::Cancelled)?
    }
}
```

```rs
/// A GOG installation, as its own receipt records it.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]

pub struct Installation {

    /// The program, from the installation's content root.
    pub path: String,
    pub arguments: String,
```
