```rs
mod build_choice;

pub(super) type Downloads = Transfers<TransferProgress>;

/// A build of a product, in a language: what a Mac build's facts are kept by.
type BuildKey = (String, String, String);

/// The key of a build of a product in `language`; none for a build GOG gives no id.
fn build_key(product_id: &str, build_id: &str, language: &str) -> Option<BuildKey> {
    (!build_id.is_empty()).then(|| {
        (
            product_id.to_owned(),
            build_id.to_owned(),
            language.to_owned(),
        )
    })
}

/// Each Mac build's verdict, and the depot items of the last native one,
/// which its download starts from.
pub(super) type BuildChoice = obelisk_core::build_choice::BuildChoice<BuildKey, Installed>;

impl From<TransferBusy> for GogError {
    fn from(_: TransferBusy) -> Self {
        Self::AlreadyDownloading
    }
}

impl From<InstallFailure> for GogError {
    fn from(failure: InstallFailure) -> Self {
        match failure {
            InstallFailure::ParentMissing => Self::Service {
                message: "backend.gog.choose_existing_folder".into(),
            },
            InstallFailure::UnsafeDirectory(name) => Self::UnsafePath(name),
            InstallFailure::DestinationIsLink(path)
            | InstallFailure::DestinationIsFile(path)
            | InstallFailure::UnsafeLock(path)
            | InstallFailure::UnsafeReceipt(path) => {
                Self::UnsafePath(path.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
            }
            InstallFailure::Locked => Self::AlreadyDownloading,
            InstallFailure::Io(error) => Self::Io(error),
        }
    }
}

impl TransferError for GogError {
    fn is_cancellation(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Cancelled)
    }
}

/// Everything fetched before the installation lock is taken.
struct Prepared {
    manifest: BuildManifest,
    version_name: String,
    products: Vec<Product>,
    dependencies: Vec<Dependency>,
    installed: Installed,
    user_id: String,
}

/// The build Obelisk installs of `product_id` for `platform` (`osx` or
/// `windows`), and its manifest.
async fn current_build(
    api: &Api,
    product_id: &str,
    platform: &str,
) -> Result<(BuildManifest, String), GogError> {
    let build = listed_build(api, product_id, platform).await?;
    Ok((
        build_manifest(api, product_id, &build).await?,
        build.version_name,
    ))
}

/// The manifest of `product_id`'s listed `build`.
async fn build_manifest(
    api: &Api,
    product_id: &str,
    build: &Build,
) -> Result<BuildManifest, GogError> {
    let manifest: BuildManifest = document(api, content::checked_url(&build.link)?).await?;
    if manifest.base_product_id != product_id {
        return Err(GogError::Protocol);
    }
    Ok(manifest)
}

/// The build Obelisk installs of `product_id` for `platform`, as GOG lists
/// it, before its manifest is read.
async fn listed_build(api: &Api, product_id: &str, platform: &str) -> Result<Build, GogError> {
    let mut url = endpoint(
        &api.content,
        &["products", product_id, "os", platform, "builds"],
    )?;
    url.query_pairs_mut().append_pair("generation", "2");
    let response = api
        .http
        .get(url)
        .send()
        .await
        .map_err(|_| GogError::Network)?;
    if response.status() == reqwest::StatusCode::NOT_FOUND {
        return Err(GogError::NoBuild);
    }
    check_status(response.status())?;
    let builds: Builds = crate::http::bounded_json(response, 16 * 1024 * 1024).await?;
    builds.current().ok_or(GogError::NoBuild)
}

/// `listed_build`, none when GOG has no such build.
async fn present_build(
    api: &Api,
    product_id: &str,
    platform: &str,
) -> Result<Option<Build>, GogError> {
    match listed_build(api, product_id, platform).await {
        Ok(build) => Ok(Some(build)),
        Err(GogError::NoBuild) => Ok(None),
        Err(error) => Err(error),
    }
}

/// A content-system document, without any account credential, inflated and
/// parsed off the async workers.
async fn document<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned + Send + 'static>(
    api: &Api,
    url: reqwest::Url,
) -> Result<T, GogError> {
    let bytes = bounded_bytes(send(api.http.get(url)).await?, MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES).await?;
    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || inflate_json(&bytes, MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES as u64 * 4))
        .await
        .map_err(|_| GogError::Protocol)?
}

/// A depot's items, from its manifest under the CDN's `folder`.
async fn depot_items(
    api: &Api,
    folder: &str,
    manifest: &str,
) -> Result<Vec<manifest::Item>, GogError> {
    let url = content::checked_url(&format!(
        "{}/content-system/v2/{folder}/{}",
        api.cdn,
        galaxy_path(manifest)?
    ))?;
    let manifest: DepotManifest = document(api, url).await?;
    Ok(manifest.depot.items)
}

/// Adds the items of `depots`, each a manifest under the CDN's `folder` and
/// the secure link that serves its chunks, under `content_root`, in order.
async fn add_depots<'a>(
    api: &Api,
    installed: &mut Installed,
    content_root: &str,
    folder: &str,
    depots: impl IntoIterator<Item = (&'a str, &'a str)>,
) -> Result<(), GogError> {
    let (manifests, sources): (Vec<_>, Vec<_>) = depots.into_iter().unzip();
    let fetches: Vec<_> = manifests
        .into_iter()
        .map(|manifest| depot_items(api, folder, manifest))
        .collect();
    let items: Vec<Vec<manifest::Item>> = stream::iter(fetches)
        .buffered(MANIFEST_CONCURRENCY)
        .try_collect()
        .await?;
    for (source, items) in sources.into_iter().zip(items) {
        installed.add(content_root, source, items)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Every product the account owns, DLCs included.
async fn owned(api: &Api, access_token: &str) -> Result<HashSet<String>, GogError> {
    #[derive(Deserialize)]
    struct Owned {
        #[serde(default)]
        owned: Vec<serde_json::Value>,
    }
    let owned: Owned = api
        .get(
            endpoint(&api.embed, &["user", "data", "games"])?,
            access_token,
        )
        .await?;
    Ok(owned
        .owned
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|id| match id {
            serde_json::Value::Number(id) => Some(id.to_string()),
            serde_json::Value::String(id) => Some(id),
            _ => None,
        })
        .collect())
}

/// The products of the build the account owns: the game, and its DLCs.
fn owned_products(
    manifest: &BuildManifest,
    owned: &HashSet<String>,
) -> Result<Vec<Product>, GogError> {
    if !owned.contains(&manifest.base_product_id) {
        return Err(GogError::Service {
            message: "backend.gog.game_not_owned".into(),
        });
    }
    let mut products: Vec<Product> = manifest
        .products
        .iter()
        .filter(|product| {
            owned.contains(&product.product_id) && valid_product_id(&product.product_id)
        })
        .cloned()
        .collect();
    if !products
        .iter()
        .any(|product| product.product_id == manifest.base_product_id)
    {
        products.insert(
            0,
            Product {
                product_id: manifest.base_product_id.clone(),
                name: String::new(),
                temp_executable: String::new(),
                temp_arguments: String::new(),
            },
        );
    }
    Ok(products)
}

/// The products of the build the account owns, and their depots an
/// installation in `language` holds.
fn owned_depots<'a>(
    manifest: &'a BuildManifest,
    owned: &HashSet<String>,
    language: &str,
) -> Result<(Vec<Product>, Vec<&'a Depot>), GogError> {
    let products = owned_products(manifest, owned)?;
    let ids: HashSet<&str> = products
        .iter()
        .map(|product| product.product_id.as_str())
        .collect();
    let depots = manifest::depots(manifest, &ids, language);
    Ok((products, depots))
}

impl Client {
    pub fn progress(&self) -> Option<TransferProgress> {
        self.downloads.snapshot()
    }

    pub fn cancel_download(&self) {
        self.build_choice.cancel();
        self.downloads.cancel();
    }

    /// The build a download of the game installs, with the depots of
    /// `language`: the Mac build when its game runs natively on Apple
    /// silicon, else the Windows build. `cancel_download` stops it.
    pub async fn platform(&self, product_id: &str, language: &str) -> Result<Platform, GogError> {
        self.build_choice
            .pick(async |pick| {
                if !valid_product_id(product_id) || language.is_empty() || language.len() > 32 {
                    return Err(GogError::Protocol);
                }
                pick.of(&CurrentBuilds {
                    client: self,
                    product_id,
                    language,
                })
                .await
            })
            .await
    }

    /// The build the game's page shows before any download, and its size
    /// with the depots of `language`: the Mac build, unless a download found
    /// that its game does not run natively and GOG has a Windows build of
    /// it. None of the build's files is read.
    pub(super) async fn shown_build(
        &self,
        access_token: &str,
        product_id: &str,
        language: &str,
    ) -> Result<(Platform, Option<u64>), GogError> {
        let game = CurrentBuilds {
            client: self,
            product_id,
            language,
        };
        let offered = game.builds().await?;
        let (platform, build) = self
            .build_choice
            .shown(&game, offered)
            .await
            .ok_or(GogError::NoBuild)?;
        let size = match self
            .build_size(access_token, product_id, &build, language)
            .await
        {
            Ok(size) => Some(size),
            Err(GogError::Unauthorized) => return Err(GogError::Unauthorized),
            Err(_) => None,
        };
        Ok((platform, size))
    }

    /// Whether the program the primary play task of `installed` starts holds
    /// an arm64 slice.
    async fn plays_natively(
        &self,
        product_id: &str,
        installed: &Installed,
        content_root: &str,
        cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> Result<bool, GogError> {
        let from_root = |path: &str| match content_root {
            "" => path.to_owned(),
            root => format!("{root}/{path}"),
        };
        let mut listing = mac_build::Listing::default();
        for (index, file) in installed.files.iter().enumerate() {
            listing.file(&file.path, index, file.file.size());
        }
        for link in &installed.links {
            listing.link(&link.path, &link.target);
        }
        let links = SecureLinks::new(self.secure_links());
        let http = &self.tokens.api.http;
        let links = &links;
        let read = move |index: usize, bytes: u64| {
            content::read(http, links, &installed.files[index], bytes, cancel)
        };
        let mut program = None;
        for info in launch::info_files(product_id) {
            if let Some((file, size)) = listing.find(&from_root(&info))
                && size <= launch::MAX_INFO_BYTES as u64
            {
                program = launch::played_program(&read(file, size).await?);
                break;
            }
        }
        let Some(program) = program else {
            return Ok(false);
        };
        mac_build::runs_natively(&listing, &from_root(&program), &[], read).await
    }

    /// The size of the listed `build` an installation in `language` holds.
    async fn build_size(
        &self,
        access_token: &str,
        product_id: &str,
        build: &Build,
        language: &str,
    ) -> Result<u64, GogError> {
        let api = &self.tokens.api;
        let (manifest, owned) = tokio::try_join!(
            build_manifest(api, product_id, build),
            owned(api, access_token),
        )?;
        let (_, depots) = owned_depots(&manifest, &owned, language)?;
        Ok(depots.iter().map(|depot| depot.size).sum())
    }

    /// Whether GOG's current build of the game differs from the one installed
    /// in `directory`. An installation whose receipt is gone needs its
    /// Transfer too. It reads GOG's public build list only.
    pub async fn update_available(
        &self,
        product_id: &str,
        platform: Platform,
        directory: &Path,
    ) -> Result<bool, GogError> {
        if !valid_product_id(product_id) {
            return Err(GogError::Protocol);
        }
        let Some(installed) = installation::read_receipt::<Installation>(directory)?
            .filter(|receipt| receipt.product_id == product_id && receipt.platform == platform)
        else {
            return Ok(true);
        };
        let current =
            listed_build(&self.tokens.api, product_id, content_platform(platform)).await?;
        // A build without its identity cannot be compared.
        Ok(!current.build_id.is_empty()
            && !installed.build_id.is_empty()
            && current.build_id != installed.build_id)
    }

    /// Installs `product_id`'s current build for `platform`, with the depots
    /// of `language`, in its dedicated folder under `parent`, or updates and
    /// repairs the installation there.
    pub async fn download(
        &self,
        product_id: &str,
        platform: Platform,
        language: &str,
        parent: &Path,
    ) -> Result<Installation, GogError> {
        if !valid_product_id(product_id) || language.is_empty() || language.len() > 32 {
            return Err(GogError::Protocol);
        }
        let directory = installation_directory_name(product_id, platform);
        installation::install(
            &self.downloads,
            product_id,
            Destination {
                parent,
                directory: &directory,
            },
            |_, cancel| async move {
                let prepared = cancel
                    .race(self.prepare_download(product_id, platform, language))
                    .await??;
                // A revoked account withdraws nothing: the receipt stays until
                // the installation lock is taken.
                if self.tokens.session.lock().await.is_none() {
                    return Err(GogError::Unauthorized);
                }
                Ok(prepared)
            },
            |prepared, destination, transfer| async move {
                self.install_files(
                    product_id,
                    platform,
                    language,
                    prepared,
                    &destination,
                    &transfer,
                )
                .await
            },
        )
        .await
    }

    async fn prepare_download(
        &self,
        product_id: &str,
        platform: Platform,
        language: &str,
    ) -> Result<Prepared, GogError> {
        let user_id = self.credentials().await?.user_id;
        let api = &self.tokens.api;
        let ((manifest, version_name), owned) = tokio::try_join!(
            current_build(api, product_id, content_platform(platform)),
            self.with_access_token(|token| async move { owned(api, &token).await }),
        )?;
        let (products, depots) = owned_depots(&manifest, &owned, language)?;
        let content_root = manifest.content_root()?;
        // The depot items the build's pick read, when it is that build.
        let picked = build_key(product_id, &manifest.build_id, language)
            .and_then(|key| self.build_choice.take(&key));
        let mut installed = match picked {
            Some(installed) => installed,
            None => {
                let mut installed = Installed::default();
                let depots = depots
                    .iter()
                    .map(|depot| (depot.manifest.as_str(), depot.product_id.as_str()));
                add_depots(api, &mut installed, &content_root, "meta", depots).await?;
                installed
            }
        };
        let dependencies = if platform == Platform::Windows && !manifest.dependencies.is_empty() {
            self.add_dependencies(&manifest, &content_root, &mut installed)
                .await?
        } else {
            Vec::new()
        };
        installed.validate()?;
        Ok(Prepared {
            manifest,
            version_name,
            products,
            dependencies,
            installed,
            user_id,
        })
    }

    /// Adds the redistributables the build names to the installation, and
    /// returns those that run once in its prefix.
    async fn add_dependencies(
        &self,
        manifest: &BuildManifest,
        content_root: &str,
        installed: &mut Installed,
    ) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>, GogError> {
        #[derive(Deserialize)]
        struct Repository {
            repository_manifest: String,
        }
        let mut url = endpoint(&self.tokens.api.content, &["dependencies", "repository"])?;
        url.query_pairs_mut().append_pair("generation", "2");
        let repository: Repository = self.tokens.api.get_public(url).await?;
        let repository: DependencyRepository = document(
            &self.tokens.api,
            content::checked_url(&repository.repository_manifest)?,
        )
        .await?;
        let wanted: Vec<&DependencyDepot> = manifest
            .dependencies
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|id| {
                repository
                    .depots
                    .iter()
                    .find(|depot| &depot.dependency_id == id)
            })
            .filter(|depot| depot.installs_in_wine())
            .collect();
        let depots = wanted
            .iter()
            .map(|depot| (depot.manifest.as_str(), DEPENDENCIES));
        add_depots(
            &self.tokens.api,
            installed,
            content_root,
            "dependencies/meta",
            depots,
        )
        .await?;
        Ok(wanted
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|depot| !depot.executable.path.is_empty())
            .map(|depot| Dependency {
                id: depot.dependency_id.clone(),
                path: depot.executable.path.replace('\\', "/"),
                arguments: depot.executable.arguments.clone(),
            })
            .collect())
    }

    async fn install_files(
        &self,
        product_id: &str,
        platform: Platform,
        language: &str,
        prepared: Prepared,
        destination: &Path,
        transfer: &TransferContext<TransferProgress>,
    ) -> Result<InstalledFiles<Installation>, GogError> {
        let cancel = transfer.cancel_token();
        let Prepared {
            manifest,
            version_name,
            products,
            dependencies,
            installed,
            user_id,
        } = prepared;
        let key = hex(&md5::Md5::digest(
            format!("{product_id}\0{}\0{language}", manifest.build_id).as_bytes(),
        ));
        let links = Arc::new(SecureLinks::new(self.secure_links()));
        let progress = transfer.clone();
        let summary = content::download(
            self.tokens.api.http.clone(),
            links,
            Arc::new(installed),
            key,
            destination,
            cancel,
            move |snapshot| progress.update(|progress| progress.show(snapshot)),
        )
        .await?;
        cancel.check()?;
        if self.tokens.session.lock().await.is_none() {
            return Err(GogError::Unauthorized);
        }
        Ok(InstalledFiles {
            receipt: Installation {
                product_id: product_id.into(),
                user_id,
                directory: destination.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
                platform,
                total_bytes: summary.total_bytes,
                build_id: manifest.build_id.clone(),
                version_name,
                language: language.into(),
                content_root: manifest.content_root()?,
                script_interpreter: manifest.script_interpreter,
                products,
                dependencies,
            },
            total_bytes: summary.total_bytes,
            network_bytes: summary.downloaded_bytes,
            content_bytes: summary.content_bytes,
        })
    }

    /// Renews a product's secure link with the account's credentials, or the
    /// redistributables' open link.
    fn secure_links(&self) -> content::Renew {
        let tokens = self.tokens.clone();
        Arc::new(move |source: String| {
            let tokens = tokens.clone();
            async move {
                let api = &tokens.api;
                #[derive(Deserialize)]
                struct Links {
                    #[serde(default)]
                    urls: Vec<Endpoint>,
                }
                if source == DEPENDENCIES {
                    let mut url = endpoint(&api.content, &["open_link"])?;
                    url.query_pairs_mut()
                        .append_pair("generation", "2")
                        .append_pair("_version", "2")
                        .append_pair("path", "/dependencies/store/");
                    let links: Links = api.get_public(url).await?;
                    return Ok(links.urls);
                }
                if !valid_product_id(&source) {
                    return Err(GogError::Protocol);
                }
                let mut url = endpoint(&api.content, &["products", &source, "secure_link"])?;
                url.query_pairs_mut()
                    .append_pair("generation", "2")
                    .append_pair("_version", "2")
                    .append_pair("path", "/");
                let links: Links = tokens
                    .with_access_token(|token| {
                        let url = url.clone();
                        async move { api.get(url, &token).await }
                    })
                    .await?;
                Ok(links.urls)
            }
            .boxed()
        })
    }
}

/// The dedicated directory name for one GOG installation. The host relies on
/// this exact scheme to recognise and remove installations it created.
pub fn installation_directory_name(product_id: &str, platform: Platform) -> String {
    format!("gog-{product_id}-{}", PLATFORM.name(platform))
}
```

```rs
//! GOG's answers to the build choice: the builds its content system lists,
//! and a Mac build's depot items, read to find the program it plays.
use obelisk_core::{
    build_choice::{GameBuilds, Inspection, Offered},
    platform::Platform,
    transfer::CancelToken,
};

use super::{
    BuildKey, add_depots, build_key, build_manifest, content_platform, owned, owned_depots,
    present_build,
};
use crate::{
    GogError,
    client::Client,
    manifest::{Build, Installed},
};

/// A product's current builds, with the depots of `language`.
pub(super) struct CurrentBuilds<'a> {
    pub(super) client: &'a Client,
    pub(super) product_id: &'a str,
    pub(super) language: &'a str,
}

impl GameBuilds for CurrentBuilds<'_> {
    type Build = Build;
    type Key = BuildKey;
    type Kept = Installed;
    type Error = GogError;

    async fn builds(&self) -> Result<Offered<Build>, GogError> {
        let api = &self.client.tokens.api;
        let (mac, windows) = tokio::try_join!(
            present_build(api, self.product_id, content_platform(Platform::Mac)),
            present_build(api, self.product_id, content_platform(Platform::Windows)),
        )?;
        Ok(Offered { mac, windows })
    }

    async fn key(&self, mac: &Build) -> Result<Option<BuildKey>, GogError> {
        Ok(build_key(self.product_id, &mac.build_id, self.language))
    }

    /// Whether the program the build's primary play task names holds an
    /// arm64 slice. It reads the build's manifests, then the first bytes of
    /// a few of its files. A build Obelisk cannot install does not.
    async fn inspect(
        &self,
        mac: &Build,
        cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> Result<Inspection<Installed>, GogError> {
        let (client, product_id) = (self.client, self.product_id);
        let api = &client.tokens.api;
        let manifest = build_manifest(api, product_id, mac).await?;
        let owned = client
            .with_access_token(|token| async move { owned(api, &token).await })
            .await?;
        let (_, depots) = owned_depots(&manifest, &owned, self.language)?;
        let content_root = manifest.content_root()?;
        let mut installed = Installed::default();
        let depots = depots
            .iter()
            .map(|depot| (depot.manifest.as_str(), depot.product_id.as_str()));
        add_depots(api, &mut installed, &content_root, "meta", depots).await?;
        if installed.validate().is_err() {
            return Ok(Inspection::NotNative);
        }
        Ok(
            match client
                .plays_natively(product_id, &installed, &content_root, cancel)
                .await?
            {
                true => Inspection::Native(installed),
                false => Inspection::NotNative,
            },
        )
    }
}

mod tests {

    use obelisk_core::{

    use super::*;

    /// A client signed in to no account, which no key asks anything of.

            downloads: Default::default(),
```

`crates/storefronts/gog-kit/src/client/gameplay.rs`:

```rs
//! What the account did in its games, from `gameplay.gog.com`, as Heroic's
//! `games.ts` reads it with the account's own token: each game's playtime and
//! achievements.
use std::{collections::BTreeMap, time::Duration};

use futures_util::{StreamExt, TryStreamExt, stream};
use obelisk_core::date::unix_seconds;
use reqwest::StatusCode;
use serde::Deserialize;

use super::{Client, valid_product_id};
use crate::{
    GogError,
    auth::Api,
    http::{bounded_json, check_status, safe_https_url, send_retrying},
    library::endpoint,
};

/// Concurrent playtime requests: GOG answers one game at a time.
const PLAYTIMES: usize = 12;

/// One achievement of a game, as the account stands with it.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Achievement {
    pub id: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub description: String,
    /// Its unlocked icon once unlocked, else its locked one.
    pub icon_url: String,
    pub hidden: bool,
    pub unlocked: bool,
    /// Seconds since the Unix epoch.
    pub unlock_time: Option<u64>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct Achievements {
    #[serde(default)]
    items: Vec<RawAchievement>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct RawAchievement {
    #[serde(default)]
    achievement_id: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    achievement_key: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    name: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    description: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    image_url_locked: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    image_url_unlocked: String,
    #[serde(default = "visible")]
    visible: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    date_unlocked: Option<String>,
}

fn visible() -> bool {
    true
}

impl From<RawAchievement> for Achievement {
    fn from(raw: RawAchievement) -> Self {
        let unlock_time = raw.date_unlocked.as_deref().and_then(unix_seconds);
        let unlocked = raw.date_unlocked.is_some();
        let icon = match unlocked {
            true => &raw.image_url_unlocked,
            false => &raw.image_url_locked,
        };
        Self {
            id: match raw.achievement_key.is_empty() {
                true => raw.achievement_id,
                false => raw.achievement_key,
            },
            name: raw.name,
            description: raw.description,
            icon_url: safe_https_url(icon).unwrap_or_default(),
            hidden: !raw.visible,
            unlocked,
            unlock_time,
        }
    }
}

impl Client {
    /// The game's achievements, named in `locale`, such as `fr-FR`. A game
    /// without any has none.
    pub async fn achievements(
        &self,
        product_id: &str,
        locale: &str,
    ) -> Result<Vec<Achievement>, GogError> {
        if !valid_product_id(product_id) || locale.len() > 32 {
            return Err(GogError::Protocol);
        }
        let user_id = self.credentials().await?.user_id;
        let url = endpoint(
            &self.tokens.api.gameplay,
            &["clients", product_id, "users", &user_id, "achievements"],
        )?;
        self.with_access_token(|token| {
            let url = url.clone();
            async move {
                let response = self
                    .tokens
                    .api
                    .http
                    .get(url)
                    .bearer_auth(&token)
                    .header("X-Gog-Lc", locale)
                    .send()
                    .await
                    .map_err(|_| GogError::Network)?;
                if response.status() == StatusCode::NOT_FOUND {
                    return Ok(Vec::new());
                }
                check_status(response.status())?;
                let achievements: Achievements = bounded_json(response, 8 * 1024 * 1024).await?;
                Ok(achievements.items.into_iter().map(Into::into).collect())
            }
        })
        .await
    }

    /// How many minutes the account played each of `product_ids`, by product.
    /// A game never played has no entry.
    pub async fn playtimes(
        &self,
        product_ids: &[String],
    ) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, u64>, GogError> {
        let user_id = self.credentials().await?.user_id;
        let user_id = user_id.as_str();
        self.with_access_token(|token| async move {
            let requests: Vec<_> = product_ids
                .iter()
                .filter(|id| valid_product_id(id))
                .map(|id| playtime(&self.tokens.api, &token, user_id, id))
                .collect();
            let played: Vec<Option<(String, u64)>> = stream::iter(requests)
                .buffer_unordered(PLAYTIMES)
                .try_collect()
                .await?;
            Ok(played.into_iter().flatten().collect())
        })
        .await
    }
}

/// The minutes the account played `product_id`, if any. A failed request is
/// tried again once.
async fn playtime(
    api: &Api,
    access_token: &str,
    user_id: &str,
    product_id: &str,
) -> Result<Option<(String, u64)>, GogError> {
    #[derive(Deserialize)]
    struct Sessions {
        #[serde(default)]
        time_sum: u64,
    }
    let url = endpoint(
        &api.gameplay,
        &["games", product_id, "users", user_id, "sessions"],
    )?;
    let request = || api.http.get(url.clone()).bearer_auth(access_token);
    let Some(response) = send_retrying(request, 2, Duration::from_millis(500)).await? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let sessions: Sessions = bounded_json(response, 64 * 1024).await?;
    Ok((sessions.time_sum > 0).then(|| (product_id.to_owned(), sessions.time_sum)))
}

#[cfg(test)]
```

`crates/storefronts/gog-kit/src/client/launch.rs`:

```rs
//! Resolve a verified GOG installation: the play task its `goggame-*.info`
//! file names, and what its build runs once before its game first starts, as
//! heroic-gogdl's `launch.py` and Heroic's `setup.ts` read them. Process
//! execution remains in the native host.
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use obelisk_core::{
    install::read_file_bounded,
    installation::{self, InstallFailure},
    launch::{self, LaunchTarget},
    platform::Platform,
};
use serde::Deserialize;

use super::{Installation, valid_product_id};
use crate::{GogError, manifest::SUPPORT_DIRECTORY};

pub(super) const MAX_INFO_BYTES: usize = 1024 * 1024;

/// The game an installation starts, from its receipt and its own files alone.
/// Nothing is fetched.
pub struct InstalledLaunch {
    pub target: LaunchTarget,
    installation: Installation,
    /// The folder the build's files are in.
    root: PathBuf,
}

/// A program run once in a Windows build's prefix before its game first
/// starts, with its Windows command line.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Prerequisite {
    pub id: String,
    pub program: PathBuf,
    pub arguments: String,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct GameInfo {
    #[serde(default)]
    play_tasks: Vec<PlayTask>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct PlayTask {
    #[serde(rename = "type", default)]
    kind: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    is_primary: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    is_hidden: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    category: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    path: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    working_dir: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    arguments: String,
}

/// What the installation in `directory` starts, from its receipt alone.
pub fn installed_launch(
    product_id: &str,
    platform: Platform,
    directory: &Path,
) -> Result<InstalledLaunch, GogError> {
    if !valid_product_id(product_id) {
        return Err(GogError::Protocol);
    }
    let installed =
        installation::open::<Installation>(directory).map_err(|failure| match failure {
            InstallFailure::Io(_) => launch_error("directoryUnreadable"),
            failure => failure.into(),
        })?;
    let installation = installed
        .receipt
        .ok_or_else(|| launch_error("incompleteInstallation"))?;
    if installation.product_id != product_id || installation.platform != platform {
        return Err(launch_error("incompleteInstallation"));
    }
    let root = match installation.content_root.as_str() {
        "" => installed.root.clone(),
        content => installed
            .root
            .join(obelisk_core::install::safe_relative_path(content)?),
    };
    let task = play_task(&root, product_id)?;
    let path = task.path.replace('\\', "/");
    let working_directory = match task.working_dir.replace('\\', "/") {
        directory if !directory.is_empty() => directory,
        _ => Path::new(&path)
            .parent()
            .and_then(Path::to_str)
            .unwrap_or("")
            .to_owned(),
    };
    let target = launch::resolve(platform, &root, &path, &task.arguments, &working_directory)
        .map_err(|error| launch_error(error.key_suffix()))?;
    Ok(InstalledLaunch {
        target,
        installation,
        root,
    })
}

/// Where a build keeps the file that names its play tasks, from the folder
/// its files are in: that folder, or its bundle's resources.
pub(super) fn info_files(product_id: &str) -> [String; 2] {
    let name = format!("goggame-{product_id}.info");
    [name.clone(), format!("Contents/Resources/{name}")]
}

/// The task Galaxy plays: the primary one, else the first game.
fn play_task(root: &Path, product_id: &str) -> Result<PlayTask, GogError> {
    let bytes = info_files(product_id)
        .iter()
        .find_map(|path| {
            read_file_bounded(&root.join(path), MAX_INFO_BYTES)
                .ok()
                .flatten()
        })
        .ok_or_else(|| launch_error("noPlayTask"))?;
    primary_task(&bytes)
}

/// The program the task Galaxy plays starts, from the folder the build's
/// files are in, as its `goggame-*.info` file's `bytes` name it.
pub(super) fn played_program(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<String> {
    primary_task(bytes)
        .ok()
        .map(|task| task.path.replace('\\', "/"))
}

/// The primary task of an info file, else its first game.
fn primary_task(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<PlayTask, GogError> {
    let info: GameInfo = serde_json::from_slice(bytes).map_err(|_| launch_error("noPlayTask"))?;
    let mut tasks: Vec<PlayTask> = info
        .play_tasks
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|task| task.kind == "FileTask" && !task.path.is_empty())
        .collect();
    let index = tasks
        .iter()
        .position(|task| task.is_primary)
        .or_else(|| tasks.iter().position(|task| task.category == "game"))
        .or_else(|| tasks.iter().position(|task| !task.is_hidden))
        .ok_or_else(|| launch_error("noPlayTask"))?;
    Ok(tasks.swap_remove(index))
}

impl InstalledLaunch {
    /// What a Windows build runs once in its prefix before its game first
    /// starts, in order: its installer scripts, then its redistributables.
    /// `windows_path` names a Mac path as Wine sees it.
    pub fn prerequisites(&self, windows_path: impl Fn(&Path) -> String) -> Vec<Prerequisite> {
        let installation = &self.installation;
        if installation.platform != Platform::Windows {
            return Vec::new();
        }
        let language = &installation.language;
        let name = language_name(language);
        let switches = |product_id: &str| {
            format!(
                "/VERYSILENT \"/DIR={}\" /Language={name} /LANG={name} /ProductId={product_id} \
                 /galaxyclient /buildId={} /versionName={} /lang-code={language} \
                 /nodesktopshorctut /nodesktopshortcut",
                windows_path(&self.root),
                installation.build_id,
                quoted(&installation.version_name),
            )
        };
        let mut prerequisites = Vec::new();
        for product in &installation.products {
            let support = self.root.join(SUPPORT_DIRECTORY).join(&product.product_id);
            if installation.script_interpreter {
                prerequisites.push(Prerequisite {
                    id: format!("isi:{}:{}", product.product_id, installation.build_id),
                    program: self.root.join("__redist/ISI/scriptinterpreter.exe"),
                    arguments: format!(
                        "{} \"/supportDir={}\"",
                        switches(&product.product_id),
                        windows_path(&support)
                    ),
                });
            } else if let Some(installer) = inside(&support, &product.temp_executable) {
                prerequisites.push(Prerequisite {
                    id: format!("installer:{}:{}", product.product_id, installation.build_id),
                    program: installer,
                    arguments: switches(&product.product_id),
                });
            }
        }
        prerequisites.extend(installation.dependencies.iter().filter_map(|dependency| {
            Some(Prerequisite {
                id: dependency.id.clone(),
                program: inside(&self.root, &dependency.path)?,
                arguments: dependency.arguments.clone(),
            })
        }));
        prerequisites
    }
}

/// `relative` inside `root`, unless it is empty or leaves it.
fn inside(root: &Path, relative: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    obelisk_core::install::safe_relative_path(relative)
        .ok()
        .map(|relative| root.join(relative))
}

/// A switch value with spaces, quoted for Windows.
fn quoted(value: &str) -> String {
    match value.contains([' ', '\t']) {
        true => format!("\"{}\"", value.replace('"', "")),
        false => value.to_owned(),
    }
}

/// The English name GOG's installer scripts take for a language.
fn language_name(language: &str) -> &'static str {
    let base = language
        .split(['-', '_'])
        .next()
        .unwrap_or(language)
        .to_ascii_lowercase();
    match base.as_str() {
        "fr" => "French",
        "de" => "German",
        "es" => "Spanish",
        "it" => "Italian",
        "pt" if language.eq_ignore_ascii_case("pt-BR") => "Brazilian-Portuguese",
        "pt" => "Portuguese",
        "pl" => "Polish",
        "ru" => "Russian",
        "cs" | "cz" => "Czech",
        "hu" => "Hungarian",
        "nl" => "Dutch",
        "tr" => "Turkish",
        "ja" | "jp" => "Japanese",
        "ko" => "Korean",
        "zh" => "Chinese",
        _ => "English",
    }
}

fn launch_error(suffix: &str) -> GogError {
    GogError::Service {
        message: format!("backend.gog.launch.{suffix}"),
    }
}
```

`crates/storefronts/gog-kit/src/content.rs`:

```rs
//! Galaxy chunk delivery and atomic installation.
//!
//! The shared chunk engine and the blocking disk worker come from
//! `obelisk_core`, as do path confinement, locking, hashing and progress
//! reporting. Each file is assembled from its chunks in order: a chunk
//! already on disk, in the file's partial copy or at the same place in its
//! installed copy, is reused once its MD5 matches, so a cancelled Transfer
//! resumes and an update downloads only the chunks that changed.
use std::{
    collections::{HashMap, HashSet},
    fs::{self, File, OpenOptions},
    io::{self, Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write},
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    sync::Arc,
    time::{Duration, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH},
};

use md5::{Digest, Md5};
use obelisk_core::{
    install::{
        self, FileDigest, Md5Part, PARTIAL_DIRECTORY, apply_permissions, checked_file_path,
        ensure_directory, hex, safe_relative_path, unhex,
    },
    transfer::{
        self, BodyError, BodySize, CancelToken, Chunks, Delivery, DownloadPhase, DownloadProgress,
        DownloadSummary, Interrupted, Pipeline, Reporter,
    },
    verification::{self, VerificationError, VerificationFile},
};
use reqwest::Url;
use serde::Deserialize;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;

use crate::{
    GogError,
    manifest::{Chunk, Installed, InstalledFile, galaxy_path, relative_target},
};

const CHUNK_CONCURRENCY: usize = 12;
/// Files whose chunks are requested ahead of the one being written.
const FILE_PREFETCH: usize = 8;
const PIPELINE: Pipeline = Pipeline {
    delivery: Delivery::InOrder,
    fetches: CHUNK_CONCURRENCY,
    queue: CHUNK_CONCURRENCY,
};

/// One CDN a product's chunks come from, as its secure link describes it.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize)]
pub(crate) struct Endpoint {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub url: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub url_format: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub parameters: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
    /// Higher first.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub priority: i64,
    /// Tried only once every other endpoint failed.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub fallback_only: bool,
}

impl Endpoint {
    /// The URL of the chunk at `galaxy_path`: the endpoint's `path` parameter
    /// extended with it, or, for an endpoint without parameters such as the
    /// redistributables', its URL.
    pub fn chunk_url(&self, galaxy_path: &str) -> Result<Url, GogError> {
        if !self.parameters.contains_key("path") {
            return checked_url(&format!("{}/{galaxy_path}", self.url.trim_end_matches('/')));
        }
        let mut url = self.url_format.clone();
        for (name, value) in &self.parameters {
            let value = match value {
                serde_json::Value::String(value) => value.clone(),
                serde_json::Value::Number(value) => value.to_string(),
                serde_json::Value::Bool(value) => value.to_string(),
                _ => continue,
            };
            let value = match name.as_str() {
                "path" => format!("{}/{galaxy_path}", value.trim_end_matches('/')),
                _ => value,
            };
            url = url.replace(&format!("{{{name}}}"), &value);
        }
        if url.contains(['{', '}']) {
            return Err(GogError::Protocol);
        }
        checked_url(&url)
    }

    /// Whether the endpoint's signature lapsed, or lapses within a minute.
    fn expired(&self) -> bool {
        let now = SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map(|now| now.as_secs())
            .unwrap_or(0);
        self.parameters
            .get("expires_at")
            .and_then(|value| value.as_u64().or_else(|| value.as_str()?.parse().ok()))
            .is_some_and(|expires| expires <= now + 60)
    }
}

/// Only HTTPS locations without embedded credentials.
pub(crate) fn checked_url(value: &str) -> Result<Url, GogError> {
    let url = Url::parse(value).map_err(|_| GogError::Protocol)?;
    let secure = url.scheme() == "https";
    // Tests serve their CDN on the loopback interface.
    #[cfg(test)]
    let secure = secure || url.scheme() == "http" && url.host_str() == Some("127.0.0.1");
    if !secure
        || url.host_str().is_none()
        || !url.username().is_empty()
        || url.password().is_some()
        || url.fragment().is_some()
    {
        return Err(GogError::Protocol);
    }
    Ok(url)
}

/// Renews a product's secure link with the account's credentials.
pub(crate) type Renew = Arc<
    dyn Fn(String) -> futures_util::future::BoxFuture<'static, Result<Vec<Endpoint>, GogError>>
        + Send
        + Sync,
>;

/// Each product's CDN endpoints, renewed once they lapse.
pub(crate) struct SecureLinks {
    links: Mutex<HashMap<String, Arc<[Endpoint]>>>,
    renew: Renew,
}

impl SecureLinks {
    pub fn new(renew: Renew) -> Self {
        Self {
            links: Mutex::new(HashMap::new()),
            renew,
        }
    }

    /// The product's endpoints, fetched again when they lapsed or `stale`.
    async fn endpoints(&self, product_id: &str, stale: bool) -> Result<Arc<[Endpoint]>, GogError> {
        let mut links = self.links.lock().await;
        match links.get(product_id) {
            Some(endpoints) if !stale && !endpoints.iter().any(Endpoint::expired) => {
                Ok(Arc::clone(endpoints))
            }
            _ => {
                let mut endpoints = (self.renew)(product_id.to_owned()).await?;
                if endpoints.is_empty() || endpoints.len() > 16 {
                    return Err(GogError::Protocol);
                }
                // Fallbacks last, then the highest priority first.
                endpoints.sort_by_key(|endpoint| (endpoint.fallback_only, -endpoint.priority));
                let endpoints: Arc<[Endpoint]> = endpoints.into();
                links.insert(product_id.to_owned(), Arc::clone(&endpoints));
                Ok(endpoints)
            }
        }
    }
}

/// What the disk worker asks the network for: one chunk, and the secure
/// link that serves it.
#[derive(Clone)]
struct Request {
    source: String,
    chunk: Chunk,
}

type ChunkResult = Result<Vec<u8>, GogError>;

/// Installs `installed`, already validated, into `destination` and returns
/// what the Transfer did.
pub(crate) async fn download(
    http: reqwest::Client,
    links: Arc<SecureLinks>,
    installed: Arc<Installed>,
    key: String,
    destination: &Path,
    cancel: &CancelToken,
    progress: impl Fn(DownloadProgress) + Send + Sync + 'static,
) -> Result<DownloadSummary, GogError> {
    cancel.check()?;
    let reporter = Reporter::new(
        DownloadProgress {
            phase: DownloadPhase::Verifying,
            total_bytes: installed.total_bytes(),
            total_files: u32::try_from(installed.files.len()).map_err(|_| GogError::Protocol)?,
            ..Default::default()
        },
        progress,
    );
    let disk = DiskInstall::engine_side(
        destination.to_owned(),
        installed,
        key,
        cancel.clone(),
        Arc::clone(&reporter),
    );
    let reused_bytes = transfer::run_engine(PIPELINE, cancel, disk, |request| {
        fetch_chunk(&http, &links, request, cancel, &reporter)
    })
    .await?;
    Ok(reporter.summary(reused_bytes))
}

/// The first `bytes` of an installation's file, from the chunks that hold
/// them, without installing it.
pub(crate) async fn read(
    http: &reqwest::Client,
    links: &SecureLinks,
    installed: &InstalledFile,
    bytes: u64,
    cancel: &CancelToken,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, GogError> {
    let reporter = Reporter::new(DownloadProgress::default(), |_| {});
    let mut output = Vec::new();
    for chunk in &installed.file.chunks {
        if output.len() as u64 >= bytes {
            break;
        }
        let request = Request {
            source: installed.source.clone(),
            chunk: chunk.clone(),
        };
        output.extend(fetch_chunk(http, links, request, cancel, &reporter).await?);
    }
    output.truncate(usize::try_from(bytes).unwrap_or(usize::MAX));
    Ok(output)
}

async fn fetch_chunk(
    http: &reqwest::Client,
    links: &SecureLinks,
    request: Request,
    cancel: &CancelToken,
    reporter: &Reporter,
) -> ChunkResult {
    let path = galaxy_path(&request.chunk.compressed_md5)?;
    let mut failure = GogError::Network;
    let mut stale = false;
    for attempt in 0..4 {
        cancel.check()?;
        let endpoints = links.endpoints(&request.source, stale).await?;
        stale = false;
        for endpoint in endpoints.iter() {
            let url = endpoint.chunk_url(&path)?;
            reporter.update(|status| status.phase = DownloadPhase::Downloading);
            match fetch(http, url, request.chunk.compressed_size, cancel, reporter).await {
                Ok(bytes) => {
                    let chunk = request.chunk.clone();
                    match cancel
                        .spawn_blocking(move || decode_chunk(&bytes, &chunk))
                        .await
                        .map_err(|_| GogError::Protocol)?
                    {
                        Ok(bytes) => return Ok(bytes),
                        Err(error) => failure = error,
                    }
                }
                Err(GogError::Cancelled) => return Err(GogError::Cancelled),
                // A lapsed signature: the next attempt renews the link.
                Err(error @ GogError::Http(401 | 403 | 410)) => {
                    stale = true;
                    failure = error;
                    break;
                }
                Err(error) => failure = error,
            }
        }
        if attempt < 3 {
            cancel
                .race(tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(
                    250 * (attempt + 1),
                )))
                .await?;
        }
    }
    Err(failure)
}

async fn fetch(
    http: &reqwest::Client,
    url: Url,
    expected: u64,
    cancel: &CancelToken,
    reporter: &Reporter,
) -> ChunkResult {
    let response = cancel
        .race(http.get(url).timeout(Duration::from_secs(60)).send())
        .await?
        .map_err(|_| GogError::Network)?;
    if !response.status().is_success() {
        return Err(GogError::Http(response.status().as_u16()));
    }
    Ok(transfer::read_body(
        response.content_length(),
        response.bytes_stream(),
        BodySize::Exactly(expected),
        cancel,
        |length| {
            reporter.update(|status| {
                status.network_bytes += length;
                status.content_bytes += length;
            });
        },
    )
    .await?)
}

/// A chunk's zlib stream, checked before and after it inflates.
pub(crate) fn decode_chunk(bytes: &[u8], chunk: &Chunk) -> ChunkResult {
    if bytes.len() as u64 != chunk.compressed_size || !md5_is(bytes, &chunk.compressed_md5) {
        return Err(GogError::Integrity);
    }
    let mut decoder = flate2::read::ZlibDecoder::new(bytes);
    let mut output = Vec::with_capacity(chunk.size as usize);
    decoder
        .by_ref()
        .take(chunk.size + 1)
        .read_to_end(&mut output)
        .map_err(|_| GogError::Integrity)?;
    if output.len() as u64 != chunk.size || !md5_is(&output, &chunk.md5) {
        return Err(GogError::Integrity);
    }
    Ok(output)
}

impl From<Interrupted> for GogError {
    fn from(_: Interrupted) -> Self {
        Self::Protocol
    }
}

impl From<BodyError> for GogError {
    fn from(error: BodyError) -> Self {
        match error {
            BodyError::Network => Self::Network,
            // The manifest names each chunk's exact size.
            BodyError::Size => Self::Integrity,
            BodyError::Cancelled => Self::Cancelled,
        }
    }
}

/// An installation's file as the shared verification scheduler reads it.
struct Verified<'a> {
    installed: &'a InstalledFile,
    parts: Vec<Md5Part>,
}

impl VerificationFile for Verified<'_> {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        &self.installed.path
    }
    fn size(&self) -> u64 {
        self.installed.file.size()
    }
    fn digest(&self) -> FileDigest<'_> {
        FileDigest::Md5Parts(&self.parts)
    }
}

impl From<VerificationError> for GogError {
    fn from(error: VerificationError) -> Self {
        match error {
            VerificationError::Cancelled => Self::Cancelled,
            VerificationError::Install(error) => error.into(),
            VerificationError::SchedulerFailed => Self::Protocol,
        }
    }
}

fn md5_is(bytes: &[u8], expected: &str) -> bool {
    unhex::<16>(expected).is_some_and(|expected| Md5::digest(bytes)[..] == expected)
}

fn parts(chunks: &[Chunk]) -> Result<Vec<Md5Part>, GogError> {
    chunks
        .iter()
        .map(|chunk| {
            Ok(Md5Part {
                size: chunk.size,
                md5: unhex(&chunk.md5).ok_or(GogError::Protocol)?,
            })
        })
        .collect()
}

/// Where one chunk of a file comes from.
#[derive(Clone)]
enum Source {
    /// The same place in a copy already on disk, whose MD5 matched.
    Reused(PathBuf),
    Download,
}

struct PlannedFile {
    index: usize,
    sources: Vec<Source>,
}

struct DiskInstall {
    destination: PathBuf,
    installed: Arc<Installed>,
    /// Names this build's partial files.
    key: String,
    cancel: CancelToken,
    reporter: Arc<Reporter>,
    chunks: Chunks<Request, Vec<u8>, GogError>,
    planned: std::collections::VecDeque<PlannedFile>,
    next_file: usize,
}

impl DiskInstall {
    /// The disk side of one engine run, from its first file.
    fn engine_side(
        destination: PathBuf,
        installed: Arc<Installed>,
        key: String,
        cancel: CancelToken,
        reporter: Arc<Reporter>,
    ) -> impl FnOnce(Chunks<Request, Vec<u8>, GogError>) -> Result<u64, GogError> + Send + 'static
    {
        move |chunks| {
            Self {
                destination,
                installed,
                key,
                cancel,
                reporter,
                chunks,
                planned: Default::default(),
                next_file: 0,
            }
            .run()
        }
    }

    /// Returns the number of verified bytes reused from disk.
    fn run(mut self) -> Result<u64, GogError> {
        self.cancel.check()?;
        fs::create_dir_all(&self.destination)?;
        let root = fs::canonicalize(&self.destination)?;
        let _lock = install::lock_engine(&root)?.ok_or(GogError::AlreadyDownloading)?;
        let installed = Arc::clone(&self.installed);
        let partial_relative = PathBuf::from(PARTIAL_DIRECTORY).join("gog").join(&self.key);
        let partial_root = ensure_directory(&root, &partial_relative)?;
        let checked = installed
            .files
            .iter()
            .map(|installed| {
                Ok(Verified {
                    installed,
                    parts: parts(&installed.file.chunks)?,
                })
            })
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, GogError>>()?;
        let verified = verification::verify_files(&root, &checked, &self.cancel, &self.reporter)?;
        let mut reused_bytes = verified.reused_bytes;
        for directory in &installed.directories {
            ensure_directory(&root, &safe_relative_path(directory)?)?;
        }
        self.plan_ahead(&verified, &checked, &partial_root, &root)?;
        let mut ensured_parents: HashSet<PathBuf> = HashSet::new();
        for (index, (file, valid)) in checked.iter().zip(&verified.valid).enumerate() {
            self.cancel.check()?;
            let relative = safe_relative_path(&file.installed.path)?;
            let parent = relative.parent().unwrap_or(Path::new(""));
            if ensured_parents.insert(parent.to_path_buf()) {
                ensure_directory(&root, parent)?;
            }
            let target = checked_file_path(&root, &relative)?;
            if *valid {
                apply_permissions(&target, is_executable(&file.installed.file, &target)?)?;
                continue;
            }
            self.reporter.update(|status| {
                status.current_file.clone_from(&file.installed.path);
            });
            let plan = self.planned.pop_front().ok_or(GogError::Protocol)?;
            if plan.index != index {
                return Err(GogError::Protocol);
            }
            reused_bytes += self.assemble(file, &plan, &partial_root, &target)?;
            self.reporter.update(|status| status.completed_files += 1);
            self.plan_ahead(&verified, &checked, &partial_root, &root)?;
        }
        self.cancel.check()?;
        for link in &installed.links {
            place_link(&root, &link.path, &link.target)?;
        }
        // Partial copies stay only after a failure or a cancellation.
        fs::remove_dir_all(partial_root)?;
        Ok(reused_bytes)
    }

    /// Plans the next few files to repair: which chunks a copy on disk
    /// already holds, and requests the rest, in the order they are written.
    /// The target's leading chunks that `verified` matched are not read again.
    fn plan_ahead(
        &mut self,
        verified: &verification::Verified,
        files: &[Verified<'_>],
        partial_root: &Path,
        root: &Path,
    ) -> Result<(), GogError> {
        while self.planned.len() < FILE_PREFETCH
            && self.next_file < files.len()
            && !self.chunks.refused()
        {
            self.cancel.check()?;
            let index = self.next_file;
            self.next_file += 1;
            if verified.valid[index] {
                continue;
            }
            let file = &files[index].installed;
            let partial = checked_file_path(partial_root, Path::new(&partial_name(&file.path)))?;
            let target = checked_file_path(root, &safe_relative_path(&file.path)?)?;
            let mut sources = Vec::with_capacity(file.file.chunks.len());
            let mut offset = 0;
            for (part, chunk) in file.file.chunks.iter().enumerate() {
                self.cancel.check()?;
                let holds =
                    |copy: &Path| copy_chunk(copy, offset, chunk, &mut io::sink()).unwrap_or(false);
                let reused = if holds(&partial) {
                    Some(&partial)
                } else if part < verified.matched_parts[index] || holds(&target) {
                    Some(&target)
                } else {
                    None
                };
                if let Some(copy) = reused {
                    sources.push(Source::Reused(copy.clone()));
                } else if self.chunks.request(Request {
                    source: file.source.clone(),
                    chunk: chunk.clone(),
                }) {
                    sources.push(Source::Download);
                } else {
                    // Every remaining place receives the outcome that stopped
                    // the network side: the file stays fully planned, so it is
                    // never published short.
                    sources.resize(file.file.chunks.len(), Source::Download);
                    break;
                }
                offset += chunk.size;
            }
            self.planned.push_back(PlannedFile { index, sources });
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Writes the file's chunks in order into a fresh partial copy, checks
    /// each one, then publishes the file atomically.
    fn assemble(
        &mut self,
        file: &Verified<'_>,
        plan: &PlannedFile,
        partial_root: &Path,
        target: &Path,
    ) -> Result<u64, GogError> {
        let name = partial_name(&file.installed.path);
        let partial = checked_file_path(partial_root, Path::new(&name))?;
        let next = checked_file_path(partial_root, Path::new(&format!("{name}.next")))?;
        let mut output = OpenOptions::new()
            .create(true)
            .truncate(true)
            .write(true)
            .open(&next)?;
        let mut reused_bytes = 0;
        let mut offset = 0;
        for (chunk, source) in file.installed.file.chunks.iter().zip(&plan.sources) {
            self.cancel.check()?;
            match source {
                Source::Download => {
                    self.reporter
                        .update(|status| status.phase = DownloadPhase::Downloading);
                    output.write_all(&self.chunks.receive()?)?;
                }
                Source::Reused(copy) => {
                    reused_bytes += chunk.size;
                    if !copy_chunk(copy, offset, chunk, &mut output)? {
                        return Err(GogError::Integrity);
                    }
                }
            }
            offset += chunk.size;
            // A partial copy that lasts across a cancellation keeps what was
            // written: the next attempt reuses it.
            self.reporter
                .update(|status| status.completed_bytes += chunk.size);
        }
        self.cancel.check()?;
        output.sync_all()?;
        drop(output);
        fs::rename(&next, &partial)?;
        apply_permissions(&partial, is_executable(&file.installed.file, &partial)?)?;
        self.cancel.check()?;
        fs::rename(&partial, target)?;
        File::open(target.parent().ok_or(GogError::Protocol)?)?.sync_all()?;
        Ok(reused_bytes)
    }
}

/// The partial copy of the file at `path`.
fn partial_name(path: &str) -> String {
    format!("{}.part", hex(&Md5::digest(path.to_lowercase().as_bytes())))
}

/// Streams the chunk at `offset` in `copy` into `output` in 64 KiB reads;
/// `false` when `copy` is too short to hold it or its MD5 differs.
fn copy_chunk(
    copy: &Path,
    offset: u64,
    chunk: &Chunk,
    output: &mut impl Write,
) -> Result<bool, GogError> {
    let expected: [u8; 16] = unhex(&chunk.md5).ok_or(GogError::Protocol)?;
    let mut file = match File::open(copy) {
        Ok(file) => file,
        Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(false),
        Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
    };
    if file.metadata()?.len() < offset + chunk.size {
        return Ok(false);
    }
    file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(offset))?;
    let mut hasher = Md5::new();
    let mut buffer = [0_u8; 64 * 1024];
    let mut remaining = chunk.size;
    while remaining > 0 {
        let count = buffer
            .len()
            .min(usize::try_from(remaining).unwrap_or(usize::MAX));
        file.read_exact(&mut buffer[..count])?;
        hasher.update(&buffer[..count]);
        output.write_all(&buffer[..count])?;
        remaining -= count as u64;
    }
    Ok(hasher.finalize()[..] == expected)
}

/// Places the link at `path` to `target`, both from the installation's root,
/// replacing whatever an earlier build left there. The link is relative, so
/// it keeps its target wherever the installation goes.
fn place_link(root: &Path, path: &str, target: &str) -> Result<(), GogError> {
    let relative = safe_relative_path(path)?;
    safe_relative_path(target)?;
    install::place_link(root, &relative, Path::new(&relative_target(path, target)))?;
    Ok(())
}

/// Galaxy flags executables, but some builds miss the flag on helpers their
/// game starts: programs are also recognised by their header.
fn is_executable(file: &crate::manifest::File, path: &Path) -> std::io::Result<bool> {
    Ok(file.executable() || install::starts_as_program(path)?)
}
```

```rs
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    io::{BufRead, BufReader},
    net::{TcpListener, TcpStream},
    os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt,
    sync::Mutex as StdMutex,
    thread,
};

use futures_util::FutureExt;
use serde_json::json;
use tokio::sync::mpsc;

use super::*;
use crate::manifest::{DepotManifest, Installed};

/// A CDN on the loopback interface that serves fixed chunks and records
/// every request.
struct Cdn {
    base: String,
    requests: Arc<StdMutex<Vec<String>>>,
}

impl Cdn {
    fn new(responses: HashMap<String, Vec<u8>>) -> Self {
        let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
        let base = format!("http://{}/store", listener.local_addr().unwrap());
        let requests = Arc::new(StdMutex::new(Vec::new()));
        let recorded = requests.clone();
        thread::spawn(move || {
            for socket in listener.incoming().flatten() {
                serve(socket, &responses, &recorded);
            }
        });
        Self { base, requests }
    }

    fn requests(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        std::mem::take(&mut *self.requests.lock().unwrap())
    }
}

fn serve(
    socket: TcpStream,
    responses: &HashMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
    requests: &StdMutex<Vec<String>>,
) {
    let mut reader = BufReader::new(socket.try_clone().unwrap());
    let mut line = String::new();
    reader.read_line(&mut line).unwrap();
    let path = line
        .split_whitespace()
        .nth(1)
        .unwrap_or_default()
        .to_owned();
    loop {
        let mut header = String::new();
        if reader.read_line(&mut header).unwrap() <= 2 {
            break;
        }
    }
    requests.lock().unwrap().push(path.clone());
    let mut socket = socket;
    match responses.get(&path) {
        Some(body) => {
            write!(
                socket,
                "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
                body.len()
            )
            .unwrap();
            socket.write_all(body).unwrap();
        }
        None => write!(
            socket,
            "HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
        )
        .unwrap(),
    }
}

fn md5_hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    hex(&Md5::digest(bytes))
}

fn compressed(bytes: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut encoder = flate2::write::ZlibEncoder::new(Vec::new(), flate2::Compression::default());
    encoder.write_all(bytes).unwrap();
    encoder.finish().unwrap()
}

/// A depot whose files are made of `chunks`, served by the CDN it returns.
struct Fixture {
    cdn: Cdn,
    installed: Arc<Installed>,
    chunks: HashMap<&'static str, (Vec<u8>, String)>,
}

fn fixture() -> Fixture {
    fixture_serving(|_, _| {})
}

/// `fixture`, with `edit` changing the body the CDN serves for a named chunk.
fn fixture_serving(edit: impl Fn(&str, &mut Vec<u8>)) -> Fixture {
    let parts: [(&str, &[u8]); 3] = [
        ("a", b"first part "),
        ("b", b"second"),
        ("tool", b"\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe tool"),
    ];
    let mut responses = HashMap::new();
    let mut chunks = HashMap::new();
    let mut described = HashMap::new();
    for (name, bytes) in parts {
        let packed = compressed(bytes);
        let path = format!("/store/{}", galaxy_path(&md5_hex(&packed)).unwrap());
        let mut served = packed.clone();
        edit(name, &mut served);
        responses.insert(path.clone(), served);
        chunks.insert(name, (bytes.to_vec(), path));
        described.insert(
            name,
            json!({"md5": md5_hex(bytes), "size": bytes.len(), "compressedMd5": md5_hex(&packed),
                   "compressedSize": packed.len()}),
        );
    }
    let manifest: DepotManifest = serde_json::from_value(json!({"depot": {"items": [
        {"type": "DepotFile", "path": "Game\\game.exe", "chunks": [described["a"], described["b"]]},
        {"type": "DepotFile", "path": "empty.txt", "chunks": []},
        {"type": "DepotFile", "path": "bin/tool", "chunks": [described["tool"]]},
        {"type": "DepotDirectory", "path": "saves"},
        {"type": "DepotLink", "path": "bin/current", "target": "Game/game.exe"},
    ]}}))
    .unwrap();
    let mut installed = Installed::default();
    installed
        .add("", "1207658924", manifest.depot.items)
        .unwrap();
    Fixture {
        cdn: Cdn::new(responses),
        installed: Arc::new(installed),
        chunks,
    }
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn a_corrupt_chunk_fails_the_transfer() {
    let fixture = fixture();
    let (bytes, _) = &fixture.chunks["a"];
    let mut chunk: crate::manifest::Chunk = serde_json::from_value(json!({
        "md5": md5_hex(bytes), "size": bytes.len(), "compressedMd5": md5_hex(b"other"), "compressedSize": 5,
    }))
    .unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(

/// Each chunk's file and decoded bytes, by the chunk's MD5.
type Decoded = HashMap<String, (usize, Vec<u8>)>;

/// `FILE_PREFETCH + 2` files of one chunk each, and what their chunks decode to.
fn one_chunk_files() -> (Arc<Installed>, Decoded) {
    let mut decoded = HashMap::new();
    let items: Vec<_> = (0..FILE_PREFETCH + 2)
        .map(|index| {
            let bytes = format!("file {index}").into_bytes();
            let packed = compressed(&bytes);
            let item = json!({"type": "DepotFile", "path": format!("file-{index:02}"), "chunks": [
                {"md5": md5_hex(&bytes), "size": bytes.len(), "compressedMd5": md5_hex(&packed),
                 "compressedSize": packed.len()},
            ]});
            decoded.insert(md5_hex(&bytes), (index, bytes));
            item
        })
        .collect();
    let manifest: DepotManifest =
        serde_json::from_value(json!({"depot": {"items": items}})).unwrap();
    let mut installed = Installed::default();
    installed
        .add("", "1207658924", manifest.depot.items)
        .unwrap();
    (Arc::new(installed), decoded)
}

/// How long a scripted install may wait on either side before the test fails.
const WAIT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);

/// A disk side installing `one_chunk_files` with no engine behind it. The test
/// plays the network side: it takes `requests` and queues `outcomes`.
struct ScriptedInstall {
    disk: tokio::task::JoinHandle<Result<u64, GogError>>,
    requests: mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<Request>,
    outcomes: mpsc::Sender<ChunkResult>,
    decoded: Decoded,
}

impl ScriptedInstall {
    fn start(
        root: &Path,
        cancel: &CancelToken,
        progress: impl Fn(DownloadProgress) + Send + Sync + 'static,
    ) -> Self {
        let (installed, decoded) = one_chunk_files();
        let (chunks, requests, outcomes) = Chunks::detached(PIPELINE.queue);
        let disk = DiskInstall::engine_side(
            root.to_owned(),
            installed,
            "build".into(),
            cancel.clone(),
            Reporter::new(DownloadProgress::default(), progress),
        );
        Self {
            disk: tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || disk(chunks)),
            requests,
            outcomes,
            decoded,
        }
    }

    /// Takes the next `count` requests: each chunk's file and decoded bytes.
    async fn take(&mut self, count: usize) -> Vec<(usize, Vec<u8>)> {
        let mut taken = Vec::with_capacity(count);
        for _ in 0..count {
            let request = tokio::time::timeout(WAIT, self.requests.recv())
                .await
                .expect("the disk side requests its window")
                .unwrap();
            taken.push(self.decoded[&request.chunk.md5].clone());
        }
        taken
    }

    async fn outcome(self) -> Result<u64, GogError> {
        tokio::time::timeout(WAIT, self.disk)
            .await
            .expect("the disk side ends")
            .unwrap()
    }
}

fn partial_root(root: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    root.join(PARTIAL_DIRECTORY).join("gog").join("build")
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn a_failed_chunk_reports_its_own_error_not_protocol() {
    // Red check: with `plan_ahead` returning `Protocol` when `request` is
    // refused, as it did before the shared engine, this returned `Protocol`.
    let folder = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let root = folder.path().join("game");
    let mut network = ScriptedInstall::start(&root, &CancelToken::new(), |_| {});

    let window = network.take(FILE_PREFETCH).await;
    assert!(
        window.iter().map(|(index, _)| *index).eq(0..FILE_PREFETCH),
        "the first files are planned in order"
    );
    // The network side stops here, as after a chunk that failed for good:
    // the disk side blocks on file 0, so its refill always meets the refusal.
    network.requests.close();
    for outcome in [
        Ok(window[0].1.clone()),
        Ok(window[1].1.clone()),
        Err(GogError::Http(404)),
    ] {
        network.outcomes.send(outcome).await.unwrap();
    }
    let result = network.outcome().await;

    assert!(
        matches!(result, Err(GogError::Http(404))),
        "{:?}",
        result.err()
    );
    assert_eq!(fs::read(root.join("file-00")).unwrap(), b"file 0");
    assert_eq!(fs::read(root.join("file-01")).unwrap(), b"file 1");
    assert!(!root.join("file-02").exists());
    assert!(partial_root(&root).is_dir(), "kept for the next attempt");
    assert!(install::lock_engine(&root).unwrap().is_some());
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn a_cancelled_transfer_reports_cancelled_not_protocol() {
    let folder = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let root = folder.path().join("game");
    let cancel = CancelToken::new();
    let progress = {
        let cancel = cancel.clone();
        move |snapshot: DownloadProgress| {
            if snapshot.completed_files == 1 {
                cancel.cancel();
            }
        }
    };
    let mut network = ScriptedInstall::start(&root, &cancel, progress);

    let window = network.take(FILE_PREFETCH).await;
    network
        .outcomes
        .send(Ok(window[0].1.clone()))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    // What the engine does on a cancellation. The disk side may already have
    // seen it and gone, so the send may find nobody.
    tokio::time::timeout(WAIT, cancel.cancelled())
        .await
        .expect("file 0's progress cancels");
    let _ = network.outcomes.send(Err(GogError::Cancelled)).await;
    network.requests.close();
    let result = network.outcome().await;

    assert!(
        matches!(result, Err(GogError::Cancelled)),
        "{:?}",
        result.err()
    );
    assert_eq!(fs::read(root.join("file-00")).unwrap(), b"file 0");
    assert!(partial_root(&root).is_dir(), "kept for the next attempt");
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn a_chunk_with_a_wrong_length_fails_as_integrity() {
    let fixture = fixture_serving(|name, body| {
        if name == "a" {
            body.push(0);
        }
    });
    let folder = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let root = folder.path().join("gog-1207658924-windows");

    let result = fixture.install(&root).await;

    assert!(
        matches!(result, Err(GogError::Integrity)),
        "{:?}",
        result.err()
    );
    let path = &fixture.chunks["a"].1;
    let asked = fixture
        .cdn
        .requests()
        .iter()
        .filter(|request| *request == path)
        .count();
    assert_eq!(asked, 4, "every round asks again before the chunk fails");
    assert!(!root.join("Game/game.exe").exists());

    // The decode's MD5 check would refuse this body too. Fetched alone, the
    // exact bound refuses its advertised length before a byte is read.
    let (bytes, path) = &fixture.chunks["a"];
    let url = Url::parse(&fixture.cdn.base).unwrap().join(path).unwrap();
    let reporter = Reporter::new(DownloadProgress::default(), |_| {});
    let fetched = fetch(
        &crate::http::client().unwrap(),
        url,
        compressed(bytes).len() as u64,
        &CancelToken::new(),
        &reporter,
    )
    .await;
    assert!(matches!(fetched, Err(GogError::Integrity)));
    assert_eq!(reporter.snapshot().network_bytes, 0);
}

#[test]
fn chunk_urls_extend_the_endpoints_path() {
    let endpoint: Endpoint = serde_json::from_value(json!({
        "endpoint_name": "fastly",
        "url_format": "{base_url}/token=nva={expires_at}~dirs={dirs}~token={token}{path}",
        "parameters": {
            "base_url": "https://gog-cdn-fastly.gog.com",
            "path": "/content-system/v2/store/1207658924",
            "expires_at": 1_700_000_000,
            "dirs": 4,
            "token": "signed"
        },
        "priority": 10,
        "fallback_only": false
    }))
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        endpoint.chunk_url("ab/cd/abcd").unwrap().as_str(),
        "https://gog-cdn-fastly.gog.com/token=nva=1700000000~dirs=4~token=signed/content-system/v2/store/1207658924/ab/cd/abcd"
    );
    assert!(endpoint.expired());
    let open: Endpoint = serde_json::from_value(json!({
        "url": "https://gog-cdn-fastly.gog.com/content-system/v2/dependencies/store",
        "url_format": "https://gog-cdn-fastly.gog.com/content-system/v2/dependencies/store",
        "parameters": {}
    }))
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        open.chunk_url("ab/cd/abcd").unwrap().as_str(),
        "https://gog-cdn-fastly.gog.com/content-system/v2/dependencies/store/ab/cd/abcd"
    );
    let unknown: Endpoint = serde_json::from_value(json!({
        "url_format": "{base_url}{missing}{path}",
        "parameters": {"base_url": "https://cdn", "path": "/p"}
    }))
    .unwrap();
    assert!(unknown.chunk_url("ab/cd/abcd").is_err());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn endpoints_put_fallbacks_last_and_renew_once_stale() {
    let renewals = Arc::new(StdMutex::new(0));
    let counted = renewals.clone();
    let links = SecureLinks::new(Arc::new(move |_| {
        *counted.lock().unwrap() += 1;
        let endpoints: Vec<Endpoint> = serde_json::from_value(json!([
            {"url": "https://fallback", "priority": 20, "fallback_only": true},
            {"url": "https://low", "priority": 1},
            {"url": "https://high", "priority": 10},
        ]))
        .unwrap();
        async move { Ok(endpoints) }.boxed()
    }));
    let order: Vec<_> = links
        .endpoints("1", false)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .iter()
        .map(|endpoint| endpoint.url.clone())
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(order, ["https://high", "https://low", "https://fallback"]);
    links.endpoints("1", false).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(*renewals.lock().unwrap(), 1);
    links.endpoints("1", true).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(*renewals.lock().unwrap(), 2);
}
```
