`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/client/build_choice.rs`:

```rs
//! Steam's answers to the build choice: the builds the account's licenses
//! grant, and a Mac build's depot manifests, read to find the program and
//! Steam API library a launch would start.
use std::{collections::HashMap, sync::Arc};

use obelisk_core::{
    build_choice::{GameBuilds, Inspection, Offered},
    mac_build,
    platform::Platform,
};

use super::{
    Client, ClientError, DepotAuthorization, MacBuild, installable_builds, select_depots,
    shared_sources,
};
use crate::{
    cm::{AppInfo, ContentLicenses},
    content::{CachedManifest, CancelToken, ContentClient, DepotFiles, DepotSource},
};

/// The account's licenses and a game's PICS metadata, from which both of
/// its builds are selected.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(super) struct Licensed {
    pub(super) owned: Arc<ContentLicenses>,
    pub(super) app: Arc<AppInfo>,
}

impl Licensed {
    /// The builds offered, of the Mac build and the Windows build, each
    /// when the account's licenses select depots of it.
    pub(super) fn offered(self, mac: bool, windows: bool) -> Offered<Licensed> {
        Offered {
            mac: mac.then(|| self.clone()),
            windows: windows.then_some(self),
        }
    }
}

/// A game the account owns, with the depots of `language`.
pub(super) struct OwnedApp<'a> {
    pub(super) client: &'a Client,
    pub(super) app_id: u32,
    pub(super) language: &'a str,
}

impl GameBuilds for OwnedApp<'_> {
    type Build = Licensed;
    type Key = MacBuild;
    type Kept = HashMap<(u32, u64), CachedManifest>;
    type Error = ClientError;

    async fn builds(&self) -> Result<Offered<Licensed>, ClientError> {
        let (owned, app) = self.client.owned_app(self.app_id).await?;
        let (mac, windows) = installable_builds(&app, &owned, self.language);
        Ok(Licensed { owned, app }.offered(mac, windows))
    }

    /// A build without a Mac launch configuration has no program to read,
    /// so it keeps no verdict.
    async fn key(&self, mac: &Licensed) -> Result<Option<MacBuild>, ClientError> {
        if crate::launch::configuration(&mac.app, Platform::Mac).is_none() {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        self.client
            .mac_build(&mac.app, &mac.owned, self.language)
            .await
            .map(Some)
    }

    /// Whether the build's program and its Steam API library hold arm64
    /// slices, as a launch would start them. It reads their first bytes from
    /// the build's depots.
    async fn inspect(
        &self,
        mac: &Licensed,
        cancel: &CancelToken,
    ) -> Result<Inspection<Self::Kept>, ClientError> {
        let Some(executable) = crate::launch::configuration(&mac.app, Platform::Mac)
            .map(|config| config.executable.clone())
        else {
            return Ok(Inspection::NotNative);
        };
        let (client, app) = (self.client, &*mac.app);
        let selected = select_depots(app, &mac.owned, Platform::Mac, self.language);
        let sources = client
            .cached_app_infos(&shared_sources(app, &selected))
            .await?;
        let servers = client.content_servers(app.app_id).await?;
        let mut depots = Vec::new();
        for depot in &selected {
            if let Some(prepared) = client.prepare_depot(app, depot, &sources, cancel).await? {
                let request_code = client
                    .cm
                    .manifest_request_code(
                        prepared.depot_id,
                        prepared.authorizing_app,
                        prepared.manifest_id,
                    )
                    .await?;
                depots.push((prepared, request_code));
            }
        }
        let authorizations: Vec<_> = depots
            .iter()
            .map(|(depot, _)| DepotAuthorization {
                cm: &client.cm,
                app_id: depot.authorizing_app,
                depot_id: depot.depot_id,
            })
            .collect();
        let content = ContentClient::new(client.http.clone());
        let mut files = Vec::new();
        let mut listing = mac_build::Listing::default();
        for ((depot, request_code), authorization) in depots.iter().zip(&authorizations) {
            let source = DepotSource {
                depot_id: depot.depot_id,
                manifest_id: depot.manifest_id,
                request_code: *request_code,
                depot_key: depot.key,
                servers: &servers,
                authorization: Some(authorization),
            };
            let depot_files = content.depot_files(source, cancel).await?;
            depot_files.list(&mut listing, files.len());
            files.push(depot_files);
        }
        let read = |(depot, file): (usize, usize), bytes: u64| {
            let files: &Vec<_> = &files;
            files[depot].read(file, bytes, cancel)
        };
        let native =
            mac_build::runs_natively(&listing, &executable, &["libsteam_api.dylib"], read).await?;
        Ok(match native {
            true => Inspection::Native(files.into_iter().map(DepotFiles::into_manifest).collect()),
            false => Inspection::NotNative,
        })
    }
}
```

```rs
use super::*;
use crate::cloud::{
    CloudError, deadline,
    upload::{sync, write_private},
};
use std::{fs, os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt};

#[cfg(debug_assertions)]
mod interruption_probe;

impl Client {
    /// Publisher metadata and Mac manifests. Never downloads or mutates saves.
    #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
    pub async fn cloud_autocloud_metadata(&self) -> Result<String, CloudError> {
        deadline(240, async {
            let cm = &self.cm;
            let games = cm.owned_games().await?;
            let mut apps = Vec::new();
            let mut inspected = 0;
            for batch in games.chunks(30) {
                if !self.cloud_authorized() {
                    return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
                }
                let ids: Vec<_> = batch.iter().map(|g| g.app_id).collect();
                for app in cm.app_infos(&ids).await? {
                    inspected += 1;
                    if let Some(ufs) = app.cloud {
                        let listing = if app.os_list.iter().any(|os| os == "macos")
                            && ufs.field("savefiles").is_some()
                        {
                            Some(cm.cloud_listing(app.app_id).await?)
                        } else {
                            None
                        };
                        apps.push(serde_json::json!({"app_id":app.app_id,
                            "name":app.name,"os_list":app.os_list,"ufs":ufs,
                            "listing":listing}));
                    }
                }
            }
            serde_json::to_string_pretty(&serde_json::json!({
                "operation":"read_only_autocloud_metadata", "inspected":inspected,
                "owned_count":games.len(), "apps":apps
            }))
            .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)
        })
        .await
    }
    /// Whether Cloud transfers may still run. Sign-out clears this; UI closure
    /// and lost IPC do not.
    pub(crate) fn cloud_authorized(&self) -> bool {
        self.cloud_authorized
            .load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire)
    }
    /// Read-only discovery of owned, empty Cloud namespaces for isolated SDK
    /// validation. This neither acquires licenses nor starts native sync.
    #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
    pub async fn cloud_sdk_candidates(&self) -> Result<String, CloudError> {
        let cm = &self.cm;
        let games = cm.owned_games().await?;
        let mut candidates = Vec::new();
        let mut inspected = 0;
        for batch in games.chunks(30).take(4) {
            let ids: Vec<_> = batch.iter().map(|g| g.app_id).collect();
            for app in cm.app_infos(&ids).await? {
                if !self.cloud_authorized() {
                    return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
                }
                inspected += 1;
                let Some(ufs) = app.cloud else {
                    continue;
                };
                // An empty explicit AutoCloud rule list still needs its own
                // interpretation; require an absent list for this SDK probe.
                if ufs.field("savefiles").is_some() {
                    continue;
                }
                let quota = match cm.cloud_quota(app.app_id).await {
                    Ok(q)
                        if q.max_bytes.is_some_and(|n| n >= 1024)
                            && q.max_files.is_some_and(|n| n >= 2)
                            && q.existing_files == Some(0)
                            && q.existing_bytes == Some(0) =>
                    {
                        q
                    }
                    _ => continue,
                };
                let listing = cm.cloud_listing(app.app_id).await?;
                if listing.files.iter().any(|f| f.persist_state == 0) {
                    continue;
                }
                candidates.push(serde_json::json!({"app_id":app.app_id,
                    "name":batch.iter().find(|g| g.app_id == app.app_id).map(|g| &g.name),
                    "quota":quota,"revision":listing.change_number,"ufs":ufs}));
                if candidates.len() == 3 {
                    break;
                }
            }
            if candidates.len() == 3 {
                break;
            }
        }
        serde_json::to_string_pretty(
            &serde_json::json!({"operation":"read_only_sdk_candidate_search",
            "inspected":inspected,"candidates":candidates}),
        )
        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)
    }
    /// Live rules and remote identities for preserving local saves before
    /// uninstall. This reads CM metadata only; it does not transfer save bytes.
    pub async fn cloud_archive_metadata(
        &self,
        app_id: u32,
    ) -> Result<Option<(crate::cloud::CloudMetadata, crate::cloud::CloudListing)>, CloudError> {
        deadline(120, async {
            if !self.cloud_authorized() {
                return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
            }
            let cm = &self.cm;
            let Some(metadata) = cm.app_info(app_id).await?.cloud else {
                return Ok(None);
            };
            if metadata.field("savefiles").is_none() {
                return Ok(None);
            }
            let listing = cm.cloud_listing(app_id).await?;
            if !self.cloud_authorized() {
                return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
            }
            Ok(Some((metadata, listing)))
        })
        .await
    }
    /// Opt-in validation with no native runtime or game running. A complete
    /// verified backup precedes the unique disposable file; only that file is
    /// deleted. This does not activate synchronization for production launches.
    #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
    pub async fn cloud_transfer_probe(
        &self,
        app_id: u32,
        directory: &Path,
    ) -> Result<String, CloudError> {
        let preferences = self.cloud_preferences(app_id).await?;
        if preferences.account_enabled != Some(true) || preferences.game_enabled != Some(true) {
            return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
        }
        let backup = self.cloud_backup(app_id, directory).await?;
        let backup: serde_json::Value =
            serde_json::from_str(&backup).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
        let before: crate::cloud::CloudListing =
            serde_json::from_value(backup["listing"].clone()).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
        let directory = directory.canonicalize().map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
        let marker = tempfile::Builder::new()
            .prefix("fixture-")
            .tempdir_in(&directory)
            .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
        let name = format!(
            "__obelisk_cloud_validation_{}.bin",
            marker
                .path()
                .file_name()
                .and_then(|s| s.to_str())
                .ok_or(CloudError::Storage)?
        );
        if before.files.iter().any(|file| file.name == name) {
            return Err(CloudError::Changed);
        }
        let bytes = b"Obelisk Steam Cloud transport validation\nOnly this disposable file is created and removed.\n".to_vec();
        let timestamp = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?
            .as_secs();
        let mut upload = crate::cloud::UploadTransaction::create(
            &directory,
            before.clone(),
            vec![crate::cloud::CloudUpload {
                name: name.clone(),
                bytes,
                timestamp,
                platforms: u32::MAX,
            }],
            vec![],
        )?;
        let cm = &self.cm;
        let authorized = || self.cloud_authorized();
        let uploaded = cm.cloud_upload(&self.http, &mut upload, authorized).await?;
        let mut cleanup = crate::cloud::UploadTransaction::create(
            &directory,
            uploaded.clone(),
            vec![],
            vec![name.clone()],
        )?;
        let after = cm
            .cloud_upload(&self.http, &mut cleanup, authorized)
            .await?;
        let persisted = |listing: &crate::cloud::CloudListing| -> std::collections::BTreeMap<_, _> {
            listing
                .files
                .iter()
                .filter(|file| file.persist_state == 0)
                .map(|file| {
                    (
                        file.name.clone(),
                        (file.sha1.clone(), file.size, file.platforms),
                    )
                })
                .collect()
        };
        if persisted(&before) != persisted(&after) {
            return Err(CloudError::Changed);
        }
        serde_json::to_string_pretty(&serde_json::json!({
            "operation":"disposable_cloud_upload_readback_delete", "status":"verified", "app_id":app_id,
            "original_file_count":persisted(&before).len(), "before_revision":before.change_number,
            "uploaded_revision":uploaded.change_number, "cleaned_revision":after.change_number,
            "upload_directory":upload.directory(), "cleanup_directory":cleanup.directory(),
            "backup_directory":backup["backup_directory"], "preferences":preferences,
            "original_remote_contents_preserved":true, "fixture_removed":true
        })).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)
    }

    pub async fn cloud_preferences(
        &self,
        app_id: u32,
    ) -> Result<crate::cloud::CloudPreferences, CloudError> {
        deadline(30, async {
            self.cm.cloud_preferences(&self.http, app_id).await
        })
        .await
    }
    /// Read-only remote operation. Backups use numbered local filenames; remote
    /// names, including Auto-Cloud roots, never become filesystem paths.
    pub async fn cloud_backup(&self, app_id: u32, directory: &Path) -> Result<String, CloudError> {
        deadline(120, self.cloud_backup_inner(app_id, directory)).await
    }

    async fn cloud_backup_inner(
        &self,
        app_id: u32,
        directory: &Path,
    ) -> Result<String, CloudError> {
        if !directory.is_absolute()
            || !fs::symlink_metadata(directory).is_ok_and(|m| m.file_type().is_dir())
        {
            return Err(CloudError::Storage);
        }
        let directory = directory.canonicalize().map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
        let cm = &self.cm;
        let metadata = cm.app_info(app_id).await?;
        let quota = cm.cloud_quota(app_id).await?;
        let before = cm.cloud_listing(app_id).await?;
        let inspection = serde_json::json!({"operation":"read_only_cloud_inspection", "listing":before, "quota":quota, "ufs":metadata.cloud});
        let inspection_path =
            directory.join(format!("inspection-{app_id}-{}.json", before.change_number));
        match fs::File::create_new(inspection_path) {
            Ok(output) => {
                let bytes =
                    serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&inspection).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
                write_private(output, &bytes)?;
            }
            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => {}
            Err(_) => return Err(CloudError::Storage),
        }

        // A fresh generation prevents an interrupted backup from replacing a
        // previously verified one. A success manifest is published last.
        let backup = tempfile::Builder::new()
            .prefix("remote-")
            .permissions(fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700))
            .tempdir_in(&directory)
            .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
        let mut files = Vec::new();
        for (index, file) in before.files.iter().enumerate() {
            if file.persist_state != 0 {
                continue;
            }
            let bytes = cm.cloud_download(&self.http, app_id, file).await?;
            let local_name = format!("file-{index:05}.bin");
            let output = fs::File::create(backup.path().join(&local_name))
                .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
            write_private(output, &bytes)?;
            files.push(serde_json::json!({"remote":file,"backup_file":local_name}));
        }
        let after = cm.cloud_listing(app_id).await?;
        if before != after {
            return Err(CloudError::Changed);
        }
        let report = serde_json::json!({"operation":"read_only_cloud_backup", "steam_id":before.steam_id,
            "app_id":app_id,"change_number":before.change_number,"quota":quota,"listing":before,
            "ufs":metadata.cloud,"files":files,"backup_directory":backup.path()});
        let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&report).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
        let output = fs::File::create(backup.path().join("manifest.json"))
            .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
        write_private(output, json.as_bytes())?;
        sync(backup.path())?;
        let _ = backup.keep();
        sync(&directory)?;
        Ok(json)
    }
}
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/client/cloud/interruption_probe.rs`:

```rs
//! Restartable diagnostic restricted to one newly named disposable Cloud file.
use super::*;
use crate::cloud::{CloudListing, CloudUpload, UploadPhase, UploadTransaction};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::{collections::BTreeMap, path::PathBuf};

const SIZE: usize = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct Probe {
    before: CloudListing,
    name: String,
    timestamp: u64,
    interrupted: PathBuf,
    prefix_bytes: Option<usize>,
    retry: Option<PathBuf>,
    cleanup: Option<PathBuf>,
}

fn save(directory: &Path, probe: &Probe) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
    let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(probe).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
    obelisk_core::write_atomic(&directory.join("interruption-probe.json"), &bytes)
        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
    crate::cloud::upload::sync(directory)
}

fn payload() -> Vec<u8> {
    // Reproducible diagnostic bytes; contains no save or account material.
    (0..SIZE)
        .map(|i| ((i.wrapping_mul(73) ^ (i >> 8)) & 255) as u8)
        .collect()
}

fn upload(probe: &Probe) -> CloudUpload {
    CloudUpload {
        name: probe.name.clone(),
        bytes: payload(),
        timestamp: probe.timestamp,
        platforms: u32::MAX,
    }
}

fn original_files(
    listing: &CloudListing,
    fixture: &str,
) -> BTreeMap<String, crate::cloud::CloudFile> {
    listing
        .files
        .iter()
        .filter(|f| f.persist_state == 0 && f.name != fixture)
        .map(|f| (f.name.clone(), f.clone()))
        .collect()
}

impl Client {
    /// First invocation interrupts an HTTP body before CM commit. Invoke again
    /// after restarting Obelisk to close the old batch, verify remote state, create
    /// a fresh attempt, verify it and remove only the diagnostic file.
    pub async fn cloud_interruption_probe(
        &self,
        app_id: u32,
        directory: &Path,
    ) -> Result<String, CloudError> {
        let preferences = self.cloud_preferences(app_id).await?;
        if preferences.account_enabled != Some(true) || preferences.game_enabled != Some(true) {
            return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
        }
        let directory = directory.canonicalize().map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
        let journal = directory.join("interruption-probe.json");
        let authorized = || self.cloud_authorized();
        let mut probe: Probe = match fs::read(&journal) {
            Ok(bytes) if bytes.len() <= 64 * 1024 * 1024 => {
                serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?
            }
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
                let backup: serde_json::Value =
                    serde_json::from_str(&self.cloud_backup(app_id, &directory).await?)
                        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
                let before: CloudListing = serde_json::from_value(backup["listing"].clone())
                    .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
                let cm = &self.cm;
                let quota = cm.cloud_quota(app_id).await?;
                if quota
                    .max_bytes
                    .zip(quota.existing_bytes)
                    .is_none_or(|(max, used)| max.saturating_sub(used) < SIZE as u64)
                    || quota
                        .max_files
                        .zip(quota.existing_files)
                        .is_none_or(|(max, used)| max <= used)
                {
                    return Err(CloudError::Invalid("probe quota"));
                }
                let marker = tempfile::Builder::new()
                    .prefix("fixture-")
                    .tempdir_in(&directory)
                    .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
                let name = format!(
                    "__obelisk_cloud_interruption_{}.bin",
                    marker
                        .path()
                        .file_name()
                        .and_then(|s| s.to_str())
                        .ok_or(CloudError::Storage)?
                );
                if before.files.iter().any(|f| f.name == name) {
                    return Err(CloudError::Changed);
                }
                let timestamp = std::time::SystemTime::now()
                    .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
                    .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?
                    .as_secs();
                let mut transaction = UploadTransaction::create(
                    &directory,
                    before.clone(),
                    vec![CloudUpload {
                        name: name.clone(),
                        bytes: payload(),
                        timestamp,
                        platforms: u32::MAX,
                    }],
                    vec![],
                )?;
                let mut probe = Probe {
                    before,
                    name,
                    timestamp,
                    interrupted: transaction.directory().into(),
                    prefix_bytes: None,
                    retry: None,
                    cleanup: None,
                };
                save(&directory, &probe)?;
                let prefix = cm
                    .cloud_interrupt_upload_probe(
                        &self.http,
                        &mut transaction,
                        &directory.join("transport-trace.jsonl"),
                        authorized,
                    )
                    .await?;
                if !matches!(transaction.phase(), UploadPhase::Open { .. })
                    || transaction.is_settled()
                {
                    return Err(CloudError::Invalid("probe interruption phase"));
                }
                probe.prefix_bytes = Some(prefix);
                save(&directory, &probe)?;
                return serde_json::to_string_pretty(&serde_json::json!({
                    "operation":"interrupted_http_upload", "status":"awaiting_restart", "app_id":app_id,
                    "payload_bytes":SIZE, "prefix_consumed_by_http_client":prefix,
                    "provider_receipt_of_prefix_proven":false, "file_commit_sent":false,
                    "phase":transaction.phase(), "transaction":transaction.directory(),
                    "original_file_count":original_files(&probe.before, &probe.name).len(),
                    "before_revision":probe.before.change_number
                })).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage);
            }
            _ => return Err(CloudError::Storage),
        };
        if probe.before.app_id != app_id
            || !probe.name.starts_with("__obelisk_cloud_interruption_")
            || probe.name.contains('/')
            || probe.before.files.iter().any(|f| f.name == probe.name)
            || [
                &Some(probe.interrupted.clone()),
                &probe.retry,
                &probe.cleanup,
            ]
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            .any(|p| p.parent() != Some(directory.as_path()))
        {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("probe scope"));
        }
        let cm = &self.cm;
        let mut interrupted = UploadTransaction::open(&probe.interrupted)?;
        cm.cloud_settle_upload_probe(
            &self.http,
            &mut interrupted,
            &directory.join("transport-trace.jsonl"),
            authorized,
        )
        .await?;
        if !interrupted.is_settled() {
            return Err(CloudError::Uncertain);
        }
        let originals = original_files(&probe.before, &probe.name);
        let mut fresh = cm.cloud_listing(app_id).await?;
        if fresh.steam_id != probe.before.steam_id
            || original_files(&fresh, &probe.name) != originals
        {
            return Err(CloudError::Changed);
        }
        // Verify every original file after closure, before admitting a new plan.
        for file in originals.values() {
            if !authorized() {
                return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
            }
            cm.cloud_download(&self.http, app_id, file).await?;
        }
        if cm.cloud_listing(app_id).await? != fresh {
            return Err(CloudError::Changed);
        }
        let after_settlement = fresh.change_number;
        if probe.cleanup.is_none() {
            let mut retry = if let Some(path) = &probe.retry {
                UploadTransaction::open(path)?
            } else {
                if fresh.files.iter().any(|f| f.name == probe.name) {
                    return Err(CloudError::Changed);
                }
                let retry = UploadTransaction::create(
                    &directory,
                    fresh.clone(),
                    vec![upload(&probe)],
                    vec![],
                )?;
                probe.retry = Some(retry.directory().into());
                save(&directory, &probe)?;
                retry
            };
            fresh = cm
                .cloud_upload_probe(
                    &self.http,
                    &mut retry,
                    &directory.join("transport-trace.jsonl"),
                    authorized,
                )
                .await?;
            let cleanup = UploadTransaction::create(
                &directory,
                fresh.clone(),
                vec![],
                vec![probe.name.clone()],
            )?;
            probe.cleanup = Some(cleanup.directory().into());
            save(&directory, &probe)?;
        }
        let mut cleanup =
            UploadTransaction::open(probe.cleanup.as_ref().ok_or(CloudError::Storage)?)?;
        let after = cm
            .cloud_upload(&self.http, &mut cleanup, authorized)
            .await?;
        if original_files(&after, &probe.name) != originals
            || after
                .files
                .iter()
                .any(|f| f.name == probe.name && f.persist_state == 0)
        {
            return Err(CloudError::Changed);
        }
        serde_json::to_string_pretty(&serde_json::json!({
            "operation":"interrupted_http_upload", "status":"verified", "app_id":app_id,
            "payload_bytes":SIZE, "prefix_consumed_by_http_client":probe.prefix_bytes,
            "provider_receipt_of_prefix_proven":false, "interrupted_file_commit_sent":false,
            "settled_phase":interrupted.phase(), "before_revision":probe.before.change_number,
            "after_settlement_revision":after_settlement, "cleaned_revision":after.change_number,
            "original_file_count":originals.len(), "original_remote_contents_preserved":true,
            "fresh_attempt_verified":true, "fixture_removed":true
        }))
        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)
    }
}
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/cloud.rs`:

```rs
//! Lossless PICS Cloud metadata. Unknown roots, overrides and fields remain
//! available to the Cloud rule resolver; missing metadata is not an empty rule
//! set and malformed shapes are not silently converted into one.
use crate::kv::Kv;
pub(crate) mod downloads;
mod paths;
mod sdk;
pub use sdk::SdkCloudPaths;
pub(crate) mod preferences;
mod read;
pub(crate) mod upload;
pub(crate) mod wire;
pub use paths::{AutoCloudPaths, CloudPlatform, LocalCloudFile};
pub use preferences::{CloudPreferences, CloudPreferencesCache};
pub use read::*;
pub(crate) use read::{download, listing};
pub use upload::{CloudUpload, UploadPhase, UploadTransaction};

/// Run one Cloud operation under a hard deadline. Every request already has its
/// own transport timeout; this bounds the operation as a whole.
pub(crate) async fn deadline<T>(
    seconds: u64,
    operation: impl Future<Output = Result<T, CloudError>>,
) -> Result<T, CloudError> {
    tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(seconds), operation)
        .await
        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Timeout)?
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
pub enum CloudMetadata {
    Value(String),
    Object(Vec<(String, CloudMetadata)>),
}

impl CloudMetadata {
    pub fn entries(&self) -> Option<&[(String, Self)]> {
        match self {
            Self::Object(entries) => Some(entries),
            Self::Value(_) => None,
        }
    }

    pub fn text(&self) -> Option<&str> {
        match self {
            Self::Value(value) => Some(value),
            Self::Object(_) => None,
        }
    }

    /// Duplicate names are ambiguous. Callers may inspect entries for an
    /// unsupported-state diagnostic, but cannot silently choose the first.
    pub fn field(&self, name: &str) -> Option<&Self> {
        let mut matches = self
            .entries()?
            .iter()
            .filter(|(key, _)| key.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name));
        let (_, value) = matches.next()?;
        if matches.next().is_some() {
            None
        } else {
            Some(value)
        }
    }
}

impl From<&Kv> for CloudMetadata {
    fn from(value: &Kv) -> Self {
        match value {
            Kv::Value(text) => Self::Value(text.clone()),
            Kv::Object(entries) => Self::Object(
                entries
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(key, value)| (key.clone(), Self::from(value)))
                    .collect(),
            ),
        }
    }
}
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/cloud/downloads.rs`:

```rs
use super::{CloudError, CloudFile};
use obelisk_core::transfer::Window;

/// Each file waits about 200 ms for its CM request before its HTTP body, so
/// only overlapping files makes a save set of hundreds of them fast.
const WINDOW: Window = Window {
    width: 16,
    bytes: 32 * 1024 * 1024,
};

/// CM requests and HTTP bodies overlap in one sliding window and are consumed
/// as each file completes. Dropping this future cancels every in-flight read;
/// no detached worker can outlive the transfer owner.
pub(crate) async fn download_files<P, R, D>(
    files: &[CloudFile],
    request: impl Fn(CloudFile) -> R,
    download: impl Fn(CloudFile, P) -> D,
    authorized: &impl Fn() -> bool,
    mut receive: impl FnMut(&CloudFile, Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), CloudError>,
) -> Result<(), CloudError>
where
    R: Future<Output = Result<P, CloudError>>,
    D: Future<Output = Result<Vec<u8>, CloudError>>,
{
    let (request, download) = (&request, &download);
    WINDOW
        .run(
            files,
            |file| u64::from(file.size),
            || check(authorized),
            |file| async move {
                let plan = request(file.clone()).await?;
                check(authorized)?;
                let read = download(file.clone(), plan).await?;
                check(authorized)?;
                file.verify(&read)?;
                Ok((file, read))
            },
            |(file, read)| receive(file, read),
        )
        .await
}

fn check(authorized: &impl Fn() -> bool) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
    if authorized() {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(CloudError::Revoked)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests;
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/cloud/downloads/tests.rs`:

```rs
use super::*;
use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};
use std::cell::Cell;

fn files(count: usize) -> Vec<CloudFile> {
    (0..count)
        .map(|i| CloudFile {
            name: i.to_string(),
            sha1: crate::content::hex(&Sha1::digest(b"save")),
            size: 4,
            timestamp: 1,
            persist_state: 0,
            platforms: 7,
            reupload_requested: false,
        })
        .collect()
}

struct Active<'a>(&'a Cell<usize>);
impl<'a> Active<'a> {
    fn new(active: &'a Cell<usize>, peak: &Cell<usize>) -> Self {
        active.set(active.get() + 1);
        peak.set(peak.get().max(active.get()));
        Self(active)
    }
}
impl Drop for Active<'_> {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.0.set(self.0.get() - 1);
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn sixteen_small_files_or_one_large_file_are_read_at_once() {
    let active = Cell::new(0);
    let peak = Cell::new(0);
    let requested = Cell::new(0);
    for large in [false, true] {
        let mut files = files(40);
        if large {
            for file in &mut files {
                file.size = 32 * 1024 * 1024 + 1;
            }
        }
        peak.set(0);
        requested.set(0);
        let operation = download_files(
            &files,
            |_| {
                requested.set(requested.get() + 1);
                std::future::ready(Ok(()))
            },
            |_, ()| async {
                let _active = Active::new(&active, &peak);
                std::future::pending::<()>().await;
                Ok(Vec::new())
            },
            &|| true,
            |_, _| panic!("cancelled read must not deliver bytes"),
        );
        assert!(
            tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_millis(10), operation)
                .await
                .is_err()
        );
        let expected = if large { 1 } else { 16 };
        assert_eq!(peak.get(), expected);
        assert_eq!(requested.get(), expected);
        assert_eq!(active.get(), 0);
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn revocation_corruption_and_receiver_failure_stop_the_batch() {
    let authorized = Cell::new(true);
    let requests = Cell::new(0);
    let result = download_files(
        &files(8),
        |_| {
            authorized.set(false);
            std::future::ready(Ok(()))
        },
        |_, ()| async {
            requests.set(requests.get() + 1);
            Ok(b"save".to_vec())
        },
        &|| authorized.get(),
        |_, _| panic!("revoked transfer"),
    )
    .await;
    assert!(matches!(result, Err(CloudError::Revoked)));
    assert_eq!(requests.get(), 0);

    let result = download_files(
        &files(8),
        |_| std::future::ready(Ok(())),
        |_, ()| async { Ok(b"bad!".to_vec()) },
        &|| true,
        |_, _| panic!("unverified bytes"),
    )
    .await;
    assert!(matches!(result, Err(CloudError::Integrity)));

    requests.set(0);
    let result = download_files(
        &files(32),
        |_| {
            requests.set(requests.get() + 1);
            std::future::ready(Ok(()))
        },
        |_, ()| async { Ok(b"save".to_vec()) },
        &|| true,
        |_, _| Err(CloudError::Storage),
    )
    .await;
    assert!(matches!(result, Err(CloudError::Storage)));
    // Nothing past the first window is requested once the receiver failed.
    assert!(requests.get() <= 16);
}
```

```json
                ]
              ]
            }
          ]
```

```md
# Publisher AutoCloud fixtures

Captured September 20, 2026 through Obelisk's normal authenticated PICS session. These files contain only publisher UFS configuration, not account IDs, file manifests, saves or credentials. Numeric filenames are AppIDs. Runtime behavior is generic; tests select representative configurations by AppID.

1145360 Hades: omitted recursive flag, root override.
774171 Muse Dash: platform lists and a root-relative leading slash.
1809540 Nine Sols: empty added path.
504230 Celeste: lowercase gameinstall and nonempty added path.
1585220 Melatonin: install-root files and omitted recursive flag.
1062160 Poly Bridge 2: cross-platform rules plus Windows-only alternatives.
225260 Brütal Legend: platform-specific roots and SteamID placeholder.
2239150 Thronefall: backslash-separated publisher paths.
1030300 Silksong: existing cross-platform transform and account placeholder.
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/cloud/paths.rs`:

```rs
use super::{CloudError, CloudFile, CloudMetadata};
use std::{
    collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet},
    fs,
    os::unix::fs::MetadataExt,
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
};

/// Resolves and discovers Auto-Cloud files. This is not a RemoteStorage cache
/// adapter. Unsupported metadata cannot produce an empty set.
pub struct AutoCloudPaths {
    rules: Vec<Rule>,
    foreign: Vec<(String, String, bool)>,
    mask: u32,
}

/// The build of a game that runs, and where its Auto-Cloud roots live.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum CloudPlatform {
    /// A macOS build: its roots are under the player's home.
    Mac { home: PathBuf },
    /// A Windows build running in Wine: its roots are under the user profile
    /// of its prefix.
    Windows { profile: PathBuf },
}

impl CloudPlatform {
    /// This platform's bit in a Cloud file's platform mask.
    pub fn mask(&self) -> u32 {
        match self {
            Self::Mac { .. } => 2,
            Self::Windows { .. } => 1,
        }
    }

    /// The name root overrides compare against.
    fn os(&self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Mac { .. } => "MacOS",
            Self::Windows { .. } => "Windows",
        }
    }

    /// Whether `name` is another platform's root. Steam skips a rule there,
    /// unless a root override moves it onto this platform.
    fn foreign_root(&self, name: &str) -> bool {
        let foreign: &[&str] = match self {
            Self::Mac { .. } => &["Win", "Linux"],
            Self::Windows { .. } => &["Mac", "Linux"],
        };
        foreign.iter().any(|prefix| name.starts_with(prefix))
    }

    fn base(&self) -> &Path {
        match self {
            Self::Mac { home } => home,
            Self::Windows { profile } => profile,
        }
    }

    fn root(&self, name: &str, install: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, CloudError> {
        if canonical_root(name) == "GameInstall" {
            return Ok(install.to_owned());
        }
        let folder = match (self, name) {
            (Self::Mac { .. }, "MacHome") => "",
            (Self::Mac { .. }, "MacAppSupport") => "Library/Application Support",
            (Self::Mac { .. }, "MacDocuments") => "Documents",
            (Self::Windows { .. }, "WinMyDocuments") => "Documents",
            (Self::Windows { .. }, "WinAppDataLocal") => "AppData/Local",
            (Self::Windows { .. }, "WinAppDataLocalLow") => "AppData/LocalLow",
            (Self::Windows { .. }, "WinAppDataRoaming") => "AppData/Roaming",
            (Self::Windows { .. }, "WinSavedGames") => "Saved Games",
            _ => return Err(CloudError::Invalid("unsupported Auto-Cloud root")),
        };
        Ok(self.base().join(folder))
    }
}

fn canonical_root(name: &str) -> &str {
    if name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("GameInstall") {
        "GameInstall"
    } else {
        name
    }
}

fn rule_suffix(
    name: &str,
    root: &str,
    source: &str,
    recursive: bool,
) -> Result<Option<String>, CloudError> {
    let Some(after_root) = name.strip_prefix(&format!("%{root}%")) else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let path = after_root.strip_prefix('/').unwrap_or(after_root);
    let suffix = if source.is_empty() {
        path
    } else {
        let Some(suffix) = path.strip_prefix(&format!("{source}/")) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        suffix
    };
    let suffix = relative(suffix, false)?;
    Ok((recursive || !suffix.contains('/')).then_some(suffix))
}

struct Rule {
    root: String,
    source: String,
    destination: PathBuf,
    recursive: bool,
    pattern: String,
    platforms: u32,
}

fn platforms(save: &CloudMetadata) -> Result<u32, CloudError> {
    let Some(platforms) = save.field("platforms") else {
        return Ok(u32::MAX);
    };
    let entries = platforms
        .entries()
        .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud platforms"))?;
    let mut mask = 0;
    let mut keys = BTreeSet::new();
    for (key, value) in entries {
        if !keys.insert(key) {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("duplicate Auto-Cloud platform"));
        }
        mask |= match value.text() {
            Some("Windows") => 1,
            Some("MacOS") => 2,
            Some("Linux") => 4,
            _ => return Err(CloudError::Invalid("unsupported Auto-Cloud platform")),
        };
    }
    if mask == 0 {
        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("empty Auto-Cloud platforms"));
    }
    Ok(mask)
}

// Publisher paths are root-relative even when serialized with one leading '/'.
// Remote filenames still use the stricter relative() validation below.
fn publisher_path(value: &str, steam_id: u64) -> Result<String, CloudError> {
    let value = substitute(value, steam_id).replace('\\', "/");
    if value.starts_with("//") {
        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud network path"));
    }
    relative(value.strip_prefix('/').unwrap_or(&value), true)
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct LocalCloudFile {
    pub name: String,
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub platforms: u32,
}

fn text<'a>(node: &'a CloudMetadata, key: &str) -> Result<&'a str, CloudError> {
    node.field(key)
        .and_then(CloudMetadata::text)
        .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud field"))
}

fn fields(node: &CloudMetadata, allowed: &[&str]) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
    let entries = node
        .entries()
        .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud object"))?;
    let mut seen = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
    for (key, _) in entries {
        if !allowed.iter().any(|a| key.eq_ignore_ascii_case(a))
            || !seen.insert(key.to_ascii_lowercase())
        {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid(
                "unsupported or duplicate Auto-Cloud field",
            ));
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn relative(value: &str, allow_empty: bool) -> Result<String, CloudError> {
    if value.chars().any(char::is_control) || value.contains([':', '%', '{', '}', '*', '?']) {
        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud path"));
    }
    let value = value.replace('\\', "/");
    if value.starts_with('/') || value.split('/').any(|p| p == "..") {
        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud traversal"));
    }
    let value = value
        .split('/')
        .filter(|p| !p.is_empty() && *p != ".")
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join("/");
    if value.is_empty() && !allow_empty {
        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("empty Auto-Cloud filename"));
    }
    Ok(value)
}

fn substitute(value: &str, steam_id: u64) -> String {
    value
        .replace("{64BitSteamID}", &steam_id.to_string())
        .replace("{Steam3AccountID}", &(steam_id as u32).to_string())
}

impl AutoCloudPaths {
    /// The paths of a macOS build whose roots are under `home`.
    pub fn mac(
        metadata: &CloudMetadata,
        steam_id: u64,
        home: &Path,
        install: &Path,
    ) -> Result<Self, CloudError> {
        Self::new(
            metadata,
            steam_id,
            &CloudPlatform::Mac { home: home.into() },
            install,
        )
    }

    pub fn new(
        metadata: &CloudMetadata,
        steam_id: u64,
        platform: &CloudPlatform,
        install: &Path,
    ) -> Result<Self, CloudError> {
        let mask = platform.mask();
        let mut keys = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
        for (key, _) in metadata
            .entries()
            .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud metadata"))?
        {
            if !keys.insert(key.to_ascii_lowercase()) {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid("duplicate Auto-Cloud metadata field"));
            }
        }
        if steam_id >> 32 != 0x0110_0001
            || steam_id as u32 == 0
            || !platform.base().is_absolute()
            || !install.is_absolute()
        {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud identity or roots"));
        }
        // Redirects need an adapter that resolves and authenticates the target
        // Cloud App ID. Never silently use the logical game's store instead.
        if metadata
            .field("appidredirect")
            .is_some_and(|v| v.text() != Some("0"))
        {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("unresolved Cloud App ID redirect"));
        }
        let saves = metadata
            .field("savefiles")
            .and_then(CloudMetadata::entries)
            .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("missing Auto-Cloud rules"))?;
        let overrides = match metadata.field("rootoverrides") {
            Some(value) => value
                .entries()
                .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud overrides"))?,
            None => &[],
        };
        let mut rules = Vec::new();
        let mut foreign = Vec::new();
        for (_, save) in saves {
            fields(save, &["root", "path", "pattern", "recursive", "platforms"])?;
            let platforms = platforms(save)?;
            let source_root = text(save, "root")?;
            let source_path = text(save, "path")?;
            let pattern = text(save, "pattern")?;
            if pattern.is_empty()
                || pattern.len() > 255
                || pattern.contains(['/', '\\', '[', ']', ';', '{', '}'])
                || pattern.chars().any(char::is_control)
            {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid("unsupported Auto-Cloud wildcard"));
            }
            let recursive = match save.field("recursive").map(CloudMetadata::text) {
                None | Some(Some("0")) => false,
                Some(Some("1")) => true,
                _ => return Err(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud recursion")),
            };
            if platforms & mask == 0 {
                foreign.push((
                    canonical_root(source_root).to_owned(),
                    publisher_path(source_path, steam_id)?,
                    recursive,
                ));
                continue;
            }
            let mut local_root = source_root;
            let mut local_path = source_path.to_owned();
            let mut matched = false;
            for (_, override_) in overrides {
                if text(override_, "root")? != source_root {
                    continue;
                }
                let applies = match (text(override_, "os")?, text(override_, "oscompare")?) {
                    (os @ ("MacOS" | "Windows" | "Linux"), "=") => os == platform.os(),
                    _ => return Err(CloudError::Invalid("unsupported Auto-Cloud OS comparison")),
                };
                if !applies {
                    continue;
                }
                fields(
                    override_,
                    &[
                        "root",
                        "os",
                        "oscompare",
                        "useinstead",
                        "pathtransforms",
                        "addpath",
                    ],
                )?;
                if matched {
                    return Err(CloudError::Invalid("ambiguous Auto-Cloud override"));
                }
                matched = true;
                local_root = text(override_, "useinstead")?;
                if let Some(addpath) = override_.field("addpath") {
                    let prefix = publisher_path(
                        addpath
                            .text()
                            .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud added path"))?,
                        steam_id,
                    )?;
                    if !prefix.is_empty() {
                        if override_.field("pathtransforms").is_some() {
                            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("ambiguous Auto-Cloud path transform"));
                        }
                        local_path = format!("{prefix}/{}", publisher_path(&local_path, steam_id)?);
                    }
                }
                if let Some(transforms) = override_.field("pathtransforms") {
                    for (_, transform) in transforms
                        .entries()
                        .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud transforms"))?
                    {
                        fields(transform, &["find", "replace"])?;
                        let find = text(transform, "find")?;
                        let replacement = text(transform, "replace")?;
                        // Only a complete subdirectory or component prefix is
                        // supported until other transform forms are validated.
                        if find.is_empty()
                            || !(local_path == find
                                || local_path
                                    .strip_prefix(find)
                                    .is_some_and(|s| s.starts_with('/')))
                        {
                            return Err(CloudError::Invalid(
                                "unsupported Auto-Cloud path transform",
                            ));
                        }
                        local_path = format!("{replacement}{}", &local_path[find.len()..]);
                    }
                }
            }
            if !matched && platform.foreign_root(source_root) {
                foreign.push((
                    canonical_root(source_root).to_owned(),
                    publisher_path(source_path, steam_id)?,
                    recursive,
                ));
                continue;
            }
            // Valve serializes some override replacements with a leading slash.
            // It is relative to the new root, never an absolute filesystem path.
            let source = publisher_path(source_path, steam_id)?;
            let local = publisher_path(&local_path, steam_id)?;
            rules.push(Rule {
                root: canonical_root(source_root).to_owned(),
                source,
                destination: platform.root(local_root, install)?.join(local),
                recursive,
                pattern: pattern.to_owned(),
                platforms,
            });
        }
        if rules.is_empty() {
            return Err(if foreign.is_empty() {
                CloudError::Invalid("empty Auto-Cloud rules")
            } else {
                CloudError::OtherPlatforms
            });
        }
        Ok(Self {
            rules,
            foreign,
            mask,
        })
    }

    /// Existing files can outlive a publisher's current wildcard. Keep their
    /// remote identities and apply them under the declared directory; wildcard
    /// changes do not authorize deletion of historical backups.
    pub fn existing_file(&self, file: &CloudFile) -> Result<Option<PathBuf>, CloudError> {
        if file.persist_state != 0 {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        self.destination(&file.name, file.platforms)
    }

    /// The local path a remote name projects to, or `None` when the file is not
    /// published for this platform. A name no rule maps is an error, not a skip.
    pub fn destination(&self, name: &str, platforms: u32) -> Result<Option<PathBuf>, CloudError> {
        if platforms & self.mask == 0 {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        if let Some(path) = self.path_for_name(name)? {
            return Ok(Some(path));
        }
        // Older files may carry an all-platform mask even though the current
        // publisher rule explicitly confines their namespace to another OS.
        for (root, source, recursive) in &self.foreign {
            if rule_suffix(name, root, source, *recursive)?.is_some() {
                return Ok(None);
            }
        }
        Err(CloudError::Invalid("unmapped Auto-Cloud file"))
    }

    fn path_for_name(&self, name: &str) -> Result<Option<PathBuf>, CloudError> {
        let mut selected = None;
        for rule in &self.rules {
            let Some(suffix) = rule_suffix(name, &rule.root, &rule.source, rule.recursive)? else {
                continue;
            };
            let destination = rule.destination.join(suffix);
            if selected
                .as_ref()
                .is_some_and(|previous| previous != &destination)
            {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid("ambiguous Auto-Cloud destination"));
            }
            selected = Some(destination);
        }
        Ok(selected)
    }

    /// Includes known files even after deletion or a publisher wildcard change.
    /// The caller can therefore distinguish a missing known save from an empty
    /// discovery. Scan only while the supervisor has established game quiescence.
    pub fn local_files(&self, known: &[CloudFile]) -> Result<Vec<LocalCloudFile>, CloudError> {
        let mut selected = BTreeMap::<PathBuf, LocalCloudFile>::new();
        let mut excluded = BTreeSet::new();
        for file in known {
            let path = if file.persist_state != 0 && file.platforms & self.mask != 0 {
                // A recreated save keeps its deleted remote identity, including
                // its platform mask and historical wildcard exceptions.
                self.path_for_name(&file.name)?
            } else {
                self.existing_file(file)?
            };
            if let Some(path) = path {
                let entry = LocalCloudFile {
                    name: file.name.clone(),
                    path: path.clone(),
                    platforms: file.platforms,
                };
                if selected
                    .insert(path, entry.clone())
                    .is_some_and(|previous| previous != entry)
                {
                    return Err(CloudError::Invalid("aliased Auto-Cloud identity"));
                }
            } else if let Some(path) = self.path_for_name(&file.name)? {
                // Foreign-platform identities are outside the managed set.
                // Ignore matching local files instead of reclassifying them.
                excluded.insert(path);
            }
        }
        let known_paths: BTreeSet<_> = selected.keys().cloned().collect();
        let mut visited = 0;
        for rule in &self.rules {
            let mut pending = vec![(rule.destination.clone(), 0)];
            while let Some((directory, depth)) = pending.pop() {
                if depth > 64 {
                    return Err(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud directory depth"));
                }
                if !plain_path(&directory)? {
                    continue;
                }
                if !fs::symlink_metadata(&directory)
                    .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?
                    .is_dir()
                {
                    return Err(CloudError::Storage);
                }
                for entry in fs::read_dir(&directory).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)? {
                    visited += 1;
                    if visited > 100_000 {
                        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud scan size"));
                    }
                    let entry = entry.map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
                    let path = entry.path();
                    if excluded.contains(&path) && !known_paths.contains(&path) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(&path).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
                    // A matching symlink or recursive directory alias must never
                    // turn into an absent file and cause a remote deletion.
                    let name = entry
                        .file_name()
                        .into_string()
                        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud filename encoding"))?;
                    if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
                        if rule.recursive
                            || wildcard(&rule.pattern, &name)
                            || selected.contains_key(&path)
                        {
                            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud symlink"));
                        }
                        continue;
                    }
                    if metadata.is_dir() {
                        if rule.recursive {
                            pending.push((path, depth + 1));
                        }
                        continue;
                    }
                    if !wildcard(&rule.pattern, &name) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if !metadata.is_file() || metadata.nlink() != 1 {
                        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud file alias"));
                    }
                    let suffix = path
                        .strip_prefix(&rule.destination)
                        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?
                        .to_str()
                        .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud filename encoding"))?;
                    let suffix = relative(suffix, false)?;
                    let separator = if rule.source.is_empty() { "" } else { "/" };
                    let remote = format!("%{}%{}{separator}{suffix}", rule.root, rule.source);
                    if let Some(previous) = selected.get(&path) {
                        if !known_paths.contains(&path)
                            && (previous.name != remote || previous.platforms != rule.platforms)
                        {
                            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("ambiguous Auto-Cloud source"));
                        }
                        continue;
                    }
                    selected.insert(
                        path.clone(),
                        LocalCloudFile {
                            name: remote,
                            path,
                            platforms: rule.platforms,
                        },
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        let mut names = BTreeSet::new();
        let mut identities = BTreeSet::new();
        for file in selected.values() {
            if !names.insert(&file.name) {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid("ambiguous Auto-Cloud remote name"));
            }
            if plain_path(&file.path)? {
                let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(&file.path).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
                if !metadata.is_file()
                    || metadata.nlink() != 1
                    || !identities.insert((metadata.dev(), metadata.ino()))
                {
                    return Err(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud file alias"));
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(selected.into_values().collect())
    }
}

pub(super) fn plain_path(path: &Path) -> Result<bool, CloudError> {
    let mut exists = true;
    for parent in path.ancestors() {
        match fs::symlink_metadata(parent) {
            Ok(metadata) if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() => {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid("Auto-Cloud symlink"));
            }
            Ok(_) => {}
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => exists = false,
            Err(_) => return Err(CloudError::Storage),
        }
    }
    Ok(exists)
}

// Linear-space matching of the supported Steam filename '*' and '?' patterns.
// Case is preserved, as are the destination filesystem's own alias semantics.
fn wildcard(pattern: &str, name: &str) -> bool {
    let name: Vec<_> = name.chars().collect();
    let mut previous = vec![false; name.len() + 1];
    previous[0] = true;
    for token in pattern.chars() {
        let mut next = vec![false; name.len() + 1];
        if token == '*' {
            next[0] = previous[0];
        }
        for index in 0..name.len() {
            next[index + 1] = if token == '*' {
                previous[index + 1] || next[index]
            } else {
                previous[index] && (token == '?' || token == name[index])
            };
        }
        previous = next;
    }
    previous[name.len()]
}

    #[test]
    fn a_windows_build_finds_its_saves_in_its_prefix_and_ignores_mac_overrides() {
        let temp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let profile = temp
            .path()
            .canonicalize()
            .unwrap()
            .join("drive_c/users/crossover");
        let saves = profile.join("AppData/LocalLow/Studio/Game/42/nested");
        fs::create_dir_all(&saves).unwrap();
        fs::write(saves.join("slot.sav"), b"windows").unwrap();
        let platform = CloudPlatform::Windows {
            profile: profile.clone(),
        };
        let resolver =
            AutoCloudPaths::new(&metadata(), 0x011000010000002a, &platform, temp.path()).unwrap();

        assert_eq!(
            resolver
                .destination("%WinAppDataLocalLow%Studio/Game/42/slot.sav", u32::MAX)
                .unwrap(),
            Some(profile.join("AppData/LocalLow/Studio/Game/42/slot.sav"))
        );
        let selected = resolver.local_files(&[]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(selected.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(
            selected[0].name,
            "%WinAppDataLocalLow%Studio/Game/42/nested/slot.sav"
        );
        assert_eq!(selected[0].path, saves.join("slot.sav"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn platform_specific_rules_discover_only_mac_files_with_mac_mask() {
        let metadata = serde_json::from_str(include_str!("fixtures/774171.json")).unwrap();
        let temp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let home = temp.path().canonicalize().unwrap();
        fs::create_dir_all(home.join("Steam/MuseDash/nested")).unwrap();
        fs::write(home.join("Steam/MuseDash/slot.sav"), b"mac").unwrap();
        fs::write(home.join("Steam/MuseDash/nested/slot.sav"), b"ignored").unwrap();
        let resolver = AutoCloudPaths::mac(&metadata, 0x011000010000002a, &home, &home).unwrap();
        let selected = resolver.local_files(&[]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(selected.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(selected[0].platforms, 2);
        assert_eq!(selected[0].name, "%MacHome%Steam/MuseDash/slot.sav");
        let foreign = file("%WinAppDataLocal%Steam/MuseDash/windows.sav");
        assert_eq!(resolver.existing_file(&foreign).unwrap(), None);
        assert_eq!(resolver.local_files(&[foreign]).unwrap(), selected);
        assert!(resolver.destination("%Unknown%slot.sav", u32::MAX).is_err());
    }

    }

    #[test]
    fn invalid_platform_lists_and_foreign_only_rules_never_become_empty_saves() {
        for list in [
            value("MacOS"),
            object(vec![]),
            object(vec![("1", value("Unknown"))]),
            object(vec![("1", value("MacOS")), ("1", value("Windows"))]),
            object(vec![("1", value("Windows"))]),
        ] {
            let mut metadata = metadata();
            let CloudMetadata::Object(top) = &mut metadata else {
                unreachable!()
            };
            let CloudMetadata::Object(saves) = &mut top[0].1 else {
                unreachable!()
            };
            let CloudMetadata::Object(rule) = &mut saves[0].1 else {
                unreachable!()
            };
            rule.push(("platforms".into(), list));
            assert!(
                AutoCloudPaths::mac(
                    &metadata,
                    0x011000010000002a,
                    Path::new("/Users/fixture"),
                    Path::new("/Games/fixture")
                )
                .is_err()
            );
        }
    }
    fn value(s: &str) -> CloudMetadata {
        CloudMetadata::Value(s.into())
    }
    fn object(entries: Vec<(&str, CloudMetadata)>) -> CloudMetadata {
        CloudMetadata::Object(entries.into_iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.into(), v)).collect())
    }
    fn metadata() -> CloudMetadata {
        object(vec![
            (
                "savefiles",
                object(vec![(
                    "0",
                    object(vec![
                        ("root", value("WinAppDataLocalLow")),
                        ("path", value("Studio/Game/{Steam3AccountID}")),
                        ("pattern", value("*.sav")),
                        ("recursive", value("1")),
                    ]),
                )]),
            ),
            (
                "rootoverrides",
                object(vec![(
                    "0",
                    object(vec![
                        ("root", value("WinAppDataLocalLow")),
                        ("os", value("MacOS")),
                        ("oscompare", value("=")),
                        ("useinstead", value("MacHome")),
                        (
                            "pathtransforms",
                            object(vec![(
                                "0",
                                object(vec![
                                    ("find", value("Studio/Game/{Steam3AccountID}")),
                                    (
                                        "replace",
                                        value(
                                            "/Library/Application Support/Studio.Game/{Steam3AccountID}",
                                        ),
                                    ),
                                ]),
                            )]),
                        ),
                    ]),
                )]),
            ),
        ])
    }
    fn file(name: &str) -> CloudFile {
        CloudFile {
            name: name.into(),
            sha1: "00".repeat(20),
            size: 1,
            timestamp: 0,
            persist_state: 0,
            platforms: u32::MAX,
            reupload_requested: false,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn local_discovery_selects_new_saves_and_keeps_missing_known_files_and_backups() {
        let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let home = temporary.path().canonicalize().unwrap();
        let directory = home.join("Library/Application Support/Studio.Game/42");
        fs::create_dir_all(directory.join("nested")).unwrap();
        for name in [
            "new.sav",
            "existing.sav.bak",
            "ignored.txt",
            "nested/next.sav",
        ] {
            fs::write(directory.join(name), b"data").unwrap();
        }
        let resolver = AutoCloudPaths::mac(&metadata(), 0x011000010000002a, &home, &home).unwrap();
        let mut backup = file("%WinAppDataLocalLow%/Studio/Game/42/existing.sav.bak");
        backup.platforms = 7;
        let missing = file("%WinAppDataLocalLow%Studio/Game/42/deleted.sav");
        let selected = resolver
            .local_files(&[backup.clone(), missing.clone()])
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(selected.len(), 4);
        assert!(
            selected
                .iter()
                .any(|file| file.name == backup.name && file.platforms == 7)
        );
        assert!(
            selected
                .iter()
                .any(|file| file.name == missing.name && !file.path.exists())
        );
        assert!(
            selected
                .iter()
                .any(|file| file.name == "%WinAppDataLocalLow%Studio/Game/42/nested/next.sav")
        );
        assert!(
            !selected
                .iter()
                .any(|file| file.path.ends_with("ignored.txt"))
        );
        fs::remove_dir_all(&directory).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(resolver.local_files(&[missing]).unwrap().len(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn discovery_refuses_directory_links_file_links_and_remote_aliases() {
        let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let home = temporary.path().canonicalize().unwrap();
        let directory = home.join("Library/Application Support/Studio.Game/42");
        fs::create_dir_all(&directory).unwrap();
        let resolver = AutoCloudPaths::mac(&metadata(), 0x011000010000002a, &home, &home).unwrap();
        fs::write(directory.join("real.sav"), b"data").unwrap();
        std::os::unix::fs::symlink(directory.join("real.sav"), directory.join("alias.sav"))
            .unwrap();
        assert!(resolver.local_files(&[]).is_err());
        fs::remove_file(directory.join("alias.sav")).unwrap();
        fs::hard_link(directory.join("real.sav"), directory.join("alias.sav")).unwrap();
        assert!(resolver.local_files(&[]).is_err());
        fs::remove_file(directory.join("alias.sav")).unwrap();
        assert!(
            resolver
                .local_files(&[
                    file("%WinAppDataLocalLow%Studio/Game/42/real.sav"),
                    file("%WinAppDataLocalLow%/Studio/Game/42/real.sav")
                ])
                .is_err()
        );
        std::os::unix::fs::symlink(&directory, directory.join("loop")).unwrap();
        assert!(resolver.local_files(&[]).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn filename_patterns_preserve_case_and_unicode() {
        for name in ["slot.sav", "é.sav", ".sav"] {
            assert!(wildcard("*.sav", name));
        }
        assert!(!wildcard("*.sav", "slot.sav.bak"));
        assert!(!wildcard("*.sav", "slot.SAV"));
        assert!(wildcard("?.sav", "é.sav"));
        assert!(!wildcard("?.sav", "ab.sav"));
        assert!(wildcard("*", ""));
    }
    #[test]
    fn maps_canonical_cross_platform_names_without_losing_backups() {
        let resolver = AutoCloudPaths::mac(
            &metadata(),
            0x0110_0001_0000_002a,
            Path::new("/Users/example"),
            Path::new("/Games/example"),
        )
        .unwrap();
        for source in [
            "%WinAppDataLocalLow%Studio/Game/42/nested/slot.sav.bak",
            "%WinAppDataLocalLow%/Studio/Game/42/nested/slot.sav.bak",
        ] {
            assert_eq!(
                resolver.existing_file(&file(source)).unwrap().unwrap(),
                Path::new(
                    "/Users/example/Library/Application Support/Studio.Game/42/nested/slot.sav.bak"
                )
            );
        }
        for source in [
            "%WinAppDataLocalLow%Studio/Game/42/../../../escape",
            "%WinAppDataLocalLow%Studio/Game/420/file.sav",
            "%WinAppDataLocalLow%Studio/Game/99/file.sav",
            "api-file.sav",
        ] {
            assert!(resolver.existing_file(&file(source)).is_err());
        }
        let mut other = file("%WinAppDataLocalLow%Studio/Game/42/slot.sav");
        other.platforms = 1;
        assert!(resolver.existing_file(&other).unwrap().is_none());
    }
    #[test]
    fn rejects_unknown_or_ambiguous_rules() {
        let mut m = metadata();
        if let CloudMetadata::Object(ref mut e) = m {
            e.push(("appidredirect".into(), value("7")));
        }
        assert!(
            AutoCloudPaths::mac(
                &m,
                0x0110_0001_0000_002a,
                Path::new("/Users/example"),
                Path::new("/Games/example")
            )
            .is_err()
        );
        assert!(relative("../../save", false).is_err());
        assert!(relative("/absolute", false).is_err());
        assert!(relative("C:\\save", false).is_err());
        assert!(relative("{unknown}/save", false).is_err());
        assert_eq!(relative("./folder\\save", false).unwrap(), "folder/save");
    }

    #[test]
    fn native_roots_and_steam64_substitution_are_independent_of_the_game() {
        let id = 0x0110_0001_0000_002a;
        for (name, base) in [
            ("MacHome", "/Users/example"),
            (
                "MacAppSupport",
                "/Users/example/Library/Application Support",
            ),
            ("MacDocuments", "/Users/example/Documents"),
            ("GameInstall", "/Games/example"),
        ] {
            let m = object(vec![(
                "savefiles",
                object(vec![(
                    "0",
                    object(vec![
                        ("root", value(name)),
                        ("path", value("saves/{64BitSteamID}")),
                        ("pattern", value("*")),
                        ("recursive", value("0")),
                    ]),
                )]),
            )]);
            let resolver = AutoCloudPaths::mac(
                &m,
                id,
                Path::new("/Users/example"),
                Path::new("/Games/example"),
            )
            .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                resolver
                    .existing_file(&file(&format!("%{name}%saves/{id}/slot")))
                    .unwrap()
                    .unwrap(),
                Path::new(base).join(format!("saves/{id}/slot"))
            );
            assert!(
                resolver
                    .existing_file(&file(&format!("%{name}%saves/{id}/nested/slot")))
                    .is_err()
            );
        }
    }
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/cloud/preferences.rs`:

```rs
use super::{CloudError, CloudFile, CloudListing};
use crate::kv::Kv;

/// The Steam client's own Cloud namespace, which stores roaming preferences.
pub(crate) const ROAMING_CONFIG_APP: u32 = 7;
pub(crate) const ROAMING_CONFIG_FILE: &str = "sharedconfig.vdf";

/// Actual roaming preferences, separate from the game's metadata/capabilities.
/// Missing remote storage leaves these unknown. Defaults are applied only to a
/// verified, well-formed UserRoamingConfigStore, matching the pinned runtime.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize)]
pub struct CloudPreferences {
    pub account_enabled: Option<bool>,
    pub game_enabled: Option<bool>,
    pub revision: u64,
}

/// A session-local cache of verified preferences. A fresh listing is still
/// required on every read; account, app and file identity must all match.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct CloudPreferencesCache {
    entry: Option<(u64, u32, CloudFile, CloudPreferences)>,
}

impl CloudPreferencesCache {
    pub(crate) async fn read(
        &mut self,
        app_id: u32,
        listing: &CloudListing,
        download: impl AsyncFnOnce(&CloudFile) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CloudError>,
    ) -> Result<CloudPreferences, CloudError> {
        let Some(file) = listing
            .files
            .iter()
            .find(|f| f.name == ROAMING_CONFIG_FILE && f.persist_state == 0)
        else {
            self.entry = None;
            return Ok(CloudPreferences {
                account_enabled: None,
                game_enabled: None,
                revision: listing.change_number,
            });
        };
        if file.size > 16 * 1024 * 1024 {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("Cloud preference size"));
        }
        if let Some((account, app, cached, preferences)) = &self.entry
            && *account == listing.steam_id
            && *app == app_id
            && cached == file
        {
            return Ok(CloudPreferences {
                revision: listing.change_number,
                ..preferences.clone()
            });
        }
        let bytes = download(file).await?;
        file.verify(&bytes)?;
        let preferences = parse_preferences(&bytes, app_id, listing.change_number)?;
        self.entry = Some((listing.steam_id, app_id, file.clone(), preferences.clone()));
        Ok(preferences)
    }
}

pub(crate) fn parse_preferences(
    bytes: &[u8],
    app_id: u32,
    revision: u64,
) -> Result<CloudPreferences, CloudError> {
    if app_id == 0 {
        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("Cloud preference app id"));
    }
    let tree =
        crate::kv::text(bytes).map_err(|_| CloudError::Invalid("Cloud preference document"))?;
    let root = child(Some(&tree), "UserRoamingConfigStore")?
        .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("Cloud preference root"))?;
    object(root)?;
    let software = child(Some(root), "Software")?;
    let valve = child(software, "Valve")?;
    let steam = child(valve, "Steam")?;
    let account_enabled = boolean(steam, "CloudEnabled")?;
    let apps = child(steam, "apps")?;
    let game = child(apps, &app_id.to_string())?;
    let game_enabled = boolean(game, "cloudenabled")?;
    Ok(CloudPreferences {
        account_enabled: Some(account_enabled),
        game_enabled: Some(game_enabled),
        revision,
    })
}

fn object(node: &Kv) -> Result<&[(String, Kv)], CloudError> {
    match node {
        Kv::Object(entries) => Ok(entries),
        _ => Err(CloudError::Invalid("Cloud preference object")),
    }
}
fn child<'a>(node: Option<&'a Kv>, name: &str) -> Result<Option<&'a Kv>, CloudError> {
    let Some(node) = node else { return Ok(None) };
    let mut entries = object(node)?
        .iter()
        .filter(|(key, _)| key.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name));
    let value = entries.next().map(|(_, value)| value);
    if entries.next().is_some() {
        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("duplicate Cloud preference"));
    }
    Ok(value)
}
fn boolean(node: Option<&Kv>, name: &str) -> Result<bool, CloudError> {
    match child(node, name)? {
        None => Ok(true),
        Some(Kv::Value(value)) if value == "1" => Ok(true),
        Some(Kv::Value(value)) if value == "0" => Ok(false),
        _ => Err(CloudError::Invalid("Cloud preference value")),
    }
}

                .unwrap()

            .read(10, &listing, async |_| {
                downloads += 1;
                Ok(disabled.to_vec())
            })
            .await
            .unwrap();

            .read(11, &listing, async |_| {
                downloads += 1;
                Ok(disabled.to_vec())
            })
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(downloads, 4);
        listing.files.clear();
        let unknown = cache
            .read(11, &listing, async |_| panic!("absent config downloaded"))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(unknown.account_enabled, None);
        assert_eq!(unknown.game_enabled, None);
        listing.files.push(file(enabled));
        assert!(
            cache
                .read(11, &listing, async |_| Ok(disabled.to_vec()))
                .await
                .is_err()
        );

                .account_enabled,
            Some(true)
```
