`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/cloud/read.rs`:

```rs
use super::wire;
use crate::content::hex;
use serde::Serialize;
use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};
use std::collections::BTreeSet;
use std::io::{Cursor, Read};

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum CloudError {
    #[error("Steam Cloud response is invalid: {0}")]
    Invalid(&'static str),
    #[error("Steam Cloud returned a delta without a complete baseline")]
    Delta,
    #[error(
        "Steam Cloud file format is unsupported: encrypted={encrypted}, transfer={transfer_size:?}, raw={raw_size}"
    )]
    UnsupportedFormat {
        encrypted: bool,
        transfer_size: Option<u32>,
        raw_size: u32,
    },
    #[error("Steam Cloud changed during synchronization")]
    Changed,
    #[error("Steam Cloud transfer failed")]
    Network,
    #[error("Steam Cloud download host is unsupported: {0}")]
    Host(String),
    #[error("Steam Cloud content failed verification")]
    Integrity,
    #[error("Steam Cloud backup storage failed")]
    Storage,
    #[error("Steam Cloud request exceeded its deadline")]
    Timeout,
    #[error("Steam Cloud upload requires reconciliation before another attempt")]
    Uncertain,
    #[error("Steam did not confirm the uploaded file")]
    NotCommitted,
    #[error("Steam Cloud transfer authorization was revoked")]
    Revoked,
    #[error("Steam Cloud keeps this game's saves only on other platforms")]
    OtherPlatforms,
    #[error("{0}")]
    Cm(#[from] crate::cm::CmError),
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, serde::Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct CloudFile {
    pub name: String,
    pub sha1: String,
    pub size: u32,
    pub timestamp: u64,
    pub persist_state: i32,
    pub platforms: u32,
    pub reupload_requested: bool,
}

impl CloudFile {
    /// Validate bytes against this remote identity.
    pub fn verify(&self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        if bytes.len() != self.size as usize || hex(&Sha1::digest(bytes)) != self.sha1 {
            return Err(CloudError::Integrity);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, serde::Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct CloudListing {
    pub steam_id: u64,
    pub app_id: u32,
    pub change_number: u64,
    pub files: Vec<CloudFile>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize)]
pub struct CloudQuota {
    pub existing_files: Option<u32>,
    pub existing_bytes: Option<u64>,
    pub max_files: Option<u32>,
    pub max_bytes: Option<u64>,
}

pub(crate) fn listing(
    steam_id: u64,
    app_id: u32,
    raw: wire::ListingResponse,
) -> Result<CloudListing, CloudError> {
    if raw.is_only_delta.unwrap_or(false) {
        return Err(CloudError::Delta);
    }
    let change_number = raw
        .current_change_number
        .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("change number"))?;
    let mut names = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut files = Vec::new();
    for file in raw.files {
        let prefix = match file.prefix_index {
            None => "",
            Some(index) => raw
                .path_prefixes
                .get(index as usize)
                .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("path prefix"))?,
        };
        // The path-prefix index is presence-sensitive. These are remote names,
        // never joined to the filesystem path of the backup.
        let separator = if prefix.is_empty() || prefix.ends_with('/') {
            ""
        } else {
            "/"
        };
        let name = format!("{prefix}{separator}{}", file.name);
        if name.is_empty()
            || name.len() > 4096
            || name.chars().any(char::is_control)
            || !names.insert(name.clone())
            || !(0..=2).contains(&file.persist_state)
            || file.persist_state == 0 && file.sha.len() != 20
        {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("file identity"));
        }
        files.push(CloudFile {
            name,
            sha1: hex(&file.sha),
            size: file.size,
            timestamp: file.timestamp,
            persist_state: file.persist_state,
            platforms: file.platforms,
            reupload_requested: file.reupload,
        });
    }
    files.sort_by(|a, b| a.name.cmp(&b.name));
    Ok(CloudListing {
        steam_id,
        app_id,
        change_number,
        files,
    })
}

pub(crate) fn download_url(raw: &wire::DownloadResponse) -> Result<reqwest::Url, CloudError> {
    if !raw.https || !raw.path.starts_with('/') || raw.host.contains(['/', '?', '#', '@']) {
        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("download URL"));
    }
    let url = reqwest::Url::parse(&format!("https://{}{}", raw.host, raw.path))
        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Invalid("download URL"))?;
    let host = url.host_str().ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("download host"))?;
    let allowed = [
        "steamusercontent.com",
        "steamcontent.com",
        "steamstatic.com",
        "amazonaws.com",
        "steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net",
    ]
    .iter()
    .any(|suffix| host == *suffix || host.ends_with(&format!(".{suffix}")))
        || host
            .strip_suffix(".blob.core.windows.net")
            .is_some_and(|account| {
                account.starts_with("steamcloud")
                    && account.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric())
            })
        || host
            .strip_suffix(".storage.googleapis.com")
            .is_some_and(|bucket| {
                bucket.starts_with("steamcloud-")
                    && bucket
                        .bytes()
                        .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || byte == b'-')
            });
    if !allowed {
        return Err(CloudError::Host(host.to_owned()));
    }
    if !url.username().is_empty()
        || url.password().is_some()
        || url.fragment().is_some()
        || url.port_or_known_default() != Some(443)
    {
        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("download host"));
    }
    Ok(url)
}

pub(crate) async fn download(
    http: &reqwest::Client,
    app_id: u32,
    file: &CloudFile,
    raw: wire::DownloadResponse,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CloudError> {
    if raw.app_id != Some(app_id)
        || raw.deleted
        || raw.raw_size != Some(file.size)
        || hex(&raw.sha) != file.sha1
        || raw.timestamp != file.timestamp
    {
        return Err(CloudError::Changed);
    }
    if raw.encrypted
        || raw.file_size.is_none_or(|s| s > 256 * 1024 * 1024)
        || file.size > 256 * 1024 * 1024
    {
        return Err(CloudError::UnsupportedFormat {
            encrypted: raw.encrypted,
            transfer_size: raw.file_size,
            raw_size: file.size,
        });
    }
    let mut request = http.get(download_url(&raw)?);
    for header in raw.headers {
        let name = reqwest::header::HeaderName::from_bytes(header.name.as_bytes())
            .map_err(|_| CloudError::Invalid("header name"))?;
        if name == reqwest::header::HOST {
            if !header.value.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&raw.host) {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid("download Host mismatch"));
            }
            // Azure plans include Host. Reqwest derives the same value from
            // the validated HTTPS URL; do not install an independent authority.
            continue;
        }
        if name == reqwest::header::PROXY_AUTHORIZATION {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("download proxy authorization"));
        }
        let value = reqwest::header::HeaderValue::from_str(&header.value)
            .map_err(|_| CloudError::Invalid("header value"))?;
        request = request.header(name, value);
    }
    let response = request.send().await.map_err(|_| CloudError::Network)?;
    if !response.status().is_success() {
        return Err(CloudError::Network);
    }
    let transfer_size = raw.file_size.unwrap() as usize;
    let bytes = crate::client::read_bounded(response, transfer_size)
        .await
        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Network)?;
    if bytes.len() != transfer_size {
        return Err(CloudError::Integrity);
    }
    let bytes = unpack(file, bytes)?;
    file.verify(&bytes)?;
    Ok(bytes)
}

fn unpack(file: &CloudFile, transfer: Vec<u8>) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CloudError> {
    if transfer.len() == file.size as usize {
        return Ok(transfer);
    }
    let mut archive =
        zip::ZipArchive::new(Cursor::new(transfer)).map_err(|_| CloudError::Integrity)?;
    if archive.len() != 1 {
        return Err(CloudError::Integrity);
    }
    let entry = archive.by_index(0).map_err(|_| CloudError::Integrity)?;
    if entry.is_dir() || entry.encrypted() || entry.size() != u64::from(file.size) {
        return Err(CloudError::Integrity);
    }
    // The archive entry's name is intentionally ignored. It can never escape
    // into the filesystem; decoded bytes are verified and stored by index.
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    entry
        .take(u64::from(file.size) + 1)
        .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Integrity)?;
    Ok(bytes)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn complete_lists_expand_prefixes_but_deltas_never_become_full_sets() {
        let raw = wire::ListingResponse {
            current_change_number: Some(10),
            path_prefixes: vec!["%MacDocuments%Game/".into()],
            files: vec![wire::FileInfo {
                name: "save.dat".into(),
                prefix_index: Some(0),
                sha: vec![1; 20],
                ..Default::default()
            }],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let full = listing(123, 42, raw.clone()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(full.files[0].name, "%MacDocuments%Game/save.dat");
        assert!(matches!(
            listing(
                123,
                42,
                wire::ListingResponse {
                    is_only_delta: Some(true),
                    ..raw.clone()
                }
            ),
            Err(CloudError::Delta)
        ));
        let mut invalid = raw;
        invalid.files[0].prefix_index = Some(2);
        assert!(listing(123, 42, invalid).is_err());
    }
    #[test]
    fn compressed_downloads_require_one_bounded_verified_entry() {
        use std::io::Write;
        let payload = vec![b'x'; 4096];
        let file = CloudFile {
            name: "save.dat".into(),
            sha1: hex(&Sha1::digest(&payload)),
            size: payload.len() as u32,
            timestamp: 0,
            persist_state: 0,
            platforms: 7,
            reupload_requested: false,
        };
        for entries in [1, 2] {
            let mut zip = zip::ZipWriter::new(Cursor::new(Vec::new()));
            for index in 0..entries {
                zip.start_file(
                    format!("../../outside-{index}"),
                    zip::write::SimpleFileOptions::default()
                        .compression_method(zip::CompressionMethod::Deflated),
                )
                .unwrap();
                zip.write_all(&payload).unwrap();
            }
            let encoded = zip.finish().unwrap().into_inner();
            assert!(encoded.len() < payload.len());
            let result = unpack(&file, encoded);
            if entries == 1 {
                let bytes = result.unwrap();
                file.verify(&bytes).unwrap();
                assert_eq!(bytes, payload);
            } else {
                assert!(result.is_err());
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn download_endpoints_and_content_are_checked_without_exposing_signed_urls() {
        let mut response = wire::DownloadResponse {
            https: true,
            host: "steamcloud.s3.amazonaws.com".into(),
            path: "/file?signature=fixture".into(),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert!(download_url(&response).is_ok());
        response.host = "steamcloudparis.blob.core.windows.net".into();
        assert!(download_url(&response).is_ok());
        response.host = "steamcloud-paris.storage.googleapis.com".into();
        assert!(download_url(&response).is_ok());
        for host in [
            "localhost",
            "127.0.0.1",
            "steamusercontent.com.evil.invalid",
            "steamusercontent.com@evil.invalid",
            "steamcloudparis.blob.core.windows.net.evil.invalid",
            "unrelated.blob.core.windows.net",
            "steamcloud.paris.blob.core.windows.net",
        ] {
            response.host = host.into();
            assert!(download_url(&response).is_err());
        }
        let file = CloudFile {
            name: "save".into(),
            size: 4,
            sha1: hex(&Sha1::digest(b"good")),
            timestamp: 0,
            persist_state: 0,
            platforms: 7,
            reupload_requested: false,
        };
        assert!(file.verify(b"good").is_ok());
        assert!(file.verify(b"evil").is_err());
        assert!(file.verify(b"goo").is_err());
    }
}
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/cloud/sdk.rs`:

```rs
//! Root-0 RemoteStorage projection. Only use while the native host is stopped.
use super::{CloudError, CloudFile, LocalCloudFile};
use crate::kv::{self, Kv};
use std::{
    collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet},
    fs,
    os::unix::fs::MetadataExt,
    path::PathBuf,
};

pub struct SdkCloudPaths {
    directory: PathBuf,
    app_id: u32,
    mask: u32,
}
impl SdkCloudPaths {
    /// `mask` is the platform of the game, as a `CloudPlatform` mask. A file
    /// synced to other platforms only stays in the Cloud.
    pub fn new(directory: PathBuf, app_id: u32, mask: u32) -> Result<Self, CloudError> {
        if app_id == 0 || mask == 0 || !directory.is_absolute() {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK cache scope"));
        }
        super::paths::plain_path(&directory)?;
        Ok(Self {
            directory,
            app_id,
            mask,
        })
    }
    pub fn destination(&self, name: &str, platforms: u32) -> Result<Option<PathBuf>, CloudError> {
        let normalized = super::paths::relative(name, false)?;
        if normalized != name {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK filename alias"));
        }
        if platforms & self.mask == 0 {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        let path = self.directory.join("remote").join(name);
        super::paths::plain_path(&path)?;
        Ok(Some(path))
    }
    pub fn existing_file(&self, file: &CloudFile) -> Result<Option<PathBuf>, CloudError> {
        if file.persist_state != 0 {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        self.destination(&file.name, file.platforms)
    }
    fn records(&self) -> Result<Vec<(String, u32, u32)>, CloudError> {
        let path = self.directory.join("remotecache.vdf");
        super::paths::plain_path(&path)?;
        let bytes = match fs::read(path) {
            Ok(bytes) => bytes,
            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(Vec::new()),
            Err(_) => return Err(CloudError::Storage),
        };
        let root = kv::text(&bytes).map_err(|_| CloudError::Invalid("SDK cache index"))?;
        let [(key, app)] = root.children() else {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK cache scope"));
        };
        if key != &self.app_id.to_string() {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK cache AppID"));
        }
        if !matches!(app, Kv::Object(_)) {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK cache object"));
        }
        let mut records = Vec::new();
        let mut names = BTreeSet::new();
        for (name, value) in app.children() {
            if !names.insert(name.to_lowercase()) {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK cache alias"));
            }
            if let Kv::Value(_) = value {
                if !["changenumber", "ostype"].contains(&name.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str()) {
                    return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK cache field"));
                }
                continue;
            }
            let mut fields = BTreeSet::new();
            for (key, _) in value.children() {
                if !fields.insert(key.to_lowercase()) {
                    return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK cache duplicate field"));
                }
            }
            let number = |field: &str| {
                value
                    .get(field)
                    .and_then(Kv::text)
                    .and_then(|n| n.parse::<i64>().ok())
                    .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("SDK cache field"))
            };
            if number("root")? != 0 {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK cache root"));
            }
            let state = number("persiststate")?;
            if ![0, 2].contains(&state) {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK cache persistence state"));
            }
            let platforms = number("platformstosync2")?;
            if !(-1..=u32::MAX as i64).contains(&platforms) {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK cache platform mask"));
            }
            self.destination(name, platforms as u32)?;
            records.push((name.clone(), platforms as u32, state as u32));
        }
        Ok(records)
    }
    pub fn local_files(&self, known: &[CloudFile]) -> Result<Vec<LocalCloudFile>, CloudError> {
        let mut files = BTreeMap::new();
        for file in known {
            if let Some(path) = self.destination(&file.name, file.platforms)? {
                files.insert(
                    file.name.clone(),
                    LocalCloudFile {
                        name: file.name.clone(),
                        path,
                        platforms: file.platforms,
                    },
                );
            }
        }
        for (name, platforms, state) in self.records()? {
            if known
                .iter()
                .any(|file| file.name == name && file.platforms & self.mask == 0)
            {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid(
                    "SDK local record conflicts with foreign platform",
                ));
            }
            if let Some(path) = self.destination(&name, platforms)? {
                if state == 2 && path.exists() {
                    return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK deletion still has bytes"));
                }
                files.insert(
                    name.clone(),
                    LocalCloudFile {
                        name,
                        path,
                        platforms,
                    },
                );
            }
        }
        let mut identities = BTreeSet::new();
        for file in files.values() {
            match fs::symlink_metadata(&file.path) {
                Ok(m)
                    if !m.is_file() || m.nlink() != 1 || !identities.insert((m.dev(), m.ino())) =>
                {
                    return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK file alias"));
                }
                Err(e) if e.kind() != std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
                    return Err(CloudError::Storage);
                }
                _ => (),
            }
        }
        let expected: BTreeSet<_> = files.values().map(|file| file.path.clone()).collect();
        let mut pending = vec![(self.directory.join("remote"), 0)];
        let mut count = 0;
        while let Some((directory, depth)) = pending.pop() {
            if depth > 64 {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK directory depth"));
            }
            if !super::paths::plain_path(&directory)? {
                continue;
            }
            for entry in fs::read_dir(&directory).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)? {
                count += 1;
                if count > 100_000 {
                    return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK scan size"));
                }
                let path = entry.map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?.path();
                let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(&path).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
                if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
                    return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK symlink"));
                }
                if metadata.is_dir() {
                    pending.push((path, depth + 1));
                } else if !expected.contains(&path) {
                    return Err(CloudError::Invalid("unindexed SDK save"));
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(files.into_values().collect())
    }
    /// Replace the index before a fresh native generation, never while loaded.
    pub fn prepare_index(&self, files: &[LocalCloudFile]) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};
        let mut index = format!(
            "\"{}\"\n{{\n\"ChangeNumber\" \"0\"\n\"OSType\" \"-1\"\n",
            self.app_id
        );
        for file in files {
            if self.destination(&file.name, file.platforms)?.as_ref() != Some(&file.path) {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid("SDK cache binding"));
            }
            let data = match fs::read(&file.path) {
                Ok(bytes) => bytes,
                Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => continue,
                Err(_) => return Err(CloudError::Storage),
            };
            let time = fs::metadata(&file.path)
                .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?
                .mtime();
            let name = file.name.replace('"', "\\\"");
            index.push_str(&format!("\"{name}\"\n{{\n\"root\" \"0\"\n\"size\" \"{}\"\n\"localtime\" \"{time}\"\n\"time\" \"{time}\"\n\"remotetime\" \"0\"\n\"sha\" \"{}\"\n\"syncstate\" \"3\"\n\"persiststate\" \"0\"\n\"platformstosync2\" \"{}\"\n}}\n", data.len(), crate::content::hex(&Sha1::digest(&data)), file.platforms as i32));
        }
        index.push_str("}\n");
        fs::create_dir_all(&self.directory).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
        obelisk_core::write_atomic(&self.directory.join("remotecache.vdf"), index.as_bytes())
            .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    fn fixture() -> (tempfile::TempDir, SdkCloudPaths, LocalCloudFile) {
        let temp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let directory = temp.path().canonicalize().unwrap();
        let paths = SdkCloudPaths::new(directory, 42, 2).unwrap();
        let path = paths.destination("nested/slot.dat", 7).unwrap().unwrap();
        fs::create_dir_all(path.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
        fs::write(&path, b"fixture").unwrap();
        let file = LocalCloudFile {
            name: "nested/slot.dat".into(),
            path,
            platforms: 7,
        };
        (temp, paths, file)
    }
    #[test]
    fn index_roundtrip_preserves_nested_names_bytes_and_platforms() {
        let (_temp, paths, file) = fixture();
        paths.prepare_index(std::slice::from_ref(&file)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(paths.local_files(&[]).unwrap(), vec![file.clone()]);
        assert_eq!(fs::read(file.path).unwrap(), b"fixture");
    }
    #[test]
    fn unindexed_writes_and_foreign_or_aliased_paths_never_become_empty_saves() {
        let (_temp, paths, file) = fixture();
        assert!(paths.local_files(&[]).is_err());
        paths.prepare_index(std::slice::from_ref(&file)).unwrap();
        fs::write(paths.directory.join("remote/unindexed.dat"), b"last write").unwrap();
        assert!(paths.local_files(&[]).is_err());
        for name in [
            "../escape",
            "/absolute",
            "a//b",
            "./slot",
            "a\\b",
            "%MacHome%save",
        ] {
            assert!(paths.destination(name, 7).is_err());
        }
        assert_eq!(paths.destination("foreign.dat", 1).unwrap(), None);
    }
    #[test]
    fn a_windows_game_keeps_windows_files_and_leaves_mac_only_files_in_the_cloud() {
        let temp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let paths = SdkCloudPaths::new(temp.path().canonicalize().unwrap(), 42, 1).unwrap();
        assert!(paths.destination("windows.dat", 1).unwrap().is_some());
        assert!(
            paths
                .destination("everywhere.dat", u32::MAX)
                .unwrap()
                .is_some()
        );
        assert_eq!(paths.destination("mac.dat", 2).unwrap(), None);
        let mac = CloudFile {
            name: "mac.dat".into(),
            sha1: String::new(),
            size: 0,
            timestamp: 0,
            persist_state: 0,
            platforms: 2,
            reupload_requested: false,
        };
        paths.prepare_index(&[]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(paths.local_files(&[mac]).unwrap(), vec![]);
    }
    #[test]
    fn changed_app_scope_duplicate_records_and_symbolic_links_are_rejected() {
        let (_temp, paths, file) = fixture();
        paths.prepare_index(std::slice::from_ref(&file)).unwrap();
        let index = paths.directory.join("remotecache.vdf");
        let text = fs::read_to_string(&index).unwrap();
        fs::write(&index, text.replacen("\"42\"", "\"43\"", 1)).unwrap();
        assert!(paths.local_files(&[]).is_err());
        fs::write(
            &index,
            text.replace("\"root\" \"0\"", "\"root\" \"0\"\n\"root\" \"1\""),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(paths.local_files(&[]).is_err());
        fs::write(&index, text).unwrap();
        fs::remove_file(&file.path).unwrap();
        std::os::unix::fs::symlink("/tmp/unrelated", &file.path).unwrap();
        assert!(paths.local_files(&[]).is_err());
    }
}
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/cloud/upload.rs`:

```rs
//! CM upload execution. Policy, preferences and native-runtime exclusion belong
//! to the caller. Never resume a possibly sent mutation by sending it again.
use super::{CloudError, CloudFile, CloudListing, read, wire};
use prost::Message;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};
use std::{
    collections::BTreeMap,
    fs,
    io::Write,
    os::unix::fs::{MetadataExt, PermissionsExt},
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
};

const MAX_FILE: usize = 256 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_JOURNAL: u64 = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
/// How many file requests of one batch Steam's client keeps in flight.
pub(crate) const PARALLEL_FILES: usize = 10;
/// How many bytes Steam's client uploads at once, unless one file is larger.
const PARALLEL_BYTES: u64 = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
/// The journal's format. Schema 3 journals still open.
const SCHEMA: u32 = 4;

/// Bytes must come from the coordinator's immutable archive, not a running game.
pub struct CloudUpload {
    pub name: String,
    pub bytes: Vec<u8>,
    pub timestamp: u64,
    pub platforms: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum UploadPhase {
    Prepared,
    /// The begin request might have arrived even when its reply did not.
    Beginning,
    Open {
        batch_id: u64,
    },
    Completing {
        batch_id: u64,
    },
    Acknowledged,
    Verified,
    /// Closing a failed batch does not roll back already committed files.
    Interrupted {
        batch_id: Option<u64>,
    },
    /// Steam acknowledged closure. This alone does not fence an older file
    /// mutation whose response was lost; the journal tracks that separately.
    Closed {
        batch_id: u64,
    },
}

#[derive(Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct State {
    schema: u32,
    before: CloudListing,
    uploads: Vec<CloudFile>,
    deletes: Vec<String>,
    phase: UploadPhase,
    unanswered_mutation: bool,
    // Begin-file replied; no positive commit has been sent while unanswered is
    // false. Retain the exact files needed to report interrupted HTTP uploads.
    // Schema 3 kept at most one, as `staged_upload`.
    #[serde(alias = "staged_upload", deserialize_with = "staged")]
    staged_uploads: Vec<usize>,
}

/// The staged uploads as either schema wrote them.
fn staged<'de, D: serde::Deserializer<'de>>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Vec<usize>, D::Error> {
    #[derive(Deserialize)]
    #[serde(untagged)]
    enum Staged {
        One(Option<usize>),
        Many(Vec<usize>),
    }
    Ok(match Staged::deserialize(deserializer)? {
        Staged::One(one) => one.into_iter().collect(),
        Staged::Many(many) => many,
    })
}

/// Private, locked journal and immutable file bodies. No signed URL, header or
/// credential is persisted. Retain this directory until the coordinator has
/// reconciled the outcome; interrupted transactions are never restarted here.
pub struct UploadTransaction {
    directory: PathBuf,
    state: State,
    poisoned: bool,
    _lock: fs::File,
}

impl UploadTransaction {
    pub fn create(
        parent: &Path,
        before: CloudListing,
        uploads: Vec<CloudUpload>,
        deletes: Vec<String>,
    ) -> Result<Self, CloudError> {
        safe_directory(parent)?;
        if before.app_id == 0
            || before.steam_id == 0
            || before.files.len() > 100_000
            || uploads.len() + deletes.len() > 100_000
            || uploads.is_empty() && deletes.is_empty()
        {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("upload scope"));
        }
        let directory = tempfile::Builder::new()
            .prefix("upload-")
            .permissions(fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700))
            .tempdir_in(parent)
            .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
        let mut files = Vec::new();
        for (index, upload) in uploads.into_iter().enumerate() {
            if upload.bytes.len() > MAX_FILE {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid("upload size"));
            }
            let file = CloudFile {
                name: upload.name,
                sha1: crate::content::hex(&Sha1::digest(&upload.bytes)),
                size: upload.bytes.len() as u32,
                timestamp: upload.timestamp,
                persist_state: 0,
                platforms: upload.platforms,
                reupload_requested: false,
            };
            write_new(
                &directory.path().join(format!("file-{index}.bin")),
                &upload.bytes,
            )?;
            files.push(file);
        }
        let state = State {
            schema: SCHEMA,
            before,
            uploads: files,
            deletes,
            phase: UploadPhase::Prepared,
            unanswered_mutation: false,
            staged_uploads: Vec::new(),
        };
        expected(&state)?;
        let lock = lock(directory.path())?;
        let mut transaction = Self {
            directory: directory.path().into(),
            state,
            poisoned: false,
            _lock: lock,
        };
        transaction.save(UploadPhase::Prepared)?;
        let _ = directory.keep();
        sync(parent)?;
        Ok(transaction)
    }

    pub fn open(directory: &Path) -> Result<Self, CloudError> {
        safe_directory(directory)?;
        let lock = lock(directory)?;
        let path = directory.join("state.json");
        regular(&path, MAX_JOURNAL)?;
        let mut state: State =
            serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&path).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?)
                .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
        if !(3..=SCHEMA).contains(&state.schema)
            || state.before.app_id == 0
            || state.before.steam_id == 0
        {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("upload journal"));
        }
        state.schema = SCHEMA;
        expected(&state)?;
        let mut staged = state.staged_uploads.clone();
        staged.sort_unstable();
        staged.dedup();
        if staged.len() != state.staged_uploads.len()
            || staged.last().is_some_and(|i| *i >= state.uploads.len())
            || matches!(
                state.phase,
                UploadPhase::Prepared
                    | UploadPhase::Completing { .. }
                    | UploadPhase::Acknowledged
                    | UploadPhase::Verified
            ) && (!state.staged_uploads.is_empty() || state.unanswered_mutation)
        {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("upload progress"));
        }
        let transaction = Self {
            directory: directory.into(),
            state,
            poisoned: false,
            _lock: lock,
        };
        for (index, file) in transaction.state.uploads.iter().enumerate() {
            transaction.content(index, file)?;
        }
        Ok(transaction)
    }

    pub fn directory(&self) -> &Path {
        &self.directory
    }
    pub fn phase(&self) -> &UploadPhase {
        &self.state.phase
    }
    pub fn steam_id(&self) -> u64 {
        self.state.before.steam_id
    }
    pub fn app_id(&self) -> u32 {
        self.state.before.app_id
    }
    /// The planned file writes, in upload order.
    pub fn uploads(&self) -> &[CloudFile] {
        &self.state.uploads
    }
    /// The planned remote deletions.
    pub fn deletes(&self) -> &[String] {
        &self.state.deletes
    }
    /// The immutable body of planned upload `index`, checked against its hash.
    pub fn upload_body(&self, index: usize) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CloudError> {
        let file = self
            .state
            .uploads
            .get(index)
            .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("upload index"))?;
        self.content(index, file)
    }

    /// Reports complete receipts for the coordinator's confirmed recovery path.
    /// False does not prevent a separate fresh-comparison retry policy. This
    /// method says nothing about rollback or equality.
    pub fn is_settled(&self) -> bool {
        !self.poisoned
            && match self.phase() {
                UploadPhase::Prepared | UploadPhase::Acknowledged | UploadPhase::Verified => true,
                UploadPhase::Closed { .. } => {
                    !self.state.unanswered_mutation && self.state.staged_uploads.is_empty()
                }
                _ => false,
            }
    }

    fn save(&mut self, phase: UploadPhase) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        self.save_progress(phase, self.state.unanswered_mutation)
    }

    fn save_progress(
        &mut self,
        phase: UploadPhase,
        unanswered_mutation: bool,
    ) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        let mut next = self.state.clone();
        next.phase = phase;
        next.unanswered_mutation = unanswered_mutation;
        self.persist(next)
    }

    fn save_file_progress(
        &mut self,
        unanswered: bool,
        staged: Vec<usize>,
    ) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        let mut next = self.state.clone();
        next.unanswered_mutation = unanswered;
        next.staged_uploads = staged;
        self.persist(next)
    }

    fn persist(&mut self, next: State) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        if self.poisoned {
            return Err(CloudError::Storage);
        }
        let result = (|| {
            let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&next).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
            if bytes.len() as u64 > MAX_JOURNAL {
                return Err(CloudError::Storage);
            }
            obelisk_core::write_atomic(&self.directory.join("state.json"), &bytes)
                .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
            sync(&self.directory)
        })();
        if result.is_err() {
            self.poisoned = true;
        }
        result?;
        self.state = next;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn content(&self, index: usize, file: &CloudFile) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CloudError> {
        let path = self.directory.join(format!("file-{index}.bin"));
        regular(&path, MAX_FILE as u64)?;
        let bytes = fs::read(path).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
        file.verify(&bytes)?;
        Ok(bytes)
    }
}

fn safe_directory(directory: &Path) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
    if !directory.is_absolute() {
        return Err(CloudError::Storage);
    }
    // macOS /var is a system alias. Canonicalize the caller's parent first, but
    // reject user-supplied links at any subsequent transaction path component.
    for parent in directory.ancestors() {
        if !fs::symlink_metadata(parent).is_ok_and(|m| m.file_type().is_dir()) {
            return Err(CloudError::Storage);
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn regular(path: &Path, max: u64) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
    let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
    if !metadata.file_type().is_file() || metadata.nlink() != 1 || metadata.len() > max {
        return Err(CloudError::Storage);
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn lock(directory: &Path) -> Result<fs::File, CloudError> {
    let path = directory.join("owner.lock");
    let file = match fs::File::create_new(&path) {
        Ok(file) => file,
        Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => {
            regular(&path, 0)?;
            fs::File::options()
                .read(true)
                .write(true)
                .open(&path)
                .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?
        }
        Err(_) => return Err(CloudError::Storage),
    };
    file.set_permissions(fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600))
        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
    file.try_lock().map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
    Ok(file)
}
fn write_new(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
    let file = fs::File::create_new(path).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
    write_private(file, bytes)
}
/// Account data is written owner-only and fsynced before the caller treats it
/// as published.
pub(crate) fn write_private(mut file: fs::File, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
    file.set_permissions(fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600))
        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
    file.write_all(bytes).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
    file.sync_all().map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)
}
/// fsync a directory so a completed rename or create within it is durable.
pub(crate) fn sync(path: &Path) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
    fs::File::open(path)
        .and_then(|file| file.sync_all())
        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)
}

fn valid_file(file: &CloudFile) -> bool {
    !file.name.is_empty()
        && file.name.len() <= 4096
        && !file.name.chars().any(char::is_control)
        && file.size as usize <= MAX_FILE
        && (0..=2).contains(&file.persist_state)
        && (file.persist_state != 0
            || file.sha1.len() == 40
                && file
                    .sha1
                    .bytes()
                    .all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit() || (b'a'..=b'f').contains(&b)))
}
fn expected(state: &State) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, CloudFile>, CloudError> {
    if state.before.files.len() > 100_000 || state.uploads.len() + state.deletes.len() > 100_000 {
        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("upload manifest size"));
    }
    let mut files = BTreeMap::new();
    for file in &state.before.files {
        if !valid_file(file) || files.insert(file.name.clone(), file.clone()).is_some() {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("remote file"));
        }
    }
    let mut changed = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
    for file in &state.uploads {
        if !valid_file(file) || file.persist_state != 0 || !changed.insert(&file.name) {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("upload file"));
        }
        files.insert(file.name.clone(), file.clone());
    }
    for name in &state.deletes {
        if !changed.insert(name) || !files.get(name).is_some_and(|file| file.persist_state == 0) {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("upload deletion"));
        }
        files.remove(name);
    }
    files.retain(|_, file| file.persist_state == 0);
    if files.len() > 100_000 {
        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("upload manifest size"));
    }
    Ok(files)
}

pub(crate) trait Transport {
    async fn commit(
        &mut self,
        request: &wire::CommitUploadRequest,
    ) -> Result<wire::CommitUploadResponse, CloudError> {
        self.call("Cloud.ClientCommitFileUpload#1", request).await
    }
    async fn call<R: Message + Default>(
        &mut self,
        name: &str,
        request: &impl Message,
    ) -> Result<R, CloudError>;
    /// Answers `requests` to the same method, in their order. A transport
    /// may keep up to `PARALLEL_FILES` in flight. The first failure ends the
    /// set, and the requests already sent may have arrived.
    async fn calls<R: Message + Default>(
        &mut self,
        name: &str,
        requests: &[impl Message],
    ) -> Result<Vec<R>, CloudError> {
        let mut answers = Vec::with_capacity(requests.len());
        for request in requests {
            answers.push(self.call(name, request).await?);
        }
        Ok(answers)
    }
    async fn block(&mut self, block: &wire::UploadBlock, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CloudError>;
    /// Sends each file's blocks in sequence. A transport may send up to
    /// `PARALLEL_FILES` files at once; the first failure ends the set.
    async fn bodies(&mut self, files: &[(&[wire::UploadBlock], &[u8])]) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        for (blocks, bytes) in files {
            for block in *blocks {
                self.block(block, bytes).await?;
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    /// Commits each file, as `calls` answers requests.
    async fn commits(
        &mut self,
        requests: &[wire::CommitUploadRequest],
    ) -> Result<Vec<wire::CommitUploadResponse>, CloudError> {
        let mut receipts = Vec::with_capacity(requests.len());
        for request in requests {
            receipts.push(self.commit(request).await?);
        }
        Ok(receipts)
    }
    async fn listing(&mut self, app_id: u32) -> Result<CloudListing, CloudError>;
}

/// Every step re-checks authorization: a revoked session must not advance a
/// partially applied batch.
fn check(authorize: &impl Fn() -> bool) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
    if authorize() {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(CloudError::Revoked)
    }
}

/// Runs the batch, then confirms it with one complete listing: every file
/// must carry the identity the batch gave it. Like Steam's own client, no
/// remote byte is read back.
pub(crate) async fn execute(
    transport: &mut impl Transport,
    job: &mut UploadTransaction,
    authorize: &impl Fn() -> bool,
) -> Result<CloudListing, CloudError> {
    if job.poisoned {
        return Err(CloudError::Storage);
    }
    let app = job.app_id();
    check(authorize)?;
    match job.phase() {
        UploadPhase::Prepared => {
            // Acquire the current complete view before any mutation. This detects
            // stale user choices; the protocol does not offer atomic CAS.
            if transport.listing(app).await? != job.state.before {
                return Err(CloudError::Changed);
            }
            for (index, file) in job.state.uploads.iter().enumerate() {
                job.content(index, file)?;
            }
            check(authorize)?;
            job.save_progress(UploadPhase::Beginning, true)?;
            let begin: wire::BeginBatchResponse = transport
                .call(
                    "Cloud.BeginAppUploadBatch#1",
                    &wire::BeginBatchRequest {
                        app_id: app,
                        machine_name: "Obelisk".into(),
                        uploads: job.state.uploads.iter().map(|f| f.name.clone()).collect(),
                        deletes: job.state.deletes.clone(),
                    },
                )
                .await?;
            let batch_id = begin
                .batch_id
                .filter(|id| *id != 0)
                .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("upload batch id"))?;
            job.save_progress(UploadPhase::Open { batch_id }, false)?;
            let uploaded = upload_files(transport, job, batch_id, authorize).await;
            if let Err(error) = uploaded {
                // Best-effort closure releases Steam's batch. It never reports
                // rollback or permits a blind retry of already sent mutations.
                job.save(UploadPhase::Interrupted {
                    batch_id: Some(batch_id),
                })?;
                if authorize() {
                    // A failed HTTP transfer still needs its negative file
                    // receipt. Never negate an unanswered positive commit.
                    let _ = abort_staged_uploads(transport, job, authorize).await;
                    if job.poisoned {
                        return Err(CloudError::Storage);
                    }
                    // Preserve the original failure if the best-effort close
                    // also fails. A failed journal write still poisons the job.
                    if authorize() {
                        let _ = close_batch(transport, job, batch_id).await;
                    }
                    if job.poisoned {
                        return Err(CloudError::Storage);
                    }
                }
                return Err(error);
            }
            check(authorize)?;
            job.save(UploadPhase::Completing { batch_id })?;
            let _: wire::EmptyResponse = transport
                .call(
                    "Cloud.CompleteAppUploadBatchBlocking#1",
                    &wire::CompleteBatchRequest {
                        app_id: app,
                        batch_id,
                        result: 1,
                    },
                )
                .await?;
            job.save(UploadPhase::Acknowledged)?;
        }
        UploadPhase::Acknowledged | UploadPhase::Verified => {}
        _ => return Err(CloudError::Uncertain),
    }
    check(authorize)?;
    let actual = transport.listing(app).await?;
    let desired = expected(&job.state)?;
    let persisted: BTreeMap<_, _> = actual
        .files
        .iter()
        .filter(|f| f.persist_state == 0)
        .map(|f| (f.name.clone(), f))
        .collect();
    if actual.steam_id != job.steam_id()
        || actual.app_id != app
        || persisted.len() != desired.len()
        || desired.iter().any(|(name, file)| {
            persisted.get(name).is_none_or(|other| {
                file.sha1 != other.sha1
                    || file.size != other.size
                    || file.platforms != other.platforms
                    || other.reupload_requested
            })
        })
    {
        return Err(CloudError::Changed);
    }
    check(authorize)?;
    job.save(UploadPhase::Verified)?;
    Ok(actual)
}

async fn upload_files(
    transport: &mut impl Transport,
    job: &mut UploadTransaction,
    batch_id: u64,
    authorize: &impl Fn() -> bool,
) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
    for wave in waves(&job.state.uploads) {
        upload_wave(transport, job, batch_id, &wave, authorize).await?;
    }
    if job.state.deletes.is_empty() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    // As Steam's client does, the deletions go out together: the journal
    // holds them as one unanswered mutation until each is answered.
    let deletes: Vec<_> = job
        .state
        .deletes
        .iter()
        .map(|name| wire::DeleteRequest {
            app_id: job.app_id(),
            name: name.clone(),
            explicit: true,
            batch_id,
        })
        .collect();
    check(authorize)?;
    job.save_progress(job.phase().clone(), true)?;
    let _: Vec<wire::EmptyResponse> = transport
        .calls("Cloud.ClientDeleteFile#1", &deletes)
        .await?;
    job.save_progress(job.phase().clone(), false)
}

/// The uploads' indexes in order, grouped as Steam's client bounds its
/// parallel uploads: at most `PARALLEL_FILES` files and `PARALLEL_BYTES`.
fn waves(uploads: &[CloudFile]) -> Vec<Vec<usize>> {
    let mut waves: Vec<Vec<usize>> = Vec::new();
    let mut bytes = 0;
    for (index, file) in uploads.iter().enumerate() {
        let size = u64::from(file.size);
        match waves.last_mut() {
            Some(wave) if wave.len() < PARALLEL_FILES && bytes + size <= PARALLEL_BYTES => {
                wave.push(index);
                bytes += size;
            }
            _ => {
                waves.push(vec![index]);
                bytes = size;
            }
        }
    }
    waves
}

/// Uploads the files at `wave` together, as Steam's client does: their
/// begins, then their bodies, then their commits. Between the begin replies
/// and the commits, the journal lists the wave as staged.
async fn upload_wave(
    transport: &mut impl Transport,
    job: &mut UploadTransaction,
    batch_id: u64,
    wave: &[usize],
    authorize: &impl Fn() -> bool,
) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
    let mut files = Vec::with_capacity(wave.len());
    for &index in wave {
        let file = job.state.uploads[index].clone();
        let bytes = job.content(index, &file)?;
        let sha = Sha1::digest(&bytes).to_vec();
        files.push((file, bytes, sha));
    }
    let begins: Vec<_> = files
        .iter()
        .map(|(file, _, sha)| wire::BeginUploadRequest {
            app_id: job.app_id(),
            file_size: file.size,
            raw_size: file.size,
            sha: sha.clone(),
            timestamp: file.timestamp,
            name: file.name.clone(),
            platforms: file.platforms,
            can_encrypt: false,
            batch_id,
        })
        .collect();
    check(authorize)?;
    job.save_progress(job.phase().clone(), true)?;
    let plans: Vec<wire::BeginUploadResponse> = transport
        .calls("Cloud.ClientBeginFileUpload#1", &begins)
        .await?;
    job.save_file_progress(false, wave.to_vec())?;
    // Validate every block before sending the first. Each file's blocks go
    // in sequence, preserving control requests around multipart data blocks.
    for (plan, (_, bytes, _)) in plans.iter().zip(&files) {
        if plan.encrypted || plan.blocks.len() > 4096 {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("upload format"));
        }
        for block in &plan.blocks {
            block_request(block, bytes)?;
        }
    }
    let bodies: Vec<_> = plans
        .iter()
        .zip(&files)
        .map(|(plan, (_, bytes, _))| (plan.blocks.as_slice(), bytes.as_slice()))
        .collect();
    check(authorize)?;
    transport.bodies(&bodies).await?;
    let commits: Vec<_> = files
        .iter()
        .map(|(file, _, sha)| wire::CommitUploadRequest {
            succeeded: true,
            app_id: job.app_id(),
            sha: sha.clone(),
            name: file.name.clone(),
        })
        .collect();
    check(authorize)?;
    job.save_progress(job.phase().clone(), true)?;
    let receipts = transport.commits(&commits).await?;
    // A missing result is malformed, not a negative acknowledgement.
    if receipts.iter().any(|receipt| receipt.committed.is_none()) {
        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("file commit result"));
    }
    job.save_file_progress(false, Vec::new())?;
    if receipts
        .iter()
        .any(|receipt| receipt.committed != Some(true))
    {
        return Err(CloudError::NotCommitted);
    }
    Ok(())
}

async fn close_batch(
    transport: &mut impl Transport,
    job: &mut UploadTransaction,
    batch_id: u64,
) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
    let _: wire::EmptyResponse = transport
        .call(
            "Cloud.CompleteAppUploadBatchBlocking#1",
            &wire::CompleteBatchRequest {
                app_id: job.app_id(),
                batch_id,
                result: 2,
            },
        )
        .await?;
    job.save(UploadPhase::Closed { batch_id })
}

/// Report failed transfers only when the durable journal proves that their
/// file commits were never sent. A lost abort reply is uncertain and is never
/// replayed.
async fn abort_staged_uploads(
    transport: &mut impl Transport,
    job: &mut UploadTransaction,
    authorize: &impl Fn() -> bool,
) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
    if job.state.unanswered_mutation {
        return Err(CloudError::Uncertain);
    }
    if job.state.staged_uploads.is_empty() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    check(authorize)?;
    let mut aborts = Vec::with_capacity(job.state.staged_uploads.len());
    for &index in &job.state.staged_uploads {
        let file = &job.state.uploads[index];
        aborts.push(wire::CommitUploadRequest {
            succeeded: false,
            app_id: job.app_id(),
            sha: Sha1::digest(job.content(index, file)?).to_vec(),
            name: file.name.clone(),
        });
    }
    job.save_progress(job.phase().clone(), true)?;
    let receipts = transport.commits(&aborts).await?;
    if receipts
        .iter()
        .any(|receipt| receipt.committed != Some(false))
    {
        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("failed transfer receipt"));
    }
    job.save_file_progress(false, Vec::new())
}

/// Reports unfinished HTTP files as failed, then closes the known batch. No
/// file request is resent. A lost Begin reply or an unanswered commit/deletion
/// remains blocked, even if Steam previously acknowledged batch closure.
pub(crate) async fn settle(
    transport: &mut impl Transport,
    job: &mut UploadTransaction,
    authorize: &impl Fn() -> bool,
) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
    if job.poisoned {
        return Err(CloudError::Storage);
    }
    check(authorize)?;
    if job.is_settled() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    if job.state.unanswered_mutation {
        return Err(CloudError::Uncertain);
    }
    let batch_id = match job.phase() {
        UploadPhase::Open { batch_id }
        | UploadPhase::Completing { batch_id }
        | UploadPhase::Interrupted {
            batch_id: Some(batch_id),
        } => *batch_id,
        _ => return Err(CloudError::Uncertain),
    };
    abort_staged_uploads(transport, job, authorize).await?;
    check(authorize)?;
    job.save(UploadPhase::Interrupted {
        batch_id: Some(batch_id),
    })?;
    close_batch(transport, job, batch_id).await
}

pub(crate) fn block_request(
    block: &wire::UploadBlock,
    bytes: &[u8],
) -> Result<reqwest::Request, CloudError> {
    let url = read::download_url(&wire::DownloadResponse {
        host: block.host.clone(),
        path: block.path.clone(),
        https: block.https,
        ..Default::default()
    })?;
    let method = match block.method {
        1 => reqwest::Method::GET,
        2 => reqwest::Method::HEAD,
        3 => reqwest::Method::POST,
        4 => reqwest::Method::PUT,
        5 => reqwest::Method::DELETE,
        6 => reqwest::Method::OPTIONS,
        7 => reqwest::Method::PATCH,
        _ => return Err(CloudError::Invalid("upload HTTP method")),
    };
    let body = match &block.body {
        Some(body) if body.len() <= MAX_FILE => body.as_slice(),
        Some(_) => return Err(CloudError::Invalid("upload explicit body size")),
        None => {
            let start =
                usize::try_from(block.offset).map_err(|_| CloudError::Invalid("upload offset"))?;
            let end = start
                .checked_add(block.length as usize)
                .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("upload length"))?;
            bytes
                .get(start..end)
                .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("upload range"))?
        }
    };
    if (method == reqwest::Method::GET || method == reqwest::Method::HEAD) && !body.is_empty() {
        return Err(CloudError::Invalid("upload method body"));
    }
    let mut request = reqwest::Request::new(method, url);
    for header in &block.headers {
        let name = reqwest::header::HeaderName::from_bytes(header.name.as_bytes())
            .map_err(|_| CloudError::Invalid("upload header"))?;
        if name == reqwest::header::HOST {
            if !header.value.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&block.host) {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid("upload Host mismatch"));
            }
            continue;
        }
        if name == reqwest::header::CONTENT_LENGTH {
            if header.value.parse::<usize>().ok() != Some(body.len()) {
                return Err(CloudError::Invalid("upload Content-Length"));
            }
            continue;
        }
        if [
            reqwest::header::PROXY_AUTHORIZATION,
            reqwest::header::TRANSFER_ENCODING,
            reqwest::header::CONNECTION,
            reqwest::header::COOKIE,
        ]
        .contains(&name)
        {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("upload header"));
        }
        let mut value = reqwest::header::HeaderValue::from_str(&header.value)
            .map_err(|_| CloudError::Invalid("upload header"))?;
        value.set_sensitive(true);
        request.headers_mut().append(name, value);
    }
    *request.body_mut() = Some(body.to_vec().into());
    Ok(request)
}
```

```rs
#[test]
fn opening_requires_current_upload_schema_and_recovery_information() {
    let (_root, job, _server) = fixture();
    let directory = job.directory().to_owned();
    let path = directory.join("state.json");
    let current = serde_json::to_value(&job.state).unwrap();
    drop(job);
    assert!(UploadTransaction::open(&directory).is_ok());
    for case in 0..3 {
        let mut old = current.clone();
        match case {
            0 => old["schema"] = 1.into(),
            1 => old["schema"] = 2.into(),
            2 => {
                old.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("unanswered_mutation");
            }
            _ => unreachable!(),
        }
        fs::write(&path, serde_json::to_vec(&old).unwrap()).unwrap();
        let before = fs::read(&path).unwrap();
        assert!(UploadTransaction::open(&directory).is_err());
        assert_eq!(fs::read(&path).unwrap(), before);
    }

struct Fake {
    remote: CloudListing,
    bodies: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
    calls: Vec<String>,
    fault: Option<&'static str>,
    commit: bool,
    /// The bytes each file's blocks carried, by file name.
    blocks: BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
    pending: BTreeMap<String, wire::BeginUploadRequest>,
    /// The uploads and deletions the batch must announce.
    batch: (Vec<String>, Vec<String>),
    /// Someone else's file appears once the batch completed.
    concurrent_edit: bool,
    pause_block: bool,
    move_journal: Option<(PathBuf, PathBuf)>,
    abort_receipt: Option<bool>,
}
impl Fake {
    fn response<R: Message + Default>(
        &mut self,
        name: &str,
        response: &impl Message,
    ) -> Result<R, CloudError> {
        if self.fault == Some(name) {
            self.fault = None;
            return Err(CloudError::Network);
        }
        Ok(R::decode(response.encode_to_vec().as_slice()).unwrap())
    }
}
impl Transport for Fake {
    async fn call<R: Message + Default>(
        &mut self,
        name: &str,
        request: &impl Message,
    ) -> Result<R, CloudError> {
        self.calls.push(name.into());
        let data = request.encode_to_vec();
        match name {
            "Cloud.BeginAppUploadBatch#1" => {
                let req = wire::BeginBatchRequest::decode(data.as_slice()).unwrap();
                assert_eq!(req.uploads, self.batch.0);
                assert_eq!(req.deletes, self.batch.1);
                if let Some((from, to)) = self.move_journal.take() {
                    fs::rename(from, to).unwrap();
                }
                self.response(
                    name,
                    &wire::BeginBatchResponse {
                        batch_id: Some(123),
                        change_number: Some(3),
                    },
                )
            }
            "Cloud.ClientBeginFileUpload#1" => {
                let req = wire::BeginUploadRequest::decode(data.as_slice()).unwrap();
                if self.pending.contains_key(&req.name) {
                    return Err(CloudError::Cm(crate::cm::CmError::Rejected {
                        action: "fixture file busy",
                        result: 10,
                    }));
                }
                assert!(!req.can_encrypt);
                assert_eq!(req.file_size, req.raw_size);
                // Two parts, each block's path naming its file.
                let split = req.file_size.min(3);
                let block = |path: String, offset: u32, length: u32| wire::UploadBlock {
                    https: true,
                    host: "steamcloud-test.storage.googleapis.com".into(),
                    path,
                    method: 4,
                    offset: offset.into(),
                    length,
                    ..Default::default()
                };
                let plan = wire::BeginUploadResponse {
                    encrypted: false,
                    blocks: vec![
                        block(format!("/{}/part1?secret=never-log", req.name), 0, split),
                        block(format!("/{}/part2", req.name), split, req.file_size - split),
                    ],
                };
                self.pending.insert(req.name.clone(), req);
                self.response(name, &plan)
            }
            "Cloud.ClientCommitFileUpload#1" => {
                let req = wire::CommitUploadRequest::decode(data.as_slice()).unwrap();
                let pending = self.pending.remove(&req.name).unwrap();
                assert_eq!(req.sha, pending.sha);
                let sent = self.blocks.remove(&req.name).unwrap_or_default();
                if !req.succeeded {
                    self.calls.push("abort-file".into());
                }
                if self.commit && req.succeeded {
                    let bytes = sent;
                    assert_eq!(
                        crate::content::hex(&Sha1::digest(&bytes)),
                        crate::content::hex(&req.sha)
                    );
                    self.remote.files.retain(|file| file.name != req.name);
                    self.remote.files.push(file(&req.name, &bytes));
                    self.bodies.insert(req.name, bytes);
                }
                self.response(
                    name,
                    &wire::CommitUploadResponse {
                        committed: if req.succeeded {
                            Some(self.commit)
                        } else {
                            self.abort_receipt
                        },
                    },
                )
            }
            "Cloud.ClientDeleteFile#1" => {
                let req = wire::DeleteRequest::decode(data.as_slice()).unwrap();
                assert!(req.explicit);
                assert_eq!(req.batch_id, 123);
                self.remote.files.retain(|file| file.name != req.name);
                self.bodies.remove(&req.name);
                self.response(name, &wire::EmptyResponse {})
            }
            "Cloud.CompleteAppUploadBatchBlocking#1" => {
                let req = wire::CompleteBatchRequest::decode(data.as_slice()).unwrap();
                self.calls.push(format!("complete-result-{}", req.result));
                self.remote.change_number = 3;
                self.response(name, &wire::EmptyResponse {})
            }
            _ => panic!("unexpected test RPC"),
        }
    }
    async fn block(&mut self, block: &wire::UploadBlock, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        self.calls.push("block".into());
        if self.fault == Some("block") {
            self.fault = None;
            return Err(CloudError::Network);
        }
        let request = block_request(block, bytes)?;
        let name = block.path.split('/').nth(1).unwrap().to_owned();
        self.blocks
            .entry(name)
            .or_default()
            .extend_from_slice(request.body().unwrap().as_bytes().unwrap());
        if self.pause_block {
            std::future::pending::<()>().await;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    async fn listing(&mut self, _: u32) -> Result<CloudListing, CloudError> {
        self.calls.push("listing".into());
        if self.concurrent_edit && self.remote.change_number == 3 {
            self.remote
                .files
                .push(file("concurrent", b"someone else's edit"));
            self.concurrent_edit = false;
        }
        Ok(self.remote.clone())
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn interrupted_http_recovery_releases_file_before_a_fresh_upload() {
    let (root, mut job, mut server) = fixture();
    server.pause_block = true;
    assert!(
        tokio::time::timeout(
            std::time::Duration::from_millis(20),
            execute(&mut server, &mut job, &|| true),
        )
        .await
        .is_err()
    );
    let path = job.directory().to_owned();
    drop(job);
    let mut job = UploadTransaction::open(&path).unwrap();
    server.pause_block = false;
    server.calls.clear();
    settle(&mut server, &mut job, &|| true).await.unwrap();
    assert!(job.is_settled());
    let mut fresh = UploadTransaction::create(
        &root.path().canonicalize().unwrap(),
        server.remote.clone(),
        vec![CloudUpload {
            name: "new".into(),
            bytes: b"new-data".to_vec(),
            timestamp: 4,
            platforms: 7,
        }],
        vec!["delete".into()],
    )
    .unwrap();
    execute(&mut server, &mut fresh, &|| true)
        .await
        .expect("settlement must release the staged file");
    assert_eq!(server.bodies["new"], b"new-data");
    assert_eq!(server.bodies["keep"], b"same");
    assert_eq!(
        &server.calls[..4],
        [
            "Cloud.ClientCommitFileUpload#1",
            "abort-file",
            "Cloud.CompleteAppUploadBatchBlocking#1",
            "complete-result-2"
        ]
    );
}

#[tokio::test]

    let (_root, mut job, mut server) = fixture();

        execute(&mut server, &mut job, &|| true).await,
        Err(CloudError::NotCommitted)
    ));

    drop(job);
    let mut job = UploadTransaction::open(&path).unwrap();

#[test]
fn upload_plans_honor_explicit_bodies_offsets_methods_and_authorities() {
    let mut block = wire::UploadBlock {
        https: true,
        host: "steamcloud-test.storage.googleapis.com".into(),
        path: "/data?sig=secret".into(),
        method: 4,
        offset: 2,
        length: 3,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    assert_eq!(
        block_request(&block, b"abcdef")
            .unwrap()
            .body()
            .unwrap()
            .as_bytes()
            .unwrap(),
        b"cde"
    );
    block.offset = u64::MAX;
    assert!(block_request(&block, b"abcdef").is_err());
    block.body = Some(b"completion document".to_vec());
    block.method = 3;
    assert_eq!(
        block_request(&block, b"abcdef")
            .unwrap()
            .body()
            .unwrap()
            .as_bytes()
            .unwrap(),
        b"completion document"
    );
    block.body = Some(vec![]);
    block.method = 1;
    assert!(block_request(&block, b"abcdef").is_ok());
    block.body = None;
    assert!(block_request(&block, b"abcdef").is_err());
    block.offset = 0;
    block.method = 4;
    block.headers = vec![wire::Header {
        name: "Host".into(),
        value: "evil.invalid".into(),
    }];
    assert!(block_request(&block, b"abcdef").is_err());
    block.headers.clear();
    block.https = false;
    assert!(block_request(&block, b"abcdef").is_err());
    block.https = true;
    block.host = "localhost".into();
    assert!(block_request(&block, b"abcdef").is_err());
}

/// A batch of `uploads` new files and `deletes` deletions, beside a kept file.
fn batch_fixture(uploads: usize, deletes: usize) -> (tempfile::TempDir, UploadTransaction, Fake) {
    let (root, job, mut server) = fixture();
    drop(job);
    let parent = root.path().canonicalize().unwrap();
    let doomed: Vec<String> = (0..deletes).map(|i| format!("old-{i:02}")).collect();
    let mut before = listing(vec![file("keep", b"same")]);
    before
        .files
        .extend(doomed.iter().map(|name| file(name, name.as_bytes())));
    let new: Vec<_> = (0..uploads)
        .map(|i| CloudUpload {
            name: format!("file-{i:02}"),
            bytes: format!("data-{i}").into_bytes(),
            timestamp: 4,
            platforms: 7,
        })
        .collect();
    server.batch = (new.iter().map(|u| u.name.clone()).collect(), doomed.clone());
    server.remote = before.clone();
    server.bodies = doomed
        .iter()
        .map(|name| (name.clone(), name.as_bytes().to_vec()))
        .chain([("keep".to_owned(), b"same".to_vec())])
        .collect();
    let job = UploadTransaction::create(&parent, before, new, doomed).unwrap();
    (root, job, server)
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn files_go_in_waves_of_ten_before_the_deletions() {
    let (_root, mut job, mut server) = batch_fixture(12, 3);
    execute(&mut server, &mut job, &|| true).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(job.phase(), &UploadPhase::Verified);
    for i in 0..12 {
        assert_eq!(
            server.bodies[&format!("file-{i:02}")],
            format!("data-{i}").as_bytes()
        );
    }
    assert!(!server.bodies.keys().any(|name| name.starts_with("old-")));
    let wave = |files: usize| {
        [
            vec!["Cloud.ClientBeginFileUpload#1"; files],
            vec!["block"; 2 * files],
            vec!["Cloud.ClientCommitFileUpload#1"; files],
        ]
        .concat()
    };
    let expected = [
        vec!["listing", "Cloud.BeginAppUploadBatch#1"],
        wave(PARALLEL_FILES),
        wave(2),
        vec!["Cloud.ClientDeleteFile#1"; 3],
        vec![
            "Cloud.CompleteAppUploadBatchBlocking#1",
            "complete-result-1",
            "listing",
        ],
    ]
    .concat();
    assert_eq!(server.calls, expected);
}

#[test]
fn a_schema_3_journal_opens_with_its_one_staged_upload() {
    let (_root, job, _server) = fixture();
    let directory = job.directory().to_owned();
    let path = directory.join("state.json");
    let mut current = serde_json::to_value(&job.state).unwrap();
    drop(job);
    let object = current.as_object_mut().unwrap();
    object.remove("staged_uploads");
    object.insert("schema".into(), 3.into());
    object.insert(
        "phase".into(),
        serde_json::json!({"Open": {"batch_id": 123}}),
    );
    for (staged, opens) in [
        (serde_json::json!(0), true),
        (serde_json::Value::Null, true),
        (serde_json::json!(1), false),
        (serde_json::json!([0, 0]), false),
    ] {
        let mut old = current.clone();
        old["staged_upload"] = staged.clone();
        fs::write(&path, serde_json::to_vec(&old).unwrap()).unwrap();
        let opened = UploadTransaction::open(&directory);
        assert_eq!(opened.is_ok(), opens, "{staged}");
        if let Ok(job) = opened {
            assert_eq!(
                job.state.staged_uploads.len(),
                usize::from(!staged.is_null())
            );
            assert_eq!(job.state.schema, SCHEMA);
            assert!(!job.is_settled());
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn a_wave_holds_ten_files_or_64_megabytes() {
    let sized = |sizes: &[u32]| -> Vec<CloudFile> {
        sizes
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(i, size)| CloudFile {
                size: *size,
                ..file(&format!("file-{i}"), b"")
            })
            .collect()
    };
    const MB: u32 = 1024 * 1024;
    assert_eq!(
        waves(&sized(&[1; 12])),
        [(0..10).collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![10, 11]]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        waves(&sized(&[40 * MB, 24 * MB, 1, 100 * MB, 2])),
        [vec![0, 1], vec![2], vec![3], vec![4]]
    );
    assert!(waves(&[]).is_empty());
}
```

```rs
//! Field numbers from SteamDatabase/Protobufs d35adb23d7d48ad9673261f9572b60d1bfe06c12.
//! Download response URLs/headers are credentials: never serialize or log them.

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, prost::Message)]
pub(crate) struct AppRequest {
    #[prost(uint32, tag = "1")]
    pub app_id: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, prost::Message)]
pub(crate) struct ListingRequest {
    #[prost(uint32, tag = "1")]
    pub app_id: u32,
    #[prost(uint64, optional, tag = "2")]
    pub synced_change_number: Option<u64>,
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, prost::Message)]
pub(crate) struct ListingResponse {
    #[prost(uint64, optional, tag = "1")]
    pub current_change_number: Option<u64>,
    #[prost(message, repeated, tag = "2")]
    pub files: Vec<FileInfo>,
    #[prost(bool, optional, tag = "3")]
    pub is_only_delta: Option<bool>,
    #[prost(string, repeated, tag = "4")]
    pub path_prefixes: Vec<String>,
    #[prost(string, repeated, tag = "5")]
    pub machine_names: Vec<String>,
    #[prost(uint64, optional, tag = "6")]
    pub app_build_id: Option<u64>,
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, prost::Message)]
pub(crate) struct FileInfo {
    #[prost(string, tag = "1")]
    pub name: String,
    #[prost(bytes = "vec", tag = "2")]
    pub sha: Vec<u8>,
    #[prost(uint64, tag = "3")]
    pub timestamp: u64,
    #[prost(uint32, tag = "4")]
    pub size: u32,
    #[prost(int32, tag = "5")]
    pub persist_state: i32,
    #[prost(uint32, tag = "6")]
    pub platforms: u32,
    #[prost(uint32, optional, tag = "7")]
    pub prefix_index: Option<u32>,
    #[prost(uint32, optional, tag = "8")]
    pub machine_index: Option<u32>,
    #[prost(bool, tag = "9")]
    pub reupload: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, prost::Message)]
pub(crate) struct QuotaResponse {
    #[prost(uint32, optional, tag = "1")]
    pub existing_files: Option<u32>,
    #[prost(uint64, optional, tag = "2")]
    pub existing_bytes: Option<u64>,
    #[prost(uint32, optional, tag = "3")]
    pub max_files: Option<u32>,
    #[prost(uint64, optional, tag = "4")]
    pub max_bytes: Option<u64>,
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, prost::Message)]
pub(crate) struct DownloadRequest {
```

```rs
//! Authenticated Steam CM content queries over TLS WebSocket.
//!
//! Requests on one connection run concurrently: its background worker routes
//! each response to the request that sent its job, and keeps heartbeats going
//! while callers download content over HTTP. Dropping it closes that session.

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum CmError {
    #[error("backend.steam.cm.disconnected")]
    Disconnected,
    #[error("backend.steam.cm.timeout")]
    Timeout,
    #[error("{}", crate::message::format("backend.steam.cm.rejected", &[.action.to_string(), .result.to_string()]))]
    Rejected { action: &'static str, result: i32 },
    #[error("{}", crate::message::format("backend.steam.cm.protocol", std::slice::from_ref(.0)))]
    Protocol(String),
    #[error("{}", crate::message::format("backend.steam.cm.missingApp", &[.0.to_string()]))]
    MissingApp(u32),
    #[error("backend.steam.cm.noContentServer")]
    NoContentServer,
    #[error("{}", crate::message::format("backend.steam.cm.directory", &[.0.to_string()]))]
    Directory(#[from] reqwest::Error),
}

impl CmError {
    /// A rejection whose EResult means the session itself is no longer valid,
    /// as opposed to a transient service or transport failure.
    pub fn authentication_required(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Rejected { result, .. } if friends::authentication_required(*result))
    }
}

impl From<prost::DecodeError> for CmError {
    fn from(_: prost::DecodeError) -> Self {
        Self::Protocol("backend.steam.cm.unreadableProtobuf".into())
    }
}

impl From<kv::KvError> for CmError {
    fn from(error: kv::KvError) -> Self {
        Self::Protocol(error.to_string())
    }
}

/// The library's order: most recently played first, then name.
pub(crate) fn library_order(left: &OwnedGameInfo, right: &OwnedGameInfo) -> std::cmp::Ordering {
    right
        .last_played
        .cmp(&left.last_played)
        .then_with(|| left.name.cmp(&right.name))
        .then_with(|| left.app_id.cmp(&right.app_id))
}
```
