```rs
                0,
                &mut { MAX_PACKET },
                &mut Vec::new()
            )
            .is_err()
        );
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    #[ignore = "contacts Steam anonymously; verifies one public file up to 8 MiB in memory"]
    async fn live_anonymous_cm_public_content_metadata() {
        let mut connection = SteamConnection::connect(crate::client::http_client().unwrap())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        connection.steam_id = (1_u64 << 56) | (10_u64 << 52);
        let packet = connection
            .request_route(
                LOGON,
                &proto::Logon {
                    protocol_version: PROTOCOL,
                    language: "english".into(),
                    os_type: (-102_i32) as u32,
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                None,
                |_| Route::Kind(LOGON_RESPONSE),
                LOGON_RESPONSE,
            )
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .next()
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let response = proto::LogonResponse::decode(&packet.body[..]).unwrap();
        check_result(response.result, "the anonymous test sign-in").unwrap();
        connection.steam_id = packet.header.steam_id.unwrap();
        connection.session_id = packet.header.session_id.unwrap();
        connection.cell_id = response.cell_id;
        connection.logged_on.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        connection
            .outgoing
            .send(Command::Session {
                steam_id: connection.steam_id,
                session_id: connection.session_id,
                heartbeat_seconds: response.out_of_game_heartbeat.max(1) as u64,
            })
            .await
            .unwrap();

        let app = connection.app_info(1007).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(app.app_id, 1007);
        assert!(!app.name.is_empty());
        assert!(!app.depots.is_empty());
        let packages = connection
            .products(
                &[],
                &[proto::ProductId {
                    id: 17906,
                    access_token: 0,
                }],
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let package = packages
            .packages
            .iter()
            .find(|package| package.id == 17906)
            .unwrap();
        let package_tree = kv::package(&package.buffer).unwrap();
        assert!(
            !package_tree
                .at(&["17906", "appids"])
                .unwrap()
                .children()
                .is_empty()
        );
        let servers = connection.content_servers().await.unwrap();
        assert!(!servers.is_empty());
        let depot = app
            .depots
            .iter()
            .find(|depot| depot.public_manifest.is_some())
            .unwrap();
        let key = connection
            .depot_key(depot.depot_id, app.app_id)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(key.len(), 32);
        let code = connection
            .manifest_request_code(depot.depot_id, app.app_id, depot.public_manifest.unwrap())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_ne!(code, 0);
        let http = crate::client::http_client().unwrap();
        let content = crate::content::ContentClient::new(http);
        let authorization = crate::client::DepotAuthorization {
            cm: &connection,
            app_id: app.app_id,
            depot_id: depot.depot_id,
        };
        let plan = crate::content::DepotDownload {
            depot_id: depot.depot_id,
            manifest_id: depot.public_manifest.unwrap(),
            request_code: code,
            depot_key: key.as_slice().try_into().unwrap(),
            servers: servers
                .iter()
                .filter(|server| {
                    server.allowed_app_ids.is_empty()
                        || server.allowed_app_ids.contains(&app.app_id)
                })
                .cloned()
                .collect(),
            authorization: Some(&authorization),
            destination: std::path::PathBuf::new(), // Helper never writes files.
            cached_manifest: None,
        };
        let verified = match content.verify_live_sample(&plan).await {
            Err(error @ crate::content::ContentError::InvalidData(_)) => {
                panic!("Steam content format: {error}")
            }
            result => result,
        };
        let (bytes_verified, chunks_verified) =
            verified.unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("No CDN verified the public sample: {error:?}"));
        assert!(bytes_verified > 0 && bytes_verified <= 8 * 1024 * 1024);
        assert!(chunks_verified > 0);
        eprintln!(
            "CM live: {} ({}), {} depots, {} HTTPS content servers, depot {} authorized; full public file verified: {} bytes in {} chunks",
            app.name,
            app.app_id,
            app.depots.len(),
            servers.len(),
            depot.depot_id,
            bytes_verified,
            chunks_verified,
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn multi_gzip_is_bounded_and_validates_lengths() {
        let packet = encode(
            HELLO,
            &proto::Header::default(),
            &proto::Hello {
                protocol_version: PROTOCOL,
            },
        );
        let mut body = (packet.len() as u32).to_le_bytes().to_vec();
        body.extend_from_slice(&packet);
        let mut gzip = flate2::write::GzEncoder::new(Vec::new(), flate2::Compression::default());
        gzip.write_all(&body).unwrap();
        let compressed = gzip.finish().unwrap();
        let message = encode(
            MULTI,
            &proto::Header::default(),
            &proto::Multi {
                size_unzipped: body.len() as u32,
                body: compressed.clone().into(),
            },
        );
        let mut output = Vec::new();
        decode_packets(
            Bytes::from(message.clone()),
            0,
            &mut { MAX_PACKET },
            &mut output,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(output.len(), 1);
        let bad = encode(
            MULTI,
            &proto::Header::default(),
            &proto::Multi {
                size_unzipped: 2,
                body: compressed.into(),
            },
        );
        assert!(
            decode_packets(
                Bytes::from(bad.clone()),
                0,
                &mut { MAX_PACKET },
                &mut Vec::new()
            )
            .is_err()
        );
        for end in 0..8 {
            assert!(
                decode_packets(
                    Bytes::copy_from_slice(&message[..end]),
                    0,
                    &mut { MAX_PACKET },
                    &mut Vec::new()
                )
                .is_err()
            );
        }
    }
```

```rs
//! Read-only Player services. Wire fields follow steammessages_player.steamclient.proto.
use super::{CmError, SteamConnection};
use prost::Message;
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Achievement {
    pub id: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub icon_url: String,
    pub hidden: bool,
    pub unlocked: bool,
    pub unlock_time: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Message)]
struct GameRequest {
    #[prost(uint32, tag = "1")]
    app_id: u32,
    #[prost(string, tag = "2")]
    language: String,
}
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Message)]
struct UserRequest {
    #[prost(uint64, tag = "1")]
    steam_id: u64,
    #[prost(uint32, tag = "2")]
    app_id: u32,
}
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Message)]
pub(crate) struct GameResponse {
    #[prost(message, repeated, tag = "1")]
    achievements: Vec<Definition>,
    #[prost(int32, optional, tag = "2")]
    schema_version: Option<i32>,
    #[prost(uint32, optional, tag = "4")]
    schema_hash: Option<u32>,
}
impl GameResponse {
    /// Whether the game defines no achievement.
    pub(crate) fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.achievements.is_empty()
    }
}
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Message)]
struct Definition {
    #[prost(string, tag = "1")]
    id: String,
    #[prost(string, tag = "2")]
    name: String,
    #[prost(string, tag = "3")]
    description: String,
    #[prost(string, tag = "4")]
    icon: String,
    #[prost(string, tag = "5")]
    icon_gray: String,
    #[prost(bool, tag = "6")]
    hidden: bool,
    #[prost(uint32, optional, tag = "8")]
    key: Option<u32>,
    #[prost(bool, tag = "12")]
    archived: bool,
}
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Message)]
pub(crate) struct UserResponse {
    #[prost(message, repeated, tag = "1")]
    achievements: Vec<Unlock>,
    #[prost(int32, optional, tag = "2")]
    schema_version: Option<i32>,
    #[prost(uint32, optional, tag = "3")]
    schema_hash: Option<u32>,
}
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Message)]
struct Unlock {
    #[prost(uint32, optional, tag = "1")]
    key: Option<u32>,
    #[prost(bool, tag = "2")]
    unlocked: bool,
    #[prost(fixed32, tag = "3")]
    time: u32,
}

impl SteamConnection {
    /// The game's achievements; none when Steam has no stats for it, as for
    /// a game without achievements.
    pub(crate) async fn game_achievements(
        &self,
        app_id: u32,
        language: &str,
    ) -> Result<Option<GameResponse>, CmError> {
        stats(
            self.service(
                "Player.GetGameAchievements#1",
                &GameRequest {
                    app_id,
                    language: language.into(),
                },
            )
            .await,
        )
    }

    /// What the account unlocked of the game; none when it has no stats in
    /// the game yet, as an account that never played it.
    pub(crate) async fn user_achievements(
        &self,
        app_id: u32,
    ) -> Result<Option<UserResponse>, CmError> {
        stats(
            self.service(
                "Player.GetUserAchievements#1",
                &UserRequest {
                    steam_id: self.steam_id,
                    app_id,
                },
            )
            .await,
        )
    }
}

/// Steam's answer when there are no stats to tell.
const NO_MATCH: i32 = 42;

/// `response`, none when Steam answered that it has no stats to tell.
fn stats<T>(response: Result<T, CmError>) -> Result<Option<T>, CmError> {
    match response {
        Err(CmError::Rejected {
            result: NO_MATCH, ..
        }) => Ok(None),
        response => response.map(Some),
    }
}

fn invalid() -> CmError {
    CmError::Protocol("backend.steam.achievements.invalidResponse".into())
}
/// `schema`'s achievements as the account stands with them; none unlocked
/// without `user`'s stats.
pub(crate) fn combine(
    app_id: u32,
    schema: GameResponse,
    user: Option<UserResponse>,
) -> Result<Vec<Achievement>, CmError> {
    if user.as_ref().is_some_and(|user| {
        schema.schema_hash != user.schema_hash || schema.schema_version != user.schema_version
    }) {
        return Err(invalid());
    }
    let mut states = HashMap::new();
    for state in user.into_iter().flat_map(|user| user.achievements) {
        let key = state.key.ok_or_else(invalid)?;
        if states.insert(key, state).is_some() {
            return Err(invalid());
        }
    }
    let mut ids = HashSet::new();
    let mut keys = HashSet::new();
    let mut result = Vec::new();
    for definition in schema.achievements {
        let key = definition.key.ok_or_else(invalid)?;
        if definition.id.is_empty() || !ids.insert(definition.id.clone()) || !keys.insert(key) {
            return Err(invalid());
        }
        // Drain an archived definition's state too, so the leftover check
        // below still only reports keys with no definition at all.
        let state = states.remove(&key).filter(|state| state.unlocked);
        if definition.archived {
            continue;
        }
        let unlocked = state.is_some();
        // A hidden achievement the account has not earned exposes its identity
        // and nothing else, so its icon is never even resolved to a URL.
        let hidden = definition.hidden && !unlocked;
        let (name, description, icon_url) = if hidden {
            (String::new(), String::new(), String::new())
        } else {
            let icon = if unlocked {
                definition.icon
            } else {
                definition.icon_gray
            };
            (
                definition.name,
                definition.description,
                achievement_icon(app_id, &icon),
            )
        };
        result.push(Achievement {
            id: definition.id,
            name,
            description,
            icon_url,
            hidden,
            unlocked,
            unlock_time: state.map_or(0, |state| state.time),
        });
    }
    // Unknown keys usually mean a schema changed between the two requests.
    if !states.is_empty() {
        return Err(invalid());
    }
    result.sort_by(|a, b| {
        b.unlocked
            .cmp(&a.unlocked)
            .then_with(|| b.unlock_time.cmp(&a.unlock_time))
            .then_with(|| a.id.cmp(&b.id))
    });
    Ok(result)
}

fn achievement_icon(app_id: u32, icon: &str) -> String {
    if let Some((hash, extension)) = icon.rsplit_once('.')
        && hash.len() == 40
        && hash.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit())
        && matches!(extension, "jpg" | "png")
    {
        return format!(
            "https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/apps/{app_id}/{icon}"
        );
    }
    reqwest::Url::parse(icon)
        .ok()
        .filter(|url| {
            url.scheme() == "https"
                && url.host_str().is_some()
                && url.username().is_empty()
                && url.password().is_none()
        })
        .map_or_else(String::new, |url| url.into())
}
```

```rs
use super::*;
use crate::cloud::{
    CloudError, CloudFile, CloudListing, CloudQuota, UploadTransaction, deadline,
    preferences::ROAMING_CONFIG_APP, upload, wire,
};
use futures_util::TryStreamExt;

#[cfg(debug_assertions)]
mod interruption_probe;

const UPLOAD_DEADLINE: u64 = 120;

impl SteamConnection {
    /// Read only the account's remote roaming configuration. Never consult a
    /// local Steam installation or change preferences as an ownership shortcut.
    pub async fn cloud_preferences(
        &self,
        http: &reqwest::Client,
        app_id: u32,
    ) -> Result<crate::cloud::CloudPreferences, CloudError> {
        self.cloud_preferences_cached(http, app_id, &mut Default::default())
            .await
    }

    pub async fn cloud_preferences_cached(
        &self,
        http: &reqwest::Client,
        app_id: u32,
        cache: &mut crate::cloud::CloudPreferencesCache,
    ) -> Result<crate::cloud::CloudPreferences, CloudError> {
        let before = self.cloud_listing(ROAMING_CONFIG_APP).await?;
        let preferences = cache
            .read(app_id, &before, async |file| {
                self.cloud_download(http, ROAMING_CONFIG_APP, file).await
            })
            .await?;
        if self.cloud_listing(ROAMING_CONFIG_APP).await? != before {
            return Err(CloudError::Changed);
        }
        Ok(preferences)
    }
    /// Low-level, journaled transport. The caller must hold the coordinator's
    /// upload permit and exclude a native synchronizer for this account/store.
    /// The guard is rechecked before every request; UI closure is not revocation.
    /// Returns the complete listing that confirmed the batch.
    pub async fn cloud_upload(
        &self,
        http: &reqwest::Client,
        transaction: &mut UploadTransaction,
        authorized: impl Fn() -> bool,
    ) -> Result<CloudListing, CloudError> {
        let mut transport = self.upload_transport(http, transaction, &authorized)?;
        deadline(
            UPLOAD_DEADLINE,
            upload::execute(&mut transport, transaction, &authorized),
        )
        .await
    }

    /// Obtain a positive closure receipt without resending file mutations.
    /// Ambiguous old file requests remain blocked; the caller must read a new
    /// complete remote view after this method returns before reconciliation.
    pub async fn cloud_settle_upload(
        &self,
        http: &reqwest::Client,
        transaction: &mut UploadTransaction,
        authorized: impl Fn() -> bool,
    ) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        let mut transport = self.upload_transport(http, transaction, &authorized)?;
        deadline(
            UPLOAD_DEADLINE,
            upload::settle(&mut transport, transaction, &authorized),
        )
        .await
    }

    /// Shared admission for journaled upload operations: the session must be
    /// logged on as the transaction's account.
    fn upload_transport<'a, F: Fn() -> bool>(
        &'a self,
        http: &'a reqwest::Client,
        transaction: &UploadTransaction,
        authorized: &'a F,
    ) -> Result<UploadTransport<'a, F>, CloudError> {
        self.ensure_logged_on()?;
        if transaction.steam_id() != self.steam_id {
            return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
        }
        Ok(UploadTransport {
            connection: self,
            http,
            authorized,
        })
    }

    pub async fn cloud_listing(&self, app_id: u32) -> Result<CloudListing, CloudError> {
        if app_id == 0 {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("app id"));
        }
        let response: wire::ListingResponse = self
            .service(
                "Cloud.GetAppFileChangelist#1",
                &wire::ListingRequest {
                    app_id,
                    synced_change_number: Some(0),
                },
            )
            .await?;
        crate::cloud::listing(self.steam_id, app_id, response)
    }

    pub async fn cloud_quota(&self, app_id: u32) -> Result<CloudQuota, CloudError> {
        if app_id == 0 {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("app id"));
        }
        let response: wire::QuotaResponse = self
            .service(
                "Cloud.ClientGetAppQuotaUsage#1",
                &wire::AppRequest { app_id },
            )
            .await?;
        Ok(CloudQuota {
            existing_files: response.existing_files,
            existing_bytes: response.existing_bytes,
            max_files: response.max_files,
            max_bytes: response.max_bytes,
        })
    }

    pub async fn cloud_download(
        &self,
        http: &reqwest::Client,
        app_id: u32,
        file: &CloudFile,
    ) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CloudError> {
        let response = self.download_request(app_id, file).await?;
        crate::cloud::download(http, app_id, file, response).await
    }

    /// Bounded concurrent reads, CM requests included, on this account's CM
    /// session. The caller owns the listing checks before and after the set.
    pub async fn cloud_download_files(
        &self,
        http: &reqwest::Client,
        app_id: u32,
        files: &[CloudFile],
        authorized: impl Fn() -> bool,
        receive: impl FnMut(&CloudFile, Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), CloudError>,
    ) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        self.ensure_logged_on()?;
        crate::cloud::downloads::download_files(
            files,
            |file| async move { self.download_request(app_id, &file).await },
            |file, response| {
                let http = http.clone();
                async move { crate::cloud::download(&http, app_id, &file, response).await }
            },
            &authorized,
            receive,
        )
        .await
    }

    /// The CM's answer for one file's body. Persist-state files are never read.
    async fn download_request(
        &self,
        app_id: u32,
        file: &CloudFile,
    ) -> Result<wire::DownloadResponse, CloudError> {
        if file.persist_state != 0 {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("persist state"));
        }
        Ok(self
            .service(
                "Cloud.ClientFileDownload#1",
                &wire::DownloadRequest {
                    app_id,
                    name: file.name.clone(),
                },
            )
            .await?)
    }
}

struct UploadTransport<'a, F> {
    connection: &'a SteamConnection,
    http: &'a reqwest::Client,
    authorized: &'a F,
}

impl<F: Fn() -> bool> UploadTransport<'_, F> {
    async fn send_commit(
        &self,
        request: &wire::CommitUploadRequest,
    ) -> Result<wire::CommitUploadResponse, CloudError> {
        if !(self.authorized)() {
            return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
        }
        self.connection.ensure_logged_on()?;
        let packet = self
            .connection
            .request(
                SERVICE_REQUEST,
                request,
                Some("Cloud.ClientCommitFileUpload#1"),
                SERVICE_RESPONSE,
            )
            .await?
            .next()
            .await?;
        commit_response(packet.header.result, &packet.body, request.succeeded)
    }

    async fn send_block(&self, block: &wire::UploadBlock, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        let request = crate::cloud::upload::block_request(block, bytes)?;
        if !(self.authorized)() {
            return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
        }
        let response = self
            .http
            .execute(request)
            .await
            .map_err(|_| CloudError::Network)?;
        if !response.status().is_success() {
            return Err(CloudError::Network);
        }
        crate::client::read_bounded(response, 1024 * 1024)
            .await
            .map_err(|_| CloudError::Network)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl<F: Fn() -> bool> crate::cloud::upload::Transport for UploadTransport<'_, F> {
    async fn commit(
        &mut self,
        request: &wire::CommitUploadRequest,
    ) -> Result<wire::CommitUploadResponse, CloudError> {
        self.send_commit(request).await
    }
    async fn commits(
        &mut self,
        requests: &[wire::CommitUploadRequest],
    ) -> Result<Vec<wire::CommitUploadResponse>, CloudError> {
        let this = &*self;
        // Collected first, as in `calls`.
        let commits: Vec<_> = requests
            .iter()
            .map(|request| this.send_commit(request))
            .collect();
        futures_util::stream::iter(commits)
            .buffered(upload::PARALLEL_FILES)
            .try_collect()
            .await
    }
    async fn call<R: Message + Default>(
        &mut self,
        name: &str,
        request: &impl Message,
    ) -> Result<R, CloudError> {
        if !(self.authorized)() {
            return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
        }
        Ok(self.connection.service(name, request).await?)
    }
    async fn calls<R: Message + Default>(
        &mut self,
        name: &str,
        requests: &[impl Message],
    ) -> Result<Vec<R>, CloudError> {
        let (connection, authorized) = (self.connection, self.authorized);
        // Collected first: a stream mapping through a closure leaves the
        // future without a provable Send, which UniFFI's exports need.
        let requests: Vec<_> = requests
            .iter()
            .map(|request| async move {
                if !authorized() {
                    return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
                }
                Ok(connection.service(name, request).await?)
            })
            .collect();
        futures_util::stream::iter(requests)
            .buffered(upload::PARALLEL_FILES)
            .try_collect()
            .await
    }
    async fn block(&mut self, block: &wire::UploadBlock, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        self.send_block(block, bytes).await
    }
    async fn bodies(&mut self, files: &[(&[wire::UploadBlock], &[u8])]) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        let this = &*self;
        // Collected first, as in `calls`.
        let files: Vec<_> = files
            .iter()
            .map(|(blocks, bytes)| async move {
                for block in *blocks {
                    this.send_block(block, bytes).await?;
                }
                Ok::<_, CloudError>(())
            })
            .collect();
        futures_util::stream::iter(files)
            .buffer_unordered(upload::PARALLEL_FILES)
            .try_collect::<Vec<()>>()
            .await?;
        Ok(())
    }
    async fn listing(&mut self, app: u32) -> Result<CloudListing, CloudError> {
        if !(self.authorized)() {
            return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
        }
        self.connection.cloud_listing(app).await
    }
}

fn commit_response(
    result: Option<i32>,
    body: &[u8],
    succeeded: bool,
) -> Result<wire::CommitUploadResponse, CloudError> {
    // Steam reports a failed HTTP transfer with EResult::Fail and an explicit
    // file_committed=false body. That is the requested negative receipt, not
    // upload success. Never apply this exception to a positive commit, an
    // absent/malformed receipt, a missing envelope result or another rejection.
    if !succeeded && result == Some(2) {
        let response =
            wire::CommitUploadResponse::decode(body).map_err(|e| CloudError::Cm(e.into()))?;
        if response.committed == Some(false) {
            return Ok(response);
        }
    }
    check_result(result, "backend.steam.cm.action.contentRequest")?;
    wire::CommitUploadResponse::decode(body).map_err(|e| CloudError::Cm(e.into()))
}

mod upload_receipt_tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn failed_transfer_accepts_only_the_explicit_negative_file_receipt() {
        // Exact nonsensitive body/result observed in the authenticated restart
        // probe: EResult::Fail with file_committed explicitly false.
        let receipt = commit_response(Some(2), &[0x08, 0x00], false).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(receipt.committed, Some(false));
        for (result, body, succeeded) in [
            (Some(2), vec![0x08, 0x00], true),
            (Some(2), vec![0x08, 0x01], false),
            (Some(2), vec![], false),
            (Some(10), vec![0x08, 0x00], false),
            (None, vec![0x08, 0x00], false),
            (Some(2), vec![0x80], false),
        ] {
            assert!(commit_response(result, &body, succeeded).is_err());
        }
    }

#[cfg(test)]
mod parallel_tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::cloud::upload::Transport;

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn a_batch_keeps_ten_file_requests_in_flight_and_answers_in_order() {
        let (connection, mut server) = super::super::test_server::connection(1, true).await;
        let http = reqwest::Client::new();
        let mut transport = UploadTransport {
            connection: &connection,
            http: &http,
            authorized: &|| true,
        };
        let deletes: Vec<_> = (0..12)
            .map(|index| wire::DeleteRequest {
                app_id: 7,
                name: format!("save-{index}"),
                explicit: true,
                batch_id: 1,
            })
            .collect();
        // Each answer echoes its request, so the order shows.
        let answer = async {
            let mut sent = Vec::new();
            for _ in 0..upload::PARALLEL_FILES {
                sent.push(server.request(SERVICE_REQUEST).await);
            }
            assert!(server.quiet().await, "an eleventh request waits");
            for packet in sent.iter().rev() {
                let request = wire::DeleteRequest::decode(packet.body.clone()).unwrap();
                server.reply(packet, SERVICE_RESPONSE, &request).await;
            }
            for _ in upload::PARALLEL_FILES..deletes.len() {
                let packet = server.request(SERVICE_REQUEST).await;
                let request = wire::DeleteRequest::decode(packet.body.clone()).unwrap();
                server.reply(&packet, SERVICE_RESPONSE, &request).await;
            }
        };
        let (answers, ()) = tokio::join!(
            transport.calls::<wire::DeleteRequest>("Cloud.ClientDeleteFile#1", &deletes),
            answer
        );
        let names: Vec<_> = answers.unwrap().into_iter().map(|a| a.name).collect();
        let sent: Vec<_> = deletes.into_iter().map(|d| d.name).collect();
        assert_eq!(names, sent);
    }
}
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/cm/cloud/interruption_probe.rs`:

```rs
//! Opt-in, disposable-file diagnostic. Never used by the production uploader.
use super::*;
use crate::cloud::upload::{self, Transport};
use futures_util::StreamExt;
use std::{io::Write, os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt, path::Path};
use tokio::sync::oneshot;

impl SteamConnection {
    pub(crate) async fn cloud_settle_upload_probe(
        &self,
        http: &reqwest::Client,
        transaction: &mut crate::cloud::UploadTransaction,
        trace: &Path,
        authorized: impl Fn() -> bool,
    ) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        self.ensure_logged_on()?;
        if transaction.steam_id() != self.steam_id {
            return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
        }
        tokio::time::timeout(
            Duration::from_secs(120),
            upload::settle(
                &mut InterruptedTransport {
                    inner: UploadTransport {
                        connection: self,
                        http,
                        authorized: &authorized,
                    },
                    started: None,
                    interrupt: false,
                    trace,
                },
                transaction,
                &authorized,
            ),
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Timeout)?
    }
    /// Drop the real upload executor while its HTTP body is still incomplete.
    /// The returned count means bytes consumed by the HTTP client, not bytes
    /// acknowledged by the storage provider. No file commit is sent.
    pub(crate) async fn cloud_interrupt_upload_probe(
        &self,
        http: &reqwest::Client,
        transaction: &mut crate::cloud::UploadTransaction,
        trace: &Path,
        authorized: impl Fn() -> bool,
    ) -> Result<usize, CloudError> {
        self.ensure_logged_on()?;
        if transaction.steam_id() != self.steam_id {
            return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
        }
        let (started, observed) = oneshot::channel();
        let mut transport = InterruptedTransport {
            inner: UploadTransport {
                connection: self,
                http,
                authorized: &authorized,
            },
            started: Some(started),
            interrupt: true,
            trace,
        };
        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(120), async {
            tokio::select! {
                result = upload::execute(&mut transport, transaction, &authorized) => {
                    result?;
                    Err(CloudError::Invalid("probe did not interrupt an upload"))
                }
                prefix = observed => {
                    prefix.map_err(|_| CloudError::Network)
                }
            }
        })
        .await
        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Timeout)?
    }

    pub(crate) async fn cloud_upload_probe(
        &self,
        http: &reqwest::Client,
        transaction: &mut crate::cloud::UploadTransaction,
        trace: &Path,
        authorized: impl Fn() -> bool,
    ) -> Result<CloudListing, CloudError> {
        self.ensure_logged_on()?;
        if transaction.steam_id() != self.steam_id {
            return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
        }
        tokio::time::timeout(
            Duration::from_secs(120),
            upload::execute(
                &mut InterruptedTransport {
                    inner: UploadTransport {
                        connection: self,
                        http,
                        authorized: &authorized,
                    },
                    started: None,
                    interrupt: false,
                    trace,
                },
                transaction,
                &authorized,
            ),
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Timeout)?
    }
}

struct InterruptedTransport<'a, F> {
    inner: UploadTransport<'a, F>,
    started: Option<oneshot::Sender<usize>>,
    interrupt: bool,
    trace: &'a Path,
}

fn trace(path: &Path, event: serde_json::Value) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
    let mut output = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .append(true)
        .create(true)
        .mode(0o600)
        .open(path)
        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
    serde_json::to_writer(&mut output, &event).map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)?;
    output
        .write_all(b"\n")
        .and_then(|_| output.sync_all())
        .map_err(|_| CloudError::Storage)
}

fn result_code<T>(result: &Result<T, CloudError>) -> Option<i32> {
    match result {
        Ok(_) => Some(1),
        Err(CloudError::Cm(CmError::Rejected { result, .. })) => Some(*result),
        _ => None,
    }
}

impl<F: Fn() -> bool> Transport for InterruptedTransport<'_, F> {
    async fn commit(
        &mut self,
        request: &wire::CommitUploadRequest,
    ) -> Result<wire::CommitUploadResponse, CloudError> {
        if self.interrupt {
            return Err(CloudError::Invalid("probe reached file commit"));
        }
        trace(
            self.trace,
            serde_json::json!({"event":"file_commit_request", "transfer_succeeded":request.succeeded}),
        )?;
        let result = self.inner.commit(request).await;
        trace(
            self.trace,
            serde_json::json!({"event":"file_commit_receipt", "ok":result.is_ok(),
            "committed":result.as_ref().ok().and_then(|r| r.committed)}),
        )?;
        result
    }

    async fn call<R: Message + Default>(
        &mut self,
        name: &str,
        request: &impl Message,
    ) -> Result<R, CloudError> {
        trace(
            self.trace,
            serde_json::json!({"event":"cm_request", "method":name}),
        )?;
        let result = self.inner.call(name, request).await;
        trace(
            self.trace,
            serde_json::json!({"event":"cm_response", "method":name,
            "result":result_code(&result), "ok":result.is_ok()}),
        )?;
        result
    }

    async fn block(&mut self, block: &wire::UploadBlock, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CloudError> {
        trace(
            self.trace,
            serde_json::json!({"event":"http_start", "interrupt":self.interrupt,
            "length":block.length, "explicit_body":block.body.is_some()}),
        )?;
        if !self.interrupt {
            let result = self.inner.block(block, bytes).await;
            trace(
                self.trace,
                serde_json::json!({"event":"http_finish", "ok":result.is_ok()}),
            )?;
            return result;
        }
        const PREFIX: usize = 64 * 1024;
        let mut request = upload::block_request(block, bytes)?;
        let body = request
            .body()
            .and_then(reqwest::Body::as_bytes)
            .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("probe body"))?;
        // Pass through multipart control requests, interrupt only a data block.
        if block.body.is_some() || body.len() <= PREFIX {
            return self.inner.block(block, bytes).await;
        }
        let length = body.len();
        let prefix = Bytes::copy_from_slice(&body[..PREFIX]);
        let started = self
            .started
            .take()
            .ok_or(CloudError::Invalid("probe already armed"))?;
        let stream = futures_util::stream::once(async { Ok::<_, std::io::Error>(prefix) }).chain(
            futures_util::stream::once(async move {
                // A second poll proves that the first chunk was consumed.
                let _ = started.send(PREFIX);
                std::future::pending::<Result<Bytes, std::io::Error>>().await
            }),
        );
        request
            .headers_mut()
            .insert(reqwest::header::CONTENT_LENGTH, length.into());
        *request.body_mut() = Some(reqwest::Body::wrap_stream(stream));
        if !(self.inner.authorized)() {
            return Err(CloudError::Revoked);
        }
        let response = self
            .inner
            .http
            .execute(request)
            .await
            .map_err(|_| CloudError::Network)?;
        // An early HTTP response is not a successful interrupted-body proof.
        drop(response);
        Err(CloudError::Network)
    }

    async fn listing(&mut self, app: u32) -> Result<CloudListing, CloudError> {
        self.inner.listing(app).await
    }
}
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/cm/connect_tests.rs`:

```rs
use super::first_to_answer;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::Duration;
use tokio::time::{Instant, sleep};

const STAGGER: Duration = Duration::from_millis(50);

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_server_that_never_answers_does_not_hold_up_the_next() {
    let start = Instant::now();

    let answer = first_to_answer(
        vec!["silent".into(), "failing".into(), "answering".into()],
        STAGGER,
        |server| async move {
            match server.as_str() {
                "silent" => {
                    sleep(Duration::from_secs(30)).await;
                    Some("silent")
                }
                "failing" => None,
                _ => {
                    sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
                    Some("answering")
                }
            }
        },
    )
    .await;

    assert_eq!(answer, Some("answering"));
    assert!(
        start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(1),
        "{:?}",
        start.elapsed()
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_server_that_answers_in_time_is_the_only_one_tried() {
    let tried = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));

    let answer = first_to_answer(vec!["first".into(), "second".into()], STAGGER, |server| {
        tried.lock().unwrap().push(server.clone());
        async move {
            sleep(Duration::from_millis(5)).await;
            Some(server)
        }
    })
    .await;

    assert_eq!(answer.as_deref(), Some("first"));
    assert_eq!(*tried.lock().unwrap(), ["first"]);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn no_server_answering_gives_nothing() {
    let answer = first_to_answer::<(), _, _>(
        vec!["one".into(), "two".into(), "three".into()],
        STAGGER,
        |_| async { None },
    )
    .await;

    assert_eq!(answer, None);
    assert_eq!(
        first_to_answer::<(), _, _>(Vec::new(), STAGGER, |_| async { None }).await,
        None
    );
}
```

```rs
use super::*;

// Decode only the independently specified session-disambiguation wire fields.
// CMsgClientLogon: legacy uint32 field 2, CMsgIPAddress field 11, fixed32 v4.
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, prost::Message)]
struct WireLogin {
    #[prost(uint32, optional, tag = "2")]
    legacy: Option<u32>,
    #[prost(message, optional, tag = "11")]
    address: Option<WireAddress>,
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, prost::Message)]
struct WireAddress {
    #[prost(fixed32, optional, tag = "1")]
    v4: Option<u32>,
}

async fn logon_request() -> (SteamConnection, WireLogin) {
    const ACCOUNT: u64 = 0x0110_0001_0000_002a;
    let (mut connection, mut server) = test_server::connection(0, false).await;
    let steam = async {
        let logon = server.request(LOGON).await;
        server
            .send(
                LOGON_RESPONSE,
                proto::Header {
                    steam_id: Some(ACCOUNT),
                    session_id: Some(42),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                &proto::LogonResponse {
                    result: Some(1),
                    ..Default::default()
                }
                .encode_to_vec(),
            )
            .await;
        WireLogin::decode(&logon.body[..]).unwrap()
    };
    let (logged_on, wire) = tokio::join!(
        connection.log_on("fixture", ACCOUNT, "fixture-token", ChatMode::Disabled),
        steam
    );
    logged_on.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(connection.session_id, 42);
    (connection, wire)
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn concurrent_logons_for_one_account_do_not_share_the_default_login_id() {
    // Keep the first physical session alive while admitting the Cloud session.
    let (_main_session, main) = logon_request().await;
    let (_cloud_session, cloud) = logon_request().await;
    let mut ids = std::collections::HashSet::new();
    for login in [main, cloud] {
        let id = login
            .address
            .and_then(|ip| ip.v4)
            .expect("missing login ID: concurrent Steam sessions would replace each other");
        assert_ne!(id, 0);
        assert_eq!(login.legacy, Some(id));
        assert!(
            ids.insert(id),
            "physical connections reused the same login ID"
        );
    }
}
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/cm/pics.rs`:

```rs
//! PICS product metadata: what Steam declares about an app, its depots and
//! launch options, and the rights a license package grants.
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

use obelisk_core::Platform;

use super::{CmError, OwnedGameInfo};
use crate::client::PLATFORM;
use crate::kv;

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct AppInfo {
    pub app_id: u32,
    pub name: String,
    /// Declared application platforms. Empty means Steam supplied no declaration.
    pub os_list: Vec<String>,
    pub free_to_download: bool,
    pub depots: Vec<DepotInfo>,
    pub launch_configs: Vec<LaunchConfig>,
    /// Complete Steam UFS configuration, including unknown future fields.
    pub cloud: Option<crate::cloud::CloudMetadata>,
    /// The whole app info as PICS returned it.
    pub(crate) tree: kv::Kv,
}

impl AppInfo {
    /// The whole app info as PICS returned it, such as its store details,
    /// associations, assets, depots and launch options, as JSON.
    pub fn metadata(&self) -> serde_json::Value {
        self.tree.get("appinfo").unwrap_or(&self.tree).to_json()
    }

    /// The game as the library lists one the account never played, when it
    /// is a released game: not a DLC, tool, soundtrack or demo, nor a game
    /// Steam has yet to release.
    pub(crate) fn unplayed_game(&self) -> Option<OwnedGameInfo> {
        let common = |field| {
            let root = self.tree.get("appinfo").unwrap_or(&self.tree);
            root.at(&["common", field]).and_then(kv::Kv::text)
        };
        let game = common("type").is_some_and(|kind| kind.eq_ignore_ascii_case("game"));
        let released =
            common("releasestate").is_none_or(|state| state.eq_ignore_ascii_case("released"));
        (game && released && !self.name.is_empty()).then(|| OwnedGameInfo {
            app_id: self.app_id,
            name: self.name.clone(),
            icon_hash: common("icon").unwrap_or_default().to_owned(),
            last_played: 0,
            playtime_minutes: 0,
            record: serde_json::Value::Null,
        })
    }
}

/// App ownership and depot entitlement are distinct package fields.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct ContentLicenses {
    pub apps: BTreeSet<u32>,
    pub depots: BTreeSet<u32>,
    /// The apps the account's own licenses grant, not a family member's.
    pub own_apps: BTreeSet<u32>,
    /// When the account got each app: the creation of its oldest license
    /// that grants it, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
    pub acquired: BTreeMap<u32, u32>,
}

impl ContentLicenses {
    /// Adds what a package grants, under a license created at `created`
    /// when Steam told it, which is the account's `own` or a family member's.
    pub(super) fn extend_package(&mut self, root: &kv::Kv, created: Option<u32>, own: bool) {
        let ids = |field| {
            root.get(field).into_iter().flat_map(|entries| {
                entries
                    .children()
                    .iter()
                    .filter_map(|(_, value)| value.text()?.parse::<u32>().ok().filter(|id| *id > 0))
            })
        };
        for app in ids("appids") {
            self.apps.insert(app);
            if own {
                self.own_apps.insert(app);
            }
            if let Some(created) = created {
                let acquired = self.acquired.entry(app).or_insert(created);
                *acquired = (*acquired).min(created);
            }
        }
        self.depots.extend(ids("depotids"));
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct DepotInfo {
    pub depot_id: u32,
    pub shared_from_app: Option<u32>,
    pub dlc_app_id: Option<u32>,
    pub os_list: Vec<String>,
    pub os_arch: Option<String>,
    pub language: Option<String>,
    pub public_manifest: Option<u64>,
    pub size_bytes: Option<u64>,
}

/// Steam `oslist` semantics: an empty list means no platform restriction.
pub(crate) fn supports_platform(os_list: &[String], platform: Platform) -> bool {
    os_list.is_empty() || os_list.iter().any(|os| os == PLATFORM.name(platform))
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct LaunchConfig {
    pub executable: String,
    pub arguments: String,
    pub working_directory: String,
    pub launch_type: String,
    pub os_list: Vec<String>,
    pub os_arch: Option<String>,
}

fn string_at(tree: &kv::Kv, path: &[&str]) -> String {
    tree.at(path)
        .and_then(kv::Kv::text)
        .unwrap_or_default()
        .to_owned()
}

fn optional_at(tree: &kv::Kv, path: &[&str]) -> Option<String> {
    tree.at(path)
        .and_then(kv::Kv::text)
        .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
        .map(str::to_owned)
}

fn number_at<T: std::str::FromStr>(tree: &kv::Kv, path: &[&str]) -> Option<T> {
    tree.at(path)
        .and_then(kv::Kv::text)
        .and_then(|value| value.parse().ok())
}

fn os_list(tree: &kv::Kv, path: &[&str]) -> Vec<String> {
    string_at(tree, path)
        .split(',')
        .map(str::trim)
        .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
        .map(str::to_ascii_lowercase)
        .collect()
}

pub(super) fn parse_app(app_id: u32, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<AppInfo, CmError> {
    let tree = kv::text(bytes)?;
    let root = tree.get("appinfo").unwrap_or(&tree);
    if number_at::<u32>(root, &["appid"]).is_some_and(|id| id != app_id) {
        return Err(CmError::Protocol("backend.steam.cm.unexpectedAppId".into()));
    }
    let mut depots = Vec::new();
    if let Some(entries) = root.get("depots") {
        for (id, depot) in entries.children() {
            let Ok(depot_id) = id.parse::<u32>() else {
                continue;
            };
            depots.push(DepotInfo {
                depot_id,
                shared_from_app: number_at(depot, &["depotfromapp"]),
                dlc_app_id: number_at(depot, &["dlcappid"]),
                os_list: os_list(depot, &["config", "oslist"]),
                os_arch: optional_at(depot, &["config", "osarch"]),
                language: optional_at(depot, &["config", "language"]),
                public_manifest: number_at(depot, &["manifests", "public", "gid"])
                    .or_else(|| number_at(depot, &["manifests", "public"])),
                size_bytes: number_at(depot, &["manifests", "public", "size"]),
            });
        }
    }
    let mut launch_configs = Vec::new();
    if let Some(entries) = root.at(&["config", "launch"]) {
        for (_, launch) in entries.children() {
            let executable = string_at(launch, &["executable"]);
            if executable.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            launch_configs.push(LaunchConfig {
                executable,
                arguments: string_at(launch, &["arguments"]),
                working_directory: string_at(launch, &["workingdir"]),
                launch_type: string_at(launch, &["type"]),
                os_list: os_list(launch, &["config", "oslist"]),
                os_arch: optional_at(launch, &["config", "osarch"]),
            });
        }
    }
    let mut declared_os = os_list(root, &["common", "oslist"]);
    if declared_os.is_empty() {
        declared_os = launch_configs
            .iter()
            .flat_map(|launch| launch.os_list.iter().cloned())
            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>()
            .into_iter()
            .collect();
    }
    Ok(AppInfo {
        app_id,
        name: string_at(root, &["common", "name"]),
        os_list: declared_os,
        free_to_download: matches!(
            string_at(root, &["common", "freetodownload"]).as_str(),
            "1" | "true"
        ),
        depots,
        launch_configs,
        cloud: root.get("ufs").map(crate::cloud::CloudMetadata::from),
        tree,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn app_info_retains_generic_cloud_rules_and_unknown_fields() {
        let app = parse_app(42, br#""appinfo" {
            "appid" "42" "ufs" {
                "quota" "100000" "maxnumfiles" "32"
                "savefiles" { "0" { "root" "MacDocuments" "path" "Game/{64BitSteamID}" "pattern" "*.sav" } }
                "rootoverrides" { "0" { "root" "WinMyDocuments" "useinstead" "MacDocuments" } }
                "future-field" { "nested" "retained" }
                "duplicate" "a" "duplicate" "b"
            }
        }"#).unwrap();
        let cloud = app.cloud.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(cloud.field("quota").and_then(|v| v.text()), Some("100000"));
        assert_eq!(
            cloud
                .field("savefiles")
                .unwrap()
                .field("0")
                .unwrap()
                .field("path")
                .unwrap()
                .text(),
            Some("Game/{64BitSteamID}")
        );
        assert!(cloud.field("rootoverrides").is_some());
        assert_eq!(
            cloud
                .field("future-field")
                .unwrap()
                .field("nested")
                .unwrap()
                .text(),
            Some("retained")
        );
        assert!(cloud.field("duplicate").is_none());
        assert_eq!(
            cloud
                .entries()
                .unwrap()
                .iter()
                .filter(|(key, _)| key == "duplicate")
                .count(),
            2
        );
        let absent = parse_app(42, br#""appinfo" { "appid" "42" }"#).unwrap();
        assert!(absent.cloud.is_none());
        let malformed =
            parse_app(42, br#""appinfo" { "appid" "42" "ufs" "invalid shape" }"#).unwrap();
        assert!(malformed.cloud.unwrap().entries().is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn package_entitlements_preserve_app_and_depot_namespaces() {
        let package = kv::text(br#""appids" { "0" "588650" } "depotids" { "0" "588651" "1" "588652" "2" "588653" "3" "588654" }"#).unwrap();
        let mut rights = ContentLicenses::default();
        rights.extend_package(&package, None, true);
        assert_eq!(rights.apps, BTreeSet::from([588650]));
        assert_eq!(
            rights.depots,
            BTreeSet::from([588651, 588652, 588653, 588654])
        );
        assert!(!rights.depots.contains(&1046443));
        rights.extend_package(
            &kv::text(br#""appids" { "0" "99" } "depotids" { "0" "1046443" "1" "0" "2" "bad" }"#)
                .unwrap(),
            None,
            false,
        );
        assert!(rights.depots.contains(&1046443));
        assert!(rights.apps.contains(&99));
        // A family member's license grants downloads, not a place in the library.
        assert_eq!(rights.own_apps, BTreeSet::from([588650]));
        assert!(!rights.apps.contains(&1046443));
        assert!(!rights.depots.contains(&99));
        assert!(!rights.depots.contains(&0));
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_app_is_acquired_with_its_oldest_license() {
        let bundle = kv::text(br#""appids" { "0" "10" "1" "20" }"#).unwrap();
        let single = kv::text(br#""appids" { "0" "10" }"#).unwrap();
        let mut rights = ContentLicenses::default();
        rights.extend_package(&single, Some(2_000), true);
        rights.extend_package(&bundle, Some(1_000), true);
        rights.extend_package(&kv::text(br#""appids" { "0" "30" }"#).unwrap(), None, true);
        assert_eq!(rights.acquired, BTreeMap::from([(10, 1_000), (20, 1_000)]));
        assert!(rights.apps.contains(&30));
    }

    #[test]
    fn only_a_released_game_joins_the_library_unplayed() {
        let app = |common: &str| {
            let info = format!(r#""appinfo" {{ "appid" "730" "common" {{ {common} }} }}"#);
            parse_app(730, info.as_bytes()).unwrap().unplayed_game()
        };
        let game = app(
            r#""name" "Counter-Strike 2" "type" "Game" "icon" "8dbc71" "releasestate" "released""#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(game.name, "Counter-Strike 2");
        assert_eq!(game.icon_hash, "8dbc71");
        assert_eq!((game.last_played, game.playtime_minutes), (0, 0));
        assert!(app(r#""name" "Old game" "type" "game""#).is_some());
        assert!(app(r#""name" "Soundtrack" "type" "Music""#).is_none());
        assert!(app(r#""name" "Expansion" "type" "DLC""#).is_none());
        assert!(app(r#""name" "Server" "type" "Tool""#).is_none());
        assert!(app(r#""name" "Upcoming" "type" "Game" "releasestate" "prerelease""#).is_none());
        assert!(app(r#""type" "Game""#).is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_download_filters_shared_depots_and_launches() {
        let app = parse_app(42, br#""appinfo" {
            "appid" "42" "common" { "name" "Test" "type" "Game" "FreeToDownload" "1" "oslist" "windows" }
            "config" { "installdir" "Test" "launch" { "0" { "executable" "game.exe" "workingdir" "bin" "type" "default" "config" { "oslist" "windows" } } } }
            "depots" {
                "43" { "config" { "oslist" "windows,macos" "osarch" "64" "language" "french" }
                    "manifests" { "public" { "gid" "123456789012345" "size" "1000" "download" "500" } } }
                "44" { "depotfromapp" "99" "dlcappid" "45" }
                "branches" { "public" { "buildid" "123" } }
            }
        }"#).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(app.name, "Test");
        assert_eq!(app.os_list, ["windows"]);
        assert!(app.free_to_download);

        assert_eq!(app.depots[0].os_list, ["windows", "macos"]);

        assert_eq!(app.depots[1].shared_from_app, Some(99));
        assert_eq!(app.depots[1].dlc_app_id, Some(45));
        assert_eq!(app.launch_configs[0].executable, "game.exe");
        assert_eq!(app.launch_configs[0].working_directory, "bin");
        assert_eq!(app.launch_configs[0].launch_type, "default");
    }

    #[test]
    fn missing_app_platforms_fall_back_to_explicit_launch_platforms_only() {
        let unknown = parse_app(
            1,
            br#""appinfo" { "depots" { "2" { "manifests" { "public" "3" } } } }"#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(unknown.os_list.is_empty());
        let with_launch = parse_app(1, br#""appinfo" { "config" { "launch" { "0" { "executable" "game.exe" "config" { "oslist" "Windows" } } } } }"#).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(with_launch.os_list, ["windows"]);
    }
}
```

```rs
fn playing(source: &friends::FriendsEventSource, app_id: u32) {

            status_flags: friends::REQUESTED | friends::STATUS,

            }],

        .encode_to_vec(),
    );

        .name
        .as_deref()

async fn respond_batch(
    server: &mut test_server::TestServer,
    expected_ids: &[u32],
    result: proto::ProductResponse,
) {
    respond_batches(server, &[(expected_ids, result)]).await;
}

/// Answers PICS batches sent together: every token request, then every product
/// request, each matched to its batch by the apps it names.
async fn respond_batches(
    server: &mut test_server::TestServer,
    batches: &[(&[u32], proto::ProductResponse)],
) {
    let mut token_requests = Vec::new();
    for _ in batches {
        token_requests.push(server.request(TOKEN_REQUEST).await);
    }
    for token_request in &token_requests {
        let tokens = proto::AccessTokenRequest::decode(token_request.body.clone()).unwrap();
        assert!(batches.iter().any(|(ids, _)| tokens.app_ids == *ids));
        assert!(tokens.package_ids.is_empty());
        server
            .reply(
                token_request,
                TOKEN_RESPONSE,
                &proto::AccessTokenResponse::default(),
            )
            .await;
    }
    for _ in batches {
        let product_request = server.request(PRODUCT_REQUEST).await;
        let products = proto::ProductRequest::decode(product_request.body.clone()).unwrap();
        let ids: Vec<_> = products.apps.iter().map(|app| app.id).collect();
        let (_, result) = batches
            .iter()
            .find(|(expected, _)| *expected == ids)
            .expect("a product request for a sent batch");
        assert!(products.packages.is_empty());
        server
            .reply(&product_request, PRODUCT_RESPONSE, result)
            .await;
    }
}

fn metadata(ids: &[u32]) -> proto::ProductResponse {
    proto::ProductResponse {
        apps: ids
            .iter()
            .filter(|id| **id != 25)
            .map(|id| proto::ProductInfo {
                id: *id,
                // 51 has valid metadata with no platform declaration.
                buffer: format!(
                    "\"appinfo\" {{ \"appid\" \"{id}\" \"common\" {{ \"oslist\" \"{}\" }} }}",
                    if *id == 51 { "" } else { "windows,macos" }
                )
                .into_bytes()
                .into(),
                ..Default::default()
            })
            .collect(),
        unknown_apps: ids.iter().copied().filter(|id| *id == 25).collect(),
        ..Default::default()
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn library_platforms_batches_51_ids_preserves_unknown_and_reuses_metadata() {
    let (client, mut server, _) = fixture().await;
    let mut requested = vec![0, 1];
    requested.extend(1..=51);
    requested.extend([51, 0]);
    let responder = async {
        let first: Vec<_> = (1..=50).collect();
        // Both batches are in flight at once.
        respond_batches(
            &mut server,
            &[(&first, metadata(&first)), (&[51], metadata(&[51]))],
        )
        .await;
    };
    let (result, ()) = tokio::join!(client.platforms(&requested), responder);
    let result = result.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(result.len(), 51);
    assert_eq!(
        result.iter().map(|game| game.app_id).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        (1..=51).collect::<Vec<_>>()
    );
    assert_eq!(result[0].platforms, ["windows", "macos"]);
    assert!(result[24].platforms.is_empty());
    assert!(result[50].platforms.is_empty());

    // Known metadata, including a valid empty declaration, needs no new CM job.
    let cached = timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), client.platforms(&[51, 1, 51, 0]))
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(cached, vec![result[50].clone(), result[0].clone()]);
    assert!(server.quiet().await);
    assert!(client.platforms(&[0, 0]).await.unwrap().is_empty());
}

/// The account's licenses, as Steam pushes them after logon.
async fn push_licenses(server: &mut test_server::TestServer, licenses: Vec<proto::License>) {
    let list = proto::LicenseList {
        result: Some(1),
        licenses,
    };
    server
        .send(
            LICENSE_LIST,
            proto::Header::default(),
            &list.encode_to_vec(),
        )
        .await;
}

/// A package as PICS sends it, in binary KeyValues, granting `apps`.
fn package(id: u32, apps: &[u32]) -> proto::ProductInfo {
    let mut buffer = 1_u32.to_le_bytes().to_vec();
    buffer.push(0);
    buffer.extend(format!("{id}\0").bytes());
    buffer.push(0);
    buffer.extend(b"appids\0");
    for (index, app) in apps.iter().enumerate() {
        buffer.push(2);
        buffer.extend(format!("{index}\0").bytes());
        buffer.extend(app.to_le_bytes());
    }
    buffer.extend([8, 8, 8]);
    proto::ProductInfo {
        id,
        buffer: buffer.into(),
        ..Default::default()
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn library_adds_the_free_games_owned_games_leave_out() {
    const ACCOUNT: u32 = 76_561_198_000_000_000_u64 as u32;
    const BORROWED: u32 = 0x4000;
    let (client, mut server, _) = fixture().await;
    push_licenses(
        &mut server,
        vec![
            proto::License {
                package_id: 1,
                owner_id: ACCOUNT,
                time_created: 1_700_000_000,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            // A family member lends app 400.
            proto::License {
                package_id: 2,
                owner_id: ACCOUNT + 1,
                flags: BORROWED,
                ..Default::default()
            },
        ],
    )
    .await;
    let answer = async {
        let owned = server.request(SERVICE_REQUEST).await;
        let response = proto::OwnedGamesResponse {
            game_count: 1,
            games: vec![proto::OwnedGame {
                app_id: 620,
                name: "Portal 2".into(),
                last_played: 1_789_430_000,
                ..Default::default()
            }],
        };
        server.reply(&owned, SERVICE_RESPONSE, &response).await;
        let packages = server.request(PRODUCT_REQUEST).await;
        let response = proto::ProductResponse {
            packages: vec![package(1, &[620, 730, 731, 732, 733]), package(2, &[400])],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        server.reply(&packages, PRODUCT_RESPONSE, &response).await;
        let app = |id: u32, common: &str| proto::ProductInfo {
            id,
            buffer: format!(r#""appinfo" {{ "appid" "{id}" "common" {{ {common} }} }}"#)
                .into_bytes()
                .into(),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let apps = proto::ProductResponse {
            apps: vec![
                app(
                    730,
                    r#""name" "Counter-Strike 2" "type" "Game" "icon" "cs2""#,
                ),
                app(731, r#""name" "Soundtrack" "type" "Music""#),
                app(
                    732,
                    r#""name" "Upcoming" "type" "Game" "releasestate" "prerelease""#,
                ),
                // Steam withholds this one's metadata from the account.
                proto::ProductInfo {
                    id: 733,
                    missing_token: true,
                    ..Default::default()
                },
            ],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        respond_batch(&mut server, &[730, 731, 732, 733], apps).await;
    };
    let (games, ()) = tokio::join!(client.games(), answer);
    let games = games.unwrap();
    let names: Vec<_> = games.iter().map(|game| game.name.as_str()).collect();
    assert_eq!(names, ["Portal 2", "Counter-Strike 2"]);
    assert_eq!(games[1].icon_hash, "cs2");
    // The licenses this load read date the games without asking Steam again.
    assert_eq!(
        client.acquisitions().await.unwrap().get(&730),
        Some(&1_700_000_000)
    );
    assert!(server.quiet().await);
}
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/cm/social.rs`:

```rs
//! Presence, friends chat and game invitations for the account's UI session.
//! Wire fields follow steammessages_friendmessages.steamclient.proto and the
//! clientserver friends, MMS and base protobufs; EMsgs follow SteamKit's emsg.steamd.
use rsa::rand_core::{OsRng, RngCore};

use super::{CmError, SERVICE_REQUEST, SteamConnection, chat, invites, own_game, proto};

const CHANGE_STATUS: u32 = 716;
const MMS_INVITE_TO_LOBBY: u32 = 6621;
/// EPersonaState::Online.
const ONLINE: u32 = 1;
/// EResult values a chat request reports to the person (SteamKit eresult.steamd).
const ACCESS_DENIED: i32 = 15;
const RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: i32 = 84;
/// Steam's history pages; Valve's web chat loads the same amount.
pub(crate) const HISTORY_PAGE: u32 = 50;
/// The SteamID of every public individual account, without its account ID.
const INDIVIDUAL: u64 = 0x0110_0001_0000_0000;

/// Chat and invitation failures the person can act on, apart from transport.
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum SocialError {
    #[error(transparent)]
    Cm(#[from] CmError),
    #[error("backend.steam.chat.rateLimited")]
    RateLimited,
    #[error("backend.steam.chat.notFriends")]
    NotFriends,
    #[error("backend.steam.chat.emptyMessage")]
    EmptyMessage,
    #[error("backend.steam.chat.invalidRecipient")]
    InvalidRecipient,
    #[error("backend.steam.invite.unavailable")]
    InviteUnavailable,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct SentMessage {
    pub timestamp: u32,
    pub ordinal: u32,
    /// BBCode, as Steam stored it.
    pub message: String,
    pub plain: String,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct HistoryMessage {
    pub from_me: bool,
    pub timestamp: u32,
    pub ordinal: u32,
    /// BBCode.
    pub message: String,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct History {
    /// Oldest first.
    pub messages: Vec<HistoryMessage>,
    pub more_available: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct MessageSession {
    pub friend: u64,
    pub last_message: u32,
    pub last_view: u32,
    pub unread_message_count: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum GameInviteKind {
    Lobby,
    Connect,
}

impl SteamConnection {
    pub(crate) fn chat_source(&self) -> chat::ChatEventSource {
        self.social.chat.clone()
    }

    pub(crate) fn own_game_source(&self) -> own_game::OwnGameSource {
        self.social.own_game.clone()
    }

    pub(crate) fn invite_source(&self) -> invites::InviteSource {
        self.social.invites.clone()
    }

    /// Shows the account Online. Steam keeps the status for the session, so a
    /// caller sends it again after anything else changed it, such as a game.
    pub(crate) async fn set_online(&self) -> Result<(), CmError> {
        self.send_unjobbed(
            CHANGE_STATUS,
            &proto::ChangeStatus {
                persona_state: Some(ONLINE),
            },
            None,
            None,
        )
        .await
    }

    /// Sends text as Valve's web chat does, with BBCode enabled; literal
    /// brackets are escaped so the text cannot become markup.
    pub(crate) async fn send_friend_message(
        &self,
        friend: u64,
        text: &str,
    ) -> Result<SentMessage, SocialError> {
        if text.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(SocialError::EmptyMessage);
        }
        let message = text.replace('[', "\\[");
        let response: proto::SendMessageResponse = self
            .chat_service(
                "FriendMessages.SendMessage#1",
                &self.chat_entry(friend, chat::CHAT_MESSAGE, message.clone())?,
            )
            .await?;
        Ok(SentMessage {
            timestamp: response.server_timestamp,
            ordinal: response.ordinal,
            message: if response.modified_message.is_empty() {
                message
            } else {
                response.modified_message
            },
            plain: if response.message_without_bb_code.is_empty() {
                text.to_owned()
            } else {
                response.message_without_bb_code
            },
        })
    }

    pub(crate) async fn send_typing(&self, friend: u64) -> Result<(), SocialError> {
        let _: proto::SendMessageResponse = self
            .chat_service(
                "FriendMessages.SendMessage#1",
                &self.chat_entry(friend, chat::TYPING, String::new())?,
            )
            .await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn chat_entry(
        &self,
        friend: u64,
        entry_type: i32,
        message: String,
    ) -> Result<proto::SendMessageRequest, SocialError> {
        self.check_friend(friend)?;
        let mut id = [0; 8];
        OsRng
            .try_fill_bytes(&mut id)
            .map_err(|_| CmError::Protocol("backend.steam.cm.invalidSession".into()))?;
        Ok(proto::SendMessageRequest {
            steamid: friend,
            chat_entry_type: entry_type,
            message,
            contains_bbcode: true,
            echo_to_sender: false,
            client_message_id: crate::content::hex(&id),
        })
    }

    /// Messages before `before` (timestamp, ordinal), or the latest ones.
    pub(crate) async fn recent_messages(
        &self,
        friend: u64,
        before: Option<(u32, u32)>,
        count: u32,
    ) -> Result<History, SocialError> {
        self.check_friend(friend)?;
        // Valve's web chat bounds the latest page by the end of RTime32 time.
        let (time_last, ordinal_last) = before.unwrap_or((i32::MAX as u32, 0));
        let response: proto::RecentMessagesResponse = self
            .chat_service(
                "FriendMessages.GetRecentMessages#1",
                &proto::RecentMessagesRequest {
                    steamid1: self.steam_id,
                    steamid2: friend,
                    count: count.clamp(1, HISTORY_PAGE),
                    bbcode_format: true,
                    time_last,
                    ordinal_last,
                },
            )
            .await?;
        let me = self.steam_id as u32;
        let mut messages: Vec<_> = response
            .messages
            .into_iter()
            // The page may repeat its boundary message.
            .filter(|message| before != Some((message.timestamp, message.ordinal)))
            .map(|message| HistoryMessage {
                from_me: message.accountid == me,
                timestamp: message.timestamp,
                ordinal: message.ordinal,
                message: message.message,
            })
            .collect();
        messages.sort_by_key(|message| (message.timestamp, message.ordinal));
        Ok(History {
            messages,
            more_available: response.more_available,
        })
    }

    pub(crate) async fn active_sessions(&self) -> Result<Vec<MessageSession>, SocialError> {
        let response: proto::ActiveSessionsResponse = self
            .chat_service(
                "FriendMessages.GetActiveMessageSessions#1",
                &proto::ActiveSessionsRequest {
                    lastmessage_since: 0,
                    only_sessions_with_messages: true,
                },
            )
            .await?;
        Ok(response
            .message_sessions
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|session| session.accountid_friend != 0)
            .map(|session| MessageSession {
                friend: INDIVIDUAL | u64::from(session.accountid_friend),
                last_message: session.last_message,
                last_view: session.last_view,
                unread_message_count: session.unread_message_count,
            })
            .collect())
    }

    /// Marks the conversation read up to `timestamp`, for every session.
    pub(crate) async fn ack(&self, friend: u64, timestamp: u32) -> Result<(), SocialError> {
        self.check_friend(friend)?;
        self.send_unjobbed(
            SERVICE_REQUEST,
            &proto::AckMessage {
                steamid_partner: friend,
                timestamp,
            },
            Some("FriendMessages.AckMessage#1"),
            None,
        )
        .await
        .map_err(Into::into)
    }

    /// Steam answers neither invitation; the friend's client receives it.
    pub(crate) async fn invite(
        &self,
        friend: u64,
        app_id: u32,
        invite: &own_game::GameInvite,
    ) -> Result<GameInviteKind, SocialError> {
        self.check_friend(friend)?;
        match invite {
            own_game::GameInvite::Lobby { lobby_id } => {
                self.send_unjobbed(
                    MMS_INVITE_TO_LOBBY,
                    &proto::InviteToLobby {
                        steam_id_lobby: *lobby_id,
                        steam_id_user_invited: friend,
                    },
                    None,
                    Some(app_id),
                )
                .await?;
                Ok(GameInviteKind::Lobby)
            }
            own_game::GameInvite::Connect { connect } => {
                self.send_unjobbed(
                    invites::INVITE_TO_GAME,
                    &proto::InviteToGame {
                        steam_id_dest: friend,
                        steam_id_src: self.steam_id,
                        connect_string: connect.clone(),
                        remote_play: String::new(),
                    },
                    None,
                    Some(app_id),
                )
                .await?;
                Ok(GameInviteKind::Connect)
            }
            own_game::GameInvite::None => Err(SocialError::InviteUnavailable),
        }
    }

    fn check_friend(&self, friend: u64) -> Result<(), SocialError> {
        if crate::friends::individual(friend, self.steam_id) {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(SocialError::InvalidRecipient)
        }
    }

    async fn chat_service<R: prost::Message + Default>(
        &self,
        name: &str,
        request: &impl prost::Message,
    ) -> Result<R, SocialError> {
        self.service_for(name, request, "backend.steam.cm.action.chat")
            .await
            .map_err(|error| match error {
                CmError::Rejected {
                    result: RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED,
                    ..
                } => SocialError::RateLimited,
                // Valve's web chat shows this result as "not friends".
                CmError::Rejected {
                    result: ACCESS_DENIED,
                    ..
                } => SocialError::NotFriends,
                error => error.into(),
            })
    }
}
```

```rs
use super::*;
use crate::client::{Client, GameInviteKind};

const ACCOUNT: u64 = 76_561_198_000_000_000;
const FRIEND: u64 = ACCOUNT + 1;

/// A logged-on UI session whose worker knows its account, as after a logon.
async fn session() -> (Client, test_server::TestServer) {
    let (connection, server) = test_server::connection(ACCOUNT, true).await;
    connection
        .outgoing
        .send(Command::Session {
            steam_id: ACCOUNT,
            session_id: 1,
            heartbeat_seconds: 15,
        })
        .await
        .unwrap();
    (Client::with_test_connection(connection), server)
}

fn fixed64(tag: u8, value: u64) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut bytes = vec![tag];
    bytes.extend_from_slice(&value.to_le_bytes());
    bytes
}

fn own_persona(app_id: u32, lobby_id: u64, connect: Option<&str>) -> Vec<u8> {
    crate::own_game::fixture::persona(ACCOUNT, app_id, lobby_id, connect)
}

// Decodes only CMsgClientLogon.chat_mode (33), independently of proto::Logon.
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, prost::Message)]
struct WireChatMode {
    #[prost(uint32, optional, tag = "33")]
    chat_mode: Option<u32>,
}

async fn logon_body(chat: ChatMode) -> Bytes {
    let (mut connection, mut server) = test_server::connection(0, false).await;
    let steam = async {
        let logon = server.request(LOGON).await;
        server
            .send(
                LOGON_RESPONSE,
                proto::Header {
                    steam_id: Some(ACCOUNT),
                    session_id: Some(7),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                &proto::LogonResponse {
                    result: Some(1),
                    ..Default::default()
                }
                .encode_to_vec(),
            )
            .await;
        logon.body
    };
    let (logged_on, body) = tokio::join!(
        connection.log_on("fixture", ACCOUNT, "fixture-token", chat),
        steam
    );
    logged_on.unwrap();
    body
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn messages_are_sent_as_valves_web_chat_sends_them() {
    let (client, mut server) = session().await;
    let sending = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let sent = client.send_message(FRIEND, "a[b").await;
        (client, sent)
    });
    let request = server.request(SERVICE_REQUEST).await;
    assert_eq!(
        request.header.target_name.as_deref(),
        Some("FriendMessages.SendMessage#1")
    );
    assert!(request.header.job_source.is_some());
    // steamid 1, chat_entry_type 2 = 1, message 3 escaped, contains_bbcode 4,
    // no echo_to_sender 5, client_message_id 8 of 16 hex characters.
    let mut expected = fixed64(0x09, FRIEND);
    expected.extend_from_slice(&[0x10, 0x01, 0x1a, 0x04, b'a', b'\\', b'[', b'b', 0x20, 0x01]);
    expected.extend_from_slice(&[0x42, 0x10]);
    assert_eq!(&request.body[..expected.len()], expected);
    let id = &request.body[expected.len()..];
    assert_eq!(id.len(), 16);
    assert!(id.iter().all(u8::is_ascii_hexdigit));
    server
        .reply(
            &request,
            SERVICE_RESPONSE,
            &proto::SendMessageResponse {
                modified_message: "a\\[b".into(),
                server_timestamp: 1_700_000_000,
                ordinal: 2,
                message_without_bb_code: "a[b".into(),
            },
        )
        .await;
    let (client, sent) = sending.await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        sent.unwrap(),
        SentMessage {
            timestamp: 1_700_000_000,
            ordinal: 2,
            message: "a\\[b".into(),
            plain: "a[b".into(),
        }
    );
    assert_eq!(
        client
            .send_message(FRIEND, "  ")
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .to_string(),
        "backend.steam.chat.emptyMessage"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        client
            .send_message(ACCOUNT, "me")
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .to_string(),
        "backend.steam.chat.invalidRecipient"
    );
}
```
