`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/content/tests/prefetch.rs`:

```rs
use super::*;

/// The disk side of depot 42's engine, for `transfer::run_engine`.
fn disk_install(
    destination: &Path,
    files: Vec<ManifestFile>,
    cancel: &CancelToken,
) -> (
    impl FnOnce(DepotChunks) -> Result<u64, ContentError> + Send + 'static,
    Arc<Reporter>,
) {
    let reporter = Reporter::new(
        DownloadProgress {
            total_bytes: files.iter().map(|file| file.size).sum(),
            total_files: files.iter().filter(|file| !file.is_directory()).count() as u32,
            ..Default::default()
        },
        |_| {},
    );
    let manifest = Arc::new(Manifest {
        depot_id: 42,
        manifest_id: 99,
        files,
    });
    let disk = DiskInstall::engine_side(
        destination.to_owned(),
        42,
        99,
        None,
        manifest,
        cancel.clone(),
        Arc::clone(&reporter),
    );
    (disk, reporter)
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn fetches_a_future_file_before_the_first_finishes_and_refills_the_window() {
    let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let contents: Vec<_> = (0..12)
        .map(|index| format!("unique contents of file {index}").into_bytes())
        .collect();
    let mut files: Vec<_> = contents
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(index, bytes)| file(&format!("data/{index:02}.bin"), &[bytes]))
        .collect();
    let first = files[0].chunks[0].sha.clone();
    let second = files[1].chunks[0].sha.clone();
    let payloads: HashMap<_, _> = files
        .iter()
        .zip(&contents)
        .map(|(file, bytes)| (file.chunks[0].sha.clone(), bytes.clone()))
        .collect();
    // Neither a valid file nor a directory between two repairs should stop
    // requests for the next file. The empty file still needs publication.
    let valid = b"already installed";
    fs::create_dir(directory.path().join("data")).unwrap();
    fs::write(directory.path().join("data/valid.bin"), valid).unwrap();
    files.insert(1, file("data/valid.bin", &[valid]));
    files.insert(
        2,
        ManifestFile {
            name: "data".into(),
            flags: 64,
            ..Default::default()
        },
    );
    files.push(file("data/empty.bin", &[]));
    let cancel = CancelToken::new();
    let (disk, reporter) = disk_install(directory.path(), files, &cancel);
    let future_started = tokio::sync::Notify::new();
    let observed = AtomicBool::new(false);
    let fetched = Mutex::new(Vec::new());
    let installed =
        transfer::run_engine(PIPELINE, &cancel, disk, |(place, chunk): ChunkRequest| {
            let first = &first;
            let second = &second;
            let payloads = &payloads;
            let future_started = &future_started;
            let observed = &observed;
            let fetched = &fetched;
            async move {
                fetched.lock().unwrap().push(chunk.sha.clone());
                if &chunk.sha == first {
                    // The old file-at-a-time scheduler cannot start file two
                    // while this first chunk is held, and fails this deadline.
                    tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), future_started.notified())
                        .await
                        .map_err(|_| ContentError::Network)?;
                } else if &chunk.sha == second {
                    observed.store(true, Ordering::Release);
                    future_started.notify_one();
                }
                Ok((place, payloads.get(&chunk.sha).unwrap().clone()))
            }
        })
        .await;
    assert_eq!(installed.unwrap(), valid.len() as u64);
    assert!(observed.load(Ordering::Acquire));
    for (index, bytes) in contents.iter().enumerate() {
        assert_eq!(
            fs::read(directory.path().join(format!("data/{index:02}.bin"))).unwrap(),
            *bytes
        );
    }
    assert!(directory.path().join("data/empty.bin").is_file());
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read(directory.path().join("data/valid.bin")).unwrap(),
        valid
    );
    assert_eq!(fetched.lock().unwrap().len(), contents.len());
    let status = reporter.snapshot();
    assert_eq!(status.completed_files, 14);
    assert_eq!(status.completed_bytes, status.total_bytes);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn cancellation_bounds_prepared_files_and_resumes_each_verified_partial() {
    let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    // More files than may be prepared at once, with fewer chunks than the window.
    let pieces: Vec<_> = (0..PREPARED_FILES + 8)
        .map(|index| {
            [
                format!("first chunk of file {index}").into_bytes(),
                format!("second chunk of file {index}").into_bytes(),
            ]
        })
        .collect();
    let files: Vec<_> = pieces
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(index, parts)| file(&format!("{index:02}.bin"), &[&parts[0], &parts[1]]))
        .collect();
    let mut responses = HashMap::from([(
        "/depot/42/manifest/99/5/123".into(),
        zip(&manifest(files.clone(), false)),
    )]);
    for bytes in pieces.iter().flatten() {
        responses.insert(
            format!("/depot/42/chunk/{}", hex(&Sha1::digest(bytes))),
            encrypt(&zip(bytes)),
        );
    }
    let original = b"old working version";
    for file in &files {
        fs::write(directory.path().join(&file.name), original).unwrap();
    }
    // A later file already has one valid partial chunk before prefetch begins.
    let partial_root = directory.path().join(PARTIAL_DIRECTORY).join("42/99");
    fs::create_dir_all(&partial_root).unwrap();
    let reused_path = partial_root.join(format!(
        "{}.part",
        hex(&Sha1::digest(files[3].name.as_bytes()))
    ));
    fs::write(reused_path, &pieces[3][0]).unwrap();
    let fixture = CdnFixture::new(responses);
    let client = fixture.client();
    let cancel = CancelToken::new();
    let trigger = cancel.clone();
    let partial_count = Arc::new(Mutex::new(None));
    let count = Arc::clone(&partial_count);
    let counted_root = partial_root.clone();
    let reused = pieces[3][0].len() as u64;
    let result = client
        .download_depot(&plan(directory.path()), &cancel, move |status| {
            if status.completed_bytes > reused && !trigger.is_cancelled() {
                // The first chunk was written, but no replacement has been
                // published.
                *count.lock().unwrap() = Some(fs::read_dir(&counted_root).unwrap().count());
                trigger.cancel();
            }
        })
        .await;
    assert!(matches!(result, Err(ContentError::Cancelled)));
    assert_eq!(*partial_count.lock().unwrap(), Some(PREPARED_FILES));
    for file in &files {
        assert_eq!(
            fs::read(directory.path().join(&file.name)).unwrap(),
            original
        );
    }
    assert!(install::lock_engine(directory.path()).unwrap().is_some());
    let resumed = client
        .download_depot(&plan(directory.path()), &CancelToken::new(), |_| {})
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .summary;
    // The verified partial chunk, and the chunk written before cancellation.
    assert!(resumed.reused_bytes > reused);
    assert_eq!(resumed.completed_files, files.len() as u32);
    for (file, parts) in files.iter().zip(&pieces) {
        assert_eq!(
            fs::read(directory.path().join(&file.name)).unwrap(),
            parts.concat()
        );
    }
    let route = format!("/depot/42/chunk/{}", hex(&Sha1::digest(&pieces[3][0])));
    assert!(!fixture.requests.lock().unwrap().contains(&route));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn a_refused_request_stops_preparing_and_returns_the_queued_cdn_error() {
    let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let (kept, lost): (&[u8], &[u8]) = (b"kept chunk of file 00", b"lost chunk of file 00");
    let mut files = vec![file("00.bin", &[kept, lost])];
    files.extend((1..10).map(|index| file(&format!("{index:02}.bin"), &[b"new file content"])));
    // 00.bin's partial already holds its first chunk: only the second is requested.
    let partial_root = directory.path().join(PARTIAL_DIRECTORY).join("42/99");
    fs::create_dir_all(&partial_root).unwrap();
    let partial = format!("{}.part", hex(&Sha1::digest(b"00.bin")));
    fs::write(partial_root.join(&partial), kept).unwrap();
    let cancel = CancelToken::new();
    let (disk, _) = disk_install(directory.path(), files, &cancel);
    // The network side already stopped on a CDN error: its outcome is queued
    // and every request is refused.
    let (chunks, requests, deliveries) = DepotChunks::detached(WRITE_QUEUE);
    drop(requests);
    deliveries.send(Err(ContentError::Http(403))).await.unwrap();
    let result = tokio::time::timeout(
        Duration::from_secs(8),
        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || disk(chunks)),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap()
    .unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(result, Err(ContentError::Http(403))), "{result:?}");
    assert!(
        !directory.path().join("00.bin").exists(),
        "a file missing a refused chunk is never published"
    );
    let prepared: Vec<_> = fs::read_dir(&partial_root)
        .unwrap()
        .map(|entry| entry.unwrap().file_name())
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(prepared, [partial.as_str()], "no file is prepared after it");
    assert!(install::lock_engine(directory.path()).unwrap().is_some());
}
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/content/verification.rs`:

```rs
//! Steam manifest entries described for the shared verification scheduler.
//!
//! Path confinement, the SHA-1 read, the reader bound and the join-before-repair
//! guarantee all live in `obelisk_core::verification`. Rust's orphan rule is why
//! the trait implementation stays in this crate.
use obelisk_core::{
    install::FileDigest,
    verification::{VerificationError, VerificationFile},
};

use super::{ContentError, format::ManifestFile, invalid};

pub(super) use obelisk_core::verification::verify_files;

impl VerificationFile for ManifestFile {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        &self.name
    }
    fn size(&self) -> u64 {
        self.size
    }
    fn digest(&self) -> FileDigest<'_> {
        FileDigest::Sha1(&self.sha)
    }
    /// Links are placed, never read: the scheduler passes over them like folders.
    fn is_directory(&self) -> bool {
        ManifestFile::is_directory(self) || self.is_link()
    }
}

impl From<VerificationError> for ContentError {
    fn from(error: VerificationError) -> Self {
        match error {
            VerificationError::Cancelled => Self::Cancelled,
            VerificationError::Install(error) => error.into(),
            // A reader panic and a counter overflow are the scheduler's own
            // failures; the installation stopped either way.
            VerificationError::SchedulerFailed => {
                invalid("backend.steam.verification.workerFailed")
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use obelisk_core::{
        install::{checked_file_path, safe_relative_path},
        transfer::{CancelToken, DownloadProgress, Reporter},
        verification::{verify_with_workers, worker_limit},
    };
    use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};
    use std::fs;

    #[test]
    #[ignore = "Reads an existing installation selected by OBELISK_VERIFY_BENCH_DIRECTORY; no writes or network"]
    fn benchmark_installed_files() {
        use std::{fs::File, io::Read, time::Instant};

        let root = std::env::var_os("OBELISK_VERIFY_BENCH_DIRECTORY")
            .map(std::path::PathBuf::from)
            .expect("set OBELISK_VERIFY_BENCH_DIRECTORY to an existing game installation")
            .canonicalize()
            .unwrap();
        assert!(root.is_dir());
        let mut directories = vec![root.clone()];
        let mut paths = Vec::new();
        while let Some(directory) = directories.pop() {
            for entry in fs::read_dir(directory).unwrap() {
                let entry = entry.unwrap();
                if entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().starts_with(".obelisk") {
                    continue;
                }
                let kind = entry.file_type().unwrap();
                assert!(
                    !kind.is_symlink(),
                    "benchmark does not follow symbolic links"
                );
                if kind.is_dir() {
                    directories.push(entry.path());
                } else {
                    assert!(kind.is_file(), "benchmark only reads regular game files");
                    paths.push(entry.path());
                }
            }
        }
        paths.sort();
        assert!(!paths.is_empty(), "installation contains no game files");

        // Build expected hashes before either timer. Both passes receive the same
        // complete-file expectations and run the actual production verifier.
        let mut files = Vec::with_capacity(paths.len());
        let mut buffer = [0_u8; 64 * 1024];
        for path in paths {
            let relative = path.strip_prefix(&root).unwrap();
            let name = relative.to_str().expect("game path must be UTF-8");
            let checked = checked_file_path(&root, &safe_relative_path(name).unwrap()).unwrap();
            let mut input = File::open(checked).unwrap();
            let mut hasher = Sha1::new();
            let mut size = 0_u64;
            loop {
                let count = input.read(&mut buffer).unwrap();
                if count == 0 {
                    break;
                }
                size += count as u64;
                hasher.update(&buffer[..count]);
            }
            files.push(ManifestFile {
                name: name.into(),
                size,
                sha: hasher.finalize().to_vec(),
                ..Default::default()
            });
        }
        let bytes: u64 = files.iter().map(|file| file.size).sum();
        let profile = if cfg!(debug_assertions) {
            "debug"
        } else {
            "release"
        };
        let reporter = Reporter::new(DownloadProgress::default(), |_| {});
        for workers in [1, worker_limit()] {
            let start = Instant::now();
            let result =
                verify_with_workers(&root, &files, &CancelToken::new(), &reporter, workers)
                    .unwrap();
            let duration = start.elapsed();
            let all_valid = result.valid.iter().all(|valid| *valid);
            println!(
                "verification_benchmark profile={profile} workers={workers} files={} bytes={bytes} seconds={:.6} all_valid={all_valid}",
                files.len(),
                duration.as_secs_f64()
            );
            assert!(all_valid, "a file changed during the read-only benchmark");
        }
    }
}
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/friends.rs`:

```rs
//! Account-scoped, event-driven Steam friends state. The watch channel contains
//! complete snapshots, so a slow consumer can coalesce updates without losing
//! relationship removals or field clears. Content requests never wait for it.
use std::{
    collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet},
    sync::{Arc, Mutex, PoisonError},
};

use prost::Message;
use tokio::sync::watch;

use crate::{own_game::GameInvite, proto};

pub(crate) const PERSONA_STATE: u32 = 766;
pub(crate) const FRIENDS_LIST: u32 = 767;
pub(crate) const STATUS: u32 = 1;
pub(crate) const PLAYER_NAME: u32 = 2;
pub(crate) const PRESENCE: u32 = 16;
pub(crate) const GAME_EXTRA_INFO: u32 = 256;
pub(crate) const GAME_DATA_BLOB: u32 = 512;
pub(crate) const RICH_PRESENCE: u32 = 4096;
pub(crate) const REQUESTED: u32 = PLAYER_NAME | PRESENCE;
pub(crate) const REQUEST_BATCH: usize = 100;
// These are defensive client limits, not claims about Steam's account limits.
const MAX_FRIENDS: usize = 10_000;
const MAX_EARLY_PERSONAS: usize = 512;
const MAX_SOCIAL_PACKET: usize = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_LABEL_BYTES: usize = 1024;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum FriendPresence {
    Unknown,
    Offline,
    Online,
    Busy,
    Away,
    Snooze,
    LookingToTrade,
    LookingToPlay,
    Invisible,
}

impl From<u32> for FriendPresence {
    fn from(value: u32) -> Self {
        match value {
            0 => Self::Offline,
            1 => Self::Online,
            2 => Self::Busy,
            3 => Self::Away,
            4 => Self::Snooze,
            5 => Self::LookingToTrade,
            6 => Self::LookingToPlay,
            7 => Self::Invisible,
            _ => Self::Unknown,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct FriendGame {
    pub app_id: Option<u32>,
    pub name: Option<String>,
    /// The lobby the friend is in, 0 for none, as their persona shows it.
    pub lobby_id: u64,
    /// The friend's rich presence `connect` string, for this game.
    pub connect: Option<String>,
}

impl FriendGame {
    /// What Steam's "Join Game" joins: the friend's lobby, else their rich
    /// presence `connect` string. A game without an app has neither.
    pub fn invite(&self) -> GameInvite {
        let invite = match (self.app_id, self.lobby_id, &self.connect) {
            (None, _, _) => GameInvite::None,
            (Some(_), lobby_id, _) if lobby_id != 0 => GameInvite::Lobby { lobby_id },
            (Some(_), _, Some(connect)) => GameInvite::Connect {
                connect: connect.clone(),
            },
            (Some(_), _, None) => GameInvite::None,
        };
        if invite.sendable() {
            invite
        } else {
            GameInvite::None
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Friend {
    pub steam_id: u64,
    pub display_name: Option<String>,
    pub avatar_url: Option<String>,
    pub presence: FriendPresence,
    pub game: Option<FriendGame>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum FriendsConnection {
    Loading,
    Ready,
    Disconnected,
    AuthenticationRequired,
    Error,
}

impl FriendsConnection {
    /// Terminal states: the reducer is done accepting packets and metadata.
    pub(crate) fn ended(self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Disconnected | Self::AuthenticationRequired)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct FriendsSnapshot {
    pub revision: u64,
    pub account_id: u64,
    pub connection: FriendsConnection,
    pub friends: Vec<Friend>,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct CachedFriend {
    friend: Friend,
    /// Persona flag groups received so far; readiness needs the name, avatar
    /// and status groups, so a status-less identity reply never marks a friend ready.
    received: u32,
}

impl CachedFriend {
    fn new(steam_id: u64) -> Self {
        Self {
            friend: Friend {
                steam_id,
                display_name: None,
                avatar_url: None,
                presence: FriendPresence::Unknown,
                game: None,
            },
            received: 0,
        }
    }

    fn apply(&mut self, flags: u32, persona: &proto::Persona) {
        self.received |= flags;
        if flags & PLAYER_NAME != 0 {
            self.friend.display_name = persona.player_name.as_deref().and_then(label);
        }
        if flags & PRESENCE != 0
            && let Some(hash) = &persona.avatar_hash
        {
            self.friend.avatar_url = crate::cm::avatar_url_from_hash(hash);
        }
        // Valve's shipped friends client treats Status1 as the complete
        // presence/activity group, with protobuf defaults for omitted scalars.
        // Identity-only responses (mask18) must never erase this group.
        if flags & STATUS != 0 {
            self.friend.presence = persona.persona_state.unwrap_or(0).into();
            let app_id = persona
                .game_played_app_id
                .filter(|id| *id != 0)
                .or_else(|| {
                    persona
                        .game_id
                        .map(|id| (id & 0x00ff_ffff) as u32)
                        .filter(|id| *id != 0)
                });
            let previous = self.friend.game.take();
            self.friend.game = (app_id.is_some() || persona.game_id.is_some_and(|id| id != 0))
                .then(|| FriendGame {
                    app_id,
                    name: persona.game_name.as_deref().and_then(label),
                    lobby_id: persona.game_lobby_id.unwrap_or(0),
                    // A connect string only holds for the game it came with.
                    connect: previous
                        .filter(|game| game.app_id == app_id)
                        .and_then(|game| game.connect),
                });
        } else {
            // Compatibility with explicitly populated historical game groups.
            // Missing groups/fields here remain partial updates.
            if flags & GAME_DATA_BLOB != 0
                && let Some(app_id) = persona.game_played_app_id
            {
                if app_id == 0 {
                    self.friend.game = None;
                } else {
                    let game = self.friend.game.get_or_insert_default();
                    if game.app_id != Some(app_id) {
                        *game = FriendGame::default();
                    }
                    game.app_id = Some(app_id);
                }
            }
            if flags & (GAME_EXTRA_INFO | GAME_DATA_BLOB) != 0 {
                if let Some(game_id) = persona.game_id {
                    if game_id == 0 {
                        self.friend.game = None;
                    } else {
                        // CGameID's low 24 bits are the app ID. Non-Steam shortcuts
                        // can have no app ID while still supplying a game name.
                        let app_id = (game_id & 0x00ff_ffff) as u32;
                        let game = self.friend.game.get_or_insert_default();
                        let app_id = (app_id != 0).then_some(app_id);
                        if game.app_id != app_id {
                            *game = FriendGame::default();
                        }
                        game.app_id = app_id;
                    }
                }
                if let Some(name) = &persona.game_name {
                    let name = label(name);
                    if let Some(game) = &mut self.friend.game {
                        game.name = name;
                    } else if name.is_some()
                        && persona.game_id != Some(0)
                        && (persona.game_played_app_id != Some(0)
                            || persona.game_id.is_some_and(|id| id != 0))
                    {
                        self.friend.game = Some(FriendGame {
                            name,
                            ..FriendGame::default()
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // Valve's friends client replaces rich presence only with its flag.
        if flags & RICH_PRESENCE != 0
            && let Some(game) = &mut self.friend.game
        {
            game.connect = persona
                .rich_presence
                .iter()
                .find(|pair| pair.key.eq_ignore_ascii_case("connect"))
                .map(|pair| pair.value.clone())
                .filter(|connect| !connect.is_empty());
        }
        // An explicit offline event invalidates activity even without a game
        // field. Later online-only events cannot resurrect the old game.
        if matches!(
            self.friend.presence,
            FriendPresence::Offline | FriendPresence::Invisible
        ) {
            self.friend.game = None;
        }
    }
}

fn label(value: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let value = value.trim();
    if value.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    let mut end = value.len().min(MAX_LABEL_BYTES);
    while !value.is_char_boundary(end) {
        end -= 1;
    }
    Some(value[..end].to_owned())
}

pub(crate) fn individual(id: u64, account_id: u64) -> bool {
    id != account_id && id as u32 != 0 && (id >> 52) & 0xf == 1
}

// Count repeated top-level friends before prost allocates their structs. Tiny
// empty nested messages otherwise amplify a bounded frame into a huge Vec.
fn within_entry_limit(mut body: &[u8]) -> bool {
    let mut count = 0;
    while !body.is_empty() {
        let Ok((tag, wire)) = prost::encoding::decode_key(&mut body) else {
            return true; // Normal decoding handles malformed optional packets.
        };
        if tag == 2 {
            count += 1;
            if count > MAX_FRIENDS {
                return false;
            }
        }
        if prost::encoding::skip_field(
            wire,
            tag,
            &mut body,
            prost::encoding::DecodeContext::default(),
        )
        .is_err()
        {
            return true;
        }
    }
    true
}

struct Reducer {
    account_id: u64,
    full_list_received: bool,
    relationships_valid: bool,
    connection: FriendsConnection,
    friends: BTreeMap<u64, CachedFriend>,
    // Only before the first full list: afterwards unknown persona events are
    // ignored, so late updates cannot recreate a removed relationship.
    early: BTreeMap<u64, CachedFriend>,
    // Session-local PICS names, including unknown apps to avoid repeated queries.
    game_names: BTreeMap<u32, Option<String>>,
    dirty: bool,
}

impl Reducer {
    fn new(account_id: u64) -> Self {
        Self {
            account_id,
            full_list_received: false,
            relationships_valid: false,
            connection: FriendsConnection::Loading,
            friends: BTreeMap::new(),
            early: BTreeMap::new(),
            game_names: BTreeMap::new(),
            dirty: false,
        }
    }

    /// An oversized or undecodable social packet invalidates relationships
    /// until the next full list; nothing further is hydrated from it.
    fn fail(&mut self) -> Vec<u64> {
        self.connection = FriendsConnection::Error;
        self.relationships_valid = false;
        self.dirty = true;
        vec![]
    }

    fn relationships(&mut self, list: proto::FriendsList) -> Vec<u64> {
        if list.friends.len() > MAX_FRIENDS {
            return self.fail();
        }
        let accepted: BTreeMap<_, _> = list
            .friends
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|item| individual(item.steam_id, self.account_id))
            .map(|item| (item.steam_id, item.relationship == 3))
            .collect();
        if list.incremental
            && self.friends.len()
                + accepted
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|(id, yes)| **yes && !self.friends.contains_key(id))
                    .count()
                > MAX_FRIENDS
        {
            return self.fail();
        }
        if !list.incremental {
            self.friends.retain(|id, _| accepted.get(id) == Some(&true));
            self.full_list_received = true;
            self.relationships_valid = true;
        }
        let mut hydrate = Vec::new();
        for (id, accepted) in accepted {
            if accepted {
                let newly_added = !self.friends.contains_key(&id);
                self.friends.entry(id).or_insert_with(|| {
                    self.early
                        .remove(&id)
                        .unwrap_or_else(|| CachedFriend::new(id))
                });
                if !list.incremental || newly_added {
                    // Every full list rehydrates everyone, including offline
                    // friends, and every accepted relationship gets fresh data.
                    hydrate.push(id);
                }
            } else {
                self.friends.remove(&id);
                self.early.remove(&id);
            }
        }
        if self.full_list_received {
            self.early.clear();
        }
        self.update_readiness();
        self.dirty = true;
        hydrate
    }

    fn personas(&mut self, state: proto::PersonaState) {
        if state.friends.len() > MAX_FRIENDS {
            self.connection = FriendsConnection::Error;
            self.dirty = true;
            return;
        }
        for persona in state.friends {
            if !individual(persona.friend_id, self.account_id) {
                continue;
            }
            if let Some(cached) = self.friends.get_mut(&persona.friend_id) {
                let previous = cached.friend.clone();
                cached.apply(state.status_flags, &persona);
                self.dirty |= previous != cached.friend;
            } else if !self.full_list_received {
                if self.early.len() >= MAX_EARLY_PERSONAS
                    && !self.early.contains_key(&persona.friend_id)
                {
                    // The full list subsequently requests every real friend;
                    // evicting speculative pre-list cache cannot lose state.
                    self.early.pop_first();
                }
                self.early
                    .entry(persona.friend_id)
                    .or_insert_with(|| CachedFriend::new(persona.friend_id))
                    .apply(state.status_flags, &persona);
            }
        }
        self.update_readiness();
    }

    fn update_readiness(&mut self) {
        let ready = self.full_list_received
            && self.relationships_valid
            && self.friends.values().all(|cached| {
                cached.received & (PLAYER_NAME | PRESENCE | STATUS)
                    == PLAYER_NAME | PRESENCE | STATUS
            });
        if ready
            && matches!(
                self.connection,
                FriendsConnection::Loading | FriendsConnection::Error
            )
        {
            self.connection = FriendsConnection::Ready;
            self.dirty = true;
        }
    }
}

/// The single CM reader reduces packets; optional PICS metadata fills game titles.
/// Public mutation methods let debug fixtures exercise the same observation path.
/// Read/await methods touch only a watch receiver, never the reducer mutex.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct FriendsEventSource {
    reducer: Arc<Mutex<Reducer>>,
    updates: watch::Sender<Arc<FriendsSnapshot>>,
}

impl FriendsEventSource {
    pub fn new(account_id: u64) -> Self {
        let (updates, _) = watch::channel(Arc::new(FriendsSnapshot {
            revision: 1,
            account_id,
            connection: FriendsConnection::Loading,
            friends: vec![],
        }));
        Self {
            reducer: Arc::new(Mutex::new(Reducer::new(account_id))),
            updates,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_account(&self, account_id: u64) {
        *self.reducer.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner) = Reducer::new(account_id);
        self.updates.send_modify(|snapshot| {
            *snapshot = Arc::new(FriendsSnapshot {
                revision: snapshot.revision + 1,
                account_id,
                connection: FriendsConnection::Loading,
                friends: vec![],
            });
        });
    }

    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> FriendsSnapshot {
        // Release the watch's read guard before cloning the friend list.
        let snapshot = self.updates.borrow().clone();
        (*snapshot).clone()
    }

    /// The account alone, without cloning the friend list `snapshot` copies.
    pub(crate) fn account_id(&self) -> u64 {
        self.updates.borrow().account_id
    }

    /// Atomic revision check + subscription. Dropping the future cancels the
    /// wait; disconnect wakes existing waits even when no persona changed.
    pub async fn next(&self, after_revision: u64) -> FriendsSnapshot {
        let ready = obelisk_core::watch::next_matching(self.updates.subscribe(), |snapshot| {
            snapshot.revision != after_revision || snapshot.connection.ended()
        })
        .await;
        match ready {
            Ok(snapshot) => (*snapshot).clone(),
            Err(snapshot) => {
                let mut snapshot = (*snapshot).clone();
                snapshot.connection = FriendsConnection::Disconnected;
                snapshot
            }
        }
    }

    /// Returns IDs requiring a bounded ClientRequestFriendData hydration.
    /// Unknown or malformed optional social packets do not fail CM queries.
    pub fn apply_packet(&self, kind: u32, body: &[u8]) -> Vec<u64> {
        let hydrate = self.apply_packet_deferred(kind, body);
        self.publish();
        hydrate
    }

    pub(crate) fn apply_packet_deferred(&self, kind: u32, body: &[u8]) -> Vec<u64> {
        if !matches!(kind, FRIENDS_LIST | PERSONA_STATE) {
            return vec![];
        }
        let mut reducer = self.reducer.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner);
        if reducer.connection.ended() {
            return vec![];
        }
        if body.len() > MAX_SOCIAL_PACKET || !within_entry_limit(body) {
            return reducer.fail();
        }
        match kind {
            FRIENDS_LIST => match proto::FriendsList::decode(body) {
                Ok(list) => reducer.relationships(list),
                Err(_) => reducer.fail(),
            },
            PERSONA_STATE => {
                if let Ok(state) = proto::PersonaState::decode(body) {
                    reducer.personas(state);
                }
                vec![]
            }
            _ => vec![],
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn publish(&self) {
        let mut reducer = self.reducer.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner);
        if !reducer.dirty {
            return;
        }
        reducer.dirty = false;
        let friends: Vec<_> = reducer
            .friends
            .values()
            .map(|cached| {
                let mut friend = cached.friend.clone();
                if let Some(game) = &mut friend.game
                    && game.name.is_none()
                    && let Some(app_id) = game.app_id
                {
                    game.name = reducer.game_names.get(&app_id).cloned().flatten();
                }
                friend
            })
            .collect();
        self.updates.send_if_modified(|snapshot| {
            if snapshot.account_id == reducer.account_id
                && snapshot.connection == reducer.connection
                && snapshot.friends == friends
            {
                return false;
            }
            *snapshot = Arc::new(FriendsSnapshot {
                revision: snapshot.revision + 1,
                account_id: reducer.account_id,
                connection: reducer.connection,
                friends,
            });
            true
        });
    }

    pub fn disconnect(&self, authentication_required: bool) {
        let mut reducer = self.reducer.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner);
        if reducer.connection != FriendsConnection::AuthenticationRequired {
            reducer.connection = if authentication_required {
                FriendsConnection::AuthenticationRequired
            } else {
                FriendsConnection::Disconnected
            };
        }
        reducer.dirty = true;
        drop(reducer);
        self.publish();
    }

    pub(crate) fn loading_timed_out(&self) {
        let mut reducer = self.reducer.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner);
        if reducer.connection == FriendsConnection::Loading {
            reducer.connection = FriendsConnection::Error;
            reducer.dirty = true;
        }
        drop(reducer);
        self.publish();
    }

    pub(crate) fn retains(&self, id: u64) -> bool {
        self.reducer
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner)
            .friends
            .contains_key(&id)
    }

    /// Distinct apps whose title is still unknown. Bounded by the friend cap;
    /// the caller batches, since PICS request size is a transport concern.
    pub(crate) fn missing_game_names(&self) -> Vec<u32> {
        let reducer = self.reducer.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner);
        if reducer.connection.ended() {
            return vec![];
        }
        reducer
            .friends
            .values()
            .filter_map(|cached| cached.friend.game.as_ref())
            .filter(|game| game.name.is_none())
            .filter_map(|game| game.app_id)
            .filter(|id| !reducer.game_names.contains_key(id))
            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>()
            .into_iter()
            .collect()
    }

    pub(crate) fn resolve_game_names(&self, account_id: u64, names: &[(u32, Option<String>)]) {
        let mut reducer = self.reducer.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner);
        if reducer.account_id != account_id || reducer.connection.ended() {
            return;
        }
        for (id, name) in names {
            // An unresolved app caches as None so it is never queried twice; that
            // publishes nothing, so only a changed title needs a snapshot rebuild.
            let resolved = name.as_deref().and_then(label);
            reducer.dirty |=
                reducer.game_names.get(id).and_then(Option::as_deref) != resolved.as_deref();
            reducer.game_names.insert(*id, resolved);
        }
        drop(reducer);
        self.publish();
    }

    pub(crate) fn has_full_list(&self) -> bool {
        self.reducer
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner)
            .full_list_received
    }

    pub(crate) fn retain_hydration(&self, pending: &mut BTreeSet<u64>) {
        let reducer = self.reducer.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner);
        pending.retain(|id| reducer.friends.contains_key(id));
    }
}

/// What a CM session still owes the friends list: one push of every friend's
/// persona state once the full list arrived, and the details of friends it
/// revealed, requested in bounded batches. The connection sends the messages.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct Hydration {
    pending: BTreeSet<u64>,
    push_pending: bool,
    push_in_flight: bool,
    deadline: Option<tokio::time::Instant>,
}

impl Hydration {
    /// A session started; its friends list must load in time.
    pub(crate) fn started(&mut self) {
        self.deadline = Some(tokio::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(20));
    }

    pub(crate) fn deadline(&self) -> Option<tokio::time::Instant> {
        self.deadline
    }

    pub(crate) fn timed_out(&mut self, friends: &FriendsEventSource) {
        friends.loading_timed_out();
        self.deadline = None;
    }

    /// Applies one packet, noting the friends whose details it revealed.
    pub(crate) fn apply(&mut self, friends: &FriendsEventSource, kind: u32, body: &[u8]) {
        let revealed = friends.apply_packet_deferred(kind, body);
        self.push_pending |= !revealed.is_empty();
        self.pending.extend(revealed);
        if kind == FRIENDS_LIST {
            friends.retain_hydration(&mut self.pending);
        }
    }

    /// Whether to ask Steam to push every friend's persona state now. Bursts
    /// of relationship changes coalesce into one push at a time.
    pub(crate) fn push_due(&self, friends: &FriendsEventSource) -> bool {
        self.push_pending && !self.push_in_flight && friends.has_full_list()
    }

    pub(crate) fn push_sent(&mut self) {
        self.push_pending = false;
        self.push_in_flight = true;
    }

    pub(crate) fn push_answered(&mut self) {
        self.push_in_flight = false;
    }

    pub(crate) fn has_batch(&self) -> bool {
        !self.pending.is_empty()
    }

    /// The next friends whose details to request, still in the list.
    pub(crate) fn next_batch(&mut self, friends: &FriendsEventSource) -> Vec<u64> {
        (0..REQUEST_BATCH)
            .filter_map(|_| self.pending.pop_first())
            .filter(|id| friends.retains(*id))
            .collect()
    }
}

/// EResult authentication/session invalidation values from SteamKit's pinned
/// enum. Service outages and transport failures remain reconnectable.
pub fn authentication_required(result: i32) -> bool {
    matches!(
        result,
        5 | 6 | 15 | 18 | 26 | 27 | 34 | 43 | 50 | 63 | 65 | 66 | 71 | 74 | 77 | 85 | 88 | 89 | 93
    )
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::task::Poll;

    const ACCOUNT: u64 = 76_561_197_960_265_730;
    const FRIEND: u64 = 76_561_197_960_265_729;
    // Hand-authored wire fixtures, checked independently against SteamTracking
    // 08f0f630b3ada21a6a48ffede2116df3ef3c918d, friends.proto fields. No
    // project protobuf encoder produced these bytes. IDs/names are synthetic.
    const FULL_LIST: &[u8] = &[
        0x08, 0x00, 0x12, 0x0b, 0x09, 0x01, 0, 0, 0, 0x01, 0, 0x10, 0x01, 0x10, 0x03,
    ];
    const PERSONA: &[u8] = &[
        0x08, 0x93, 0x06, 0x12, 0x2a, 0x09, 0x01, 0, 0, 0, 0x01, 0, 0x10, 0x01, 0x10, 0x03, 0x18,
        0xba, 0x04, 0x7a, 0x03, 0x42, 0x6f, 0x62, 0xfa, 0x01, 0x03, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0xba, 0x03,
        0x04, 0x47, 0x61, 0x6d, 0x65, 0xc1, 0x03, 0x3a, 0x02, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
    ];

    fn list(source: &FriendsEventSource, incremental: bool, entries: &[(u64, u32)]) -> Vec<u64> {
        source.apply_packet(
            FRIENDS_LIST,
            &proto::FriendsList {
                incremental,
                friends: entries
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(steam_id, relationship)| proto::FriendRelationship {
                        steam_id: *steam_id,
                        relationship: *relationship,
                    })
                    .collect(),
            }
            .encode_to_vec(),
        )
    }

    fn persona(source: &FriendsEventSource, flags: u32, update: proto::Persona) {
        source.apply_packet(
            PERSONA_STATE,
            &proto::PersonaState {
                status_flags: flags,
                friends: vec![update],
            }
            .encode_to_vec(),
        );
    }

    fn update() -> proto::Persona {
        proto::Persona {
            friend_id: FRIEND,
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    /// Published title of every friend, which each must be in a game to have.
    fn titles(source: &FriendsEventSource) -> Vec<Option<String>> {
        source
            .snapshot()
            .friends
            .iter()
            .map(|friend| friend.game.as_ref().expect("friend in a game").name.clone())
            .collect()
    }

    fn title(source: &FriendsEventSource) -> Option<String> {
        titles(source).remove(0)
    }

    #[test]
    fn resolved_titles_follow_current_activity_and_preserve_persona_names() {
        let source = FriendsEventSource::new(ACCOUNT);
        list(&source, false, &[(FRIEND, 3), (FRIEND + 2, 3)]);
        let playing = proto::Persona {
            persona_state: Some(1),
            game_played_app_id: Some(620),
            ..update()
        };
        persona(&source, STATUS, playing.clone());
        persona(
            &source,
            STATUS,
            proto::Persona {
                friend_id: FRIEND + 2,
                ..playing.clone()
            },
        );
        assert_eq!(source.missing_game_names(), [620]);
        source.resolve_game_names(ACCOUNT, &[(620, Some(" Portal 2 ".into()))]);
        let portal = || Some("Portal 2".to_owned());
        assert_eq!(titles(&source), [portal(), portal()]);
        assert!(source.missing_game_names().is_empty());

        // A repeated persona frame keeps the resolved title.
        persona(&source, STATUS, playing.clone());
        assert_eq!(title(&source).as_deref(), Some("Portal 2"));

        persona(
            &source,
            STATUS,
            proto::Persona {
                game_played_app_id: Some(570),
                ..playing
            },
        );
        assert_eq!(title(&source), None);
        assert_eq!(source.missing_game_names(), [570]);
        persona(&source, STATUS, update());
        source.resolve_game_names(ACCOUNT, &[(570, Some("Dota 2".into()))]);
        assert!(
            source.snapshot().friends[0].game.is_none(),
            "Late metadata cannot restore a closed game"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_persona_supplied_title_wins_over_resolved_metadata() {
        let source = FriendsEventSource::new(ACCOUNT);
        list(&source, false, &[(FRIEND, 3)]);
        let playing = proto::Persona {
            persona_state: Some(1),
            game_played_app_id: Some(620),
            ..update()
        };
        persona(&source, STATUS, playing.clone());
        source.resolve_game_names(ACCOUNT, &[(620, Some("Portal 2".into()))]);
        assert_eq!(title(&source).as_deref(), Some("Portal 2"));
        persona(
            &source,
            STATUS,
            proto::Persona {
                game_name: Some("Custom title".into()),
                ..playing
            },
        );
        assert_eq!(title(&source).as_deref(), Some("Custom title"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_friends_game_tells_how_to_join_it_as_steams_pushes_show_it() {
        let source = FriendsEventSource::new(ACCOUNT);
        list(&source, false, &[(FRIEND, 3)]);
        let invite = |source: &FriendsEventSource| {
            source.snapshot().friends[0]
                .game
                .as_ref()
                .map(FriendGame::invite)
        };
        let connect = proto::RichPresence {
            key: "connect".into(),
            value: "+connect 10.0.0.1".into(),
        };
        let playing = proto::Persona {
            persona_state: Some(1),
            game_played_app_id: Some(620),
            game_lobby_id: Some(0),
            rich_presence: vec![connect.clone()],
            ..update()
        };
        persona(&source, STATUS | RICH_PRESENCE, playing.clone());
        assert_eq!(
            invite(&source),
            Some(GameInvite::Connect {
                connect: "+connect 10.0.0.1".into()
            })
        );
        // A lobby wins; a Status update keeps the game's connect string.
        const LOBBY: u64 = 109_775_244_421_126_053;
        persona(
            &source,
            STATUS,
            proto::Persona {
                game_lobby_id: Some(LOBBY),
                rich_presence: vec![],
                ..playing.clone()
            },
        );
        assert_eq!(invite(&source), Some(GameInvite::Lobby { lobby_id: LOBBY }));
        // Another game drops the previous game's connect string.
        persona(
            &source,
            STATUS,
            proto::Persona {
                game_played_app_id: Some(730),
                rich_presence: vec![],
                ..playing.clone()
            },
        );
        assert_eq!(invite(&source), Some(GameInvite::None));
        // Rich presence alone replaces it; offline drops the game.
        persona(
            &source,
            RICH_PRESENCE,
            proto::Persona {
                rich_presence: vec![connect],
                ..update()
            },
        );
        assert!(matches!(invite(&source), Some(GameInvite::Connect { .. })));
        persona(&source, STATUS, update());
        assert_eq!(invite(&source), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn switching_account_drops_resolved_titles_and_rejects_the_old_accounts_answers() {
        let source = FriendsEventSource::new(ACCOUNT);
        list(&source, false, &[(FRIEND, 3)]);
        persona(
            &source,
            STATUS,
            proto::Persona {
                persona_state: Some(1),
                game_played_app_id: Some(620),
                ..update()
            },
        );
        source.resolve_game_names(ACCOUNT, &[(620, Some("Portal 2".into()))]);

        source.set_account(ACCOUNT + 1);
        source.resolve_game_names(ACCOUNT, &[(620, Some("Old account result".into()))]);
        assert!(source.reducer.lock().unwrap().game_names.is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn unknown_titles_are_cached_without_publishing_false_activity() {
        let source = FriendsEventSource::new(ACCOUNT);
        list(&source, false, &[(FRIEND, 3)]);
        persona(
            &source,
            STATUS,
            proto::Persona {
                persona_state: Some(1),
                game_played_app_id: Some(620),
                ..update()
            },
        );
        let before = source.snapshot();
        source.resolve_game_names(ACCOUNT, &[(620, Some("   ".into()))]);
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot(), before);
        assert!(source.missing_game_names().is_empty());
        source.disconnect(false);
        source.resolve_game_names(ACCOUNT, &[(620, Some("Late title".into()))]);
        assert_eq!(title(&source), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn independent_wire_fixtures_decode_group_fields_and_initial_offline_hydration() {
        let source = FriendsEventSource::new(ACCOUNT);
        assert_eq!(source.apply_packet(FRIENDS_LIST, FULL_LIST), [FRIEND]);
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().connection, FriendsConnection::Loading);
        source.apply_packet(PERSONA_STATE, PERSONA);
        let snapshot = source.snapshot();
        assert_eq!(snapshot.connection, FriendsConnection::Ready);
        assert_eq!(snapshot.friends[0].display_name.as_deref(), Some("Bob"));
        assert_eq!(snapshot.friends[0].presence, FriendPresence::Away);
        assert_eq!(
            snapshot.friends[0].game,
            Some(FriendGame {
                app_id: Some(570),
                name: Some("Game".into()),
                ..FriendGame::default()
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(snapshot.friends[0].avatar_url, None);
        // Independently encoded presence-only Offline: field2 explicitly zero.
        let offline = [
            0x08, 0x01, 0x12, 0x0b, 0x09, 0x01, 0, 0, 0, 0x01, 0, 0x10, 0x01, 0x10, 0,
        ];
        source.apply_packet(PERSONA_STATE, &offline);
        assert_eq!(
            source.snapshot().friends[0].presence,
            FriendPresence::Offline
        );
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().friends[0].game, None);
        assert_eq!(list(&source, false, &[(FRIEND, 3)]), [FRIEND]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn live_default_offline_status_group_completes_identity_only_hydration() {
        let source = FriendsEventSource::new(ACCOUNT);
        source.apply_packet(FRIENDS_LIST, FULL_LIST);
        // Independent wire fixture: Status1, friendID only. Valve's reducer
        // defaults missing field2 to Offline inside this authoritative group.
        let status = [
            0x08, 0x01, 0x12, 0x09, 0x09, 0x01, 0, 0, 0, 0x01, 0, 0x10, 0x01,
        ];
        source.apply_packet(PERSONA_STATE, &status);
        // Names/avatars arrive separately, as observed on the normal live CM
        // session. No presence fields or game fields in this identity packet.
        let identity = [
            0x08, 0x12, 0x12, 0x14, 0x09, 0x01, 0, 0, 0, 0x01, 0, 0x10, 0x01, 0x7a, 3, b'B', b'o',
            b'b', 0xfa, 0x01, 3, 1, 2, 3,
        ];
        source.apply_packet(PERSONA_STATE, &identity);
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().connection, FriendsConnection::Ready);
        assert_eq!(
            source.snapshot().friends[0].presence,
            FriendPresence::Offline
        );
        source.loading_timed_out();
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().connection, FriendsConnection::Ready);
    }

    #[test]
    fn full_and_incremental_relationships_filter_deduplicate_and_remove_without_revival() {
        let source = FriendsEventSource::new(ACCOUNT);
        let clan = (7_u64 << 52) | 1;
        assert_eq!(
            list(
                &source,
                false,
                &[
                    (ACCOUNT, 3),
                    (clan, 3),
                    (FRIEND, 3),
                    (FRIEND, 3),
                    (FRIEND + 2, 2),
                    (FRIEND + 3, 1),
                    (FRIEND + 4, 4),
                    (FRIEND + 5, 999)
                ]
            ),
            [FRIEND]
        );
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().friends.len(), 1);
        source.apply_packet(PERSONA_STATE, PERSONA);
        list(&source, true, &[(FRIEND, 0), (FRIEND + 2, 3)]);
        source.apply_packet(PERSONA_STATE, PERSONA);
        assert_eq!(
            source
                .snapshot()
                .friends
                .iter()
                .map(|f| f.steam_id)
                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            [FRIEND + 2]
        );

        list(&source, false, &[]);

        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().connection, FriendsConnection::Ready);
    }

    #[test]
    fn personas_before_full_list_are_hydrated_without_losing_partial_groups() {
        let source = FriendsEventSource::new(ACCOUNT);

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn observation_is_atomic_coalesces_exact_snapshots_and_can_be_cancelled() {
        let source = FriendsEventSource::new(ACCOUNT);
        let before = source.snapshot().revision;
        list(&source, false, &[(FRIEND, 3)]);
        // The update happened before installing the wait: revision catches it.
        let mut latest = source.next(before).await;
        for state in 0..1000 {
            persona(
                &source,
                STATUS,
                proto::Persona {
                    persona_state: Some(state % 5),
                    ..update()
                },
            );
        }
        latest = source.next(latest.revision).await;
        assert_eq!(latest.friends[0].presence, FriendPresence::Snooze);
        let wait = source.next(latest.revision);
        tokio::pin!(wait);
        std::future::poll_fn(|cx| {
            assert!(matches!(
                std::future::Future::poll(wait.as_mut(), cx),
                Poll::Pending
            ));
            Poll::Ready(())
        })
        .await;
        source.disconnect(false);
        let disconnected = wait.await;
        assert_eq!(disconnected.connection, FriendsConnection::Disconnected);
        assert_eq!(disconnected.friends[0].presence, FriendPresence::Snooze);
        let other = FriendsEventSource::new(ACCOUNT + 1);
        let cancellation = tokio::spawn(async move { other.next(other.snapshot().revision).await });
        cancellation.abort();
        assert!(cancellation.await.unwrap_err().is_cancelled());
    }
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/install_script.rs`:

```rs
//! Steam install scripts: the redistributables, such as Visual C++ or DirectX,
//! Steam runs once on a Windows machine before a game's first launch.
use std::path::{Component, Path, PathBuf};

use crate::kv::{self, Kv};

/// The manifest flag of an install script file.
pub(crate) const FLAG: u32 = 256;
/// Where an installation lists, one relative path per line, the install
/// scripts its depots carry.
pub const LIST: &str = ".obelisk-content/install-scripts";
/// "process 1" through "process 16" in one step.
const MAX_PROGRAMS: usize = 16;

/// One program of a step, with its Windows command line.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Program {
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub arguments: String,
}

/// One "Run Process" step. Steam records it under `HasRunKey` and runs it
/// once per machine, so `id` names both.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Step {
    pub id: String,
    pub programs: Vec<Program>,
}

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
#[error("{0}")]
pub struct InstallScriptError(&'static str);

/// The steps of a 64-bit Windows machine. `%INSTALLDIR%` is `install` in
/// program paths, which must stay inside it, and `windows_install` in command
/// lines. A step with a requirement Obelisk cannot check is left out.
pub fn steps(
    script: &[u8],
    install: &Path,
    windows_install: &str,
) -> Result<Vec<Step>, InstallScriptError> {
    let root = kv::text(&utf8(script)?).map_err(|_| InstallScriptError("malformed"))?;
    let Some(processes) = root.at(&["installscript", "Run Process"]) else {
        return Ok(Vec::new());
    };
    let mut steps = Vec::new();
    'steps: for (name, step) in processes.children() {
        for (requirement, value) in step.get("Requirement_OS").map_or(&[][..], Kv::children) {
            if !requirement.eq_ignore_ascii_case("Is64BitWindows") || value.text() == Some("0") {
                continue 'steps;
            }
        }
        let mut programs = Vec::new();
        for index in 1..=MAX_PROGRAMS {
            let Some(path) = step.get(&format!("process {index}")).and_then(Kv::text) else {
                break;
            };
            let Some(path) = program_path(path, install) else {
                continue 'steps;
            };
            let arguments = step
                .get(&format!("command {index}"))
                .and_then(Kv::text)
                .unwrap_or_default();
            programs.push(Program {
                path,
                arguments: replace_install_dir(arguments, windows_install),
            });
        }
        if programs.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let id = match step.get("HasRunKey").and_then(Kv::text) {
            Some(key) => format!("{key}\\{name}"),
            None => name.clone(),
        };
        steps.push(Step { id, programs });
    }
    Ok(steps)
}

/// Scripts come in UTF-8 or, from older tools, UTF-16 with a byte order mark.
fn utf8(script: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, InstallScriptError> {
    let Some(units) = script.strip_prefix(&[0xff, 0xfe]) else {
        return Ok(script.to_vec());
    };
    let units: Vec<u16> = units
        .as_chunks::<2>()
        .0
        .iter()
        .map(|pair| u16::from_le_bytes(*pair))
        .collect();
    String::from_utf16(&units)
        .map(String::into_bytes)
        .map_err(|_| InstallScriptError("invalid UTF-16"))
}

/// Only `%INSTALLDIR%` paths run: the installation's own files.
fn program_path(path: &str, install: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let relative = strip_install_dir(path)?.replace('\\', "/");
    let relative = Path::new(relative.trim_start_matches('/'));
    relative
        .components()
        .all(|component| matches!(component, Component::Normal(_)))
        .then(|| install.join(relative))
}

fn strip_install_dir(path: &str) -> Option<&str> {
    let prefix = path.get(..12)?;
    prefix
        .eq_ignore_ascii_case("%INSTALLDIR%")
        .then(|| &path[12..])
}

fn replace_install_dir(text: &str, windows_install: &str) -> String {
    let mut result = String::new();
    let mut rest = text;
    while let Some(start) = rest.to_ascii_uppercase().find("%INSTALLDIR%") {
        result.push_str(&rest[..start]);
        result.push_str(windows_install);
        rest = &rest[start + 12..];
    }
    result.push_str(rest);
    result
}

mod tests;
```

```rs
// Depot 228989 of Steamworks Common Redistributables, as Valve ships it.
```

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/invites.rs`:

```rs
//! Game invitations friends send the account, as they reach its UI session.
//! Steam writes each one into the friends chat as BBCode, and also sends a
//! lobby invitation as ClientChatInvite (800) and a connect invitation as
//! ClientInviteToGame (7005); whichever comes first is the invitation, the
//! others repeat it. Like Valve's chat, the source keeps only the latest
//! invitation of each friend.
use std::time::{Duration, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

use prost::Message;
use tokio::sync::watch;

use crate::{chat, own_game::GameInvite, proto};

pub const CHAT_INVITE: u32 = 800;
pub const INVITE_TO_GAME: u32 = 7005;
/// EChatRoomType::Lobby (SteamKit enums.steamd).
const LOBBY_ROOM: i32 = 3;
/// How long the same invitation from the same friend counts as one: its
/// copies arrive together, a resent one much later.
const REPEAT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(120);
const MAX_INVITES: usize = 32;

/// An invitation into a game, as its friend sent it.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ReceivedInvite {
    pub friend: u64,
    pub app_id: u32,
    /// Never `GameInvite::None`.
    pub invite: GameInvite,
    /// When this session received it, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
    pub received_at: u64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ReceivedInvites {
    pub revision: u64,
    pub connected: bool,
    /// Newest first, at most one per friend.
    pub invites: Vec<ReceivedInvite>,
}

/// The invitation a friends chat message carries: the first `[lobbyinvite]`
/// or `[gameinvite]` tag, read as Valve's chat reads its arguments. A Remote
/// Play invitation, or one naming no app, is none.
pub fn chat_invite(bbcode: &str) -> Option<(u32, GameInvite)> {
    let (name, arguments) = tags(bbcode).find(|(name, _)| {
        name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("lobbyinvite") || name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("gameinvite")
    })?;
    let argument = |key: &str| {
        arguments
            .iter()
            .find(|(name, _)| name == key)
            .map(|(_, value)| value.as_str())
    };
    let app_id = argument("appid")?
        .trim()
        .parse::<u32>()
        .ok()
        .filter(|id| *id != 0)?;
    let invite = if name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("lobbyinvite") {
        GameInvite::Lobby {
            lobby_id: argument("lobbyid")?.trim().parse().ok()?,
        }
    } else {
        if argument("remoteplay").is_some_and(|value| !value.is_empty()) {
            return None;
        }
        GameInvite::Connect {
            connect: argument("connect")?.to_owned(),
        }
    };
    invite.sendable().then_some((app_id, invite))
}

/// The opening tags of `bbcode` with their arguments. A backslash escapes the
/// next character; a quoted argument may hold a closing bracket.
fn tags(bbcode: &str) -> impl Iterator<Item = (String, Vec<(String, String)>)> + '_ {
    let mut characters = bbcode.chars();
    std::iter::from_fn(move || {
        loop {
            match characters.next()? {
                '\\' => {
                    characters.next();
                }
                '[' => {
                    let mut inner = String::new();
                    let (mut quoted, mut escaped) = (false, false);
                    for character in characters.by_ref() {
                        if !escaped && character == ']' && !quoted {
                            break;
                        }
                        if !escaped && character == '"' {
                            quoted = !quoted;
                        }
                        escaped = !escaped && character == '\\';
                        inner.push(character);
                    }
                    if let Some(tag) = tag(&inner) {
                        return Some(tag);
                    }
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
    })
}

/// An opening tag's name and arguments, split as Valve's chat splits them:
/// `name=value` gives the unnamed argument "", `name key="value" …` the others.
fn tag(inner: &str) -> Option<(String, Vec<(String, String)>)> {
    if inner.starts_with('/') {
        return None;
    }
    let end = match (inner.find('='), inner.find(' ')) {
        (Some(equals), Some(space)) => equals.min(space),
        (equals, space) => equals.or(space).unwrap_or(inner.len()),
    };
    let (name, rest) = inner.split_at(end);
    if name.is_empty() || !name.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_') {
        return None;
    }
    Some((name.to_owned(), arguments(rest)))
}

/// Valve's argument reader (friends.js, the BBCode parser's `args`), state
/// for state: 0 between arguments, 1 in a key, 2 after `=`, 3 in a bare
/// value, 4 in a quoted one.
fn arguments(source: &str) -> Vec<(String, String)> {
    let characters: Vec<char> = source.chars().collect();
    let mut arguments = Vec::new();
    let Some(first) = characters.first() else {
        return arguments;
    };
    let (mut key, mut value) = (String::new(), String::new());
    let mut state = if *first == '=' { 2 } else { 0 };
    let mut escaped = false;
    for &character in &characters[1..] {
        let (mut keep, mut commit) = (true, false);
        match state {
            0 => {
                if character == '=' {
                    return Vec::new();
                }
                if character == ' ' {
                    continue;
                }
                state = 1;
            }
            1 => {
                if (character == '=' || character == ' ') && !escaped {
                    state = if character == ' ' { 0 } else { 2 };
                    keep = false;
                }
            }
            2 => {
                if character == ' ' {
                    (state, keep, commit) = (0, false, true);
                } else if character == '"' {
                    (state, keep) = (4, false);
                } else {
                    state = 3;
                }
            }
            _ => {
                if (character == ' ' && state != 4 && !escaped)
                    || (character == '"' && state == 4 && !escaped)
                {
                    (state, keep, commit) = (0, false, true);
                }
            }
        }
        if keep {
            if character != '\\' || escaped {
                escaped = false;
                match state {
                    1 => key.push(character),
                    3 | 4 => value.push(character),
                    _ => {}
                }
            } else {
                escaped = true;
            }
        }
        if commit {
            arguments.push((std::mem::take(&mut key), std::mem::take(&mut value)));
        }
    }
    if state != 0 {
        arguments.push((key, value));
    }
    arguments
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct InviteSource {
    state: watch::Sender<ReceivedInvites>,
}

impl Default for InviteSource {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl InviteSource {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            state: watch::channel(ReceivedInvites {
                revision: 1,
                connected: true,
                invites: Vec::new(),
            })
            .0,
        }
    }

    /// Applies a friends chat notification: a friend's message carrying an
    /// invitation. The account's own messages, from any session, are not.
    /// Malformed bodies are ignored.
    pub fn receive_notification(&self, method: &str, body: &[u8]) {
        if method != chat::INCOMING_MESSAGE {
            return;
        }
        let Ok(message) = proto::IncomingMessage::decode(body) else {
            return;
        };
        if message.local_echo || message.chat_entry_type != chat::CHAT_MESSAGE {
            return;
        }
        if let Some((app_id, invite)) = chat_invite(&message.message) {
            self.receive(message.steamid_friend, app_id, invite);
        }
    }

    /// Applies a ClientChatInvite into a lobby, or a ClientInviteToGame whose
    /// header's routing AppID names the game. Other packets are ignored.
    pub fn receive_packet(&self, kind: u32, routing_app: Option<u32>, body: &[u8]) {
        match kind {
            CHAT_INVITE => {
                let Ok(invite) = proto::ChatInvite::decode(body) else {
                    return;
                };
                // CGameID of an app: no type or mod above its 24-bit AppID.
                if invite.chatroom_type != LOBBY_ROOM || invite.game_id >> 24 != 0 {
                    return;
                }
                self.receive(
                    invite.steam_id_patron,
                    invite.game_id as u32,
                    GameInvite::Lobby {
                        lobby_id: invite.steam_id_chat,
                    },
                );
            }
            INVITE_TO_GAME => {
                let Ok(invite) = proto::InviteToGame::decode(body) else {
                    return;
                };
                if !invite.remote_play.is_empty() {
                    return;
                }
                self.receive(
                    invite.steam_id_src,
                    routing_app.unwrap_or(0),
                    GameInvite::Connect {
                        connect: invite.connect_string,
                    },
                );
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    fn receive(&self, friend: u64, app_id: u32, invite: GameInvite) {
        if !individual(friend) || app_id == 0 || !invite.sendable() {
            return;
        }
        let now = SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map_or(0, |elapsed| elapsed.as_secs());
        self.state.send_if_modified(|state| {
            if !state.connected {
                return false;
            }
            if state.invites.iter().any(|known| {
                known.friend == friend
                    && known.app_id == app_id
                    && known.invite == invite
                    && now.saturating_sub(known.received_at) < REPEAT.as_secs()
            }) {
                return false;
            }
            state.invites.retain(|known| known.friend != friend);
            state.invites.insert(
                0,
                ReceivedInvite {
                    friend,
                    app_id,
                    invite,
                    received_at: now,
                },
            );
            state.invites.truncate(MAX_INVITES);
            state.revision += 1;
            true
        });
    }

    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> ReceivedInvites {
        self.state.borrow().clone()
    }

    /// Waits for a revision other than `after_revision`; disconnection wakes
    /// every wait.
    pub async fn next(&self, after_revision: u64) -> ReceivedInvites {
        match obelisk_core::watch::next_matching(self.state.subscribe(), |state| {
            state.revision != after_revision || !state.connected
        })
        .await
        {
            Ok(state) | Err(state) => state,
        }
    }

    pub fn disconnect(&self) {
        self.state.send_if_modified(|state| {
            if !state.connected {
                return false;
            }
            state.connected = false;
            state.revision += 1;
            true
        });
    }
}

/// A person's SteamID: account type Individual, in a real universe, with an
/// account number.
fn individual(steam_id: u64) -> bool {
    (steam_id >> 52) & 0xf == 1 && steam_id >> 56 != 0 && steam_id as u32 != 0
}

/// Wire bodies for debug fixtures, so tests feed the production decoders.
#[cfg(debug_assertions)]
pub mod fixture {
    use prost::Message;

    use crate::proto;

    /// A ClientChatInvite into `lobby` of `app_id`, from `inviter`.
    pub fn lobby_invite(inviter: u64, lobby: u64, app_id: u32) -> Vec<u8> {
        proto::ChatInvite {
            steam_id_invited: 0,
            steam_id_chat: lobby,
            steam_id_patron: inviter,
            chatroom_type: super::LOBBY_ROOM,
            game_id: u64::from(app_id),
        }
        .encode_to_vec()
    }

    /// A ClientInviteToGame from `inviter`, its routing AppID apart.
    pub fn connect_invite(inviter: u64, connect: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
        proto::InviteToGame {
            steam_id_dest: 0,
            steam_id_src: inviter,
            connect_string: connect.into(),
            remote_play: String::new(),
        }
        .encode_to_vec()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const FRIEND: u64 = 76_561_197_960_265_729;
    const OTHER: u64 = FRIEND + 1;
    const LOBBY: u64 = 109_775_244_421_126_053;
    const PEAK: u32 = 3_527_290;

    fn lobby(lobby_id: u64) -> GameInvite {
        GameInvite::Lobby { lobby_id }
    }

    fn connect(connect: &str) -> GameInvite {
        GameInvite::Connect {
            connect: connect.into(),
        }
    }

    fn message(friend: u64, entry_type: i32, text: &str, local_echo: bool) -> Vec<u8> {
        crate::chat::fixture::incoming_message(
            friend,
            entry_type,
            text,
            1_700_000_000,
            1,
            local_echo,
        )
    }

    #[test]
    fn chat_reads_valves_invitation_tags() {
        assert_eq!(
            chat_invite(&format!(
                "[lobbyinvite appid=\"{PEAK}\" lobbyid=\"{LOBBY}\"][/lobbyinvite]"
            )),
            Some((PEAK, lobby(LOBBY)))
        );
        // Bare values and any argument order, and text around the tag.
        assert_eq!(
            chat_invite(&format!(
                "hey [LobbyInvite lobbyid={LOBBY} appid={PEAK}]join[/lobbyinvite]"
            )),
            Some((PEAK, lobby(LOBBY)))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            chat_invite(
                r#"[gameinvite appid="620" connect="+connect \"10.0.0.1:27015\" ]x"][/gameinvite]"#
            ),
            Some((620, connect(r#"+connect "10.0.0.1:27015" ]x"#)))
        );
        for (text, why) in [
            (
                format!("\\[lobbyinvite appid=\"{PEAK}\" lobbyid=\"{LOBBY}\"]"),
                "escaped",
            ),
            (
                format!("[lobbyinvite appid=\"0\" lobbyid=\"{LOBBY}\"]"),
                "no app",
            ),
            (format!("[lobbyinvite lobbyid=\"{LOBBY}\"]"), "app missing"),
            (
                format!("[lobbyinvite appid=\"{PEAK}\" lobbyid=\"{FRIEND}\"]"),
                "not a lobby",
            ),
            (
                "[gameinvite appid=\"620\" connect=\"\"]".into(),
                "empty connect",
            ),
            (
                "[gameinvite appid=\"620\" connect=\"\" remoteplay=\"abc\"]".into(),
                "remote play",
            ),
            (
                format!("[invite appid=\"{PEAK}\" lobbyid=\"{LOBBY}\"]"),
                "another tag",
            ),
            ("just text".into(), "no tag"),
        ] {
            assert_eq!(chat_invite(&text), None, "{why}");
        }
        let long = "a".repeat(256);
        assert_eq!(
            chat_invite(&format!("[gameinvite appid=\"620\" connect=\"{long}\"]")),
            None,
            "too long"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn arguments_follow_valves_reader() {
        assert_eq!(arguments("=https://x"), [("".into(), "https://x".into())]);
        assert_eq!(
            arguments(" a=1  b=\"two words\" c"),
            [
                ("a".into(), "1".into()),
                ("b".into(), "two words".into()),
                ("c".into(), String::new())
            ]
        );
        assert_eq!(arguments(" =x"), []);
        assert_eq!(
            arguments(r#" k="a\\b\"c""#),
            [("k".into(), r#"a\b"c"#.into())]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn every_channel_brings_the_same_invitation_once() {
        let source = InviteSource::new();
        let text = format!("[lobbyinvite appid=\"{PEAK}\" lobbyid=\"{LOBBY}\"][/lobbyinvite]");
        source.receive_notification(chat::INCOMING_MESSAGE, &message(FRIEND, 1, &text, false));
        source.receive_packet(
            CHAT_INVITE,
            None,
            &fixture::lobby_invite(FRIEND, LOBBY, PEAK),
        );
        let invites = source.snapshot();
        assert_eq!(invites.revision, 2);
        assert_eq!(invites.invites.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(invites.invites[0].friend, FRIEND);
        assert_eq!(invites.invites[0].app_id, PEAK);
        assert_eq!(invites.invites[0].invite, lobby(LOBBY));

        source.receive_packet(
            INVITE_TO_GAME,
            Some(620),
            &fixture::connect_invite(OTHER, "+connect 1"),
        );
        let invites = source.snapshot();
        assert_eq!(invites.revision, 3);
        assert_eq!(invites.invites[0].friend, OTHER);
        assert_eq!(invites.invites[0].app_id, 620);
        assert_eq!(invites.invites[0].invite, connect("+connect 1"));
        assert_eq!(invites.invites[1].friend, FRIEND);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_friends_newer_invitation_replaces_the_older() {
        let source = InviteSource::new();
        source.receive_packet(
            CHAT_INVITE,
            None,
            &fixture::lobby_invite(FRIEND, LOBBY, PEAK),
        );
        source.receive_packet(
            INVITE_TO_GAME,
            Some(620),
            &fixture::connect_invite(FRIEND, "+connect 1"),
        );
        let invites = source.snapshot();
        assert_eq!(invites.invites.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(invites.invites[0].invite, connect("+connect 1"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn what_is_no_invitation_from_a_friend_is_ignored() {
        let source = InviteSource::new();
        let text = format!("[lobbyinvite appid=\"{PEAK}\" lobbyid=\"{LOBBY}\"][/lobbyinvite]");
        // The account's own invitation, echoed; typing; another service.
        source.receive_notification(chat::INCOMING_MESSAGE, &message(FRIEND, 1, &text, true));
        source.receive_notification(chat::INCOMING_MESSAGE, &message(FRIEND, 2, &text, false));
        source.receive_notification(chat::ACK_ECHO, &message(FRIEND, 1, &text, false));
        source.receive_notification(chat::INCOMING_MESSAGE, &[0xff]);
        // A chat room invitation, a mod's lobby, a lobby from no one.
        let mut room =
            proto::ChatInvite::decode(&fixture::lobby_invite(FRIEND, LOBBY, PEAK)[..]).unwrap();
        room.chatroom_type = 1;
        source.receive_packet(CHAT_INVITE, None, &room.encode_to_vec());
        let mut modded = room.clone();
        modded.chatroom_type = LOBBY_ROOM;
        modded.game_id |= 1 << 32;
        source.receive_packet(CHAT_INVITE, None, &modded.encode_to_vec());
        source.receive_packet(
            CHAT_INVITE,
            None,
            &fixture::lobby_invite(LOBBY, LOBBY, PEAK),
        );
        // A connect invitation without its game, or for Remote Play.
        source.receive_packet(INVITE_TO_GAME, None, &fixture::connect_invite(FRIEND, "+x"));
        let mut remote =
            proto::InviteToGame::decode(&fixture::connect_invite(FRIEND, "")[..]).unwrap();
        remote.remote_play = "token".into();
        source.receive_packet(INVITE_TO_GAME, Some(620), &remote.encode_to_vec());
        source.receive_packet(766, Some(620), &fixture::connect_invite(FRIEND, "+x"));
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().revision, 1);
        assert!(source.snapshot().invites.is_empty());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn observers_wake_on_invitations_and_disconnect() {
        let source = InviteSource::new();
        let waiting = tokio::spawn({
            let source = source.clone();
            async move { source.next(1).await }
        });
        tokio::task::yield_now().await;
        source.receive_packet(
            CHAT_INVITE,
            None,
            &fixture::lobby_invite(FRIEND, LOBBY, PEAK),
        );
        assert_eq!(waiting.await.unwrap().invites.len(), 1);
        let waiting = tokio::spawn({
            let source = source.clone();
            async move { source.next(2).await }
        });
        tokio::task::yield_now().await;
        source.disconnect();
        assert!(!waiting.await.unwrap().connected);
        // Nothing arrives once disconnected.
        source.receive_packet(
            INVITE_TO_GAME,
            Some(620),
            &fixture::connect_invite(OTHER, "+x"),
        );
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().invites.len(), 1);
    }
}
```
