`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/kv.rs`:

```rs
//! Bounded readers for Steam's text VDF and binary KeyValue package metadata.

use std::str;

const MAX_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_DEPTH: usize = 64;
const MAX_ENTRIES: usize = 250_000;

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
#[error("{}", crate::message::format("backend.steam.kv.invalid", &[.0.to_string()]))]
pub(crate) struct KvError(pub(crate) &'static str);

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) enum Kv {
    Value(String),
    Object(Vec<(String, Kv)>),
}

impl Kv {
    pub(crate) fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<&Self> {
        self.children()
            .iter()
            .find(|(name, _)| name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(key))
            .map(|(_, value)| value)
    }

    pub(crate) fn at(&self, path: &[&str]) -> Option<&Self> {
        path.iter().try_fold(self, |node, name| node.get(name))
    }

    pub(crate) fn text(&self) -> Option<&str> {
        match self {
            Self::Value(value) => Some(value),
            Self::Object(_) => None,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn children(&self) -> &[(String, Kv)] {
        match self {
            Self::Object(children) => children,
            Self::Value(_) => &[],
        }
    }

    /// The whole tree as JSON, every value a string as text VDF writes it. A
    /// repeated key keeps its first value, the one `get` reads.
    pub(crate) fn to_json(&self) -> serde_json::Value {
        match self {
            Self::Value(value) => serde_json::Value::String(value.clone()),
            Self::Object(children) => {
                let mut object = serde_json::Map::with_capacity(children.len());
                for (key, value) in children {
                    object.entry(key.clone()).or_insert_with(|| value.to_json());
                }
                serde_json::Value::Object(object)
            }
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn text(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Kv, KvError> {
    if bytes.len() > MAX_BYTES {
        return Err(KvError("backend.steam.kv.documentTooLarge"));
    }
    let source = str::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|_| KvError("backend.steam.kv.invalidUtf8"))?;
    let source = source.trim_end_matches('\0').trim_start_matches('\u{feff}');
    let mut parser = TextParser {
        source,
        offset: 0,
        entries: 0,
    };
    parser.object(0, false)
}

struct TextParser<'a> {
    source: &'a str,
    offset: usize,
    entries: usize,
}

#[derive(Debug, PartialEq)]
enum Token {
    Word(String),
    Open,
    Close,
}

impl TextParser<'_> {
    fn object(&mut self, depth: usize, nested: bool) -> Result<Kv, KvError> {
        if depth > MAX_DEPTH {
            return Err(KvError("backend.steam.kv.excessiveNesting"));
        }
        let mut fields = Vec::new();
        loop {
            let key = match self.token()? {
                Some(Token::Word(key)) => key,
                Some(Token::Close) if nested => return Ok(Kv::Object(fields)),
                None if !nested => return Ok(Kv::Object(fields)),
                _ => return Err(KvError("backend.steam.kv.missingKeyOrBrace")),
            };
            self.entries += 1;
            if self.entries > MAX_ENTRIES {
                return Err(KvError("backend.steam.kv.tooManyFields"));
            }
            let value = match self.token()? {
                Some(Token::Word(value)) => Kv::Value(value),
                Some(Token::Open) => self.object(depth + 1, true)?,
                _ => return Err(KvError("backend.steam.kv.missingValue")),
            };
            fields.push((key, value));
        }
    }

    fn token(&mut self) -> Result<Option<Token>, KvError> {
        loop {
            while self.peek().is_some_and(char::is_whitespace) {
                self.next();
            }
            if self.source[self.offset..].starts_with("//") {
                while self.next().is_some_and(|ch| ch != '\n') {}
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        let Some(first) = self.next() else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        match first {
            '{' => Ok(Some(Token::Open)),
            '}' => Ok(Some(Token::Close)),
            '"' => {
                let mut value = String::new();
                loop {
                    match self.next() {
                        Some('"') => return Ok(Some(Token::Word(value))),
                        Some('\\') => match self.next() {
                            Some('n') => value.push('\n'),
                            Some('r') => value.push('\r'),
                            Some('t') => value.push('\t'),
                            Some('"') => value.push('"'),
                            Some('\\') => value.push('\\'),
                            Some(other) => {
                                value.push('\\');
                                value.push(other);
                            }
                            None => return Err(KvError("backend.steam.kv.truncatedEscape")),
                        },
                        Some(ch) => value.push(ch),
                        None => return Err(KvError("backend.steam.kv.unterminatedString")),
                    }
                }
            }
            _ => {
                let mut word = String::from(first);
                while self
                    .peek()
                    .is_some_and(|ch| !ch.is_whitespace() && ch != '{' && ch != '}')
                {
                    if let Some(ch) = self.next() {
                        word.push(ch);
                    }
                }
                Ok(Some(Token::Word(word)))
            }
        }
    }

    fn peek(&self) -> Option<char> {
        self.source[self.offset..].chars().next()
    }

    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<char> {
        let ch = self.peek()?;
        self.offset += ch.len_utf8();
        Some(ch)
    }
}

pub(crate) fn package(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Kv, KvError> {
    if bytes.len() > MAX_BYTES {
        return Err(KvError("backend.steam.kv.documentTooLarge"));
    }
    let mut parser = BinaryParser {
        remaining: bytes,
        entries: 0,
    };
    if u32::from_le_bytes(parser.take::<4>()?) != 1 {
        return Err(KvError("backend.steam.kv.unknownPackageVersion"));
    }
    let value = parser.object(0)?;
    if !parser.remaining.is_empty() {
        return Err(KvError("backend.steam.kv.trailingBytes"));
    }
    Ok(value)
}

struct BinaryParser<'a> {
    remaining: &'a [u8],
    entries: usize,
}

impl BinaryParser<'_> {
    fn take<const N: usize>(&mut self) -> Result<[u8; N], KvError> {
        let (head, tail) = self
            .remaining
            .split_at_checked(N)
            .ok_or(KvError("backend.steam.kv.truncatedPackage"))?;
        self.remaining = tail;
        head.try_into()
            .map_err(|_| KvError("backend.steam.kv.truncatedPackage"))
    }

    fn string(&mut self) -> Result<String, KvError> {
        let length = self
            .remaining
            .iter()
            .position(|byte| *byte == 0)
            .ok_or(KvError("backend.steam.kv.truncatedBinaryString"))?;
        let value = str::from_utf8(&self.remaining[..length])
            .map_err(|_| KvError("backend.steam.kv.invalidUtf8"))?
            .to_owned();
        self.remaining = &self.remaining[length + 1..];
        Ok(value)
    }

    fn object(&mut self, depth: usize) -> Result<Kv, KvError> {
        if depth > MAX_DEPTH {
            return Err(KvError("backend.steam.kv.excessiveNesting"));
        }
        let mut fields = Vec::new();
        loop {
            let kind = self.take::<1>()?[0];
            if kind == 8 || kind == 11 {
                return Ok(Kv::Object(fields));
            }
            self.entries += 1;
            if self.entries > MAX_ENTRIES {
                return Err(KvError("backend.steam.kv.tooManyFields"));
            }
            let name = self.string()?;
            let value = match kind {
                0 => self.object(depth + 1)?,
                1 => Kv::Value(self.string()?),
                2 | 4 | 6 => Kv::Value(i32::from_le_bytes(self.take::<4>()?).to_string()),
                3 => Kv::Value(f32::from_le_bytes(self.take::<4>()?).to_string()),
                7 => Kv::Value(u64::from_le_bytes(self.take::<8>()?).to_string()),
                10 => Kv::Value(i64::from_le_bytes(self.take::<8>()?).to_string()),
                _ => return Err(KvError("backend.steam.kv.unsupportedBinaryType")),
            };
            fields.push((name, value));
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn reads_nested_text_comments_escapes_and_unicode() {
        let parsed = text(
            br#"// generated
            "appinfo" { "appid" "42" "config" { "installdir" "A\\B" } }
        "#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            parsed.at(&["appinfo", "appid"]).and_then(Kv::text),
            Some("42")
        );
        assert_eq!(
            parsed
                .at(&["appinfo", "config", "installdir"])
                .and_then(Kv::text),
            Some("A\\B")
        );
        assert_eq!(
            text("key \"Star ☆\"".as_bytes())
                .unwrap()
                .get("key")
                .and_then(Kv::text),
            Some("Star ☆")
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_incomplete_text_and_unmatched_braces() {
        for input in [b"a {".as_slice(), b"a", b"a \"b", b"}", b"a { b }"] {
            assert!(text(input).is_err());
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn decodes_package_app_ids_and_rejects_truncation() {
        let mut bytes = 1_u32.to_le_bytes().to_vec();
        bytes.extend_from_slice(b"\0" /* object */);
        bytes.extend_from_slice(b"123\0\0appids\0\x020\0");
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&42_i32.to_le_bytes());
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&[8, 8, 8]);
        let parsed = package(&bytes).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            parsed.at(&["123", "appids", "0"]).and_then(Kv::text),
            Some("42")
        );
        for length in 0..bytes.len() {
            assert!(package(&bytes[..length]).is_err());
        }
    }
}

//! Host BCP-47 locale to Steam depot language code.
//! https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/store/localization/languages

const SIMPLE: &[(&str, &str)] = &[
    ("ar", "arabic"),
    ("bg", "bulgarian"),
    ("cs", "czech"),
    ("da", "danish"),
    ("nl", "dutch"),
    ("en", "english"),
    ("fi", "finnish"),
    ("fr", "french"),
    ("de", "german"),
    ("el", "greek"),
    ("hu", "hungarian"),
    ("id", "indonesian"),
    ("it", "italian"),
    ("ja", "japanese"),
    ("ko", "koreana"),
    ("ms", "malay"),
    ("no", "norwegian"),
    ("nb", "norwegian"),
    ("nn", "norwegian"),
    ("pl", "polish"),
    ("ro", "romanian"),
    ("ru", "russian"),
    ("sv", "swedish"),
    ("th", "thai"),
    ("tr", "turkish"),
    ("uk", "ukrainian"),
    ("vi", "vietnamese"),
];

pub fn from_locale(locale: &str) -> &'static str {
    let normalized = locale.to_ascii_lowercase().replace('_', "-");
    let parts: Vec<_> = normalized.split(['-', '.', '@']).collect();
    match parts.first().copied().unwrap_or_default() {
        "zh" if parts.contains(&"hans") => "schinese",
        "zh" if parts
            .iter()
            .any(|part| matches!(*part, "hant" | "tw" | "hk" | "mo")) =>
        {
            "tchinese"
        }
        "zh" => "schinese",
        "pt" if parts.contains(&"br") => "brazilian",
        "pt" => "portuguese",
        "es" if parts.iter().any(|part| {
            matches!(
                *part,
                "419"
                    | "ar"
                    | "bo"
                    | "bz"
                    | "cl"
                    | "co"
                    | "cr"
                    | "cu"
                    | "do"
                    | "ec"
                    | "gt"
                    | "hn"
                    | "mx"
                    | "ni"
                    | "pa"
                    | "pe"
                    | "pr"
                    | "py"
                    | "sv"
                    | "us"
                    | "uy"
                    | "ve"
            )
        }) =>
        {
            "latam"
        }
        "es" => "spanish",
        language => SIMPLE
            .iter()
            .find(|(code, _)| *code == language)
            .map_or("english", |(_, steam)| *steam),
    }
}

pub fn is_supported(language: &str) -> bool {
    SIMPLE.iter().any(|(_, value)| *value == language)
        || matches!(
            language,
            "schinese" | "tchinese" | "portuguese" | "brazilian" | "spanish" | "latam"
        )
}

#[cfg(test)]

            ("id-ID", "indonesian"),
            ("", "english"),

        ] {

//! Resolve publisher-provided launch options without executing a game or a shell.
use std::path::Path;

use obelisk_core::{
    Platform,
    launch::{LaunchDirectory, LaunchTarget},
};

use crate::cm::{AppInfo, LaunchConfig, supports_platform};

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct LaunchPlan {
    pub app_id: u32,
    pub platform: Platform,
    pub target: LaunchTarget,
}

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
#[error("{0}")]
pub struct LaunchError(String);

/// The caller checks account ownership and the installation receipt first.
pub fn plan(
    app: &AppInfo,
    platform: Platform,
    directory: &Path,
) -> Result<LaunchPlan, LaunchError> {
    if !supports_platform(&app.os_list, platform) {
        return Err(LaunchError(
            "backend.steam.launch.platformUnavailable".into(),
        ));
    }
    let root = LaunchDirectory::new(directory).map_err(shared_error)?;
    let config = configuration(app, platform).ok_or(LaunchError(
        "backend.steam.launch.noCompatibleConfiguration".into(),
    ))?;
    let target = root
        .resolve(
            platform,
            &config.executable,
            &config.arguments,
            &config.working_directory,
        )
        .map_err(shared_error)?;
    Ok(LaunchPlan {
        app_id: app.app_id,
        platform,
        target,
    })
}

/// The publisher's launch option a build for `platform` starts with.
pub(crate) fn configuration(app: &AppInfo, platform: Platform) -> Option<&LaunchConfig> {
    app.launch_configs
        .iter()
        .filter(|config| supports_platform(&config.os_list, platform))
        .filter_map(|config| launch_rank(config).map(|rank| (config, rank)))
        .min_by_key(|(config, rank)| {
            (
                *rank,
                config.os_list.is_empty(),
                config.os_arch.as_deref() == Some("32"),
            )
        })
        .map(|(config, _)| config)
}

fn shared_error(error: obelisk_core::launch::LaunchError) -> LaunchError {
    LaunchError(format!("backend.steam.launch.{}", error.key_suffix()))
}

fn launch_rank(config: &LaunchConfig) -> Option<u8> {
    // Special setup, uninstall, editor and VR entries must not become the default.
    match config.launch_type.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
        "default" => Some(0),
        "" | "none" => Some(1),
        "option1" | "option2" | "option3" | "option4" => Some(2),
        _ => None,
    }
}

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/news.rs`:

```rs
//! Public news never require, receive or persist account credentials.
use std::sync::OnceLock;

use crate::client::{ClientError, http_client, read_bounded};
use obelisk_core::transfer::BodyError;
use serde::Deserialize;

const MAX_NEWS_BYTES: usize = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

/// One pooled client for every news request instead of a TLS setup per game opened.
fn shared_client() -> Result<reqwest::Client, ClientError> {
    static CLIENT: OnceLock<reqwest::Client> = OnceLock::new();
    if let Some(client) = CLIENT.get() {
        return Ok(client.clone());
    }
    let client = http_client()?;
    Ok(CLIENT.get_or_init(|| client).clone())
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct NewsItem {
    pub id: String,
    pub title: String,
    pub url: String,
    pub excerpt: String,
    pub date: u64,
    pub source: String,
}

pub async fn for_app(app_id: u32) -> Result<Vec<NewsItem>, ClientError> {
    let response = shared_client()?
        .get("https://api.steampowered.com/ISteamNews/GetNewsForApp/v2/")
        .query(&[
            ("appid", app_id.to_string()),
            ("count", "8".into()),
            ("maxlength", "1500".into()),
            ("feeds", "steam_community_announcements".into()),
            ("format", "json".into()),
        ])
        .send()
        .await
        .map_err(|_| ClientError::Failure("backend.steam.news.loadFailed".into()))?
        .error_for_status()
        .map_err(|_| ClientError::Failure("backend.steam.news.unavailable".into()))?;
    let bytes = read_bounded(response, MAX_NEWS_BYTES)
        .await
        .map_err(|error| match error {
            BodyError::Size => ClientError::Failure("backend.steam.news.responseTooLarge".into()),
            BodyError::Network | BodyError::Cancelled => {
                ClientError::Failure("backend.steam.news.incompleteResponse".into())
            }
        })?;
    let envelope: Envelope = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)
        .map_err(|_| ClientError::Failure("backend.steam.news.incompatibleFormat".into()))?;
    if envelope.appnews.appid != app_id {
        return Err(ClientError::Failure("backend.steam.news.wrongGame".into()));
    }
    let mut items: Vec<_> = envelope
        .appnews
        .newsitems
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|item| {
            let url = reqwest::Url::parse(&item.url).ok()?;
            if url.scheme() != "https" || !url.username().is_empty() || url.password().is_some() {
                return None;
            }
            Some(NewsItem {
                id: item.gid,
                title: plain_text(&item.title),
                url: item.url,
                excerpt: plain_text(&item.contents),
                date: item.date,
                source: item.feedlabel,
            })
        })
        .collect();
    items.sort_by_key(|item| std::cmp::Reverse(item.date));
    Ok(items)
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct Envelope {
    appnews: AppNews,
}
#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct AppNews {
    appid: u32,
    #[serde(default)]
    newsitems: Vec<WireNews>,
}
#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct WireNews {
    gid: String,
    title: String,
    url: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    contents: String,
    date: u64,
    #[serde(default)]
    feedlabel: String,
}

// News are plain excerpts. No remote HTML, script or BBCode is executed by the app.
fn plain_text(value: &str) -> String {
    let mut text = String::new();
    let mut tag = None;
    for c in value.chars() {
        match (tag, c) {
            (None, '<') => tag = Some('>'),
            (None, '[') => tag = Some(']'),
            (Some(end), c) if c == end => {
                tag = None;
                text.push(' ');
            }
            (None, c) => text.push(c),
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    text.replace("&amp;", "&")
        .replace("&quot;", "\"")
        .replace("&#39;", "’")
        .replace("&nbsp;", " ")
        .replace("&lt;", "<")
        .replace("&gt;", ">")
        .split_whitespace()
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" ")
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn excerpts_do_not_render_remote_markup() {
        assert_eq!(
            plain_text("[h1]Patch[/h1]<p>Two &amp; three</p>"),
            "Patch Two & three"
        );
    }
    #[tokio::test]
    #[ignore = "contacts the public Steam news API"]
    async fn live_news() {
        let items = for_app(620).await.unwrap();
        assert!(!items.is_empty());
        assert!(items.iter().all(|item| item.url.starts_with("https://")));
    }
}

`crates/storefronts/steam-kit/src/own_game.rs`:

```rs
//! The account's own game as Steam pushes it to the UI session, and whether
//! that game can invite a friend right now. The friends list never includes
//! the account itself, so its persona feeds this separate watch channel.
//! Asking Steam for the account's own persona makes its game drop out and
//! come back, which tells every friend again that it started: Obelisk never
//! asks, and only reads what Steam pushes.
use prost::Message;
use tokio::sync::watch;

use crate::{
    friends::{self, RICH_PRESENCE},
    proto,
};
/// EClientPersonaStateFlag Status | PlayerName | Presence | GameExtraInfo |
/// GameDataBlob | RichPresence (SteamKit enums.steamd), as fixtures push them.
#[cfg(any(test, debug_assertions))]
pub(crate) const REQUESTED: u32 = friends::STATUS
    | friends::PLAYER_NAME
    | friends::PRESENCE
    | friends::GAME_EXTRA_INFO
    | friends::GAME_DATA_BLOB
    | RICH_PRESENCE;

/// What Steam's own friend menu would offer: a lobby invitation when the game
/// published a lobby, else its rich presence `connect` string, else nothing.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum GameInvite {
    #[default]
    None,
    Lobby {
        lobby_id: u64,
    },
    Connect {
        connect: String,
    },
}

impl GameInvite {
    /// Steam's limit on a connect string, without its terminating NUL.
    pub const MAX_CONNECT: usize = 255;

    /// An invitation Steam can carry: a lobby's SteamID (account type Chat,
    /// in a real universe) or a connect string that fits Steam's buffer.
    pub fn sendable(&self) -> bool {
        match self {
            Self::None => false,
            Self::Lobby { lobby_id } => {
                (lobby_id >> 52) & 0xf == 8 && lobby_id >> 56 != 0 && *lobby_id as u32 != 0
            }
            Self::Connect { connect } => {
                !connect.is_empty() && connect.len() <= Self::MAX_CONNECT && !connect.contains('\0')
            }
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct OwnGame {
    pub revision: u64,
    pub connected: bool,
    /// 0 when the account plays nothing.
    pub app_id: u32,
    pub lobby_id: u64,
    pub connect: Option<String>,
}

impl OwnGame {
    /// What Steam's own friend menu would offer for this game now.
    pub fn invite(&self) -> GameInvite {
        if self.app_id == 0 {
            GameInvite::None
        } else if self.lobby_id != 0 {
            GameInvite::Lobby {
                lobby_id: self.lobby_id,
            }
        } else if let Some(connect) = &self.connect {
            GameInvite::Connect {
                connect: connect.clone(),
            }
        } else {
            GameInvite::None
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct OwnGameSource {
    game: watch::Sender<OwnGame>,
}

impl Default for OwnGameSource {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl OwnGameSource {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            game: watch::channel(OwnGame {
                revision: 1,
                connected: true,
                app_id: 0,
                lobby_id: 0,
                connect: None,
            })
            .0,
        }
    }

    /// Applies a ClientPersonaState packet's entry for `account_id`, if any.
    /// Malformed optional packets are ignored.
    pub fn receive(&self, account_id: u64, body: &[u8]) {
        if let Ok(state) = proto::PersonaState::decode(body) {
            self.receive_state(account_id, &state);
        }
    }

    /// Applies a decoded ClientPersonaState's entry for `account_id`, if any.
    pub(crate) fn receive_state(&self, account_id: u64, state: &proto::PersonaState) {
        if state.status_flags & (friends::STATUS | RICH_PRESENCE) == 0 {
            return;
        }
        let Some(persona) = state
            .friends
            .iter()
            .find(|persona| account_id != 0 && persona.friend_id == account_id)
        else {
            return;
        };
        self.game.send_if_modified(|current| {
            if !current.connected {
                return false;
            }
            let mut next = current.clone();
            apply(&mut next, state.status_flags, persona);
            if next == *current {
                return false;
            }
            next.revision += 1;
            *current = next;
            true
        });
    }

    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> OwnGame {
        self.game.borrow().clone()
    }

    /// Waits for a revision other than `after_revision`; disconnection wakes
    /// every wait.
    pub async fn next(&self, after_revision: u64) -> OwnGame {
        match obelisk_core::watch::next_matching(self.game.subscribe(), |game| {
            game.revision != after_revision || !game.connected
        })
        .await
        {
            Ok(game) | Err(game) => game,
        }
    }

    pub fn disconnect(&self) {
        self.game.send_if_modified(|current| {
            if !current.connected {
                return false;
            }
            *current = OwnGame {
                revision: current.revision + 1,
                connected: false,
                app_id: 0,
                lobby_id: 0,
                connect: None,
            };
            true
        });
    }
}

/// Valve's friends client applies the game fields only with the Status flag
/// and replaces rich presence only with the RichPresence flag.
fn apply(game: &mut OwnGame, flags: u32, persona: &proto::Persona) {
    if flags & friends::STATUS != 0 {
        if persona.persona_state.unwrap_or(0) == 0 {
            game.app_id = 0;
            game.lobby_id = 0;
            game.connect = None;
        } else {
            let app_id = persona
                .game_played_app_id
                .filter(|id| *id != 0)
                .or_else(|| persona.game_id.map(|id| (id & 0x00ff_ffff) as u32))
                .unwrap_or(0);
            // Another game's connect string must never invite into this one.
            if app_id != game.app_id {
                game.connect = None;
            }
            game.app_id = app_id;
            game.lobby_id = persona.game_lobby_id.unwrap_or(0);
        }
    }
    if flags & RICH_PRESENCE != 0 {
        game.connect = persona
            .rich_presence
            .iter()
            .find(|pair| pair.key.eq_ignore_ascii_case("connect"))
            .map(|pair| pair.value.clone())
            .filter(|connect| !connect.is_empty());
    }
}

/// Wire bodies for debug fixtures, so tests feed the production decoder.
#[cfg(debug_assertions)]
pub mod fixture {
    use prost::Message;

    use crate::proto;

    /// The account's persona with the Status and RichPresence groups.
    pub fn persona(account_id: u64, app_id: u32, lobby_id: u64, connect: Option<&str>) -> Vec<u8> {
        proto::PersonaState {
            status_flags: super::REQUESTED,
            friends: vec![proto::Persona {
                friend_id: account_id,
                persona_state: Some(1),
                game_played_app_id: Some(app_id),
                game_lobby_id: Some(lobby_id),
                rich_presence: connect
                    .map(|value| proto::RichPresence {
                        key: "connect".into(),
                        value: value.into(),
                    })
                    .into_iter()
                    .collect(),
                ..Default::default()
            }],
        }
        .encode_to_vec()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const ACCOUNT: u64 = 76_561_197_960_265_730;

    fn persona(flags: u32, persona: proto::Persona) -> Vec<u8> {
        proto::PersonaState {
            status_flags: flags,
            friends: vec![proto::Persona {
                friend_id: ACCOUNT,
                ..persona
            }],
        }
        .encode_to_vec()
    }

    fn playing(app_id: u32, lobby_id: u64, connect: Option<&str>) -> proto::Persona {
        proto::Persona {
            persona_state: Some(1),
            game_played_app_id: Some(app_id),
            game_lobby_id: Some(lobby_id),
            rich_presence: connect
                .map(|value| proto::RichPresence {
                    key: "Connect".into(),
                    value: value.into(),
                })
                .into_iter()
                .collect(),
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn independent_wire_fixture_decodes_lobby_and_rich_presence() {
        // status_flags 1 = 4097; friend: friendid fixed64 1, persona_state 2,
        // game_played_app_id 3 = 620, rich_presence 71 {key 1, value 2},
        // game_lobby_id fixed64 73.
        let mut friend = vec![0x09];
        friend.extend_from_slice(&ACCOUNT.to_le_bytes());
        friend.extend_from_slice(&[0x10, 0x01, 0x18, 0xec, 0x04]);
        friend.extend_from_slice(&[0xba, 0x04, 0x0e, 0x0a, 0x07]);
        friend.extend_from_slice(b"connect");
        friend.extend_from_slice(&[0x12, 0x03]);
        friend.extend_from_slice(b"+cx");
        friend.extend_from_slice(&[0xc9, 0x04]);
        friend.extend_from_slice(&0x0186_0000_0000_0042_u64.to_le_bytes());
        let mut body = vec![0x08, 0x81, 0x20, 0x12, friend.len() as u8];
        body.extend_from_slice(&friend);
        let source = OwnGameSource::new();
        source.receive(ACCOUNT, &body);
        let game = source.snapshot();
        assert_eq!(game.app_id, 620);
        assert_eq!(game.connect.as_deref(), Some("+cx"));
        assert_eq!(
            game.invite(),
            GameInvite::Lobby {
                lobby_id: 0x0186_0000_0000_0042
            }
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn invite_follows_steams_menu_rule() {
        let source = OwnGameSource::new();
        source.receive(
            ACCOUNT,
            &persona(REQUESTED, playing(620, 0, Some("+connect 1"))),
        );
        assert_eq!(
            source.snapshot().invite(),
            GameInvite::Connect {
                connect: "+connect 1".into()
            }
        );
        // A lobby wins over the connect string.
        source.receive(
            ACCOUNT,
            &persona(REQUESTED, playing(620, 9, Some("+connect 1"))),
        );
        assert_eq!(
            source.snapshot().invite(),
            GameInvite::Lobby { lobby_id: 9 }
        );
        // No game, no invitation, whatever the leftovers say.
        source.receive(
            ACCOUNT,
            &persona(REQUESTED, playing(0, 9, Some("+connect 1"))),
        );
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().invite(), GameInvite::None);
        // A game without lobby or connect string offers nothing.
        source.receive(ACCOUNT, &persona(REQUESTED, playing(620, 0, None)));
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().invite(), GameInvite::None);
        // The app may come from the game ID's low 24 bits.
        source.receive(
            ACCOUNT,
            &persona(
                friends::STATUS,
                proto::Persona {
                    persona_state: Some(1),
                    game_id: Some(0x0100_0000_0000_026c),
                    game_lobby_id: Some(5),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
            ),
        );
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().app_id, 620);
        assert_eq!(
            source.snapshot().invite(),
            GameInvite::Lobby { lobby_id: 5 }
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn game_fields_need_the_status_flag_and_other_accounts_are_ignored() {
        let source = OwnGameSource::new();
        source.receive(ACCOUNT, &persona(friends::STATUS, playing(620, 0, None)));
        let revision = source.snapshot().revision;
        // Without Status, a packet cannot change the game or lobby.
        source.receive(
            ACCOUNT,
            &persona(
                friends::PLAYER_NAME | friends::GAME_DATA_BLOB,
                playing(730, 3, None),
            ),
        );
        source.receive(
            ACCOUNT,
            &proto::PersonaState {
                status_flags: REQUESTED,
                friends: vec![proto::Persona {
                    friend_id: ACCOUNT + 1,
                    ..playing(730, 3, None)
                }],
            }
            .encode_to_vec(),
        );
        source.receive(ACCOUNT, &[0xff]);
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().app_id, 620);
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().revision, revision);
        // Rich presence alone updates the connect string of the current game.
        source.receive(
            ACCOUNT,
            &persona(RICH_PRESENCE, playing(0, 0, Some("+join"))),
        );
        assert_eq!(
            source.snapshot().invite(),
            GameInvite::Connect {
                connect: "+join".into()
            }
        );
        // A different game drops the previous game's connect string.
        source.receive(ACCOUNT, &persona(friends::STATUS, playing(730, 0, None)));
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().connect, None);
        // Going offline clears everything.
        source.receive(
            ACCOUNT,
            &persona(friends::STATUS, proto::Persona::default()),
        );
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().app_id, 0);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn observers_wake_on_change_and_disconnect() {
        let source = OwnGameSource::new();
        // An unchanged persona changes no revision.
        source.receive(ACCOUNT, &persona(REQUESTED, playing(0, 0, None)));
        assert_eq!(source.snapshot().revision, 1);

        let waiting = tokio::spawn({
            let source = source.clone();
            async move { source.next(1).await }
        });
        tokio::task::yield_now().await;
        source.receive(ACCOUNT, &persona(REQUESTED, playing(620, 2, None)));
        assert_eq!(waiting.await.unwrap().revision, 2);
        let waiting = tokio::spawn({
            let source = source.clone();
            async move { source.next(2).await }
        });
        tokio::task::yield_now().await;
        source.disconnect();
        let ended = waiting.await.unwrap();
        assert!(!ended.connected);
        assert_eq!(ended.invite(), GameInvite::None);
    }
}

`docs/CONTRACT.md`:

```md
# The contract between Obelisk and Voile

Obelisk runs Windows games in a [Voile](https://github.com/Zagrios/Voile) runtime it downloads on its own: as a Windows game launches, it reads Voile's signed `voile-feed.json` and moves to the newest release of its contract. The contract is everything Obelisk relies on inside a runtime. One number counts its changes, on both sides:

- Voile's `CONTRACT` file, which every release built from that commit carries in its `runtime.json`;
- `contract` in Obelisk's `crates/game-runtime/voile-release.json`.

Obelisk runs only the releases whose contract equals its own. A release older than `CONTRACT` counts as contract 1.

## When to raise it

Raise both numbers in the change that alters anything below, whichever repository it starts in. A fix inside the runtime that keeps all of it, such as a Wine, Linux engine, DXMT or Neptune fix, keeps the contract: players get it with the next published release.

A release of a new contract reaches only the Obelisk builds of that contract. Older builds stay on the last release of theirs until Sparkle updates them.

## What it covers

### Paths inside a release

- `bin/wine`, `bin/wineserver`
- `runtime.json`, and its `version` field
- `lib/d3dmetal`, `lib/dxmt`: each graphics backend's DLLs, which `WINEDLLPATH_PREPEND` names and `wineboot` lays into prefixes
- `lib/external/D3DMetal.framework/D3DMetal`, `lib/external/libd3dshared.dylib`
- `lib/gstreamer-1.0`
- `share/wine/mono/wine-mono-*`: its folder name is recorded in each prefix, and a new one updates the prefix
- `steam/steamclient.dll`, `steam/steamclient64.dll`, copied into each prefix
- `linux/engine/fexdarwin-run`, `linux/engine/wsd`, `linux/engine/wsdctl`, `linux/engine/obelisk-input`, `linux/engine/run-with-timeout.sh`
- `linux/root`, the Linux guest's root, and `linux/wine`, bound at `/opt/wine`
- `linux/windows/{d3d11,dxgi,d3d12}.dll`, copied into the Linux engine's prefix on each launch
- `linux/steam/linux64`, Valve's Linux steamclient, bound at `/opt/steam`
- `linux/guest/steam-hostpid.so`, preloaded in the guest
- `linux/graphics/libexec/virgl_render_server`, `linux/graphics/dxmt-native.framework`
- `linux/graphics/x86_64/{bin/virgl_test_server, libexec/virgl_render_server, lib/libd3dmetal-native.dylib}`

### What Obelisk's Wine reads

On the macOS engine, the variables Obelisk sets and the Wine features they need:

- `WINEDLLPATH_PREPEND`, the backend folders searched before Wine's own
- `CX_ACTIVE_GRAPHICS_BACKEND`, `CX_APPLEGPTK_LIBD3DSHARED_PATH`, `CX_HIDE_BUILTIN_VERSION_RESOURCES`
- `D3DMETAL_FRAMEWORK_PATH`, `D3DM_SUPPORT_DXR`
- `GST_PLUGIN_SYSTEM_PATH`, `GST_REGISTRY`
- `WINEMSYNC`, `WINE_LARGE_ADDRESS_AWARE`, `ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX`, `DOTNET_EnableWriteXorExecute`
- `WINE_OBELISK_INPUT_SOCKET`, which Voile's Obelisk input bus reads
- the DLL overrides Obelisk sets: `mscoree`, `mshtml`, `winemenubuilder.exe`

In the Linux engine's guest:

- `WINEARCH`, `WINEDLLOVERRIDES` with `d3d11,dxgi,d3d12=n`
- `VTEST_SOCKET_NAME`, `NPT_DEBUG`, `LD_PRELOAD`

### The Linux engine's launch

`crates/game-runtime/src/wine/linux_engine/launch.sh`, built into Obelisk, assembles a launch from the runtime. Its contract covers:

- the `FEXDARWIN_LKD`, `FEXDARWIN_ROOT`, `FEXDARWIN_ROOT_RO`, `FEXDARWIN_SUPERVISOR_PID` and `FEXDARWIN_BIND` variables, and `fexdarwin-run --cwd`
- `wsd --dir`, and the bundle `wsd` is copied into
- `virgl_test_server --no-virgl --no-fork --socket-path`, with `RENDER_SERVER_EXEC_PATH`, `NPT_BACKEND`, `NPT_{D3D11,DXGI,D3D12}_LIBRARY_PATH` and `DMN_RESIDENCY_SET`
- the render server's `--obelisk-translate`
- `obelisk-input --dir`, and the `wsd.sock`, `vtest.sock` and `input.sock` sockets it waits for
- `wineserver -p0` and `wineserver -w`

### The Steam bridge

- Voile's ntdll sends the exports of `steamclient(64).dll` to lsteamclient.
- lsteamclient loads the Intel slice of Obelisk's `steamclient.dylib` from `STEAM_COMPAT_CLIENT_INSTALL_PATH`.
- `steam.exe` starts the game, which gets `SteamAppId`, `SteamGameId` and `SteamOS`.
- In the Linux engine, `~/.steam/sdk64` leads to `/opt/steam/linux64`.

## Releasing across a change

1. In Voile, raise `CONTRACT`, then run the Release workflow and publish the release. The Feed workflow offers it, and Obelisk builds of the old contract ignore it.
2. In Obelisk, raise `contract` in `voile-release.json` with the change that needs it, then tag a release. Its workflow pins the newest Voile release of the new contract with `scripts/pin-voile.sh`, and refuses to build when there is none.
3. Sparkle brings players the new Obelisk, which moves them to the new release.

## The feed

`voile-feed.json` lives on Voile's `main`, newest release first:

```json
{
  "format": 1,
  "releases": [
    {
      "version": "v26.3.0-16",
      "contract": 1,
      "published": "2026-10-21",
      "url": "https://github.com/Zagrios/Voile/releases/download/v26.3.0-16/voile-v26.3.0-16.tar.xz",
      "size": 431204816,
      "sha256": "…"
    }
  ]
}
```

Voile's Feed workflow writes a release's entry when the release is published, from its assets and its commit's `CONTRACT`. It then signs the file with Ed25519 into `voile-feed.json.sig`, the base64 of the signature. Obelisk checks it with the public key in `crates/game-runtime/src/voile/feed.rs`, which Voile's `scripts/feed-key.sh` made; it ignores a feed whose signature does not hold, or of another `format`, and goes on with the last one it checked.

To withdraw a release, run the Feed workflow from Voile's Actions tab with its version and a reason. The entry stays, with `withdrawn`: Obelisk no longer runs that release, downloads the newest one left on the next launch, and removes the withdrawn one once no game runs. Running the workflow again with an empty reason puts the release back.

## A game that needs a release

A game profile in `crates/game-runtime/profiles.json` can name the oldest release its game runs in, with `minimum_voile`. It is a floor, not a pin: the game runs in the newest release installed, as every game does. Only when the release in place is older than that one does the game's launch wait for the newest release of the contract to download, instead of starting with the old one. Other games start at once, and the newer release downloads once no game runs.

```

`packaging/macos/generate-layout.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regenerate the Finder layout template, without opening Finder.

This is an optional maintenance tool. Normal DMG builds copy the checked-in
FinderLayout.dsstore and require neither Python nor third-party packages.

From the repository root:
    python3 -m venv build/dmg-layout-tools
    build/dmg-layout-tools/bin/pip install ds-store==1.3.1 mac-alias==2.2.2
    build/dmg-layout-tools/bin/python packaging/macos/generate-layout.py

Format references:
    https://github.com/dmgbuild/ds_store
    https://github.com/dmgbuild/dmgbuild/blob/main/src/dmgbuild/core.py
    https://metacpan.org/dist/Mac-Finder-DSStore/view/DSStoreFormat.pod

All records are created from scratch. The template contains only relative item
names and Finder presentation settings, with no volume aliases or user paths.
"""

from pathlib import Path

from ds_store import DSStore


def generate_layout(destination: Path) -> None:
    with DSStore.open(str(destination), "w+") as store:
        root = store["."]
        root["vSrn"] = ("long", 1)
        root["bwsp"] = {
            "WindowBounds": "{{100, 100}, {640, 380}}",
            "ShowToolbar": False,
            "ShowSidebar": False,
            "ContainerShowSidebar": False,
            "SidebarWidth": 0,
            "ShowPathbar": False,
            "ShowStatusBar": False,
            "ShowTabView": False,
            "PreviewPaneVisibility": False,
        }
        root["icvp"] = {
            "viewOptionsVersion": 1,
            "backgroundType": 0,  # Finder's system background, no image alias.
            "backgroundColorRed": 1.0,
            "backgroundColorGreen": 1.0,
            "backgroundColorBlue": 1.0,
            "iconSize": 128.0,
            "textSize": 14.0,
            "labelOnBottom": True,
            "showItemInfo": False,
            "showIconPreview": True,
            "arrangeBy": "none",  # Preserve the two explicit icon positions.
            "gridOffsetX": 0.0,
            "gridOffsetY": 0.0,
            "gridSpacing": 54.0,
            "scrollPositionX": 0.0,
            "scrollPositionY": 0.0,
        }
        root["icvl"] = ("type", b"icnv")
        root["vstl"] = ("type", b"icnv")  # Always open in icon view.
        store["Obelisk.app"]["Iloc"] = (165, 180)
        store["Applications"]["Iloc"] = (475, 180)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    generate_layout(Path(__file__).with_name("FinderLayout.dsstore"))

```

`packaging/rosetta/main.m`:

```m
#import <AppKit/AppKit.h>
#include <string.h>

// This app exists only to request macOS's normal Intel-app launch path. It
// never starts a game, reads credentials, or changes Obelisk's launch state.
@interface ObeliskRosettaDelegate : NSObject <NSApplicationDelegate>
@end

@implementation ObeliskRosettaDelegate
- (void)applicationDidFinishLaunching:(NSNotification *)notification {
    (void)notification;
    // Finish AppKit's launch handshake before exiting, so LaunchServices can
    // deliver its launch completion. The real installer flow needs UI testing.
    dispatch_after(dispatch_time(DISPATCH_TIME_NOW, NSEC_PER_SEC),
                   dispatch_get_main_queue(), ^{
        [NSApp terminate:nil];
    });
}
@end

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
    // Successful execution of this x86_64-only binary on Apple silicon is the
    // readiness check. Direct execution cannot start our AppKit launch path.
    if (argc == 2 && strcmp(argv[1], "--probe") == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    @autoreleasepool {
        NSApplication *application = [NSApplication sharedApplication];
        [application setActivationPolicy:NSApplicationActivationPolicyProhibited];
        __attribute__((objc_precise_lifetime))
        ObeliskRosettaDelegate *delegate = [ObeliskRosettaDelegate new];
        application.delegate = delegate;
        [application run];
    }
    return 0;
}

`scripts/build-dmg.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
OUTPUT_DIRECTORY="$PROJECT_ROOT/build/dist"
BUILD_APPLICATION=true
NOTARIZE=true
# Created once with: xcrun notarytool store-credentials obelisk-notary --apple-id ... --team-id ...
NOTARY_PROFILE="${OBELISK_NOTARY_PROFILE:-obelisk-notary}"
# An App Store Connect API key (the .p8 file, its ID and issuer) replaces the profile, as in CI.
if [[ -n "${OBELISK_NOTARY_KEY:-}" ]]; then
    NOTARY_AUTH=(--key "$OBELISK_NOTARY_KEY" --key-id "${OBELISK_NOTARY_KEY_ID:?}" \
        --issuer "${OBELISK_NOTARY_ISSUER:?}")
else
    NOTARY_AUTH=(--keychain-profile "$NOTARY_PROFILE")
fi

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        --skip-build) BUILD_APPLICATION=false; shift ;;
        --no-notarize) NOTARIZE=false; shift ;;
        --output-dir)
            if [[ $# -lt 2 || -z "$2" || "$2" == --* ]]; then
                echo "--output-dir requires a directory." >&2
                exit 2
            fi
            OUTPUT_DIRECTORY="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;
        --help|-h)
            echo "Usage: $0 [--skip-build] [--no-notarize] [--output-dir DIRECTORY]"
            echo "Build the Release application and a signed, notarized drag-and-drop DMG for its architecture."
            echo "Notarization uses the notarytool keychain profile \$OBELISK_NOTARY_PROFILE (default obelisk-notary),"
            echo "or the API key \$OBELISK_NOTARY_KEY with \$OBELISK_NOTARY_KEY_ID and \$OBELISK_NOTARY_ISSUER."
            exit 0
            ;;
        *) echo "Unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    esac
done

if [[ "$(uname -s)" != Darwin ]]; then
    echo "Create the DMG on macOS with Xcode installed." >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [[ "$BUILD_APPLICATION" == true ]]; then
    CONFIGURATION=Release "$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/build.sh"
fi

APP="$PROJECT_ROOT/build/xcode/Build/Products/Release/Obelisk.app"
INFO="$APP/Contents/Info.plist"
LAYOUT="$PROJECT_ROOT/packaging/macos/FinderLayout.dsstore"
if [[ ! -f "$INFO" || ! -f "$LAYOUT" ]]; then
    echo "Missing Release app or Finder layout. Run without --skip-build." >&2
    exit 1
fi

VERSION="$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :CFBundleShortVersionString' "$INFO")"
EXECUTABLE="$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :CFBundleExecutable' "$INFO")"
ARCHITECTURES="$(/usr/bin/lipo -archs "$APP/Contents/MacOS/$EXECUTABLE" | tr ' ' '-')"
case "$VERSION-$ARCHITECTURES" in
    *[!a-zA-Z0-9._+-]*) echo "Invalid version or architecture in DMG filename." >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
"$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/verify-app-signature.sh" --distribution "$APP"
IDENTITY="$(/usr/bin/codesign -dvv "$APP" 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^Authority=//p' | head -n 1)"

mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIRECTORY" "$PROJECT_ROOT/build/dmg"
OUTPUT_DIRECTORY="$(cd "$OUTPUT_DIRECTORY" && pwd)"
STAGING="$(mktemp -d "$PROJECT_ROOT/build/dmg/staging.XXXXXX")"
# This directory is created by this invocation and contains only generated files.
trap 'rm -rf "$STAGING"' EXIT
mkdir "$STAGING/content"
/usr/bin/ditto "$APP" "$STAGING/content/Obelisk.app"
ln -s /Applications "$STAGING/content/Applications"
cp "$LAYOUT" "$STAGING/content/.DS_Store"

NAME="Obelisk-$VERSION-$ARCHITECTURES.dmg"
/usr/bin/hdiutil create -volname "Installer Obelisk" -fs HFS+ \
    -srcfolder "$STAGING/content" -format UDZO \
    -imagekey zlib-level=9 "$STAGING/$NAME"
/usr/bin/hdiutil verify "$STAGING/$NAME"
/usr/bin/codesign --force --sign "$IDENTITY" --timestamp "$STAGING/$NAME"
if [[ "$NOTARIZE" == true ]]; then
    RESULT="$STAGING/notarization.json"
    /usr/bin/xcrun notarytool submit "$STAGING/$NAME" "${NOTARY_AUTH[@]}" \
        --wait --output-format json > "$RESULT"
    STATUS="$(/usr/bin/plutil -extract status raw -o - "$RESULT")"
    if [[ "$STATUS" != Accepted ]]; then
        SUBMISSION="$(/usr/bin/plutil -extract id raw -o - "$RESULT")"
        echo "Notarization ended with status $STATUS. Apple's log:" >&2
        /usr/bin/xcrun notarytool log "$SUBMISSION" "${NOTARY_AUTH[@]}" >&2 || true
        exit 1
    fi
    /usr/bin/xcrun stapler staple "$STAGING/$NAME"
    /usr/sbin/spctl --assess --type open --context context:primary-signature --verbose "$STAGING/$NAME"
fi
mv -f "$STAGING/$NAME" "$OUTPUT_DIRECTORY/$NAME"
(
    cd "$OUTPUT_DIRECTORY"
    /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$NAME" > "$STAGING/$NAME.sha256"
)
mv -f "$STAGING/$NAME.sha256" "$OUTPUT_DIRECTORY/$NAME.sha256"

echo "DMG: $OUTPUT_DIRECTORY/$NAME"
echo "SHA-256: $OUTPUT_DIRECTORY/$NAME.sha256"
if [[ "$NOTARIZE" != true ]]; then
    echo "This DMG is not notarized: Gatekeeper blocks it on other Macs."
fi

```

`scripts/build-rust.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/target"
CONFIGURATION="${CONFIGURATION:-Debug}"
case "$CONFIGURATION" in
    Debug) CARGO_PROFILE=debug; PROFILE_NAME=dev ;;
    Release) CARGO_PROFILE=release; PROFILE_NAME=release ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported configuration: $CONFIGURATION" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

HOST_ARCH="$(uname -m)"
case "$HOST_ARCH" in
    arm64) HOST_TARGET=aarch64-apple-darwin ;;
    x86_64) HOST_TARGET=x86_64-apple-darwin ;;
    *) echo "Build this application on macOS." >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

RUST_TARGET="${RUST_TARGET:-$HOST_TARGET}"
if [[ "$RUST_TARGET" != "$HOST_TARGET" ]]; then
    echo "This starter builds for the host architecture ($HOST_TARGET)." >&2
    echo "A universal distribution needs a separate multi-architecture build." >&2
    exit 1
fi

GENERATED="$PROJECT_ROOT/apps/macos/Obelisk/Bridge/Generated"
STAGING="$PROJECT_ROOT/build/bindings/$CONFIGURATION"
LIBRARY_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/build/rust/$CONFIGURATION"
mkdir -p "$GENERATED" "$STAGING" "$LIBRARY_DIR"

cargo build --locked --manifest-path "$PROJECT_ROOT/Cargo.toml" -p obelisk-bridge --lib \
    --target "$RUST_TARGET" --profile "$PROFILE_NAME"

cargo run --locked --manifest-path "$PROJECT_ROOT/Cargo.toml" -p obelisk-bridge \
    --bin uniffi-bindgen --features cli -- generate \
    --library "$PROJECT_ROOT/target/$RUST_TARGET/$CARGO_PROFILE/libobelisk_bridge.dylib" \
    --language swift --config "$PROJECT_ROOT/uniffi.toml" --out-dir "$STAGING" --no-format

# Preserve timestamps when generated contents have not changed.
for generated_file in "$STAGING"/*; do
    destination="$GENERATED/$(basename "$generated_file")"
    if ! cmp -s "$generated_file" "$destination"; then
        cp "$generated_file" "$destination"
    fi
done
MODULEMAP="$STAGING/ObeliskBridgeFFI.modulemap"
if ! cmp -s "$MODULEMAP" "$GENERATED/module.modulemap"; then
    cp "$MODULEMAP" "$GENERATED/module.modulemap"
fi
cp "$PROJECT_ROOT/target/$RUST_TARGET/$CARGO_PROFILE/libobelisk_bridge.a" "$LIBRARY_DIR/"

`scripts/build-steam-native.sh`:

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
if [[ "$(uname -m)" != arm64 ]]; then
    echo "The native Steam engine integration currently requires Apple silicon." >&2
    exit 1
fi
case "${CONFIGURATION:-Debug}" in
    Debug) PROFILE_NAME=dev; PROFILE_DIRECTORY=debug ;;
    Release) PROFILE_NAME=release; PROFILE_DIRECTORY=release ;;
    *) exit 1 ;;
esac
# Obelisk ships no Valve binary: a Steam game's download, or a launch that
# misses them, gets the pinned packages from Valve's CDN. Remove the payload earlier builds bundled.
rm -rf "$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH/SteamRuntime"
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/build/steam-native-target"
cargo build --locked --manifest-path "$PROJECT_ROOT/crates/steam-native/Cargo.toml" \
    --workspace --bin obelisk-steam-host --lib --profile "$PROFILE_NAME" --target aarch64-apple-darwin
cargo build --locked --manifest-path "$PROJECT_ROOT/crates/steam-native/Cargo.toml" \
    -p obelisk-steam-native --bin obelisk-steam-sdk --profile "$PROFILE_NAME" --target x86_64-apple-darwin
cargo build --locked --manifest-path "$PROJECT_ROOT/crates/steam-native/Cargo.toml" \
    -p obelisk-steam-discovery-adapter --lib --profile "$PROFILE_NAME" --target x86_64-apple-darwin
ARM_BUILD="$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/aarch64-apple-darwin/$PROFILE_DIRECTORY"
INTEL_BUILD="$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/x86_64-apple-darwin/$PROFILE_DIRECTORY"
DESTINATION="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$CONTENTS_FOLDER_PATH/Helpers/SteamNative"
mkdir -p "$DESTINATION"
cp "$ARM_BUILD/obelisk-steam-host" "$DESTINATION/obelisk-steam-host"
# Remove the former diagnostic helper from incremental app builds.
rm -f "$DESTINATION/obelisk-steam-sdk-arm64"
cp "$INTEL_BUILD/obelisk-steam-sdk" "$DESTINATION/obelisk-steam-sdk-x86_64"
ADAPTER="$DESTINATION/libobelisk_steam_discovery_adapter.dylib"
/usr/bin/lipo -create "$ARM_BUILD/libobelisk_steam_discovery_adapter.dylib" \
    "$INTEL_BUILD/libobelisk_steam_discovery_adapter.dylib" -output "$ADAPTER"
IDENTITY="${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY:?A stable Apple signing identity is required}"
# Notarization needs a secure timestamp; Debug skips the round trip to Apple.
if [[ "${CONFIGURATION:-Debug}" == Release ]]; then TIMESTAMP=--timestamp; else TIMESTAMP=--timestamp=none; fi
/usr/bin/codesign --force --sign "$IDENTITY" "$TIMESTAMP" --options runtime \
    --identifier com.zagrios.obelisk.steam-host \
    --entitlements "$PROJECT_ROOT/packaging/steam-host.entitlements" "$DESTINATION/obelisk-steam-host"
/usr/bin/codesign --force --sign "$IDENTITY" "$TIMESTAMP" \
    --identifier com.zagrios.obelisk.steam-discovery "$ADAPTER"
/usr/bin/codesign --force --sign "$IDENTITY" "$TIMESTAMP" --options runtime \
    --identifier com.zagrios.obelisk.steam-sdk-x86_64 \
    --entitlements "$PROJECT_ROOT/packaging/steam-host.entitlements" \
    "$DESTINATION/obelisk-steam-sdk-x86_64"

# Opening this Intel-only app through LaunchServices lets macOS present its
# Rosetta installer. A direct --probe invocation never starts the app run loop.
ROSETTA_SOURCE="$PROJECT_ROOT/packaging/rosetta"
ROSETTA_BUILD="$PROJECT_ROOT/build/rosetta"
ROSETTA_APP="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$CONTENTS_FOLDER_PATH/Helpers/Obelisk Rosetta.app"
mkdir -p "$ROSETTA_BUILD" "$ROSETTA_APP/Contents/MacOS"
ROSETTA_EXECUTABLE="$ROSETTA_BUILD/ObeliskRosetta"
SDK_PATH="$(xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path)"
MINIMUM_MACOS="${MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET:-26.4}"
BUILD_SETTINGS="$SDK_PATH|$MINIMUM_MACOS"
PREVIOUS_SETTINGS="$(cat "$ROSETTA_BUILD/settings" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ ! -f "$ROSETTA_EXECUTABLE" \
    || "$ROSETTA_SOURCE/main.m" -nt "$ROSETTA_EXECUTABLE" \
    || "$0" -nt "$ROSETTA_EXECUTABLE" \
    || "$BUILD_SETTINGS" != "$PREVIOUS_SETTINGS" ]]; then
    xcrun --sdk macosx clang -arch x86_64 -isysroot "$SDK_PATH" \
        "-mmacosx-version-min=$MINIMUM_MACOS" -fobjc-arc -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror \
        -framework AppKit "$ROSETTA_SOURCE/main.m" -o "$ROSETTA_EXECUTABLE"
    printf '%s\n' "$BUILD_SETTINGS" > "$ROSETTA_BUILD/settings"
fi
cp "$ROSETTA_EXECUTABLE" "$ROSETTA_APP/Contents/MacOS/ObeliskRosetta"
if ! cmp -s "$ROSETTA_SOURCE/Info.plist" "$ROSETTA_APP/Contents/Info.plist"; then
    cp "$ROSETTA_SOURCE/Info.plist" "$ROSETTA_APP/Contents/Info.plist"
fi
/usr/bin/codesign --force --sign "$IDENTITY" "$TIMESTAMP" --options runtime "$ROSETTA_APP"

`scripts/pin-voile.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# Writes into crates/game-runtime/voile-release.json the newest release Voile's feed offers for the contract that file
# names: the release a build installs until it reads the feed itself, such as without the network. The Release
# workflow runs it before it builds, so the pin needs no commit of its own. The feed's signature is checked with the key
# Obelisk checks it with, in crates/game-runtime/src/voile/feed.rs. FEED_URL and KEY replace those, to try it.
set -euo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
PIN="$HERE/crates/game-runtime/voile-release.json"
FEED_URL="${FEED_URL:-https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zagrios/Voile/main/voile-feed.json}"
KEY="${KEY:-$(sed -n 's/^const KEY: &str = "\(.*\)";$/\1/p' "$HERE/crates/game-runtime/src/voile/feed.rs")}"
OPENSSL="${OPENSSL:-$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/bin/openssl}"

fail() {
    echo "$*" >&2
    exit 1
}

[[ -x "$OPENSSL" ]] || brew install --quiet openssl@3
work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
curl -fsSL "$FEED_URL" -o "$work/feed.json"
curl -fsSL "$FEED_URL.sig" -o "$work/feed.json.sig"
# An Ed25519 key's SubjectPublicKeyInfo is a fixed prefix, then the key's 32 bytes.
{
    printf '\x30\x2a\x30\x05\x06\x03\x2b\x65\x70\x03\x21\x00'
    base64 --decode <<<"$KEY"
} > "$work/key.der"
base64 --decode < "$work/feed.json.sig" > "$work/feed.sig"
"$OPENSSL" pkeyutl -verify -pubin -keyform DER -inkey "$work/key.der" -rawin -in "$work/feed.json" \
    -sigfile "$work/feed.sig" > /dev/null || fail "The feed's signature does not hold with Obelisk's key."

[[ "$(jq .format "$work/feed.json")" == 1 ]] || fail "The feed is of a format Obelisk does not read."
contract="$(jq .contract "$PIN")"
entry="$(jq -c --argjson contract "$contract" '
    [.releases[] | select(.contract == $contract and (.withdrawn | not))]
    | sort_by(.version | ltrimstr("v") | [splits("[.-]")] | map(tonumber)) | last // empty' "$work/feed.json")"
[[ -n "$entry" ]] || fail "The feed offers no release of contract $contract."
jq --argjson entry "$entry" '{contract} + ($entry | {version, url, size, sha256})' "$PIN" > "$work/pin.json"
cp "$work/pin.json" "$PIN"
cat "$PIN"

```

`scripts/probe-steam-cloud.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run a signed, offline Rust Cloud probe against Obelisk's bundled Valve files.

No game, account credential, installed Steam client or existing save is used.
All native writes are restricted to a fresh temporary directory. The profile
denies external networking and all reads beneath the real user's home.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import socket
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import zipfile


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=["inventory", "storage-inventory", "local-storage", "local-projection", "local-cache-refresh", "local-live-mutation", "sync-controls"], default="inventory")
    parser.add_argument("--keep-scratch", action="store_true", help="Keep the disposable runtime for inspection")
    parser.add_argument("--fixture-appinfo", action="store_true", help="Seed synthetic offline app quota metadata")
    parser.add_argument("--fixture-identity", action="store_true", help="Request a test-only identity with all external networking denied")
    parser.add_argument("--fixture-cache", action="store_true", help="Project a synthetic RemoteStorage index with the Obelisk fixture")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.fixture_cache and args.mode not in ["local-projection", "local-cache-refresh"]:
        parser.error("--fixture-cache requires a projection mode")
    if args.mode == "local-cache-refresh" and not all([args.fixture_appinfo, args.fixture_identity, args.fixture_cache]):
        parser.error("local-cache-refresh requires all three --fixture-* flags")
    if args.mode in ["local-live-mutation", "sync-controls"] and not (args.fixture_appinfo and args.fixture_identity):
        parser.error(f"{args.mode} requires --fixture-appinfo and --fixture-identity")
    project = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    subprocess.run([
        "cargo", "build", "--locked", "--offline", "--manifest-path",
        str(project / "crates/steam-native/Cargo.toml"), "--example", "cloud_storage_probe",
        "--target-dir", str(project / "build/steam-native-target"),
    ], check=True)
    binary = project / "build/steam-native-target/debug/examples/cloud_storage_probe"
    manifest = json.loads((project / "crates/game-runtime/runtime-manifest.json").read_text())
    # Valve's Steam components, as Obelisk downloads them with a Steam game's download or launch.
    package = Path.home() / f"Library/Caches/com.zagrios.obelisk/SteamRuntime/valve-{manifest['version']}.zip"
    if not package.is_file():
        raise SystemExit("Launch a Steam game in Obelisk once so it downloads Valve's Steam components")
    signing = (project / "apps/macos/Config/Signing.local.xcconfig").read_text()
    identity = re.search(r"^CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY\s*=\s*([0-9A-Fa-f]{40})\s*$", signing, re.M)
    if identity is None:
        raise SystemExit("Configure the existing Apple signing identity first")
    scratch = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="obelisk-cloud-probe-", dir="/private/tmp"))
    scratch.chmod(0o700)
    for name in ["runtime", "home", "tmp"]:
        (scratch / name).mkdir(mode=0o700)
    runtime = scratch / "runtime"
    if args.fixture_appinfo:
        # Test-only appinfo v40, generated without installed-Steam data. These
        # quota values are fixture inputs, not claims about App 480 on Steam.
        def kv(items):
            output = bytearray()
            for key, value in items.items():
                output += (b"\x00" if isinstance(value, dict) else b"\x01") + key.encode() + b"\x00"
                output += kv(value) if isinstance(value, dict) else str(value).encode() + b"\x00"
            return bytes(output) + b"\x08"
        data = kv({"appinfo": {"appid": "480", "common": {"name": "Obelisk offline fixture", "type": "Game"},
                              "ufs": {"quota": "1048576", "maxnumfiles": "16"}}})
        entry = struct.pack("<IIQ", 2, 1, 0) + bytes(20) + struct.pack("<I", 1) + hashlib.sha1(data).digest() + data
        cache = struct.pack("<IIII", 0x07564428, 1, 480, len(entry)) + entry + struct.pack("<I", 0)
        path = scratch / "home/Library/Application Support/Steam/appcache/appinfo.vdf"
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(cache)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(package) as archive:
        for entry in manifest["files"]:
            payload = archive.read(entry["path"])
            if len(payload) != entry["size"] or hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() != entry["sha256"]:
                raise SystemExit("Downloaded Steam components do not match the pinned manifest")
            target = runtime / entry["path"]
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(payload)
    executable = scratch / "cloud_storage_probe"
    shutil.copy2(binary, executable)
    subprocess.run([
        "/usr/bin/codesign", "--force", "--sign", identity.group(1), "--options", "runtime",
        "--identifier", "com.zagrios.obelisk.cloud-probe", "--entitlements",
        str(project / "packaging/steam-host.entitlements"), str(executable),
    ], check=True, capture_output=True)
    subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/codesign", "--verify", "--strict", str(executable)], check=True)
    # These variables belong only to the disposable child, not the shell/session.
    environment = {"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "HOME": str(scratch / "home"),
                   "CFFIXED_USER_HOME": str(scratch / "home"), "TMPDIR": str(scratch / "tmp"),
                   "OBELISK_CLOUD_PROBE_ROOT": str(scratch)}
    if args.fixture_identity:
        environment["OBELISK_CLOUD_PROBE_IDENTITY"] = "fixture"
    if args.fixture_cache:
        environment["OBELISK_CLOUD_PROBE_CACHE"] = "fixture"
    # Reserve distinct private endpoints while preparing the sandbox. No default
    # Steam endpoint or local discovery is used. Release just before exec.
    reservations = []
    network_rules = []
    if args.mode != "inventory":
        for key in ["Steam3Master", "SteamClientService"]:
            listener = socket.socket()
            listener.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
            reservations.append(listener)
            port = listener.getsockname()[1]
            environment[key] = f"127.0.0.1:{port}"
            network_rules.append(f'(allow network-outbound (remote ip "localhost:{port}"))')
        network_rules.append('(allow network-bind network-inbound (local ip "localhost:*"))')
        environment["SteamAppId"] = "480"
        environment["SteamGameId"] = "480"
    profile = "\n".join([
        "(version 1)", "(allow default)", "(deny network*)", "(deny file-write*)",
        *network_rules,
        f"(allow file-write* (subpath {json.dumps(str(scratch))}) (literal \"/dev/null\"))",
        f"(deny file-read* (subpath {json.dumps(str(Path.home()))}))",
        "(deny mach-lookup (global-name-regex \".*[Ss]team.*\") (global-name \"com.apple.coreservices.launchservicesd\") (global-name \"com.apple.lsd.mapdb\"))",
        "(deny process-exec)", f"(allow process-exec (literal {json.dumps(str(executable))}))",
    ])
    profile_path = scratch / "probe.sb"
    profile_path.write_text(profile)
    started = time.monotonic()
    for listener in reservations:
        listener.close()
    phases = {"local-storage": ["local-write", "local-read"],
              "local-projection": ["project-write", "project-read"],
              "local-live-mutation": ["live-mutate", "live-read"],
              "sync-controls": ["sync-download", "sync-upload", "sync-cancel"],
              "local-cache-refresh": ["project-write", "project-rename", "project-read-renamed"]}.get(args.mode, [args.mode])
    result = {"mode": args.mode, "exit_code": 0, "events": [], "phases": [], "stderr_present": False, "timeout": False}
    for phase in phases:
        try:
            run = subprocess.run([
                "/usr/bin/sandbox-exec", "-f", str(profile_path), str(executable), phase,
                str(runtime / "steamclient.dylib"),
            ], cwd=runtime, env=environment, capture_output=True, timeout=30, text=True)
            # Only typed JSON emitted through the Rust-owned pipe is retained.
            result["events"].extend({**json.loads(line), "phase": phase} for line in run.stdout.splitlines())
            result["phases"].append({"phase": phase, "exit_code": run.returncode})
            if run.returncode != 0:
                result["exit_code"] = run.returncode
            result["stderr_present"] |= bool(run.stderr)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            result["timeout"] = True
            result["exit_code"] = None
            # Preserve completed typed events even if a later native call hangs.
            for line in (error.stdout or b"").splitlines():
                try:
                    result["events"].append({**json.loads(line), "phase": phase})
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    pass
        if result["timeout"] or (result["exit_code"] != 0 and args.mode not in ["local-projection", "local-cache-refresh"]):
            break
    result.update({"elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),
                   "synthetic_appinfo": args.fixture_appinfo,
                   "synthetic_identity_requested": args.fixture_identity,
                   "synthetic_cache": args.fixture_cache,
                   "runtime_version": manifest["version"], "authenticated": False,
                   "external_network": "denied by sandbox", "real_home_reads": "denied by sandbox",
                   "scratch": str(scratch)})
    result["source_sha256"] = {
        path: hashlib.sha256((project / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        for path in ["crates/steam-native/examples/cloud_storage_probe.rs",
                     "crates/steam-native/examples/cloud_storage_probe/live_storage.rs",
                     "crates/steam-native/examples/cloud_storage_probe/sync_controls.rs",
                     "scripts/probe-steam-cloud.py", "crates/game-runtime/runtime-manifest.json"]
    }
    cloud_log = scratch / "home/Library/Application Support/Steam/logs/cloud_log.txt"
    if cloud_log.is_file():
        result["native_cache_observations"] = [
            line for line in cloud_log.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
            if "[AppID 480]" in line and any(message in line for message in [
                "Init cache request complete", "Sync Failed, no user set", "(ValidateCache)",
                "YldWriteCacheDirectoryToFile",
                "Starting sync", "Sync failed", "Sync Failed", "Sync complete", "sync request complete",
                "Failed sync",
            ])
        ]
    account_component = 1 if args.fixture_identity else 0
    name = "obelisk-offline-probe-renamed.dat" if args.mode == "local-cache-refresh" else "obelisk-offline-probe.dat"
    if args.mode == "local-live-mutation":
        name = "obelisk-offline-live.dat"
    fixture = scratch / f"home/Library/Application Support/Steam/userdata/{account_component}/480/remote/{name}"
    if fixture.is_file():
        payload = fixture.read_bytes()
        result["fixture"] = {"bytes": len(payload), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()}
    result["scratch_retained"] = args.keep_scratch
    suffix = "-appinfo" if args.fixture_appinfo else ""
    suffix += "-identity" if args.fixture_identity else ""
    suffix += "-cache" if args.fixture_cache else ""
    output = project / "build/steam-cloud-feasibility" / f"probe-{args.mode}{suffix}.json"
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({**result, "events": [
        {key: value for key, value in event.items() if key != "methods"}
        for event in result["events"]
    ], "report": str(output)}, indent=2))
    if not args.keep_scratch:
        shutil.rmtree(scratch)
    return 0 if result.get("exit_code") == 0 and not result["timeout"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

```sh
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
"$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/build.sh"
APP="$PROJECT_ROOT/build/xcode/Build/Products/${CONFIGURATION:-Debug}/Obelisk.app"
# Quitting Obelisk only hides it, so a running build would stay in place:
# end it, and with it any game it runs, before opening the new one.
if pkill -f "$APP/Contents/MacOS/Obelisk"; then
    while pgrep -f "$APP/Contents/MacOS/Obelisk" >/dev/null; do sleep 0.2; done
fi
open "$APP"

```sh
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
# Sparkle's helpers come ad hoc signed, and Xcode signs only the framework they
# sit in. Notarization wants every one signed with Obelisk's identity and the
# hardened runtime, innermost first, then the framework that seals them.
SPARKLE="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$FRAMEWORKS_FOLDER_PATH/Sparkle.framework"
IDENTITY="${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY:?A stable Apple signing identity is required}"
# Notarization needs a secure timestamp; Debug skips the round trip to Apple.
if [[ "${CONFIGURATION:-Debug}" == Release ]]; then TIMESTAMP=--timestamp; else TIMESTAMP=--timestamp=none; fi
sign() {
    /usr/bin/codesign --force --sign "$IDENTITY" "$TIMESTAMP" --options runtime "$@"
}
sign "$SPARKLE/Versions/B/XPCServices/Installer.xpc"
sign --preserve-metadata=entitlements "$SPARKLE/Versions/B/XPCServices/Downloader.xpc"
sign "$SPARKLE/Versions/B/Autoupdate"
sign "$SPARKLE/Versions/B/Updater.app"
sign "$SPARKLE"
