`scripts/verify-app-signature.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

DISTRIBUTION=false
if [[ "${1:-}" == --distribution ]]; then
    DISTRIBUTION=true
    shift
fi
if [[ $# -ne 1 ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 [--distribution] APP" >&2
    exit 2
fi

# An ad hoc signature can be valid, but its identity changes with the binary.
# Require an Apple-issued certificate as well as a valid bundle signature.
if ! /usr/bin/codesign --verify --deep --strict -R='anchor apple generic' "$1"; then
    echo "Obelisk needs a valid Apple certificate signature to preserve Keychain access across builds." >&2
    echo "Configure apps/macos/Config/Signing.local.xcconfig using the example beside it." >&2
    exit 1
fi

require_architectures() {
    local binary="$1"
    local expected="$2"
    local actual
    actual="$(/usr/bin/lipo -archs "$binary" | tr ' ' '\n' | LC_ALL=C sort | paste -sd ' ' -)"
    if [[ "$actual" != "$expected" ]]; then
        echo "Unexpected architectures for $binary: $actual; expected $expected." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    /usr/bin/codesign --verify --strict -R='anchor apple generic' "$binary"
}

STEAM_HELPERS="$1/Contents/Helpers/SteamNative"
require_architectures "$STEAM_HELPERS/obelisk-steam-host" "arm64"
if [[ -e "$STEAM_HELPERS/obelisk-steam-sdk-arm64" ]]; then
    echo "Obelisk contains the removed ARM64 SDK diagnostic helper." >&2
    exit 1
fi
require_architectures "$STEAM_HELPERS/obelisk-steam-sdk-x86_64" "x86_64"
require_architectures "$STEAM_HELPERS/libobelisk_steam_discovery_adapter.dylib" "arm64 x86_64"
require_architectures "$1/Contents/Helpers/Obelisk Rosetta.app/Contents/MacOS/ObeliskRosetta" "x86_64"
# Valve's Steam components are downloaded with a Steam game, never shipped.
if [[ -e "$1/Contents/Resources/SteamRuntime" ]]; then
    echo "Obelisk contains Valve's Steam components, which it must download instead." >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [[ "$DISTRIBUTION" != true ]]; then
    exit 0
fi

# What Gatekeeper and notarization demand of every binary a stranger downloads:
# a Developer ID of one team, a secure timestamp, no debugger entitlement, and
# the hardened runtime on executables.
TEAM="$(/usr/bin/codesign -dv "$1" 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^TeamIdentifier=//p')"
if [[ -z "$TEAM" || "$TEAM" == "not set" ]]; then
    echo "Obelisk has no signing team." >&2
    exit 1
fi
DEVELOPER_ID="anchor apple generic and certificate 1[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.2.6] exists \
and certificate leaf[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.1.13] exists and certificate leaf[subject.OU] = \"$TEAM\""
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
    kind="$(/usr/bin/file -b "$file")"
    [[ "$kind" == *Mach-O* ]] || continue
    if ! /usr/bin/codesign --verify --strict -R="$DEVELOPER_ID" "$file"; then
        echo "$file is not signed with team $TEAM's Developer ID." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    details="$(/usr/bin/codesign -dvv "$file" 2>&1)"
    if ! grep -q '^Timestamp=' <<<"$details"; then
        echo "$file has no secure timestamp." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    if [[ "$kind" == *executable* ]] && ! grep -q '^CodeDirectory.*flags=.*runtime' <<<"$details"; then
        echo "$file is not signed with the hardened runtime." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    if /usr/bin/codesign -d --entitlements - --xml "$file" 2>/dev/null | grep -q get-task-allow; then
        echo "$file allows debugging (get-task-allow)." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done < <(find "$1" -type f -print0)

```

`scripts/verify-localization.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check that every application translation key has complete en/fr resources."""

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CATALOG = ROOT / "apps/macos/Obelisk/Resources/Localizable.xcstrings"
PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r"%(?:(\d+)\$)?([-+0 #]*\d*(?:\.\d+)?(?:ll|l)?[@diufgs])")
UI_LITERAL = re.compile(
    r'\b(?:Text|Button|Label|Window|Toggle|Picker|TextField|SecureField|ProgressView|'
    r'help|accessibilityLabel|accessibilityHint|navigationTitle|errorAlert)'
    r'\(\s*(?:verbatim:\s*)?"([^"\n]*)"'
)


def formats(localization):
    if "stringUnit" in localization:
        unit = localization["stringUnit"]
        assert unit["state"] == "translated", "Unfinished translation"
        assert unit["value"], "Empty translation"
        return [unit["value"]]
    plurals = localization["variations"]["plural"]
    assert {"one", "other"} <= plurals.keys(), "Missing plural forms"
    return [value for variant in plurals.values() for value in formats(variant)]


def signature(value):
    matches = PLACEHOLDER.findall(value.replace("%%", ""))
    return sorted((int(position or index), kind) for index, (position, kind) in enumerate(matches, 1))


def main():
    catalog = json.loads(CATALOG.read_text())
    assert catalog["sourceLanguage"] == "en", "English must be the source language"
    entries = catalog["strings"]
    for key, entry in entries.items():
        languages = entry["localizations"]
        assert {"en", "fr"} <= languages.keys(), f"Missing language: {key}"
        variants = [value for language in ("en", "fr") for value in formats(languages[language])]
        assert all(signature(value) == signature(variants[0]) for value in variants), f"Placeholder mismatch: {key}"

    referenced = set()
    for path in (ROOT / "apps/macos/Obelisk").rglob("*.swift"):
        if "Generated" in path.parts:
            continue
        source = path.read_text()
        referenced.update(re.findall(r'L10n\.string\("([^"]+)"', source))
        for match in UI_LITERAL.finditer(source):
            assert not any(character.isalpha() for character in match[1]), (
                f"Hardcoded UI text in {path.relative_to(ROOT)}: {match[1]}"
            )
    for path in (ROOT / "crates").rglob("*.rs"):
        referenced.update(re.findall(r'"(backend\.[a-zA-Z0-9_.]+)"', path.read_text()))
    missing = referenced - entries.keys()
    assert not missing, f"Untranslated keys: {sorted(missing)}"
    print(f"Localization verified: {len(entries)} keys, complete English/French text and matching placeholders.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`scripts/write-appcast.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
# Writes the Sparkle feed of one release: its DMG, signed with the EdDSA key
# whose public half is SUPublicEDKey in apps/macos/Config/Info.plist, and its
# notes. The key comes from $SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY, as in CI, or else from
# the login Keychain, where generate_keys --account zagrios keeps it.
if [[ $# -ne 4 ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 DMG DMG_URL NOTES_HTML OUTPUT" >&2
    exit 2
fi
DMG="$1" URL="$2" NOTES="$3" OUTPUT="$4"
PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
# The tools of the Sparkle that apps/macos/project.yml pins.
SPARKLE_VERSION=2.10.0
SPARKLE_SHA256=c2bf58aa8387266ac179357b1415d6f2635f044da8be41042af32425dae6da0c
TOOLS="$PROJECT_ROOT/build/sparkle-$SPARKLE_VERSION"
if [[ ! -x "$TOOLS/bin/sign_update" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$TOOLS"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$TOOLS.tar.xz.partial" \
        "https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle/releases/download/$SPARKLE_VERSION/Sparkle-$SPARKLE_VERSION.tar.xz"
    if [[ "$(shasum -a 256 "$TOOLS.tar.xz.partial" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$SPARKLE_SHA256" ]]; then
        echo "Sparkle $SPARKLE_VERSION checksum mismatch." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    tar -xJf "$TOOLS.tar.xz.partial" -C "$TOOLS" ./bin/sign_update
    rm "$TOOLS.tar.xz.partial"
fi

# The versions the app inside the DMG declares, which Sparkle compares.
MOUNT="$(mktemp -d)"
/usr/bin/hdiutil attach -nobrowse -readonly -noautoopen -mountpoint "$MOUNT" "$DMG" > /dev/null
INFO="$MOUNT/Obelisk.app/Contents/Info.plist"
VERSION="$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :CFBundleVersion' "$INFO")"
SHORT_VERSION="$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :CFBundleShortVersionString' "$INFO")"
MINIMUM_SYSTEM="$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :LSMinimumSystemVersion' "$INFO")"
/usr/bin/hdiutil detach -quiet "$MOUNT"
rmdir "$MOUNT"

if [[ -n "${SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY:-}" ]]; then
    SIGNATURE="$(printf '%s' "$SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY" | "$TOOLS/bin/sign_update" --ed-key-file - -p "$DMG")"
else
    SIGNATURE="$("$TOOLS/bin/sign_update" --account zagrios -p "$DMG")"
fi
LENGTH="$(stat -f %z "$DMG")"

{
    cat <<EOF
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<rss version="2.0" xmlns:sparkle="http://www.andymatuschak.org/xml-namespaces/sparkle">
  <channel>
    <title>Obelisk</title>
    <item>
      <title>Obelisk $SHORT_VERSION</title>
      <pubDate>$(LC_ALL=C date -u '+%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S +0000')</pubDate>
      <sparkle:version>$VERSION</sparkle:version>
      <sparkle:shortVersionString>$SHORT_VERSION</sparkle:shortVersionString>
      <sparkle:minimumSystemVersion>$MINIMUM_SYSTEM</sparkle:minimumSystemVersion>
EOF
    if [[ -s "$NOTES" ]]; then
        # Sparkle shows the notes as HTML; a CDATA section cannot hold its own end.
        printf '      <description><![CDATA[%s]]></description>\n' "$(sed 's/]]>/]]]]><![CDATA[>/g' "$NOTES")"
    fi
    cat <<EOF
      <enclosure url="$URL" length="$LENGTH" type="application/octet-stream" sparkle:edSignature="$SIGNATURE"/>
    </item>
  </channel>
</rss>
EOF
} > "$OUTPUT"

```
